source_text: Italy have defeated Portugal 31-5 in Pool C of the 2007 Rugby World Cup at Parc des Princes, Paris, France.
target_text: 意大利在法国巴黎王子公园体育场举办的2007年橄榄球世界杯C组以31-5击败葡萄牙。

source_text: Andrea Masi opened the scoring in the fourth minute with a try for Italy.
target_text: 安德里亚·马西在第四分钟成功达阵，意大利率先得分。

source_text: Despite controlling the game for much of the first half, Italy could not score any other tries before the interval but David Bortolussi kicked three penalties to extend their lead.
target_text: 尽管上半场大部分时间意大利都控制着比赛，但在中场休息前，意大利未能再次达阵得分，不过大卫·博尔托鲁斯通过三个罚踢进球，扩大了领先优势。

source_text: Portugal never gave up and David Penalva scored a try in the 33rd minute, providing their only points of the match.
target_text: 葡萄牙从未放弃，大卫·佩纳尔瓦在第33分钟成功达阵，这是他们本场比赛唯一的得分。

source_text: Italy led 16-5 at half time but were matched by Portugal for much of the second half.
target_text: 上半场意大利以16-5领先，但下半场大部分时间葡萄牙的表现不相上下。

source_text: However Bortolussi scored his fourth penalty of the match, followed by tries from Mauro Bergamasco and a second from Andrea Masi to wrap up the win for Italy.
target_text: 然而，博尔托鲁斯踢进了他本场比赛的第四个罚球，随后是莫罗·贝加马斯科的数次达阵和安德烈·马西的第二次达阵，为意大利赢得了比赛。

source_text: New Zealand lead the group with ten points, ahead of Scotland on points difference.
target_text: 新西兰以10分位居小组首位，在积分上领先苏格兰。

source_text: Portugal are bottom of the group with no points, behind Romania with one.
target_text: 葡萄牙以零分垫底，落后罗马尼亚一分。

source_text: Some personal details of 3 million British learner drivers who had applied for the 'theory test' component of their Driving licence have been lost in Iowa, in the USA.
target_text: 在美国爱荷华州，300万申请驾照“理论测试”部分的英国驾车者的一些个人信息丢失。

source_text: The data was lost on a hard drive that was owned by Pearson Driving Assessments Ltd, a private contractor to the UK driving standards agency.
target_text: 这些数据是在英国驾驶标准局私人承包商培生驾驶评估有限公司的硬盘上丢失的。

source_text: Details were given by the UK Transport Secretary, Ruth Kelly, in the House of Commons at 1730 UTC yesterday.
target_text: 英国交通大臣露丝·凯利昨天于英国时间17：30分在下议院公布了详细情况。

source_text: It is the first major loss of data in the UK since information on 25 million people was lost by HM Revenue in October.
target_text: 这是自去年10月英国税务机构丢失2500万人信息以来，英国首次出现重大数据丢失。

source_text: In her statement to MPs, Ruth Kelly confirmed that no banking information was contained within the lost data, nor were individuals' dates of birth.
target_text: 在向国会议员发表的声明中，露丝凯利证实，丢失的数据中不包含任何银行信息，也不包括个人的出生日期。

source_text: She highlighted that security measures had been taken, and that the information that had been stored was not in a format "readily usable or accessible" by standard means.
target_text: 她强调已采取安全措施，并且所存储的信息不是采用标准手段“易于使用或可获取”的格式。

source_text: Susan Kramer, representing the Liberal Democrats stated "This constant attempt to gather data, to get more data, to know more about you, to link it more together, all of that it seems to me is what comes into question."
target_text: 代表自由民主党的苏珊克雷默说：“这种不断收集数据、获取更多数据、了解更多关于你的信息、将其联系在一起的尝试，在我看来，所有这些都是问题所在。”

source_text: Criticism was targeted to Government efforts in the affair of the Jian Seng in the Australian Senate March 28 and 29 over the handling of the ghost ship, the tanker Jian Seng, which was found abandoned and unlit in the Gulf of Carpentaria.
target_text: 3月28日和29日，澳大利亚参议院就“建胜”号幽灵船的处理问题对政府在“建胜”号事件中的努力提出了批评，这艘名为“建胜”的油轮，在卡本塔利亚湾被发现时被遗弃且没有亮灯。

source_text: Senator Joe Ludwig (Labor, Queensland) asked of the Minister for Justice and Customs Senator Chris Ellison in Question Time whether he stood by his claim that he made yesterday that the discovery of the Jian Seng demonstrated that the Australian Government had in place "aerial and maritime surveillance to intercept a vessel in these circumstances, and that was done", and asked why it took the Government two weeks to intercept the vessel after it entered Australian waters.
target_text: 参议员乔·路德维希（工党，昆士兰）在接受《时代》周刊采访时，问司法和海关部长克里斯·埃里森，他是否坚持自己昨天的说法，即“建胜号”的发现，表明澳大利亚政府“在这种情况下进行了空中和海上监视，拦截了一艘船只，而且确实做到了”。并询问为什么政府在这艘船进入澳大利亚水域后花了两周时间拦截它。

source_text: Senator Ellison responded that at the vessel's first sighting on March 8 "it was not doing anything illegal", and criticised the Opposition's claim that the ship was drifting for seventeen days, saying that "it was not stated as having drifted for the whole of the 17 days".
target_text: 埃里森参议员回应称，该船于3月8日首次发现“它没有采取任何违法行为”，并批评反对派声称这艘船漂流了17天，并说“没有说明这艘船漂流了整整17天”。

source_text: Ludwig went on to note that it was not Customs that spotted the ship but a "passing Australian barge", but Ellison had defended this, stating that Ludwig "thinks that commercial vessels have absolutely no role in looking out for Australia" and that Ellison will "rely on reports to our hotline and go out and inspect vessels".
target_text: 路德维希接着指出，发现这艘船的不是海关，而是一艘“经过澳大利亚的驳船”，但埃利森对此进行了辩护，他说，路德维希“认为商业船只在为澳大利亚着想方面完全没有什么作用”，埃利森将“依靠向我们的热线报告，出海检查船只”。

source_text: Later, Senator Kerry O'Brien (Labor, Tasmania) criticised the Government's implementation of coastal defense, and highlighted the dangers of ignoring the ship for seventeen days, saying that "it posed and possibly still poses unknown environmental and quarantine risks" and that the Jian Seng "has been refused admission to Weipa harbour...It could have been carrying literally anything."
target_text: 后来，参议员克里·奥布莱恩（工党，塔斯马尼亚州）批评政府实施沿海防御的做法，并强调忽视这艘船17天的危险，说“它构成了而且可能仍然构成未知的环境和检疫风险”，并说建胜号“已被拒绝进入威帕港……它可能携带了任何东西。”

source_text: Senator David Johnston (Liberal, Western Australia) went on to debate that there are no shipping lanes in the area where the Jian Seng was found, and that devoting resources to a harmless ship would leave gaps in the coastal defenses elsewhere.
target_text: 参议员约翰斯顿（自由党，西澳大利亚）继续辩论说，在“建胜”号被发现的海域没有航道，把资源投入一艘无害的船只，会给其他地方的海防留下缺口。

source_text: NASCAR Sprint Cup Series driver Jimmie Johnson won his second consecutive race of the season on Sunday during the 2010 Lenox Industrial Tools 301 at New Hampshire Motor Speedway.
target_text: NASCAR Sprint Cup系列赛车手吉米·约翰逊周日在新罕布什尔赛道举办的2010年Lenox工具301赛事中连续第二场比赛获胜。

source_text: It was his fifth victory in the 2010 season of the US's leading professional stock car series, drawing him level with Denny Hamlin for the most wins.
target_text: 这是他在2010年赛季美国重要职业赛车系列赛中的第五场胜利，使他追上丹尼·哈姆林已取得的最多场胜利。

source_text: The victory earned Johnson 190 points (including a 5 point bonus), moving him closer to point leader Kevin Harvick, but he is still 105 points behind in second position.
target_text: 此次胜利让约翰逊获得了190分（包括5分的额外加分），让他更接近积分榜首位的凯文·哈维克，但他仍然落后105分，位居第二位。

source_text: In the point standings, Harvick and Johnson remained in the first and second position.
target_text: 在积分榜上，哈维克和约翰逊分列第一和第二。

source_text: Kyle Busch, because of his accident with Jeff Burton maintained the third position while his team mate Hamlin is fourth.
target_text: 凯尔·布斯克因为与杰夫·布顿的意外而停留在第三的位置，而他的队友哈姆林则排名第四。

source_text: Gordon, Kurt Busch, Matt Kenseth, and Burton followed in the top-eight points positions.
target_text: 戈登，科特·布斯克，马特·肯瑟斯和布顿紧随其后，分列前八名。

source_text: Stewart move up one position after finishing second and is in the ninth position, as Greg Biffle fell to tenth.
target_text: 斯图尔特在获得第二名后上升了一个位置，目前排名第九，而格雷格·比弗尔跌至第十。

source_text: Mark Martin and Carl Edwards rounded out the top-twelve, and is currently in the Chase.
target_text: 马克·马丁和卡尔·爱德华兹也进入了前12名，目前正处于追赶之中。

source_text: Palestinian militants denied claims by an Israeli minister that they had agreed a ceasefire.
target_text: 巴勒斯坦武装分子否认了以色列部长关于他们已经同意停火的说法。

source_text: Just a short while after a ceasefire was apparently agreed between Israel and the new Palestinian leader Mahmoud Abbas, a spokesman for Palestinian militant group Hamas denied the claim.
target_text: 就在以色列和巴勒斯坦新领导人马哈茂德·阿巴斯看来似乎达成停火协议后不久，巴勒斯坦激进组织哈马斯的发言人否认了这一说法。

source_text: City officials in seven United States cities were warned today about a possible attack on NFL stadiums using "dirty bombs."
target_text: 美国7个城市的官员在今天接到警告，称美国职业橄榄球大联盟的体育场可能遭到“脏弹”袭击。

source_text: The Department of Homeland Security, which issued the warnings, has also added that the threat is "not credible."
target_text: 发布警告的国土安全部也补充说，威胁“不可信”。

source_text: The bomb threat, originally discovered on 4chan, stated that truck bombs containing radiological materials would be detonated during the football games this Sunday.
target_text: 最初在4chan上发现的炸弹威胁声称，载有放射性物质的卡车炸弹将在周日的足球比赛期间引爆。

source_text: While the Department of Homeland Security did not disclose which cities were mentioned, an unnamed department official has said the cities named were Atlanta, Miami, New York, Seattle, Houston, Oakland, California, and Cleveland, Ohio.
target_text: 虽然美国国土安全部没有透露哪些城市被提及，但一位不愿透露姓名的部门官员表示，这些城市的名字分别是亚特兰大，迈阿密，纽约，西雅图，休斯敦，奥克兰，加利福尼亚和俄亥俄州克利夫兰。

source_text: In response to the threat, several teams are scheduled to sweep some stadiums with radiation detection devices on Sunday for the presence of radioactive materials.
target_text: 为了应对这一威胁，几个小组计划在周日用辐射检测设备清扫一些体育场，检查是否存在放射性物质。

source_text: In addition, the parking areas and entrances will be monitored closely for suspicious activity.
target_text: 此外，将严密监控停车区和入口是否有可疑活动。

source_text: The NFL has released a statement saying that the stadiums are well protected through security measures already in place.
target_text: 美国职业橄榄球大联盟发布声明说，体育场已经通过现有的安全措施得到很好的保护。

source_text: The FBI has declined to release the details of the investigation.
target_text: 联邦调查局拒绝透露调查细节。

source_text: South-east China has been flooded by torrential rainstorms as the Severe Tropical Storm Bilis came ashore on Friday, July 14.
target_text: 7月14日星期五，中国东南部遭遇强热带风暴“毕利斯”登陆，并遭遇暴雨袭击。

source_text: Floods, 10 meters high in some areas washed away 19,100 houses, damaged roads, power lines, and devastated villages and agriculture.
target_text: 一些地区10米高的洪水冲走了19,100所房屋，破坏了道路，电力线路，毁坏了村庄和农业。

source_text: Three million people were affected by the tropical storm which Xinhua, the state news agency, estimated would cost three billion yuan ($375 million) damage.
target_text: 300万人受到这场热带风暴的影响。据官方媒体新华社估计，这场风暴将造成30亿元人民币（合3.75亿美元）的损失。

source_text: The worse-hit provinces were Fujian, Hunan and Guangdong while there were deaths and an economic impact in Zhejian, Jiangxi and Guangxi provinces.
target_text: 受灾最严重的省份是福建，湖南和广东，而浙江，江西和广西省则有人员伤亡和经济损失。

source_text: At least 92 died in Hunan where dam reservoirs rose to their limits.
target_text: 湖南至少有92人死于大坝水库突破水位警戒线。

source_text: The water swell in Leiyang rose 10 metres above the levels from Friday.
target_text: 从上周五开始，耒阳的水位上涨了10米。

source_text: 40,000 people in the cities of Hengyang and Chenzhou were reported stranded.
target_text: 据报道，衡阳和郴州有4万人被困。

source_text: 14 coal miners died when a dam burst, ravaging the land and flooding their pit at Shenjiawan Colliery.
target_text: 在沈家湾煤矿，14名矿工死于大坝决口，毁坏了土地，淹没了矿井。

source_text: The floods in Hunan also took out the Beijing-Guangzhou railway leaving 5,000 stranded in the capital, Changsha.
target_text: 湖南的洪水还冲毁了京广线，致使5000人滞留在省会长沙。

source_text: 10,000 workers were sent to repair the damaged sections of line.
target_text: 10,000名工人被派去修理损坏的路段。

source_text: An estimated 33 people died in Guangdong, an important economic area near Hong Kong.
target_text: 估计有33人在香港附近的重要经济区广东省死亡。

source_text: Lechang was submerged under three metres of water and 1663 prisoners had to be moved from the city.
target_text: 乐昌被淹没在三米深的水下，1663名囚犯不得不离开这座城市。

source_text: Deadly mudslides killed 10 in the city of Zhangzhou and another 10 are missing from a second mudslide.
target_text: 漳州市发生10起致命泥石流事故，另有10人因第二次泥石流而失踪。

source_text: At least two people were wounded after two freight trains collided with each other near Kotri in southern Pakistan today.
target_text: 今天巴基斯坦南部戈德里附近有两列货运列车相撞，造成至少两人受伤。

source_text: A freight train was on the track near the Kotri railway station when a Hyderabad-bound freight train coming from Karachi, loaded with oil drums, hit it and a fire broke out.
target_text: 一列货运列车在戈德里火车站附近的轨道上行驶时，一辆满载油桶、从卡拉奇开往海德拉巴的货运列车撞上了它，并起火。

source_text: Twenty eight goods wagons of the freight train carrying 1,372,000 litres of oil were derailed, and oil was spilled.
target_text: 载有137.2万升石油的货运列车的28节货车脱轨，石油泄漏。

source_text: Firebrigade and ambulance immediately reached the spot while Pakistan Railway's emergency relief train has left Karachi towards the spot.
target_text: 消防队和救护车立即赶到现场，巴基斯坦铁路紧急救援列车已驶离卡拉奇前往现场。

source_text: Pakistani officials have said that a suspected suicide bomber exploded a car near the provincial legislative assembly that was in session in Peshawar, killing at least 49 people and wounding more than 100 others.
target_text: 巴基斯坦官员表示，一名疑似自杀式炸弹袭击者在白沙瓦会议期间在省立法议会附近引爆了一辆汽车，造成至少49人死亡，100多人受伤。

source_text: The blast scattered debris and destroyed vehicles in Peshawar's crowded Khyber Bazaar area, located in the center of the city.
target_text: 爆炸发生在白沙瓦市中心熙熙攘攘的开伯尔巴扎地区，造成碎片散落，车辆被毁。

source_text: "A suicide bomber blew himself up as the car was next to a passenger bus passing through the market," said senior police officer Shafqat Malik.
target_text: 高级警官沙夫卡特马利克说：“一名自杀式炸弹袭击者在一辆经过市场的客车旁引爆了自己。”

source_text: He said that the bomb consisted of fifty kilograms of explosives, and contained shells and bearings to maximise damage.
target_text: 他说，为了达到最大杀伤力，这枚炸弹由50公斤炸药组成，装有炮弹和轴承。

source_text: One eyewitness told the Voice of America news agency he was sitting in his shop when a big explosion shook the area Friday morning, sending dust in the air and causing objects to fall from the walls.
target_text: 一名目击者对美国之音说，星期五早上，他坐在自己的店里，突然发生了一起大爆炸，震动了这个地区，空气中充满了灰尘，一些东西从墙上掉了下来。

source_text: A teacher working in a nearby school also said that when he went outside after the blast, he saw bodies lying all around the area.
target_text: 附近一所学校的一名教师也说，爆炸发生后他走到外面，看到到处都是尸体。

source_text: Pakistani Interior Minister Rehman Malik indicated that such acts of terrorism might force the government to launch a much anticipated anti-Taliban operation in South Waziristan.
target_text: 巴基斯坦内政部长雷曼马利克表示，这种恐怖主义行为可能会迫使政府在南瓦济里斯坦发起备受期待的反塔利班行动。

source_text: He said that Friday's blast, along with a number of other deadly attacks in Peshawar, shows the government has in his words "no option" but to go on the offensive.
target_text: 他说星期五的爆炸以及白沙瓦发生的其他一些致命袭击事件表明，政府在他的言论中“没有选择”，只能继续进攻。

source_text: While the military has not publicly set a date for any major operation in the area, UN officials say some 80,000 civilians have fled the region in anticipation of a new offensive.
target_text: 尽管军方尚未公开确定在该地区采取任何重大行动的日期，但联合国官员表示，约8万名平民已逃离该地区，因为他们预计将发动新一轮进攻。

source_text: After three days of talks, parties in Northern Ireland have come to a stalemate over the election of a chairperson for a committee to help setup a devolved government in Northern Ireland.
target_text: 经过三天的会谈，北爱尔兰政党在选举一个委员会主席以帮助在北爱尔兰建立一个权力下放的政府时陷入了僵局。

source_text: It is now up to Northern Ireland Secretary of State Peter Hain to choose the next course of action.
target_text: 现在由北爱尔兰国务卿彼得·海恩选择下一步行动。

source_text: The committee, known as the Preparation for Government Committee, convened Monday to begin its first task: the election of a chairperson for the committee.
target_text: 该委员会称为政府委员会筹备委员会，于周一召开会议，开始其首要任务：选举委员会主席。

source_text: Its main task however is to help set a roadmap for devolved government in Northern Ireland.
target_text: 然而，它的主要任务是帮助制定北爱尔兰下放政府的路线图。

source_text: The committee is made up of the two republican parties (Sinn Féin and SDLP), the two unionist parties (DUP and UUP) and the non-sectarianist Alliance Party.
target_text: 该委员会由两个共和党派（新芬党和社会民主党）、两个统一主义政党（DUP和UUP）以及非宗派主义联盟党组成。

source_text: Sinn Féin's proposal is for the chairpersonship to revolve between them and the Democratic Unionist Party.
target_text: 新芬党的提议是让主席一职在他们和民主统一党之间产生。

source_text: The DUP proposed that Speaker of the Assembly Eileen Bell should be the chairperson.
target_text: DUP提议大会议长艾琳贝尔应担任主席。

source_text: However, Bell stated that it would inappropriate for her to take the post and refused.
target_text: 然而，贝尔表示，她不适合担任该职位并拒绝。

source_text: They also suggested the DUP MP for South Antrim William McCrea and Alliance Party leader David Ford as possible candidates.
target_text: 他们还建议南安特里姆的民主统一党议员威廉·麦克里亚和联盟党领袖大卫·福特作为可能的候选人。

source_text: Peter Hain called the refusal of parties to cooperate "frustrating."
target_text: 彼得海恩称各方拒绝合作“令人沮丧”。

source_text: Sinn Féin, SDLP and the Alliance Party have all blamed the DUP for the failure.
target_text: SinnFéin，SDLP和联盟党都将失败归咎于DUP。

source_text: "Yet again the DUP, instead of helping to remove obstacles to devolution, have shown themselves to be nothing but obstructive and lacking in any spirit of co-operation," said Sean Farren of the SDLP.
target_text: 社民党的肖恩·法伦表示：“民主统一党非但没有帮助消除权力下放的障碍，反而表现出了自己的阻碍和缺乏合作精神。”

source_text: "If the DUP is not prepared to do the business or give any substantive indication in the course of June, then the British government would be as well stopping the salaries at the end of June," said Sinn Fein's Martin McGuinness.
target_text: 新芬党的马丁·麦吉尼斯表示：“如果民主统一党不准备在6月份开展工作或给出任何实质性的指示，那么英国政府也会在6月底停止发放工资。”

source_text: "The practical reality is that the two biggest parties have not shown they are prepared to move forward at all."
target_text: “现实情况是，这两个最大的政党根本没有表现出他们准备向前迈进的意愿。”

source_text: "The prevarication and petty wriggling by the DUP is preventing the potential for progress and holding us all up to public ridicule."
target_text: “民主统一党的推诿和小动作阻碍了进步的可能，让我们所有人都受到公众的嘲笑。”

source_text: This is part of plan by British Prime Minister Tony Blair and Irish Toaiseach Bertie Ahern to set up a devolved government in Northern Ireland after its assembly was suspended in October 2002 over allegations of a IRA spy ring.
target_text: 这是英国首相托尼·布莱尔和爱尔兰总理伯蒂·埃亨计划的一部分，他们计划在2002年10月议会因爱尔兰共和军间谍组织的指控被暂停后，在北爱尔兰建立一个权力下放的政府。

source_text: If a plan for devolved government is not setup by November 24, direct rule from London will continue with greater input from the Republic of Ireland.
target_text: 如果在11月24日之前不能制定移交政府的计划，伦敦将继续实行直接统治，爱尔兰共和国将加大投入。

source_text: PC manufacturer and Apple Computer competitor Dell, Inc. has stated that it is interested in shipping computers running Apple's Mac OS X. Michael Dell, founder and chairman of Dell Computers, made the comments while talking to David Kirkpatrick of Fortune magazine.
target_text: 个人电脑制造商且为苹果电脑竞争对手的戴尔公司表示，有意销售运行苹果Mac OS x操作系统的电脑。戴尔电脑公司创始人兼董事长迈克尔·戴尔在接受《财富》杂志记者戴维·柯克帕特里克采访时发表了上述言论。

source_text: "If Apple decides to open the Mac OS to others, we would be happy to offer it to our customers," Dell wrote in an email to Kirkpatrick.
target_text: “如果苹果公司决定向其他人开放Mac OS，我们很乐意将其提供给我们的客户，”戴尔在给柯克帕特里克的电子邮件中写道。

source_text: Apple recently announced that it would begin using Intel x86 microprocessors in its computers next year, but has continued to deny reports that they will allow their OS to be run on non-Apple hardware.
target_text: 苹果公司最近宣布，明年将开始在其电脑中使用英特尔x86微处理器，但该公司继续否认有关该公司将允许其操作系统在非苹果硬件上运行的报导。

source_text: Seismologists at USGS have indicated that this earthquake is an aftershock of the 9.0 earthquake which had occurred just a few hours earlier, 305 km (190 miles) distant, in the Indian Ocean near Sumatra, Indonesia.
target_text: 美国地质勘探局的地震学家指出，这次地震是几小时前发生在305公里（190英里）远的印尼苏门答腊岛附近的印度洋上的9.0级地震的余震。

source_text: Researchers say that two men claiming to be 'Bigfoot' hunters in Georgia in the United States and who claimed to have found the remains of the mythical creature earlier this month, are part of an elaborate hoax.
target_text: 研究人员称，本月早些时候在美国乔治亚州发现大脚怪遗骸的两名自称是大脚怪猎人的男子，是一场精心策划的骗局的一部分。

source_text: Bigfoot hunters Matt Whitton and Rick Dyer stated on August 15, 2008 that they were hunting for the creature in the forests of northeastern Georgia when they came across the supposed corpse of one of the legendary cryptids.
target_text: 大脚猎人马特・惠顿和里克・代尔在2008年8月15日表示他们在乔治亚州东北部的森林中搜寻这种生物时，发现了传说中神秘生物之一的尸体。

source_text: After finding the body, they claimed to have taken it home where they stored it in a freezer.
target_text: 在找到尸体后，他们声称已经把尸体带回家，并把它存放在冰箱里。

source_text: The researchers then attempted to reclaim their money and went to the hotel Whitton and Dyer were staying in, only to find the rooms empty, and the two men nowhere to be found.
target_text: 然后，研究人员试图收回他们的钱，并前往惠顿和代尔下榻的酒店，却发现房间空无一人，两人也无处可寻。

source_text: Whitton and Dyer claimed they had photos, video and DNA evidence to support their claim, but only one photo portraying a blurred black figure in the distance in the forest was provided.
target_text: 惠顿和代尔声称他们有照片，视频和DNA证据支持他们的说法，但只提供了一张照片，只能看出森林中远处模糊的黑色人影。

source_text: The TimesOnline reports that the joke fell flat with Jeffrey Turner, who as Chief of Police in Clayton County, Georgia, put Mr Whitton on medical leave when he was shot in the wrist as he tried to foil a robbery earlier this summer.
target_text: 泰晤士报网站报道说，这个玩笑把乔治亚州克莱顿县警察局长杰弗里·特纳给笑倒了。今年夏天早些时候，惠顿在试图挫败一起抢劫案时手腕中枪，特纳因此请了病假。

source_text: "As soon as we saw it was a hoax, I filed the paperwork to terminate his employment," said Chief Turner.
target_text: 特纳警长说：“我们一看到这是一个骗局，我就提交了文件，要求终止他的工作。”

source_text: "He's disgraced himself, he's an embarrassment to the Clayton County Police Department, his credibility and integrity as an officer is gone, and I have no use for him," he declared.
target_text: “他让自己蒙羞了，他让克莱顿县警察局感到难堪，他作为一名警官的信誉和正直已经荡然无存，我对他毫无用处，”他宣称。

source_text: London, England — With the 2012 Summer Paralympics starting in less than a week, parts of Papua New Guinea's Paralympic delegation arrived in London earlier today in order to support the pair of athletes the country qualified for the Games, athletics competitor Francis Kompaon and powerlifter Timothy Harabe.
target_text: 英国伦敦-随着2012年夏季残奥会在不到一周的时间内开幕，巴布亚新几内亚残奥代表团的部分成员今天早些时候抵达伦敦，以支持该国有资格参加奥运会的两名运动员——田径运动员弗朗西斯·孔帕恩和举重运动员蒂莫西·哈拉比。

source_text: The Games are Kompaon's second, having competed at the 2008 Summer Paralympics where he earned his country's first Paralympic medal when he finished second in the 100 metre event.
target_text: 这是孔帕翁的第二届奥运会，他参加了2008年夏季残奥会，并在100米比赛中获得第二名，为该国赢得了第一枚残奥会奖牌。

source_text: The British High Commissioner to Papua New Guinea, Jackie Barson, MBE, wished both athletes well, saying in a written statement, "It is a fantastic achievement for the PNG to be represented by two world class Paralympic athletes".
target_text: 英国驻巴布亚新几内亚高级专员杰姬·巴森在一份书面声明中祝愿这两名运动员身体健康，他说：“巴布亚新几内亚能有两名世界级残疾人运动员代表，这是一项了不起的成就。”

source_text: PNG Paralympic Committee President Bernard Chan also congratulated his country's athletes, saying, "They will be great ambassadors for PNG and I hope both Francis and Timothy will inspire other athletes to train hard and hope to represent PNG at this Paralympic level during their participation."
target_text: 巴布亚新几内亚残奥委员会主席伯纳德陈也祝贺该国运动员，他说：“他们将是巴布亚新几内亚伟大的大使，我希望弗朗西斯和蒂莫西都能激励其他运动员努力训练，并希望在参加残奥期间代表巴布亚新几内亚参加残奥会。”

source_text: The 2012 Games will be the fourth time the country has participated, with the three other appearances happening at the 1984 Summer Paralympics, 2000 Summer Paralympics and 2008 Summer Paralympics.
target_text: 2012年奥运会将是该国第四次参加，另外三次分别是1984年夏季残奥会、2000年夏季残奥会和2008年夏季残奥会。

source_text: Other members of the Papua New Guinea 2012 Paralympic delegation include PNG Paralympic Committee President Bernard Chan; Chef de Mission Dr. Kefu Ma; team manager Rosemary Mawe; Davina Chan, the president's wife; coach William McKenny; and official Jeffrey Robby.
target_text: 巴布亚新几内亚2012年残奥会代表团的其他成员包括巴布亚新几内亚残奥委员会主席伯纳德・陈、主教练马克福博士、团队经理罗斯玛丽・莫、总统夫人戴维娜・陈、教练威廉・麦肯尼和官方杰弗里・罗比。

source_text: India's economy has grown by 9.2 percent in Q2 (July-September) of the fiscal year 2006-07, which was 8.4 percent last year for the same quarter.
target_text: 印度经济在2006-07财年第二季度（7月至9月）增长了9.2％，去年同期为8.4％。

source_text: The annual growth rate, of Asia's fourth-largest economy, for the quarter is also higher than that of the last quarter's (April-June), which was 8.9 percent.
target_text: 亚洲第四大经济体本季度的年增长率也高于上一季度（4月至6月），即8.9％。

source_text: India's annual economic growth has been an average of 8 percent since past three fiscal years.
target_text: 自过去三个财政年度以来，印度的年经济增长率平均为8％。

source_text: Reserve Bank of India hiked repo rate by 0.25 percent to 7.25 percent, keeping the reverse repo rate unchanged at 6% on October 31.
target_text: 印度储备银行将回购利率上调0.25％至7.25％，并将反向回购利率维持在10月31日的6％不变。

source_text: Finance minister P. Chidambaram said that he was very worried about the higher inflation rate due to supply side constraints.
target_text: 财政部长P.奇丹巴拉姆表示，他非常担心由于供应方面的限制导致通胀率上升。

source_text: At least seven bomb blasts occurred early on New Year's Eve in Bangkok.
target_text: 曼谷新年前夜至少发生七起炸弹爆炸事件。

source_text: The first blast was in a bus-stop shelter at Victory Monument, which is a busy hub for public transportation.
target_text: 第一次爆炸发生在胜利纪念碑的一个公共汽车站，这是一个繁忙的公共交通枢纽。

source_text: Five people were injured, and one of them died later at a hospital.
target_text: 五人受伤，其中一人后来在医院死亡。

source_text: Another fatal attack was in the Khlong Toei port district near the Na Ranong intersection, where a bomb hidden in a trash can near a Chinese spirit shrine exploded and injured seven people, one of them a 10-year-old girl.
target_text: 另一起致命袭击发生在南朗路口附近的空堤县港口区，一枚藏在中国灵祠附近垃圾桶里的炸弹爆炸，造成7人受伤，其中一人是一名10岁的女孩。

source_text: Another was a 61-year-old man who later died at a hospital.
target_text: 另一名是一名61岁的男子，后来在医院死亡。

source_text: Seventeen people were wounded in a blast at a police box near a Big C supermarket at the Saphan Kwai intersection.
target_text: 在洒番快路口的Big C超市附近的一个警察岗亭发生爆炸，造成17人受伤。

source_text: A witness there said a man dropped a grenade from a pedestrian bridge.
target_text: 一名目击者说，一名男子从一座人行天桥上投下一枚手榴弹。

source_text: Another blast was at a police box on Sukhumvit Soi 62.
target_text: 另一场爆炸发生在素坤逸路62巷的警察局。

source_text: A blast was reported at a police box in Nonthaburi Province on the northern outskirts of Bangkok.
target_text: 据报道，曼谷北郊农塔武里省的一个警察岗亭发生爆炸。

source_text: There was another explosion at a Tesco Lotus store in Prachachuen, while another was planted in a trash bin at Seacon Square, a shopping mall in suburban Bangkok's Prawet district.
target_text: 在帕查楚恩的乐购莲花商店发生了另一次爆炸，另一起爆炸发生在曼谷郊区巴威区的购物中心Seacon广场的垃圾箱里。

source_text: A bomb squad was able to defuse the device without mishap.
target_text: 拆弹小组成功地拆除了装置的引信，没有发生事故。

source_text: Other suspicious packages are being investigated by police at locations throughout the capital, the iTV network in Thailand has reported.
target_text: 据泰国独立电视台报道，泰国警方正在首都各地调查其他可疑包裹。

source_text: The New Year's countdown at CentralWorld was held at around 9:00 p.m. with police and Bangkok Governor Apirak Kosayothin then urging the thousands of gathered revelers to "go home and stay in peace."
target_text: 尚泰世界商业中心的新年倒计时大约在晚上9点举行。警察和曼谷总督Apirak Kosayothin随后敦促成千上万的狂欢者“回家并保持和平”。

source_text: Since then, there have been a number of schools burnt by suspected Thaksin sympathizers in various parts of the country.
target_text: 从那时起，在全国各地有许多学校被疑似他信支持者烧毁。

source_text: There is also the ongoing violence by Muslim separatists in the South Thailand insurgency, which has left 1,900 people dead since 2004.
target_text: 泰国南部的穆斯林分裂分子还在继续制造暴力活动。自2004年以来，暴力活动已经造成1900人死亡。

source_text: It was not immediately clear if the bombings had anything to do with the coup or the southern insurgency.
target_text: 目前还不清楚爆炸事件是否与政变或南部叛乱有关。

source_text: In southern Afghanistan in the province of Ghazni, the 29-year old Dutch pilot Michael Donkervoort died when his F-16 fighter jet crashed.
target_text: 在加兹尼省的阿富汗南部，29岁的荷兰飞行员迈克尔·唐克沃特在他的F-16战斗机坠毁时死亡。

source_text: "The plane was flying at a great height when the accident occurred, which means it can be ruled out that the craft was shot down. "
target_text: “事故发生时，飞机正在高空飞行，这意味着可以排除飞机被击落的可能性。”

source_text: "We therefore assume it was an accident," said the Dutch Defense Ministry.
target_text: “我们因此认为这是一次意外，”荷兰国防部说。

source_text: The history of the riding can, in some measure, be read in the parties fielding candidates; in addition to the four national parties there are contestants from Libertarian, Communist, and Marxist-Leninist parties.
target_text: 在某种程度上，英格兰约克郡行政区的历史可以在派出候选人的政党中看得出来，除了四个全国性政党之外，还有来自自由主义、共产主义和马克思列宁主义政党的竞争者。

source_text: The rich diversity of the riding has less than half of all households reporting English as the first language at home.
target_text: 英格兰约克郡行政区的丰富多样性使不到一半的家庭将英语作为家庭的第一语言。

source_text: Emerson cited this diversity after announcing he would not be running for a third term.
target_text: 艾默生在宣布他不会参加第三届任期后引用了这种多样性。

source_text: "The reality is, Kingsway was an eminently winnable seat," said the Conservative Minister.
target_text: “事实是，京士威是一个非常容易赢得的席位，”保守党大臣说。

source_text: "Not because I'm a hugely popular fellow in Kingsway, but because of vote splits and the way the first-past-the-post system works."
target_text: “这并不是因为我在京士威是一个非常受欢迎的人，而是因为选票的分歧和得票多者当选的制度。”

source_text: Key in those vote splits are issues dividing the Liberal and NDP candidates.
target_text: 这些选票分歧的关键是自由党和新民主党候选人之间的分歧。

source_text: Naturalized Canadian Yuan points to her immigrant history, giving her an empathy with the immigrant and ethnic neighborhoods of the riding.
target_text: 入籍加拿大的袁女士提到了她的移民历史，让她对英格兰约克郡行政区的移民和民族社区产生了共鸣。

source_text: "I came with limited means but through hard work, I got recognized and became a successful businesswoman."
target_text: “我出身贫寒，但通过努力工作，我得到了认可，成为了一名成功的女商人。”

source_text: "I understand what immigrants have to go through to reach what they want."
target_text: “我理解移民必须经历什么才能达到他们想要的目标。”

source_text: "I really respect and appreciate and like the multicultural fabric of our riding," says her NDP opponent Davies.
target_text: “我非常尊重和欣赏，喜欢我们英格兰约克郡行政区的多元文化结构，”她的NDP对手戴维斯说。

source_text: "I'm the only candidate who lives here with roots here." The Teamster's lawyer is originally from Edmonton, but has been living in Vancouver environs since 1991.
target_text: “我是唯一一个在这里有根的候选人。”Teamster的律师最初来自埃德蒙顿，但自1991年以来一直住在温哥华郊区。

source_text: The Teamster's lawyer is originally from Edmonton, but has been living in Vancouver environs since 1991.
target_text: Teamster的律师最初来自埃德蒙顿，但自1991年以来一直住在温哥华郊区。

source_text: The Conservative party candidate Salomon Rayek is not responding to press inquiries from several sources, and is cited as an example of a long-shot candidate - a candidate with little likelihood of being elected yet represents the party anyway.
target_text: 保守党候选人所罗门·罗耶克没有回应来自多个来源的媒体询问，他被引用为一个不太可能当选的候选人的例子-一个无论如何都代表保守党的候选人。

source_text: He's lived for the past three years in the riding, an engineer and small business owner who has a history of community involvement across south Vancouver.
target_text: 在过去的三年里，他一直住在英格兰约克郡行政区，曾经是一个工程师和小企业主，与南温哥华有社区有密切联系。

source_text: "I see the neighbourhoods in and around Kingsway as a great place to build on the natural vibrancy of the small business sector as a backbone for ethnically and economically diverse communities."
target_text: “我认为京士威内外的社区是一个很好的地方，可以将小型企业的自然活力作为族裔和经济多样性社区的支柱。”

source_text: The stage for this fight was set in 2006, when newly-elected Liberal Dave Emerson crossed the floor and directly into the Conservative Cabinet, first as Minister of International Trade then as Minister of Foreign Affairs following the resignation of Maxime Bernier.
target_text: 这场斗争的舞台是在2006年，当时新当选的自由派人士戴维·爱默生跨过议会，直接进入保守党内阁，先是担任国际贸易部长，后来在马克西姆·贝尔尼埃辞职后，又担任外交部长。

source_text: His defection stirred a firestorm of controversy locally in the staunchly left-leaning riding, which had elected a Progressive Conservative candidate exactly once since it's creation in 1953 - during the 1958 Diefenbaker landslide.
target_text: 他的倒戈在当地坚定的左倾英格兰约克郡行政区中引发了激烈的争议。自1953年该党成立以来，在1958年迪芬贝克的压倒性胜利中，该党只选出过一位进步保守党候选人。

source_text: The resolution, was submitted in the House of Representatives and referred to the U.S. House Committee on International Relations.
target_text: 该决议在众议院提交，并提交给美国众议院国际关系委员会。

source_text: The resolution comes in response to questions that have been raised about the handling of pre-war intelligence by the Bush administration, and the planning and execution of the Iraq war.
target_text: 这项决议是对布什政府在处理战前情报以及伊拉克战争的计划和执行方面提出的问题作出的回应。

source_text: "We would like to see a member of Congress look into whether or not the president committed impeachable offenses," said John Bonifaz, a constitutional lawyer.
target_text: “我们希望看到国会议员调查总统是否犯下了可弹劾的罪行，”宪法律师约翰·博尼法兹说。

source_text: "We've been having that discussion with a number of offices."
target_text: “我们一直在和一些办公室进行讨论。”

source_text: But Conyers is reluctant to take such a bold step just yet.
target_text: 但科尼尔斯不愿意采取如此大胆的举措。

source_text: Earlier this month, Rep. Zoe Lofgren (D-Calif.) said at a forum held by Conyers "If you read the record of the writing of the Constitution, 'high crimes and misdemeanors' had a very particular meaning at the time of the drafting of the Constitution."
target_text: 本月早些时候，加州民主党众议员洛夫・格伦在科尼尔斯举办的一个论坛上说，“如果你读过宪法的撰写记录，‘重罪和轻罪’在宪法起草时有着非常特殊的意义。”

source_text: Rep. Barbara Lee's resolution of inquiry is a less-drastic parliamentary maneuver that would ask the administration to provide more information related to the claims in classified British memos that suggest that pre-war intelligence in Iraq was "fixed" in order to justify the invasion.
target_text: 众议员芭芭拉·李的调查决议案是一项不那么激烈的议会策略，要求政府提供更多与英国机密备忘录中的说法相关的信息。这些备忘录显示，战前在伊拉克的情报是“固定的”，目的是证明入侵伊拉克是正当的。

source_text: The Resolution of Inquiry is a privileged resolution, which means that if it is not acted on in 14 legislative days after it is introduced, the member of Congress who introduced it is entitled to request that it be brought to the House floor for a vote.
target_text: 质询决议案是一项特权决议案，也就是说，如果质询决议案在提交14个立法日后没有得到实施，提交质询决议案的国会议员有权要求将质询决议案提交众议院表决。

source_text: The committee may take the matter up right away, and could vote it down before the August recess.
target_text: 委员会可能会立即着手处理此事，并在8月休会前投票否决。

source_text: If they do not, they will be required to take it up by September 16th.
target_text: 如果他们不这样做，他们将被要求在9月16日之前接受它。

source_text: The United States has said that "regional extremists" may be targeting Air Uganda airplane flights between Southern Sudan and Uganda.
target_text: 美国表示，“地区极端分子”可能把乌干达航空公司在南苏丹和乌干达之间的航班作为袭击目标。

source_text: A warning posted yesterday on the Web site of the US Embassy in Khartoum says there is a "potential threat" on the flights between Juba, Sudan and Kampala, Uganda.
target_text: 美国驻喀土穆大使馆网站昨日发布警告称，苏丹朱巴与乌干达坎帕拉之间的航班存在“潜在威胁”。

source_text: The embassy did not name the potential attackers but said the threat is of "sufficient seriousness," and that air travelers should "maintain vigilance at all times."
target_text: 大使馆没有透露潜在袭击者的名字，但表示威胁“足够严重”，航空旅行者应该“始终保持警惕”。

source_text: Two scientists working at McGill University in Canada, reporting on their research and the research of other scientists, state in Scientific American that Vitamin D may have many uses in the human body besides building strong bones.
target_text: 两位在加拿大麦吉尔大学工作的科学家报告了他们的研究和其他科学家的研究，他们在“科学美国人”杂志中指出，维生素D除了可以建立强壮的骨骼外，还可能在人体中有很多用途。

source_text: According to the scientists, Luz E. Tavera-Mendoza and John H. White, Vitamin D intake may also be beneficial in the prevention of cancer, multiple sclerosis, diabetes, and fighting tuberculosis, influenza and inflammatory bowel disease.
target_text: 根据科学家卢斯·E·塔维拉-门多萨和约翰·H·怀特的说法，摄入维生素D也可能有益于预防癌症，多发性硬化症，糖尿病以及抗击肺结核，流行性感冒和炎症性肠病。

source_text: The researchers say that there is an emerging "widespread consensus" among experts that a large part of the population has levels of Vitamin D in their bodies that is well below optimal concentrations for health, particularly in temperate regions, due to decreased sunlight and or less time outdoors, and during or just after the winter months.
target_text: 研究人员表示，专家们之间正在形成一种“广泛的共识”，即大部分人口体内的维生素D水平远远低于健康的最佳浓度，特别是在阳光减少或户外时间减少的温带地区，以及在冬季或刚过冬季的几个月。

source_text: One study indicated that as many as 92% of adolescent girls in Northern Europe may have deficient levels of Vitamin D and 37% have severely deficient levels.
target_text: 一项研究表明，北欧多达92％的少女可能缺乏维生素D，37％的人严重缺乏。

source_text: The problem is far worse among African-Americans than Americans with lighter skin.
target_text: 非裔美国人的问题比皮肤较浅的美国人要严重得多。

source_text: Furthermore, the authors say researchers at Harvard University and elsewhere believe the FDA minimum recommended daily allowance of Vitamin D is far too low.
target_text: 此外，作者说，哈佛大学和其他地方的研究人员认为，FDA最低建议维生素D的每日允许量太低了。

source_text: The Recommended Dietary Allowance (RDA) ranges from 200 to 600 International Units (IU).
target_text: 推荐膳食津贴（RDA）范围为200至600国际单位（IU）。

source_text: The first author takes 1000 IU during wintertime and the second author takes 5,000 IU in wintertime.
target_text: 第一作者在冬季需要1000IU而第二作者在冬季需要5000IU。

source_text: They do caution, however, that there is a level at which Vitamin D becomes toxic.
target_text: 不过，他们也警告说，维生素D在一定程度上是有毒的。

source_text: Similar research has also been recently performed by researchers at the Queensland University of Technology who found that many elderly were likely not getting sufficient Vitamin D due in part to insufficient exposure to the sun.
target_text: 昆士兰科技大学的研究人员最近也进行了类似的研究，他们发现，许多老年人可能得不到足够的维生素D，部分原因是晒太阳不足。

source_text: The shooting death by Canadian troops of a 10 year-old boy in Afghanistan has raised fears of a backlash and retaliation.
target_text: 加拿大军队在阿富汗开枪打死一名10岁男孩的事件引发了人们对强烈反应和报复的担忧。

source_text: The boy was shot and a teenager injured at around 5pm local time yesterday when, while driving a motorcycle, they sped through a roadblock cordoning off the scene of a suicide bombing.
target_text: 昨天当地时间下午5点左右，这名男孩被枪杀，一名青少年受伤。当时，他们驾驶摩托车冲出封锁自杀式爆炸现场的路障。

source_text: A soldier fired a bullet which passed through the 17 year-old driver and killed the boy.
target_text: 一名士兵开了一枪，子弹穿过17岁的司机，杀死了男孩。

source_text: "A motorcycle carrying two people broke through the Afghan National Police outer security cordon at high speed," said Colonel Fred Lewis, deputy commander of the Canadian contingent of NATO's International Security Assistance Force (ISAF) in Afghanistan.
target_text: 北约驻阿富汗国际安全援助部队加拿大特遣队副指挥官弗雷德·刘易斯上校说：“一辆载着两个人的摩托车高速冲破了阿富汗国家警察的外安全警戒线。”

source_text: "The driver failed to heed multiple warnings to stop as he headed towards the inner Canadian cordon. "
target_text: “当他朝着加拿大内部封锁线前进时，司机未能注意到多次停止警告。”

source_text: "A Canadian ISAF soldier then opened fire in a defensive application of our rules of engagement. "
target_text: “一名加拿大国际安全援助部队士兵随后根据我们的交战规则自卫射击。”

source_text: "A single round struck both the driver and the passenger of the motorcycle."
target_text: “司机和摩托车乘客都挨了一枪。”

source_text: Lewis doubts soldiers had time to fire warning shots due to the speed of the oncoming motorcycle.
target_text: 刘易斯怀疑士兵们是否有时间鸣枪示警，因为迎面开来的摩托车速度太快。

source_text: He also said that while no explosives were found on the vehicle he had a "sneaking suspicion" that soldiers feared the motorcycle carried a second suicide bomber and acted defensively.
target_text: 他还说，虽然没有在车上发现爆炸物，但他有一种“偷偷的怀疑”，士兵们担心这辆摩托车上有第二名自杀式炸弹袭击者，于是采取了防御行动。

source_text: He added that he was concerned that the Taliban would try to exploit the incident for propaganda purposes and that he was concerned about a possible backlash by locals.
target_text: 他补充说，他担心塔利班会试图利用这一事件进行宣传，并担心当地人可能会采取强烈反对措施。

source_text: "The message is that we're here to help them and we certainly would never want to hurt them."
target_text: “我们要传达的信息是，我们是来帮助他们的，我们当然不想伤害他们。”

source_text: Relatives of the boys were at the gates of the Canadian military base last night demanding answers.
target_text: 昨晚，这些男孩的亲属在加拿大军事基地的门口要求答案。

source_text: Corporal David Braun was killed in the suicide attack which occurred two hours before the shooting.
target_text: 大卫·布劳恩下士在枪击事件发生前两小时发生的自杀式袭击中丧生。

source_text: Three other soldiers were wounded but are listed in good condition.
target_text: 另有三名士兵受伤，但情况良好。

source_text: An Afghan child also died in the blast which occurred when a suicide bomber rammed his car into a Canadian convoy on patrol in Kandahar.
target_text: 一名阿富汗儿童也在爆炸中死亡，当时一名自杀式炸弹袭击者将他的车撞向加拿大一支在坎大哈巡逻的车队。

source_text: Corporal Braun is the 27th Canadian soldier to die since Canadian military operations in Afghanistan began in late 2001 as part of the American led "War on Terror".
target_text: 布劳恩下士是自2001年底加拿大在阿富汗的军事行动开始以来死亡的第27名加拿大士兵，该行动是美国领导的“反恐战争”的一部分。

source_text: Researchers at Japan's Kanazawa University announced the identification of a hormone produced by the liver, apparently a previously unknown cause of insulin resistance.
target_text: 日本金泽大学的研究人员宣布，他们发现了一种由肝脏产生的激素，这显然是一种此前未知的胰岛素抵抗原因。

source_text: The discovery may offer new research targets in treating insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes.
target_text: 该发现可能为治疗胰岛素抵抗和2型糖尿病提供新的研究目标。

source_text: Insulin resistance (IR) is a condition where the body's cells are unable to respond properly to insulin-based treatments.
target_text: 胰岛素抵抗（IR）是身体细胞无法对基于胰岛素的治疗做出适当反应的病症。

source_text: The researchers found the liver expresses higher levels of the gene encoding "selenoprotein P" (SEPP1) in people with type 2 diabetes – those with more insulin resistance.
target_text: 研究人员发现，在胰岛素抵抗程度较高的2型糖尿病患者的肝脏中，编码“硒蛋白P”（SEPP1）的基因表达水平较高。

source_text: This new connection between SEPP1 and adipokine is to be an area for further research.
target_text: SEPP1和脂肪因子之间的这种新联系将成为进一步研究的领域。

source_text: The discovery may help in understanding plaques associated with Alzheimer's disease.
target_text: 这一发现可能有助于了解与阿尔茨海默病相关的斑块。

source_text: Researchers at Kyushu University in Fukuoka, Japan concluded in an earlier study that insulin resistance and the development of plaques found in Alzheimer's sufferers were likely linked.
target_text: 日本福冈九州大学的研究人员在早期的一项研究中得出结论，胰岛素抵抗和阿尔茨海默氏症患者的斑块发展可能有关。

source_text: The World Health Organisation estimates 37 million people worldwide live with dementia and/or Alzheimer's.
target_text: 据世界卫生组织估计，全世界有3700万人患有痴呆症和或阿尔茨海默病。

source_text: Former New Mexico governor Gary Johnson received the 2012 presidential nomination of the U.S. Libertarian Party at Saturday's Libertarian National Convention in Las Vegas, Nevada.
target_text: 前新墨西哥州州长加里·约翰逊星期六在内华达拉斯维加斯举行的自由意志主义全国代表大会上获得2012年美国自由党总统候选人提名。

source_text: Judge James P. Gray of California was selected as his running mate.
target_text: 加利福尼亚州的杰姆斯·P·格雷法官被选为他的竞选伙伴。

source_text: Johnson's association with the Libertarian Party stretches back to 1993, when he was a dues-paying-member for about a year.
target_text: 约翰逊与自由党的关系可以追溯到1993年，当时他是一名缴纳会费的党员，任期约一年。

source_text: In 2000, the party recruited him to run as their presidential nominee, but he rejected the offer, saying, "I'm a Republican, and I'm not going to run for President."
target_text: 2000年，该党招募他作为总统候选人参选，但他拒绝了这一提议，并说：“我是共和党人，我不会竞选总统。”

source_text: As a Republican, Johnson was elected and re-elected as governor of New Mexico in 1994 and 1998.
target_text: 作为共和党人，约翰逊在1994年和1998年当选并再次当选为新墨西哥州州长。

source_text: During his governorship, he vetoed over 750 bills, more than all other then-governors combined, and left the state with a $1 billion budget surplus.
target_text: 在他担任州长期间，他否决了750多项法案，比当时所有其他州长否决的法案加起来还多，并为该州留下了10亿美元的预算盈余。

source_text: Since leaving office in 2003 due to term limits, he has advocated for marijuana legalization, climbed Mount Everest, and has entered into presidential politics.
target_text: 自2003年因任期限制而卸任以来，他一直倡导大麻合法化，攀登过珠穆朗玛峰，并参与了总统竞选。

source_text: During the 2008 Republican primaries, Johnson endorsed the candidacy of Congressman Ron Paul, the Libertarian Party's 1988 presidential nominee.
target_text: 在2008年的共和党初选中，约翰逊支持了1988年自由党总统候选人、国会议员罗恩·保罗。

source_text: In 2012, he chose to mount his own presidential campaign, seeking the Republican Party nomination on a platform of non-interventionism in foreign affairs and extensive cuts to the federal budget.
target_text: 2012年，他选择发起自己的总统竞选，以不干涉外交事务和大幅削减联邦预算为竞选纲领，寻求共和党提名。

source_text: As a result, in December, he decided to end his Republican campaign and return to the Libertarian Party.
target_text: 结果，在12月，他决定结束他的共和党竞选并返回自由党。

source_text: After months of campaigning, Johnson edged activist R. Lee Wrights on the first ballot with 70 percent of the 595 convention delegates.
target_text: 经过几个月的竞选活动，约翰逊在第一轮投票中以595名党代会代表的百分之70击败了活动人士R·李·莱特斯。

source_text: Upon his victory, Johnson proclaimed, "I am honored and I just want to pledge that no one will be disappointed."
target_text: 在胜利之后，约翰逊宣称：“我很荣幸，我只想承诺没有人会失望。”

source_text: He suggested the party nominate James P. Gray as his running mate, and they complied, choosing Gray as the vice presidential nominee.
target_text: 他建议共和党提名杰姆斯·P·格雷为竞选伙伴，他们同意了，选择了格雷为副总统候选人。

source_text: Gray is a jurist, who has served as a trial judge for Orange County, California since 1983.
target_text: 格雷是一名法学家，自1983年以来一直担任加利福尼亚州奥兰治县的审判法官。

source_text: He ran for Congress as a Republican in 1998, and was the Libertarian Party's 2004 nominee for U.S. Senate in California.
target_text: 1998年，他以共和党人的身份竞选国会议员，2004年，他被自由意志党提名为美国加利福尼亚州参议员。

source_text: In his writings and media appearances, Gray has advocated against the War on Drugs.
target_text: 在他的作品和媒体露面中，格雷一直主张反对毒品战争。

source_text: In 2008, the Libertarian Party appeared on 45 state ballots with Barr winning 0.4 percent of the popular vote.
target_text: 2008年，自由党参加了45个州的投票，巴尔赢得了百分之0.4的选票。

source_text: A recent Public Policy Polling (PPP) survey shows Johnson with six percent national support in a matchup with President Barack Obama and the presumptive Republican nominee Mitt Romney.
target_text: 最近的一项公共政策民调显示，约翰逊在与美国总统巴拉克·奥巴马和共和党总统候选人米特·罗姆尼的较量中获得了百分之6的全国支持率。

source_text: A PPP poll from December showed Johnson with 23 percent support in a three way race in New Mexico.
target_text: 12月的PPP调查显示约翰逊在新墨西哥州的三方竞选中获得23％的支持。

source_text: The United Kingdom Home Secretary Charles Clarke has lost his position in a Cabinet reshuffle by Tony Blair, on the morning after the Labour Party suffered losses in local elections across England.
target_text: 就在工党在英格兰各地的地方选举中遭受失利后的次日上午，英国内政大臣查尔斯·克拉克在托尼·布莱尔的内阁改组中失去了自己的职位。

source_text: The news follows two weeks of headlines caused by the release of over 1000 foreign prisoners mistakenly released from prison at the end of their sentence rather than being deported.
target_text: 此前两周的头条新闻是，1000多名外国囚犯在判决结束时被错误释放，而不是被驱逐出境。

source_text: The inventor of The Club steering lock James E. Winner, Jr. has died in a head-on car accident in Clarion County, Pennsylvania aged 81 today.
target_text: 球杆转向锁的发明者小詹姆斯·E·温纳今天在宾夕法尼亚州克莱伦县死于一场迎头相撞的车祸，享年81岁。

source_text: Authorities say the accident occurred when Winner drove his SUV into oncoming traffic.
target_text: 有关当局说，事故发生时维纳驾驶的越野车撞上迎面而来的车辆。

source_text: Winner created The Club steering lock in the early 80s after his car was stolen.
target_text: 在80年代早期，维纳的车被偷后，他发明了转向锁。

source_text: He came up with the idea while fighting in the Korean War; he secured his vehicle with metal chains to stop anybody taking it.
target_text: 他在朝鲜战争中战斗时提出了这个想法，他用金属链固定车辆，以阻止任何人拿走它。

source_text: He sold the first Club in Pennsylvania and later founded Winner International and sold over ten million units.
target_text: 他在宾夕法尼亚州出售了第一家俱乐部，后来创立了维纳国际并销售了超过一千万个。

source_text: Winner also owned hotels, a steel company, and other companies.
target_text: 维纳还拥有酒店，钢铁公司和其他公司。

source_text: A spokesman for Winner International said in a statement, "[this is] a very difficult time for all of us and the family would request that you honor their privacy."
target_text: 维纳国际的一位发言人在一份声明中表示，“对我们所有人来说，这是一个非常困难的时期，家人会要求你尊重他们的隐私。”

source_text: Friday, an undersea earthquake off the far east coast of Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula was felt in the capital city of Moscow, 10,000 kilometers away.
target_text: 星期五，俄罗斯堪察加半岛远东海岸发生海底地震，在1万公里外的首都莫斯科有震感。

source_text: The earthquake occurred 600km below sea level in the Okhotsk Sea and recorded an 8.2 magnitude on the Richter Scale, with the Moscow shock measured as 1.0 on the scale.
target_text: 地震发生在鄂霍次克海海平面下600公里处，里氏震级为8.2级，莫斯科震级为1.0级。

source_text: The last time such a shock was felt in Moscow was in 1984.
target_text: 莫斯科上一次有这样的震感是在1984年。

source_text: This is a so-called deep-focus earthquake, that's why it was felt at such a large territory.
target_text: 这就是所谓的深源地震，这就是为什么在这么大的区域都能感觉到。

source_text: If an earthquake happens at such a low depth, the waves move along low layers, practically the mantle, but weaken significantly before reaching the earth surface.
target_text: 如果地震发生在如此浅的深度，地震波就会沿较浅的层移动，实际上是沿地幔移动，但在到达地表之前会明显减弱。

source_text: This is why there usually is no injuries or casualties in such cases.
target_text: 这就是为什么在这种情况下通常没有人员受伤或伤亡的原因。

source_text: Sahkalin Island was under a tsunami warning on Friday, however, it was lifted soon after.
target_text: 萨哈林岛周五遭到海啸警告，但很快就被解除了。

source_text: The island may have to prepare for a tsunami situation again, with another under sea earthquake predicted in the next week with a magnitude of over 7.0.
target_text: 该岛可能不得不再次为海啸情况做好准备，因为预计下周将发生另一次海底地震，震级超过7.0级。

source_text: Authorities from the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation are currently investigating death threats targeted towards the New York investment firm Goldman Sachs.
target_text: 美国联邦调查局的官员目前正在调查针对纽约投资公司高盛的死亡威胁。

source_text: Threatening letters were sent to 20 U.S. newspapers, stating: "Goldman Sachs."
target_text: 向20家美国报纸发出了威胁信，称：“高盛。”

source_text: The letter was described as being neatly written in red ink on blue-lined loose-leaf paper, and was signed "A.Q.U.S.A".
target_text: 这封信被描述为用红墨水整洁地写在蓝色衬里的活页纸上，署名为“A.Q.U.S.A”。

source_text: The letters were believed to have been mailed from Queens, New York.
target_text: 据信这些信件是从纽约皇后区邮寄的。

source_text: The bank is working closely with law enforcement authorities, however, it was told by Goldman Sachs that the threat is not likely to be credible.
target_text: 该银行正在与执法机关密切合作，但高盛告诉该机构威胁不太可信。

source_text: A spokesperson for the bank says they take any threat very seriously.
target_text: 该银行的发言人表示，他们非常重视任何威胁。

source_text: "We have a broad range of security measures in place to counter all likely threats and we're monitoring the situation closely."
target_text: “我们已采取广泛的安全措施来应对所有可能的威胁，我们正密切关注这一情况。”

source_text: Goldman Sachs is headquartered in New York and maintains offices in London, Frankfurt, Tokyo, Hong Kong and other major financial centers.
target_text: 高盛集团总部位于纽约，在伦敦，法兰克福，东京，香港和其他主要金融中心设有办事处。

source_text: More than 3,000 of its employees work in Jersey City, New Jersey, in the state's tallest building.
target_text: 超过3000名员工在新泽西州泽西市的最高的建筑内工作。

source_text: Three people were killed and another was injured during a campus shooting at University of Alabama's Shelby Center for Science and Technology in Huntsville, Alabama.
target_text: 在阿拉巴马州亨茨维尔的阿拉巴马大学谢尔比科技中心发生校园枪击案，造成3人死亡，1人受伤。

source_text: Several other possible victims were soon rushed by ambulance to a nearby hospital.
target_text: 其他几名可能的受害者很快被救护车送往附近的医院。

source_text: The surrounding area has since been cordoned off, and the entire university is currently under lockdown.
target_text: 此后，周边地区被封锁，整个大学目前都处于封锁状态。

source_text: "We have three confirmed people who are dead, one injured.
target_text: “我们确认有3人死亡，1人受伤。

source_text: "The shooter is in custody," university spokesperson, Ray Garner, told local media on the scene.
target_text: “枪手已经被拘留，”该校发言人雷加纳在现场告诉当地媒体。

source_text: Mr. Garner also said the shooter was a female, but he could not identify her or any of the victims.
target_text: 加纳还表示，枪手是一名女性，但他无法确定她或任何受害者的身份。

source_text: Pioneer Malaysian bloggers Ahiruddin Attan and Jeff Ooi have been sued for defamation by a leading Malaysian newspaper, The New Straits Times.
target_text: 马来西亚先锋博主阿希鲁丁・阿坦和杰夫・欧欧义因诽谤被马来西亚主要报纸《新海峡时报》起诉。

source_text: They are alleged to have defamed top executives of the English daily.
target_text: 据称他们诽谤了英国日报的高层管理人员。

source_text: The case marks the first time bloggers have been sued for libel in the country.
target_text: 该案件标志着博主第一次因诽谤罪在该国被起诉。

source_text: The oldest newspaper group in Malaysia is owned by the Media Prima group, which is in turn owned by the United Malays National Organization, the leading party in the government.
target_text: 马来西亚历史最悠久的报业集团由首要媒体集团所有，该集团又由马来西亚民族统一组织所有，该组织是政府的主要政党。

source_text: Malaysia has strict media laws but they function less effectively on newer forms of electronic media.
target_text: 马来西亚有严格的媒体法，但它们在新式的电子媒体上起到的效果较差。

source_text: Leading members of the ruling coalition, Barisan Nasional (the National Front) have suggested making amendments to its media laws, such as to punish bloggers who publish materials that are deemed controversial and "anti-government".
target_text: 执政联盟的主要成员国民阵线（简称国民阵线）建议修改其媒体法，比如惩罚那些发表被认为有争议和“反政府”内容的博客作者。

source_text: Falkirk were today relegated from the Scottish Premier League (SPL), after they failed to beat Kilmarnock away from home.
target_text: 法尔柯克今天从苏格兰超级联赛（SPL）降级，因为他们没有在主场击败基尔马诺克。

source_text: The teams fought out a 0–0 draw at Rugby Park, a game which did not see many shots on goal with only nine in the whole game.
target_text: 球队在橄榄球公园0比0战平，整场比赛只有9次射门，射门次数不多。

source_text: It is the first time Falkirk have been in the second tier of Scottish football since 2005.
target_text: 这是福尔柯克自2005年以来第一次进入苏格兰足球的第二梯队。

source_text: The team in last place would be relegated, and, only needing a draw, Kilmarnock played a slow and defensive game.
target_text: 最后一名的球队将被降级，而基马诺克只需要一场平局，所以就踢了一场慢吞吞的防守比赛。

source_text: On 77 minutes, the Falkirk side had the ball in the net, but the goal was disallowed for a clear foul on the Kilmarnock goalkeeper.
target_text: 第77分钟，福尔柯克一方将球打进球门，但由于对基马诺克门将的一次明显犯规，进球被判无效。

source_text: Falkirk had a glorious opportunity to win the game on 86 minutes, when the ball landed for Ryan Flynn with the goal empty, but the young midfielder put it over from ten yards.
target_text: 福尔柯克在第86分钟有一个绝佳的机会赢得比赛，当时球落在了莱恩·弗林的前面，面对球门空门，但这位年轻的中场球员在10码外把球射偏。

source_text: Kilmarnock manager Jimmy Calderwood, speaking after the game, spoke of his experiences: "It was a long, long day."
target_text: 基尔马诺克的主教练吉米·卡尔德伍德在赛后谈到了他的经历：“这是漫长的一天。”

source_text: "We had a chance on the counter attack, we didn't take it, and then I think it was the 92nd or 93rd minute young Flynn missed a dottie of a chance."
target_text: “我们有机会反击，但我们没有抓住机会，我想那是在第92分钟或第93分钟，年轻的弗林错过了一次机会。”

source_text: When asked about his future at the club, Calderwood replied: "I'll see what the idea is."
target_text: 当被问及他在俱乐部的未来时，卡尔德伍德回答说：“我会看到这个想法是什么。”

source_text: " I wouldn't want to stay with too many games like this."
target_text: “我不想玩踢太多这样的比赛。”

source_text: The manager of Falkirk, Steven Pressley, also told Radio Scotland his views on the game: "It was a very emotional day, you know, we're bitterly disappointed, but once again I couldn't ask any more from this group of players. "
target_text: 福尔柯克的主教练史蒂文·普雷斯利也告诉苏格兰广播电台他对这场比赛的看法：“这是非常激动人心的一天，你知道，我们非常失望，但我不能再向这群球员要求更多了。”

source_text: "The things we talk about, the desire, the effort, the application, they were in abundance today."
target_text: “我们谈论的事情，包括欲望，努力，战术运用，它们今天都得到了充分发挥。”

source_text: This was Pressley's first season as a manager, and he was questioned on his experience in the role: "I love it. "
target_text: 这是普里斯利作为主教练的第一个赛季，他在这个角色上的经验受到了质疑：“我喜欢这个角色。”

source_text: "It's been an emotional day today, but in terms of my three months in charge, it's been a terrific experience. "
target_text: “今天是激动人心的一天，但就我任职的三个月而言，这是一次非常棒的经历。”

source_text: "I very much enjoy it here and hopefully we can certainly build for next season."
target_text: “我非常喜欢这里，希望我们能为下一季做好准备。”

source_text: 14 people have died after heavy rain and flash flooding hit a gorge near the south western city of Chongqing, China.
target_text: 在中国重庆西南部城市附近的一个峡谷遭遇暴雨和洪水泛滥后，已有14人死亡。

source_text: It is reported that a group of hikers entered a forbidden area of the Tanzhangxia Gorge along with a guide.
target_text: 据报道，一群徒步旅行者和导游一起进入了潭獐峡峡谷的禁区。

source_text: 16 members of the group of 35 were rescued but 14 died and 5 are still missing.
target_text: 35名小组中的16名成员获救，但14人死亡，5人仍然失踪。

source_text: The flooding was caused by a heavy rainstorm on Saturday which caused a wall of water to trigger down the gorge.
target_text: 洪水是由星期六的一场暴雨引起的，这场暴雨触发了一堵水墙冲下峡谷。

source_text: Around 400 rescue workers are helping the rescue effort and looking for any possible survivors.
target_text: 大约400名救援人员正在协助救援行动并寻找任何可能的幸存者。

source_text: Several homes and streets were flooded during the rainstorm despite the effort of the villagers who built temporary flood guards.
target_text: 尽管村民们建造了临时防洪堤，暴雨中还是有几处房屋和街道被淹。

source_text: Mutharika, who has in the past dismissed homosexuality as alien, stated that he was releasing the couple on humanitarian grounds.
target_text: 穆塔里卡过去曾将同性恋视为异类而不予理会，他表示他是出于人道主义的考虑释放这对夫妇。

source_text: On Thursday, the President of South Africa condemned the decision of the Malawi courts in a rare dissenting statement stating, "We have condemned the action taken to arrest people in terms of our constitution," in response to questions about the Malawi arrests.
target_text: 星期四，南非总统在一份罕见的持不同意见的声明中谴责了马拉维法院的决定，声明“我们已经谴责了根据我们的宪法采取的逮捕人民的行动”，以回应有关马拉维逮捕行动的问题。

source_text: In December, Steven Monjeza, 26, and Tiwonge Chimbalanga, 20, were arrested following a personal engagement ceremony.
target_text: 12月，26岁的斯蒂文孟吉札和20岁的蒂旺格秦巴兰加在个人订婚仪式后被捕。

source_text: The men were charged with gross indecency and unnatural acts, based on laws imposed during the British colonial period in Malawi.
target_text: 根据英国殖民时期在马拉维实施的法律，这些人被控犯有严重猥亵和违反自然的行为。

source_text: The largest extrasolar planet or exoplanet has been discovered orbiting the star GSC 02620-00648, around 1,435 light years away.
target_text: 已发现最大的太阳系外行星或系外行星围绕恒星GSC 02620-00648轨道运行，距离大约1,435光年。

source_text: The planet, named TrES-4, after the Transatlantic Exoplanet Survey (TrES) is 1.7 times the size of the planet Jupiter.
target_text: 在跨大西洋系外行星测量（TrES）之后，这颗名为TrES-4的行星是木星行星的1.7倍。

source_text: TrES-4 also has a lower mass than Jupiter and an extremely low density of 0.2 grams per cubic centimetre, which is less than a wine cork.
target_text: TrES-4的质量也低于木星，密度极低，每立方厘米0.2克，低于葡萄酒软木塞。

source_text: TrES-4 orbits its star at a distance of only 7 million km (4.5 million miles), meaning that the temperature of the planet is estimated at 1,327°C (approximately 1,600K or 2,300°F).
target_text: TrES-4的轨道距离仅为700万公里（450万英里），这意味着该星球的温度估计为1,327°C（约1600K或2300°F）。

source_text: Mandushev went on to say, "Because of the planet's relatively weak pull on its upper atmosphere, some of the atmosphere probably escapes in a comet-like tail."
target_text: 曼杜舍夫接着说：“由于这颗行星对上层大气的引力相对较弱，一些大气层可能会以彗星状的尾巴逃逸。”

source_text: Due to the planet's size, current theories about superheated giant planets find it hard to explain why it is so large.
target_text: 由于行星的大小，目前关于过热巨行星的理论很难解释为什么它如此之大。

source_text: Francis O'Donovan, a graduate student in astronomy at the California Institute of Technology which operates one of the TrES telescopes said, "We continue to be surprised by how relatively large these giant planets can be.
target_text: 加州理工学院天文学操作一台TrES望远镜的研究生弗朗西斯·奥多诺万说：“我们仍然对这些巨型行星的相对巨大的大小感到惊讶。

source_text: "But if we can explain the sizes of these bloated planets in their harsh environments, it may help us better understand our own Solar System planets and their formation."
target_text: “但如果我们能够在恶劣的环境中解释这些膨胀行星的大小，它可能有助于我们更好地了解我们自己的太阳系行星及其形成。”

source_text: Michael Baigent and Richard Leigh, who jointly wrote together with a third author, a 1982 Non-Fiction book The Holy Blood and the Holy Grail have taken The Da Vinci Code publisher Random House, to court claiming that The Holy Blood and the Holy Grail storyline has been stolen by Dan Brown.
target_text: 迈克尔·贝金特和理查德·利与第三位作者共同撰写了1982年的一本非小说类书籍《圣血与圣杯》，他们将达芬奇密码出版商兰登书屋告上法庭，声称圣血与圣杯的故事情节已被丹·布朗窃取。

source_text: The third author of Holy Blood and the Holy Grail Henry Lincoln, is not involved in the case.
target_text: 《圣血》和《圣杯》的第三作者亨利·林肯，并没有参与此案。

source_text: Random House is the of publisher of both The Da Vinci Code and The Holy Blood and The Holy Grail.
target_text: 兰登书屋是“达芬奇密码”和“圣血”和“圣杯”的出版商。

source_text: The central theme of the two books is that the bloodline from a marriage between Jesus and Mary Magdalene survives today.
target_text: 这两本书的中心主题是耶稣与玛利亚抹大拉之间婚姻的血统幸存到今天。

source_text: Random House has denied the claim and, Random House chief executive Gail Rebuck says in a statement that she believed the lawsuit was without merit.
target_text: 兰登书屋否认了这份指控，兰登书屋首席执行官盖尔·雷巴克在一份声明中表示，她相信这起诉讼是没有根据的。

source_text: "As publisher of both The Da Vinci Code and The Holy Blood and The Holy Grail, we are genuinely saddened that two of the three authors of HBHG have chosen to bring this litigation against us...Random House takes no pleasure in defending a legal action that it believes is without merit and we are confident that we will prevail."
target_text: “作为《达芬奇密码》、《圣血》和《圣杯》的出版商，HBHG的三位作者中有两位选择对我们提起诉讼，我们真的很难过……”兰登书屋不愿意为它认为毫无价值的法律行动辩护，我们相信我们将获胜。

source_text: If this case is successful it could threaten the film; starring Tom Hanks and Sir Ian McKellen from opening.
target_text: 如果这个案子获胜，可能会威胁到由汤姆·汉克斯和伊恩·麦凯伦爵士主演的电影。

source_text: The Da Vinci Code is a fiction book and has over 36 million copies in print worldwide.
target_text: “达芬奇密码”是一本虚构的书，全世界印刷发行超过3600万册。

source_text: The dust jacket for the novel apparently includes longitude and latitude coordinates which lead to the CIA headquarters near Langley, Virginia.
target_text: 这本小说的防尘套显然包括经纬度坐标，这些坐标指向弗吉尼亚州兰利附近的中央情报局总部。

source_text: Brown's next book, The Solomon Key, is rumoured to be about the Yale Skull and Bones society.
target_text: 布朗的下一本书《所罗门之钥》据传是关于耶鲁骷髅会的。

source_text: Notable alumni of the society include current United States President George W. Bush, former President George H.W. Bush, and Massachusettes Senator John Kerry.
target_text: 该协会的著名校友包括现任美国总统乔治·W·布什、前总统乔治·H·W·布什和马萨诸塞州参议员约翰·克里。

source_text: New Zealand beat South Africa by 5 wickets in the Super 8 phase of the World Cup at the Cricket National Stadium, St. George's, Grenada, securing their place in the semi-finals, along with Australia, Sri Lanka and a currently unknown team.
target_text: 在格林纳达圣乔治板球国家体育场举行的世界杯超级8阶段比赛中，新西兰以五个未出局的优势击败了南非，与澳大利亚、斯里兰卡和一支目前还不为人知的球队一起，确保了自己在半决赛中的位置。

source_text: South Africa will have to beat England in their upcoming game in order to secure their progression.
target_text: 南非将不得不在即将到来的比赛中击败英格兰，以确保他们的晋级。

source_text: Wikinews has learned that American rock singer Meat Loaf has taken ill during a concert in Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom.
target_text: 维基新闻了解到，在英国泰恩河畔纽卡斯尔举行的一场音乐会上，美国摇滚歌手密特·劳弗生病了。

source_text: He told the audience that it was "the last concert of his life," and left the stage.
target_text: 他告诉听众，这是“他生命中的最后一场音乐会”，并离开了舞台。

source_text: The incident came 70 minutes into the show on Halloween night.
target_text: 这一事件发生在万圣节之夜演唱会开始70分钟后。

source_text: During the opening of Paradise by the Dashboard Light he suggested that the crowd of thousands should enjoy the performance as it was the last of his career.
target_text: 在仪表盘灯光下的乐园演唱会的开幕白中，他建议成千上万的观众应该好好欣赏这场表演，因为这是他职业生涯的最后一场演出。

source_text: "I'm taking my coat off; I bow; and I say goodbye forever."
target_text: “我脱掉外套，我鞠躬，我永远说再见。”

source_text: He then left the stage, soon followed by his band.
target_text: 然后他离开了舞台，不久他的乐队也跟着离开了。

source_text: However, they also say that fans are unlikely to be refunded the cost of their tickets, priced at between £37.50 and £45, because he had performed for over an hour.
target_text: 然而，他们还说，球迷不太可能退还价格在37.50英镑到45英镑之间的门票费用，因为他已经表演超过一个小时。

source_text: Portuguese Prime Minister Pedro Santana Lopes, along with his entire cabinet, resigned Saturday after President Jorge Sampaio dissolved the Western European nation's parliament.
target_text: 葡萄牙总理佩德罗·桑塔纳·洛佩斯和他的整个内阁星期六在总统若热·桑帕约解散这个西欧国家的议会后辞职。

source_text: After a slew of crises during Santana Lopes's tenure, including poor credit ratings and accusations of media censorship, Sampaio dissolved the parliament on Friday in an attempt to restore credibility to the nation.
target_text: 桑塔纳·洛佩斯任职期间发生了一系列危机，包括信用评级不佳和媒体审查指控，桑帕约周五解散议会，试图恢复国家的信誉。

source_text: He then scheduled new elections ahead of the ones already scheduled for 2006.
target_text: 然后，他计划在定于2006年进行的选举之前举行新的选举。

source_text: Two sculptures have been confiscated and thirteen pro-democracy activists arrested in Hong Kong, in what critics have described as "politically motivated" censorship.
target_text: 在香港，两尊雕塑被没收，13名民主派活动人士被捕，批评人士称这是“出于政治动机”的审查。

source_text: The sculptures, a new replica of the "Goddess of Democracy" and a carving called the "Tiananmen Massacre Relief", had been placed in the piazza of Hong Kong's Times Square shopping mall in remembrance of the 21st anniversary of the Tiananmen Square Incident.
target_text: 这些雕塑是“民主女神”的新复制品和一幅名为“天安门大屠杀救济”的雕刻品，已被放置在香港时代广场购物中心的广场上，以纪念天安门事件21周年。

source_text: Although the Causeway Bay piazza is designated as a public space, its day-to-day operations are run by the shopping mall's management.
target_text: 虽然铜锣湾广场被指定为公共空间，但其日常运作由购物中心的管理层负责。

source_text: They made a complaint that the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements in China, or the "Alliance" for short, had failed to ask permission for their activities.
target_text: 他们抱怨支持中国爱国民主运动的香港联盟，简称“联盟”未能就他们的活动获得许可。

source_text: When police and officials from the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department attempted to remove the sculptures on the grounds for obstructing public access, they were prevented from doing so by activists for two hours.
target_text: 当警方和食品环境卫生署的官员试图以妨碍公众进入为由移除这些雕塑时，他们被活动人士阻止了两个小时。

source_text: The police made 13 arrests, including that of a legislator for preventing the police from carrying out their duties.
target_text: 警方共拘捕13人，包括一名阻止警方执行职务的议员。

source_text: The statue was removed and is currently in the custody of the Customs and Excise department (C&ED).
target_text: 该雕像被移除，目前由海关（C＆ED）保管。

source_text: The 13 persons arrested were released on bail the same day.
target_text: 被捕的13人当天获准保释。

source_text: Alliance secretary Albert Ho claimed that as Times Square was a public area, the police had no right to stop them, that similar activities had been held before, and that he had "...never been treated so barbarically and so violently...".
target_text: 联盟秘书长何鸿燊声称，由于时代广场是一个公共区域，警方没有权利阻止他们，之前曾举行过类似的活动，并且“他从来没有受过如此野蛮和如此暴力的待遇……”。

source_text: Alliance vice-chairman Lee Cheuk-yan said that C&ED's action was unusual, and that he has contacted the department to find out if the department was trying to censor materials related to the Tiananmen Square incident.
target_text: 联盟副主席李卓人表示，中电国际的行为不同寻常，他已与新闻部联系，以查明新闻部是否试图审查与天安门事件有关的材料。

source_text: As part of its Basic Law, Hong Kong continues to enjoy western-style liberties within the One country, two systems settlement within China.
target_text: 作为《基本法》的一部分，香港继续享有“一国两制”的自由。

source_text: In the past political activities that are taboo in China proper have been tolerated by the Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China (SAR) authorities.
target_text: 过去，中华人民共和国特别行政区当局一直容忍在中国境内属于禁忌的政治活动。

source_text: A passenger was killed Monday evening after a fire started in a washroom aboard a train near Leighton Buzzard, in Bedfordshire, England.
target_text: 周一晚上，英国贝德福德郡莱顿・巴泽德附近一列火车上的洗手间发生火灾，一名乘客死亡。

source_text: Emergency services were called to the London Midland train, where they found the body of a female passenger who had suffered burns.
target_text: 紧急服务部门接到伦敦米德兰火车站的电话，在那里他们发现了一名被烧伤的女乘客的尸体。

source_text: British Transport Police confirmed one female individual was killed in the blaze.
target_text: 英国交通警察证实，一名女性人员在大火中丧生。

source_text: A spokesperson said: "The deceased woman has injuries consistent with burns, no other person is believed to have been involved in the incident."
target_text: 一名发言人说：“死者的伤势与烧伤情况相符，没有其他人被认为与这起事件有关。”

source_text: "Officers from the fire and ambulance services are on the scene."
target_text: “来自消防和救护车服务的人员正在现场。”

source_text: The fire has caused serious disruption to trains on the West Coast Main Line.
target_text: 大火严重扰乱了西海岸干线的火车。

source_text: A spokesperson for Network Rail said they were attempting to reopen two of the four tracks on the line as London Midland scrambled to organise a replacement bus service.
target_text: 铁路网的一名发言人表示，他们正试图重新开放这条线路上的四条轨道中的两条。目前，伦敦米德兰正忙于组织一项巴士替代服务。

source_text: London Midland said no-one else was injured in the incident.
target_text: 伦敦米德兰说，事件中没有其他人受伤。

source_text: "The fire appeared to have been in the toilet," a spokesperson said.
target_text: 一位发言人说：“火灾似乎是在厕所里发生的。”

source_text: Zulia has a large portion of Venezuela's oil and gas reserves and is ruled by governor Manuel Rosales, a friend of the United States.
target_text: 祖里亚拥有委内瑞拉很大一部分石油和天然气储备，由美国的朋友、委内瑞拉州长曼努埃尔・罗萨莱斯控制。

source_text: Upon arrival, a woman's sevens match was in progress between the Sunshine Coast Stingrays and Toowoomba Army.
target_text: 抵达后，阳光海岸黄貂鱼和图文巴军队正在进行女子七人制比赛。

source_text: Sunshine Coast won this contest 26 to 15, an 11 point margin.
target_text: 阳光海岸以26比15获胜，领先11分。

source_text: The local A-Grade contest between University and Caloundra started almost immediately after the completion of the woman's game.
target_text: 女子比赛一结束，大学队和卡永德拉之间的A级比赛就开始了。

source_text: Caloundra went ahead after 12 minutes with a converted try.
target_text: 卡拉德拉在12分钟后尝试战术改变。

source_text: They would lead by 26 points early in the second half before University gained the momentum.
target_text: 在大学队发动攻势之前，他们在下半场早些时候领先了26分。

source_text: University put on 21 points to 6 in the final half an hour.
target_text: 大学队在最后半个小时内把比分改写为21比6。

source_text: The Sunshine Coast Stingrays lost their last Premier Rugby home game for a month against Sunnybank 36 points to 6.
target_text: 阳光海岸黄貂鱼输掉了一个月来最后一场重要的橄榄球主场比赛，以36比6输给了桑尼班克。

source_text: Sunnybank lead 17 points to 3 in the dying moments of the first half, but conceded a penalty which resulted in the hosts scoring what would ultimately be their final points of the game.
target_text: 桑尼班克在上半场的最后时刻以17比3领先，但造成了一个点球，导致主队得分，这是主队本场比赛中的最后一分。

source_text: They won lineouts against the throw and counter rucked in a more efficient manner than Sunshine Coast.
target_text: 他们在抛球和反击中赢得了边线发球的机会线，比阳光海岸更有效率。

source_text: The final score in a lop side contest — Sunnybank Dragons 36 defeated Sunshine Coast Stingrays 6.
target_text: 在一场一边倒的比赛中最终结果是桑尼班克以36比6击败了阳光海岸黄貂鱼。

source_text: Aid agencies and Indian government officials have warned that there may be food shortages in the country, following severe floods that affected southern states.
target_text: 援助机构和印度政府官员警告说，在影响南部各州的严重洪灾之后，该国可能存在粮食短缺问题。

source_text: Officials have predicted that food production in Andra Pradesh, one of the southern states most affected by flooding, will go down by over 900,000 tonnes.
target_text: 官员们预测，受洪水影响最严重的南部州之一安德拉邦的粮食产量将减少90多万吨。

source_text: The waters are said to have ruined large quantities of grain stocks as well.
target_text: 据说洪水也破坏了大量的粮食储备。

source_text: Jayakumar Christian, director of World Vision India, an aid agency working in the region, said that "floods and drought have set back India's fight against poverty by years."
target_text: 在该地区工作的援助机构印度世界展望组织主任贾亚库马尔･克里斯蒂安表示，“洪水和干旱让印度抗击贫困的努力倒退了好几年。”

source_text: Heavy flooding last week, mainly in Andhra Pradesh and neighbouring Karnataka, has killed about three hundred people and forced the evacuation of over a milion.
target_text: 上周，主要在安得拉邦和邻近的卡纳塔克邦发生的大洪水已造成大约三百人死亡，并迫使一百多万人疏散。

source_text: The Group of Ministers (GoM) set up by the union government has given the thumbs-up for community radio stations to operate in India.
target_text: 由联合政府成立的部长小组（GoM）已经同意让社区电台在印度运营。

source_text: The GoM has proposed that universities, registered trusts, civil society bodies and NGOs be allowed to run such stations.
target_text: 部长小组提议允许大学，注册信托机构，民间社会机构和非政府组织运营这些电台。

source_text: It has also proposed a single window clearance system to authorise such networks, with the assurance that the requisite clearances will be provided within three months.
target_text: 它还提议设立一个单一的窗口清除系统，授权这种网络保证在三个月内提供必要的清除。

source_text: The GoM has also proposed that community radios be allowed up to 5 minutes of commercial advertising for every hour of broadcast.
target_text: 部长小组还提议社区广播每小时最多允许播放5分钟的商业广告。

source_text: The possibility that the proposal may run into some trouble when put before the Cabinet does exist.
target_text: 提案可能在提交内阁之前遇到麻烦的可能性确实存在。

source_text: Many private FM channels are supposedly displeased with the idea of having to face more competition.
target_text: 据说，许多私人调频频道对不得不面对更多竞争的想法感到不满。

source_text: There are also concerns that community radios may be used by insurgent groups to compromise India's internal security.
target_text: 还有人担心，叛乱组织可能会利用社区无线电危及印度国内安全。

source_text: Those in favour of the proposal, however, say that this concept will start a revolution and empower rural India.
target_text: 然而，支持该提案的人表示，这一概念将开启一场革命并赋予印度农村权力。

source_text: Columnist, author and visiting professor at Centre for Policy Research, B G Verghese says, "This operates at the grassroot level and once people can have access to this kind of information, you can put across anything to them, whether it is education or health."
target_text: 政策研究中心专栏作家、作家兼客座教授B·G·韦尔盖塞表示：“这是在基层运作的，一旦人们能够获得此类信息，你就可以向他们传达任何信息，无论是教育还是健康。”

source_text: "The twin towers have happened, there is no way you can stop it."
target_text: “双子塔事件已经发生，你无法阻止它。”

source_text: According to reports, the government of People's Republic of China has stopped restricting access to the Chinese Wikipedia in some parts of the country starting on July 3.
target_text: 据报道，自7月3日起，中华人民共和国政府已停止限制在该国部分地区访问中文维基百科。

source_text: The report originated on the Wikimedia Foundation's mailing list quoting a website saying "Wikipedia Chinese version unblocked."
target_text: 这份报告来自维基媒体基金会的邮件列表，其中引用了一个网站的话说：“维基百科中文版已被解禁。”

source_text: Despite the report, there are still some issues with accessing the site according to readers of the site.
target_text: 尽管有这份报告，但据网站的读者说，访问该网站仍然存在一些问题。

source_text: Sources tell Wikinews that although the English version is unblocked, the Chinese version still remains blocked or hard to access in many parts of the country.
target_text: 消息人士告诉维基新闻，尽管英文版本未被封锁，但中国版本在该国许多地方仍然受阻或难以访问。

source_text: This comes after the Chinese unblocking of the all other language variations of Wikipedia in April.
target_text: 这是在四月份中国对维基百科所有其他语言版本解禁之后的事情。

source_text: Ian A. Holton, who is an administrator on the English Wikipedia, has confirmed that the Chinese Wikipedia is accessible in the Liaoning Province, although users in Shanghai, Shenzhen and some in Beijing are still unable to access the site.
target_text: 英文维基百科的管理员伊恩·A·霍尔顿证实，在辽宁省可以访问中文维基百科，不过上海、深圳和北京的一些用户仍然无法访问该网站。

source_text: The restriction in Beijing does not appear to cover the entire area: sources have told Wikinews the site can be accessed in many parts of Beijing.
target_text: 北京的限制似乎并未覆盖整个地区：消息人士告诉维基新闻，该网站可以在北京的许多地方访问。

source_text: There has been some doubt on whether Wikipedia will remain accessible after the Olympic games.
target_text: 人们对奥运会后维基百科是否还能继续开放持怀疑态度。

source_text: Christiano Moreschi, another active contributor to the English Wikipedia, said that "I doubt this will last 5 minutes beyond the end of the closing ceremony of the Olympics."
target_text: 英语维基百科的另一位活跃贡献者克里斯蒂亚诺·莫雷斯基表示：“我怀疑，奥运会闭幕式结束后，这种情况是否会持续5分钟。”

source_text: The International Olympic Committee warned China in April that it wanted the internet freely accessible for the entire duration of the Olympic Summer Games.
target_text: 国际奥委会4月份警告中国，希望在整个奥运会夏季期间可以自由上网。

source_text: Unrestricted access is guaranteed to the 30,000 reporters and media staff expected for the Olympics under Beijing's 'host city contract'.
target_text: 根据北京的“主办城市协议”，预计参加奥运会的30000名记者和媒体工作人员将保证可以无限制访问网页。

source_text: Former President of Russia Boris Yeltsin has died at age 76, according to a Kremlin spokesperson.
target_text: 据克里姆林宫发言人称，俄罗斯前总统鲍里斯·叶利钦去世，享年76岁。

source_text: "Today, at 15:45 (11:45 GMT) Boris Nikolayevich Yeltsin died in the Central Clinical Hospital as a result of a deteriorating cardio-vascular problem," said the spokesperson.
target_text: “今天，15：45（格林尼治标准时间11：45），鲍里斯·尼古拉耶维奇叶利钦因心血管问题恶化而死于中央临床医院，”发言人说。

source_text: The Yeltsin era was a traumatic period in Russian history— marked by widespread corruption, economic collapse, and enormous political and social problems.
target_text: 叶利钦时代是俄罗斯历史上的一个创伤时期，其特点是普遍的腐败、经济崩溃以及巨大的政治和社会问题。

source_text: Yeltsin maintained a low profile since his resignation, making almost no public statements or appearances.
target_text: 自辞职以来，叶利钦一直保持低调，几乎没有公开声明或露面。

source_text: However, on February 1, 2006, Yeltsin celebrated his 75th birthday.
target_text: 然而，在2006年2月1日，叶利钦庆祝了他的75岁生日。

source_text: He used this occasion as an opportunity to criticize a "monopolistic" United States foreign policy, and to state that Vladimir Putin was the right choice for Russia.
target_text: 他利用这个机会批评美国的“垄断”外交政策，并表示弗拉基米尔·普京是俄罗斯的正确选择。

source_text: Sporting games are more popular with younger gamers and sporting people with a conjunction from two industries, between sporting and gaming.
target_text: 体育游戏更受年轻玩家和从事体育运动的人的欢迎，它是来自两个行业，即体育与游戏的结合。

source_text: Although games from the NBA series are not the official games of the World Cyber Games, but with fashions of the NBA, and PC gaming population having a stable scale, the NBA game series attracted not only basketball and game fans but also sporting and gaming media world-wide, and its market was progressively expanded from America and Europe to Asia and other countries.
target_text: 虽然NBA系列游戏并不是世界电子竞技大赛的官方游戏，但由于NBA的流行以及PC游戏玩家数量的稳定，NBA游戏系列不仅吸引了篮球和游戏迷，也吸引了全球的体育和游戏媒体，且市场逐步从欧美扩展到亚洲等国家。

source_text: With those issues in mind, Wikinews Reporter Rico Shen briefly interviewed Event Director of NBA Asia Corporation Ritchie Lai about the sports gaming market developments at the NBA 2K8 Asia Championship Taiwan Qualifier.
target_text: 考虑到这些问题，维基新闻记者Rico Shen在NBA 2K8亚锦赛台湾预选赛上，就体育游戏市场发展情况对NBA亚洲公司赛事总监Ritchie Lai进行了简短采访。

source_text: The Colombian Caracol Radio reported on January 31, 2005 that the government of Colombia released a detailed document which describes how the FARC operates in Colombia and around the world.
target_text: 哥伦比亚卡拉科尔电台于2005年1月31日报道，哥伦比亚政府发布了一份详细文件，描述了哥伦比亚革命武装力量在哥伦比亚和世界各地的运作情况。

source_text: Kevin Rudd, Australia's Leader of the Opposition has promised a special home buyers' bank account with tax concessions if Labor is elected on November 24.
target_text: 澳大利亚反对党领袖凯文·拉德承诺，如果工党于11月24日当选，那么特别购房者的银行账户将享受税收优惠。

source_text: Mr Rudd says AU$64,000 could be saved by a couple on the average wage over five years.
target_text: 凯文·拉德（陆克文）表示，一对夫妇五年的平均工资可以节省6.4万澳元。

source_text: The Housing Industry Association has welcomed the announcement but says it would be a start and would "avoid a stampede of first home buyers into the market."
target_text: 澳洲住房产业协会对这一消息表示欢迎，但表示这将是一个开端，将“避免首批购房者蜂拥进入市场”。

source_text: Prime Minister John Howard is bracing himself for a possible Wednesday interest rate rise which may decide the election.
target_text: 总理约翰·霍华德正在为的可能的周三加息做准备，这可能决定选举。

source_text: Police are investigating a shooting on Buffalo's East Side late Saturday night which left one person in critical condition at a local hospital.
target_text: 警方正在调查星期六晚上在布法罗东区发生的枪击事件，这起事件导致一名人员在当地一家医院处于危急状态。

source_text: Police say that witness reports indicate that the shooter then ran over the victim with a car and sped off Westbound on E. Utica.
target_text: 警方说，目击者的报告显示，枪手随后开着一辆汽车从受害者身上碾过，然后在东尤蒂卡街向西行驶。

source_text: No other details on the suspect or his vehicle were given.
target_text: 没有提供关于嫌疑人或其车辆的其他细节。

source_text: The victim was taken to Erie County Medical Center where he is undergoing treatment.
target_text: 受害者被送往伊利县医疗中心接受治疗。

source_text: The extent of his injuries has not yet been released, but he is listed in stable condition.
target_text: 他的伤势尚未缓解，但目前情况稳定。

source_text: Three nations in three continents have seen attention focused on high suicide rates this week.
target_text: 本周三大洲三个国家的注意力集中在高自杀率上。

source_text: A study found Scotland's suicide rate to be increasing away from neighbouring England, Russian press and politicians are examining the world's third-highest teen suicide rate, and new figures showed increasing Aboriginal children's suicides in Australia's Northern Territory.
target_text: 一项研究发现苏格兰的自杀率远远高于邻国英格兰，俄罗斯媒体和政界人士正在研究世界上第三高的青少年自杀率，新数据显示，澳大利亚北领地土著儿童的自杀率不断上升。
