source_text: The hostages said they were treated well and were not threatened with violence, Hansell said.
target_text: Hansell说道，人质表示他们受到善待并未受到暴力恐吓。

source_text: The same bank was robbed just 2 months ago on November 16, 2005.
target_text: 同一家银行在2个月前的2005年11月16日曾遭受抢劫。

source_text: Bangladesh pulled off a surprising victory over South Africa by 67 runs in the Super 8 phase of the World Cup at the Providence Stadium, Georgetown, Guyana.
target_text: 孟加拉国取得了令人惊叹的胜利，在圭亚那乔治城的普罗维登斯体育场举行的板球世界杯超级八强赛中以67分优势战胜南非队。

source_text: The U.S. armed forces detained five Iranians working at a "liaison office" located in Erbil, Iraq before dawn on Friday.
target_text: 美国武装部队于周五黎明前扣押了5名于伊拉克埃尔比勒市“联络办公室”工作的伊朗人。

source_text: Sources said that the U.S. forces first landed their helicopters around the building, then broke through the office's gate, disarmed the guards, confiscated some documents and certain objects, arrested five suspected terrorists, and then left for an undisclosed location.
target_text: 消息称美国军方使用直升机在大楼附近降落，破开了办公室大门，解除了安保的武装，没收了一些文件和相关物品，逮捕了5名犯罪分子嫌疑人并前往一个秘密地点。

source_text: However, there was no raid on the Iranian Consulate General as earlier reported.
target_text: 然而，根据早前报道伊朗总领事馆并无袭击情况。

source_text: Pentagon spokesman Bryan Whitman told Agence France-Presse that the building raided was "not a consulate or a government building", which appears to be confirmed by the Iraqi foreign minister, Hoshyar Zebari, who said the Iranians were working at an office that had government approval and was in the process of being approved as a consulate, but was not a Consulate nor the Iranian Consulate General.
target_text: 五角大楼发言人布莱恩・惠特曼向法国新闻社表示，伊拉克外交部长霍希亚尔・泽巴里似已确认突袭的大楼并非领事馆或政府大楼，其表示伊拉克政府已批准这些伊朗人在办公室工作，该办公室已被政府批准并在审批成为领事机构过程中，但并不是作为领事馆或伊朗总领事馆。

source_text: The US is strategically insisting that they raided a "liaison office" instead of a Consulate to avoid being found in violation of Article 36 of the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations.
target_text: 美国政府战略上坚持认为突袭的是“联络办公室”而不是领事馆，以此避免违反《维也纳领事关系公约》第36条条款。

source_text: Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Mikhail Kamynin said that the raid was absolutely unacceptable and was a violation of the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations.
target_text: 俄罗斯外交部长米哈伊尔·卡米宁表示该袭击是完全无法接受的，违背了《维也纳领事关系公约》。

source_text: The Kurdistan Regional Government also expressed their shock and disapproval of the raid.
target_text: 库尔德斯坦地方政府也表示未批准该次袭击并对此表示震惊。

source_text: On Thursday's hearing on Iraq, Senator Joseph Biden (D-Delware), chairman of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, told Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice that the Bush Administration did not have the authority to send U.S. troops on cross-border raids.
target_text: 在周四伊拉克的听证会上，特拉华州参议员参议院、对外关系委员会主席约瑟夫·拜登（D-Delware）向国务卿康多莉扎·赖斯表示布什政府没有权利派遣美国士兵在他国实施袭击。

source_text: Biden said, "I believe the present authorization granted the president to use force in Iraq does not cover that, and he does need congressional authority to do that."
target_text: 拜登说道，“我认为现在赋予总统的权利不包括在伊拉克使用武力，总统需要得到议会的授权。”

source_text: On Thursday morning, Iran's foreign ministry official sent a letter to Iraq's foreign ministry asking Iraq to stop the Bush Administration from interfering with Iraq-Iran relations, and has protested the raid on its liaison office.
target_text: 周四上午，伊朗外交部官方致信伊拉克外交部要求其停止布什政府干涉伊拉克与伊朗之间的关系，并对该次袭击联络办公室表示抗议。

source_text: The official said, "We expect the Iraqi government to take immediate measures to set the aforesaid individuals free and to condemn the U.S. troopers for the measure."
target_text: 其官方表示，“我们希望伊拉克政府立即采取措施释放上述伊朗公民并对美国的行为表示谴责”。

source_text: "Following up on the case and releasing the arrestees is a responsibility of primarily the Iraqi government and then the local government and officials of the Iraqi Kurdistan."
target_text: “跟进此次事件并释放被捕人员首先是伊拉克政府的责任，其次是当地伊拉克库尔德斯坦政府的责任。”

source_text: This past Tuesday, a United States federal judge ordered the popular video sharing website YouTube to hand over a record of every video that users have watched, including registered accounts and IPs.
target_text: 上周二，美国一位联邦法官要求热门视频分享网站YouTube公司提供观看每个视频的用户注册账户和IP地址。

source_text: Viacom, which owns several U.S. television networks such as MTV and Nickelodeon, launched a $1 billion lawsuit last year alleging that YouTube wasn't doing enough to stop its copyrighted material from appearing in over 160,000 unauthorized clips that have been viewed over 1.5 billion times.
target_text: 拥有例如MTV和尼克国际儿童频道等数个美国电视网络公司的维亚康姆公司去年以YouTube公司没有及时停止侵权文件导致未授权视频数量超过16万，总浏览量超过15亿次，而向其发起了10亿美元的诉讼。

source_text: Viacom argued that since they claimed that copyright material is more popular than user-made videos, they needed access to the information to strengthen the case, in which US District Court judge Louis L. Stanton agreed and ordered Google to turn over such information.
target_text: 维亚康姆争辩道，他们表明版权材料比用户自制的视频更受欢迎，他们需要得到这些信息来源去强调该情况，美国地方联邦法院法官路易斯·斯坦顿支持该观点并要求谷歌提供上述信息。

source_text: Google argued that this would cause privacy issues, but Stanton said it was just speculation.
target_text: 谷歌争辩这将会造成隐私问题，但是斯坦顿表示这只是谷歌的推测。

source_text: The Electronic Frontier Foundation, a San Francisco-based privacy advocate group, said the ruling was "a setback to privacy rights, and will allow Viacom to see what you are watching on YouTube." said EFF's senior staff attorney Kurt Opsahl.
target_text: 电子前线基金会是倡导保护个人隐私的组织，其高级职业律师科特奥普萨表示，该判决“将允许维亚康姆知道个人在Youtube上看了什么，是保护个人隐私权利的倒退”。

source_text: Viacom had also requested for the code used to search keywords for each video and access to Google's advertising database to see if Google was receiving revenue from ads from the alleged videos, but these requests were denied by the judge, arguing that code and ad data was too valuable.
target_text: 维亚康姆也要求搜索每个视频关键字的代码和谷歌广告数据库的权限来判断谷歌是否从可疑视频的广告中获利，但是这些要求被法官以代码和广告数据价值太高而驳回。

source_text: There are concerns that Google is violating the Digital Millennium Copyright Act which allows a video provider service to not to be sued if it removes copyrighted material.
target_text: 相关信息表明谷歌因允许视频提供者移去版权材料并免于起诉，这违反了《数字千年著作权法案》。

source_text: After a referendum, the Montenegro region of Serbia and Montenegro declares independence to form the new Republic of Montenegro.
target_text: 全民公投后，“塞尔维亚和黑山”的黑山地区宣布独立，成立新的黑山共和国。

source_text: "I am convinced Montenegro could be the next country from this region to join the European Union, after Romania, Bulgaria and Croatia, which are further along the process," says Prime Minister Milo Djukanovic, who has promoted Montenegro's independence.
target_text: 促成独立的黑山总理米洛·久卡诺维奇说道，“我确信黑山可以成为自罗马尼亚、保加利亚和克罗地亚后，此区域下一个加入欧盟的国家。在此进程中这些国家先我们一步”。

source_text: It is also predicted that Montenegro will join the United Nations in September.
target_text: 黑山也预计将在9月加入联合国。

source_text: The referendum, with an 86.3% voter turnout, had a 55.4% approval for the secession, which satisfies the European Union's minimum 55% approval.
target_text: 全民公投的投票率为百分之86.3，有百分之55.4支持退出塞尔维亚，满足欧盟百分之55的最低支持率要求。

source_text: Serbia reluctantly agreed to the split, and the European Union approved.
target_text: 塞尔维亚不情愿地同意两国分离，而欧盟则予以承认。

source_text: Despite expectations, there were no riots that night; however, early celebrations had occurred in the capital Podgorica based off of expected results.
target_text: 尽管之前有过预想，但是当晚没有任何暴乱；然而基于预期的结果，在首都波德戈里察有提早的庆祝活动。

source_text: This is the first time Montenegro has been independent since 1916, when it became a part of Austro-Hungary.
target_text: 这是自1916年黑山加入奥匈帝国以来第一次独立。

source_text: Soon Serbia, Croatia and Slovenia together formed "Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenians", which later changed the name into Kingdom Yugoslavia.
target_text: 塞尔维亚、克罗地亚和斯洛文尼亚随即共同成立“塞尔维亚、克罗地亚、斯洛文尼亚共同王国”，其后更名为南斯拉夫王国。

source_text: In 1991 and 1992 four of six Yugoslavian republics declared independence but two, Serbia and Montenegro, remained together.
target_text: 在1991年和1992年，6个南斯拉夫共和国中的4个宣布独立，但塞尔维亚和黑山仍旧维持合并。

source_text: Each republic had separate anthems, laws, and currencies and their joint parliament did not meet very often.
target_text: 每个共和国都有其独立的国歌、法律和货币，而且他们的联合议会也不是经常见面。

source_text: The lead singer of Boston, Brad Delp was found dead in his house alone last Friday.
target_text: 上周五，波士顿乐队的领唱，布莱德·戴尔普被发现独自死在家中。

source_text: The Atkinson police have stated that there was no "foul play" involved, and the cause was still under investigation by the medical examiner.
target_text: 阿特金森警方声明表示，没有他杀嫌疑，而法医仍在调查死因当中。

source_text: After the death, the bands website went down and was replaced with the message: "We just lost the nicest guy in rock and roll."
target_text: 在他死亡后，乐队网站关闭并换为如下信息，“我们失去了最好的摇滚歌手”。

source_text: Delp joined Boston in the ealry 70's after meeting with guitarist, songwriter and producer Tom Scholz.
target_text: 戴尔普在70年代初期遇到吉他手、作曲家和制作人汤姆·科尔兹后加入波士顿乐队。

source_text: Their first album, which was self titled, was a huge success.
target_text: 以乐队名字命名的首张专辑，获得了巨大的成功。

source_text: The album had hits on it such as "Long Time" and "More than a Feeling".
target_text: 专辑中打榜歌曲包括“Long Time”和”More than a Feeling”等。

source_text: Delp left the band in 1991, and was replaced by Fran Cosmo.
target_text: 戴尔普于1991年离开乐队，由弗兰·科斯莫接替位置。

source_text: Delp rejoined the band later for the Walk On tour, and shared vocal duties with Cosmo.
target_text: 戴尔普后来因巡演会而重新加入乐队，并与科斯莫一同担任乐队主唱。

source_text: A new album with Delp singing was reported to have been in the making, but no release date was ever given.
target_text: 据报道，一张由戴尔普主唱的新专辑正在制作中，但未曾提及发行日期。

source_text: Amidst ongoing Israeli bombings of Gaza, with the death toll of the bombardments up to 537 with another 2,500 people wounded, UN food agencies again warned that the people of Gaza are facing a heavy humanitarian crisis.
target_text: 被以色列炮火包围的加沙地区，因轰炸造成的死亡数字上升到537名，另有2500人受伤，联合国食品署再次告诫加沙人民正面临着严峻的人道主义危机。

source_text: "The current situation in Gaza is appalling, and many basic food items are no longer available on the market," Said Christine van Nieuwenhuyse, the World Food Program's (WFP) representative in the Palestinian territory, in a statement that was released on Friday.
target_text: 据世界粮食计划署巴勒斯坦区域代表克里斯汀·范·尼乌文胡斯在周五发表的报道，“现在加沙的情形恶劣不堪，很多基本的食物已经无法在市场上找到”。

source_text: "This area ... is one of the poorest and most heavily affected by the recent conflict," she added.
target_text: 她补充道，“这个区域现在已经是受冲突影响最严重和最贫乏的区域之一”。

source_text: Struggling Gazan hospitals say that they are completely out of even the most basic medical supplies and have little or no capacity to deal with further casualties.
target_text: 苦苦挣扎的加沙地区医院表达，他们已经用尽了所有的基本医疗供给，仅能供少数或没有能力对未来的伤员进行救治。

source_text: In addition, Israeli ground forces entered Gaza on Saturday causing an immediate spike in casualties and even attacks on the hospitals and paramedics themselves.
target_text: 另外，以色列的地面部队于周六进入加沙时立即造成伤亡人数猛增，其甚至向医院及医护人员发起进攻。

source_text: As sewage runs through the streets, many Gazans are trying to flee the area by storming the border with Egypt, a move which Egyptian police blocked on Sunday and are planning to do so again today as Egyptian leaders ordered their policemen to open fire on Gazans trying to flee into Egypt.
target_text: 街道上遍布着污物，很多加沙人民寄希望冲击埃及边界网逃离加沙，而埃及领导人要求警方随时可以向企图逃往埃及的人加沙人民开枪，埃及警方在周日迅速在隔离边界区域作出部署并计划今天再次实施。

source_text: Hasan Khalaf, Gaza's assistant deputy health minister, described the ongoing assault on Gaza as "an Israeli massacre".
target_text: 加沙卫生部副部长助理哈桑哈拉夫形容对加沙的持续袭击是“一场以色列的屠杀”。

source_text: "There is no comparison between what we have and what [Israel] are doing to us."
target_text: “以色列对我们做的和我们现有的完全没有可比性”。

source_text: "The international community are standing unable to help us, and yet we know they have been helping Israel for tens of years."
target_text: “国际组织仍保持无法帮助我们的态度，而我们都知道他们已经帮助了以色列数十年。”

source_text: Bolessuaf, 86, likes to read the card written in Polish that he received from his cousin, the Pope.
target_text: 现年86岁的Bolessuaf喜欢阅读他从堂兄教皇那里收到的用波兰语写的卡片。

source_text: "A great man, who always fought for the good of the others," he adds.
target_text: “一个总想着他人优点的好人”，他补充道。

source_text: The cousins got very sad when they heard that the Pope was gone.
target_text: 当堂兄弟们得知教皇去世时非常伤心。

source_text: "To me, he seems to be a brother, more than my own brother ," said Isidoro.
target_text: Isidoro说道，“对于我来说，他比我的亲兄弟更亲。”

source_text: João said about the Pope: "I think he did the work what should be done."
target_text: Joao谈论教皇时说道，“我觉得他完成了应该完成的伟业”。

source_text: He added: "It is like to lose a father, I am very sad".
target_text: 他补充道：“我就像失去了一位父亲，实在太伤心了。”

source_text: According to Folha de São Paulo, Brazilian government invited João to take part in the funeral of the Pope.
target_text: 根据圣保罗业报报道，巴西政府邀请了Joao参加教皇的葬礼。

source_text: He declined saying that he is afraid of flying in airplanes.
target_text: 他因害怕乘坐飞机而谢绝了邀请。

source_text: He succumbed to injuries suffered when a young police officer allegedly beat him into a coma earlier in the month while in a holding cell reserved for the drunk and disorderly.
target_text: 他死于受伤严重不治，几个月前，在专为醉鬼和扰乱治安人员提供的拘留室中，据说一名年轻的警官殴打他至昏迷。

source_text: The injuries included severe damage to many of his internal organs.
target_text: 伤情包括他的很多内脏器官受损严重。

source_text: Authorities identified this little-known reporter who specialized in economics as Konstantin Popov.
target_text: 官方确认了这个鲜为人知的记者是经济专业的康斯坦丁·波波夫。

source_text: Popov was one of the cofounders of a small regional newspaper publisher and a local magazine called Tema.
target_text: 波波夫是当地一家小型报纸发行商和Tema杂志的联合创始人之一。

source_text: In a country where police brutality and corruption—especially against journalists—is not uncommon, the editor-in-chief of Tema, Konstantin Karpachyov, said it was unlikely Popov's murder was in any way related to his work.
target_text: Tema的总编辑Konstantin Karpachyov表示、在一个警察残忍且腐败，尤其针对记者的国度，波波夫的死与他的职业不太可能没有关系。

source_text: However, Karpachyov went on to say that, "This could happen to absolutely anyone."
target_text: 然而，Karpachyov继续说道：“这当然可能发生在任何人身上。”

source_text: "The only thing different about this case is that he happened to be a journalist, so it became a high-profile public case."
target_text: “关于此事唯一的区别在于他发生在一个记者身上，所以这将会成为一个引人注意的公共事件”。

source_text: "But the same thing happens every day," said Svetlana Gannushkina, of Russia's Civic Assistance committee.
target_text: 俄罗斯公民援助委员会的斯维特拉娜·冈努西奇娜说道，“但是同样的事情每天都在发生”。

source_text: "Usually the cases are just closed down because there's no evidence, nobody testifies, and it's impossible to get to the bottom of it."
target_text: “通常这样的案件因为没有证据，没有证人，不可能调查清楚而只能中止”。

source_text: Upon learning Popov's identity, numerous members of the state-controlled media strongly criticized the police for their passive response to the actions allegedly committed by one of their own.
target_text: 当得知波波夫的身份时，很多国有媒体人强烈指责警方对于他们队伍中一人疑似所作所为的消极回应。

source_text: Following which, news conferences were called, and before long Popov's case began to draw national attention.
target_text: 紧接着，召开新闻会议后不久，波波夫事件开始吸引了国民的关注。

source_text: This resulted in the holding cell where Popov's beating occurred being closed down.
target_text: 这导致波波夫殴打事件的拘留所处于关闭状态。

source_text: In addition, the deputy police chief resigned as well as supervisor of the precinct in question.
target_text: 另外，负责该区域的警局副局长宣布辞职。

source_text: The suspected officer, Alexei Mitayev, was dismissed from the force, arrested, and is said to have since confessed to this crime.
target_text: 嫌疑人警官Alexei Mitayev据说因为承认了罪行，已经被开除出警队并被逮捕。

source_text: Mitayev cited that "stress due to family problems" is what led to his actions against Popov.
target_text: Mitayev表示是“家庭问题引发的压力”导致他对波波夫实施了暴力。

source_text: The chairman of the Tomsk branch of the Union of Journalists of Russia said that a source close to the investigation told him that Popov was not only beaten but was also "tortured" and "violated" with a foreign object.
target_text: 俄罗斯记者联合会托木斯克分会主席表示，据调查有消息表明波波夫不仅仅是被殴打，还遭到使用某异物施加“虐待”和“侵犯”。

source_text: "Hands off journalists!" the journalist union said in a statement on its website.
target_text: 记者联合会在其网站上声明：“不要向记者下手”。

source_text: According to the United States-based Committee to Protect Journalists, as far as they know, "since 2000, at least seventeen Russian journalists have been killed due to their work, and the killers have been convicted in only one case."
target_text: 根据美国记者保护委员会，正如我们所知的，自2000年以来，每年有超过17名俄罗斯记者因为他们的工作而被杀害，而只有一起案件找到了凶手。

source_text: President Dmitry Medvedev said that such police misconduct was not only angering the Russian public, but was also undermining the state's authority.
target_text: 梅德韦杰夫总统表示警局的这种不端行为不仅使俄罗斯民众愤怒，也有损于国家权威。

source_text: He called for comprehensive reform and ordered the Interior Ministry to cut its staff by one-fifth by 2012.
target_text: 他要求全面改革并命令内政部在截止2012年的第一个五年计划中削减员工。

source_text: In the "2008 Taipei City New Year Countdown Party", several local and foreign media focused on the fireworks of the Taipei 101 due to the notability of the skyscraper world-wide.
target_text: 在2008年台北市新年倒数晚会上，一些当地和国外媒体因台北101作为世界级的摩天大楼而关注其烟花表演。

source_text: After some criticism from government executives because some wordmarks by sponsors appeared on the Taipei 101, the Taipei Financial Center (owner of Taipei 101) decided to set up 12,000 sparklers 500 meters tall from the 34th floor to the top of the tower on the 101st floor.
target_text: 在政府部门批评一些赞助商的名字标志出现在台北101之后，台北金融中心（台北101的所有者）决定施放12000发烟花，烟花从第34层到顶楼的101层共500米高。

source_text: According to TV channel TVBS, the light of "Love Taiwan" wordmarks accidentally appeared before the celebration while President of the Republic of China Shui-bian Chen addressed in the "2008 Dream More Kaohsiung" New Year Celebration in Kaohsiung City.
target_text: 根据电视频道TVBS报道，当中华民国总统陈水扁在高雄市的“2008年追梦高雄”新年典礼演讲时，“爱台湾”字样的灯光突然在庆典活动举办前出现。

source_text: After the Taipei City Government became aware of this accident and remonstrated against current Chairman of Taipei 101 Diana Chen, the Taipei 101 re-lighted the wordmark after successfully celebrating New Year's.
target_text: 在台北市政府发现这一事故并告诫当时台北101的董事长陈敏薰后，台北101在成功地庆祝新年典礼之后又重新点亮该字样。

source_text: Current Mayor of Taipei Lung-pin Hau regretted the incident and hoped the Executive Yuan could notify the government in the future of the incident.
target_text: 时任台北市长的郝龙斌对此意外感到遗憾，并希望以后行政院可以将此类意外告知政府。

source_text: The Minister of the Government Information Office Jhy-wey Hsieh complained in the City's Government of the sponsorships.
target_text: 行政院新闻局长谢志伟就赞助一事对市政府表示不满。

source_text: The 2008 Taipei City New Year Countdown Party was apparently "faded" with political factor.
target_text: 2008年台北新年倒数晚会看来因政治因素而显得黯然失色。

source_text: At least eight construction workers have died and thirteen more are injured after a building collapsed during construction in Qiuzhigou Village, a suburb of China's Wuhan City.
target_text: 中国武汉市郊区的邱之沟村一在建大楼倒塌，导致至少8名建筑工人死亡，13人以上受伤。

source_text: It is unclear how many more if any are trapped as the project's coordinator fled and is being sought by police.
target_text: 项目负责人已逃逸并被警方通缉，现不清楚是否有更多人被困。

source_text: The collapse occurred at 5 p.m. local time yesterday and reduced the four-story structure to a five-metre pile of rubble.
target_text: 坍塌发生在昨天当地时间下午5点，4层结构坍塌为5米高的碎石堆。

source_text: The building was a private residence and was illegal as authorities had not been informed of it.
target_text: 该建筑是私人住宅，建造时没有通知当地部门，属于违法建筑。

source_text: Its location in an area accessible only via narrow alleys is hampering search and rescue efforts as heavy equipment such as cranes is having difficulty reaching the scene.
target_text: 坍塌地点位于仅有窄巷子通达的地区，起重机等重型设备很难到达现场，因此影响了搜救进度。

source_text: Around 100 rescuers continue to pick through the rubble in the rain.
target_text: 大约100名搜救人员仍在雨中翻开碎石堆继续搜救。

source_text: This is an excerpt translation of a text found on the German wikipedia site, with an update.
target_text: 这是来自德国维基百科网站更新后的某篇文章的摘录翻译。

source_text: The roof over the local ice and tennis court crashed shortly after the end of the official skating time on 2 Jan 05, at about 16.50 hrs.
target_text: 2005年1月2日约16点50分，在官方滑冰时间结束后，当地的滑冰中心上方的屋顶突然塌陷。

source_text: At the time, there were about 50 people inside, mostly families with children.
target_text: 当时，有大约50人在里面，大部分是带着孩子的家庭。

source_text: By 10 pm, five had been found dead, one child among them.
target_text: 截至10点，有5人遇难，其中包括一名儿童。

source_text: 20 to 25 people have been injured, just as many are missing.
target_text: 20至25人受伤，更多人处于失踪状态。

source_text: The reason for the cave-in of the roof was most likely massive snowfalls.
target_text: 屋顶塌陷的原因很有可能是因为大量的降雪。

source_text: Earlier that afternoon, measurements had been taken to determine its stability.
target_text: 当天下午之前，曾采取措施对其稳定性做过确认。

source_text: In an investigation reported on first by Wikinews, Wikileaks today revealed another chapter in the story of the Standard Operations Procedure (SOP) manual for the Camp Delta facility at Guantanamo Bay.
target_text: 在一份维基百科第一手报道的调查报告中指出，今天维基解密透露了关于关塔那摩湾监狱三角洲营区标准操作程序（SOP）指南的另一则故事。

source_text: The latest documents they have received are the details of the 2004 copy of the manual signed off by Major General Geoffrey D. Miller of the U.S. Southern Command.
target_text: 他们最新收到的文档是由美国南方司令部少将杰弗里·D·米勒签署的2004年指南的副本详情。

source_text: This is following on from the earlier leaking of the 2003 version.
target_text: 这是继早先2003年版本泄漏后的文档。

source_text: Wikileaks passed this document to people they consider experts in the field to carry out an analysis trying to validate it.
target_text: 维基解密将文档交给他们认为是该领域专家的人，以进行分析，尝试证实该文档。

source_text: Following this, they set out to assess what had changed between 2003 and 2004; including attempts to link publicly known incidents with changes to the manual.
target_text: 这之后，他们开始着手评估2003年和2004年之间的变动；包括试图将公开已知的事件与指南的改动相关联。

source_text: The American Civil Liberties Union had previously made a request to view and obtain copies of the same document, but was denied access to them.
target_text: 美国公民自由联盟先前曾请求查看并取得该文档的副本，但被拒绝接触文档。

source_text: One of the first notable changes to the document relates to the detainees themselves.
target_text: 文档中的显著变化之一与囚犯本身有关。

source_text: Rules are now posted around the camp in detainees' languages.
target_text: 现在规则以囚犯的母语张贴在营内。

source_text: Of concern to groups such as Amnesty International who campaign for the camp's closure, or Human Rights Watch concerned about prisoner handling under the prisoner of war aspects of the Geneva Convention, is the fact that policy for newly admitted detainees still allows for up to 4 weeks where access to the detainee by the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) may be denied.
target_text: 尽管受到各团体的关注，例如国际特赦等组织为关闭监狱营地做出努力，或是人权观察组织顾虑到战俘在《日内瓦公约》中有关战俘方面规定下的待遇，事实上，对于新认定囚犯的政策仍规定，可以拒绝国际红十字会（ICRC）对囚犯的接触，而此期间长达4周。

source_text: In addition, guards are not to allow ICRC staff to pass mail to detainees.
target_text: 此外，警卫不允许国际红十字会工作人员将新信件交给囚犯。

source_text: A new process has been formed which allows guards to determine whether or not a detainee receives awards, or is punished.
target_text: 新的程序规定，允许由警卫来确定囚犯是否可以获得奖励或受到惩罚。

source_text: The form is called a GTMO Form 508-1 (pictured to the right).
target_text: 该表格被称为GTMO格式508-1（见右图）。

source_text: According to the manual, the form "is used to determine which rewards the detainee will lose or gain," but "special rewards" can also be earned, outside of the process.
target_text: 根据指南，该表格“用来确认犯人将失去或获得哪些奖励“，但在此程序外，囚犯还可以获得“特别奖励”。

source_text: Another special reward is a roll of toilet paper, but the detainee cannot share it with others.
target_text: 另一个特殊奖励是一卷厕纸，但囚犯不能与他人分享。

source_text: Doing so will result in "punishment" and confiscation of the roll.
target_text: 这样做将会导致“惩罚”并没收厕纸。

source_text: If the detainee already has a roll of toilet paper, he is not allowed to have another.
target_text: 如果犯人已经有了一卷厕纸，那他将不允许再得到另一卷。

source_text: "Guards need to ensure that the detainee doesn't receive additional toilet paper when the detainee already has it."
target_text: “警卫需要确认，当囚犯已经有厕纸时，禁止得到额外的厕纸。”

source_text: "The amount given to the detainee will be the same amount as normally distributed to the detainee," states the manual.
target_text: 根据指南记载，“奖励给囚犯的数量将与正常发放的数量相同”。

source_text: No matter how bad a detainee may act, "haircuts will never be used as punitive action" against them, but they can have hair removed for health reasons.
target_text: 无论囚犯表现多么恶劣，“永远不会以剪头发来作为惩罚”，但他们可能因健康原因而被剪掉头发。

source_text: "If a detainee has committed an offense that requires segregation time, even if a segregation cell is not available, the detainee will receive a shave and a haircut for hygiene and medical reasons."
target_text: “如果囚犯承认犯规而需要隔离一段时间，虽然没有可用的隔离室，但囚犯将因卫生医疗的原因而被剃须理发。”

source_text: "If the detainee is IRFed, the haircut and shave will follow the decontamination process," adds the manual.
target_text: 指南补充道，“如果囚犯曾是IRF成员，在清洗过后也将剃须理发。”

source_text: Infractions such as spitting, throwing water at, or attempting to urinate on guards appear as explicitly listed cases where pepper spray may not be used.
target_text: 发生随地吐痰、扔水或企图在警卫面前小便等明确列明的违规行为时，不得使用胡椒喷剂。

source_text: Extensive decontamination procedures are included in the document, including immediately calling for a medical check on any detainee exposed to pepper spray.
target_text: 文档中记载了额外的清洗流程，包括任何囚犯被胡椒喷雾喷到时，立即接受医疗检查。

source_text: As a counter to the clearer instructions on use of pepper spray, Wikileaks asserts that many of the stricter rules for guards (referred to as Military Police or MPs in the 2003 manual) aim to reduce fraternisation that may improve detainee morale and adversely influence any interrogation process.
target_text: 作为使用胡椒喷雾说明的反例，维基解密断言，许多更加严格的警卫规则（参照军事警察或2003年手册的“军事警察”），旨在减少囚犯斗志高昂和对审讯过程有不利影响的情况发生。

source_text: Guards are informed in the manual not to take personal mail and parcels within the detention blocks or at any other duty stations.
target_text: 指南要求警卫，不能把个人信件和包裹带到囚犯牢房或其他工作地点。

source_text: All electronic devices except issued materiel are prohibited, and guards may face disciplinary action should they keep detainees apprised of current affairs or discuss issues in their personal lives.
target_text: 除派发的物资以外严禁所有的电子设备，如果告知犯人时事或讨论犯人的个人生活问题，警卫将可能面临纪律处分。

source_text: Additional restrictions on the detainees' chaplain are included in the revised document.
target_text: 对囚犯的牧师的额外限制都包含在修改后的文档中。

source_text: Wikileaks speculated that many of these changes might have stemmed from the widely publicised case of James Yee.
target_text: 维基解密推测，这些改变可能源于被广泛宣传的James Yee事件。

source_text: Captain Yee, a West Point graduate, served at the Guantanamo Bay base as a Muslim chaplain to the detainees and received two Distinguished Service medals for his work.
target_text: 西点军校毕业的Yee上尉曾在关塔那摩湾基地担任囚犯的穆斯林牧师，并因他的工作获得两枚卓越服役勋章。

source_text: Following discovery of a list of detainees and interrogators by U.S. Customs in Florida Yee was charged with sedition, aiding the enemy, spying, espionage, and failure to obey a general order.
target_text: 在美国佛罗里达海关发现一份囚犯及审讯人员的名单后，Yee被指控煽动、帮助敌人、从事间谍活动及未能遵守士兵守则。

source_text: Eventually all charges were dropped with national security concerns being raised should evidence be released.
target_text: 最终出于公布证据对国家安全的考虑，所有指控均被撤销。

source_text: The most notable changes surrounding the role of the chaplain include its removal as a permanent position on the facility's Library Working group and its exclusion from the decision process on appropriate detainee reading material.
target_text: 围绕牧师角色最引人注目的变化包括，其不再作为图书馆工作小组的永久成员并无法决定哪些是囚犯适合阅读的材料。

source_text: Wikileaks contacted lawyers representing detainees in the camp to perform their own analysis.
target_text: 维基解密联系营内囚犯的代理律师来表达自己的分析。

source_text: Duplicate books are required for the individual four camps to prevent covert use of books to communicate between camps.
target_text: 复制的书籍各自分属四个营地，以避免营地之间暗中使用书籍进行沟通。

source_text: Periodicals, dictionaries, language instruction books, technology or medical update information, and geography were additions to the prohibited material.
target_text: 期刊、字典、语言指导书，最新医学、技术信息和地理书被增添为违禁物品。

source_text: Instructions indicate such books must be returned to the source or donor.
target_text: 指令显示这些书必须退回到源头或捐赠者手中。

source_text: A lengthy addition details rules to follow in the event of an escape or escape attempt.
target_text: 对于逃狱和企图逃狱的事件，有很多额外的详细规则。

source_text: Laced throughout this procedure is an emphasis on having any such incident fully documented and - wherever possible - filmed.
target_text: 整个流程贯穿强调，对于任何事件都完整记录并尽可能拍下。

source_text: The procedure is explicit in how to recapture an escaped detainee with minimal use of force.
target_text: 该流程明确说明如何以最少的警力重新逮捕一名逃狱的囚犯。

source_text: One additional procedure covers the admission of ambulances to the main base area.
target_text: 另一个流程涵盖了主要基地的救护车许可情况。

source_text: However, additional steps are to be taken for "MRE Sanitization"; supply personnel must remove anything that can damage waste disposal systems— presumably a military term for toilets.
target_text: 然而，即食的餐食需要额外的卫生处理步骤；供应人员必须除掉任何可能损害废物处理系统——大概是军方用语表达厕所的东西。

source_text: Under normal camp conditions, detainees should be fed hot meals as opposed to MREs, but no details on the variety of menu are included.
target_text: 营区正常条件下，囚犯应该吃热饭而不是吃即食食物，但关于菜单种类未标明细节。

source_text: US Southern Command passed a query on to Rick Haupt (Commander, U.S. Navy Director of Public Affairs, Joint Task Force at Guantanamo) who responded that "questions were forwarded along with a request to authenticate the leaked document; a response is pending."
target_text: 美国南方司令部询问里克·豪普特（美国海军公共事务司关塔那摩联合特遣部队指挥官），他回复：“问题与对泄露文档进行鉴定的要求已转交；回复待定。”

source_text: At this time no response to emails has been received from the ICRC or Human Rights Watch.
target_text: 直到现在，国际红十字会和人权观察组织的电子邮件并未收到任何回复。

source_text: The Pentagon has requested that the document be removed from Wikileaks because "information with the FOUO (For Official Use Only) label is not approved for release to the public."
target_text: 五角大楼要求维基解密删除该文件，因为“具有FOUO（仅供官方使用）标签的信息不允许向公众发布。”

source_text: They then state that the document can be "made available through a Freedom Of Information Act request through official channels."
target_text: 接着他们表示，“经由信息自由法的要求，文档可以通过官方渠道查询。”

source_text: Two weeks ago, on February 1st, it was the second day of the national environmental Focus the Nation teach-in.
target_text: 两周前的2月1日是国家环境焦点座谈会的第二天。

source_text: One of these events, which took place at the same time at other educational institutions across the country, took place in the city of Lynn at the campus of North Shore Community College.
target_text: 其中一个项目在林恩市的北岸社区学院的校园举行，同时也在全国其他教育机构举办。

source_text: One of Lynn's two representatives, Robert Fennell, also attended; the other representative Steven Walsh sent an aide.
target_text: 林恩的两位代表之一罗伯特·范内尔也出席活动，另一位代表斯蒂芬·沃尔什则派助手出席。

source_text: The representatives for the nearby cities of Salem and Beverly, John Keenan and Mary Grant along with various local area mayors and city councilors also attended the event.
target_text: 附近萨勒姆市和贝弗利市的代表约翰·基南和玛丽·格兰特与各市市长和市议员也出席了活动。

source_text: John F. Kerry, the senator for Massachusetts was supposed to attend but could not due to voting on the economic stimulus package in Washington D.C..
target_text: 计划出席的马萨诸塞州参议员约翰·F·凯瑞，因在华盛顿特区参与经济刺激综合法案的投票而未能出席。

source_text: However, Senator Kerry did record a video statement DVD for the event in which he addressed the gathered crowd.
target_text: 然而，凯瑞参议员确实为该活动录制了DVD，内容为他在聚集群众前发表的演讲。

source_text: Senator McGee started things off by talking about the need to recreate the North Shore Technical High School to include a focus on environmental jobs and the need to improve the Essex Agricultural and Technical High School which is deteriorating, but is known for it's agricultural teaching which would help to save the dwindling farming areas north of Boston.
target_text: 参议员麦基以谈论需要重建北岸技术高中以关注环保就业作为开头，并表示需要改进以农业教学闻名但日益衰微的埃塞克斯农业和技术高中，这将有助于挽救波士顿北部日益减少的农业地区。

source_text: McGee urged people that should get more involved with their local farming co-ops and that farmland needs to be recognized and redeveloped.
target_text: 麦基鼓励人们更多地参与到当地的农业合作活动中，推动人们重新认识和发展农田。

source_text: He noted that obesity in young people is a problem and that schools are developing partnerships with local farms to provide more healthy meals and to show students whats going on at their local farm.
target_text: 他指出，年轻人的肥胖成为问题，而学校正与当地农场合作以提供更多健康的食物，并向学生展示当地农场的现况。

source_text: Representative Keenan commended the college for holding this dialogue and Al Gore along with his movie, An Inconvenient Truth.
target_text: 基南代表对学院开展对话以及阿尔·戈尔和他的电影《难以忽视的真相》表示称赞。

source_text: Keenan noted the need for Salem's coal-fired power station for the need to switch to clean coal.
target_text: 基南指出，萨勒姆的燃煤发电站需要更换为清洁煤。

source_text: Walsh aide's brought up the fact he is committed to ending paper waste at the Massachusetts State House.
target_text: 沃尔什的助手表示，他将致力于停止马萨诸塞州政府办公室的纸张浪费。

source_text: The city council president from Chelsea, Roseann Bongiovanni, who is also the associate executive director of the local community organization, the Chelsea Collaborative, asked the various reasons for the crowd in why they became concerned about global warming.
target_text: 切尔西市议会主席，当地社区组织“合作切尔西”的联合执行董事罗森·博吉奥瓦尼向群众提问，他们是基于哪些理由而开始担心全球变暖问题？

source_text: The audience noted the melting of ice sheets, air quality, Hurricane Katrina and Al Gore.
target_text: 听众的回答是：融化的冰盖，空气质量，卡特里娜飓风以及阿尔·戈尔。

source_text: Bongiovanni then noted that Chelsea and neighboring East Boston have no green space or waterfront due the industrialization of both areas, noting that 100% of the jet fuel for planes at Logan Airport, 70% to 80% of heating oil and that the trucks delivering the oil are spewing diesel.
target_text: 博吉奥瓦尼随后指出，切尔西和邻近的东波士顿这两个地区由于工业化已经没有绿地或海滨，并指出包括在洛根机场百分之百的飞机航空燃油，百分之70到80的取暖油和运送油的卡车都排放柴油。

source_text: She also noted the large salt pile in Chelsea used for the deicing of highways in the Commonwealth and said that it is located there "illegally."
target_text: 她还指出，切尔西堆放了大量用于联邦高速公路除冰的盐堆，而它们是“非法地”被放置于该地。

source_text: She further noted the company, Energy Management Inc., behind the controversial Cape Wind project, proposed building a diesel power plant across the street from a Chelsea elementary school and that air quality in Chelsea is bad.
target_text: 她进一步指出，能源管理公司，这个隐藏于具争议的海角风能项目背后的公司，已计划在切尔西小学对面建造一个柴油发电厂，而切尔西的空气质量已经很不好了。

source_text: She closed her dialogue by noting that "Global warming does not recognize boundaries."
target_text: 她以“全球变暖无分界”来结束了对话。

source_text: Mary Grant said she was interested in hearing ideas and noted the redeveloping of Beverly's high school to include more solar panels and a new wind turbine and that the school would be powered by 50% of it.
target_text: 玛丽·格兰特表示，她对听取大家的想法很感兴趣，并表示重建中的贝弗利高中将拥有更多的太阳能电池板和一个新的风力涡轮机，学校百分之50的能源将由此供应。

source_text: Robert Fenell, the owner of Lynn's Capitol Diner who is notable for keeping chickens at the establishment located in downtown Lynn just two blocks away from the college noted that people should start going organic and going back to nature, that people should switch to more energy efficient lighting and grow gardens in their backyard.
target_text: 林恩Capitol Diner餐厅的老板罗伯特·范内尔以将养鸡场建在离学院两个街区远的林恩市中心而闻名。他表示，人们应该开始体验有机生活，回归自然，并且转而使用能源效率更高的灯光及在自家后院种植花园。

source_text: After Fennell spoke it was time for questions and answers, and questions were given by various audiences members including Mannion himself, who asked about the MBTA's Blue Line and rapid transit and others asking various questions such wither or not to include a green curriculum in state education or asking for the politicians to talk more on some of their positions.
target_text: 范内尔结束发言后是问答环节，不同的听众成员提出了问题，其中包括曼尼翁本人，他询问了有关马萨诸塞州海湾交通局蓝线和快速运输的问题，而其他人则问了诸如州教育在绿色课程方面是否凋零？或是要求政治家们谈论更多关于他们自身立场等问题。

source_text: After questions and answers finished, the video statement from John Kerry began to play.
target_text: 在问答结束后，约翰·凯瑞的视频演讲开始播放。

source_text: Kerry noted that there are still skeptics of global warming and climate change in Congress who "test the science" despite the efforts and research of Al Gore and the United Nations and noting that "the White House is the last place for change."
target_text: 凯瑞指出，尽管阿尔·戈尔和联合国作出了努力和研究，但在国会上仍有人怀疑全球变暖和气候变化，想要“检验科学”。他并且指出：“白宫是最后改变的地方”。

source_text: He then went on to say that the world needed a new international treaty on climate change and noted that America is horrendous when it comes to energy efficiency.
target_text: 他接着指出，世界需要一个新的关于气候变化的国际性条约，并指出美国在能源效率上表现可怕。

source_text: Kerry also noted that the Bush administration resisted the change and the points of the climate conference in Bali; "Luckily, time is almost up," added Kerry.
target_text: 凯瑞也指出，布什政府反对巴厘岛气候会议上的观点及变化；凯瑞补充道，“幸运的是，时间快结束了”。

source_text: Kerry went on to mention the need for massive new research on new energy and capturing carbon and noted he was working with Alaska's senator, Ted Stevens on pushing for sequestering plants.
target_text: 凯瑞接着提到大量关于新能源和获取碳的新研究的必要性，并表示他与阿拉斯加参议员特德·史蒂文在推动植物隔离。

source_text: Kerry continued the theme of environmental conservation and change by topping off his statement by reminding the crowd of first Earth Day and how it lead to the creation of the Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act, Endangered Species Act and the Environmental Protection Agency and it noted it happened because of people's actions.
target_text: 凯瑞继续阐述环境保护与变化的主题，并在结论中提醒听众，是人类的行动创造出第一个地球日，并由其导向清洁空气法案、清洁水法案、濒危物种法案和美国环境保护署的成立。

source_text: Tierney finished off the speech by noting the need for high risk energy research in the style of DARPA so we can better compete against the "Chinas and Japans."
target_text: 蒂尔尼最后指出，需要以美国国防部高级研究计划局的方式进行高风险能源研究，以便能够更好地与“中国和日本”竞争，并以此结束演讲。

source_text: He also called for more green-collar jobs and noted his work on last year's Green Jobs Act.
target_text: 他还呼吁更多的绿领工作并提到了去年他在绿色就业法案的努力。

source_text: The United Stated Department of Justice has asked for corruption charges against former Alaska Senator Ted Stevens to be dropped because evidence was withheld from the defense team by the original prosecutors.
target_text: 美国司法部对前阿拉斯加参议员特德·史蒂文斯贪污腐败的指控已经撤销，因为辩方提供的证据被原检察官扣留。

source_text: The Justice Department has stated that they will not retry Stevens.
target_text: 司法部表示他们将不会重审史蒂文斯。

source_text: In a statement, US Attorney General Eric Holder said, "After careful review, I have concluded that certain information should have been provided to the defense for use at trial."
target_text: 声明中提出，美国司法部长埃里克·霍尔德表示，“经过仔细的调查，我认定某些信息可以提供给辩方在法庭上使用”。

source_text: "In light of this conclusion, and in consideration of the totality of the circumstances of this particular case, I have determined that it is in the interest of justice to dismiss the indictment and not proceed with a new trial."
target_text: “根据本结论并考虑到整个案子的特殊情况，我决定驳回诉讼请求并不再开庭审理。”

source_text: Stevens was convicted in October on seven felony counts of lying on senate disclosure forms about gifts, largely in the form of free renovations to his home, received from an oil service company; his conviction is thought to have been a large factor in his November electoral defeat to former Anchorage mayor Mark Begich, the current junior Senator from Alaska.
target_text: 10月份，史蒂文斯被控在担任参议员期间犯有7项罪行，包括接受大部分是以免费翻修他房子形式所进行的油服公司赠礼。这项指控被认为对他在11月的选举中被前任安克雷奇市长、现任阿拉斯加资浅参议员马克·贝吉奇击败起到重要因素。

source_text: Stevens immediately appealed his conviction and has maintained his innocence.
target_text: 史蒂文斯立即对他的指控表示上诉并坚称自己的清白。

source_text: The prosecution case has met with a number of procedural difficulties, with US District Court judge Emmet G. Sullivan holding the prosecution in contempt in March for failing to turn over documents concerning an FBI whistleblower's reports of mishandling of the case.
target_text: 这场起诉遇到了很多程序上的困难，3月份，美国联邦地区法院法官埃米特·G·沙利文对起诉态度轻蔑，没有翻阅FBI检举者的报告而错误的处理了案子。

source_text: The Justice Department has since replaced the case's prosecutors, and the allegations of misconduct have held up sentencing from the original convictions.
target_text: 司法部因此更换了案子的检察官，根据最初的证据，无法对其不端行为的指控提供量刑依据。

source_text: The filed papers indicate that notes were never turned over from an interview that has the oil contractor estimated the house renovation for far less then he specified at trial.
target_text: 存档文件表明这些笔记从未被翻阅浏览，笔记表明石油服务商对房屋翻修的预估要远小于他在庭审时的说明。

source_text: The original trial team was removed, but in the end Attorney General Eric Holder thought it would be best if the case was dropped.
target_text: 最初的庭审团队被调走，但是最后司法部长埃里克·霍尔德认为案子撤诉将会是最好的结果。

source_text: NPR's source indicate that Holder wish to forcefully transmit that prosecutorial misconduct will not be tolerated.
target_text: 美国国家公共电台表明，霍尔德希望强力传播检方不端行为是无法容忍的情况。

source_text: The trying prosecutors are under investigation by the Justice Department for their conduct in the matter.
target_text: 这些难堪的检察官将因他们在本案当中的行为而接受司法部调查。

source_text: On Saturday Mikheil Saakashvili, the President of Georgia, called for a ceasefire in the South Ossetia war.
target_text: 星期六，格鲁吉亚总统米哈伊尔·萨卡什维利呼吁在南奥赛梯战争中实现停火。

source_text: "I call for an immediate ceasefire," said Saakashvili, speaking in Tbilisi.
target_text: “我呼吁立即停火，”萨卡什维利在第比利斯的讲话中提出。

source_text: "Russia has launched a full scale military invasion of Georgia."
target_text: “俄罗斯在格鲁吉亚发动了全面军事入侵”。

source_text: After calling for the ceasefire Saakashvili continued by saying that "I am willing to have international mediation; I am willing to have international separation of forces; we have to establish normal regime under international supervision."
target_text: 在呼吁停火后，萨卡什维利继续说到：“我愿意诉诸国际仲裁；我愿意采取国际军事隔离手段；我们必须在国际监督下建立正常的体制”。

source_text: Russian President Dmitry Medvedev stated his position regarding the ending of the conflict in a phone call with Federal Chancellor of Germany Angela Merkel: "The only possible and reasonable way out of this situation is the withdrawal of Georgian troops to their initial positions and the immediate signing of a legally binding agreement on the non-use of force."
target_text: 俄罗斯总统德米特里•梅德韦杰夫在他与德国总理安格拉·默克尔的通话中，就终止冲突问题表明了他的立场：“摆脱这一形势的唯一可能且合理的方式，是格鲁吉亚部队必须撤回其最初的位置，并立即签署一份关于不使用武力的、具有法律约束力的协议”。

source_text: He reiterated much the same position in telephone conversation with the President of the United States, George W. Bush, today.
target_text: 他在今天与美国总统乔治·W·布什的电话交谈中，重申了几乎相同的立场。

source_text: Saakashvili's call for a ceasefire comes soon after his declaration that Georgia is now in a state of war.
target_text: 萨卡什维利在宣布格鲁吉亚进入战争状态之后，立即发出停火呼吁。

source_text: "I have signed a decree on a state of war."
target_text: “我已经签署了进入战争状态的法令”。

source_text: "Georgia is under a state of total military aggression by the Russian navy, air force, large-scale ground operations," he said in a televised meeting that was broadcast on national television.
target_text: “格鲁吉亚正遭到由俄罗斯海军、空军和大规模地面作战行动构成的全面军事侵略”，他在国家电视台播出的电视会议上这样说道。

source_text: Alexandre Lomaia, the head of the Georgian security council, said that President Saakashvili's proposal states that the Georgian troops will withdraw from Tskhinvali, and will stop reacting to the Russian bombings.
target_text: 格鲁吉亚安全委员会首脑亚历山大·洛玛亚指出，萨卡什维利总统在他的建议中表示，格鲁吉亚部队将撤离茨欣瓦利，并将停止对俄罗斯的轰炸做出反应。

source_text: The crisis broke out after days of heavy fighting in the region.
target_text: 在该地区经历了为期数日的激烈战斗之后，危机爆发了。

source_text: On August 7, Georgian troops launched an offensive against the Ossetian town of Tskhinvali.
target_text: 8月7日，格鲁吉亚部队对茨欣瓦利的奥赛梯镇发动了进攻。

source_text: Russia responded to these actions by sending their own troops into South Ossetia on August 8.
target_text: 8月8日，俄罗斯对此做出了反应，派遣自己的部队进入南奥赛梯。

source_text: According to the Russian Presidents office, drinking water is no longer available in what constitutes South Ossetia's capital, Tskhinvali, because "the water and sewage treatment plants have been destroyed".
target_text: 根据俄罗斯总统办公室提供的信息，在所谓的南奥赛梯首府茨欣瓦利，已经无法获得饮用水，因为“水厂和污水处理厂均已被摧毁”。

source_text: It is further stated that 30,000 people have left South Ossetia to seek refuge in Russia in the last 36 hours alone; and that preparations are underway to provide tented and permanent accommodation for these.
target_text: 信息中进一步指出，仅仅在过去36小时中，就有30,000人离开南奥赛梯前往俄罗斯寻求庇护；为这些人提供帐篷和永久住所的准备工作正在进行之中。

source_text: South Ossetia is a former province of Georgia that broke away from Georgia and declared its independence on November 28, 1991.
target_text: 南奥赛梯曾经是格鲁吉亚的一个省，它于1991年11月28日脱离格鲁吉亚并宣布独立。

source_text: Investigators with the National Transportation Safety Board in the United States have issued an 'urgent safety recommendation' in connection to their role alongside the United Kingdom's Air Accidents Investigation Branch in investigating loss of power in Rolls-Royce engines on Boeing 777s, with the AAIB following suit.
target_text: 美国国家运输安全委员会的调查人员发布了一份“紧急安全建议书”。该建议书与其协同英国航空事故调查局调查波音777劳斯莱斯引擎动力丧失事件中所承担的任务有关。而后者亦效仿了这一作法。

source_text: One of them resulted in British Airways Flight 38 crashing short of the runway at London's Heathrow Airport last year.
target_text: 其中的一次事故导致英国航空公司38号航班去年在接近伦敦希思罗机场跑道处坠毁。

source_text: The NTSB and the AAIB want Rolls-Royce to redesign the engines.
target_text: 国家运输安全委员会和航空事故调查局要求劳斯莱斯公司重新设计这些引擎。

source_text: Both events occurred on Boeing 777-200ER airplanes powered by Rolls-Royce RB211 Trent 800 Series engines.
target_text: 这两个事件均发生在由劳斯莱斯RB211 Trent800系列引擎提供动力的波音777-200ER飞机上。

source_text: On January 17, 2008 British Airways Flight 38 experienced a dual engine rollback (reduction of engine power) on final approach to Heathrow and crashed, leaving one passenger seriously injured, eight passengers and four of the flight crew with minor injuries and the airplane written off.
target_text: 2008年1月17日，英国航空公司38号航班在降落希思罗机场的最后进近阶段因双引擎失灵（发动机功率降低）而坠落，导致1名乘客受重伤，8名乘客及4名机组人员受轻伤，飞机报废。

source_text: The second event occurred on November 26, 2008, when a Delta Air Lines Boeing 777 experienced a single engine rollback during cruise flight over Montana, United States while en route from Shanghai to Atlanta.
target_text: 第二个事件发生在2008年11月26日，当时有一架达美航空公司的波音777从上海飞往亚特兰大，途中在美国蒙大拿州上空巡航飞行时，发生了单引擎失灵。

source_text: Normal operations resumed after the flight crew followed Boeing's published procedure to recover engine performance and the airplane landed safely in Atlanta.
target_text: 当机组人员按照波音公司发布的程序恢复了发动机性能后，飞机便恢复了正常运行并在亚特兰大安全着陆。

source_text: Boeing has already developed new procedures after the crash to prevent ice from building up within their 777 fuel systems after it became apparent that icing may have been a factor, and it was some of these that the Delta flight crew had followed.
target_text: 在估计到结冰可能是导致事故的一个因素之后，波音公司已经在坠机事件发生后制定了新的程序以防止其777燃油系统结冰，而达美航班机组人员后来执行的恰恰是这些程序中的某些步骤。

source_text: As part of the recent releases by the NTSB and AAIB it has become apparent that investigators from both bodies, which are collaborating, have found ice buildup in the fuel system caused both rollbacks.
target_text: 在国家运输安全委员会和航空事故调查局最近发布的消息中已经明确指出：合作双方的调查人员均已发现，燃油系统结冰确为导致上述两个发动机失灵事件的原因。

source_text: In both cases a build-up of ice (from water normally present in all jet fuel) developed on a component called the fuel/oil heat exchanger.
target_text: 在上述两个案例中，均在一个被称作燃油或滑油热交换器上发生了结冰现象（产生于通常存在于所有喷气燃油中的水）。

source_text: This restricted the flow of fuel to the engine, resulting in the uncommanded engine rollback.
target_text: 结冰限制了燃油流入引擎，导致非指令性引擎失灵。

source_text: Investigators initially struggled to produce enough ice under test conditions but have now found that at high concentration, fuel can form ice at very low temperatures in enough quantity to seriously restrict fuel flow, according to a new interim report by the AAIB.
target_text: 根据航空事故调查局最新发布的中期报告，调查人员起初尽力在试验条件下制造足够的冰，但是现在发现，高浓度的燃油可在非常低的温度下形成足够量的冰，从而严重限制燃油的流动。

source_text: This does not occur when fuel demand is lower, as the hot oil then becomes sufficient to entirely melt the ice.
target_text: 当燃油需求量比较低的时候，不会发生这种情况，因为热滑油足以完全融化所结成的冰。

source_text: They have also confirmed that while ice may have formed elsewhere in the airliner's fuel system fuel was probably not restricted at any other location.
target_text: 它们还证实，虽然在班机燃油系统中的其他位置也可能结了冰，但是燃油的流动在那些部位可能并未受到限制。

source_text: Instead, it is thought 'soft' ice formed in the pipes and then broke off, travelling to the fuel/oil heat exchanger and restricting it.
target_text: 相反，人们认为是管路中形成的“软”冰脱落后，进入了燃油或滑油热交换器，从而对其产生了限制作用。

source_text: The NTSB has now revealed that they have advised Rolls-Royce to redesign the fuel/oil heat exchanger, and Rolls-Royce have stated that they are indeed working on a replacement part that will be available within twelve months.
target_text: 国家运输安全委员会透露说，他们已经建议劳斯莱斯重新设计其燃油或滑油热交换器，而后者表示，他们确实正在设计一个替换部件，并将于12个月内供货。

source_text: The AAIB advised Boeing and Rolls-Royce to jointly review the problem across the fuel system, and both companies responded that they 'accepted' this recommendation and repeated that a replacement part was being developed.
target_text: 航空事故调查局建议波音和劳斯莱斯公司联合起来对整个燃油系统进行评估，而这两个公司均回应道，他们“接受”该项建议，并重申其正在研制一个替换部件。

source_text: Both the NTSB and the AAIB also sent letters to the US Federal Aviation Administration and the European Aviation Safety Agency requesting the installment of the modified component be mandatory.
target_text: 国家运输安全委员会和航空事故调查局同时又向美国联邦航空管理局和欧洲航空安全局致函，要求强制性安装改进后的部件。

source_text: The NTSB suggested this should be either the next maintenance check or within six months.
target_text: 国家运输安全委员会建议，应在下一次保养检查的时候，或者在6个月内进行安装。

source_text: There are 220 Boeing 777-200s - the only type using the affected engine - with Trent 800 series engines.
target_text: 现有的220架波音777-200型飞机是唯一采用上述受到影响的Trent800系列引擎的型号。

source_text: The fuel/oil heat exchanger is a dual purpose part designed to simultaneously melt fuel ice and cool down engine oil.
target_text: 燃油或滑油热交换器是一个双重用途部件，其设计目的是使其能够在融化燃油冰的同时又能对引擎滑油进行冷却。

source_text: The AAIB further noted that it is unclear whether other aircraft designs are at risk, and advised the FAA and EASA to look into increased use of de-icing additives and investigate both the accumulation and sudden movement of ice in aircraft fuel systems and the actual formation of ice in the fuel itself.
target_text: 航空事故调查局进一步指出，尚不清楚其他飞机的设计中是否存有同样的风险，并建议联邦航空管理局和欧洲航空安全局对日益增多的除冰添加剂使用情况进行调查，同时对飞机燃油系统中的积冰和冰块的突然移动，以及燃油本身的实际结冰机制展开调研。

source_text: A new advertising campaign in USA for the Sony PSP which looks like graffiti and is often sprayed on previously vandalized walls has come under attack from other graffiti artists.
target_text: 索尼PSP游戏机在美国发动的新一轮广告攻势，看起来貌似涂鸦，且经常喷涂在破壁残垣之上。这些广告现已成为其他涂鸦艺术家抨击的目标。

source_text: A collective group of graffiti artists and street artists are now banding together, vandalizing the look-alike graffiti advertisements.
target_text: 一群涂鸦艺术家和街头艺人正聚集到一起，联手破坏这些貌似涂鸦的宣传广告。

source_text: The campaign has offended a lot of graffiti artists and street artists, drawing responses like "keep your desperate corporate long arm out of a movement that is the only thing that is ours!"
target_text: 这一轮攻势惹恼了许多涂鸦艺术家和街头艺人，招致各种各样的回应。比如：“不要把贵公司那只该死的长臂伸到只属于我们的活动中来！”

source_text: But not all the responses have been negative, with many artists defending Sony saying they have the right.
target_text: 然而，并非所有的反应都是负面的。不少艺术家为索尼辩护说，他们有这个权利。

source_text: "Sony and PSP have every right to use this type of media," Floyd Hayes, the head creative director at Cunning Work told Wired News.
target_text: “典雅之作”的创意总监弗洛伊德·海斯告诉连线新闻说：“索尼和PSP完全有权使用这种媒体”。

source_text: "They have done it for (a) very long time very successfully and spoke the language of the streets without being patronizing."
target_text: “他们已经这样做了很久，非常成功，说的是街头语言，完全没有高人一等的感觉”。

source_text: Casa Maria was paid $100 for two weeks' use of its wall, co-owner Mario Arana told Wired News.
target_text: 大楼的共同业主玛利欧·阿兰娜告诉连线新闻说，卡萨·玛丽亚收到了100美元，换取使用其墙面两周的权利。

source_text: Tats Cru, the graffiti crew responsible for the designs, have also been targeted with insulting slogans on Sony's advertisements.
target_text: 负责设计广告的Tats Cru涂鸦团队同样因索尼公司的广告而成为侮辱性标语的攻击对象。

source_text: Six energy companies in the United Kingdom have announced that it is likely that the prices for energy bills could increase over the course of 2010.
target_text: 英国六家能源公司宣布，在2010年中，能源账单的价格可能上涨。

source_text: The companies, which are nicknamed the "big six" in the United Kingdom, did not pass on information that there would be price cuts in energy bills despite increasing profits.
target_text: 尽管它们的利润在增加，但是这几家号称英国“六强”的公司并没有传递有关能源账单降价的信息。

source_text: However, the companies have in fact sent a message in response saying that the prices of bills may even increase over the course of the next year.
target_text: 然而，它们实际上却发送了一条消息作为回应，说是明年的账单价格甚至有可能上涨。

source_text: Energy company watchdog the Office of Gas and Electricity Markets (Ofgem) have estimated that energy companies will make gross margins of ￡170 ($276) per dual fuel customer over the course of the next twelve months, due to the recent fall in wholesale energy costs.
target_text: 作为能源公司的监督机构，燃气和电力市场办公室（Ofgem）估计，由于近期能源批发成本的下跌，今后12个月中，能源公司的毛利润将达到每个双燃料用户170英镑（276美元）的水平。

source_text: Ofgem have said: "Our analysis shows that based on an 18-month hedging strategy and assuming that retail prices remain unchanged, projected gross margin is set to increase by around ￡80 for dual fuel customers over the next six months."
target_text: 燃气和电力市场办公室指出：“我们的分析表明，基于为期18个月的套期保值策略，假设零售价格不变，那么在今后6个月中，预计毛利润必定会增加到每个双燃料用户80英镑的水平”。

source_text: The "big six" energy companies in the United Kingdom are British Gas, E-on, Npower, Scottish and Southern Energy, Scottish Power, and EDF Energy.
target_text: 英国“六强”能源公司包括英国天然气公司、意昂集团、英国可再生能源公司、苏格兰及南方能源公司、苏格兰电力公司，以及英国电网。

source_text: British Gas stated: "Prices [are] likely to remain at historically high levels, and in fact likely to increase as non-commodity costs rise ever upwards."
target_text: 英国天然气公司指出：“价格有可能维持在历史最高水平，实际上还可能继续上涨，因为非商品成本在不断上涨”。

source_text: EDF Energy said: "[We] would of course be prepared to reduce tariffs if market conditions allowed."
target_text: 英国电网表示：“如果市场条件许可，我们当然随时准备降低费用”。

source_text: Scottish Power stated: "There are no immediate signals that would indicate a fall in retail prices for this winter, and risks of an increase next year."
target_text: 苏格兰电力公司说：“没有直接的征兆显示今年冬季的零售价格会下降，也不存在明年上涨的风险”。

source_text: A spokesperson for Ofgem said that there was no evidence of any cartel in operation, or evidence of profiteering.
target_text: 燃气和电力市场办公室的发言人说，没有证据表明其中存在着任何同业联盟操纵行为，也没有从中谋取暴利的迹象。

source_text: The spokesperson commented: "It is up to the companies themselves to decide whether to cut their bills."
target_text: 该发言人评论道：“是否削减账单应由公司自己做决定”。

source_text: "Consumer Focus data suggests that Scottish Power has increased dual fuel prices by the most since 2003 - up 148% - while decreasing prices by 0.6% so far this year."
target_text: “客户导向提供的数据表明，自2003年以来，苏格兰电力公司的双燃料价格上涨幅度最大，高达百分之148，而今年到目前为止则降低了百分之0.6”。

source_text: "RWE's Npower has increased tariffs by 132% since 2003, but has reduced bills by 2.7% in 2009."
target_text: “自2003年以来，德国莱茵集团旗下的英国可再生能源公司增加费用达百分之132，但在2009年已削减了百分之2.7的账单价格”。

source_text: The University of California, Berkeley announced that one of its graduate students, Michael Park, rediscovered on May 24 the Mount Diablo buckwheat, a plant not sighted since 1936 and believed to have been extinct.
target_text: 加州大学伯克利分校宣布，该校研究生迈克尔·帕克于5月24日重新发现了魔鬼山荞麦。这是一种自1936年以来就无人见过的，据信已经灭绝的植物。

source_text: Found nearly 30 miles east of San Francisco, Park [aged 35] identified the small pink flowering plant said to resemble baby's breath during a routine visit to the mountain.
target_text: 在一次例行游山的活动中，35岁的帕克在这座位于旧金山东部近30英里处的山中，发现了这种酷似满天星的粉色小花植物。

source_text: The significance of the find drew comparisons to the recent discovery of the Ivory-billed woodpecker in Arkansas earlier this year in April.
target_text: 这一发现的重要意义，可与较早于今年4月在阿肯色州发现的象牙喙啄木鸟相比肩。

source_text: The exact location of the flowering plant is, for now, being kept secret.
target_text: 至于这一有花植物生长的准确地点，目前尚需保密。

source_text: Several botanists have confirmed it along with the nearly dozen or so other plants.
target_text: 数名植物学家已经对这种植物，连同差不多十几个其他植物品种进行了确认。

source_text: Mohammed Bouyeri, a radical Islamist who was a member of the Hofstad Network, was sentenced to life in prison by a court in Amsterdam for the killing of the controversial filmmaker Theo van Gogh in November 2004.
target_text: 霍夫斯塔德网络组织成员、激进伊斯兰主义分子的默罕默德·布叶里，因2004年11月杀害具争议性的电影制作人特奥·梵高，而被阿姆斯特丹的一家法院判处终身监禁。

source_text: Van Gogh was ambushed on an Amsterdam street and shot repeatedly in the chest before Bouyeri stabbed him and slit his throat.
target_text: 梵高在阿姆斯特丹的一条街道上遭到伏击，被多次射中胸部，最后布叶里又捅了他一刀并割断了他的喉咙。

source_text: Bouyeri, a 27 year who holds joint Dutch-Moroccan citizenship, claimed he acted on behalf of Islam.
target_text: 持有荷兰摩洛哥联合公民身份的布叶里今年27岁。他声称自己代表伊斯兰教行事。

source_text: He made a confession in the courtroom and vowed he would "do it again" if he had the chance.
target_text: 他在法庭上承认了自己的罪行，但又发誓，如果有机会，自己“还会这样做”。

source_text: Van Gogh had been a staunch critic of Islam and its perceived mistreatment of women.
target_text: 梵高曾经是伊斯兰教及其虐待妇女行为的坚定批判者。

source_text: Van Gogh directed several movies critical of Islam, most notably Submission in which verses of the Qur'an were written on naked women's bodies.
target_text: 他导演了几部批判伊斯兰教的影片，其中最值得关注的一部名为“归顺”。在这部影片中，古兰经的经文被誊写到裸露的女人身体上。

source_text: Severe flooding in the island nation of Fiji has killed eight people and forced thousands to evacuate.
target_text: 岛国斐济发生的严重洪灾已经致使8人丧生，并迫使数千居民撤离。

source_text: The flooding is mainly in the western part of the country's main island, Viti Levu, where most of the resorts hosting international travellers are located.
target_text: 洪水主要发生在该国主岛维提岛的西部地区。多数接待国际旅游者的度假胜地均位于这个岛上。

source_text: Fiji's National Disaster Office has advised all tourists still in the country to prepare for more bad weather and possibly more flooding.
target_text: 斐济国家灾害办公室建议，所有仍停留在该国的旅游者要准备应对更糟糕的天气，也许还有更多的洪水。

source_text: Fiji's chief of disaster management Aisea Qumihajelo said in a statement, "There's another depression heading toward Fiji within the next two days and that will bring an additional threat."
target_text: 斐济灾害管理主任艾希·曲米哈杰罗在一份声明中指出：“今后两天，将有另一股低气压向斐济逼近，并带来新的威胁”。

source_text: The government of Fiji's military dictator Frank Bainimarama declared a state of emergency in the city of Nadi, the country's tourist centre, and other parts of western Viti Levu.
target_text: 斐济政府的军事独裁者弗朗克·贝尼玛拉玛已宣布该国旅游中心纳迪市，以及其他维提岛西部地区，进入紧急状态。

source_text: Over 6,000 people have evacuated the area and are now in one of Fiji's 144 evacuation centers sheltered from the storm.
target_text: 超过6000人已经撤离该地区，并已入住斐济提供的144个避风疏散中心。

source_text: Government sources have reported that at least six people have been killed by floodwaters, and two people were crushed by a landslide.
target_text: 据政府消息人士报道，至少有6人已死于洪水，2人死于滑坡。

source_text: The flood has affected many of the rural areas of the island, washing out sugar cane crops across the area and damaging roads and bridges.
target_text: 洪水影响到岛上许多农村地区，将甘蔗作物洗劫一空，并冲垮了道路和桥梁。

source_text: "Widespread flooding, including severe flooding of major rivers and streams, is expected on Wednesday and Thursday."
target_text: “预计星期三和星期四将发生大面积洪水，包括来自主要河流的严重洪水”。

source_text: Rescue efforts, led by the government and the Red Cross, have begun especially in rural and heavily-flooded areas.
target_text: 在政府和红十字会的领导下，救援行动已经展开，特别是在农村和洪水重灾区。

source_text: Vetaia Dokonivalu, a local resident from Ba, a hard-hit town, commented, "It was really frightening."
target_text: 在受到重创的坝镇，一位当地居民维塔亚·多科尼瓦鲁评论说：“这真的很可怕”。

source_text: "We watched as the doors of our homes were forced open by the water."
target_text: “当我们家的大门被洪水冲开的时候，我们只能眼巴巴地看着”。

source_text: "We saw our belongings being swept out of the houses."
target_text: “我们看到家里的物品被冲出屋外”。

source_text: This flooding has also caused a food crisis in some parts.
target_text: 这场洪水还在有些地区引发了粮食危机。

source_text: Isimeli Tukana, a health official, said, "People need to collect as much rainwater as possible and drink as much of this as possible."
target_text: 卫生官员伊西梅里·图卡纳说：“人们必须尽量收集雨水，并尽量饮用这种水”。

source_text: "Watch out for food from supermarkets especially from the towns of Ba, Nadi, Sigatoka and Rakiraki."
target_text: “要注意超市中的食品，特别是来自坝镇、纳迪市、辛加东卡市和拉吉拉吉镇的食品”。

source_text: "Our health inspectors will be doing their rounds as soon as the water goes down."
target_text: “一旦洪水下降，我们的卫生检察官就会立即开始巡视”。

source_text: According to the Fiji Retailers Association, the storm has caused over a million dollars worth of damage to Fiji's businesses.
target_text: 根据斐济零售商协会提供的信息，这场风暴给斐济商界造成了价值百万美元的损失。

source_text: At 07:00 UTC today (19:00 NZST, local time), the polls closed in the New Zealand general election, 2005.
target_text: 今天世界时07：00（新西兰标准时19：00），新西兰2005年大选投票结束。

source_text: Turnout was strong, turnout results are predicted to be to be higher than the 2002 turnout (77%)
target_text: 投票率很高。据预测，投票率将高于2002年（那年的投票率为百分之77）。

source_text: Preliminary election results will be on Wikinews as they come through it is expected that all votes will be counted by 11:30 UTC (23:30 NZST)
target_text: 初步选举结果将在收到后公布于维基新闻上。预期全部选票的统计工作将于世界时11：30（新西兰标准时23：30）完成。

source_text: The official results are expected to be available by Saturday, 1 October 2005, on the Chief Electoral Office 2005 General Election Results website
target_text: 预计官方统计结果将于2005年10月1日星期六，公布于首席选举办公室2005年大选结果网站上。

source_text: The three armed robbers entered the museum half an hour before closing.
target_text: 三名武装劫匪在闭馆之前半小时进入了博物馆。

source_text: One man with a pistol forced employees to the ground while the other two men stole the paintings.
target_text: 一人用手枪强迫员工们趴在地上，另外两人则动手盗画。

source_text: The four paintings are worth a total of 163 million US dollars.
target_text: 这四幅绘画作品的总价值高达1.63亿美元。

source_text: It's said that it would be hard to sell the stolen paintings on the open market due to the popularity of the paintings.
target_text: 据说由于这些被盗的绘画作品非常有名，很难将它们在公开市场上售出。

source_text: There is a reward of 90 thousand US dollars for the artwork.
target_text: 为这些艺术品开出了9万美元的悬赏金。

source_text: The robbers, who were still at large, stole the paintings Sunday from the E.G. Bührle Collection, one of Europe's finest private museums for Impressionist and ｖ, police said.
target_text: 劫匪们仍然在逃。他们星期日从E·G·比尔勒馆藏盗窃了这些名画。那可是欧洲最好的印象派私人博物馆之一，警察如是说。

source_text: It was the largest art robbery in Swiss history and one of the biggest ever in Europe, said Marco Cortesi, spokesman for the Zurich police.
target_text: 苏黎世警方发言人马可·科特西说，这是瑞士历史上最大的艺术品盗窃案，在欧洲也算得上有史以来最大的窃案之一。

source_text: He compared it to the theft in 2004 of Edvard Munch's The Scream and Madonna from the Munch Museum in Norway.
target_text: 他将之与2004年从挪威蒙克博物馆盗取爱德华·蒙克的“尖叫”和“麦当娜”窃案相比。

source_text: Last week, Swiss police reported that two Pablo Picasso paintings were stolen from a Swiss exhibition near Zurich.
target_text: 瑞士警方上周报告说，在苏黎世附近的瑞士展会上有两幅毕加索绘画作品被盗。

source_text: Fires continue to burn in Greece on Monday destroying everything in their path.
target_text: 希腊的大火星期一继续燃烧，沿途的所有物品均付之一炬。

source_text: Death toll has exceeded 60 with daily Greek newspapers Kathimerini and Ta Nea reporting 61 and 63 deaths respectively.
target_text: 死亡人数已超过60人。希腊“每日新闻报”和“新闻报”各自报道的死亡人数分别为61人和63人。

source_text: Ancient Olympia, birthplace of the Olympics, was also threatened but firefighters kept the site safe.
target_text: 奥林匹克运动会的诞生地古代奥林匹亚也受到大火的威胁，但是消防队员确保了遗址的安全。

source_text: The new museum of Olympia was saved in the last minute but part of the ancient stadium was not spared.
target_text: 新建的奥林匹亚博物馆在最后一刻被挽救了下来，但是古代体育场的一部分却未能逃过劫难。

source_text: The Greek Government has offered a €1 million reward for anyone providing information which leads to the arrest of an arsonist.
target_text: 希腊政府悬赏100万欧元，以奖励任何根据其提供的信息抓捕到纵火犯的人员。

source_text: Six additional members of the pod had died during the stranding, including at least one calf.
target_text: 这个群体中另外6个成员已经在搁浅期间死亡，其中至少包括一头幼鲸。

source_text: More than 300 people were watching as the whales set out to sea following a 30 hour rescue effort.
target_text: 当长达30个小时的营救行动结束后，鲸群在300余人的注视下游回大海。

source_text: Western Australian State Government Department of Conservation and Land Management (CALM) officers feared that the whales could become stranded again.
target_text: 西澳大利亚州政府的环保与土地管理部（CALM）官员担心鲸群可能会再次搁浅。

source_text: "The vet has checked them all and given them some antibiotics yesterday, last thing before dark," he had told the Australian national broadcaster.
target_text: 他告诉澳大利亚国家广播公司说：“昨天，兽医逐一检查了这些鲸的健康状况，并给它们服用了抗生素。这是天黑前做的最后一件事”。

source_text: "I think the plan is that the vet will be there again [today] and will give them some vitamins to kick them along before they actually take their swim out to sea."
target_text: “我想，按计划今天兽医还会去那里，给它们服用一些维生素，让它们在实际游回大海前恢复体力”。

source_text: Two diplomats within the Romanian Embassy to Moldova have been declared personae non gratae due to the incompatibility between their activity and the diplomatic status they are holding.
target_text: 罗马利亚驻摩尔多瓦大使馆的两名外交官被宣布为不受欢迎的人。原因是他们的活动与其外交官身份不符。

source_text: In line with a press statement made by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and European Integration (MFAEI), on Wednesday, December 12, Romanian Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary to Moldova Filip Teodorescu was invited to the MFAEI.
target_text: 按照外交与欧洲一体化部（MFAEI）12月12日星期三发布的新闻声明，罗马尼亚驻摩尔多瓦特命全权大使菲利普·齐奥多列斯库应邀前往该部。

source_text: "The Foreign Ministry considers such an act as inimical, totally unjustified and incompatible with Romania’s permanent constructive and cooperative attitude towards Moldova," the Romanian Foreign Ministry says in a communique releases in reaction...
target_text: 罗马尼亚外交部在其发布的一份公报中回应道：“外交部认为这一做法是有害的，完全不正当的，不符合罗马尼亚对摩尔多瓦所持有的永久建设性合作态度”。

source_text: "I expected many of the problems in our relations to disappear after Romania joined the EU," said Vladimir Voronin President of Moldova, "but relations between Moldova and Romania have not changed."
target_text: “我原本期待在罗马尼亚加入欧盟以后，两国之间的很多问题会随之消失”，摩尔多瓦总统弗拉迪米尔·沃罗宁说，“但是摩尔多瓦与罗马尼亚的关系并没有改变”。

source_text: "All those statements are so stupid they don't deserve criticism."
target_text: “那些声明显得如此愚蠢，不值得评论”。

source_text: Taiwan Electromagnetic Radiation Hazard Protection and Control Association (TEPCA), an environmental organization set to promote environmental hazard warnings on electromagnetic radiation, protested over the potential health impact of electromagnetic radiation as Ying-jeou Ma, President of the Republic of China, visited this show on the 2nd Day of 2008 WiMAX Expo Taipei (June 3).
target_text: 台湾电磁辐射公害防治协会（TEPCA）是一个旨在推进电磁辐射环境危害预警的环保组织。在中华民国总统马英九于2008年台北WiMAX展的第二天（6月3日）前往参观的时候，该组织针对电磁辐射对健康的潜在影响举行了抗议活动。

source_text: "Base stations of WiMAX are unnecessary in Taiwan! The governmental people didn't care about the living and health of the public!" strongly stated Jiau-hua Chen, Chairman of TEPCA during the protest.
target_text: 在抗议活动中，TEPCA理事长陈椒华强烈抗议道：“没有必要在台湾建WiMAX基站！政府人员不在乎公众的生活和健康！”

source_text: The on-site rate of electromagnetic radiation was firmly higher than the international standards as some experts examined at the showground, according to the Taiwan Hakka Television.
target_text: 据台湾客家电视台报道，一些专家对展示场地进行了检测，发现现场的电磁辐射率稳定不变地高于国际标准。

source_text: As a result of the protest, not only the information security, but also environmentalists disputed the future of WiMAX.
target_text: 作为这些抗议活动的结果，信息安全业和环保主义者均对WiMAX的未来提出了质疑。

source_text: Nonetheless the national health system of Sierra Leone demands payment for all treatment with simple consultations costing as much as 25 days of income.
target_text: 然而，塞拉利昂的国家卫生体系要求所有的治疗均需付费，连一些简单的医疗咨询费用都高达一个人25天的收入水平。

source_text: According to Action Against Hunger the number of children with acute malnutrition has reached almost twice the level of the WHO's emergency threshold of 2% in the Moyamba district of Sierra Leone.
target_text: 根据反饥饿行动组织提供的信息，在塞拉利昂的莫扬巴区，患有急性营养不良症的儿童数量，几乎达到世界卫生组织百分之2紧急阈值水平的2倍。

source_text: The Los Angeles Times writes that Sierra Leone, in spite of decades of foreign aid, has not yet increased the standard of living of its people considerably and 60% of the public spending of Sierra Leone come from other governments and nonprofit organizations.
target_text: 洛杉矶时报写道，尽管几十年来一直在接受外援，塞拉利昂还是未能大幅度提高人民的生活水平。该国公共支出的百分之60，来自其他国家政府和非营利组织。

source_text: Since 2002 the country received $1 billion in aid but the infant mortality rate is almost the highest in the world, lower than Angola but higher than Afghanistan.
target_text: 自从2002年以来，该国接受了10亿美元的援助，但是其婴儿死亡率几乎是全球最高的，低于安哥拉，高于阿富汗。

source_text: The newspaper further reports that the United Nations state that 1 in 8 Sierra Leonean women die giving birth, as compared to 1 in 4,800 in the United States and that life expectancy in Sierra Leone is merely 41 years while in Bangladesh life expectancy reaches 60 years.
target_text: 该报进一步报道说，联合国声称，在塞拉利昂，8分之1的妇女死于分娩；而在美国，这个数字只有4800分之1。在塞拉利昂，人们的预期寿命只有41岁，而在孟加拉则达到了60岁。

source_text: The government of Sierra Leone had expressed its intend to abolish user fees for women and children with a new plan for a fairer health care system that was to be revealed on the Sierra Leone Investment and Donor Conference, which was held in London on November 18 and 19.
target_text: 塞拉利昂政府已表明其有意取消妇女儿童的使用费，并制定一个新的计划以建立更加公平合理的医疗保健体系。该计划将在11月18日和19日在伦敦召开的塞拉利昂投资与捐助者会议上公布。

source_text: "The Sierra Leone government has publicly stated its commitment to abolish user fees, and the UK government and other donors have promised to help," said Seco Gerard, advisor at Medecins Sans Frontieres’s analysis and advocacy unit.
target_text: 无国界医生组织分析与倡导组的顾问塞克·杰拉尔德指出：“塞拉利昂政府已公开表明其取消使用费的决心，而英国政府和其他捐助者均承诺要提供帮助”。

source_text: "What is crucial now is that Sierra Leone actually receives the necessary funding and technical assistance to realise this objective."
target_text: “问题的关键在于，塞拉利昂必须将其收到的必要的资金和技术援助真正用于实现这个目标”。

source_text: "It is time that words are being followed up by concrete action."
target_text: “到了采取具体行动来兑现诺言的时候了”。

source_text: "If not, people who could otherwise be saved will continue to die needlessly every day."
target_text: “如果不是这样，那么本来可以获救的人们还会继续一天又一天没有必要地死去”。

source_text: The Telegraph reports that president Bai Koroma was also hoping to secure a significant increase in aid donations with his new health plan.
target_text: 据电讯报报道，巴伊·科罗马总统也希望为他的新健康计划增加大量的捐赠援助。

source_text: While Germany declined to support president Bai Koroma’s "Agenda for Change" and urged to give more consideration to women's welfare the country received support from the European Union, DFID, UNIPSIL, World Bank, IFAD and the African Development Bank.
target_text: 虽然德国拒绝支持巴伊·科罗马总统的“改革议程”并要求更多地关注妇女福利，但是该国仍然从欧盟、国际发展署、联合国塞拉利昂建设和平综合办事处、世界银行、联合国国际农业发展基金会和非洲发展银行得到了资助。

source_text: From the pledges of $850 million the government of Sierra Leone was hoping for only about $300 millions could be secured, with attached conditionalities concerning the use of funding.
target_text: 在塞拉利昂政府希望获承诺提供的8.5亿美元资金中，仅有3亿美元得到保证，而且还附带对资金使用的限制条件。

source_text: In a presentation at the Ministry of Finance and Economic Development in Freetown the Unicef representative for Sierra Leone, Mr. Mahimbo Mdoe, expressed gratitude about a pledge of about $1.3 million conveyed by the Ambassador of Japan to Sierra Leone, His Excellency Mr. Keiichi Katakami, and about earlier donations to UNICEF-Sierra Leone in the past years, amounting to over $20 million.
target_text: 塞拉利昂驻联合国儿童基金会代表马辛伯·姆多先生在弗里敦财政和经济发展部作陈述的时候，对日本驻塞拉利昂大使片上庆一阁下承诺的大约130万美元援助，以及过去几年里为塞拉利昂国际儿童基金会提供的超过2000万美元的捐赠表示感谢。

source_text: The intended application of the funding is the goal to half child and maternal mortality by 2010, to introduce a social health insurance scheme, to improve equipment and to train health professionals.
target_text: 资金的使用意图如下：到2010年，达到将儿童和孕妇死亡率降低一半的目标，推出社会健康保险计划，改善设备和培训健康专业人才。

source_text: Over 500 groups, including the Democratic Progressive Party, are planning a massive march and rally for Saturday in Taipei City.
target_text: 超过500个团体，包括民进党，正在计划于星期六在台北市举行大规模游行和集会。

source_text: March promoters are vowing to bring one million people onto the streets to protest the People's Republic of China's "anti-secession" law aimed at thwarting Taiwan independence.
target_text: 游行的组织者发誓，将动员一百万人上街抗议中华人民共和国旨在阻止台湾独立的“反分裂国家法”。

source_text: The march, titled "326 March for Democracy and Peace", will begin in ten different locations, converging on the square near the Presidential Office in downtown Taipei City.
target_text: 游行的名目叫做“326民主与和平游行”；将于10个不同地点出发，最后在台北市中心总统府附近的广场会合。

source_text: "Democracy and peace are the ultimate goal of the march," said Joseph Wu, the Mainland Affairs Council Chairman.
target_text: 陆委会主委吴钊燮说：“游行的最终目标是民主与和平”。

source_text: Wu announced on Friday that he would take part in the rally, but did not disclose in which part of the parade he would appear.
target_text: 吴于星期五宣布说，他将参加集会，但并未透露他将在哪一个游行队伍中露面。

source_text: Taiwan's President Chen Shui-bian announced on Thursday that he will also attend the event with his family.
target_text: 台湾总统陈水扁于星期四宣布说，他也将携带全家参加活动。

source_text: "I cannot and will not be absent on March 26, and I will take my entire family to participate in this sacred moment in history to walk and stand up together with the Taiwanese people," Chen said.
target_text: 陈说：“3月26日的活动我不能，也不愿意缺席。我将携带全家参与这一神圣的历史时刻，与台湾人民站在一起，行走在一起”。

source_text: Chen further declared that he has, "heard the outrage and anger of the Taiwan people."
target_text: 陈进一步宣布，他已经“听到了台湾人民的愤怒心声”。

source_text: A Chinese scholar warned that the situation could become "further aggravated" by Saturday's planned event.
target_text: 一位中国学者警告道，计划于星期六召集的活动可能会使形势“进一步恶化”。

source_text: "The secessionist forces plot to stir up public sentiments to embolden themselves."
target_text: “分裂势力企图通过煽动公众情绪为自己壮胆”。

source_text: "Such moves are doomed to meet failure," said Huang Jiashu, a professor at the People's University of China.
target_text: 中国人民大学教授黄家述说：“这种举动注定会失败”。

source_text: The Taiwan Domestic News Hour on ETTV is running a 326 graphic to note the march and rally during its news reports about the upcoming event, and also has an animated graphic with marchers carrying signs in the lower-left hand corner of the screen.
target_text: ETTV“台湾国内新闻时间”在对这个即将到来的活动进行报道时，制作了326活动图表来解说该游行和集会。还播出了一幅动画图片，在屏幕左下角出现了游行者手持标语的画面。

source_text: Zorn discussed a variety of issues, including frustration with the classification system that has disadvantaged some United States swimmers because of what she sees as its subjective nature.
target_text: 佐恩讨论了各种各样的问题，包括对分级体制的不满。该体制将某些美国游泳运动员置于不利的地位，而她认为原因在于其主观性。

source_text: She also talked about the increased visibility of the Games, how things have changed from when she started in 1980 to the current 2012 Summer Paralympics.
target_text: 她还谈到对比赛关注度的提高，从她1980年首次参赛一直到最近的2012年夏季残奥会之间已有很大的变化。

source_text: Zorn discussed how sponsorship has evolved from her early time participating, and issues with the Paralympics inside the United States at the present.
target_text: 佐恩讨论了自从她早期参会以来赞助机制的发展状况，以及当前美国国内残奥会面临的问题。

source_text: This year Zorn was inducted into the International Paralympic Hall of Fame at a ceremony in London.
target_text: 今年，在伦敦举行的一个仪式上，佐恩被纳入国际残奥会名人堂。

source_text: She currently works for the United States Department of Veterans Affairs, helping returning soldiers adjust to life as civilians.
target_text: 目前她为美国退伍军人事务部工作，帮助退役士兵适应公民生活。

source_text: Between 3,000 (police estimate) and 8,000 people (organiser's estimate) took to the streets in Gießen, Germany today, protesting the planned introduction of tuition fees at Hessian universities.
target_text: 今天，有3,000（据警方估计）至8,000人（据组织者估计）涌向德国吉森市街头，抗议黑森州各大学引入缴纳学费机制的计划。

source_text: Beginning at 1pm CEST (1100 UTC) students, pupils and ordinary citizens marched through much of downtown Gießen, accompanied by a massive police presence, in the largest demonstration the city has seen in years.
target_text: 从中欧夏季时间下午1点（世界时11：00）开始，学生和普通市民在大量警察的伴随下，游行穿过吉森市中心的大部分地区。这是该市多年以来规模最大的一场示威游行。

source_text: They occupied the office of the Regierungsbezirk and the city office.
target_text: 他们占领了行政区办公室和城市办公室。

source_text: From 4 to 7pm, at least 200 people also blocked the Berliner Platz, the most important inner city crossing, bringing most of the downtown bus and car traffic to a standstill.
target_text: 下午4点至7点，至少有200人封锁了市内最重要的十字路口——柏林广场，导致大多数车辆交通陷于瘫痪。

source_text: The crowd dispersed after the police threatend several times to clear the crossing by force.
target_text: 在警察多次威胁将动用武力来疏散路口以后，人群才散开。

source_text: In July, the Hessian state legislature is due to pass a bill that would require all undergraduate students to pay a tuition fee of 500€ per semester; graduate students could be charged up to 1,500€.
target_text: 7月，黑森州立法机构即将通过一项法案，要求所有本科学生每学期缴纳500欧元的学费；而研究生缴纳的学费可能会多达1,500欧元。

source_text: Slovenians yesterday voted in a referendum in favour of a border deal with Croatia.
target_text: 斯洛文尼亚昨日以全民公投的方式通过了与克罗地亚的边界约定。

source_text: The Border Arbitration Agreement allows for international arbitrators to resolve a 20-year border dispute that dates back to the break-up of Yugoslavia.
target_text: 边境仲裁协议使得国际仲裁员能够解决一件长达20年的边界纠纷案。这一纠纷从南斯拉夫解体之日就开始了。

source_text: Parliaments in both countries approved the deal, which will be binding on both countries.
target_text: 两个国家的议会都批准了这项对双方均具有约束力的约定。

source_text: In March, Slovenian Prime Minister Borut Pahor's centre-left government yielded to demands for a referendum on whether to accept a border deal.
target_text: 3月，斯洛文尼亚总理博鲁特·帕霍尔的中间偏左政府屈服于国民的要求，决定采取全民公决的方式来决定是否接受边界约定。

source_text: "Solving the border dispute with Croatia is the basis for a lasting peace, security and friendship of both nations," Pahor said.
target_text: 帕霍尔说：“解决与克罗地亚的边界纠纷，可为两国间的永久和平、安全和友谊奠定基础”。

source_text: "If it is rejected, it is questionable how long I or my successor will need to reach another agreement which, I believe, could not be better."
target_text: “如果被拒绝，那么我或者我的继任者就不知道还需要多久才能够达成另一份新的协议。而且，我认为新的协议不可能比现在的更好”。

source_text: The national Electoral Commission said that after 99.9 per cent of votes were counted, 51.5 per cent voted for the deal and 48.5 were against it.

source_text: Slovenia is situated between Italy and Croatia, where the dispute involves land on the Istrian peninsula in the northern Adriatic and the small Bay of Piran in the Adriatic Sea.

source_text: A panel of five international experts will define the new land and maritime borders and could force Croatia to cede some of the sea it views as its own.
target_text: 一个由五名国际专家组成的小组将负责标定新的陆地与海上边界，并有可能迫使克罗地亚让出某些该国认为属于自己的海域。

source_text: In the past, Croatia has called for the border to be drawn down the middle of the bay.

source_text: Slovenia is the only former Yugoslav state to have joined the European Union (EU), while Croatia hopes to conclude EU accession talks this year and join the twenty-seven member union in 2012.
target_text: 斯洛文尼亚是唯一一个加入欧盟（EU）的前南斯拉夫国家。而克罗地亚则希望于今年结束加入欧盟的谈判并于2012年成为这个27国联盟的成员。

source_text: Slovenia has blocked Croatia's membership talks over the border issue in the past.
target_text: 斯洛文尼亚曾一度因边界问题而阻止了克罗地亚的加盟谈判。
