source_text: The bodies of two of the four Alabama children allegedly thrown off a bridge by their father have been found.
target_text: 据传有四名阿拉巴马州儿童被他们的父亲从一座桥上扔下，其中两名儿童的尸体已经被找到。

source_text: On Saturday, Danny Luong, the youngest of the children at four months old, was discovered by a duck hunter in a marshy area near Bayou la Batre, about 5 miles west of the 80 foot high Dauphin Island Bridge.
target_text: 星期六，四名儿童中最小的一位，只有四个月大的丹尼·龙，被一位猎鸭人在拜乌拉巴特里附近的沼泽地里发现。此地位于80英尺高的道芬岛大桥以西大约5英里处。

source_text: A second child, 3-year-old Ryan Phan, was found near Barton Bay by a search and rescue team today at 10:30 am local time.
target_text: 第二名儿童3岁的瑞安·梵于今日当地时间上午10点30分被一支搜救队在巴顿湾附近找到。

source_text: Barton Bay is about 10 miles northwest of the bridge.
target_text: 巴顿湾位于该桥西北大约10英里处。

source_text: The father, Lam Luong, a 37 year old shrimp fisherman, has been charged with four counts of capital murder.
target_text: 这位父亲名叫莱姆·龙，是个37岁的捕虾人。他已被指控犯有四项极刑谋杀罪。

source_text: If convicted, he faces either the death penalty or life imprisonment without parole.
target_text: 如果罪名成立，他就面临死刑或终身监禁不得减刑的判决。

source_text: "The inevitable nightmare we have feared has now been confirmed."
target_text: “我们一直担心的不可避免的噩梦现在应验了”。

source_text: "We believe, certainly now, that the father of these children threw these children off the Dauphin Island bridge," Mobile County sheriff Sam Cochran said on Saturday.
target_text: 莫比尔郡警长山姆·考克兰于星期六说：“我们现在可以确定，这几个孩子的父亲将他们从道芬岛大桥扔下”。

source_text: Luong and his wife, Kieu Ngoc Phan, reported the children missing on Monday.
target_text: 龙和他的妻子基尔·恩格·梵于星期一报案说这几个孩子失踪了。

source_text: When questioned, Luong claimed responsibility for the act, saying that he threw the children into the river after an argument with his wife.
target_text: 在受审的时候，龙承认对此事负责。他说，在与妻子争吵之后，他将孩子们扔到了河里。

source_text: However, he later retracted his confession, instead claiming that two women, one of whom is named "Kim", took the children and drove off in a van.
target_text: 然而，后来他又翻供了，声称是两个女人，其中一人名叫“吉姆”，用一辆厢货车绑架了孩子们。

source_text: "Why didn't he kill me instead of the children? It's too much hurting," Phan said through an interpreter while weeping.
target_text: 梵通过翻译哭着说：“他为什么不杀了我，却杀了孩子们？太伤心了”。

source_text: She was being comforted by an associate pastor from a Vietnamese church.
target_text: 当时一名来自越南教会的副牧师一直在安慰她。

source_text: According to the family, Luong called from jail and told them he wanted to be "more famous than the 9/11 hijackers" and that he "wasn't afraid of the electric chair".
target_text: 据他的家人说，龙在狱中打电话告诉他们，他想比“911劫机犯更有名”，而且他“不惧怕电椅”。

source_text: The search continues for the other two children - Hannah Luong, 2, and Lindsey Luong, 1.
target_text: 搜索另外两名儿童的行动正在继续中。一名是2岁的汉娜·龙，另一名是1岁的林赛·龙。

source_text: The search area has been expanded across the state border towards Pascagoula, Mississippi, as authorities believe the strong currents may have moved the bodies westward.
target_text: 搜索区域已经跨越州界进入密西西比州的帕斯卡古拉，因为当局认为尸体可能已被强大的水流带向西方。

source_text: Mobile County Commissioner Steve Nodine reports that the search is costing an estimated $100,000 per day.
target_text: 莫比尔郡治安法官史蒂夫·诺丹说，搜索行动估计每天要花费10万美元。

target_text: 近来，罗马尼亚西部遭到长达一周的暴雨，在某些地区引发严重的洪灾，还摧毁了其他地区的基础设施。

source_text: He was known to suffer from prostate cancer since October 2009.
target_text: 众所周知，他自2009年以来就患有前列腺癌。

source_text: He was born Dennis Lee Hopper on May 17, 1936 in Dodge City, Kansas.
target_text: 他于1936年5月17日出生在堪萨斯州道奇城，取名丹尼斯·李·霍珀。

source_text: As a young man, Hopper became interested in acting and eventually became a student of the Actors Studio.
target_text: 年轻的时候，霍帕对表演产生了兴趣，最终成为演员工作室的学生。

source_text: He made his first television appearance in 1955, and appeared in two films featuring James Dean, Rebel Without a Cause (1955) and Giant (1956).
target_text: 他于1955年首次在电视上露面，并在詹姆斯·迪恩主演的两部电影中扮演角色。一部是“无因的叛逆”（1955），另一部是“巨人”（1956）。

source_text: Over the next ten years, Hopper appeared frequently on television in guest roles, and by the end of the 1960s had played supporting roles in several films.
target_text: 在此后的10年里，霍帕频繁地以客串身份出现在电视上，并于1960年代末期在几部影片中出演配角。

source_text: He directed and starred in Easy Rider (1969), winning an award at the Cannes Film Festival, and was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay as co-writer of the film's script.
target_text: 他导演并主演了“逍遥骑士”（1969）。该片在戛纳电影节获奖，霍帕并以联合编剧的身份获奥斯卡最佳原创电影剧本提名。

source_text: Hopper was unable to build on this success for several years, until a featured role in Apocalypse Now (1979) brought him attention.
target_text: 霍帕好几年都无法取得进一步的发展，直到在“现代启示录”（1979）中扮演了一个特色角色。这个角色为他赢得了关注。

source_text: He subsequently received critical recognition for his work in Blue Velvet and Hoosiers, with the latter film garnering him an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actor.
target_text: 随后他又因其在“蓝丝绒”和“篮球怪杰”两部片子中的表现而获得评论家的承认，后一部影片为他收获了奥斯卡最佳男配角提名。

source_text: Hopper's more recent work included a leading role in the television series Crash.
target_text: 霍帕的近期作品包括在电视连续剧“撞车”中担任主演。

source_text: Hopper was a prolific photographer, painter, and sculptor whose works have been exhibited worldwide.
target_text: 霍帕是一个多产的摄影家、画家和雕塑家，他的作品在全世界都有展出。

source_text: The Swiss people have voted yes to the freedom of circulation to the new EU states.
target_text: 对于允许人员向新欧盟国家自由流通的协议，瑞士国民投了赞成票。

source_text: All the cantons voted yes, apart from the six and a half Ticino, Appenzell Innerrhoden, Obwalden, Nidwalden, Glarus, Schwyz and Uri.
target_text: 除了提契诺、内阿彭策尔、上瓦尔登、下瓦尔登、格拉鲁斯、施维茨和乌里这六个半州以外，所有的州都投了赞成票。

source_text: German-speaking and French-speaking parts of Switzerland had similar results; in previous national popular consultations, German-speaking cantons were regarded as less progressive than French-speaking ones.
target_text: 瑞士德语区和法语区的投票结果相似。在此前的全民协商公投中，德语州区被认为不像法语州区那么先进。

source_text: The campaign was especially harsh, most governmental parties calling for acceptance, except the far-right wing Swiss People's Party (though Swiss People's Party's charismatic figure Christoph Blocher personally called for acceptance as well).
target_text: 争论特别激烈。多数政府党派呼吁接受这一协议，但是极右翼的瑞士人民党则不在此列（尽管瑞士人民党的极具魅力的领导人克里斯托弗·布洛克个人也呼吁接受这一协议）。

source_text: Smaller formations, both from the extreme Right and extreme Left, attempted to smear fear of massive immigration and unemployement.
target_text: 小一点的团体，既有极右翼的又有极左翼的，试图散布对大规模移民和失业的恐惧。

source_text: Switzerland has ratified bilateral agreements with the members of the European Union in March 2004, but the new members (Cyprus, Czech Republic, Estonia, Hungary, Latvia, Lithuania, Malta, Poland, Slovakia and Slovenia) were not included in the deal.
target_text: 瑞士于2004年3月批准了与欧盟成员国的双边协议，但是约定中并不包括新成员国（塞浦路斯、捷克共和国、爱沙尼亚、匈牙利、拉脱维亚、立陶宛、马耳他、波兰、斯洛伐克和斯洛文尼亚）。

source_text: The results have been greeted by most of the political establishment.
target_text: 投票结果受到多数政治机构的欢迎。

source_text: Alinghi has defeated Team New Zealand by one second in the seventh race to win the 32nd America's Cup in a close run race.
target_text: 在第32届美国杯帆船赛第7段比赛中，阿灵基队以1秒的优势险胜新西兰队。

source_text: The final score was five wins for Alinghi and two for Team New Zealand in the best of nine challenge.
target_text: 九局五胜挑战赛的最后比分是：阿灵基队五胜，新西兰队二胜。

source_text: Skipper Brad Butterworth, coincidently a New Zealander, led the Switzerland-based boat to a second straight "Auld Mug" trophy.
target_text: 船长布莱德·巴塔沃斯碰巧也是新西兰人。他带领瑞士赛船连续第二次赢得了“奥德杯”。

source_text: The race started with Team New Zealand, skippered by Dean Barker, having a slight advantage.
target_text: 比赛刚开始时，迪恩·巴克船长率领的新西兰队略占优势。

source_text: Nearing the end of the second mark, Team New Zealand managed to overtake Alinghi to gain a 14 second lead.
target_text: 在接近第二个航标时，新西兰队超越阿灵基队，领先14秒。

source_text: However, when SUI-100 were catching up to NZL-92, Team New Zealand were penalised for port-starboard incident.
target_text: 然而，当SUI100号船正在赶超NZL92号船时，新西兰队因左右舷事故被处罚。

source_text: Coming up to the final leg of the race, Team New Zealand managed to take a 70 metre lead after the wind faded, and both yachts had dropped their spinnakers and Alinghi dropped into a hole.
target_text: 在比赛的最后一段，新西兰队在风停以后领先70米。两船都降下了大三角帆，阿灵基队掉进洞里。

source_text: Team New Zealand still had to complete their 360 degree penalty turn, and did so.
target_text: 新西兰队仍然必须完成360度转圈惩罚，于是只好这样去做。

source_text: After completing the turn, Alinghi sailed up beside them and took the win by one second.
target_text: 转圈完成后，阿灵基队从旁边超越，赢了1秒钟。

source_text: Micheline Calmy-Rey, president of Switzerland, sent a telegram to the team congratulating them of their win.
target_text: 瑞士总统米其林·卡尔米·雷伊向船队发贺电祝贺他们赢得了比赛。

source_text: "We Swiss find our way at sea, not just in the mountains," referring to Switzerland being most popular for Alpine skiing.
target_text: “我们瑞士不仅仅在山里，而且在海上也找到了路”。暗指瑞士是最受欢迎的高山滑雪胜地。

source_text: Managing director of Team New Zealand, Grant Dalton, said, "All credit to Alinghi."
target_text: 新西兰队总经理格兰特·达尔顿说：“阿灵基队值得大加称赞”。

source_text: "They kept it close when we got past them on the first run they just kept on sailing the way they do and beat us fair and square in the end."
target_text: “在第一段比赛过程中，当我们超过他们时，他们仍然按照自己的方式航行，最后正大光明地战胜了我们”。

target_text: 新西兰政府宣布，正拨款1千万新西兰元帮助把主要赛船保留下来。

source_text: This is just under double what the government gave them after the loss in 2003.
target_text: 这个数字几乎达到2003年输掉比赛后政府给他们拨款的两倍。

target_text: 新西兰体育和娱乐部长特雷弗·马拉德说：“政府认为，队伍要继续保留，要以新西兰为基地，而且奥克兰应该再次举办美洲杯帆船赛”。

source_text: Martin Garbus, Esq. filed a shareholder derivative suit Monday against Marvel Entertainment and its Chief Executive Officer Isaac Perlmutter, as well as Stan Lee, the creator of Marvel superhero characters, and Lee's wife and former Marvel Studios head, Avi Arad.
target_text: 马丁·贾伯斯先生于星期一对漫威娱乐公司及其首席执行官艾萨克·普尔玛塔和漫威超级英雄角色的原创人斯坦·李及其妻子，以及前漫威工作室负责人阿维·阿拉德提出了股东衍生诉讼。

source_text: The suit is for more than US$750 million (£528M) — about half of the estimated proceeds from Marvel's movies.
target_text: 诉案索赔超过7.5亿美元（5.28亿英镑），大约占漫威电影所得收益的一半。

source_text: Plaintiff Stan Lee Media (SLM) has four shareholders who live in Florida, California and Canada, and include Jose Abadin and Nelson Thall.
target_text: 原告斯坦·李媒体公司（SLM）有四位股东，分别居住在弗洛里达州、加利福尼亚州和加拿大，其中包括约瑟夫·阿巴丁和纳尔逊·塔尔。

source_text: The company is suing for recovery of civil damages representing one-half of film and book earnings from such blockbuster films as Spider-Man, Iron Man, X-Men, Hulk, and Fantastic Four franchises.
target_text: 该公司诉求民事赔偿，金额为来自走红大片，包括蜘蛛侠、钢铁侠、X战警、绿巨人，以及神奇四侠等特许经营权所获得的影片和图书收益的一半。

source_text: Defendants are accused of copyright violations over both the Marvel superhero characters and intellectual properties created by Stan Lee.
target_text: 被告被指控侵犯了斯坦·李原创的漫威超级英雄角色和知识产权。

source_text: Spider-Man's three cinematic outings, starring Tobey Maguire, earned more than $1bn (￡702m).
target_text: 由托比·马奎尔主演的三部蜘蛛侠影片收入了超过10亿美元（7亿2千万英镑）。

source_text: "Most of Marvel's financial success, including from the films, comes out of assets created by Stan Lee that are the subject of this suit," the complaint states.
target_text: 诉状指出：“漫威公司的大部分财务成功，包括经营影片的收入，均来自斯坦·李所创造的资产，这些都是诉讼标的”。

source_text: Lee, 86, has denied the allegations and has previously filed his own $50 million counter lawsuit against SLM, claiming the company has destroyed his name and reputation and prevented his effort to develop such properties as "The Accuser" and "The Drifter" and others via his first-look deals with Disney and Virgin Comics.
target_text: 今年86岁的李否认这一指控，并于此前对SLM公司提出了价值5千万美元的反诉讼，声称该公司毁坏了他的名誉并阻止他通过与迪斯尼和维京漫画公司签订优先合作契约来开发诸如“原告”和“流浪汉”等新资产的努力。

source_text: Former dot-com company STM further alleges that it has agreed to pay Lee a $250,000 annual salary plus $100 million in company stock in exchange for the rights to the superhero characters.
target_text: 前网络公司STM进一步声称其已经同意每年向李支付25万美元的年薪，外加1亿美元的公司股权，以换取超级英雄角色的使用权。

source_text: "That money should have gone to the corporation," said Garbus.
target_text: “那些钱应该已经到了该公司”，贾伯斯说。

source_text: Lee's counsel, Mark Williams, replied: "We look forward to a positive resolution for Stan Lee and his family."
target_text: 李的律师马克·威廉回答说：“我们期盼着能为斯坦·李及其家庭提供一个积极的解决方案”。

source_text: Marvel has said the court pleadings, which were filed in U.S. District Court in Manhattan, are filled with "ridiculous claims".
target_text: 漫威公司说，在曼哈顿联邦地方法院提交的诉状充满了“荒谬的主张”。

source_text: SLM ran out of operating capital during the dot-com meltdown in December 2000, closing operations entirely by December 19 of that year.
target_text: SLM公司在2000年12月网络公司崩溃期间耗尽了经营资本，当年12月19日彻底停止运营。

source_text: The company was placed into Chapter 11 Reorganization in Bankruptcy by Stan Lee in 2001.
target_text: 该公司被斯坦·李于2001年申请根据联邦破产法第11章进行重组。

source_text: During the insolvency proceedings, Lee assigned the major character franchises he had created to his new public company, POW! Entertainment, without the bankruptcy court's approval.
target_text: 在执行破产程序期间，李未经破产法庭的许可就将其原创的主要角色特许经营权转让给他的新上市公司POW！娱乐公司。

source_text: Two multi-billion dollar lawsuits for damages were filed against Lee, his new company, his new partner Arthur Lieberman and Marvel Entertainment for cybersquatting and failure to disclose the existence and value of the Rights Assignment Lee made to the company when he founded it.
target_text: 李、李的新公司、他的新合作伙伴阿瑟·利伯曼和漫威娱乐公司被提起了两项金额高达数十亿美元的诉讼，内容为恶意抢注物联网域名，以及李在设立公司时并未披露特许经营权转让的存在及其价值。

source_text: By November 2006, all of the officers and directors of the company had resigned or abandoned their positions and the company's lawyers for the debtors in possession attempted to obtain court authorization to destroy or dispose of the company's books and records.
target_text: 到了2006年11月，公司所有的高级职员和董事都辞职或放弃了自己的职位，而公司的债务人律师则试图获得法庭授权以销毁或处置公司的图书和录像录音。

source_text: This initiated a long-running legal battle between shareholders and the company's founder, Lee.
target_text: 这就在股东和公司创建人李之间引发了一场旷日持久的争斗。

source_text: The plaintiffs in this most recent suit contend that Lee, Perlmutter, Arthur Lieberman and Avi Arad conspired in bad faith to conceal and misappropriate financial interests in Lee's creations assigned to Stan Lee Media in 1998.
target_text: 最新诉讼案的原告声称，李、普尔玛塔、阿瑟·利伯曼和阿维·阿拉德恶意串通起来隐瞒和私占李于1998年转让给斯坦·李媒体公司的原创作品的经济利益。

source_text: SLM's meltdown involved its former President Peter F. Paul fleeing to Brazil, contributions made to Bill and Hillary Clinton, Paul's extradition and more.
target_text: 导致SLM公司崩溃的原因包括其前总裁彼得·F·保尔逃亡巴西、为比尔·克林顿和希拉里·克林顿提供的献金、保尔的引渡，以及其他各种原因。

source_text: Polling places opened at 13:00 UTC (8:00 AM EST) this morning in Palm Beach County, Florida for the United States midterm elections.
target_text: 弗洛里达州棕榈海滩郡的各个美国中期选举投票站于今日上午世界时13：00（东部时间上午8：00）开放。

source_text: Early voters wreaked havoc on the city streets, causing backups near polling locations and interrupting traffic flows to area elementary and senior high schools.
target_text: 早来投票的选民在城市街道上造成严重拥堵，导致投票站附近的交通堵塞，阻断了当地中小学的车流。

source_text: Due to the increase in traffic, some area school administrations asked teachers to accept late students without reprimand.
target_text: 由于交通量的增加，有些地区学校行政部门要求教师不得训斥迟到的学生。

source_text: Florida will elect a Federal senator, all of its House membership, a Governor, various other officers and vote on various questions.
target_text: 弗洛里达州将选举一名联邦参议员、该州全部众议员、州长和各类其他官员，并就各种各样的问题投票表决。

source_text: On Sunday, Iran tested its second underwater missile, the Fajr-3.
target_text: 星期日，伊朗试验了第二枚水下导弹Fajr3。

source_text: "The missile carries a very powerful warhead that enables it to operate against groups of warships and big submarines."
target_text: “该导弹携带非常强大的战斗部，可攻击舰艇集群和大型潜艇”。

source_text: "Even if an enemy's warship sonar can detect the missile, no warship can escape from this missile because of its high speed," said General Ali Fadavi of the Revolutionary Guards.
target_text: 革命卫队的阿里·法达维将军说：“即使敌方军舰的声纳能够侦察到该导弹，也绝对无法逃脱它的攻击，因为这枚导弹的速度极高”。

source_text: He said the missile can travel at 328 feet a second.
target_text: 他说，该导弹的飞行速度为每秒钟328英尺。

source_text: If Iran's claims are correct, it would make this missile the fastest underwater missile in the world.
target_text: 如果伊朗的说法正确，那么这种导弹将是世界上速度最快的水下导弹。

source_text: The second fastest missile would be the Russian's VA-111 Shkval, which was developed in 1995.
target_text: 速度第二快的导弹是俄罗斯于1995年研制的VA111“暴风”导弹。

source_text: "This technology is completely new, without copying any other missile systems that may exist in other countries" and also says it can carry several warheads.
target_text: “这是一项全新的技术，没有抄袭任何其他国家的导弹系统”。他还说，该导弹能携带多种战斗部。

source_text: It is also reported that more missiles will be tested during war games later in the week.
target_text: 另据报道，本周晚些时候将在作战演习中试验更多的导弹。

source_text: Norwegian cyclist Thor Hushovd sprinted his way to a stage four victory in the 2007 Tour de France on Wednesday.
target_text: 星期三，在2007年环法自行车赛上，挪威车手托尔·胡舒福德全力冲刺赢得了第四段的胜利。

source_text: Fabian Cancellara of Switzerland maintained the overall lead, while Hushovd moved into second place, 29 seconds behind Cancellara.
target_text: 瑞士车手法比安·堪萨拉拉保持总体领先，而胡舒福德上升到第二名，比前者落后29秒。

source_text: "When I get into the mountains, it's sure that it's finished," Cancellara said.
target_text: 堪萨拉拉说：“当我进入山地后，就确信比赛结束了”。

source_text: Danish mountain specialist, and "King of the Mountains" for 2005 and 2006, Michael Rasmussen agrees that the Alps will be a turning point in the race.
target_text: 丹麦山地专业车手，2005年和2006年的“山地之王”迈克尔·拉斯姆森也认为阿尔卑斯山将成为比赛的转折点。

source_text: "We'll definitely get some answers on those days," Rasmussen said.
target_text: 拉斯姆森说：“到了那几天，我们肯定就有答案了”。

source_text: French mountain specialist Remy Di Gregorio withdrew from the Tour after fracturing his elbow during stage 4.
target_text: 法国山地专业车手雷米·迪·格里高利在第四段时肘部受伤骨折，因而退出了比赛。

source_text: The Norwegian Ministry of Health and Care Services is considering prosecuting and banning some Scientology practices, in particular the use of the Scientology personality test to sell courses.
target_text: 挪威卫生和保健服务部长正考虑起诉和禁止山达基教的某些行为，特别是利用山达基教的人格测试来出售课程的行为。

source_text: State Secretary Rigmor Aasrud said that the activities in question might be prosecuted as fraud or as violations of existing healthcare regulations.
target_text: 国务秘书瑞格莫·阿斯鲁德说，上述活动可能被指控为欺诈或违反现存保健条例。

source_text: A Norwegian Member of Parliament (MP) whose daughter killed herself after taking such a test, supports the idea of prosecuting illegal practices rather than trying to ban the movement as a whole.
target_text: 一位女儿已在接受这种测试后自杀的挪威议员（MP）支持起诉非法行为的想法，而不是禁止整个山达基教运动。

source_text: The statement was made after three journalists from the online edition of the newspaper Verdens Gang (VG) took the test.
target_text: 这项声明是在三名“世界之路报”（VG）网络版记者接受测试以后发布的。

source_text: The journalists wore hidden recording devices, and did not disclose that they were journalists; VG put the recordings on its website.
target_text: 记者们身上隐藏着录音装置，而且没有暴露自己的记者身份。《世界之路报》将录音发到了网站上。

source_text: Scientology staff members told all three that they should buy a course to handle psychological issues.
target_text: 山达基教的工作人员告诉三人说，他们都需要买一节课来解决心理问题。

source_text: Two of the journalists filled out the 200 questions with honest answers, while the third gave answers consistent with being depressed.
target_text: 两名记者如实回答了200个问题，而第三名记者按照心情抑郁的症状回答了问题。

source_text: The "depressed" journalist was told that he should avoid traditional medicine, while one of the "normal" journalists was told that the course was her only hope for improvement unless she wanted to start taking "chemicals".
target_text: 那名“抑郁”的记者被告知，他应该避免服用传统药物，而“正常”记者中的一名被告知，该课程是她改善状态的唯一希望，除非她想开始服用“化学品”。

source_text: Matthias Fosse, spokesperson for the Church of Scientology in Norway, said that the staff members in question were acting individually.
target_text: 挪威的山达基教会发言人马提亚斯·佛斯说，上述工作人员所行属于个人行为。

source_text: He said that the Church of Scientology does not give medical advice, but that it encourages people to focus on the side effects of medications, and is critical of the "over-medication" of psychiatric patients.
target_text: 他说，山达基教教会并不提供医疗咨询，但是该组织鼓励人们注意药物的副作用，而且对精神病患者的“用药过度”持批判态度。

source_text: Olav Gunnar Ballo, a Norwegian MP and medical doctor whose daughter Kaja suddenly killed herself after a negative experience with the Scientology test in France in March 2008, released a book about Kaja Ballo's life in April 2009.
target_text: 挪威国会议员并是医师的奥拉夫·古纳尔·巴罗于2009年4月出版了一本书，描述他的女儿卡嘉·巴罗的生活。卡嘉2008年3月在法国经历了山达基教测试的负面体验后，突然结束了自己的生命。

source_text: The book debuted on 2nd place in the Norwegian best seller list.
target_text: 这本书首次发行就成为挪威最佳畅销书榜单上的第二名。

source_text: Ballo listened to the recorded test result sessions from VG and said that he found the practice "horrible and harmful".
target_text: 在听了来自VG的山达基教测试结果录音后，巴罗说，他发现这一行径“恐怖而且有害”。

source_text: He told the newspaper Dagbladet that Norway could have something to learn from the current French prosecution of Scientology corporations and individuals, by prosecuting specific harmful practices rather than banning Scientology as a whole.
target_text: 他对挪威日报说，挪威从当前法国对山达基教的组织和个人的起诉中，能够学到一些经验教训，可以对具体的有害行为进行起诉，而不是禁止整个山达基教运动。

source_text: Matthias Fosse said that France is a far more secular society than Norway, and that France were going too far in their prosecution.
target_text: 马提亚斯·佛斯说，法国社会的世俗观念比挪威社会强很多，法国的起诉太离谱了。

source_text: He said that France has a list of 165 organizations considered to be "sects", which not just included Scientology but also covered Baptists such as former U.S. president Bill Clinton.
target_text: 他说，法国开出了一份清单，列出了165个被认为是“教派”的组织，其中不仅包括山达基教，而且还包括像美国前总统比尔·克林顿等的浸礼会教徒。

source_text: The list which Fosse referred to is a list from the 1995 Parliamentary Commission on Cults in France.
target_text: 佛斯提到的清单系指1995年法国议会邪教委员会开列的那份清单。

source_text: Fosse said that the OSCE, the U.S. State Department and the UN had criticised French "violations of human rights".
target_text: 佛斯说，欧安组织、美国国务院和联合国均曾批评法国“侵犯人权”。

source_text: General Motors Corporation (GM) announced on Wednesday that it saw a 45% drop in United States vehicle sales for its cars in March.
target_text: 通用汽车公司（GM）星期三宣布，该公司于美国的汽车销售在3月份下降了百分之45。

source_text: Executives from several auto firms, however, said that there was some hope for the auto industry to stabilise, as car sales rebounded in the last week of March.
target_text: 然而，几家汽车公司的高管说，汽车工业有希望稳定下来，因为汽车销售在3月最后一周有所反弹。

source_text: "The market is starting to show small signs of life which need to be nourished like seedlings," said the vice president and chairman of Chrysler LLC Jim Press.
target_text: 克莱斯勒有限责任公司副总裁和董事长吉姆·普莱斯指出：“市场开始显示微小的生命迹象，需要像幼苗一样来滋养”。

source_text: "It's too early to see a trend, but spring shows signs of hope."
target_text: “现在对趋势进行预测还为时过早，但是春天已显示出希望的迹象”。

source_text: Other automobile manufacturers also saw their car sales slip: Chrysler and the Japanese Toyota both reported a 39% loss, whilst Ford Motor Company sales fell 41%.
target_text: 其他汽车制造厂商的汽车销售同样发生下滑：克莱斯勒和日本丰田都报告了百分之39的亏损，而福特汽车公司的销售则下降了百分之41。

source_text: Annualised sales of vehicles in the car industry in the US are predicted to have dipped below nine million in March, compared to February's 9.12 million, which was the lowest number since 1981.
target_text: 相较于2月份的九百一十万辆，3月份预测的美国汽车产业年销售量已经降到九百万辆以下，这是1981年以来最低的数字。

source_text: "Auto makers are pulling every lever in their effort to attract buyers, as evidenced by the new programs from Ford and GM."
target_text: “汽车制造商正在竭尽全力吸引买主，福特和通用汽车的新计划证明了这一点”。

source_text: "The typical incentive programs simply do not resonate in today's economy," Jesse Toprak, an analyst for Edmunds.
target_text: 埃德蒙兹汽车交易平台的分析家杰西·托普拉克说：“典型的激励计划在现今的经济环境中得不到回应”。

source_text: Ford shares gained 2.3% to a level of US$2.69 in early trading at US stock markets on Wednesday, while stocks for Toyota's US depository increased 5.9% to $67.
target_text: 在星期三的美国股市早期交易中，福特的股价上涨了百分之2.3，达到2.69美元，而丰田的美股存托股票的股价则上涨了百分之5.9，达到67美元。

source_text: Gonzalez had suffered with the illness for several years and was wheelchair bound.
target_text: 冈萨雷斯已患此病多年，并被迫长期坐在轮椅上。

source_text: Standing over 7.5 feet (2.3 metres) tall, Gonzalez was originally a basketball player before becoming a wrestler.
target_text: 身高7.5英尺（2.3米）的冈萨雷斯原先是一名篮球运动员，后来又成了一名摔跤运动员。

source_text: Upon moving to the United States, he was drafted in the third round of the 1988 NBA draft by the Atlanta Hawks.
target_text: 他刚刚移居美国，就在1988年NBA第三轮选秀中被亚特兰大鹰队选中。

source_text: After his basketball career ended, he joined World Championship Wrestling (WCW).
target_text: 结束了篮球生涯以后，他加入了世界摔跤锦标赛（WCW）。

source_text: During his time there, he wrestled as El Gigante for two years, then joining the World Wrestling Federation (WWF), now World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE).
target_text: 在从事摔跤运动期间，他化名伊莱·吉根特参加了两年比赛，然后参加了世界摔跤联合会（WWF），现在是世界摔跤娱乐公司（WWE）的成员。

source_text: He debuted at the 1993 Royal Rumble where he eliminated Undertaker from the Royal Rumble match.
target_text: 他于1993年“皇家大战”中首次出场就将“送葬者”淘汰出局。

source_text: After leaving the company, he wrestled in Japan before retiring in 1995 after suffering from sciatic nerve pain.
target_text: 此后，他又去日本从事摔跤运动。1995年因坐骨神经痛而退役。

source_text: A gunman shot and injured two men early this morning outside the Vault XXI nightclub in the Little Tokyo district in Los Angeles, California.
target_text: 今晨，在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶市小东京区金库二十一夜总会，一名枪手开枪击伤两人。

source_text: Witnesses say the two men, both Asian and in their 20s, were smoking outside the club when a man wearing a ski mask approached and shot the two around 1:30 a.m. local time (9:30 UTC).
target_text: 据目击者说，当时这两名二十几岁的亚裔男子正在夜总会门外吸烟，突然一名带着滑雪面具的男人走了过来，随即开枪击中了他们。事发时间大约为当地时间清晨1：30（世界时9：30）。

source_text: The men suffered multiple wounds and crawled into the club.
target_text: 两人身上多处受伤并爬进夜总会。

source_text: Police believe the shooter was possibly Asian and was about five feet seven inches tall.
target_text: 警方说，枪手可能也是亚裔，大约身高5英尺7英寸。

source_text: Investigators say there were ten bullet casings at the scene from a semiautomatic firearm.
target_text: 调查人员说，现场留下了10枚半自动武器的弹壳。

source_text: Lt. Vernon said, "We’re lucky more people were not injured in this attack."
target_text: 弗农上尉说：“幸运的是，在这次袭击中没有更多人受伤”。

source_text: In the second set, Great Britain managed to keep the game competitive by forcing Ukraine to make more use of the full court.
target_text: 在第二局中，英国队通过逼迫乌克兰队更多地利用全场而设法使比赛变得更加激烈。

source_text: They went from being behind 14-8 to being down 20-17; at which point, Ukraine took a time out.
target_text: 他们从14比8落后追到20比17；此时乌克兰队叫停。

source_text: Ukraine managed to stay ahead despite a challenge from Great Britain in the second set, which saw the score get to 23-20.
target_text: 尽管在第二局中英国发起了挑战，但是乌克兰队依然保持领先，最后比分是23比20。

source_text: Following the game, both teams were loudly cheered as they exited the court.
target_text: 比赛结束后，两个队都受到全场的欢呼。

source_text: This was followed by a demonstration of the sport by the Lord Mayor of London Boris Johnson and British actress Barbara Windsor, with the arena commentator noting Johnson is a surprisingly good player.
target_text: 赛后，伦敦市长波利斯·约翰逊和英国女演员芭芭拉·温莎进行了该项运动的表演赛。场内评论员指出，约翰逊是一名技艺惊人的好运动员。

source_text: The game was the first for Great Britain in the country's history, having never qualified a team before.
target_text: 在英国举办的这场比赛是史无前例的。此前没有任何一支英国队获得该项运动的参赛资格。

source_text: Players on the team are drawn from several clubs around the nation, with Julie Rogers, Jessica Frezza and Andrea Green coming from the Loughborough Lions, Victoria Widdup, Martine Wright and Claire Harvey usually playing for the London Lynx, Samantha Bowen, Jessica O'Brien and Amy Brierly playing for the FDSW Celtic Dragons, and Emma Wiggs and Nicole Hill playing for Portsmouth.
target_text: 队员们是从全国各地抽调的。居里·罗杰斯、杰西卡·弗莱泽和安德里亚·格林来自拉夫堡狮队，维多利亚·维达普、马丁·莱特和克莱尔·哈维通常效力于伦敦猞猁队，萨曼塔·波文、杰西卡·奥布莱恩和艾米·布里厄利效力于FDSW凯尔特龙队，艾玛·维格斯和尼克尔·希尔则来自朴次茅斯。

source_text: They will play their second match of pool play tomorrow when they face the Netherlands.
target_text: 他们明天将在小组赛的第二场比赛中与荷兰队相遇。

source_text: Ukraine, the top ranked European side in the competition, entered the tournament having finished second at the Intercontinental Cup earlier in the year where they beat Russia, Slovenia, Brazil and Great Britain.
target_text: 作为欧洲排名最高的队伍，乌克兰队在今年年初的洲际杯赛中获得第二名，分别击败了俄罗斯、斯洛文尼亚、巴西和英国。

source_text: According to media reports, John McCain has won the New Hampshire Primary for the Republicans in the 2008 Presidential race.
target_text: 根据媒体报道，在2008年总统竞选中，约翰·麦凯恩赢得了新罕布什尔州的共和党初选。

source_text: "I hate to use to the word kid, but I think we showed the people of this country what a real comeback looks like."
target_text: “我认为，我们已经让这个国家的人民知道了什么叫做东山再起，虽然我并不愿意使用这个词”。

source_text: "I'm committed to keeping this country safe, and we're going to move on to Michigan and South Carolina and win the nomination," said McCain.
target_text: 麦凯恩说：“我承诺维护这个国家的安全。我们将向密歇根和加利福尼亚进军，并赢得最终提名”。

source_text: Also according to media reports, New York Senator Hillary Clinton has won the New Hampshire Primary in the 2008 United States Presidential race.
target_text: 另据媒体报道，纽约州参议员希拉里·克林顿在2008年美国总统竞选中也已赢得了新罕布什尔州的初选。

source_text: MSNBC reports that Clinton beat Barack Obama by a "very narrow margin."
target_text: 微软全国有线广播电视公司报道说，克林顿以“非常微弱的优势”战胜了巴拉克·奥巴马。

source_text: Opinion polls held before the polls closed showed Obama winning.
target_text: 投票结束前的民意调查显示，奥巴马获胜。

source_text: The BBC has announced it will not play "Ding-Dong! The Witch Is Dead" in its entirety on today's Radio 1 Chart Show.
target_text: 英国广播公司宣布，今天的1号台排行榜节目中将不会完整播出“叮咚！女巫已死！”。

source_text: The song has become the third most downloaded single of the week, following the death of former United Kingdom Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher.
target_text: 这首歌已经在英国前首相玛格丽特·撒切尔去世后的那一周，成为该周下载量第三大的单曲。

source_text: The song is featured in the 1939 film The Wizard of Oz.
target_text: 它是1939年发行的电影“绿野仙踪”主题曲。

source_text: Controller of Radio 1 Ben Cooper said "about a four or five second clip" of the song would be included in a news item explaining why it has featured in the charts, which will air as part of the programme.
target_text: 1号台负责人本·库珀说：这首歌中有一段大约“四五秒钟长的剪辑”将出现在一个新闻条目中，作为节目的一部分播出，以说明它为何能够在榜单上出现。

source_text: BBC Director-General Tony Hall stated that although he believed the song was "distasteful and inappropriate", an outright ban would breach the principle of free speech.
target_text: 英国广播公司总干事托尼·豪尔指出，虽然他认为这首歌“既品位低下又不合时宜”，但是，如果明令禁止，则有悖于言论自由的原则。

source_text: Mrs Thatcher's supporters have launched a campaign to get "I'm in Love with Margaret Thatcher" into the music chart alongside "Ding Dong the Witch is Dead".
target_text: 撒切尔夫人的支持者发动了一场运动，以使“我爱玛格丽特·撒切尔”与“叮咚！女巫已死！”一起进入音乐排行榜。

source_text: Mrs Thatcher's funeral is scheduled for St.Paul's Cathedral on Wednesday.
target_text: 撒切尔夫人的葬礼计划于星期三在圣保罗大教堂举行。

source_text: It is to be attended by leading figures from the worlds of politics and entertainment, as well as several international figures, including former Australian Prime Minister John Howard and inventor of the World Wide Web Sir Tim Berners-Lee.
target_text: 出席葬礼的有政界和娱乐界的重要人物，以及几位国际知名人士，包括澳大利亚前总理约翰·霍华德和万维网创始人蒂姆·伯纳斯·李。

source_text: Two Canadian navy ships and two airforce planes, a CC-138 Twin Otter and a CP-140 Aurora, took part in the exercises in the Canada's Arctic.
target_text: 两艘加拿大军舰和两架空军飞机，一架CC138双引擎“水獭”和一架CP140“北极光”，参加了在加拿大北极海区举行的演习。

source_text: The HMCS Toronto and the Canadian Coast Guard ship Pierre Radisson travelled along the Hudson Strait.
target_text: 加拿大皇家海军舰艇“多伦多”号和加拿大海岸警卫队舰艇“皮埃尔·拉迪森”号穿越了哈德孙海峡。

source_text: The Operation extended to Davis Strait, and Frobisher Bay during the annual NANOOK Operation.
target_text: 这次一年一度的“NANOOK行动”延伸到戴维斯海峡和弗罗比舍湾。

source_text: As more Arctic ice melts, the ships sail through uncharted waters.
target_text: 由于越来越多的北极浮冰正在融化，这两艘舰艇得以在未知水域航行。

source_text: Emergency response times were tested for such potential disasters as oil spills, or rescue operations such as responding to cruise ship emergencies.
target_text: 演习中对应急反应时间，包括对石油泄漏，或对大型邮轮应急事件等潜在海难的反应时间进行了测试。

source_text: General Walter Natynczyk, Canada's chief of Defence staff, the Honourable Peter MacKay, Defence Minister as well as Minister of the Atlantic Canada Opportunities Agency, and Steven Fletcher, Member of Parliament for Charleswood–St.James–Assiniboia and Parliamentary Secretary for Health, flew to Iqaluit, Nunavut to officially launch the exercise on August 19, 2008 and observe the process.
target_text: 2008年8月19日，加拿大国防军总参谋长沃特·纳汀奇克上将、国防部长兼加拿大大西洋机遇署署长皮特·麦凯和查尔斯伍德、圣詹姆斯以及阿西尼博亚地区国会议员兼议会卫生秘书斯蒂芬·弗莱彻飞往努纳武特地区的伊奎特启动了演习并观察了演习过程。

source_text: In addition to the military exercises, Veterans Affairs Canada held a commemorative event onboard the HMCS Toronto to honour the 55th Anniversary of the Cease Fire in Korea, the 65th Anniversary of the Battle of the Atlantic, and the start of the Last 100 days of the First World War.
target_text: 除了军事演习之外，加拿退伍军人事务部还在“多伦多”舰上举行了纪念仪式，庆祝朝鲜战争停战55周年、大西洋之战65周年和第一次世界大战最后100天的开始。

source_text: The inaugural ceremonies were held during Community Day activities in the capital city of Iqaluit, followed by the public panel discussion held on Saturday.
target_text: 庆典当日正是伊奎特首府的社区活动日。庆典结束后又在星期六举办了公开小组讨论会。

source_text: The community day ceremonies were organized by participants in Operation NANOOK 2008.
target_text: 社区活动日的庆典是由“NANOOK2008”行动的参加人员所组织的。

source_text: The public ceremonies received neither Nunavut politicians nor Inuit leaders.
target_text: 公共庆典既未邀请努纳武特政界人物，也未邀请因纽特领导人。

source_text: United States presidential candidate Hillary Clinton warned Iran against an attack on Israel; "I want the Iranians to know that if I'm the president, we will attack Iran," the former First Lady said.
target_text: 美国总统候选人希拉里·克林顿警告伊朗不要对以色列发动进攻。这位前第一夫人说：“我想让伊朗人知道，如果我是总统，我们将会攻击伊朗”。

source_text: Clinton was speaking in an interview on ABC's Good Morning America television program.
target_text: 克林顿夫人是在美国广播公司电视节目“早安，美国”中接受采访的时候说出这番话的。

source_text: "In the next 10 years, during which they might foolishly consider launching an attack on Israel, we would be able to totally obliterate them," Clinton said.
target_text: 克林顿夫人说：“在今后10年里，如果他们愚蠢地考虑对以色列发动一场攻击，那么我们将有能力把他们彻底消灭”。

source_text: "That's a terrible thing to say but those people who run Iran need to understand that because that perhaps will deter them from doing something that would be reckless, foolish and tragic."
target_text: “说出那样的话很可怕，但是伊朗的统治者们需要懂得这一点，因为也许只有这样才能阻止他们做出鲁莽、愚蠢和悲剧性的事情”。

source_text: "One of the things that we've seen over the last several years is a bunch of talk using words like 'obliterate,'" Barack Obama said in a separate ABC interview.
target_text: 巴拉克·奥巴马在另一次ABC采访中说：“在过去几年里，我们听到在大量的谈话中都用到了‘消灭’这类词语”。

source_text: Last night, on MSNBC's Countdown with Keith Olbermann, Hillary Clinton said US allies in the Middle East are "intimidated and bullied into submission by Iran."
target_text: 昨晚，在微软全国有线广播电视台与基斯·奥尔伯曼进行的倒计时辩论中，希拉里·克林顿说，中东地区的美国盟友“在伊朗的恐吓与威胁下屈服了”。

source_text: Here also, she warned that an attack on Israel would bring "massive retaliation" for Iran.
target_text: 她再次警告说，如果伊朗对以色列发动攻击，它将遭受“大规模报复行动”。

source_text: Clinton and Obama face off today in the Pennsylvania Democratic primary.
target_text: 克林顿夫人和奥巴马今天将在宾夕法尼亚州民主党初选中对决。

source_text: With 158 delegates at stake, Pennsylvania is the largest of the remaining states and territories yet to decide.
target_text: 宾夕法尼亚州有158个选举人投票意向未决，因此成为在余下的几个州和领地中最大的一个有待定夺的选区。

source_text: The 2013 Beverly Hills Film Festival is set to open on Wednesday.
target_text: 2013年贝弗利山电影节将于星期三开幕。

source_text: The event will feature multiple independently produced films and screenplays.
target_text: 这次活动将以多部独立制作的电影和剧本为其特色。

source_text: 130 screenplays have been listed as finalists in the Screenplays category.
target_text: 在进入最后角逐的剧本目录中已列入了130个电影剧本。

source_text: Numerous films will be screened at the festival, including the short film, Byron's Theme.
target_text: 节日活动中将放映大量的电影片，其中包括短片“拜伦主题曲”。

source_text: Other films include A Thousand Kisses Deep, and A White Mule.
target_text: 此外还有“一千个深吻”和“白骡”等电影。

source_text: Screenwriter and indie film producer, Kara Rainer's story entitled RORRIM was selected as a finalist in the screenplay category.
target_text: 电影剧本作家兼独立电影制作人卡拉·雷纳的故事片“RORRIM”入选参加最后角逐的剧本目录。

source_text: Rainer told Wikinews, "...I am thrilled that RORRIM was picked with so many [screenplays] being selected."
target_text: 雷纳告诉维基新闻说，“……很激动，RORRIM能从如此多的参选【剧本】中脱颖而出”。

source_text: In 2012, the festival opened with the film, The Black Tulip, a film shot entirely in Afghanistan.
target_text: 2012年，在该电影节的开幕式上放映了影片“黑郁金香”，该片全部镜头均在阿富汗境内拍摄。

source_text: Previous festival attendees reads like a 'Who's Who' in Hollywood: Martin Landua, Danny Devito and Doris Roberts, among many others.
target_text: 此前的电影节与会者有：马丁·兰度瓦、丹尼·德维托和多丽丝·罗伯茨，读起来就像一本好莱坞名人录。

source_text: Up to 539 oil workers are being moved off the affected rig in an operation that began at 09:20 UTC this morning.
target_text: 撤离行动于今天上午世界时9点20开始，多达539名工人离开了这座危险钻塔。

source_text: Barry Nielson, a Squadron leader with the RAF was quoted (BBC News) as saying "It's unusual, that's probably the best way to describe it."
target_text: （BBC新闻）引用皇家空军中队长巴利·尼尔松的话说：“情况非常罕见，恐怕这样描述是最合适的”。

source_text: "But it falls within our normal operating procedures and we are reacting accordingly."
target_text: “但是它没有超出我们的正常操作程序，所以我们采取了相应行动”。

source_text: By the end of the day, the alert had ended, with Kathy McGill (manging director of the firm responsible for the rig) being quoted as saying "We are very relieved that this has turned out to be a false alarm, but we obviously had to treat it seriously and act appropriately to ensure the safety and well being of all our people."
target_text: 当天傍晚，警报解除。引用卡西·麦克吉尔（该公司负责这部钻塔的总经理）说：“结果发现那是一个虚警。但是我们显然不得不认真对待它，并采取适当行动来确保全体人员的安全和健康”。

source_text: A Mig-29 jet fighter of the Serbian Air Force and Air Defense crashed near Belgrade, Serbia, on Tuesday.
target_text: 星期二，一架塞尔维亚空军及防空军的米格29喷气式战斗机坠落在塞尔维亚贝尔格拉德市附近。

source_text: The pilot ejected from the airplane and was transferred to military hospital.
target_text: 飞行员从飞机中弹射出来后，已被转送军方医院。

source_text: Lt. Col. Rade Randjelovic, aged 47, suffered serious injuries and died at the hospital.
target_text: 今年47岁的拉德·兰杰洛维奇中校伤势严重并在医院死去。

source_text: A soldier located on the ground was also killed, and another injured.
target_text: 此外，还有一位在地面执勤的士兵死亡，另一名受伤。

source_text: Randjelovic was conducting a training flight at the time of the accident and was preparing for the Belgrade aircraft acrobatics show.
target_text: 事故发生时，兰杰洛维奇正在执行训练飞行，为贝尔格拉德特技飞行表演做准备。

source_text: The Serbian Air Force has five MiG-29s which were repaired between 2007 and 2008 at a cost of €15m (£13 m).
target_text: 塞尔维亚空军拥有5架米格29。在2007年与2008年期间，该国花费了1千5百万欧元（1千3百万英镑）对它们进行维修。

source_text: The cause of the crash is still unknown, pending an official investigation.
target_text: 坠机原因不明，有待官方进行调查。

source_text: The Australian federal government has announced it will subsidise the breast-cancer drug Herceptin under the Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme (PBS) for women with HER2 positive cancer.
target_text: 澳大利亚联邦政府宣布，将根据药物福利计划（PBS）为HER2阳性癌症妇女的乳腺癌药物赫赛汀提供补贴。

source_text: Those with advanced breast cancer will continue to be eligible for special assistance from Medicare Australia independently from the PBS.
target_text: 晚期乳腺癌患者将继续享有澳大利亚联邦医疗保险独立于PBS提供的特殊援助。

source_text: According to the Commonwealth Department of Health and Ageing, around 2,000 of the 14,000 cases of breast cancer diagnosed annually are of the HER2 positive type.
target_text: 根据英联邦卫生和老龄部的统计，每年诊断出的14,000例乳腺癌中约有2,000例属于HER2阳性型。

source_text: Herceptin has shown to prevent the recurrence of cancer in 30% of these patients.
target_text: 赫赛汀已经证明可以防止百分之30的患者再次发生癌症。

source_text: In order to constrain costs, the government has accepted a recommendation from the Pharmaceutical Benefits Advisory Committee (PABC) to provide Herceptin under the PBS only to patients who have the HER2 positive type of cancer, who have undergone surgery and who are undergoing chemotherapy.
target_text: 为了限制成本，政府已接受药物福利咨询委员会（PABC）的建议，仅在患有HER2阳性癌症，接受过手术和正在接受化疗的患者中提供PBS下的赫赛汀。

source_text: In addition, those who are predisposed to heart damage (which can be a side effect of the drug) will not be provided with the subsidised medication.
target_text: 此外，那些易患心脏病（可能是药物的副作用）的人将不会获得补贴药物。

source_text: The government will provide subsidised Herceptin for 52 weeks (as found to be most effective in clinical trials) at a cost of around AUD$50,000 per patient.
target_text: 政府将提供为期52周的赫赛汀补贴（在临床试验中被证明是最有效的），费用约为每位患者5万澳元。

source_text: Herceptin will become available on the PBS from 1 October.
target_text: 赫赛汀将于10月1日起可通过PBS获取。

source_text: The most successful country this year was Italy, with a total of 153 medals, 57 of which were gold.
target_text: 今年最成功的国家是意大利，共有153枚奖牌，其中57枚是金牌。

source_text: France tied in their total number of medals, but had one less gold medal.
target_text: 在奖牌总数上法国队与之相同，但少了一枚金牌。

source_text: The next Mediterranean Games will be held in Pescara, Italy in 2009.
target_text: 下一届地中海运动会将于2009年在意大利佩斯卡拉举行。

source_text: Washington, D.C. - The Environmental Protection Agency may have a new tool in its arsenal to fight global warming.
target_text: 华盛顿特区-环境保护署可能在其工具库中中有了对抗全球变暖的新工具。

source_text: The agency has submitted a proposal to the Obama administration which aims to list carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gasses as pollutants under the Clean Air Act.
target_text: 该机构向奥巴马政府提交了一份提案，旨在根据“清洁空气法”将二氧化碳和其他温室气体列为污染物。

source_text: The policy had previously been proposed to and rejected by the Bush administration, which said it was the wrong tool to be using.
target_text: 该政策此前曾向布什政府提出但并拒绝，该政府表示这是一个错误的工具。

source_text: The proposal lists the negative effects of global warming, including longer and hotter heat waves, increased flooding, and the increased spread of diseases due to warmer weather.
target_text: 该提案列出了全球变暖的负面影响，包括更长和更热的热浪，洪水增加以及由于天气变暖导致的疾病传播增加。

source_text: EPA administrator Lisa Jackson has previously suggested declaring global warming a health threat, and that the agency could use the 1970 Clean Air Act to use to combat it.
target_text: 环境保护署署长丽莎·杰克逊此前曾建议宣布全球变暖是一种健康威胁，该机构可以利用1970年的《清洁空气法》来对抗它。

source_text: Environmental groups applauded the finding, with the director of Clean Air Watch, Frank O'Donnell, calling it "a green-letter day for the environment."
target_text: 环保组织对这一发现表示欢迎，“清洁空气观察”主任弗兰克·奥唐奈称这是“环境的绿色日”。

source_text: One of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce vice presidents, William L. Kovacs, said if the the proposal is put into effect that it "will be devastating to the economy."
target_text: 美国商会副会长威廉·L·科瓦奇表示，如果该提案付诸实施，“将对经济造成毁灭性的打击”。

source_text: It is unclear whether the Obama administration will go along with the proposal.
target_text: 目前还不清楚奥巴马政府是否会同意该提议。

source_text: White House spokesman Ben LaBolt commented that "The president has made clear that to combat climate change, his strong preference is for Congress to pass energy security legislation that includes a cap on greenhouse gas emissions."
target_text: 白宫发言人本·拉伯特评论说：“总统已经明确表示，为了应对气候变化，他强烈希望国会通过能源安全立法，其中包括限制温室气体排放。”

source_text: No specific timeline has been given for when a decision would be made.
target_text: 至于何时做出决定，目前还没有给出具体的时间表。

source_text: An upcoming conference in Copenhagen, Denmark will focus on drawing up a new international global warming treaty, which the United States plans to attend, a clear reversal from the Bush administration's non-participation in the 1997 Kyoto Protocol.
target_text: 丹麦哥本哈根即将召开的会议将重点拟定美国计划参加的新的国际全球变暖条约，这与布什政府不参加1997年“京都议定书”的情况明显相反。

source_text: Facebook announced Thursday it will begin to share some of the technology from their social network.
target_text: Facebook周四宣布将开始分享其社交网络中的部分技术。

source_text: Facebook hopes that they will be able to benefit from the innovations of others.
target_text: Facebook希望他们能够从其他人的创新中受益。

source_text: Mark Zuckerberg, Facebook's CEO, announced the company's "Open Compute Project" at an event held for reporters at the company's headquarters in Palo Alto, California.
target_text: Facebook首席执行官马克·扎克伯格在加利福尼亚州帕洛阿尔托公司总部为记者举办的活动中宣布了该公司的“公开计算项目”。

source_text: Facebook will not directly make any money from the new project.
target_text: Facebook不会直接从新项目中赚到钱。

source_text: However, by making the designs of its servers open source, the company hopes others will find ways to improve them.
target_text: 然而，通过使其服务器的设计成为开源，该公司希望其他人能找到改进它们的方法。

source_text: They can then incorporate those advances into their own servers.
target_text: 然后，他们可以将这些进步纳入自己的服务器。

source_text: Anything that can make Facebook's servers run more efficiently provides a major benefit for the company.
target_text: 任何可以使Facebook服务器更高效运行的东西都为公司带来了巨大的好处。

source_text: More efficient servers will also drive down utility costs for the social media giant, which relies on massive data centers around the United States to keep its operations going.
target_text: 更高效的服务器也将降低这家社交媒体巨头的公用事业成本，该公司依赖美国各地的大型数据中心来维持运营。

source_text: Facebook says it is already working with manufacturers, including Dell, that are manufacturing servers based on its designs.
target_text: Facebook表示，它已经与包括戴尔在内的制造商合作，这些制造商正在根据其设计制造服务器。

source_text: Republican John McCain has conceded the election to Democrat Barack Obama.
target_text: 共和党人约翰・麦凯恩在选举中输给了民主党人巴拉克・奥巴马。

source_text: After two years of campaigning, today United States citizens went to the polls to vote for the Presidency and for numerous Senate, House, state and local races across the country.
target_text: 经过两年的竞选活动，今天美国公民前往投票站投票选举总统，并在全国各地参加许多参议院、众议院、州和地方的竞选活动。

source_text: The District of Columbia and at least 32 states had early voting before election day.
target_text: 哥伦比亚特区和至少32个州在选举日之前提前投票。

source_text: By October 31, over 23 million people had voted by mail or at early voting locations.
target_text: 截至10月31日，已有2300多万人通过邮寄或提前投票的方式进行了投票。

source_text: Of the approximately 6 million people of known party affiliation who voted early, 58% were Democrats and 42% were Republicans.
target_text: 在早期投票的大约600万已知党派人士中，百分之58是民主党人，百分之42是共和党人。

source_text: Record numbers of voters were expected to the polls on election day.
target_text: 选举日预计选民人数创历史新高。

source_text: There were reports of technical problems and long lines across the country.
target_text: 据报道，全国各地都存在技术问题和排长队的现象。

source_text: Heavy turnouts were reported in Indiana, Ohio, and Wyoming, among other states.
target_text: 据报道，印第安纳、俄亥俄和怀俄明等州都有大量选民参加投票。

source_text: By 11:45 A.M. EST Obama is projected to have won 349 electoral votes to McCain's 163 votes.
target_text: 到美国东部时间上午11点45分，奥巴马预计赢得349张选举人票，而麦凯恩赢得163张。

source_text: The popular vote at this time was 62,992,553 (52%) for Obama, 55,796,823 (46%) for McCain.
target_text: 奥巴马当时的民众投票率为62,992,553（百分之52），麦凯恩为55,796,823（百分之46）。

source_text: I'll Have Another, who won both the 2012 Kentucky Derby and Preakness Stakes, was removed from the field in this weekend's Belmont Stakes — effectively ending the thoroughbred's attempt to become the twelfth US Triple Crown winner in history.
target_text: I'll Have Another这匹马赢得了2012年肯塔基赛马会和普利内斯大奖赛，但在本周末贝尔蒙特赛马会的角逐中被淘汰出局，从而成功终止了该纯种马要成为美国历史上第12位三连冠冠军的企图。

source_text: I'll Have Another was not the favorite in either the Kentucky Derby or the Preakness Stakes, but he was twice able to pass the leader Bodemeister, who was the pace setting horse in both those races, to take the victories.
target_text: 在肯塔基赛马会和普利内斯大奖赛上，I'll Have Another都不是最受欢迎的，但他两次都超过了领跑者波德梅斯特，赢得了比赛，而波德梅斯特在这两场比赛中都是领先的。

source_text: Bodemeister will also not race in the Belmont Stakes Saturday.
target_text: 波德梅斯特也不会参加周六在贝尔蒙特的比赛。

source_text: Before the Kentucky Derby, I'll Have Another won the Santa Anita Derby.
target_text: 在肯塔基赛马会之前，I'll Have Another赢得了圣安妮塔赛马会的比赛。

source_text: All of these races were won with Mexican jockey Mario Gutierrez.
target_text: 所有这些比赛都是由墨西哥骑师马里奥·古铁雷斯赢得的。

source_text: Dale Romans, who is Dullahan's trainer, reacted to the news, "It's devastating."
target_text: 杜拉罕的教练戴尔·罗马斯对这个消息的反应是：“这是毁灭性的。”

source_text: "I thought this was going to be one of the greatest races in history, and I wanted the opportunity to be part of it."
target_text: “我认为这将成为历史上最伟大的比赛之一，我希望有机会参与其中。”

source_text: Dullahan raced in this year's Kentucky Derby and took third place.
target_text: 杜拉汉在今年的肯塔基赛马会中获得第三名。

source_text: In order to win the Triple Crown, a horse has to race and win the Kentucky Derby, the Preakness Stakes, and the Belmont Stakes.
target_text: 为了赢得三冠王，一匹马必须参加比赛并赢得肯塔基赛马会、普雷克内斯大奖赛和贝尔蒙特赛马会。

source_text: The first Triple Crown winner was Sir Barton in 1919 and the last was Affirmed in 1978.
target_text: 第一个三连冠得主是1919年的巴顿爵士，上一届的三连冠得主是1978年的阿傅梅德。

source_text: The dry spell will continue at least another year — the 34th year without a Triple Crown victory.
target_text: 空窗期将持续至少一年，这是第34年没有产生三冠王。

source_text: In a 5-4 vote, the United States Supreme Court overturned the death penalty for Patrick Kennedy, convicted of raping a child, saying it is not proportional to the crime and that it violates the Constitutional ban on cruel and unusual punishment, and thereby setting a precedent.
target_text: 美国最高法院以5比4的投票结果推翻了对强奸儿童的帕特里克·肯尼迪的死刑判决，称其与罪行不成比例，违反了宪法对残忍和非常规惩罚的禁令，从而开创了先例。

source_text: In the case Kennedy v. Louisiana, Patrick Kennedy of New Orleans, Louisiana was convicted of raping his eight-year old stepdaughter, and was sentenced to death for the crime.
target_text: 在肯尼迪诉路易斯安那州案中，路易斯安那州新奥尔良市的帕特里克・肯尼迪因强奸他8岁的继女而被判有罪，并因犯罪被判处死刑。

source_text: A Louisiana law adopted in 1995 allowed the death penalty for those who had raped a child under 12 years old (later amended to 13).
target_text: 1995年通过的路易斯安那州法律允许对强奸12岁以下儿童的人判处死刑（后来修改为13岁）。

source_text: Five other states have similar laws, while the remaining states ban the death penalty for rape.
target_text: 其他五个州也有类似的法律，而其余的州则禁止对强奸判处死刑。

source_text: The last execution for rape in America occurred in 1964.
target_text: 美国上一次强奸案的死刑判决是在1964年。

source_text: The Louisiana Supreme Court defended Kennedy's sentence, saying that "short of first-degree murder, we can think of no other non-homicide crime more deserving" of the death penalty.
target_text: 路易斯安那州最高法院为肯尼迪的判决进行了辩护，称“除了一级谋杀，我们想不出还有比一级谋杀更应被判处死刑的非杀人罪行”。

source_text: Kennedy, who was one of two criminals on death row in America who did not commit murder, challenged the court's decision, and the case was brought to the U.S. Supreme Court.
target_text: 肯尼迪是美国两名未犯谋杀罪的死囚之一，他对最高法院的判决提出异议，并将此案提交美国最高法院。

source_text: Writing for the majority, Justice Anthony Kennedy said the Constitution did not allow the death penalty where the crime did not result, and was not intended to result, in a person's death.
target_text: 大法官安东尼·肯尼迪代表大多数人的意见写道，宪法不允许在犯罪没有导致、也不打算导致一个人死亡的情况下判处死刑。

source_text: He noted exceptions in cases of crimes against the state, such as treason and espionage.
target_text: 他指出，叛国罪和间谍罪等反国家罪行中存在例外情况。

source_text: Despite "the years of long anguish that must be endured by the victim of child rape," Justice Kennedy wrote, "the death penalty should not be expanded to instances where the victim's life was not taken."
target_text: 尽管“儿童强奸受害者必须忍受多年的痛苦，”肯尼迪大法官写道，“但死刑不应扩大到受害者的生命没有被夺走的情况。”

source_text: He added, "When the law punishes by death, it risks its own sudden descent into brutality, transgressing the constitutional commitment to decency and restraint."
target_text: 他还说，“当法律判处死刑时，它本身就有可能突然陷入残暴，违背宪法对正派和克制的承诺。”

source_text: The four liberal-leaning justices (Stevens, Souter, Ginsburg and Breyer) joined Kennedy, a moderate who often casts the deciding vote in close cases.
target_text: 四位自由主义倾向的大法官（史蒂文斯、苏特、金斯堡和布雷耶）支持肯尼迪，还有一位在销案中投决定性的一票的温和派人士也支持了他。

source_text: The four conservative-leaning justices (Roberts, Scalia, Thomas and Alito) dissented.
target_text: 四位倾向保守派的法官（罗伯茨、斯卡利亚、托马斯和阿利托）表示反对。

source_text: Samuel Alito wrote in his dissent, "The harm that is caused to the victims and to society at large by the worst child rapists is grave..."
target_text: 塞缪尔·阿利托在异议中写道，“最恶劣的儿童强奸犯对受害者和整个社会造成的伤害是严重的……”。

source_text: "It is the judgment of the Louisiana lawmakers and those in an increasing number of other states that these harms justify the death penalty."
target_text: “这是路易斯安那州议员和越来越多其他州议员的判断，这些伤害证明死刑是合理的。”

source_text: Alito said the decision would bar the death penalty "no matter how young the child, no matter how many times the child is raped, no matter how many children the perpetrator rapes, no matter how sadistic the crime, no matter how much physical or psychological trauma is inflicted, and no matter how heinous the perpetrator's prior criminal record may be."
target_text: 阿利托说，这项决定将禁止死刑，“无论孩子多小，无论孩子被强奸多少次，无论罪犯强奸多少个孩子，无论犯罪行为多么残忍，无论造成多少生理或心理创伤，无论罪犯以前的犯罪记录多么可恶。”

source_text: "One thing is clear: The five members of the court who issued the opinion do not share the same 'standards of decency' as the people of Louisiana," Jindal said.
target_text: “有一件事是清楚的：发表意见的五名法官成员与路易斯安那州的人民没有相同的‘道德行为标准’，”金达尔说。

source_text: The U.S. Supreme Court today ruled that Internet file sharing networks can be sued for copyright infringement.
target_text: 美国最高法院今天裁定，互联网文件共享网络可能因侵犯版权而被起诉。

source_text: The court ruled that businesses created with the purpose of letting users commit copyright violations should be held liable for the infringement.
target_text: 法院裁定，以让用户侵犯版权为目的而创建的企业应对侵权行为承担责任。

source_text: Writing for the court, Justice David Souter wrote: "One who distributes a device with the object of promoting its use to infringe copyright, as shown by clear expression or other affirmative steps taken to foster infringement, going beyond mere distribution with knowledge of third-party action, is liable for the resulting acts of infringement by third parties using the device, regardless of the device's lawful uses."
target_text: 大法官大卫·苏特在写给法院的信中写道：“有人分发设备目的是推广其使用以侵犯版权，正如通过明确表达或其他积极措施来鼓励侵权所示的那样，除了仅通过第三方行为进行知识传播外，无论该设备的合法使用情况如何，对使用该设备的第三方所带来的侵权行为该企业均应承担责任。”

source_text: The strength of the decision was unexpected — this is the first major Internet copyright case to reach the Supreme Court in many years, and the Justices' unanimity sends a strong message about their lack of tolerance for companies designed to violate the law.
target_text: 这一裁决的力度出乎意料，这是多年来最高法院受理的首个重大互联网版权案件，法官们的一致意见发出了一个强烈的信号，即他们对旨在违反法律的公司缺乏容忍。

source_text: The decision affects such companies as Grokster and StreamCast, both of which were defendants in this suit.
target_text: 该决定影响了Grokster和StreamCast等公司，两者都是此诉讼的被告。

source_text: The court's ruling does not have an immediate effect, however, as the Justices referred the decisions to a lower court to be reconsidered.
target_text: 然而，法院的裁决没有立即生效，因为大法官将决定提交下级法院进行重新审议。

source_text: Fred von Lohmann, senior staff attorney for the EFF, panned the court for not providing a clear test for what constitutes inducement, saying it would discourage innovators unsure of their project's legality.
target_text: EFF的高级律师弗雷德·冯·娄曼严厉批评了该法院，称它没有对诱因的构成进行明确的测试，称这将打击不确定其项目合法性的创新者的积极性。

source_text: He did however remain optimistic about Grokster and StreamCast's chances in the lower courts.
target_text: 然而，他确实对Grokster和StreamCast在下级法院的机会持乐观态度。

source_text: An internet forum, run by the non-profit Epilepsy Foundation, was attacked last week by a group of vandals.
target_text: 由非营利性癫痫基金会运营的互联网论坛上周被一群破坏者袭击。

source_text: The attack, first reported by Wired News, exploited a function of the forums to post JavaScript code.
target_text: 据有线新闻的第一手报道，该攻击利用论坛的功能发布JavaScript代码。

source_text: The code injected by the vandals flashed two images repeatedly and tried to lead users off to external websites showing flashing lights and shapes intended to trigger off epileptic fits.
target_text: 由破坏者注入的代码反复闪现两个图像，并试图引导用户跳转到外部网站。在那些网站中显现试图触发癫痫发作的闪烁灯光和形状。

source_text: The Epilepsy Foundation had to shut down the forum, and took some measures to prevent future attacks.
target_text: 癫痫基金会不得不关闭论坛，并采取一些措施来防止未来的攻击。

source_text: In a press release, the Foundation stated that several users of the forum, sufferers of epilepsy, experienced harsh migraines and seizures as a result of the attack.
target_text: 在一份新闻稿中，基金会表示，该论坛的一些用户，即癫痫患者，由于袭击事件而经历了严重的偏头痛和癫痫发作。

source_text: One woman, RyAnne Fultz, was paralyzed by the flashing images in what she calls her worst attack in over a year, until her 11-year old son managed to get her to stop looking at the screen and close the flashing images.
target_text: 一名名叫莱恩·富尔茨的妇女被这些闪烁的图像惊呆了，她称这是她一年多来遭受的最严重的一次攻击，直到她11岁的儿子设法让她停止看屏幕，关掉这些闪烁的图像。

source_text: They also posted a message regarding new measures saying "In our upping of security on the forums, we have established the following new rules: No animated images are allowed to be used anywhere from now on."
target_text: 他们还发布了一条关于新措施的消息，称“为了提高论坛的安全性，我们制定了以下新规则：从现在起，任何地方都不允许使用动画图像。”

source_text: "No rich text is allowed in the body of messages at all, either."
target_text: “也不允许在消息体中使用任何富文本。”

source_text: Wired News additionally reports that there is "circumstantial evidence" linking the perpetrators of the attack to the internet group "Anonymous", who are most well known for their recent protests and attacks against the Church of Scientology, and their members created a reputation as "griefers" in the virtual worlds Second Life, and Habbo Hotel.
target_text: 有线新闻还报道说，有“间接证据”将袭击者与网络组织“匿名”联系起来，后者因最近对山达基教会的抗议和攻击而闻名，他们的成员在虚拟世界第二人生和哈博酒店是恶名昭彰的“滋事者”。

source_text: The Austrian paper Krone reports that the "usual goal of their attacks is to raise a fuss or disturb others".
target_text: 奥地利报纸克朗报道称，“他们攻击的通常目标是制造混乱或干扰他人”。

source_text: Following critical reports about the attack, members of the group blamed the attack on the Church of Scientology.
target_text: 在关于袭击事件的批评报道之后，该组织的成员将袭击归咎于山达基教会。

source_text: Wired News states that the attack on the forum may have been the first computer attack in history to inflict physical harm on its victims.
target_text: 有线新闻称，对该论坛的攻击可能是历史上第一次对其受害者造成人身伤害的计算机攻击。

source_text: Between three and five per cent of all epilepsy sufferers are vulnerable to seizures triggered by flashing lights, shapes or colours, like ones used in the attack.
target_text: 在所有癫痫患者中，有百分之3至百分之5的人很容易受到闪光灯、形状或颜色引发的癫痫发作，就像袭击中使用的那种。

source_text: Photosensitive epilepsy has been in the news increasingly over the last few years as various media have triggered seizures in people.
target_text: 在过去几年里，光敏性癫痫愈来愈常出现在新闻中，因为各种媒体引发了人们的癫痫发作。

source_text: Recently a logo animation for the 2012 London Olympics caused thousands of people to experience seizures.
target_text: 最近，2012年伦敦奥运会的标志动画导致数千人癫痫发作。

source_text: In another incident, the episode "Dennō Senshi Porygon" of the animated TV series Pokémon caused thousands of children to experience seizures in Japan.
target_text: 在另一起事件中，动画电视剧“神奇宝贝”的剧集“电脑战士3D龙”让数千名儿童在日本遭受癫痫发作。

source_text: In March, MTV refused to air a new video by Gnarls Barkley out of fear it would trigger seizures.
target_text: 3月，由于担心会引发癫痫发作，MTV拒绝播放奈尔斯·巴克利发布的新视频。

source_text: Irish low fares airline, Ryanair, this week celebrated its 20th birthday.
target_text: 爱尔兰低价航空公司瑞安航空本周庆祝其20岁生日。

source_text: Having reached the milestone, the airline promptly used the opportunity, as always, to sell seats; launching a massive 200,000 seat sale at 99p/99c a seat.
target_text: 达到里程碑后，航空公司一如既往地利用这个机会出售座位，以99便士99c的座位推出200,000个座位。

source_text: The airline was founded in 1985 by the Irish businessman, Dr Tony Ryan.
target_text: 1985年，爱尔兰商人托尼·瑞安博士创建了这家航空公司。

source_text: It began its existence flying a small 15 seat aircraft between Waterford and London Gatwick with the small aim of breaking the duopoly on London-Ireland flights, held at that time by British Airways and Aer Lingus.
target_text: 它最初是在沃特福德和伦敦盖特威克机场之间运营一架15座的小型飞机，目的是打破当时由英国航空公司和爱尔兰航空公司把持的伦敦-爱尔兰航线的双头垄断。

source_text: The company today carries as much as 3m passengers a month (depending on the season) and has revealed it made a profit of €245m (USD$307,916,000) in the past year.
target_text: 该公司目前每月运送300万乘客（取决于季节），并透露它在过去一年中实现了2.45亿欧元（307,916,000美元）的利润。

source_text: Ryanair CEO Michael O'Leary has stated that the airline will carry over 70m passengers annually within five years.
target_text: 瑞安航空首席执行官迈克尔O'Leary表示，该公司将在五年内每年运送超过7000万名乘客。

source_text: To demonstrate the huge drop in airfares over the last year, the company claimed while the price of a Ryanair seat had dropped from ￡99.99 in 1985 to 99p today, the price of a pint of beer had trebled and the average house price in England had increased by 500%.
target_text: 为了证明去年的机票价格大幅下降，该公司声称，瑞安航空公司的座位价格从1985年的99.99英镑降至今天的99便士，而一品脱啤酒的价格却翻了三倍，英格兰的平均房价也增加了百分之500。

source_text: Australian airline Qantas has returned the first of its fleet of Airbus A380s to service, after all six of the "superjumbo" aircraft were grounded three weeks ago following one aircraft's engine sustaining extensive midair damage; it landed safely in Singapore without injury.
target_text: 澳大利亚航空公司已让首批空客A380客机恢复服务。三周前，这六架“超大型”客机全部停飞，原因是一架飞机的发动机在空中遭受严重损坏，飞机安全降落在新加坡，无人受伤。

source_text: The airline stated that all of the aircraft have undergone extensive safety inspections and they are satisfied they are safe.
target_text: 该航空公司表示，所有飞机都经过了全面的安全检查，他们对飞机的安全感到满意。

source_text: Alan Joyce, CEO of Qantas, said: "It's great that we can reintroduce the aircraft."
target_text: 澳航首席执行官艾伦·乔伊斯表示：“我们能够重新推出这款飞机，这太棒了。”

source_text: "If we weren't, we wouldn't be restarting the operations today."
target_text: “如果我们不这样做，我们今天就不会重新开始运营。”

source_text: A spokesperson confirmed that tests had been performed "in close consultation with Rolls-Royce and Airbus" on the model's Trent 900 engines.
target_text: 一位发言人证实，在“与劳斯莱斯和空客密切协商”的情况下，对该机型的Trent900发动机进行了测试。

source_text: Qantas has replaced at least 14 engines, and modifications have been made to Trent 900s used by two other companies, Lufthansa and Singapore Airlines.
target_text: 澳航已经更换了至少14台发动机，另外两家公司汉莎航空和新加坡航空也对Trent900进行了改装。

source_text: Experts said that the incident was embarrassing for Airbus; the airline's shares have dropped by 7% since.
target_text: 专家表示，这一事件令空客感到尴尬，自那以来，该航空公司的股价已经下跌了百分之7。

source_text: Aviation journalist Tom Ballantyne said that the failure earlier this month was "certainly the most serious incident that the A380 has experienced since it entered operations."
target_text: 航空记者汤姆·巴兰提恩表示，本月早些时候的故障“无疑是A380投入运营以来遭遇的最严重事故”。

source_text: The A380 made its first commercial flight in 2007, and is now in service with several other airlines, including Air France.
target_text: A380于2007年首次进行商业飞行，目前正在与包括法国航空在内的其他几家航空公司合作。

source_text: It is the largest commercial passenger airliner in the world, with an 840-passenger maximum capacity, though Qantas's can carry 450.
target_text: 它是世界上最大的商业客机，最大载客量为840人，而澳航的最大载客量为450人。

source_text: There are reportedly plans to build a cargo version of the plane, which, aviation experts have suggested, would be the world's first "triple-decker" freight aircraft; Airbus has not confirmed that this variant will be built.
target_text: 据报道，有人计划制造一架货机，航空专家建议，这将是世界上第一架“三层”货机，空客还没有证实这种改型飞机将被制造。

source_text: The U.S. space agency NASA called off the launch of Space shuttle Discovery today after a problem with a fuel sensor in the external tank used to detect fuel exhaustion.
target_text: 美国宇航局今天取消了发现号航天飞机的发射，原因是用于探测燃料耗尽的外部燃料箱的燃料传感器出现问题。

source_text: According to the agency-run NASA TV, the low-fuel sensor was either malfunctioning or damaged.
target_text: 据NASA电视台报道，这个低燃料传感器要么出了故障，要么损坏了。

source_text: The launch was already facing the threat of a scrub due to thunderstorms in the area.
target_text: 由于该地区的雷雨天气，发射已经面临取消的威胁。

source_text: The sensor is one of four used to trigger the engine cutout after launch.
target_text: 该传感器是发射后四个用来触发发动机熄火后的传感器之一。

source_text: Although only two are required for normal operation, and the Shuttle can be flown with one, NASA elected to maintain full redundancy.
target_text: 虽然正常操作只需要两个，并且航天飞机只要一个正常就可以飞行，但NASA还是选择保持完全冗余。

source_text: Should more of the sensors fail, the engine might burn out due to lack of fuel, a situation that has not been tested.
target_text: 如果更多的传感器发生故障，发动机可能由于缺乏燃料而烧坏，这种情况尚未经过测试。

source_text: The problem was detected during a simulation of an empty tank.
target_text: 在模拟空罐时检测到该问题。

source_text: When placed in a mode simulating an empty tank, three of the sensors correctly registered that the tank was empty, while the faulty sensor stayed in the "full" state.
target_text: 当放置在模拟空罐的模式中时，三个传感器正确地记录了罐是空的，而故障传感器保持在“满”状态。

source_text: NASA is currently unsure whether the problem relates to the sensor, the instrumentation circuits reporting the sensor's state, or the simulation circuits.
target_text: 美国宇航局目前还不确定这个问题是否与传感器，仪器电路报告传感器的状态，或模拟电路有关。

source_text: The problem comes after a separate incident yesterday when a cockpit window cover fell from the Orbiter, damaging thermal protection tiles.
target_text: 昨天发生了另一起事故，驾驶舱窗户盖从轨道飞行器上脱落，损坏了隔热瓦。

source_text: The launch, which was scheduled for 3:51 ET (20:51 UTC), would have been the first launch of a shuttle since Columbia's February 2003 crash which killed all crew members aboard.
target_text: 这次发射计划在美国东部时间3点51分（UTC时间20点51分）进行，这将是自2003年2月哥伦比亚号航天飞机失事以来的首次航天飞机发射。

source_text: It is still unknown to NASA officials what caused the sensor to become defective.
target_text: NASA官员仍然不知道导致传感器出现故障的原因。

source_text: It is also unknown at the moment whether the issue will be fixed on the launch pad, or in the Vehicle Assembly Building - in which it takes close to a full day's time to transport a shuttle between the two areas.
target_text: 目前还不知道这个问题是要在发射台还是在车辆装配大楼中进行修复，因为往返于两个区域之间的穿梭车需要一整天的时间。

source_text: In the interim, the crew of the shuttle will stay at KSC unless there are further delays, in which case the crew might be transported back to JSC in Houston for refresher training.
target_text: 在此期间，航天飞机的机组人员将留在KSC，除非有进一步的延误，在这种情况下，机组人员可能会被运回休斯顿的JSC进行进修培训。

source_text: The president of Uganda, Yoweri Museveni, has distanced himself from a controversial bill in the Parliament that would make certain acts of homosexuality punishable by death.
target_text: 乌干达总统电视台的约韦里·穆塞韦尼与议会一项有争议的法案保持距离，该法案将某些同性恋行为定为死刑。

source_text: Until President Museveni publicly spoke out, this proposal was widely supported by the ruling majority party, the National Resistance Movement (NRM), and, as a result, was expected to easily pass with a significant number of votes in its favor.
target_text: 在穆塞韦尼总统公开表态之前，这项提案得到了执政的多数党全国抵抗运动（NRM）的广泛支持，因此，预计这项提案将以相当多的赞成票轻易获得通过。

source_text: In a nation where homosexuality is already a criminal offense punishable by up to fourteen years in jail, this bill would raise that penalty to life in prison.
target_text: 在这个国家，同性恋已经是一种刑事犯罪，最高可判处14年监禁，这项法案将把这种刑罚提高到终身监禁。

source_text: It would also dole out the death penalty for any offense categorized as "aggravated homosexuality"—meaning a case in which one of the participants is either a minor, HIV-positive, or a "serial offender."
target_text: 该法案还将对任何被归类为“严重同性恋”的犯罪行为处以死刑。“严重同性恋”指的是其中一名参与者要么是未成年人，要么是hiv阳性，要么是“连环犯罪者”。

source_text: Museveni, who admitted being at the center of widespread international criticism, said in the same statement that this matter was now a "foreign policy issue," and therefore his government, Parliament included, "must take into account [Uganda's] foreign policy interests."
target_text: 穆塞韦尼承认自己处于广泛的国际批评的中心，他在同一份声明中表示，此事现在是一个“外交政策问题”，因此他的政府，包括议会在内，“必须考虑到【乌干达】的外交政策利益”。

source_text: Case in point, Sweden has since threatened to cut financial support to the small African nation if this bill does in fact go through.
target_text: 一个恰当的例子是，瑞典后来威胁说，如果这项法案真的通过，它将削减对这个非洲小国的财政支持。

source_text: In addition, numerous other world powers over the past weeks have contacted Museveni directly to elaborate upon their objections.
target_text: 此外，过去几周其他许多世界大国直接联系穆塞韦尼，以阐述他们的反对意见。

source_text: Following which, a frustrated Museveni told the BBC, "The Prime Minister of Canada came to see me and what was he talking about? Gays."
target_text: 在此之后，沮丧的穆塞韦尼告诉BBC，“加拿大总理来看我，他在说什么？同性恋。”

source_text: "Prime Minister Gordon Brown came to see me and what was he talking about? Gays."
target_text: “首相戈登・布朗来看我，他在说什么？同性恋。”

source_text: In light of all that has occurred, Museveni told his party that the issue as of today was no longer a parliamentary one, and that it is to be discussed and handled accordingly by him and his cabinet alone.
target_text: 鉴于所发生的一切，穆塞韦尼告诉他的政党，从今天起，这个问题不再是一个议会问题，将由他和他的内阁单独讨论和处理。

source_text: UK Prime Minister Tony Blair is at 3:30pm to present a White Paper in the House of Commons today indicating the Government’s plans to replace the Trident missile system with a similar system but on a reduced scale.
target_text: 英国首相布莱尔将于下午3点30在下议院提交白皮书，表明政府计划用类似的系统取代三叉戟导弹系统，但规模缩小。

source_text: The speech is called : Statement: Trident - The Future of the UK Nuclear Deterrent.
target_text: 演讲被称为：声明：三叉戟-英国核威慑的未来。

source_text: The Trident defence system was developed as Britain’s response to the Cold War which ended with the collapse of the USSR in December 1991.
target_text: 三叉戟防御系统是随着英国对冷战的回应而发展起来的，随着1991年12月苏联解体而结束。

source_text: The first Trident submarine went on patrol in December 1994.
target_text: 第一艘三叉戟潜艇于1994年12月巡逻。

source_text: The present system consists of Trident ballistic missiles with nuclear warheads carried by four Vanguard class nuclear powered submarines.
target_text: 目前的系统包括由四艘先锋级核动力潜艇携带的核弹头的三叉戟弹道导弹。

source_text: Supporters who include the majority of the main opposition party, argue that because of the proliferation of nuclear weapons and threats from countries such as Iran and North Korea, Britain must have a nuclear defence capability.
target_text: 包括大多数主要反对党在内的支持者认为，由于核武器的扩散以及伊朗和朝鲜等国家的威胁，英国必须拥有核防御能力。

source_text: Opponents including at least one Cabinet Minister and several Labour backbenchers, say that the system is an inappropriate response to the present threats to national security, terrorism, energy shortage and climate change and that there are better ways of spending the money.
target_text: 包括至少一名内阁部长和几名工党后座议员在内的反对者表示，该体系是对当前国家安全、恐怖主义、能源短缺和气候变化等威胁的不恰当回应，而且还有更好的花钱方式。

source_text: Fifteen Anglican bishops have denounced the possession of such a weapon as ‘evil’.
target_text: 15位圣公会主教谴责拥有这种武器是“邪恶的”。

source_text: Alex Salmond, leader of the Scottish National Party (SNP), said that although Scotland had no power to stop the replacment of the Trident weapons system, it had a host of powers to protect the environment.
target_text: 苏格兰民族党（SNP）领袖亚历克斯·萨尔蒙德表示，尽管苏格兰没有权力阻止三叉戟武器系统的替换，但它有许多保护环境的权力。

source_text: He promised that if the UK government went ahead with the Trident project, the SNP would propose to use those powers to stop it proceeding in Scotland.
target_text: 他承诺，如果英国政府推进三叉戟项目，SNP将建议利用这些权力阻止它在苏格兰进行。

source_text: There are two establishments in Scotland, at Faslane and Rosyth, providing services to the nuclear submarine fleet.
target_text: 苏格兰有两家机构，分别位于Faslane和Rosyth，为核潜艇舰队提供服务。

source_text: Three rescue workers at the Crandall Canyon Mine in Utah were killed trying to rescue six trapped miners who have been missing for over a week.
target_text: 犹他州克兰德尔峡谷矿区的三名救援人员在试图营救六名失踪超过一周的被困矿工时遇难。

source_text: Utah's governor, Jon Huntsman, honored the dead rescuers by saying, "There's nothing more selfless than someone giving their life in pursuit of saving someone else."
target_text: 犹他州州长乔恩·亨茨曼向死去的救援人员致敬，他说：“没有什么比为了拯救别人而牺牲自己的生命更无私了。”

source_text: Six other workers were injured in what is being called a seismic "bump."
target_text: 其他六名工人在所谓的地震“隆起”中受伤。

source_text: Seismologists said a similar incident happened on the day of the original August 6 cave in.
target_text: 地震学家说，在8月6日最初塌陷的那一天也发生了类似的事件。

source_text: A "bump" is caused by coal shooting out from the walls of a mine due to extreme pressure.
target_text: “隆起”是由于煤矿的压力太大，煤从井壁中喷出造成的。

source_text: No further details were available about the official cause of the rescuers' deaths.
target_text: 关于救援人员死亡的官方原因没有进一步的细节。

source_text: All rescue efforts to find the remaining six missing miners have been called off for now.
target_text: 所有寻找其余六名失踪矿工的救援工作目前已被取消。

source_text: It is not known at this time if the six miners are alive or dead.
target_text: 目前尚不清楚这六名矿工是活着还是死了。

source_text: Most of the Eurovision entrants have returned home from their sojourn in Moscow, Russia, and the newspapers across Europe have varied opinions.
target_text: 大多数“欧洲电视”的参赛者已经从俄罗斯莫斯科的短暂停留中返回家乡，欧洲各地的报纸对此有不同的看法。

source_text: Most national newspapers congratulated their entrants on a job well done, while others trash-talked other entrants, and still others called for their countries to pull out of the Contest.
target_text: 大多数全国性报纸都对他们的参赛者表现出色表示祝贺，但有其他报纸则诋毁参赛者，还有一些报纸呼吁他们的国家退出比赛。

source_text: Here are some interviews, articles and opinions that made it to the front pages of newspapers and to their sanctioned blogs.
target_text: 以下是一些报纸头版与其认可博客所登载的访谈，文章和意见。

source_text: The Los Angeles City Council voted unanimously to sue a police officer accused of creating a story about being shot by someone at El Camino High School, causing a costly search for the assailant by police.
target_text: 洛杉矶市议会一致投票决定起诉一名警察，该警察被控编造了一篇在埃尔卡米诺高中被人开枪打死的故事，导致警方对袭击者进行了代价高昂的搜索。

source_text: The officer, Jeffrey Stenroos, who had worked for the Los Angeles Unified School District police for eight years, caused thousands of students to remain on lockdown for hours.
target_text: 这名名叫杰弗里·斯滕鲁斯的警官在洛杉矶联合学区警察局工作了八年，他让数千名学生被封锁了几个小时。

source_text: Traffic officers, county sheriffs, California Highway Patrol, and the Federal Bureau of Investigation were involved in the search.
target_text: 交通官员，县治安官，加州公路巡逻队和联邦调查局都参与了搜索。

source_text: Thursday, the Los Angeles Police chief announced Stenroos' claim was false and he was later arrested and released on $20,000 (€14,600) bail, charged with filing a false police report.
target_text: 周四，洛杉矶警察局长宣布斯滕鲁斯的说法是假的，随后他以2万美元（14600欧元）保释金被捕并获释，罪名是提交了一份虚假的警方报告。

source_text: Stenroos allegedly mishandled a firearm and shot himself in his bulletproof vest, according to an anonymous police official.
target_text: 据一位不愿透露姓名的警官说，斯滕鲁斯涉嫌不当使用枪支，穿着防弹背心自杀。

source_text: A chemical part of the saliva of a poisonous lizard, the Gila monster, has become an integral partner in the control of Type 2 diabetes.
target_text: 毒蜥蜴吉拉怪兽唾液中的一种化学成分，已成为控制2型糖尿病不可或缺的成分。

source_text: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved its use for people who have not achieved adequate control of their diabetes with oral medications.
target_text: 美国食品和药物管理局已经批准对那些通过口服药物没能充分控制糖尿病的人使用该药物。

source_text: It is injected before eating morning and evening meals as part of a combination treatment with oral drugs.
target_text: 在进食早餐和晚餐之前注射，作为口服药物联合治疗的一部分。

source_text: The FDA said it could be approved as a stand-alone treatment if the drug companies can support such use with data.
target_text: 美国食品和药物管理局表示，如果制药公司可以通过数据支持此类使用，它可以被批准为独立治疗。

source_text: Eli Lilly & Co. was the development partner in creation of the drug.
target_text: Eli Lilly＆Co.是该药物的开发合作伙伴。

source_text: "With Byetta's demonstrated effects on blood sugar and its safety profile, physicians and patients now have a new approach to fight the growing diabetes epidemic," said Sidney Taurel, CEO of Lilly.
target_text: Lilly首席执行官西德尼·陶瑞尔说：“鉴于比埃塔对血糖的影响及其安全性，医生和患者现在有了一种新的方法来对抗日益蔓延的糖尿病。”

source_text: Microsoft has extended the warranty on its Xbox 360 video game console to three years from the date of purchase following a large number of problems with the console and "an unacceptable number of repairs", costing the company more than one billion US dollars.
target_text: 微软将Xbox360游戏机的保修期从购买之日起延长至3年，此前该游戏机出现了大量问题，“维修次数多得令人无法接受”，导致微软损失逾10亿美元。

source_text: The fault, which has been dubbed the "red ring of death", causes the console to fail completely.
target_text: 这个被称为“红色死亡之环”的故障导致控制台完全失效。

source_text: In an open letter to owners of the Xbox 360, Peter Moore of Microsoft said, "As of today, all Xbox 360 consoles are covered by an enhanced warranty program to address specifically the general hardware failures indicated by the three flashing red lights on the console."
target_text: 在一封致Xbox360用户的公开信中，微软的彼得・摩尔表示，“截至今日，Xbox360所有控制台都纳入了一项强化保修计划，专门针对控制台上三道红灯所显示的一般硬件故障。”

source_text: The extended warranty covers repairing and shipping of the console and the company has promised to reimburse those owners who have already had to pay for repairs.
target_text: 延长保修期包括控制台的维修和运输，公司承诺偿还那些已经支付维修费用的用户。

source_text: Microsoft has not released details of the number of units that have suffered from the problem but has said it is "bigger than we are comfortable with".
target_text: 微软尚未公布该问题所涉及的设备数量的细节，但表示“比我们所能接受的要多”。

source_text: The Xbox 360 was launched by Microsoft in 2005 and in January of this year the company lowered its sales expectations to 12 million units for the year ending June 2007.
target_text: Xbox360于2005年由微软推出，今年1月，该公司将截至2007年6月的销售预期下调至1200万台。

source_text: Kasey Kahne rode into victory early Sunday morning at Richmond International Raceway in the state of Virginia, USA, in his first Nascar Nextel Cup victory.
target_text: 周日早上，卡西·卡恩在美国弗吉尼亚州的里士满国际赛道上获得胜利，这是他第一次获得纳斯卡诺克斯杯冠军。

source_text: Kahne, who drives a Dodge, and is sponsored by the same company, won automaker competitor Chevrolet's sponsored race, the Chevy American Revolution 400.
target_text: 驾驶道奇汽车并得到该公司赞助的卡尼，赢得了道奇竞争对手、汽车制造商雪佛兰赞助的雪佛兰美国革命400赛事。

source_text: The 25-year old from Huntersville, North Carolina had previously gained the pole position for Saturday's night race on Friday.
target_text: 这位来自北卡罗来纳州亨特斯维尔的25岁车手，此前曾在周五的比赛中获得周六晚间比赛的杆位。

source_text: Early in the race, second-place finisher Tony Stewart took lead from Kahne, continuing on to lead over 100 cumulative laps in the race.
target_text: 在比赛之初，第二位发车的托尼·斯图尔特领先卡恩，并在比赛中维持领先超过100圈。

source_text: At lap 234 of 400, Stewart spun out coming out of the fourth turn, which resulted in Kahne regaining the lead.
target_text: 在400圈的第234圈，斯图尔特在第四个转弯时打滑，这使得卡恩重新领先。

source_text: After two more lead changes between the two, Kahne led the last 7 laps to take the checkered flag.
target_text: 在两人的领先优势又发生了两次变化之后，卡恩在最后7圈中领先，拿到了方格旗。

source_text: Points leader Jimmie Johnson crashed his car early into the race, taking a last-place finish.
target_text: 积分榜头名吉米·约翰逊在比赛一开始就撞坏了自己的车，以最后一名的成绩结束了比赛。

source_text: A 6.4 magnitude earthquake hit near the east coast of Honshu, Japan early Monday morning, according to the USGS.
target_text: 据美国地质调查局称，日本本州东海岸附近星期一清早发生6.4级地震。

source_text: The earthquake took place at 06:55:51 AM local time on July 5.
target_text: 地震发生在当地时间7月5日上午06点55分51秒。

source_text: The earthquake occurred at a depth of 23.7 kilometres (14.7 miles) and the epicentre was located 120 kilometers to the east of Morioka, Honshu, 125 kilometers to the southeast of Hachinohe, 195 kilometers to the southeast of Aomori, Honshu and 510 kilometers to the northeast of Tokyo.
target_text: 地震发生在23.7公里（14.7英里）的深度，震中位于日本本州守冈以东120公里，八户河东南方125公里，青森本州东南方195公里，东京东北方510公里。

source_text: No tsunami warnings were issued, and the quake was not reported to have caused any major damage.
target_text: 没有发布海啸警报，据报道地震没有造成任何重大损失。

source_text: Oregon State University (OSU) animal researchers in conjunction with the U.S. Department of Agriculture's (USDA) Dubois, Idaho-based Sheep Experiment Station released a report on an OSU-USDA study which was initiated in 1995 after breeders asked the government to determine why some rams bought as breeding studs showed no interest in females.
target_text: 俄勒冈州立大学（OSU）动物研究人员与美国农业部（USDA）位于爱达荷州杜波依斯绵羊实验站联合发布了一份关于OSU-USDA研究的报告。该研究始于1995年，当时饲养员要求政府弄清楚为什么一些买来做种羊的公羊对雌性没有兴趣。

source_text: The researchers are working under a $2.8 million grant from the National Institutes of Health in hopes of developing a test which can determine the likelihood of a ram being female-oriented before it is sold as a stud.
target_text: 研究人员获得了国家卫生研究院280万美元的资助，在进行相关研究，希望开发出一种测试方法，可以确定公羊在作为种羊出售之前是否对雌性感兴趣。

source_text: By studying difference in the animal's brains after slaughter, the study also showed what could be a biological determiner for what makes a ram male-oriented instead of female-oriented sexually.
target_text: 通过研究动物屠宰后大脑的差异，研究还显示了什么可以成为生物决定因素，使公羊以雄性为导向而不是以雌性为导向的性行为。

source_text: The scientists' results showed that the anterior preoptic area of the rams' hypothalamus was 50 percent smaller in male-oriented rams as opposed to female oriented rams.
target_text: 科学家的研究结果表明，公绵羊下丘脑的前视区比母绵羊小百分之50。

source_text: A 1991 study of human brains of AIDS victims showed a similar hypothalamus size difference between gay and heterosexual men.
target_text: 1991年对艾滋病受害者的人类大脑进行的一项研究显示，同性恋和异性恋男性之间存在类似的下丘脑大小差异。
