source_text: The sheep researchers postulate that low levels of aromatase hormones in the brain of a developing male sheep fetus may have kept the brain from fully masculinizing, leading to sexually male-oriented rams.
target_text: 绵羊研究人员推断正在发育的雄性绵羊胎儿大脑中的芳香化酶激素水平低，可能使大脑更加完全雄性化，从而孕育出雄心倾向的公羊。

source_text: "This lends further support to the idea that homosexuality has biological underpinnings," Charles Roselli, a professor of physiology and pharmacology, said in an interview with the Corvallis Gazette-Times.
target_text: 生理学和药理学教授查尔斯·罗塞利在接受《科瓦利斯公报时报》采访时说：“这进一步支持了同性恋具有生物学基础的观点。”

source_text: Professor Stormshak believes that "understanding sexual drives and the continuum of sexual behavior could possibly help explain the scientific basis of sexual assault [and] put an end to assertions that homosexuality is a lifestyle choice."
target_text: 斯托姆沙克教授认为，“理解性冲动和性行为的连续性可能有助于解释性侵犯的科学基础，并终结同性恋是一种生活方式选择的断言。”

source_text: A 67-year-old man, Thomas Ouellette, of Bonita Springs, Florida was questioned by the FBI Monday after he brought fireworks onto an airliner.
target_text: 美国联邦调查局周一对一名67岁的佛罗里达州博尼塔斯普林斯市男子托马斯・奥埃莱特进行了调查，他将烟花带上了一架飞机。

source_text: Piedmont Airlines flight 4126, a Bombardier Dash 8, from Baltimore, Maryland landed safely and without complications in New York's LaGuardia Airport.
target_text: 来自马里兰州巴尔的摩的皮埃蒙特航空公司4126航班是一架庞巴迪冲锋8型飞机，在纽约拉瓜迪亚机场安全着陆，没有出现复杂情况。

source_text: No suspicions were raised until cleaning crews found the pyrotechnics on the airplane.
target_text: 在清洁人员发现飞机上的烟火之前，没有人怀疑。

source_text: The fireworks are currently being held as evidence by the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey police, owner of LaGuardia Airport.
target_text: 烟花目前被纽约港务局和新泽西州警方，拉瓜迪亚机场的所有者，作为证据。

source_text: Ouellette has been issued a summons to appear in federal court.
target_text: 奥埃莱特已被传唤到联邦法院出庭。

source_text: Pyrotechnics are banned on American flights and individuals face a $10,000 civil penalty for bringing them on board.
target_text: 烟火在美国被禁止携带上飞机，个人携带将面临10,000美元的民事罚款。

source_text: This case comes after an incident on December 25 when Umar Farouk Abdulmutallab, a Nigerian national, attempted to bomb an airliner with explosives concealed in his underpants.
target_text: 这起案件发生在12月25日尼日利亚国民乌马尔·法鲁克·阿卜杜勒·穆塔拉布企图用藏在内裤中的炸药炸毁一架客机之后。

source_text: Multiple news agencies, including the New York Times and CNET yesterday suggested that a campaign operative for Sarah Palin, the Republican vice presidential candidate, worked on the Wikipedia article on her in the 24 hours before the vice presidential candidate was announced.
target_text: 包括《纽约时报》和CNET在内的多家新闻机构昨日表示，共和党副总统候选人萨拉•佩林的一名竞选工作人员，在这位副总统候选人宣布参选的24小时前，曾在维基百科上撰写有关她的文章。

source_text: Wikinews has investigated the claim further, after seeing these allegations.
target_text: 维基新闻在看到这些指控后进一步调查了这一说法。

source_text: The user who added the content on Wikipedia was known as Young Trigg, and Wikinews has learned that the account was created at exactly 08:02 UTC on August 28.
target_text: 在维基百科上添加内容的用户被称为Young Trigg，而维基新闻已经知道该帐户是在8月28日08点02 UTC创建的。

source_text: Just eight minutes later the user made their first edit to Wikipedia.
target_text: 仅仅八分钟后，用户首次编辑维基百科。

source_text: In this first edit the user said that Palin "briefly worked as a sports reporter for local Anchorage television stations, while also working as a commercial fisherman with her husband, Todd, her high school sweetheart".
target_text: 这位用户在第一次编辑中说，佩林“曾短暂地在当地的安克雷奇电视台做过体育记者，同时也和她的丈夫、高中时的恋人托德一起做过商业渔民”。

source_text: In the second edit Palin and her family were described as "avid outdoors enthusiasts."
target_text: 在第二次编辑中，佩林和她的家人被描述为“狂热的户外爱好者”。

source_text: Some of the other edits say that Sarah was "brought to statewide attention because of whistleblowing on ethical violations by state Republican Party leaders," she played in a "championship game despite a stress fracture in her ankle, hitting a critical free throw in the last seconds," and she won a "scholarship to help pay her way through college."
target_text: 其他一些编辑说，萨拉“因为州共和党领导人对违反道德的行为的举报而引起全州的关注，”她参加了一场“冠军赛，尽管脚踝处有压力骨折，在最后几秒钟内打了一个关键的罚球，”她赢得了“帮助她完成大学学业的奖学金”。

source_text: Young Trigg also noted that "Palin holds a lifetime membership with the National Rifle Association".
target_text: Young Trigg还指出，“佩林拥有全国步枪协会的终身会员资格”。

source_text: The editor also said that her election of mayor came "despite the lack of support from party leaders and being outspent by her Democratic opponent."
target_text: 这位编辑还说，她当选市长是“尽管缺乏党内领导人的支持，而且她的民主党对手的开支也超过了她”。

source_text: Other positive claims added included the statement that "Palin successfully killed the Bridge to Nowhere project that had become a nationwide symbol of wasteful earmark spending".
target_text: 其他正面的声明还包括“佩林成功地扼杀了‘通向虚无之桥’项目，该项目已经成为全国范围内浪费专项拨款的象征。”

source_text: This unusual editing pattern aroused some suspicion among other editors of Wikipedia.
target_text: 这种不同寻常的编辑模式引起了维基百科其他编辑的怀疑。

source_text: One of these editors is Justen Deal, who told Young Trigg that "some of yours edits may have affected the article in such a way so as to reflect more favorably on the subject of the article."
target_text: 其中一位编辑是贾斯廷·迪尔，他告诉Young Trigg“你的一些编辑可能会以这种方式影响文章，以便更好地反映文章的主题。”

source_text: Deal described his reason for suspecting a conflict of interest to a reporter for Wikinews.
target_text: 迪尔向维基新闻的一名记者描述了他怀疑存在利益冲突的原因。

source_text: He said that "It was clear to me that an editor very familiar with Wikipedia and the governor had made a single-purpose account that had made a significant number of edits that were universally favorable to the subject of the article."
target_text: 他说，“我很清楚，一位非常熟悉维基百科的编辑和州长创建了一个单一用途的账户，对文章的主题进行了大量普遍有利的编辑。”

source_text: "Given the fortuitous timing, it made sense to remind the editor of our conflict of interest guidelines".
target_text: “考虑到这个偶然的时机，提醒编辑我们的利益冲突指导方针是有意义的”。

source_text: After this message was sent by Deal, Young Trigg said that "I will acknowledge that I volunteer for the McCain campaign."
target_text: 在此消息由迪尔发送后，Young Trigg说：“我将承认我为麦凯恩竞选活动做志愿者。”

source_text: "I did this on my own 'becuz' I like improving Wikipedia articles".
target_text: “这是我自己做的，因为我喜欢改进维基百科的文章。”

source_text: Young Trigg made a total of 43 contributions (many on talk pages) and announced they would retire from Wikipedia at 07:58 UTC on August 31.
target_text: Young Trigg总共贡献了43篇文章（很多都在谈话页面上），并宣布他们将在8月31日UTC时间07点58退出维基百科。

source_text: In addition to editing the article on Sarah Palin, the user also asked an anonymous contributor to Wikipedia about that person's edit that stated that Palin was the VP nominee, before the official announcement:
target_text: 除了编辑有关萨拉·佩林的文章外，这位用户还询问维基百科上一位匿名贡献者，在正式宣布佩林获得副总统提名之前，此人的编辑是这样说的。

source_text: Wikinews contacted the McCain campaign with a request for a statement regarding this issue; and, at the time of publication, had not received a response.
target_text: 维基新闻与麦凯恩竞选团队联系，要求就这一问题发表声明；在发表时，没有收到任何回应。

source_text: Following misleading reports that Rev Professor Michael Reiss had advocated that creation should be taught in science class, he left his post as director of education at the Royal Society, the UK's national academy of science.
target_text: 有误导性的报道称，Rev教授迈克尔•赖斯主张在科学课上教授创作，随后他辞去了英国国家科学院英国皇家学会教育主任的职务。

source_text: Professor Reiss, who was director of education at the Royal Society, said that since a substantial number of pupils have concerns about the issue, they are likely to "detach from" science if their concerns and world view are not addressed.
target_text: 皇家学会教育主任赖斯教授表示，由于大量学生对此问题表示担忧，如果他们的担忧和世界观得不到解决，他们很可能会“远离”科学。

source_text: Creation should not be taught, he said, but if it comes up, teachers should be encouraged to explain the science of evolution.
target_text: 他说，不应该讲授创世论，但如果出现了，应鼓励教师解释进化论。

source_text: He also said that students should be taught the nature of a scientific theory - that it does not simply mean a hypothesis about the way things might work, but a rigorously supported system of ideas that fit with the available evidence.
target_text: 他还说，应该教给学生科学理论的本质-它不仅仅意味着对事物可能运行方式的一种假设，而是一种与现有证据相符的、得到严格支持的思想体系。

source_text: This provoked a storm of protest from a group that included two Nobel Laureates and other scientists who strongly oppose the teaching, or even the discussion of creation in science class.
target_text: 这激起了包括两位诺贝尔奖得主和其他科学家在内的一群人的强烈抗议，他们强烈反对科学课上的这种教学，哪怕是关于创世论的讨论。

source_text: Yesterday the Royal Society said in a statement that some of Professor Reiss' comments had been "open to misinterpretation", and that this had damaged the Society's reputation.
target_text: 昨天，英国皇家学会在一份声明中说，赖斯教授的一些评论是“容易被误解”，这已经损害了该协会的声誉。

source_text: "As a result, Professor Reiss and the Royal Society have agreed that, in the best interests of the society, he will step down immediately as director of education."
target_text: “因此，赖斯教授和皇家学会一致同意，为了社会的最佳利益，他将立即辞去教育主任的职务。”

source_text: The Royal Society went on to say: "However, if a young person raises creationism in a science class, teachers should be in a position to explain why evolution is a sound scientific theory and why creationism is not, in any way, scientific."
target_text: 英国皇家学会接着说：“然而，如果一个年轻人在科学课上提出了创造论，那么教师应该能够解释为什么进化论是一个健全的科学理论，以及为什么创造论在任何方面都不科学。”

source_text: The chief executive of the British Association for the Advancement of Science, Roland Jackson, said that the Royal Society should have supported Professor Reiss and used this opportunity to further a reasoned debate.
target_text: 英国科学促进会首席执行官罗兰·杰克逊表示，英国皇家学会应该支持赖斯教授，并利用这个机会进一步展开一场理性的辩论。

source_text: French Presidential candidate Nicolas Sarkozy has promised to address what he calls the French "moral crisis... of work".
target_text: 法国总统候选人尼古拉·萨科齐承诺将解决他所谓的法国“道德危机……工作”。

source_text: With unemployment for younger people running at alarming levels (15.5% in 2002 for those aged between 20 and 24 according to the OECD) and the memory of the 2005 riots still recent, Sarkozy promised to reign in government spending and implement tax policies that reward longer working hours.
target_text: 由于年轻人的失业率达到了令人担忧的水平（根据经合组织的数据，2002年20到24岁的年轻人的失业率为百分之15.5），加上对2005年骚乱的记忆仍然历历在目，萨科齐承诺要控制政府开支，并实施奖励延长工作时间的税收政策。

source_text: Once a matter of pride, the 35 hour maximum working week is seen by Mr. Sarkozy as contributing to the sluggish growth of the French economy.
target_text: 每周最多工作35小时一度是一件值得骄傲的事，萨科齐认为这是法国经济增长乏力的原因之一。

source_text: In previous years France's aversion to "anglo-saxon" economic and labour policies contributed to the rejection of the EU constitution in a referendum last year.
target_text: 前几年，法国对“盎格鲁-撒克逊”经济和劳工政策的厌恶，在去年的公投中导致了对欧盟宪法的否决。

source_text: However, such views are now being challenged by the French right's main Presidential candidate as he proposes to abolish tax on hours worked above the 35 hours limit as well as proposing to introduce new measures to increase share options for employees outside of the managerial elite.
target_text: 然而，这种观点目前正受到法国右翼主要总统候选人的挑战，他提议取消对35小时工作时间以上的员工征税，并提议引入新措施，增加管理精英以外员工的股票期权。

source_text: As well as challenging France's work ethic he is planning to roll back the boundaries of the State by adopting policies that will reduce the size of State organisations to allow for tax reductions in the hope of kick-starting the economy.
target_text: 除了挑战法国的职业道德之外，他还计划通过采取一些政策，缩小国有组织的规模，以实现减税，以期启动法国经济。

source_text: The effect of his tax and spend reduction plans on state social provision has not yet been explained.
target_text: 他的税收和支出削减计划对国家社会保障的影响尚未得到解释。

source_text: Reaction from Socialist candidate Ségolène Royal was immediate in describing his proposal as "scandalous" and that tax reductions on the richest on society would aggravate the already existing social divisions in the country.
target_text: 社会党候选人塞格琳·罗亚尔立即做出反应，称他的提议“可耻”，并表示对社会上最富有人群减税将加剧该国业已存在的社会分歧。

source_text: She argues that State spending on public services were essential at a time when such divisions existed in the country.
target_text: 她认为，国家在公共服务上的开支在这个国家存在这种分歧的时候是必不可少的。

source_text: Mr. Sarkozy is currently pulling ahead in the polls one week after announcing his candidacy for the May poll.
target_text: 萨科齐在宣布参加5月的总统大选一星期后，目前在民调中领先。

source_text: Police briefly cordoned off Mile-End tube station in East London on Saturday morning.
target_text: 周六早上，警方在东伦敦短暂封锁了Mile-End地铁站。

source_text: A man has been taken away and the alert has now been lifted.
target_text: 一名男子已被带走，警报现已解除。

source_text: The Swedish Navy have released a picture regarding a foreign submarine discovered in the Saltsjöbaden river of Lake Mälaren in Stockholm, the capital city of Sweden, situated on the western coast of the Baltic Sea.
target_text: 瑞典海军发布了一张关于在位于波罗的海西海岸的瑞典首都斯德哥尔摩的Mälaren湖Saltsjöbaden河发现的外国潜艇的照片。

source_text: The submarine was seen by Hanna Harge, a 40-year-old entrepreneur who lives locally, when walking with her dog on the morning of 13 April this year.
target_text: 今年4月13日早晨，当一名住在当地的40岁企业家汉娜·哈格和她的狗一起散步时，看到了这艘潜艇。

source_text: She woke up her family, brought them to the location and took pictures of the submarine, before it disappeared.
target_text: 她叫醒家人，带他们到目击地点，并在潜艇消失之前拍下照片。

source_text: She and her family immediately called the Swedish Navy, believing it to be an exercise, and told them to hide the vessel better.
target_text: 她和家人立即打电话给瑞典海军，认为这是一次演习，并告诉他们要更好地隐藏船只。

source_text: The Navy, however, had no knowledge of such an exercise, and no reports from other nations regarding the submarine.
target_text: 然而，海军并不知道这样的演习，也没有接到其他国家关于潜艇的报告。

source_text: Soon afterwards, the Navy's intelligence agency visited Harge, taking the pictures to technical staff.
target_text: 不久之后，海军情报局访问了哈格，将照片交给了技术人员。

source_text: The Harge family compares them to the submarines of the former Soviet Union and the early Russian Federation which allegedly violated Sweden's border in the same vicinity.
target_text: 哈格家族把它们比作前苏联和早期俄罗斯联邦的潜艇，据称这些潜艇侵犯了瑞典在同一地区的边界。

source_text: In addition to the Armed Forces of Sweden, other government agencies are also involved in the investigation such as SMHI and Environmental Protection Agency.
target_text: 除瑞典武装部队外，其他政府机构也参与调查，如SMHI和环境保护局。

source_text: In a small-scale trial on humans, American scientists say they may have developed a new drug that could stop the spread of HIV and "rapidly clears" the blood of the virus.
target_text: 在一项关于人类的小规模试验中，美国科学家表示，他们可能已开发出一种新药，可以阻止艾滋病毒的传播并“迅速清除”病毒的血液。

source_text: "There is a lot of interest in this product," said editor Keith Alcorn of the National Aids Manual.
target_text: 《国家艾滋病手册》编辑基思·奥尔康说：“人们对这种产品很感兴趣。”

source_text: The drug called PA-457, which is derived from betulinic acid and comes from by-products from paper manufacturers, is being manufactured and developed by Maryland drug manufacturer Panacos Pharmaceuticals.
target_text: 这种名为PA-457的药物是由桦木酸衍生而来，来自纸张制造商的副产品，由马里兰州药品制造商帕纳科斯制药公司生产和开发。

source_text: The drug is known as a maturation inhibitor, which is a new group of drugs.
target_text: 该药物被称为成熟抑制剂，是一组新的药物。

source_text: Its purpose is to break down the protective protein coating of HIV.
target_text: 其目的是打破HIV的保护性蛋白质涂层。

source_text: The drug exposes the inner genetic material by making holes in the coating of the virus essentially causing it to break down and disabling its ability to be passed from one human to the next.
target_text: 这种药物通过在病毒涂层上开洞来暴露病毒内部的遗传物质，从而导致病毒分解，并使其丧失从一个人传给另一个人的能力。

source_text: The drug also shows that it works on strains of HIV that are resistant to other medications.
target_text: 该药还表明，它可以对抗其他药物的艾滋病毒株起作用。

source_text: "It's a truly novel new class of drugs, and I really support their development."
target_text: “这是一种真正新颖的新型药物，我非常支持它们的开发。”

source_text: "If PA-457 turns out to be non-toxic, easy to use and not to select for resistance, it will find good use," said Charles Boucher who researches HIV at Utrecht university medical center in the Netherlands.
target_text: 荷兰乌得勒支大学医学中心艾滋病毒研究人员查尔斯·鲍彻说：“如果PA-457被证明无毒、易于使用且不易产生耐药性，那么它将得到很好的利用。”

source_text: "It stops the virus by interfering in one of the final stages in its assembly and stops it from 'budding out' from the wall of a cell," said Alcorn.
target_text: 奥尔康说：“它通过干预病毒装配的最后阶段之一来阻止病毒，阻止病毒从细胞壁‘出芽’。”

source_text: Scientists are expected to begin a larger scale test on 48 people in one month, whose drugs are no longer working; however, the drug itself is not likely to be available for wide-scale use for at least 3 years.
target_text: 科学家预计将在一个月内对48人进行更大规模的测试，这些人的药物已经失效，然而，这种药物本身至少在3年内不太可能大规模使用。

source_text: Test subjects will be administered either a placebo or PA-457 that will be taken in combination with the medication they already take.
target_text: 测试对象将给予安慰剂或PA-457，其将与他们已服用的药物组合服用。

source_text: "This provides the basis for future studies that will be designed to provide a detailed understanding of the interaction between PA-457 and its target as well as insights into the design of new generations of maturation inhibitors," said CEO of Panacos Pharmaceuticals, Graham Allaway.
target_text: 帕纳科斯制药公司的首席执行官格雷厄姆·阿拉韦说：“这为未来的研究提供了基础，这些研究将旨在提供对PA-457及其目标之间相互作用的详细理解，以及对新一代成熟抑制剂设计的深入了解。”

source_text: In the United Kingdom, television presenter Derek Batey has died at the age of 84.
target_text: 在英国，电视节目主持人德里克·巴蒂去世，享年84岁。

source_text: Yesterday, ITV Border, the company for whom he used to work, said Batey died Sunday night in a hospice near his Lytham St Annes residence in Lancashire, England after experiencing a brief illness.
target_text: 昨天，他曾供职的独立电视公司（ITV Border公司）表示，巴蒂在英国兰开夏郡利瑟姆圣安内斯住所附近的一家临终关怀机构短暂患病，于周日晚去世。

source_text: Batey, who was born in Brampton, Carlisle in 1928, was at one time a ventriloquist.
target_text: 巴蒂1928年出生于卡莱尔的布兰普顿，曾经是一名口技表演者。

source_text: According to BBC News Online, Batey first worked in broadcasting for the BBC.
target_text: 据BBC新闻在线报道，巴蒂最初在BBC从事广播工作。

source_text: Batey was notable for presenting the game show Mr. and Mrs., a format which he developed for Border Television after seeing a similar game show on Canadian television.
target_text: 巴蒂是著名的游戏节目《先生和太太》（Mr.and Mrs.）的主持人，这是他在加拿大电视上看到类似的游戏节目后为Border tv开发的一种形式。

source_text: Batey presented 500 episodes of the TV programme, which tested married persons on their knowledge of their partners to see which which couple had the best knowledge of each other.
target_text: 巴蒂主持了500集电视节目，测试了已婚人士对伴侣的了解程度，看哪对夫妇最了解对方。

source_text: At its peak in the 1970s, the programme achieved nine million viewers.
target_text: 在20世纪70年代的巅峰时期，该节目的观众达到了900万。

source_text: Batey adapted the game show into a successful stage show which he presented 5000 times.
target_text: 巴蒂将游戏节目改编成了一个成功的舞台表演，他展示了5000次。

source_text: Batey also presented a talk show called Look Who's Talking.
target_text: 巴蒂还主持了一档名为《看谁在说话》的脱口秀节目。

source_text: Recalling the basis for the launch of the series, Batey said: "[T]here wasn't a lot of theatre in the Border area and we thought if we could bring the national names to Carlisle and invite the audiences in, it is a chance to see names where they couldn't see elsewhere, so we did that."
target_text: 回忆起该系列节目的推出背景，巴蒂说：“Border地区的剧院并不多，我们认为如果我们能把国家的名字带到卡莱尔，邀请观众进去，这是一个机会，让他们看到在别处看不到的名字，所以我们做到了。”

source_text: Both Mr. and Mrs. and Look Who's Talking were originally regional programmes and were later broadcast across the ITV Network, Batey reported.
target_text: 巴蒂报道说，《先生和太太》（Mr.and Mrs.）和《看谁在说话》最初都是地区性节目，后来在ITV网络上播出。

source_text: Harry King, a former colleague and friend of Derek Batey, described him as "a proud Cumbrian [...] a people person and was never happier than when he was talking to people."
target_text: 德里克·巴蒂的前同事兼朋友哈里·金形容他是“一个骄傲的坎布里亚人……”他是个善于交际的人，从来没有比与人交谈时更快乐。

source_text: "He could be talking to the Queen or the person next door".
target_text: “他可以和女王或隔壁的人交谈”。

source_text: King described Mr. and Mrs. as "iconic" and said Batey "would always let the people he was talking to take the limelight".
target_text: 金将《先生和太太》（Mr.and Mrs.）描述为“标志性的”，并说巴蒂“永远会让他谈话的人成为人们关注的焦点”。

source_text: ITV News Border reporter Matthew Taylor said Batey "will leave a lasting legacy in this region".
target_text: ITV新闻边境记者马修・泰勒表示，巴蒂“将在该地区留下永久的遗产”。

source_text: His death at age 73 was announced by his agent.
target_text: 他的经纪人宣布他73岁去世。

source_text: After his dentist noticed something unusual with him, Brown was told to visit a doctor immediately.
target_text: 在他的牙医注意到他的一些不寻常之后，布朗被告知立即去看医生。

source_text: It is not known whether he received a pneumonia vaccination, as recommended for people of his age.
target_text: 目前还不清楚他是否接受了肺炎疫苗接种，这是为他这个年龄的人推荐的。

source_text: He was born in 1933 and grew up in poverty until he formed James Brown & The Famous Flames.
target_text: 他生于1933年，在贫困中长大，直到他创立了“詹姆斯·布朗和顶好的火焰”乐队。

source_text: His influence on 20th century music, from funk to hip hop was profound.
target_text: 他对20世纪音乐的影响，从放克到嘻哈都是深刻的。

source_text: Before he died, he scheduled a New Year's Eve concert series in New Jersey and New York that would help kick off a 2007 tour.
target_text: 在他去世之前，他在新泽西和纽约安排了一场新年前夜的系列音乐会，这将有助于开启2007年的巡演。

source_text: Chicago peace activist and musician Malachi Ritscher burned himself alive Friday morning (Nov. 3, 2006) on the Kennedy Expressway, apparently in protest of the Iraq war.
target_text: 芝加哥和平活动家和音乐家马拉奇·里查于周五早晨（2006年11月3日）在肯尼迪高速公路上自焚，显然是为了抗议伊拉克战争。

source_text: Police found a homemade sign near his body which said "Thou Shalt Not Kill."
target_text: 警方在他的尸体附近发现了一个自制的牌子，上面写着“不得杀人”。

source_text: Before the act, he posted a suicide note on his website.
target_text: 在此之前，他在自己的网站上发布了遗书。

source_text: The United Kingdom Parliament is planning to expand the powers of bailiffs in pursuit of unpaid debts.
target_text: 英国议会正计划扩大执行官的权力，以追究未偿还的债务。

source_text: While the new measures are not yet officially active, bailiffs are expected to soon be able to use force in entering debtors' homes and restraining them.
target_text: 虽然新措施尚未正式实施，但执行官预计很快就能够使用强制力进入债务人的家园并限制他们。

source_text: The preemptive crackdown was introduced with predictions of hundreds of thousands of British citizens losing their homes to credit companies as the international financial crisis grows worse.
target_text: 这场先发制人的打击行动，是基于随着国际金融危机愈演愈烈，预测将有数十万英国公民的住房会被信贷公司夺走。

source_text: Previous to the proposed laws, bailiffs were not allowed to break into or enter homes unless the debtor was already there, or as a last resort.
target_text: 在拟议的法律之前，执行官不得闯入或进入民宅，除非债务人已经在那里，或作为最后手段。

source_text: Justice Lord Bach stated the Act would not be made active until after Parliament had finished extensive consulting, and that the new powers of bailiffs would be carefully monitored.
target_text: 巴赫勋爵表示，在议会完成广泛的咨询之后，该法案才会生效，并且将严格监督执行官的新权力。

source_text: Civil rights activists like Paul Nicolson of the Zacchaeus 2000 Trust, however, have heavily criticized the new laws, accusing them of destroying fundamental civil rights and stripping away "tried and tested protections that make a person's home his castle and which have stood for centuries".
target_text: 然而，像扎凯2000信托基金的保罗•尼科尔森这样的民权活动人士，对这些新法律提出了严厉批评，指责它们破坏了公民的基本权利，剥夺了“久经考验的保护措施，这些保护措施使一个人的家成为他的城堡，而且屹立了数百年”。

source_text: A government spokesman said the Parliament was considering its options for implementing the new laws and would make an announcement soon.
target_text: 一名政府发言人表示，议会正在考虑实施新法律的方案，并将很快宣布。

source_text: Chris Christie, governor of the US state of New Jersey, complained on ABC's Sunday morning talk show This Week that TV series Jersey Shore promotes a negative image of the state.
target_text: 美国新泽西州州长克里斯·克里斯蒂在美国广播公司周日早间的脱口秀节目“这个星期”中抱怨称，电视剧“泽西海岸”宣传了该州的负面形象。

source_text: Prompted by a feature in The New York Times on Nicole "Snooki" Polizzi, one of the stars of the MTV show, interviewer Jake Tapper asked the governor whether he thought the series was positive or negative for the state.
target_text: 纽约时报一篇关于MTV节目明星之一的妮可“Snooki”波利兹的特写文章，促使主持人杰克·塔珀询问州长，他认为该节目对该州是正面的还是负面的。

source_text: Christie unequivocally answered that the show was "negative for New Jersey..."
target_text: 克里斯蒂毫不含糊地回答说这个节目“对新泽西不利……”。

source_text: "It takes a bunch of New Yorkers, drops them on the Jersey Shore, and tries to make America feel like this is New Jersey".
target_text: “它将一大群纽约人扔到泽西海岸，并试图让美国人觉得这就是新泽西”。

source_text: He concluded, "I can tell people: they want to know what New Jersey really is? I welcome them to come to New Jersey any time."
target_text: 他总结道，“我可以告诉他们：他们想知道新泽西到底是什么？我欢迎他们随时来新泽西。”

source_text: In a wide-ranging interview the governor also faced questions about local and national politics, including New Jersey's US$11 billion budget deficit.
target_text: 在广泛的访谈中，州长还面临有关地方和国家政治的问题，包括新泽西州110亿美元的预算赤字。

source_text: Specifically, he was challenged over his plans to not pay $3 billion into public pension funds, payments described by the interviewer as a "legal obligation".
target_text: 具体而言，他不向公共养老基金支付30亿美元的计划受到了质疑，面试官将该支付描述为“法律义务”。

source_text: He said that he "wasn't going to put $3 billion into a failing pension system" and that there would be further reforms of pensions and health benefits.
target_text: 他说，他“不会将30亿美元投入到一个失败的养老金体系中”，并且将进一步改革养老金和健康福利。

source_text: Christie was further questioned over his ongoing conflicts with teachers unions.
target_text: 克里斯蒂因与教师工会的持续冲突而受到进一步质疑。

source_text: He responded that "we can't have one sector of our society sheltered from the ravages of the recession, at the cost to people who have been hurt by the recession the most", citing the example of construction unions in New Jersey currently suffering unemployment between 35 and 50%.
target_text: 他回应说，“我们的社会不能有一个免受经济衰退侵害的部门，而代价是那些受经济衰退伤害最深的人群。”他以新泽西州的建筑工会为例，该工会目前的失业率在百分之35至50之间。

source_text: Sir Alan Sugar will continue to front the BBC series The Apprentice after his appointment as "enterprise tsar" for the British government.
target_text: 艾伦·休格爵士被任命为英国政府的“企业冠军”后，将继续主持BBC电视剧集“学徒”。

source_text: Sugar will return as host for the sixth series in the spring of next year.
target_text: 休格将在明年春季作为第六个系列赛的主持人回归。

source_text: Sugar was previously being pushed to choose between the roles.
target_text: 休格之前被迫在自身扮演的角色之间做出选择。

source_text: The BBC released a statement saying that "The BBC is satisfied that [Sir Alan's] new role as an Enterprise Champion to the government will not compromise the BBC's impartiality or his ability to present The Apprentice."
target_text: BBC发表声明称，“BBC很满意，艾伦爵士作为政府企业冠军的新角色不会损害BBC的公正性，也不会损害他在‘学徒’中的演出能力。”

source_text: They commented that they have stated that it would breach the BBC's impartiality rules.
target_text: 他们评论说，他们已经表示会违反BBC的公正性规则。

source_text: The Conservatives said that it would be impossible for him to continue both roles.
target_text: 保守党说，他不可能继续担任这两个角色。

source_text: They added the fact that the next series is due to start during the build up to a possible General Election.
target_text: 他们补充说，实际上，下一个系列预定在可能举行大选的准备期间开始。

source_text: According to a new diagnosis by a surgical pathologist, Frida Kahlo most likely suffered uterine damage during a streetcar accident as a teenager and this led to a rare condition known as Asherman's syndrome, and that would explain the Mexican artist's infertility.
target_text: 根据一名外科病理学家的最新诊断，弗里达·卡罗十几岁时最有可能在一场电车事故中遭受子宫损伤，这导致了一种罕见的疾病——阿什曼综合征，这也解释了这位墨西哥艺术家的不孕不育。

source_text: Dr. Fernando Antelo, from the Harbor–UCLA Medical Center, said, "Her survival defied the grim prognostication by her physicians; however, complications from this physical trauma would emerge in her adulthood."
target_text: 来自加州大学洛杉矶分校哈伯分校医学中心的费尔南多·安特洛博士说：“她的存活战胜了医生们的可怕预言，然而，这种身体创伤的并发症会在她成年后出现。”

source_text: He presented his diagnosis yesterday at the annual meeting of the American Association of Anatomists in San Diego.
target_text: 他昨天在圣地亚哥美国解剖学家协会年会上提出了他的诊断。

source_text: Asherman's syndrome is normally caused by a trauma to the uterus that results in internal scar tissue.
target_text: 阿舍曼综合症通常是由子宫损伤导致的内部疤痕组织引起的。

source_text: For example, it can occur after multiple procedures to clear the uterus after a miscarriage or abortion, which is known as a "D & C" procedure.
target_text: 例如，早产或流产后，这种情况可以在多次手术清理子宫后发生，这被称为“D&C”手术。

source_text: Antelo said Kahlo tried to have children many times and her miscarriages, as well as three therapeutic abortions, could have further aggravated the scarring.
target_text: 安特洛说，卡罗曾多次尝试生育，她的早产以及三次治疗性流产可能会进一步加深疤痕。

source_text: At present the condition could be diagnosed and treated after advancements in medical imaging and hysteroscopy, but in Kahlo's time, Dr. Antelo said, the technology had not advanced far enough to diagnose and treat her.
target_text: 安特洛博士说，目前这种疾病可以通过医学成像和宫腔镜技术的进步来诊断和治疗，但在卡罗的时代，这项技术还没有发展到足以诊断和治疗她的程度。

source_text: Asherman's syndrome has been known since 1894 when it was first reported.
target_text: 自1894年首次报道阿舍曼综合征以来，人们就已经知道了。

source_text: "She kept attempting to have children with a uterus that wasn't in any condition to do that," Antelo said.
target_text: 安特洛说：“她一直试图用子宫生育孩子，但子宫不具备任何怀孕条件。”

source_text: Antelo, who has been working on connections between art and medicine, says that Kahlo brought her infertility to the canvas and this can be seen in her many paintings of reproductive organs or in her depiction of her own bleeding body in the 1932 painting Henry Ford Hospital.
target_text: 安特洛一直致力于研究艺术和医学之间的联系，她说卡罗把她的不孕带到了画布上，这可以在她许多关于生殖器官的画作中看到，或者在1932年亨利福特医院的画作中看到她自己流血的身体。

source_text: In that image, Kahlo is shown lying on a hospital bed with multiple umbilical cords extending from her body and each one holds an object or body part, except one holding a baby.
target_text: 在这张图片中，卡罗躺在医院的病床上，身上有多条脐带，每个脐带都连着一个物体或身体的某个部位，只有一条脐带连着婴儿。

source_text: Manchester United and Barcelona will face off in the Champions League semi-finals after both teams won their quarterfinal matches.
target_text: 曼联和巴塞罗那将在欧冠半决赛中相遇，两队都在四分之一决赛中获胜。

source_text: Both sides came into their second legs having won their away legs, Barcelona having defeated Schalke 04 1-0 in Germany, and United coming out of Italy with a 2-0 decision.
target_text: 两支球队都在客场取得胜利后进入第二场赛事，巴塞罗那在德国以1-0击败沙尔克04，曼联在意大利以2-0胜出。

source_text: Abkhazia, a region located within the internationally recognised borders of Georgia, but which is a de facto independent republic without international recognition, has closed its border with the country following recent bomb blasts.
target_text: 阿布哈兹是位于国际承认的格鲁吉亚边界内的一个地区，但它实际上是一个没有得到国际承认的独立共和国。在最近发生炸弹爆炸之后，阿布哈兹关闭了与格鲁吉亚的边界。

source_text: Several people have been injured in the blasts which occurred today and on Sunday when two bombs exploded in Gagra.
target_text: 今天和周日发生在加格拉的两起爆炸造成数人受伤。

source_text: Abkhazia broke away from Georgia after the early 1990s war when separatists defeated Georgian forces and commenced a campaign of ethnic cleansing of Georgians in Abkhazia.
target_text: 20世纪90年代初的战争结束后，阿布哈兹从格鲁吉亚脱离出来，当时分离主义分子击败了格鲁吉亚军队，并开始在阿布哈兹开展种族清洗格鲁吉亚人的运动。

source_text: The region's foreign minister said, "Georgia's aim is to destabilise the economic situation in Abkhazia."
target_text: 该地区的外交部长说：“格鲁吉亚的目标是破坏阿布哈兹的经济形势。”

source_text: Georgian authorities have denied any involvement in the bomb blasts.
target_text: 格鲁吉亚当局否认参与炸弹爆炸事件。

source_text: Shota Utiashvili ,an interior ministry spokesman, said, "It will be a humanitarian catastrophe if the border is closed."
target_text: 内政部发言人绍塔·乌蒂亚什维利说，“如果边境关闭，那将是一场人道主义灾难。”

source_text: "Thousands of Georgians in Abkhazia cross the border to get pensions, do their shopping and work".
target_text: “阿布哈兹的数千名格鲁吉亚人越过边境以获得养老金，购物和工作”。

source_text: Russia, which is said to support the separatist forces, have peacekeeping troops within the region but this has been described as an occupying force by Georgia and Russia accused of trying to take over the region by stealth.
target_text: 据称支持分裂势力的俄罗斯在该地区部署了维和部队，但格鲁吉亚称其为一支占领军，并指控俄罗斯试图秘密接管该地区。

source_text: The central midfielder, who will now partner Brazilian - Emerson, has signed a 5 year contract at the Stadio Delle Alpi.
target_text: 这名中场球员在阿尔皮球场签了5年的合同，现在将与巴西人埃莫森搭档。

source_text: Juve had been in talks for the 29-year-old for the last few weeks and a deal has been completed.
target_text: 过去几周，尤文一直在为获得这位29岁的球员进行谈判，而协议已经达成。

source_text: Vieira will now link up with boss Fabio Capello again after a brief stint at AC Milan with him almost a decade ago.
target_text: 维埃拉将在近10年前短暂效力于AC米兰后，再次与主教练比奥·卡佩罗携手合作。

source_text: The Frenchman joins the side despite being strongly linked with a move to Real Madrid over the last two summers.
target_text: 这名法国人加入了该球队，尽管在过去的两个夏天，他一直被联想极有可能会转至皇马。

source_text: Vieira ends his Premiership stay after nine years in England since he became Arsene Wenger's first signing at Arsenal.
target_text: 维埃拉结束了他的英超生涯，自从他成为阿尔塞纳·温格在阿森纳签下的第一名球员以来，他已经留在英格兰9年了。

source_text: A man, reportedly a postman, has died as the result of a one-vehicle road traffic collision in the Outer Hebrides of Scotland.
target_text: 一名男子据报道是一名邮递员因苏格兰外赫布里底群岛的单车道路交通相撞事故而死亡。

source_text: Emergency services were alerted to the incident, which occurred on Ford Terrace on the island of Benbecula, at 1139 UTC yesterday.
target_text: 昨天，UTC时间1139，本贝库拉岛上的福特台地上发生了这起事故后，紧急服务部门接到了警报。

source_text: STV News reported the mail carrier, who has not yet been publicly identified, was conducting his duties at the time of the incident.
target_text: STV新闻报道称，这名邮递员在事故发生时正在履行职责，但他的身份尚未公开。

source_text: According to Hebrides News, the accident occurred when the man was standing outside of the van he was driving; the vehicle rolled over the man, fatally injuring him.
target_text: 据赫布里底斯新闻报道，事故发生时，这名男子正站在他驾驶的货车外，汽车辗过那个人，使他受了致命伤。

source_text: The Northern Constabulary said the local Road Policing Unit based in the town of Dingwall in the Scottish Highlands has launched an investigation into the incident.
target_text: 北警察局称，位于苏格兰高地丁沃尔镇的当地公路警务部门已对该事件展开调查。

source_text: "Our thoughts are with the postman's family, friends and colleagues at this very sad time", the spokesperson added.
target_text: 发言人补充说：“在这个悲痛的时刻，我们与邮递员的家人、朋友和同事在一起。”

source_text: Police do not intend to disclose any further information about the incident until relatives of the deceased have been informed of the incident.
target_text: 在死者的亲属被告知此事件之前，警方无意披露有关该事件的任何进一步资料。

source_text: No other vehicles are thought to have been involved; the Northern Constabulary has not yet said if it is looking for any other persons in relation to the fatality.
target_text: 据信没有其他车辆卷入其中，北方警察还没有说他们是否在寻找与死亡有关的其他人员。

source_text: The Kenyan government has dismissed 25,000 striking health workers, mostly nurses, citing failure to heed government orders to recommence work and concern for the welfare of hospital patients.
target_text: 肯尼亚政府已经解雇了25,000名罢工的卫生工作者，其中大多数是护士，理由是他们没有听从政府的命令重新开始工作，也不关心医院病人的福利。

source_text: The workers, who had been on strike for four days, were wishing to have improvements made to their wages, working conditions, and allowances.
target_text: 罢工四天的工人们希望改善他们的工资，工作条件和津贴。

source_text: The strikes have caused a significant number of Kenyan hospitals to cease operations.
target_text: 罢工导致大量肯尼亚医院停止运营。

source_text: According to Kenya Health Professionals Society spokesperson Alex Orina, the average monthly wage plus allowances for health workers in Kenya is KSh25,000 (£193, US$302 or €230) approximately.
target_text: 肯尼亚卫生专业人员协会发言人亚历克斯·奥里纳表示，肯尼亚卫生工作者的月平均工资加津贴约为25000肯尼亚先令（193英镑，302美元或230欧元）。

source_text: With an increasing number of reports of patients neglected in hospitals emerging, two trade unions met with the Kenyan government yesterday and negotitated a return to work, although a significant proportion of demonstrators defied the agreement, The Guardian reported.
target_text: 据英国《卫报》报道，随着越来越多的报道称医院里的病人被忽视，两家工会昨天与肯尼亚政府举行了会谈，就恢复工作进行了谈判，尽管相当一部分示威者不服从协议。

source_text: Orina told Reuters the dismissals were "cat-and-mouse games, you cannot sack an entire workforce."
target_text: 奥里纳对路透表示，裁员是“猫捉老鼠的游戏，不能解雇全部员工。”

source_text: "It is a ploy to get us to rush back to work, but our strike continues until our demands are met".
target_text: “这是一个让我们赶快回去工作的计谋，但我们的罢工将继续，直到我们的要求得到满足为止。”

source_text: Kenya Medical Practitioners, Pharmacists and Dentists Union chairperson Dr. Victor Ng'ani described government actions as "reckless".
target_text: 肯尼亚医生、药剂师和牙医工会主席维克多·吴安尼博士称政府的行为是“鲁莽的”。

source_text: Mutua said the health workers were "no longer employees of the government" and had been eliminated from the payroll.
target_text: 穆图亚说，卫生工作者“不再是政府的雇员”，并已从工资单中被除名。

source_text: While Ng'ani told the BBC of difficulties with finding other workers as skilled and experienced, Mutua reportedly stated that this would not be an issue.
target_text: 尽管Ng'ani告诉BBC很难找到其他有技术和经验的工人，但据报道穆图亚称这不是问题。

source_text: "We have over 100,000 to 200,000 health professionals looking for work today," Mutua commented.
target_text: “我们现在有10万到20万卫生专业人员在找工作。穆图亚评论道。”

source_text: "There will be a lag of a day or two ... but it is better than letting people die on the floor, at the gate, or suffer in pain".
target_text: “将会有一两天的滞后……但这比让人们死在地板上，在门口或遭受痛苦更好”。

source_text: Over the summer a customized distribution of the Linux (or GNU/Linux) operating system was installed on 2,460 desktops in the Italian South Tyrol province of Bolzano.
target_text: 今年夏天，在意大利南蒂罗尔州博尔扎诺的2,460台桌面上安装了Linux（或GNU/Linux）操作系统的定制发行版。

source_text: This deployment included all 70 of the province's private and public schools and affects more than 16,000 students.
target_text: 这次部署包括全省70所私立和公立学校，影响了超过16,000名学生。

source_text: The distribution installed, FUSS Soledad GNU/Linux, is a customized version of the popular Debian GNU/Linux distribution.
target_text: 安装的发行版FUSS Soledad GNU/Linux是流行的Debian GNU/Linux发行版的定制版本。

source_text: FUSS Soledad GNU/Linux has multi-language support and uses the GNOME desktop environment.
target_text: FUSS Soledad GNU/Linux具有多语言支持并使用GNOME桌面环境。

source_text: In addition to the desktops in the schools, more than 20,000 LiveCDs are scheduled to be created and given free of charge to the students and their families.
target_text: 除了学校的桌面设备外，还计划为学生及其家庭免费提供20,000多个LiveCD。

source_text: These LiveCDs allow students to use the same software on their home computers that they are going to use at school.
target_text: 这些liveCD允许学生在家里的电脑上使用与在学校使用相同的软件。

source_text: Project co-director Antonio Russo said, "With the participation of all the public and private schools, this will give to all the students, families, teachers, and operators from the educational world the opportunity to use a entirely free operating system, both at school and at home."
target_text: 项目联席主任安东尼奥·鲁索说：“在所有公立和私立学校的参与下，这将给来自教育界的所有学生、家庭、教师和运营商提供在学校和家庭使用完全免费操作系统的机会。”

source_text: The switch was funded by the province of Bolzano, the European Social Fund, and the Center for Professional Formation in Italian Language.
target_text: 该转变由博尔扎诺省，欧洲社会基金和意大利语专业形成中心资助。

source_text: Earlier this week, Wikinews interviewed Sarah Walsh, a former Australian women's national soccer team (Matilidas) player, about women's football in the country.
target_text: 本周早些时候，维基新闻采访了前澳大利亚国家女子足球队球员萨拉・沃尔什，内容是关于澳大利亚的女子足球。

source_text: The Australian women's team is currently ranked ninth by FIFA, down one spot from the previous quarter when they were tied at eighth with the North Korea women's national football team.
target_text: 澳大利亚女足目前在国际足联的排名中位列第九，比上一季度下降了一位。上一季度，澳大利亚女足与朝鲜女足并列第八。

source_text: Meanwhile, Australia's men (Socceroos) are currently ranked 59th in the world, between the Burkina Faso and Slovakia national football team.
target_text: 与此同时，澳大利亚男子足球队（Socceroos）目前在世界排名第59位，排在布基纳法索和斯洛伐克国家足球队之间。

source_text: Walsh retired from the national team in September of last year, after scoring 32 goals in 71 appearances.
target_text: 去年9月，沃尔什在71场比赛中打入32球后，从国家队退役。

source_text: She was on Matildas side that qualified for the World Cup for the first time while playing in the Asian Football Confederation instead of the Oceania Football Confederation.
target_text: 她在亚足联而不是大洋洲足联踢球时，第一次代表马蒂达斯队获得了世界杯参赛资格。

source_text: She also played in two World Cup quarter-finals for the team.
target_text: 她还代表国家队参加了两次世界杯四分之一决赛。

source_text: Playing in Australia's top level domestic league, the W-League, she won the league championship in 2009.
target_text: 在澳大利亚顶级国内联赛，W联赛中，她在2009年赢得了联赛冠军。

source_text: Walsh played professionally in the United States for Sky Blue FC and Saint Louis Athletica.
target_text: 沃尔什在美国为天蓝色足球俱乐部和圣路易斯竞技队效力。

source_text: The Matildas are ranked 8th by FIFA in the latest rankings.
target_text: 在国际足联的最新排名中，马蒂达斯队排在第8位。

source_text: Should media coverage correlate to team performance and internationally rankings?
target_text: 媒体报道是否涉及团队表现和国际排名？

source_text: Is there an element of tall poppy syndrome in the coverage of the Socceroos?
target_text: 在Socceroos的报道中是否存在高大罂粟花综合症的元素？

source_text: What other factors can be used to explain the relative differences in media attention other than performance?
target_text: 除了表现之外，还有哪些其他因素可以用来解释媒体关注的相对差异？

source_text: ::Sarah Walsh: Traditionally in Australia, male sports have dominated media coverage.
target_text: ：莎拉·沃尔什：传统上，在澳大利亚，男性体育在媒体报道中占据主导地位。

source_text: Slowly we are seeing women's sports feature more frequently in mainstream media publications.
target_text: 慢慢地，我们在主流媒体出版物上看到越来越多的女性体育特写。

source_text: With time, the public will be exposed to more female sports on a daily basis and perhaps will build the same affections for these female sports.
target_text: 随着时间的推移，公众将每天接触更多的女性运动，也许会对这些女性运动产生同样的感情。

source_text: Young female teenagers today, have the option to turn the TV on and watch the W-league and follow their heroes.
target_text: 今天的年轻女性青少年，可以选择打开电视，观看W联赛，追随他们的英雄。

source_text: I believe in 5–10 years' time we will see a cultural change with regards to media coverage and gender bias.
target_text: 我相信，在5到10年后，我们将看到媒体报道和性别偏见方面的文化变革。

source_text: : What's the difference in style of play between the men and women's national teams?
target_text: ：男女国家队的比赛风格有什么不同？

source_text: ::Sarah Walsh: Men :: They appear to play a possession-based game working at effective possession combined with a developing system of pressing using our natural athleticism and high work rate as well as our cultural mental strength.
target_text: ：莎拉·沃尔什：男人们：他们似乎在玩一种以占有为基础的游戏，在有效占有的情况下工作，并结合一种发展中的系统，利用我们的自然运动精神和高工作率以及我们的文化精神力量进行施压。

source_text: ::Sarah Walsh: Women ::The women seem to employ a more defensive and well organized "block" making it hard for teams to play through particularly in the middle and our back thirds utilizing transitional moments (BPO – BP) to good effect with quick attacks through the natural speed of certain players.
target_text: ：莎拉·沃尔什：女人：女人们似乎采用更具防守性的方法和组织良好的“拦截”，使得球员很难通过，特别是在中后卫和后场，利用过渡时刻（BPO-BP），通过某些球员的天生速度快速进攻，取得良好的效果。

source_text: : Why are the Matildas more successful in international competitions and ranking wise than the Socceroos?
target_text: 为什么马蒂达斯在国际比赛中比足球更成功，排名也更靠前？

source_text: ::Sarah Walsh: There could be a number of contributing factors.
target_text: 莎拉·沃尔什：可能有很多因素在起作用。

source_text: Given there is more financial support for men's national teams globally in general, I believe the competition across the board is more extensive.
target_text: 鉴于全球男子国家队的财政支持更多，我相信全面的竞争更为广泛。

source_text: : Does the media feed into traditional Australian gender stereotypes by not covering elite women's sports?
target_text: ：：媒体没有报道澳大利亚的精英女子体育项目，这是否助长了澳大利亚传统的性别成见？

source_text: : What is your role in sports?
target_text: 你在体育运动中扮演什么角色？

source_text: Journalist?
target_text: 记者？

source_text: Academic?
target_text: 学术的？

source_text: Sport administrator?
target_text: 体育管理员？

source_text: Player?
target_text: 球员吗？

source_text: Please provide one to two sentence biography to contextualize your answers.
target_text: 请提供一到两句的个人简介，将你的答案与上下文联系起来。

source_text: ::Sarah Walsh: I started playing football at 5 years of age.
target_text: ：：萨拉·沃尔什：我5岁开始踢足球。

source_text: I made my debut for the Matildas at 21 (2004–2012) I have spent the past two years working in community football at FFA delivering a Drug and Alcohol program.
target_text: 我在21岁的时候（2004年至2012年）第一次为马蒂达斯队效力。在过去的两年里，我一直在FFA的社区足球工作，负责一个药物和酒精项目。

source_text: I am currently the Women's Football Coordinator and Female Elite Player mentor at FFA.
target_text: 我目前是FFA的女子足球协调员和女性精英球员导师。

source_text: Actually on wikipedia if you would like to cut and paste all that info!
target_text: 实际上在维基百科上，如果你想剪切和粘贴所有信息！

source_text: Brazilian driver Filipe Massa, driving for Ferrari, won the Brazilian Grand Prix at Autódromo José Carlos Pace in Interlagos, São Paulo.
target_text: 为法拉利车队效力的巴西车手菲利普·马萨在圣保罗英特拉格斯的何塞·卡洛斯·佩斯高速公路上赢得了巴西大奖赛的冠军。

source_text: Massa started from pole and controlled the race from start to the finish line.
target_text: 马萨从杆位出发，控制了从起点到终点的比赛。

source_text: Alonso, along with the second Renault driver, Giancarlo Fisichella who finished sixth, won the constructors' cup for their team with only five points ahead of Ferrari.
target_text: 阿隆索和雷诺车队的第二位车手吉安卡洛·费斯切拉以第六名的成绩获得车队的总冠军，他们只领先法拉利5分。

source_text: In the race he was almost on the back of Fisichella, but damaged his tyre in the overtaking attempt and lose all positions.
target_text: 在比赛中，他几乎跑到了费斯切拉的后面，但在超车过程中，他的轮胎受损，失去了所有的有利位置。

source_text: But the retiring champion was right on the back of Fisico for the second time near the end of the race.
target_text: 但这位即将退役的冠军在比赛即将结束时第二次出现在菲斯科的背后。

source_text: Giancarlo made a crucial mistake prior to Senna's "S"-curve allowing Michael to pass him.
target_text: 在塞纳的“S”弯道之前，吉安卡洛犯了一个致命错误，让迈克尔超越了他。

source_text: Must note that all Schumacher overtook most of the other drivers in the same turn.
target_text: 必须注意的是，所有舒马赫车队的车手都在同一弯道超过了大多数其他车手。

source_text: The "Red Baron" set up the fastest time and the top speed record for this track.
target_text: “红色男爵”在这条赛道上创造了最快的时间和最高的速度记录。

source_text: Danke, Michael, for the fantastic race and so many seasons together.
target_text: 丹克，迈克尔，一起为了精彩的比赛和这么多的赛季。

source_text: Rubens Barrichello (Honda, Pedro de la Rosa (McLaren-Mercedes) and Poland Robert Kubica (Sauber-BMW) were 7-th, 8-th and 9-th respectfully.
target_text: 鲁本斯・巴里切罗（本田，佩德罗德拉罗莎（迈凯轮-梅塞德斯）和波兰罗伯特库比卡（索伯宝马）分别位列第7、第8和第9位。

source_text: Takuma Sato closed the season with 10-th place, first who finished in one lap after the winner, the best result for Super Aguri-Honda team.
target_text: 佐藤琢磨以第10名的成绩结束了本赛季，他落后冠军一圈完成了比赛，这是超级日本本田车队的最好成绩。

source_text: With ten laps to go, the most surprising event was Kimi's resistance when his open wheels untimely overlapped with Michael's, especially when one knows Kimi will run with Ferrari next season.
target_text: 在还有10圈的时候，最令人惊讶的事情是来自基米的阻挡，当时他张开的车轮不合时宜地与迈克尔的车轮相撞，特别是当人们知道基米下赛季将与参加法拉利车队时。

source_text: The Canadian Government is watching the "slowing growth" of the BP oil spill.
target_text: 加拿大政府正在关注英国石油公司漏油事件的“缓慢进展”。

source_text: Canada is running their dash-8 on a twice a day mission to the gulf, monitoring for signs that the BP Oil slick may expand up the Eastern seaboard into Canadian waters, and to provide assistance to US efforts to contain the spill.
target_text: 加拿大正在执行他们的dash-8计划，每天两次前往墨西哥湾，监测英国石油公司浮油可能向东海岸扩散至加拿大水域的迹象，并为美国遏制漏油的努力提供帮助。

source_text: This started in May, and is expected to continue until the spill has been fully contained, or no longer needed.
target_text: 这项工作于5月开始，预计将持续到泄漏完全被控制或不再需要为止。

source_text: Canada has also provided technical experts, research and development teams, and general staffing to assist in spill containment and cleanup.
target_text: 加拿大还提供技术专家，研究和开发团队以及一般人员配置，以协助泄漏控制和清理。

source_text: While the risk is slim that the oil slick will move up the seaboard enough to get into Canadian waters, it is possible.
target_text: 虽然浮油沿海岸上升进入加拿大水域的风险很小，但这是有可能的。

source_text: Currently the spill is being held within the Gulf of Mexico, however, as the spill grows each day it is at bigger risk of being picked up by the Loop Current.
target_text: 然而，目前泄漏仍在墨西哥湾内，随着泄漏量与日俱增，它被环流捕获的风险也越来越大。

source_text: If oil is swept up into the Loop Current—which moves at about 3.3 to 6.5 feet (one to two meters) a second—there's essentially no way to stop it, Tony Sturges, professor emeritus of oceanography at Florida State University, told National Geographic.
target_text: 佛罗里达州立大学海洋学荣誉退休教授托尼·斯特奇斯告诉《国家地理》杂志，如果石油以每秒3.3到6.5英尺（1到2米）的速度进入环流，基本上没有办法阻止它。

source_text: After being picked up by the Loop Current, the oil spill could then quickly be carried further by the Gulf Stream, which can travel up to 2.5 metres per second (5.6 mph).
target_text: 在被环流捕获后，原油泄漏可能会被墨西哥湾流带到更远的地方，墨西哥湾流的速度可以达到每秒2.5米（5.6英里）。

source_text: This current leads right through some of Canada's best fishing waters, and could potentially even be washed up directly onto the shores of Canada, if not properly contained.
target_text: 这股水流直接穿过加拿大一些最好的渔业水域，如果没有得到适当的控制，甚至有可能被直接冲到加拿大海岸。

source_text: This spill could devastate the fishing industry of Canada, and harm any potential tourism on the beautiful coastal waters of Eastern Canada.
target_text: 这次泄漏可能会摧毁加拿大的捕鱼业，损害加拿大东部美丽的沿海水域的旅游业。

source_text: So while Canada is offering its hand to the United States as a gesture of assistance, it serves dually as a self assurance that Canada will not be affected by the spill, and to stop it before it reaches the border if it does get picked up by the currents.
target_text: 因此，当加拿大向美国伸出援助之手时，它同时也是在向美国保证，加拿大不会受到石油泄漏的影响，如果它确实被洋流卷走，会在到达边境之前阻止它。

source_text: In addition to war funds, the bill includes educational benefits for young troops and veterans, a 13-week extension of unemployment benefits, $2.7 billion in emergency relief for victims of the Midwest floods, and billions of dollars for items such as international food aid, anti-drug enforcement, and repairs of Louisiana levees.
target_text: 除了战争基金，该法案还包括为年轻军人和退伍军人提供教育福利，延长13周的失业救济，为中西部洪灾受害者提供27亿美元的紧急救济，以及数十亿美元的国际食品援助、禁毒执法和路易斯安那州堤坝维修等项目。

source_text: At a ceremony in the White House's Oval Office, Bush praised the legislation as a necessary product of bipartisanship.
target_text: 在白宫椭圆形办公室举行的仪式上，布什赞扬该立法是两党合作的必要产物。

source_text: I appreciate that Republicans and Democrats in Congress agreed to provide these vital funds without tying the hands of our commanders, and without an artificial timetable of withdrawal from Iraq.
target_text: 我感谢国会的共和党人和民主党人同意提供这些至关重要的资金，而不束缚我们指挥官的手脚，也不设定从伊拉克撤军的人为时间表。

source_text: This bill shows the American people that even in an election year, Republicans and Democrats can come together to stand behind our troops and their families.
target_text: 该法案向美国人民表明，即使在大选年，共和党人和民主党人也可以齐聚一堂，支持我们的军队及其家人。

source_text: Although not mentioned by Bush in his statement, the bill also waives an older law that restricted America's capacity to finance the removal of nuclear weapons in North Korea.
target_text: 尽管布什在他的声明中没有提到这项法案，但它也放弃了一项限制美国资助朝鲜拆除核武器的旧法律。

source_text: The absence of the waiver could have led to an embarrassing situation where progress on dismantling North Korea's nuclear program would have been delayed because of a technicality, said Leonor Tomero of the Center for Arms Control and Non-Proliferation.
target_text: 美国军备控制和不扩散中心的莱昂诺尔·托梅罗表示，如果朝鲜不放弃核武器，可能会导致一种尴尬的局面，即由于技术上的原因，朝鲜放弃核计划的进程可能会被推迟。

source_text: North Korea was recently removed from a U.S. list of countries that sponsor terrorism, as a reward for turning over all documents relating to the country's nuclear program.
target_text: 北韩最近被从美国的支持恐怖主义国家名单上除名，这是北韩交出与北韩核项目有关的所有文件的奖励。

source_text: For months, the Democrats and Republicans in Congress had argued over the bill, forcing several compromises to be made in the form of amendments.
target_text: 几个月来，国会中的民主党人和共和党人一直在争论该法案，迫使以修正案的形式作出若干妥协。

source_text: One of these amendments, the Post-9/11 Veterans Educational Assistance Act of 2008, can be described as a modern version of the World War II-era G.I.
target_text: 其中一项修正案，即2008年911后退伍军人教育援助法案，可以被描述为第二次世界大战时期G.I.（军人安置法案）的现代版本。

source_text: It provides lower college tuition costs for war veterans, which was originally opposed by Bush and Senate Republicans, including Presidential candidate John McCain.
target_text: 它为退伍军人提供了较低的大学学费，这一计划最初遭到布什和包括总统候选人麦凯恩在内的参议院共和党人的反对。

source_text: Senate Democratic majority leader Harry Reid commented on the bill, saying, "At a time when 2 million men and women have fought in Iraq and Afghanistan and when our troops have had to endure multiple deployments ... and an unclear strategy, giving them the opportunity to fuel our future economy is the least we can do."
target_text: 参议院民主党多数党领袖哈利・里德对这项法案发表评论说：“在这个时代，有200万男女军人在伊拉克和阿富汗作战，我们的军队不得不忍受多次部署。一个不明确的战略，让他们有机会推动我们未来的经济，是我们至少能做的。”

source_text: With the passing of this bill, Congress has provided $650 billion for the Iraq War effort, and nearly $200 billion for war operations in Afghanistan.
target_text: 随着这项法案的通过，国会为伊拉克战争的努力提供了6500亿美元，为阿富汗的战争行动提供了近2000亿美元。

source_text: The United Nations Committee against Torture told the United States today that the US should close its detention facility at Guantanamo Bay, Cuba as well as disclose the existence of any secret prisons it operates.
target_text: 联合国禁止酷刑委员会今天告诉美国，美国应关闭其在古巴关塔那摩湾的拘留设施，并要公开其开办的所有秘密监狱。

source_text: In an 11-page report, the committee said that the US should not detain anyone in a secret facility under its control.
target_text: 委员会在一份长达11页的报告中表示，美国不应该将任何人拘留在其控制下的秘密设施中。

source_text: It is alleged that the US has a number of secret prisons where suspects are transported to and questioned using techniques that violate international human rights conventions.
target_text: 美国拥有多座秘密监狱，嫌疑人被送往这些监狱，并使用违反国际人权公约的技术进行审讯。

source_text: Earlier this month, the US sent 30 officials to a torture committee hearing in Geneva.
target_text: 本月早些时候，美国派出30名官员到日内瓦的酷刑委员会听证会。

source_text: The delegation was criticized for failing to comment on questions relating to America's alleged secret prisons.
target_text: 代表团因未能就有关美国涉嫌秘密监狱的问题发表评论而受到批评。

source_text: The committee ruled that there was evidence that US military personnel in Iraq and Afghanistan had violated the rights of some detainees.
target_text: 委员会裁定有证据表明美国在伊拉克和阿富汗的军事人员侵犯了一些被拘留者的权利。

source_text: The committee said that some of the US' techniques had resulted in the deaths of prisoners during the interrogation process.
target_text: 该委员会表示，美国的一些技术导致了审讯过程中囚犯的死亡。

source_text: The committee further claimed that "vague" guidelines had led to abuse of detainees.
target_text: 委员会还声称，“模糊的”指导方针导致了对被拘留者的虐待。

source_text: According to the Associated Press, John B. Bellinger III, a State Department legal advisor and participant during the hearings at Geneva, said of the recommendation to close the base that, "one, seems to be beyond their mandate; two, legally wrong to say that the existence of Guantanamo is a per se violation of the convention; and, three, a not very practical recommendation given that they say that it ought to be closed but that individuals can't be sent back to a large number of countries."
target_text: 据美联社报道，在日内瓦听证会期间，国务院法律顾问和与会者约翰・贝林格三世在谈到关闭基地的建议时说：“一、似乎超出了他们的职责范围；二、在法律上错误地说关塔那摩的存在本身就是违反《公约》；三、这是一个不太实际的建议，因为他们认为应该关闭它，但不能将个人送回许多国家。”

source_text: President Bush said previously on ARD German television that he wants to close the Guantanamo Bay detainment camp.
target_text: 布什总统此前曾在ARD德国电视台表示，他希望关闭关塔那摩湾拘留营。

source_text: According to White House spokesman Tony Snow, the President is waiting for the US Supreme Court to decide on the issue of whether military tribunals or civilian courts would try the detainees.
target_text: 根据白宫发言人托尼·斯诺的说法，总统正在等待美国最高法院就军事法庭或民事法庭审判被拘留者的问题作出决定。

source_text: On Friday, the 189 Parties to the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) agreed to a final resolution calling for steps toward the banning of weapons of mass destruction (WMD) in the Middle East.
target_text: 周五，“不扩散核武器条约”（NPT）的189个缔约方同意最终决议，呼吁采取步骤，在中东禁止大规模杀伤性武器。

source_text: The resolution directs United Nations Secretary-General Ban Ki-Moon to organize a conference of all the Middle East states.
target_text: 该决议指示联合国秘书长潘基文组织所有中东国家的会议。

source_text: The resolution singles out Israel, calling on "all states in the Middle East that have not yet done so to accede to the treaty as non-nuclear weapon states so as to achieve its universality at an early date."
target_text: 该决议点名以色列，呼吁“中东所有尚未这样做的国家作为无核武器国家加入该条约，以便早日实现其普遍性。”

source_text: "It ignores the realities of the Middle East and the real threats facing the region and the entire world."
target_text: “它忽视了中东的现实以及该地区和整个世界面临的真正威胁。”

source_text: The statement went on to state, "[the resolution] singles out Israel, the Middle East's only true democracy and the only country threatened with annihilation."
target_text: 声明还说，“【该决议】特别指出以色列是中东唯一真正的民主国家，也是唯一面临毁灭威胁的国家。”

source_text: "Yet the terrorist regime in Iran, which is racing to develop nuclear weapons and which openly threatens to wipe Israel off the map, is not even mentioned in the resolution."
target_text: “然而，该决议中甚至没有提到伊朗的恐怖主义政权，该政权正在竞相发展核武器并公开威胁要将以色列从地图上抹去。”

source_text: As a non-signatory state, Israel is not bound by any resolutions of the NPT.
target_text: 作为一个非签署国，以色列不受“不扩散核武器条约”任何决议的约束。

source_text: President Niyazov of Turkmenistan had declared himself to be "President For Life" in 1999 after his last elected victory in 1992 and had not selected a successor.
target_text: 土库曼斯坦总统尼亚佐夫在1992年最后一次当选胜利之后，于1999年宣布自己为“终身总统”，而没有选出继任者。

source_text: His reign in Turkmenistan led to 21 years of relative peace within the country, but was not welcoming of diverse opinions and viewpoints throughout the culture.
target_text: 他在土库曼斯坦的统治带来该国21年的相对和平，但对于整个文化中的不同意见和观点并不表示欢迎。

source_text: His rule over Turkmenistan came after years of service in the Communist Party of the USSR.
target_text: 担任苏联共产党职务多年之后，他取得了对土库曼斯坦的统治权。

source_text: Twenty-five miners are confirmed dead, two injured, and four missing, after an explosion in a West Virginia coal mine Monday.
target_text: 周一西弗吉尼亚州煤矿爆炸后，25名矿工被证实死亡，2人受伤，4人失踪。

source_text: The incident occurred in the Upper Big Branch mine in Montcoal, West Virginia.
target_text: 事故发生在西弗吉尼亚州蒙煤上大支流煤矿。

source_text: It is the deadliest mining accident in the United States since 1984.
target_text: 这是自1984年以来美国最致命的采矿事故。

source_text: Search and rescue operations were suspended Tuesday due to high levels of methane gas which made conditions unsafe for rescuers.
target_text: 周二，由于甲烷气体含量高，救援人员面临危险，搜救行动暂停。

source_text: A team attempting to ventilate the mine is expected to complete the work by Wednesday evening.
target_text: 一个试图让矿井通风的团队预计将在周三晚上完成工作。

source_text: Officials said that it was unlikely that the missing miners were still alive, although they would not stop efforts until they were found.
target_text: 有关官员说，失踪的矿工不太可能还活着，尽管他们不会在找到之前停止努力。

source_text: The mine is owned by Massey Energy but operated by Performance Coal Company, a subsidiary of Massey, which is the fourth largest coal producer in the US.
target_text: 该矿归梅西能源所有，但由美国第四大煤炭生产商梅西的子公司Performance Coal Company运营。

source_text: Federal officials have fined Massey nearly US $900,000 after numerous safety violations were found at the mine that suffered the explosion.
target_text: 在遭遇爆炸的矿山发生多起安全违规事件后，联邦官员对梅西罚款近900,000美元。

source_text: US President Barack Obama held a prayer breakfast in the White House Tuesday morning.
target_text: 美国总统巴拉克・奥巴马周二早上在白宫举行了祈祷早餐会。

source_text: He said that "I would ask for the faithful who are gathered here to pray for the safe return of the missing, the men and women who put their lives on the line to save them and the souls that have been lost in this tragic accident."
target_text: 他说：“我请求聚集在这里的信徒们祈祷失踪人员的安全归来，那些冒着生命危险拯救他们的男男女女，以及在这场悲惨事故中失去的灵魂。”

source_text: "May they rest in peace, and may their families find comfort in the hard days ahead."
target_text: “愿他们安息吧，愿他们的家人在未来的艰难日子里找到安慰。”

source_text: The two dominant parties of Pakistan's National Assembly have united in a coalition to impeach President Pervez Musharraf.
target_text: 巴基斯坦国民议会的两个主要政党，联合起来弹劾总统佩尔韦兹·穆沙拉夫。

source_text: The decision was announced by party leaders Asif Ali Zardari, widower of former premier Benazir Bhutto, and Nawaz Sharif, with the parties aiming for a successful no-confidence vote against President Musharraf.
target_text: 两党领导人，身为前总理贝娜齐尔·布托鳏夫的阿西夫·阿里·扎尔达里与纳瓦兹·谢里夫宣布了这一决定，双方的目标是成功地对穆沙拉夫总统进行不信任投票。

source_text: The impeachment process is planned to start within the following week.
target_text: 弹劾程序计划在下一周内开始。

source_text: There have been concerns that an attempt at impeachment would result in a detrimental political battle in a country already facing political instability.
target_text: 有人担心，企图弹劾将会为已经面临政治不稳定的国家带来有害的政治斗争。

source_text: A senior member of a party allied with Musharraf stated that the impeachment would "open a Pandora's box" regarding Pakistan's future.
target_text: 与穆沙拉夫结盟的一个党的高级成员表示，弹劾将“打开关于巴基斯坦未来的潘多拉盒子”。

source_text: Musharraf has little support in the National Assembly, as most of his political allies were defeated in the February elections.
target_text: 由于穆沙拉夫的大多数政治盟友在今年2月的选举中被击败，他在巴基斯坦国民议会所能得到的支持很少。

source_text: If the coalition is successful, Musharraf will be the first president in Pakistan's sixty-one year history to have been impeached.
target_text: 如果联盟成功，穆沙拉夫将成为巴基斯坦六十一年历史上第一位被弹劾的总统。

source_text: Musharraf has canceled his trip to the Beijing Olympics so that he can focus on planning a response to the coalition.
target_text: 穆沙拉夫取消了他的北京奥运之旅，以便他可以集中精力策划对联盟的回应。

source_text: Other options Musharraf may explore include declaring a state of emergency, which could aid him in getting the support of the military, or dissolving parliament, though this would likely lead to political chaos.
target_text: 穆沙拉夫可能寻求的其他选择包括宣布国家进入紧急状态，这可能有助于他获得军方的支持，或者解散议会，尽管这可能会导致政治混乱。

source_text: Saturday, September 2nd, Wellington held a computer recycling day for free hosted by computer maker, Dell.
target_text: 9月2日，星期六，惠灵顿举行了由戴尔电脑公司主办的免费电脑回收日活动。

source_text: Now Auckland is looking to host one of their own.
target_text: 现在奥克兰正在寻找自己的主办方。

source_text: Instead of the equipment going to a landfill where it is unable to decompose and will leak chemicals into the ground, 97% of all equipment collected will be recycled.
target_text: 百分之97的收集到的设备将被回收，而不是被送往无法分解并将化学物质泄漏到地下的垃圾填埋场。

source_text: Susan McGregor, an Auckland City Council spokesperson, said: "There is a regional forum looking into waste disposal; but to date there is only a scheme for hazardous material to be collected separately by the council."
target_text: 奥克兰市议会发言人苏珊·麦格雷戈说：“有一个地区论坛正在研究垃圾处理，但到目前为止，只有一个方案，让理事会单独收集危险材料。”

source_text: "It [the council] would welcome computer companies taking some responsibility for disposing of old computer ware."
target_text: “它【理事会】会欢迎计算机公司承担处理旧电脑软件的责任。”

source_text: Dell has indicated it will hold another PC clean up next year.
target_text: 戴尔已表示将在明年再举行一次个人电脑清理工作。

source_text: According to Dell, out of the 6.3 million New Zealand computers, 250,000 of them are old and obsolete, mainly because most computer owners, according to a survey, will upgrade their computers every two to five years.
target_text: 据戴尔公司称，在新西兰的630万台电脑中，有25万台是旧的和过时的，主要是因为根据一项调查，大多数电脑用户每两到五年就会升级一次电脑。

source_text: Sydney, Australia had recently hosted one of their own computer recycling days; however Wellington's event was four times more successful.
target_text: 澳大利亚悉尼最近举办了一次自己的电脑回收日活动，但惠灵顿的活动更是大获成功。

source_text: Italian Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi is in San Raffaele Hospital overnight in Milan following an assault during an autograph session at the end of a rally.
target_text: 意大利总理西尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼在米兰的圣拉斐尔医院过夜，此前他在集会结束后的一次签名活动中遭到袭击。

source_text: Tartaglia was holding a replica of Milan's famous Domo Cathedral as he struck the premier; the composition of the replica is unknown, but eyewitnesses suggest it may have been made from marble, iron or another heavy material.
target_text: 塔尔塔利亚在袭击总理时，手里拿着米兰著名的多莫大教堂的复制品，该复制品的组成尚不清楚，但目击者表示，它可能是由大理石、铁或其他重材料制成的。

source_text: The assailant is currently in custody at a police station somewhere in Milan; police have confirmed he has no prior criminal record.
target_text: 袭击者目前在米兰的某个警察局被拘留，警方已证实他之前没有犯罪记录。

source_text: The attack on Berlusconi left him requiring treatment for damage to his mouth, a broken nose, cuts to his face and, according to reports from BBC News, at least two broken teeth.
target_text: 对贝卢斯科尼的袭击使他需要治疗，因为他的嘴巴受损，鼻子骨折，脸部受伤，据BBC新闻报道，至少有两颗牙齿断了。

source_text: This is not the only attack Berlusconi has received; several years ago a man hit him with a tripod, leaving him with a cut to his forehead.
target_text: 这不是贝卢斯科尼收到的唯一攻击，几年前，一名男子用三脚架击中他，让他的前额受伤。

source_text: More details have emerged over the weekend after the surprise announcement last week of Honda's intention to sell its Formula One racing team, Honda Racing F1.
target_text: 上周末，本田出人意料地宣布有意出售其一级方程式赛车车队本田F1，更多细节随之浮出水面。

source_text: The team management, Nick Fry and Ross Brawn, have already announced confidence in their ability not only to find a buyer for the team but also to deliver the performance expected of Honda's 2009 car.
target_text: 车队管理人员尼克·弗莱和罗斯·布朗已经宣布，他们不仅有能力为车队找到买家，而且有能力实现本田2009款汽车的预期业绩。

source_text: On Saturday the Japanese car giant said that before selling the team it was going to offer British driver Jensen Button, who had given the Honda team its only victory, a way out of his recently signed multi-million pound contract with the team so he could try to get a drive with other teams.
target_text: 上周六，这家日本汽车巨头表示，在出售车队之前，它将向英国车手詹森·巴顿提供一种摆脱他最近与车队签订的数百万英镑合同的方法，以便他能尝试与其他车队合作。

source_text: However, Ross Brawn appears eager to retain the Briton and either retain Brazilian Rubens Barrichello or sign GP2 driver Bruno Senna, nephew of legendary racer Ayrton Senna.
target_text: 然而，罗斯·布朗似乎渴望留住这位英国人，要么留住巴西人鲁本斯·巴里切罗，要么签下传奇车手埃尔顿·塞纳的侄子、GP2车手布鲁诺·塞纳。

source_text: At an industry awards dinner, Button indicated his desire for a buyer to be found for Honda, saying any buyer would get "... a great team with excellent facilities."
target_text: 在一次行业颁奖晚宴上，巴顿表示他希望本田能找到买主，他说任何买主都想得到“……一个拥有优秀设备的伟大团队”。

source_text: "And with the leadership of Ross Brawn, and the whole team as they are, we can come through this and be on the grid in 2009."
target_text: “在罗斯·布朗的领导下，在整个团队的帮助下，我们能够度过难关，并在2009年回到赛车起跑线。”

source_text: Ross Brawn, who was brought into the Honda team with much fan fare before the 2008 season, has spoken of his shock at finding out about the sale of the team.
target_text: 罗斯·布朗，在2008赛季前带着大量的球迷进入本田车队，他谈到了他在得知球队的销售情况时的震惊。

source_text: Brawn, who is credited with helping Michael Schumacher and Ferrari dominate Formula One for much of the last decade, indicated he was expected funding cuts and had prepared a reduced budget but hadn't expected the full withdrawal of support that Honda announced.
target_text: 布朗在过去十年的大部分时间里帮助舒马赫和法拉利称霸一级方程式。他表示，他预计会削减资金，并已准备好削减预算，但没想到本田宣布的全面撤回支持。

source_text: Brawn has also indicated understanding of Honda's reasoning, with their sales down 40% in some markets and Honda F1's £200m+ budget a cost they were unwilling to bear.
target_text: 布朗还表示理解本田的理由，他们在一些市场的销售额下降了百分之40，本田F1的2亿英镑以上的预算是他们不愿承担的成本。

source_text: Though Honda has committed to providing a budget for the team until March, the budget is lower than that which had been expected and so the team has had to pull out of the crucial winter tests at Jerez.
target_text: 尽管本田已承诺在3月份之前为球队提供预算，但预算低于预期，因此球队不得不退出赫雷斯的关键冬季测试。

source_text: This has denied Formula One hopeful Bruno Senna another test with the team and has combined with the engine implications of Honda's withdrawal to push the new car's final testing from January to March, just weeks before the first Grand Prix in Australia.
target_text: 这使得F1车手布鲁诺·塞纳无法再参加车队的另一场测试，并与本田退出比赛对发动机的影响相结合，将这款新车的最后测试时间从1月推迟至3月，而此时距离澳大利亚的首届大奖赛只有几周时间。

source_text: Ross Brawn however remains confident of competing with new Formula One frontrunners BMW Sauber and Formula One supremo Bernie Ecclestone has tipped the team as a great buy, saying "I've no doubt Honda would have been in top four next year without any problems."
target_text: 然而，罗斯·布朗仍然有信心与新的一级方程式车手宝马索伯和一级方程式车手伯尼·埃克莱斯顿竞争，他说：“毫无疑问，本田明年将毫无问题地跻身前四。”

source_text: "They've spent a lot of money to put themselves in that position so if anyone does want to be in F1 this is a team they should look to buy."
target_text: “他们花了很多钱让自己处于这个位置，所以如果有人想进入F1，那么他们就应该购买一支球队。”

source_text: "It's a big opportunity for any company that's run efficiently to benefit."
target_text: “对于任何一家高效运营的公司来说，这都是一个巨大的获益机会。”

source_text: Two activists who helped identify a vagrant Genetically Modified (GM) crop of papaya, which was later confirmed and destroyed by Thai officials, now face prison over their actions, says Greenpeace.
target_text: 绿色和平组织说，两名活动家帮助确认了一种经过基因改造的木瓜，后来泰国官员确认并销毁了该木瓜。现在，这两名活动家将因他们的行为面临牢狱之灾。

source_text: They were charged with theft, trespassing and destruction of property.
target_text: 他们被控盗窃、非法侵入和破坏财产。

source_text: Instead of getting to the bottom of who precisely was responsible for the contamination, the very department that was responsible for the contamination decided to take legal action against Pat and Jay.
target_text: 需对该基因污染负责的部门决定对帕特和杰伊采取法律行动，而不是深究谁才应该对污染负责。

source_text: UN Secretary General Kofi Annan will formally present a plan this morning to the UN General Assembly when it meets in New York later today.
target_text: 联合国秘书长科菲·安南将于今天晚些时候在纽约会晤时向联合国大会正式提出一项计划。

source_text: The plan, entitled In Larger Freedom, is part of the UN's attempt to revitalise itself during its sixtieth anniversary year.
target_text: 这项名为“更大自由”的计划，是联合国在其成立60周年之际重振自身的努力的一部分。

source_text: The Canadian ambassador to the UN, Allan Rock, was the first diplomat to officially respond by saying, "A lot of hard work lies ahead but we are optimistic."
target_text: 加拿大驻联合国大使艾伦·洛克是第一位正式回应的外交官，他说：“未来还有很多艰苦的工作，但我们很乐观。”

source_text: Oxfam, Amnesty International, and other NGOs, have come out in support of the plan.
target_text: 乐施会、大赦国际和其他非政府组织都支持这项计划。

source_text: Nick Clarke, the UK radio broadcaster, died today from cancer at the age of 58.
target_text: 英国无线电广播播音员尼克・克拉克今天因癌症去世，享年58岁。

source_text: He had worked for the BBC for over 20 years, and won the Broadcasting Press Guild Broadcaster of the year award in 2001, but was best known for presenting the Radio 4 news show, The World at One.
target_text: 他为英国广播公司工作了20多年，并于2001年获得广播记者协会的年度播音员奖，但他最出名的是主持了Radio4的新闻节目《世界在一起》（the World at One）。

source_text: The Israeli Defence Forces have carried out 5 to 8 air strikes targeting the office of the Palestinian interior ministry's headquarters occupied by the governing party Hamas in Gaza and an office of President Mahmoud Abbas's Fatah party in Gaza, Palestinian and Israeli sources say.
target_text: 巴勒斯坦和以色列消息人士称，以色列国防军对加沙执政党哈马斯占领的巴勒斯坦内政部总部办公室以及加沙总统马哈茂德・阿巴斯的法塔赫政党办公室进行了5至8次空袭。

source_text: There were mixed reports of casualties from the air strike, although one source said a member of Islamic Jihad had been killed in the air strikes.
target_text: 有关空袭造成伤亡的报导内容不一，不过有消息说，一名伊斯兰圣战组织成员在空袭中丧生。

source_text: In addition, an Israeli official stated to the Associated Press that the attacks will only end when the captured Israeli soldier is unconditionally freed.
target_text: 此外，一名以色列官员向美联社表示，袭击只会在被捕的以色列士兵无条件释放后才能结束。

source_text: Days after the initial raid reports from Israeli officials stated that they had found the body of 18-year-old Eliyahu Yitzhak Asheri who was kidnapped by the Palestinian ruling party, Hamas, and shot in the back of the head on Sunday.
target_text: 几天后来自以色列官员的最初突袭报告说，他们发现了18岁的艾莉亚胡·伊扎克·阿什里的尸体，他被巴勒斯坦执政党哈马斯绑架，并在周日被射中头后部而亡。

source_text: In his first appearance since the raid began, Palestinian PM and leader of the Hamas organization, Ismail Haniya denounced the raid saying it was a "premeditated plan" to bring down the new Hamas government.
target_text: 自突袭开始以来，巴勒斯坦总理和哈马斯组织领导人伊斯梅尔・哈尼亚首次亮相，谴责这次突袭行动称，这是打击新哈马斯政府的“预谋计划”。

source_text: A significant portion of the American LGBT media landscape is about to become a conglomerate.
target_text: 美国LGBT媒体领域的很大一部分即将成为一个集团。

source_text: (PlanetOut.com, Gay.com) sent out a press release stating it signed a definitive merger agreement with Here Networks LLC (operator of cable network here!) and Regent Entertainment Media Inc. (properties including magazines The Advocate, Out).
target_text: （PlanetOut.com，Gay.com）发布了一份新闻稿，声称它与Here Networks LLC（有线网络的运营商在这里！）和Regent Entertainment Media Inc.（包括杂志The Advocate，Out的所有权）签署了最终的合并协议。

source_text: The company sold its magazine and book publishing businesses back in April, and its vacation company in December.
target_text: 该公司于4月份出售其杂志和图书出版业务，并于12月份出售其度假公司。

source_text: The newly formed public holding company, Here Media Inc., will be helmed by Chairman Stephen P. Jarchow and CEO Paul Colichman.
target_text: 新成立的上市控股公司Here Media Inc.将由董事长斯蒂芬 P･贾科夫和首席执行长保罗･科利奇曼执掌。

source_text: Its unknown whether any of struggling PlanetOut's jobs will be cut.
target_text: 目前尚不清楚陷于困境的PlanetOut是否会裁员。

source_text: Plans are for all three companies to operate separately, as of subsidiaries of Here Media.
target_text: 三家公司计划分别运营，就像Here Media的子公司一样。

source_text: The agreement still has to be approved by a majority of PlanetOut common stock holders, comply with regulatory filings and approvals, and meet various closing conditions.
target_text: 该协议仍需得到大多数PlanetOut普通股持有人的批准，遵守监管备案和批准，并满足各种成交条件。

source_text: PlanetOut shareholders will represent only 20% of Here Media Inc.'s shares.
target_text: PlanetOut股东仅占Here Media Inc.股份的百分之20。

source_text: A report by the International Water Management Institute (IWMI) says rising demand for irrigation to produce food and biofuels will aggravate scarcities of water.
target_text: 国际水资源管理研究所（IWMI）的一份报告称，用于生产食品和生物燃料的灌溉需求不断增加将加剧水的稀缺。

source_text: One in three people is enduring one form or another of water scarcity, states the report compiled by 700 experts.
target_text: 这份由700名专家撰写的报告指出，三分之一的人正遭受着某种形式的水资源短缺。

source_text: IWMI warns there has to be a radical transformation in the management of water resources - citing as examples Australia, south-central China, and last year’s devastating drought in India.
target_text: 国际水资源管理研究所警告说，必须对水资源管理进行彻底的改革，例如澳大利亚、中国中南部和印度去年发生的灾难性干旱。

source_text: Report authors claim that the price of water could double or triple over the next two decades.
target_text: 报告作者声称，未来二十年水价可能会翻倍或翻三倍。

source_text: The report, backed by the United Nations and farm research groups, shows that globally, water usage had increased by six times in the past 100 years and would double again by 2050 - driven mainly by irrigation and demands by agriculture.
target_text: 这份由联合国和农业研究小组支持的报告显示，在全球范围内，过去100年的用水量增加了6倍，到2050年将再翻一番-主要是由灌溉和农业需求推动的。

source_text: Record oil prices and concerns about rapid onset climate change are driving more countries to produce biofuels - from sugarcane, corn or wood - as an alternative to fossil fuel.
target_text: 创纪录的油价以及对气候快速变化的担忧正促使更多国家生产生物燃料-来源自甘蔗、玉米或木材-作为化石燃料的替代品。

source_text: If people are growing biofuels and food it will put another new stress, says David Molden, who led the study at the Sri Lanka-based IWMI.
target_text: 在总部位于斯里兰卡的IWMI，领导这项研究的大卫・莫尔登说，如果人们在种植生物燃料和食物，就会产生另一种新的压力。

source_text: The big solution is to find ways to grow more food with less water.
target_text: 最大的解决方案是找到用更少的水来种植更多食物的方法。

source_text: " The number one recommendation... is to look to improve rain-fed systems in Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia."
target_text: “排名第一的建议是改善撒哈拉以南非洲和南亚的雨水灌溉系统。”

source_text: The report says conquering hunger and coping with an estimated 3 billion more humans by 2050 will result in an 80 percent increase in water use for agriculture.
target_text: 报告说，到2050年，战胜饥饿和解决大约30亿多人口的问题将导致农业用水增加百分之80。

source_text: Irrigation absorbs around 74 percent and is likely to surge by 2050.
target_text: 灌溉吸收率约为百分之74，并可能在2050年前激增。

source_text: We will have to change business as usual in order to deal with growing scarcity, said Frank Rijsberman, director general of the IWMI, of the report released at the 2006 "World Water Week" conference in Stockholm.
target_text: 在斯德哥尔摩举行的2006年“世界水周”会议上发布的报告中，国际水资源管理研究所所长弗兰克·里兹伯曼表示，我们将不得不改变传统的作业方式，以应对日益严重的水资源短缺。

source_text: Solutions included helping poor countries to grow more food with available fresh water via simple, low-cost measures, a shift from past policies that favoured expensive dams or canals, the report said.
target_text: 报告称，解决方案包括通过简单、低成本的措施，帮助贫穷国家利用可用的淡水种植更多的粮食，改变过去青睐昂贵水坝或运河的政策。

source_text: According to Rijsberman, there are two types of shortages: those observed in regions where water is over-exploited, causing a lowering of groundwater levels and rivers to dry up; and those in countries lacking the technical and financial resources to capture water - despite its abundance.
target_text: 根据里兹伯曼的说法，有两种类型的水资源短缺：一种是在水资源过度开发的地区，导致地下水水位下降，河流干涸，以及那些缺乏技术和财政资源来捕获水资源的国家，尽管它们很丰富。

source_text: We will not run out of bottled water any time soon, but some countries have already run out of water to produce their own food, he said.
target_text: 他说：“我们的瓶装水不会很快用完，但是一些国家已经没有水来生产他们自己的食品了。”

source_text: The report said that a calorie of food took roughly 1 litre of water to produce, with a kilo of grain needing only 500-4,000 litres compared to a kilo of industrially produced meat taking 10,000 litres.
target_text: 报告称，一卡路里的食物大约需要1升水来生产，一公斤谷物只需要500到4000升水，而一公斤工业生产的肉类则需要1万升水。

source_text: Without improvements in water productivity the consequences of this will be even more widespread water scarcity and rapidly increasing water prices.
target_text: 如果不提高水的生产力，其后果将是更广泛的缺水和迅速上涨的水价。

source_text: Rijsberman said water scarcity in Africa was caused by a lack of infrastructure to get the water to the people who needed it.
target_text: 里兹伯曼说，非洲的水资源短缺是由于缺乏基础设施来向需要水的人们提供水。

source_text: The water is there, the rainfall is there, but the infrastructure isn't there, Rijsberman told reporters.
target_text: 里兹伯曼告诉记者，那里有水，有雨水，但是没有基础设施。

source_text: Other recommendations for certain regions include the extension and the improvement of agriculture using rainwater, the introduction of cereal varieties that need less water as well as the development of irrigation systems.
target_text: 对某些地区的其他建议包括利用雨水扩大和改善农业，引进需要更少水的谷物品种以及灌溉系统的发展。

source_text: But the priority, Rijsberman stresses, is to change mentalities and often outdated government policies.
target_text: 但里兹伯曼强调，当务之急是改变人们的心态和往往过时的政府政策。

source_text: Government policies and their approach to water are probably the most urgent that need changing in the short term, he said.
target_text: 他说，政府政策及其对水的处理可能是短期内需要改变的最紧迫的政策。

source_text: There is, he says, enough land, water and human capacity to produce enough food for a growing population over the next 50 years, but one of the challenges is to provide enough water for agriculture without damaging the environment.
target_text: 他说，在未来50年里，有足够的土地，水和人类能力为不断增长的人口生产足够的粮食，但其中一个挑战是为农业提供足够的水而不破坏环境。

source_text: Agriculture is driving water scarcity and water scarcity is driving environmental degradation and destruction, he said.
target_text: 他说，农业正在推动水资源短缺，水资源短缺正在推动环境恶化和破坏。

source_text: In Australia last week, Rijsberman said he would "not be surprised to see the price of water double or triple over the next two decades."
target_text: 上周在澳大利亚，里兹伯曼说，他“对未来20年水价上涨一倍或两倍不会感到惊讶”。

source_text: The finger, which probably belonged to a woman as it had a long and manicured fingernail, did not belong to any of the restaurant employees.
target_text: 手指不是任何餐厅员工的，可能是某个女性的，因为它有修长而且修剪整齐的指甲。

source_text: The food supplies were seized by officials to be traced back to its manufacturers, while the restaurant was permitted to open again later with chili prepared from fresh ingredients.
target_text: 食品供应被官员查封，追溯至生产厂家。随后，这家餐厅获准重新开业，供应用新鲜配料烹制的辣椒。

source_text: He was a member of the Royal Military Police, and was killed while on foot patrol in the Helmand province, close to the Gereshk district in Southern Afghanistan.
target_text: 他是皇家宪兵的一员，在阿富汗南部靠近格雷斯克地区的赫尔曼德省徒步巡逻时被打死。

source_text: The cause of death has been reported to be an explosion, but the source is unclear.
target_text: 据报道，死亡原因是爆炸，但消息来源尚不清楚。

source_text: It is my sad duty to confirm the death of a soldier, a Royal Military Policeman, in an explosion earlier today in Helmand Province, Lieutenant Colonel David Wakefield said of the incident.
target_text: 今天早些时候在赫尔曼德省发生爆炸事件，确认一名士兵，一名皇家军警死亡，这是我的遗憾，大卫・韦克菲尔德中校说。

source_text: He died doing his duty and we will remember him.
target_text: 他为履行职责而死，我们将缅怀他。

source_text: Former Australian Prime Minister John Howard supported the launch of a new book "How to Get Expelled from School: A Guide to Climate Change for Pupils, Pundits and Parents", authored by geology professor .
target_text: 澳大利亚前总理约翰·霍华德支持由地质学教授撰写的新书《如何被学校开除：学生、专家和家长应对气候变化指南》的发行。

source_text: The book includes 101 questions for students to use to challenge their climate science teachers.
target_text: 这本书包括101个问题，供学生用来挑战他们的气候科学教师。
