source_text: Professor Plimer said the previous book received feedback from parents concerned about education.
target_text: 普利默教授说，上一本书从关心教育的家长那里得到了反馈。

source_text: This prompted him to address the next book to children.
target_text: 这促使他向孩子们讲下一本书。

source_text: He said, "After Heaven and Earth came out I had many parents write to me and say, 'Look, what do we do, our kids are being fed activism."
target_text: 他说：“天地出来后，我有很多家长写信告诉我，看，我们做了什么，我们的孩子正在接受激进主义。”

source_text: "I want my children to have the basics of scientists, I don't want to be fed activism'."
target_text: “我希望我的孩子拥有科学家的基本知识，我不想被灌输激进主义思想。”

source_text: He says he considered it feasible if the rest of the world acted too, otherwise to introduce carbon trading plans would risk Australian industries.
target_text: 他表示，如果世界其他国家也采取行动，他认为这是可行的，否则引入碳交易计划会给澳大利亚工业带来风险。

source_text: What science teachers do, she said, "is put all of the facts, pro and con, against any topic, whatever it is, and show the children how to work through the evidence".
target_text: 她说，科学教师所做的，“是把所有的事实，无论是正面的还是负面的，与任何话题，无论它是什么，放在一起，向孩子们展示如何利用这些证据”。

source_text: Professor Plimer said of the 101 questions in his book, "They're questions that kids should be asking of teachers, because if the teacher can answer it means they might know something about the subject."
target_text: 普利默教授在他的书中提到了101个问题，“他们是孩子应该问老师的问题，因为如果老师能够回答这个问题，就意味着他们可能会对这个问题有所了解。”

source_text: "If they can't, or start to promote ideology, it shows that our schools have been captured."
target_text: “如果他们不能，或者开始宣扬意识形态，那就说明我们的学校已经被占领了。”

source_text: "Parents are telling me that schools have been captured by a lot of activists and kids are being fed stuff that is not relevant to the real world."
target_text: “家长们告诉我，很多活动人士占领了学校，孩子们正在汲取与现实世界无关的东西。”

source_text: At the recently held 22nd ICANN International Conference in Mar del Plata, Argentina, the ICANN (Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers), officially designated three new top level domain names: .jobs and .travel and .eu.
target_text: 最近在阿根廷马德普拉塔召开的第22届ICANN国际会议上，ICANN（互联网名称与数字地址分配机构）正式指定了三个新的顶级域名：.jobs和.travel以及.eu。

source_text: .jobs was created for the use of personnel businesses, .travel for the travel industry, and .eu will be used by organizations based in the European Union.
target_text: .jobs是为人事业务而创建的，.travel是为旅游业而创建的，.eu将由欧盟的组织使用。

source_text: ICANN has also entered into negotiations with registries for .cat, .post and .mobi domains.
target_text: ICANN还与.cat，.post和.mobi域名的注册管理机构进行了谈判。

source_text: The ICANN, established by the U.S. Department of Commerce in 1998, is a non-profit corporation responsible for the technical coordination of the Internet through the assignment of domain names and IP addresses.
target_text: ICANN于1998年由美国商务部设立，是一家非盈利性公司，负责通过域名和IP地址的分配来对互联网进行技术协调。

source_text: The People's Republic of China has banned free plastic shopping bags in a move to take effect from June 1, 2008.
target_text: 中华人民共和国已禁止免费塑料购物袋从2008年6月1日起生效。

source_text: The decision made by the Chinese Cabinet, the State Council, is intended to reduce the amount of plastic bags used in China, currently being estimated at three billion per day.
target_text: 中国国务院的这一决定旨在减少中国的塑料袋使用量，目前估计中国每天使用的塑料袋数量为30亿个。

source_text: The State Council also announced that at the same time as the ban, the manufacturing, sale and even use of very thin plastic bags, which are defined as being under 0.025mm thick, will be banned.
target_text: 国务院还宣布，与禁令同时，将禁止生产、销售甚至使用厚度小于0.025毫米的超薄塑料袋。

source_text: Any company that does not follow this ban can be fined.
target_text: 任何不遵守此禁令的公司都可能被罚款。

source_text: The ban of free plastic bags and complete ban on very thin bags will, the government hopes, help reduce the amount of crude oil used for plastic packaging, which is currently at five million tonnes per year according to Times Online.
target_text: 政府希望，禁止免费塑料袋和完全禁止超薄塑料袋的禁令，将有助于减少塑料包装使用的原油量。据《泰晤士报》网站报道，目前塑料包装使用的原油量为每年500万吨。

source_text: The notice issued by the Chinese government said: "We should encourage people to return to carrying cloth bags, using baskets for their vegetables."
target_text: 中国政府发布的通知说：“我们应该鼓励人们重新拿起布袋，用篮子装蔬菜。”

source_text: The People's Republic of China is not the first country to ban or restrict plastic shopping bags and the notice names Uganda and South Africa according to CNN.
target_text: 据CNN报道，中华人民共和国并不是第一个禁止或限制塑料购物袋的国家，这份通知提到了乌干达和南非。

source_text: Many supermarkets in the European Union have voluntarily adopted methods to reduce usage of plastic bags, which often also consist of charging for bags (e.g. Germany) or rewarding customer loyalty points for returning used carrier bags.
target_text: 欧盟的许多超市都主动采取了减少塑料袋使用的方法，通常还包括对塑料袋收费（如德国）或对顾客退还使用过的塑料袋进行积分奖励。

source_text: Still, many of the world's leading polluting countries, including the United States of America, have not yet introduced any legislation intended to reduce the usage of plastic bags.
target_text: 尽管如此，包括美利坚合众国在内的世界上许多污染严重的国家尚未制定任何旨在减少塑料袋使用的立法。

source_text: The United States Environmental Protection Agency claimed that in 2000 only 1% of plastic bags in the United States were recycled.
target_text: 美国环境保护局声称，2000年美国只有百分之1的塑料袋被回收利用。

source_text: The People's Republic of China has attracted a lot of attention in the past for having possibly the highest greenhouse emissions in the world, disproportionate to the size of its economy, according to The Telegraph.
target_text: 据《每日电讯报》报道，过去，中华人民共和国因其温室气体排放量可能是世界上最高的，与经济规模不成比例而备受关注。

source_text: Times Online quoted a Chinese activist as saying that plastic bags are not the main problem and the government needed to make people care more about the environment.
target_text: 《泰晤士报》在线援引一位中国活动家的话说，塑料袋不是主要问题，政府需要让人们更加关注环境。

source_text: On March 18, President Kevin Baugh of the Republic of Molossia, a micronation located in Nevada, announced that his country would hold its first ever international summit this June.
target_text: 3月18日，位于内华达州的微型国家摩洛西亚共和国总统凯文·鲍夫宣布，该国将于今年6月举行首次国际峰会。

source_text: Grand Prince Christopher I and Princess Erin of the Principality of Vikesland, another micronation located in Canada, will be attending.
target_text: 位于加拿大的另一个微型国家威克什兰公国的大王子克里斯托弗一世和公主艾琳也将出席。

source_text: Besides the meeting itself, which is scheduled to take place in Molossia's capital city, Espera, President Baugh is to give them a tour of his country as well as the surrounding areas.

source_text: Bill Clinton, the former President of the United States of America, will make a visit to Romania on May 21, to participate as the keynote speaker at the BeyondBorders 2005 conference in Bucharest.
target_text: 美利坚合众国前总统比尔・克林顿将作为2005年Beyond Borders（超越国界）布加勒斯特会议的主旨发言人于5月21日访问罗马尼亚。

source_text: The conference will have the theme of "Branding a Country: Building a Reputation from Within" and is the inaugural BeyondBorders conference launched by the Brand Academy, the first Romanian institution dedicated to brand education.
target_text: 会议的主题是“打造一个国家：从内部建立声誉”，这是由品牌学院推出的首届BeyondBorders会议，这是罗马尼亚第一家致力于品牌教育的机构。

source_text: Clinton's previous visit to Romania was July 11, 1997, when he visited the country to promote political and military integration around the time of the NATO Summit.
target_text: 克林顿上次访问罗马尼亚是在1997年7月11日访问该国，以促进北约峰会期间的政治和军事一体化。

source_text: He was the first US president to visit Romania since the Romanian Revolution of 1989 that overthrew the Communist regime.
target_text: 自1989年罗马尼亚革命推翻共产党政权以来，他是第一位访问罗马尼亚的美国总统。

source_text: The BeyondBorders 2005 conference will focus on strategies to brand Romania and promote it to the world.
target_text: BeyondBorders2005年会议将重点讨论罗马尼亚的品牌战略，并向世界推广罗马尼亚。

source_text: In recent years, Romania has realised the need for branding and for improving its image in the world in order to fuel prosperity.
target_text: 近年来，罗马尼亚已经认识到，为了促进繁荣，必须树立品牌，改善其在世界上的形象。

source_text: Branding would focus on building a reputation a positive reputation for the country abroad and emphasising its authentic values.
target_text: 品牌建设的重点是建立声誉，为国家的在海外树立良好声誉，并强调其真实价值。

source_text: The conference organisers hope that it will act as a springboard for an integrated national branding project for Romania.
target_text: 会议组织者希望它能成为罗马尼亚国家品牌整合项目的跳板。

source_text: Australian Capital Territory — Thousands of Canberrans took a look at the new Cotter Dam on the Cotter River on open day on Sunday.
target_text: 澳大利亚首都领地——周日的开放日，数千名堪培拉人参观了位于科特河上的新科特大坝。

source_text: The public was given limited access to the still-active construction site.
target_text: 公众只能有限地进入仍然在建的建筑工地。

source_text: Buses took viewers from the car park below to top of the dam wall.

source_text: They ran every 15 minutes from 8:30 am to 4:00 pm.

source_text: The dam is to supply fresh water to the city of Canberra.
target_text: 大坝将为堪培拉市供应淡水。

source_text: This is to provide water security for the city as droughts become more frequent due to global warming.
target_text: 这是为了提供城市的水安全，因为全球变暖导致干旱变得更加频繁。

source_text: It is a gravity dam, which holds back the waters through sheer mass.
target_text: 它是一个重力坝，通过绝对质量阻挡水域。

source_text: In addition to the main dam, there are two saddle dams filling depressions in the landscape so flood waters flow over the spillway and not out the sides of the lake.
target_text: 除了主坝，还有两座鞍状大坝填满了洼地，这样洪水就会流经溢洪道，而不会从湖岸流出。

source_text: The dam on the Cotter River has been under construction for four years.
target_text: 科特河上的大坝已建了四年。

source_text: These are to be replanted to replace the native flora.
target_text: 这些植物将被重新种植以取代当地的植物群。

source_text: The dam replaces an old dam, first built in 1911 but subsequently expanded several times.
target_text: 这座大坝取代了一座建于1911年但后来扩建了好几次的旧大坝。

source_text: Now heritage listed, it has been submerged by the waters of the new dam.
target_text: 现在列入遗产，它已被新大坝的水域淹没。

source_text: Some materials were salvaged from the old dam to build the new, and some have been put on display.
target_text: 一些材料是从旧坝上打捞来的用来建造新大坝，有些已经展出。

source_text: The river is named after Garrett Cotter, an Irish-born convict who was transported to Australia and lived in the area in the 1830s and 1840s.

target_text: 大约600名愤怒的苏丹抗议者，其中一些人手持刀具和棍棒，在周五要求判处吉莉安·吉本斯死刑进行的祈祷结束后，聚集在喀土穆的烈士广场。吉本斯是英国一名教师，因允许班上7岁的孩子给一只泰迪熊取名穆罕默德而于昨日入狱。穆罕默德是阿拉伯世界最常见的名字之一。

target_text: 他去世的消息通过澳大利亚税务局和澳大利亚残奥委员会的托尼·纳尔与维基新闻分享。

source_text: French, who lived in Penrith, New South Wales, was one of fifteen athletes to compete at Australia's second Paralympic Games in 1964 in Tokyo when he won a silver medal in the men's 25 metre freestyle event.
target_text: 这位住在新南威尔士州彭里斯的法国人参加了参加了1964年在东京举办的残奥会的，他是澳大利亚第二次派队参加的十五名运动员之一，当时他在男子25米自由泳比赛中获得银牌。

source_text: It was the only medal he earned at the Games and one of 30 Australia earned that year.
target_text: 这是他在奥运会上获得的唯一一枚奖牌，也是当年澳大利亚赢得的30个奖牌之一。

source_text: His legacy of participation can be seen in the upcoming 2012 Summer Paralympics in London.
target_text: 在即将到来的2012年伦敦夏季残奥会上，我们可以看到他参与残奥会的精神。

source_text: Australia are sending 161 athletes to the Paralympics this year.
target_text: 澳大利亚今年将向残奥会派遣161名运动员。

source_text: The Paralympic team is expected to finish the Games having earned the country's one thousandth medal.
target_text: 残奥会代表团有望在该届奥运会上为该国获得第一千枚奖牌。

source_text: An 11-year-old boy has died after being shot in the car park of the Fir Tree pub in the Croxteth area of Liverpool, shortly after 1930 BST.
target_text: 1930年BST后不久，一名11岁的男孩在利物浦克罗克泰斯地区的冷杉树酒吧停车场被枪杀后死亡。

source_text: An eyewitness, who had been drinking outside the pub at the time, said the boy was one of three playing football in the car park when a teenager, believed to be male, on a BMX bicycle fired three shots at the group from approximately 30 metres away, one hitting the victim in the neck.
target_text: 当时在酒吧外喝酒的一名目击者说，男孩是在停车场踢足球的三个人之一，当时一名少年，据信是男性，骑着BMX自行车，从大约30米远的地方向人群开了三枪，其中一枪击中了受害者的脖子。

source_text: The other shots missed the boys, one hitting a car.
target_text: 其他的子弹没有击中男孩们，其中一个击中了一辆汽车。

source_text: The boy's mother was called to the scene as people came out of the pub to help him.
target_text: 当人们从酒吧出来帮助他时，男孩的母亲被叫到现场。

source_text: A spokesman for North West Ambulance Service said: "We treated an 11-year-old with serious gunshot wounds."
target_text: 西北急救中心的一位发言人说：“我们治疗了一名11岁的严重枪伤儿童。”

source_text: He added the boy was taken to Alder Hey Children's Hospital, but police later confirmed he had died.
target_text: 他补充说，这名男孩被带到Alder Hey儿童医院，但警方后来证实他已经死亡。

source_text: Officers have sealed off the scene, including a neighbouring street of shops.
target_text: 警员封锁了现场，包括邻近的商店街。

source_text: There have currently been no arrests in connection with the shooting.
target_text: 目前还没有人因枪击事件被捕。

source_text: In an appeal to the local community to help catch the killer, Merseyside Police Assistant Chief Constable Simon Byrne said: "Someone out there knows who put the gun in his hand and I want your help to get the community to turn that gunman in tonight."
target_text: 默西塞德郡警察局助理局长西蒙·伯恩呼吁当地社区帮助抓捕凶手，他说：“有人知道是谁把枪放在他手里的，我希望你能帮助社区在今晚将凶手绳之以法。”

source_text: "This is quite an awful crime, quite senseless, and the community holds the clue to solving this crime quickly."
target_text: “这是非常可怕的罪行，非常愚蠢，社区掌握了迅速解决这一罪行的线索。”

source_text: "You can only imagine the heartache of the family that's been ripped apart."
target_text: “你只能想象家人被夺走的心痛。”

source_text: Local councillor Rose Bailey, who lives nearby, also appealed for people with information to come forward, saying: "It sends shockwaves through the community of Croxteth and really it must be devastating."
target_text: 住在附近的地方议员罗斯贝利也呼吁有线索的人站出来，她说：“这给克罗克泰斯社区带来了冲击，这肯定是毁灭性的。”

source_text: "To think your young son is out playing football and then to get a call to say he's been shot, I really don't know as a parent how you would handle that."
target_text: “想到你年幼的儿子在外面踢足球，然后接到电话说他中枪了，我真的不知道作为一个家长，你会怎么处理这件事。”

source_text: Today the New Zealand Finance Minister, Hon. Dr Michael Cullen, presented the 2006 New Zealand Budget to the House of Representatives.
target_text: 今天，新西兰财政部长迈克尔·卡伦博士向众议院提交了2006年新西兰预算。

source_text: There is a NZ$8.5 billion OBERAC surplus and a NZ$1.5 billion cash surplus.
target_text: OBERAC盈余为85亿新西兰元，现金盈余为15亿新西兰元。

source_text: It has been labelled as the "Bondi Budget" by National leader Don Brash, "Helen Clark and Michael Cullen believe there is a place for tax cuts - it's called Australia" he said.
target_text: 国家领导人唐纳德·布拉什将其称为“邦迪预算”，他说：“海伦·克拉克和迈克尔·卡伦认为有一个地方可以减税，那就是澳大利亚。”

source_text: West Indies have beaten England by 15 runs in the first Twenty20 international of their tour of England at The Oval, London, England.
target_text: 西印度群岛在伦敦椭圆球场以15分的优势击败了英格兰队，这是西印度群岛首次派对参加在英国举办的国际性二十20比赛。

source_text: The West Indian innings started off badly by losing Gayle early, however they turned their fortunes around with some attacking and aggressive cricket and posted a huge total of 208.
target_text: 攻方西印度群岛的击球局一开始就很糟糕并且盖尔被罚出局，然而他们在打出了一些攻击性和侵略性的比赛后扭转了他们的命运，总共得了208分。

source_text: A bigger total could have been posted if it had not been for a late innings batting collapse.
target_text: 如果不是因为最后的击球局失利，这个总分可能会更高。

source_text: England started their reply by getting off to a flyer, but lost some early wickets that slowed down the run-rate.
target_text: 英格兰队开始以飞击进行反击，但由于过早错失了几次三柱门，以致减慢了得分的节奏。

source_text: Leading the charge was Paul Collingwood with a fast 79 with 5 4's and 4 6's.
target_text: 在比赛中冲锋陷阵的是保罗·柯林伍德，以54's and 46's的速度快速得了79分。

source_text: Had they not have lost the early wickets, England would have probably won the match to take a 1-0 lead in the series.
target_text: 要不是他们错失了早先的几次三柱门，英格兰很可能会赢得这场比赛，在系列赛中以1-0领先。

source_text: Instead, it is West Indies that have taken a 1-0 lead in the series.
target_text: 相反，西印度群岛在系列赛中以1-0领先。

source_text: An Australian air safety group claims that Yogyakarta International Airport was opearating illegally with no license when Garuda Indonesia Flight 200, a Boeing 737, crashed at the airport, killing 16 Indonesians and five Australians.
target_text: 一家澳大利亚航空安全组织声称日惹国际机场在没有执照的情况下非法操作，当时印尼鹰航飞机公司的一架波音737飞机在机场坠毁，导致16名印度尼西亚人和5名澳大利亚人丧生。

source_text: Flight Safety Pty Ltd had been asked to carry out an independent investigation by an anonymous client after the March 2007 disaster, which occurred when the aircraft landed at excessive speed and shot off the end of the runway.
target_text: 2007年3月飞机超速降落并冲出跑道尽头的灾难发生后，一位匿名客户要求飞行安全有限公司进行独立调查。

source_text: Flight Safety has now announced that they have found Yogyakarta International had been granted a five year license but this would be withdrawn after twelve months if several conditions were not met.
target_text: 飞行安全部门现在宣布，他们发现日惹国际机场已经获得了5年的执照，但如果有几个条件不满足，12个月后，执照将被吊销。

source_text: Since these conditions remained unchanged, the license effectively voided six months before the disaster, claim Flight Safety.
target_text: 飞行安全公司称，由于这些条件保持不变，许可证在灾难发生前六个月实际上无效。

source_text: One of the conditions was extension of the runway and provision of an adequate Runway End Safety Area (RESA).
target_text: 其中一个条件是延长跑道并提供足够的跑道末端安全区（RESA）。

source_text: The group adds that it also conducted checks on Solo International Airport and Semarang International Airport, and that these airports also had invalid Airport Operating Certificates.
target_text: 该集团还对梭罗国际机场和三宝国际机场进行了检查，发现这些机场的运营证明无效。

source_text: The final report was not released at the time as the client in question felt it 'too sensitive', and Flight Safety says that it was rapidly covered up three months later when it leaked in Indonesia.
target_text: 最终报告当时没有公布，因为客户觉得报告“过于敏感”。飞行安全部门说，三个月后，报告在印尼泄露，很快就被掩盖了起来。

source_text: The group says it notified the International Civil Aviation Organisation (ICAO), and that they in turn said the Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB) - who assisted in the crash investigation - was in control of the situation.
target_text: 该组织表示，已通知国际民用航空组织（ICAO），并表示澳大利亚交通安全局（ATSB）控制了局面。

source_text: However, Flight Safety claim that when approached, the ATSB denied knowing about it.
target_text: 然而，飞行安全声明称，当接近时，ATSB否认知道此事。

source_text: Allegedly, the ATSB had missed the licensing discrepancy because they only checked the front page of the airport's license and did not conduct a detailed analysis of the small print.
target_text: 据称，由于ATSB只查看了机场执照的首页，没有对小字进行详细分析，所以没有发现执照不符点。

source_text: Flight Safety claim that the Indonesian Director of Aviation Safety told them that the situation had been rectified.
target_text: 飞行安全公司称，印度尼西亚航空安全局局长告诉他们情况已经得到纠正。

source_text: However, the group have now conducted a re-audit and say Solo and Yogyakarta airports both remain illegal.
target_text: 然而，该组织目前进行了重新审计，称梭罗机场和日惹机场仍属非法。

source_text: They go on to accuse the ICAO, ATSB and Indonesian Director of Aviation Safety of "keeping quiet" and described them as 'compromised'.
target_text: 他们继续指责国际民航组织，ATSB和印度尼西亚航空安全局局长“保持沉默”并将其描述为“妥协”。

source_text: Flight Safety go on to claim that the survivors of the crash and relatives of the deceased have not been informed either, and say that this will have a serious effect on the compensation process and on any insurance claims.
target_text: 飞行安全公司继续声称，坠机的幸存者和死者的亲属也没有得到通知，并表示这将对赔偿程序和任何保险索赔产生严重影响。

source_text: Crikey, an Australian news service, also suggested that AU$12 million of aid promised by Australia to help Indonesia improve air safety is also being misused.
target_text: 澳大利亚新闻机构Crikey还表示，澳大利亚承诺帮助印尼改善航空安全的1200万澳元援助也被滥用。

source_text: All Indonesia's air carriers are currently on the list of air carriers banned in the EU.
target_text: 所有印尼航空公司目前都被列入欧盟禁止的航空承运人名单。

source_text: An official statement by Flight Safety head Chris Weir concluded "It [the group's findings] should now be exposed as the safety issues remain unresolved."
target_text: 飞行安全负责人克里斯威尔的官方声明得出结论：“由于安全问题尚未得到解决，因此该集团的调查结果现在应该曝光。”

source_text: Mardjono Siswo Suwarno of the National Transport Safety Committee, the body responsible for investigating the disaster, denied that Yogyakarta Airport was illegal, saying "At that time [the license] was still valid, but the RESA was not long enough…"
target_text: 负责调查灾难的国家运输安全委员会的Mardjono Siswo Suwarno否认日惹机场是非法的，并说“当时【许可证】仍然有效，但RESA不够长……”。

source_text: "But still in the [Garuda] case, even if the RESA length was adequate, the plane would have still overrun because the speed was 1.8 times normal speed."
target_text: “但仍然在【鹰航】的情况下，即使RESA长度足够，飞机仍然会超速，因为速度是正常速度的1.8倍。”

source_text: The final report found that the pilot-in-command, who has been arrested and charged over the crash, attempted to land after fifteen Ground Proximity Warning System activations to tell him he was landing too fast, and says that although a longer runway and full-sized RESA wouldn't have stopped an airliner traveling at such excessive speed it could have reduced the toll of deaths and injuries.
target_text: 最后一份报告发现，因飞机坠毁而被捕并被指控的机长，在启动了15次近地警告系统后，试图着陆，告诉他着陆速度太快，并说，虽然较长的跑道和全尺寸的RESA不会阻止飞机以如此过快的速度飞行，但它可以减少了伤亡人数。

source_text: The directors of Yogyakarta and Solo airports claim that since the re-audit they have taken steps to improve safety and rectify any problems, but have not actually admitted their airports were illegal.
target_text: 日惹和梭罗机场的负责人声称，自重新审计以来，他们已采取措施改善安全，并纠正任何问题，但实际上并没有承认他们的机场是非法的。

source_text: Indonesian director general of air transportation Budi Mulyawan Suyitno said that although local budget limitations have prevented some airports from being improved there are no problems currently at Yogyakarta, with improvements including declaration of a RESA for 140 metres of the 2,250 metre runway and stationing Aircraft Rescue and Firefighting trucks at the airport.
target_text: 印尼航空运输总干事Budi Mulyawan Suyitno说，虽然地方预算限制阻碍了一些机场的改善，但日惹目前没有问题，包括RESA的声明宣布对长2250米的跑道进行140米的修复工程，以及在机场放置飞机救援及消防车。

source_text: The prosecutor did not withhold complains for "simple" and "severe" physical harm by negligence against gendarmes Poget and Deiss in the trial of the Aubonne Bridge affair.
target_text: 检察官没有对奥邦桥事件审判中警察Poget和Deiss因疏忽造成的“简单”和“严重”身体伤害提出申诉。

source_text: A jawbone found in Aruba is not that of missing American Natalee Holloway, who was a recent high school-graduate at the time of her disappearance.
target_text: 在阿鲁巴发现的颚骨不是失踪的美国人娜塔莉·霍洛威的颚骨，她失踪时刚从高中毕业。

source_text: Officials confirmed the news after Dutch scientists completed tests on the bone.
target_text: 在荷兰科学家完成对骨头的检测后，官方证实了这一消息。

source_text: The jawbone, which also had a wisdom tooth with it, was found by an American tourist close to the Phoenix Hotel.
target_text: 颚骨上也有一颗智齿，是凤凰酒店附近的美国游客发现的。

source_text: A second bone had also been found by another tourist earlier this month.
target_text: 本月早些时候，另一名游客也发现了第二块骨头。

source_text: The bone was sent to the Netherlands Forensic Institute where scientists completed tests.
target_text: 骨头被送到荷兰法医学院，科学家在那里完成了测试。

source_text: They compared the bone to dental records given to them by Natalee's father, from which they confirmed the the bone was not that of Natalee, although it was human.
target_text: 他们把这块骨头和娜塔莉的父亲给他们的牙齿记录进行了比较，并从中确认这块骨头不是娜塔莉的，尽管它是人的。

source_text: It was said to be unlikely that the bone was Holloway's as there is no physical evidence that she was murdered.
target_text: 据说这块骨头不太可能是霍洛威的，因为没有实物证据表明她是被谋杀的。

source_text: Taco Stein, the Aruban Solicitor General, released a statement after the announcement was made.
target_text: 阿鲁巴总检察长塔科·斯坦在声明发布后发表了一份声明。

source_text: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.
target_text: 上周，《裸体新闻》宣布，将大幅增加新闻报道的国际语言授权，增加三家新的广播公司。

source_text: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.
target_text: 该组织已经用英语和日语进行报道，正在推出用于电视，网络和移动设备的西班牙语，意大利语和韩语语言程序。

source_text: Wikinews interviewed one of the English broadcast's anchors a little while ago, about the program.
target_text: 不久之前，维基新闻关于这个节目采访了一位英语广播的主持人。

source_text: The internationally-focused newscast created a stir upon its launch in 1999, but has since expanded with online viewers in 172 nations.
target_text: 这部聚焦国际的新闻节目在1999年开播时就引起了轰动，但自那以后，它的网络观众遍及172个国家。

source_text: Naked News President David Warga commented in a press release that "our intention at Naked News is to be a global media source, much like CNN or BBC World."
target_text: 《裸体新闻》总裁大卫·瓦尔加在一份新闻稿中说：“我们创办《裸体新闻》的目的是成为一个全球性的媒体来源，就像CNN或BBC一样。”

source_text: "We are looking forward to expanding into other languages as well, because there is definitely a market demanding our brand of infotainment."
target_text: “我们也期待着扩展到其他语言，因为市场肯定要求我们的信息娱乐品牌。”

source_text: Unlike the foreign stations run by the BBC or CNN, the international broadcasts will not be produced by the company.
target_text: 与英国广播公司或美国有线电视新闻网运营的外国电台不同，这些国际广播不会由该公司制作。

source_text: Branding and practices will be licensed to the other production and distribution companies.
target_text: 品牌和实践将授权给其他生产和分销公司。

source_text: Warga claims that, instead of presenting the naked female form as "fluff-head bimbos", their news organization "encourages society to see women as being smart, powerful, and sophisticated."
target_text: 沃加称，他们的新闻机构“鼓励社会把女性视为聪明、强大和成熟的女性”，而不是把裸体女性形象描绘成“愚蠢的荡妇”。

source_text: Despite this, the press release lists hotel rooms as being one of the primary distribution methods; hotels account for a large segment of the pornography industry's broadcast market.
target_text: 尽管如此，新闻稿还是将酒店客房列为主要的分销方式之一，酒店占色情行业广播市场的一大部分。

source_text: The Islamic Republic of Iran says it is conducting naval drills in the Strait of Hormuz.
target_text: 伊朗伊斯兰共和国称它正在霍尔木兹海峡进行海军演习。

source_text: According to the Iranian navy's Habibollah Sayyari, the "Velayat 91" drills — to be held for a six day period ending on Wednesday — are intended to showcase "the armed forces' military capabilities."
target_text: 伊朗海军的哈比纽拉·萨耶里表示，将于周三结束的为期六天的“维拉亚91”军演，旨在展示“武装部队的军事能力”。

source_text: Iran's state-run media reports that the Iranian government warns all ships to stay away until the end of the exercises.
target_text: 伊朗官方媒体报导说，伊朗政府警告所有船只在演习结束前不要靠近。

source_text: According to this report the drills — which began on Friday — are to be conducted over roughly half a million square miles (a million square kilometers) of waters stretching from the Strait of Hormuz to the northern part of the Indian Ocean which includes the Gulf of Oman.
target_text: 根据这份报告，从周五开始的演习将在从霍尔木兹海峡延伸到印度洋北部的大约五十万平方英里（一百万平方公里）的水域进行，其中包括阿曼海湾。

source_text: The Strait of Hormuz is a major shipping route of great strategic importance.
target_text: 霍尔木兹海峡是具有重要战略意义的主要航线。

source_text: That is nearly 20% of the worldwide oil trade and about 35% of oil transported by sea.
target_text: 这占全球石油贸易的近百分之20，海上运输的石油约占百分之35。

source_text: This is only one in a series of major naval drills held by Iran in the Strait of Hormuz.
target_text: 这只是伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡举行的一系列主要海军演习中的一次。

source_text: Ten days of drills, "Velayat 90", was conducted last December and "Velayat 89" a year and a half before that in May 2010.
target_text: 为期十天的演习“Velayat 90”于去年12月进行，“Velayat 89”于一年半前的2010年5月进行。

source_text: Iran has said it might close the strait if its nuclear program were attacked.
target_text: 伊朗表示，如果其核项目受到攻击，可能会关闭该海峡。

source_text: South Africa crashed out of the 2011 Cricket World Cup after being beaten by New Zealand in the quarterfinals, played at Mirpur, in Bangladesh.
target_text: 南非队在孟加拉国米尔布尔举行的四分之一决赛中被新西兰击败后，在2011年板球世界杯中惨遭淘汰。

source_text: Chasing a victory target of 222, South Africa were all out for 172 after some inspired bowling performance by Jacob Oram and Nathan McCullum.

source_text: Early last night, massive attacks targeted China's Internet, slowing access to a crawl.
target_text: 昨晚，大规模袭击攻占了中国的互联网，减缓了抓取的速度。

source_text: The Chinese domain was targeted in the latest of many denial of service attacks against China.
target_text: 中国域名最近成为针对中国的众多终止服务的攻击目标。

source_text: According to the China Internet Network Information Center, which manages the .cn domain, this attack was the largest of its kind.
target_text: 据管理.cn域名的中国互联网络信息中心称，这次袭击是同类攻击中规模最大的。

source_text: The domain was attacked twice, once at 2am local time, and again at 4am.
target_text: 域被攻击了两次，一次是在当地时间凌晨2点，再次是凌晨4点。

source_text: The second was larger, and Chinese officials said work to restore service was progressing slowly.
target_text: 第二个更大，中国官员说恢复服务的工作进展缓慢。

source_text: State-run newsmedia said numerous .cn websites and microblogging website Sina Weibo were targeted.
target_text: 官方新闻媒体说，许多.cn网站和新浪微博网站都是攻击目标。

source_text: This outage comes at a sensitive time for China, with the trial of , a former government official, having just ended.
target_text: 对中国来说，这次网络中断正值一个敏感时期，对一名前政府官员的审判刚刚结束。

source_text: The attack also comes amidst rumors that the Chinese government will be cracking down on social media commentators, according the The Wall Street Journal.
target_text: 据《华尔街日报》报道，攻击事件发生之际，有传言称中国政府将打击社交媒体评论员。

source_text: According to a Wall Street Journal interview with Matthew Prince, CEO of , a company that tracks web traffic and metrics, during the attack Chinese Internet traffic dropped by 32%.
target_text: 据《华尔街日报》对追踪网络流量和指标的公司首席执行长马修・普林斯的采访，攻击期间中国互联网流量下降了百分之32。

source_text: He also claimed this attack is an indicator of the susceptibility of Chinese Internet infrastructure to these attacks.
target_text: 他还声称，此次攻击是中国互联网基础设施易受这些攻击影响的一个象征。

source_text: More than half of Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni's convoy was prevented from entering Rwanda on Thursday.
target_text: 周四，乌干达总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼的一半以上的车队被阻止进入卢旺达。

source_text: The President was travelling to Kigali to hand over the chairmanship of the Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa (COMESA) to Rwandan president Paul Kagame.
target_text: 总统正前往基加利，将东非和南部非洲共同市场（COMESA）主席一职移交给卢旺达总统保罗·卡加梅。

source_text: Rwandan officials have been quoted as saying that the Ugandan convoy violated rules on the number of guns they are allowed to carry across the border.
target_text: 据报道，卢旺达官员说，乌干达车队违反了关于允许他们越过边境的枪支数量的规定。

source_text: Uganda has blamed the incident solely on Rwanda, arguing that the situation could have been resolved with much less controversy.
target_text: 乌干达将这一事件完全归咎于卢旺达，认为情况本可以通过较少的争议得到解决。

source_text: What happened at the border was the sole responsibility of the Rwandese officials involved.
target_text: 在边境发生的事情是所涉及的卢旺达官员的唯一责任。

source_text: If there had been extra guns, why could they not be left on the border for later collection and allow the vehicles to continue? said a statement from Uganda's foreign ministry.
target_text: 如果有多余的枪支，为什么不把它们留在边境上，待以后收集，让车辆继续行驶呢？乌干达外交部发表声明称。

source_text: The guns could even have been returned to Uganda, it is only 200 meters away.
target_text: 这些枪甚至可能被送回乌干达，那里离乌干达只有200米远。

source_text: They, then, give them to you on arrival, it added.
target_text: 然后，他们在抵达时将它们交给你，它补充道。

source_text: Relations between Uganda and Rwanda have been improving over the last few years, however recently the situation has deteriorated.
target_text: 乌干达和卢旺达之间的关系在过去几年中一直在改善，但是最近局势恶化了。

source_text: On the IntercontinentalExchange Brent Crude futures reached US$89.30 (basis December) as of 8:34 a.m..
target_text: 截至上午8：34，洲际交易所布伦特原油期货价格达到89.30美元（12月基准价格）。

source_text: The raise come when the United States announced that it had an "unexpected loss" in the nation's stockpile of oil.

target_text: 澳大利亚联邦银行表示，此次加息“得到了地缘政治紧张局势加剧和市场发展的支持”。

source_text: "The US has announced that it is imposing new sanctions on Iran, Oil markets also continued to have an eye on developments related to the current tensions between Turkey and Kurd rebels in Iraq."
target_text: “美国已宣布对伊朗实施新的制裁，石油市场也继续关注土耳其与库尔德叛乱分子目前在伊拉克的紧张关系。”

source_text: Just two weeks after China sent global markets into a tumble, growing worries about sub-prime mortgage lenders in the United States are sending jitters through stock exchanges around the globe.
target_text: 就在中国令全球市场陷入动荡的两周后，对美国次级抵押贷款机构的担忧日益加剧，令全球各地的证券交易所都感到不安。

source_text: London's FTSE 100, Paris' CAC 40 and Frankfurt's DAX 30 indices each closed down more than 1 percent.
target_text: 伦敦的FTSE 100，巴黎的CAC 40和法兰克福的DAX 30指数均下跌超过百分之1。

source_text: As the Mortgage Bankers Association reported that late payments on mortgages and home foreclosures in the US homes rose in the fourth quarter to their highest level in years, investors are concerned that not only US banks but also multi-national banks around the globe could have exposure.
target_text: 美国抵押贷款银行家协会报告称，去年第四季度，美国住房抵押贷款逾期付款和房屋止赎上升至多年来的最高水平。与此同时，投资者担心，不仅是美国的银行，全球各地的跨国银行也可能面临风险敞口。

source_text: More than two dozen sub-prime lenders have closed or sold operations as defaults on those mortgages have risen.
target_text: 随着次级抵押贷款违约上升，20多家次级抵押贷款机构已经关闭或出售了业务。

source_text: The delinquencies and defaults have started to soar, said Nicolas Retsinas, director of Housing Studies at Harvard University.
target_text: 哈佛大学住房研究主任尼古拉斯·雷齐纳斯说，拖欠和违约已经开始飙升。

source_text: New Century Financial Corporation, the second largest sub-prime lender in the US, has recently revealed that its creditors were no longer providing funds and, further, it has become subject of an SEC investigation.
target_text: 美国第二大次级贷款机构新世纪金融公司最近披露，其债权人不再提供资金，并已成为美国证交会调查的对象。

source_text: The New York Stock Exchange has said it will delist New Century.
target_text: 纽约证券交易所已表示将退市新世纪。

source_text: Accredited Home Loan Lending, another major sub-prime mortgage specialist, said it was seeking fresh capital and waivers on its lending covenants.
target_text: 另一家主要的次级抵押贷款专业机构“合格住房贷款公司”表示，它正在寻求新的资本，并在贷款契约上寻求豁免。

source_text: Sub-prime lenders provide mortgages to people who do not qualify for loans from mainstream lenders, typically due to their credit histories.
target_text: 次级贷款人向不符合主流贷款人贷款条件的人提供抵押贷款，通常是由于他们的信用记录。

source_text: The lenders then bundle these mortgages as collateral for loans that they obtain from other financing firms, such as GMAC.
target_text: 然后，贷款机构将这些抵押贷款打包，作为从GMAC等其它金融公司获得贷款的抵押品。

source_text: Such firms can then repackage these loans and sell them as mortgage-backed securities.
target_text: 然后，这些公司可以重新包装这些贷款并将其作为抵押贷款支持证券出售。

source_text: These securities may end up in the hands of major multi-national banks such as Citibank, HSBC, and Commerzbank.
target_text: 这些证券可能最终落入花旗银行，汇丰银行和德国商业银行等主要跨国银行的手中。

source_text: Each level of lending assumes a level of financial risk, but trouble can arise when the risk tolerances are exceeded.
target_text: 每个级别的贷款都会产生一定程度的财务风险，但是当超出风险承受能力时会出现问题。

source_text: If too many homeowners default on their mortgages, the sub-prime lender can end up defaulting.
target_text: 如果太多房主拖欠抵押贷款，次级贷款人可能最终违约。

source_text: If too many of these lenders default, as it is feared may be happening now, the defaults can cascade upward.
target_text: 如果这些贷款机构中有太多出现违约，人们担心这种情况现在可能正在发生，违约可能会一级级上升。

source_text: While no one is predicting major bank failures at this point, it is feared that their profits could be hurt.
target_text: 虽然目前没有人预测会有大型银行倒闭，但人们担心它们的利润可能受到影响。

source_text: Oprah Winfrey has announced that she will retire from her talk show on September 9, 2011, during season 25.
target_text: 奥普拉·温弗瑞宣布，她将于2011年9月9日在第25季的脱口秀节目中退休。

source_text: Winfrey made the announcement on Friday's broadcast of The Oprah Winfrey Show.
target_text: 温弗瑞于周五播出的奥普拉·温弗瑞秀上宣布了这一消息。

source_text: Suppressing tears, she explained that careful thought and prayer had gone into her decision.
target_text: 她强忍着眼泪解释说，她的决定是经过深思熟虑和祈祷的。

source_text: Twenty-five years feels right in my bones and feels right in my spirit, she told her audience.
target_text: 她对听众说：“25年在我的骨子里感觉很好，在我的精神里也感觉很好。”

source_text: The Oprah Winfrey Show was first televised on September 8, 1986.
target_text: 奥普拉·温弗瑞秀于1986年9月8日首次播出。

source_text: For the first ten years she competed with other talk shows by discussing relationships and parallel subjects.
target_text: 在最初的十年里，她通过讨论人际关系和类似的话题与其他脱口秀节目竞争。

source_text: In the late 1990s her show changed focus to incorporate stories relating to spirituality and human interest.
target_text: 上世纪90年代末，她的节目重心发生了变化，加入了有关灵性和人类兴趣的故事。

source_text: Winfrey has had lasting effects on the city of Chicago, Illinois.
target_text: 温弗瑞对伊利诺伊州芝加哥市产生了持久的影响。

source_text: The surrounding neighborhood of Harpo Productions was rundown prior to the company's success.
target_text: 在公司取得成功之前，哈波公司的周边社区已经破败不堪。

target_text: 芝加哥居民对如果温弗瑞离开会发生什么事表示担忧。

source_text: April 9, 2005 A rise in flesh-eating staph infections has worried doctors about the possible spread of drug resistant bacteria.
target_text: 2005年4月9日肉食性葡萄球菌感染的增加令医生担心抗药性细菌可能会传播。

source_text: Staphylococcus aureus, commonly known as staph, is a bacteria that commonly causes skin infections in otherwise healthy people.
target_text: 金黄色葡萄球菌，通常称为葡萄球菌，是一种通常在健康人群中引起皮肤感染的细菌。

source_text: However, as a persistent threat in hospitals, it tends to infect patients who are already sick and whose systems are vulnerable due to IV lines that pierce the skin.
target_text: 然而，作为一种持续存在于医院的威胁，它往往会感染已经患病的患者，而这些患者的系统也容易受到穿透皮肤的静脉注射线的影响。

source_text: Doctors have already battled for years against drug-resistant strains of the bacteria, but the struggle has generally been confined to hospitals.
target_text: 医生们已经与这种耐药菌株斗争了多年，但斗争通常仅限于医院。

source_text: Now, however, Methicillin Resistant Staph Aureus (MRSA) has been spreading in communities outside hospitals.
target_text: 然而，现在，耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）已经在医院外的社区中传播。

source_text: Cases have multiplied by 25 times since 1998 at the University of Chicago.
target_text: 自1998年以来，芝加哥大学的病例数增加了25倍。

source_text: A Los Angeles hospital documented 14 cases of the flesh-eating infection, where patients required substantial time in intensive care and surgery.
target_text: 洛杉矶一家医院记录了14例食肉感染病例，患者需要长时间的重症监护和手术。

source_text: The infections are particularly problematic because nearly a quarter of people who get a staph infection require hospitalization.
target_text: 感染特别成问题，因为近四分之一的感染葡萄球菌的人需要住院治疗。

source_text: Staph infections are spread much like other diseases, with crowded conditions, poor hygiene, and skin-to-skin contact most frequently to blame.
target_text: 葡萄球菌感染的传播与其他疾病非常相似，最常见的原因是拥挤的环境、糟糕的卫生条件和皮肤间的接触。

source_text: At higher risk are prison inmates, homeless people, military personnel, and families with kids in day care.
target_text: 监狱囚犯，无家可归者，军人以及有日托儿童的家庭风险较高。

source_text: Athletes also have a higher risk, because sweating makes it easier for bacteria to infect the skin.
target_text: 运动员也有较高的风险，因为出汗使细菌更容易感染皮肤。

source_text: An overnight explosion and fire at a Washington State oil refinery in Anacortes, Washington, United States, a city about 80 miles south of Vancouver, Canada, yesterday killed four people and critically injured three others.
target_text: 昨天，美国华盛顿州阿纳科特的一家华盛顿州立炼油厂发生夜间爆炸和火灾，该炼油厂位于加拿大温哥华以南80英里处，造成4人死亡，3人重伤。

source_text: Some people reportedly felt the explosion, which sent flames as high as the tower in the refinery, from as far as five miles away.
target_text: 据报道，一些人从5英里外就能感觉到爆炸，爆炸产生的火焰窜到和炼油厂的塔一般高。

source_text: The fire, whose cause is not yet known, burned for around an hour and a half before being extinguished.
target_text: 起火原因尚不清楚，大火燃烧了大约一个半小时才被扑灭。

source_text: Initially, Tesoro announced that three people had died in the fire.
target_text: 起初，特索罗宣布有三人在火灾中丧生。

source_text: According to a spokesperson from Harborview Medical Center in Seattle, a fourth person, a 29-year-old woman, later died from her injuries at the hospital, while three other people, a woman and two men, all remain in critical condition with major burns.
target_text: 西雅图港景医疗中心的一名发言人表示，第四名死者是一名29岁的女性，后来在医院因伤势过重而死亡，另外三名患者，一名女性和两名男性，目前仍处于严重烧伤的危重状态。

source_text: Three of the dead were named as Matthew Bowen, Darren Hoines and Daniel Aldridge, while the person who died in the hospital has not been identified.
target_text: 死者中有三人名叫马修·鲍恩、达伦·霍恩和丹尼尔·奥尔德里奇，而在医院死亡的人还没有被确认身份。

source_text: According to CNN, three workers are still missing, and a search has begun for them.
target_text: 据美国有线电视新闻网报道，仍有三名工人失踪，他们已开始搜查。

source_text: The incident was the first fire at an oil refinery in Anacortes since 2007, when a fire at the Shell Puget Sound Refinery damaged a storage, resulting in three minor injuries.
target_text: 这是2007年以来阿纳科特炼油厂发生的第一起火灾。当时，壳牌普吉特湾炼油厂的一场大火损毁了一个仓库，造成三人轻伤。

source_text: A Tesoro-owned refinery was involved in another fire in 2002, also with no reported injuries.
target_text: 特索罗拥有的炼油厂在2002年又发生了另一起火灾，也没有受伤报告。

source_text: The 15-year-old Australian boy charged on Sunday night related to the alleged theft of a Tram, faces another nine charges over prior incidents, bringing the total to 18 charges.
target_text: 这名15岁的澳大利亚男孩在星期天晚上被指控涉嫌盗窃电车，在此前的事件中又面临9项指控，使总数达到18项指控。

source_text: Police allege he drove a vehicle in the Southbank yard and hit another tram, on April 10, causing $2000 damage.
target_text: 警方指称，4月10日，他在南岸停车场驾驶车辆，撞向另一辆有轨电车，造成2000元损失。

source_text: And on April 9, it is alleged, he jumped a fence at a Footscray bus depot, found some keys and drove a bus around the yard.
target_text: 据称，4月9日，他跳过Footscray公交车站的栅栏，找到一些钥匙，并在院子里开着一辆公交车。

source_text: Police forces in India have ended the hostage sieges which followed the Mumbai attacks, which began on Wednesday in Mumbai, the financial capital of India.
target_text: 印度警方结束了孟买袭击事件后的人质包围行动。孟买袭击事件于周三在印度金融中心孟买开始。

source_text: It ended when commandos finally caught up with a lone gunman, who had played a cat-and-mouse game in the Taj Mahal Palace & Tower, nearly 56 hours after the attacks began.
target_text: 袭击开始近56个小时后，突击队员终于逮捕了一名在泰姬陵皇宫酒店玩猫捉老鼠游戏的枪手。

source_text: According to Indian television and radio, 155 people have been killed and 327 others wounded.
target_text: 据印度电视台和电台报道，有155人遇难，另有327人受伤。

source_text: Police say that they are in control of both the Taj Mahal and Oberoi Trident hotels.
target_text: 警方称，他们控制着泰姬陵和欧贝罗伊三叉戟酒店。

source_text: These people were very, very familiar with the hotel layouts and it appears they had carried out a survey before, said an unidentified commander of MARCOS, India's elite marine commandos.
target_text: 这些人非常非常熟悉酒店的布局，看起来他们之前已经进行了一项调查，一位身份不明的印度精英海洋突击队员MARCOS指挥官说。

source_text: The commandos were hampered because they feared injuring hotel guests if they used overwhelming force.
target_text: 突击队受到阻碍，因为他们担心如果使用压倒性的武力会伤害酒店客人。

source_text: Bodies were strewn all over the place, and there was blood everywhere, he said.
target_text: 他说，尸体遍布整个地方，到处都是鲜血。

source_text: The commander also noted that his unit found a backpack belonging to one of the gunmen.
target_text: 指挥官还注意到他的部队发现了一个属于其中一名枪手的背包。

source_text: Inside they found dried fruit, 400 rounds of AK-47 ammunition, four grenades, Indian rupees and American dollars, and seven credit cards from some of the world’s leading banks and a national ID card for the island nation of Mauritius.
target_text: 他们在里面找到了干果，400发AK-47弹药，四枚手榴弹，印度卢比和美元，以及一些世界主要银行的七张信用卡和毛里求斯岛国家的身份证。

source_text: Once the bodies are collected, the number of deaths might go up to 200, said India's Minister of Home Affairs Sri Prakash Jaiswal.
target_text: 印度内政部长斯里普拉卡什贾伊斯瓦尔说，一旦尸体被收集起来，死亡人数可能会达到200人。

source_text: We came up against highly motivated terrorists, said Vice-Admiral J.S.
target_text: 我们面对的是动机非常强烈的恐怖分子。

source_text: India's foreign minister, Pranab Mukherjee, said, "Preliminary evidence indicates that elements with links to Pakistan are involved," stirring a diplomatic row between India and Pakistan.
target_text: 印度外交部长慕克吉说，“初步证据表明，一些与巴基斯坦有联系的人参与其中”，这在印度和巴基斯坦之间引发了一场外交争端。

source_text: However, Prime Minister of Pakistan Yousaf Raza Gillani said that Pakistan had "nothing to do with the attacks."
target_text: 然而，巴基斯坦总理优素福・拉扎・吉拉尼表示，巴基斯坦“与这些袭击无关”。

source_text: It is unfair to blame Pakistan or Pakistanis for these acts of terrorism even before an investigation is undertaken, Husain Haqqani, Pakistan's ambassador to the United States, said in a statement.
target_text: 巴基斯坦驻美国大使侯赛因・哈卡尼在一份声明中表示，甚至在进行调查之前，将这些恐怖主义行为归咎于巴基斯坦或巴基斯坦人是不公平的。

source_text: Instead of scoring political points at the expense of a neighboring country that is itself a victim of terrorism, it is time for India's leaders to work together with Pakistan's elected leaders in putting up a joint front against terrorism.
target_text: 印度领导人现在应该与巴基斯坦民选领导人合作，建立一个共同打击恐怖主义的战线，而不是牺牲自己是恐怖主义受害者的邻国来获得政治加分。

target_text: 周四在马德里巴拉哈斯机场，维基新闻采访了西班牙残奥会游泳选手玛尔塔·戈麦斯，她将参加周一在加拿大蒙特利尔举行的2013年国际残奥委会游泳世锦赛。

source_text: Are you going to Montreal and what strokes and distances are you competing in?

source_text: Following Hungary's release and repatriation of convicted Azeri axe-murderer Ramil Safarov, who Azerbaijan subsequently pardoned, Armenia announced it is "ready for war".
target_text: 匈牙利释放并遣返了被定罪的阿塞拜疆斧头杀人犯拉米尔·萨法罗夫，阿塞拜疆随后赦免了他，亚美尼亚宣布它“准备好开战”。

source_text: The declaration is in-response to Safarov's pardon and promotion, despite the Azeri officer having been given a life sentence — with a minimum jail term of 30 years, by Hungarian authorities in 2006.
target_text: 该声明是对萨法罗夫的赦免和晋升的回应，尽管2006年匈牙利当局对阿塞拜疆军官判处终身监禁，最低刑期为30年。

source_text: Safarov killed Margaryan in his sleep with an axe; the attack allegedly stemming from a desire to avenge Azeris killed during the Nagorno-Karabakh War and being mocked by Margaryan and another Armenian.
target_text: 萨法罗夫在睡梦中用斧头杀死了玛格丽特；据称，这次袭击是为了报复在纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫战争中被杀害的阿塞拜疆人，并被玛格丽特和另一亚美尼亚人嘲笑。

source_text: On his return home, Safarov was met with a hero's welcome, given a pardon by president Ilham Aliyev, promoted to the rank of major, awarded eight-years of back-pay and given a house.
target_text: 在他返回家园时，萨法洛夫受到了英雄的欢迎，总统阿利耶夫赦免了他，将他提升为少校，并给予他8年的补偿金和一所房子。

source_text: Armenia sees these acts, when it was expected that Safarov would serve out his prison term in Azerbaijan, as highly provocative.
target_text: 亚美尼亚认为这些行为是高度挑衅性的，当时人们预期萨法罗夫将在阿塞拜疆服完他的刑期。

source_text: Armenian President Serzh Sarkisian declared: "We don't want a war, but if we have to, we will fight and win."
target_text: 亚美尼亚总统塞尔吉斯·萨基西安宣称：“我们不希望发动战争，但如果必须，我们将战斗并赢得胜利。”

source_text: "We are not afraid of killers, even if they enjoy the protection of the head of state" .
target_text: “我们不怕凶手，即使他们享受国家元首的保护”。

source_text: Historically both Armenia and Azerbaijan lay claim to some of the same territories, an issue complicated by the intermingling of ethnic populations so some areas have no clearly demarcated Azeri and Armenian border; these potential sources of conflict remained quiescent whilst both nations were subsumed by greater powers.
target_text: 从历史上看，亚美尼亚和阿塞拜疆都声称拥有一些相同的领土，这一问题因种族人口的混合而复杂化，因此一些地区没有明确划分阿塞拜疆和亚美尼亚边界；这些潜在的冲突源虽然是静止状态，但两国都被更大的国家所包围。

source_text: However, the collapse of the Ottoman and Russian Empires in the wake of the First World War led to the Armenian–Azerbaijani War.
target_text: 然而，在第一次世界大战之后奥斯曼帝国和俄罗斯帝国的崩溃导致了亚美尼亚-阿塞拜疆战争。

source_text: With the demise of the short-lived Armenian-Azerbaijan-Georgia Transcaucasian Democratic Federative Republic, fighting broke out which only ended when the two nations were annexed by the expanding Soviet Union.
target_text: 随着短命的亚美尼亚-阿塞拜疆-格鲁吉亚外高加索民主联邦共和国的灭亡，战争爆发了，直到两国被不断扩大的苏联吞并后才结束。

source_text: With the USSR's collapse, Armenia and Azerbaijan re-emerged as independent states — as-did old rivalries over territory.
target_text: 随着苏联的解体，亚美尼亚和阿塞拜疆重新成为独立的国家-就像过去在领土问题上的竞争一样。

source_text: Between 1988 and 1994 over thirty thousand people died, and a million were displaced in bitter ethnic fighting between Armenians and Azeris over the enclave of Nagorno-Karabakh; despite an Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe brokered ceasefire, no final armistice has been signed and intermittent violence between them the two states continues.
target_text: 1988年至1994年期间，亚美尼亚人与阿塞拜疆人就纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫飞地发生激烈的种族战斗，造成3万多人死亡，100万人流离失所，尽管欧洲安全与合作组织促成了停火，但尚未签署最终的停战协议，两国间断断续续的暴力冲突仍在继续。

source_text: Nagorno-Karabakh remains legally part of Azerbaijan, but under effective Armenian control.
target_text: 纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫在法律上仍然是阿塞拜疆的一部分，但处于亚美尼亚的有效控制之下。

source_text: On multiple occasions president Ilham Aliyev has stated his willingness to resort to force in order to assert Azeri rule, with oil wealth tipping any local arms race in favour of Azerbaijan.
target_text: 总统伊利哈姆·阿利耶夫多次表示，他愿意诉诸武力以维护阿塞拜疆的统治，石油财富使任何地方军备竞赛都有利于支持阿塞拜疆。

source_text: On Friday, The National Security Council of Armenia decided to break ties with Hungary during an emergency summit, describing the Hungarian actions as a "grave mistake".
target_text: 星期五，亚美尼亚国家安全委员会决定在紧急峰会期间与匈牙利断绝关系，称匈牙利的行动为“严重错误”。

source_text: In turn, the Azeri ambassador was summoned by Hungary on Monday regarding the breach of Azeri assurances that Safarov would serve out the remainder of his sentence in Azerbaijan.
target_text: 反过来，匈牙利星期一召见了阿塞拜疆大使，因为他违反了阿塞拜疆方面的保证，即萨法罗夫将在阿塞拜疆服完他的刑期。

source_text: The camp of Manny Pacquiao led by manager Freddie Roach claimed that Diaz will need a "fucking miracle" to stop 'The Pacman' from moving up to the 135 lbs. weight class where Diaz is top brass.
target_text: 曼尼·帕奎奥的阵营由经理弗雷迪·罗奇领导，他们声称迪亚兹需要一个“他妈的奇迹”来阻止《吃豆人》上升到135磅的体重级别，而迪亚兹是这个级别的最高级别。

source_text: Boxing punters observed that Diaz has a lot of heft in the way he delivers his punches but Pacquiao's speed and strong punches are something Diaz should be wary about.
target_text: 拳击赌客注意到迪亚兹在出拳方面很有分量，但是帕奎奥的速度和有力的出拳是迪亚兹应该警惕的。

source_text: Pacquiao has won three different belts in three different weight classes of the World Boxing Council or WBC.
target_text: 帕奎奥在世界拳击理事会或WBC的三个不同重量级别中赢得了三种不同的腰带。

source_text: Diaz debuted in the boxing world when he was part of the winning United States Olympic boxing team during the 1996 Atlanta Olympic games.
target_text: 迪亚兹在1996年亚特兰大奥运会期间成为美国奥运拳击队的一员，在拳击界首次亮相。

source_text: Meanwhile, Pacquiao dedicated his bout against Diaz to all the victims of Typhoon Fengshen which devastated his home country, the Philippines, and killed hundreds of people.
target_text: 与此同时，帕奎奥把他与迪亚兹的比赛奉献给台风“风神”的所有受害者。“风神”摧毁了他的祖国菲律宾，造成数百人死亡。

source_text: Bucharest, the capital of Romania, will become the first southeastern European city to host CowParade.
target_text: 罗马尼亚首都布加勒斯特将成为欧洲东南部第一个举办奔牛节的城市。

source_text: Between June 1 and the end of August this year, the city will be flooded by herds of decorated cow sculptures, exhibited at well-known landmarks, such as The Palace of the Parliament, Europe's largest building, as well as on the streets and outside metro stations.
target_text: 从今年6月1日到8月底，这座城市将被一群群装饰精美的牛雕塑所淹没，这些雕塑将在欧洲最大的建筑，议会宫等著名地标建筑以及街道和地铁站外展出。

source_text: Over 3000 local and international artists will participate in the event, decorating more than 100 life-sized fibreglass cows.
target_text: 超过3000名本地和国际艺术家将参加此次活动，装饰100多只真人大小的玻璃纤维奶牛。

source_text: The decorated cows will feature Romanian and Bucharestean themes, as well as issues related to international city life.
target_text: 装饰牛将以罗马尼亚和布加勒斯特为主题，以及与国际城市生活相关的问题。

source_text: After the event ends, all the cows will be auctioned off, with the proceeds donated to the Special Olympics Romania, a charity helping athletes with mental disabilities.
target_text: 活动结束后，所有奶牛将被拍卖，所得款项将捐赠给罗马尼亚特奥会，这是一个帮助智障运动员的慈善机构。

source_text: CowParade, which was first held in Zurich in 1998, has been held in 22 cities in 5 continents and is today the world's largest public art event.
target_text: 奔牛节于1998年首次在苏黎世举行，目前已在5大洲的22个城市举行，是当今世界最大的公共艺术活动。

source_text: Bucharest was chosen from over 500 other candidate cities and has waited for the event for a couple of years.
target_text: 布加勒斯特从其他500多个候选城市中选出，并等待了几年。

source_text: The new local government in Bucharest wants to relaunch the city's image as a creative and colourful metropolis and have therefore enthusiastically supported the exhibition.
target_text: 布加勒斯特的新一届地方政府希望重新树立该市作为一个富有创造性和丰富多彩的大都市的形象，因此热情地支助了这次展览。

source_text: The high-profile event is expected to boost the image of Bucharest worldwide, especially in the artistic scene.
target_text: 这一备受瞩目的活动有望提升布加勒斯特在全球的形象，特别是在艺术领域。

source_text: A controversial development training course called "Landmark Forum" is cited in religious discrimination lawsuits in United States federal courts in New York and Washington, D.C.
target_text: 在纽约和华盛顿特区的美国联邦法院提起的宗教歧视诉讼中，提到了一门名为“里程碑论坛”的有争议的发展培训课程。

source_text: The seminars are run by a San Francisco, California-based for-profit training company called Landmark Education.
target_text: 这些研讨会是由一家位于加利福尼亚旧金山的盈利性培训公司运营的，名为里程碑教育。

source_text: The company evolved from Erhard Seminars Training "est", and has faced criticism regarding its techniques and its use of unpaid labor.
target_text: 该公司从艾哈德研讨会培训“est”发展而来，并因其技术和无偿劳动的使用而受到批评。

source_text: The sperm bank and surrogacy company Los Angeles-based Growing Generations is named as a defendant in the New York lawsuit, and the Democratic political action committee Twenty-First Century Democrats is a defendant in the Washington, D.C. case.
target_text: 总部位于洛杉矶的精子银行和代孕公司“成长的一代”在纽约的诉讼中被列为被告，21世纪的民主党政治行动委员会在华盛顿的案件中被列为被告。

source_text: In separate lawsuits filed in the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York in Manhattan, New York, and in the United States District Court for the District of Columbia in Washington, D.C., former employees are suing their employers for monetary damages and claiming religious discrimination after their employers allegedly mandated that they attend courses at Landmark Education.
target_text: 在纽约曼哈顿纽约南部地区的美国地方法院和华盛顿哥伦比亚特区的美国地方法院分别提起的诉讼中，前雇员正在起诉他们的雇主，要求赔偿经济损失，并声称在雇主强制他们参加里程碑教育的课程后，他们受到了宗教歧视。

source_text: In the US$3 million federal lawsuit filed in New York, Scott Glasgow is suing his former employer Growing Generations and its CEO Stuart Miller.
target_text: 在纽约提起的300万美元的联邦诉讼中，斯科特·格拉斯哥起诉了他的前雇主、成长一代和首席执行官斯图尔特·米勒。

source_text: Growing Generations maintains sperm banks and also arranges surrogacy for gay couples who wish to have children.
target_text: 成长一代经营精子库，并为希望生孩子的同性恋夫妇安排代孕。

source_text: The company has offices in New York and Los Angeles, and has done business with celebrities including actor B. D. Wong of Law & Order: SVU.
target_text: 该公司在纽约和洛杉矶设有办事处，并与包括法律与秩序：SVU的演员B·D·王在内的名人做过生意。

source_text: Glasgow was marketing director of Growing Generations, and claims he was fired in June 2007 after refusing to continue attending Landmark Education seminars.
target_text: 格拉斯哥是成长一代的营销总监，并声称他在拒绝继续参加里程碑教育研讨会后于2007年6月被解雇。

source_text: Glasgow is also suing for sexual harassment, and claims Miller came on to him in September 2006.
target_text: 格拉斯哥也在起诉性骚扰，并声称米勒于2006年9月向他求助。

source_text: He made approximately $100,000 per year as the company's marketing director, and was the company's only employee based out of New York City.
target_text: 他作为公司的营销总监每年赚大约10万美元，并且是公司在纽约市以外唯一的员工。

source_text: "I want them to stop imposing Landmark on the employees, and I want an apology," said Glasgow in a statement in The Village Voice.
target_text: 格拉斯哥在乡村之声的一份声明中说：“我希望他们不再对员工强加里程碑，我希望他们道歉。”

source_text: Brent Pelton, one of Glasgow's attorneys, stated that: "The Landmark philosophy is deeply ingrained in the culture of the company".
target_text: 格拉斯哥律师之一布伦特佩尔顿表示：“里程碑哲学在公司文化中根深蒂固”。

source_text: Glasgow said that the Landmark Education training courses were "opposite" to his Christian beliefs.
target_text: 格拉斯哥说，里程碑教育培训课程与他的基督教信仰“相反”。

source_text: Ian Wallace, an attorney who represents Growing Generations, claimed that Glasgow wasn't fired but walked away from his position.
target_text: 代表成长一代的律师伊恩华莱士声称，格拉斯哥没有被解雇，而是离开了他的位置。

source_text: Growing Generations and Mr. Miller are very confident that these claims will be dismissed ultimately, and there's no factual basis for them whatsoever, said Wallace in a statement to The Village Voice.
target_text: 华莱士在乡村之声的一份声明中表示，成长一代和米勒先生非常有信心这些说法最终会被驳回，并且没有任何事实根据。

source_text: Lawyers representing Growing Generations and Stuart Miller declined comment to The New York Post, and did not immediately return a message from ABC News.
target_text: 代表成长一代的律师和斯图尔特·米勒拒绝对纽约邮报发表评论，并没有立即回复ABC新闻的消息。

source_text: In Glasgow's complaint, entered into federal court record on April 18, he asserts that Landmark Education constitutes a "religion", and "perceived their philosophy as a form of religion that contradicted his own personal beliefs".
target_text: 在4月18日提交联邦法院备案的格拉斯哥诉状中，他声称，里程碑教育构成了一种“宗教”，并“将其哲学视为一种与他个人信仰相抵触的宗教形式”。

source_text: He states that when he was promoted to Director of Marketing, he asked Miller if he could stop attending the Landmark sessions but was told that they were mandatory for all of the company's executives and that Landmark is "very much the language of the company."
target_text: 他说，当他被提升为市场总监时，他问米勒是否可以停止参加这些里程碑会议，但米勒告诉他，这些会议对公司所有高管都是强制性的，里程碑会议“在很大程度上是公司的语言”。

source_text: Glasgow said his performance at the company was assessed based on how he was "touching, moving and inspiring" others, a phrase from the Landmark philosophy, as opposed to his business accomplishments at the company.
target_text: 格拉斯哥表示，他在公司的表现是基于他如何“触动，感动和鼓舞”他人来评估的，这是里程碑哲学的一句话，而不是他在公司的商业成就。

source_text: The complaint claims that the actions of Miller and Growing Generations violated Federal, New York State and New York City civil rights laws.
target_text: 诉状称，米勒和成长一代的行为违反了联邦，纽约州和纽约市的民权法。

source_text: The lawsuit filed in federal court in Washington, D.C. deals with a separate plaintiff and company, but the plaintiff in the suit also claims that religious discrimination took place for allegedly being mandated to attend Landmark Education courses.
target_text: 在华盛顿特区联邦法院提起的诉讼涉及另一名原告和一家公司，但原告还声称，宗教歧视是由于被强制参加里程碑教育课程。

source_text: Kenneth Goldman is suing the United States Democratic political action committee Twenty-First Century Democrats (also 21st Century Democrats) and its former executive director Kelly Young.
target_text: 肯尼思・高德曼起诉美国民主党政治行动委员会二十一世纪民主党人（也是21世纪民主党人）及其前执行董事凯莉扬。

source_text: Goldman was formerly the communications director of 21st Century Democrats.
target_text: 高德曼曾是21世纪民主党的传播主管。

source_text: According to Goldman's complaint, three employees of 21st Century Democrats were fired after refusing to attend the Landmark Forum course.
target_text: 根据高德曼的投诉，21世纪民主党的三名员工在拒绝参加里程碑论坛课程后被解雇。

source_text: The complaint asserts that Landmark Education has "religious characteristics and theological implications" which influenced the mission of 21st Century Democrats and the way the organization conducted business.
target_text: 该投诉称，里程碑教育具有“宗教特征和神学意义”，影响了21世纪民主党的使命和组织开展业务的方式。

source_text: Goldman's complaint states that in addition to himself, a training director and field director were also fired after they made it clear they would not attend the Landmark Forum.
target_text: 高德曼的投诉称，除了他自己之外，培训主管和现场主管在明确表示他们不会参加里程碑论坛后也被解雇了。

source_text: Goldman says executive director Young infused Landmark Education jargon terms into staff meetings such as "create possibilities", "create a new context", and "enroll in possibilities".
target_text: 高德曼表示，执行董事杨将里程碑教育术语术语融入员工会议，如“创造可能性”，“创造新环境”和“注入可能性”。

source_text: He also claims that Young "urged" staff members to participate in Landmark Education events outside of the workplace, drove employees to and from Landmark functions, and used funds from 21st Century Democrats to pay for employees to attend those functions.
target_text: 他还声称，杨“敦促”工作人员参加工作场所以外的里程碑教育活动，驱使员工往返里程碑职能部门，并利用21世纪民主党人的资金支付员工参加这些职能。

source_text: Goldman's complaint asserts that he was discriminated against in violation of the District of Columbia Human Rights Act.
target_text: 高德曼的投诉称，他因违反哥伦比亚特区人权法案而受到歧视。

source_text: In a statement in The Washington Times, the executive director of 21st Century Democrats, Mark Lotwis, called the lawsuit "frivolous" and said: "we're going to defend our organization's integrity".
target_text: 在《华盛顿时报》的一份声明中，21世纪民主党的执行董事马克·洛特维斯称这起诉讼“毫无意义”，并表示：“我们将捍卫我们组织的诚信。”

source_text: Landmark Education spokeswoman Deborah Beroset said that the Landmark Forum "is in no way religious in nature and any claim to the contrary is simply absurd," and stated: "While we are not a party to this lawsuit and have no firsthand knowledge of it, we can only assume that we are being used as a legal and political football to further the plaintiff's own financial interests."
target_text: 里程碑教育发言人黛博拉·贝罗塞特说，地标性论坛“根本不是宗教性质的，任何相反的说法都是荒谬的，”并表示：“虽然我们不是这场诉讼的当事人，也没有第一手的资料，但我们只能假设，我们是被当作一场法律和政治足球，来推进原告自己的经济利益。”

source_text: A conference with the federal court judge in the case has been scheduled for June 17.
target_text: 该案件的联邦法院法官会议定于6月17日召开。

source_text: The Washington, D.C. suit began in November 2007, and entered mediation this past March.
target_text: 华盛顿特区的诉讼始于2007年11月，并于今年3月进入调解阶段。

source_text: As of April 15 the parties in the case were due back to court on July 11 to update the court on the mediation process.
target_text: 截至4月15日，该案件的当事人于7月11日返回法院，就调解程序向法院提交最新情况。

source_text: Landmark Education is descended from Erhard Seminars Training, also called "est", which was founded by Werner Erhard.
target_text: 里程碑教育是由沃纳·埃哈德创立的埃哈德研讨会培训，又称est发展而来的。

source_text: est began in 1971, and Erhard's company Werner Erhard and Associates repackaged the course as "The Forum" in 1985.
target_text: est始于1971年，1985年，埃哈德的公司沃纳·埃哈德及其同事将该课程重新包装为“论坛”。

source_text: Associates of Erhard bought the license to his "technology" and incorporated Landmark Education in California in 1991.
target_text: 埃哈德的合伙人购买了他的“技术”许可证，并于1991年在加利福尼亚州注册了里程碑教育。

source_text: This is not the first time employees have sued claiming mandatory attendance at "Forum" workshops violated their civil rights.
target_text: 这不是员工第一次起诉声称强制参加“论坛”研讨会，侵犯了他们的公民权利。

source_text: Many of these training programs, particularly at large corporations, claim to be purely psychological, aimed at improving productivity and morale and loyalty.
target_text: 许多这些培训计划，特别是大公司，声称纯粹是心理学，旨在提高生产力，士气和忠诚度。

source_text: But in fact they are religious, said University of Denver religious studies professor Carl Raschke in a statement to The Wall Street Journal.
target_text: 但实际上他们是宗教信仰，丹佛大学宗教研究教授卡尔・拉什克在给华尔街日报的一份声明中说。

source_text: The DeKalb Farmers Market employees were represented by lawyers for the American Civil Liberties Union.
target_text: 迪卡尔布农贸市场的雇员由美国公民自由联盟的律师代表。

source_text: Transformational Technologies was founded by Werner Erhard, and was not named as a party in the suit.
target_text: 转型技术公司由沃纳·埃哈德创立，并没有被列为诉讼当事人。

source_text: The "Forum" course that the employees claimed they were mandated to attend was developed by Werner Erhard and Associates.
target_text: 员工们声称他们被要求参加的“论坛”课程是由沃纳·埃哈德和他的同事们开发的。

source_text: Employees said that they were fired or pressured to quit after they objected to the Forum courses.
target_text: 员工表示，他们在反对论坛课程后被解雇或被迫辞职。

source_text: The workers claimed that the Forum course contradicted with their religious beliefs.
target_text: 工人声称论坛课程与他们的宗教信仰相矛盾。

source_text: The plaintiffs in the suit included adherents of varying religious backgrounds, including Christianity and Hinduism.
target_text: 诉讼中的原告包括不同宗教背景的信徒，包括基督教和印度教。

source_text: "It's like brainwashing," said Dong Shik Kim, one of the plaintiffs in the case.
target_text: “这就像洗脑，”本案原告之一金东植说。

source_text: The plaintiffs said they lost their jobs after objecting to a "new age quasi-religious cult" which they said was developed by Werner Erhard.
target_text: 原告称，他们是在反对沃纳•埃哈德发展的“新时代准宗教崇拜”之后丢掉工作的。

source_text: The DeKalb Farmers Market denied the allegations, and an attorney for the company Edward D. Buckley III told The Wall Street Journal that employees were encouraged, not coerced, to attend the training sessions.
target_text: 迪卡尔布农民市场否认了这些指控，该公司的律师爱德华·D·巴克利三世告诉“华尔街日报”，员工受到鼓励，而不是被强迫参加培训课程。

source_text: According to The Wall Street Journal, The Forum said it would not sanction workers being coerced to attend its training sessions.
target_text: 据“华尔街日报”报道，该论坛表示不会批准工人被迫参加培训课程。

source_text: The parties in the DeKalb Farmers Market religious discrimination case came to a settlement in May 1989, and the case was dismissed with prejudice in June.
target_text: 迪卡尔布农民市场宗教歧视案的当事人于1989年5月达成和解，该案于6月被驳回。

source_text: The terms of the out-of-court settlement were not made public, but the employees' attorney Amy Totenberg told The Wall Street Journal that the case "has made employers come to grips with the legitimate boundaries of employee training".
target_text: 庭外和解的条款尚未公开，但雇员的律师艾米·托滕伯格告诉《华尔街日报》，此案“让雇主开始认真对待员工培训的合法界限”。

source_text: According to Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, employers must "reasonably accommodate" their employees' religious beliefs unless this creates "undue hardship".
target_text: 根据1964年“民权法案”第七章，雇主必须“合理地容纳”其雇员的宗教信仰，除非这会造成“过度的困难”。

source_text: In September 1988, the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission issued a policy-guidance notice which stated that New Age courses should be handled under Title VII of the Act.
target_text: 1988年9月，平等就业机会委员会发布了一份政策指导通知，其中规定新时代课程应根据该法第七章处理。

source_text: According to the Commission, employers must provide "reasonable accommodation" if an employee challenges a training course, unless this causes "undue hardship" for the company.
target_text: 根据委员会的说法，如果雇员挑战培训课程，雇主必须提供“合理的调解”，除非这会给公司带来“不必要的困难”。

source_text: In October 2006, Landmark Education took legal action against Google, YouTube, the Internet Archive and a website owner in Queensland, Australia in attempts to remove criticism of its products from the Internet.
target_text: 2006年10月，里程碑教育对谷歌、YouTube、互联网档案馆和澳大利亚昆士兰的一家网站所有者采取了法律行动，试图从互联网上删除对其产品的批评。

source_text: The company sought a subpoena under the Digital Millennium Copyright Act in an attempt to discover the identity of an anonymous critic who uploaded a 2004 French documentary of the Landmark Forum to the Internet.
target_text: 该公司根据“数字千年版权法案”寻求传票，试图查明一名匿名评论家的身份。这名评论家在2004年将里程碑论坛的一部法国纪录片上传到互联网上。

source_text: The Electronic Frontier Foundation represented the anonymous critic and the Internet Archive, and Landmark withdrew its subpoena in November 2006 in exchange for a promise from the anonymous critic not to repost the video.
target_text: 电子前沿基金会代表匿名评论家和互联网档案馆，里程碑于2006年11月撤回其传票，以换取匿名评论家不转发视频的承诺。

source_text: Landmark Education itself has come under scrutiny for its controversial labor practices.
target_text: 里程碑教育因其有争议的劳动实践而受到审查。

source_text: The company has been investigated by the United States Department of Labor in separate investigations originating out of California, Colorado, and Texas.
target_text: 该公司已经在加利福尼亚州、科罗拉多州和德克萨斯州分别接受了美国劳工部的调查。

source_text: Investigations focused on the heavy reliance of unpaid labor in the company's workforce, which Landmark Education calls "assistants" and deems volunteers.
target_text: 调查的重点是公司的劳动力严重依赖无偿劳动力的情况，里程碑教育称之为“助手”并认为是志愿者。

source_text: Labor based out of Colorado found that activities performed by Landmark Education's "assistants" include: "office, clerical, telephone solicitation and enrollment, as well as greeting customers, setting up chairs, handling microphones during the seminars and making coffee."
target_text: 科罗拉多州的劳工组织发现，里程碑教育公司的“助理”们所从事的活动包括：“办公室、文员、电话招揽和登记，以及问候顾客、摆好椅子、在研讨会期间处理麦克风和煮咖啡。”

source_text: "Additionally, a number of volunteers actually teach the courses and provide testimonials during and after the courses."
target_text: “此外，一些志愿者实际上教授课程，并在课程期间和课程结束后提供推荐书。”

source_text: The Colorado investigation's 1996 report found that "No records are kept of any hours worked by any employees."
target_text: 科罗拉多调查的1996年报告发现，“没有记录任何员工工作的任何时间。”

source_text: According to a 1998 article in Metro Silicon Valley: "In the end the Department of Labor dropped the issue, leaving Landmark trumpeting about its volunteers' choice in the matter."
target_text: 根据Metro硅谷1998年发表的一篇文章：“最终劳工部放弃了这个问题，让里程碑大肆宣传其志愿者在此事上的选择。”

source_text: Metro Silicon Valley reported that Landmark Education at the time employed 451 paid staff, and also utilized the services of 7,500 volunteers.
target_text: Metro硅谷报道，里程碑教育当时雇用了451名付薪员工，并利用了7,500名志愿者的服务。

source_text: After an investigation into Landmark Education's labor practices by the U.S. Dept.Labor's offices out of California, the company was deemed to have overtime violations.
target_text: 在美国加州劳工部对里程碑教育公司的劳工行为进行调查后，该公司被认定存在违反加班规定的行为。

source_text: According to the Department of Labor's 2004 report on the investigation, back wages of $187,569.01 were found due to 45 employees.
target_text: 根据美国劳工部2004年的调查报告，，发现拖欠了45名员工187,569.01美元的薪金。

source_text: Labor in Texas which concluded in 2005 stated: "Minimum wage violation found."
target_text: 2005年德克萨斯州工党做出结论表示：“发现最低工资违规。”

source_text: "Volunteers (Assistants) are not paid any wages for hours worked while performing the major duties of the firm."
target_text: “在履行公司的主要职责时，志愿者（助理）在工作时间内没有得到任何工资。”

source_text: "The assistants set up rooms, call registrants, collect fees, keep stats of classroom data/participants, file, they also are answering phones, training and leading seminars."
target_text: “助理们设置房间，呼叫注册人，收取费用，保存教室数据和参与者的统计数据，文件，他们还接听电话，培训和领导研组织讨会。”

source_text: Landmark Education agreed to pay back wages for the overtime violation, but did not comply with the overtime violation found by the U.S. Dept.
target_text: 里程碑教育同意支付加班费，但不服从承认美国部门发现的加班费违规行为。

source_text: Landmark Education denied that the "assistants" are employees, though the Department of Labor report concluded: "Interviews reveal that the employees are taking payments, registering clients, billing, training, recruiting, setting up locations, cleaning, and other duties that would have to be performed by staff if the assistants did not perform them."
target_text: 里程碑教育否认这些“助理”是雇员，尽管劳工部的报告总结道：“采访显示，这些雇员在收取报酬、注册客户、记账、培训、招聘、设立地点、打扫卫生，以及其他一些工作，如果这些助理不履行这些职责，员工就必须履行这些职责。”

source_text: According to the 2004 investigative report by Pièces à Conviction in the "Voyage au pays des nouveaux gourous" program, Landmark Education was investigated by the French government in 1995.
target_text: 根据PiècesàConviction在2004年的“Voyage au pays des nouveaux gourous”项目中的调查报告，里程碑教育于1995年被法国政府调查。

source_text: In the "Voyage au pays des nouveaux gourous" program volunteers were filmed through a hidden camera and shown performing duties for Landmark Education in France including manning phones, recruitment and financial work for the company, and one volunteer was shown cleaning a toilet.
target_text: 在“Voyage au pays des nouveaux gourous”项目中，志愿者通过一个隐藏的摄像机拍摄，并展示了法国里程碑教育的职责，包括为公司配备电话，招聘和财务工作，并且一名志愿者被要求清洁厕所。

source_text: Le Nouvel Observateur reported that after "Voyage au pays des nouveaux gourous" aired in France, labor inspectors investigated Landmark Education's use of unpaid volunteers.
target_text: Le Nouvel Observateur报道称，在法国播出的“Voyage au pays des nouveaux gourous”之后，劳动监察员调查了里程碑教育对无偿志愿者的使用情况。

source_text: According to Le Nouvel Observateur, one month after the labor investigation took place the French branch of the company had disbanded.
target_text: 根据Le Nouvel Observateur的说法，劳工调查发生一个月后，该公司的法国分公司解散了。

source_text: A former "Introduction Leader" to the Landmark Forum, Lars Bergwik, has recently posted a series of videos to YouTube critical of the company and its practices.
target_text: 作为里程碑论坛的前“引言负责人”，拉尔斯•伯格威克最近向YouTube上发布了一系列视频，批评该公司及其做法。

source_text: Last night, Adly Mansour, the interim leader of Egypt, announced plans to reform Egypt's constitution and hold a new round of parliamentary and presidential elections.
target_text: 昨晚，埃及临时领导人阿迪·曼苏尔宣布计划改革埃及宪法，并举行新一轮的议会和总统选举。

source_text: The interim president also announced a judicial investigation into yesterday's shooting of at least 51 supporters of deposed president Mohamed Morsi.
target_text: 临时总统还宣布对昨天至少51名被罢免总统穆罕默德·穆尔西的支持者被枪杀一事进行司法调查。

source_text: Mansour plans to form a panel within fifteen days to review and suggest changes to the now-suspended constitution.
target_text: 曼苏尔计划在十五天内组建一个小组，审查并建议对现已暂停的宪法进行修改。

source_text: Those amendments would be voted on in a referendum within four months.
target_text: 这些修正案将在四个月内通过公民投票进行表决。

source_text: Parliamentary elections would then be held, perhaps in early 2014, followed by presidential elections upon the forming of a new parliament.
target_text: 随后将于2014年初举行议会选举，随后在组建新议会后举行总统选举。

source_text: Yesterday in Cairo, protestors supporting Mohamed Morsi and the Muslim Brotherhood were shot outside the Presidential Guard barracks, where pro-Morsi supporters believe the former president is being kept under arrest.
target_text: 昨天在开罗，支持穆罕默德·穆尔西和穆斯林兄弟会的抗议者被枪杀在总统卫队军营外，亲穆尔西的支持者认为这位前总统被逮捕。

source_text: The Muslim Brotherhood claim 53 people died, while the health ministry claim 51 people died and 435 were injured.
target_text: 穆斯林兄弟会声称有53人死亡，而卫生部声称有51人死亡，435人受伤。

source_text: The Muslim Brotherhood claim the attack was unprovoked and those gathered were praying.
target_text: 穆斯林兄弟会声称这次袭击是无缘无故的，而那些聚集的人正在祈祷。

source_text: Colonel Ahmed Mohammed Ali, spokesman for the army, said the group had attacked security forces and were armed with "large quantities of firearms, ammunition and Molotov cocktails".
target_text: 军方发言人艾哈迈德·穆罕默德·阿里上校说，该组织袭击了安全部队并装备了“大量枪支，弹药和莫洛托夫鸡尾酒”。

source_text: The Muslim Brotherhood claimed children were killed in the conflict but Colonel Ali claims the photos being used by the Muslim Brotherhood are actually photos from Syria in March.
target_text: 穆斯林兄弟会声称儿童在冲突中丧生，但阿里上校声称穆斯林兄弟会使用的照片实际上是3月份来自叙利亚的照片。

source_text: Colonel Ali also stated two policemen and a soldier were killed.
target_text: 阿里上校还说两名警察和一名士兵被杀。

source_text: I held my prayer mat in my hand and I started to cover my head with it.
target_text: 我手里拿着我的祈祷垫，我开始用它盖住我的头。

source_text: "But I couldn't stop the bleeding because there was so much blood."
target_text: “但我无法止血，因为血液太多了。”

source_text: The shooting of 51 people on Monday follows violence last week which killed 36 people in Cairo.
target_text: 周一的枪击事件造成51人死亡，上周开罗的暴力事件造成36人死亡。

source_text: The Muslim Brotherhood have asked supporters to protest non-violently and support peaceful vigils.
target_text: 穆斯林兄弟会要求支持者非暴力抗议并支持和平守夜。

source_text: Some within the Muslim Brotherhood movement have suggested they may be outlawed, as they were under Hosni Mubarak.
target_text: 穆斯林兄弟会运动中的一些人暗示，他们可能会像胡斯尼•穆巴拉克统治时期那样被宣布为非法。

source_text: British Foreign Sectretary William Hague said: "It is crucial that there is a swift return to democratic processes in Egypt."
target_text: 英国外交部门威廉·黑格说：“埃及迅速恢复民主进程至关重要。”

source_text: "All sides of the political spectrum should work together for the sake of the country's political and economic future."
target_text: “为了国家的政治和经济未来，政治领域的各方应该共同努力。”

source_text: Former British Prime Minister Tony Blair said the intervention by the army was necessary to prevent "chaos", and said the protests that led to the downfall of Morsi are due to dissatisfaction with the efficacy of government: "When governments don't deliver, people protest."
target_text: 英国前首相托尼·布莱尔表示，军队的干预对于防止“混乱”是必要的，并表示导致穆尔西下台的抗议活动是由于人们对政府的效力不满：“当政府不履行承诺时，人们就会抗议。”

source_text: Blair also blamed the "ideology and intolerance of the Muslim Brotherhood": "People felt that the Brotherhood was steadily imposing its own doctrines on everyday life".
target_text: 布莱尔还指责“穆斯林兄弟会的意识形态和不宽容”：“人们觉得兄弟会正在稳步地将自己的教义强加于日常生活。”

source_text: Blair advised Western governments to "engage with the new de facto power and help the new government make the changes necessary, especially on the economy, so they can deliver for the people."
target_text: 布莱尔建议西方政府“参与新的事实上的权力，并帮助新政府进行必要的变革，特别是在经济方面，以便他们能够为人民服务。”

source_text: "In that way, we can also help shape a path back to the ballot box that is designed by and for Egyptians".
target_text: “通过这种方式，我们还可以帮助塑造一条回到由埃及人设计并为埃及人设计的投票箱的道路”。

source_text: During his trial today, Muslim cleric Abu Hamza al-Masri, denied the claim that he had incited his followers to commit acts of murder.
target_text: 在今天的审判期间，穆斯林神职人员阿布·哈姆扎·马斯里否认了他煽动他的追随者犯下谋杀罪的说法。

source_text: Instead he claimed that he had asked them to fight abroad.
target_text: 相反，他声称他曾要求他们在国外战斗。

source_text: The charges against Abu Hamza include nine counts of soliciting to murder and three of trying to stir up racial hatred.
target_text: 对阿布哈姆扎的指控包括九项谋杀罪和三项试图挑起种族仇恨的罪名。

source_text: The cleric also denies that he was in possession of a document which could be considered to help in the preparation of terrorist attacks.
target_text: 这位神职人员还否认他拥有一份可以被认为有助于准备恐怖袭击的文件。

source_text: The defense barrister warned the jury to ignore the comments of the press as they may have convicted the defendant before the trial has begun.
target_text: 辩护律师警告陪审团不要理会新闻界的评论，因为他们可能在审判开始前已经判定被告有罪。

source_text: Mr. Fitzgerald told them of "exaggeration and misrepresentation by the media".
target_text: 菲茨杰拉德先生告诉他们“媒体的夸大和歪曲”。

source_text: The cleric faces nine charges under the Offences against the Person Act 1861, plus four charges under the Public Order Act 1986 of "using threatening, abusive or insulting words or behavior with the intention of stirring up racial hatred".
target_text: 根据“1861年侵害人身罪法”，该神职人员面临九项指控，并根据1986年“公共秩序法”提出四项指控，即“使用威胁，辱骂或侮辱性的言辞或行为，旨在激起种族仇恨”。

source_text: The possession of video and audio recordings with the intent to be used to stir-up racial hatred, and a final charge of the possession of the Encyclopedia of the Afghani Jihad, which, is said to have information "of a kind likely to be useful to a person committing or preparing an act of terrorism".
target_text: 持有旨在煽动种族仇恨的视频和音频记录，以及持有阿富汗人圣战组织百科全书的最终指控，据称该百科全书具有“对从事或准备恐怖主义行为的人可能有用的信息”。

source_text: Southampton bosses are now contemplating the sale of one of their top players, 16-year old Theo Walcott to the highest bidder.
target_text: 南安普顿的老板们正在考虑将他们的顶级球员之一，16岁的西奥·沃尔科特卖给出价最高的人。

source_text: Walcott and his family are keen to take his current skills to an even higher plataeu, and feel that only this kind of skill could be achieved with Arsenal, despite the fact that other clubs have offered to outbid Arsenal.
target_text: 沃尔科特和他的家人都渴望把他现在的技术提升到一个更高的水平，他们觉得只有阿森纳才能达到这种水平，尽管其他俱乐部已经出价超过阿森纳。

source_text: He is likely to make the move to Arsenal's squad when his current contract runs out on his 17th Birthday.
target_text: 他很有可能在17岁生日合同到期后转会到阿森纳。

source_text: Arsenal manager, Arsene Wenger is as happy about the move as Walcott himself is.
target_text: 阿森纳主教练温格和沃尔科特一样对这次转会感到高兴。

source_text: Despite the fact Southampton has released no details of the proceedings, Wenger let slip that the deal was almost done, after revealing he was buying "two and a half" players; Emmanuel Abedayor, Abo Daiby - Walcott being referred to has the "half".
target_text: 尽管南安普顿没有透露转会的细节，温格在透露他将购买“两名半”球员后，还是透露交易已经基本完成，艾曼纽·阿贝达约尔、阿波·代比，沃尔科特被称为有“一半”。

source_text: When interviewed on his interest in the striker, he revealed that he had been watching him and was a big admirer
target_text: 当被问及他对这名前锋的兴趣时，他透露他一直在关注着他，并且非常崇拜他。

source_text: Two people were killed and two others were seriously injured yesterday when a boulder collapsed onto a house in the German town of Stein an der Traun, south-east of Munich.
target_text: 昨天，当一块巨石倒塌在慕尼黑东南部德国小镇Stein an der Traun的一所房子里时，两人死亡，另外两人受重伤。

source_text: A family of four were said to have been watching television together in the lounge when a large lump of rock, about 50 tons, broke off from a 50 foot cliff above the house.
target_text: 据说四口之家一共在休息室看电视时，一块大约50吨的大块岩石从房子上方50英尺的悬崖上脱落。

source_text: The boulder fell from about 15 metres above the residence and landed on top of the house, crushing it.
target_text: 巨石从住宅上方约15米处落下，落在房屋顶部，将其碾碎。

source_text: The cause of the rock fall is unknown, but police have said that there had been no prior signs that the cliff was unstable.
target_text: 岩石坠落的原因尚不清楚，但警方已经说过，先前没有迹象显示悬崖不稳定。

source_text: A 40-year-old mother and her 16-year-old son were seriously injured and were taken to hospital for treatment, after a rescue operation that lasted into the early hours of the following morning.
target_text: 一位40岁的母亲和她16岁的儿子严重受伤，在一次持续到第二天凌晨的救援行动后被送往医院治疗。

source_text: The task involved up to 250 rescue personnel, some with sniffer dogs.
target_text: 这项任务涉及多达250名救援人员，其中一些人带有搜救犬。

source_text: Joachim Herrmann, the Bavarian Interior Minister, spoke of his thoughts about the incident.
target_text: 巴伐利亚内政部长约阿希姆·赫尔曼谈到了他对这一事件的看法。

source_text: I have never seen anything like this, he was quoted as saying.
target_text: 引用他的话说：“我从未见过这样的事。”

source_text: The Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA), one of the main stock indices in the United States, has broken an all-time closing record, to close at 14,000.41 points which is up 82.19 points (0.59%) from its last close.
target_text: 作为美国主要股指之一的道琼斯工业平均指数（道琼斯工业平均指数）创下历史最高收盘纪录，收于14,000.41点，较上次收盘价上涨82.19点（0.59％）。

source_text: Just 59 days before, the Dow hit an all-time high when it passed 13,000.
target_text: 就在59天之前，道琼斯指数在超过13,000点时创下历史新高。

source_text: This is the first time the DJIA has ever closed above 14,000 since its debut on May 26, 1896.
