target_text: 自1896年5月26日首次亮相以来，这是道琼斯工业平均指数首次突破14,000点。

source_text: The Standard & Poor's 500 Index closed at 1,553.08 points which was up 6.91 points (0.45%) and the NASDAQ Composite Index closed at a six-year high to 2,724.74 points, which was up 20.55 point (0.76%).
target_text: 标准普尔500指数收于1,553.08点，上涨6.91点（百分之0.45），纳斯达克综合指数收于2,724.74点，上涨20.55点（百分之0.76），创下六年新高。

source_text: Breaking News: Iran reported to U.N. Security Council. The IAEA has passed a resolution, by 27 to 3 votes, to report concerns over Iran's nuclear program to the UN Security Council.
target_text: 爆炸性新闻：伊朗向联合国安理会报告。国际原子能机构以27票对3票通过一项决议，向联合国安理会报告对伊朗核项目的担忧。

source_text: Iranian officials have said that Iran will respond by downgrading its cooperation with the IAEA and resuming full scale fuel enrichment.
target_text: 伊朗官员说，作为回应，伊朗将降低与国际原子能机构的合作级别，并恢复全面的燃料浓缩活动。

source_text: Two strong earthquakes shook the north of Argentina and a remote region of the Amazon, in Brazil.
target_text: 阿根廷北部和巴西的亚马逊偏远地区发生了两次强烈地震。

source_text: The United States Geological Survey (USGS) reported that the first earthquake took place at 9:27 (-3 UTC) 165 kilometers from the city of Cruzeiro do Sul, in the Amazonian state of Acre and measured 6.1 degrees on the Richter scale.
target_text: 美国地质调查局（USGS）报告说，第一次地震发生在距离亚马逊州阿克里的Cruzeiro do Sul市165公里的9：27（-3 UTC），里氏6.1度。

source_text: The telluric movement took place at a depth of 632.9 kilometers.
target_text: 这次地震运动发生在632.9公里的深处。

source_text: At 12:34 (-3 UTC) another earthquake with an intensity of 6.2 degrees in Richter scale shook the north of Argentina, and the phenomenon was also felt in some Bolivian cities.
target_text: 12点34分（格林威治标准时间），另一场震级为6.2度的里氏震级袭击了阿根廷北部，一些玻利维亚城市也有震感。

source_text: According to the USGS, the epicentre was the Jujuy region 140 kilometres east of Tarija (Bolivia) at a depth of 247 kilometers.
target_text: 根据美国地质调查局的报告，震中位于塔里哈（玻利维亚）以东140公里处的胡胡伊地区，深度为247公里。

source_text: The authorities have not reported any injuries or property damage.
target_text: 当局没有报告任何伤害或财产损失。

source_text: As Tom DeLay's (Republican member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Texas), alleged ethical lapses began to dominate American political news stories and the Sunday talk shows, have led some Republican members of the Majority Leader’s own party to question the reasoning for his refusal to account for his actions or resign.
target_text: 正如汤姆·迪莱（来自德克萨斯州的美国众议院共和党成员）所说，所谓的道德失范开始主导美国政治新闻报道和星期天的脱口秀，导致多数党领袖所在党派的一些共和党成员质疑他拒绝为自己的行为负责或辞职的理由。

source_text: Last year, in a glimpse of problems yet to surface, the Republican head of the U.S. House Committee on Standards of Official Conduct, or "House Ethics Committee", presided over three admonitions that included offering to endorse the candidacy of a political lawmaker’s son in exchange for votes on legislation.
target_text: 去年，美国众议院官方行为标准委员会的共和党领导人，也就是“众议院道德委员会”，在对尚未浮出水面的问题的一瞥中，主持了三项训诫，其中包括提议支持一位政治立法者儿子的候选人资格，以换取对立法的投票。

source_text: The ethics complaints were originally filed by Democratic Rep. Chris Bell of Texas on June 15, 2004, and began to heat up in the months prior to last year's elections.
target_text: 道德投诉最初是由德克萨斯州民主党众议员克里斯·贝尔于2004年6月15日提出的，并在去年选举前几个月开始升温。

source_text: A Texas grand jury is taking a hard look at Delay’s fund raising practices, and has already indicted three of his close associates.
target_text: 德克萨斯大陪审团正在严格审视延迟的筹资行为，并且已经起诉了他的三名亲密伙伴。

source_text: Last week the Washington Post reported that Mr. DeLay took a trip to Moscow in 1997, financed by lobbyists of the Russian Government.
target_text: 上周，“华盛顿邮报”报道，迪莱先生于1997年前往莫斯科，由俄罗斯政府的说客提供资金。

source_text: Delay’s representative, Dan Allen, told reporters "Congressman DeLay's effective leadership to build and strengthen the House majority is exactly the reason he is being targeted by liberal groups funded by George Soros."
target_text: 迪莱的代表丹·艾伦对记者说：“国会议员迪莱在建立和加强众议院多数派方面的有效领导，正是他被乔治·索罗斯资助的自由派组织作为攻击目标的原因。”

source_text: But Christopher Shays, a Republican from Connecticut, a Republican moderate, told the Associated Press that DeLay’s "conduct is hurting the Republican Party" and "hurting any Republican who is up for re-election [in 2006]."
target_text: 但是来自康涅狄格州的共和党温和派克里斯托弗·谢斯对美联社说，拖延的行为“伤害了共和党”，“伤害了任何准备【2006年】连任的共和党人”。

source_text: The news agency reported that DeLay would look forward to meeting the charges with the ethics committee in a sit-down and blamed all of his problems on House Democrats.
target_text: 该通讯社报道说，迪莱将期待与道德委员会在一次静坐会议上讨论这些指控，并将所有问题归咎于众议院民主党人。

source_text: Senator Chris Dodd, a Democrat from Connecticut, advised his Republican colleagues strongly to "Be careful about how closely you embrace Mr. DeLay, as long as he's there, he's going to become a pretty good target."
target_text: 来自康涅狄格州的民主党参议员克里斯·多德强烈建议他的共和党同僚们“小心你对迪莱先生的拥抱，只要他在那里，他就会成为一个很好的目标。”

source_text: Those Republicans working with the Majority Leader said his ethics are only a problem to Democrats trying to regain power in the House.
target_text: 那些与多数党领袖一起工作的共和党人表示，他的道德规范只是民主党试图在众议院夺回政权的一个问题。

source_text: But the Ethics Committee’s membership is equally divided between Republicans and Democrats.
target_text: 但道德委员会的成员资格在共和党人和民主党人之间平分秋色。

source_text: Other Republicans are starting to get jittery about their reelection hopes if DeLay is allowed to retain power.
target_text: 其他共和党人开始对他们的连任希望感到紧张，如果允许迪莱保留权力的话。

source_text: Tom's conduct is hurting the Republican Party, is hurting this Republican majority and it is hurting any Republican who is up for re-election, Rep. Christopher Shays, R-Conn., told the Associated Press after making similar comments at community meetings in his home district this weekend.
target_text: 康涅狄格州共和党众议员克里斯托弗·谢斯本周末在家乡社区会议上发表类似言论后对美联社表示，汤姆的行为伤害了共和党，伤害了共和党的多数派，也伤害了任何准备连任的共和党人。

source_text: The third-ranking Republican in the Senate, Rick Santorum of Pennsylvania, said DeLay needs to "clear the air."
target_text: 参议院排名第三的共和党人，宾夕法尼亚州的里克·桑托勒姆说，迪莱需要“净化空气”。

source_text: But he thinks everything done by DeLay was "according to the law."
target_text: 但他认为迪莱所做的一切都是“依法行事”。

source_text: I think he has to come forward and lay out what he did and why he did it and let the people then judge for themselves, he said on ABC's This Week, a Sunday political talk program.
target_text: 我认为他必须站出来展示他的所作所为，以及为什么他这样做，然后让人们自己判断，他在美国广播公司的本周周日政治谈话节目中说。

source_text: Now you may not like some of the things he's done, that’s for the people of his district to decide, whether they want to approve that kind of behavior.
target_text: 现在你可能不喜欢他所做的一些事情，那是他所在地区的人民决定，是否他们想要批准这种行为。

source_text: According to reports, only a thin strip of ice connects it to the Charcot Island, and cracks are expanding rapidly.
target_text: 据报道，只有一条薄薄的冰带连接到夏科岛，裂缝迅速扩大。

source_text: This is the largest shelf of ice so far to have disintegrated in the Antarctic.
target_text: 到目前为止，这是迄今为止在南极洲解体的最大冰架。

source_text: In February 2008, the shelf lost 425 square kilometres (164 square miles) of ice, followed by a loss of another 62 square miles in May 2008.
target_text: 2008年2月，冰架上的冰减少了425平方公里（164平方英里），随后在2008年5月又减少了62平方英里。

source_text: During the last year the ice shelf has lost about 1800 square kilometers (694 square miles), or about 14 percent of its size, said Angelika Humbert from the Institute of Geophysics at University of Münster in Germany.
target_text: 德国明斯特大学地球物理研究所的安吉丽卡·亨伯特表示，去年冰架已损失约1800平方公里（694平方英里），约占其面积的14％。

source_text: Scientists say that the shelf, if it detaches from the mainland, won't cause an increase in sea levels, as it is already floating.
target_text: 科学家表示，如果冰架与大陆分离，它将不会导致海平面上升，因为它已经浮动。

source_text: Most scientists believe that the incident is further evidence of global warming.
target_text: 大多数科学家认为这一事件是全球变暖的进一步证据。

source_text: Average temperatures in the Antarctic peninsula have increased by about 2.5 degrees Celsius (3.8 degrees Fahrenheit) in the past fifty years.
target_text: 在过去的五十年里，南极半岛的平均气温上升了约2.5摄氏度（3.8华氏度）。

source_text: Britain's Secretary of State for Health, John Reid, is amongst those calling for the withdrawal of Conservative candidate for Dorset South, Ed Matts, after he doctored photos in campaign literature.
target_text: 英国卫生大臣约翰·里德是呼吁多塞特南部保守党候选人埃德·马茨退出竞选的人之一，此前他篡改了竞选文献中的照片。

source_text: When the photo appeared in Matts' campaign literature, the people in the background were removed from the photo and a slogan calling for the family to be allowed to stay was replaced by one calling for immigration control.
target_text: 当这张照片出现在马茨的竞选宣传册上时，背景中的人被从照片中删除，一个要求允许这家人留在美国的口号被一个要求移民控制的口号所取代。

source_text: The seat, taken by Labour's Jim Knight in the 2001 general election, is one of the most fiercely contested in the country, being Labour's smallest majority.
target_text: 这个席位由工党的吉姆•奈特在2001年大选中获得，是英国竞争最激烈的席位之一，是工党的最小多数席位。

source_text: Conservative leader Michael Howard condemned Matts' behaviour but refused to sack him.
target_text: 保守党领袖迈克尔·霍华德谴责了马茨的行为，但拒绝解雇他。

source_text: Conservative shadow Chancellor Oliver Letwin, from neighbouring Dorset West, said that the message on the doctored photo was consistent with conservative policy.
target_text: 来自邻近的多西特郡的保守党影子大臣奥利弗•莱特温表示，篡改照片上的信息符合保守党的政策。

source_text: 20-year-old pitching phenom Phil Hughes cruised through hitters in just his second start for the New York Yankees, but the end result created even more frustration for the organization and fans everywhere.
target_text: 在代表纽约洋基队的第二次首发的比赛中，20岁的投手菲尔·休斯轻松击败击球手，但最终的结果却给组织和球迷带来了更多的挫败感。

source_text: Hughes retired 19 Texas Rangers without allowing a hit on Tuesday at the Rangers Ballpark in Arlington.
target_text: 周二在阿灵顿的巡游者棒球场击退了19德克萨斯巡游者队，没有一次让球被击中。

source_text: Established big league stars such as Kenny Lofton, Mark Teixeira and Michael Young could not solve the youngster's blazing fastball or sharply biting curve.
target_text: 像肯尼·洛夫顿、马克·泰西拉和迈克尔·扬这样的大联盟球星无法解决年轻人的快速球和急转弯问题。

source_text: Even as his pitch count rose, the Yankees allowed him to keep firing.
target_text: 即使他当投手的次数增加了，洋基仍然允许他继续投球。

source_text: He was fine, manager Joe Torre said of the 2004 first round draft pick.
target_text: 在谈到2004年第一轮选秀时，经理乔·托瑞说他很好。

source_text: We were going to allow him to go 100 pitches last time, so I didn't think that would be a problem.
target_text: 我们上次允许他第100次当投手，所以我认为这不会是一个问题。

source_text: Just when the Yankees thought they found an answer to their early struggles, the organization was treated to an agonizing sight.
target_text: 正当洋基队认为他们找到了他们早期问题的答案时，该组织却被视为令人痛苦的事情。

source_text: After Teixeira fouled off an 0-2 pitch with one out in the sixth inning, Hughes grabbed his leg, having suffered a hamstring injury.
target_text: 泰西拉在第六局0-2时投出一球后被罚出局，而后休斯抓住了他的腿筋被拉伤了的大腿。

source_text: He walked off the mound under his own power, but will reportedly miss 4-6 weeks.
target_text: 他凭自己的力量从球场上走了下来，但据报道他将缺席4-6周。

source_text: He added, "I'm at a point now where our rotation really needs it," referring to his presence on the New York pitching staff.
target_text: 他补充说，“我现在正处在我们轮值的关键时刻，”这是指他在纽约洋基队投手的位置。

source_text: Several Yankees have already voiced their excitement for the righthander's chances in the big leagues.
target_text: 一些洋基队队员已经表示他们对这位右投手在大联盟的机会感到兴奋。

source_text: For his part, Yankees star Jason Giambi compared him to Roger Clemens during Spring Training: "He looks like a young Rocket."
target_text: 洋基球星杰森·吉安穆比在春训时把他和罗杰·克莱门斯相提并论：“他看起来像个年轻的火箭发动机。”

source_text: The Yankees are currently just 10-14, thanks in large part to injuries that have befallen pitchers Chien-Ming Wang, Mike Mussina, Carl Pavano and Jeff Karstens.
target_text: 洋基目前只有10胜14负，这在很大程度上是因为被伤势击倒的投手王建民、穆西纳、帕瓦诺和卡斯滕斯。

source_text: In a related story from today, the Yankees fired strength and conditioning coach Marty Miller.
target_text: 在今天的相关报导中，洋基解雇了力量与体能训练教练马蒂·米勒。

source_text: Reportedly, this was out of general manager Brian Cashman's concern for the alarming number of hamstring injuries so far this season.
target_text: 据报道，这是由于总经理布莱恩·卡什曼对本赛季迄今为止令人担忧的腿筋伤病数量的担心。

source_text: King Abdullah of Saudi Arabia has announced women will be allowed to vote in the country and run for municipal elections there.
target_text: 沙特阿拉伯国王阿卜杜拉宣布，将允许妇女在该国投票并参加那里的市政选举。

source_text: Abdullah made this announcement at the start of a new Shura Council term.
target_text: 阿卜杜拉在一个新的舒拉委员会任期开始时宣布这一消息。

source_text: In a speech, the king said "we refuse to marginalise women in society in all roles that comply with sharia" and so made the decision "to involve women in the Shura Council as members, starting from next term".
target_text: 在一次演讲中，国王说：“我们拒绝将社会上所有符合伊斯兰教法的角色的女性边缘化”，因此决定“从下一届开始，让女性成为舒拉议会的成员”。

source_text: Abdullah clarified that female adults "will be able to run as candidates in the municipal election and will even have a right to vote."
target_text: 阿卜杜拉澄清说，成年女性“将能够作为候选人参加市政选举，甚至将有投票权。”

source_text: Such changes are to be put in place "according to Islamic principles," he said.
target_text: 他说，这些变化将根据伊斯兰原则实施。

source_text: Muslim women, he continued, "must not be marginalised in opinion or advice".
target_text: 他继续说，穆斯林妇女“绝不能在意见或建议中被边缘化”。

source_text: Activists have sought women's right to vote in Saudi Arabia for years.
target_text: 多年来，积极分子一直在寻求女性在沙特阿拉伯投票的权利。

source_text: As it stands, women in Saudi Arabia cannot drive, nor travel without male permission, based on Sunni Islam principles.
target_text: 根据逊尼派伊斯兰教的原则，沙特阿拉伯的妇女不能驾驶，也不能在没有男性许可的情况下旅行。

source_text: Apple Inc. today has introduced the much-anticipated iPhone at the Macworld Conference in San Francisco.
target_text: 苹果公司今天在旧金山的麦客世界大会上发布了备受期待的苹果手机。

source_text: The device appears to be running a mobile version of the Apple operating system Mac OSX.
target_text: 该设备似乎正在运行苹果操作系统Mac OSX的移动版本。

source_text: It is approximately the same size as a 5th generation iPod, it has a 3.5-inch LCD touchscreen display that is used to access all features of the phone including number dial, as well as making phone calls.
target_text: 它的大小与第五代iPod差不多，有一个3.5英寸的液晶触摸屏，用于访问手机的所有功能，包括拨号和打电话。

source_text: The iPhone plays music, movies, displays pictures and is able to connect to a wireless network.
target_text: 苹果手机播放音乐，电影，显示图片，并能够连接到无线网络。

source_text: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.
target_text: 苹果首席执行官史蒂夫·乔布斯走上舞台，将苹果手机从牛仔裤口袋中取出，从而推出了该设备。

source_text: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".
target_text: 在他2个小时的演讲中，他表示“今天苹果将重塑手机，我们今天将创造历史”。

source_text: Today Apple also released their Media Center device - Apple TV.
target_text: 今天苹果也发布了他们的媒体中心设备-Apple TV。

source_text: It will directly compete with Microsoft's Media Center operating system.
target_text: 它将直接与微软的媒体中心操作系统竞争。

source_text: Apple has taken a different approach to the media center market; rather than storing content (such as movies, music and photos) on the device, Apple TV connects to a computer (Mac and Windows) over a wirless network connection and plays all content stored on that computer.
target_text: 苹果对媒体中心市场采取了不同的方法，苹果TV不是在设备上存储内容（如电影、音乐和照片），而是通过无线网络连接连接到计算机（Mac和Windows），并播放存储在该计算机上的所有内容。

source_text: This makes it substantially easier for users to organize their media content.
target_text: 这使得用户更容易组织他们的媒体内容。

source_text: The global war on smoking passed a major milestone on 30 November 2004.
target_text: 全球反吸烟战争于2004年11月30日通过了一个重要的里程碑。

source_text: On that date, Peru became the 40th country to ratify an international treaty to reduce smoking, thus triggering activation of the treaty in 90 days.
target_text: 在那一天，秘鲁成为第40个批准减少吸烟国际条约的国家，将在90天后让条约生效。

source_text: According to the World Health Organization's World Health Report 2003, tobacco consumption is the single leading preventable cause of death.
target_text: 根据世界卫生组织2003年的“世界卫生报告”，烟草消费是唯一可预防的死亡原因。

source_text: It prematurely ends the lives of 5 million people a year, a figure which will double by 2020 if current trends are not reversed.
target_text: 它过早地结束了每年500万人的生活，如果目前的趋势没有逆转，这个数字到2020年将翻一番。

source_text: Tobacco is the only legal product that causes the death of one half of its regular users, more than many illegal drugs.
target_text: 烟草是导致半数经常吸食者死亡的唯一合法产品，死亡人数超过许多非法毒品。

source_text: This means that of the current 1.3 billion smokers, 650 million people will die prematurely due to tobacco.
target_text: 这意味着目前13亿吸烟者中有6.5亿人因烟草而过早死亡。

source_text: A study published in the British Medical Journal in June 2004 followed 34,439 male doctors since 1951 and showed that smokers died on average 10 years earlier than non-smokers.
target_text: 2004年6月在英国医学杂志上发表的一项由34,439名男医生从1951年开始进行的研究成果，显示吸烟者平均比非吸烟者早10年死亡。

source_text: Although the number of smokers has stabilized or fallen in developed areas, it is rising in developing or transitional regions, which contain more of the world's population and already 84% of the world's smokers.
target_text: 尽管发达地区的吸烟者人数已经稳定或下降，但在发展中国家或转型地区，吸烟者数量正在上升，这些地区包含了世界上更多的人口，而且已经占世界吸烟者的84％。

source_text: To fight this increasing health threat, the World Health Organization Framework Convention on Tobacco Control (WHO FCTC) was unanimously adopted by the 56th World Health Assembly in May 2003 following almost three years of negotiations.
target_text: 为了应对这一日益严重的健康威胁，经过近三年的谈判，第五十六届世界卫生大会于2003年5月一致通过了世界卫生组织烟草控制框架公约（WHO FCTC）。

source_text: The treaty aims to reduce both the demand for and the supply of tobacco by setting standards on tobacco price and tax increases, tobacco advertising and sponsorship, labelling, illicit trade and second-hand smoke.
target_text: 该条约旨在通过制定烟草价格和税收增加，烟草广告和赞助，标签，非法贸易和二手烟的标准来减少烟草的需求和供应。

source_text: Studies show that increasing prices through taxes on tobacco products is the most cost-effective way to reduce smoking.
target_text: 研究表明，通过对烟草制品征税来提高价格是减少吸烟的最具成本效益的方法。

source_text: Thus the treaty suggests tobacco taxes or price controls, although it neither suggests specific levels nor requires any taxes or price controls.
target_text: 因此，该条约提出了烟草税或价格控制，尽管它既没有提出具体的水平，也没有要求任何税收或价格控制。

source_text: The treaty requires all countries adopting it to ban, to the extent allowed by their constitutions, all tobacco advertising, promotion and sponsorship within five years.
target_text: 该条约要求所有采用该条约的国家在其宪法允许的范围内，在五年内禁止所有烟草广告，促销和赞助。

source_text: These health warnings must be changed regularly and may include pictures.
target_text: 这些健康警告必须定期更改，也可以包括图片。

source_text: The treaty aims to reduce smuggling by requiring adopting nations to mark all tobacco packages for tracing purposes and to indicate their country of destination, as well as to cooperate with each other in monitoring and controlling the movement of tobacco products and investigating their diversion.
target_text: 该条约旨在通过要求各国为追查目的标记所有烟草包装并指明其目的地国家以及在监测和控制烟草制品的流动和调查其转移方面相互合作来减少走私。

source_text: The idea for an international instrument for tobacco control was initiated in May 1995 at the 48th World Health Assembly.
target_text: 国际烟草控制工具的想法于1995年5月在第48届世界卫生大会上启动。

source_text: But it wasn’t until 1999, a year after the then WHO Director-General, Dr Gro Harlem Brundtland, made global tobacco control a priority, that work on the present treaty began.
target_text: 但直到1999年，也就是当时世界卫生组织总干事格罗·哈莱姆·布伦特兰博士将全球烟草控制作为优先事项的一年后，开始就现有条约开展工作。

source_text: During the year after the FCTC was written, 167 countries signed and 23 countries ratified it, making it one of the most rapidly embraced UN treaties of all time.
target_text: 在“烟草控制框架公约”编写完成后的一年中，有167个国家签署，23个国家批准了该国，使其成为有史以来最快速接受的联合国条约之一。

source_text: The momentum growing around the WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control seems unstoppable.
target_text: 围绕世界卫生组织烟草控制框架公约的势头增长似乎势不可挡。

source_text: It demonstrates the importance placed by the international community on saving many of the millions of lives now lost to tobacco, said Dr Lee Jong-wook, WHO Director-General.
target_text: 世卫组织总干事李钟郁博士说，这表明国际社会重视拯救现在因烟草而丧失的数百万人的生命。

source_text: I look forward to more countries joining the 40 states that are making it possible for this Treaty to become law.
target_text: 我期待着更多的国家加入到正在让这项条约成为法律可能的40个国家的行列。

source_text: Of the countries ratifying the treaty, the largest are (in order of decreasing population) India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Japan, Mexico, Thailand, France, and Burma.
target_text: 在批准该条约的国家中，最大的是（按人口减少的顺序）印度、巴基斯坦、孟加拉国、日本、墨西哥、泰国、法国和缅甸。

source_text: Nations that have signed but not yet ratified include China, USA, Brazil, Nigeria, Philippines, Viet Nam, Germany, and Egypt.
target_text: 签署但尚未批准的国家包括中国、美国、巴西、尼日利亚、菲律宾、越南、德国和埃及。

source_text: The largest non-signers are Indonesia, Russia, Colombia, Tanzania, and Uzbekistan.
target_text: 最大的非签名者是印度尼西亚、俄罗斯、哥伦比亚、坦桑尼亚和乌兹别克斯坦。

source_text: The Himalayan kingdom of Bhutan went beyond the treaty requirements when on December 17 it became the first country in the world to completely ban the sale of tobacco.
target_text: 喜玛拉雅山脉的不丹王国在12月17日成为世界上第一个完全禁止烟草销售的国家，超越了条约的要求。

source_text: Israel has purchased two more Dolphin class submarines which have the capacity to carry nuclear warheads.
target_text: 以色列购买了两艘具有携带核弹头能力的海豚级潜艇。

source_text: Israel already has three older nuclear weapons-capable Dolphin submarines but the new Dolphins have propulsion systems that allow them to remain submerged for longer periods of time, according to the Jerusalem Post, making it harder for them to be tracked by satellite.
target_text: 据“耶路撒冷邮报”报道，以色列已经拥有三艘具有核武器能力的海豚潜艇，但新型海豚拥有推进系统，可以让它们长时间潜在水下，这使得它们更难以被卫星追踪。

source_text: Experts view the purchase as a clear signal to Iran that Israel can retaliate if subjected to a nuclear attack.
target_text: 专家认为此次购买是对伊朗的一个明确信号，即如果受到核攻击，以色列可以进行报复。

source_text: The Iranians would be very foolish if they attacked Israel, said Paul Beaver, a British based defence analyst, speaking to the Washington Post.
target_text: 英国的国防分析家保罗·比弗在接受“华盛顿邮报”采访时说，如果他们袭击以色列，那将是非常愚蠢的。

source_text: According to Beaver, the submarines would provide Israel with both first strike and second strike capability.
target_text: 据比弗称，潜艇将为以色列提供第一次和第二次打击能力。

source_text: Israel already has land-based nuclear-capable ballistic missiles in the form of the Jericho I and II missiles.
target_text: 以色列已经拥有杰里科一号和二号导弹形式的陆基核弹道导弹。

source_text: German officials confirm that the contracts for the new submarines was signed July 6.
target_text: 德国官员证实，新潜艇的合同于7月6日签署。

source_text: The Jerusalem Post reports that they will be operational shortly.
target_text: “耶路撒冷邮报”报道说它们将很快投入使用。

source_text: Israel has never confirmed nor denied that it has nuclear weapons but is believed to have the world's sixth largest stockpile of the devices, with most outside estimates putting their stockpile in the low hundreds.
target_text: 以色列从未证实或否认它拥有核武器，但据信拥有世界上第六大装备库存，大多数外界估计将其储存量降至数百。

source_text: Meanwhile, the Jerusalem Post reports there is a growing mood among Israel's defence establishment that the country will have to act independently to stop Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons as the United States is unlikely to do so.
target_text: 与此同时，“耶路撒冷邮报”报道，以色列国防机构越来越担心该国必须采取独立行动阻止伊朗获得核武器，因为美国不太可能这样做。

source_text: America is stuck in Iraq and cannot go after Iran militarily right now, according to an unnamed official quoted by the paper.
target_text: 据该报援引一位不愿透露姓名的官员称，美国现在陷入伊拉克，不能在伊朗军事上进行军事行动。

source_text: A report by the US House of Representatives' Intelligence Committee released on Wednesday asserts that if Iran arms itself with nuclear weapons, Israel would be pressed to respond militarily.
target_text: 美国众议院情报委员会周三公布的一份报告称，如果伊朗武装自己拥有核武器，以色列将被迫在军事上做出回应。

source_text: "Israel would find it hard to live with a nuclear armed Iran and could take military action against Iranian nuclear facilities," the report states.
target_text: 报告称：“以色列将发现很难与拥有核武器的伊朗共存，并可能对伊朗核设施采取军事行动。”

source_text: Iran has continually maintained that it seeks only to develop nuclear technology for the production of electrical power, though this has been disputed by many nations.
target_text: 伊朗一直坚称，它只寻求开发用于发电的核技术，尽管许多国家对此存在争议。

source_text: Thirty-four Indonesian fisherman have been jailed in Broome in northern Western Australia (WA) for illegal fishing offences.
target_text: 34名印尼渔民因非法捕鱼罪在西澳大利亚州（WA）布鲁姆被捕。

source_text: Seven of the 34 have been jailed in Australia before for previous fishing offences.
target_text: 34人中有7人曾因之前的捕鱼罪在澳大利亚被监禁。

source_text: Their vessels were found hiding in mangroves off the Kimberley coast.
target_text: 发现他们的船只藏在金伯利海岸附近的红树林中。

source_text: The fisherman were found in possession of nearly two tonnes of trochus shell, a shell valued for fashioning into high quality buttons, beads and trinkets.
target_text: 这名渔民被发现拥有近两吨重的特罗科斯贝壳，这种贝壳可以用来制作高质量的纽扣、珠子和小饰品。

source_text: The WA Fisheries Department says the jail terms reflect the seriousness with which the offence is being viewed.
target_text: 西澳大利亚州渔业部表示，监狱条款反映了对犯罪行为的严肃性。

source_text: He says their actions are a serious breach of fisheries laws.
target_text: 他说他们的行为严重违反了渔业法。

source_text: "In the early days, the courts would have given a good behaviour bond for a first offender", he said.
target_text: 他说：“在早期，法院会为第一个罪犯提供守行保释令”。

source_text: That was more specifically for the traditional sail-powered vessels, not these motorised vessels that are coming down and because these are in state waters it is far more serious.
target_text: 那更具体地说是传统的帆船动力船，而不是那些正在下降的机动船，因为这些船在州水域中更为严重。

source_text: Three of the men, who had previous convictions, were fined $15,000 each, with 100 days to pay.
target_text: 其中三人之前有前科，每人被罚款1.5万美元，罚款期限为100天。

source_text: The remaining eight were fined $9000 each and given 60 days to pay.
target_text: 其余八人每人被罚款9000美元，并有60天的时间支付罚款。

source_text: The captains were fined between $9,000 and $15,000 for fishing and taking trochus shell from Australian waters off the north-west coast last month.
target_text: 这两名船长上个月在澳大利亚西北海岸附近水域捕鱼并拿走了圆锥形贝壳，因此被处以9000美元至1.5万美元不等的罚款。

source_text: Three of the captains have been caught fishing in Australian waters before between 1997 and 2004.
target_text: 其中三名船长在1997年至2004年之间曾在澳大利亚水域捕鱼被抓。

source_text: Legal Aid lawyer David McKenzie, says the fishermen were very poor and it was highly unlikely they would be able to pay the fines.
target_text: 法律援助律师大卫麦肯齐说，渔民非常贫穷，他们极不可能支付罚款。

source_text: The magistrate ordered that they spend between 60 and 100 days in jail in Western Australia if the fines were not paid.
target_text: 如果没有支付罚款，地方法官命令他们在西澳大利亚州的监狱中度过60至100天。

source_text: The U.S. government warned private financial services that al Qaeda is planning a cyber attack on the U.S. stock and bank accounts, officials said on Thursday.
target_text: 官员周四表示，美国政府警告私人金融服务基地组织计划对美国股票和银行账户进行网络攻击。

source_text: Homeland Security spokesman Russ Knocke says: "There is no information to corroborate this aspirational threat."
target_text: 国土安全部发言人鲁斯·诺克说：“没有任何信息可以证实这一强烈的威胁。”

source_text: "As a routine matter and out of an abundance of caution, US-CERT issued the situational awareness report to industry stakeholders."
target_text: “作为一个例行事项并且出于非常谨慎，US-CERT向行业利益相关者发布了态势感知报告。”

source_text: The officials said that the attacks are aimed at destroying the databases of U.S. banking and stock market web sites.
target_text: 这些官员说，袭击的目的是摧毁美国银行和股票市场网站的数据库。

source_text: The Homeland Security group claims that the threat was for all of December.
target_text: 国土安全组织声称威胁持续了整个12月。

source_text: A U.S. official said that the threat was posted on an website and called for the attack to avenge the imprisonment of Muslims in the Guantanamo detention camp.
target_text: 一名美国官员说，这一威胁被张贴在一个网站上，并呼吁发动袭击，以报复关塔纳摩拘留营关押的穆斯林。

source_text: The independent and nonpartisan US congressional watchdog, the Government Accountability Office (GAO) called the Food and Drug Administration's decision not to allow over-the-counter (OTC) sales of an Emergency Contraceptive pill, "unusual".
target_text: 独立无党派的美国国会监督机构政府问责局（GAO）称美国食品和药物管理局不允许非处方（OTC）销售紧急避孕药的决定是“不寻常的”。

source_text: They are objectionable for abortion opponents who consider their use to be a form of abortion, though scientific studies (including those by the FDA) classify them as contraceptives.
target_text: 尽管科学研究（包括食品和药物管理局的研究）将其归类为避孕用品，但反对堕胎的人认为它们是堕胎的一种形式，因此它们是不受欢迎的。

source_text: The pill, called Plan B is manufactured by Barr Laboratories and had been approved earlier by the FDA as a prescription drug.
target_text: 这种名为“B计划”的药丸是由Barr实验室生产的，早前已被FDA批准为处方药。

source_text: Barr Laboratories requested that the drug be approved for OTC sale for adults and prescription-only sale for minors.
target_text: 巴尔实验室要求该药物被批准用于成人的OTC销售和未成年人的处方销售。

source_text: The decision to not approve went against the advice given by the FDA's Joint Advisory Committee and its Review staff and led to a GAO investigation into the decision making process.
target_text: 不批准的决定违背了FDA联合咨询委员会及其审查人员的建议，并导致了GAO对决策过程的调查。

source_text: The investigation was requested by 30 House members and 17 Senators.
target_text: 30名众议院议员和17名参议员要求进行调查。

source_text: The GAO found several anomalies in the decision making process.
target_text: GAO在决策过程中发现了几个异常现象。

source_text: The rationale used by Dr. Steven Galson, the acting director of the Centre for Drug Evaluation and Research for rejecting the application was novel and did not follow usual FDA practices.
target_text: 药物评估和研究中心代理主任史蒂文·高尔森博士拒绝申请的理由是新颖的，不符合FDA的惯例。

source_text: The decision was not signed off by the director of the office responsible for the application and the director of the Office of New Drugs, as they disagreed with the "reject" decision.
target_text: 负责申请的办公室主任和新药办公室主任没有签署这项决定，因为他们不同意“拒绝”的决定。

source_text: The GAO also found that the FDA's high-level management more involved in reviewing this decision than in other change-to-OTC applications.
target_text: GAO还发现，FDA的高层管理人员在审查这一决定时比在其他OTC药品变更申请时参与更多。

source_text: The Plan B decision was the only one of 67 proposed prescription to OTC changes to be disapproved, even after advisory committees approved the changes.
target_text: 即使在咨询委员会批准了这些变更之后，计划B的决定也是67个提议的OTC变更处方中唯一被拒绝的决定。

source_text: FDA review staff told the investigators that they were told early in the review process that the decision would be made by high-level management.
target_text: FDA审查人员告诉调查人员，他们在审查过程的早期就被告知，高级管理层将做出决定。

source_text: E-mail and other documents involving the then-FDA Commissioner Mark McClellan were found to have been destroyed "routinely".
target_text: 当时的FDA局长马克·麦克莱伦的电子邮件和其他文件被发现“例行”销毁。

source_text: The acting director cited concerns about the potential behavioral implications for younger adolescents from OTC marketing of Plan-B, given their supposed lower cognitive ability, and that it was not valid to extrapolate data from older to younger audiences.
target_text: 代理导演提到了对计划b的OTC营销对青少年潜在行为影响的担忧，因为他们的认知能力被认为较低，而且不能从年龄较大的观众身上推断出数据。

source_text: However, the FDA had not considered similar "potential behavioral implications" for younger users for other OTC-switches and had previously considered it appropriate to extrapolate data from older to younger audiences.
target_text: 然而，FDA没有考虑对年轻用户使用其他OTC交换机的类似“潜在行为影响”，并且之前认为从年长观众到年轻观众推断数据是合适的。

source_text: On April 4, 2008 Bobbi-Jo Arnold, accompanied by her mother Mary Patricia Moore and other family members, claimed a $3.5 million lottery ticket win in Toronto.
target_text: 2008年4月4日，波比乔·阿诺德在其母亲玛丽·帕特里夏·摩尔和其他家庭成员的陪同下，在多伦多赢得了350万美元的彩票。

source_text: On October 2 the two women were arrested by Ontario Police.
target_text: 10月2日，两名妇女被安大略省警察逮捕。

source_text: Both are facing charges including fraud over $5000, possession of property obtained by crime, false pretenses and uttering a forged document.
target_text: 两人都面临多项指控，包括诈骗逾五千元、持有犯罪所得财物、伪证及使用伪造文件。

source_text: The family dispute has led to Ms Moore (59) filing for divorce from her husband of ten years, Gerald Moore (81), in August.
target_text: 这场家庭纠纷导致摩尔（59岁）于今年8月向结婚10年的丈夫杰拉尔德·摩尔（81岁）提出离婚。

source_text: Mr Moore alleges Ms Arnold received the ticket from her mother, who took it from his bedside table.
target_text: 摩尔先生声称阿诺德女士是从她母亲那里收到这张票的，她母亲从他的床头柜上拿走了这张票。

source_text: He further alleges his wife "manipulated" his medications to leave him incapable to grasp what was occurring.
target_text: 他进一步声称他的妻子“操纵”了他的药物，使他无法掌握正在发生的事情。

source_text: The bail judge's order requires Ms Moore to live with her daughter Arnold in a home she purchased with the lottery winnings, and not with her husband.
target_text: 保释法官的命令要求穆尔女士和她的女儿阿诺德住在她用彩票中奖买的房子里，而不是和她的丈夫。

source_text: A gunman has opened fire on tourists in Amman, the capital of Jordan.
target_text: 一名持枪歹徒向约旦首都安曼的游客开火。

source_text: It is not yet clear whether the man was acting on his own or as part of group.
target_text: 目前还不清楚这名男子是独自行动，还是作为团体的一员。

source_text: The attack took place at 12:30 local time (09:30 GMT).
target_text: 袭击发生在当地时间12：30（格林威治标准时间09：30）。

source_text: The lone gunman shouted "God is great" (in Arabic) before firing up to 12 shots, according to eye witness reports given to the AFP news agency.
target_text: 据目击者向法新社提供的报道，这名枪手先是用阿拉伯语高呼“真主伟大”，然后开了12枪。

source_text: A BBC reporter in the area has said that the area is cordoned and currently being patrolled by armed police.
target_text: 该地区的一名BBC记者表示，该地区已被封锁，目前正由武装警察巡逻。

source_text: Scottish IndyCar driver Dario Franchitti won his second Indianapolis 500 in four years today after leading 155 laps, which is the fourth most in the 99-year history of the race.
target_text: 今天，苏格兰印地赛车手达里奥·弗朗奇蒂以155圈一直领先的优势赢得了四年来的第二个印第安纳波利斯500赛，这是该赛事99年历史上的第四快的成绩。

source_text: Franchitti, aged 37, also won a rain-shortened race in 2007, when the race was stopped after 166 laps due to the inclement weather and he was declared the winner.
target_text: 今年37岁的弗兰奇蒂在2007年的一场因雨缩短的比赛中也获得了冠军。由于恶劣的天气，比赛在跑完166圈后停止，弗兰奇蒂被宣布获胜。

source_text: This temperature made the race the second hottest to the 1932 race, which reached 92° F.
target_text: 这一温度使这场比赛成为1932年比赛中第二热的比赛，达到了92华氏度。

source_text: After a failed attempt to race in the NASCAR Sprint Cup series in 2008, Franchitti returned to the IndyCar series to race for Chip Ganassi Racing.
target_text: 在2008年尝试参加纳斯卡冲刺杯系列赛失败后，弗朗奇蒂回到了印地卡系列赛，参加了奇普加纳西的比赛。

source_text: With this victory, owner Chip Ganassi became the first team owner in racing history to have their drivers win both the Daytona 500 of the Sprint Cup (won by Jamie McMurray) and the Indianapolis 500 in the same year.
target_text: 随着这场胜利，奇普·加纳西队拥有者成为了赛车史上第一个车队老板，他的车手在同一年赢得了短跑杯的代托纳500和印第安纳波利斯500。

source_text: "The milk tastes just as good the second time around here," said Franchitti, referring to the ceremonial winner's milk drink following the race.
target_text: “这附近的牛奶第二次尝起来也一样好”弗朗奇蒂说，他指的是比赛结束后举行仪式的获胜者的牛奶饮料。

source_text: "I just needed to know what the other guys were doing with fuel. "
target_text: “我只需要知道其他人用燃料做什么。”

source_text: " There was a gap behind them and a lot of confusion. "
target_text: “他们之间有隔阂，也有很多困惑。”

source_text: "This means so much after coming back when I went away for a year in 2008 and to come back win a championship and win the Indianapolis 500," he added in an interview in the winner's circle.
target_text: “当我在2008年离开一年并回来赢得总冠军并赢得印第安纳波利斯500时，这意味着很多，”他在获胜者范围内的采访中补充道。

source_text: Franchitti won the race on less than a tenth of a gallon of fuel, after he and his team decided to not pit during the final laps of the race.
target_text: 在他和他的团队决定在比赛的最后几圈不停下来加油之后，弗朗奇蒂以不到十分之一加仑的燃料赢得了比赛，。

source_text: The race ended on a caution after a massive crash between drivers Mike Conway and Ryan Hunter-Reay, when Conway's car got caught onto Hunter-Reay's left outside wheel and was sent airborne.
target_text: 比赛在车手迈克·康威和瑞安·亨特·雷伊的一次大碰撞后出于谨慎而宣布结束，当时康威的车撞上了亨特·雷伊的左外轮，并被送上了飞机。

source_text: Conway's car then hit the track's retaining wall and landed on its front side.
target_text: 康威的车撞上了跑道的挡土墙，并在前面停了下来。

source_text: Medics took Conway out of the car, and he was taken to the hospital with a leg injury.
target_text: 医护人员把康威从车里抬了出来，他的腿受了伤，被送进了医院。

source_text: Finishing behind Franchitti in second place was British driver Dan Wheldon of Partner Racing.
target_text: 排在弗兰奇蒂之后的第二位是英国赛车手丹·威尔顿。

source_text: The last two journalists reported killed at the turn of the year were Syrians; just at a time when protests and violence in the country are escalating, and the Arab League begins its initial assessment of the situation.
target_text: 据报道，今年年初被杀的最后两名记者是叙利亚人；正当这个国家的抗议和暴力升级，阿拉伯联盟开始对局势进行初步评估的时候。

source_text: Shot on December 30, and the first journalist to die in 2012, was veteran journalist Shukri Ratib Abu Burghol.
target_text: 2012年12月30日，资深记者舒克里·拉蒂布·阿布·伯格尔被枪杀，成为首位在2012年去世的记者。

source_text: The senior journalist was shot in the face after arriving home from work at a radio station in Darayya, on the southern outskirts of the capital city Damascus.
target_text: 这名资深记者在首都大马士革南郊达拉亚一家电台下班回家后被击中脸部。

source_text: According to Reporters Without Borders, he died three days after the shooting at Al Mouwsat Hospital.
target_text: 据无国界记者报道，他在Al Mouwsat医院枪击案发生三天后死亡。

source_text: Burghol, 56, was a journalist for about 21 years, working for the newspaper Al-Thawra (The Revolution) whilst also hosting a weekly show for Radio Damascus.
target_text: 现年56岁的伯格霍尔是一名约有21年经历的记者，曾在报纸Al-Thawra（革命）工作，同时还为大马士革电台主持每周一次的节目。

source_text: A source told the Xinhua news agency Burghol had received threats.
target_text: 一位消息人士告诉新华社博格尔已经收到威胁。

source_text: Basil Al-Sayed became the last journalist to die in 2011, shot on December 29 by a sniper in the city of Homs.
target_text: 巴兹尔·艾尔-赛义德于2011年12月29日在霍姆斯市被狙击手击毙，成为最后一名在2011年去世的记者。

source_text: The Arab League has confirmed that the Syrian government have been seen using snipers against protesters elsewhere in Daraa.
target_text: 阿拉伯联盟证实，有人看到叙利亚政府在德拉其他地方使用狙击手对付抗议者。

source_text: The city has been one of the hot spots for protests against Bashar al-Assad's government during 2011.
target_text: 2011年，该市一直是抗议巴沙尔・阿萨德政府的热门地点之一。

source_text: In the last week of the year, the Bab Amr neighbourhood was attacked by the Syrian military and experienced heavy violence.
target_text: 在今年的最后一周，Bab Amr社区遭到叙利亚军队的袭击并经历了严重的暴力事件。

source_text: The 24-year-old camera operator was a citizen journalist who uploaded his videos to video-sharing sites to spread information about the protests.
target_text: 这位24岁的摄影师是一名公民记者，他将视频上传到视频分享网站，传播有关抗议活动的信息。

source_text: Photojournalists and camera operators have been some of the the most at-risk during the Arab uprisings in Tunisia and Libya.
target_text: 在突尼斯和利比亚的阿拉伯起义期间，摄影记者和摄影师一直是风险最高的人。

source_text: Ferzat Jarban — the first known journalist to be killed in Syria — was a freelance camera operator, arrested on November 19 whilst filming protests in Al-Qusayr, Homs Governorate.
target_text: 费扎特·贾班是第一位在叙利亚遇害的记者，他是一名自由摄影师，11月19日在霍姆斯省阿尔·库萨尔拍摄抗议活动时被捕。

source_text: Currently information is hard to verify and reliable independent sources are largely banned or restricted inside Syria.
target_text: 目前，信息很难核实，可靠的独立来源在叙利亚境内基本上被禁止或限制。

source_text: At the end of 2011 Arab League observers had sent out observers to different cities in Syria to monitor the situation, whilst one of its advisers called for the organization to retreat after Al-Assad's government reneged on agreements to halt the crackdown.
target_text: 2011年底，阿拉伯国家联盟观察员派出观察员前往叙利亚的不同城市监测情况，同时其中一名顾问呼吁该组织在阿萨德政府违反停止打击协议后撤退。

source_text: According to Navi Pillay, High Commissioner for Human Rights at the United Nations, more than 5,000 people have been killed during the Syrian uprising, a figure that includes around 300 children.
target_text: 根据联合国人权事务高级专员纳维皮莱的说法，在叙利亚起义期间，有5000多人被杀，这一数字包括大约300名儿童。

source_text: Three journalists are now known to have been killed in Syria.
target_text: 现在已知有三名记者在叙利亚遇害。

source_text: The CPJ reported that 45 journalists were killed worldwide in 2011, whereas — using differing criteria — Reporters Without Borders state that 66 journalists around the world died in 2011, and assert that, by almost every indicator, violence and censorship against international journalists was worse in 2011, up 16% on their 2010 figures.
target_text: CPJ报道，2011年全世界共有45名记者丧生，而无国界记者则用不同的标准表示，2011年全世界共有66名记者死亡，并声称，从几乎所有的指标来看，2011年针对国际记者的暴力和审查情况更糟，比2010年的数字上升了百分之16。

source_text: Two of the victims were young girls aged 14 and 16.
target_text: 其中两名受害者是14岁和16岁的年轻女孩。

source_text: The Moscow Investigative Committee identify the main suspect as former convict Sergei Pomazun.
target_text: 莫斯科调查委员会将主要嫌犯确定为前罪犯谢尔盖·波马赞。

source_text: Authorities said the man, believed to have used a hunting rifle, killed three salespeople and two bystanders, and injured another woman who died of head wounds shortly after the incident.
target_text: 有关当局说，这名据信使用猎枪的男子杀死了三名销售人员和两名旁观者，另一名女子在事件发生后不久因头部受伤而死亡。

source_text: The man left the scene in a BMW, later abandoning the vehicle.
target_text: 这名男子乘坐宝马离开现场，后来把车辆遗弃。

source_text: Local authorities have said the search involves around 1200 police; InSerbia reports a team of 50 troops have also been dispatched to assist with the manhunt.
target_text: 地方当局表示搜查涉及约1200名警察；据塞尔维亚报道，还派遣了一支由50名士兵组成的小组协助进行搜捕。

source_text: Police also warned civilians the suspect may have a gas pistol and a semi-automatic rifle.
target_text: 警方还警告平民，嫌疑人可能有气枪和半自动步枪。

source_text: Regional police spokesperson Alexei Pomorov told AFP, "We do not know whether it was a conflict because there's no one we can ask: everyone's dead".
target_text: 地区警察发言人亚历克谢波莫罗夫告诉法新社：“我们不知道这是否是一场冲突，因为我们不能问任何人：每个人都死了。”

source_text: Police cordoned off the suspect's residence and found an empty weapons-storage safe.
target_text: 警方封锁了嫌疑犯的住所，发现了一个空的武器储藏箱。

source_text: Wall Street had its best finish since November 2008 after a four day rally with the stock market’s indexes seeing their best weekly gain in nearly five months.
target_text: 经过四天的反弹，华尔街股市自2008年11月以来表现最佳，股市指数创下近五个月以来的最佳单周涨幅。

source_text: The major indicators in the NYSE had a gain of around 10 percent.
target_text: 纽约证券交易所的主要指标涨幅约为10％。

source_text: This was mainly due to bank shares bouncing and alleviating fears about the economy.
target_text: 这主要是由于银行股反弹和对经济担忧的减轻。

source_text: The Dow Jones industrial average (INDU) finished on 7223.98, an increase of 54 points from March 12 2009.
target_text: 道琼斯工业平均指数（INDU）收于7223.98点，较2009年3月12日上涨54点。

source_text: The rally began earlier this week after the news from Citigroup Inc. about managing profits during first two months of the year.
target_text: 本周早些时候，花旗集团公布了今年头两个月管理利润的消息后，股市开始反弹。

source_text: The news lessened fears about the country's major financial institutions collapsing after the collapse of Lehman Brothers in September.
target_text: 这一消息减轻了人们对中国主要金融机构在雷曼兄弟9月破产后崩溃的担忧。

source_text: There was more good news from Bank of America Corp. and JPMorgan Chase & Co., who announced that they have had profits in the current year.
target_text: 美国银行和摩根大通则有更多好消息，他们宣布今年已实现盈利。

source_text: Today was a mixed day for the financial sector, Drug makers had some gains and so did General Motors and Berkshire Hathaway , which helped the indexes gain.
target_text: 今天是金融业喜忧参半的一天，制药商有所上涨，通用汽车和伯克希尔・哈撒韦也有所上涨，这有助于指数上涨。

source_text: The value of the US dollar fell against other world currencies, but gold prices increased.
target_text: 美元兑其他世界货币汇率下跌，但金价上涨。

source_text: Prince Harry has today been ordered to return home, after details that the 23 year old's front line engagement was leaked by an American website.
target_text: 哈里王子今天被勒令回国，此前一家美国网站透露了23岁的哈里王子前线服役的细节。

source_text: The details of the Prince's engagement had previously been kept secret by many British and international news agencies, including the BBC and the Associated Press.
target_text: 此前，包括英国广播公司和美联社在内的许多英国和国际新闻机构都对王子服役的细节保密。

source_text: The leak of the information was said to be "regrettable" by the Ministry of Defence, however this meant that Prince Harry was ordered to return home due to fears for his, and the others in his unit's safety.
target_text: 据国防部称，泄密消息是“令人遗憾的”，但这意味着哈里王子因担心自己和他所在部队其他人的安全而被勒令回家。

source_text: Prince Harry will be flown home "immediately", after 10 weeks of front line service.
target_text: 在经过10周的前线服役后，哈里王子将“立即”飞回家。

source_text: During this he worked as a Joint terminal attack controller (JTAC) and was involved in major operations on the frontline against Taliban forces.
target_text: 在此期间，他担任联合终端攻击控制员（JTAC）并参与了对阵塔利班部队的前线的主要行动。

source_text: The media blackout was created to lower the risk to the royal, whilst in service in Afghanistan, and was the first large scale agreement of its kind.
target_text: 在阿富汗服役期间，媒体封锁是为了降低王室面临的风险，这是第一次大规模的类似协议。

source_text: The media groups who signed up to the agreement were rewarded with interviews with the Prince.
target_text: 签署这项协议的媒体团体得到了对王子的采访。

source_text: The leader of the main opposition party, Alaksandar Milinkievič, has been jailed for 15 days in Belarus for taking part in an 'unsanctioned rally'.
target_text: 主要反对党领袖阿拉卡斯姗达尔·密林科维奇因参加“未经批准的集会”而在白俄罗斯被判入狱15天。

source_text: Held every year, it is a traditional forum for expressing political opposition.
target_text: 每年举行一次，这是一个表达政治反对意见的传统论坛。

source_text: At least 6,000 protesters took part, accompanied by riot police.
target_text: 在防暴警察的陪同下，至少有6,000名抗议者参加了活动。

source_text: Demonstrators are said to have asked permission for the rally and to have received authorisation for having the protest on some sites.
target_text: 据说示威者已经要求获得集会的许可，并已获得在某些网站上抗议的授权。

source_text: Protestors say that their protest was on the authorised sites and was not unlawful.
target_text: 抗议者说，他们的抗议是在授权网站上进行的，并不是非法的。

source_text: Conflicts between the opposition party and the government, led by Alexander Lukashenko, have been numerous since Lukashenko was re-elected as President on March 19, 2006.
target_text: 自卢卡申科于2006年3月19日再次当选总统以来，由亚历山大·卢卡申科领导的反对党与政府之间的冲突已经很多。

source_text: The opposition party has organised numerous demonstrations and rallies, and over 1,000 of their members being arrested.
target_text: 反对党组织了许多示威和集会，其中1000多名成员被捕。

source_text: US secretary of state Condoleezza Rice has said the US "condemns this act" and called upon Belarus to act within accepted international principles on the treatment of political opposition.
target_text: 美国国务卿康多莉扎•赖斯表示，美国“谴责这一行为”，并呼吁白俄罗斯在对待政治反对派的公认国际原则范围内采取行动。

source_text: NATO chief Jaap de Hoop Scheffer has also condemned the action.
target_text: 北约首席执行官亚普·德·霍普·谢弗也谴责了这一行动。

source_text: Tuggeranong, Canberra — Nineteen year old Australian Shadow Olympic team member Alice Ingley was attending the second day of the National Archery Championships, a few days before the start of the target recurve event that she hopes to represent Australia at the Olympics in.
target_text: 图格拉侬，堪培拉。19岁的澳大利亚影子奥运代表队成员爱丽丝·英格利正在参加全国射箭锦标赛的第二天的赛程，也就是在她希望代表澳大利亚参加奥运会的射准反曲弓射箭比赛开始的前几天。

source_text: The archer found out about her inclusion on the shadow team the night after returning from a concert by her favorite band, Celtic Thunder, in Wollongong.
target_text: 她最喜欢的乐队凯尔特雷霆队在乌隆贡举办了一场演唱会，回来后的那个晚上，这位射手发现了自己被招入影子队的消息。

source_text: The National Championships have possible Olympic qualification implications for Ingley as there are more girls on the shadow squad than eligible to compete on the full team at the Olympics, so cuts will be made based on performance at the event.
target_text: 全国锦标赛可能会对英格利的奥运参赛资格产生影响，因为影子代表队中女孩的数量超过了参加奥运会全队比赛的资格要求，因此将根据比赛成绩进行筛选。

source_text: From here, the three Australian women chosen to represent Australia will compete at the archery team event qualifier in the United States six weeks before the 2012 London Games.
target_text: 从这里开始，选择代表澳大利亚的三名澳大利亚女性将参加2012年伦敦奥运会六周前在美国举办的射箭团体赛预选赛。

source_text: The possibility of individual qualification at the Games is another important part of the event, as Australia has only secured one spot for a female archer.
target_text: 争取获得奥运会个人参赛资格是参加该项赛事的另一个重要原因，因为澳大利亚只获得了一名女子射箭运动员的参赛资格。

source_text: The only Olympic archery event is the target recurve competition, and it is the only event Ingley will be participating in at Nationals.
target_text: 唯一的奥运射箭项目是射准反曲弓射箭比赛，这是英格利在全国锦标赛上唯一参加的项目。

source_text: She has competed in field recurve but is not competing to maximize her training for Olympic inclusion.
target_text: 她参加过室外反曲弓比赛，但并不是为了最大限度地提高自己的奥运参赛能力。

source_text: She is hyper focused on the sport at the moment, with archery being her life.
target_text: 她此刻高度专注于这项运动，射箭就是她的生命。

source_text: Ingley, who might be related to the historical Robin Hood, is not a stranger to high level international competition, having competed at the 2010 Youth Olympics.
target_text: 可能与历史上伟大的罗宾汉有关的英格利就参加了2010年青年奥运会，因此也不是第一次参加高水平的国际比赛。

source_text: This event was the only time she enjoyed substantial media interest, as otherwise archery is largely ignored by the Australian press.
target_text: 这次大赛是她唯一一次受到媒体的广泛关注，因为澳大利亚媒体基本上忽略了射箭运动。

source_text: She has also competed at the first Youth Olympics, the Junior World Cup and two senior World Cups.
target_text: 她还参加了第一届青年奥运会，青少年世界杯和两届成人世界杯。

source_text: She has also participated at the 2011 University Games in China and the 2011 Olympic Test Event in London.
target_text: 她还参加了2011年中国大学生运动会和2011年伦敦奥运会测试赛。

source_text: She is a member of the Yokine Archery Club in Western Australia.
target_text: 她是西澳大利亚洋子射箭俱乐部的成员。

source_text: Previously, for two and a half years, she had been affiliated with the archery program at the Australian Institute of Sport (AIS), but poor performances by the national team and other considerations led to the AIS dropping their high performance archery sport.
target_text: 在此之前的两年半时间里，她一直参加澳大利亚体育学院（AIS）的射箭项目，但由于国家队表现不佳等原因，AIS放弃了高水平的射箭项目。

source_text: Ingley cannot drive, as she has not had the time to learn because of her archery focus.
target_text: 英格利不会开车，因为她没有时间学习，因为她专注于射箭。

source_text: When not competing in archery, she works for Western Australian Newspapers.
target_text: 如果不参加射箭比赛，她就会为西澳大利亚报纸工作。

source_text: She deferred university for a year to try to realize her Olympic dream, taking time off from Edith Cowan University where she was working on a Bachelors of Arts in History.
target_text: 为了实现自己的奥运梦想，她推迟了一年上大学，从伊迪丝·考恩大学休学，当时她正在那里攻读历史文学学士学位。

source_text: Conservative Party leader David Cameron was last night a victim of crime following the theft of his bicycle.
target_text: 昨晚，保守党领袖戴维·卡梅伦的自行车被盗，他也因此成为犯罪的受害者。

source_text: The Leader of the Opposition in the United Kingdom was out shopping in West London when the incident happened at around 6:30 last night.
target_text: 事件发生在昨晚6点半左右，英国反对党领袖正在西伦敦购物。

source_text: When he came out, the bike along with its chain had vanished.
target_text: 当他出来时，那辆带着链子的自行车不见了。

source_text: He stated that he "would very much like it back" and that to him "it was absolutely priceless".
target_text: 他说他“非常想要它回来”，对他来说“这绝对是无价的”。

source_text: He is also said to have reported the theft on the Scotland Yard online reporting website, but was pessimistic about it being returned.
target_text: 据说，他还在伦敦警察厅的在线报道网站上报告了这起盗窃案，但他对被归还持悲观态度。

source_text: The thieves are said to be a group of teenagers.
target_text: 据说盗贼是一群青少年。

source_text: Cameron's spokesperson said he had owned the bike for five years, and used it regularly to cycle to work.
target_text: 卡梅伦的发言人说，卡梅伦已经拥有这辆自行车五年了，经常骑着它去上班。

source_text: She stated he was "pretty hacked off" by the theft.
target_text: 她说他被偷了“很惨”。

source_text: Amid the confusion surrounding today's London blasts, officials have urged the public to avoid the city if possible to allow emergency services to operate more quickly.
target_text: 在围绕今天的伦敦爆炸事件的混乱中，官员们敦促公众尽可能避开城市，以便让紧急服务更快地运作。

source_text: All rail and underground stations remain closed, although efforts are being made to reopen them.
target_text: 尽管正在努力重新开放，但所有铁路和地铁站仍然关闭。

source_text: Air links are now closed at Stansted, Heathrow, Gatwick and London City airports.
target_text: 现在，斯坦斯特德，希思罗机场，盖特威克机场和伦敦城机场的航空联系已经关闭。

source_text: Those trying to contact friends and family via mobile have struggled as the largest mobile networks, Vodafone, O2 and Orange, have all suffered from full capacity on several occasions this morning meaning voice calls failed.
target_text: 那些试图通过手机与朋友和家人联系的人一直在挣扎，因为最大的移动网络，沃达丰、O2和桔子，今天早上都遭遇了几次满负荷运行，这意味着语音通话失败。

source_text: On the web, websites such as BBC, TfL and the G8 2005 website struggled for a short time at one point this morning under the strain of so many web users visiting them.
target_text: 在网络上，像BBC、TfL和G8 2005网站这样的网站在今天早上的某一时刻，在如此多的网络用户访问的压力下挣扎了一小段时间。

source_text: The national grid has said that it has sustained no damage to the electricity network.
target_text: 国家电网表示，它没有对电网造成任何损害。

source_text: The Royal Mail is warning customers that mail collections and deliveries across the UK will be disrupted because of the incidents.
target_text: 皇家邮政警告客户，由于这些事件，英国各地的邮件收集和交付将被中断。

source_text: Royal Mail vehicles will not be moving in or out of London, or between Royal Mail sites in central London for the remainder of today.
target_text: 皇家邮政车辆今天剩余时间内不会进出伦敦或伦敦市中心的皇家邮政站点。

source_text: At least 25 per cent of the UK's mail moves through London, even if its end destination is elsewhere.
target_text: 至少有25％的英国邮件通过伦敦，即使它的最终目的地是在其他地方。

source_text: Bus services in Zone 1 have resumed as of 16:00 BST.
target_text: 1区的巴士服务已于美国中部时间16：00恢复。

source_text: The following is the second in a monthly series chronicling the U.S. 2012 presidential election.
target_text: 以下是记录2012年美国总统大选的月刊系列中的第二篇。

source_text: It features original material compiled throughout the previous month after a brief mention of some of the month's biggest stories.
target_text: 它简要介绍了本月的一些最重要的故事，其中包含了上个月编制的原始材料。

source_text: At least 15 people are feared dead and at least 60 others are wounded after three explosions in the Hindu pilgrimage town of Varanasi, India.
target_text: 在印度瓦拉纳西的印度朝圣小镇发生三次爆炸后，至少有15人死亡，至少60人受伤。

source_text: At approximately 1230 UTC/0730 EST, the first explosion occurred outside the crowded Sankat Mochan temple.
target_text: 在世界时间12时30分左右，美国东部时间0730分，第一次爆炸发生在拥挤的桑卡德莫陈寺庙外。

source_text: The second took place just minutes later at the Cantonment Railway Station, leaving a crater just outside the stationmaster's room, and the third occurred on the Shiv Ganga Express, which had been leaving for New Delhi.
target_text: 第二次发生在几分钟后，在兵营火车站，在站长的房间外留下了一个坑。第三次发生在开往新德里的恒河特快列车上。

source_text: Officials say that the area has been cordoned off and the injured have been shifted to a hospital on the Benaras Hindu University campus.
target_text: 有关官员说，该地区已经被封锁，伤者已经被转移到本纳拉斯印度教大学校园的一家医院。

source_text: They also report that at least four unexploded bombs were found near a holy site by the Ganges River.
target_text: 他们还报告说，在恒河附近的一个圣地附近发现了至少四枚未爆炸的炸弹。

source_text: According to media advisor Sanjay Baru, Prime Minister Manmohan "has appealed for peace and calm.
target_text: 根据媒体顾问桑杰·巴鲁的说法，曼莫汉总理“呼吁和平与平静。

source_text: Taiwan electronics giant Foxconn has moved to repair its reputation after the suicide of a tenth employee this year, two others having survived attempted suicides.
target_text: 台湾电子巨头富士康今年发生了第10起员工自杀事件，另有两名员工在自杀未遂后生还。

source_text: The latest death came on the same day as Terry Gou, Chairman of Foxconn's parent Hon Hai Precision, opened the Shenzen production facility to the media for the first time.
target_text: 新一起死亡事件发生在富士康母公司鸿海精密董事长郭台铭首次向媒体开放深圳工厂的同一天。

source_text: In the face of accusations that he ran a modern day sweatshop, he showed off employee recreation facilities.
target_text: 面对指控他经营现代血汗工厂，他展示了员工娱乐设施。

source_text: Gou, bowing as an expression of regret, promised to work to prevent such tragedies occurring again.
target_text: 郭台铭深深鞠躬深表遗憾，承诺会努力防止这种悲剧再次发生。

source_text: Although not a household name, Foxconn is the largest producer of electronics components and badge engineered electronics products in the world, manufacturing products for companies like Apple, Hewlett-Packard, Intel and Dell.
target_text: 虽然不是家喻户晓，但富士康是全球最大的电子元件和徽章工程电子产品生产商，为苹果，惠普，英特尔和戴尔等公司生产产品。

source_text: ”Apple is deeply committed to ensuring that conditions throughout our supply chain are safe and workers are treated with respect and dignity”, said Steve Dowling, an Apple spokesperson.
target_text: 苹果公司发言人史蒂夫道林说：“苹果公司致力于确保整个供应链的条件安全，工人得到尊重和尊重。”

source_text: Allen Pu of Fubon Securities said: "Hon Hai needs to resolve the issue because the situation is also negative for Apple and HP.
target_text: 富邦证券的艾伦普说：“鸿海需要解决这个问题，因为形势对苹果和惠普也是不利的。

source_text: Labor activists have criticised conditions at Foxconn's factories as "military-style", with workers working long shifts and not being able to speak to each other.
target_text: 劳工维权人士批评富士康工厂的工作环境是“军事化”的，工人们轮班工作时间很长，彼此之间无法交流。

source_text: However, Foxconn claims that the suicides were mostly the result of relationship problems unrelated to its own management style, and it argues that for a work force so large the number of suicides is small.
target_text: 然而，富士康声称，这些自杀事件大多是关系问题的结果，与自身的管理风格无关。该公司辩称，对于如此庞大的劳动力而言，自杀数量很少。

source_text: Police have found the body of a man they had been hunting in Cumbria, United Kingdom for a series of shootings.
target_text: 警方在英国坎布里亚郡发现了一名男子的尸体，该男子因一系列枪击事件而被警方追捕。

source_text: Shots were fired in Whitehaven, Seascale and Egremont, with a total of thirty different crime scenes.
target_text: 在怀特黑文、西斯卡尔和埃默里蒙特，总共发生了30起不同的犯罪现场。

source_text: The Sellafield nuclear reprocessing plant was locked down for the first time in its history.
target_text: 塞拉菲尔德核后处理厂有史以来第一次被封锁。

source_text: The prime suspect was named as 52 year old local man Derrick Bird, a taxi driver.
target_text: 嫌疑人名叫德里克·伯德，是当地一名52岁的出租车司机。

source_text: The first of Bird's victims was a fellow taxi driver shot in Whitehaven at about 10.30 local time, with the following victims being shot at random as Bird drove down the west coast.
target_text: 伯德的第一个受害者是当地时间10点30分左右在怀特海文被枪击的出租车司机，当时他在伯德沿西海岸行驶，其他以下受害者则是被乱枪枪击。

source_text: Originally driving a Citroën Picasso, he was later said to be on foot when he crashed his vehicle.
target_text: 他最初开的是雪铁龙毕加索汽车，后来据说撞车时他是步行的。

source_text: Members of the public were advised by police to stay indoors, and for those who saw him not to approach him, but to call them.
target_text: 警方建议公众呆在室内，看到他的人不要接近他，而是打电话给他们。

source_text: The manhunt covered the Boot or Scafell Pike area, and at 14:04 BST (13:04 UTC) the Deputy Chief Constable of Cumbria reported that a body believed to be Bird was found in a wood near Boot with a firearm, and that he had turned the weapon on himself.
target_text: 搜捕行动覆盖了Boot或Scafell Pike地区，并于英国夏令时14：04（格林威治标准时间13点04分），坎布里亚副警长报告说，一个据信是伯德的尸体被发现在Boot附近的树林里，尸体上有一支枪，他把枪对准了自己。

source_text: The affected area is popular with walkers and hikers, and currently, many schools across England are on half term, meaning the pupils have no classes.
target_text: 受影响的地区很受步行者和徒步旅行者的欢迎，目前，英格兰的许多学校都在期中假，这意味着学生没有上课。

source_text: British news network BBC News spoke to several eye-witnesses in relation to the incidents, from each of the areas, including Peter Watson of Whitehaven.
target_text: 英国广播公司新闻网就这些事件采访了来自各个地区的目击者，包括怀特黑文的彼得·沃森。

source_text: When I first got here it must have just happened.
target_text: 我来到这里时，肯定是刚刚发生。

source_text: There was a man lying on the ground with police stood over him and a jacket on him, he reported.
target_text: 他说，当时有一名男子躺在地上，警察站在他身旁，身上穿着一件夹克。

source_text: Construction workers and next of kin of deceased workers filed a lawsuit in Tokyo, Japan Friday seeking damages of approximately 6.6 billion yen (about US$64 million) from the government and manufacturers related to illnesses stemming from exposure to asbestos.
target_text: 上周五，建筑工人和已故工人的近亲在日本东京提起诉讼，要求政府和制造商赔偿约66亿日元（约合6400万美元）的损失，赔偿金额与接触石棉导致的疾病有关。

source_text: 178 plaintiffs; including construction workers and family members filed the suit in Tokyo District Court against 46 building manufacturers and the Government of Japan.
target_text: 178名原告，包括建筑工人和家庭成员，向东京地方法院起诉46家建筑制造商和日本政府。

source_text: According to the Mainichi Daily News, the class action suit is the first that has been filed in Japan related to health damages caused by asbestos exposure at construction sites.
target_text: 据“每日新闻”报道，集体诉讼是日本第一起提交的与建筑工地石棉暴露造成的健康损害有关的诉讼。

source_text: The plaintiffs claim that the government and manufacturers knew of the dangers of asbestos inhalation but failed to take proper precautions, including ceasing to promote asbestos as a cheap fire retardant and banning production of the material.
target_text: 原告声称政府和制造商知道吸入石棉的危险，但没有采取适当的预防措施，包括停止推广石棉作为廉价的阻燃剂并禁止生产这些材料。

source_text: They state that after inhaling asbestos in the workplace, 172 people have developed lung cancer or mesothelioma, and that almost half of those afflicted are now dead.
target_text: 他们指出，在工作场所吸入石棉后，有172人患上了肺癌或间皮瘤，而且几乎有一半患者现已死亡。

source_text: Plaintiffs argue that the government and health ministry did not act quickly enough after international organizations issued warnings in 1972 that asbestos could be a carcinogen.
target_text: 原告认为，1972年国际组织发出石棉可能致癌的警告后，政府和卫生部行动不够迅速。

source_text: Plaintiffs also place blame with the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry for sanctioning the use of asbestos under Japanese Industrial Standards, and with the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport for approving the use of materials comprised of asbestos and other substances under Japan's Building Standards Law.
target_text: 原告还指责日本经济产业省依据日本工业标准批准使用石棉，以及国土交通省依据日本建筑标准法批准使用石棉和其他物质组成的材料。

source_text: ”We will do our utmost until we win the suit”, said Kazuo Miyajima, 78, who heads the group of plaintiffs.
target_text: “我们将尽最大努力，直到我们赢得诉讼”，原告团长78岁的宫川一夫说。

source_text: Lawyers for the plaintiffs released a statement saying: "We seek complete relief for the victims by clarifying the liability of the state and the manufacturers."
target_text: 原告律师发表声明称：“我们通过明确国家和制造商的责任，为受害者寻求完全的救济。”

source_text: Approximately 40 construction workers from Kanagawa Prefecture plan to file a similar lawsuit in June in Yokohama District Court.
target_text: 来自神奈川县的大约40名建筑工人计划在6月份在横滨地方法院提起类似的诉讼。

source_text: After a 2005 revelation that residents who lived near a factory in Amagasaki, Hyogo Prefecture developed diseases related to asbestos, the government implemented a law in 2006 which provides monetary assistance to asbestos victims and relatives of deceased family members.
target_text: 2005年，兵库县尼崎市一家工厂附近的居民被曝出与石棉有关的疾病，此后政府在2006年实施了一项法律，为石棉受害者和已故家庭成员的亲属提供经济援助。

source_text: The plaintiffs argue that the amount of financial assistance given to families and victims of asbestos-related diseases is not sufficient.
target_text: 原告认为，向石棉相关疾病的家庭和受害者提供的经济援助不够。

source_text: Asbestos has been used in Japan as a fire retardant, for sound absorption, and for insulation.
target_text: 石棉在日本被用作阻燃剂、吸声材料和绝缘材料。

source_text: It was mixed in concrete and water and sprayed on walls and ceilings, but the practice of spraying asbestos in this manner was banned in Japan in 1975.
target_text: 它混合在混凝土和水里，喷洒在墙壁和天花板上，但这种喷洒石棉的做法在1975年被日本禁止。

source_text: After a press conference in London from the Metropolitan Police and Transport for London, more details are emerging about the attacks in London on Thursday.
target_text: 在伦敦大都会警察局和伦敦交通局举行的伦敦新闻发布会后，有关周四伦敦袭击的更多细节正在披露。

source_text: Data from the Underground system's power and control systems have revealed that all three bombs went off within 50 seconds of each other, at 8.50am, with the managing director of Transport for London, Tim O'Toole saying the bombs went "bang bang bang, very close together".
target_text: 来自地铁系统的电力和控制系统的数据显示，上午8点50分，这三枚炸弹在50秒内相继爆炸，伦敦交通总监蒂姆·奥图尔说，炸弹“砰砰砰，先后时间非常近”。

source_text: The first bomb to detonate was on the Liverpool Street train soon after it left for Aldgate on the Circle line, seconds before the others.
target_text: 第一颗爆炸的炸弹是利物浦街的一列火车，它在开往奥尔盖特的环线上，比其他炸弹早了几秒钟。

source_text: The blast tripped out the power system, visible in the control room.
target_text: 爆炸摧毁了电力系统，在控制室可见。

source_text: The first call the police received that morning reported "a bang" at Aldgate East, coming within a minute of the blast.
target_text: 警方当天早上接到的第一个电话报告说，爆炸发生后不到一分钟，奥尔德盖特东部发生了“一声巨响”。

source_text: The Edgware Road train, leaving for Paddington and also on the Circle, exploded opposite a train coming from the other direction, making people think at first that it was a derailment.
target_text: 埃奇韦尔公路上开往帕丁顿的火车也在环形车道上，爆炸发生在一辆从另一个方向驶来的火车对面，起初人们以为这是脱轨。

source_text: The first call to the Police spoke not of an explosion, but of a person falling under the wheels of the train.
target_text: 警察接到的第一个电话里说的不是爆炸，而是一个人掉进了火车车轮下。

source_text: The confirmation of a bomb did not come until 9.17am, but by that time the emergency services were already on scene.
target_text: 直到上午9点17分才确认有炸弹，但那时应急服务已经到位。

source_text: Transport for London's new TrackerNet software is fully opertational on the Circle line, which allows for precise tracking of trains, but is not yet fully installed on the Piccadilly line.
target_text: 伦敦交通局新推出的TrackerNet软件在伦敦环线上完全可以运行，该软件可以对列车进行精确跟踪，但皮卡迪利线上尚未完全安装。

source_text: The first indication of the Piccadilly line bomb was when the tunnel telephone system wires were cut by the blast, an event logged by other software.
target_text: 皮卡迪利线爆炸案的第一个迹象是，隧道电话系统的电线被爆炸切断，其他软件记录了这一事件。

source_text: The cutting of the lines then tripped out the track current.
target_text: 然后切割线路使轨道电流跳闸。

source_text: The tunnel itself suffered only slight damage and is safe, but the train - which was packed with commuters heading for Russell Square - is very badly damaged.
target_text: 隧道本身只受到了轻微的损坏，而且是安全的，但是这列满载着通勤者前往罗素广场的火车却受到了严重的损坏。

source_text: London Underground declared a 'code Amber' within minutes, moving trains to platforms and opening all doors.
target_text: 伦敦地铁在几分钟内就发出了“黄色信号”，将列车移至站台，并打开所有车门。

source_text: A 'code Red' - full evacuation - was set at around 9.15am.
target_text: 上午9点15分左右设置了“红色警戒”，即全面疏散。

source_text: O'Toole described the decision to evacuate as being "very grave, not taken lightly".
target_text: 奥图尔形容撤离的决定是“非常严肃的，不是轻率的”。

source_text: When questioned as to whether everything possible had been done on the day to save lives, the managing director of Transport for London was "very proud" of the choices made that morning.
target_text: 当被问及当天是否采取了一切可能的措施来拯救生命时，伦敦交通局的董事总经理对当天上午做出的选择感到“非常自豪”。

source_text: As investigations continue, all bodies have been removed from the sub-surface Circle line trains, but the carriages themselves are still in situ while a painstaking forensic investigation takes place.
target_text: 随着调查的继续，所有尸体都已从地下环线列车上运走，但车厢本身仍在原地，目前正在进行艰苦的法医调查。

source_text: Currently, work is on-going to retrieve bodies and forensic evidence from the carriage of the train in the deep tunnel of the Piccadilly line near King's Cross.
target_text: 目前，在靠近国王十字车站的皮卡迪利线的深隧道中，正在进行从火车车厢中提取尸体和法医证据的工作。

source_text: Teams of rescue workers looking for human remains are working alongside forensics experts in a "meticulous" search to find evidence.
target_text: 寻找人类遗骸的救援人员团队正在与法医专家一起进行“细致”搜索，寻找证据。

source_text: Conditions are described as being very difficult, with high temperatures and lots of dust.
target_text: 据描述，那里的条件非常困难，有高温和大量灰尘。

source_text: Work was halted over Friday night when conditions became too bad, and resumed this morning.
target_text: 工作在周五晚上由于情况变得非常糟糕而暂停，今天早上恢复。

source_text: The exact number of bodies still in the wrecked carriage is unknown.
target_text: 目前尚不清楚失事车厢内的确切遇难者人数。

source_text: Access from King's Cross is impossible, so workers are taking the longer route from Russell Square station to get to the front of the train.
target_text: 从国王十字车站进入火车站是不可能的，所以工人们从罗素广场站走较长的路线到达列车前部。

source_text: Police have revealed that the bombs were 'high explosives' - not homemade.
target_text: 警方透露，这些炸弹是“烈性炸药”，不是自制的。

source_text: However they are declining to be specific about their composition as the information could be useful when they interrogate suspects.
target_text: 但是，他们拒绝具体说明他们的组成，因为这些资料在审问嫌疑犯时可能有用。

source_text: Police believe the use of timers more likely than suicide bombings as the blasts were so closely timed, but are not ruling out anything.
target_text: 警方认为使用定时炸弹比自杀式爆炸更有可能，因为爆炸发生的时间非常接近，但不排除任何可能性。

source_text: An investigation by the BBC has revealed that millions of dollars in famine relief aid money, including the money raised from the charity supergroup Band Aid and the Live Aid concert held by Bob Geldof, was "siphoned off" by Ethiopian rebels to buy weapons.
target_text: BBC的一项调查显示，数百万美元的饥荒援助资金，包括慈善组织“超级乐队援助”筹集的资金，以及鲍勃·格尔多夫举办的现场援助音乐会，被埃塞俄比亚叛军“挪用”去购买武器。

source_text: One rebel said that at least US$ 95 million (£63 million) from — Western governments and private charities — was diverted into rebel coffers.
target_text: 一名叛乱分子表示，至少有9500万美元（6300万英镑）来自西方政府和私人慈善机构，被转移到反叛分子的库房中。

source_text: This was also noted in a declassified Central Intelligence Agency assessment of the famine situation titled Ethiopia: Political and Security Impact of the Drought, in which the report states, "Some funds that insurgent organizations are raising for relief operations, as a result of increased world publicity, are almost certainly being diverted for military purposes."
target_text: 在一份题为《埃塞俄比亚：干旱对政治和安全的影响》的对饥荒情况的解密中央情报局评估报告中也提到了这一点，报告指出，“由于世界宣传的增加，一些叛乱组织为救援行动筹集的资金几乎肯定被转移到军事目的。”

source_text: During the 1984–1985 famine, Ethiopia was fighting Eritrean and Tigray rebels in those two northern provinces, although Eritrea has since gained its independence.
target_text: 在1984-1985年的饥荒期间，埃塞俄比亚正在这两个北部省份与厄立特里亚和提格雷叛乱分子作战，尽管厄立特里亚已经获得独立。

source_text: Since the countryside was out of the government's control, aid was brought in from neighboring Sudan.
target_text: 由于农村不受政府控制，援助来自邻国苏丹。

source_text: Some aid came in the form of food, while other aid came as cash which would be used by the aid agencies to buy grain from Ethiopian farmers.
target_text: 一些援助以食物形式提供，而其他援助则来自援助机构用来从埃塞俄比亚农民那里购买粮食的现金。

source_text: Rebels would disguise themselves as traders and merchants to get their hands on the currency.
target_text: 反叛者会把自己伪装成交易商和商人来获取货币。

source_text: I was given clothes to make me look like a Muslim merchant.
target_text: 我得到的衣服让我看起来像一个穆斯林商人。

source_text: This was a trick for the NGOs, said Gebremedhin Araya, a senior member of the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF).
target_text: Tigray人民解放阵线（TPLF）的高级成员格布雷梅丁·阿拉雅说，这对非政府组织来说是个骗局。

source_text: Peberdy is seen in a photo with Araya buying grain.
target_text: 佩伯迪与阿拉雅在一张购买谷物的照片中出现。

source_text: Araya said that only some of the sacks were filled with grain; the rest were filled with sand.
target_text: 阿拉雅说，只有一些麻袋里装满了谷物，其余的都是沙子。

source_text: The transaction was overseen by a member of the Relief Society of Tigray (REST), the humanitarian wing of the TPLF.
target_text: 该交易由蒂格雷救济协会（REST）的成员监督，该协会是TPLF的人道主义部门。

source_text: The money was then given to TPLF leaders, including chairman Meles Zenawi, who has been Prime Minister of Ethiopia since 1991.
target_text: 这笔钱随后交给了TPLF领导人，其中包括自1991年以来一直担任埃塞俄比亚总理的梅莱斯泽纳维主席。

source_text: Peberdy disputes the claims that he was duped, saying, "As far as we were concerned and as far as we were told by REST, the people we were dealing with were merchants."
target_text: 佩伯迪反驳了他受骗的说法，他说：“就我们而言，就别人告诉我们的而言，我们所打交道的人都是商人。”

source_text: He added, "It's 25 years since this happened, and in the 25 years it's the first time anybody has claimed such a thing."
target_text: 他补充道，“自从这件事发生25年以来，25年来，这是有史以来第一次声称这样的事情。”

source_text: However, an exiled TPLF commander who lives in the Netherlands, Aregawi Berhe, is backing Araya's story.
target_text: 然而，一个流亡在荷兰的TPLF指挥官，阿雷加维·贝赫，支持阿拉雅的故事。

source_text: He said the group got their hands on over US$100 million (£66 million) of which 95% went to buy weapons and build up a hardliner Marxist party inside the rebel movement.
target_text: 他说，该团体获得了超过1亿美元（6600万英镑）的资金，其中95％用于购买武器并在反叛运动中建立强硬派马克思主义政党。

source_text: Berhe told the BBC that the group would put on a "drama" to get the money.
target_text: 贝尔赫告诉英国广播公司，该组织将上演“一部剧”来募集这笔钱。

source_text: Nick Guttmann, who is director of emergency relief operations for the group, says the "story has to be put into context".
target_text: 该组织的紧急救援行动负责人尼克·古特曼表示，“必须将时间放到背景之中”。

source_text: ”We were working in a major conflict, there was a massive famine and people on all sides were suffering”, Guttmann said, adding, "Both the rebels and the government were using innocent civilians to further their own political ends."
target_text: 古特曼说：“我们当时正在处理一场重大冲突，那里发生了大规模饥荒，各方人民都在受苦。反叛分子和政府都在利用无辜平民来达到自己的政治目的。”

source_text: Bob Geldof, the Irish rock star who help organized Live Aid, said, "We are talking about a disgruntled, exiled general.”
target_text: 帮助组织“生命援助”的爱尔兰摇滚明星鲍勃·格尔多夫说：“我们谈论的是一位心怀不满的流亡将军。”

source_text: The essence of the report also is not just about Live Aid.
target_text: 报告的实质还不仅仅是关于生命援助。

source_text: It's that all monies going into Tigray — that would be Oxfam, Save the Children, UNICEF and Christian Aid — somehow, we were all duped and gulled.
target_text: 所有的钱都捐给了蒂格雷，包括牛津饥荒救济委员会、救助儿童会、联合国儿童基金会和基督教救助会，不知怎么的，我们都被骗了。

source_text: The 4,500 attendees include government delegates from 182 governments, representatives from business and industry, environmental organizations and research institutions.
target_text: 4,500名与会者包括来自182个政府的政府代表，工商界代表，环境组织和研究机构。

source_text: He criticised the outgoing head of the U.N.'s climate secretariat, Yvo de Boer, and the European Union's climate commissioner Connie Hedegaard for their scepticism.
target_text: 他批评即将离任的联合国气候秘书处负责人伊沃·德布尔和欧盟气候专员康妮·赫泽高的怀疑态度。

source_text: Negotiating under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change , the next negotiating session is scheduled to take place in August, followed by another, final one-week intersessional meeting, before Cancún.
target_text: 根据《联合国气候变化框架公约》进行的谈判，下一届谈判会议定于8月举行，随后在坎昆会议之前举行为期一周的最后一次休会会议。

source_text: The two working groups are the Ad Hoc Working Group on Long-Term Cooperative Action and the Ad Hoc Working Group on Further Commitments for Annex .
target_text: 这两个工作组是长期合作行动问题特设工作组和附件进一步承诺问题特设工作组。

source_text: These groups were specifically designed to negotiate a long-term response to climate change.
target_text: 这些小组专门用于谈判对气候变化的长期反应。

source_text: The AWG-LCA is the negotiating group tasked to deliver a new "COP16 negotiative text" ahead of the June negotiating session.
target_text: AWG-LCA是一个谈判小组，其任务是在6月谈判会议之前提交新的“COP16谈判案文”。

source_text: The AWG-KP is to focus on emissions reduction commitments for the 37 industrialised countries that have ratified the Kyoto Protocol for the period beyond 2012.
target_text: AWG-KP将重点关注已批准2012年以后“京都议定书”的37个工业化国家的减排承诺。

source_text: There are also two UNFCCC standing committees meetings, the Subsidiary Body for Scientific and Technological Advice and the Subsidiary Body for Implementation .
target_text: 还有两个UNFCCC常设委员会会议，即附属科学技术咨询机构和附属履行机构。

source_text: The conference is officially referred to as the 16th session of the Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) and the 6th session of the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to the Kyoto Protocol.
target_text: 会议正式名称为《联合国气候变化框架公约》第十六届缔约方会议和《京都议定书》缔约方会议第六届缔约方会议。

source_text: European Union (EU) Agriculture Commissioner Mariann Fischer Boel pledged €280 (US$418) million in aid to dairy farmers Monday, after weeks of protests.
target_text: 抗议发生的几周后欧洲联盟（欧盟）农业专员玛丽安·费舍尔·波尔周一承诺向奶农提供2.8亿欧元（4.18亿美元）的援助。

source_text: She said she would "empty her pockets", but that was as much as she could offer; "I don't have a special account in Switzerland or anywhere else," she commented at an EU farm conference in Luxembourg where farmers were holding their third protest in as many weeks.
target_text: 她说她会“掏空口袋”，但这是她所能提供的一切。“我在瑞士或其他任何地方都没有特别账户，”她在卢森堡举行的欧盟农场会议上评论说，在那里，农民们举行了长达数周的第三次抗议。

source_text: A recent demonstration in Belgium saw farmers dump three million litres (660,000 gallons) of milk on fields — and requests from 21 EU member states for emergency aid.
target_text: 比利时最近的一次示威活动看到农民在田地上倾倒了300万升（660,000加仑）牛奶，并要求21个欧盟成员国提供紧急援助。

source_text: This is in addition to the announcement in September that the EU would modify rules to allow temporary state aid payments; each farmer could receive a maximum of €15,000.
target_text: 此外，9月份宣布欧盟将修改允许临时国家援助付款的规则，每个农民最多可获得15,000欧元。

source_text: Last November, EU agriculture ministers planned to abolish milk quotas completely by 2015.
target_text: 去年11月，欧盟农业部长计划到2015年完全取消牛奶配额。

source_text: The quotas are aimed at supporting prices, as the demand for dairy products has plummeted throughout the economic crisis; in some cases, prices have halved since 2007.
target_text: 配额旨在支持价格，因为在整个经济危机期间乳制品需求急剧下降，在某些情况下，价格自2007年以来减半。

source_text: These measures seek to alleviate temporary problems, but the commission still intends to end the quota system for milk, and reduce market intervention which helps support prices.
target_text: 这些措施旨在缓解暂时性问题，但该委员会仍打算终止牛奶配额制度，并减少有助于支撑价格的市场干预。

source_text: Michael Ryan, a messenger at the office of the prime minister, has been identified as the mole who leaked confidential papers to Telecom.
target_text: 英国首相办公室的信使迈克尔•瑞安已被确认为向电信公司泄露机密文件的内奸。

source_text: Michael Ryan, May 2, was told to shred a document, but instead of doing that he took it and gave it to Telecom's Group Financial Controller Peter Garty, a close friend.
target_text: 5月2日，迈克尔·瑞安被告知撕碎一份文件，但他没有这么做，而是把文件交给了电信集团的财务总监、他的密友彼得·加蒂。

source_text: He gave it to Peter Garty because he thought he would find it interesting.
target_text: 他把它给了彼得·加蒂，因为他认为他会觉得它很有趣。

source_text: Michael Ryan told Peter Garty to not make a copy of it.
target_text: 迈克尔·瑞安告诉彼得·加蒂不要复制它。

source_text: Telecom shares fell from $5.65 to $4.65 following the disclosure, wiping about $2 billion off the value of the company.
target_text: 披露后，电信股价从5.65美元下跌至4.65美元，该公司股价下跌约20亿美元。

source_text: The States Service Commission has passed the case onto the police.
target_text: 州服务委员会已将此案移交警方处理。

source_text: Authorities in western Kenya have arrested 19 suspects in connection with a spree of recent mob killings.
target_text: 肯尼亚西部当局逮捕了19名涉嫌与最近暴徒杀戮事件有关的嫌疑人。

source_text: Earlier this week 11 elderly people had been burned on suspicion of witchcraft.
target_text: 本周早些时候，11名老人因涉嫌巫术而被烧死。

source_text: The 8 female and 3 male victims were aged 80 to 96 according to BBC News.
target_text: 据BBC新闻报道，8名女性和3名男性受害者年龄在80至96岁之间。

source_text: Belief in witchcraft is widespread in the Kisii District of Nyanza Province and attacks against purported witches had happened before, but this week's attacks targeted an unusually large number of people.
target_text: 在尼扬扎省的基西地区，对巫术的信仰十分普遍，对传说中的女巫的袭击以前也发生过，但本周的袭击针对的是数量异常庞大的人群。

source_text: Police launched an investigation into the incident and have deployed additional personnel to guard the area to prevent revenge attacks.
target_text: 警方已对该事件展开调查，并部署了额外人员来保护该地区，以防止报复袭击。

source_text: Approximately 300 young men were reportedly responsible for the attacks.
target_text: 据报道，大约有300名年轻男子应对袭击事件负责。

source_text: According to deputy police spokesman Charles Owino, those who can be proven to have had direct involvement in the killings would be charged with murder.
target_text: 据警方副发言人查尔斯·奥维诺称，那些被证明直接参与谋杀的人将被控谋杀罪。

source_text: Fourteen bodies were found on Thursday by police in Baghdad, Iraq.
target_text: 星期四，伊拉克巴格达的警察发现了14具尸体。

source_text: According to the Iraq Interior Ministry, the bodies appeared to have been tortured.
target_text: 据伊拉克内政部称，这些尸体似乎遭受了酷刑。

source_text: Each one had been blind-folded and had their hands tied behind their back.
target_text: 每个人都被蒙住眼睛，双手被绑在背后。

source_text: The men, all civilians, were stabbed repeatedly, had marks on their wrists which suggests their wrists were tied together, and all of the victims had gunshot wounds to their heads.
target_text: 这些人都是平民，他们被反复刺伤，手腕上有伤痕，这表明他们的手腕是绑在一起的，所有受害者头上都有枪伤。

source_text: Eleven of the men were found in the back of a truck.
target_text: 其中11人在一辆卡车的后部被发现。

source_text: Police do not yet know the identities of the men.
target_text: 警方尚不清楚这些人的身份。

source_text: A report released tonight by the Health and Safety Executive has confirmed that there is a "strong possibility" that the cause of the recent foot-and-mouth outbreak is contamination, most probably by human movement, from a nearby research facility in Guildford, Surrey, UK.
target_text: 英国卫生与安全管理局今晚发布的一份报告证实，最近口蹄疫爆发的“极有可能”是来自英国萨里郡吉尔福德附近一家研究机构的污染造成的，很可能是人类活动造成的。

source_text: The labs in Pirbright, where both private firm Merial and the governmental Institute for Animal Health operate, have been subject to ongoing investigations since the discovery of a new foot-and-mouth outbreak on Friday.
target_text: 自上周五发现口蹄疫爆发以来，位于皮布莱特的实验室一直在接受调查，这家实验室是由私人公司Merial和政府动物卫生研究生构共同经营。
