source_text: The strain of the disease had already been identified as an O1 BFS67-like virus, which was isolated in a 1967 outbreak and was being used at the labs for research and the production of vaccines.
target_text: 这种疾病的菌株已被鉴定为O1 BFS67样病毒，该病毒于1967年爆发时被分离出来，并在实验室用于研究和生产疫苗。

source_text: It is not yet known whether the virus escaped from the Merial or the IAH lab.
target_text: 目前尚不清楚该病毒是否从Merial或IAH实验室逃脱。

source_text: A protection zone has been set up around the affected areas and rules preventing the movement of livestock have been introduced throughout the country, with the aim of stopping further spread of the contagious disease.
target_text: 在疫区周围设立了保护区，并在全国各地实施了防止牲畜流动的规定，目的是制止这种传染病的进一步传播。

source_text: Restrictions on the import of English beef have already been imposed.
target_text: 已经限制进口英国牛肉。

source_text: The last outbreak of foot-and-mouth in the UK, in the spring and summer of 2001, resulted in total losses estimated at £8bn.
target_text: 2001年春季和夏季，英国最后一次爆发口蹄疫，导致总损失估计为80亿英镑。

source_text: Seven million animals were slaughtered, and tourism was also badly hit.
target_text: 屠宰了七百万只动物，旅游业也受到严重打击。

source_text: This morning about 500 policemen occupied the Morro da Rocinha, a favela in Rio de Janeiro.
target_text: 今天上午，大约500名警察占领了里约热内卢贫民区的莫罗达罗金哈。

source_text: The action is a part of a police operation against drug dealers.
target_text: 该行动是警察针对毒贩采取措施的一部分。

source_text: Police say they recovered 11 previously stolen motorcycles, a grenade, a fusil, a walkie-talkie and fireworks (the criminals usually use fireworks to warn fellows about the arrival of police).
target_text: 警方说，他们找到了11辆以前被盗的摩托车、一枚手榴弹、一枚引信、一台对讲机和烟花（犯罪分子通常用烟花来警告同伙警察的到来）。

source_text: Three men suspected of drug dealing were arrested: Fernando Pereira Lima (aged 22) Alessandro Martins (aged 27) and a boy (aged 17 - Brazilian laws forbid the release of names of teenagers younger than 18 in reporting legal cases).
target_text: 三名涉嫌贩毒的男子被捕：费尔南多·佩雷拉·利马（22岁）、亚历山德罗·马丁斯（27岁）和一名男孩（17岁，巴西法律禁止在报道法律案件时公布18岁以下青少年的姓名）。

source_text: The teenager allegedly shot the grenade against the policemen, but was himself hurt.
target_text: 据称这名少年向警察射击手榴弹，但他自己受伤了。

source_text: He is stable after treatment at the Miguel Couto hospital.
target_text: 他在米格尔库托医院接受治疗后病情稳定。

source_text: The drug dealers from Morro da Rocinha are in a war against drug dealers from the neighboring Vidigal favela.
target_text: 来自莫罗达罗金哈的毒贩正在与来自邻近维迪加尔贫民窟的毒贩作战。

source_text: Local populations of both Morro da Rocinha and Vidigal are endangered by the criminals, and have demanded urgent actions by the authorities.
target_text: 当地居民莫罗达罗金哈和维迪加尔都受到犯罪分子的威胁，他们要求当局采取紧急行动。

source_text: The morning of Saturday the 1st was a tragic one for El Salvador, as the Santa Ana Volcano, the largest and most active volcano in the country began an eruptive phase.
target_text: 1日星期六上午对萨尔瓦多来说是一个悲惨的早晨，该国最大和最活跃的火山圣安娜火山开始爆发。

source_text: The road that was designed as an evacuation route from that sector of the volcano was blocked completely and the inhabitants of the area had to be evacuated by helicopters.
target_text: 从火山该地区撤离的道路被完全封锁，该地区的居民不得不乘坐直升飞机撤离。

source_text: Minutes after the flow of hot mud was visible from Lake Coatepeque, a huge cloud of ash appeared, which reached an altitude of 50,000 feet, then covering the northwestern part of the country which contains the largest concentration of coffee farms (main export).
target_text: 从科阿特佩克湖可以看到热泥流出现的几分钟后，出现了一团巨大的灰烬，达到了50,000英尺的高度，然后覆盖了该国西北部，其中咖啡农场的浓度最高（主要出口）。

source_text: The local authorities expect that this layer of ash burns the coffee plants of the affected area, decreasing the coffee production of the region considerably.
target_text: 当地政府预计，这一层火山灰会烧毁受影响地区的咖啡树，从而大大减少该地区的咖啡产量。

source_text: Along with the ash cloud, a large amount of hot rocks (some reaching three feet in diameter) flew on all directions, damaging roads, homes and vegetation.
target_text: 随着灰云，大量的热岩石（有些直径达到3英尺）飞向各个方向，破坏道路，房屋和植被。

source_text: According to the people living in the surroundings of the volcano, the rocks were released due to the huge amount of pressure released when the ash cloud appeared.
target_text: 据居住在火山周围的人们说，由于灰云出现时释放出巨大的压力，岩石被释放出来。

source_text: Authorities report the loss of two human lives due to this incident, the cause has not yet been revealed.
target_text: 当局报告因此事件导致两人失去生命，原因尚未透露。

source_text: To prevent the loss of more lives, the government decreed a red alert in a radius of four kilometres of the crater, but yet, some people resist the evacuation proposals due to fear of losing their belongings, as they have to leave their homes without any surveillance.
target_text: 为了防止更多的生命损失，政府在火山口方圆4公里的范围内发布了红色预警，但一些人因为担心失去财产而拒绝撤离建议，因为他们不得不在没有任何监控的情况下离开家园。

source_text: In response to this, the army and the police agreed to patrol the areas evacuated in order to prevent robberies.
target_text: 为此，军队和警察同意在撤离的地区巡逻，以防止抢劫。

source_text: It is expected that this incident is only the beginning of a large eruptive process, which may result in a catastrophe for El Salvador.
target_text: 预计这一事件只是一个可能给萨尔瓦多造成灾难的大规模爆发进程的开始。

source_text: The Council of Australian Governments (COAG) will meet in Canberra today for its first meeting of 2006.
target_text: 澳大利亚政府理事会（COAG）将于今天在堪培拉举行2006年第一次会议。

source_text: Members of COAG are the Prime Minister, State Premiers, Australian Capital and Northern Territory Chief Ministers, and the President of the Australian Local Government Association.
target_text: 农委会成员包括总理、州总理、澳大利亚首都和北领地首席部长以及澳大利亚地方政府协会主席。

source_text: On the agenda is a wide range of issues such as health, economic reform, regulation, and education.
target_text: 会议议程包括一系列广泛的问题，如卫生、经济改革、监管和教育。

source_text: The state leaders (all of whom are members of the Australian Labor Party), met last night to develop a strategy for dealing with John Howard, Australia's Prime Minister.
target_text: 这些州的领导人（都是澳大利亚工党的成员）昨晚开会，制定了一项应对澳大利亚总理约翰·霍华德的策略。

source_text: Major said that there won't be a currency union between a newly independent Scotland and a post-split United Kingdom: "A currency union, which the SNP [Scottish National Party] assume is negotiable, would require the UK to underwrite Scottish debts.
target_text: 梅杰表示，新独立的苏格兰和分裂后的英国不会建立货币联盟：“苏格兰民族党【SNP】认为货币联盟是可以协商的，它将要求英国为苏格兰债务提供担保。”

source_text: That cannot, will not, happen if Scotland leaves the Union.
target_text: 如果苏格兰脱离欧盟，这种情况不可能、也不会发生。

source_text: There can be no halfway house, no quasi-independence underpinned by UK institutions."
target_text: 不可能有过渡机构，也不可能有英国机构支持的准独立性。”

source_text: Spain uses uncertainty over EU membership to deter Catalonia from even holding a referendum on independence.
target_text: 西班牙利用欧盟成员国身份的不确定性，阻止加泰罗尼亚举行独立公投。

source_text: It is hardly likely she would happily wave in Scotland.
target_text: 她不大可能在苏格兰愉快地挥挥手告别。

source_text: Major also said that Scottish nationalists engaged in anti-English sentiment.
target_text: 梅杰还说，苏格兰民族主义者参与了反英格兰的情绪。

source_text: Anti-English sentiment from separatists irritates and enrages, as it is intended to do, but across the UK people know and value Scots as partners, work colleagues, friends and neighbours.
target_text: 分离主义者的反英情绪激怒和激怒，正如其打算做的那样，但在整个英国，人们都知道并重视苏格兰人作为合作伙伴，同事，朋友和邻居。

source_text: A spokesperson for Alex Salmond, First Minister of Scotland and the leader of the Scottish National Party, responded to Major's remarks: Sir John Major is quite wrong to suggest that the rest of the UK should lay exclusive claim to all the assets of the UK, which the people of Scotland contribute to and of which Sterling is one.
target_text: 苏格兰第一部长、苏格兰民族党领袖亚历克斯·萨尔蒙德的发言人对梅杰的评论作出了回应：约翰·梅杰爵士认为英国其他国家应该对英国的所有资产享有专属权利，这是完全错误的，苏格兰人民对这些资产作出了贡献，而英镑就是其中之一。

source_text: But he is also just about the very last person the No campaign should be calling on to make their case.
target_text: 但他也是要求对不采取运动做出合理解释最不合适的人选。

source_text: He was the Tory prime minister who presided over his party's complete wipe-out in Scotland and the more he tries to lecture the people of Scotland, the better it will be for the Yes vote."
target_text: 他曾是保守党的首相，在他的领导下，保守党在苏格兰全军覆没。他越是试图向苏格兰人民说教，就越有利于赞成票的投票。

source_text: A1 Team New Zealand has won the feature race at the A1 Grand Prix in Shanghai, China today, followed by A1 Team Great Britain and A1 Team Germany.
target_text: A1新西兰队在今天中国上海举行的A1大奖赛中获得特色赛冠军，英国A1队和德国A1队分获第二，三名。

source_text: The third place win for Germany has secured the 2006/2007 championship.
target_text: 德国队获得第三名，该队曾经赢得了2006/2007赛季的冠军。

source_text: In qualifying for the sprint race, Great Britain's driver Robbie Kerr managed to secure the pole position with the fastest lap time recorded this weekend.
target_text: 在冲刺赛的资格赛中，英国车手罗比·科尔以本周末的最快圈速保住了杆位。

source_text: New Zealand's driver, Jonny Reid, started in second position, narrowly missing out on what would have been his third pole position of the season.
target_text: 新西兰车手强尼·里德以第二名的成绩出线，险些错失本赛季第三杆的位置。

source_text: Third and fourth place starters are the United States and Germany respectively.
target_text: 第三和第四名的首发球员分别是美国和德国。

source_text: Great Britain managed to win the sprint race, thus securing a first place start in the feature race.
target_text: 英国成功赢得了冲刺赛，从而确保了在正赛中的第一出发杆位。

source_text: During the entire sprint race, Great Britain were the leaders, with a "comfortable" lead, always maintaining their position in front of New Zealand.
target_text: 在整个冲刺赛中，英国以“轻松”的优势领先，始终保持着领先于新西兰的位置。

source_text: During the feature race Jonny Reid, driving New Zealand's Black Beauty car, passed Great Britain on lap number 16 of the 50-lap race.
target_text: 在正赛期间，驾驶新西兰“黑美人”赛车的强尼·里德在50圈比赛的第16圈超过了英国。

source_text: After five hours of meeting, the presidents Hugo Chávez from Venezuela and Alvaro Uribe from Colombia put a end to the diplomatic tension that had completed two months.
target_text: 经过五个小时的会晤，来自委内瑞拉的乌戈·查韦斯总统和来自哥伦比亚的阿尔瓦罗·乌里韦结束了两个月来的外交紧张局势。

source_text: The crisis started with the alleged irregular arrest (according to Venezuela) of the FARC guerrilla Rodrigo Granda by Colombian authorities.
target_text: 这场危机始于哥伦比亚当局对FARC游击队罗德里戈·格兰达的非法逮捕（据委内瑞拉称）。

source_text: President Chavez said: "We have decided to turn the page so we can fix the things that were misadjusted, clarify the things that could be clouded and work together in the construction for the common people".
target_text: 查韦斯总统说：“我们已经决定翻过这一页，这样我们就可以修复那些被错误调整的地方，澄清那些可能被混淆的地方，共同为普通民众的建设而努力。”

source_text: The meeting was scheduled for early this month, however it was postponed due to a disease of the Colombian president.
target_text: 会议定于本月初举行，但由于哥伦比亚总统的疾病而推迟举行。

source_text: The encounter served both to finish the harshness between the two countries and to resume bilateral agreements and the activity in the border which were paralyzed as a result of the crisis.
target_text: 这次会晤既是为了结束两国之间的不和谐因素，也是为了恢复双边协议以及因危机而陷入瘫痪的边境活动。

source_text: As a result of the meeting, the presidents will organize a binational high level commission in the next weeks.
target_text: 会议结果表明，总统将在未来几周内组织一次双边高级别委员会。

source_text: The commission will evaluate the crisis's consequences, reinforce the integration between both countries and coordinate the future of the antiterrorist fight.
target_text: 该委员会将评估危机的后果，加强两国的融合，协调反恐斗争的未来。

source_text: The fight against terrorism will be done by security organisms of both countries by means of a rigorous legal adjustment in the actions which implies to cooperate so that the sovereignty is not affected and the sovereignty is respected, according to Uribe.
target_text: 乌里韦说，打击恐怖主义的斗争将由两国的安全机构通过对行动进行严格的法律调整来完成，这种法律调整意味着进行合作，使主权不受影响，主权得到尊重。

source_text: A collision between Christian band MercyMe's tour bus and a car has killed two passengers in the car and the 18-year-old driver's unborn baby.
target_text: 基督教乐队MercyMe的旅游巴士和一辆汽车之间的碰撞导致车内两名乘客和18岁的司机未出生的婴儿死亡。

source_text: The woman is in critical condition following the crash, which occurred in Fort Wayne, northeastern Indiana.
target_text: 事故发生在印第安纳州东北部的韦恩堡，这名妇女目前情况危急。

source_text: The bus was headed to Six Flags St. Louis in Missouri for the band to play to a sold-out crowd.
target_text: 巴士开往密苏里州的六旗圣路易，乐队将在座无虚席的人群中演出。

source_text: At 1:15 a.m. Saturday, according to witnesses, the bus was going through a green light when the car made a turn in front of it.
target_text: 据目击者说，周六凌晨1点15分，当汽车在前面转弯时，公共汽车正在通过绿灯。

source_text: No-one on the bus was injured, and the band rescheduled the show for September as a result of the incident.
target_text: 公共汽车上没有人受伤，由于事件原因，乐队重新安排了9月份的演出。

source_text: A photograph of the damaged bus was posted on the band's website, depicting moderate crumpling to the front area of the vehicle.
target_text: 乐队的网站上发布了一幅受损巴士的照片，照片中巴士的前部有轻微的变形。

source_text: Marxist intellectuals released a letter supporting both the arrested FARC leader Ricardo Gonzalez (also known as Rodrigo Granda) and the Venezuelan President Hugo Chavez.
target_text: 马克思主义知识分子发表了一封信，支持被捕的FARC领导人里卡多·冈萨雷斯（又名罗德里戈·格兰达）和委内瑞拉总统乌戈·查韦斯。

source_text: The FARC is accused of terrorism by the governments of the USA and Colombia.
target_text: 哥伦比亚革命武装力量被美国和哥伦比亚政府指控为恐怖主义。

source_text: The FARC accuses Colombian authorities of capturing Granda inside Venezuelan territory.
target_text: 哥伦比亚革命武装力量指控哥伦比亚当局在委内瑞拉领土内占领格兰达。

source_text: Venezuelan President Chavez claims Colombia invaded Venezuelan territory and possibly bribed Venezuelan officers.
target_text: 委内瑞拉总统查韦斯称，哥伦比亚入侵委内瑞拉领土，并可能贿赂委内瑞拉军官。

source_text: Colombia says the arrest occurred inside Colombian territory and that Granda was moved to Colombia by Venezuelans.
target_text: 哥伦比亚说，逮捕发生在哥伦比亚境内，格兰达被委内瑞拉人移居哥伦比亚。

source_text: Colombia admitted the payment of a reward for Granda, but rebutted accusations of bribery.
target_text: 哥伦比亚承认支付给格兰达的奖励，但反驳了对贿赂的指控。

source_text: Recently, the Colombian government released an official notice accusing Venezuela of accepting representatives of terrorist organizations in political events sponsored by official Venezuelan institutions.
target_text: 最近，哥伦比亚政府发布正式通知，指责委内瑞拉在委内瑞拉官方机构赞助的政治活动中接受恐怖组织的代表。

source_text: Open letter from international intellectuals, to the international public opinion
target_text: 国际知识分子致国际舆论的公开信。

source_text: The kidnapping of Rodrigo Granda, carried out in Venezuelan territory presumably by agents of the Colombian police, is an attempt to create difficulties between both countries in order to debilitate the Bolivarian movement.
target_text: 罗德里戈·格兰达在委内瑞拉境内被绑架，据推测是哥伦比亚警方的特工所为，目的是在两国之间制造困难，以削弱玻利瓦尔运动。

source_text: An additional effect is to reduce the international prestige of the conduct of President Hugo Chávez creating doubts about a possible Venezuelan implication in said kidnapping.
target_text: 另一个影响是，总统乌戈·查韦斯的行为降低了国际威望，使人对委内瑞拉可能卷入绑架事件产生怀疑。

source_text: All intended to cause a possible armed intervention of the United States as a result of the conflict.
target_text: 所有这些都是为了使美国有可能对冲突进行武装干预。

source_text: For the Chesapeake Bay, the largest estuary in the United States, a first-time-ever “water quality forecast” was issued Monday for the upcoming summer season by the Chesapeake Bay Program.
target_text: 对于美国最大的河口切萨皮克湾，切萨皮克湾项目于本周一发布了有史以来首次的夏季“水质预报”。

source_text: The prediction is for this to be the fourth-worst season for dissolved oxygen in two decades.
target_text: 预测这是二十年来溶解氧的第四个最差季节。

source_text: The Chesapeake Bay Program launched the new forecast to build on a base of environmental data gathered over the last two decades as water quality concerns have grown.
target_text: 由于水质问题日益严重，切萨皮克湾计划在过去二十年收集的环境数据基础上发布了新的预测。

source_text: The forecast is meant to be a proactive tool that provides resource managers with information that can be used to guide policies for the bay’s protection and restoration.
target_text: 该预测旨在成为一种主动的工具，为资源管理人员提供可用于指导海湾保护和恢复政策的信息。

source_text: Cars, fertilizer, human and animal wastes, industrial and agricultural pollutants all play a part.
target_text: 汽车，肥料，人类和动物废物，工业和农业污染物都起着作用。

source_text: "This means that we need to do a lot more to reduce phosphorus and nitrogen pollution from getting into the bay, said Beth McGee, of the Chesapeake Bay Foundation.
target_text: 切萨皮克湾基金会的贝斯·麦吉说：“这意味着我们需要做更多的工作来减少磷和氮污染进入海湾。”

source_text: "The biggest source of pollution in the bay is agriculture, and we've got to find a way to provide farmers with more resources to manage the land better."
target_text: “海湾最大的污染源是农业，我们必须找到一种方法，为农民提供更多的资源来更好地管理土地。”

source_text: Nutrient rich pollutants composed mainly of nitrogen and phosphorous come from far away places carried by rivers, and nearby the bay from farm and metropolitan runoff.
target_text: 以氮、磷为主要成分的富营养化污染物来自河流所携带的遥远地方，来自农业和都市径流的海湾附近。

source_text: They collect in the huge bay and meet tidal flows from the ocean.
target_text: 它们聚集在巨大的海湾，迎接来自海洋的潮汐流。

source_text: Algae feed off the nutrients, and they are either consumed by aquatic life or sink at the end of their life cycle.
target_text: 藻类以营养物质为食，它们或者被水生生物消耗掉，或者在它们的生命周期结束时下沉。

source_text: Later when the plants die, the process of their decomposition on the bottom consumes oxygen to a state where the water becomes anoxic, and unable to support life.
target_text: 当植物死亡后，它们在底部的分解过程消耗氧气，使水缺氧，无法维持生命。

source_text: As notorious as weather forecasters are for often being wrong, it should come as no surprise if this first forecasting step by the federally funded program misses its mark.
target_text: 尽管天气预报经常出错是出了名的，但如果这项由联邦政府资助的计划的第一步预报失误，也不足为奇。

source_text: Forces such as heavy storms or hurricanes, which churn water, would have an effect.
target_text: 猛烈的风暴或飓风等搅动水的力量会产生影响。

source_text: Excessive wind and unexpected precipitation, or nutrient level jumps, would also contribute.
target_text: 过多的风和意想不到的降水，或营养水平的上升，也会造成这种情况。

source_text: An earthquake with a magnitude of 7.0 Mw struck the Ryukyu Islands, off the coast of Japan on Friday morning at 5:31am (20:31 UTC).
target_text: 周五上午5：31（日本时间20：31），日本海岸附近的琉球群岛发生了7.0兆瓦的地震。

source_text: The Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said there was no "destructive threat" from the tsunami.
target_text: 太平洋海啸预警中心表示，海啸没有“破坏性威胁”。

source_text: At its center, the depth of the earthquake had been measured at ten kilometers (6.2 miles).
target_text: 在其中心，地震的深度是在十公里（6.2英里）处测量的。

source_text: At 5:57am local time (20:57 UTC), the Japan Meteorological Agency recorded a ten centimetre (four inch) tsunami Nanjō, Okinawa.
target_text: 当地时间早上5点57分（日本时间20：57），日本气象厅记录了一个10厘米（4英寸）的海啸，南冲岛、冲绳岛。

source_text: Initially the agency had predicted that the depth of the tsunami would be three feet (one metre).
target_text: 最初该机构曾预测海啸的深度为3英尺（1米）。

source_text: There were no reports of damage, although, according to the Agency, "there may be slight sea level changes from now on."
target_text: 目前还没有关于损失的报告，不过，根据该机构的说法，“从现在开始，海平面可能会有轻微的变化。”

source_text: The islands were advised to evacuate from the seashore were Okinawa Islands, Amami Islands and Tokara Islands.
target_text: 建议从海岸撤离的岛屿有冲绳群岛、阿玛米群岛和托卡拉群岛。

source_text: Ivan Brackin, a resident of Yoron Island, described his experience of the earthquake.
target_text: 约伦岛居民伊万·布拉金讲述了他的地震经历。

source_text: "I woke up to violent shudders that lasted about six seconds then a pause followed by a couple of sharp jumps", he stated.
target_text: 他说：“我醒来时剧烈的颤抖持续了大约6秒，然后停顿了一下，接着是几次剧烈的跳跃。”

source_text: Jumpers are the most dangerous so that sent me under the desk.
target_text: 跳是最危险的，所以我躲到了桌子下面。

source_text: Jayant Patel, wanted for manslaughter, grievous bodily harm and fraud in Australia, was arrested by FBI agents in Oregon, United States and is scheduled to face an extradition hearing on April 10.
target_text: 以过失杀人、严重人身伤害和欺诈罪在澳大利亚被通缉的贾扬特·帕特尔在美国俄勒冈州被联邦调查局特工逮捕，定于4月10日举行引渡听证会。

source_text: According to an affidavit filed by US prosecutors, Patel, previously restricted from performing surgery in the US due to "professional misconduct", lied about his professional history in order to work at Bundaberg Base Hospital in Bundaberg, Queensland.
target_text: 根据美国检察官提交的一份书面证词，帕特尔曾因“职业不端”而被禁止在美国进行手术，为了在昆士兰邦达伯格的邦达伯格基地医院工作，他谎报了自己的职业经历。

source_text: If successfully extradited to Australia, Patel "will get a fair trial", according to the Federal Member for Hinkler, Paul Neville, whose electorate includes Bundaberg, although the extradition may take some time due to Patel's US citizenship.
target_text: 如果成功引渡到澳大利亚，帕特尔“将得到公正的审判”，据亨克勒，选民包括班德堡的联邦成员保罗·内维尔称，由于帕特尔是美国公民，引渡可能需要一些时间。

source_text: The Nanhaijiu 196 rescue vessel was dispatched about 8 pm local time, when authorities were notified that the ship may sink.
target_text: 当地时间晚上8点左右，当有关部门接到“南海救196号”可能沉没的通知时，救援船已被派出。

source_text: There were winds up to 90 kilometers per hour when the ship sank during a gale.
target_text: 当船在大风中沉没时，风速高达每小时90公里。

source_text: Saturday morning rescue operations were supplemented by a rescue helicopter.
target_text: 星期六早上救援行动由救援直升机进行援助。

source_text: There were a total of seven crew members on board.
target_text: 船上共有七名船员。

source_text: Four are missing, while three bodies have been recovered by the South China Sea Rescue Bureau.
target_text: 四人失踪，三具尸体已被中国南海救援队找到。

source_text: The state-run Xinhua news agency says the cause of the disaster is under investigation.
target_text: 官方的新华社说，灾难的原因正在调查中。

source_text: Four people are reported to be in a serious condition.
target_text: 据报道有四人情况严重。

source_text: Originally, Xinhua reported only five fatalities, but as rescue workers continued to move away debris, the full extent of the death toll was discovered.
target_text: 起初，新华社只报道了5人死亡，但随着救援人员继续清理废墟，死亡人数的全部情况已被发现。

source_text: Xinhua has also reported that several employees at the bar, as well as the wife of the owner, were being questioned.
target_text: 新华社还报道说，酒吧的几名员工以及老板的妻子正在接受讯问。

source_text: According to a philly.com article authored by The Associated Press, Xinhua failed to state whether this was as witnesses or as suspects in any potential criminal activity, but the Shanghai Daily said that Xinhua had reported the people had been detained as suspects.
target_text: 据美联社在philly.com上发表的一篇文章说，新华社没有说明这两人是作为证人还是作为任何潜在犯罪活动的嫌疑人，但《上海日报》说，新华社报道说，这些人是作为嫌疑人被拘留的。

source_text: The owner himself, Mr. Qu, was killed in the blast.
target_text: 主人自己，曲先生，在爆炸中丧生。

source_text: Investigators say they are currently unsure if the blast was purely accidental, or if foul play was involved, as all efforts were initially focused on attempting to locate survivors.
target_text: 调查人员说，他们目前还不确定爆炸是否纯粹是意外，或者是否与谋杀有关，因为所有的努力最初都集中在寻找幸存者上。

source_text: The two-storey building, which also housed a bathhouse, was completely leveled by the blast.
target_text: 这座两层楼的建筑，也、里面还有一个浴室，在爆炸中完全夷为平地。

source_text: In addition, several cars were buried under the debris and windows in nearby buildings were shattered by the pressure wave.
target_text: 此外，几辆车被埋在碎片下面，附近建筑物的窗户被压力波破碎。

source_text: A power cut in the area was also caused by the blast due to damage to the local electricity network.
target_text: 由于当地电力网络的损坏，该地区的停电也是由于爆炸造成的。

source_text: 77-year-old local resident Chen Xiaohong, who lives 50 metres from ground zero, described the explosion: "I was watching my grandson finishing his lessons.
target_text: 77岁的当地居民陈晓红住在离原爆点50米的地方，他描述了这次爆炸：“当时我正看着我的孙子完成他的功课。

source_text: Suddenly, we heard a big bang, then the door burst open from effects of a powerful shock wave and the lights went out...
target_text: 突然间，我们听到了一声巨响，然后门被一股强大的冲击波撞开，灯光熄灭……。

source_text: China has been the location of many disasters in both public and private places, such as fires and explosions.
target_text: 中国发生了很多公共和私人场所的灾难，比如火灾和爆炸。

source_text: Earlier this year, an unsafe arrangement with a two-ton steel ladle resulted in the Qinghe Special Steel Corporation disaster, in which molten steel was accidentally poured into a room full of workers, killing 32.
target_text: 今年早些时候，一个两吨钢包的不安全安排导致了清河特钢公司的灾难，其中钢水被意外倒入满是工人的房间，造成32人死亡。

source_text: US Supreme Court Justice John Paul Stevens has given federal prosecutors until next Friday to respond to the request of former Illinois governor Rod Blagojevich and his brother Robert to delay their corruption trial.
target_text: 美国最高法院法官约翰·保罗·史蒂文斯要求联邦检察官在下周五之前对前伊利诺斯州州长罗德·布拉戈耶维奇和他的兄弟罗伯特提出的推迟腐败审判的请求做出回应。

source_text: The trial is set to begin on June 3, and many of the charges they face are based on a federal honest-services law.
target_text: 审判定于6月3日开始，他们面临的许多指控都是基于联邦诚信服务法。

source_text: The Blagojevich brothers challenge the constitutionality of this law and believe the trial should be delayed until the high court is expected to decide the issue next month.
target_text: 布拉戈耶维奇兄弟对这项法律的合宪性提出质疑，并认为审判应该推迟到高等法院预计下个月对这个问题作出裁决。

source_text: The request had already been denied by District Judge James Zagel and the Seventh Circuit Court of Appeals.
target_text: 地方法官詹姆斯·扎格尔和第七巡回上诉法院已经驳回了这一请求。

source_text: Stevens, who handles appeals from the Seventh Circuit, had three options: reject the request for a delay of trial, grant it, or allow the federal government to respond.
target_text: 处理第七巡回上诉的史蒂文斯有三种选择：拒绝延迟审判的请求，批准，或允许联邦政府作出回应。

source_text: Prosecutors added new charges, including bribery, against the brothers in case the Supreme Court finds the honest-services law unconstitutional.
target_text: 检察官增加了新的指控，包括针对兄弟贿赂，以防最高法院认为诚实服务法违反宪法。

source_text: They believe the June 3 start date should not be held back.
target_text: 他们认为6月3日的开始日期不应该推迟。

source_text: An airplane, a Warrior PA28 that went missing at 1700 GMT may have been found Saturday night, February 3rd as rescuers searching for the airplane have discovered wreckage about a mile from South Shore near Blackpool, England.
target_text: 2月3日星期六晚，一架在格林尼治时间1700时失踪的勇士PA28飞机可能已经被发现。搜救人员在距离英格兰布莱克浦南岸约一英里的地方发现了飞机残骸。

source_text: The pilot of the air plane reported to Blackpool Tower that he was low on fuel before 5 pm Saturday evening and disappeared from radar screens shortly afterwards.
target_text: 这架飞机的飞行员向布莱克浦大厦报告说，他在星期六晚上5点之前燃油不足，不久之后就从雷达屏幕上消失了。

source_text: There is no news about the two men who were on board the airplane.
target_text: 没有关于飞机上两名男子的消息。

source_text: The weather conditions on parts of the coast are described as foggy.
target_text: 沿海部分地区的天气状况被描述为有雾。

source_text: Three lifeboats, two coastguard teams and an RAF helicopter are searching for the airplane which was believed to have been traveling from Exeter to Blackpool, says Lancashire Police.
target_text: 兰开夏警方表示，三艘救生艇，两艘海岸警卫队和一架皇家空军直升机正在搜寻据信从埃克塞特前往布莱克浦的飞机。

source_text: Blogger George Vaccaro is a customer from the US who apparently purchased wireless network connection from Verizon, thinking that he was getting a good deal.
target_text: 博主乔治·瓦卡罗是一名来自美国的客户，他显然是从威瑞森购买了无线网络连接，认为自己得到了一笔不错的交易。

source_text: Instead, he says he was charged about 71 dollars instead of 71 cents: 100 times more than what his bill should have been at the rate quoted.
target_text: 相反，他说他的收费大约是71美元而不是71美分：比他的账单应该按照报价率多出100倍。

source_text: When he called the Verizon customer service, he said he also found out that several Verizon representatives think 0.002 cents is equal to 0.002 dollars.
target_text: 当他打电话给威瑞森客户服务时，他说他还发现威瑞森的几位代表认为0.002美分等于0.002美元。

source_text: The United Nations (UN) suspended all of its operations in Gaza from yesterday, after the bombing of a convoy of UN aid trucks which killed one Palestinian driver, and wounded three others.
target_text: 在联合国援助卡车车队遭到轰炸，造成一名巴勒斯坦司机死亡，另有三人受伤后，联合国（联合国）于昨天暂停了在加沙的所有行动。

source_text: Thursday was the second day of attacks on UN targets after three UN schools housing refugees were bombed on Tuesday, killing over 50 civilians.
target_text: 星期四是袭击联合国目标的第二天，因为周三有三所联合国学校的住房难民遭到轰炸，造成50多名平民死亡。

source_text: "UNRWA decided to suspend all its operations in the Gaza Strip because of the increasing hostile actions against its premises and personnel", Adnan Abu Hasna, a Gaza-based spokesman for the United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA), said yesterday.
target_text: 联合国救济和工程处（近东救济工程处）驻加沙的发言人阿德南·阿布·哈斯娜昨天表示，“近东救济工程处决定暂停其在加沙地带的所有行动，因为对其房地和人员的敌对行动日益增加”。

source_text: Richard Miron, spokesman for the UN said that the Israeli military had been notified in advance of the coordinates of the relief trucks saying, "This underlines the fundamental insecurity inside Gaza at a time when we are trying to address the dire humanitarian needs of the population there."
target_text: 联合国发言人理查德·米伦表示，以色列军方在得知救援卡车的坐标之前就得到了通知，他说，“这突显出加沙内部的根本不安全，而我们正在努力解决那里居民的人道主义需求。”

source_text: The bombing of the UN trucks was the last straw for the UN, already angered after Israeli tanks fired on a UN school housing refugees killing 50 including an entire family of seven young children.
target_text: 联合国卡车的爆炸事件是联合国的最后一根稻草，以色列坦克向一所联合国学校的难民开枪，造成50人死亡，其中包括7名儿童的全家，这已经激怒了联合国。

source_text: The UN said that they had given Israel the GPS coordinates of their schools, and demanded accountability for the attacks.
target_text: 联合国表示，他们已经向以色列提供了他们学校的GPS坐标，并要求对这些攻击负责。

source_text: Hours before the attack on the al-Fakhora School was an attack on Asma Elementary School which killed three Palestinian cousins.
target_text: 在al-法克霍拉学校遇袭数小时前，阿斯马小学遇袭，三名巴勒斯坦表亲丧生。

source_text: The cousin's father said the bodies were so mangled he couldn't tell the bodies apart, "We came to the school when the Israelis warned us to leave," he said.
target_text: 这位表亲的父亲说，尸体已经血肉模糊，他分不清这两具尸体，“当以色列人警告我们离开时，我们来到这所学校，”他说。

source_text: A relative came and told me one of my sons was killed.
target_text: 一位亲戚来告诉我，我的一个儿子被杀了。

source_text: The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) said on yesterday that they were trying for four days to get their ambulances to a Gaza neighborhood before being allowed to by Israeli military forces.
target_text: 红十字国际委员会（ICRC）昨天表示，他们花了四天时间试图将救护车开到加沙地带的一个社区，然后才被以色列军方允许进入。

source_text: After getting there, they said, they found four starving children sitting next to the bodies of their dead mothers.
target_text: 他们说，到达那里后，他们发现四个饥饿的孩子坐在他们死去的母亲的尸体旁边。

source_text: "This is a shocking incident", said Pierre Wettach, ICRC chief for Israel and the occupied Palestinian territories.
target_text: “这是一个令人震惊的事件”，红十字国际委员会以色列和巴勒斯坦被占领土负责人皮埃尔·韦特奇说。

source_text: The Israeli military must have been aware of the situation but did not assist the wounded.
target_text: 以色列军方必须意识到这种情况，但没有帮助伤员。

source_text: Neither did they make it possible for us or the Palestinian Red Crescent to assist the wounded.
target_text: 它们也没有使我们或巴勒斯坦红新月会有可能援助伤员。

source_text: Israel granted a three-hour ceasefire yesterday that they gave for aid workers to enter areas that they had closed off.
target_text: 以色列昨天同意停火三小时，允许救援人员进入他们封锁的地区。

source_text: Eight Israeli soldiers and three civilians have died in the same period.
target_text: 同期有8名以色列士兵和3名平民死亡。

source_text: Israeli forces also shot a Palestinian man in the West Bank during a protest against Israel's actions in Gaza.
target_text: 在抗议以色列在加沙的行动期间，以色列部队还在西岸开枪打死了一名巴勒斯坦人。

source_text: Yesterday, a Palestinian man was killed by Israeli forces after a confrontation in the West Bank Jewish settlement of Ma'ale Adumim near Jerusalem.
target_text: 昨天，在耶路撒冷附近的约旦河西岸犹太人定居点马阿勒阿杜明发生冲突后，一名巴勒斯坦男子被以色列军队杀害。

source_text: Britain's Ministry of Defence (MoD) has admitted sixteen instances of sensitive information being leaked on social networking websites in the past eighteen months.
target_text: 英国国防部（MoD）承认，在过去的18个月中，有16个敏感信息泄露在社交网站上。

source_text: The MoD would not comment on what disciplinary action was taken, or whether the leaks involved operational information.
target_text: 国防部不愿就采取了何种惩戒行动，也不愿就泄密是否涉及运营信息发表评论。

source_text: "It's worrying that employees in sensitive positions have been sharing confidential information via Twitter and other means", said Mikko Hypponen, of F-Secure.
target_text: F-Secure的米科·海波宁表示：“令人担忧的是，处于敏感职位的员工一直在通过推特和其它方式分享机密信息。”

source_text: According to Lewis PR, computers on the main MoD networks are blocked from visiting social networking sites.
target_text: 根据Lewis PR的说法，主要国防部网络上的计算机被阻止访问社交网站。

source_text: Some personnel in Afghanistan and Iraq also have access through internet cafés on military bases.
target_text: 阿富汗和伊拉克的一些人员也可以通过军事基地的网吧进入。

source_text: The ministry's "online engagement guidelines", released in August last year, recognise the importance of social media such as Facebook for personnel keeping in touch with friends and family.
target_text: 该部去年8月发布的“网络参与指南”承认，脸书等社交媒体对于员工与朋友和家人保持联系的重要性。

source_text: According to the document: "Service and MOD civilian personnel are encouraged to talk about what they do, but within certain limits to protect security, reputation and privacy."
target_text: 根据该文件：“鼓励服务和MOD文职人员谈论他们的工作，但在一定限度内保护安全，声誉和隐私。”

source_text: On August 11, United States Senator and 2008 presidential Republican candidate John McCain gave a speech regarding the crisis between Georgia and Russia.
target_text: 8月11日，美国参议员、2008年共和党总统候选人约翰·麦凯恩就格鲁吉亚和俄罗斯之间的危机发表演讲。

source_text: Following the speech, a regular Wikipedia editor noticed that his speech was very similar to an article on Wikipedia also regarding the crisis, in what could be considered plagiarism.
target_text: 演讲结束后，维基百科的一位普通编辑注意到，他的演讲与维基百科上的一篇关于这场危机的文章非常相似，也就是所谓的剽窃。

source_text: Wikinews was able to talk to that editor about how he found out about the similarities and what he did in response.
target_text: 维基新闻能够和编辑谈论他是如何发现这些相似之处的，以及他是如何回应的。

source_text: Wikinews also took a deeper look at the claim and investigated further.
target_text: 维基新闻也对这一说法进行了更深入的调查。

source_text: McCain gave his speech in Erie, Pennsylvania and was speaking to citizens, giving a warning to Russia stating, "Russian President Medvedev and Prime Minister Putin must understand the severe, long-term negative consequences that their government’s actions will have for Russia’s relationship with the U.S. and Europe."
target_text: 麦凯恩在宾夕法尼亚州伊利市发表演讲，并对民众发表讲话。他警告俄罗斯说：“俄罗斯总统梅德韦杰夫和总理普京必须明白，他们的政府的行动将对俄罗斯与美国和欧洲的关系产生严重的、长期的负面影响。”

source_text: After a brief period of independence following the Russian revolution, the Red Army forced Georgia to join the Soviet Union in 1922.
target_text: 在俄罗斯革命后短暂独立后，红军于1922年迫使格鲁吉亚加入苏联。

source_text: As the Soviet Union crumbled at the end of the Cold War, Georgia regained its independence in 1991, but its early years were marked by instability, corruption, and economic crises."
target_text: 随着苏联在冷战结束时崩溃，格鲁吉亚于1991年重新获得独立，但其早年的特点是不稳定，腐败和经济危机。

source_text: While reading the first few paragraphs, the Wikipedia editor Killing Vector, (who wishes to be called by his contributor name in fear of retribution for coming forward with the claim), noticed a striking similarity to McCain's speech and the Wikipedia article on the country of Georgia.
target_text: 在阅读前几段时，维基百科编辑凯琳·维克多（希望被其贡献者名称称为担心报复以提出索赔），注意到麦凯恩的演讲和维基百科上有关格鲁吉亚的文章有惊人的相似之处。

source_text: Not only did he notice the similarities, but after reading through the article's edit history, 'Killing Vector' noticed that his speech might have been lifted from Wikipedia, with some of the material in McCain's speech dating prior to the start of the Georgian and Russian crisis.
target_text: 他不仅注意到了这篇文章的相似之处，而且在通读了这篇文章的编辑历史后，凯琳·维克多发现他的演讲可能是从维基百科上抄袭来的，麦凯恩演讲中的一些材料可以追溯到格鲁吉亚和俄罗斯危机爆发之前。

source_text: I began reading the text of McCain's address on the Georgia crisis, and as I was browsing it the irregularity jumped out almost immediately.
target_text: 我开始阅读麦凯恩关于格鲁吉亚危机的讲话，当我浏览时，几乎立刻就能发现其中的不规范之处。

source_text: The paragraphs which discussed the history of Georgia simply didn't fit with the rest of the speech; the rhetorical style was jarringly different.
target_text: 那些讨论格鲁吉亚历史的段落与演讲的其余部分完全不符；修辞风格截然不同。

source_text: I figured, where's someone in a hurry going to get basic information on the Republic of Georgia?"
target_text: 我想，哪里有人急着得到关于格鲁吉亚共和国的基本信息？

source_text: I opened up Wikipedia, went to the article, picked a recent but not current revision more or less at random (July 24th), and hit gold on the first try; McCain's speech and the Wikipedia article had significant strings of words in common, emphasized the same events, made largely the same word choices," Vector said to Wikinews.
target_text: 我打开了维基百科，浏览了这篇文章，随机挑选了一篇最近但不是最新的修订本（7月24日），并在第一次尝试中获得了成功；麦凯恩的演讲和维基百科的文章有大量的共同词串，强调了相同的事件，做出了基本相同的词选择，”维克多对维基新闻说。

source_text: Although other media outlets reported the alleged plagiarism, the two passages below were dated at least one week prior to the Georgian and Russian crisis.
target_text: 虽然其他媒体报道了所谓的抄袭，但下面的两段文字至少在格鲁吉亚和俄罗斯危机前一周发生。

source_text: The first two paragraphs of McCain's speech appear to resemble the Wikipedia article in the history dated July 24, 2008.
target_text: 麦凯恩演讲的前两段似乎与2008年7月24日的历史上的维基百科文章类似。

source_text: Two paragraphs, about an eighth of the full speech, contain material directly copied from Wikipedia or superficially modified from its text.
target_text: 两段，约为完整演讲的八分之一，包含直接从维基百科复制或从其文本表面修改的材料。

source_text: Those two paragraphs constitute the entire factual background of the speech, though — the rest is reaction and proposed policy, added Vector.
target_text: 这两段话构成了演讲的整个事实背景，然而，剩下的是反应和提议的政策，维克多补充说道。

source_text: McCain's campaign denies they plagiarized Wikipedia, but also didn't state whether they used it as a source for his speech.
target_text: 麦凯恩的竞选活动否认他们抄袭了维基百科，但也没有说明他们是否将其作为演讲的来源。

source_text: There are only so many ways to state basic historical facts and dates and that any similarities to Wikipedia were only coincidental," said a spokesman for the McCain campaign, Brian Rogers to The Politico.
target_text: 麦凯恩竞选班子的发言人布莱恩·罗杰斯对《政治》杂志说：“陈述基本历史事实和日期的方法太多了，与维基百科的任何相似之处都只是巧合。”

source_text: Wikinews contacted McCain's campaign, but has yet to receive a response.
target_text: 维基新闻联系了麦凯恩的竞选活动，但尚未收到回应。

source_text: Wikinews e-mailed Jay Walsh, the director of communications for the Wikimedia Foundation to see what they thought of the situation, and what if anything they planned to do about it.
target_text: 维基新闻给维基媒体基金会的通讯主管杰伊·沃尔什发了一封电子邮件，询问他们对这一情况的看法，以及他们是否打算对此采取行动。

source_text: "We aren't particularly concerned with this", said Walsh who also added that "I'm only aware of this situation through media coverage I've seen, nor do we or I have any in-depth detail about the situation."
target_text: 沃尔什说：“我们并不特别担心这个问题。”他还说，“我只是通过我看到的媒体报道才知道这个情况，我们和我对这个情况都没有任何深入的了解。”

source_text: I would say it's a good practice to attribute text or content whenever possible.
target_text: 我会说，尽可能将文本或内容属性化是一个好的实践。

source_text: Obviously when it's a matter of copyright then there are legal considerations, but the Foundation is not able to examine individual cases, added Walsh.
target_text: 沃尔什说：“显然，当涉及到版权问题时，就会有法律上的考虑，但是基金会不能审查个别案件。”

source_text: Wikinews attempted to contact Mike Godwin, the legal counsel for the Foundation, but has yet to receive a response.
target_text: 维基新闻试图联系该基金会的法律顾问迈克•戈德温，但尚未收到回复。

source_text: Vector stands by his claim and also notes what he calls 'dishonesty' on the part of McCain's campaign.
target_text: 维克多支持他的主张并且还记录了麦凯恩竞选中他称之为“不诚实”的内容。

source_text: What concerns me more, as a voter, is the ethical issue.
target_text: 作为选民，我更关心的是道德问题。

source_text: "Plagiarism comes from dishonesty and intellectual laziness on the part of an individual, but McCain's campaign's later denial adopts that individual's dishonesty", stated Vector.
target_text: “剽窃来自个人的不诚实和知识懒惰，但麦凯恩的竞选活动后来否认了该个人的不诚实行为”，维克多说。

source_text: 66 passengers and the crew of a New York to San Francisco UAL flight got an unwanted stop in the "Windy City," Chicago, on Tuesday, following a bomb scare.
target_text: 美国联合航空公司一架从纽约飞往旧金山的航班于本周二遭遇炸弹袭击，机上66名乘客和机组人员在“风城”芝加哥意外停留。

source_text: United Air Lines spokesman Jeff Green said a flight attendant was alerted by a passenger to another passenger's suspicious materials and wires.
target_text: 联合航空公司发言人杰夫格林说，一名空姐接到一名乘客对另一名乘客的可疑材料和电线的警告。

source_text: The crew decided to divert the flight to O’Hare, empty the plane, and allow the bomb squad to inspect for safety.
target_text: 机组决定将飞机转移到奥黑尔，清空飞机，让炸弹小组检查安全。

source_text: They discovered vials of herbal liquids, some wires, and an MP3 player.
target_text: 他们发现了几瓶药液、一些电线和一个MP3播放器。

source_text: The passenger and music player were reunited, everybody re-boarded the aircraft, and with three hours lost, the flight took off for San Francisco.
target_text: 乘客和音乐播放器重新团聚，每个人都重新登上飞机，三个小时后，飞机起飞前往旧金山。

source_text: Before a crowd of 575 on Saturday at Wembley Park in Box Hill, metropolitan Melbourne, Australia, W-League team Canberra United lost to the Melbourne Victory 0–3 in the team's first loss since January of last year.
target_text: 上周六，在澳大利亚墨尔本大都会区Box Hill的温布利公园，面对575名球迷，W联赛球队堪培拉联队以0比3输给墨尔本，这是该队自去年1月以来首次失利。

source_text: Two of the Victory's goals came in the first half, with Canadian import Jessica McDonald and English import Jessica Fishlock each scoring for the Victory.
target_text: 胜利的两个进球来自上半场，加拿大的杰西卡·麦克唐纳和英国的杰西卡·菲什洛克各进一球。

source_text: Enza Barilla scored the third unanswered goal for the Victory in the second half.
target_text: 恩扎·巴里拉为下半场的胜利打入了第三个无人防守的进球。

source_text: Canberra went into the game with a depleted roster, with six players called away to participate in national team training, suspended or out because of injury, including team captain Ellie Brush, midfielder Sally Shipard, Michelle Heyman, goalkeeper Mackenzie Arnold, striker Ashleigh Sykes, and winger Hayley Raso.
target_text: 堪培拉以精疲力竭的阵容进入比赛，6名球员被征召参加国家队的训练，因受伤停赛或退出比赛，包括球队队长埃利·布鲁什、中场萨利·希帕德、米歇尔·海曼、门将麦肯齐·阿诺德、前锋阿什利·赛克斯和边锋海利·拉索。

source_text: Caitlin Munoz filled in as the team's captain in Brush's absence, while Sally Rojahn and Catherine Brown each had their first United start and Grace Gill earned her first start of the season.

source_text: A robotic system at Stanford Medical Center was used to perform a laparoscopic gastric bypass surgery successfully with a theoretically similar rate of complications to that seen in standard operations.
target_text: 斯坦福医学中心的一个机器人系统被用来成功地进行腹腔镜胃旁路手术，理论上并发症的发生率与标准手术相似。

source_text: However, as there were only 10 people in the experimental group (and another 10 in the control group), this is not a statistically significant sample.
target_text: 然而，由于实验组中只有10人（对照组中另外10人），这不是具有统计学意义的样本。

source_text: If this surgical procedure is as successful in large-scale studies, it may lead the way for the use of robotic surgery in even more delicate procedures, such as heart surgery.
target_text: 如果这种外科手术在大规模研究中是成功的，那么它可能会导致机器人手术在更复杂的手术中使用，例如心脏手术。

source_text: Note that this is not a fully automated system, as a human doctor controls the operation via remote control.
target_text: 请注意，这不是一个完全自动化的系统，因为人类医生通过远程控制来控制操作。

source_text: There were concerns that doctors, in the future, might only be trained in the remote control procedure.
target_text: 有人担心，未来医生可能只接受远程控制程序的培训。

source_text: Ronald G. Latimer, M.D., of Santa Barbara, CA, warned "The fact that surgeons may have to open the patient or might actually need to revert to standard laparoscopic techniques demands that this basic training be a requirement before a robot is purchased.
target_text: 来自加利福尼亚州圣巴巴拉市的罗纳德G·拉蒂默医学博士警告说：“外科医生可能不得不为病人开刀，或者实际上可能需要恢复到标准的腹腔镜技术，这一事实要求在购买机器人之前必须进行基本的训练。

source_text: We should not be seduced to buy this instrument to train surgeons if they are not able to do the primary operations themselves."
target_text: 如果他们不能自己做主要手术，我们就不应该被诱惑购买这种仪器来培训外科医生。

source_text: A previous "new technology", the electrocardiogram (ECG), has lead to a lack of basic education on the older technology, the stethoscope.
target_text: 先前的“新技术”，即心电图（ECG），导致缺乏对旧技术（听诊器）的基础教育。

source_text: As a result, many heart conditions now go undiagnosed, especially in children and others who rarely undergo an ECG procedure.
target_text: 因此，许多心脏病现在都未得到诊断，尤其是儿童和其他很少接受心电图检查的人。

target_text: 平克·弗洛伊德在一份声明中指出，赛迪是乐队早期阵容的指路明灯，他留下的遗产将继续鼓舞人心。

source_text: However, due to mental illness, he was forced to leave the band after recording only one album, The Piper at the Gates of Dawn.

target_text: 这张专辑的特点是《闪耀在你疯狂的钻石上》，歌词明确表达了巴雷特的成名和随后的解散。

source_text: An alleged Russian spy was arrested in Montreal, having threatened national security.
target_text: 一名涉嫌俄罗斯间谍在蒙特利尔被捕，威胁国家安全。

source_text: The man is identified as a Russian spy and has been living under a false name.
target_text: 这名男子被确认为俄罗斯间谍，一直以化名生活。

source_text: Public Safety Minister Stockwell Day and Immigration Minister Monte Solberg signed the document that authorized the man's arrest.
target_text: 公共安全部部长斯托克威尔·戴和移民部部长蒙特・索尔伯格签署了授权逮捕此人的文件。

source_text: This document is called the national security certificate and is rarely used.
target_text: 该文件称为国家安全证书，很少使用。

source_text: The certificate alerts Ottawa about possible threats to the country.
target_text: 该证书提醒渥太华有关该国可能面临的威胁。

source_text: The ministers of immigration and public safety are obliged to sign the national security certificate.
target_text: 移民和公共安全部长有义务签署国家安全证书。

source_text: The government's most important duty is to ensure the security of all Canadians.
target_text: 政府最重要的职责是确保所有加拿大人的安全。

source_text: A security certificate has been issued ... against a foreign national.
target_text: 已签发安全证书，针对外国公民。

source_text: A foreign national alleging to be a Canadian citizen named Paul William Hampel was arrested in Montreal after a national security certificate under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act was issued against him."
target_text: 一个自称是加拿大公民的外国人，名叫保罗·威廉·汉佩尔，在蒙特利尔根据移民和难民保护法签发国家安全证书后被捕。

source_text: The man came to Canada several years ago with the name of Paul William Hampel, and is now reported to be false.
target_text: 几年前，这名男子以保罗·威廉·汉普尔的名义来到加拿大，现在据报道他是假的。

source_text: Officials at the Canadian Security Intelligence Service (CSIS) are working on identifying the man who entered Canada years ago.
target_text: 加拿大安全情报局（CSIS）的官员们正在努力确定几年前进入加拿大的男子的身份。

source_text: More information will become available as the Federal Court process unfolds.
target_text: 随着联邦法院程序的展开，将会提供更多信息。

source_text: Ottawa believed the man had been "engaging in an act of espionage or an act of subversion," and "belonged to an organization that there are reasonable grounds to believe engages."
target_text: 渥太华认为这名男子“从事间谍活动或颠覆行为”，并且“属于一个有合理理由相信参与的组织”。

source_text: "I don't think we're going to get the most intimate of details, no, not at all", he told CTV Montreal....We'll see a public version of the allegations that will be released by the federal court judge who is going to be responsible for reviewing the basis upon which cabinet will have declared this individual subject to a security certificate.
target_text: “我不认为我们会得到最详尽的细节，不，一点也不，”他告诉CTV蒙特利尔……我们将看到一份公开版本的指控，这些指控将由联邦法院法官发布，该法官将负责审查内阁宣布此人须遵守安全证书的依据。

source_text: "beyond that, though, we may see things settle more quietly between governments," said David Harris, former chief of strategic planning at CSIS.
target_text: “除此之外，我们可能会看到各国政府之间的关系更加平静，”CSIS战略规划前负责人大卫哈里斯说。

source_text: There are also influence operations where countries might try to influence their expatriates and émigré communities in Canada.
target_text: 还有影响力的行动，各国可能会试图影响他们在加拿大的外籍人士和移民社区。

source_text: "Beyond that, there is a real appetite building among many countries for technological secrets", he said.
target_text: 他表示：“除此之外，许多国家对技术秘密的真正兴趣正在增强。”

source_text: They can be of use to industries of the sponsoring nations and these things can have values in the billions for the economies of those countries undertaking these operations.
target_text: 它们可以用于赞助国的工业，这些东西对于从事这些业务的国家的经济可以有数十亿的价值。

source_text: Reports say the man's methods in Canada matched the techniques used by the Russian intelligence agency's Directorate S, which runs the Russian spy network.
target_text: 报道说，这名男子在加拿大的作案手法与俄罗斯情报机构管理俄罗斯间谍网络的理事会所使用的手法相吻合。

source_text: Twenty people since 1991 have been charged under the Security Certificate legislation in Canada.
target_text: 自1991年以来，已有20人根据加拿大的安全证书立法被起诉。

source_text: The court hearing for the man being held in Montreal will be on Wednesday.
target_text: 该男子在蒙特利尔举行的法庭听证会将于周三举行。

source_text: It is still unclear if the hearing will be in Ottawa, the nations capital, or in Montreal.
target_text: 目前还不清楚听证会将在加拿大首都渥太华还是蒙特利尔举行。

source_text: The call-in quiz show is a staple of cheap programming throughout Europe.
target_text: 电话接听智力竞答节目是整个欧洲廉价节目的主要内容。

source_text: The format is simple: a question is displayed on screen, and callers phone in with their guesses – paying a premium rate to do so.

source_text: The programs are often repetitive, the average question simple, the average prize small.
target_text: 节目往往是重复的，问题一般简单，奖品一般小。

source_text: Throwing the telephone down on the studio floor and stomping on it, she admonished her viewers, "I want the telephone to ring now.
target_text: 她把电话扔在演播室的地板上，重重地踩在上面，警告观众说：“我现在要电话铃响。”

source_text: We want to look like the celebrities that television launches."

source_text: And I was doing all this in order to increase my chances to get my dream job in television."
target_text: 我做这些都是为了增加我在电视行业找到梦想工作的机会。”

source_text: She describes a typical day: "One hour and a half before the show I'm in the make-up room.
target_text: 她描述了一个典型的一天：“演出前一个半小时，我在化妆室。

source_text: After I'm done with hair and make-up I go down to the studio for the before the show to talk to the producer.

source_text: And then is the result that anyone gets to see."
target_text: 然后是每个人都能看到的结果。”

source_text: All of her banter on-air is improvised: "Definitely there is no script! Everything that you see comes out spontaneosly during the show."
target_text: 她所有播出的表演都是即兴的：“绝对没有剧本！你看到的所有东西都是在节目中自发出现的。”

source_text: I enjoy it very much!
target_text: 我非常喜欢！

source_text: If I'm tired at the end of the show it means I've done a good show.
target_text: 如果我在节目结束时累了，那就说明我演得不错。

source_text: When I play a clip of one of her energetic show presentations – not the one she's become best known for – she elaborates on her exuberance.
target_text: 当我播放一个她充满活力的演出片段，而不是她最出名的那个时，她详述她的激动表现。

source_text: I'm always excited when I'm about to give big prizes!
target_text: 当我即将给予大奖时，我总是很兴奋！

source_text: There is no show without winners!

target_text: 她去了演播室，准备好发型和妆容，和制片人谈了话，然后上了银幕。

source_text: The only thing out of the ordinary, she says, was the size of the prize: 1500 leu, about $US 450, or roughly a month's wage for a typical Romanian.
target_text: 她说，唯一不同寻常的是奖金的大小：1500列伊，约450美元，或典型罗马尼亚人大约一个月的工资。

source_text: She says she and her show weren't fired or fined.
target_text: 她说，她和她的节目没有被解雇或罚款。

target_text: 事实上，当2009年1月9日，俄罗斯MTV播放了她在电话上大喊大叫和跺脚的片段，并混合了一些戏剧性的管弦乐摇滚音乐时，她第一次意识到那天的广播有一些不寻常的地方。

source_text: That same clip, uploaded onto video service YouTube, quickly garnered over one million views.

source_text: And as for the charge most frequently leveled against her, that she's "crazy": "I think it is normal that people have prejudicies, everyone is free to express his opinion in the same way that I'm free to do my job the best that I can!
