source_text: Some of the United Kingdom's most influential British Muslims have written a letter to Prime Minister Tony Blair saying that there must be urgent changes to UK foreign policy.
target_text: 英国一些最具影响力的穆斯林致信英国首相托尼·布莱尔，称英国外交政策必须立即改变。

source_text: In the memo, they say current government policy musters fanaticism and puts ordinary people at risk in both the United Kingdom and abroad.
target_text: 他们在备忘录中表示，当前的政府政策会引起狂热，并使普通民众在英国和国外都处于危险之中。

source_text: The letter has been signed by three Muslim Members of Parliament, three Muslim peers and thirty-eight Muslim groups including the Muslim Council of Britain, the Muslim Association of Britain, the British Muslim Forum and the Muslim Solidarity Committee.
target_text: 这封信已由三名穆斯林议员，三名穆斯林同僚和三十八个穆斯林团体签署，其中包括英国穆斯林委员会，英国穆斯林协会，英国穆斯林论坛和穆斯林团结委员会。

source_text: This government has had some major foreign policy successes that have helped make the world a better place.
target_text: 这个政府已经取得了一些重大的外交政策成功，这些成功使世界变得更加美好。

source_text: But current policy on the Middle East is seen by almost everyone I speak to as unfair and unjust.
target_text: 但是，我所说的几乎每个人都认为目前的中东政策是不公平和不公正的。

source_text: Whether we like it or not such a sense of injustice plays into the hands of extremists.
target_text: 无论我们喜欢与否，这种不公正感都会落入极端主义者的手中。

source_text: As moderates we will do all we can to fight extremism.
target_text: 作为温和派，我们将尽一切努力打击极端主义。

source_text: We hope the government will join us in this, not just by changing the rules on hand luggage, but by showing itself as an advocate for justice in the world.
target_text: 我们希望政府能够加入我们，不仅仅是通过改变手提行李的规则，而是通过展示自己作为世界公正的倡导者。

source_text: In a response to the letter, a 10 Downing Street spokesman said: "We should always remember that the terrorism affecting the West today has blighted Muslim countries for several decades.
target_text: 唐宁街10号发言人在回信时说：“我们应该永远记住，今日影响西方的恐怖主义已经摧毁了穆斯林国家几十年。

source_text: It certainly pre-dated our decision to support democracy in Afghanistan and Iraq and of course the September 11 attacks.
target_text: 这当然早于我们支持阿富汗和伊拉克民主的决定，当然也早于911恐怖袭击。

source_text: Our foreign policy is focused on supporting the people of those countries in their desire to live in a democracy just as we enjoy in the UK."
target_text: 我们的外交政策重点是支持这些国家的人民希望像我们在英国一样生活在一个民主国家。”

source_text: The letter comes after police foiled an alleged attempt by terrorists to blow up several planes travelling mid-air from the United Kingdom to the United States of America.
target_text: 这封信是在警方挫败恐怖分子企图炸毁几架从英国飞往美利坚合众国的飞机之后发出的。

source_text: An accident involving two school buses, a tractor trailer and an sport utility vehicle has left at least two people dead and fifty more injured about 40 miles outside of St. Louis, Missouri according to reports.
target_text: 据报道，密苏里州圣路易斯市40英里外发生一起事故，涉及两辆校车、一辆拖拉机拖车和一辆运动型多用途车，造成至少两人死亡，50多人受伤。

source_text: The school buses were carrying students from St. James High School and were en route to the Six Flags St. Louis amusement park, approximately 10 miles (16.1 kilometres) from the scene of the accident.
target_text: 校车上载着圣詹姆斯高中的学生，他们正前往六旗圣路易斯游乐园，那里距离事故现场大约10英里（16.1公里）。

source_text: In an interview Saturday, October 21 with Aljazeera.net, Alberto Fernandez, a senior diplomat with the State Department, made the following statement concerning the war in Iraq: "We tried to do our best, but I think there is much room for criticism, because, undoubtedly, there was arrogance and there was stupidity from the United States in Iraq,"
target_text: 10月21日星期六，美国国务院高级外交官阿尔贝托·费尔南德斯在接受Aljazeera.net的采访时，就伊拉克战争发表了如下声明：“我们尽了最大努力，但我认为还有很大的批评余地，因为毫无疑问，在伊拉克，美国有些傲慢和愚蠢。”

source_text: Fernandez later apologized, "Upon reading the transcript of my appearance on Al-Jazeera, I realized that I seriously misspoke by using the phrase 'there has been arrogance and stupidity' by the U.S. in Iraq."
target_text: 费尔南德斯后来道歉说：“当我看到我在半岛电视台露面的文字记录时，我意识到我严重说错了，因为使用了‘在伊拉克，美国有些傲慢和愚蠢’这句话。”

source_text: Wikileaks has obtained and released a list of all 3,863 websites that are being censored by Danish Internet Service Providers as of February 2008.
target_text: 维基解密已获得并发布了截至2008年2月由丹麦互联网服务提供商审查的所有3,863个网站的列表。

source_text: We discussed the unusual leak with them, and the results are published here.
target_text: 我们与他们讨论了不寻常的泄漏，结果发表在这里。

source_text: We asked if Wikileaks was worried about the criminal implications of linking to so much illegal content, but they were not.
target_text: 我们问维基解密是否担心与这么多非法内容链接会带来犯罪后果，但他们并不担心。

source_text: We asked them if they were "concerned about the possibility of censorship in the UK, Denmark, Finland etc.?"
target_text: 我们问他们是否“担心在英国、丹麦、芬兰等地有可能实施审查”。

source_text: Wikinews wondered if this was because of the Streisand effect, but Wikileaks said it was "because it will demonstrate how censorship systems are abused."
target_text: 维基新闻想知道这是否是因为史翠珊效应，但维基解密称这是“因为它将证明审查制度是如何被滥用的。”

source_text: Wikinews asked Wikileaks why they didn't simply post a list of the sites which they felt were legal and add that all the others contained child porn, but Wikileaks felt "that would not be a fair representation of the material we obtained."
target_text: 维基新闻问维基解密他们为什么不简单地发布他们认为合法的网站列表，并补充说所有其他网站都包含儿童色情内容，但维基解密认为“以这种方式呈现我们所获得的材料并不公平”。

source_text: After seeking clarification, Wikinews was told "the question is not what we need to be told.
target_text: 在寻求解释后，维基新闻被告知“问题不在于我们需要被告知什么。

source_text: The question is what we need not to be told and who decides.
target_text: 问题是我们不需要被告知什么以及由谁来决定。

source_text: Wikinews then asked why they didn't leave the full list available, but mark which sites they felt should not be censored.
target_text: 维基新闻随后询问为什么他们没有留下完整的清单，但标出他们认为不应该审查的网站。

source_text: We have better things to do, was the response given.
target_text: 得到的答复是，我们有更好的事情要做。

source_text: And what would due process be?
target_text: 什么是正当程序？

source_text: Due process would involve sending a letter to the owner of the merchant account with the accusation and giving them a right to be heard and an appeal process.
target_text: 正当程序将包括向商户账户的所有者发送一封带有指控的信函，并赋予他们被听取的权利和上诉程序。

source_text: The banks are politically a lot more powerful than the internet industry so this hasn't happened."
target_text: 银行在政治上比互联网行业强大得多，所以这种情况尚未发生。”

source_text: And should funds in these accounts be seized straight away, or simply frozen until a judge or similar clears their release?
target_text: 这些账户中的资金应该立即被扣押，还是干脆被冻结，直到法官或类似机构批准释放这些资金？

source_text: "If the accounts are in-jurisdiction, they should be frozen and released or not at the end of the process.
target_text: “如果帐户属于司法管辖，它们应该被冻结，并在流程结束时决定释放或否。

source_text: There are plenty of existing mechanisms to do this for drug trafficking, for example."
target_text: 例如，在毒品贩运方面有许多现有的机制可以做到这一点。”

source_text: Wikileaks then added "As an analogy, one might argue that everyone should have a loaded gun in the house to protect themselves against home invasions.
target_text: 维基解密接着补充道：“作为一个类比，有人可能会说，每个人在家里都应该有一把上膛的枪，以保护自己免受家庭入侵。”

source_text: A class action suit has been filed on Tuesday by the Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) against the telecom giant AT&T.
target_text: 周二，电子前线基金会（EFF）向电信巨头AT＆T提起集体诉讼。

source_text: The suit, filed in San Francisco, alleges that AT&T violated federal laws by collaborating with government to eavesdrop on U.S. citizens.
target_text: 该诉讼在旧金山提起，指控AT＆T违反联邦法律，与政府合作窃听美国公民。

source_text: The Bush Administration and NSA have come under fire over the issue.
target_text: 布什政府和国家安全局在这个问题上遭到抨击。

source_text: They defend the program by saying they are only listening in on suspected terrorists.
target_text: 他们捍卫该计划，称他们只是在聆听可疑的恐怖分子。

source_text: The EFF claims that AT&;T turned over 2 databases consisting of their subscribers' communication and internet usage records.
target_text: EFF声称AT&T移交了2个数据库，包括用户的通信和互联网使用记录。

source_text: Attorney Kevin Bankston representing the EFF said the government could not conduct their surveillance without the help of companies like AT&T.
target_text: EFF的代表律师凯文·班克斯顿表示，如果没有AT&T等公司的帮助，政府无法进行监控。

source_text: He also said their goal is to tell AT&T that it is not in their fiscal best interests, along with not being legal, to cooperate with the President's wiretap program.
target_text: 他还表示，他们的目标是告诉AT&T，与总统的窃听计划合作，不符合他们的财政利益，也不符合法律规定。

source_text: According to the class action suit, AT&T granted "access to all or a substantial number of the communications transmitted through its key domestic telecommunications facilities, including direct access to streams of domestic, international and foreign telephone and Internet communications."
target_text: 根据集体诉讼，AT&T允许政府访问“通过其国内关键电信设施传输的全部或相当数量的通信，包括直接访问国内、国际和国外电话及互联网通信流”。

source_text: The lawsuit is seeking damages of $22,000 for each AT&T customer in addition to punitive fines.
target_text: 除了惩罚性罚款外，诉讼还要求对每个AT&T客户赔偿22000美元。

source_text: AT&T is also facing scrutiny from the Federal Communications Commission and possibly fines for failing to properly certify that customer records were safeguarded.
target_text: AT&T还面临美国联邦通信委员会的审查，可能会因未能正确证明客户记录受到了保护而被罚款。

source_text: New reports have emerged detailing the extent of the efforts by the Iranian government to purge Western cultural influence in Iran that is deemed un-Islamic.
target_text: 新的报道已经出现，详细描述了伊朗政府在伊朗清除被认为是非伊斯兰的西方文化影响力的努力程度。

source_text: Based on Iran's Islamic Sharia law, non-compliance results in legal punishment because the state sees itself responsible in executing punishment for Islamic theological sins.
target_text: 根据伊朗的伊斯兰教法，不遵守规定会导致法律惩罚，因为国家认为自己有责任对伊斯兰神学罪行进行惩罚。

source_text: Newspaper headlines such as "Western hairstyles ... have been banned" re-iterated the legal status of Western hairstyles; barbers who offer to what officials consider un-Islamic hairdos, provide make-up services, and pluck eyebrows have been warned that they can face month-long suspension or revocation of their licenses.
target_text: 诸如“西方发型……被禁止”等报纸头条再次反映了西方发型的法律地位。这些提供被官员认为是非伊斯兰的发型、提供化妆服务或挑眉毛的理发师已经遭到警告，可能面临长达一个月的执照暂停或撤销。

source_text: Barber clients who violate government policies will be subject to lashes, fines and imprisonment.
target_text: 违反政府政策的理发师客户将受到鞭刑、罚款和监禁。

source_text: According to Iranian television statement, "In order to prevent possible misuse of MMS, immoral actions and social problems, the Telecommunications Ministry will filter immoral MMS."
target_text: 根据伊朗电视台的声明，“为防止可能滥用彩信、不道德行为和社会问题，电信部将过滤不道德的彩信。”

source_text: No details of how immoral messages would be filtered such naming the type of software to be used were divulged.
target_text: 没有任何关于如何过滤不道德信息的细节，例如将要使用的软件类型的命名被泄露。

source_text: One store-owner says that fewer than 50 units were sold in the first 2 hours of its release.
target_text: 一位店主表示，在发布后的前2个小时内，售出不到50个台。

source_text: Many believe that in Japan it is difficult for any games console to be successful that isn't from a Japanese company, such as Sony or Nintendo.
target_text: 许多人认为，在日本，任何一款游戏机，如果不是来自索尼或任天堂等日本公司，都很难取得成功。

source_text: The first generation of Xbox consoles performed similarly possibly due to being released two years after the PlayStation 2.
target_text: 第一代Xbox游戏机的表现类似，这可能是因为它比PlayStation 2晚两年发布。

source_text: The large size of the console and the differing style of games was also said to have contributed.
target_text: 游戏机的巨大尺寸和不同风格的游戏也被认为是原因之一。

source_text: Members of Australia's Health Services Union (HSU) will go on strike in Victoria next week in a dispute over stalled wage and career structure negotiations.
target_text: 澳大利亚卫生服务联盟（HSU）成员基于在停滞工资和职业结构的谈判上仍有争端，将于下周在维多利亚州继续罢工。

source_text: Over 5000 physiotherapists, speech pathologists and radiation therapists will walk off the job next week, effectively closing the state's 68 largest health services.
target_text: 超过5000名的物理治疗师、语言病理学家和放射治疗师将于下周离开工作岗位，有效关闭该州最大的68家医疗服务机构。

source_text: The strike will force the closure of intensive care units and emergency departments across the state.
target_text: 罢工将迫使整个州的重症监护病房和急诊部门关闭。

source_text: National secretary of the HSU, Kathy Jackson said admissions would be crippled, while intensive care patients would have to be evacuated to New South Wales, Tasmania and South Australia as hospitals will not be able to perform tests or administer treatment.
target_text: HSU的国家秘书凯西·杰克逊说，入院安排将瘫痪，而重症监护病人不得不撤离到新南威尔士州、塔斯马尼亚州和南澳大利亚州，因为医院将无法进行检查或实施治疗。

source_text: If something goes wrong in an ICU you need to be able to X-ray, use nuclear medicine or any diagnostic procedure, said Ms Jackson.
target_text: 杰克逊女士说，如果ICU出现问题，你需要能够进行X光检查，使用核医学或任何诊断程序。

source_text: Ms Jackson said the HSU offered arbitration last year, but the state government refused.
target_text: 杰克逊女士说，HSU去年提出了仲裁，但州政府拒绝了。

source_text: They're not interested in settling disputes, they hope that we are just going to go away.
target_text: 他们对解决争端不感兴趣，他们希望我们能够走开。

source_text: We're not going away, we've gone back and balloted the whole public health workforce in Victoria, those ballots were successful, 97 percent approval rating, she said.
target_text: 她说，我们不会走开，我们已经回来并要求整个维多利亚州的公共卫生人员投票，这些投票是成功的，有97％的支持率。

source_text: The HSU is urging the government to commence serious negotiations to resolve the dispute before industrial action commenced.
target_text: HSU敦促政府在工业行动开展之前开始认真谈判以解决争端。

source_text: The government has offered the union a 3.25 per cent pay increase, in line with other public sector workers but the union has demanded more, but stopped short of specifying a figure.
target_text: 政府已向工会提议3.25％的加薪，与其他公共部门工人一致，但工会要求更多，但没有说明一个数字。

source_text: Victorian Premier John Brumby said the claim would be settled according to the government's wages policy.
target_text: 维多利亚州州长约翰·布伦比表示，这一要求将根据政府的工资政策来解决。

source_text: The Government is always willing and wanting to sit down and negotiate with the relevant organisations .
target_text: 政府总是愿意并希望与有关组织坐下来谈判。

source_text: we have a wages policy based around an increase of 3.25 per cent and, above that, productivity offset, he told parliament.
target_text: 他对议会表示，我们的工资政策基础是百分之3.25左右的增长，高于这一水平，将抵消生产率的上升。

source_text: Ms Jackson said wages and career structures in Victoria were behind other states.
target_text: 杰克逊女士说，维多利亚州的工资和职业结构落后于其他州。

source_text: Victorian Opposition Leader Ted Baillieu said he was not in support of the proposed strike and called on the government to meet with unions.
target_text: 维多利亚反对党领袖泰德·贝利厄表示，他不支持罢工提议，并呼吁政府与工会会面。

source_text: There could not be a more serious threat to our health system than has been announced today.
target_text: 对我们的卫生系统来说，没有比今天宣布的更严重的威胁了。

source_text: We now have to do whatever is possible to stop this strike from proceeding, he said.
target_text: 他说，我们现在必须尽一切可能阻止这次罢工。

source_text: The opposition leader will meet with the union at 11:30 AM today.
target_text: 反对派领导人将于今天上午11：30与工会会面。

source_text: Victorian Hospitals Industry Association industrial relations services manager Simon Chant said hospitals were looking at the possible impact and warned that patients may have to be evacuated interstate if the strike goes ahead.
target_text: 维多利亚州医院行业协会工业关系服务经理西蒙·钱特说，医院正在考虑可能产生的影响，并警告说，如果罢工继续进行，病人可能必须撤出至州外。

source_text: The Belgian parliament on Friday approved the new Van Rompuy I Government consisting of the same five political parties that formed the last ruling coalition, temporarily ending the country's political crisis.
target_text: 比利时议会周五批准了新的范龙佩一世政府，该政府由组成最后一个执政联盟的五个政党组成，暂时结束了该国的政治危机。

source_text: Lower house deputies approved the Motion of Confidence by a majority of 88 votes to 45, with no abstentions.
target_text: 众议院代表以88票赞成、45票反对、零票弃权通过了这项信任动议。

source_text: Don't judge the government... by its intentions but by its results, but no results in the very short-term, judge us in 2011, Van Rompuy told the lawmakers.
target_text: 范龙佩告诉议员们，“不要以它的意图，而要以结果来评判政府，但在短期内不会有结果。请在2011年评判我们”。

source_text: He also asked for full restoration of confidence amid the near-collapse of the country’s two largest banks.
target_text: 在该国两大银行近乎崩溃的情况下，他还要求充分恢复信心。

source_text: The previous government proposed such a plan (pumping 2 billion euros or $2.84 billion, into the economy next year, part of a 200 billion euro EU-wide stimulus package).
target_text: 上届政府提出了这样一项计划（明年向经济注入20亿欧元或28.4亿美元，这是欧盟范围内2000亿欧元刺激计划的一部分）。

source_text: It is clear that in the coming weeks and months the government will take new initiatives to cope with the challenges that the crisis poses for the economy and employment, he added.
target_text: 他补充说，很明显，在未来几周和几个月，政府将采取新的举措，应对危机给经济和就业带来的挑战。

source_text: Van Rompuy, age 61, is a conservative Belgian Flemish politician and member of the CD&V (formerly called CVP) who succeeds Yves Leterme.
target_text: 现年61岁的范龙佩是比利时佛兰德的保守派政治家，也是接替伊夫·莱特姆的CD&V（前称CVP）的成员。

source_text: Eighteen of the 22 ministers served in the same posts in Prime Minister Yves Leterme's government.
target_text: 22位部长中有18位曾在伊夫·莱特姆总理的政府中担任同样的职务。

source_text: Prime Minister Yves Leterme offered the resignation of his government on December 18 to King Albert after a crisis erupted surrounding the sale of troubled Fortis bank to BNP Paribas.
target_text: 12月18日，在陷入困境的富通银行被法国巴黎银行收购引发危机后，总理伊夫·莱特姆向阿尔贝国王递交了辞呈。

source_text: Leterme, Justice Minister Jo Vandeurzen, and Didier Reynders were accused of violating the separation of powers and exerting improper influence by trying to influence the Court of Appeals; this accusation was made by the First Chairman of the Court of Cassation.
target_text: 莱特姆、司法部长范德生和雷恩·代尔被指控试图影响上诉法院，违反权力分离和施加不当影响；这一指控是由终审法院第一任主席提出的。

source_text: Other opposition parties also questioned the created "Fortisgate" parliamentary commission of enquiry alleging it was a scheme to acquit Leterme.
target_text: 其他反对党也对成立的“Fortisgate”议会调查委员会提出质疑，指称这是一个无罪释放莱特姆的计划。

source_text: It is a founding member of the European Union and hosts its headquarters, as well as those of other major international organizations, including NATO.
target_text: 它是欧洲联盟的创始成员，并拥有其总部以及包括北约在内的其他主要国际组织的总部。

source_text: Belgium covers an area of 30,528 km2 (11,787 square miles) and has a population of about 10.5 million.
target_text: 比利时占地面积30,528平方公里（11,787平方英里），人口约1050万。

source_text: Belgium shares borders with France (620 km), Germany (167 km), Luxembourg (148 km) and the Netherlands (450 km).
target_text: 比利时与法国（620公里）、德国（167公里）、卢森堡（148公里）和荷兰（450公里）接壤。

source_text: Its total area, including surface water area, is 33,990 square kilometres; land area alone is 30,528 km2.
target_text: 其总面积，包括地表水面积为33,990平方公里；仅土地面积就达30,528平方公里。

source_text: Art thieves in Greece broke into the Athens National Gallery on Monday and stole three valuable works of art.
target_text: 希腊艺术品窃贼周一闯入雅典国家美术馆，偷走了三件珍贵的艺术品。

source_text: Among them was a painting by famous Spanish painter Pablo Picasso, dated 1939, called Woman's Head which was a gift to the Greek people for their resistance to the Nazis during World War 2.
target_text: 其中有一幅是着名的西班牙画家巴勃罗·毕加索于1939年绘制、名为“女人的头”的画作，这幅画是送给希腊人民的礼物，为的是他们在第二次世界大战期间抵抗纳粹。

source_text: The other two works were Mill by Piet Mondrian and a sketch of St. Diego de Alcala by Guglielmo Caccia.
target_text: 其他两件作品分别是皮特·蒙德里安的“磨坊”和古列尔莫·卡西亚的“圣迭戈·德阿尔卡拉素描”。

source_text: A fourth painting, Landscape, also by Piet Mondrian was dropped by the thieves when pursued by security.
target_text: 第四幅画是风景画，也是皮特·蒙德里安的作品，在小偷们被保安追捕时被扔下了。

source_text: The police stated multiple alarms during the evening of the heist in other parts of the building had distracted the gallery guard.
target_text: 警方表示，当晚大楼其他地方的多次警报分散了画廊警卫的注意力。

source_text: Investigating yet another alarm, he saw the shadow of a fleeing individual.
target_text: 在调查另一起警报事件时，他看到了一个逃跑的人的影子。

source_text: Citizen's Protection Minister Christos Papoutsis apologized for the loss, citing that the security at the gallery was "non-existent".
target_text: 公民保护部长克里斯托斯·帕普蒂斯为损失道歉，称美术馆的安全措施“不存在”。

source_text: The value of the works stolen was not yet determined by gallery officials.
target_text: 被盗作品的价值尚未由画廊官员确定。

source_text: The artwork in question was on display at the gallery as part of an exhibition called "Unknown Treasures", including works of Albrecht Durer and Rembrandt.
target_text: 这些被偷走的艺术品是美术馆展出的“未知珍宝”展览的一部分，该展览中还包括阿尔布莱希特·丢勒和伦勃朗的作品。

source_text: A U.S. Army report finds stress is weighing heavily on Iraq War-era troops with 54 percent of soldiers rating their units' morale as low or very low.
target_text: 美国陆军的一份报告发现，伊拉克战争时期的军队承受着巨大的压力，百分之54的士兵评价他们的部队士气低落或非常低落。

source_text: This is better than the comparable figure in a year-earlier Army survey.
target_text: 这比一年前陆军调查中的可比数字要好。

source_text: Defense Secretary Donald H. Rumsfeld said that the Army's 12-month requirement is linked to reorganization.
target_text: 国防部长唐纳德·拉姆斯菲尔德说，陆军12个月的要求与重组有关。

source_text: I've tried to get the Army to look at the length of tours and I think at some point down the road they will, Rumsfeld said.
target_text: 拉姆斯菲尔德说：“我已经试着让军队审视军旅的长度，我认为在将来的某个时点他们会这样做的。”

source_text: Homeland Security Secretary Janet Napolitano announced today at a news conference that the U.S. has declared a public health emergency in light of the swine flu outbreak.
target_text: 国土安全部长珍妮特·纳波利塔诺今天在一次新闻发布会上宣布，鉴于猪流感爆发，美国已宣布进入公共卫生紧急状态。

source_text: The total number of confirmed swine flu cases in the United States stands at 20.
target_text: 美国确诊的猪流感病例总数为20。

source_text: Secretary Napolitano said that the United States' declaration follows suit with the "standard operating procedure" of such an outbreak to make more government resources available to combat the disease.
target_text: 国务卿纳波利塔诺说，美国的声明与疫情的“标准操作程序”是一致的，目的是提供更多的政府资源来抗击疫情。

source_text: One direct result of the declaration is the government's mobilization of approximately 12 million doses of Tamiflu to locations where the states can quickly access their share of the medication if needed.
target_text: 宣言的一个直接结果是，政府动员了大约1200万剂达菲至各地区，使各州可以在需要时迅速获得其份额。

source_text: Secretary Napolitano urged residents not to panic saying that the government is issuing a "declaration of emergency preparedness."
target_text: 国务卿纳波利塔诺敦促居民不要惊慌，她说，政府正在发布“应急准备声明”。

source_text: Secretary Napolitano added, "Really that's what we're doing right now.
target_text: 国务卿纳波利塔诺补充道，“真的，这就是我们现在正在做的事情。

source_text: We're preparing in an environment where we really don't know ultimately what the size of seriousness of this outbreak is going to be."
target_text: 我们的确不知道疫情最终会发展到如何严重的程度，我们在这样的一个环境中进行准备。”

source_text: John Brennan, a Homeland Security assistant, added that "at this point, a top priority is to ensure that communication is robust and that medical surveillance efforts are fully activated."
target_text: 国土安全助理约翰·布伦南补充说：“目前，首要任务是确保通讯畅通，医疗监督工作全面启动。”

source_text: This afternoon, New York City Mayor Michael Bloomberg reported that 8 students from the St. Francis Prepatory School in Queens, New York have contracted the swine flu.
target_text: 今天下午，纽约市市长迈克尔·布隆伯格报告说，来自纽约皇后区圣弗朗西斯预科学校的8名学生感染了猪流感。

source_text: All in all, more than 100 students from that high school were absent last week with flu-like symptoms.
target_text: 上周，该校共有100多名学生因流感样症状缺课。

source_text: Meanwhile, public health officials in Ohio today announced one confirmed case of swine flu in the state.
target_text: 与此同时，俄亥俄州的公共卫生官员今天在该州宣布了一例确诊的猪流感病例。

source_text: Thus far, California has reported 7 confirmed cases of swine flu, while Kansas and Texas have each reported two confirmed cases.
target_text: 到目前为止，加利福尼亚已经报告了7例确诊的猪流感病例，而堪萨斯州和德克萨斯州则分别报告了2例确诊病例。

source_text: At the same news conference Dr. Richard Besser, the acting director from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), said to expect additional cases of swine flu to be reported in the short term.
target_text: 在同一场新闻发布会上，美国疾病控制和预防中心（CDC）代理主任理查德·贝瑟博士说，预计在短期内还会报告更多的猪流感病例。

source_text: Dr. Besser added that the U.S. could also start seeing cases of the disease where the effects are more dramatic: "We're going to see more severe disease in this country".
target_text: 贝瑟博士补充说，美国也可能开始看到疾病的影响更为显著的病例：“我们将在这个国家看到更严重的疾病。”

source_text: So far, no one in the U.S. has died from swine flu.
target_text: 到目前为止，美国没有人死于猪流感。

source_text: The Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard has conducted a missile test exercise, in which nine missiles of three different types were launched simultaneously.
target_text: 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队进行了一次导弹试验，同时发射了三种不同类型的九枚导弹。

source_text: The exercise, known as Great Prophet III was conducted early this morning from an undisclosed location near to the Strait of Hormuz.
target_text: 这次演习被称为“大先知3号”，于今天凌晨在霍尔木兹海峡附近的一个秘密地点进行。

source_text: One of the missiles launched was an upgraded version of the Shahab-3, capable of reaching Eastern European countries like Bulgaria and Greece as well and Middle Eastern countries such as Israel, Egypt and the Arabian Peninsula.
target_text: 其中一枚导弹是“流星-3”的升级版，能够到达保加利亚和希腊等东欧国家，以及以色列、埃及和阿拉伯半岛等中东国家。

source_text: The Iranians have been under international pressure to withraw from their plans of achieving nuclear proficiency, but have rejected putting a hold on their programme and have also been moving forward with their rocketry programme.
target_text: 伊朗一直受到国际社会的压力，要求其放弃提升核能力的计划，但伊朗拒绝搁置核计划，并一直在推进火箭计划。

source_text: The test is believed to have been a reaction to Israeli and American military exercises, which the Iranian government believed to be training for an attack on facilities related to the Iranian nuclear development programme.
target_text: 据信这次试验是对以色列和美国军事演习的反应，伊朗政府认为这些演习是为了攻击与伊朗核发展计划有关的设施而进行的。

source_text: In addition to these tests, Iran's first indigenous satellite launch attempt, which will place the Omid spacecraft into low Earth orbit, is expected immanently.
target_text: 除了这些试验之外，伊朗预计不久之后将进行第一次的本土卫星发射尝试，将把Omid航天器送入近地轨道，。

source_text: A successful satellite launch would demonstrate that Iran's missiles have global reach.
target_text: 一次成功的卫星发射将证明伊朗的导弹射程扩及全球。

source_text: The tests have been widely criticised by the international community.
target_text: 这些测试受到国际社会的广泛批评。

source_text: The British government stated that it "underlines the need for Iran to comply with its international obligations on the nuclear issue", and that the test was "unwelcome".
target_text: 英国政府在声明中强调，“伊朗必须遵守其在核问题上的国际义务”，并且该测试“不受欢迎”。

source_text: The French ministry of defence suggested that "these missile tests can only reinforce the concerns of the international community", and the German government described the exercise as "regrettable".
target_text: 法国国防部建议“这些导弹试验只会加深国际社会的担忧”，而德国政府称这次演习“令人遗憾”。

source_text: The United States government claims that the test was "evidence that the missile threat is not an imaginary one".
target_text: 美国政府声称，这次试验“证明导弹威胁不是凭空捏造的”。

source_text: American presidential candidate John McCain suggested that it justified US proposals to construct a missile defence system in Eastern Europe, whilst his opponent Barack Obama described Iran's missile programme as a "great threat".
target_text: 美国总统候选人约翰·麦凯恩表示，它证明了美国在东欧建设导弹防御系统的提议是合理的，而他的对手巴拉克·奥巴马则称，伊朗的导弹计划是一个“巨大威胁”。

source_text: Russia, however called for diplomacy, stating that they believe Iran to be "ready for negotiations", and Israel's Prime Minister issued a statement saying that he had "no desire for conflict or hostilities with Iran".
target_text: 然而，俄罗斯呼吁进行外交努力，称他们相信伊朗已“准备好谈判”，以色列总理发表声明称，他“无意与伊朗发生冲突或敌对行动”。

source_text: Bayern Munich beat Red Star Belgrade 3-2 on the last kick of the game on 17-year-old Toni Kroos' 1st professional goal.
target_text: 拜仁慕尼黑3-2击败贝尔格莱德红星，17岁的托尼·克罗斯打进了比赛的最后一球，这是他职业生涯的第一个进球。

source_text: Toni Kroos played a key role as he also assisted on Miroslav Klose's 2nd equalizer only minutes earlier.
target_text: 托尼·克罗斯在前几分钟帮助米罗斯拉夫·克洛泽扳平第二球时发挥了关键作用。

source_text: Red Star Belgrade opened the scoring in the 16th minute while Miroslav Klose 1st equalizer 4 minutes later.
target_text: 贝尔格莱德红星在第16分钟率先破门，克洛泽在4分钟后率先扳平比分。

source_text: Red Star Belgrade took the lead again when Michael Rensing couldn't handle a long distance shot.
target_text: 贝尔格莱德红星队再次领先，当时迈克尔·伦辛没能扑住一次远距离射门。

source_text: The eruption of volcano Tungurahua on August 16 destroyed several small villages in the Ecuadorian Andes.
target_text: 8月16日，通古拉瓦火山爆发，摧毁了厄瓜多尔安第斯山脉的几个小村庄。

source_text: At least 6 people have been killed and about 4000 residents of the affected area have been evacuated.
target_text: 至少6人死亡，大约4000名受灾地区的居民被疏散。

source_text: The 5,023 m high volcano spat lava, stones and ash for several hours on Wednesday night.
target_text: 周三晚上，5023米高的火山喷出岩浆、石块和火山灰长达数小时。

source_text: A 10km high ash cloud spread over an area of 740 by 180 km.
target_text: 一个10公里高的灰烬云分布在180到740公里的区域内。

source_text: Towns like Ambato or Riobamba, 30 km away from the volcano have been covered with up to 5cm of ash.
target_text: 像安巴托或里奥班巴这样距离火山30公里的城镇，已经被5厘米厚的火山灰覆盖。

source_text: Pyroclastic flows descending on the northwestern slopes of the volcano left a path of destruction behind.
target_text: 火山碎屑流从火山的西北斜坡上流下，留下了一条破坏之路。

source_text: At least seven small villages and hamlets have been completely destroyed.
target_text: 至少有七个小村庄和村庄被完全摧毁。

source_text: The Institute for Geophysics has lost an important part of its equipment installed on the slopes of Tungurahua, limiting their capability to monitor the volcanic activity.
target_text: 地球物理研究所失去了安装在通古拉瓦斜坡上的一项重要设备，限制了它们监测火山活动的能力。

source_text: On Thursday the provinces of Chimborazo, Tungurahua, Cotopaxi and Bolivar have been declared a disaster area.
target_text: 周四，钦博拉索、通古拉瓦、科托帕希和玻利瓦尔省被宣布为灾区。

source_text: Losses in agriculture due to the ash cover are estimated at $150 Million.
target_text: 由灰烬覆盖造成的农业损失估计为1.5亿美元。

source_text: In 1999, after a long period of rest, the volcano started an eruptive process that continues to this day.
target_text: 1999年，经过长时间的休眠，火山开始喷发，一直持续到今天。

source_text: In May 2006 it increased dramatically culminating in violent eruptions on July 14 and August 16.
target_text: 2006年5月，火山爆发急剧增加，在7月14日和8月16日达到顶峰。

source_text: After the first, overnight on Tuesday at Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge, it was reported in a press release by Marussia that she had lost her right eye, and was still in a "critical but stable" condition.
target_text: 周二在剑桥的阿登布鲁克医院度过了第一个晚上，据玛鲁西亚在新闻发布会上报道，她失去了右眼，目前仍处于“危急但稳定”的状态。

source_text: On Friday, she underwent a second operation, according to Marussia, "a planned procedure that would depend upon the continued stability of Maria’s head injuries, and this morning the medical team were sufficiently happy with her progress to allow the operation to go ahead."
target_text: 根据玛鲁西亚的说法，她在周五接受了第二次手术，“这是一次有计划的手术，将取决于玛利亚头部伤势的持续稳定。今天早上，医疗小组对她的进展非常满意，允许手术继续进行。”

source_text: Subsequent to the operation, her condition was upgraded to "serious but stable".
target_text: 手术后，她的病情升级为“严重但稳定”。

source_text: Her sister, Isabel de Villota, has thanked both F1 fans and drivers for their response, saying "We remain positive and this is due, in no small part, to the overwhelming expression of love for Maria from every corner of the world."
target_text: 她的姐姐伊莎贝尔·德·维洛塔感谢了F1车迷和车手们的回应，她说：“我们保持乐观，这在很大程度上要归功于来自世界各地的人们对玛利亚的爱。”

source_text: Ferrari driver Fernando Alonso was among those expressing his support, dedicating his pole postion in Saturday's qualifying to De Villota.
target_text: 法拉利车手费尔南多·阿隆索也表示了他的支持，他在周六的排位赛中把杆位献给了德·维洛塔。

source_text: Regarding the accident itself, F1 Race Director Charlie Whiting is of the opinion that it was a "one-in-five-million" fluke.
target_text: 关于事故本身，F1赛事总监查理·怀廷认为，这是一个“百万分之一”的偶然。

source_text: Despite questions being raised, both about De Villota's experience and the positioning of the truck with which she collided, he has described it as "so unique that it was just incredible bad luck".
target_text: 尽管德·维洛塔的遭遇和她撞上的那辆卡车的位置都引发了质疑，但他形容这是“如此独特的经历，简直是难以置信的坏运气”。

source_text: The mayor of San Francisco, California, Gavin Newsom, has announced via Twitter that he will be running for the state's governor in the 2010 elections.
target_text: 加州旧金山市长加文·纽瑟姆通过推特宣布，他将参加2010年的州长竞选。

source_text: He will be in the running to replace California's current governor, Arnold Schwarzenegger.
target_text: 他将参与竞选以取代现任加州州长阿诺德·施瓦辛格。

source_text: Need your help," said Newsom on his official Twitter profile.
target_text: 需要你的帮助，“纽瑟姆在他的官方推特个人资料中说。

source_text: Newsom also posted a video on his campaign website which was launched earlier this morning.
target_text: 纽瑟姆还在今天清晨推出的竞选网站上发布了一段视频。

source_text: We can't afford to keep returning to the same old, tired ideas and expect a different result, says Newsom in his campaign video.
target_text: 纽瑟姆在他的竞选视频中表示，我们不能再回到老样子、老旧的想法，而期待一个不同的结果。

source_text: Newsom promises more green technology, local economic stimulus and universal healthcare.
target_text: 纽瑟姆承诺提供更多绿色技术、地方经济刺激和全民医疗。

source_text: His video doesn't mention anything about same-sex marriage, but Newsom is an active opponent of Proposition 8, California's ban on same-sex marriages.
target_text: 他的视频没有提到任何关于同性婚姻的事情，但是纽瑟姆是加州禁止同性婚姻的第8号提案的积极反对者。

source_text: Newsom has been San Francisco's mayor since 2003 and was re-elected in 2007.
target_text: 纽瑟姆自2003年以来一直担任旧金山市长，并于2007年再次当选。

source_text: Everton came from behind to thrash Fulham 4-1 on Friday at Goodison Park.
target_text: 周五，埃弗顿后来居上在古迪逊公园以4-1击败富勒姆。

source_text: Everton had a chance to jump into fifth place in the league ahead of Bolton, while Fulham could have jumped from fifteenth all the way to eleventh, boosting their chances of league survival.
target_text: 埃弗顿本有机会在博尔顿之前跃入联赛第五，而富勒姆本可以从第十五跃升到第十一，从而增加他们在联赛中生存的机会。

source_text: England international Andy Johnson was paired with 18 year old James Vaughan up front for Everton, while Chris Coleman's Fulham had a full North American strike force through American Bryan McBride and Canadian Thomasz Radzinski.
target_text: 英格兰国脚安迪·约翰逊和18岁的詹姆斯·沃恩搭档担任埃弗顿的前锋，而克里斯·科尔曼的富勒姆则通过美国人布莱恩·麦克布莱德和加拿大人托马兹·拉津斯基组成了一个由北美人担当的攻击线。

source_text: The visitors started the game strongly with long range efforts from Rosenior and Smertin, but neither were able to bother Tim Howard in the Everton goal.
target_text: 客队在比赛一开始就在罗西尔和斯默丁的大力配合发动攻击，但两人都没能对蒂姆·霍华德把守的埃弗顿的球门形成威胁德。

source_text: Mikel Arteta was able to trouble Antti Niemi, however, in the Fulham goal, but the Finnish keeper did well to keep the ball out of the bottom corner.
target_text: 然而，米克尔·阿尔特塔却在富勒姆的球门给安蒂·尼米制造了麻烦，但是这位芬兰人门将表现出色将球档出了底角。

source_text: Everton answered back quickly through Lee Carsley after Joleon Lescott's ball found him in the box, and Carsley knocked home the equalizing goal.
target_text: 当乔莱昂·莱斯科特的球在禁区内被发现后，埃弗顿很快通过李·卡斯利做出了回应，卡斯利将比分扳平。

source_text: Everton put Fulham on the back foot after their goal, and should have taken the lead when a nice interchange of play between Vaughan and Johnson left Vaughaun all alone on net, but his shot was hit off the post, and bobbled safely to a Fulham defender.
target_text: 埃弗顿在进球后把富勒姆放到了后脚，本来应该在沃恩和约翰逊之间的一次漂亮的换位后让沃格豪恩独自一人在网上，但他的射门被击中门柱，并被富勒姆的后卫安全绊倒。

source_text: Everton were then awarded a free kick in the Fulham zone, and Mikel Arteta stepped up to take.
target_text: 埃弗顿随后在富勒姆禁区获得了一个任意球，米克尔·阿尔特塔挺身而出。

source_text: His outswinging ball was glanced off the head of Alan Stubbs, and it somehow eluded Niemi, as the homeside took the lead.
target_text: 他的外摆球从阿兰·斯塔布斯的头上擦过，不知怎么地躲过了尼米，因为主队领先。

source_text: Vaughaun would hit the post again several minutes later, but he finally notched his name on the scoresheet just before the break.
target_text: 几分钟后，沃格豪恩再次击中门柱，但就在中场休息前，他终于在得分榜上写下了自己的名字。

source_text: Arteta and Johnson made room on the left side, and Arteta's cross was finished well by the young Vaughan, giving Everton a demanding 3-1 lead.
target_text: 阿尔特塔和约翰逊在左侧腾出了空间，年轻的沃恩完成了阿尔特塔的传中，让埃弗顿以3-1领先。

source_text: After the break, Fulham came out strongly, eager to get back into the match.
target_text: 休息之后，富勒姆强势出场，渴望重新回到比赛中。

source_text: McBride had two good chances from headers, but he was unable to find the net on either.
target_text: 麦克布莱德在头球方面有两次很好的机会，但他也无法找到网。

source_text: Zat Knight then had a chance for Fulham, but the cottagers where again unable to get their attempts on target.
target_text: 扎特·奈特本来有机会得到富勒姆，但是富勒姆的球员们还是没能进球。

source_text: Vuaghan was soon replaced by fellow youngster Victor Anichebe, and he made a nearly instant impact.
target_text: 不久，维亚汉就被另一位年轻球员维克多·阿尼切比所取代，他很快就产生了巨大的影响。

source_text: Anichebee received a pass within the box, and he cooly side-footed the ball hard and low past Niemi, leaving the keeper no chance, and guaranteeing Everton the win on the afternoon.
target_text: 阿尼切比接到禁区内的传球，他冷静地侧脚大力低射，越过涅米，让门将没有机会，并保证埃弗顿在下午取得胜利。

source_text: Substitute Helguson had two chances in quick succession for Fulham, but it wasn't to be their day, as the cottagers drop dangerously into relegation contention.
target_text: 替补赫尔古森为富勒姆连续两次获得机会，但这不是他们的日子，因为这支球队正面临降级的危险。

source_text: Everton's next match in the league is in only 3 days time against Bolton, who are now in sixth place after the Toffee's win.
target_text: 埃弗顿在联赛中的下一场比赛是在3天内对阵博尔顿的比赛中，博尔顿在太妃糖夺冠后现在已经排在第六位。

source_text: Fulham on the other hand will be facing off with fellow relegation contenders Manchester City at Craven Cottage, and it is looking up to be a true relegation six-pointer.

source_text: According to an announcement made by the Office for National Statistics (ONS) on Tuesday, the inflation rate of the United Kingdom measured by the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increased to 3.5% in January 2010, an increase of 0.6% from December 2009.

source_text: The British Government has an inflation target of 2%, which was surpassed by more than 1%.

source_text: For this reason, Mervyn King, who is the Governor of the Bank of England has written a required explanatory letter to Chancellor of the Exchequer Alistair Darling.

target_text: 据说古蒂在离开节目前与大老板签订了一份价值10万英镑的合同。

source_text: She is expected to undergo medical tests so doctors can see how far the cancer has spread.
target_text: 预计她将接受医学检查，以便医生能够了解癌症扩散的程度。

source_text: A multi-center US study of 748 patients, who were to undergo treatment for coronary artery disease, has found that prayer by Christian, Muslim, Jewish, and Buddhist groups had no measurable effects on the medical health of the study subjects.
target_text: 美国多中心对748名接受冠状动脉疾病治疗的患者进行的一项研究发现，基督教、穆斯林、犹太教和佛教团体的祈祷，对研究对象的医疗健康没有可测量的影响。

source_text: The prayers were conducted by established congregations and were held away from the hospitals.
target_text: 祈祷是由既有的会众在远离医院的地方进行的。

source_text: The study, published in the 16 July 2005 issue of The Lancet, found that the likelihood of an adverse cardiovascular event in hospital, re-admission or death within six months was unaffected by prayer.
target_text: 这项研究发表在2005年7月16日出版的“柳叶刀”杂志上。研究发现，在医院里发生心血管疾病、再次入院或在六个月内死亡的可能性不受祈祷的影响。

source_text: None of the patients were told that they were prayed for, and none of the prayer groups knew who they prayed for.
target_text: 没有一个病人被告知有人为他们祈祷，也没有一个祈祷团体知道他们为谁祈祷。

source_text: The study also examined the effects of "music, imagery, and touch (MIT) therapy" before heart surgery.
target_text: 该研究还检查了心脏手术前“音乐、图像和触觉（MIT）治疗”的效果。

source_text: Practitioners qualified to Level 1 Healing Touch taught the patient relaxation techniques and played soothing music before applying 21 Healing Touch hand positions, over a 40 minute session.
target_text: 在40分钟的疗程中，拥有1级触摸治疗资格的从业者，在21处位置实施手触摸治疗前，教授患者放松技巧和播放舒缓音乐。

source_text: There was no significant change in the combined chance of an adverse cardiovascular event in hospital, re-admission or death within six months.
target_text: 6个月内住院、再次入院或死亡的不良心血管事件的总发生率无显著变化。

source_text: However, while the set of patients was evenly split, only 7 patients who received MIT therapy died, and 20 patients who did not receive it died.
target_text: 然而，尽管这组患者被平均分配，但接受MIT治疗的患者只有7名死亡，未接受的患者则有20名死亡。

source_text: The result is not highly significant due to the low overall number of people who died.
target_text: 由于死亡总人数较低，结果并不显着。

source_text: A number of studies has recently examined the possible effects of prayer, with mixed results.
target_text: 最近，一些研究调查了祈祷可能产生的影响，结果并不一致。

source_text: While some religious groups have hailed studies which found positive results , skeptics have challenged the very notion of scientifically examining prayer , and have described past studies as flawed or even fraudulent.
target_text: 尽管一些宗教团体对发现积极结果的研究表示欢迎，但怀疑论者对科学检验祈祷的概念本身提出了质疑，称过去的研究存在缺陷，甚至存在欺诈。

source_text: The mechanisms through which distant intercessory prayer might convey healing benefit are unknown, the authors of the study explain.
target_text: 这项研究的作者解释说，远距离的代祷可能传递治愈益处的机制尚不清楚。

source_text: One hypothesis they propose for such effects are "non-local features of consciousness based theoretically around observations in quantum physics."
target_text: 对于这种效应，他们所提出的假设之一是“基于量子物理学观察理论的意识的非局部特征”。

source_text: The United Nations brokered cease-fire between Israel and Hezbollah is largely holding as Israel has begun to withdraw its forces from Lebanon.
target_text: 在联合国的斡旋下，以色列和真主党之间实现了停火。目前，以色列已经开始从黎巴嫩撤军。

source_text: UNSC Resolution 1701, which calls for a "full cessation of hostilities" in the Israeli-Lebanon war, was passed by the UN Security Council last Friday and was approved by Lebanon and Israel over the weekend.
target_text: 联合国安理会上周五通过了呼吁以黎战争“全面停止敌对行动”的1701号决议，黎巴嫩和以色列周末也批准了该决议。

source_text: Lebanon's defence minister, Elias Murr, says that the 15,000 troops Lebanon has committed to the peacekeeping operation will be on the north side of the Litani River by the end of the week.
target_text: 黎巴嫩国防部长埃利亚斯·穆尔说，到本周末，黎巴嫩已承诺的15,000人部队的维和行动，将在利塔尼河北侧展开。

source_text: As part of the truce agreement, they must cross the river and exercise control over what has been Hezbollah controlled territory in southern Lebanon.
target_text: 作为停火协议的一部分，他们必须过河，对黎巴嫩南部真主党控制的地区实施控制。

source_text: The head of the Israeli army says the IDF could complete its withdrawal from Lebanon in 7 to 10 days.
target_text: 以色列陆军司令表示，以色列国防军可能在7到10天内完成从黎巴嫩的撤军。

source_text: The new international peace-keeping force may number as many as 15,000, significantly larger than the existing force of 2,000, known as UNIFIL, which is expected to take up border positions in the mean time.
target_text: 新的国际维持和平部队可能多达15,000人，远远大于现有的2000人，即联黎部队，预计此时将占据边界阵地。

source_text: The UN hopes for an advance force of up to 3,500 within the next 10 to 14 days.
target_text: 联合国希望在未来10到14天内派遣3500人的先遣部队。

source_text: France, who is expected to lead the international force, is seeking a clearer mandate from the UN on the rules of engagement.
target_text: 预计将领导这支国际部队的法国，正在寻求联合国对交战规则的更明确授权。

source_text: Over 1,200 people have lost their lives in the conflict.
target_text: 在冲突中有1200多人丧生。

source_text: 1,110, mostly civilians, have died in Lebanon and 157 Israelis, mostly military, were killed.
target_text: 在黎巴嫩有1,110人，其中大多数是平民，已有157名以色列人被杀，其中大部分是军人。

source_text: People studying the situation in Myanmar are claiming that an inadequate response of the government of Myanmar (formerly Burma) to scientists' warnings about the cyclone, coupled with large-scale destruction of protective mangroves along its coasts, aggravated the devastation wreaked by tropical Cyclone Nargis.
target_text: 研究缅甸局势的人士声称，缅甸政府（前缅甸）对科学家关于气旋的警告反应不足，再加上沿海地区大规模地破坏具保护性的红树林，加剧了纳尔吉斯热带气旋所造成的破坏。

source_text: The cyclone has killed an estimated 22,980 people so far, with millions rendered homeless by the disaster, which struck the Irrawaddy Delta region of Myanmar last week (3 May).
target_text: 上周（5月3日）袭击缅甸伊洛瓦底三角洲地区的灾难导致数百万人无家可归，而到目前为止，气旋已造成约22,980人死亡。

source_text: Scientists at the Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) in New Delhi, theWorld Meteorological Organisation's specialist centre for Asia, say they issued the first of the cyclone bulletins to Myanmar as early as 26 April.
target_text: 世界气象组织亚洲专家中心新德里印度气象局（IMD）的科学家表示，他们早在4月26日即向缅甸发布了第一个气旋公报。

source_text: Mrityunjay Mohapatra, director of IMD's cyclone-warning centre, told SciDev.Net that Myanmar was warned of the impending cyclone at least 48 hours in advance.
target_text: IMD气旋预警中心主任米利辛杰·莫哈帕特拉告诉SciDev.Net说，缅甸至少在48小时前就收到了有关即将来临气旋的警告。

source_text: But there was no acknowledgement from Myanmar's meteorological office, or any indication of a response.
target_text: 但是没有得到缅甸气象局的承认，也没有任何回应的迹象。

source_text: It warned that a cyclone with wind speeds of 180 kilometres per hour would cross the southwest coast of Myanmar sometime between 8pm and midnight on the night of the 2 May.
target_text: 它警告说，风速为每小时180公里的气旋，将在5月2日晚上8点至午夜的某个时间穿越缅甸的西南海岸。

source_text: IMD's bulletins contain information on the actual and predicted centre, intensity and movement of the cyclone, as well as sea conditions and maximum wind speeds around the cyclone centre.
target_text: IMD的公告包含有关气旋的实际和预测中心、强度和移动的信息，以及海洋条件和气旋中心周围的最大风速。

source_text: Uma Charan Mohanty, from the Asian Disaster Preparedness Centre in Thailand, said that, according to the World Meteorological Organisation's data, Asian cyclones are fewer and less intense than hurricanes in the Atlantic Ocean or typhoons in the Pacific Ocean region, but they cause more death and destruction.
target_text: 泰国亚洲备灾中心的乌玛·查兰·莫汉蒂表示，根据世界气象组织的数据，亚洲气旋较少且强度比大西洋的飓风或太平洋地区的台风都要小，但它们造成的死亡和破坏更多。

source_text: In 2005, 25 hurricanes in the Atlantic caused 10 deaths, but cyclone Sidr, which hit Bangladesh in 2007, left 3,500 dead.
target_text: 2005年，大西洋的25次飓风造成10人死亡，但2007年袭击孟加拉国的西德尔气旋造成3,500人死亡。

source_text: Mohanty says that the Atlantic coast has a good early-warning system and people have the means to drive to safer areas.
target_text: 莫汉蒂说，大西洋沿岸有一个良好的预警系统，人们有办法开车到更安全的地区。

source_text: In contrast, Asian coasts are densely populated, with many poor fishing and farming communities who cannot evacuate on their own, even if they have been warned.
target_text: 相比之下，亚洲沿海人口密集，许多贫困的渔业和农业社区即使受到警告也无法自行疏散。

source_text: News agencies quote Maung Swe, Myanmar's minister for relief and resettlement, who told a press conference (6 May) that most deaths were caused by a 3.5-metre-high storm surge — a wall of water that develops when cyclonic winds churn up sea water.
target_text: 新闻机构援引缅甸救济和重新安置部长蒙·斯威的话，他在5月6日的新闻发布会上说，大多数死亡是由一场3.5米高的风暴潮造成的，当气旋风吹起海水时会形成一堵水墙。

source_text: Mohanty says that 85 per cent of cyclone deaths are due to storm surges and that predictions of the size and location of such surges are critical in disaster forecasting.
target_text: 莫汉蒂说，百分之85的气旋死亡是由风暴潮造成的，对风暴潮的规模和位置的预测在灾害预测中至关重要。

source_text: Asian coasts are also becoming increasingly vulnerable because of the loss of protective mangrove forests that serve as windbreaks and limit damage by storm and tidal surges.
target_text: 亚洲海岸也变得越来越脆弱，因为失去了作为防风林而限制风暴和潮汐潮破坏的保护性红树林。

source_text: In a 2006 report, the International Union for Conservation of Nature said that areas in Sri Lanka with mangrove forests suffered less damage in the 2004 Asian tsunami, compared with regions where forests had been destroyed.
target_text: 在2006年的一份报告中，国际自然保护联盟表示，与森林已遭破坏的地区相比，斯里兰卡红树林区域在2004年亚洲海啸中遭受的损害较小。

source_text: And in January 2008, the UN Food and Agriculture Organization warned that Asia is fast losing its coastal mangroves, with more than 1.9 million hectares being destroyed each year.
target_text: 2008年1月，联合国粮食及农业组织警告说，亚洲正在迅速失去沿海红树林，每年有超过190万公顷的土地遭到破坏。

source_text: The organisation's report reviewed the world's mangroves between 1980 and 2005.
target_text: 该组织的报告回顾了1980年至2005年间的世界红树林。

source_text: It found that the mangrove forests around Myanmar's Irrawady Delta had degraded because of "overexploitation" and the conversion of land for rice fields — promoted by the government as a way to ensure self-sufficiency in food production.
target_text: 报告发现，缅甸伊洛瓦底三角洲周围的红树林已经退化，原因是“过度开发”和将土地转为稻田-政府提倡这是确保粮食生产自给自足的一种方式。

source_text: Government officials in Myanmar have said that 22,464 people have been confirmed dead from Cyclone Nargis.
target_text: 缅甸政府官员表示已确认有22,464人死于纳尔吉斯气旋。

source_text: Only once rescue workers reached the hardest hit areas of the storm did they begin to realize the extent of damage that had occurred.
target_text: 只有当救援人员到达风暴受灾最严重的地区时，他们才开始了解到所造成的破坏程度。

source_text: At least 10,000 people died in one town alone, Bogalay in the Pyapon District of the country.
target_text: 仅在该国皮蓬地区的波加莱镇，就有至少1万人死亡。

source_text: The United Nations has reported that one million people are homeless, or in need of help in some other way.
target_text: 联合国报告说，有100万人无家可归，或者需要其他方面的帮助。

source_text: Dutch financial institution ING Group reported today in its quarterly results an impairment charge of €194 million euros (approximately US$285.6 million).
target_text: 荷兰金融机构荷兰国际集团今天在其季度业绩中报告了1.94亿欧元（约2.856亿美元）的减值支出。

source_text: However, as a result of selling an equity stake in rival ABN AMRO, the net profit of €2.48 billion, was 18% higher than last year.
target_text: 然而，由于出售竞争对手ABN AMRO的股权，净利润为24.8亿欧元，比去年高出18％。

source_text: The impairment charge is a result of risky investments, including RBMS (mortgage) investments backed by subprime loans and Alt-A loans, which are made to borrowers with a slightly better credit profile than those in the subprime category, as well as from collateral debt obligations (CDOs).
target_text: 减值支出是风险投资的结果，包括次级贷款和针对信用状况略好于次级贷款类别借款人的Alt-A贷款支持的RBMS（抵押贷款）投资，以及抵押债务凭证（CDOs）。

source_text: The two share a distinct genetic marker not present in other brown bears, strongly suggesting that all modern polar bears are descended from the same extinct species.
target_text: 这两种棕熊共有一种独特的遗传标记，强烈暗示所有现代北极熊都是同一种灭绝物种的后代。

source_text: The study found evidence of polar bear hybridization with a now-extinct population of brown bears that lived in Ireland and Britain during the last ice age.
target_text: 该研究发现了北极熊与现已灭绝的棕熊种群杂交的证据，这些棕熊在上一个冰河时期生活在爱尔兰和英国。

source_text: Brown bears are no longer found on the British Isles, and it had been thought that polar bears interbred more recently with brown bears living around Alaska.
target_text: 现在在不列颠群岛上已经找不到棕熊了，人们认为北极熊最近与生活在阿拉斯加附近的棕熊杂交。

source_text: However, the samples used in the analysis came from the past 120,000 years and show that interbreeding of the two species occurred a great deal earlier.
target_text: 然而，分析中使用的样本来自过去12万年，表明这两个物种的杂交发生得早得多。

source_text: Climate change is thought to have presented opportunities for the two species to mate now and then in the past 100,000 years.
target_text: 在过去的10万年里，气候变化被认为是这两个物种偶尔交配的机会。

source_text: The evidence comes from a DNA analysis of fossil bones collected from the teeth and bones of seventeen bears from eight Irish caves.
target_text: 这一证据来自于对来自爱尔兰8个洞穴的17只熊牙齿和骨骼化石的DNA分析。

source_text: Ten Irish brown bears from between 10,000 and 38,000 years ago carried a distinct sequence of mitochondrial DNA, originating from a specific female brown bear, and this DNA sequence has been passed down the female polar bear line and is found in all polar bears today.
target_text: 10000年到38000年前的十只爱尔兰棕熊携带着一组独特的线粒体DNA序列，它们来自于一只特定的雌性棕熊，而这组DNA序列已经被传递到雌性北极熊的后代中，并且在今天所有的北极熊身上都能找到。

source_text: Fossils from the last species of ancient brown bears in Ireland, living from 3,000 to 5,000 years ago, have a different genetic fingerprint, matching neither that of polar bears nor of modern brown bears.
target_text: 生活在3000至5000年前的爱尔兰最后一个古老棕熊物种的化石，拥有不同的基因指纹，既不匹配北极熊，也不匹配现代棕熊。

source_text: A member of the international team conducting the study, Dr Ceiridwen Edwards from Oxford University, said: "Hybridisation between ancient Irish brown bears and polar bears has led to the complete replacement of the original polar bear mitochondria.
target_text: 牛津大学的希里德温·爱德华兹博士是这项研究的国际小组成员，他说：“古老的爱尔兰棕熊和北极熊的杂交已经完全取代了最初的北极熊线粒体。

source_text: This maternal lineage is now present in all modern polar bears."
target_text: 这种母系血统现在存在于所有现代北极熊身上。

source_text: The authors of the paper conclude that their evidence shows that matrilineal history of brown and polar bears suggest that "a likely genetic exchange with extinct Irish brown bears forms the origin of the modern polar bear matriline."
target_text: 这篇论文的作者总结说，他们的证据表明，棕熊和北极熊的母系历史表明，“与灭绝的爱尔兰棕熊可能的基因交换形成了现代北极熊母系的起源。”

source_text: They suggest that hybridization may be more common than previously recognized and may be a way species deal with loss of their habitats when the environment is changing.
target_text: 他们认为杂交可能比以前认识的更为常见，并且可能是物种在环境变化时处理其栖息地丧失的一种方式。

source_text: In Wikinews' attempt to speak with as many candidates as possible during the 2008 Canadian federal election, Wikinews has talked via email with Jo-Anne Boulding.
target_text: 在2008年加拿大联邦选举期间，维基新闻试图与尽可能多的候选人交谈，并通过电子邮件与乔·安妮·博尔丁进行了交谈。

source_text: The riding's Conservative incumbent is Tony Clement, Minister of Health and Minister for FedNor.
target_text: 里丁区的现任保守党人是卫生部长和联邦事务部部长托尼·克莱门特。

source_text: Other candidates in the riding are Liberal Jamie McGarvey, Green Glen Hodgson, and independent David Rowland.
target_text: 里丁区其他的候选人包括自由派的杰米·麦克加维、格林·格伦·霍奇森和无党派的大卫·罗兰。

source_text: The following is an interview with Ms. Boulding, conducted via email, over a week ago.
target_text: 以下是一周前通过电子邮件对博尔丁女士的采访。

source_text: She did not respond to two of the main questions: “Previous to this campaign, have you been politically involved? How will you apply your previous work/volunteer/life experience to serving your constituents?” and “What would you say are the three hottest topics this election, in your riding? What would you and your party do to address these issues?”
target_text: 她没有回答两个主要问题：“在这次竞选之前，你是否参与过政治？你会如何运用你以前的工作、义工、生活经验来服务你的选民？”和“你认为这次选举中最热门的三个话题是什么？你和你的政党将如何解决这些问题？”

source_text: Being unanswered, these questions were edited out of the interview, which otherwise is published as received.
target_text: 由于没有得到答复，这些问题在访谈中被删除，否则将按照得到答复的方式发布。

source_text: Freelance journalist, Gabriel Pollard, spoke to Joe Stewart and David Farrar about the new anti-spam legislation in New Zealand that comes into effect today.
target_text: 自由撰稿人加布里尔·波拉德就今天生效的新西兰反垃圾邮件法对乔·斯图尔特和戴维·法勒发表谈话。

source_text: Joe Stewart is the Unit Manager of the Department of Internal Affairs new Anti-Spam Compliance Unit, and David Farrar is Chair of InternetNZ’s Public Policy Committee, who also had significant input into the final bill.
target_text: 乔·斯图尔特是内政部新设反垃圾邮件合规部门的主管，而戴维·法勒是新西兰英特网公共政策委员会的主席，他也对法案的最后通过做出重要贡献。

source_text: Keith Norris, CEO of the New Zealand Marketing Association, didn't respond to multiple requests for an interview.
target_text: 新西兰市场协会首席执行官基思·诺里斯并未对多个采访请求做出回应。

source_text: The anti-spam legislation, or the Unsolicited Electronic Messages Act 2007, promotes spam education and awareness and will enable international agencies to work together to share information and will enable cross-border pursuit of serious law breakers.
target_text: 这项反垃圾邮件法，或者“主动电子垃圾信息法”，将促进有关垃圾信息问题的教育和意识，并将有助于国际机构联手分享信息和跨境追踪严重违法人员。

source_text: And it doesn't just cover e-mail spam, but all electronic messaging such as SMS/text messaging, etc.
target_text: 该法不仅涵盖垃圾邮件，而且涉及全部电子信息，比如手机短信、文本信息的收发等。

source_text: However, New Zealand isn't the most up-to-date country with implementing similar legislation, Farrar says, “We are in fact almost the last country in the OECD to have such legislation.”
target_text: 然而，新西兰并不是第一个通过类似立法的国家。法勒说：“事实上，我们是经合组织中最后一个通过这类立法的国家”。

source_text: He urges Eastern Europe and China to take part in the fight against spam.
target_text: 他敦促东欧和中国加入反垃圾邮件的战斗。

source_text: Stewart said that the new law would only help combat a small amount of spam, as 99%-99.9% of all spam received originates from overseas.
target_text: 斯图尔特说，新法律只能有助于制止一小部分垃圾邮件，因为百分之99到百分之99.9的垃圾邮件来自海外。

source_text: As well as it helping to fight New Zealand-sourced spam and preventing New Zealand from “becoming a haven for spammers”, it will promote good practices within the e-marketing community, Stewart said.
target_text: 斯图尔特说，它不但有助于阻击来自新西兰的垃圾邮件和防止新西兰“成为垃圾邮件发送者的庇护所”，还将推动电商市场建立良好的营销方式。

source_text: The new Act will affect legitimate marketers in New Zealand by making sure they have expressed or inferred consent to continue sending marketing messages to people on their database.
target_text: 新法案将会影响到新西兰的合法营销者，确保他们在继续向其数据库中的人们发送营销信息时必须获得对方明确许可或推断许可。

source_text: Inferred consent is where the marketers have the e-mail address and send messages to those on their database, but didn't get expressed consent to send messages.
target_text: 所谓推断许可，即营销者在其数据库中拥有对方的电子邮件地址并向对方发送了信息，但是并未获得收件人的明确许可。

source_text: Stewart does issue a warning against using inferred consent saying, “They may have been sending these people messages for years, but this does not establish consent.”
target_text: 斯图尔特向利用推断许可发送信息的做法发出警告说：“他们可能已经连续多年一直在向这些人们发送信息，但是这并不意味着得到了对方的许可”。

source_text: A surge in emails has also been felt with companies/marketers making sure they have consent to continue the e-mails and asking those to confirm they wish to continue their subscription.
target_text: 由于公司、营销者需要确定对方是否许可继续发送邮件并要求对方确认其是否希望继续订阅信息，人们已经感到电子邮件数量在迅速激增。

source_text: “However, many marketers are already fulfilling these requirements because they are standard good e-marketing practice,” Stewart said.
target_text: 斯图尔特说：“然而，许多营销者已经在按照要求行事，因为这些都是标准的良好营销行为”。

source_text: Due to legislative requirements, as well as having consent, businesses will have to provide details about the company sending the item, and provide a free way to unsubscribe from future mailings.
target_text: 由于立法要求，以及必须事先得到许可的要求，公司必须提供有关其发送邮件的详细信息，并提供免费退订未来邮件的方法。

source_text: Those found breaking these requirements deliberately could find themselves facing a personal fine of up to NZ$200,000.
target_text: 那些故意违反这些要求的人，一旦被发现，可能会面临高达200,000新西兰元的个人罚款。

source_text: Farrar said, “Experience from Australia shows most cases are dealt with by way of education.”
target_text: 法勒说：“澳大利亚的经验表明，多数案件是通过批评教育的方式予以处理的”。

source_text: China Daily said of President Chen that, "his participation in the protest added to his record as a man of bad faith.
target_text: 《中国日报》在提到陈总统时说：“他参加了抗议活动，就为他的不诚信记录又添加了一笔新账”。

source_text: Only one month ago, Chen solemnly pledged to develop cross-Straits relations during his meeting with PFP chairman James Soong.
target_text: 仅仅在一个月前，陈还在他与亲民党主席宋楚瑜会面时庄重承诺其将发展两岸关系。

source_text: The Taipei Times quoted Lee, "The March 26 march ended perfectly, yet it wasn't just the close of a political carnival."
target_text: 《台北时报》引用李的话说：“3月26日的游行圆满结束，但是这不仅仅是一次政治嘉年华的结束”。

source_text: Lee continued, "It was a new starting point for consolidating people's identification with Taiwan and declaring the Taiwanese people's strong will to defend their right of self-determination."
target_text: 李继续说道：“它是一个新的开端，巩固了人民对台湾的认同感，并宣示了台湾人民捍卫其自决权的坚强意志”。

source_text: That 1 million Taiwanese people came out was a display of the mainstream of Taiwanese public opinion, and officials should respond to that with practical actions and policies, Lee told a symposium.
target_text: 李在一次讨论会上说，1百万台湾人民涌上街头，表明了台湾人的民意，而官方应该用实际行动和政策来回应这一民意。

source_text: Otherwise the march will just have been emotional venting, which won't solve the current [cross-strait] problems.
target_text: 否则，这次游行只能算得上是一次情绪宣泄，并不能解决当前的【两岸】问题。

source_text: After being held for more than four years at the Guantanamo Bay detention facility, German born Turkish citizen Murat Kurnaz was transferred to German custody by U.S. authorities on Thursday.
target_text: 在关塔纳摩湾监狱被关了4年多以后，德国出生的土耳其公民穆拉特·科尔纳兹于星期四被美国当局移交给德国进行监护。

source_text: Kurnaz was picked up in Pakistan in 2001 when riding a bus.
target_text: 2001年，科尔纳兹在巴基斯坦乘坐一辆公共汽车时被逮捕。

source_text: He was first transferred to a prison camp in Afghanistan and then transferred to Guantanamo bay.
target_text: 他起先被送到阿富汗的一个战俘集中营，后来被转移到关塔那摩湾。

source_text: He was designated an "enemy combatant" even after German law enforcement and US intelligence officials concluded that there was no information tying him to al-Qaeda or other terrorist activities.
target_text: 即使在德国执法部门和美国情报官员均断定没有任何证据说明他与基地组织或其他恐怖活动存在联系以后，他仍然被称作“敌方战斗人员”。

source_text: Kurnaz's lawyers have charged that Kurnaz was tortured while being held in Afghanistan and - to a lesser degree - while at Guantanamo Bay.
target_text: 科尔纳兹的律师指控说，科尔纳兹被关押在阿富汗期间曾遭受酷刑，而在关塔纳摩湾亦受到拷问，但是程度略轻。

source_text: Pentagon spokesman Chito Peppler said that the conditions for the prisoner transfer of Kurnaz to Germany included guarantees that Kurnaz be treated humanely by German authorities and that Germany take steps to ensure Kurnaz would not pose any threat to the world.
target_text: 五角大楼发言人奇托·佩普勒说，将囚犯科尔纳兹移交德国的条件中包括：德国当局必须保证以人道主义精神对待科尔纳兹，而且德国应采取措施确保科尔纳兹不再对全世界构成威胁。

source_text: Late on Thursday the United Nations Security Council passed a resolution calling for an immediate ceasefire between Israel and Hamas in the Gaza Strip.
target_text: 星期四晚些时候，联合国安理会通过一项决议，呼吁以色列和哈马斯在加沙地带立即停火。

source_text: Only the United States abstained because of the view that Hamas was committed to violence.
target_text: 只有美国弃权，因为它认为哈马斯致力于暴力行动。

source_text: Fighting has continued since the resolution, and yesterday Israel warned of increased military action.
target_text: 决议通过后，战斗仍在继续，昨日以色列还警告说，存在军事行动加剧的可能。

source_text: The death toll from the first 13 days of the Israeli offensive was 770 Palestinians and 14 Israelis.
target_text: 在以色列发动攻势后的前13天内，死亡人数为770名巴勒斯坦人和14名以色列人。

source_text: US Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice has given an explanation for why the United States abstained and did not veto the resolution.
target_text: 美国国务卿赖斯解释了美国为何弃权而不是否决这项决议。

source_text: ...But after a great deal of consideration, we decided that this resolution, the text of which we support, the goals of which we support, and the objectives that we fully support, should indeed be allowed to go forward.
target_text: ……但是，经过再三考虑，我们的结论是，这项决议的文字是我们赞同的，决议的目标也是我们赞同的，而我们完全支持的这些目标确实应该获得通过。

source_text: I believe in doing so, the council has provided a roadmap for a sustainable, durable peace in Gaza.
target_text: 我相信这样一来，安理会就为加沙地带的可持续持久和平提供了路线图。

source_text: Palestinian Authority Foreign Minister Riyad al-Maliki has commented that the resolution was still a disappointment.
target_text: 巴勒斯坦当局外交部长利亚德·艾尔·马利基评论道，这项决议仍然令人失望。

source_text: To tell you the truth, we have really expected that all countries would vote in favor.
target_text: 实话告诉你，我们确实预期所有的国家都会投赞成票。

source_text: But we are really satisfied with the outcome so far.
target_text: 但是，到目前为止，我们对这个结果真是很满意。

source_text: What really concerns us the most is the immediate applicability of the resolution on ground.
target_text: 我们最关心的是这个决议能否确确实实得到立即执行。

source_text: We fear, and we have reasons to do so, that Israel will delay its acceptance and implementation of the cease-fire for few hours, if not few days.
target_text: 我们担心，而且有理由担心，以色列会推迟几小时，如果不是几天的话，接受和执行停火决议。

source_text: Israel continued to drop warning leaflets and send phone messages to Gaza residents, with one phone message on Saturday saying that the "third stage" of their operation will begin soon.
target_text: 以色列仍在不断散发警告传单并向加沙居民发送手机短信，其中在星期六发出的一条短信说，他们将很快发起“第三阶段”作战行动。

source_text: United Nations aid agency UNRWA resumed aid shipments yesterday, after halting them on Thursday citing safety risks.
target_text: 在星期四因存在安全风险而暂停运送救援物资后，联合国援助机构“联合国难民救济和工程处”已于昨日恢复了这项工作。

source_text: Ferrari driver Felipe Massa and his teammate Michael Schumacher won the front row on the FIA Formula-1 2006 Fuji Television Japanese Grand Prix on the Suzuka International Racing Course.
target_text: 法拉利车队的车手菲利佩·马萨和队友迈克尔·舒马赫在2006年国际汽车联合会一级方程式富士电视台日本大奖赛的铃木国际赛道上赢得了第一排位。

source_text: On the dying minutes of the qualification Massa suddenly overtook the seven times world champion thus winning the pole for the red team.
target_text: 在资格赛的最后关键时刻，马萨突然超越了获得过7届世界冠军的对手，从而为红队赢得了杆位。

source_text: Ralf Schumacher's Toyota amazed Japanese fans, showed third result, followed by the other Toyota of Jarno Trulli.
target_text: 拉尔夫·舒马赫的丰田赛车震撼了日本粉丝，排在第三，紧随其后的是另一位丰田车手雅诺·特鲁利。

source_text: Renault drivers Fernando Alonso and Giancarlo Fisicella classified after him.
target_text: 雷诺车手费尔南多·阿隆索和胡安卡洛·非塞拉排位在他后面。

source_text: Not a bad result for another Japanese team - Honda drivers Jenson Button and Rubens Barrichello on the fourth line of the grid.
target_text: 另一支日本车队的结果也不错：本田车手简森·巴顿和鲁本斯·巴利彻罗排在第四位。

source_text: Wikinews has learned that the Wikimedia Foundation has decided not to participate in a panel discussion that is to take place at Santa Clara University in California.
target_text: 据维基新闻了解，维基媒体基金会决定不参加加州圣克拉拉大学举办的小组讨论会。

source_text: The discussion, which is titled 'The World that Wikipedia Made,' was to be based on the online encyclopedia Wikipedia and ethics involved in the editing of the website.
target_text: 名为“维基百科创造的世界”的这次讨论会将以维基在线百科全书以及网站编辑中涉及的行为准则为基本议题。

source_text: In an e-mail to Wikinews, Miriam Schulman the communications director for the Markkula Center for Applied Ethics at Santa Clara University which is to host the discussion, states that Mike Godwin, legal counsel for the Foundation, will not be speaking during the discussion as was originally planned.
target_text: 圣克拉拉大学马库拉应用伦理学中心的联络主管米里亚姆·舒尔曼在其发给维基新闻的电子邮件中说，该基金会的法律顾问麦克·戈德温将不能按原来计划的那样在讨论会上发言。

source_text: According to Schulman, Godwin canceled his scheduled appearance just one week ago and has decided not to have anyone from the foundation replace him.
target_text: 根据舒尔曼的说法，戈德温在一周前刚刚取消了他参会的计划，并决定不让基金会的任何人员代为出席。

source_text: Valleywag, a gossip website about technology, recently reported that Godwin was not attending due to a "groundswell of criticism of Wikipedia".
target_text: “硅谷闲话”一个技术八卦网站最近报道说，戈德温不出席会议的原因是由于“对维基百科的批评突然迅速增多”。

source_text: I don't want to speak for Mr. Godwin or Wikimedia, but someone else made an incorrect assumption about this, so let me clarify that in our understanding, the problem was never with the composition of the panel.
target_text: 我不想为戈德温先生或维基百科辩解，但是有人对此事做了错误的假设，所以就让我来说清楚吧。按照我们的理解，这个问题与小组会的构成没有一点关系。

source_text: Mike Godwin, General Counsel of Wikimedia, was scheduled to participate in the panel, 'The World that Wikipedia Made,' on May 15.
target_text: 维基百科总顾问麦克·戈德温原计划出席这个将于5月15日举行的，名为“维基百科创造的世界”的小组讨论会。

source_text: Last week, Mr. Godwin informed us that he would not participate, and subsequent discussions with Wikimedia Foundation indicated that they would not designate a replacement speaker, stated Schulman to Wikinews.
target_text: 舒尔曼对维基新闻说，上周，戈德温先生通知我们他将不会出席会议，而且在与维基百科基金会的后续洽谈过程中表明，他们也不会指定其他发言人替代出席。

source_text: This is our ninth such panel (in addition to the hundreds of events on other topics our centers run each year), and we feel confident in our ability to set a respectful tone for discourse on controversial topics, added Schulman.
target_text: 这是我们的第九次这类小组讨论（不包括本中心每年举办的上百场有关其他议题的讨论会），而且我们有信心能够为争议性议题设定一个相互尊重的基调，舒尔曼补充道。

source_text: Schulman would not comment on the reason for the Foundation's decision.
target_text: 舒尔曼不打算对基金会的决定做评论。

source_text: The panel was to include Carl Hewitt an electrical and computer science engineer at Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Godwin discussing Wikipedia with Pedro Hernández-Ramos, associate director for the Center for Science, Technology, and Society moderating the discussion.
target_text: 在小组讨论会上，将由麻省理工学院电气与计算机工程师卡尔·黑维特与戈德温在一起就维基百科的问题展开讨论，由该中心负责科学、技术与社会事务的副主任佩德罗·赫尔南德兹·拉莫斯担任主持。

source_text: The plan was to discuss Wikipedia, and what does and doesn't work for the encyclopedia.
target_text: 按计划，将讨论维基百科以及该百科全书可以和不可以做什么。

source_text: Schulman states that the discussion, which is open to the public, is "still planned" for Thursday May 15 at 6:00 p.m. (pacific time) at the De Saisset Museum on the university's campus, but it is not yet known if anyone outside the Foundation will be replacing Godwin.
target_text: 舒尔曼说，这场公开讨论“仍然计划”于5月15日下午6：00（太平洋时间）在圣克拉拉大学校园内的塞塞博物馆举行，但是尚不知道是否会由不属于基金会的人员来代替戈德温的角色。

source_text: The High Tech Law Institute along with the Ethics Center are sponsoring the discussion.
target_text: 讨论会由高科技法律研究所和伦理中心共同主办。

source_text: These events are always open to the public, which means everyone is welcome.
target_text: 这些活动一贯对外开放，这意味着欢迎所有人出席。

source_text: In this kind of setting, we invite anyone with an interest in the topic, stated Schulman to Wikinews.
target_text: 舒尔曼对维基新闻说，我们邀请所有对这个议题感兴趣的人们出席会议。

source_text: The Foundation is the parent organization of Wikipedia and other projects such as Wikinews and Wikimedia Commons, a Wiki dedicated to hosting images that can be used throughout the projects of the Foundation.
target_text: 该基金会是维基百科和例如维基新闻和维基共享资源等其他项目的上级组织。维基共享资源致力于开发可供该基金会各项目共享的各种形象。

source_text: Jurors in the Rod Blagojevich corruption trial began their fifth day of deliberations this morning, having sent no notes to the judge at all yesterday.
target_text: 罗德·布拉格耶维奇腐败案审判的陪审员们今天上午开始第五天的审议，昨天没有向法官递交任何通知。

source_text: Notes they sent out last week, however, suggest that the discussions could take much longer.
target_text: 他们于上周发出的通知表明，讨论可能会持续很久。

source_text: The jury has sent two notes to US District Judge James B. Zagel since deliberations began last Wednesday.
target_text: 自从审议于上周三开始以来，陪审团向美国地区法官詹姆斯·B·扎吉尔递交了两份通知。

source_text: Zagel interpreted the request as saying that the jury wanted transcripts of the testimony of every single witness in the trial.
target_text: 扎吉尔的解释是，陪审团要求得到每一位证人的证词誊本。

source_text: Zagel again declined the request because it was not practical to do so; about 30 witnesses testified in this case, and the transcripts have not yet been prepared.
target_text: 扎吉尔再次拒绝了这一要求，因为这样做是不现实的；本案的证人大约有30人，而誊本尚未准备好。

source_text: Zagel instead offered to consider requests for transcripts of testimony from "specific identified witnesses", but said that he would warn the jury that such requests could take some time to fulfill.
target_text: 作为一个替代办法，扎吉尔提出可以考虑提供“特定证人”的证词誊本，但是他又说，他会提醒陪审团，还需要一些时间才能满足这些要求。

source_text: Defense attorney Sheldon Sorosky objected to this plan, saying that "the government will have the benefit of presenting its case a whole second time."
target_text: 被告辩护人谢尔登·索罗斯基反对这一计划。他说：“政府将从对这一案情的第二次完整陈述中受益”。

source_text: Zagel said in reply that he would still consider each of the jury's requests individually.
target_text: 扎吉尔回答说，他仍然会逐一考虑陪审团的每项要求。

source_text: The six male and six female jurors continued their deliberations on Monday without sending any further notes to the judge.
target_text: 6名男性陪审员和6名女性陪审员于星期一继续进行审议，并未进一步向法官提交任何通知。

source_text: The new book Game of Shadows: Barry Bonds, BALCO, and the Steroids Scandal that Rocked Professional Sports, by Mark Fainaru-Wada and Lance Williams of The San Francisco Chronicle, is being released today.
target_text: 《旧金山纪事报》记者马克·费纳鲁·瓦达和兰斯·威廉姆斯的新书《阴影游戏：震撼了职业体育界的巴里·邦兹、海湾地区实验室合作公司和类固醇丑闻》将于今日发行。

source_text: The authors not only implicate professional baseball celebrity Barry Bonds in the use of performance-enhancing drugs, but also say Gary Sheffield received human growth hormone and testosterone from Greg Anderson, Bonds's personal trainer.
target_text: 作者不仅暗示职业棒球名将巴里·邦兹服用提高成绩的药物，而且还说，加里·谢菲尔德从格雷格·安德森那里得到了人体生长荷尔蒙和睾丸酮。后者是邦兹的私人教练。

source_text: The book goes on to claim that Jason Giambi also took performance-enhancing drugs from Anderson.
target_text: 该书还声称，杰森·吉昂比也从安德森那里拿到了提高成绩的药物。

source_text: Bonds continues to insist that he did not realize his trainer was giving him steriods.
target_text: 邦兹坚持说，他不知道教练一直在给他服用类固醇。

source_text: He claimed in his grand jury testimony that he thought he was receiving flaxseed oil and an arthritis salve.
target_text: 他在为大陪审团作证的时候说，他以为自己使用的是亚麻籽油和关节炎药膏。

source_text: Sheffield's response to the claims was quite simple: when asked if the allegations made against him were true, his response was "Nope."
target_text: 谢菲尔德的回应非常简单：当被问及对他的指控是否属实时，他的答复是：“不”。

source_text: Despite the book's accusations of Sheffield and Giambi, it centers around Bonds and the founder of the Bay Area Laboratory Co-Operative or BALCO, Victor Conte Jr.
target_text: 尽管对谢菲尔德和吉昂比提出了指控，但是这本书重点指向了邦兹和海湾地区实验室合作公司的创始人小维克多·孔黛。

source_text: Conte is currently serving four months in prison for distribution of steriods and money laundering.
target_text: 孔黛正在监狱服刑四个月，罪名是分发类固醇和洗钱。

source_text: It appears that the steroid controversy concerning Bonds will only intensify as he continues to march on towards the career home runs record, one of baseball's most sacred records.
target_text: 看起来，随着邦兹继续向职业本垒打纪录-棒球界最神圣的纪录之一——挺进，有关他服用类固醇的争议将愈演愈烈。

source_text: A sixteen-year-old girl, Darlene Etienne, was pulled out from underneath the rubble of a collapsed school in Haiti yesterday, fifteen days after a magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck the country, devastating most buildings in the capital, Port-au-Prince.
target_text: 昨日，在一场7.0级地震袭击海地15天之后，一名16岁女孩达琳·艾蒂安被人们从该国一所倒塌的学校废墟下面救了出来，地震摧毁了首都太子港的大多数建筑物。

source_text: Etienne had been studying at school in the capital when the tremors starｔed, collapsing the building.
target_text: 艾蒂安正在首都的学校学习时，地震开始并摧毁了这座建筑物。

source_text: She had apparently survived by drinking water from a bathroom, and the Al Jazeera news agency reports rescuers had heard her mumbling something about having some Coca-Cola.
target_text: 她显然是因为在洗手间喝水而幸存下来。据半岛通讯社报道，救援人员听见她咕哝着说想要喝点可口可乐。

source_text: When pulled from the rubble, she was reportedly dehydrated, but happy.
target_text: 据报道，被拖出废墟时，她虽然已经脱水，但是很愉快。

source_text: Etienne was taken to a French-run field hospital, and later to a hospital ship moored off the Haitian coast for further treatment.
target_text: 艾蒂安被送往一家法国人办的战地医院，后来又被送往在海地近海锚泊的一艘医院船上继续治疗。

source_text: She just said 'Thank you', she's very weak, which suggests that she's been there for 15 days, said the head of the rescue team that recovered the girl, Samuel Bernes, noting that she was located "in a pocket, surrounded by concrete".
target_text: 救出这位姑娘的救援队长塞缪尔·伯恩斯说，她身体非常虚弱，只说了一句“谢谢”。这意味着15天来她一直被困在那里。他指出，她当时位于“一个空当里，四周都是混凝土构件”。

source_text: She couldn't really talk to us or say how long she'd been there but I think she'd been there since the earthquake.
target_text: 她无法跟我们说话，或告诉我们她在那儿被困了多久，但是我想，地震开始后她就一直在那里。

source_text: I don't think she could have survived even a few more hours, rescuer Claude Fuilla told the Associated Press.
target_text: 救援队员克劳德·弗伊拉告诉美联社说，我想，要是再晚几个小时，她就不可能活着被救出来了。

source_text: I don't know how she happened to resist that long, said another rescue worker, JP Malaganne, as quoted by the BBC.
target_text: 据BBC引用另一名救援工作者JP·玛拉加纳的话说，我不知道她何以能够坚持那么久。

source_text: It all happened very quickly, but rescue teams managed to get her out and she was covered in layers of dust and concrete, said Jonah Hull, a correspondent for Al Jazeera, describing the rescue effort as being "a delicate process".
target_text: 这一切都发生得很快，但是救援队设法把她救了出来。她被埋在好几层灰尘和混凝土下面，半岛通讯社的记者乔纳·赫尔说。该记者将这次救援行动描述为“一个小心翼翼的过程”。

source_text: Five days ago, the Haitian government officially ended its search for living people under the rubble; upwards of 130 people have been rescued from underneath the remains of collapsed buildings.
target_text: 五天以前，海地政府正式结束在废墟下搜寻幸存者的行动。从倒塌的建筑物下面救出了130余人。

source_text: The infected cow was found in the province of Alberta, where two previous cases of BSE have been reported in the past year.
target_text: 被感染的牛是在艾伯塔省被发现的，去年该地区曾报道了2例疯牛病疫情。

source_text: The cow itself was born in March of 1998, mere months after a ban placed by the CFIA to stop the use of any feed which might contain any "specified risk material"-- material that is known to carry the BSE agent.
target_text: 这头牛出生于1998年3月，距加拿大食品检疫局发布禁止使用任何可能包含“特定风险物质”饲料的禁令只有几个月的时间。据了解，这种物质携带疯牛病感染源。

source_text: A team of experts from the United States have been sent to re-evaluate the situation and to make recommendations about reopening the U.S. border.
target_text: 美国已派出了一个专家团队对形势进行重新评估，并针对是否重新开放美国边境提出建议。

source_text: The closure continues to cause major problems for Canadian beef farmers who depended on the United States beef market.
target_text: 边境的关闭为依赖美国牛肉市场的加拿大肉牛业主带来了大麻烦。

source_text: The Australian House of Representatives have considered the bill regarding whether the Australian Health Minister Tony Abbott, or the Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA) regulate the abortifacient mifepristone (RU486), and has passed the bill unamended.
target_text: 澳大利亚众议院对关于该由澳大利亚卫生部长托尼·艾伯特，还是由治疗用品管理局（TGA）来监管堕胎药米非司酮（RU486）的提案进行了辩论，并未经修改就通过了这项提案。

source_text: Earlier today, the Prime Minister John Howard (Australian Liberal Party, Bennelong) has spoken on the amendments earlier proposed by Jackie Kelly (Liberal, Lindsay) and Andrew Laming (Liberal, Bowman), speaking in favour of the Laming amendments and reiterating his support for Abbott, stating that he is the "best friend that Medicare ever had", Abbott's usual phrase he states in Question Time in support of the Government's handling of Medicare.
target_text: 今天早些时候，约翰·霍华德总理（澳大利亚自由党，贝尼隆选区）已就先期由杰克·凯利（自由党，林赛选区）和安德鲁·拉明（自由党，伯曼选区）提出的两项修正案发表了意见。他赞同拉明修正案并重申自己对艾伯特的支持。他说道，艾伯特是“医疗保险制度有史以来的最佳朋友”。那是艾伯特在“质询时间”表示他赞同政府对医疗保险制度的处理方式时常用的说法。

source_text: Howard's counterpart, the Leader of the Opposition, Kim Beazley (Australian Labor Party, Brand), spoke in support of the bill in its unamended form, noting that it is "simply commonsense that the minister does not have the scientific capacity" to evaluate the drug, and reiterating that the bill is "not really about Tony Abbott".
target_text: 霍华德的对手，反对党领袖金姆·比兹利（澳大利亚工党，布兰德选区）发言支持未经修改的提案。他指出：“说这位部长不具备”对这种药物进行评估“的科学能力，这简直就是一个尽人皆知的常识”。他重申，这个提案“并不是真正针对托尼·艾伯特的”。

source_text: More controversially he however said that those with certain personal views such as Tony Abbott's conservative Catholic faith should not hold certain offices in Government, which drew criticism from the Government later in the debate noting that an earlier Labor Prime Minister of Australia John Curtin's pacificism was a strong wartime leader.
target_text: 然而，更有争议的是，他提出带有某些个人观点——比如，托尼·艾伯特的保守天主教信仰-的人不应该在政府中任职。这一说法在后来的辩论中受到了政府的批评。政府指出，早期的一位工党出身的澳大利亚工党总理约翰·科廷就持和平主义观点，但他却是一位强硬的战时领袖。

source_text: Later, the Kelly amendments were put to the vote and were lost on the voices and in subsequent division with 49 agreeing to the amendments and 96 disagreeing.
target_text: 后来，凯利的修正案被付诸表决，结果被宣布未获通过。表决结果是49票赞成修正案，96票反对。

source_text: The vote on whether the bill should be read a second time 95 for to 50 against.
target_text: 在表决是否需要对该提案进行第二次宣读时，95票赞成，50票反对。

source_text: In the consideration in detail stage, the Laming amendments were debated, but the vote on these amendments were lost with 56 supporting the amendments and 90 against them.
target_text: 在深入讨论阶段，针对拉明的修正案展开了辩论，但是表决结果为56票支持，90票反对。

source_text: The bill as unamended was agreed to and passed the third reading on the voices, without having to resort to a vote.
target_text: 这项未经修改的提案在进行第三次宣读时获得通过，因而不必投票表决。

source_text: Organizers of the upcoming London Live 8 concert have announced that legendary rock band Pink Floyd plans to perform on July 2.
target_text: 即将到来的伦敦“Live 8”音乐会组织者宣布，传奇摇滚乐队“平克·弗洛伊德”计划于7月2日登台演出。

source_text: The band will come together, along with other musical acts such as Coldplay, Elton John, and Paul McCartney for this event.
target_text: 这支乐队将与其他音乐人，包括酷玩乐队、艾尔顿·约翰和保罗·麦卡特尼等，一起参加这次活动。

source_text: Live 8 is a series of free concerts at each of the G8 nations organized by Bob Geldof.
target_text: “Live 8”是鲍勃·吉尔道夫在八国集团（G8）各国分别组织的系列免费音乐会。

source_text: These concerts, set on the 20th anniversary of Geldof's Live Aid, have been planned to support the Make Poverty History campaign, which aims to reduce African poverty.
target_text: 这些音乐会定于吉尔道夫现场义助音乐会20周年之际举办，计划为“让贫穷成为历史”运动提供支持。该运动的目的是为了减少非洲贫困。

source_text: This lineup of Pink Floyd has not played together for 24 years due to a conflict between David Gilmour and Roger Waters over leadership and creative influence of the band.
target_text: 由于戴维·吉尔摩和罗杰·沃特斯在乐队的领导权和创造性影响力等问题上发生了冲突，平克·弗洛伊德乐队的这个阵容已经有24年没在一起演奏过了。

source_text: However, it seems that they are willing to put their differences behind to support Live 8; "Like most people I want to do everything I can to persuade the G8 leaders to make huge commitments to the relief of poverty and increased aid to the third world," said David Gilmour and added, "Any squabbles Roger and the band have had in the past are so petty in this context, and if reforming for this concert will help focus attention then it's got to be worthwhile."
target_text: 然而，看起来他们似乎愿意将分歧搁置起来，转而为“Live 8”提供支持；戴维·吉尔摩说：“像多数人一样，我愿意尽一切努力来劝说八国集团的领导人对缓解贫苦做出重大承诺，并增加对第三世界的援助”。他又说：“在这个背景下，罗杰与乐队之间过去发生的吵吵闹闹都显得微不足道，而且如果重整旗鼓有助于凝聚关注度，那么就肯定值得这样去做”。

source_text: A 1.5m tidal surge is expected tonight in the United Kingdom and could lead to flooding on the Kent coast, according to the UK Met Office.
target_text: 根据英国气象局的通报，预计今晚在英国将会出现1.5米高的潮涌，可能在肯特海岸引起洪水。

source_text: The surge is expected to cause "severe" flooding and the Thames Barrier was closed at 2000 UTC.
target_text: 预计潮涌将带来“严重”的洪水，因而泰晤士防潮闸将于世界时2000关闭。

source_text: 1,300 properties are thought to be in the affected area.
target_text: 据信，在受影响地区内有1,300处房产。
