source_text: The Environment agency representative said that they would have extra staff available to inform the public of the risks but are also asking people to check that others are aware of the potential risks, especially to the elderly.
target_text: 环境署代表说，他们将部署更多的人员向公众通报与这些风险有关的情况，但是也要求人们确保其他人也了解这些潜在的危险，特别是老年人。

source_text: The surge has been caused by the high wind speeds of over 80 miles per hour, and could be over hurricane force, high tides and low pressure over the North Sea.
target_text: 潮涌因每小时高达80英里的风速而形成，风力可能超过飓风，并在北海导致高潮和低气压。

source_text: There are currently 42 flood warnings of various degrees, eight of which are rated severe.
target_text: 目前已发出42次不同程度的洪水警报，其中有8次严重警报。

source_text: North Sea oil platforms are being evacuated in advance of the storm.
target_text: 北海上的石油平台正抢在风暴前面提前撤离。

source_text: BP is expecting to shut down the production on its North Sea oil platforms on Thursday.
target_text: BP集团预期将于星期四停止北海石油平台的生产活动。

source_text: At the same time, Conoco Inc. has announced, that they will evacuate around 500 staff oil from platforms at the Ekofisk oil field.
target_text: 同时，康菲石油公司宣布将从埃科菲斯克油田的平台上撤离大约500名石油员工。

source_text: The METAR reports from Ekofisk Oil Platform are indicating continuously intensifying winds.
target_text: 来自埃科菲斯克石油平台的航空例行天气报告表明，风力在不断加强。

source_text: At 11:50 UTC on Thursday, wind gusts of 57 knots were reported
target_text: 星期四世界时11：50报告的阵风风速为57节。

source_text: Earlier today, the Australian Institute of Sport and Swimming Australia cancelled a team meeting for the Australian Stingers and a Swimming Australia Grand Prix event scheduled for this weekend after two Olympic bound water polo players, Melissa Rippon and Nicola Zagame, were diagnosed with whooping cough.
target_text: 今天早些时候，在两名奥运水球选手，麦理沙·里本和尼科拉·扎加米被确诊患上百日咳之后，澳大利亚体育学院和澳大利亚游泳协会取消了澳大利亚毒刺队的队务会议和预定于本周末举行的澳大利亚游泳大奖赛。

source_text: Both players are receiving treatment administered by the Australian Institute of Sport.
target_text: 两名选手正在澳大利亚体育学院接受治疗。

source_text: In a statement issued by Water Polo Australia, they said "Water Polo Australia is taking this very seriously and will continue to work closely with AIS health professionals to provide the best care for those players diagnosed and to reduce any potential further risk".
target_text: 澳大利亚水球协会在其声明中指出：“澳大利亚水球协会非常重视这件事，并将继续与澳大利亚体育学院的健康专业人士密切合作，为确诊的运动员提供最好的治疗，减少潜在的未来风险”。

source_text: For Australia's Olympic bound swimmers, their coaches are expected to arrange alternative training ahead of their leaving for Europe.
target_text: 在澳大利亚奥运游泳选手动身去欧洲之前，教练们将为他们安排替代性训练。

source_text: In a statement released by Olympic swimming head coach Leigh Nugent, he said, "Originally we'd planned to have this camp as an opportunity to come together for some further relay preparation and the chance for some of the athletes to race and time trial, a month or so out from the Games.
target_text: 奥运游泳主教练雷·纽金特发表声明说：“原先我们计划在奥运会开幕前一个月左右的时间内，利用这个训练营让运动员在一起为接力赛作进一步准备，同时也为泳道赛和计时赛运动员提供训练的机会”。

source_text: From a relay perspective we are confident we're on track with our preparations and will fine-tune things when we get to Manchester in July."
target_text: 从接力赛的角度看，我们确信已经做好了准备，到达曼彻斯特以后还可以做些微调。

source_text: Rippon and Zagame are expected to be recovered next week and should be ready for London.
target_text: 预期里本和扎加米将于下周康复，届时应该可以去伦敦。

source_text: Robin Cook, the former British foreign secretary and current Member of Parliament, has died of a suspected heart attack after collapsing on a walk with his wife on Ben Stack hill, Scotland.
target_text: 英国前外交大臣，现任下院议员罗宾·库克在苏格兰本斯塔克山与夫人一起散步时昏迷并死亡，疑似心脏病发作。

source_text: Cook, aged 59, was flown to a hospital in Inverness by a rescue service helicopter half an hour after collapsing.
target_text: 现年59岁的库克先生在昏迷半小时后，被救援直升机送往因弗内斯的一家医院。

source_text: A spokesperson for NHS Highland said that Mr. Cook arrived at hospital 90 minutes after his collapse, and was reported dead five minutes later.
target_text: 高地国家医疗保健体系的发言人说，库克先生在昏迷90分钟后到达医院，5分钟后被宣布死亡。

source_text: A postmortem examination has concluded that he died from hypertensive heart disease.
target_text: 尸检结果表明，他死于高血压性心脏病。

source_text: Mr. Cook was buried on August 12 at St Giles Cathedral in Edinburgh in a service attended by close family, friends and political figures from across the world.
target_text: 库克先生于8月12日被葬于爱丁堡圣吉尔斯大教堂，出席葬礼的有其家人、朋友和来自世界各地的政界人物。

source_text: British Prime Minister Tony Blair however came under attack from Mr. Cooks friend and racing pundit John McCririck for his absence from the service.
target_text: 英国首相托尼·布莱尔未出席葬礼，为此他受到库克先生的朋友，赛马记者迈克里里克的批评。

source_text: Robin Cook served as Foreign Secretary under New Labour and was a critic of the war in Iraq.
target_text: 罗宾·库克在新工党执政期间担任外交大臣，对伊拉克战争持批判态度。

source_text: He resigned as Leader of the House of Commons in 2003 in protest against Prime Minister Blair's foreign policies.
target_text: 2003年，为了对首相布莱尔的外交政策表示抗议，他辞去了下院领袖的职务。

source_text: The US Senate rejected Wednesday a bill amendment aimed at increasing the security of gun background checks, on what President Barack Obama described as "a shameful day for Washington."
target_text: 星期三，美国参议院驳回一项旨在提高枪支背景检查安全性的修正案，巴拉克·奥巴马总统将这一天描述为“华盛顿耻辱日”。

source_text: On April 10 Senator Pat Toomey, accompanying Senator Joe Manchin in announcing the amendment, said it aimed to make "it more difficult for criminals and mentally ill people to obtain guns".
target_text: 4月10日，参议员帕特·图米和参议员乔•曼钦共同宣布了这项修正案，指出其目的是为了让“罪犯和精神病患者更难以获得枪械”。

source_text: The amendment would expand checks to sales online and at gun shows.
target_text: 这项修正案将枪支检查的范围扩大到网络销售和各种枪械展览会。

source_text: The vote followed weeks of campaigning by the President, who was supported by a speech by Michelle Obama describing his proposed measures as "common sense."
target_text: 经过总统长达数周的斡旋之后，开始了表决。米歇尔·奥巴马发表演讲对此表示支持。她将总统提出的措施描述为“人之常情”。

source_text: The bill received only 54 of the required 60 votes to proceed, despite strong public support for tighter gun control in the wake of the Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting last year.
target_text: 尽管在去年桑迪·胡克小学枪击案发生以后，民众强烈支持对枪支进行严格控制，但是该提案仅获得54票。它必须得到60票才能被通过。

source_text: Gun rights groups have campaigned strongly against the vote, claiming that the measures would violate constitutional rights, and targeting individual Senators with mocking material appearing online.
target_text: 维护持枪权的集团强烈反对这次表决。他们声称这些措施违反宪法权利，并在网上发布宣传材料嘲弄个别参议员。

source_text: Other proposed amendments to the bill which endeavoured to ban the sale of assault weapons like the one used in the Sandy Hook shooting and to place limits on the amount of ammunition which could be purchased in a single transaction also failed to garner sufficient votes.
target_text: 针对这项提案，又提出了其他试图禁止出售类似桑迪·胡克小学枪击案中所使用的攻击性武器和限制单项交易购买弹药数量的修正案，但是没有一项能够获得足够的票数。

source_text: An onlooker in the gallery shouted "Shame on you" as the result of the vote was announced.
target_text: 在宣布表决结果时，坐在记者席上的一位旁听者高喊道：“你们真可耻”。

source_text: The President spoke to the press and spectators shortly after the vote was announced, passionately assuring his audience that he would continue to pursue measures to reduce the incidence of gun violence in the United States.
target_text: 表决结果宣布后不久，总统对记者和旁听者发表讲话。他激动地向听众保证将继续采取措施减少美国的枪支暴力事件。

source_text: Robert Gibbs, the former press secretary for the U.S. White House, has been said to be in talks with Facebook about possible future employment as a manager for the communications aspect of the company.
target_text: 据说，美国白宫前新闻秘书罗伯特·吉布斯已与“脸书”就未来担任该公司负责联络工作的经理的可能性进行洽谈。

source_text: Mr. Gibbs, who has worked for the Obama administration for two years, left in February 2011, and was reportedly "relaxing" and had denied rumors that he was planning to campaign for chairman of the Democratic National Committee if Tim Kaine were to leave the committee to run for a position in the senate.
target_text: 吉布斯先生曾为奥巴马政府工作过2年，后于2011年离职。据报道，他目前正在“放松”，并否认了一个谣传，即一旦蒂姆·凯恩辞职去竞选参议院的职位，那么吉布斯就准备去竞选民主党全国委员会主席。

source_text: In recent months, Facebook has stepped up lobbying the US capital to communicate its public image to policy makers, and may use Gibbs for their public relations stratagem in the future.
target_text: 最近几个月，“脸书”正加紧在国会的游说活动，以向政策制定者们传达其公众形象，因此可能会利用吉布斯为他们未来的公共关系策略服务。

source_text: New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) announced last Wednesday that it has agreed definitively to merge with Chicago-based Archipelago Exchange (ArcaEx) and form a new publicly traded, for-profit company known as NYSE Group.
target_text: 纽约证券交易所（NYSE）上周三宣布，该交易所已经明确同意与位于芝加哥的群岛交易所（ArcaEx）合并，从而组成一个新的营利性公开交易集团，即纽约证券交易所集团。

source_text: This announcement was followed two days later by NASDAQ®, which independently announced a definitive agreement to purchase Instinet Group.
target_text: 声明发布两天之后，NASDAQ®即独立宣布其明确同意收购电子股票交易网络公司。

source_text: Archipelago and Instinet are innovative e-trading (electronic trading) companies, and formerly were the two largest American rivals to NYSE and NASDAQ, in recent years taking increasingly large portions of their market share.
target_text: 群岛交易所和电子股票交易网络公司都是富有创新能力的电子交易公司，此前曾是纽约股票交易所和纳斯达克最大的两个美国竞争对手，近年来占据了越来越大的市场份额。

source_text: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and other regulatory agencies still have to review and approve the transactions, particularly with respect to US securities law and antitrust law, in order to ensure that the marketplace remains lawful and competitive.
target_text: 证券交易委员会（SEC）和其他监管机构仍然必须对这两项交易进行审查和批准，特别需要从美国安全法和反托拉斯法的角度进行审批，以确保市场的合法性和竞争性。

source_text: Other pending issues for NASDAQ include obtaining the approval of Instinet shareholders, as well as customary closing conditions.
target_text: 纳斯达克有待解决的其他问题包括必须得到电子股票交易网络公司持股人的批准，以及满足惯例成交条件等。

source_text: NYSE must obtain the approval of its members and Archipelago shareholders.
target_text: 纽约证券交易所也必须得到其董事会成员和群岛持股人的批准。

source_text: These changes, a reaction to increased e-trading competition and a changed regulatory environment, will result in NASDAQ and NYSE trading each other's shares and attempting to grab market share, which many hope will drive down transaction costs and ultimately benefit consumers.
target_text: 这些变动是针对日益加剧的电子交易竞争和改变了的监管环境而做出的反应，将导致纳斯达克和纽约证券交易所互相交换股份并试图抢占市场份额。很多人希望这会降低交易成本并最终使消费者受益。

source_text: However, at least one commentator, Dan Ackman writing in Forbes, has noted that the trading commission at the NYSE currently averages less than a nickel (US$0.05) per share, and was less enthusiastic about potential efficiency gains from electronic trading at the exchange.
target_text: 然而，至少有一名评论员（为福布斯撰稿的丹·阿克曼）注意到，纽约股票交易所的交易委员会最近的股价为平均每股一个镍币（0.05美元），而且他们对交易所电子交易的潜在效益没有那么高的热情。

source_text: The transactions are also intended to make the two leading American stock exchanges more globally competitive with such exchanges as the London Stock Exchange, the Frankfurt Stock Exchange, the Toronto Stock Exchange, and the Australian Stock Exchange located in Sydney.
target_text: 这两项交易亦试图让这两大美国股票交易所具有更强的全球竞争能力，其竞争对象包括伦敦股票交易所、法兰克福股票交易所、多伦多股票交易所和位于悉尼的澳大利亚股票交易所。

source_text: The 6th Stage of 2008 Tour de Taiwan held its long-distance race through 9 townships including Banciao, Hsinchuang, Wugu, Bali, Tamshui, Jinshan, Sanjhih, Shihmen, and Wanli in Taipei County today.
target_text: 2008年长距离自行车环台大赛第6阶段将穿越台北县的9个城镇，包括板桥、新庄、五股、八里、淡水、金山、新北、石门和万里。

source_text: Even though this race is the second longest race in 2008 Tour de Taiwan, the weather challenged 89 cyclists due to an earlier rain in Taipei-Keelung metropolitan area.
target_text: 尽管这是2008年环台大赛中距离第二长的阶段赛，但由于早些时候在台北基隆都市区下了一场雨，天气状况对89名自行车手形成了挑战。

source_text: Even though some cyclists were unable to finish this race due to some crashes, but several participated cyclists still successfully finished this race steadily and safely.
target_text: 尽管有些车手因发生碰撞而未能完成比赛，但是仍有几名参赛车手稳定安全地成功完成了比赛。

source_text: Finally, Kyle Gritters from Health Net Pro Cycling Team won the Champion of this stage.
target_text: 最后，健康网职业车队的凯尔·格里特斯夺得该阶段冠军。

source_text: At least one person has been killed and at least thirty were injured as the result of a fire in the city of Lagos in Nigeria after an explosion in a building with fireworks stored in it.
target_text: 尼日利亚拉各斯市一幢储藏烟火产品的建筑物发生爆炸起火，导致至少1人死亡，30人受伤。

source_text: As many as nine other buildings in the Lagos Island fire yesterday were also impacted by the flames, according to authorities.
target_text: 根据权威报道，在拉各斯岛昨天发生的火灾中，多达9幢其他建筑物也受到大火的影响。

source_text: The fire was reportedly the cause of the explosion, although this is yet to be confirmed.
target_text: 据报道，火灾是爆炸引起的，虽然这一点还有待证实。

source_text: Some local residents reportedly jumped out of the windows of buildings in fright in the large commercial area of Jankara.
target_text: 据说在詹卡拉大商业区，有些当地居民因恐惧而跳窗逃生。

source_text: Some local businesses were open when the incident occurred, but yesterday was a public holiday in Nigeria.
target_text: 事件发生时，一些当地商铺仍然在营业，但是昨天是尼日利亚的公共假日。

source_text: A school located in close proximity to the warehouse was significantly damaged in the incident.
target_text: 距离该仓库很近的一所学校遭受重创。

source_text: Numerous vehicles in the area were completely burnt out by the fire.
target_text: 该地区有无数车辆被完全烧毁。

source_text: Crowds of thousands of nearby people accumulated near the fire, with spectators and individuals intending to assist or gain information about relatives amongst them.
target_text: 数千名附近的居民聚集到火灾现场附近，其中有旁观者，也有人试图提供援助或探听亲友的情况。

source_text: Three fire service tanker vehicles attended the scene, but used up all their water supplies.
target_text: 现场有3辆消防水车，但是水已被全部耗尽。

source_text: Some of these people were taken to hospital for treatment after experiencing injuries.
target_text: 有些人受伤后被送往医院进行治疗。

source_text: Additional water arrived later, as the severity of the fire slowly decreased.
target_text: 后来，随着更多的水被运送到现场，火势逐渐减弱。

source_text: The large crowds were part of the reason it took around an hour for fire service members to reach the scene of the fire.
target_text: 消防队员花费了大约一个小时才到达火场，部分原因是周围聚集了大量的人群。

source_text: News agency Reuters was told by a government official that the possibility of further explosions from fireworks also interfered with the fire service's rescue operation.
target_text: 一位政府官员告诉路透社说，储存的烟火有可能发生进一步爆炸，这一点也干扰了消防队的救援行动。

source_text: "It's very dangerous for the firemen to go in, because the government don't want any of these men to be injured", they said.
target_text: 他们说：“让消防队员进去是非常危险的，因为政府不想让他们中间的任何人受伤”。

source_text: Ibrahim Farinloye from the National Emergency Management Agency reported one fatality to Agence France-Presse (AFP), saying: "We pulled out a body from the building".
target_text: 来自国家应急管理局的易卜拉辛·法林洛耶向法新社提供了一例死亡报告。他说：“我们从建筑物内拖出了一具尸体”。

source_text: Nicolas Adesile, of the Red Cross, told the same news agency that as many as thirty people have been treated thus far.
target_text: 红十字会人员尼科拉斯·阿德西勒告诉上述同一家通讯社说，目前已救治了30人。

source_text: In the United States, the state of Connecticut has repealed the death penalty, becoming the seventeenth state in the U.S. to do so.
target_text: 美国康涅狄格州废除了死刑，从而成为美国第十七个这样做的州。

source_text: The state's governor Dannel Malloy signed the repeal into law on Wednesday and is to take effect immediately.
target_text: 星期三，经该州州长达奈尔·马洛伊签署了废除死刑的法案并立即生效。

source_text: "This afternoon I signed legislation that will, effective today, replace the death penalty with life in prison without the possibility of release as the highest form of legal punishment in Connecticut."
target_text: “今天下午，我签署了用终生监禁不得释放来取代死刑的法案并于今日生效，以此作为康涅狄格州最高形式的法律惩戒手段”。

source_text: In future convictions, the death penalty will be replaced with life imprisonment with no possibility of parole.
target_text: 在未来的判决中，死刑将被终生监禁不得假释所取代。

source_text: However, despite the state's decision, prisoners currently serving a death row sentence are still set to be executed as planned.
target_text: 然而，尽管该州做了此项决定，但是目前已被判死刑的囚犯仍然必须按计划执行死刑。

source_text: The repeal bill was passed in the state's house of representatives with 86 supporting the measure and 63 opposing it.
target_text: 废除死刑的提案在该州众议院获得通过，86票赞成，63票反对。

source_text: The senate had passed the measure just seven days before.
target_text: 参议院于7天前刚刚通过了这项提案。

source_text: Jodi Rell, then Connecticut's governor, blocked a prior attempt at repeal by state lawmakers in 2009.
target_text: 2009年，当时的康涅狄格州长约迪·瑞尔阻止了该州立法者废除死刑的企图。

source_text: Only one person in Connecticut has been executed since 1976, when the U.S. government reinstated the death penalty after the U.S. Supreme Court upheld capital punishment.
target_text: 自1976年以来，在康涅狄格州只有1人被执行了死刑。由于美国最高法院坚持要保留死刑处罚，美国政府在那一年恢复了死刑。

source_text: That execution of serial killer Michael Bruce Ross occurred in 2005 by lethal injection.
target_text: 那次对连环杀手迈克尔·布鲁斯·罗斯执行的死刑发生在2005年，执行方式是死亡注射。

source_text: "As our state moves beyond this divisive debate, I hope we can all redouble our efforts and common work to improve the fairness and integrity of our criminal justice system, and to minimize its fallibility," added Malloy.
target_text: 马洛伊还说：“随着本州完成了这一决定性的辩论，希望我们大家加倍努力，共同改进刑事司法制度的公平性和完整性，并最大限度地减少误判率”。

source_text: A suicide bomber has killed at least 24 people near the Pakistani army headquarters in Rawalpindi when he detonated explosives while riding on a motorbike outside a bank, several hundred metres away from army headquarters.
target_text: 在拉瓦尔品第的巴基斯坦陆军司令部附近，一位自杀炸弹袭击者炸死了至少24人。在距离陆军司令部几百米处的银行门外，该袭击者骑在摩托车上引爆了炸弹。

source_text: Gunmen had kept up a 24-hour hostage-taking assault last month at those same headquarters.
target_text: 上个月，持枪歹徒对这个司令部进行了持续24小时的劫持人质袭击。

source_text: Many people, such as retired and serving military officials, civilians, had come to the bank to collect their salaries, were killed or wounded by the blast.
target_text: 爆炸导致很多人伤亡，其中包括去这家银行领取薪资的退役军官、现役军官和平民。

source_text: Many hospitals declared emergency services and rushed to help the people out.
target_text: 多家医院宣布进入应急服务状态，并快速前往现场提供帮助。

source_text: Soon after the bomb blast, military personnel patrolled the road and diverted all the traffic in front of the bank and Shalimar hotel beside it.
target_text: 爆炸发生后，军人立即上街巡逻并疏散了银行及旁边夏尔美酒店门前的车辆交通。

source_text: Most of the people who died or wounded in the blast were mainly military officials.
target_text: 在爆炸中伤亡的人员中，大多数是军官。

source_text: The bomb blast destroyed many window panes in the building and in neighbouring buildings.
target_text: 爆炸摧毁了这座楼和临近建筑物中的许多玻璃窗。

source_text: Raja Sajid, who was an eyewitness to the incident, helped people into the ambulances.
target_text: 事件的目击者拉贾·萨吉德帮忙将伤员抬入救护车。

source_text: Television stations showed ambulances and police vehicles racing to the scene.
target_text: 电视台播出了救护车和警车向现场疾驰的画面。

source_text: "I helped the rescuers and put several of them in the ambulances."
target_text: “我帮助救助人员将几名伤员抬入救护车”。

source_text: Militants carried out several retaliatory attacks last month that killed hundreds of people.
target_text: 激进分子于上个月发动了数次报复性攻击，导致数百人死亡。

source_text: Nineteen people were killed and three are unaccounted for after an overloaded ferry boat sank in a river in a flooded region of Burma.
target_text: 在缅甸的一个洪涝地区，一艘超载渡船在河里沉没，导致19人死亡，3人下落不明。。

source_text: Many young children, travelling to an inter-village football tournament in Michaungai, were killed when the boat sank.
target_text: 渡船的沉没造成许多少年儿童死亡。这些儿童当时正前往密场街参加村际足球联赛。

source_text: During the rescue efforts, bodies of children aged between five and fifteen were recovered from the water, along with the bodies of two teachers and two local villagers.
target_text: 在救援期间，从水中打捞出许多年龄在5岁至15岁之间的儿童遗体，还有2名老师和2名当地村民的遗体。

source_text: Authorities are continuing to search for three people who are still missing after the disaster.
target_text: 当局仍在继续搜救3名失踪人员。

source_text: There were 79 people aboard the boat when it sank in the Irrawaddy river, according to an unnamed official.
target_text: 据一名不愿透露姓名的官员说，当渡船在伊洛瓦底江沉没时，船上搭载了79人。

source_text: A rescue worker suggested that there had been heavy rain around 10 a.m., when the ferry struck a strong wave and sank.
target_text: 一名救援工作者提到，上午10时左右，下了一场大雨，这艘渡船被一个巨浪掀翻。

source_text: "The boat flipped at a confluence of creeks—these are small, narrow creeks connecting villages," he said.
target_text: “渡船在溪流汇合处突然翻转，这些溪流通往各个村庄，”他说道。

source_text: Locals suggested that the boat, which was reportedly overloaded, flipped and lost balance, trapping young children underneath.
target_text: 根据当地人的说法，这艘据说是超载的渡船突然翻转，失去平衡，结果将孩子们困在了水下。

source_text: On November 13, Torontonians will be heading to the polls to vote for their ward's councillor and for mayor.
target_text: 11月13日，多伦多市民将前往投票站选举该选区的议员和市长。

source_text: This ward's candidates include Donald Blair, Diana Hall, Mohammed Mirza, Ron Moeser, Kevin Richardson, Richard Rieger, Richard Ross, and Kevin Wellington.
target_text: 这个选区的候选人包括唐纳德·布莱尔、戴安娜·霍尔、默罕默德·米尔扎、罗恩·莫艾泽、凯文·理查森、理查德·里埃杰、理查德·罗斯和凯文·威林顿。

source_text: For more information on the election, read Toronto municipal election, 2006.
target_text: 若想了解更多与选举有关的信息，可查看《2006年多伦多市政选举公报》。

source_text: A Turkish court had determined that he had already completed his sentence with time served.
target_text: 土耳其法庭判定他已服满刑期。

source_text: Agca was a Turkish militant who was a member of the nationalist Grey Wolves; however, his motives for the shooting remain unclear.
target_text: 阿格卡是一名土耳其激进分子，民族主义组织“灰狼”的成员。但是他的刺杀动机尚不清楚。

source_text: Agca was sentenced to life in prison in Italy, before being pardoned by former Pope John Paul II in 2000 and extradited to Turkey to serve jail time for the murder of Abdi Ipekci, a journalist.
target_text: 他先是在意大利被判终生监禁，后来，在2000年被前教皇保罗二世赦免以后，他又因刺杀记者阿卜迪·伊派柯西而被引渡到土耳其服刑。

source_text: Turkish citizens were outraged that he served only four and a half years for murder.
target_text: 土耳其公民愤怒了，因为他犯了谋杀罪，却只服了四年半的刑期。

source_text: The former CEO of Tyco International, Dennis Kozlowski, as well as CFO Mark Swartz are convicted of taking more than $600 million from the company.
target_text: 特科国际公司的首席执行官德尼斯·柯兹洛斯基和财务总监马克·斯沃兹被宣判从该公司挪用6亿美元。

source_text: Charges include grand larceny, securities fraud, conspiracy, and falsifying business records.
target_text: 指控的罪名中包括重大盗窃罪、证券欺诈罪、共谋罪和伪造商业记录罪。

source_text: The first trial ended in a mistrial after one juror received a threatening letter.
target_text: 在一名陪审员收到恐吓信后，第一次审判的结果被宣布无效。

source_text: Nancy Salomon says of the second trial that the "Defense was counting on the jury not reaching a verdict; they had used their challenges during the jury selection process to kick almost every potential juror who had a college degree, or had any business experience or Wall Street experience off the jury ... they were hoping that this case was just going to be too confusing for the jury."
target_text: 南希·萨罗门在谈到第二次审判时说：“辩方指望陪审团无法做出判决；他们在陪审员选择过程中几乎对每一位持有大学学位的，或者拥有华尔街工作经历的候选陪审员都提出质疑并把他们踢出陪审团……。他们希望这个案子在陪审团面前变得扑朔迷离”。

source_text: To combat the aggressive jury selection strategy undertaken by the defense, the prosecution "basically gave the jury several credit hours worth of an MBA", teaching them about following paper trails and detecting falsification of business records.
target_text: 为了应对辩方在陪审员挑选过程中采取的攻击性策略，控方“主要是给陪审员上了相当于几个学分的MBA培训课”，教他们如何跟踪文件中的蛛丝马迹和如何发现伪造的商业记录。

source_text: It paid off during deliberation as the jury requested over 100 documents to review.
target_text: 这个办法在审议过程中收到了效果，因为陪审员被要求审查100多份文件。

source_text: The two former executives face a minimum of eight years in prison, up to a maximum of 25 years.
target_text: 这两位前高管面临最少8年，最高可达25年的监禁，。

source_text: In addition, Kozlowski is accused of evading $1 million in sales taxes on six paintings that he bought in 2001 in a separate New York State case, and Swartz faces tax evasion charges in New Hampshire.
target_text: 此外，在另一件独立的纽约州案子中，柯兹洛斯基还被指控在2001年购买6幅名画的时候逃避了1百万美元的销售税，而斯沃兹也在新罕布什尔州面临逃税的指控。

source_text: If convicted in these cases as well, they would face up to 30 years in prison.
target_text: 如果在这两个案子中也被宣判有罪，那么他们将面临多达30年的监禁。

source_text: Italian Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi's government received a vote of confidence from the Italian Senate Thursday, after it earned the confidence of the House yesterday.
target_text: 意大利总理希尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼的政府在昨天获得众院的信任票后，又于星期四获得了参院的信任票。

source_text: The Senate's tally was 170 pros, 117 cons and no abstentions.
target_text: 参院的计票结果是170票赞成，117票反对，没有弃权票。

source_text: Berlusconi declared these votes of confidence as demonstrating the strength and coherence of his coalition.
target_text: 贝卢斯科尼宣布这些信任票显示了联合政府的力量和团结一致。

source_text: He also declared that he wanted a change in the electoral law so that a bipartisan political system would arise, and that he wants to form a majority government after the next election.
target_text: 他还宣布自己想要修改选举法，以便形成两党制的政治体制，而且他还想在下一次选举后组成一个多数派政府。

source_text: In a Tuesday media event, Verizon Wireless announced it had reached an agreement with Apple Inc. and would begin selling a CDMA version of the iPhone 4 beginning early February.
target_text: 在星期二的一次媒体活动中，威讯无线公司宣布，该公司已与苹果公司达成协议，将于2月初开始销售CDMA版本的iPhone4。

source_text: The move means the end of rival company AT&T's status as the only official US carrier of the iPhone, a status it held since the first iPhone debuted in 2007.
target_text: 这一举动意味着AT&T公司作为iPhone唯一美国官方载体的竞争地位已经结束。自2007年第一部iPhone首次推出以来，该公司一直保持着这种地位。

source_text: The press conference, held in New York City, was hosted by Verizon's president, Lowell McAdam, Apple's chief operating officer, Tim Cook, and Verizon Wireless' chief executive officer, Dan Mead.
target_text: 威讯无线总裁洛维尔·麦克亚当、苹果公司首席运营官蒂姆·库克和威讯无线的首席执行官丹·米德主持了在纽约城召开的这次记者会。

source_text: Neither Verizon Communications CEO Ivan Seidenberg nor Apple CEO Steve Jobs attended the conference.
target_text: 威讯通讯公司的首席执行官伊万·赛登伯格和苹果公司首席执行官史蒂夫·乔布斯均未出席会议。

source_text: During the event, McAdam said, "If the press writes something long enough and hard enough, it eventually comes true."
target_text: 在记者会上，麦克亚当说：“如果新闻界报道的东西足够长，足够有力，那么它最终就会成为现实”。

source_text: "We're bringing the fruit of our labor with a giant partner, and that's Apple."
target_text: “我们正将自己的劳动成果与一个巨人伙伴结合到一起，那就是苹果公司”。

source_text: Such a partnership had been rumored for years, and the amount of speculation grew over the past few months.
target_text: 这一伙伴关系已经被谣传了多年，而在过去几个月里各种猜测愈发多了起来。

source_text: iPhone 4 pre-orders for current Verizon users begin February 3, and a public release is scheduled for February 10.
target_text: 威讯用户将于2月3日开始提交iPhone4的预订单，计划将于2月10日公开发行。

source_text: The "Verizon iPhone," as it has been dubbed for months, has been altered from the original iPhone 4 so it can utilize Verizon's 3G CDMA (code division multiple access) network.
target_text: “威讯iPhone”已经冠名几个月了。它是原始iPhone4的修改版，以便让它能够利用威讯的3G CDMA（码分多址连接方式）网络。

source_text: This means, however, that Verizon iPhone users will not be able to use the company's 4G LTE (long term evolution) network, and will thus be unable to make calls and access the Internet at the same time.
target_text: 然而，这又意味着“威讯iPhone”的用户将不能使用该公司的4G LTE（长期演进技术）网络，同时也就不能访问英特网和打电话。

source_text: Cook told the audience that the LTE hardware was not ready yet, saying, "The first generation LTE chip sets force some design compromises, some of which we would not make."
target_text: 库克告诉听众说，LTE硬件尚未制作完备，“第一代LTE芯片提出了一些折衷性设计方案，有些方案我们不会采纳”。

source_text: "Secondly—and most importantly—Verizon Wireless customers have told us they want the iPhone now."
target_text: “第二点也是最重要的一点，威讯无线客户告诉我们，他们现在就想得到iPhone”。

source_text: However, Verizon's iPhone 4 allows the user to create a personal Wi-Fi hotspot, which means up to five other wireless devices can connect to the Internet through the phone.
target_text: 然而，威讯的iPhone4允许用户创建个人WiFi热点，这意味着另外5部无线设备可以通过该手机接入英特网。

source_text: Pricing was announced as US$199 for a 16 GB version and US$299 for a 32 GB version, both requiring two-year contracts—the same cost for an AT&T iPhone 4.
target_text: 公布的价格是：16GB版199美元，32GB版299美元。两个版本都需要签订两年的合同-与AT&T iPhone4的价格相同。

source_text: However, Verizon said it would not mention the cost of data plans at this time, with Mead saying, "We talked about the device pricing, but we're not going to talk about the pricing for the network for that connectivity."
target_text: 然而威讯又说，它不愿意在这个时候谈到数据计划的成本。米德说：“我们商谈了设备的定价问题，但是不打算商谈网络连接定价的问题”。

source_text: Four members of a filmcrew have been arrested on suspicion of assault after squirting water at movie star Tom Cruise at the London premiere of the War of the Worlds on Sunday evening.
target_text: 一个电影制作团队的4名成员因涉嫌袭击而被捕。他们在星期日晚上《世界大战》伦敦首映式上向影星汤姆·克鲁兹脸上喷水。

source_text: The crew were freelancers filming a new comedy show for Channel 4.
target_text: 这个自由电影团队当时正在为第四频道拍摄一部新滑稽剧。

source_text: Channel 4 has no production facilities itself; all television programmes are commissioned from independent companies .
target_text: 第四频道没有自己的制作设备；所有的电视节目都委托给独立公司制作。

source_text: Cruise had been on a walkabout meeting and greeting fans, and was being interviewed by the crew under the impression that it was a serious interview, when they used a fake microphone to squirt him in the face.
target_text: 克鲁兹当时正在一次漫游会面中与粉丝打招呼。他接受了这个团队的采访，还以为那是一次认真的采访。结果这几个人用一支假麦克风向他脸上喷水。

source_text: He took hold of the culprit, grasping his wrist, asking him why he did it.
target_text: 他一把抓住了恶作剧者，握住他的手腕，质问他为什么那样做。

source_text: "Why would you do that? What's so funny about that? It's ridiculous."
target_text: “你为什么要那样干？很好玩吗？荒唐”。

source_text: "I'm here giving you an interview, answering your questions and you do something nasty."
target_text: “我在这里接受你们的采访，回答你们的问题，而你们却干出这种讨厌的事”。

source_text: Security guards then took the filmcrew away, before they were arrested and bailed by the police.
target_text: 随后，保安人员拉走了这拨人并逮捕了他们。后来他们被警方保释了。

source_text: Scotland Yard have said, "We will see whether to pursue the charges, or see whether the victim wants to pursue it."
target_text: 苏格兰场曾表示：“我们要看看是否需要起诉，或者看看受害者是否打算起诉”。

source_text: Tom Cruise resumed meeting fans and signing autographs, spending an hour in Leicester Square.
target_text: 汤姆·克鲁兹则继续与粉丝见面并为粉丝签名，在莱斯特广场逗留了一个小时。

source_text: The Bulls rugby team has managed to reach the semi-finals of the Southern Hemisphere provincial rugby union competition, the Super 14.
target_text: 公牛橄榄球队进入了南半球省级橄榄球联盟赛-超级14大赛的半决赛。

source_text: Despite entering the match with the burden of having to score 32 points and receiving a bonus point (by scoring four tries), the Bulls managed to overcome fellow South African team, the Stormers, at Newlands Stadium in Cape Town on Saturday May 13, winning the match 43 points to 10 in the final round of the regular season.
target_text: 尽管背负着必须得到32分并（通过四次触地得分）获得奖励分的包袱进入赛场，公牛队仍然于5月13日星期六在开普敦新地体育场战胜了南非的风暴者队。这场常规赛季最后一轮比赛的比分是43比10。

source_text: Entering the final round of the regular season, the Bulls and fellow South African Durban-based Sharks, as well as the Australian Canberra-based Brumbies were the only sides in contention for the fourth and last finals position.
target_text: 进入常规赛季最后一轮以来，公牛队和同样以南非德班为基地的鲨鱼队，以及以澳大利亚堪培拉为基地的野马队是唯一三支争夺第四个，而且也是最后一个半决赛名额的队伍。

source_text: The Sharks stormed to victory over Perth-based Western Force, winning 41 points to 25, meaning that the Bulls would have to score at least four tries to be ensured of a bonus point, to move ahead of the Sharks, who were now sitting in front of them on points difference.
target_text: 鲨鱼队以41比25的比分横扫帕斯西部力量队赢得了胜利。这意味着公牛队必须通过至少四次触地得分来赢得奖励分。那样才能超越鲨鱼队。后者当前在比分上领先于前者。

source_text: Despite the set back of both prop Danie Thiart and captain Victor Matfield to the sin-bin in the first half, the Pretoria-based Bulls entered halftime leading 26 points to 3.
target_text: 尽管在上半场，两名第一排边锋丹尼·夏特和队长维克多·麦特菲尔德被罚下场，比勒陀利亚公牛队还是以26比3的比分领先进入下半场。

source_text: A try to the Stormers happened in the opening minute of the second half, though the Bulls held on to the victory.
target_text: 风暴者队在下半场取得了一次触地得分，但是公牛队依然一路领先获得胜利。

source_text: Bryan Habana scored the last try, which was subsequently converted and pushed the Bulls into fourth place on the table on points difference.
target_text: 布莱扬·哈巴纳赢造成了最后一次触地得分，最终扭转了局势，将公牛队推上积分表排名第四的位置。

source_text: The Bulls will now faced the Crusaders in New Zealand next week for a spot in the final, the other spot is to be contested also in New Zealand, between the Wellington-based Hurricanes and the New South Wales Waratahs.
target_text: 现在，公牛队将于下周在新西兰对决十字军队以争夺决赛的一个席位，另一个决赛席位也将在新西兰争夺，对抗双方为威灵顿飓风队和新南威尔士瓦拉塔队。

source_text: Wikinews' Nick Moreau interviewed him regarding his values, his experience, and his campaign.
target_text: 维基新闻记者尼克·莫罗就他的价值观、经验和选战等问题对他进行了采访。

source_text: Note that he did not answer the question "Of the decisions made by Ontario's 38th Legislative Assembly, which was the most beneficial to your electoral district?"
target_text: 请注意，他并没有回答下面这个问题：“在安大略第38届议会所作出的各项决定中，哪一项对您的选区最有利？”

source_text: "To the province as a whole?"
target_text: “对全省而言？”

source_text: "Which was least beneficial, or even harmful, to this riding?"
target_text: “哪一项最不利，甚至有害？”

source_text: Expect interviews from Liberals, Progressive Conservatives, New Democratic Party members, Ontario Greens, as well as members from the Family Coalition, Freedom, Communist, Libertarian, and Confederation of Regions parties, as well as independents.
target_text: 预期被采访的对象将包括自由党、进步保守党、新民主党的成员，安大略绿党的成员，以及家庭联盟、自由联盟、共产党、自由主义者和地区政党联盟，还有独立候选人等。

source_text: On January 8, 2008 in Stephenville, Texas, one of the larger UFO sightings in the United States occurred.
target_text: 2008年1月8日，在德克萨斯州斯蒂芬维尔发生了一次美国境内较大的UFO目击事件。。

source_text: MUFON is a UFO investigative organization in the United States.
target_text: MUFON是美国的一个UFO调查组织。

source_text: Founded in 1969, it now has 3,000 members and is headquartered in Fort Collins, Colorado.
target_text: 该组织成立于1969年，现有成员3,000人，总部设在科罗拉多州的科林斯堡。

source_text: The MUFON report, entitled "Special Research Report Stephenville, Texas" was written by Glen Schulze and Ropert Powell.
target_text: MUFON提供的这篇报告标题为“特别研究报告，德克萨斯州斯蒂芬维尔”。撰写人是格兰·舒尔茨和罗伯特·鲍尔。

source_text: Shulze has radar experience from working at the White Sands Missile Range.
target_text: 舒尔茨拥有在白沙导弹靶场从事雷达工作的经验。

source_text: Powell has a chemistry degree and has extensive experience with semiconductors from working for Advanced Micro Devices.
target_text: 鲍尔持有化学学位，为先进电子设备公司工作，在半导体工程方面有着丰富的经验。

source_text: The report is an analysis of radar records from the Federal Aviation Administration and the National Weather Service, obtained through several Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests, and comparing them to witness accounts.
target_text: 报告对联邦航空管理局和国家气象局提供的雷达记录进行了分析。在根据《信息自由法案（FOIA）》提出多次请求后，得到了这些记录。他们将其与目击者的陈述进行了比较。

source_text: Shulze/Powell concluded that the radar data confirms the witness observations of an object, as well as the Air Force's statement that said ten aircraft were operating in the area.
target_text: 舒尔茨和鲍尔的结论是，这些雷达数据可以证明目击者当时确实观察到了一个物体，也可以证实空军的说法，即当时有10架飞机在该地区飞行。

source_text: They say that it is too difficult to say what the witnesses saw, but that there was something there.
target_text: 他们说，很难判断目击者看到的是什么，但是那里确实存在某种东西。

source_text: Twice, they say, radar picked up an object travelling at nearly 2,000 mph, and at other times it showed a slow moving object.
target_text: 他们还说，雷达两次发现了一个以接近2,000英里每小时的速度飞行的物体，而在其他时刻显示的则是一个慢速移动的物体。

source_text: Much media attention has been focused on the report's observation that radar records show one of two objects moving directly toward the Prairie Chapel Ranch in Crawford.
target_text: 报告中提到，根据雷达记录显示，这两个物体中有一个直接飞往克劳福德的草原教堂牧场。这一点吸引了媒体的极大关注。

source_text: This is the home of United States President George W. Bush, which has been nicknamed the Western White House.
target_text: 那是美国总统乔治·W·布什的家，又被冠以“西部白宫”的绰号。

source_text: They did not draw any conclusion as to why such movement was observed.
target_text: 至于为什么这一动作能被观察到，他们并未提供任何结论。

source_text: The authors also concluded that military air activity was heavy at the time, but that the radar records show no overt action toward the unknown object.
target_text: 两位作者还得出结论说，虽然当时空中的军事活动很频繁，但是雷达记录中并没有显示出针对这个不明物体采取了任何公开行动。

source_text: They express concern about the possibilty that this could have been a terrorist aircraft with no transponder.
target_text: 他们担心，那有可能是一架未装备应答器的恐怖分子飞机。

source_text: Shulze/Powell stated that they felt that they had been stonewalled in some of their FOIA requests by some government agencies.
target_text: 舒尔茨和鲍尔感觉到，他们根据《信息自由法案》提交的某些请求被某些政府机构耽误了。

source_text: The Stephenville incident on January 8, saw dozens of witnesses reporting a large object in the evening sky that hovered above the community before it took off at high speed.
target_text: 1月8日在斯蒂芬维尔发生的事件中，有数十名目击者报告说，他们发现夜空中有个大物体。它先是在社区上空盘旋，然后高速离去。

source_text: "I don't know if it was a biblical experience or somebody from a different universe or whatever but it was definitely not from around these parts," Allen said.
target_text: 艾伦说：“我不知道这是不是来自圣经里的故事，或者是来自另一个宇宙的某个人，或者是其他什么东西，但是它肯定不是来自附近这些地方”。

source_text: Another witness was local law enforcement officer Leroy Gateman who reported it as a red glowing object suspended 3,000 feet in the air.
target_text: 另一名目击者是当地的执法官勒罗伊·盖特曼。据他报告，那是个闪着红光的物体，悬停在3,000英尺高的空中。

source_text: "It was so fast I couldn't track it with my binoculars," said Gateman.
target_text: 盖特曼说：“它太快了，用我的望远镜根本无法跟踪”。

source_text: Rick Sorrells says he saw the object while deer hunting in the woods.
target_text: 里克·索莱尔斯说，当他看到这个物体的时候，他正在树林中猎鹿。

source_text: He estimated it to be the length of "three or four football fields," though he could not be entirely sure due to his vantage point.
target_text: 据他估计，它的长度有“三个或四个足球场那么长”，但是由于观察位置的关系，不能完全确定。

source_text: He also claims that an unknown man came to his door, even once told him that,"Son we have the same caliber weapons you have, but we have more of them", after Sorrells grabbed his rifle, and, "You need to shut your mouth about what you saw."
target_text: 他还声称，一个来历不明的男人走进他的家门，有一次，索莱尔斯抓住了他的步枪，那人甚至对他说：“小子，我们的武器口径和你的一样大，但是我们的更多”。“关于你看到的这些，你得管住你的嘴”。

source_text: "I'm trying to decide whether or not to open the door," Sorrells said to the Empire-Tribune.
target_text: 索莱尔斯对《帝国论坛报》说：“我当时一直犹豫是否要去开门”。

source_text: "We're just standing there face to face looking at each other."
target_text: “我们面对面站着，眼睛盯住对方”。

source_text: "I'm thinking he's dressed for the elements and the dogs are raising such a ruckus he must know he's in danger of being caught."
target_text: “我想，他穿着的是防风防雨的服装，门外狗叫得很凶，他一定意识到有被抓住的危险”。

source_text: "That's when I realized he wanted me to see him."
target_text: “这时我才意识到他想见我”。

source_text: The man then turned away and walked into the woods.
target_text: 这个男人后来转过身，走进树林。

source_text: The United States Air Force initially said witnesses must have seen reflections coming from commercial airliners.
target_text: 美国空军最初的说法是，目击者看到的一定是来自商业班机的反光。

source_text: However, they later clarified that ten F-16 Fighting Falcons had been on a night-time training mission in the area on January 8.
target_text: 但是，他们后来又澄清说，1月8日那天，有10架F16战隼战斗机正在该地区执行夜间训练任务。

source_text: According to Air Force spokesperson Karl Lewis, the aircraft were from the 457th Fighter Squadron and the error in the initial report was due to an internal communications problem between offices at the base.
target_text: 根据空军发言人卡尔·路易斯的说法，那些飞机属于第457战斗机中队，最初的误报是由于基地办公室之间的通信问题而引起的。

source_text: Following on from January's strike, the UK's Public and Commercial Services Union (PCS) yesterday took 24 hours strike action in a dispute over working conditions within call centres providing Jobcentre services for the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP).
target_text: 自1月的罢工以后，英国公共和商业服务工会（PCS）昨天又采取了24小时罢工行动。这次罢工的原因是，在为工作与养老金部（DWP）提供就业中心服务的呼叫中心里，就工作条件问题发生了争议。

source_text: A press release sent Sunday night by Katrine Williams, the Chair of PCS Wales, states 70% of members who voted were in favour of the industrial action.
target_text: 据PCS威尔士的主席卡特林·威廉姆斯于星期日晚上发布的新闻稿披露，参加投票的工会会员中，有百分之70的人赞成这一劳工行动。

source_text: PCS members "suffer oppressive working conditions that simply result in high levels of stress and sickness" according to the union, and points to the 2,779 staff who left Jobcentre Plus call centres since April last year – approximately 20% of the workforce in the 37 Jobcentre Plus offices handling calls from the public – as evidence of the challenging work environment.
target_text: 根据该工会的说法，PCS会员“面临的压迫性工作条件直接导致巨大的压力和疾病”。工会指出，自从去年4月份以来，有2,779名员工离开了就业中心的普拉斯呼叫中心，大约占所有37个就业中心办事处中负责处理公众电话人员总数的百分之20，这证明他们的工作环境该有多么严峻。

source_text: The union says management is "obsessed with hitting call centre targets at the expense of providing good quality services to the public".
target_text: 工会说，管理层“沉迷于实现呼叫中心的各种指标，以向公众提供优质服务为代价”。

source_text: The DWP characterises the action differently, stating 75% of staff voted against the strike.
target_text: 而工作与养老金部（DWP）对此却有着不同的说法。据他们说，75%的员工对罢工投了反对票。

source_text: According to the DWP staff work under reasonable terms, but "we have to ensure that our service is available when our customers, who include some of the most vulnerable people in the country, need us."
target_text: 根据工作与养老金部的说法，员工们的工作条件是合理的，但是“我们必须要保证的是，当客户，其中包括某些我国最弱势的客户，需要我们的时候，我们能够提供这些服务”。

source_text: To that end the DWP readily admits it uses performance measures to ensure high productivity and performance, their goal is to "deliver value for money for the taxpayer", and they do not have any plans to change the way they do business.
target_text: 为了这一目的，工作与养老金部毫不犹豫地承认其利用绩效来提高生产率和工作能力。他们的目标是“让纳税人的钱物有所值”，所以没有任何要改变工作方式的计划。

source_text: A report in the Liverpool Daily Post cites more than 500 Merseyside staff on strike, and quotes PCS regional secretary Peter Middleman describing the culture in-place in Jobcentre Plus contact centres as "battery-farmed working practices".
target_text: 《利物浦每日邮报》在其刊登的报道中援引了500名梅赛德斯员工罢工的消息，并引用PCS区域秘书彼得·米德尔曼描述普拉斯呼叫中心企业文化的话说，就象“养鸡场的工作环境”。

source_text: Similarly, the Lancashire Telegraph cites 120 staff on strike at the Cardwell Place call centre and the expectation that 2,500 across the North West of England were expected to take action; Middleman is quoted describing the call centres as "the modern day equivalents of dark, satanic mills where our members are over worked, overly monitored and forced to endure an obsession with arbitrary targets".
target_text: 同样，《兰开夏电讯报》也援引了卡德维尔地方呼叫中心120名员工罢工的消息，并预期在英格兰东北部将有超过2,500人参加行动；他们援引米德尔曼描述该呼叫中心的话说：“这就是一个现代版的黑暗魔鬼作坊，我们的工会会员过度劳累，被过度监控，不得不忍受任意规定的指标所造成的折磨”。

source_text: The DWP reported the union informed them approximately 40% of the 9,000 staff in JSP contact centres would be taking action, which tallied with their own estimates.
target_text: 根据工作与养老金部提供的消息，工会通知他们说，在就业中心普拉斯联络中心的9,000名员工中，大约有百分之40将参加罢工行动。这与他们自己的估计数字相吻合。

source_text: Face-to-face Jobcentre services were unaffected by yesterday's strike action; the union have announced that this will be followed with an indefinite ban on members working overtime.
target_text: 就业中心的面对面服务没有受到昨天罢工的影响；工会宣布，随后将无限期禁止会员超时工作。

source_text: The remains of the last missing person following the bridge collapse in Minneapolis were recovered on Monday.
target_text: 星期一，在明尼阿波利斯大桥垮塌事故中失踪的最后一名人员的遗体被找到。

source_text: The official death toll now stands at 13, following the collapse nearly three weeks ago.
target_text: 在垮塌发生接近三周以后，官方提供的死亡总数达到13人。

source_text: Jolstad, nicknamed "Jolly," was a member of the construction crew that was resurfacing the bridge.
target_text: 约尔斯塔德，绰号“快乐小子”，是建筑队的一员。这个建筑队当时正在重铺桥面。

source_text: Jolstad's wife, Lisa Jolstad, was worried that the search for her husband's remains would drag on, leaving her without any closure.
target_text: 约尔斯塔德的妻子，莉萨·约尔斯塔德曾担心搜寻她丈夫遗体的工作会不会拖起来没完没了。

source_text: Sheriff Rich Stanek said, "There aren't a lot of smiles here tonight…"
target_text: 行政长官里奇·斯塔奈克说：“今晚在这里没有笑声……”。

source_text: "We all have very heavy hearts."
target_text: “大家心情都很沉重”。

source_text: "It weighed on a lot of people, both personally and professionally."
target_text: “这件事压在很多人心头，不论从个人感情来说，还是从专业角度来说都是这样”。

source_text: Governor Tim Pawlenty asked President Bush on Monday to declare the collapse a major disaster, allowing the state to be eligible for more federal money.
target_text: 州长蒂姆·波伦蒂星期一请求布什总统宣布大桥垮塌为重大灾难，这样该州可以获得更多的联邦资金。

source_text: President Bush is scheduled to be in Minneapolis today to get a briefing on the bridge.
target_text: 布什总统计划于今天前往明尼阿波利斯听取有关这座大桥垮塌的情况介绍。

source_text: They said that they defend the investigation of corruption schemes, however they said that the Lula government is the victim of a destabilization campaign.
target_text: 他们说，他们要保护腐败案的调查计划。然而他们又说，卢纳政府是一场稳定破坏运动的受害者。

source_text: They say that the government of Lula is victim of a coup attempt by Bush supporters.
target_text: 他们说，卢纳政府是布什支持者发动的政变的受害者。

source_text: Other parliamentarians, even some of the Workers' Party, didn't agree with the coup argument.
target_text: 其他议员，其中甚至包括一些工人党议员，都不同意政变的说法。

source_text: Some senators said that only the Wokers' Party itself initiated the crisis.
target_text: 有些参议员说，引发危机的恰恰是工人党自己。

source_text: The NATO-led force in Afghanistan issued a statement on Friday saying that that two of its troops went missing on Wednesday while on a routine supply mission.
target_text: 驻阿富汗的北约部队星期五发表声明说，该部两名士兵在星期三执行常规补给任务时失踪。

source_text: The statement said a search operation is under way, but did not give many details.
target_text: 该声明说，搜寻行动正在展开，但并未提供很多细节。

source_text: A NATO press officer said that "We continue exhaustive search and rescue operations to locate our missing service members."
target_text: 北约新闻官说，“我们将继续全面彻底地执行搜救任务，以找到我们的失踪军人”。

source_text: Local police said that the soldiers were likely swept away by a river in Badghis, a western province, while they were trying to get to an airdropped food parcel that had fallen into the river.
target_text: 当地警察说，这两名士兵有可能被西部省份巴德吉斯省的一条河冲走了，当时他们正试图爬上一个落入河中的空降食品包。

source_text: Officials said it was not likely that they were taken captive.
target_text: 官员们说，他们被俘的可能性不大。

source_text: "The families of these service members have been notified about their loved ones' status and we will continue to keep them informed as information becomes available," a press officer said.
target_text: 一名新闻官说：“已向这两名军人的家庭通报了其亲人的情况，而且一旦得到更多的消息，我们将继续向他们通报”。

source_text: The Dover, Pennsylvania school board became the first to mandate inclusion of Intelligent Design in a public school biology curriculum.
target_text: 宾夕法尼亚州的多弗尔学校教育委员会率先授权将智能设计纳入公立学校生物学课程体系。

source_text: For this year's November 8 election, Republicans fielded a pro-Intelligent Design slate of candidates including some returning candidates who had previously voted to include a statement about Intelligent Design in the biology curriculum.
target_text: 为了准备今年11月8日的选举，共和党为候选人推出了一个由赞成智能设计的候选人组成的名单，包括一些此前曾投票赞成将智能设计纳入生物学课程体系而后来又改变了观点的候选人。

source_text: A mixed slate of Democrat and Republican candidates came forward as an alternative group of school board candidates, the Dover CARES coalition.
target_text: 这份由民主党候选人和共和党候选人混合组成的名单形成了教育委员会候选人的替代群体，即多弗尔CARES联盟。

source_text: They proposed to remove Intelligent Design from the biology curriculum but allow discussion of Intelligent Design in courses dealing with philosophy and comparative religion.
target_text: 他们建议将智能设计从生物课程体系中删除，但是却允许在哲学课和比较宗教学课程中讨论智能设计问题。

source_text: All eight open school board seats were won by Dover CARES coalition candidates.
target_text: 全部8个教育委员会的公开席位都被多弗尔CARES联盟的候选人夺得。

source_text: Two candidates who had previously voted as school board members to include intelligent design in the public school science curriculum received the fewest votes in Tuesday's election.
target_text: 在星期二的选举中，两名此前曾作为教育委员会成员赞成将智能设计纳入公立学校科学课程体系的候选人所得到的选票最少。

source_text: One of the newly elected board members is Bryan Rehm, a parent of a Dover school student.
target_text: 布莱恩·莱姆是新当选的教育委员会成员之一。他是多弗尔学校一名学生的父亲。

source_text: Rehm, along with ten other parents, initiated a law suit against the school board for its decision to insert Intelligent Design into the science curriculum.
target_text: 莱姆以及其他10名父母对教育委员会提起诉讼，谴责后者将智能设计纳入科学课程体系。

source_text: The board mandated that a statement should be read in those classes stating "Intelligent Design is an explanation of the origin of life," and "The school leaves the discussion of the Origins of Life to individual students and their families."
target_text: 教育委员会要求在那些课堂上宣读一份声明，即“智能设计是对生命起源的一种解释”，而“学校应将有关生命起源的讨论留给学生自己及其家庭去做”。

source_text: The school board's statement on Intelligent Design directs students to the book Of Pandas and People as a source of information "for students who might be interested in gaining an understanding of what Intelligent Design actually involves."
target_text: 该教育委员会关于智能设计的这一声明引导学生阅读《关于大熊猫和人类》这本书，“以此作为一个信息源，帮助可能对智能设计发生兴趣的学生了解智能设计实际上包含些什么内容”。

source_text: This book is published by the Foundation for Thought and Ethics, a non-profit organization founded for the purpose of "promoting and publishing textbooks presenting a Christian perspective."
target_text: 这本书是思想与伦理基金会出版的。这是一个以“推动和出版代表基督教观点的课本”为宗旨的非盈利组织。

source_text: Parents of some Dover public school students filed a lawsuit against the school board, charging that including the school board's statement on Intelligent Design was an attempt to introduce religion into the science curriculum.
target_text: 多弗尔公立学校的一些学生家长对学校教育委员会提出法律诉讼，指控该教育委员会关于智能设计的声明试图将宗教引入科学课程体系。

source_text: The book Of Pandas and People says, "Intelligent design means that various forms of life began abruptly through an intelligent agency."
target_text: 《关于大熊猫和人类》这本书说道：“智能设计的观点，意味着各种形式的生命均突然产生于某一智能机构”。

source_text: The original complaint in the law suit against the school board claimed that "Intelligent design is a non-scientific argument or assertion."
target_text: 诉讼中最初对学校教育委员会提出的指控是：“智能设计是一个非科学命题或者是一种断言”。

source_text: The US District Court Judge John Jones, who heard the non-jury case, hopes to make his ruling by the end of the year.
target_text: 美国地区法院的法官约翰·琼斯听取了这个无陪审团案件，并希望在年底做出裁决。

source_text: The evidence phase of the trial ended on November 4, 2005.
target_text: 审判的取证阶段于2005年11月4日结束。

source_text: A local Dover newspaper, the York Daily Record, editorialized that Dover voters should take trial testimony into account during the general election when they could cast votes for school board members along with other elective offices.
target_text: 多弗尔当地报纸《约克日志》发表评论说，多弗尔选民应该在普选期间将审判证词纳入考虑范围，以便决定对学校教育委员会成员和其他选任职位的投票。

source_text: Biology teachers in the Dover schools have refused to read the school board's statement on Intelligent Design to students because the Pennsylvania state code for education states that "The professional educator may not knowingly and intentionally misrepresent subject matter."
target_text: 多弗尔学校的生物教师拒绝宣读教育委员会关于智能设计的声明，因为宾夕法尼亚州的教育法典要求“职业教育家不得在明知不对的情况下故意曲解教学内容”。

source_text: In a letter to their administrator, the teachers stated their view that "Intelligent design is not science."
target_text: 教师们在给行政管理人的信中表明自己的观点：“智能设计不是科学”。

source_text: School administrators have been reading the school board's Intelligent Design statement to students in Dover public schools.
target_text: 学校的行政管理人员一直在研究多弗尔学校教育委员会向学生宣读的智能设计声明。

source_text: In a free trade zone in Antalya, Turkey, 80 women workers of FMC Novamed are in strike for almost a year now, since September 26th, 2006.
target_text: 自2006年9月26日起，在土耳其安塔利亚的一个自由贸易区，FMC诺米克的80名女工举行了近一年的罢工。

source_text: They allege not only low wages but also severe abuses on FMC's part.
target_text: 他们不仅声称工资低，而且还指控FMC严重滥用职权。

source_text: Novamed, founded in 2001, is a factory managed by Turkish capitalists and located in the free trade zone in Antalya, Turkey.
target_text: 诺米克成立于2001年，是一家由土耳其资本家管理的工厂，位于土耳其安塔利亚的自由贸易区。

source_text: It is owned by Fresenius Medical Care (FMC), which is an international corporation with its headquarters in Germany.
target_text: 它由费森尤斯医疗保健公司（FMC）所有，这是一家总部设在德国的国际公司。

source_text: With factories in 12 countries and a total of 100,000 workers, FMC is a monopoly in the market of dialysis products.
target_text: FMC在12个国家设有工厂，共有10万名员工，垄断透析产品市场。

source_text: NASA has completed a major test of a 20-meter square solar sail, marking a "crucial milestone" in space propulsion technology.
target_text: 美国宇航局完成了对20平方米太阳帆的重大测试，标志着太空推进技术的“关键里程碑”。

source_text: It is not the first to test solar sails, as the Japanese have deployed two solar sails in space.
target_text: 它不是第一个测试太阳帆的人，因为日本人在太空中部署了两个太阳帆。

source_text: The Planetary Society is planning on launching a solar sail possibly by June 21.
target_text: 行星学会计划在6月21日前发射太阳帆。

source_text: Shot into orbit by a converted intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM), the Cosmos 1 would be launched from a submerged Russian submarine from within the Barents Sea.
target_text: 宇宙1号将由一枚改装的洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）送入轨道，从巴伦支海的一艘俄罗斯潜艇上发射。

source_text: The spacecraft, powered by the sail, will have no destination.
target_text: 由帆提供动力的宇宙飞船将没有目的地。

source_text: The purpose is simply to test the propulsion system that uses the pressure from solar light particles to move the ship outward from a starting orbit around the earth at 500 miles.
target_text: 其目的仅仅是测试推进系统，该系统利用来自太阳光线粒子的压力将飞船从环绕地球500英里的起始轨道向外移动。

source_text: Theoretically a craft propelled by the pressure of a constant light source, such as a purpose-built laser, could achieve speeds approaching the speed of light.
target_text: 从理论上讲，由例如专用激光器等的恒定光源的压力推动的工艺可以实现接近光速的速度。

source_text: This is due to the efficiencies of the spacecraft not having to carry its own fuel.
target_text: 这是由于航天器的效率不必携带自己的燃料。

source_text: Approaching the speed of light would, however, require a long period of constant acceleration.
target_text: 然而，接近光速将需要长时间的恒定加速。

source_text: Such high speed will be impossible for the current test vehicles and any launched in the foreseeable future, as they rely on the light from the Sun, which rapidly becomes weaker with increasing distance.
target_text: 对于当前的测试车辆以及在可预见的未来发动的任何测试车辆来说，这样的高速度是不可能的，因为它们依赖于来自太阳的光线，随着距离的增加，太阳光线会迅速变弱。

source_text: The Supreme Court of Japan ruled on Wednesday that a condition imposed by an Act for acquiring Japanese nationality is unconstitutional, and confirmed the nationality of the plaintiffs.
target_text: 日本最高法院周三裁定，一项获得日本国籍的法案强加的条件违反宪法，并确认了原告的国籍。

source_text: Each of the ten plaintiffs is a child who was born to a Filipino mother and later acknowledged by a Japanese father.
target_text: 十名原告中的每一个都是菲律宾母亲所生的孩子，后来得到了一位日本父亲的承认。

source_text: They filed claims for Japanese nationality between 2003 and 2005, but the government turned down because the parents were not legally married in each case.
target_text: 他们在2003年到2005年之间申请加入日本国籍，但是都被政府拒绝了，因为他们的父母都没有合法结婚。

source_text: According to Japan's Act on nationality, a non-Japanese child (under 20) who was after its birth legitimated by marriage and acknowledgment can acquire Japanese nationality by filing notification, with some requirements which the plaintiffs had already fulfilled.
target_text: 根据《日本国籍法》，非日本籍儿童（20岁以下）经婚姻和承认合法生育后，可以通过申报通知获得日本国籍，其中一些条件原告已经满足。

source_text: The Supreme Court ruled on Wednesday that the condition 'legitimated by marriage' results in unreasonable distinctions to violate Article 14 of the Constitution of Japan, which guarantees equality under the law.
target_text: 最高法院周三裁定，“婚姻合法化”的条件导致无理的区别，违反了日本宪法第14条，该条款保障法律规定的平等。

source_text: The Supreme Court left effective the rest of this provision and accepted the plaintiffs' claims for Japanese nationality.
target_text: 最高法院对该条款的其余部分保持有效，并接受了原告对日本国籍的要求。

source_text: There are estimated to be tens of thousands of children in similar situations in Japan and a considerable number overseas.
target_text: 据估计，在日本有成千上万的儿童处于类似的情况，在海外也有相当数量。

source_text: Chief Cabinet Secretary Nobutaka Machimura on Wednesday made a comment about the judgment at a press conference.
target_text: 内阁官房长官町村信孝周三在新闻发布会上对判决作出评论。

source_text: Machimura said, "This judgment, saying violation of Constitution, weighs so much."
target_text: 町村说：“这种判断违反宪法的说法非常重要。”

source_text: "As a government, we should take it gravely, and we want to examine its content in detail and consider how to react."
target_text: “作为政府，我们应该严肃对待，我们希望详细研究其内容并考虑如何应对。”

source_text: He added, "I have an impression, just hearing of it, that it's a reasonable judgment."
target_text: 他补充说，“我有个印象，仅仅是听说，这是一个合理的判断。”

source_text: "Equality under the law is an important point of view."
target_text: “法律面前的平等是一个重要的观点。”

source_text: :(a) while it's within the scope of the Legislation of the Diet how conditions are set for acquiring / losing Japanese nationality (Article 10), a distinction without rational reasons brought by such a condition may be unconstitutional (Article 14: Paragraph 1).
target_text: ：（a）虽然日本国会的立法范围内规定了取得和丧失日本国籍的条件（第10条），但如果没有合理理由对这种条件作出区分，则可能是违反宪法的（第14条第1款）。

source_text: :(b) being legitimated by the parents' marriage or not is a thing the child can not change by its will or endeavor.
target_text: ：（b）是否因父母的婚姻而合法化，是子女不能通过意愿或努力而改变的事情。

source_text: :(c) the purpose of legislation of this provision is rational, because that is considered to demand the child's tight connection with Japan's society.
target_text: ：（c）这项规定的立法目的是合理的，因为这被认为是要求儿童与日本社会紧密联系。

source_text: :(d) after this provision was added in 1984, both notions and actual situations of people in Japan have been becoming of variety, as to family life or parent-child relationship.
target_text: ：（d）在1984年增加这项规定后，日本人的概念和实际情况在家庭生活或亲子关系方面变得多种多样。

source_text: :(e) the child's tight connection with Japan's society can not be measured instantly by whether the parents have got legally married.
target_text: ：（e）孩子与日本社会的紧密关系无法通过父母是否合法结婚来立即衡量。

source_text: :(g) this provision results in distinctions not only as to legitimacy but also as to two other factors: any non-Japanese child without legitimacy acknowledged before its birth by a Japanese father, and any child without legitimacy born to a Japanese mother, can acquire Japanese nationality provided by this Act.
target_text: ：（g）这一规定不仅在合法性方面有区别，而且在另外两个方面也有区别：任何日本父亲在出生前承认的无合法性的非日本儿童，以及任何日本母亲所生的无合法性的儿童，都可以获得本法规定的日本国籍。

source_text: These distinctions have no rational relation with the purpose of legislation.
target_text: 这些区别与立法的目的没有合理的关系。

source_text: One judge in the majority, who supported the conclusion, shared a view with the five dissenting: the distinction as to legitimacy is caused by non-existence of due legislation.
target_text: 多数派的一名法官支持这一结论，他同意五名持不同意见的法官的意见：合法性的区别是由于没有适当的立法。

source_text: This judge concluded that the Judiciary can remedy the lack, because it doesn't betray the will of the Legislation of the Diet as to this Act.
target_text: 该法官得出结论认为，司法机构可以弥补这一缺陷，因为它并没有背叛国会立法对本法案的意愿。

source_text: Two dissenting judges of the five concluded that these distinctions are unconstitutional, but correction of it depends, in principle, on legislative measures by the Diet.
target_text: 五名法官中有两名持不同意见的法官得出结论说，这些区别是违反宪法的，但是，原则上，纠正这种区别取决于国会的立法措施。

source_text: The other opinion of three dissenting judges is contrary to the major opinion.
target_text: 三位不同意见的法官的另一种意见与主要意见相悖。

source_text: They argued, for example, :the distinction as to legitimacy is not unconstitutional and is within the range of choice of legislative measures.
target_text: 例如，他们认为：对合法性的区分并非违宪，而且属于选择立法措施的范围。

source_text: :even if it's unconstitutional, the plaintiffs' appeals are to be dismissed, following the viewpoint in the other dissenting opinion.
target_text: ：即使这是违宪的，原告的上诉也要被驳回，遵循其他不同意见的观点。
