source_text: United States Secretary of State Hillary Clinton said on Saturday that the recent actions by Turkey to arrest and detain journalists in the country, as well as planned Internet restrictions, are "an area of concern" for her.
target_text: 美国国务卿希拉里·克林顿上周六表示，土耳其最近在该国逮捕和拘留记者的行动，以及计划中的互联网限制，是她“关注的一个领域”。

source_text: Clinton is on a two-day visit to Turkey and made some of her comments during a news conference on the Turkish CNN channel during an event where she answered questions from Turkish citizens.
target_text: 克林顿正在对土耳其进行为期两天的访问，她在土耳其CNN频道的新闻发布会上回答了土耳其公民的问题，并发表了一些评论。

source_text: Answering a question regarding the issue, she said that "I do not think it’s necessary or in Turkey's interests to be cracking down on journalists and bloggers and the Internet [...] it seems to me inconsistent with all the other advances that Turkey has made."
target_text: 在回答有关这个问题时，她说：“我不认为有必要或为了土耳其的利益而镇压记者、博客和互联网……在我看来，这似乎与土耳其取得的所有其他进展不一致。”

source_text: In a press conference jointly held with Ahmet Davutoglu, Turkey's foreign minister, Clinton suggested that Turkey could serve as an example for Arab countries currently undergoing governmental changes.
target_text: 在与土耳其外长艾哈迈德·达夫图鲁联合举行的新闻发布会上，克林顿表示，土耳其可以为目前正在进行政府改革的阿拉伯国家树立榜样。

source_text: She said that "people in the Middle East and North Africa are seeking to draw lessons from Turkey's experience" and that "democratic development also depends on responsible leadership."
target_text: 她说，“中东和北非的人们正在寻求从土耳其的经验中汲取教训”，“民主发展也取决于负责任的领导”。

source_text: According to Turkish media groups, upwards of 60 journalists are being held based on dubious evidence, though government officials say that only 26 are imprisoned, all on charges separate from their activities in the media.
target_text: 据土耳其媒体集团称，有60多名记者因可疑证据而被拘留，但政府官员表示，只有26名记者被监禁，所有指控都与他们在媒体中的活动无关。

source_text: In some recent arrests, authorities have cited anti-terror laws as justification.
target_text: 在最近的一些逮捕中，当局将反恐法律作为理由。

source_text: Separately, the government plans next month to place filters on Internet traffic in the country, which could allow for monitoring of individual users.
target_text: 另外，政府计划在下个月对该国的互联网流量进行过滤，这样就可以监控个人用户。

source_text: Such human rights concerns have long served as a stumbling block for Turkey's attempts to join the European Union.
target_text: 这些人权问题长期以来一直是土耳其加入欧盟的绊脚石。

source_text: Interstate 80 is closed in Cedar County, Iowa, east of the Iowa City area, due to flooding from the Iowa River and Coralville Lake.
target_text: 由于来自爱荷华河和珊瑚湖的洪水，80号州际公路在爱荷华州东部的爱荷华州锡达县关闭。

source_text: The flooding that has devastated cities in eastern Iowa has travelled downstream and is now threatening Iowa City and Coralville, both of which have issued evacuations for low-lying areas.
target_text: 洪水已经摧毁了爱荷华州东部的城市，并向下游蔓延，现在威胁着爱荷华市和科拉维尔，这两个城市都已对低洼地区进行了疏散。

source_text: Flooding on the Cedar River earlier filled Waterloo, Cedar Falls, and Cedar Rapids, Iowa, with record-breaking water levels.
target_text: 早些时候，锡达河的洪水淹没了滑铁卢、锡达瀑布和爱荷华州的锡达拉皮兹，水位创下了历史新高。

source_text: Local traffic is being allowed, since this shuts off a 150-mile stretch of highway.
target_text: 允许当地交通，因为这将关闭150英里的高速公路。

source_text: Interstate 380 has also been closed, between mile markers 4 and 10, due to flooding from the Iowa River and Lake Coralville.
target_text: 由于来自爱荷华河和科勒维尔湖的洪水，380号州际公路也在4英里到10英里之间关闭。

source_text: This, combined with the flooding of the bridges across the Cedar River at Cedar Rapids, effectively cuts Cedar Rapids off from Iowa City; the only way between the two cities, normally 30 miles apart, is a 281-mile long detour that takes drivers through Des Moines.
target_text: 再加上锡达拉皮兹市锡达拉皮兹河上桥梁的洪水，有效地切断了爱荷华市与锡达拉皮兹市的联系，这两个城市之间通常相隔30英里，唯一的路线是281英里长的绕道，司机要穿过得梅因。

source_text: The Cedar River at Cedar Rapids crested today at a record-breaking 31.1 feet, nearly 20 feet above flood stage.
target_text: 今天，锡达拉皮兹的锡达河达到了创纪录的31.1英尺，比洪水水位高出近20英尺。

source_text: The Iowa River is expected to crest at Iowa City at 33 feet, 11 feet over flood stage and 4.5 feet over the record, on the morning of June 17.
target_text: 6月17日上午，艾奥瓦州河预计将在艾奥瓦市达到33英尺的水位，比洪水位高出11英尺，比历史最高水位高出4.5英尺。

source_text: Leonard Skinner, the namesake of rock band Lynyrd Skynyrd, has died at the age of 77.
target_text: 与摇滚乐队Lynyrd Skynyrd的名字发音相同的歌手伦纳德·斯金纳去世，享年77岁。

source_text: Skinner was a gym teacher and basketball coach and taught members of the group.
target_text: 斯金纳是一名体育老师和篮球教练，并教过该组织的成员。

source_text: His death was announced by his son, also named Leonard Skinner, who also said that he was suffering from Alzheimer's disease.
target_text: 他的儿子伦纳德·斯金纳也宣布了他的死讯，还说他患有阿尔茨海默症。

source_text: Skinner died at the St. Catherine Laboure Manor nursing home in Riverside at 02.30 a.m.
target_text: 斯金纳于凌晨2点30分在河边的圣凯瑟琳工党庄园养老院去世。

source_text: His son said that he had a bowl of ice cream shortly after midnight.
target_text: 他的儿子说他午夜后不久吃了一碗冰淇淋。

source_text: He had been at the home for about a year.
target_text: 他在家里待了大约一年。

source_text: The coach taught the members of the group in the 1960s and was reportedly hard on the students.
target_text: 该教练在20世纪60年代教过该组织的成员，据说对学生很严厉。

source_text: He later said in a 2009 interview that "he was just following the rules".
target_text: 他后来在2009年的采访中说“他只是遵守规则”。

source_text: He disputed the rumours that he was extra tough on them or that he kicked them out of school.
target_text: 他驳斥了关于他对他们特别严厉或把他们赶出学校的谣言。

source_text: In later years he opened up his own bar and became friends with some members of the group and even introduced them at one of their concerts in Jacksonville.
target_text: 在后来的几年里，他开了自己的酒吧，和乐队的一些成员成为了朋友，甚至在杰克逊维尔的一场音乐会上介绍了他们。

source_text: Researchers with the University of Calgary in Canada have found that prolactin, a hormone produced during pregnancy, may reverse the progression of multiple sclerosis (MS), according to a paper published this week in The Journal of Neuroscience.
target_text: 加拿大卡尔加里大学的研究人员本周在《神经科学杂志》上发表的一篇论文称，他们发现，在怀孕期间产生的催乳素可能逆转多发性硬化症（MS）的进展。

source_text: The study, led by Drs. Samuel Weiss and V. Wee Yong of the Hotchkiss Brain Institute, compared virgin and pregnant mice with MS-like lesions introduced by lysolecithin, a chemical which destroys the myelin sheaths around neurons.
target_text: 这项由霍奇基斯大脑研究所的塞缪尔·韦斯博士和韦永勇博士领导的研究，比较了未成年和怀孕的小鼠与溶血磷脂引起的MS样损伤，溶血磷脂是一种破坏神经元周围髓鞘的化学物质。

source_text: They found the pregnant mice developed smaller lesions and fewer damaged neurons, and showed signs of repaired neurons.
target_text: 他们发现怀孕的小鼠出现了较小的病变和较少的受损神经元，并显示出修复神经元的迹象。

source_text: They also found the pregnant mice had higher levels of cells called oligodendrocytes, which create myelin and are able to repair some damaged neurons through remyelination.
target_text: 他们还发现怀孕小鼠的细胞水平较高，称为少突胶质细胞，可产生髓鞘，并能通过髓鞘再生修复一些受损神经元。

source_text: Because prolactin regulates the levels of precursors of oligodendrocytes, the scientists hypothesized that prolactin levels were responsible for the differences in damage.
target_text: 因为催乳素调节少突胶质细胞的前体水平，科学家们假设催乳素水平是造成损伤差异的原因。

source_text: They also tested virgin mice given additional prolactin, and found results similar to pregnant mice.
target_text: 他们还测试了给予额外催乳素的处女小鼠，并发现了与怀孕小鼠相似的结果。

source_text: Previous studies have shown that other hormones could reduce myelin damage, but this is the first study to show a mechanism to reverse myelin damage, and establish an empirical connection between that mechanism and pregnancy.
target_text: 以前的研究表明，其他激素可以减少髓鞘损伤，但这是第一个研究表明逆转髓鞘损伤的机制，并建立了该机制与怀孕之间的经验联系。

source_text: Dr. Weiss says, "It is thought that during pregnancy, women’s immune systems no longer destroyed the myelin."
target_text: 韦斯博士说：“人们认为，在怀孕期间，女性的免疫系统不再破坏髓磷脂。”

source_text: "However, no previous study has tested whether pregnancy actually results in the production of new myelin, which may lead to improvement of symptoms."
target_text: “然而，之前没有研究测试过怀孕是否真的会导致新髓鞘的产生，这可能会导致症状改善。”

source_text: "We're excited about this result because it suggests to us that prolactin has the potential to be used to enhance the production of new myelin."
target_text: “我们对这一结果感到兴奋，因为它告诉我们催乳素有可能被用来增强新髓鞘的产生。”

source_text: Dr. William McIlroy, national medical advisor for the Multiple Sclerosis Society of Canada, explains the significance of this study: "The results of this study should be well received by people living with MS today."
target_text: 加拿大多发性硬化症协会的国家医学顾问威廉·麦克罗伊博士解释了这项研究的意义：“这项研究的结果应该受到今天患有多发性硬化症的人的好评。”

source_text: "It represents a new insight of how we might be able to reverse some of the effects of the disease and improve the quality of life for those who live under its influence."
target_text: “它代表了一种新的见解，即我们可能如何逆转这种疾病的一些影响，并改善生活在其影响下的人的生活质量。”

source_text: Dr. Luanne Metz, director of the Calgary MS Clinic in the Department of Clinical Neurosciences, University of Calgary and Calgary Health Region, adds, "This discovery has the potential to take MS therapy a step further than current treatments that stabilize the disease in its early stages."
target_text: 卡尔加里大学临床神经科学系和卡尔加里健康区卡尔加里医学诊所主任卢安·梅茨博士补充说：“这一发现有可能使MS疗法比目前的治疗方法更进一步，以稳定疾病的早期阶段。”

source_text: "By promoting repair, which is the goal of prolactin therapy, we have hope of actually improving symptoms in people with MS."
target_text: “通过促进修复，这是催乳素治疗的目标，我们希望实际改善MS患者的症状。”

source_text: Further animal studies need to be done to examine the possibility of side effects, such as lactation in men and non-pregnant women, as well as increased inflammation which could worsen the MS.
target_text: 需要进行进一步的动物研究，以检查副作用的可能性，如男性和非孕妇哺乳，以及炎症增加，这可能会恶化多发性硬化症。

source_text: Researchers believe human trials may begin within a few years.
target_text: 研究人员认为，人体试验可能会在几年内开始。

source_text: Funding and support were provided by the Canadian Institutes of Health Research and the Multiple Sclerosis Society of Canada, the Alberta Heritage Foundation for Medical Research and the Stem Cell Network.
target_text: 加拿大卫生研究所、加拿大多发性硬化症协会、阿尔伯塔省医学研究传统基金会和干细胞网络提供了资金和支持。

source_text: MS is an autoimmune disease of the central nervous system where the body attacks the fatty myelin which helps nerves carry electrical signals, causing muscle weakness and spasming which may lead to disability.
target_text: 多发性硬化症是中枢神经系统的一种自身免疫性疾病，身体攻击脂肪髓鞘，这有助于神经传递电信号，导致肌肉无力和痉挛，从而导致残疾。

source_text: MS affects approximately one of every 1000 people in North America, northern Europe and Australasia.
target_text: 在北美、北欧和大洋洲，每1000人中就有一人患有多发性硬化症。

source_text: The microblogging service Twitter has changed its software support for censoring posts.
target_text: 微博服务推特已经改变了对审查帖子的软件支持。

source_text: With the new updates, Twitter can now withdraw individual posts and accounts in specific countries, as opposed to a global deletion.
target_text: 有了新的更新，推特现在可以撤回特定国家的个人帖子和账户，而不是在全球范围内删除。

source_text: Twitter announced these changes in a blog post on Thursday, and released a clarification update on Friday.
target_text: 推特在周四的博客文章中宣布了这些变化，并于周五发布了澄清更新。

source_text: Twitter says it needed to make the changes to expand on an international level.
target_text: 推特表示，它需要做出改变，在国际层面上进行扩张。

source_text: The new tools will give Twitter the ability to withdraw posts and entire accounts in selected countries.
target_text: 新工具将使推特能够撤回选定国家和地区的帖子和整个帐户。

source_text: Once the posts have been withdrawn, they are replaced with a message saying: "This Tweet/account has been withheld in: Country."
target_text: 一旦帖子被撤销，它们将被替换为一条消息：“此推文帐户已隐藏在：国家。”

source_text: The social network has been used in the past as an outlet for political expression.
target_text: 社交网络过去曾被用作政治表达的出路。

source_text: During the Arab Spring, protesters in various countries used Twitter to mobilize support and report information to the outside world.
target_text: 在阿拉伯之春期间，各国的抗议者使用推特动员支持并向外界报告信息。

source_text: The organization Reporters without Borders sent an open letter to Twitter's chairman, Jack Dorsey, saying "We urge you to reverse this decision, which restricts freedom of expression and runs counter to the movements opposed to censorship that have been linked to the Arab Spring, in which Twitter served as a sounding board..."
target_text: 该组织无国界记者向推特主席杰克·多西发出了一封公开信，信中说：“我们敦促你推翻这一限制言论自由的决定，并与那些反对审查制度的运动背道而驰，而审查制度与“阿拉伯之春”有关，推特在其中充当了一个传声筒……”。

source_text: "Twitter is depriving cyberdissidents in repressive countries of a crucial tool for information and organization."
target_text: “推特正在剥夺专制国家网络异见人士获取信息和组织的重要工具。”

source_text: A military weapons storage facility in al-Masalmyiah, just north of Aleppo, Syria has exploded, killing at least 15 Syrian soldiers and injuring at least 50 others.
target_text: 叙利亚阿勒颇北部al-马萨米亚一处军事武器储存设施发生爆炸，造成至少15名叙利亚士兵死亡，至少50人受伤。

source_text: The explosion occurred on the grounds of a military academy's infantry school where weapons and ammunition are stored.
target_text: 爆炸发生在一所军事学院的步兵学校，那里储存着武器和弹药。

source_text: The blast, which occurred at 4:30 a.m. EEST (UTC+3) is believed to have been caused by excessive summer temperatures, but other reports suggest that a gas leak may have sparked the blast.
target_text: 爆炸发生在EEST（UTC+3）凌晨4点30分，据信是由于夏季气温过高引起的，但其他报告显示气体泄漏可能引发爆炸。

source_text: Firefighters report several deaths and injuries, but also said that the fires caused by the blast have been extinguished.
target_text: 消防队员报告了几起伤亡事件，但也表示，爆炸引起的火灾已经被扑灭。

source_text: Tens of thousands of Syrians took to the streets Friday in cities across the country protesting for freedom.
target_text: 成千上万的叙利亚人星期五走上街头，在全国各地的城市为自由抗议。

source_text: Syria's official news agency (SANA) reported, "scattered groups of citizens came out to the streets in several areas of the provinces after Friday prayers and chanted slogans calling for freedom without the intervention of security forces."
target_text: 叙利亚官方通讯社（SANA）报道说，“星期五祈祷后，分散的民众在几个省份的街道上游行，高呼口号，要求在没有安全部队干预的情况下获得自由。”

source_text: However, protests in Damascus reportedly turned violent as security forces were said to disperse the crowds with batons and tear gas to prevent protesters reaching the capital's main square.
target_text: 然而，据报道，大马士革的抗议活动变得暴力，因为据说安全部队用警棍和催泪瓦斯驱散人群，以防止抗议者到达首都的主要广场。

source_text: "I counted 15 mukhabarat [secret police] busloads," a source reported to Reuters news agency.
target_text: 一位消息人士向路透社报道说：“我数了有15辆穆哈巴拉特【秘密警察】大巴。”

source_text: "They went into the alleyways just north of the square chasing protesters and yelling 'you pimps, you infiltrators, you want freedom? we will give it to you'."
target_text: “他们走进广场北部的小巷，追赶抗议者，大喊‘你们这些皮条客、渗透分子，你们想要自由？我们会把它给你的。”

source_text: Protests in Syria have intensified since mid-March after families of political prisoners held rallies in Damascus and people in Daraa protested against the arrests of more than a dozen children for anti-regime graffiti.
target_text: 自3月中旬以来，叙利亚的抗议活动愈演愈烈。此前，多名政治犯的家人在大马士革举行集会，德拉的民众抗议十几名儿童因涂鸦反政府而被捕。

source_text: The protests continued as Syria’s President, Bashar al-Assad failed to lift the emergency law the country has operated under since his Arab Socialist Ba’ath Party came to power in 1963.
target_text: 抗议活动在叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德任内继续进行，他领导的阿拉伯社会复兴党自1963年执政以来一直执行的紧急状态法未能得到解除。

source_text: The Assad government has met protests with a mixture of minor concessions and force.
target_text: 阿萨德政府以小让步和武力相结合的方式应对抗议活动。

source_text: After a meeting of NATO foreign ministers in Berlin, US Secretary of State Hillary Clinton said, "The Syrian government did not meet the legitimate demands of the Syrian people."
target_text: 美国国务卿希拉里·克林顿在柏林会见北约外长后表示，“叙利亚政府没有满足叙利亚人民的合法要求。”

source_text: "It is time for the Syrian government to stop its crack down on these people and begin to meet their aspirations."
target_text: “叙利亚政府是时候停止对这些人的镇压，开始实现他们的愿望了。”

source_text: The delegation asked for a deadline for their demands to be met.
target_text: 代表团要求为满足他们的要求设定最后期限。

source_text: Al Jazeera correspondent Rula Amin said, "It seems from the people in Daraa that the government is seriously trying to contain [the situation in] Daraa because that is where it all started."
target_text: 半岛电视台记者鲁拉·阿明说：“从达拉的人们看来，政府电视台正在严肃地试图控制达拉的局势，因为那里是一切开始的地方。”

source_text: "If they manage to calm the situation in Daraa, the government believes it will be able to contain the situation throughout Syria."
target_text: “如果他们设法平息达拉的局势，政府相信将能够控制整个叙利亚的局势。”

source_text: A three-year-old girl has been bitten by two dingoes while holidaying with her parents on Fraser Island, Queensland, Australia.
target_text: 澳大利亚昆士兰州弗雷泽岛，一名三岁的小女孩在和父母度假时被两只澳洲野狗咬伤。

source_text: The two animals responsible for the attack have since been captured and euthanised by wildlife rangers.
target_text: 造成此次袭击的两只动物已被野生动物保护人员抓获并实施安乐死。

source_text: The child was on the beach with her parents while they waited to be transported to the mainland on the Hook Point barge.
target_text: 这个孩子和她的父母在海滩上，他们正等着用钩点驳船把孩子运到大陆。

source_text: Witnesses report that the child wandered into nearby sand dunes where she was repeatedly bitten on the legs by the wild dogs.
target_text: 目击者报告说，这个孩子在附近的沙丘里游荡，她的腿被野狗多次咬伤。

source_text: Spokeswoman Bree Jashin has stated the attack was the result of inattentiveness.
target_text: 女发言人布雷·贾辛表示，这次袭击是由于疏忽造成的。

source_text: "The child was unsupervised and you have to ask how could a three-year-old get so close to the dingoes?"
target_text: “这个孩子无人看管，你不得不问，一个三岁的孩子怎么能离这些野狗这么近？”

source_text: Experts such as Environmental Department manager Terry Harper say the attack is uncharacteristic for the dingoes on Fraser Island which is said to be one of the last remaining safe havens for purebred dingoes.
target_text: 环保部门经理特里·哈珀等专家表示，弗雷泽岛上的野狗不太容易发动攻击，据说弗雷泽岛是纯种野狗仅存的安全庇护所之一。

source_text: "This is a very timely reminder for everybody about how important it is to stay very close to your children on Fraser Island," Harper stated.
target_text: “这是一个非常及时的提醒，告诉每个人在弗雷泽岛上与孩子保持密切联系的重要性，”哈珀说。

source_text: The child received medical attention at the site of the attack and was then transported to Gympie Hospital.
target_text: 这名儿童在袭击现场接受了医疗护理，然后被送往金皮医院。

source_text: A top US commander said yesterday that the United States is not planning a preemptive attack on Iran despite increasing rhetoric from Washington, D.C.
target_text: 美国一名高级指挥官昨日表示，尽管华盛顿方面的言论日益激烈，但美国并不计划对伊朗发动先发制人的攻击。

source_text: The United States Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice also denied that an attack was imminent, stating that there is no Congressional authorization for military action against Iran.
target_text: 美国国务卿康多莉扎·赖斯也否认袭击迫在眉睫，称没有国会授权对伊朗采取军事行动。

source_text: The denials came as The Observer ran a report saying that US personnel involved in interrogating insurgents in Iraq are under "huge" pressure to find evidence against Iran.
target_text: 《观察家报》发表的一篇报道称，参与审讯伊拉克叛乱分子的美国人员在寻找针对伊朗的证据方面面临“巨大”压力。

source_text: It quoted Micah Brose, a privately contracted interrogator working for the US military there, as saying that information on Iran is "gold".
target_text: 该报援引为驻伊美军工作的私人合同审讯员米卡•布罗斯的话称，有关伊朗的信息是“黄金”。

source_text: "They push a lot for us to establish a link with Iran," Brose claimed in the interview, adding that "it feels a lot like, if you get something and Iran's not involved, it's a let down."
target_text: “他们极力推动我们与伊朗建立联系，”布罗斯在采访中说，并补充说，“感觉很像，如果你得到了一些东西，而伊朗没有参与其中，那就会感到失望。”

source_text: He further claimed that people have said to him that "they're really pushing the Iran thing."
target_text: 他进一步声称人们对他说“他们真的在推动伊朗的事情。”

source_text: Brose denied being asked to manufacture evidence, but stated that "if a detainee wants to tell me what I want to hear so he can get out of jail ... you know what I'm saying."
target_text: 布罗斯否认被要求编造证据，但声称“如果被拘留者想告诉我我想听到什么，那么他就可以离开监狱的话……你知道我在说什么。”

source_text: The US has in the past been accused of using exaggerated and fabricated evidence to build its case against Iraq prior to the war.
target_text: 美国过去曾被指控在战前使用夸大和捏造的证据来证明其对伊拉克的指控。

source_text: On Monday, Admiral William J. Fallon, the commanding officer of United States Central Command which is responsible for the Middle East, East Africa and Central Asia, speaking in Financial Times, said that a strike against Iran is "not in the offing."
target_text: 星期一，负责中东，东非和中亚的美国中央司令部指挥官威廉·J·法伦海军上将在英国“金融时报”发表讲话说，对伊朗的攻击“并非即将到来”。

source_text: "None of this is helped by the continuing stories that just keep going around and around and around that any day now there will be another war which is just not where we want to go," Fallon continued.
target_text: 法伦说：“不断有消息说，有一天，另一场战争会爆发，而这并不是我们想要的。”

source_text: "Getting Iranian behavior to change and finding ways to get them to come to their senses and do that is the real objective."
target_text: “真正的目标是改变伊朗的行为，找到让他们恢复理智的方法。”

source_text: "Attacking them as a means to get to that spot strikes me as being not the first choice in my book."
target_text: “攻击他们作为到达那个地点的手段，在我看来并不是我书中的第一选择。”

source_text: Despite saying this, he refused to rule out a strike against Iran in the future.
target_text: 尽管如此，他拒绝排除未来对伊朗发动袭击的可能性。

source_text: Meanwhile, US Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice was on ABC's This Week on Sunday, saying that a Senate resolution designating Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist organization does not authorize military action.
target_text: 与此同时，美国国务卿赖斯星期天在美国广播公司的“本周”节目中说，参议院将伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队定性为恐怖组织的决议没有授权采取军事行动。

source_text: "There is nothing in this particular resolution that would suggest that from our point of view."
target_text: “从我们的角度来看，这个特定决议中没有任何内容可以表明这一点。”

source_text: "And, clearly, the president has also made very clear that he's on a diplomatic path where Iran comes into focus," Rice said.
target_text: 赖斯说：“而且，显然，总统也已经明确表示，他正处于伊朗成为焦点的外交道路上。”

source_text: "This resolution is saying that there needs to be strong measures taken against Iran, which we have definitely done," Rice continued.
target_text: 赖斯继续说：“这项决议表明，需要对伊朗采取强有力的措施，我们已经采取了这些措施。”

source_text: "And if the Iranians suspend their enrichment and reprocessing, I'm prepared to meet my counterpart anyplace, anytime, anywhere."
target_text: “如果伊朗停止铀浓缩和再加工，我准备随时随地与伊朗外长会晤。”

source_text: "So the question isn't why will we not talk to Tehran."
target_text: “所以问题不在于我们为什么不与德黑兰交谈。”

source_text: "The question is, why will Tehran not talk to us?"
target_text: “问题是，为什么德黑兰不跟我们说话？”

source_text: She has said that the resolution could not be used to justify war, but rather it seeks to escalate diplomatic efforts.
target_text: 她说，该决议不能被用来为战争辩护，而是寻求使外交努力升级。

source_text: "We wish to emphasize that no congressional authority exists for unilateral military action against Iran," she said in an open letter on November 1, 2007.
target_text: 她在2007年11月1日的一封公开信中说：“我们希望强调，没有国会授权对伊朗采取单边军事行动。”

source_text: Last week, former Foreign Minister of Germany, Joschka Fischer said that he was worried that the upcoming US Presidential election could heighten tensions between the US and Iran.
target_text: 上周，德国前外长约施卡·菲舍尔表示，他担心即将到来的美国总统大选可能加剧美国和伊朗之间的紧张关系。

source_text: He found particularly worrisome a statement by Presidential candidate Rudy Giuliani in October that "If I am President of the United States, I guarantee you, we will never find out what they will do if they get nuclear weapons, because they are not going to get a nuclear weapon ... the military option is not off the table."
target_text: 他发现总统候选人鲁迪·朱利亚尼在10月份发表的一份声明特别令人担忧：“如果我是美国总统，我向你保证，如果他们得到核武器，我们永远不会知道他们会做什么，因为他们不会得到核武器……军事选择并不是不可能的。”

source_text: The space shuttle Discovery is coming back to Earth after 11 days in orbit.
target_text: 发现号航天飞机在轨道运行11天后返回地球。

source_text: The a scan of the Shuttle's heat shield (now routine since the Space Shuttle Columbia disaster) showed no cause for concern and Discovery was cleared for the voyage home.
target_text: 扫描穿梭机的隔热罩（现在是哥伦比亚号航天飞机失事以来的例行程序）没有发现任何造成问题的原因，发现号被批准返航。

source_text: The mission's primary purposes were to deliver the Harmony module to the International Space Station and to help reposition and extend solar power arrays.
target_text: 此次任务的主要目的是向国际空间站运送“和谐号”模块，并帮助重新定位和扩展太阳能电池阵列。

source_text: The mission gained wide attention for including a space walk to repair damage in the solar power array.
target_text: 该任务受到广泛关注，包括太空行走修复太阳能电池阵列的损坏。

source_text: The space walk had not been planned until the mission was already underway when the damage was then detected.
target_text: 太空行走是在任务已经开始时被发现损坏才做出计划决定的。

source_text: However, additional problems with a rotary joint were not repaired and if they are not repaired they could interfere with further station construction.
target_text: 然而，旋转接头的其他问题没有得到修复，如果没有修复它们会干扰进一步的站点建设。

source_text: The return will also bring back Clay Anderson who is being replaced on the International Space Station by Dan Tani.
target_text: 这次返航还将带回正在国际空间站上被丹·塔尼取代的克莱·安德森。

source_text: Discovery is scheduled to land at Kennedy Space Center at 1:02 PM EST (UTC-5) on November 7.
target_text: 发现号计划于美国东部时间11月7日下午1：02（UTC-5）在肯尼迪航天中心着陆。

source_text: On Friday morning, United States President George W. Bush defended interrogation tactics used by the CIA, stating that "This government does not torture people."
target_text: 星期五早上，美国总统乔治·W·布什为美国中央情报局使用的审讯策略辩护，称“这个政府不会折磨人民”。

source_text: Bush's comments were a response to an article in Thursday's New York Times describing a classified 2005 Justice Department legal opinion that endorsed the use of painful physical and psychological tactics against terror suspects.
target_text: 布什的评论是对周四《纽约时报》上一篇文章的回应，该文章描述了2005年司法部的一份机密法律意见，该意见支持对恐怖分子嫌疑人使用痛苦的身体和心理战术。

source_text: Bush also claimed that "the techniques that we used have been fully disclosed to appropriate members of the US Congress."
target_text: 布什还声称，“我们使用的技术已经完全向美国国会的适当成员披露。”

source_text: According to anonymous sources cited in The New York Times article, the classified 2005 legal opinion contained "an expansive endorsement of the harshest interrogation techniques ever used by the Central Intelligence Agency," and explicitly authorized the use of tactics including head-slapping, frigid temperatures, and the simulated drowning technique known as waterboarding against terror suspects.
target_text: 据《纽约时报》文章援引的匿名消息人士称，2005年的保密法律意见包含“对中央情报局所使用的最严厉的审讯技术的广泛认可”，并被授权使用包括拍打头部、寒冷的温度和被称为水刑的模拟溺水技术等手段对付恐怖主义嫌疑人。

source_text: White House spokeswoman Dana Perino confirmed the existence of the 2005 document but did not say whether techniques such as head slapping and waterboarding constitute "torture" under U.S. law.
target_text: 白宫发言人达娜·佩里诺证实了2005年的文件的存在，但没有说像拍头和水刑这样的技术是否构成美国法律规定的“酷刑”。

source_text: "I'm not going to get into specific tactics," Perino said.
target_text: 佩里诺说：“我不打算谈具体的战术。”

source_text: She added that disclosing specific interrogation methods could reduce the effectiveness of those methods by allowing terrorists to train to resist them.
target_text: 她补充说，披露具体的审讯方法可能会降低这些方法的有效性，因为这会让恐怖分子接受训练来抵抗这些方法。

source_text: Democrats expressed frustration with the Bush administration's secrecy on the issue of interrogation tactics.
target_text: 民主党人对布什政府对审讯策略问题的保密表示沮丧。

source_text: "The administration can’t have it both ways," said Senator John D. Rockefeller IV, chairman of the Senate Intelligence Committee.
target_text: 参议院情报委员会主席参议员约翰·D·洛克菲勒四世说：“政府不可能双管齐下。”

source_text: "They can’t say that Congress has been fully briefed while refusing to turn over key documents used to justify the legality of the program."
target_text: “他们不能说国会在拒绝交出证明该计划合法性的关键文件的同时得到了充分的简报。”

source_text: The police officer has been identified as a 29-year-old officer in the Territorial Policing Command at the Metropolitan Police.

target_text: 警方尚未确认这些记者的身份，但英国广播公司表示，他们是《太阳报》前副主编费格斯·沙纳汉、格雷厄姆·杜德曼，前执行主编、犯罪编辑迈克·沙利文，还有克里斯·法罗，新闻主管。

target_text: 马雷克是一家地区性周刊的编辑，威斯基·波利基（来自警察镇的新闻）。

target_text: 2001年2月，他发表了一篇文章，指控一名私营广告公司的当地市政雇员存在利益冲突，他利用自己的职位为自己的公司谋取业务。

source_text: Brampton, Ontario woman Wendy Grant, 41, is facing 234 charges of double-doctoring after obtaining prescriptions for 6000 pills.

target_text: 从2月到5月，格兰特从皮尔和哈尔顿地区的28名医生和22家药店获得了药片。

source_text: The Workers' Compensation Board of Nova Scotia defines "double doctoring" "as a situation where a [person] seeks or obtains a prescription for a controlled drug or narcotic from more than one doctor to treat the same condition for the same period of time."
target_text: 新斯科舍省的工人补偿委员会将“双重医疗”定义为“一种情况，即【一个人】从不止一位医生那里寻求或获得控制药物或麻醉品的处方，以便在相同的时间内治疗相同的疾病。”

source_text: Apple's new 3G iPhone was introduced to consumers in 21 nations on Friday, but its first sales day was marred by minimal supplies and sluggish phone activations.
target_text: 上周五，苹果公司在21个国家向消费者推出了新款3G苹果手机，但由于供应不足和手机激活缓慢，这款手机的首个销售日受到了影响。

source_text: Systems which enable the iPhones for service had difficulty due to network failures and insufficient capacity to meet the demand for first-day sales, particularly in the United States at Apple and AT&T stores, and in Canada.
target_text: 使苹果手机能够提供服务的系统由于网络故障和容量不足而难以满足第一天销售的需求，特别是在美国苹果和AT&T商店以及加拿大。

source_text: Long lineups of customers were waiting at Australian stores for the first day of iPhone sales there, where the phone is supported by Telstra, Optus and Vodafone.
target_text: 在澳大利亚，一长串的消费者等待着iPhone销售的第一天，他们的手机得到了澳洲电信、澳都斯和沃达丰的支持。
