source_text: Residents told news agencies that troops poured petrol over slum houses located near a compound belonging to Saipem, a subsidiary of Italian oil company Eni, and set them alight.
target_text: 当地居民告诉新闻机构，军队向意大利石油公司埃尼集团子公司赛培姆附近的贫民窟房屋倾倒汽油，并点燃了房屋。

source_text: The fires have reportedly destroyed hundreds of homes and shops and hundreds of people are said to have fled from the area.
target_text: 据报道，大火摧毁了数百所房屋和商店，据说有数百人逃离该地区。

source_text: On Friday, people returning to the area and onlookers were chased away by soldiers.
target_text: 周五，返回该地区的人们和旁观者被士兵赶走了。

source_text: He said that militants active in the area had set the fires, wearing Army camouflage.
target_text: 他说，活跃在该地区的武装分子身穿军用迷彩服纵火。

source_text: On Thursday, oil workers were kidnapped from a bar near the slums by armed men who shot dead an Army soldier guarding the workers, and injured another soldier.
target_text: 星期四，石油工人在贫民窟附近的一家酒吧被武装人员绑架，枪杀了一名守卫工人的陆军士兵，另一名士兵受伤。

source_text: Nigerian military sources said at least two foreign oil workers were missing, one of them, Italian.
target_text: 尼日利亚军方消息人士称，至少有两名外国石油工人失踪，其中一人是意大利人。

source_text: The Italian foreign ministry, though, said that three foreigners were missing.
target_text: 不过，意大利外交部表示，有三名外国人失踪。

source_text: The oil-rich Niger Delta region has witnessed a spate of kidnappings recently.
target_text: 富产石油的尼日尔三角洲地区最近发生了一系列绑架事件。

source_text: Nineteen people were held captive in eight separate abductions this month.
target_text: 在本月的八起绑架案中，有19人被绑架。

source_text: All but three of them have been released since, some after the state government and the oil companies paid a ransom.
target_text: 自从州政府和石油公司支付了赎金之后，其中三个已经被释放。

source_text: The Movement for the Emancipation of the Niger Delta (MEND), a militant group which has taken hostages and attacked oil facilities, but says it does not kidnap for ransom, said in a statement that the state government has encouraged such abductions by paying ransoms.
target_text: 尼日尔三角洲解放运动（MEND）是一个武装组织，曾劫持人质并袭击石油设施，但声称绑架不是为了赎金。该组织在一份声明中说，尼日尔政府通过支付赎金鼓励绑架。

source_text: Last week, as part of a tougher line adopted by the Nigerian government, President Obasanjo sent in the Army, with orders to use "force for force" against militants in the region.
target_text: 上周，作为尼日利亚政府采取的更强硬路线的一部分，奥巴桑乔总统派遣军队，命令对该地区的武装分子使用“武力”。

source_text: Over 160 people were taken into custody in a two day crackdown, including over 100 from a nearby slum, but most have been released since then.
target_text: 在为期两天的镇压行动中，160多人被拘留，其中100多人来自附近的贫民窟，但大多数人已被释放。

source_text: The BBC's Alex Last reports that local leaders and oil companies are concerned that this new tough policy will increase tensions in the region.
target_text: BBC记者亚历克斯·拉斯塔报道称，当地领导人和石油公司担心这一新的强硬政策将加剧该地区的紧张局势。

source_text: Currently, there are blackouts, heavy rain, and high winds in British Columbia.
target_text: 目前，不列颠哥伦比亚省有停电、大雨和大风。

source_text: Buildings have already collapsed and trees have been knocked down.
target_text: 建筑物已经倒塌，树木被撞倒。

source_text: Five Vancouver rivers were in danger of flooding, which rain fell at 10 mm an hour for more than six hours at midday.
target_text: 温哥华有五条河处于泛滥的危险中，中午时分，降雨量达到每小时10毫米，持续了6个多小时。

source_text: The steel frame of a four-storey building under construction in Vancouver collapsed.
target_text: 温哥华正在建造的四层楼房的钢架倒塌。

source_text: Construction workers escaped injury, luckily they were on a coffee break at the time of the incident.
target_text: 建筑工人没有受伤，幸运的是他们当时正在喝咖啡休息。

source_text: "We also have hydro bus lines running down two sides of the building".
target_text: “我们还在建筑的两侧安装了水力发电母线”。

source_text: The Vancouver Fire Department says they have no idea as to why the building collapsed.
target_text: 温哥华消防局表示，他们不知道建筑物倒塌的原因。

source_text: Winds are gusting at more than 100 kilometres an hour (62 mph) in some areas and rainfall amounts of 50 to 130 millimetres.
target_text: 在某些地区，风速为每小时100公里（62英里小时）以上，降雨量为50至130毫米。

source_text: According BC Hydro spokeswoman Elisha Moreno, the hardest-hit areas are Vancouver, Surrey, Langley, Abbotsford and Mission, B.C.
target_text: BC水电公司发言人以利沙·莫雷诺说，受灾最严重的地区是温哥华、萨里、兰利、阿伯茨福德和米申斯。

source_text: "We're trying to be optimistic and hoping it's by end of day today, but there may very well be customers that are into the early-morning hours before restoration," Moreno said.
target_text: 莫雷诺说：“我们正努力保持乐观，希望今天就能完工，但很可能会有很多顾客在修复之前就已经迎来了清晨”。

source_text: Extensive ferry cancellations, road closures, and massive power outages are in effect until the storm ends.
target_text: 大规模的渡轮停运、道路封闭和大规模停电将持续到风暴结束。

source_text: The RCMP have advised people to stay home and off the highway.
target_text: 皇家骑警建议人们呆在家里，远离高速公路。

source_text: The same heavy weather has also affected nearby Washington State, USA.
target_text: 同样的恶劣天气也影响了附近的美国华盛顿州。

source_text: Radonski promised a shift towards more of a business-friendly stance: "Those who want progress, jobs, well-managed companies, somewhere we can develop small and medium businesses…everyone who wants that kind of country, come and join my bus for progress".
target_text: 拉多斯基承诺，将转向更有利于商业的立场：“那些想要进步的人，想要工作的人，想要管理良好的公司的人，想要发展中小企业的人……所有想要那种国家的人，都来加入我的行列，争取进步。”

source_text: Brett McKenzie is running for the Green Party of Ontario in the Ontario provincial election, in the London North Centre riding.
target_text: 布雷特·麦肯齐正在参加安大略省绿党在伦敦北部中心选区的选举。

source_text: Wikinews' Nick Moreau interviewed him regarding his values, his experience, and his campaign.
target_text: 维基新闻的尼克·莫罗就他的价值观、经历和竞选活动采访了他。

source_text: The Director of public prosecutions in England and Wales are going to seek a retrial for three men who are thought to have been involved in a plot to attempt to bomb transatlantic flights.
target_text: 英格兰和威尔士的检察署署长将要求对三名男子进行再审，他们被认为参与了试图轰炸跨大西洋航班的阴谋。

source_text: Ibrahim Savant and Arafat Khan are both 28 years old.
target_text: 易卜拉欣·莎凡特和阿拉法特·汗都是28岁。

source_text: All of the men were recently found "not guilty" of attempting to bomb aircrafts.
target_text: 所有这些人最近都被判“无罪”，没有试图炸毁飞机。

source_text: A spokesman for the Director of Public Prosecutions, Keir Starmer, confirmed that he will be seeking a retrial.
target_text: 检察署署长发言人科尔·斯达姆证实，他将寻求重审。

source_text: On Monday, a jury in Woolwich Crown Court in London, England failed to reach verdicts for the three men, based on charges of conspiracy to murder, which is why the Director of Public Prosecutions of England and Wales is seeking a retrial.
target_text: 周一，英格兰伦敦伍尔维奇皇家法院的一个陪审团未能根据共谋谋杀的指控对三人作出判决，这就是为什么英格兰和威尔士的检察署署长正在寻求重审。

source_text: Starmer said: "My task is to judge whether, taking into account all relevant considerations, the public interest is better served in this particular case by offering no evidence or by seeking a further retrial."
target_text: 斯达姆说：“我的任务是判断，在考虑到所有相关因素的情况下，即不提供证据或寻求进一步重审是否更符合本案的公共利益。”

source_text: Abdelbaset al-Megrahi has been buried in the town of Janzur, west of the Libyan capital Tripoli.
target_text: 阿卜德尔巴塞特·迈格拉希被埋在利比亚首都的黎波里西部的扬苏尔镇。

source_text: He was the only individual convicted in association with the Lockerbie bombing of 1988.
target_text: 他是唯一一个因与1988年洛克比爆炸案有关而被判有罪的人。

source_text: The bombing of Pan Am Flight 103 from London to New York resulted in 270 fatalities, including all 259 of the airplane's occupants and eleven individuals on the ground.
target_text: 从伦敦飞往纽约的泛美航空103号航班爆炸，造成270人死亡，包括机上259名乘客和11名地面人员。

source_text: 189 of those who died in the incident were US citizens.
target_text: 在事件中死亡的人中有189人是美国公民。

source_text: The death toll for this terrorist incident is larger than that for any other which has occurred in the United Kingdom thus far.
target_text: 这起恐怖事件的死亡人数大于迄今为止在英国发生的任何其他事件。

source_text: Five years later, senior judges in Scotland were to review his case, but he dropped the appeal.
target_text: 五年后，苏格兰的高级法官将复审他的案件，但他放弃了上诉。

source_text: Due to suffering from prostate cancer, he was granted a compassionate release from Scottish prison two days later.
target_text: 由于患有前列腺癌，两天后他从苏格兰监狱被释放。

source_text: Current UK Prime Minister David Cameron commented on his belief that al-Megrahi "should never have been released from prison" and said his death was an occasion "to remember the 270 people who lost their lives in what was an appalling terrorist act".
target_text: 英国现任首相戴维·卡梅伦评论说，他认为迈格拉希“本不应该被从监狱释放”的看法发表了评论，并表示迈格拉希的死是“对270名在可怕的恐怖主义行动中丧生的人的纪念”。

source_text: According to Alex Salmond, First Minister of Scotland, the investigation into the Lockerbie bombing is ongoing.
target_text: 苏格兰首席大臣亚历克斯·萨尔蒙德表示，对洛克比空难的调查仍在继续。

source_text: Prosecutors, he said, had always thought there were others besides al-Megrahi involved in the attack.
target_text: 他说，检察官一直认为除了梅格拉希之外还有其他人参与了袭击事件。

source_text: US citizen Susan Cohen, the mother of one of those killed in the Lockerbie bombing, thought of al-Megrahi as "a mass murderer" who "deserved to die", adding to CNN: "I feel no pity around him".
target_text: 美国公民苏珊·科恩是洛克比空难遇难者之一的母亲，她认为迈格拉希是“一名大屠杀凶手”，“死有余辜”。她向CNN补充道：“我对他一点也不同情。”

source_text: "My daughter [Theodora], at age 20, died a brutal, horrible death."
target_text: “我的女儿（狄奥多拉）在20岁时惨死。”

source_text: However, UK citizen Jim Swire, father of another victim of the bombing, believes al-Megrahi was not guilty.
target_text: 然而，另一名爆炸受害者的父亲、英国公民吉姆·斯怀尔认为，迈格拉希无罪。

source_text: He described al-Megrahi's death as "a sad time", telling the BBC he was "satisfied for some years that this man was nothing to do with the murder of my daughter".
target_text: 他将迈格拉希的死描述为“一段悲伤的时光”，并告诉英国广播公司，他“多年来我一直确信这个人与谋杀我女儿无关”。

source_text: According to a report released by the South African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC), a warrant has been issued by the South African National Prosecuting Authority (NPA), which operates separately from the police, for the arrest of Jackie Selebi national commissioner of the South African police and president of Interpol.
target_text: 根据南非广播公司（SABC）发表的一份报告，南非国家检察当局（NPA）发出了逮捕南非警察国家专员兼国际刑警组织主席杰基·塞莱比的逮捕令，NPA是独立于警察部门运作的。

source_text: Recent media coverage of the murder of Brett Kebble have raised questions of the close friendship between Jackie Selebi and Glenn Agliotti.
target_text: 最近媒体对布雷特·凯布尔谋杀案的报道引发了人们对杰姬·塞莱比和格伦·阿格里奥蒂之间亲密友谊的质疑。

source_text: Agliotti is alleged to have strong links with organized crime and racketeering.
target_text: 据称，阿格里奥蒂与有组织犯罪有密切联系。

source_text: The strike has affected a very large area in New Delhi including major markets in Rohini, Chandani Chowk, Karol Bagh and south extension of Delhi.
target_text: 罢工影响了新德里的一大片地区，包括罗希尼、月光集市、卡罗尔·巴格和德里以南的主要市场。

source_text: A group of traders met the union urban development minister S Jaipal Reddy to air their grievances about the government's response towards the MCD's sealing drive.
target_text: 一群商人与英国城市发展部部长伊帕尔·雷迪会面，表达了他们对政府对MCD封堵行动的不满。

source_text: Praveen Khandelwal, Secretary General of the Confederation of All India Traders, said, they will call off the strike on Wednesday night and they continue their agitation by hunger-strike and conferences against the sealing drive.
target_text: 印度贸易商联合会秘书长普拉文·坎德尔瓦尔表示，他们将在周三晚上取消罢工，并继续通过绝食抗议和反对封锁行动的会议继续煽动罢工。

source_text: Traders refused to move back from the agitation until November 1, when Municipal Corporation of Delhi is likely to resume its sealing drive.
target_text: 商人们拒绝在11月1日德里市政公司可能恢复封锁行动之前退出罢工煽动。

source_text: According to official sources, the union government is likely to file a review petition before the Supreme Court to temporarily suspend the drive and resolve this dispute as soon as possible.
target_text: 据官方消息称，工会政府可能会向最高法院提交一份复审申请，暂时中止这一行动，并尽快解决这一争端。

source_text: After seeing the law-and-order situation in Delhi, the Supreme Court's Monitoring committee recommended the Supreme Court not to resume the MCD's sealing drive on November 1.
target_text: 在看到德里的法律和秩序情况后，最高法院的监督委员会建议最高法院不要在11月1日恢复MCD的封锁行动。

source_text: Wilma ties the record for most tropical storms (named storms) in a season at 21, and the record for most hurricanes in a season at 12.
target_text: 威尔玛以1个季节21次刷平了最多热带风暴（命名为风暴）记录，并以1个季节12次刷平的最多飓风记录。

source_text: As of 2 pm EDT Wednesday, 19 October (18:00 UTC), the center of Hurricane Wilma was located near 17°5′ N 83°5′ W or about 300 miles (480 km) southeast of Cozumel, Mexico.
target_text: 截至美国东部夏令时10月19日星期三下午2时（18：00UTC），威尔玛飓风的中心位于墨西哥科苏梅尔东南部17°5′N 83°5′W附近或约300英里（480公里）。

source_text: It is moving to the west-northwest at 7 mph (11 KM/HR)with maximum sustained winds of 165 mph (270 km/h), with higher gusts, making it a dangerous Category 5 hurricane on the Saffir-Simpson Scale, and has a minimum central pressure of 900 mbar (26.58 InHg).
target_text: 它正以每小时7英里（11公里／小时）的速度向西北偏西移动，最大持续风速165英里（270公里／小时），阵风更大，使其成为萨菲尔-辛普森等级的危险5级飓风，最小中心气压为900毫巴（26.58InHg）。

source_text: Rainfall accumulations are expected in amounts of 5 to 10 inches, with isolated areas of 25 inches over the Cayman Islands, Jamaica, Haiti, and Cuba.
target_text: 预计降雨量为5至10英寸，开曼群岛、牙买加、海地和古巴的孤立区域为25英寸。

source_text: Rains of 4 to 6 inches can be expected in areas of Honduras and Nicaragua.
target_text: 洪都拉斯和尼加拉瓜地区的降雨量预计为4至6英寸。

source_text: At 5pm EDT the country of Mexico issued a Hurricane Watch for the Yucatan Peninsula from Punta Allen to Cabo Catoche.
target_text: 美国东部时间下午5点，墨西哥发布了尤卡坦半岛从蓬塔艾伦到卡波卡托什的飓风警报。

source_text: A hurricane watch remains in effect for the east coast of the Yucatan peninsula from south of Tulum to Punta Gruesa.
target_text: 从图伦南部到蓬塔格鲁埃萨，尤卡坦半岛东海岸仍处于飓风警戒状态。

source_text: A tropical storm warning is in effect for Belize from the border With Mexico southward to Belize City.
target_text: 伯利兹从墨西哥南部到伯利兹城边境的热带风暴警报正在生效。

source_text: A hurricane watch remains in effect in Cuba for the provinces of Matanzas westward through Pinar del Rio...and for the Isle of Youth.
target_text: 古巴的一个飓风警报在马坦萨斯省西边的皮纳尔德尔里奥和青年岛仍然有效。

source_text: A tropical storm warning remains in effect for Honduras from the Honduras/Nicaragua border westward to Cabo Camaron.
target_text: 从洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜边界向西到卡布卡马隆的热带风暴警报对洪都拉斯仍然有效。

source_text: Thirteen are believed dead, twelve in Haiti and one in Jamaica.
target_text: 据信十三人死亡，海地十二人，牙买加一人。

source_text: According to Xinhua News Agency, Beijing Health Bureau spokeswoman Deng Xiaohong said that the 13-month-old boy died Sunday while en route to the hospital.
target_text: 据新华社报道，北京市卫生局发言人邓晓红说，这名13个月大的男孩周日在去医院途中去世。

source_text: Health authorities state that 24,934 children in mainland China are afflicted with the disease, and 42 children have died from it.
target_text: 卫生当局表示，中国大陆有24,934名儿童患有这种疾病，42名儿童死于此。

source_text: The cause of the disease has been identified as Enterovirus 71 (EV-71).
target_text: 该疾病的原因已被确定为肠病毒71（EV-71）。

source_text: Another child infected with the virus died Monday, but as he died in Hebei province his death was counted there.
target_text: 周一，另一名感染该病毒的儿童死亡，但由于他死于河北省，所以死亡人数也被计入河北省。

source_text: Xinhua News Agency also reported that a 21-month-old boy died Monday of the virus in Hubei province.
target_text: 新华社还报道，一名21个月大的男孩于周一在湖北省死于该病毒。

source_text: After an order was given last week by the Ministry of Health of the People's Republic of China that all cases must be reported, the count of those infected has increased markedly.
target_text: 上周，中华人民共和国卫生部发布命令，要求所有病例都必须上报，之后感染人数显著增加。

source_text: Eastern China saw a large number of cases in early March, but this information was not made public until late April.
target_text: 中国东部地区在3月初出现了大量病例，但这一信息直到4月底才公布。

source_text: In March, Children under age six in eastern Anhui province began being admitted to hospitals with symptoms of the virus, and the outbreak spread quickly after that.
target_text: 3月，安徽省东部地区六岁以下的儿童开始出现因病毒症状入院治疗，随后疫情迅速蔓延。

source_text: The city of Fuyang in Anhui province was especially hard-hit by the outbreak.
target_text: 安徽省阜阳市特别受到疫情的严重打击。

source_text: The majority of patients who were in critical condition have recovered, said a Health Ministry official in a statement on Monday.
target_text: 卫生部官员周一在一份声明中表示，大多数病情危重的病人已经康复。

source_text: "What I know is the death rate has gone down drastically since early May."
target_text: “据我所知，死亡率自5月初以来急剧下降。”

source_text: "There are very, very few cases with complications — 99 percent of these are mild cases", said World Health Organization (WHO) China representative Hans Troedsson in a statement on Wednesday.
target_text: 世界卫生组织（WHO）驻中国代表韩卓升周三在一份声明中表示：“出现并发症的病例非常非常少，百分之99都是轻微病例。”

source_text: Incidents of the disease are expected to peak in June and July.
target_text: 该疾病事件预计将在6月和7月达到高峰。

source_text: Children with mild cases of the disease generally recover rapidly after manifesting a rash and a fever.
target_text: 患有轻微病症的儿童在出现皮疹和发烧后通常会迅速恢复。

source_text: Other symptoms include diarrhea, cold-like symptoms, and sores on the extremities and mouth.
target_text: 其他症状包括腹泻，感冒样症状，四肢和口腔溃疡。

source_text: In severe cases, fluid may accumulate in the brain, and result in meningitis, encephalitis, pulmonary edema, paralysis and death.
target_text: 在严重的情况下，液体可能积聚在大脑中，导致脑膜炎、脑炎、肺水肿、瘫痪和死亡。

source_text: The EV-71 virus is spread through contact with fluid secreted from blisters, nose and throat mucus, feces and saliva.
target_text: EV-71病毒通过与水疱、鼻腔和喉咙粘液、粪便和唾液分泌的液体接触而传播。

source_text: There is no specific treatment or vaccine for the virus.
target_text: 该病毒没有特定的治疗方法或疫苗。

source_text: The disease is unrelated to foot-and-mouth disease, which affects livestock.
target_text: 这种疾病与影响牲畜的口蹄疫无关。

source_text: United States Department of Health and Human Services Secretary Mike Leavitt was visiting in the country, and said in a statement Monday in Shanghai that the U.S. is assisting China fight the outbreak.
target_text: 美国卫生与公众服务部部长迈克·莱维特星期一在上海访问时说，美国正在帮助中国抗击疫情。

source_text: According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), a division of the Department of Health and Human Services, symptomatic treatment can be given to address possible fever and aches and pains.
target_text: 根据卫生和人类服务部的疾病控制和预防中心（CDC），可以采取对症治疗来解决可能的发烧和疼痛。

source_text: The CDC advises children and adults to practice proper hand washing technique, and to wash and disinfect contaminated items and surfaces using diluted solution of chlorine-containing bleach.
target_text: 疾病预防控制中心建议儿童和成人采用适当的洗手技术，并使用含氯漂白剂的稀释溶液对受污染的物品和表面进行清洗和消毒。

source_text: China is also dealing with a magnitude-7.9 earthquake which hit the country Monday and has killed almost 15,000.
target_text: 中国也正在应对周一发生的7.9级大地震，该地震造成近15,000人死亡。

source_text: The outbreak is a concern to the government, as the country prepares for the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing this August.
target_text: 随着中国为今年8月在北京举行的2008年夏季奥运会做准备，该病毒的爆发引起了政府的关注。

source_text: And at a joint press conference held by China's Ministry of Health and the WHO, he further noted that, "China is confident that it can control the spread of the disease with effective prevention methods."
target_text: 在中国卫生部和世界卫生组织举行的联合记者招待会上，他进一步指出，“中国有信心通过有效的预防方法控制疾病的传播。”

source_text: Venus Williams triumphed over Marion Bartoli of France 6-4, 6-1 yesterday to win the Women's Singles event at the 2007 Wimbledon Championships.
target_text: 昨天维纳斯·威廉姆斯以6比4和6比1战胜了法国的马里昂·巴托利，赢得了2007年温布尔登锦标赛女子单打比赛的冠军。

source_text: A Wimbledon champion in 2000, 2001 and 2005, Williams was not the favorite to win the title again this year.
target_text: 作为2000年、2001年和2005年的温布尔登冠军，威廉姆斯并不是今年再次夺冠的最佳人选。

source_text: Currently ranked 23rd in the world, she entered the tournament in the shadow of her sister, Serena Williams.
target_text: 目前她在世界排名第23位，她在姐姐塞雷娜威廉姆斯的影响下参加了比赛。

source_text: At the beginning of the tennis season, Serena stated her own determination to reclaim the No. 1 ranking.
target_text: 在网球赛季开始时，塞丽娜表示自己决心重新夺回排名第一的位置。

source_text: Serena showed better than Venus at the French Open by reaching the quarter finals, and won the Australian Open in January (Venus dropped out due to an injury).
target_text: 塞丽娜在法网公开赛上的表现优于维纳斯，进入四分之一决赛，并在1月赢得了澳网（维纳斯因伤退出）。

source_text: In spite of her initial strength, Serena's hopes to dominate the tournament were cut short when she lost to No. 1 seeded Justine Henin in the quarterfinals.
target_text: 尽管她最初的实力，在四分之一决赛中输给第一号种子贾斯汀·海宁使塞雷娜赢得比赛的希望提前终结。

source_text: Bartoli, the eighteenth seed for this year's championships, had never progressed past the fourth round of any Grand Slam event.
target_text: 巴托利，今年锦标赛的第18位种子选手，从未超过任何大满贯赛事的第四轮。

source_text: However, she progressed to the final by defeating third seed Jelena Janković in the fourth round and Justine Henin in the semifinals in one of the major upsets of Wimbledon history.
target_text: 然而，她在第四轮击败三号种子耶莱娜·扬科维奇并在半决赛中击败贾斯汀·海宁，爆出温布尔登历史上一大冷门，进入决赛。

source_text: As Henin lost to Bartoli in the semifinals, Venus Williams was poised to become the lowest seeded player in recorded history to win the Wimbledon singles title.
target_text: 因为海宁在半决赛中输给巴托利，维纳斯·威廉姆斯有望成为历史上获得温布尔登单打冠军的种子选手中排名最低的一位。

source_text: Venus was reunited with the Venus Rosewater Dish on Centre Court during the trophy ceremony.
target_text: 在颁奖仪式上，维纳斯与中央球场的维纳斯玫瑰水盘重聚。

source_text: Another first, the All England Club is paying men's and women's singles champions equal prize money.
target_text: 另一个第一次是，全英俱乐部支付男子单打冠军和女子单打冠军相同的奖金。

source_text: Venus was paid $1.407 million, to which she replied "Thank you, All England Club - we're playing under equal terms."
target_text: 维纳斯得到了1407万美元的报酬，她回答说：“谢谢你，全英格兰俱乐部-我们在平等的条件下打球。”

source_text: The men's final takes place later today with first seed and defending champion Roger Federer taking on second seed Rafael Nadal in a repeat of last year's final.
target_text: 男子决赛将于今天晚些时候举行，第一种子、卫冕冠军罗杰·费德勒将与第二种子拉斐尔·纳达尔对决，这是去年决赛的重演。

source_text: A "highly pathogenic strain" of the H5N1 Avian Flu virus has been detected in a dead Australian black swan, floating in a pond located at the Dresden Zoo in Dresden, Germany.
target_text: 德国德累斯顿动物园的池塘里漂浮着一只死亡的澳大利亚黑天鹅，它身上发现了H5N1禽流感病毒的一种“高致病性毒株”。

source_text: Conflicting reports say that the swan was found on Monday, Tuesday or Wednesday.
target_text: 有争议的报道说天鹅是在星期一、星期二或星期三被发现的。

source_text: The Friedrich Loeffler Institute which specializes in animal diseases confirmed the test results.
target_text: 专门研究动物疾病的弗里德里希·勒弗勒研究所证实了测试结果。

source_text: "We can confirm that this is the highly pathogenic strain," said a spokesperson for the institute.
target_text: “我们可以确认这是一种高致病性菌株，”该研究所的发言人说。

source_text: Officials have blocked off an area of Dresden approximately 1.9 miles (3km) from the site where the swan was found and have posted observation areas at approximately 6.2 miles (10km) outside the area as a precaution.
target_text: 官员们封锁了距离发现天鹅地点大约1.9英里（3公里）的德累斯顿地区，并在该区域外大约6.2英里（10公里）处张贴了观察区域作为预防措施。

source_text: For the moment, all birds in the zoo have been confined to their cages and viewing of birds by the public is no longer permitted.
target_text: 目前，动物园内的所有鸟类都被限制在笼子里，不再允许公众观赏鸟类。

source_text: The zoo still remains open for business and cleaning efforts have been intensified.
target_text: 动物园仍然开放营业，清洁工作也在加强。

source_text: Officials have also restricted cats and dogs from roaming areas nearby.
target_text: 官员们还限制猫狗在附近游荡。

source_text: There are at least 112 different species of birds, totaling 720, located at the zoo.
target_text: 动物园里至少有112种不同种类的鸟类，总数为720只。

source_text: In April, H5N1 was first discovered in Germany in a domestic fowl and in wild birds.
target_text: 今年4月，德国首次在家禽和野禽中发现H5N1病毒。

source_text: The last case of H5N1 to turn up in Germany was on May 12, 2006.
target_text: 德国出现的最后一例H5N1禽流感病例是在2006年5月12日。

source_text: Finland's National Bureau of Investigation, a division of Finland's national police, has ten suspects currently, in its recent investigation into alleged dog fighting in the south of the country.
target_text: 芬兰国家调查局是芬兰国家警察的一个部门，在最近对该国南部涉嫌斗狗的调查中，目前有10名嫌疑人。

source_text: All the suspects are male Finns residing in southern Finland.
target_text: 所有嫌疑人都是居住在芬兰南部的男性芬兰人。

source_text: The new developments are the result of an investigation into four to six alleged dog fights.
target_text: 这些新进展是对四到六起涉嫌斗狗事件的调查结果。

source_text: Dog fighting is a breach of animal cruelty laws in Finland, and the case will be considered for prosecution in October.
target_text: 斗狗违反了芬兰的虐待动物法，该案将于10月份考虑起诉。

source_text: They are being investigated under suspicion of breaching the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act.
target_text: 他们因涉嫌违反“防止虐待动物法”而受到调查。

source_text: At least thus far there has been no evidence of illegal gambling on the outcome of fights.
target_text: 至少到目前为止，还没有证据表明在斗殴结果上存在非法赌博。

source_text: "It would appear to be the pastime of a group of individuals."
target_text: “这似乎是一群人的消遣。”

source_text: Despite this, the group is known to have links throughout Scandinavia, as well as possible links to Russia.
target_text: 尽管如此，众所周知，该组织与斯堪的纳维亚半岛各地都有联系，也可能与俄罗斯有联系。

source_text: He added that about a dozen pit bulls from America were involved in the incidents.
target_text: 他补充说，大约有十几头美国比特犬卷入了这些事件。

source_text: Key evidence includes video footage and testimony from veterinary surgeons, who were present when police raided several locations suspected to be involved.
target_text: 关键证据包括视频片段和兽医的证词，警方突袭了几个涉嫌涉案的地点时，兽医在场。

source_text: "Statements by veterinary surgeons are a significant part of the investigation."
target_text: “兽医的声明是调查的重要部分。”

source_text: "They play the same role here as forensic pathologists would in a normal violent crime investigation," Inspector Töyräs said.
target_text: “他们在这里扮演的角色和法医病理学家在正常的暴力犯罪调查中所扮演的角色是一样的”，特于雷斯警官说。

source_text: The investigation was begun as a result of an investigation into dog fighting in the United Kingdom by the state-run British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC).
target_text: 这项调查是由英国国家广播公司（BBC）对英国斗狗事件进行调查后开始的。

source_text: This uncovered links to a group involved in comparable activity in Finland.
target_text: 这揭示了与参与芬兰类似活动的团体的联系。

source_text: The documentary, which is part of the Panorama series, was broadcast in Finland yesterday by YLE.
target_text: 芬兰广播公司昨天在芬兰播出了《全景》系列纪录片的一部分。

source_text: The BBC had contacted Finland regarding it's discoveries in April.
target_text: 英国广播公司已于4月份与芬兰联系，了解其发现情况。

source_text: The BBC itself had begun it's investigation after Gerard Cavlan, a football player from Northern Ireland, was convicted on charges related to dog fighting.
target_text: 在北爱尔兰足球运动员杰拉德·卡夫兰被判与斗狗有关的罪名成立后，BBC本身也开始了调查。

source_text: Privacy laws in Finland required the faces of those believed to be involved to be pixelated during the Finnish version of the broadcast, although this was not mirrored in the UK screening - which, in an unprecedented move, coincided exactly with the showing in Finland.
target_text: 芬兰的隐私法要求，在芬兰版的播放中，那些据信参与其中的人的脸必须打上马赛克，尽管英国版的放映中没有出现这种情况-这是一项史无前例的举措，恰好与芬兰版的放映时间吻合。

source_text: The show was widely discussed on the internet, with large volumes of material requiring deleted by site administrators as breaching Finnish privacy legislation.
target_text: 该节目在互联网上被广泛讨论，大量的材料需要被网站管理员删除，因为违反了芬兰的隐私法规。

source_text: The investigation is the only one ever conducted into dog fighting in Finland.
target_text: 这是芬兰唯一一项关于斗狗的调查。

source_text: Töyräs explained the problem to journalists: "We have only had vague unconnected hints of this sort of activity in the past, and on the basis of these it was not possible to mount an earlier investigation."
target_text: Töyräs向记者解释了这个问题：“过去我们对此类活动只有模糊的无关联线索，并且在此基础上不可能进行早期调查。”

source_text: The sole United States manufacturer of a key component of lethal injections announced Friday that it will cease production of the drug, contributing to shortages and delaying executions.
target_text: 美国唯一一家致命注射剂关键成分的生产商星期五宣布，将停止生产这种药物，这导致药品短缺和推迟执行死刑。

source_text: Sodium thiopental, the first of a three drug cocktail used in 34 states to render the prisoner to be executed unconscious, was manufactured in Italy until Italian authorities stated that they would only license the manufacture if it was used for medical purposes and not, crucially, for executions.
target_text: 硫喷妥钠是34个州为使囚犯昏迷而使用的三种药物混合物中的第一种，意大利当局声明，如果该混合物用于医疗目的，而不是用于死刑，他们才会许可该混合物的制造，此前在意大利制造。

source_text: In a statement, the company, Hospira, said that they have never condoned the use of their drug, marketed as 'Pentothal', in executions, and that they could not "prevent the drug from being diverted to departments of corrections for use in capital punishment procedures".
target_text: 赫士睿公司在一份声明中表示，他们从来没有宽恕过在执行死刑时使用这种名为“喷妥撒”的药物，他们不能“阻止毒品被转移到惩教部门用于死刑程序”。

source_text: The move means that the United States is without a viable supplier for sodium thiopental.
target_text: 此举意味着美国没有可行的硫喷妥钠供应商。

source_text: Although many European countries manufacture the drug, which is primarily used in Europe as an anæsthetic, no manufacturer has been found that is willing to supply it for use in conjunction with the death penalty, the abolition of which has been lobbied by the EU since 2008.
target_text: 虽然许多欧洲国家制造这种药物，主要在欧洲用作美容药物，但没有发现任何制造商愿意提供与死刑一起使用的药物，自2008年以来欧盟一直在游说废除死刑。

source_text: The shortage means that executions in California and Oklahoma have been delayed, with Texas' last remaining stocks of the drug due to expire in March, weeks before two scheduled executions.
target_text: 短缺意味着，加州和俄克拉荷马州的死刑执行被推迟，德克萨斯州的最后一批剩余库存将于3月到期，比原定的两起死刑提前数周。

source_text: These delays are likely to be prolonged as the legal process of drawing up new drugs to be used for injections is lengthy.
target_text: 这些延误很可能会被延长，因为制定用于注射的新药的法律程序很长。

source_text: Pentobarbital, an alternative which is used at the Dignitas clinic in Switzerland, is used for lethal injections in Oregon, and has started to be used by Oklahoma.
target_text: 戊巴比妥是瑞士尊严诊所使用的另一种药物，在俄勒冈州被用于注射死刑，俄克拉荷马州也开始使用。

source_text: Hospira's decision caused mixed reactions throughout the medical community, with the American Society of Anesthesiologists stating Monday that sodium thiopental is an "important and medically necessary anesthetic agent" that is a "first-line anesthetic in many cases", citing geriatric and cardiovascular conditions, among others.
target_text: 赫士睿的决定在整个医疗界引起了混合反应，美国麻醉师协会周一表示，硫喷妥钠是一种“重要且医学上必需的麻醉剂”，在许多情况下，它是一种“一线麻醉剂”，理由包括老年和心血管疾病。

source_text: It said that, although they disagree with the death penalty, "we also do not condone using the issue as the basis to place undue burdens on the distribution of this critical drug to the United States."
target_text: 声明说，尽管他们不同意死刑，“我们也不能宽恕以这个问题为基础，对向美国分发这种关键药物施加不必要的负担。”

source_text: "It is an unfortunate irony that many more lives will be lost or put in jeopardy as a result of not having the drug available for its legitimate medical use."
target_text: “这是一个不幸的讽刺，将有更多的生命失去或处于危险之中，因为没有药物的合法医疗用途。”

source_text: Brazilian federal police arrested Jesse James Hollywood, aged 25, in Saquarema city, Rio de Janeiro, on March 8.
target_text: 3月8日，巴西联邦警察在里约热内卢的萨夸雷马市逮捕了25岁的杰西·詹姆斯·好莱坞。

source_text: James had been sought by the FBI for more than four years.
target_text: 詹姆斯已经被联邦调查局追捕了四年多。

source_text: According to the police, he was living in Saquarema with a woman who is pregnant.
target_text: 据警方称，他当时与一名怀孕的女子住在萨夸雷马。

source_text: The two countries do not have a formal extradition treaty.
target_text: 这两个国家没有正式的引渡条约。

source_text: On Friday, James appeared in a Santa Barbara, California court for arraignment on charges of kidnapping and murdering a 15-year-old boy.
target_text: 星期五，詹姆斯出现在加利福尼亚州圣塔芭芭拉的一个法院，因涉嫌绑架和谋杀一名15岁的男孩而被提审。

source_text: James will plead not guilty, according to his attorney, James E. Blatt.
target_text: 据他的律师詹姆斯·E·布拉特说，詹姆斯将不认罪。

source_text: Blatt also criticized the portrait prosecutors had painted of his client.
target_text: 布拉特还批评了检察官为他的当事人所画的肖像。

source_text: "Have you ever seen a 20 year-old mastermind? He was not the shooter," said Blat.
target_text: “你见过20岁的策划者吗？他不是枪手。”布拉特说。

source_text: Blatt requested that the trial be continued on April 4.
target_text: 布拉特要求在4月4日继续审判。

source_text: The Wikimedia Foundation, the mother organization of the popular Wikipedia encyclopedia, and Answers.com, a search engine company, announced a new partnership.
target_text: 维基媒体基金会，一个流行的维基百科百科全书的母组织，以及一家搜索引擎公司Asfr.com宣布了一个新的合作伙伴关系。

source_text: The advertising revenues from this software will be split with the Wikimedia Foundation.
target_text: 该软件的广告收入将与维基媒体基金会分开。

source_text: It will be linked from the English Wikipedia Tools page for a 60 day trial beginning in 2006.
target_text: 它将从英文维基百科工具页面链接，从2006年开始进行为期60天的试用。

source_text: Jimmy Wales, president of the Wikimedia Foundation, said he was pleased to partner with Answers.com, encouraging software that improves access to Wikipedia.
target_text: 维基媒体基金会主席吉米•威尔士表示，他很高兴能与Answers.com合作，鼓励使用能够改善维基百科访问的软件。

source_text: Bob Rosenschein, Answers.com's founder and CEO, told the media that Wikipedia is "the most dynamic of over 120 content sources found in Answers.com".
target_text: Answers.com的创始人兼首席执行官鲍勃·罗森切恩告诉媒体，维基百科是“在Answers.com中发现的120多个内容源中最有活力的”。

source_text: One of the potential problems with encouraging software-based and third party uses of Wikipedia's content is that it could divert people from the site, one user remarked.
target_text: 一位用户指出，鼓励基于软件和第三方使用维基百科内容的一个潜在问题是，它可能会使人们的注意力离开网站。

source_text: The Congressional Hispanic Caucus has blocked voting on legislation that would allow employers to rehire foreign seasonal workers.
target_text: 美国国会拉美裔议员团阻止就允许雇主重新雇用外国季节性劳工的立法进行投票。

source_text: This year, the U.S. government will only issue 33,000 visas for winter workers and 33,000 for summer workers.
target_text: 今年，美国政府将只为冬季工人签发33,000份签证，为夏季工人签发33,000份签证。

source_text: This comes as a stark comparison to 2007, when 120,000 foreign workers entered the U.S. with H-2B visas.
target_text: 这与2007年的情况形成鲜明对比，当时有12万名外国工人以H-2B签证进入美国。

source_text: Currently, the reduction in visas is having profounds effects on both Mexico and U.S.
target_text: 目前，签证减少对墨西哥和美国产生了巨大影响。

source_text: In Tlapacoyan, a Mexican town which in the last 30 years has exported a large seasonal workforce, using H-2B visas, to work in U.S. circuses and carnivals, the effects are already a stark reality.
target_text: 在墨西哥的特拉帕科扬镇，在过去30年里，该镇利用H-2B签证出口了大量季节性劳动力，在美国马戏团和嘉年华中工作，其影响已经是一个严峻的现实。

source_text: The local economy has been paralyzed, and unemployment has reached dramatic highs.
target_text: 当地经济陷入瘫痪，失业率达到了极高的水平。

source_text: Additionally, residents like Pablo Juarez Mendoza, who last year made $450 working in Texan livestock shows, are having difficulties finding local work.
target_text: 此外，像帕布罗·华雷斯·门多萨这样的居民，去年在德州的畜牧展上工作赚了450美元，他们很难找到当地工作。

source_text: U.S. businesses are getting ready to face their own set of economical obstacles caused by the lack of cheap labor.
target_text: 美国企业正准备面对由于缺乏廉价劳动力而造成的一系列经济障碍。

source_text: Many employers are finding creative ways to cut costs, including scaling back operations.
target_text: 许多雇主正在寻找创造性的方法来削减成本，包括缩减运营。

source_text: In Cape Cod, for example, the local chamber of commerce reports that town employers will only receive 15 of the 5,000 visas requested.
target_text: 例如，在科德角，当地商会报告说，镇雇主只会收到所要求的5,000份签证中的15份。

source_text: In response, local Cape Cod business owner, Williman Zammer, has called the situation "a major crisis," and states that what the Hispanic Caucus is doing is "ruthless."
target_text: 作为回应，当地的科德角企业主威利曼·扎默称这种情况是“一场严重的危机”，并称拉美裔核心小组所做的是“无情的”。

source_text: Opponents of the change state that recent legislation blocking is part of the Caucus' efforts to push for comprehensive immigration reform, not seen in the U.S. since the early 1980s.
target_text: 反对这项改革的人士说，最近的立法阻碍是移民政策核心小组推动全面移民改革努力的一部分。美国自上世纪80年代初以来就没有出现过全面移民改革。

source_text: Hispanic Caucus Chairman, Rep. Joe Baca, D-California, hopes that policymakers will place attention not only on helping small businesses, but also on what to do with 12 million illegal immigrants currently residing in the U.S., and improving border security.
target_text: 拉美裔核心小组主席、加州民主党众议员乔·巴卡希望，政策制定者不仅要关注帮助小企业，还要关注如何处理目前居住在美国的1200万非法移民，以及改善边境安全。

source_text: The issue of immigration has become a polarizing subject in the U.S., and one that has been an intrinsic part of the fabric that makes up the American society.
target_text: 移民问题已成为美国的一个两极分化的主题，也是构成美国社会的结构的内在组成部分。

source_text: Since 2006, the U.S. accepts more legal immigrants as permanent residents than any other country in the world.
target_text: 自2006年以来，美国接受的合法移民成为永久居民的数量超过了世界上任何其他国家。

source_text: That same year, a NBC/Wall Street Journal poll revealed that the U.S. public was equally divided on the whether immigration helps or hurts the country.
target_text: 同年，美国全国广播公司、华尔街日报的民意调查显示，美国公众对移民是否有助于或伤害国家存在同样的分歧。

source_text: Forty-four percent said it helped, forty-five percent said it hurt.
target_text: 百分之44的人说有帮助，百分之45的人说有伤害。

source_text: However, a recent Pew Research Center study suggests that the issue will remain at the forefront of the American political agenda for many years to come.
target_text: 然而，最近皮尤研究中心的一项研究表明，这个问题将在未来许多年仍然是美国政治议程的重点。

source_text: The U.S Latino population will account for 30% of the population, while Asians will account for 9%.
target_text: 美国拉丁裔人口将占人口的30％，而亚洲人将占9％。

source_text: The study seems to also hint that this growth is in many ways connected to legislation passed by Congress in 1965, that abolished a quota system that had nearly ended immigration from non-European countries since the 1920s, and consequently caused an immigration surge.
target_text: 这项研究似乎还暗示，这种增长在很多方面与1965年国会通过的一项立法有关。1965年，国会废除了一项配额制度，该制度自上世纪20年代以来几乎终止了来自非欧洲国家的移民，并因此导致了移民潮。

source_text: The United Nations and French peacekeeping forces say they will not leave the Ivory Coast despite orders from incumbent president Laurent Gbagbo to leave the country.
target_text: 联合国和法国维和部队表示，尽管现任总统洛朗·巴博下令离开该国，但他们不会离开象牙海岸。

source_text: Secretary General of the UN Ban Ki-moon said in a statement that the UN in the Ivory Coast will "fulfill its mandate and will continue to monitor and document any human rights violations, incitement to hatred and violence, or attacks on U.N. peacekeepers."
target_text: 联合国秘书长潘基文在一份声明中说，联合国在科特迪瓦将“履行其使命，继续监测和记录任何侵犯人权、煽动仇恨和暴力、或袭击联合国维和人员的行为”。

source_text: He also called the orders for all peacekeeping troops to leave the nation irrelevant and without effect, adding that the UN does not believe Gbagbo is the legal president.
target_text: 他还呼吁所有要求维和部队离开该国的命令都无关紧要并且无效，他还补充说联合国不相信巴博是合法总统。

source_text: "The president-elect is Ouattara and he hasn't asked us to leave," added the UN.
target_text: 联合国补充说：“当选总统是瓦塔拉，他没有要求我们离开。”

source_text: Cuban Taekwondo athlete Ángel Matos was banned for life yesterday after an assault on Swedish referee Chakir Chelbat during the 2008 Beijing Olympic games.
target_text: 古巴跆拳道运动员恩格尔·马托斯在2008年北京奥运会期间因殴打瑞典裁判查基尔·切尔巴特而被终身禁赛。

source_text: Matos was competing in the bronze medal match against Arman Chilmanov of Kazakhstan when he sustained an injury.
target_text: 马托斯受伤时正在参加与哈萨克斯坦选手阿尔曼·齐尔马诺夫争夺铜牌的比赛。

source_text: As he lay on the mat with medical attendants, Matos was disqualified for exceeding the one minute injury time limit.
target_text: 当他在医护人员的陪伴下躺在垫子上时，马托斯因为超过了受伤时间一分钟的限制而被取消了比赛资格。

source_text: When Chilmanov was declared the winner of the bout, Matos delivered a kick to the face of Chelbat.
target_text: 当齐尔马诺夫被宣布为这场比赛的胜利者时，马托斯一脚踢在了切尔巴特的脸上。

source_text: Touch judges rushed in to try to control the situation.
target_text: 巡边员冲了进来，试图控制局面。

source_text: Matos pushed one of them and then spat on the floor.
target_text: 马托斯推了其中一个，然后在地板上吐了口水。

source_text: Both Matos and his coach Leudis Gonzalez were banned for life from all official Taekwondo events for their behavior in the incident.
target_text: 马托斯和他的教练卢迪斯·冈萨雷斯都因在事件中的行为被终身禁止参加所有官方跆拳道比赛。

source_text: The World Taekwondo Federation released a statement referring to the incident as a "strong violation of the spirit of Taekwondo and the Olympic Games".
target_text: 世界跆拳道联合会发表声明称这一事件“严重违反了跆拳道和奥运精神”。

source_text: They also called for all records of Matos to be removed from the Olympic records.
target_text: 他们还呼吁将所有马托斯记录从奥运会记录中删除。

source_text: Later coach Leudis Gonzalez claimed the Kazaks offered him money to lose the bout.
target_text: 后来教练卢迪斯·冈萨雷斯声称哈萨克斯坦给了他钱来输掉比赛。

source_text: WTF secretary general Yang Jin-suk said "due process must be followed before officially banning the two."
target_text: WTF秘书长杨金淑表示，“在正式禁止两人之前必须遵循正当程序。”

source_text: Matos won the gold medal in Sydney in 2000; he finished in 11th place in Athens four years later.
target_text: 马托斯在2000年赢得了悉尼的金牌，四年后他在雅典排名第11。

source_text: The Canterbury Bulldogs, a team in Australia's National Rugby League, has entered into an agreement with New South Wales police to provide extra police at all games in NSW.
target_text: 澳大利亚国家橄榄球联盟的坎特伯雷斗牛犬队与新南威尔士州警方达成协议，将在新南威尔士州的所有比赛中增加警力。

source_text: The agreement follows a spate of violent incidents at Bulldogs matches this year.
target_text: 该协议是在今年斗牛犬比赛中发生一连串暴力事件之后达成的。

source_text: In March, there were fights during and after a game between the Bulldogs and Wests Tigers at Telstra Stadium, the Bulldogs home ground.
target_text: 三月份，在斗牛犬主场特拉特体育场，斗牛犬队和西部猛虎队在比赛期间和之后发生了争执。

source_text: This led police to step up their presence at Bulldogs matches for the rest of the season.
target_text: 这导致警方在本赛季余下的时间里加强了对斗牛犬比赛的关注。

source_text: A month later, a group of Bulldogs supporters abused four South Sydney cheerleaders at another home match.
target_text: 一个月后，一群斗牛犬的支持者在另一场主场比赛中辱骂了四名南悉尼的啦啦队长。

source_text: According to NSW Police, a meeting was held between the police executive and Bulldogs CEO, Malcolm Noad where it was decided that the club will pay for additional police at all Bulldogs games across NSW.
target_text: 据新南威尔士州警方称，警方执行官与斗牛犬首席执行官马尔科姆·诺德举行了一次会议，决定俱乐部将在新南威尔士州所有斗牛犬比赛中支付额外的警察费用。

source_text: The additional police will include specialist police (including riot police) to provide security for spectators.
target_text: 增设的警察将包括专家警察（包括防暴警察）为观众提供安全保障。

source_text: Only police that are working outside their normal rostered hours will be paid for by the club.
target_text: 只有在正常工作时间之外工作的警察才会被俱乐部支付。

source_text: The police Commander of the North West Sydney region, Assistant Commissioner said he was pleased that the club was working with the police proactively.
target_text: 悉尼西北地区的警察指挥官，助理专员说，他很高兴俱乐部正在与警方积极合作。

source_text: "It is pleasing to see the club taking a proactive stance to ensure the games proceed with a strong police presence to provide increased safety" he said.
target_text: 他说：“很高兴看到俱乐部采取积极主动的姿态，以强大的警力存在提高安全性以确保比赛继续”。

source_text: Assistant Commissioner Clifford warned that police would not be specifically targeting Bulldogs supporters, but anyone who is causing trouble at games.
target_text: 助理专员克利福德警告说，警方不会特别针对斗牛犬的支持者，而是针对任何在比赛中制造麻烦的人。

source_text: "It is hoped this initiative will stamp out violence at future Bulldogs matches."
target_text: “希望这项新举措能够在未来的斗牛犬比赛中消除暴力。”

source_text: "Police will be targeting anyone doing the wrong thing, regardless of which team they support."he said.
target_text: “警方将针对任何做错事的人，不管他们支持哪支球队。”他说。

source_text: Ferrari driver Michael Schumacher and his teammate Felipe Massa won the front row on the FIA Formula-1 United States Grand Prix on the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
target_text: 法拉利车手迈克尔·舒马赫和他的队友费利佩·马萨在印第安纳波利斯汽车赛道上赢得了FIA一级方程式美国大奖赛的冠军。

source_text: Rubens Barrichello, Honda driver, wedged between the Renault cars on the starting grid and oust Fernando Alonso to the fifth place.
target_text: 本田车手鲁本斯·巴里切罗在起跑线上挤在雷诺汽车之间，将费尔南多·阿隆索排到第五位。

source_text: A very successful qualification for the only American driver Scott Speed, showed thirteenth result and for both MF1-Toyota team drivers, Christijan Albers and Tiago Monteiro, right after Speed.
target_text: 唯一的美国车手斯科特·斯皮德取得了非常成功的资格赛成绩，获得了第13名的好成绩，MF1-丰田车队的克里斯蒂安·阿尔伯斯和蒂亚戈·蒙泰罗紧随其后。

source_text: The United Nations World Health Organization (WHO) stated that the H1N1 virus, more commonly known as swine flu, has become the dominant flu strain in the world.
target_text: 联合国世界卫生组织（WHO）表示，H1N1病毒，通常被称为猪流感，已成为世界上主要的流感病毒株。

source_text: In a briefing with reporters Thursday, WHO Special Pandemic Influenza Advisor Keiji Fukuda said the virus has been particularly active in the Northern Hemisphere in recent months.
target_text: 世界卫生组织特别流感顾问福田敬二星期四在记者会上说，最近几个月来，这种病毒在北半球特别活跃。

source_text: He added that he expects the trend to continue through the winter months, with more severe cases and even deaths.
target_text: 他补充说，他预计这一趋势将持续整个冬季，出现更严重的病例，甚至死亡。

source_text: Fukuda said the vaccine currently in use in some 20 countries around the world remains effective and safe, and that no rare or dangerous side effects have been reported.
target_text: 福田敬二说，目前在世界上大约20个国家使用的疫苗仍然有效和安全，而且没有报导有罕见或危险的副作用。

source_text: "But even in that part of the world, the pandemic virus is becoming dominant," Fukuda commented.
target_text: 福田敬二评论说：“但是，即使在世界的那个地区，大流行病毒也正在占据主导地位。”

source_text: He noted that it was difficult to predict the activity of the virus.
target_text: 他指出，很难预测这种病毒的活性。

source_text: The H1N1 virus differs from the normal seasonal flu in that it has persisted during the summer months and affected relatively healthy people under the age of 65.
target_text: H1N1病毒与正常的季节性流感不同，因为它在夏季持续存在，并影响了相对健康的65岁以下人群。

source_text: The WHO says most people recover without hospitalization, although Fuduka pointed out that people with severe health complications and pregnant women were most at risk.
target_text: 世界卫生组织说，大多数人不需要住院就能康复，不过福田敬二指出，有严重健康并发症的人和孕妇的风险最大。

source_text: As of October 25, 2009, the WHO says there have been more than 440,000 laboratory confirmed cases of H1N1 influenza and more than 5,700 deaths reported to the UN agency.
target_text: 截至2009年10月25日，世界卫生组织称，已有超过440,000例实验室确诊的甲型H1N1流感病例，并向联合国机构报告的死亡人数超过5,700例。

source_text: In the United Kingdom, the music video for this Christmas' remake of the charity single Do They Know It's Christmas? was launched simultaneously today (Thursday) on several UK and Irish television channels including BBC One, BBC Two, RTE 1, ITV1, Channel 4, and Sky One.
target_text: 在英国，为圣诞节的慈善单曲翻拍的音乐视频“他们知道今天是圣诞节吗？”今天（星期四）在英国和爱尔兰的几个电视频道同时推出，包括BBC 1、BBC 2、RTE 1、ITV1、频道4和Sky 1。

source_text: The song was originally recorded in 1984 by several of the biggest artists of the time including Bono, Bob Geldof, Paul McCartney and George Michael.
target_text: 这首歌最初是在1984年由几个当时最伟大的艺术家录制的，其中包括波诺、鲍勃·盖尔多夫、保罗·麦卡特尼和乔治·迈克尔。

source_text: This year, in celebration of 20 years since the first single, the song has been remade by over 50 of today's best selling artists, including Coldplay frontman Chris Martin, Robbie Williams, Bono, Justin Hawkins of The Darkness and Dido.
target_text: 今年，为了庆祝第一首单曲问世20年，这首歌已经被50多位当今最畅销的艺术家重拍，其中包括酷玩乐队主唱克里斯·马丁、罗比·威廉姆斯、博诺、贾斯汀·霍金斯和迪多。

source_text: The song, which is in aid of charity, is already tipped to be the Christmas No. 1 in the UK and Ireland.
target_text: 这首歌是为慈善事业捐款的，已经被认为是英国和爱尔兰的圣诞歌曲冠军。

source_text: The song will also be launched as a charity mobile phone ringtone to raise funds for Sudan's troubled Darfur region.
target_text: 这首歌也将作为慈善手机铃声推出，为苏丹陷入困境的达尔富尔地区筹集资金。

source_text: The single will be available to buy in shops from the 29 November.
target_text: 这首单曲将于11月29日起在商店发售。

source_text: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that a British soldier has been killed in southern Afghanistan during a joint operation with Canadian-led NATO troops.
target_text: 国防部证实，在与加拿大领导的北约部队的联合行动中，一名英国士兵在阿富汗南部被杀。

source_text: It is with regret that we can confirm that a member of the UK Armed Forces has been killed in action this afternoon during ongoing operations against insurgent positions in Helmand Province, Southern Afghanistan, said an MOD statement.
target_text: 一份国防部发言人说，遗憾的是，我们可以确认英国武装部队成员今天下午在对阿富汗南部赫尔曼德省叛乱阵地的持续行动中遇害。

source_text: According to a spokesman for the International Security Assistance Force, a NATO peacekeeping organisation, troops came under fire after a successful operation.
target_text: 据北约维和组织国际安全援助部队的一位发言人表示，部队在一次成功的行动后遭到了攻击。

source_text: The soldier’s details have not been released as next of kin have not yet been told.
target_text: 士兵的详细信息尚未公布，因为尚未告知亲属。

source_text: In the past two months, ten British soldiers have been killed in Afghanistan.
target_text: 在过去的两个月里，有十名英国士兵在阿富汗遇难。

source_text: The Sunday Telegraph today quoted commandos as saying British troops in Afghanistan are on "the brink of exhaustion".
target_text: 《星期日电讯报》今天援引突击队员的话说，英国驻阿富汗部队正处于“精疲力竭的边缘”。

source_text: Pakistani armed forces say they have captured the town of Kotkai on Saturday, the hometown of Taliban Chief Hakimullah Mehsud and one of his top officers, Qari Hussain.
target_text: 巴基斯坦武装部队说，他们星期六占领了塔利班首领哈基穆拉·马苏德和他的一名高级官员卡里·侯赛因的家乡科特凯。

source_text: The operation began the previous Saturday when Pakistani forces approached from three separate areas of South Waziristan.
target_text: 上周六，当巴基斯坦军队从南瓦济里斯坦的三个不同地区接近时，该行动开始了。

source_text: Pakistan plans to trap Taliban within the area while approaching the towns of Makeen and Ladha, both of which are major Taliban strongholds.
target_text: 巴基斯坦计划在接近梅肯和拉德哈城镇时将塔利班困在该地区，这两个城镇都是塔利班的主要据点。

source_text: Major General Athar Abbas, the chief spokesman for the military, said at a news briefing that "we have complete control of Kotkai, a stronghold of the terrorists, where most of the houses had been converted into strong bunkers."
target_text: 军方首席发言人阿塔尔·阿巴斯少将在新闻发布会上表示，“我们完全控制了恐怖分子据点的科特凯，大部分房屋都被改建成了强大的掩体。”

source_text: So far, Pakistani officials have reported that 163 militants have been killed, while the military sustained 23 casualties.
target_text: 到目前为止，巴基斯坦官员报告说已有163名武装分子丧生，而军方则造成23人伤亡。

source_text: The entire area has been closed off, but there have been recent acts of violence which have officials worried.
target_text: 整个地区已被关闭，但最近发生的暴力事件令官员们感到担忧。

source_text: In recent weeks, Pakistan has seen attacks on police centers, military headquarters and a UN building.
target_text: 最近几周，巴基斯坦发生了对警察中心、军事总部和联合国大楼的攻击。

source_text: There have also been five attacks on an Islamic university in Islamabad, the capital.
target_text: 在首都伊斯兰堡的一所伊斯兰大学也发生了五起袭击事件。

source_text: It has been reported that over 21,000 civilian families, an estimated 153,000 individuals, have fled South Waziristan, and have taken refuge in the North-West Frontier Province.
target_text: 据报道，有21,000多个平民家庭，估计有153,000人逃离南瓦济里斯坦，并在西北边境省避难。

source_text: At least one fisherman has died and 134 others were rescued on Lake Erie off the shores of Ohio after an eight mile wide piece of ice broke off the frozen lake's ice shelf and began to drift.
target_text: 在俄亥俄州伊利湖，一块8英里宽的冰从冰架上脱落并开始漂移，造成至少一名渔民死亡，134人获救。

source_text: The United States Coast Guard says the unidentified man who died fell into the water while trying to find a way off the ice.
target_text: 美国海岸警卫队表示，这名身份不明的男子在试图找到离开冰面的方法时坠入水中。

source_text: Rescuers were able to get him out of the water, but he died while being flown to a nearby hospital for treatment.
target_text: 救援人员将他从水中救出，但他在被送往附近医院接受治疗时死亡。

source_text: The Coast Guard also said that the fishermen were warned that the ice could break, but many didn't believe there was any danger.
target_text: 海岸警卫队还表示，渔民们被警告说冰层可能会破裂，但许多人认为不会有任何危险。

source_text: Before heading onto the already broken ice, they made a makeshift bridge from wooden pallets to get to and from the shore, but the ice shifted and the bridge was destroyed.
target_text: 在进入已经破碎的冰面之前，他们用木制托盘搭建了一座临时的桥，用来往返于海岸，但是冰面移动了，桥被毁了。

source_text: It left all 135 people stranded more than 1,000 yards from the shoreline.
target_text: 135人全部被困在距海岸线1000多码的地方。

source_text: The combination of both high winds and temperatures, broke the thick ice into dozens of large pieces.
target_text: 大风和高温的共同作用，使厚厚的冰层断裂成了几十块大冰块。

source_text: Ottawa County sheriff Bob Bratton called those who avoided the warnings "idiotic".
target_text: 渥太华县治安官鲍勃·布拉顿称那些逃避警告的人是“白痴”。

source_text: "I don't know how else to put it," stated Bratton.
target_text: “我不知道怎么说，”布拉顿说。

source_text: Lake Erie is the fourth largest lake of the five Great Lakes in the U.S., but the smallest by volume, and the tenth largest fresh water lake in the world.
target_text: 伊利湖是美国五大湖中第四大湖，但体积最小，是世界上第十大淡水湖。

source_text: Several helicopters were called in from Detroit, Michigan and Traverse City.
target_text: 有几架费及从底特律、密歇根和特拉弗斯城召集至此。

source_text: The body’s immune system is less effective at quashing disease than it could be - but if it were better the immune system might do more harm than good, according to new research by Michael Deem and colleagues of Rice University in Houston.
target_text: 休斯顿莱斯大学的迈克尔•福斯特和同事们的最新研究表明，人体的免疫系统在对抗疾病方面的效果不如想象的那么好，但如果免疫系统更好的话，可能弊大于利。

source_text: The model also bolsters controversial suggestions that chronic infections could lead the immune system awry, ultimately resulting in rheumatoid arthritis or other autoimmune ailments.
target_text: 该模型还支持了一些有争议的观点，即慢性感染可能导致免疫系统出错，最终导致类风湿关节炎或其他自身免疫性疾病。

source_text: The study will be detailed in a forthcoming issue of the journal Physical Review Letters.
target_text: 该研究将在即将出版的“物理评论快报”杂志上详述。

source_text: The process of reconciliation and unifying the Democratic party started at the ballroom of the Mayflower hotel in Washington, DC with presumptive Democratic presidential nominee Barack Obama and his wife both individually issuing a check amounting to $2,300 to the Hillary Clinton for President committee.
target_text: 民主党和解和团结的进程从华盛顿五月花酒店的宴会厅开始，民主党总统候选人巴拉克·奥巴和他的夫人分别向希拉里·克林顿的总统竞选委员会开出了总额为2300美元的支票。

source_text: New York Senator and former First Lady Hillary Rodham Clinton introduced to her fund contributors Illinois Senator Barack Obama as the first step of unifying the two sides who quite recently bitterly fought over winning the Democratic party's nomination.
target_text: 纽约州参议员和前第一夫人希拉里·罗德姆·克林顿向她的基金捐款人伊利诺伊州参议员巴拉克·奥巴马介绍说，这是统一双方的第一步，两党最近为赢得民主党提名而进行了激烈的斗争。

source_text: Hillary Clinton appealed to her supporters to help Barack Obama and pledged that she will personally help in defeating the presidential plans of Republican presumptive Presidential candidate, Arizona senator John McCain.
target_text: 希拉里·克林顿呼吁她的支持者帮助巴拉克·奥巴马，并承诺她将亲自帮助挫败共和党总统候选人亚利桑那州参议员约翰·麦凯恩的总统计划。

source_text: Mrs. Clinton asked for nothing in exchange for her support of Obama, but Obama instead countered with a gesture of contributing to Mrs. Clinton campaign that is now burdened by debt.
target_text: 克林顿夫人没有要求任何东西来换取她对奥巴马的支持，但奥巴马做出了反击，做出了一个为克林顿夫人的竞选活动捐款的姿态。目前克林顿夫人的竞选活动背负着沉重的债务。

source_text: Obama signaled his own contributors to help Clinton pay off the debt incurred by her campaign.
target_text: 奥巴马向他自己的捐款人发出信号，要他们帮助克林顿偿还竞选期间欠下的债务。

source_text: The United Kingdom's flag carrier airline, British Airways (BA) has warned the markets that it will post a full year loss of up to £150 million.
target_text: 英国旗舰航空公司英国航空公司（BA）曾向市场发出警告称，它将全年亏损高达1.5亿英镑。

source_text: The former state airline, privatised in 1987, saw its shares fall 8.5% on the back of an announcement that "further economic weakness in January and the outlook for February and March combined with the fall in sterling are impacting our outlook for the year", according to The Daily Telegraph.
target_text: 据“每日电讯报”报道，1987年私有化的前国有航空公司股价下跌8.5％，原因是“1月份经济进一步疲软，2月和3月前景加上英镑下跌影响了我们对今年的展望”。

source_text: Quarterly revenues are still anticipated to grow by 4%, but a full-year loss is now expected.
target_text: 季度营收预计仍将增长百分之4，但现在预计全年将出现亏损。

source_text: Costs have risen in recent months, whilst the historic lows of sterling have hit the bottom line.
target_text: 近几个月来，成本有所上升，而英镑的历史低点已经触及底线。

source_text: First and Business Class traffic has fallen as the global credit crisis has hit premium and business travel.
target_text: 由于全球信贷危机打击了高端和商务旅行，头等舱和商务舱的客流量有所下降。

source_text: Fuel costs have fallen, but previous hedging has negated this benefit.
target_text: 燃料成本已经下降，但之前的对冲已经抵消了这一好处。

source_text: The airline sector in general is facing trouble, with American and United posting fourth quarter losses and the Franco-Dutch Air France-KLM issuing a profits warning.
target_text: 航空业普遍面临困境，美国和联合航空公司公布第四季度亏损，法荷航空公司发布盈利警告。

source_text: According to an original Reuters report, Venezuela's President Hugo Chavez is moving his Bolivarian Revolution forward by nationalizing more private companies and clamping down against his opponents.
target_text: 根据路透社的一份原始报道，委内瑞拉总统乌戈·查韦斯正在推动他的玻利瓦尔革命向前推进，将更多的私营公司收归国有，并打击对手。

source_text: Some oil service companies were nationalized earlier this month along with other sectors like banking, cement and steel.
target_text: 本月早些时候，一些石油服务公司与银行，水泥和钢铁等其他行业被实施了国有化。

source_text: Cited by Reuters, Chavez said on Saturday "We are proceeding and will continue to proceed with nationalizations of strategic sectors."
target_text: 查韦斯周六援引路透社的话说，“我们正在进行并将继续推进战略部门的国有化。”

source_text: According to The Financial Post, expropriation of oil service companies follows their dispute with Petróleos de Venezuela (PDVSA), the State-owned oil company.
target_text: 据英国《金融邮报》报道，石油服务公司的征用是在与国有石油公司委内瑞拉石油公司（PDVSA）发生纠纷之后发生的。

source_text: Past election victories since 1997 have strengthened Chavez's control and popularity (with more than 60% approval rating).
target_text: 自1997年以来的过去选举胜利加强了查韦斯的控制和受欢迎程度（超过60％的支持率）。

source_text: He won a February referendum amending the constitution and letting him stay in power until he is not re-elected.
target_text: 他赢得了2月份修改宪法的公投，并让他继续执政，直到他不再当选为止。

source_text: But the financial crisis, especially the low oil prices for the last months, has crippled his social revolution.
target_text: 但金融危机，特别是过去几个月的低油价，已经削弱了他的社会革命。

source_text: During the last years, Chavez relied on high oil prices to push his social agenda.
target_text: 在过去的几年里，查韦斯依靠高油价来推动他的社会议程。

source_text: With the shortening of cash, Chavez cannot use oil revenues anymore to finance his budget.
target_text: 随着现金的缩短，查韦斯不再使用石油收入来为他的预算提供资金。

source_text: This wave of expropriation and the conflicts with oil service companies seems to reflect a desperate move to tackle the crisis, despite Chavez's words that the country is "well-equipped to weather the global recession."
target_text: 这波征用浪潮以及与石油服务公司之间的冲突，似乎反映了委内瑞拉为应对危机而采取的绝望行动，尽管查韦斯曾表示，委内瑞拉“完全有能力应对全球经济衰退”。

source_text: A boxer is missing in Westmoreland County, Pennsylvania, after it chased off a bear to protect three children.
target_text: 宾夕法尼亚州威斯特摩兰县一只拳师犬为了保护三个孩子赶走了一只熊后失踪。

source_text: According to Bill Rusko, the father of two of the children, the bear crossed Route 30 in Ligonier Township and moved towards the three kids as they played badminton.
target_text: 据两个孩子的父亲比尔·拉斯科说，这只熊在利戈尼尔镇穿过了30号公路，在三个孩子打羽毛球的时候向他们走去。

source_text: The year-old dog, Major, then ran around the bear to distract it and bit it in the face.
target_text: 这只叫梅杰的一岁大的狗围着熊跑，想分散它的注意力，还咬了它的脸。

source_text: As the bear ran back into the woods, the dog chased it.
target_text: 当熊跑回树林时，狗追了上去。

source_text: It remains missing; however, neighbors say they saw it in the area.
target_text: 它仍然下落不明，但是邻居们说他们在该地区看到了它。

source_text: Australian Prime Minister John Howard has announced that leaders of APEC nations have agreed on "aspirational goals" on climate change.
target_text: 澳大利亚总理霍华德宣布，亚太经合组织各国领导人已就气候变化达成“理想目标”。

source_text: The agreement, which Prime Minister Howard calls the Sydney declaration focuses on reducing energy intensity (the amount of energy used to produce a dollar of gross domestic product), reforestation and technology sharing.
target_text: 该协议由霍华德总理称之为悉尼宣言，重点是降低能源强度（用于生产一美元国内生产总值的能源数量）、重新造林和技术共享。

source_text: Despite Australia, the United States and China being non-signatories to the United Nations' Kyoto protocol on greenhouse gas reductions which is set to expire in 2012, the APEC accord calls for "We call for a post-2012 international climate change arrangement ... that strengthens, broadens and deepens the current arrangement and leads to reduced global emissions of greenhouse gases," according to the draft declaration.
target_text: 根据宣言草案，尽管澳大利亚、美国和中国不是联合国温室气体减排京都议定书的签署国，该议定书将于2012年到期，但亚太经合组织协议呼吁“我们呼吁作出2012年后的国际气候变化安排……这将加强、扩大和深化当前的安排，并导致全球温室气体排放量减少”。

source_text: The declaration as agreed upon will be released on Sunday.
target_text: 商定的声明将于周日公布。

source_text: The draft agreement recognised that action was required to "slow, stop and reverse" greenhouse gas emissions; that nations should vow to reduce energy intensity by 25 percent by 2030; that forest cover in the region should be increased by 50 million acres by 2020; and that APEC nations will work with other nations to find a solution to climate change.
target_text: 协议草案承认，必须采取行动“减缓、制止和扭转”温室气体排放，各国应承诺到2030年将能源强度降低百分之25，到2020年，该地区的森林覆盖面积应增加5000万英亩，亚太经合组织国家将与其他国家合作，寻找解决气候变化的办法。

source_text: The declaration is non-binding and is simply a statement of goals to which the nations will try to achieve.
target_text: 该声明不具有约束力，只是各国将努力实现的目标声明。

source_text: Host nation Australia has been criticised by China, Indonesia, Japan and Malaysia for putting climate change on the agenda at the APEC summit, saying they would prefer dialogue on climate change to occur under a United Nationa framework.
target_text: 东道国澳大利亚因将气候变化列入亚太经合组织峰会议程而受到中国、印度尼西亚、日本和马来西亚的批评，称它们更愿意在联合国框架下进行气候变化对话。

source_text: Indonesia's Foreign Minister Hassan Wirayuda said "the APEC meeting does not replace the appropriate forum to deal with climate change."
target_text: 印度尼西亚外交部长哈桑·维拉尤达说：“亚太经合组织会议并没有取代应对气候变化的适当论坛。”

source_text: Mr Wiraydua said that despite Indonesia not being entirely satisfied with the declaration they would "live with it".
target_text: 维雷杜亚先生说，尽管印度尼西亚对这一声明并不完全满意，但他们会“接受它”。

source_text: Environmental group Greenpeace has rejected the APEC statement because it doesn't set firm targets and includes the use of nuclear energy as a replacement for fossil fuels.
target_text: 环保组织绿色和平组织拒绝接受APEC声明，因为它没有设定坚定的目标，包括使用核能作为化石燃料的替代品。

source_text: Mehsud was reportedly killed on August 5, 2009, during a U.S. drone attack on South Waziristan; however, Hakimullah Mehsud, who was recently chosen as Baitullah's successor, and Wali-ur-Rehman told the BBC that Mehsud had died on Sunday, August 23, 2009 of injuries sustained on August 5.
target_text: 据报道，马哈苏德于2009年8月5日在美国对南瓦济里斯坦的一次无人机袭击中丧生；然而，最近被选为巴图拉继任者的哈基穆拉·马哈苏德和瓦利·乌尔·雷赫曼告诉BBC，马哈苏德于2009年8月23日星期日因8月5日受伤而死亡。

source_text: Pakistani Interior Minister Rehman Malik delayed giving official confirmation and asked for patience and an announcement by ISPR or other agencies.
target_text: 巴基斯坦内政部长雷赫曼·马利克推迟了官方确认，并要求耐心等待ISPR或其他机构的宣布。

source_text: Major General Athar Abbas, ISPR spokesman, and Robert Gibbs of the White House had said that his death could not be confirmed although U.S. National Security Adviser James L. Jones had claimed that there was "pretty conclusive" evidence that proved Baitullah Mehsud had been killed and that he was 90% sure of it.
target_text: ISPR发言人阿塔尔·阿巴斯少将和白宫的罗伯特·吉布斯说，虽然美国国家安全顾问詹姆斯·L·琼斯声称有“相当确凿的”证据证明，巴图拉·马苏德已经被杀，而且他对此事有百分之90的把握，但他的死还不能确定。

source_text: Pakistan blamed him for numerous attacks including the assassination in 2007 of Benazir Bhutto, the former Prime Minister of Pakistan and wife of President Asif Ali Zardari, according to Bloomberg News.
target_text: 据彭博社报道，巴基斯坦指责他发动了多次袭击，包括2007年巴基斯坦前总理、总统扎尔达里的妻子贝纳齐尔·布托遇刺事件。

source_text: The U.S. offered a US$5 million bounty for his capture.
target_text: 美国为抓捕他提供了500万美元的赏金。

source_text: According to the BBC, Pakistan had been unable to provide tangible evidence of his death because of the "remote and hostile terrain" of South Waziristan.
target_text: 据英国广播公司报道，由于南瓦济里斯坦的“偏远和敌对地形”，巴基斯坦无法提供他死亡的实际证据。

source_text: A court in Salé sentenced fourteen members of Fath Al Andalous (Conquest of Andalusia) to jail yesterday for planning attacks against targets in Morocco.
target_text: 萨尔的一家法院昨天判处十四名安达卢斯法塔（征服安达卢西亚）的成员入狱，罪名是策划在摩洛哥袭击目标。

source_text: The radical group reportedly associates itself with expulsion of Muslims from the Andalusia region of Spain during the fifteenth century.
target_text: 据报道，这个激进组织与15世纪将穆斯林驱逐出西班牙安达卢西亚地区有关。

source_text: According to state agency Maghreb Arab Press (MAP), the court sentenced leader Rachid Zerbani to fifteen years in prison and fined him 500,000 dirhams (€44,175), and the remaining thirteen to four to ten years for "setting up a criminal gang to plot and carry out terror acts aimed at disturbing public order through intimidation and violence, financing terrorism, manufacturing and possessing explosives, undermining the sacred values, and holding unauthorized public meetings."
target_text: 根据阿拉伯国家机构阿拉伯马格里布新闻社（MAP），法院判处领导人拉希德·泽巴尼15年监禁，并罚款50万迪拉姆（44175欧元），余下的13人判处4到10年，罪名是“成立犯罪团伙，策划和实施旨在通过恐吓和暴力、资助恐怖主义、制造和持有爆炸物、破坏神圣价值、未经授权举行公开会议来扰乱公共秩序的恐怖行为。”

source_text: The group, which according to MAP had links with similar organisations in Algeria, Mauritania, France, Spain, and countries in the Middle East, had plotted to attack tourist locations in Agadir as well as a military barracks in Laayoune, the principal city in the Western Sahara region.
target_text: 根据MAP，该组织与阿尔及利亚、毛里塔尼亚、法国、西班牙和中东国家的类似组织有联系，曾密谋袭击阿加迪尔的旅游景点，以及西撒哈拉地区主要城市欧云的一个军营。

source_text: Since the 2003 Casablanca bombings, in which 45 people died, the country has broken up over sixty similar groups, with more than 2,000 tried and jailed.
target_text: 自2003年造成45人死亡的卡萨布兰卡爆炸案以来，这个国家已经瓦解了60多个类似的组织，其中有2000多人被审判和监禁。

source_text: The Brazilian president Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva is due to meet the French President Nicholas Sarkozy later today.
target_text: 巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦将于今天晚些时候会见法国总统尼古拉·萨科齐。

source_text: Lula da Silva is due to meet with Sarkozy in French Guiana.
target_text: 卢拉·达席尔瓦将在法属圭亚那与萨科齐会面。

source_text: In addition, subjects such as biofuels, nuclear science and defence are expected to be discussed in the meeting.
target_text: 此外，预计会议将讨论生物燃料，核科学和国防等主题。

source_text: After the meeting, at the headquarters of the local Lula and Sarkozy will present the design for a road bridge that is planned to be built over the river Oiapoque, linking the Brazil to French Guiana.
target_text: 会议结束后，卢拉和萨科齐将在当地的卢拉总部介绍计划在瓦阿皮克河上修建的一座公路桥的设计，这座桥将巴西和法属圭亚那连接起来。

source_text: Initial forecasts are suggesting that the bridge, will be about 400 meters long, and will cost approximately US$38.6 million.
target_text: 初步预测显示该桥长约400米，耗资约3860万美元。

source_text: The cost of the project is planned to be divided equally between Brazil and France.
target_text: 该项目的成本计划在巴西和法国之间平均分配。

source_text: The agreement was approved by the Brazilian government in November 2007 and was approved by the French Parliament in March 2007.
target_text: 该协议于2007年11月获得巴西政府批准，并于2007年3月获得法国议会批准。

source_text: Glen Stollery is a New Zealand website developer who created the site ScienTOMogy.info in mid 2005.
target_text: 格伦·托莱利是新西兰的一个网站开发人员，他在2005年年中创建了网站scientomogy.info。

source_text: The site, which is a parody of Tom Cruise and his involvement with the Church of Scientology, became the centre of controversy when it was served with a number of cease and desist orders initiated by the Church.
target_text: 这个网站模仿了汤姆·克鲁斯和他与山达基教会的关系，当它收到教会发出的一系列中止和停止命令时，成为争议的中心。

source_text: The release suggested that YouTube had taken this action under external pressure from Cruise or Viacom.
target_text: 这一消息表明，YouTube是在克鲁斯或维亚康姆的外部压力下采取这一行动的。

source_text: Responding to a query by Wikinews reporters, YouTube stated "We have not received a DMCA notification letter from Viacom."
target_text: 针对维基新闻记者的询问，YouTube表示“我们尚未收到维亚康姆的DMCA通知函。”

source_text: The Church of Scientology was offered the opportunity to respond to the claims made by Stollery during the interview.
target_text: 山达基教会有机会回应斯托勒里在采访中提出的指控。

source_text: This exclusive interview deals with these issues and others relating to the website.
target_text: 此独家专访涉及这些问题以及与网站相关的其他问题。

source_text: According to al-Qaeda, Osama bin Laden will release yet another video which is said to contain a will and testament from one of the September 11, 2001 hijackers, Abu Musab Waleed al-Shehri.
target_text: 据基地组织称，奥萨马·本·拉登将发布另一段视频，据说其中包含2001年9月11日劫机者之一阿布·穆萨布·瓦利德·赛赫里的遗嘱。

source_text: The second tape was reportedly recorded from the same spot as the video that was released last week.
target_text: 据报道，第二盘录像带是在与上周发布的视频的同一地点录制的。

source_text: "Coming soon, God willing, from the testaments of the martyrs of the New York and Washington attacks: The testament of the martyr Abu Musab Waleed al-Shehri, presented by Sheik Osama bin Laden, God preserve him," said a banner that was posted by As-Sahab on an extremist website which is frequented by al-Qaeda and other extremists.
target_text: “很快，上帝保佑，来自纽约和华盛顿袭击的殉道者的遗嘱：谢赫·奥萨马·本·拉登为烈士阿布·穆萨布·瓦利德·赛赫里立的遗嘱，愿上帝保佑他”，基地组织和其他极端分子经常光顾的一个极端主义网站上贴着一条横幅，上面写着萨哈布的名字。

source_text: According to the United States based terrorist monitoring group, IntelCenter, the video will be released within the next 24 hours, but it is not known if bin Laden will actually appear in the video, or if an audio recording of his voice will just be present.
target_text: 据总部设在美国的恐怖分子监控组织国际中心称，这段视频将在未来24小时内发布，但目前还不清楚本拉登是否真的会出现在视频中，或者他的声音的录音是否会出现。

source_text: Some reports suggest that the video will feature new images of bin Laden.
target_text: 一些报道称，这段视频将以本拉登的新形象为特色。

source_text: Bin Laden appeared for the first time in a video since 2004 when he released a video on September 7, 2007.
target_text: 自2004年9月7日发布视频以来，本拉登首次出现在视频中。

source_text: Nuclearelectrica considers the security of the plant, as well as of its employees and the environment, to be of utmost importance.
target_text: 核子公司认为工厂的安全、员工的安全以及环境的安全是最重要的。

source_text: In the future, the nuclear plant is expected to produce a significant amount of the electrical energy of southeastern Europe.
target_text: 在未来，这座核电站预计将生产出欧洲东南部相当数量的电能。

source_text: There were 8 games played in the National Hockey League on February 14, 2008, including the #2 Dallas Stars taking on the Phoenix Coyotes, and the Minnesota Wild and Vancouver Canucks fighting for playoff contention in the Northwest division.
target_text: 2008年2月14日，国家曲棍球联盟共有8场比赛，其中包括達拉斯星迎战凤凰郊狼队的2场比赛，明尼苏达野战队和温哥华野战队在西北区争夺季后赛冠军的争夺战。

source_text: About 100 people protested the detention and treatment of 13 men accused of terrorism offences and held at the Barwon maximum security prison, in the state of Victoria, Australia.
target_text: 大约100人抗议对13名被控犯有恐怖主义罪行的男子的拘留和待遇，他们被关押在澳大利亚维多利亚州巴旺最高安全监狱。

source_text: The protestors bussed and drove 56km from Melbourne out to the Barwon maximum security prison to voice their disapproval of the treatment of the 13 men accused of terror offences who are currently being held in the Acacia Unit of the prison.
target_text: 抗议者从墨尔本驱车56公里前往巴旺最高安全监狱，表达他们对目前被关押在该监狱阿卡恰单位的13名被控犯有恐怖主义罪行的男子所受到的待遇的不满。

source_text: Some of the accused have been held in solitary confinement for 6 months up to and during their trial.
target_text: 有些被告在审判前和审判期间被单独监禁6个月。

source_text: The group Civil Rights Defence organised the event with family members of the accused and news reporters as a peaceful protest.
target_text: 民权维护组织与被告家属和新闻记者一起组织了这次活动，作为和平抗议活动。

source_text: A small group of about 15 police officers awaited the arrival of the group.
target_text: 大约15名警察组成的小团体等待着这群人的到来。

source_text: The police said that their main concern was the health and safety of everyone as the protest was being held next to a busy road.
target_text: 警方表示，他们主要担心的是每个人的健康和安全，因为抗议活动正在繁忙的道路旁举行。

source_text: Officers only approached when the Country Fire Authority was summoned by a passerby to put out an open camp fire, as there was fire restriction in effect in the area.
target_text: 只有当一名过路人召唤国家消防局扑灭一场露天营火时，警察才会走近，因为该地区实际上有火灾限制。

source_text: The fire fighters were met with laughter and sarcastic applause.
target_text: 消防员遭到了笑声和讽刺的掌声。

source_text: In a statement read at the protest, one of the accused and his wife (Eman Abdou and Shane Kent) said they were upset at the Australian media for participating in lying to the Australian public and the government for the way they have treated the accused.
target_text: 在抗议活动中宣读的一份声明中，一名被告和他的妻子（埃曼·阿布杜和肖恩·肯特）说：他们对澳大利亚媒体参与向澳大利亚公众和政府撒谎，以及对政府对待被告的方式感到不满。

source_text: "I believe the conditions out at the Barwon Prison Acacua Unit are oppressive and inhumane."
target_text: “我认为，巴旺监狱阿卡瓜监狱的条件是压迫和不人道的。”

source_text: "These men have a right to a fair trial, and everyone is innocent until proven guilty," the statement read.
target_text: 声明说：“这些人有权获得公正的审判，在证明有罪之前，每个人都是无辜的。”

source_text: The statement also went on say that the limited legal visits were often shortened and that the best treated accused are in solitary confinement for 18 hours a day while some are in solitary confinement consistently.
target_text: 该声明还说，有限的法律访问往往缩短，待遇最好的被告每天被单独监禁18个小时，而有些则一直处于单独监禁状态。

source_text: Omar Mehri, the brother of one of the accused spoke at the day's event and talked about verbal harassment and hate mail he and his family have received.
target_text: 其中一名被告的兄弟奥马尔·迈赫里在当天的活动上发表了讲话，谈到了他和家人收到的口头骚扰和仇恨邮件。

source_text: He also talked of his brother being amazed to see grass after 5 months.
target_text: 他还谈到他的兄弟在5个月后看到草而感到惊讶。

source_text: Speakers at the event said the current laws used to prosecute murderers and other criminals should be used to prosecute terrorist suspects and had the same sentiments as Eman Abdou and Shane Kent.
target_text: 活动发言者说，目前用于起诉杀人犯和其他犯罪分子的法律应用于起诉恐怖分子嫌疑人，并与埃曼·阿布杜和肖恩·肯特有相同的看法。

source_text: They said the laws were unjust and the treatment of the accused was cruel and unusual, constituting torture under the terms of the UN charter.
target_text: 他们说这些法律是不公正的，被告的待遇是残忍和不寻常的，根据联合国宪章的规定构成酷刑。

source_text: Omar Merhi, brother of one of the detained said in a statement "My brother and the other arrested men are confused and want to know why they are in Australia's highest security unit for simply practising their religion."
target_text: 其中一名被拘留者的弟弟奥马尔·默希在一份声明中表示，“我的弟弟和其他被捕男子感到困惑，他们想知道，为什么他们只是因为信仰宗教而被关在澳大利亚最高安全部门。”

source_text: A televised debate between Australia's candidates for Prime Minister in the upcoming election has been rescheduled and shortened — to avoid a clash with popular cookery show MasterChef.
target_text: 澳大利亚总理候选人在即将到来的选举中进行的电视辩论被重新安排和缩短了时间，以避免与流行的烹饪节目《主厨》发生冲突。

source_text: The pre-election debate traditionally lasts 90 minutes and occurs at 1930 on the first Sunday of the campaign.
target_text: 选举前的辩论传统上持续90分钟，在竞选的第一个星期天举行，时间是19：30。

source_text: With the grand finale of the cooking competition already scheduled for that time, and expected to attract around four million viewers, the decision has been made to move the debate forward to 1830 and shorten it to 60 minutes.
target_text: 由于烹饪比赛的大结局已经安排在那个时间，预计将吸引大约400万观众，所以决定将辩论时间提前到18：30，并缩短到60分钟。

source_text: When asked about MasterChef, Prime Minister Julia Gillard replied: "I can understand the fascination with cooking and eating, so I know many Australians will watch that show. "
target_text: 当被问及《主厨》时，澳大利亚总理吉拉德回答说：“我能理解烹饪和饮食的魅力，所以我知道很多澳大利亚人都会看这个节目。”

source_text: The debate between Gillard and her Liberal/National Coalition primary opponent Tony Abbott has already been the subject of controversy.
target_text: 吉拉德与她的自由党全国联盟主要对手托尼·阿博特之间的争论已成为争议的主题。

source_text: Former PM Kevin Rudd had committed to holding three debates before the election.
target_text: 前总理陆克文承诺在大选前举行三场辩论。

source_text: Australian Greens leader Bob Brown had also wished to be part of the debate, but joked that he probably had more chance of appearing on MasterChef.
target_text: 澳大利亚绿党领袖鲍勃·布朗也希望参加辩论，但他开玩笑说，他可能更有机会出现在《主厨》中。

source_text: According to the first exit polls published by TNS OBOP and PBS for TVP1 Polish public television station, the Law and Justice (PiS) party has won today's parliamentary election in Poland with a 27,6% result.
target_text: 根据TNS OBOP和PBS为TVP1波兰公共电视台发布的第一份出口民调，波兰法律与公正（PiS）党以百分之27.6的得票率赢得今天的议会选举。

source_text: Runners up were Citizens Platform (PO) with 24,1% and Alliance of the Democratic Left (SLD) with 11,3%.
target_text: 排名第二的是百分之24.1的公民平台（PO）和百分之11.3的民主左翼联盟（SLD）。

source_text: PO and PiS, both of which will form the future government, will have 304 places in the new Sejm, which is 3 less than is required for making changes to the Polish constitution, which both parties support.
target_text: PO和PIS将组成未来的政府，在新的经济特区将有304个席位，比双方支持的波兰宪法修改所需的席位少3个。

source_text: Insulin production has been discovered in the brain and linked to Alzheimer's disease, potentially changing how the illness is viewed and treated.
target_text: 大脑中已发现胰岛素产生并与阿尔茨海默病有关，可能改变该疾病的观察和治疗方式。

source_text: While insulin resistance, a characteristic of diabetes, is linked with neurodegeneration, the new finding provides a strong connection between diabetes and Alzheimer's disease.
target_text: 虽然胰岛素抵抗（糖尿病的特征）与神经变性有关，但新发现提供了糖尿病和阿尔茨海默病之间的紧密联系。

source_text: "What we found is that insulin is not just produced in the pancreas, but also in the brain," says study senior author Suzanne de la Monte of Rhode Island Hospital and Brown University Medical School.
target_text: “我们发现胰岛素不仅在胰腺中产生，也在大脑中产生，”该研究的资深作者、罗德岛医院和布朗大学医学院的苏珊娜·德拉蒙特说。

source_text: "And we discovered that insulin and its growth factors, which are necessary for the survival of brain cells, contribute to the progression of Alzheimer's."
target_text: “我们发现胰岛素及其生长因子是脑细胞存活所必需的，有助于阿尔茨海默氏症的进展。”

source_text: The finding was made by studying a genetic abnormality in rats that blocks insulin signaling in the brain.
target_text: 这项发现是通过研究大鼠大脑中阻断胰岛素信号的遗传异常而得出的。

source_text: These abnormalities do not correspond to type 1 or type 2 diabetes, but reflect a different and more complex disease process that originates in the CNS (central nervous system), the researchers report.
target_text: 研究人员报告说，这些异常与1型或2型糖尿病不相符，但反映了一种源于CNS（中枢神经系统）的不同且更复杂的疾病过程。

source_text: Analysis of postmortem brain tissue also revealed that the proteins aren't produced at normal levels in human Alzheimer's sufferers.
target_text: 死后脑组织的分析还显示，人类阿尔茨海默氏症患者的蛋白质不会以正常水平产生。

source_text: Insulin and IGF I were significantly reduced in the frontal cortex, hippocampus and hypothalamus—all areas affected by Alzheimer's—while not in the cerebellum, which is generally not affected by Alzheimer's.
target_text: 所有受阿尔茨海默病影响的区域的额叶皮质、海马体和下丘脑的胰岛素和胰岛素样生长因子I均显著降低，而小脑的胰岛素和胰岛素样生长因子I则没有明显降低，而小脑通常不受阿尔茨海默病影响。

source_text: The study "opens the way for targeted treatment to the brain and changes the way we view Alzheimer's disease," says de la Monte.
target_text: 这项研究“为大脑的靶向治疗开辟了道路，改变了我们看待阿尔茨海默病的方式，”德拉蒙特说。

source_text: Dozens of people have been killed as a result of flooding in Plateau State, located in the central part of Nigeria.
target_text: 由于位于尼日利亚中部的高原州发生洪水，造成数十人死亡。

source_text: The flooding occurred as the result of a large amount of rainfall close to Jos, a city in the north of the state, causing overflow of a dam.
target_text: 洪水发生的原因是靠近乔斯（该州北部城市）的大量降雨，导致大坝溢出。

source_text: The Red Cross has reported the recovery of 35 corpses, while BBC News Online has placed the death toll at a minimum of 39.
target_text: 红十字会报告说，35具尸体已被发现，而英国广播公司新闻网则将死亡人数定在最低39人。

source_text: A spokesperson for the Red Cross said approximately two hundred houses had been sunk or wrecked.
target_text: 红十字会的发言人说，大约有两百所房屋被淹没或毁坏。

source_text: A significant number of the affected houses had been built of mud.
target_text: 大量受影响的房屋都是用泥土建造的。

source_text: Manasie Phampe, leader of the Red Cross of the state, explained: "Rainwater and water from the Lamingo dam which overflowed swept across several neighbourhoods in the city".
target_text: 该州红十字会主席马纳西·哈姆普解释说：“雨水和拉明戈大坝溢出的水席卷了该市的几个街区。”

source_text: The death toll is anticipated to increase by authorities, with 35 reported missing.
target_text: 当局预计死亡人数将增加，有35人失踪。

source_text: "We are still searching for more bodies as many people have been declared missing," Phampe added.
target_text: “我们仍在寻找更多的尸体，因为许多人已经被宣布失踪，”范佩补充说。

source_text: Seventeen were Indian and a further 13 of the dead are British; people of another six nationalities are also known to have died.
target_text: 17人是印度人，另有13人是英国人；另外6个国家的人也被认为已经死亡。

source_text: The passengers were mostly foreigners from the Nass-Murray and Roberts construction company, and were enjoying an evening dinner cruise in celebration of their completion of part of the Bahrain World Trade Centre towers.
target_text: 乘客大多是来自NASS默里和罗伯茨建筑公司的外国人，为了庆祝巴林世贸中心部分塔楼的竣工，他们正在享受晚间晚餐巡游。

source_text: Most who died were dining on the lower deck, and were trapped below.
target_text: 大多数死者都是在下层用餐，并被困在下面。

source_text: Over 130 people were onboard the boat at the time, although some say the boat was only licensed to carry 120.
target_text: 当时船上有130多人，尽管有人说这艘船只能携带120人。

source_text: The boat capsized in calm seas soon after it left, trapping many below.
target_text: 这艘船在它离开后不久就在平静的海面倾覆，将许多人困在下面。

source_text: The dhow had been modified to have an extra, higher deck making the vessel less stable.
target_text: 单桅帆船经过改装，增加了一个更高的甲板，使其不那么稳定。
