source_text: The exact cause is unknown - suggestions from eyewitnesses include the boat suddenly turning left, being hit by a wave, and many of the passengers moving to one side of the boat together.
target_text: 确切的原因还不清楚-目击者的建议包括船突然左转，被海浪击中，许多乘客一起移到船的一侧。

source_text: Professor Paul Mirecki, the chairman of the Religious Studies Department at the University of Kansas, was hospitalized after being assaulted by two unidentified men who made references to the class he had planned to teach in the spring.
target_text: 堪萨斯大学宗教研究系主任保罗·米列基教授在被两名身份不明的男子殴打后住院治疗，他们提到了他计划在春季教授的课程。

source_text: The course, entitled "Special Topics in Religion: Intelligent Design, Creationism and other Religious Mythologies" was intended to support evolution, and explore creationism as a mythology.
target_text: 该课程名为“宗教专题：智能设计、神创论和其他宗教神话”，旨在支持进化，并探索神话创造论。

source_text: He said, "I just pulled over hoping they would pass, and then they pulled up real close behind."
target_text: 他说：“我只是把车停下来，希望他们能通过，然后他们就停在了后面。”

source_text: "They got out, and I made the mistake of getting out."
target_text: “他们下了车，而我犯了从车里出去的错误。”

source_text: John Calvert, managing director of the Intelligent Design Network, had previously objected to Professor Mirecki's focus on creationism as mythology, and claimed that the religious studies professor was "labeling anybody who proposes [intelligent design] to be simply a religious nut".
target_text: 智能设计网络董事总经理约翰·卡尔弗特此前曾反对米列基教授将神创论作为神话来关注，并声称该宗教研究教授“将任何提出【智能设计】的人都贴上了简单的宗教标签”。

source_text: Paul Mirecki had already decided to cancel the course after he caused controversy by using the slang term "fundies" to refer to Christian Fundamentalists in an email to a student organization, the Society for Open Minded Atheists and Agnostics.
target_text: 保罗·米列基在给一个学生组织、思想开放的无神论者和不可知论者协会发电子邮件时，用俚语“原教旨主义”来指代基督教原教旨主义者，引起了争议，他已经决定取消这门课程。

source_text: Professor Mirecki has apologized for using the term, which is viewed as a slur by some conservatives.
target_text: 米列基教授已经为使用这个词道歉，这个词被一些保守派视为污蔑。

source_text: The Jewish Federation of Greater Seattle building in Seattle, Washington was the site of a shooting on at around 4 pm on July 28.
target_text: 7月28日下午4点左右，位于华盛顿西雅图的大西雅图犹太人联合会大楼发生了枪击事件。

source_text: According to witnesses the man walked up to the building and shot a woman in the leg.
target_text: 据目击者称，该名男子走到大楼，击中了了一名女子的腿部。

source_text: He entered the building to go onto the roof and fire one shot before walking back inside and firing several more shots.
target_text: 他进入大楼登上屋顶并开了一枪，然后再返回楼内，又射了几枪。

source_text: After a few minutes the gunman surrendered to police through 911.
target_text: 几分钟后，持枪歹徒通过911向警方投降。

source_text: According to Amy Wasser-Simpson, the federation's vice president, the man shouted, "I'm a Muslim American; I'm angry at Israel," before shooting.
target_text: 据联合会副主席艾米·沃瑟·辛普森称，在枪击事件发生之前，这名男子喊道：“我是穆斯林美国人，我对以色列很愤怒。”

source_text: An employee who wished not to be identified spoke of the shots fired, "It went 'Pop! Pop! Pop! Pop! Pop!' and then we heard a woman scream."
target_text: 一位不愿透露姓名的员工谈到了枪击事件，“枪声‘砰！砰！砰！砰！砰！’然后我们听到一个女人尖叫。”

source_text: "One of the receptionists told me that he shot her and then demanded that she call 911."
target_text: “其中一名接待员告诉我，他开枪打她，然后要求她打电话给911。”

source_text: "I saw one friend –– she had been shot twice in the stomach and was bleeding,"
target_text: “我看到一个朋友，她腹部中弹两次，还在流血。”

source_text: They have sustained wounds to the knee, groin, abdomen and arm.
target_text: 他们的膝盖，腹股沟，腹部和手臂都有伤口。

source_text: Three of the five have been taken to the operating room, said Pamela Steele, spokeswoman for the Harbourview Medical Center.
target_text: 哈伯维尤医疗中心的女发言人帕梅拉·斯蒂尔说，五名患者中有三人已被送往手术室。

source_text: The FBI will be working with local authorities on the case.
target_text: 联邦调查局将与地方当局就此案进行合作。

source_text: It was surrounded by a fence, it has bullet proof windows and all visitors must be buzzed in by reception.
target_text: 它被栅栏包围，有防弹窗，所有的来访者都必须由接待处按铃叫进来。

source_text: Thirty Americans were killed in the crash, including at least seventeen members of SEAL Team 6, Air Force members, the helicopter's crew, a dog handler and a civilian interpreter, while eight members of the Afghan Army were also on board and died.
target_text: 此次坠机事件中有30个美国人遇难，其中包括至少17名美国海豹突击队特种兵第6分队成员、美国空军成员、机组成员，以及1名训犬员、1名文职翻译，同时机上还有8名阿富汗军队成员，也全部遇难。

source_text: According to witnesses, members of the Taliban and officials from the US and Afghanistan, the Chinook was deliberately targeted, apparently by a rocket propelled grenade (RPG).
target_text: 据目击者、塔利班成员以及美国和阿富汗官员称，切努克直升机明显是被火箭助推榴弹蓄意击中。

source_text: While no American officials have spoken on the record about the cause of the crash, anonymous sources have said that the helicopter was shot down, an assertion that corresponds with reports from local officials and witness, who said that the helicopter crashed after a rocket struck it.
target_text: 但是没有美国官员公开发布此次坠机事件的原因，据匿名消息称，直升机是被击落的，这一说法与当地官员和目击者的陈述一致，据他们称，直升机是在被火箭击中后坠毁的。

source_text: The Taliban said that they had brought the aircraft down while it was involved in an operation targeting a house where insurgents were meeting.
target_text: 塔利班声称，当飞机正在瞄准叛乱者集合开会的建筑时，他们已将飞机击落。

source_text: While Taliban forces do not have a history of shooting down aircraft, they claim to have modified their RPGs for improved accuracy, but there is no proof of this.
target_text: 但是塔利班武装部队从来没有击落过飞机，他们声称已经对火箭助推榴弹进行了改良，提高了精准度，但是没有证据证明此说法。

source_text: The chairman of the US Joint Chiefs of Staff, Admiral Mike Mullen, warned against leaping to conclusions, however, saying that "[i]nformation is still coming in about this incident."
target_text: 美国参谋首长联席会议主席麦克马伦上将警告大家不要过早下结论，但是，他说：“目前我们仍不断获得关于此次事件的消息。”

source_text: " I think it's important that we allow investigators to do their work before jumping to too many conclusions."
target_text: “我认为在妄下结论之前，我们给调查者时间去调查是很重要的。”

source_text: President Barack Obama issued a statement after the incident, saying that "[t]heir deaths are a reminder of the extraordinary sacrifices made by the men and women of our military and their families, including all who have served in Afghanistan."
target_text: 美国总统巴拉克·奥巴马在此次事件后发表声明称“这些人的遇难表明，我们的军队以及他们的家人，包括所有在阿富汗执行任务的人们，都作出了巨大的牺牲。”

source_text: Irish Taoiseach Bertie Ahern and British Prime Minister Tony Blair have unveiled a new roadmap for the Northern Ireland devolution process.
target_text: 爱尔兰总理伯蒂·埃亨和英国首相托尼·布莱尔公布了北爱尔兰权力下放进程的新路线图。

source_text: The roadmap sets a target date for a new Northern Ireland Executive to be set up.
target_text: 路线图设定了建立新的北爱尔兰行政部的目标日期。

source_text: The roadmap, known as the Saint Andrews Agreement, came after three days of intense talks in St. Andrews, Scotland.
target_text: 该路线图，被称为圣安德鲁斯协议，是在苏格兰的圣安德鲁斯经过3天的激烈谈判后制定的。

source_text: The agreement gives dates for the steps to devolution culminating on March 26, 2007 when the Executive is to be fully up and running.
target_text: 协议规定了权力下放进程的日期，整个进程将于2007年3月26日最终完成，届时行政部完全建立并开始运营。

source_text: The first deadline is on November 10, 2006 during which time both parties must accept the agreement and for the first time in the history of the party, the Democratic Unionist Party will cast a vote for their rivals, Sinn Fein.
target_text: 第一个截止日期是2006年11月10日，在这期间双方必须接受该协议，而且民主统一党将首次为他们的竞争对手新芬党投票。

source_text: The second deadline is on November 27, 2006 in which the Northern Ireland Assembly, would gather to elect the first minister and deputy first minister of the Executive.
target_text: 第二个截止日期是2006年11月27日，这期间北爱尔兰议会将开会选举行政部的首席部长和副首席部长。

source_text: The first minister is speculated by many to be Ian Paisley, the leader of the Democratic Unionist Party.
target_text: 据推测，首席部长可能是民主统一党领袖伊恩·佩斯利。

source_text: The deputy first minister is speculated to be Martin McGuinness, the deputy leader of Sinn Fein.
target_text: 据推测，副首席部长可能是新芬党副领袖马丁·麦吉尼斯。

source_text: One of the key issues is Sinn Fein's recognition of the Police Service of Northern Island, which replaced the controverisal Royal Ulster Constabulary.
target_text: 关键议题之一就是新芬党对北爱尔兰警察部队的认可，它取代了颇具争议的皇家警察部队。

source_text: In a reassurance to unionists, the governments said they will not transfer duties over to the executive till 2008.
target_text: 为了使联合主义者安心，政府表示他们到2008年才会将职权转移给行政局。

source_text: Sinn Fein demanded an immediate transfer of power, possibly to a Sinn Fein minister.
target_text: 新芬党要求在可能的情况下，立即将权力转移给新芬党人担任的部长。

source_text: "You can't have a democratic society unless the police are given full support," Blair said.
target_text: 布莱尔说：“如果不给予警察足够的支持，你们不可能建立民主社会。”

source_text: After the election of ministers, three steps will take place.
target_text: 部长选举结束后，将进行3个步骤。

source_text: The Democratic Unionists will be given time to observe Sinn Fein and see if they are accepting policing.
target_text: 给民主统一党时间观察新芬党，看他们是否接受警察管制。

source_text: Finally in March, an electoral endorsement of the Saint Andrews Agreement will take place be it either through election or referendum.
target_text: 最后，3月份，将以选举或者公投的形式进行圣安德鲁斯协议的签署。

source_text: Most of the participants at the summit favored a referendum, except for Ian Paisley, according to an anoynoums source who wished not be identified as he no authorization to release details publicly.
target_text: 据匿名消息称，除了伊恩·佩斯利之外，峰会上大多数参会者更倾向于选择公投，消息提供者不希望公开身份，因为他没有向公众公布细节的权力。

source_text: On March 14, the nomination of the Executive will take place.
target_text: 3月14日，将进行行政局的任命。

source_text: Finally, if all goes well, the Northern Ireland Executive power-sharing government and full devolved Northern Ireland Assembly would be revived and take power on March 26, 2007.
target_text: 最后，如果一切顺利，北爱尔兰行政局权力共享政府和完成权力移交的北爱尔兰议会将于2007年3月26日恢复职权并开始执政。

source_text: However, if the parties fail to set up the Executive or fail to agree "at any stage", the Assembly will be dissolved and direct rule from London will continue with input from the Republic of Ireland.
target_text: 但是，如果各方未能建立行政局，或者在任何一个阶段未能达成一致，议会将被解散，继续由伦敦直接统治，爱尔兰共和国参与执政。

source_text: Tony Blair said the essential parts of the agreement are that all parties accept policing and the courts and have a clear agreement on power-sharing.
target_text: 托尼·布莱尔说，协议的重要内容就是各方均接受警察和法庭，并达成关于权力共享的明确协议。

source_text: "So those are the two essential parts of it," Mr Blair said.
target_text: “所以这是协议的两项重要内容，”布莱尔说。

source_text: Ian Paisley, the notorious hardliner evangelist who has made his political career out of saying no to comprehensive reforms, eschewed his trademark fire-brand rhetoric offered a welcome and said that the province is "at a crossroads."
target_text: 有名的强硬派传教士伊恩·佩斯利，在其政治生涯中从来不主张进行全面改革，此次避开其叛乱煽动者的身份，对改革表示欢迎，并表示北爱尔兰正处于紧要关头。

source_text: Paisley said of Ulster, "a place where there is a road to democracy and where there is a road to anarchy."
target_text: 佩斯利提到阿尔斯特时说，“它是一个带我们通往民主之路和通往无政府状态之路的地方。”

source_text: Further adding, "I trust that we will see in the coming days the vast majority of people taking the road to democracy."
target_text: 他还说：“我相信在未来的日子里，我们会看到绝大多数人走上通往民主之路。”

source_text: Blair also added, "We've been through different parts of this process many times over the past few years but I think this is a sound basis to proceed."
target_text: 布莱尔也表示：“在过去的几年里，我们多次完成了此进程的不同阶段，但是我认为这是继续完成此进程的坚实基础。”

source_text: He also said on the possible election of Paisley and McGuinness to their minister positions, "I do not think anybody will find it easy to sit in an executive with people who they are deeply opposed to, or indeed hostile to."
target_text: 关于佩斯利和麦吉尼斯可能当选部长职位之事，他还说：“我认为任何人都会觉得在一个全部是他极力反对，甚至敌对的人的行政局任职不是一件容易的事情。”

source_text: Referring to Sinn Fein, Paisley stated "We will meet the requirements. "
target_text: 关于新芬党，佩斯利表示：“我们会满足他们的要求。”

source_text: "But the IRA-Sinn Fein has got to meet those requirements."
target_text: “但是爱尔兰共和军-新芬党必须满足那些要求。”

source_text: Paisley left St. Andrews quickly after attending the press conference in order to be with his family for his fiftieth wedding anniversary.
target_text: 参加完记者招待会后，佩斯利迅速离开圣安德鲁斯，赶回家与家人一起庆祝他结婚50周年纪念日。

source_text: "Common sense, political realism and the interests of all sections of our people demand that we achieve this."
target_text: “共识、政治现实主义和我们全体人民的利益要求我们要实现这个目标。”

source_text: Sir Reg Empey, the leader of the Ulster Unionist Party said that the agreement was "Belfast for slower learners."
target_text: 北爱尔兰统一党领袖雷吉·恩皮爵士说，该协议是“慢速学习者的贝尔法斯特”。

source_text: He added "Sinn Fein will sign up to the PSNI being the only force of law and order and Ian Paisley, or a colleague, will share the joint office of first and deputy first minister with Martin McGuinness in a mandatory coalition."
target_text: 他还说：“新芬党将签约同意北爱尔兰警察为维护法律与秩序的唯一军队，伊恩·佩斯利或其同僚将与麦吉尼斯结成强制性联盟，共用首席部长和副首席部长的联合办公室。”

source_text: Leader of the more moderate nationalist Social Democratic and Labour Party, Mark Durkan stated that welcome progress had been made in devolution and that his party would continue working towards this.
target_text: 温和的民族主义者社会民主工党的领袖马克·德肯表示政权转移进展顺利，他的政党会继续进行此进程。

source_text: He added, "Despite all that remains to be done, there is now at least a sense of hope for a shared future."
target_text: 他还说：“尽管还有很多遗留工作没有做完，但是至少目前我们感受到了对共同未来的希望。”

source_text: Direct rule from London has been in place since the Assembly and Executive dissolved in 2002 over allegations of IRA spying ring.
target_text: 自2002年议会和行政部因涉嫌北爱尔兰共和军间谍组织而解散后，北爱尔兰一直处于伦敦的直接统治下。

source_text: On the last sitting day of the year in Federal Parliament, the Opposition opened with three successive motions to attempt to bring the Government to account over the major issues that the Government has faced over the last fortnight.
target_text: 在联邦议会全年最后一个会议日，反对党首先提出了三个连续的议案，试图让政府充分考虑其在最后两周所面临的主要问题。

source_text: The motions to suspend standing orders was first put by Wayne Swan (the shadow Treasurer) dealt with the Treasurer Peter Costello, calling on him to release documents and information regarding Robert Gerard; the following two put by Kevin Rudd (the shadow Foreign Minister) and (the member for Corio) dealt with the Government's involvement in the Australian Wheat Board inadvertently paying money to a front business of Saddam Hussein.
target_text: 由韦恩·斯旺（影子财长）首先提出了暂停约期汇款的议案，该议案涉及到财务部长彼得·科斯特洛，要求他公布有关罗伯特·杰拉德的文件和信息；后面的两项议案是由陆克文（影子财长）和（代表科里奥选举小组的议员）提出的，主要是关于政府参与了澳大利亚小麦局无意中向萨达姆•侯赛因的一家挂牌公司付款的行为。

source_text: The Government with their House majority moved that these speakers and their necessary seconders be no longer heard (the 'gag'), and voted down the motions.
target_text: 政府及其众议院多数党提出，不再听取这些发言人及其附议者的意见（‘言论自由限制’），并投票否决了这些议案。

source_text: The United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization has asked countries neighbouring Turkey, specifically mentioning Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Iraq, Iran, and Syria, to be cautious and take measures to prevent the avian flu, H5N1, from spreading.
target_text: 联合国粮农组织要求土耳其的邻国，特别提及亚美尼亚、阿塞拜疆、格鲁吉亚、伊拉克、伊朗和叙利亚，要谨慎防范，采取措施，预防H5N1禽流感的传播。

source_text: The UN also warned that civilians in these countries should be given more information about the disease.
target_text: 联合国也发出警告，应该给这些国家的平民提供更多有关该疾病的信息。

source_text: Two people have died in Turkey so far, possibly a third, and more hospitalized, after contracting the flu virus.
target_text: 到目前为止，土耳其已有两人死亡，还可能会有第三个，甚至更多住院治疗的人在感染流感病毒后死亡。

source_text: All 15 confirmed cases in Turkey had close contact with birds.
target_text: 土耳其所有15例确诊病例均与禽类有过密切接触。

source_text: As of now, the H5N1 virus strain does not pass easily to humans and does not spread at all between humans.
target_text: 到目前为止，H5N1病毒株不会轻易传播给人类，也决不会在人类之间传播。

source_text: Going into the third scheduled day of competition at the IPC Alpine World Championships in La Molina, Spain yesterday, the United States para-alpine team has delivered with a gold medal won by Laurie Stephens in the women's sitting downhill, a silver medal won by men's sit skier Stephen Lawler in the downhill, and bronze medal won by Laurie Stephens in the women's sitting Super-G.
target_text: 在西班牙拉莫利纳举行的国际高山滑雪世锦赛昨天进入第3个比赛日，美国滑雪队以劳里·斯蒂芬斯获得女子坐式速降项目金牌，斯蒂芬·劳勒获得男子坐式滑雪项目银牌，劳里·斯蒂芬斯获得女子坐式超级大回转项目铜牌的成绩收官。

source_text: The United States finished two days of competition fifth overall in the medal count, tied with Russia.
target_text: 美国在第2天比赛结束后，位列奖牌榜第五位，与俄罗斯并列。

source_text: A few members of Team USA had difficulties, and were not able to start or finish their races.
target_text: 有几名美国队运动员，因有特殊困难，或赛前即退出比赛，或没有坚持到比赛结束。

source_text: In the downhill and Super-G event, 2010 Winter Paralympics medalist Alana Nichols did not start.
target_text: 在速降项目和超级大回转项目中，2010年冬季残奥会奖牌获得者阿兰娜·尼克尔斯赛前退出比赛。

source_text: LW12-2 women's sit-skier Victor also did not start in the downhill event.
target_text: 在速降项目中，LW12-2女子坐式滑雪运动员维克多也在赛前即退出比赛。

source_text: Visually-impaired B3 classified skier Bathum chatted with his guide, Sean Ramsden, immediately following both his races.
target_text: B3级盲人滑雪运动员贝瑟姆赛后立即与其向导肖恩·拉姆斯登交流。

source_text: While he was unhappy with his downhill run, Bathum was happy with and had fun during his seventh place run in the Super-G event where he finished with a factored time of 1:13.51, only 3.02 seconds slower than the winning time set by Spanish skier Jon Santacana.
target_text: 贝瑟姆虽然对这次速降比赛成绩不满意，但是他非常开心能够在超级大回转项目中以1：13.51的成绩获得第7名，仅比西班牙运动员乔恩·沈拉蒙赢得比赛的用时慢3.02秒。

source_text: United States skiers were scheduled to compete yesterday in the Slalom discipline but the competition was cancelled due to high winds.
target_text: 美国滑雪运动员原计划参加昨天的障碍滑雪比赛，但是比赛因大风天气而取消。

source_text: Several members of Team USA had a pizza party after the slalom cancellation.
target_text: 障碍滑雪比赛取消后，美国队的几名运动员举行了一个披萨派对。

source_text: No snow arrived until late in the afternoon, where there was limited accumulation.
target_text: 直到傍晚时分，才开始下雪，而且雪量不大。

source_text: Some of the younger members of Team USA took advantage of the night off on Thursday to go bowling before a busy training day Friday.
target_text: 在星期五紧张的训练日到来之前，美国队一些年轻的队员，利用星期四晚上的休息时间去打保龄球。

source_text: In other United States Paralympic news, Sir Philip Craven, the President of the International Paralympic Committee, told a Wikinews reporter the country will have live television coverage of the 2016 Summer Paralympics in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
target_text: 据美国其他关于残奥会的新闻称，国际残疾人奥委会主席菲利普·克雷文先生告诉维基新闻的记者，美国将通过电视直播报道于巴西里约热内卢举办的2016年夏季残疾人奥运会。

source_text: When a member of Team USA competing in La Molina was asked if they heard confirmation of this, they were unable to confirm.
target_text: 当一位在拉莫利纳参加比赛的美国队队员被问及是否听说过此消息时，他们无法确认。

source_text: They did highlight the lack of United States media coverage was frustrating for fans wanting to follow the Games in London.
target_text: 但他们的确特别强调，美国缺乏媒体报道，曾令想观看伦敦奥运会的粉丝非常沮丧。

source_text: According to the skier, many people he knew could only follow the Games by searching for video on sites like YouTube.
target_text: 该滑雪运动员称，他认识的很多人只能通过在类似YouTube的网站上搜索视频来观看比赛。

source_text: Fud Leclerc, who represented Belgium at the Eurovision Song Contest four times, has died at the age of 86.
target_text: 曾4次代表比利时参加欧洲歌唱大赛的福德勒·克莱尔，86岁逝世。

source_text: The singer performed at the first contest in 1956 and appeared again two years later and achieved his best result with his performance of Ma petite chatte.
target_text: 这位歌手1956年第一次参加歌唱大赛，2年后再次参加比赛，并通过演唱“我的小猫咪”取得了他的最好成绩。

source_text: After appearing for the third time at the 1960 contest he made his final appearance at the 1962 contest.
target_text: 在1960年第三次参加比赛以后，又于1962年最后一次参加了该比赛。

source_text: At the 1962 contest Leclerc became the first person in Eurovision history to fail to score any points, also known as Nul Points.
target_text: 在1962年的比赛中，勒克莱尔成为在欧洲歌唱大赛中未得一分的第一人，也被称为“零分歌手”。

source_text: After his final Eurovision appearance he left the music industry and became a building contractor.
target_text: 在最后一次参加完欧洲歌唱大赛以后，他离开了乐坛，成为一名建筑承包商。

source_text: In 2005 he made an appearance on a special programme to commemorate Eurovision.
target_text: 2005年，他参加了一个纪念欧洲歌唱大赛的特别节目。

source_text: Plastic surgeon to the stars Dr. Frank Ryan has died in a car accident at age 50.
target_text: 为明星服务过的整形外科医生弗兰克·瑞恩在50岁时因车祸去世。

source_text: It is reported that the Jeep Ryan was driving crashed over the side of the Pacific Coast Highway and landed on rocks.
target_text: 据报道，瑞恩驾驶的吉普车在太平洋海岸公路一侧撞毁并落在岩石上。

source_text: Lifeguards were first on the scene and unsuccessfully tried to rescue Ryan.
target_text: 救生员是第一次出现在现场，并没有成功地营救瑞恩。

source_text: It is thought that no other vehicle was involved in the incident.
target_text: 据说此次事故中没有涉及其他车辆。

source_text: A representative for Janice Dickinson released a statement about the death of Ryan.
target_text: 珍妮丝·狄金森的代表发表了关于瑞恩死亡的声明。

source_text: She said "Janice is deeply, deeply anguished! She is stunned and wants the world to know what a genius Dr. Ryan was."
target_text: 她说：“珍妮丝对此深感悲痛！她惊呆了，希望全世界都知道瑞安博士是个天才”。

source_text: Ryan was traveling with his pet dog at the time of the crash; the dog was found seriously injured in the ocean and was transported to a local veterinarian.
target_text: 在撞车事故发生时，瑞安和他的宠物狗一起旅行；这只狗在海洋中被发现，它严重受伤，并被送往当地兽医院。

source_text: The program has been used to manage the large case load which has accumulated since the September 11, 2001 attacks, leaving US officials free to concentrate on the "high value" suspects who are kept under US control at secret locations throughout the world.
target_text: 该计划已被用于管理自2001年9月11日袭击以来积累的大量案件负担，使美国官员可以自由地专注于在全世界秘密地点受美国控制的“高价值”嫌疑人。

source_text: Today, US officials were reluctant to defend this policy for any specific cases, but White House spokesman Dan Bartlett presented a generic defense of US anti-terrorism policies on Sunday talk shows in the United States.
target_text: 今天，美国官员不愿意为任何具体案件捍卫这一政策，但白宫发言人丹·巴特利特在美国的周日脱口秀节目中提出了对美国反恐政策的一般性辩护。

source_text: A former government official claimed that the program was "fully authorized" and that the CIA was "not doing anything illegal" in an interview with The New York Times, and said that the leadership of the House and Senate intelligence committees was able to find out about the program, or had been informed of its existence.
target_text: 一位前政府官员声称该计划是“完全授权的”，在接受“纽约时报”采访时表示中情局“没有做任何违法行为”，该官员表示众议院和参议院情报委员会的领导能够找到此项程序。或已被告知其存在。

source_text: Allowing the CIA to have so much power in deciding who can stay in the country and who is shipped off to other countries is controversial, because in the past, the White House, State Department, or Justice Department would have been involved in approving individual cases of sending prisoners to other countries.
target_text: 授予中央情报局在决定谁可以留在该国以及谁被运往其他国家这样如此大的权力是有争议的，因为在过去，白宫，国务院或司法部将参与参与将囚犯送往其他国家的独立案件的审理。

source_text: While refusing to admit that the rendition policy even exists, the Bush administration claimed that they do not hand over people to be tortured in other countries, to get around US laws which prohibit such practices.
target_text: 尽管布什政府拒绝承认引渡政策的存在，但他声称，他们不会移交在其他国家受酷刑的人，从而来绕过美国法律禁止的这种做法。

source_text: However, the New York Times interviewed a number of current and former officials who believed that the policy was designed to allow the government to plausibly deny that torture was being tolerated.
target_text: 然而，纽约时报采访了一些现任和前任官员，他们认为该政策的目的是让政府合理地否认酷刑是被容忍的。

source_text: The case of Australian Mamdouh Habib attracted widespread attention in that country, after he was released in January after 40 months, without any charges being pressed.
target_text: 澳大利亚人马姆杜·哈比卜的案件在该国引起了广泛的关注，他在服刑40个月后于今年一月份被释放，并没有受到任何指控。

source_text: Australian officials were aware that he had been transferred by the United States to Egypt for six months.
target_text: 澳大利亚官员意识到他已被美国转移到埃及六个月了。

source_text: The United States denies that Habib was tortured with their knowledge, although US officials were not present during his overseas captivity and could not guarantee that he had not been tortured.
target_text: 尽管美国官员在他的海外囚禁期间不在场并无法保证他没有遭受酷刑，但美国否认他们知道哈比卜遭受了酷刑。

source_text: Egypt has not confirmed that Habib was ever in the country.
target_text: 埃方尚未证实哈比卜曾在该国居住过。

source_text: A similar case involving Syrian born Canadian Maher Arar, deported to Syria in October, 2002, subsequently held and allegedly tortured for 374 days, led to Canada issuing a travel advisory strongly cautioning Canadians born in Iraq, Iran, Syria, Libya and Sudan against travel to the United States for any reason.
target_text: 2002年10月，一宗类似的案件涉及出生在叙利亚的加拿大人马赫·阿拉尔，他被驱逐到叙利亚，随后被拘留，据称被拷打了374天，导致加拿大发布旅游警告，强烈警告在伊拉克、伊朗、叙利亚、利比亚和苏丹出生的加拿大人不要以任何理由前往美国。

source_text: A subsequent internal RCMP investigation found several instances of impropriety in the Arar case, including the provision of sensitive information on Arar to US officials, and that a liaison officer may have known of the deportation plan but did not contact his supervisors.
target_text: 随后加拿大皇家骑警内部调查发现阿拉尔案件中存在多起不当行为，包括向美国官员提供有关阿拉尔的敏感信息，以及联络官可能知道驱逐计划但未联系其上司。

source_text: Mr. Arar's attempt to sue American Attorney-General John Ashcroft over the incident in January 2004 was dismissed when the US government invoked the rarely used "state secrets privilege", claiming that to go forward in open court would jeopardize intelligence, foreign policy, and national security interests.
target_text: 阿拉尔先生试图起诉美国司法部长约翰阿什克罗夫特，当美国政府援引极少使用的国家机密特权时，2004年1月的事件被驳回。并声称在公开法庭上声称在公开法庭上继续会危及情报，外交政策和国家安全利益。

source_text: Legal analysts point out that information obtained through the use of torture is useless in court proceedings, but US officials insist that the information obtained from such interrogations is still useful for their purposes, and that "it has resulted in the capture of terrorists."
target_text: 法律分析人士指出，通过使用酷刑获得的信息在法庭诉讼程序中毫无效力，但美国官员坚持认为从这种审讯中获得的信息对他们的目的仍然有用，并且“它导致了恐怖分子被捕”。

source_text: Eleven protesters, including five members of Congress, were arrested on charges of disorderly conduct and unlawful assembly.
target_text: 包括五名国会议员在内的十一名抗议者因扰乱治安和非法集会被捕。

source_text: " I have no optimism as to the actions of the Sudanese government," Lantos said.
target_text: 兰托斯说：“我对苏丹政府的行动并不乐观。”

source_text: Democratic House members James McGovern and John Olver of Massachusetts, Sheila Jackson Lee of Texas, and Jim Moran of Virginia were among the others arrested and released after paying $50 fines after being arrested in front of the Sudanese embassy.
target_text: 民主党众议员詹姆斯·麦戈文和马萨诸塞州的约翰·奥尔弗，德克萨斯州的希拉·杰克逊·李以及弗吉尼亚州的吉姆·莫兰被捕并支付50美元罚款后在苏丹大使馆前被释放。

source_text: Olver said, "We must hold the Sudanese government accountable for the attacks they have supported on their own citizens in Darfur."
target_text: 奥尔弗说：“我们必须让苏丹政府为他们支持在达尔富尔袭击本国公民的事件负责。”

source_text: Meanwhile, President Bush met with Darfur advocates this Friday in support of rallies all over the US this weekend against the ongoing genocide in western Sudan.
target_text: 与此同时，布什总统本周五会见了达尔富尔的支持者们，他们支持这个周末在美国各地举行的反对苏丹西部正在进行的种族灭绝的集会。

source_text: There will be rallies across our country to send a message to the Sudanese government that the genocide must stop.

source_text: Barack Obama, the junior senator from Illinois and 2008 US presidential candidate has swept all three of today's Democratic contests, two caucuses in Nebraska and Washington and the primary in Louisiana.
target_text: 巴拉克•奥巴马，伊利诺斯州参议员，2008年美国总统候选人。他在今天的三场民主党初选，内布拉斯加州和华盛顿州的两场党团会议以及路易斯安那州的初选中获得全胜。

source_text: Obama won nearly 30% more over opponent Hillary Clinton in the Nebraska caucuses.
target_text: 奥巴马在内布拉斯加州的预选会议上赢得了超过对手希拉里•克林顿近30％的支持率。

source_text: Commentators have noted that Obama seems to perform well in caucus states.
target_text: 评论人士指出，奥巴马似乎在党团会议的州表现良好。

source_text: Louisiana's Democratic primary was also won by Obama in a large margin, winning nearly 53% of the vote over Clinton's 39%.
target_text: 奥巴马在路易斯安那州的民主党初选也在很大程度上赢得了胜利，他赢得了近53％的选票，超过了克林顿的39％。

source_text: Despite these wins it is still a close race between the two Democratic candidates, with Obama showing a lead in pledged delegates, and Hillary Clinton showing a narrow lead when super delegates are taken into account.
target_text: 尽管取得了这些胜利，但两位民主党候选人之间仍然是一场激烈的竞选，奥巴马在承诺代表中表现出领先优势，希拉里克林顿在宣誓代表中处于微弱的领先优势。

source_text: Each candidate needs to win the support of 2,025 delegates to secure the nomination.
target_text: 每位候选人都需要赢得2,025名代表的支持才能获得提名。

source_text: After the voting and caucusing ended yesterday both candidates gave a speech at the Democratic Party's Jefferson and Jackson Dinner in Virginia- Clinton giving her standard stump speech and refusing to talk about what had happened during the day; Obama repeating many of the things he had said earlier in his "Yes We Can" speech, this time with detailed policy proposals as well as "hope-mongering".
target_text: 昨天投票和会议结束后，两位候选人在弗吉尼亚州民主党的杰斐逊和杰克逊晚宴上发表演讲，克林顿发表了标准的政治演说，并拒绝谈论白天发生的事情。奥巴马重复了许多他之前在他的“是的，我们可以”演讲中所说的事情，这一次是详细的政策建议以及“希望传播”。

source_text: The two candidates were in Maine today doing last minute campaigning before tomorrow's Democratic caucuses there and are also preparing for the "Potomac primary" which will involve the nation's capital of Washington, D.C. and the bordering states of Maryland and Virginia to be held on February 12.
target_text: 今天两位候选人在缅因州为明天的民主党党团会议做最后一分钟的竞选活动，同时也在为“波托马克初选”做准备。初选将于2月12日在缅因州首府华盛顿特区，邻近的马里兰州和维吉尼亚州举行。

source_text: A family of six were injured at Flat Rock Bridge Family Resort and campground in Lebanon, Maine after a severe thunderstorm caused trees to topple, with one landing on a tent.
target_text: 缅因州一场严重的雷暴导致树木倒塌，其中一棵树落在了帐篷上，使得一家六口在缅因州黎巴嫩市的平石桥家庭度假村和露营地受伤。

source_text: A 10-year-old girl was critically injured after a tree fell on the tent she was sleeping in.
target_text: 一棵树倒在一名10岁女孩睡觉的帐篷上，使她严重受伤。

source_text: Witnesses say the girl was pinned under the tree for at least 10 minutes before they were able to remove it.
target_text: 目击者称这个女孩至少被压在树下10分钟后才被他们移开。

source_text: Witnesses describe a "funnel-like wind" which lifted items off the ground and threw them around.
target_text: 目击者描述了一种“漏斗状的风”，它将物品抬离地面并将它们扔到一边。

source_text: The strong winds then brought down trees and limbs, with one landing on the family's campsite and tent.
target_text: 然后强风吹倒了树和树枝，一棵树落在了这个家庭的营地和帐篷上。

source_text: "The female patient was loaded into Lebanon Ambulance One and transported to Frisbie Hospital in Rochester to be stabilized and then was transferred to the trauma center at Maine Medical Center."
target_text: “这名女性患者被抬上了黎巴嫩第一救护车，然后被运往罗切斯特的弗里斯比医院控制伤情，然后转往缅因州医疗中心的创伤中心。”

source_text: "Her injuries were considered critical and life threatening when she left the scene," said Jason Cole, the assistant rescue chief for the area.
target_text: 该地区救援副主任杰森・科尔说，“当她离开现场时，她的伤势非常危急，并且有生命危险”。

source_text: The victims names have not been released and the girl's current condition is not yet known.
target_text: 受害者姓名尚未公布，女孩目前的状况尚不清楚。

source_text: Rescuers responding to the scene noticed several other trees and limbs scattered around other campsites and searched all 350 sites, but no other injuries were reported.
target_text: 救援人员在现场发现，其他营地周围还散落几棵树和树枝，他们对所有350个营地进行了搜索，但没有发现其他伤情。

source_text: Other campers say they had several close calls with tree limbs and debris.
target_text: 其他露营者说，他们也有好几次险被树枝和碎片击中。

source_text: The family's car was also destroyed when a tree limb landed on it.
target_text: 一个树枝落在一个家庭的车上，汽车也被击毁了。

source_text: The National Weather Service in Maine says it will investigate whether or not the storm produced a tornado.
target_text: 缅因州的国家气象局表示将调查风暴是否会产生龙卷风。

source_text: Citizens in the Australian city of Bathurst in Central-Western New South Wales have turned out in the hundreds on top of Mount Panorama to observe tonight's lunar eclipse.
target_text: 位于新南威尔士州中西部的澳大利亚巴瑟斯特市的数百名市民已经在帕诺拉马山上观察到今晚的月食。

source_text: Those who turned out for the spectacle were treated to live music and purple flags with lighting to take on a mystic theme.
target_text: 为呈现神秘的主题，前来观看这一奇观的市民可享受现场音乐和带有灯光的紫色旗帜。

source_text: Mount Panorama provided perfect conditions for the show, with minimal light and clear skies.
target_text: 帕诺拉马山光线很弱和天空清亮为观赏提供了完美条件。

source_text: Just before 7 p.m. AEST the eclipse began to be visible with the Earth beginning to shadow the Moon, by 8:37 p.m. AEST the top of Mount Panorama was bathed in an eerie red glow as the moon glowed deep red.
target_text: 就在美国东部时间晚上7点之前，月食开始出现，在晚上8点37分，随着地球开始影响月球，月食开始变得明显。当月亮发出深红色的时候，帕诺拉马山顶部沐浴在诡异的红色光芒中。

source_text: Michael Stanton, a local astronomy fan told Wikinews "this is just great, we have music and this visual delight to see".
target_text: 当地天文爱好者迈克尔·斯坦顿告诉维基新闻“这真是太好了，我们有音乐和这种看得见的视觉乐趣”。

source_text: The UK Government has stated that children in Britain will no longer be required to take compulsory, externally marked tests at the age of fourteen.
target_text: 英国政府表示，英国的儿童将不再被要求在十四岁时进行强制性的外部标记测试。

source_text: The change takes effect immediately, meaning that children who were due to take the test this year no longer have to do so.
target_text: 这一变化立即生效，这意味着今年将要参加考试的孩子不再需要这样做。

source_text: Secretary of State for Children, Schools and Families Ed Balls yesterday announced his plans to radically change the UK testing system yesterday, in parliament.
target_text: 昨天，儿童，学校和家庭事务大臣埃德·鲍尔斯昨天宣布，他计划在议会中彻底改变英国的测试系统。

source_text: Currently, almost ten million tests are sat each year by British pupils.
target_text: 目前，英国学生每年都要进行近千万次测试。

source_text: This change is expected to cut the number of tests taken in half, according to The Guardian.
target_text: 据“卫报”报道，这一变化预计将减少一半的考试次数。

source_text: The tests for seven and eleven year olds are not being abolished.
target_text: 处于七岁和十一岁时所涉及的测试没有被废除。

source_text: A review group is being set up, however, to research the effect of these tests on eleven-year-olds.
target_text: 然而，正在建立一个审查小组，研究这些测试对11岁儿童的影响。

source_text: Instead of league tables showing test results, the government will produce report cards for secondary schools.
target_text: 政府将为中学制作成绩单，而不是显示测试结果的排名表。

source_text: According to Ed Balls, the results from GCSEs will be adequate to judge the performance of schools by their test results.
target_text: 根据埃德·鲍尔斯的说法，普通中学教育证书考试的结果足以判断他们在学校的表现。

source_text: The decision to abolish the tests for fourteen year olds came as a result of a situation earlier this year, when there were long delays with the delivery of test results to students of this age.
target_text: 决定取消对14岁少年的测试是由于今年早期的一种决定，当时向这个年龄的学生交付测试结果时拖延了很长一段时间。

source_text: According to Christine Blower, acting general secretary of the National Union of Teachers, the government is admitting that the previous test system failed by making this move.
target_text: 根据全国教师联合会代理秘书长克里斯蒂娜·布洛尔的说法，政府承认以前的测试系统通过现在的这一举动而导致失败了。

source_text: "For too long English, mathematics and science teachers in secondary schools have found themselves skewing everything to enable their pupils to jump through a series of unnecessary hoops," she claimed, while Chris Keates, general secretary of the National Association of Schoolmasters Union of Women Teachers, said that "the sound of a deep collective sigh of relief will emanate from secondary schools across the country."
target_text: 她声称，“长期以来，英语，中学的数学和科学教师发现自己扭曲了一切，以使他们的学生能够跳过一系列不必要的怪圈，”，同时全国校长联盟的总书记克里斯·济慈教师们表示，“全城的中学都将发出一声深沉的宽慰的叹息。”

source_text: Conservative Shadow Secretary of State for Children Michael Gove stated that his party have "argued for fewer national tests and more rigor and we want to work constructively to improve the assessment and qualifications regime."
target_text: 保守派影子国务卿迈克尔·戈夫表示，他的政党“主张减少国家考试但更加严谨，我们希望建设性地改进评估和资格制度。”

source_text: David Laws, Shadow Secretary of State for Children for the Liberal Democrats, said that "the Sats tests taken by 14-year-olds are not only a waste of time but have been highly unreliable over the last few years."
target_text: 自由民主党儿童影子国务卿戴维•劳斯表示，“14岁儿童进行的成绩测试不仅浪费时间，而且在过去几年里一直非常不可靠。”

source_text: The Italian football team Inter Milan have cancelled their tour of England, where they were to play the English teams Crystal Palace, Leicester City, Portsmouth, and Norwich City.
target_text: 意大利足球队国际米兰取消了他们的英格兰巡回赛，在那里他们将对阵英格兰的水晶宫队、莱斯特城队、朴茨茅斯和诺维奇队。

source_text: The four matches were due to take place between 25 July and 31 July.
target_text: 这四场比赛将于7月25日至7月31日举行。

source_text: Only one match — the game against Crystal Palace — was to have been played in London.
target_text: 只有一场对阵水晶宫的比赛将在伦敦进行。

source_text: Inter Milan confirmed in a statement that the attacks on London compelled the club to cancel their tour of England, saying that: "Football takes a step back because of increasing serious events which touch the sensitivity of everyone."
target_text: 国际米兰在一份声明中证实，对伦敦的袭击迫使俱乐部取消了他们对英格兰的巡回赛，他说：“由于越来越严重的事件触及每个人的敏感性，所以足球退后。”

source_text: Premier Jean Charest, 48, won a close race for his seat in Sherbrooke, despite having already been declared defeated by a PQ candidate.
target_text: 尽管已被宣布被魁北克省候选人击败，48岁的总理让·查瑞斯特赢得了他在舍布鲁克的席位。

source_text: Quebec's chief electoral officer telephoned the premier to relay the news that he had retained his seat.
target_text: 魁北克首席选举官打电话给总理，传递他保留席位的消息。

source_text: The ADQ have won well over the seats needed for them to have official party status.
target_text: ADQ已经赢得了他们获得正式党派所需的席位。

source_text: In the 2003 Quebec election they won a total of 4 seats, and would have needed 8 more seats to obtain party status.
target_text: 在2003年的魁北克大选中，他们共赢得了4个席位，并且再需要8个席位才能获得党派身份。

source_text: In the 2003 election, the ADQ garnered 21% of the vote.
target_text: 在2003年的选举中，ADQ获得了21％的选票。

source_text: If the results of the 2007 election holds, with 31% of the vote for the ADQ, it would represent a significant gain for the party.
target_text: 如果2007年选举的结果成立，并且ADQ的投票率为31％，那将对该党产生重大收益。

source_text: The Liberal campaign, under Charest's leadership, stumbled in the latter stages of the campaign when Charest allotted a $700 million windfall, in the form of a transfer from the federal Conservative government, to tax cuts for Quebecers.
target_text: 自由主义运动在查里斯特的领导下，在竞选的最后阶段，查里斯特从联邦保守党政府那里得到了7亿美元的意外之财为魁北克人减税。

source_text: The move to apply the money so quickly to tax cuts during the campaign, resonated with some as a cynical move to buy votes, and may have harmed the Liberal chances.
target_text: 在竞选期间如此迅速地将这笔资金用于减税的举动引起了一些人认为这是一种玩世不恭的购买选票的共鸣，这可能已经损害了自由党的机会。

source_text: This is the first minority government in Quebec in more than 100 years since the year 1878.
target_text: 这是自1878年以来100多年来魁北克省第一个少数民族政府。

source_text: Compared to the 2003 election, voter turnout is up by approximately 3%, according to Elections Quebec.
target_text: 据魁北克选举报道，与2003年的选举相比，选民投票率增加了约3％。
