target_text: 如果您有更多信息要添加到此新闻事件，请单击页面顶部的“编辑此页面”链接。

source_text: At 8:50 AM local time (15:50 UTC) a man attempting to enter the United States at the Tijuana – San Diego section of the US – Mexican border, tried to escape U.S. customs officers, after he could not provide official documentation.
target_text: 当地时间上午8点50分（美国东部时间15：50），一名男子试图从蒂华纳——圣地亚哥段的美墨边境进入美国。在他无法提供官方文件后试图逃脱海关官员。

source_text: According to Lieutenant Kevin Rooney of the San Diego police department, "the agent referred the driver to a secondary inspection and he [the driver] quickly accelerated away."
target_text: 根据圣地亚哥警察部门的中尉凯文·鲁尼的说法，“工作人员让司机接受二次检查时，他（司机）迅速加速离开。”

source_text: The acceleration caused him to crash into a pickup truck.
target_text: 加速导致他撞到皮卡车。

source_text: It is thought he was trying to force the other vehicle out of the way.
target_text: 据说他试图强行让其他车辆让道。

source_text: When customs officers surrounded the vehicle, the driver went into reverse, which led to two officers opening fire on the vehicle.
target_text: 当海关官员包围车辆时，司机反向行驶，导致两名警察向车辆开火。

source_text: The man was shot only once and the wound was not life threatening.
target_text: 该男子只被枪击中一次，伤口没有生命危险。

source_text: NASA's Cassini orbiter has sent back remarkable images from Saturn, revealing that the planet's famous rings are far more bumpy than expected.
target_text: 美国宇航局的卡西尼号轨道飞行器从土星发回了一些令人惊叹的图像。揭示了这颗行星著名的光环远比预期的要凹凸不平。

source_text: Astronomers previously thought that the rings were almost completely flat, with changes in height of only a few metres.
target_text: 天文学家以前认为环几乎是完全平坦的，高度变化只有几米。

source_text: However analysis of the new images show ridges up to 4 kilometres tall, similar in height to the Rocky Mountains or the Alps.
target_text: 然而，对新图像的分析显示高达4公里的山脊，高度与落基山脉或阿尔卑斯山相似。

source_text: The images were taken around the planet's equinox on August 11, when the Sun was directly over Saturn's equator and caught the rings edge on.
target_text: 这些图像是在8月11日周围的行星昼夜平分点拍摄的，当时太阳直接在土星的赤道上方，并抓拍到了环的边缘。

source_text: But whilst equinoxes occur twice a year on Earth, Saturn takes around 29.7 Earth years to orbit the Sun so the events are much rarer.
target_text: 但是，虽然昼夜平分点每年在地球上发生两次，但土星需要大约29.7个地球年才能绕太阳运行，所以这些事件更为罕见。

source_text: With the light from the Sun reaching Saturn's rings at such a low angle, scientists were able to measure the shadows cast by bumps on the rings and discover their surprising height.
target_text: 随着来自太阳的光线以如此低的角度到达土星环，科学家们能够测量环上凸起所产生的阴影并发现它们令人惊讶的高度。

source_text: As Cassini project scientist Bob Pappalardo put it: "It's like putting on 3-D glasses and seeing the third dimension for the first time."
target_text: 正如卡西尼项目的科学家鲍勃·帕帕拉多所说的那样：“这就像戴上三维眼镜，第一次看到第三个维度。”

source_text: "This is among the most important events Cassini has shown us."
target_text: “这是卡西尼向我们展示的最重要事件之一。”

source_text: Some of the ring features are known to be caused by Saturn's moons, but others are harder to explain.
target_text: 众所周知，有些环形特征是由土星的卫星造成的，但其他特征更难以解释。

source_text: "To understand what we are seeing will take more time, but the images and data will help develop a more complete understanding of how old the rings might be and how they are evolving," said Linda Spilker, Cassini deputy project scientist.
target_text: 卡西尼副项目科学家琳达·斯皮尔克说，“了解我们所看到的将会花费更多时间，但图像和数据将有助于更全面地了解光环的年龄和演变方式。”

source_text: Cassini was launched in 1997, and entered orbit around Saturn in 2004.
target_text: 卡西尼号于1997年发射升空，于2004年进入土星轨道。

source_text: It is part of the Cassini-Huygens joint mission between NASA, the European Space Agency and the Italian Space Agency.
target_text: 这是美国宇航局、欧洲航天局和意大利航天局联合执行的卡西尼-惠更斯任务的一部分。

source_text: Ballots are being counted in Sri Lanka, after a presidential election was held there, the first after the Tamil Tiger rebels were defeated during a 25-year-long civil war.
target_text: 在总统大选举行后，斯里兰卡正在计算选票，这是泰米尔猛虎组织在长达25年的内战中被击败后的第一次选举。

source_text: The incumbent president, Mahinda Rajapaksa, is expected to be in a close race against former army chief, General Sarath Fonseka; both candidates say they expect to win.
target_text: 现任总统马欣达·拉贾帕克萨预计将与前陆军总司令萨拉特·丰塞卡将军展开激烈的竞选。两位候选人都说他们希望获胜。

source_text: There are twenty other candidates on the ballot, but none of them are expected to win.
target_text: 选票上还有其他二十名候选人，但预计他们都不会获胜。

source_text: Polls closed at 16.00 local time, or 10.30 GMT on Tuesday.
target_text: 民意调查于当地时间16：00或周二格林尼治标准时间10：30结束。

source_text: There were claims of voter intimidation and sporadic acts of violence, and the BBC reports that there were some small bomb blasts.
target_text: 有人称选民受到恐吓，还有零星的暴力行为，英国广播公司报道说有一些小型炸弹爆炸。

source_text: The independent operating organisation Centre for Monitoring Election Violence said it had confirmed close to a hundred violent incidents during the day, adding that it believes the number could rise to 150.
target_text: 独立操作监督选举暴力的组织中心表示，它已证实民主变革运动期间发生了近100起暴力事件，并补充称，该组织认为暴力事件数量可能升至150起。

source_text: "I have been voting at this booth for over 20 years but never saw a crowd like this," said businessman Mohamed Sallel, who had voted in the Borella district of the capital, as quoted by The Telegraph.
target_text: “我已经在这个屋子里投票超过20年，但从未见过像这样的人群，”据“每日电讯报”引述在首都博雷拉区投票的商人穆罕默德·萨丽尔所说。

source_text: Another voter, Doctor Nimalka Perera, gave an account of the crowds: "When I first came here, the queue was too long so I went back and came two hours later on my way to the hospital and found the line even longer."
target_text: 另一位选民倪默卡·佩雷拉医生描述了人群情况：“当我第一次来到这里时，队列太长了，所以我回去了，两小时后返回医院的途中发现这条队列更长。”

source_text: President Rajapakse, after voting in his home constituency, addressed reporters.
target_text: 拉贾帕克塞总统在他的家乡选区投票后对记者发表了讲话。

source_text: "We must be ready to face the challenges of reaching new heights after this vote," he said.
target_text: 他说，“我们必须准备好迎接这次投票达到新高度的挑战。”

source_text: Fonseka, however, wasn't able to cast a ballot, apparently because his name didn't appear on the 2008 electroral register used for the elections.
target_text: 然而，丰塞卡无法投票，显然是因为他的名字没有出现在用于选举的2008年电子登记册上。

source_text: "My name is not on the 2008 register and therefore I cannot vote at this election."
target_text: “我的名字不在2008年的登记簿上，因此我不能在这次选举中投票。”

source_text: "The government is trying to use this to mislead the public at the last minute," Fonseka stated, saying that he had filled out his voter registration forms.
target_text: “政府正试图利用这一点在最后一分钟误导公众，”丰塞卡说，他说他填写了选民登记表。

source_text: "We are seeking a court order on the suitability of this candidate because he is not eligible to be declared as a candidate," Bogollagama said, adding that the government wanted a ruling from the courts.
target_text: 罗希塔·波格拉加马说：“我们正在就这名候选人的适合性寻求法院命令，因为他没有资格被宣布成为候选人。”他补充说，政府希望法院作出裁决。

source_text: Independent elections commissioner Dayananda Dissanayake, however, remarked: "Not having one's name on the electoral list is not a disqualification."
target_text: 然而，独立选举专员达耶难陀·迪萨纳亚克说：“选举名单上没有一个人的名字并不是取消资格。”

source_text: The country's electoral rules state that if neither candidate is able to obtain half of the ballots cast in the first count, then voters' second preferences are to be used to determine the winner.
target_text: 该国的选举规则规定，如果两位候选人都没有能够获得第一次计票中的半数投票，那么选民的第二选择将用于确定获胜者。

source_text: Political observers commented that election was too close to call between the two.
target_text: 政治观察家评论说，选举结果太接近，两者很难分出胜负。

source_text: Susan G. Komen for the Cure has stopped funding breast cancer screening and educational programming on breast health run by fellow US-charity Planned Parenthood and its affiliates.
target_text: 苏珊·G·科曼的治疗研究所已停止资助乳腺癌筛查和美国慈善机构亲子计划及其附属机构开展的乳房健康教育计划。

source_text: The Komen institute cites an ongoing investigation, while Planned Parenthood blame political pressures.
target_text: 科曼研究所引用了一项正在进行的调查，而亲子计划则指责政治压力。

source_text: Planned Parenthood received nearly 700,000 from the Komen Foundation last year alone.
target_text: 仅去年一年，亲子计划就从科曼基金会获得了近70万。

source_text: In the last five years, the funding from the foundation has granted 170,000 women breast exams.
target_text: 在过去五年中，该基金会已经为170,000名女性乳房检查提供了资金。

source_text: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.
target_text: 科曼基金会发言人莱斯利·奥恩表示，该组织采用了一项新规定，不允许向正在接受法律调查的组织提供补助金或资金。

source_text: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.
target_text: 科曼的政策取消了亲子计划的资格，原因是有关亲子计划如何花费并报告由克里夫·斯登代表执行的资金的未决调查。

source_text: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.
target_text: 斯特恩斯正在调查税收是否用于通过亲子计划协会为监管和调查小组委员会主席提供资金，该小组委员会由众议院能源和商业委员会负责。

source_text: "While it is regrettable when changes in priorities and policies affect any of our grantees, such as a longstanding partner like Planned Parenthood, we must continue to evolve to best meet the needs of the women we serve and most fully advance our mission," Aun said.
target_text: 奥恩说过，“虽然优先事项和政策的变化会影响我们的任何受助者，例如亲子计划的长期合作伙伴，但我们必须继续发展以最好地满足我们所服务的女性的需求，并最充分地推进我们的使命。”

source_text: Cecile Richards, president of Planned Parenthood, said, "While this is deeply disturbing and disappointing, we want to assure women who rely on Planned Parenthood for breast care that we're still here for them, and we always will be. "
target_text: 亲子计划的总裁塞西尔·理查兹说：“虽然这令人非常不安和令人失望，但我们希望向那些依赖亲子计划的女性提供乳房护理服务，我们仍然会为她们服务，而且我们将永远如此。”

source_text: Global warming campaigner and former U.S. Vice President Al Gore says it is time for humanity to stop "waging war" on planet Earth.
target_text: 全球变暖活动家和前美国副总统戈尔说，现在是人类停止在地球上“发动战争”的时候了。

source_text: Gore spoke today in Oslo after receiving the Nobel Peace Prize.
target_text: 戈尔今天在奥斯陆获得诺贝尔和平奖后发表讲话。

source_text: He urged the two largest carbon-emitting countries - the United States and China - to make what he called the "boldest moves" to fight global warming.
target_text: 他敦促两个最大的碳排放国家-美国和中国-做出他所谓的“大胆举动”来应对全球变暖。

source_text: The United States has not ratified the Kyoto Protocol, the 1997 international pact that requires reductions in greenhouse gas emissions.
target_text: 美国尚未批准1997年的国际协定“京都议定书”，该议定书要求减少温室气体排放。

source_text: China was not required to reduce emissions under the deal.
target_text: 根据协议，中国无需减少排放。

source_text: They also refused today to approve a new treaty designed to cut emissions by 25 percent to 40 percent by 2020.
target_text: 他们今天还拒绝批准一项旨在到2020年将排放量减少25％至40％的新条约。

source_text: Gore said he would go to the U.N. climate meeting in Bali later this week to urge world leaders to meet as often as every three months to enact a global cap on greenhouse gas emissions by 2010.
target_text: 戈尔表示，他稍后将于本周前往巴厘岛举行联合国气候会议，敦促世界各国领导人每三个月召开一次会议，以便在2010年之前制定全球温室气体排放上限。

source_text: Gore shared the 2007 Nobel prize with the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, represented at today's ceremony by Rajendra Pachauri.
target_text: 戈尔与政府间气候变化专家小组分享了2007年诺贝尔奖，该小组由拉金德拉·帕乔里在今天的仪式上代表。

source_text: Pachauri stressed the link between the fight against climate change and peace.
target_text: 帕乔里强调了应对气候变化与和平之间的联系。

source_text: He warned that severe climate change will trigger what he called "dramatic population migration," as well as war over water and other resources.
target_text: 他警告说，严重的气候变化将引发他所谓的“人口大规模迁移”，以及对水和其他资源的战争。

source_text: He also warned that up to 250 million people in Africa could face what he called "increased water stress because of climate change."
target_text: 他还警告说，非洲有多达2.5亿人可能面临他所谓的“因气候变化而增加的水资源压力”。

source_text: India's first lunar mission, the Chandrayaan-1 (meaning 'moon craft' in Sanskrit), reached its destined lunar orbit on Wednesday.
target_text: 印度的第一个月球任务月船-1（意为梵语中的“月球船”）于周三到达其预定的月球轨道。

source_text: It is now in a circular orbit 102 kilometres from the Moon.
target_text: 它现在处于离月球102公里的圆形轨道上。

source_text: It will stay in this orbit for two years and conduct various experiments to gain a better understanding of the Moon.
target_text: 它将在这个轨道上停留两年并进行各种实验以更好地了解月球。

source_text: According to Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) officials, the Moon Impact Probe (MIP), with an Indian flag painted on it, will be dropped late tonight.
target_text: 印度空间研究组织（印度空间研究组织）官员表示，月球撞击探测器（MIP）上印有印度国旗，将于今晚降落。

source_text: The MIP has a mass of 29 kg and it will take 20 minutes to reach the moon's surface.
target_text: 月球撞击探测器的质量为29千克，到达月球表面需要20分钟。

source_text: Two explosions were heard in the city of La Paz, Bolivia on Tuesday night, March 22 and in the early morning Wednesday, March 23.
target_text: 3月22日星期二晚上和3月23日星期三凌晨，玻利维亚拉巴斯市发生两起爆炸事件。

source_text: The first occurred at the Linares Motel, at 21:50 (01:50 UTC), and left two people dead and four injured.
target_text: 第一次发生在利纳雷斯汽车旅馆，时间是21：50（格林威治标准时间01：50），造成两人死亡，四人受伤。

source_text: Hours later, two suspects in the crime were arrested by the police in the city of El Alto.
target_text: 几小时后，两名犯罪嫌疑人在阿尔托市被警方逮捕。

source_text: They were American Claudio Lestat, approximately 30 years old (25 according to some sources) and his partner, Uruguayan Alda Ribeiros, of 35 years (40 according to other sources).
target_text: 他们是美国人克劳迪奥·列斯达，大约30岁（根据一些消息来源说是25岁）和他的同伙，乌拉圭人艾达·里贝罗，35岁（根据其他消息来源是40岁）。

source_text: Dynamite was used in both explosions, according to government attorney Jorge Gutiérrez.
target_text: 根据政府律师豪尔赫·古铁雷斯的说法，炸药被用于两次爆炸。

source_text: President Evo Morales indicated that the promoters of the incidents were "industrialists" and "oligarchists" who, "using external agents", claimed to halt the reforms that have been happening in Bolivia.
target_text: 埃沃·莫拉莱斯总统表示，这些事件的推动者是“工业家”和“寡头主义者”，他们“使用外部代理人”声称停止了玻利维亚正在进行的改革。

source_text: However, authorities have not ruled out religious motives, because Lestat is a self-proclaimed "minister of pagan rites".
target_text: 然而，当局并没有排除宗教动机，因为莱斯特是一位自称为“异教仪式的部长”。

source_text: Police also announced that the Chilean consulate in the Bolivian capital was also a target, to be attacked on Saturday the 25th.
target_text: 警方还宣布，玻利维亚首都的智利领事馆也是目标，将于周六25日遭到袭击。

source_text: The United States House of Representatives on June 29 passed a $1.17 billion funding bill for Amtrak in fiscal year 2006, an amount that is still short of the $2 billion Amtrak was originally seeking.
target_text: 美国众议院于2006年6月29日为美国国家铁路客运公司2006财年通过了一项11.7亿美元的资金法案，但该金额能没有达到美国国家铁路客运公司最初寻求的20亿美元的要求。

source_text: The House also removed the requirement in the bill that would mandate Amtrak to end passenger train service on currently unprofitable routes.
target_text: 众议院还取消了该法案中的要求，该要求将要求美国铁路终止目前无利可图路线上的旅客列车服务。

source_text: The People's Republic of China (PRC) in recent years has begun an effort to reform its judicial system and make trials more fair and accountable, according to its state-run People's Daily.
target_text: 据中国人民日报报道，为使审判更加公平和负责，近年来，中华人民共和国（PRC）已开始努力改革其司法制度。

source_text: Those efforts came to a head today with the official May 1 start of jury duty by more than 27,000 newly qualified jurors.
target_text: 今天，由于超过27,000名新合格陪审员在5月1日开始担任陪审团职务，使得这些努力达到了顶峰。

source_text: According to People's Daily, "It is the first time in Chinese history that the people's juries are appointed in a uniformed way by the people's congresses at all levels."
target_text: 据“人民日报”报道称，“这是中国历史上第一次人民陪审团是由各级人民代表大会以穿着制服方式任命的。”

source_text: Two jurors and a judge will be sitting on each three-person panel, and decide both criminal and civil cases.
target_text: 两名陪审员和一名法官将坐在每个三人小组，并决定刑事和民事案件。

source_text: The juries will be available when requested by litigants and also in cases "with considerable social repercussions", which appears to mean major cases.
target_text: 当诉讼人提出要求时，以及“具有相当大的社会影响”的情况下，陪审团都是可用的，这似乎意味着重大案件。

source_text: The jurors are not chosen for each trial but will serve a five-year term in the jury pool working on different cases from time to time.
target_text: 陪审员不是为每次审判而被选中，而是将在陪审团中任职五年，不时处理不同的案件。

source_text: Jurors have been provided for in the Chinese Constitution since 1954, but their role in the system was not well-defined by law until now.
target_text: 自1954年以来，中国宪法一直提及陪审员，但直到现在，他们在法律中的角色尚未得到明确定义。

source_text: The changes to the jury system are part of a long-term planned reform of China's judicial system that was announced in 1999 by China's top judge, Xiao Yang.
target_text: 陪审团制度的变化是中国司法系统长期计划改革的一部分，该改革由中国最高法官肖扬于1999年宣布。

source_text: In addition to jury reforms, the plan addressed trial procedures and court structure and supervision.
target_text: 除了陪审团改革，该计划还涉及审判程序和法院结构和监督。

source_text: The goal was to "perfect the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics...in accordance with the Constitution and laws, and [without] judicial independence and supremacy, which exist in many Western countries," according to Xiao Yang as reported by the People's Daily in 1999.
target_text: 根据1999年人民日报中肖扬的说法，目标是“完善中国特色的社会主义司法制度……符合宪法和法律，以及【没有】司法独立和至高无上的地位，这存在于许多西方国家。”

source_text: "Court reform represents a major part of China's reform of the judicial system and political restructuring."
target_text: “法院改革是中国司法制度改革和政治体制改革的重要组成部分。”

source_text: The essence of judicial reform is judicial fairness, which is crucial to the country's rule of law," Xiao Yang said back then.
target_text: 当时肖扬说，“司法改革的实质是司法公正，这对国家的法治至关重要。”

source_text: In August 2004, the 10th National People's Congress (NPC) Standing Committee approved a "resolution on improving the people's jury system", which took effect today.
target_text: 2004年8月，第十届全国人大常委会通过了“关于改善人民陪审员制度的决议”，该决议于今天生效。

source_text: The system specifies that either by recommendation of local work units or by self-application, potential jurors can take qualifying examinations and be presented to standing committees of the NPC for appointment as jurors.
target_text: 该系统规定，无论是通过当地工作单位的推荐还是通过自我申请，潜在的陪审员都可以参加资格考试，并被提交给全国人大常委会任命为陪审员。

source_text: The first batch of 1,342 jurors were tested in Beijing under the new law on April 23, 2005.
target_text: 根据新法，2005年4月23日，首批1,342名陪审员在北京接受了测试。

source_text: Those who were certified to begin service on May 1 are said to "participate in all hearing activities of people's courts according to the law, enjoying the same rights as do the judges except that for a presiding judge after their assumption of the post," according to the People's Daily.
target_text: 人民日报称，那些被证明可以在5月1日开始服务的人被称为“依法参与人民法院的所有听证活动，享有与法官相同的权利，但主审法官在担任该职位后享有同样的权利，”。

source_text: The implementation of the NPC's decision will add more transparency and justness to the country's judicial system, he added.
target_text: 他补充说，全国人大决定的实施将增加国家司法系统的透明度和公正性。

source_text: China has one of the world's largest prison systems with over 1 million prisoners, similar to Russia.
target_text: 中国拥有世界上最大的监狱系统之一，拥有100多万名囚犯，与俄罗斯相似。

source_text: It has received criticism over the years from the U.S. State Department and others for its arbitrariness and its treatment of political prisoners.
target_text: 多年来，美国国务院和其他组织因其任意性和政治犯待遇受到了批评。

source_text: The United States, however, is the world's largest jailer, with a staggering 2 million prison inmates, out of 9 million total around the entire globe.
target_text: 然而，美国是世界上最大的狱卒，惊人的拥有200万监狱囚犯，而全球总共有900万囚犯。

source_text: The newly formed Icelandic coalition interim government will take office today, according to a coalition leader.
target_text: 据联盟领导人称，新成立的冰岛联盟临时政府将于今天上任。

source_text: On January 27, it was announced that the nation's coalition government had collapsed and dissolved following a banking financial crisis.
target_text: 1月27日，该国的联合政府在银行业金融危机后被宣布垮台并解散。

source_text: In October of 2008, Iceland's banking sector collapsed and was largely nationalised.
target_text: 2008年10月，冰岛的银行业崩溃，并在很大程度上被国有化。

source_text: Iceland's interest rate is now 18%, with GDP expected to fall 9.6% this year.
target_text: 冰岛的利率目前为18％，今年国内生产总值预计将下降9.6％。

source_text: Just before the announcement of the government taking office, nearly 1,500 people were protesting outside the parliament building over the collapsed government and the recent financial crisis, but protesters seemed happy about the change.
target_text: 就在宣布政府上任之前，近1500名议员在议会大楼外抗议政府倒台和最近的金融危机，但抗议者似乎对这一变化感到高兴。

source_text: Therefore "today is a celebration," said protest organizer Hordur Torfason to the crowd who were cheering about hearing the news.
target_text: 因此，抗议活动组织者豪多·托法森在对听到这个消息而欢呼雀跃的人群说道，“今天是庆祝活动”。

source_text: The new minority coalition will consist of Jóhanna's Social Democratic Alliance and the Left-Green Movement with backing from the Progressive Party.
target_text: 新的少数民族联盟将由约翰娜的社会民主联盟和左翼绿色运动组成，并得到进步党的支持。

source_text: He criticizes her appointment because he believes she will not help the economic crisis, resulting in more government spending.
target_text: 他批评她的任命，因为他认为她不会对经济危机有帮助，会导致更多的政府支出。

source_text: The quick appointment of the new government also means an early election, which is scheduled to take place on April 25.
target_text: 新政府的快速任命也意味着选举计划提前到4月25日举行。

source_text: According to a press release today from the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, there are seven films in contention for the "Academy Award for Makeup".
target_text: 根据电影艺术与科学学院今天发布的新闻报道，有七部电影争夺“奥斯卡最佳化妆奖”。

source_text: Ten minutes of each film will be screened for the Academy's Makeup Award Nominating Committee on Saturday, January 20, 2006.
target_text: 2006年1月20日星期六当天，将为化妆奖提名委员会放映，每部电影有十分钟的放映时间。

source_text: This list will then be voted on by the entire Academy.
target_text: 该名单将由整个学院投票表决。

source_text: The 79th Academy Awards will honor the outstanding film achievements of 2006.
target_text: 第79届奥斯卡颁奖典礼将颁发2006年优秀电影成就。

source_text: The ceremony is scheduled for Sunday, February 25, 2007, at the Kodak Theatre at Hollywood & Highland Center.
target_text: 仪式定于2007年2月25日星期日，在好莱坞和高地中心的柯达剧院举行。

source_text: Abdullah Gül, current deputy prime minister and foreign minister of Turkey, has been named as the new presidential candidate by his party, the Justice and Development Party (AKP).
target_text: 现任副总理兼土耳其外交部长阿卜杜拉·古尔被其党派正义与发展党任命为新总统候选人。

source_text: In Turkey, the parliament votes to elect the new President of Turkey.
target_text: 在土耳其，议会投票选举土耳其新总统。

source_text: The AKP has 353 of the 550 seats in Grand National Assembly of Turkey.
target_text: 正义与发展党拥有土耳其大国民议会550个席位中的353个。

source_text: The main opposition party, the Republican People's Party (CHP), hinted that it may nominate its own candidate to challenge Gül.
target_text: 作为主要反对党，共和人民党暗示可能会提名自己的候选人来挑战古尔。

source_text: A British church group has defended a city mosque accused of "extremism", following an investigation by Channel 4 television.
target_text: 在第四频道电视台调查后，一个英国教会团体为一个被指控为“极端主义”的城市清真寺辩护。

source_text: The Saltley Gate Peace Group, an interfaith organisation based in Birmingham, has expressed "its undiminished support" for the Green Lane Masjid, featured in Channel 4's investigative Dispatches programme shown on Monday 15 January.
target_text: 位于伯明翰的跨信仰组织，萨特利门和平组织已经表达了对绿道马西德“丝毫不减的支持”，这在该频道1月15日星期一第4频道播出的深度调查新闻报道节目中得到体现。

source_text: While filming Undercover Mosque, a secret Dispatches reporter attended lectures at mosques run by key organisations whose public faces are presented as "moderate and mainstream" - but is believed to discover "preachers condemning the idea of integration into British society".
target_text: 在拍摄《揭秘清真寺》时，一名《新闻报道》的秘密记者参加了由主要组织在清真寺举办的讲座，这些组织的公众面孔被称为“温和和主流”，但人们相信发现了“传教士谴责融入英国社会的想法”。

source_text: Programme makers claim the documentary, filmed and written by journalist Bobby Pathak, reveals "a number of mosques run by high profile national organisations that claim to be dedicated to moderation and dialogue with other faiths" but are in fact spreading "a message of religious bigotry and extremism".
target_text: 节目制作人声称这部由记者鲍比·帕沙克拍摄和制作的纪录片揭示了“一些高调经营清真寺的国家组织，这些组织声称致力于与其他信仰的节制和对话”，但事实上正在传播“宗教偏见的信息和极端主义”。

source_text: It is deeply alarming that a few sentences have been taken out of context in order to create the impression that our institution is a hotbed of fanaticism they could have approached us directly - we operate an open door policy in our mosques.
target_text: 令人深感震惊的是，有几句话被断章取义，目的是制造一种印象，即我们的机构是狂热主义的温床，他们本可以直接接近我们，我们在清真寺实行门户开放政策。

source_text: The mosque explained, "We would like to make it clear that Markazi Jamiat Ahl-e-Hadith cannot be regarded as endorsing every word uttered by every speaker we invite to our various mosques.」
target_text: 清真寺解释道。“我们要明确指出，不能把玛卡齐雅米阿-伊-圣训视为赞同我们邀请的每一位演讲者在各种场合所说的每一句话。

source_text: Islam commands us to respond in kind to those who desire peaceful co-existence.
target_text: 伊斯兰教命令我们对那些渴望和平共处的人作出回应。

source_text: "If anyone contradicts this teaching then we would repudiate their views without hesitation."
target_text: “如果有人反驳这种教导，那么我们会毫不犹豫地否定他们的观点。”

source_text: A similar opinion was echoed in a statement from the Saltley Gate Peace Group.
target_text: 萨特利门和平组织的一份声明也回应了类似的意见。

source_text: The community action project, based at the Saltley Methodist Church, feared the community around the mosque would be ostracized as a result of the investigation.
target_text: 位于萨特利卫理公会教堂的社区行动项目，担心由于调查，导致清真寺周围的社区将被排斥。

source_text: "We cannot speak for the views of specific individuals featured in the film but are completely in support of the good nature of the mosque's diverse, multiracial and peaceful worshippers and administration."
target_text: “我们不能代表电影中特定个人的观点，但完全支持清真寺多元化，多种族和平的信徒和行政管理的良好性质。”

source_text: "It is our hope that more resources will be spent on preventing true radical groups from brainwashing young Muslims and less time spent on demonising the general Muslim population for the actions of a select few," they added.
target_text: 他们补充说：“我们希望能有更多的资源用于防止真正的激进团体洗脑年轻的穆斯林，并花费更少的时间用于将少数人的行为妖魔化普通穆斯林人口。”

source_text: Israel's Central Election Committee voted yesterday to disqualify two Arab political parties from running in the country's general elections scheduled for February 10th.
target_text: 以色列中央选举委员会昨天投票决定取消两个阿拉伯政党参加2月10日举行的全国大选。

source_text: Tibi condemned the ruling saying, "It was a political trial led by a group of fascists and racists who are willing to see the Knesset without Arabs and want to see the country without Arabs."
target_text: 蒂比谴责这一裁决说：“这是一个由一群法西斯主义者和种族主义者领导的政治审判，他们希望看到没有阿拉伯人的议会，并希望看到没有阿拉伯人的国家。”

source_text: Arabs constitute one fifth of the population in Israel but only have twelve of 120 parliamentary seats.
target_text: 阿拉伯人占以色列人口的五分之一，但只有120个议会席位中的12个。

source_text: Other parties associated with the Arab-Israeli minority, such as Hadash, are not affected by the committee's decision.
target_text: 与阿拉伯、以色列少数民族有关的其他组织，如哈达什，不受委员会决定的影响。

source_text: Israel's High Court of Justice reversed a similar attempt to ban Balad in 2003, and has until Friday to rule on yesterday's votes.
target_text: 以色列高等法院在2003年撤销了类似的禁止巴拉德的企图，直到周五才对昨天的选票作出裁决。

source_text: Wildfires in California continued to spread on Tuesday, having burned more than 140,000 acres of land throughout the state and caused an estimated US$13 million worth of damage.
target_text: 加利福尼亚州的野火在周二继续蔓延，已经在该州烧毁了超过14万英亩的土地，造成了价值约1300万美元的损失。

source_text: The blaze started burning last Wednesday north of Los Angeles.
target_text: 大火于上周三在洛杉矶以北开始燃烧。

source_text: Emergency crews said they were hopeful that they would be able to control the fire.
target_text: 紧急救援人员表示，他们希望能够控制火势。

source_text: Currently, twenty-two percent of the blaze is contained, rising from only five percent as little as a day ago.
target_text: 目前，百分之二十二的火焰被遏制，而一天之前仅有百分之五。

source_text: Changing weather conditions also helped firefighting efforts, as temperature in the area fell to 90 degrees Fahrenheit, down from over a hundred degrees on Monday.
target_text: 不断变化的天气条件也有助于消防工作，因为该地区的气温从周一的100多华氏度下降到90华氏度。

source_text: "I'm feeling a lot more optimistic today than I did yesterday."
target_text: “我感觉今天比昨天更乐观。”

source_text: "The crews are doing fabulous work out there on the ground, but the bottom line is that they're fighting for every foot," Dietrich said on Tuesday.
target_text: 迪特里希周二表示，“全体工作人员在地面上做了很棒的工作，但最重要的是他们为每一寸土地而战。”

source_text: In a statement, Californian governor Arnold Schwarzenegger said that "[his administration] is working around the clock to ensure that our brave men and women working on the fires front lines have the resources needed to respond and beat back these fires as quickly as possible."
target_text: 加利福尼亚州州长阿诺德·施瓦辛格在一份声明中表示，“【他的政府】正在全天候工作，以确保我们在火线前线工作的勇敢的工作人员拥有应对和尽快击退这些火灾所需的资源。”

source_text: "We have the toughest and best-trained firefighters in the world fighting to protect public safety and property."
target_text: “我们拥有世界上最坚韧，最训练有素的消防员，他们致力于保护公共安全和财产。”

source_text: "I am confident in the state's response as these fires continue to burn throughout California," he said.
target_text: 他说，“即使这些火灾继续在整个加利福尼亚燃烧，但我对该州的反应充满信心。”

source_text: Two firefighters were killed in the blaze on Sunday, after fires burnt their vehicle on front lines.
target_text: 星期天，两名消防队员在火灾中丧生，随后大火在火线上烧毁了他们的车辆。

source_text: Over 10,000 residents have evacuated areas threatened by the flames.
target_text: 超过10,000名居民从火焰威胁区撤离。

source_text: Alabama Gov. Bob Riley beat back a Republican primary challenge from Roy Moore, the former judge who tried to put up a Ten Commandments monument in his courthouse.
target_text: 阿拉巴马州州长鲍勃·莱利击败了前法官罗伊·摩尔的共和党初选挑战，他试图在他的法院建立一个十诫纪念碑。

source_text: In the weeks leading to Alabama's gubernatorial primaries, polls showed Riley had pulled ahead of Moore, the former state chief justice who became a hero to the religious right in 2003 when he was ousted over his refusal to remove a 5,300-pound Ten Commandments monument from the state judicial building.
target_text: 在阿拉巴马州州长初选的前几周。民意调查显示，赖利领先于摩尔。摩尔是佛罗里达州州长，2003年因拒绝从国家司法大楼上移走一枚5300英镑的十诫纪念碑而被赶下台，成为宗教右翼的英雄。

source_text: Moore conceded in his hometown of Gadsden, telling supporters, "God's will has been done."
target_text: 摩尔在他的家乡加兹登承认，告诉支持者，“上帝的旨意已经完成。”

source_text: Gale force winds ripped through Sydney and the South Coast of New South Wales late on Saturday night, causing widespread damage and extensive power outages, with up to 30,000 homes going without electricity at one point.
target_text: 星期六晚上，强风席卷悉尼和新南威尔士南海岸，造成大面积破坏和大面积断电，多达30,000户家庭停电。

source_text: The State Emergency Service (SES) has responded to over 800 calls for help to repair damage caused by the storms, however the storms have subsided somewhat and flood warnings around Bega and Moruya have been withdrawn.
target_text: 国家紧急服务中心回应了800多次呼救，以帮助修复风暴造成的损害，但风暴已经有所减弱，贝加和莫拉瓦周围的洪水警告已被解除。

source_text: The Los Angeles City Attorney's Office said yesterday that pop music super-star Britney Spears was facing charges for a hit and run offence and driving without a valid drivers' license.
target_text: 洛杉矶市检察官办公室昨天表示，流行音乐超级明星布兰妮·斯皮尔斯面临着一场肇事逃逸和没有有效的驾驶执照驾车的指控。

source_text: Charges were filed following an accident in which police allege Spears smashed her car into another vehicle in a parking area in August of 2007.
target_text: 警方称，斯皮尔斯于2007年8月将她的车撞到了停车场的另一辆车，事故发生后，被提出了指控罪名。

source_text: A group of paparazzi recorded a video Britney steering her car into another vehicle on August 6 as she tried to pull into a parking spot in a Studio City lot.
target_text: 一群狗仔队录制了一段布兰妮于8月6日驾驶她的车撞上另一辆车的视频，因为她试图进入影视城的一个停车位。

source_text: Kim Robard-Rifkin was the owner of the other car and she filed a police report three days after the accident.
target_text: 吉姆·罗巴德·里夫金是另一辆车的车主，她在事故发生三天后提交了一份警方报告。

source_text: The 59-year-old nurse found out that it was Spears who ran into her car after watching a video on a celebrity website.
target_text: 这位59岁的护士是在名人网站上观看视频后发现是斯皮尔斯撞了她的车。

source_text: Robard-Rifkin said, "I simply want my car fixed, the same as I would fix somebody's car if I had done that."
target_text: 罗巴德·里夫金说，“我只是想把我的车停在那里，就像我把别人的车停下来一样，如果我这么做过的话。”

source_text: The United States Department of Homeland Security (DHS) is deploying its new Homeland Security Information Network - Secret (HSIN-Secret) in all 50 state Emergency Operations Centers as well as 18 additional state and local law enforcement sites.
target_text: 美国国土安全部正在所有50个州的紧急行动中心以及另外18个州和地方执法站点部署其新的国土安全信息秘密网络。

source_text: The secret network is a component of the HSIN, which is the primary conduit for DHS to share information on terrorist threats, suspicious activity and incident management with state, local, tribal and private-sector officials.
target_text: 秘密网络是网络信息安全的一个组成部分，网络信息安全是美国国土安全部与州，地方，部落和私营部门官员分享恐怖威胁，可疑活动和事件管理信息的主要渠道。

source_text: Development on this $350 million system by Northrop Grumman Corporation was begun in March of 2004 with basic operation achieved in just 4 months.
target_text: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司于2004年3月开始开发这个价值3.5亿美元的系统，仅用了4个月便实现了基本操作。

source_text: "The Homeland is more secure when each hometown is more secure," said Secretary of Homeland Security Tom Ridge in DHS's February 24, 2004 press release that launched the program.
target_text: 国土安全部部长汤姆·里奇在2004年2月24日发布该计划的新闻发布会上说道，“当每个家乡更加安全时，国土会更加安全。”

source_text: Future program expansion will include the county level, communication at the classified SECRET level, and the involvement of the private sector.
target_text: 未来的扩展计划将包括县级，分类秘密级别的交流以及私营部门的覆盖。

source_text: With the "Secret" component in place, classified information can now be disseminated to authorized individuals at all levels of government and business throughout the country almost instantly.
target_text: 随着“秘密”组件的到位，现在几乎可以立即将分类信息传播给全国各级政府和企业的授权人员。

source_text: Internal policies and the judgement of the system's users provide privacy and civil rights protections, while who can access the system is determined by DHS.
target_text: 内部政策和系统用户的判断提供隐私和民权保护，而谁可以访问系统由美国国土安全部来决定。

source_text: The great-granddaughter of former South Africa President Nelson Mandela has died in a car crash following a concert to open the World Cup.
target_text: 前南非总统纳尔逊·曼德拉的曾孙女在一场世界杯开幕式音乐会后因车祸去世。

source_text: The Nelson Mandela Foundation released a statement which said that thirteen-year-old Zenani Mandela, who celebrated her birthday on June 9, died in a single vehicle accident and that no one else was injured.
target_text: 纳尔逊·曼德拉基金会发表声明说，13岁的泽尼亚·曼德拉于6月9日庆祝她的生日，然后在一次车祸中丧生，没有其他人受伤。

source_text: The statement continued: "The family has asked for privacy as they mourn this tragedy."
target_text: 声明继续说：“家人在哀悼这场悲剧时要求隐私。”

source_text: The driver of the vehicle of which Zenani Mandela was a passenger has been arrested and charged with drunk driving.
target_text: 泽尼亚·曼德拉乘坐的车辆司机已经被捕并被控酒后驾车。

source_text: He may also face culpable homicide charges, according to police.
target_text: 据警方称，他也可能面临判处刑事杀人罪。

source_text: South Africa has a poor road safety record and ranks ninth in the world for traffic fatalities.
target_text: 南非的道路安全记录很差，在交通事故死亡率方面排名世界第九。

source_text: Traffic safety is feared to be a threat of injury to supporters to the World Cup.
target_text: 人们担心交通安全会成为世界杯球迷受伤的威胁。

source_text: The Singapore Navy on Thursday warned of a possible pirate threat to ships passing through the Strait of Malacca after receiving a correspondence from an unnamed terrorist organization.
target_text: 新加坡海军周四警告说，在收到一个未透露姓名的恐怖组织的来信后，可能会对通过马六甲海峡的船只造成海盗威胁。

source_text: According to the Navy, the intent of the terrorists was to "achieve widespread publicity and showcase that they remain a viable group."
target_text: 根据海军的说法，恐怖分子的意图是“实现广泛的宣传并展示他们仍然是一个可行的团体。”

source_text: While the threat received covered only oil tankers, other large cargo ships were also at risk of attack, naval officials went on to say.
target_text: 海军官员接着说，虽然收到的威胁只涉及油轮，但其他大型货船也有遭受袭击的风险。

source_text: They also recommended that ships maintain a higher speed and report any unusual incidents to the proper authorities.
target_text: 他们还建议船舶保持较高的速度，并向有关当局报告任何异常事件。

source_text: The advisory said that past attacks in the Strait had been carried out by small vessels such as motorboats or fishing boats with armed crews.
target_text: 该通报称，海峡过去发生的袭击事件是由摩托艇或带有武装人员的渔船等小型船只进行的。

source_text: Commercial vessels were also warned to avoid known fishing areas accordingly.
target_text: 商业船只也被警告相应地避开已知的捕鱼区域。

source_text: The Singapore Navy said that it had contacted other countries in the area to warn them of the threat.
target_text: 新加坡海军表示已与该地区的其他国家联系，以警告他们这一威胁。

source_text: Both Indonesia and Malaysia have also announced plans to increase patrols in order to provide additional security.
target_text: 印度尼西亚和马来西亚都宣布计划增加巡逻，以提供额外的安全保障。

source_text: The Strait of Malacca is a major conduit for oil shipments.
target_text: 马六甲海峡是石油运输的主要渠道。

source_text: With around a third of global oil shipments passing through, it is the main route for travelling from the Middle East to Asia.
target_text: 全球约有三分之一的石油运输通过，这是从中东到亚洲运行的主要途径。

source_text: Any attack on vessels within the Strait would likely have a major ripple effect on global trade.
target_text: 任何对海峡内船只的袭击都可能对全球贸易产生连锁反应。

source_text: Pakistan's military has said that its soldiers killed twelve militants in recent operations targeting Taliban insurgents in South Waziristan.
target_text: 巴基斯坦军方说，在最近针对南瓦济里斯坦的塔利班叛乱分子的行动中，其士兵杀死了12名武装分子。

source_text: The military said security forces battled militants on Friday as they fought for control of Makeen, an area considered the main base of the Pakistani Taliban.
target_text: 军方表示，安全部队周五与武装分子进行了斗争，因为他们争取控制马凯恩，这个地区被认为是巴基斯坦塔利班的主要基地。

source_text: The military statement also says troops battled to tighten their control over Sararogha, which is another Taliban stronghold.
target_text: 军方声明还说，军队正在加紧控制萨拉罗格，这是塔利班的另一个据点。

source_text: The accounts of the Pakistan army's offensive in the tribal region near the Afghan border are difficult to verify, as journalists and aid workers are not allowed into the battle zone.
target_text: 巴基斯坦军队在阿富汗边境附近的部落地区的进攻难以核实，因为记者和援助工作者不被允许进入战区。

source_text: Pakistan launched an offensive against the Taliban last month in South Waziristan, an area that is believed to be a stronghold for rebels, and where the government does not have much influence.
target_text: 巴基斯坦上个月在南瓦济里斯坦发动了对塔利班的攻击，南瓦济里斯坦被认为是反叛分子的据点，而且那里的政府没有太大的影响力。

source_text: According to the Pakistani army, hundreds of militants were killed since the operation was launched, but the Taliban denies the claims.
target_text: 根据巴基斯坦军队的说法，自该行动开始以来已有数百名武装分子丧生，但塔利班否认了这一说法。

source_text: Health Minister Ben Bradshaw described the party's loss to the British National Party and to the Greens as a, "terrible loss" and blamed the economic conditions such as rising food and fuel costs as factors that dampens the Labour Party's appeal with the public.
target_text: 卫生部长本·布拉德肖将该党对英国国家党和绿党的损失描述为“可怕的损失”，并将例如食品和燃料成本上升等经济条件归咎于抑制工党对公众的吸引力。

source_text: Conservative Party leader David Cameron countered Bradshaw's opinion by saying, Mr. Brown was to blame for the economic distress.
target_text: 保守党领袖戴维•卡梅伦反驳布拉德肖的观点，称布朗应该为经济困境负责。

source_text: Cameron cited the Prime Minister's ten years of handling the economy as minister prior to assuming office when Tony Blair stepped down last year.
target_text: 卡梅伦引用了首相上任前处理经济问题的十大法宝。

source_text: Labour threw in their support with Richard McKenzie who only garnered 3% of the votes behind the BNP and Greens.
target_text: 工党向理查德·麦肯齐提供了支持，后者只获得了法国巴黎银行和绿党队3％的选票。

source_text: Henley called for an election when its representative Boris Johnson was elected Lord Mayor of the City of London.
target_text: 当其代表鲍里斯·约翰逊当选为伦敦市市长时，亨利呼吁举行大选。

source_text: The Australian Labor Party has appointed SLW Group to run it's advertisement campaign for the 2007 Australian Legislative Election.
target_text: 澳大利亚工党已任命SLW集团为2007年澳大利亚立法选举进行广告宣传。

source_text: SLW Group was successul in gaining the $10 million account it was revealed today.
target_text: SLW集团成功获得了今天公布的1000万美元账户。

source_text: The team dubbed "07" will be lead by senior executives, Luke Dunkerley and Neil Lawrence.
target_text: 被称为“07”的团队将由高级管理人员卢克·邓克利和尼尔·劳伦斯领导。

source_text: ALP campaign director Tim Gartell said that Lawrence had a wealth of experience with political campaigns, being part of the adveritsement team responsible for the election of a Victorian Labor government in the 1980s.
target_text: 新闻民意测试所竞选主管蒂姆·加特尔说，劳伦斯在政治竞选方面拥有丰富的经验，是负责在20世纪80年代选举维多利亚州工党政府的广告小组的一员。

source_text: He also added that Lawrence had worked on the campaign for election of Australian Republican Movement representatives to the Australian Constitutional Convention in 1998.
target_text: 他还补充说，劳伦斯曾参与竞选1998年澳大利亚共和党运动代表参加澳大利亚制宪会议的运动。

source_text: Present polling data from Newspoll suggests that the ALP is beginning to regain support in the electorate, narrowly polling a higher percentage of primary support since late October, 2005, ending almost 10 months of being behind John Howard's coalition government in polling.
target_text: 来自新闻民意测试所的现有民意调查数据表明，新闻民意测试所开始重新获得选民的支持，自2005年10月下旬以来勉强较高的民意初选支持率结束了近10个月落后于约翰·霍华德联合政府的民意支持。

source_text: A passenger train carrying at least 250 people, many of whom were children, derailed in Serbia-Montenegro and drove into a ravine Tuesday afternoon.
target_text: 周二下午，一列载有至少250人，其中许多是儿童的客运列车在塞尔维亚和黑山境内出轨，掉进了一个山谷中。

source_text: Close to 200 have been injured and the death toll has risen to 44.
target_text: 近200人受伤，死亡人数上升至44人。

source_text: Most of the passengers were schoolchildren returning from a ski trip.
target_text: 大多数乘客是从滑雪旅行返回的学童。

source_text: "The accident occurred because of a failure of the train's braking system," said Interior Minister Jusuf Kalomperovic.
target_text: 内政部长尤素夫·卡罗姆佩罗维奇说，“事故发生的原因是火车制动系统失灵。”

source_text: At about 4 p.m. the four-car train derailed near Bioče, a small village nearly 15 kilometers northeast of Podgorica as it was emerging from a tunnel above the Moraca River.
target_text: 下午4点左右，当它正从莫拉卡河上方的一条隧道中出现时，这列四车厢的火车在波德戈里察东北约15公里的一个小村庄比欧切附近出轨。

source_text: "The train simply went wild, out of control," said one injured passenger.
target_text: 一名受伤的乘客说：“火车简直是疯了，完全失控了。”

source_text: "It was horrible, I saw many dead and wounded around me," said another passenger from Hungary, Karman Chofu.
target_text: 另一名来自匈牙利的乘客卡曼·乔夫说，“这太可怕了，我看到很多人在我身边死伤。”

source_text: "I had fallen asleep when a loud noise woke me," said Stanislava Bukovic, 60, another injured passenger.
target_text: 另一名60岁的受伤乘客斯坦尼斯拉瓦·布科维奇说，“我被大声吵醒，我之前是睡着了的。”

source_text: Miodrag Djurovic, the head of the main Podgorica hospital, stated that another five passengers had died overnight.
target_text: 波德戈里察医院的主要负责人米奥德拉格·杜文峥表示，另外五名乘客在一夜之间死亡。

source_text: Djurovic also said at least 198 people, 90 of them children, have been treated at the hospital.
target_text: 德约洛维奇还说至少有198人，其中90人是儿童，已在医院接受治疗。

source_text: "The children's hospital admitted 90 children, 34 of them are still there, six have undergone surgery," Djurovic said.
target_text: 德约洛维奇说，“儿童医院收治了90名儿童，其中34人躺在那里，其中6人接受了手术。”

source_text: Earlier Deputy Prime Minister Miroslav Ivanisevic told the media that the death toll stood at 30 and the amount injured at 135, but said those figures could rise as rescuers continue to reach victims.
target_text: 早些时候副总理米罗斯拉夫·伊万尼塞维奇告诉媒体，死亡人数为30人，受伤人数为135人，但随着救援人员不断找到更多的受害者，这些数字可能会继续上升。

source_text: Ivanisevic described the wreck "as the worst rail accident in the history of Montenegro," Ivanisevic also said.
target_text: 伊万尼塞维奇称这起灾难“是黑山历史上最严重的铁路事故”。

source_text: President Filip Vujanovic and Prime Minister, Milo Djukanovic also rushed to the site.
target_text: 总统菲利普·武亚诺维奇和总理米洛·久卡诺维奇也冲到了现场。

source_text: Because of the accident, Montenegro's transport minister, Andrija Lompar, and National Railways chief Ranko Medenica resigned.
target_text: 由于这次事故，黑山的交通部长安德鲁·拉姆帕和国家铁路局局长兰科·莫丹尼卡辞职。

source_text: The driver of the train has been arrested because of suspicion of negligence.
target_text: 火车司机因涉嫌疏忽而被捕。

source_text: The train was heading from the northeastern town of Bijelo Polje to the Montenegrin coastal city of Bar.
target_text: 火车从东北部城镇比耶罗波列前往黑山沿海城市巴尔。

source_text: The international community has condemned the Fijian president's decision to abrogate the constitution.
target_text: 国际社会谴责斐济总统废除宪法的决定。

source_text: President Ratu Josefa Iloilo abrogated the country's constitution earlier today in response to a Court of Appeal decision declaring the removal of Prime Minister Laisenia Qarase and the appointment of military strongman Voreqe Bainimarama as interim Prime Minister unlawful.
target_text: 拉图·约瑟法·伊洛伊洛总统今天早些时候废除了该国的宪法，以回应上诉法院的裁决，宣布免去总理莱塞尼亚卡·拉塞的职务，并非法任命军事强人瓦雷泽·姆拜尼马拉马为临时总理。

source_text: Australian Prime Minister Kevin Rudd condemned the move, saying that it would take Fiji backwards.
target_text: 澳大利亚总理陆克文谴责这一举动，并表示这将使斐济倒退。

source_text: He called for the government to obey the court of appeal's ruling and hold elections promptly.
target_text: 他呼吁政府服从上诉法院的裁决并立即举行选举。

source_text: New Zealand Foreign Minister Murray McCully said that the abrogation of the constitution "will merely compound the problems faced by ordinary Fijians".
target_text: 新西兰外交部长默里·麦卡利表示，废除宪法“只会加剧普通斐济人面临的问题”。

source_text: "The President's decision, no doubt prompted by the Commodore, to override the constitution, sack the judges, and depend upon the military to keep an unlawful regime in power, will compound the already serious economic difficulties confronted by Fiji," McCully said.
target_text: 麦卡利说：“总统的决定，无疑是由准将提出的，推翻宪法，解雇法官，依靠军队维持非法政权，将加剧斐济面临的已经严重的经济困难。”

source_text: In a televised address this morning, President Iloilo abrogated the constitution, revoked all judicial appointments, and appointed himself as head of state.
target_text: 在今天上午的电视讲话中，伊洛总统废除了宪法，撤销了所有司法任命，并任命自己为国家元首。

source_text: He said he would appoint a new interim government in the coming days to implement the reforms of the People's Charter for Change, Peace and Progress and pave the way for "true democratic and parliamentary elections" to be held by September 2014.
target_text: 他表示，他将在未来的几天任命一个新的临时政府，以全面实施《人民宪章》的改革，促进变革，和平与进步，并为2014年9月份即将举行的“真正的民主和议会选举”铺平道路。

source_text: Fiji's government was overthrown by a military coup in 2006.
target_text: 斐济政府在2006年被军事政变推翻。

source_text: A letter that had been written in 1988 by Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini, who led the 1979 Iranian Revolution and is Iran's former Supreme Leader has been made public by Iran's former president Hashemi Rafsanjani and states that Iran needed to acquire nuclear weapons in an attempt to win the war with Iraq.
target_text: 伊朗前总统哈塞米·拉夫桑贾尼公布了1979年伊朗革命领导人，伊朗前任最高领导人阿亚图拉·鲁霍拉·霍梅尼于1988年写的一封信，并称伊朗需要获得核武器才能赢得伊拉克战争。

source_text: The letter was reportadly sent to "political leaders" while the Iran-Iraq war was taking place.
target_text: 据报道，在伊朗和伊拉克战争正在进行的同时，这封信被发送给“政治领导人”。

source_text: BBC News says the letter states what would be needed if Iran was willing to continue any battle with the country of Iraq.
target_text: 英国广播公司新闻说，这封信说明，如果伊朗愿意继续与伊拉克国家进行任何战斗，他们将需要什么。

source_text: Khomeini says that "more aircraft, helicopters, men and weapons" would be needed to continue the fight and that "within five years, need laser-guided and atomic weapons in order to win the war" with Iraq.
target_text: 霍梅尼说，“需要更多的战斗机，直升机，人员和武器”才能继续战斗，并且“在五年之内，配备激光制导和原子武器才能赢得与伊拉克的战争”。

source_text: BBC News also say that Khomeini states Iran's economy "was operating at a level below zero."
target_text: BBC新闻还称，霍梅尼表示“伊朗经济的运行处于负增长”。

source_text: He also said that people who were needed to volunteer for battle were "in short supply."
target_text: 他还说，需要志愿参加战斗的人短缺。

source_text: Defense Secretary Donald Rumsfeld faces a federal lawsuit brought today by the American Civil Liberties Union and Human Rights First, filed in his home state of Illinois.
target_text: 国防部长唐纳德・拉姆斯菲尔德今天面临美国公民自由联盟和第一人权提起的联邦诉讼，该诉讼是在他的家乡伊利诺伊州提起的。

source_text: The suit charges that he bears direct responsibility for the torture and abuse of detainees in U.S. military custody.
target_text: 该诉讼指控他对美国军方在拘留期间对被拘留者的酷刑和虐待负有直接责任。

source_text: The parties seek a court order declaring that Secretary Rumsfeld's actions are in violation of the U.S. Constitution, federal statutes and international law.
target_text: 双方寻求法院判令，宣布拉姆斯菲尔德部长的行为违反了美国宪法，联邦法规和国际法。

source_text: The American Physical Society has awarded its 2010 J. J. Sakurai Prize for Theoretical Particle Physics to six scientists for their contributions to theories on the origin of mass, including the key concepts of the Higgs boson and Higgs mechanism.
target_text: 美国物理学会授予六位科学家2010年J·J·樱井理论粒子物理奖，以表彰他们对质量起源理论，包括希格斯玻色子和希格斯机制的关键概念的贡献。

source_text: The full citation stated the prize was awarded "For elucidation of the properties of spontaneous symmetry breaking in four-dimensional relativistic gauge theory and of the mechanism for the consistent generation of vector boson masses."
target_text: 完整的引文表明该奖项被授予“用于阐明四维相对论规范理论中自发对称破缺的性质以及一致生成矢量玻色子质量的机制”。

source_text: The J. J. Sakurai Prize will be presented at the APS 2010 meeting in Washington, DC at a special Ceremonial session in February 2010.
target_text: J·J·樱井奖将于2010年2月在华盛顿举行的美国物理协会2010特别仪式会议上颁发。

source_text: The Higgs mechanism is a key element of the electroweak theory that forms part of the Standard Model of particle physics, and of many models that go beyond it.
target_text: 希格斯机制是弱电学理论的关键要素，它构成了粒子物理学标准模型的一部分，也是许多超越了它的模型的一部分。

source_text: The papers that introduce this mechanism were published in the journal Physical Review Letters in 1964 and were each recognized as milestone papers by PRL's 50th anniversary celebration.
target_text: 引入这种机制的论文发表于1964年的“物理评论快报”期刊，并被物理预告快报50周年庆典评为里程碑论文。

source_text: The Large Hadron Collider at CERN and the Tevatron in the United States are searching for a particle, the Higgs boson, that will constitute evidence for this theory.
target_text: 欧洲核子研究中心的大型强子对撞机和美国的加速器正在寻找一种粒子，希格斯玻色子，它将成为这一理论的证据。

source_text: The LHC, a vast scientific experiment to smash together sub-atomic particles, recently moved a step closer to its goal.
target_text: 大型强子对撞，是一项用于粉碎亚原子粒子的实验，最近向目标又迈进了一步。

source_text: On Friday physicists announced they had sent protons all the way round the 27 km ring beneath the France–Switzerland border, and on Monday announced the first successful collisions.
target_text: 周五，物理学家们宣布，在法国和瑞士边境下27公里的区域内，“五号”已经发射了大量质子，并于周一宣布第一次成功碰撞。

source_text: This follows a major setback which shut down the collider for 14 months.
target_text: 此前，对撞机遭遇重大挫折，使对撞机关闭了14个月。

source_text: The Houston Astros have fired manager Phil Garner and general manager Tim Purpura less than two years after leading the team to its first World Series appearance (2005).
target_text: 在带领球队首次参加世界大赛（2005年）之后不到两年经理菲尔·加纳和总经理蒂姆·普尔普拉就遭到了休斯敦太空人队的解雇。

source_text: Bench coach Cecil Cooper was appointed interim manager and team president Tal Smith will serve as interim general manager.
target_text: 板凳教练塞西尔库珀被任命为临时经理，球队总裁塔尔史密斯将担任临时总经理。

source_text: "I felt this was the time for a change," owner Drayton McLane said.
target_text: “我觉得这是改变的时候，”老板德雷顿·麦克雷恩说道。

source_text: Garner took over the Astros in the middle of the 2004 season after Jimy Williams was fired.
target_text: 在吉米·威廉姆斯被解雇后，加纳在2004赛季中期接管了太空人队。

source_text: The Astros went 48-26 in the second half and won 36 of their last 46 games to win the NL wild card, then defeated Atlanta in the first round of the playoffs before losing to St. Louis in Game 7 of the NL Championship Series.
target_text: 太空人队在下半场以48：26的成绩赢得了过去46场比赛中的36场从而赢得了NL外卡，然后在季后赛第一轮击败亚特兰大，之后在NL锦标赛系列赛第7场输给了圣路易斯。

source_text: Purpura joined the organization in 1994 and directed player development and the Astros' six minor league affiliates before taking over from Gerry Hunsicker as GM before the 2005 season.
target_text: 普尔普拉于1994年加入该组织，并指导球员发展和太空人队的六个小联盟分支机构，然后在2005赛季之前接替格里·汉斯克的职位。

source_text: The Astros are currently in fifth place in the National League Central with a record of 58-73.
target_text: 太空人队目前在国家联盟中部赛区排名第五，战绩为58：73。

source_text: The New Zealand government has now introduced graphic health warnings on cigarette packs.
target_text: 新西兰政府现在已经在卷烟包装上引入了图形健康警告。

source_text: The new warnings, which replace the text warnings, will show images of gangrenous toes, rotting gums and teeth and diseased lungs and will also include the quit smoking Quitline number.
target_text: 新警告取代了文字警告，将显示坏疽脚趾，牙龈和牙齿腐烂以及患病肺部的图像，还将包括戒烟热线号码。

source_text: The new warnings will cover 30% of the front side and 90% of the back.
target_text: 新警告将覆盖正面的30％和反面的90％。

source_text: The new warnings will come into effect January 2007 but the manufacturers will not have to produce the new warnings until February 27, 2008 and retailers have till August 2008 to clear all their old stock.
target_text: 新警告将于2007年1月生效，但制造商将不必在2008年2月27日之前生产新警告，零售商将在2008年8月之前将所有旧库存清空。

source_text: Damien O'Conner, associate minister of health and ex-smoker, said: "Pictures were more effective than written warnings."
target_text: 健康和戒烟联合部副部长达米安·奥康纳说：“图片比书面警告更有效。”

source_text: Actually seeing what it does to you is probably more acute than just reading the words on a cigarette packet.
target_text: 实际上，看到它对你的影响可能比阅读香烟盒上的文字更为严重。

source_text: "Using powerful imagery to remind people of the real and horrific effects of smoking will act to deter smokers and discourage New Zealand's young from starting the habit in the first place."
target_text: “利用强大的图像来提醒人们吸烟的真实和可怕的影响，这将起到阻止吸烟者的作用，并首先阻止新西兰的年轻人开始养成这种习惯。”

source_text: Other countries which also show graphic warnings include Australia and Canada; they say that the warnings are effective.
target_text: 其他也出现图形警告的国家包括澳大利亚和加拿大，并且他们说警告是有效的。

source_text: Chris Laurenson, Health Ministry team leader national drug policy, said that international evidence was strong.
target_text: 卫生部负责国家毒品政策的克里斯·劳伦森说，国际证据很有说服力。

source_text: "That was confirmed by research in New Zealand which supported the effectiveness of pictorial labelling."
target_text: “新西兰的研究证实了这一点，它认同了图片标签的有效性。”

source_text: Altogether there will be fourteen images, of which seven will be released first, with rest following.
target_text: 总共将有十四张图片，其中七张将首先发布，其余的将随后发布。

source_text: Mr O'Connor said: "The images were horrific; but they are what happen to people who smoke in this country."
target_text: 奥康纳先生说：“这些图像太可怕了，但这些都是在这个国家吸烟的人身上发生的事情。”

source_text: The industries will not be reimbursed for any cost that may occur.
target_text: 不会对行业补偿可能产生的任何费用。

source_text: "They understand what it might mean if they don't and I'm confident that they will," Mr O'Connor said.
target_text: 奥康纳先生说，“他们明白如果他们不这样做可能意味着什么，并且我相信他们会这样做。”

source_text: "They have already been implemented in other countries and the NZ tobacco industry has the technology to print the new packets within weeks," Becky Freeman, the Action on Smoking and Health director said.
target_text: 吸烟和健康行动主管贝基·弗里曼说，“它们已经在其他国家得到实施，新西兰烟草业已经拥有在几周内打印新包装的技术。”

source_text: World Heath Organization rules make New Zealand obliged to increase the warning sizes on packets.
target_text: 世界卫生组织规则使新西兰有义务增加包装上警告图的大小。

source_text: Scientists studying data from the Chandra X-ray telescope have found strong evidence for the missing half of ordinary matter in the universe.
target_text: 研究钱德拉X射线望远镜数据的科学家已经发现了宇宙中普通物质丢失一半的有力证据。

source_text: Two immense intergalactic clouds confirm the existence of a cosmic web of hot gas, predicted by computer simulations, containing baryons, the material making up visible objects in the Universe.
target_text: 两个巨大的星系间云证实了由计算机模拟预测的热气组成的宇宙网络的存在。包括重子，这种物质构成了宇宙中的可见物体。

source_text: "An inventory of all the baryons in stars and gas inside and outside of galaxies accounts for just over half the baryons that existed shortly after the Big Bang," Fabrizio Nicastro of the Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics.
target_text: 哈佛史密森尼天体物理中心的法里西欧·尼卡斯托说：“星系内外恒星和气体中所有重子的数量占据了大爆炸后存在不久的重子的一半以上。”

source_text: "Now we have found the likely hiding place of the missing baryons."
target_text: “现在我们找到了失踪重子可能藏身的地方。”

source_text: Nicastro is lead author of a paper in the February 3, 2005 issue of Nature describing the recent research.
target_text: 尼卡斯托是2005年2月3日“自然”杂志上一篇论文的主要作者，论文描述了他最近的研究。

source_text: Various measurements give a good estimate of the mass-density of baryons - the neutrons and protons that make up the nuclei of atoms and ions - in the Universe 10 billion years ago.
target_text: 各种测量方法可以很好地估计重子的质量密度。在100亿年前的宇宙中，重子是构成宇宙中原子和离子原子核的中子和质子。

source_text: However, sometime during the last 10 billion years a large fraction of the baryons, commonly referred to as "ordinary matter" to distinguish them from dark matter and dark energy, have gone missing.
target_text: 然而，在过去的100亿次小扰动中，有很大一部分重子消失了，这些重子通常被称为“普通物质”，目的是为了将它们与暗物质和暗能量区分开。

source_text: Using the computer predictions, Nicastro and colleagues searched specifically for the diffuse system of gas clouds galaxies and galaxy clusters form within.
target_text: 尼卡斯托及其同事利用计算机预测，专门搜索了气体云星系和星系团形成的扩散系统。

source_text: Evidence of the clouds had been previously detected around our own galaxy and in the Local Group, but the temperature range (a few hundred thousand to a million degrees Celsius) and low density have prevented detection outside the immediate neighborhood of galaxies and the reliable estimation of baryon density for the entire universe.
target_text: 在我们自己的星系和本地局域群中，先前已经发现了云存在的证据。但是温度范围（几十万到一百万摄氏度）和低密度阻碍了在星系邻近区域之外的探测和对整个宇宙重子密度的可靠估计。

source_text: The clouds were detected using Chandra observations when the galaxy Mkn 421 brightened in X-ray emissions.
target_text: 当星系Mkn421在X射线发射中变亮时，使用钱德拉观测检测到这些云。

source_text: The data shows the presence of carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, and neon present in the clouds.
target_text: 数据显示云中存在碳，氮，氧和氖。

source_text: Combined with other data the research team determined the thickness and mass of the clouds.
target_text: 结合其他数据，研究团队确定了云的厚度和质量。

source_text: Assuming that the size and distribution of the clouds are representative, Nicastro and colleagues made the first reliable estimate of average density of baryons in such clouds throughout the Universe, finding it consistent with the mass density of the missing baryons.
target_text: 假设云的大小和分布具有代表性，尼卡斯托及其同事首次可靠地估算了整个宇宙中这种云中重子的平均密度，并发现它与缺失重子的质量密度一致。

source_text: Mkn 421 was observed three times with Chandra's Low-Energy Transmission Grating (LETG), twice in conjunction with the High Resolution Camera (May 2000 and July 2003) and once with the Advanced CCD Imaging Spectrometer (October 2002).
target_text: 用钱德拉的低能量透射光栅观测了3次Mkn421，用高分辨率相机观测了2次（2000年5月和2003年7月），用高级的传感器成像光谱仪观测了1次（2002年10月）。

source_text: The distance to Mkn 421 is 400 million light years.
target_text: 到Mkn421的距离是4亿光年。

source_text: With the United States Australian rules football National Championship this weekend, Wikinews interviewed United States Australian Football League (USFooty) president Rich Mann, and Media Relations representative Kevin Smith.
target_text: 随着本周末美国澳大利亚规则足球全国锦标赛的来临，维基新闻采访了美国澳大利亚足球联盟总裁理奇·曼和媒体关系代表凯文·史密斯。

source_text: The USAFL Nationals will feature teams from the United States and Canada.
target_text: 美国澳大利亚足球联盟将邀请来自美国和加拿大的球队。

source_text: This means that an American team can have no more than nine players who aren't Americans and a Canadian team no more than nine non-Canadians.
target_text: 这意味着美国队不能超过9名队员是非美国人和加拿大队不能超过9名队员是非加拿大人。

source_text: Australian rules football is played on a field 170 metres by 160 metres.
target_text: 澳大利亚规则足球赛场是在一块170m×160m的场地上进行。

source_text: According to USFooty, the tournament will attract over 1000 players.
target_text: 按照美国澳大利亚足球联盟的说法，这项赛事将吸引超过1000名球员。

source_text: The tournament will have four divisions for men and one for woman.
target_text: 锦标赛将有四个男子分区赛和一个女子分区赛。

source_text: Pirates have seized control of the Sirius Star, a Saudi-owned oil tanker off the coast of Kenya and are steering her towards Somalia, reports the US Navy.
target_text: 据美国海军报道，海盗已经控制了肯尼亚海岸附近沙特拥有的“天狼星号”油轮，并将其驶向索马里。

source_text: The ship was captured roughly 830 kilometers south-east of Mombasa and is reportedly heading towards the Somali port of Eyl.
target_text: 该船在蒙巴萨东南约830公里处被捕，据报道它正驶向索马里的伊尔港。

source_text: The oil tanker was carrying over 2 million barrels of oil at the time of her capture, and was on her way to the United States via Cape Town.
target_text: 这艘油轮在被截获时携带了200多万桶石油，并且正在途径开普敦前往美国的途中。

source_text: Reuters claimed that news of the attack raised crude oil prices around the world.
target_text: 路透社声称，此次袭击的消息提高了全球原油价格。

source_text: Vela International Marine, the ship's owner, has said the Sirius Star is fully loaded.
target_text: 该船的所有者维拉国际物流表示天狼星号游轮已经满载。

source_text: The US Navy reports that all 25 crew from the United Kingdom, Croatia, the Philippines, Poland, and Saudi Arabia are 'safe'.
target_text: 美国海军报告说，来自英国，克罗地亚，菲律宾，波兰和沙特阿拉伯的所有25名船员都是“安全的”。

source_text: The area off the East coast of Africa has seen a significant amount of piracy.
target_text: 非洲东海岸附近地区出现了大量海盗行为。

source_text: In 2007, one-third of the world's piracy incidents occurred in this region.
target_text: 2007年，全球三分之一的海盗事件发生在该地区。

source_text: Hijacking off the coast of Somalia has become increasingly common over the last decade.
target_text: 在过去十年中，劫持索马里沿海地区的情况越来越普遍。

source_text: Most recently, South Korea has announced intentions to send one of its destroyers after five South Koreans were kidnapped in a Japanese cargo ship hijacking.
target_text: 最近，韩国宣布打算派遣其中一艘驱逐舰，此前有五名韩国人在一艘日本货船上被绑架劫持。

source_text: The Sirius Star is the largest ship captured by pirates in the area to date.
target_text: 天狼星号游轮是迄今为止该地区海盗捕获的最大船只。

source_text: This also sets a record for the farthest from the shore that pirates have struck.
target_text: 这也创下了海盗袭击海岸最远的记录。

source_text: Yesterday, the Milwaukee County district attorney charged Cory J. Feerick, a 33-year-old from Brookfield, Wisconsin, with five misdemeanor counts of stealing US$35,000 worth of flush valves from fast food restaurants and university toilets and urinals.
target_text: 昨天，密尔沃基县地区检察官指控来自威斯康星州布鲁克菲尔德的33岁的科里·J·费里克的五项轻罪，罪名是从快餐店和大学厕所及卫生间偷走价值35,000美元的冲洗阀门。

source_text: Initially arrested in late January following a local news television story on the thefts, he stands accused of stealing parts worth between US$300 and US$600 each from locations that included Milwaukee Area Technical College, Waukesha County Technical College, ITT Technical Institute, University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee, Marquette University, the Pick 'n Save on Capitol Drive in Brookfield, and the Arby’s also located on Capitol Drive in Brookfield.
target_text: 据当地新闻电视台关于盗窃事件的报道，他最初于1月下旬被捕，他被指控从密尔沃基地区技术学院、瓦克夏县技术学院、ITT技术学院、威斯康星大学、密尔沃基、马凯特大学、布鲁克菲尔德国会大道上以及位于布鲁克菲尔德国会大道的阿贝兹等每个地点偷取价值在300美元至600美元的零件。

source_text: Feerick was dubbed the "Backpack Bathroom Bandit" by the media because video showed him committing the thefts while wearing a backpack.
target_text: 费里克被媒体称为“浴室背包强盗”，因为视频显示他在背背包时犯了盗窃罪。

source_text: The thefts reportedly took place in September and October of last year, with several area police departments involved in investigating them.

source_text: One year on from the Indian Ocean tsunami, the world's grief and compassion returned to the tsunami-battered coastlines of the Indian Ocean, where at least 216 000 people lost their lives.
target_text: 在印度洋海啸发生一年后，世界的悲痛和同情又回到了受海啸袭击的印度洋海岸线，至少有216000人丧生。

source_text: Under a clear sky and before a gentle sea, the world commemorated those lost their lives, in one of the worst natural disasters that the modern world has experienced.
target_text: 在晴朗的天空和温柔的大海之前，世界纪念那些在现代世界经历的最严重的自然灾害之一中丧生的人。

source_text: Since the Indian Ocean tsunami, patchy progress has been made on the return to a normal life for those who lived through the experience.
target_text: 自印度洋海啸以来，经历过这种经历的人们恢复正常生活方面取得了不完善的进展。

source_text: Efforts to implement a warning system similar to that coordinated by the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center in Hawaii have past a number of significant milestones.
target_text: 夏威夷太平洋海啸预警中心协调了类似预警系统的实施工作，这些努力已经走过了一些重要的里程碑。

source_text: Tourist resorts in many places have been rebuilt, and many visiting them at this time do so as a form of remembrance.
target_text: 许多地方的旅游度假村已经重建，许多人此时作为一种纪念形式访问它们。

source_text: Yet still there remain those who may never recover from the tragic events of one year ago.
target_text: 然而，仍有一些人可能永远无法从一年前的悲惨事件中恢复过来。

source_text: Some $13 billion was pledged to relief and recovery efforts, of which 75 percent has already been secured.
target_text: 大约130亿美元用于救济和恢复工作，其中75％已经得到安全保障。

source_text: A businessman currently representing his place of employment in Thailand has left the following eyewitness account for Wikinews:
target_text: 目前在泰国代表其工作处的商人已经为维基新闻留下了以下目击证言：。

source_text: :"How safe are the streets of Bangkok?"
target_text: ：“曼谷的街道有多安全吗？”

source_text: " As a somewhat nervous US citizen holed up in a hotel room in this massive South Asian metropolis, I decided to venture forth and see for myself."
target_text: “作为一个有点紧张的美国公民躲在这个巨大的南亚大都市的酒店房间里，我决定冒险出去亲眼看看。”

source_text: "For courage as much as anything, I walked with my close friend and business partner, who like me, hails from San Diego, California."
target_text: “处于勇气，我和我的好朋友及商业伙伴走在一起，他们喜欢我，都来自加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥。”

source_text: :"I left my suite at the Royal River Hotel and walked down Soi Charansandwong, the narrow street that leads from the hotel to the busy road that crosses the city and shortly thereafter, the Chao Phraya River, known as the 'River of Kings."
target_text: ：“我离开在皇家河畔酒店的套房，沿着查拉山旺巷往前走，这条狭窄的街道从酒店通往繁忙的公路，穿过城市，不久之后，就会看见被称为‘国王河’的湄南河。”

source_text: :"Thailand does, indeed, love their kings, or particularly, their current King."
target_text: ：“的确，泰国确实爱他们的国王，特别是他们现任的国王。”

source_text: "Evidence of this is clear:"
target_text: “证据很明显：”。

source_text: "at least a third of the people walking on the streets wear the 'King Shirt,' a bright yellow shirt that bears the crest of the King."
target_text: “至少有三分之一的人走在街上，身着‘国王衬衫’，一件带有国王徽章的亮黄色衬衫。”

source_text: :"Even newsreaders on the local television news can sometimes be seen wearing the yellow shirt as a showing of support for the King."
target_text: ：“甚至连当地电视新闻的新闻广播员都可以看到穿着黄色衬衫来作为对国王的支持。”

source_text: :"Leaving the alleyway, we walked to the busy Thonburi district."
target_text: ：“离开小巷，我们走到繁忙的吞武里区。”

source_text: "Immediately, I could see a group of soldiers, some standing, others sitting, along a sidewalk on the main street."
target_text: “我立刻可以看到一群士兵，一些站着，另一些坐在主要街道的人行道上。”

source_text: "They had set up a check point, but I saw but one vehicle stopped, a beat up truck that appeared to have come in from the countryside, loaded with fruit."
target_text: “他们设置了一个检查点，但我看到一辆车停了下来，一辆似乎是从农村进来的卡车，上面装满了水果。”

source_text: :"Walking slowly down to where the soldiers were and smiling at them as we walked, we approached the man who appeared to be the commanding officer."
target_text: ：“我们慢慢地走到士兵所在的地方并对他们微笑，走近那个看起来像是指挥官的人。”

source_text: "He smiled back and asked us where we were from."
target_text: “他笑了笑，问我们来自哪里。”

source_text: "He was a bit business like at first, but this was a man who had a job to do, of course."
target_text: “起初他有点像商人，但当然，这是一个有工作要做的人。”

source_text: "It appears that the military, for the most part, is present as a show of support and to act if any anti-Coup action should take place."
target_text: “看起来，军方在很大程度上是在表示支持，并在应该采取任何反政变行动时采取行动。”

source_text: :"My friend noticed that the soldiers appeared to be uncomfortable in their uniforms, not the most comfortable clothing to wear in the hot and humid world that is Bangkok."
target_text: ：“我的朋友注意到那些军人穿制服显得很不舒服。在湿热的世界里穿不舒服的衣服。”这就是曼谷。

source_text: :"Each soldier, unable to wear a yellow shirt and stay in uniform, instead bore a yellow ribbon of support for the King, usually tied to his rifle."
target_text: ：“每个士兵都不能穿黄衬衫，也不能穿制服，而是把一条黄丝带系在步枪上，以示对国王的支持。”

source_text: :"Walking back to a small stand, we purchased twenty bottles of cold drinks and returned to the soldiers and handed them to the officer in charge."
target_text: ：“往回走到一个小摊位，我们购买了二十瓶冷饮，然后送回士兵手中，然后交给负责人员。”

source_text: "He smiled and accepted the offering and handed them out to his men."
target_text: “他微笑着接受了这些饮料，并将它们交给了他的手下。”

source_text: :"The streets of Bangkok, otherwise, appeared completely normal in all respects."
target_text: ：“曼谷的街道，在各方面都显得完全正常。”

source_text: "Street vendors hawked various items of food, car shops were installing high tech stereo systems and dogs, here and there, sat quietly in whatever shady spot they could find."
target_text: “街头摊贩兜售各种食品，汽车商店正在安装高科技立体声系统，狗到处都是，静静地坐在能找到阴凉的地方。”

source_text: :"We crossed the street and walked down an alleyway to the nearest Temple."
target_text: ：“我们穿过街道，沿着小巷走到最近的寺庙。”

source_text: "Walking on the cool, green grounds of the Temple complex, the Coup felt like it was a million miles distant."
target_text: “走在凉爽、绿油油的寺庙建筑群里，政变让人感觉仿佛远在万里之外。”

source_text: "Bowing and placing our palms together, we greeted a monk on the grounds who was trimming a hedge."
target_text: “鞠躬并且把我们的手掌放在一起，我们跟一个修剪树篱的僧侣打招呼。”

source_text: "Despite the Coup, Bangkok seemingly remains peaceful in all respects."
target_text: “尽管政变，曼谷似乎在所有方面都保持和平。”

source_text: "We could smell the delightful scent of freshly cut grass."
target_text: “我们可以闻到新鲜割草的令人愉快的气味。”

source_text: :"Earlier, I asked the doorman at the Royal River Hotel what he thought about the Coup."
target_text: ：“早些时候，我问皇家河畔酒店的门卫他对政变的看法。”

source_text: "'We needed it', he smiled,"
target_text: “我们需要它，”他笑着说。

source_text: 'things were too corrupt.'
target_text: “事情太腐败了。”

source_text: "It should all be over in three days or so."
target_text: “它应该在三天左右结束。”

source_text: "But, certainly, I felt no danger on the street from the army or from anyone I encountered."
target_text: “但是，当然，我在街上没有感觉到来自军队或任何我遇到的人的危险。”

source_text: "Returning to Soi Charansandwong, I approached an ATM and withdrew a couple of hundred dollars worth of Baht, the currency of Thailand, with my US bank issued card."
target_text: “回到查拉山旺巷，我走近一台自动取款机，用我的美国银行发行的卡取出了价值几百美元的泰铢。”

source_text: :"Money in hand, I entered a tailor shop and sat down with the shop manager, who was from India, and ordered a new suit to be made."
target_text: ：“手里拿着钱，我进入了一家裁缝店，与来自印度的店长坐下来，并订购了一套新的西装。”

source_text: "As he measured me, I asked if business had been slowed due to the Coup."
target_text: “当他给我量尺寸时，我问道，由于政变，生意是否受到影响。”

source_text: "He promised me that my suit, which included two pairs of pants and two custom made dress shirts, would be ready early the next morning."
target_text: “他答应我，我的西装，包括两条裤子和两件定制的衬衫，将在第二天一早做好。”

source_text: :"We left the alleyway and once again walked down the busy road."
target_text: ：“我们离开了小巷，再次沿着繁忙的道路走下去。”

source_text: "The commanding officer gave us a very big smile this time as we passed him and several of the soldiers gave smaller, shy smiles as we passed."
target_text: “这次当我们经过指挥官时，他给了我们一个大大的微笑，而当我们经过时，有几个士兵也给了我们一个浅浅的害羞的微笑”。

source_text: "Encouraged, we once again popped into a small shop and bought additional soft drinks to hand out."
target_text: “受到鼓舞，我们再一次进入一家小商店，额外买了一些软饮料拎在手上。”

target_text: 从1990年到2002年，泰洛一直扮演泰勒·汉密尔顿·弗雷斯特博士的角色，当她被坏女人希拉·卡特杀死的时候，扮演的是金伯林·布朗。

source_text: Taylor's love affair with Ridge Forrester (played by Ronn Moss), and the ensuing triangle with Brooke Logan (played by Katherine Kelly Lang), helped the then-fledgling soap move higher in the ratings in the early to mid-1990s.
target_text: 泰勒与里奇·弗雷斯特（由罗恩·莫斯饰演）以及随后与布鲁克·洛根（由凯瑟琳·凯利·朗饰演）扮演的三角恋，帮助这部当时刚刚起步的肥皂剧在上世纪90年代初早期到中期获得了更高的收视率。

source_text: According to Soap Opera Weekly, history has been rewritten so that Taylor, in reality, did not die from her gunshot wounds back in October 2002.
target_text: 根据每周肥皂剧的说法，历史已被重写，因此，泰勒实际上并没有因2002年10月的枪伤而死亡。

source_text: Her return is tied in with a 1994 storyline in which Taylor was held captive by Moroccan prince Omar (played by Indian actor Kabir Bedi).

source_text: Both Tylo and Bedi are first seen on Monday, May 2.

source_text: The magazine states that she has been on the set of the soap opera at CBS Television City since March 11.
target_text: 该杂志称自3月11日以来，她一直在CBS电视城观看肥皂剧。

source_text: For a while, she didn't even tell her husband, former Guiding Light actor Michael Tylo, where she was really going.

target_text: 她的丈夫目前在拉斯维加斯的内华达大学授课，她无法承受任何关于他的学生可能了解的意外提示。

source_text: She took him to court and won after nearly a year of messy legal battles.
target_text: 经过将近一年混乱的法律纠纷，她把他告上法庭并胜诉。
