source_text: Japan and South Korea, both strong allies of the United States are considered to be likely customers, if the ban is lifted.
target_text: 如果取消禁令，日本和韩国都是美国的强大盟友。

source_text: The lifting of the ban comes at a time when continued US orders will no longer be guaranteed and that the aircraft's continued production is important for Lockheed Martin Aeronautics' business.
target_text: 取消禁令的同时，美国的订单将不再得到保证，飞机的继续生产对洛克希德·马丁航空公司的业务非常重要。

source_text: On October 14, 2008, Canadians will be heading to the polls for the federal election.
target_text: 2008年10月14日，加拿大人将参加联邦选举投票。

source_text: Born in St. Catherines and raised in Barrie, Austin has a Bachelor of Physical and Health Education from the University of Windsor.
target_text: 奥斯汀出生于圣凯瑟琳，在巴里长大，拥有温莎大学的体育与健康教育学士学位。

source_text: Teaching in various Ontario schools, she has been active in the Simcoe NDP riding association since 1975.
target_text: 她在安大略省的各个学校任教，自1975年以来一直活跃在西姆科民主党选区协会。

source_text: Austin rode her bike, solo, from Victoria, British Columbia to Elmvale, Ontario (a total of 4 500 km) in 40 days during the summer of 1996, camping along the way.
target_text: 奥斯汀在1996年夏天的40天内，骑着她的自行车，从不列颠哥伦比亚省的维多利亚州到安大略省的埃尔姆韦尔（共计4500公里），沿途露营。

source_text: Wikinews contacted Katy Austin, to talk about the issues facing Canadians, and what they and their party would do to address them.
target_text: 维基新闻联系了凯蒂·奥斯汀，谈论加拿大人面临的问题，以及他们和他们的政党将如何解决这些问题。

source_text: Wikinews is in the process of contacting every candidate, in every riding across the country, no matter their political stripe.
target_text: 维基新闻正在联系全国各地的每一位候选人，无论他们的政治倾向如何。

source_text: All interviews are conducted over e-mail, and interviews are published unedited, allowing candidates to impart their full message to our readers, uninterrupted.
target_text: 所有访谈都通过电子邮件进行，访谈未经编辑发布，允许候选人不间断地向读者传达他们的全部信息。

source_text: The riding is currently held by Helena Guergis (Conservative), the Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs, International Trade and Sport.
target_text: 该选区目前由外交，国际贸易和体育大臣海伦娜·格尔吉斯（保守党）控制。

source_text: Also challenging Guergis are Peter Ellis (Green), Andrea Matrosovs (Liberal), Caley McKibbin (Libertarian), and Peter Vander Zaag (Christian Heritage).
target_text: 同样挑战郭姬丝的还有彼得·埃利斯（格林）、安得利亚·马特洛索夫斯（自由党）、卡利·麦基宾（自由主义者）和彼得·范德·杂戈（基督教遗产党）。

source_text: For more information, visit the campaign's official website, listed below.
target_text: 有关更多信息，请访问下面列出的竞选运动官方网站。

source_text: In an escalating controversy that has contributed to Italian Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi's political problems and created a national uproar in Italy, Italian prosecutors began their own independent probe on Wednesday of the death of Nicola Calipari.
target_text: 在一场不断升级的争议中，意大利总理西尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼的政治问题在意大利引起了全国性的骚动，意大利检察官周三开始对尼古拉·卡利帕里去世进行独立调查。

source_text: The premier has put his government's prestige on the line with assurances to the nation that full light would be shed on the shooting.
target_text: 总理已经将他的政府声望放在了一线，并向国家保证将全力以赴去解决。

source_text: Calipari, one of the top intelligence agents in Italy, had negotiated a settlement with hostage takers in Baghdad and was rescuing journalist Giuliana Sgrena from them when American soldiers fired on the car they were in.
target_text: 卡利帕里是意大利最高情报人员之一，曾在巴格达与人质劫持者达成和解协议，并在美国士兵向他们所驾驶的汽车开火时向他们营救记者古吉利娜·思格雷娜。

source_text: Calipari became a national hero for Italians after he bravely threw his own body across hers as the firing continued, killing him and seriously injuring Sgrena with a few bullets in her back.
target_text: 卡利帕里成为意大利人的民族英雄，因为在面临持续开火射击时，他勇敢地将自己的身体搭在思格雷娜身上，结果他被击中身亡，思格雷娜背部中了几枪，并严重受伤。

source_text: Meanwhile, Americans released a document, now described as incomplete, which says the U.S. Army, in a joint inquiry with Italian officials, cleared its own soldiers of any responsibility in the tragic events of March 4.
target_text: 与此同时，美国人发布了一份文件，现在被描述为不完整，该文件称，美国军方在与意大利官员的联合调查中，清除了自己在3月4日悲惨事件中士兵负有任何责任的部分。

source_text: South African Vipers completed a hat-trick to win their third consecutive Singapore Cricket Club International Rugby Sevens.
target_text: 南非毒蛇队完成了帽子戏法，连续第三次赢得新加坡板球俱乐部国际橄榄球七人制橄榄球赛。

source_text: Unbeaten throughout the two day tournament the South African team beat Fijian team Davetalevu by a margin of 24 points without allowing the Fijian team to score throughout the 20 minute final.
target_text: 在为期两天的比赛中，南非队以24分的优势击败了斐济队达维塔列乌，并且没有让斐济队在整场20分钟的比赛中得分。

source_text: It was tough and tight start with both teams putting heavy tackles and showing strong defence until the sixth minute when the SA Vipers finally managed a fast run down the left wing to score a converted try.
target_text: 开局就非常艰难和紧张，两队都注重铲断和防守，直到第六分钟时，南非毒蛇队终于在左翼发动快速进攻，尝试扭转得分。

source_text: From that point is looked ominous for Davetalevu as the Vipers began to find openings in nearly every move and only passionate defence keeping the Vipers at bay from further scoring, finishing the first half 5-0.
target_text: 从这一点上看，这对达维塔列乌来说是一个不祥的预兆，因为毒蛇队开始在几乎每一个动作中都找到了空位，只有充满激情的防守才能阻止毒蛇队进一步得分，上半场以5：0结束。

source_text: Only two minutes into the second half the Vipers breached Davetalevu's defence and scored a relatively easy try yet failing to convert.
target_text: 下半场仅两分钟，毒蛇队就突破了达维塔列乌的防线，取得了一个相对容易的进球机会，但未能转化为进球。

source_text: A few minutes later Vipers crossed again and then scored a further try down the favoured left wing to bring the margin to 24-0 which would be the final score.
target_text: 几分钟之后，维克斯再次越过，然后再次尝试擅长的左翼进攻得分，将比分差距提高到24：0，这可能是最终得分。

source_text: The talent and form of the South Africans clearly showed as they have been touring for the past months.
target_text: 南非人的才能和队形清楚地表明他们过去几个月一直在巡回比赛。

source_text: In the minor finals the Casuarina Cougars easily won the Bowl competition with a 17-0 defeat of Australian team East Arnhem Rugby.
target_text: 在小决赛中，美洲狮队以17：0击败澳大利亚队东阿纳姆橄榄球队轻松赢得了球赛。

source_text: The Plate final saw a strong performance from Borneo Eagles to beat New Zealand team Oriental Rongotai by 31 to 5.
target_text: 板块决赛中，婆罗洲老鹰队以31：5战胜新西兰队东方荣泰队。

source_text: Leading 12-5 at half-time the Eagles never seemed troubled during the final.
target_text: 半场结束时以12：5领先的老鹰队在决赛中似乎遇到了麻烦。

source_text: The weekend was an emotional event for the Brunei Flying Kukris who recently returned from a tour of Afghanistan where they tragically lost two of their regiment.
target_text: 对于文莱的飞行库克里斯对来说，这个周末经历了一个伤感的事情。最近从阿富汗的一次旅行中回来，在那里他们非常悲惨地失去了他们团队中的两名成员。

source_text: Serving out of Borneo the squad gathered before the commencement of their quarter-final to pay respect both to their own squadron but also in tribute to Remembrance Day which coincided with the weekend tournament.
target_text: 在婆罗洲外服役的球队在四分之一决赛开始前聚集在一起，向他们各自的队伍致敬。同时也是为了纪念与周末锦标赛同一天的荣军纪念日。

source_text: A minute of silence in respect to fallen soldiers was observed.
target_text: 大家看到对死去的队员默哀一分钟以示尊敬。

source_text: Despite mixed results for the tournament the Kukris managed to qualify for the Jug Final.
target_text: 尽管比赛结果好坏参半，但库克里斯还是有资格参加尤格决赛。

source_text: Kukris scored a try after full-time yet failing to convert a relatively simple kick that would have won the game for them.
target_text: 库克瑞斯在全场比赛结束时尝试了一次进攻得分，但是这样一次相对简单的进攻却没能转换为比赛得分。

source_text: Featuring teams from thirteen nations from as far as Kenya, South Africa and Scotland the tournament has grown from success to success over the past years and now features on the calendar of major sporting events in Singapore.
target_text: 本届的参赛队伍来自13个国家，远至肯尼亚、南非和苏格兰。在过去几年里，本届锦标赛取得了越来越大的成功，如今已成为新加坡重大体育赛事的一大亮点。

source_text: The tournament began in 1947 as an invitational event for Singapore and Malaysian teams and since grown into national and club teams from around the world are invited.
target_text: 该比赛于1947年开始，作为新加坡和马来西亚队的邀请赛，并邀请来自世界各地的国家队和俱乐部队参赛。

source_text: It is hoped that the SCC 7s will soon feature on the International Rugby Boards 7s circuit according to club officials.
target_text: 根据俱乐部官员的说法，希望7s监督控制系统很快将在国际橄榄球板7s赛道上亮相。

source_text: The competition also included the return of the SCC Schools and Colleges tournament as well as the qualifying round for the International Rugby Board's Womens Rugby World Cup.
target_text: 比赛还包括SCC学校和学院锦标赛的回归以及国际橄榄球委员会女子橄榄球世界杯的资格赛。

source_text: The Namibian government has refused to remove value added tax (VAT) on the price of milk.
target_text: 纳米比亚政府拒绝取消牛奶价格的增值税。

source_text: The Namibian Dairy producers organization requested the Namibian directorate of local income in May 2006 to follow the example of South Africa and declare fresh milk as a basic need upon which no taxation is applicable.
target_text: 纳米比亚乳业生产者组织要求纳米比亚当地收入局于2006年5月效仿南非，并宣布鲜奶作为基本需求，不征税。

source_text: Calle Schlettwein, permanent Secretary of the Namibia Ministry of Finance said the decision not to discard VAT on milk is because of two reasons: "This industry is already receiving advantages because of Article 26 of the African Customs Union (SACU)," he said.
target_text: 纳米比亚财政部常任秘书长卡勒·斯莱特温表示说，决定不对牛奶征收增值税是因为有两个原因：“由于非洲关税同盟第26条所述，该行业已经获得了优势。”

source_text: Namibia is a country that spend more than what it can collect through tax.
target_text: 纳米比亚是一个花费超过税收收入的国家。

source_text: The price of fresh milk is to climb by 50c in the beginning of April 2007 following increases in production costs to producers.
target_text: 随着生产者生产成本的增加，新鲜牛奶的价格在2007年4月初将攀升50c。

source_text: The dairy industry has warned of a collapse of the industry and a dependence on foreign imports if prices are not increased to match rising production costs.
target_text: 乳制品行业警告说，如果不增加价格以适应不断上涨的生产成本，该行业将出现崩溃并依赖外国进口。

source_text: Two people were killed in a magnitude 5.9 earthquake in Turkey shortly before midnight local time on Thursday.
target_text: 周四当地时间午夜前不久，两人在土耳其发生的5.9级地震中丧生。

source_text: Officials said two people were killed;
target_text: 官员称有两人遇难。

source_text: one was thought to have suffered a heart attack and the other died after jumping from a window in panic.
target_text: 一人被认为心脏病发作，另一人在恐慌中从窗户跳下后死亡。

source_text: Emergency services dispatched search and rescue crews and gave out blankets, food and water.
target_text: 紧急服务部门派遣搜救人员，并发放毯子，食物和水。

source_text: Officials said a wastewater dam had not been damaged by the earthquake, and it posed "no risk."
target_text: 有关官员说，地震没有损坏污水坝，并且“没有风险”。

source_text: More than 18,000 people died following two earthquakes with a magnitude of more than 7.0 in northwestern Turkey in 1999.
target_text: 1999年土耳其西北部发生两次超过7.0次地震后，超过18,000人死亡。

source_text: Reports say that the host of the United States television game show Jeopardy!, Alex Trebek, 67 is being hospitalized after suffering from a minor heart attack.
target_text: 有报道称美国电视游戏节目主持人处于危险境地！67岁的亚历克斯·特雷贝克在遭受轻微心脏病发作后住院治疗。

source_text: "He is resting comfortably in a Los Angeles, California hospital, and he will be back in the studio for the next scheduled tapings in January," said a spokesman for the show in a statement posted on the show's website.
target_text: 该节目的一位发言人在该节目的网站上发布的一份声明中表示，“他正在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的一家医院舒适地休息，他将在1月份回到工作室接受下一次预定的录音。”

source_text: Trebek is expected to remain in the hospital for at least two days for observation and continued tests.
target_text: 预计特雷贝克将留在医院至少两天进行观察和继续化验。

source_text: A 35-year old woman, Venus Critchfield of Philipippi, West Virginia, United States was convicted of child abuse and sentenced to two to six years in prison.
target_text: 一名35岁的女子，美国西弗吉尼亚州菲利皮皮的维纳斯·克里奇菲尔德因有虐待儿童罪并被判处两至六年徒刑。

source_text: Critchfield was accused of beating her stepchildren with boards, and using hooks and ropes to secure them and force them to stand for long periods of time.
target_text: 克里奇菲尔德被指控用板子殴打她的继子，并使用钩子和绳索来固定他们并强迫他们长时间站立。

source_text: Critchfield also forced the children to continuously eat food and drink, and then eat their own vomit.
target_text: 克里奇菲尔德还强迫孩子们不断吃食物和饮料，然后吃自己的呕吐物。

source_text: Her stepson, now aged 17, described the abuse in court.
target_text: 她现年17岁的继子在法庭上描述了虐待行为。

source_text: Circuit Judge Alan D. Moats called this the worst case he has seen in 30 years.
target_text: 巡回法官艾伦·D·莫特兹称这是他30年来见过的最坏情况。

source_text: "You are the antithesis of everything that is a mother."
target_text: “你是所有母亲的对立面。”

source_text: The abuse involved all six of Critchfield's children, however only some were willing to testify against her.
target_text: 虐待涉及克里奇菲尔德的所有六个孩子，但只有一些人愿意作证反对她。

source_text: Critchfield pleaded guilty and was convicted of two counts of child abuse, with injury.
target_text: 克里奇菲尔德认罪，并被判犯有两项虐待儿童的罪名。

source_text: The charges pertained to abuse committed from January 2001 until January 2002.
target_text: 这些指控涉及2001年1月至2002年1月期间的虐待行为。

source_text: State welfare services had removed the children, now 11-16 years old, from the Critchfields' care in previous cases.
target_text: 国家福利服务机构已经把这些11-16岁的儿童从福利院带走，这些儿童在之前的案件中不受克里希菲尔德的照顾。

source_text: Jenning Brian Critchfield, the father, is currently serving a 3-15 year sentence for abuse.
target_text: 父亲詹宁·布莱恩·克里奇菲尔德目前因虐待被判处3至15年徒刑。

source_text: Mosaic Fashions, a UK clothing firm, is set to make history as it becomes the first foreign company to list on the Iceland Stock Exchange (ISE).
target_text: 英国服装公司马赛克时尚公司将成为第一家在冰岛证券交易所上市的外国公司。

source_text: Mosaic, which owns the clothing brands Oasis, Karen Millen, Coast and Whistles, operates 600 stores and is majority owned by retail investment group Baugur.
target_text: 马赛克拥有服装品牌绿洲，凯伦•米伦，海岸和哨子，经营600家商店，并由零售投资集团博格集团拥有多数股权。

source_text: Mosaic employs approximately 5,400 staff throughout the UK and Ireland.
target_text: 马赛克在英国和爱尔兰拥有约5,400名员工。

source_text: The exchange was founded in 1985 and has since grown to encompass 34 firms with a combined value of over US$21bn (€16.3bn; GBP11.1bn).
target_text: 该交易所成立于1985年，现已发展到34家公司，总价值超过210亿美元（163亿欧元，111亿英镑）。

source_text: Reports suggest the World Health Organisation's declaring a swine flu pandemic was an error driven by drug companies, and lead to unjustified fear.
target_text: 报告显示，世界卫生组织宣布猪流感大流行是一个由制药公司引发的错误，并导致不合理的恐惧。

source_text: A year after the swine flu pandemic was declared, stocks are left unused and governments try to abandon contracts, pharmaceutical companies have profited at least £4.6billion from the sale of vaccines alone.
target_text: 猪流感大流行宣布一年后，库存被闲置，各国政府试图放弃合同，制药公司仅通过销售疫苗就获利至少46亿英镑。

source_text: Reports by the British Medical Journal (BMJ), the Bureau of Investigative Journalism (BIJ) and the Council of Europe claim that The World Health Organisation reaction to H1N1 was influenced by pharmaceutical companies and that key scientists behind advice had financial ties with firms Roche and GlaxoSmithKline (GSK).
target_text: 英国医学杂志，调查新闻局和欧洲委员会的报告称，世界卫生组织对H1N1的反应受到制药公司的影响，背后的主要科学家与罗氏和葛兰素史克公司有财务关系。

source_text: These conflicts of interest have never been publicly disclosed by WHO, an apparent violation of its own rules.
target_text: 世卫组织从未公开披露这些利益冲突，这明显违反了自己的规则。

source_text: The World Health Organisation issued H1N1 guidelines in 2004, recommending countries to stockpile millions of doses of antiviral medication.
target_text: 世界卫生组织于2004年发布了H1N1指南，建议各国储存数百万剂抗病毒药物。

source_text: A joint investigation with the BMJ and the BIJ, found that scientists involved in developing the WHO 2004 guidance had previously been paid by Roche or GSK for lecturing and consultancy work as well as being involved in research for the companies.
target_text: 英国医学杂志和调查新闻局的联合调查发现，参与开发世界卫生组织2004指南的科学家之前已经由罗氏或葛兰素史克的报酬，用于讲座和咨询工作以及参与公司的研究。

source_text: "The WHO's credibility has been badly damaged," BMJ editor Fiona Godlee said in an editorial.
target_text: “世界卫生组织的可信度受到了严重破坏，”英国医学杂志编辑菲奥娜·戈德利在一篇社论中说道。

source_text: A report by the health committee of the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe, a 47-member human rights watchdog, found that the WHO's reaction was influenced by drug companies that make H1N1 antiviral drugs and vaccines.
target_text: 由47名成员组成的人权监督机构欧洲理事会议健康委员会的一份报告发现，世界卫生组织的反应受到制造H1N1抗病毒药物和疫苗的制药公司的影响。

source_text: It criticised WHO lack of transparency around the handling of the swine flu pandemic and says the public health guidelines by WHO, EU agencies and national governments led to a "waste of large sums of public money and unjustified scares and fears about the health risks faced by the European public."
target_text: 它批评世卫组织在处理猪流感大流行方面缺乏透明度，并对世卫组织的公共卫生指南进行了修订。欧盟机构和各国政府“浪费了大量的公共资金和对欧洲公众面临的健康风险的统一造成恐慌和恐惧。”

source_text: A spokesman for WHO said the drug industry did not influence its decisions on swine flu.
target_text: 世卫组织发言人表示，制药业并没有影响对猪流感的决定。

source_text: Margaret Chan, the organisation's director, had dismissed inquiries into its handling of the A/H1N1 pandemic as "conspiracy theories" earlier this year,
target_text: 今年早些时候，世卫组织总干事陈冯富珍将对其处理甲型H1N1流感疫情的调查斥为“阴谋论”。

source_text: she had said: "WHO anticipated close scrutiny of its decisions, but we did not anticipate that we would be accused, by some European politicians, of having declared a fake pandemic on the advice of experts with ties to the pharmaceutical industry and something personal to gain from increased industry profits."
target_text: 她说：“世卫组织预计将仔细审查其决定。但是我们没有预料到我们会受到指控。一些欧洲政客根据与制药行业有联系的专家的建议，宣布了一场假的大流行，并从中获得了一些个人利益。”

source_text: Yesterday, a 16-member "emergency committee" consisting of advisors from the World Health Organisation said that the H1N1 pandemic is not yet over.
target_text: 昨天，由世界卫生组织16名顾问成员组成的“紧急委员会”表示，H1N1大流行尚未结束。

source_text: The WHO has refused to identify committee members, arguing that they must be shielded from industry pressure, so possible conflicts of interest with drug companies are unknown.
target_text: 世卫组织拒绝透露委员会成员的身份，称他们必须免受行业压力的影响，因此不知道他们与制药公司可能存在的利益冲突。

source_text: The BMJ report also reveals that at least one expert on the "emergency committee" received payment during 2009 from GSK.
target_text: 英国医学杂志报告还显示，至少有一位“紧急委员会”专家在2009年从葛兰素史克公司获得了报酬。

source_text: Lordi, described as "cartoon metalheads" wearing latex monster masks, beat runner-up Russian "heart throb" Dima Bilan to win this year's 51st Eurovision song contest held in Athens, Greece.
target_text: 洛尔迪被称为“卡通金属头”，他戴着乳胶怪物面具，击败了亚军俄罗斯“心脏悸动”迪马·比兰赢得今年在希腊雅典举行的第51届欧洲歌唱大赛。

source_text: In a spectacular show, hosted by Maria Menounos and Sakis Rouvas, Lordi amassed 292 points after a public vote - 44 ahead of Russia.
target_text: 在由玛利亚·梅诺诺斯和萨基斯·罗瓦斯主持的精彩表演中，洛尔迪在公众投票后积累了292分，比俄罗斯领先44分。

source_text: Greece's singer Anna Vissi, who was one of the favourites to win, came 9th, followed by Ireland's Brian Kennedy.
target_text: 希腊的歌手安娜维西是最受欢迎的选手之一，排在第9位，紧随其后的是爱尔兰的布莱恩·肯尼迪。

source_text: From the start of the song contest as well as during the televoting, the Greek organisers presented viewers choreographies and dances inspired by Greek culture and music, both ancient and modern.
target_text: 从歌曲比赛开始以及电视转播期间，希腊组织者展示了受古希腊和现代希腊文化和音乐启发的观众编舞和舞蹈。

source_text: In addition, the world famous Greek singer Nana Moushouri was presented by the hosts and gave the sign for the start of televoting.
target_text: 此外，世界着名的希腊歌手纳纳·穆苏库里由主持人介绍登场，并宣布电视投票开始。

source_text: Wielding spark-spewing instruments, the "Monster-themed" rock band beat 23 other competitors, scoring 292 points from telephone voters in 38 countries with its song "Hard Rock Hallelujah" in a performance that both shocked and amused viewers.
target_text: 挥舞着火花喷射乐器，“怪物主题”摇滚乐队击败其他23个竞争对手，在38个国家的电话选民中获得292分，其歌曲“硬摇滚哈利路亚”的演出令观众震惊和愉快。

source_text: A spokesperson for Lordi said: "We won the contest, looking like this,"he said.
target_text: 洛尔迪的发言人说：“我们赢了比赛，看起来像这样。”

source_text: "It just goes to show that Europe is not such a bad place."
target_text: “这只是表明欧洲不是一个糟糕的地方。”

source_text: The Finnish band thanked viewers for voting for their song, which featured the lead singer hoisting a double-headed-axe microphone stand above his head.
target_text: 芬兰乐队感谢观众为他们的歌曲进行投票，主唱是双头斧麦克风立在他的头之上。

source_text: The win has been dubbed as a "radical departure" from the catchy pop tunes, folk songs and emotional ballads normally associated with Eurovision.
target_text: 这场比赛的胜利被称为“彻底背离”了通常与欧洲电视网有关的朗朗上口的流行歌曲、民歌和情感歌曲。

source_text: Complete with distorted guitars, a catchy chorus and "mock-demonic imagery," Lordi is reminiscent of 1970s American band Kiss - an inspiration acknowledged by lead singer Mr Lordi.
target_text: 配上扭曲的吉他，朗朗上口的合唱和“模拟恶魔形象”，洛尔迪让人想起20世纪70年代的美国乐队之吻-主唱洛尔迪先生承认这是一个灵感的来源。

source_text: "What this has shown is that there are different styles of music than just pop and rock," Mr Lordi told news media after the surprise victory.
target_text: 洛尔迪先生在惊喜胜利后告诉新闻媒体，“这表明有不同风格的音乐，而不仅仅是流行音乐和摇滚音乐。”

source_text: Mr. Lordi, whose real name is Tomi Putaansuu, hails from Lapland and says his band's masked personas are just characters.
target_text: 洛尔迪先生的真名是托米·普塔安苏，来自拉普兰，他说他的乐队的蒙面角色只是特色。

source_text: "The guys behind the masks are not interesting - underneath, there's just a boring, normal guy who walks the dogs, goes to the supermarket, watches DVDs and eats candies."
target_text: “面具背后的家伙并不有趣，在面具下面，只有一个无聊，正常遛狗，去超市，看DVD和吃糖果的人。”

source_text: But the characters "live on stage and they live in a fantasy world", he said.
target_text: 但他说，人物“生活在舞台上，他们生活在幻想世界”。

source_text: "This element of mystery is one of the cornerstones of Lordi."
target_text: “这个神秘元素是洛尔迪的基石之一。”

source_text: The band has upset many Finns with their outrageous behaviour.
target_text: 这支乐队以其荒诞不经的行为让许多芬兰人不安。

source_text: "This is a victory for rock music... and also a victory for open-mindedness," Mr Lordi said.
target_text: 洛尔迪先生说：“这是摇滚音乐的胜利……也是开放思想的胜利。”

source_text: "For the millionth time, we're not Satanists or devil worshippers."
target_text: “我再重申第一百万次，我们不是撒旦分子或魔鬼崇拜者。”

source_text: "The masks are like our calling card and we'll　never perform without them."
target_text: “面具就像我们的名片一样，如果没有它们，我们绝不会表演。”

source_text: "It would be like Santa Claus handing a child his gifts at Christmas time and then pulling off his beard…"
target_text: “这就像圣诞老人在圣诞节的时候把礼物递给孩子，然后把他的胡子拔了下来一样……”。

source_text: The 51st annual Eurovision was broadcast live across Europe, watched by an estimated 100 million viewers.
target_text: 第51届年度欧洲电视网在欧洲各地直播，估计有1亿观众观看。

source_text: Regarded by many as the "contest good taste forgot," Eurovision is adored by fans of kitsch and camp everywhere.
target_text: 被许多人视为“比赛好品味忘的一干二净”，欧洲电视网受到各种各样的媚俗和营地粉丝的喜爱。

source_text: Lordi join the likes of Abba, Bucks Fizz, Dana and Celine Dion on the elite list of Eurovision winners.
target_text: 洛尔迪加入了Abba，Bucks Fizz，黛娜和席琳•迪翁d的行列，成为欧洲电视网比赛冠军。

source_text: Because of Lordi's first place finish, next year the 52nd Eurovision Song Contest will take place, for the first time, in Helsinki, Finland.
target_text: 由于洛尔迪的第一名，明年第52届欧洲歌唱大赛将首次在芬兰赫尔辛基举行。

source_text: Zimbabwe's 4.5 million students will not receive what was once the golden standard of education in Africa—or any education at all this school year.
target_text: 津巴布韦的450万学生将无法获得曾经是非洲黄金标准的教育，或者本学年的任何教育。

source_text: Political violence during the country's recent presidential elections hit schools hard with strikes, murder and violence against teachers, and looting.
target_text: 在最近的总统选举中，政治暴力以罢工、谋杀、暴力袭击教师和抢劫等方式对学校造成了沉重打击。

source_text: Some schools were turned into places of torture after teachers were driven out.
target_text: 教师被赶出后，一些学校变成了酷刑场所。

source_text: The country's educators were targeted by Zimbabwe's ZANU-PF party, for alleged support of the opposition.
target_text: 该国的教育工作者被津巴布韦非洲民族联盟-爱国阵线党指控为目标，据称支持反对派。

source_text: Now the country faces a second crisis due to economic troubles and an inflation rate of two trillion percent.
target_text: 现在，由于经济困难和通货膨胀率达2万亿，该国面临第二次危机。

source_text: The few teachers still around have seen their salaries made worthless and are unable to acquire teaching supplies.
target_text: 仍然有少数老师看到他们的工资变得不值钱，无法获得教学用品。

source_text: "We don't even have chalk, or red pens, never mind books," says Amos Musoni, one of the few teachers still working.
target_text: 阿莫斯·穆索尼是为数不多的仍在工作的老师之一，他说，“我们甚至没有粉笔或红笔，更不用说书。”

source_text: Schools like the one where Musoni works have given up educating and simply entertain the children before sending them off for lack of equipment.
target_text: 一些学校像穆索尼工作的学校一样放弃了教育，因缺乏仪器设备被解雇之前只是逗孩子们开心。

source_text: The universities have been unable to open without funds, water, or electricity, like many public schools.
target_text: 与许多公立学校一样，大学无法在没有资金，水或电的情况下开放。

source_text: College students, unable to register, are left waiting for more information.
target_text: 无法注册的大学生正在等待更多信息。

source_text: Pass rates in the nation went from 72 to eleven percent, with many schools not seeing even one pass.
target_text: 全国的通过率从72％下降到11％，许多学校甚至通过率为零。

source_text: Schools in the countries have not been able to prepare students for tests without timetables or even the results from last year.
target_text: 没有时间表，甚至没有去年的考试结果，这些国家的学校都无法让学生为考试做准备。

source_text: Blair, a longtime supporter of the Kyoto treaty, recognized that countries will not accept the limits imposed on Kyoto:
target_text: 作为京都条约的长期支持者，布莱尔承认各国不会接受对京都议定书施加的限制。

source_text: "No country is going to cut its growth."
target_text: “任何国家都不会削减其增长。”

source_text: Of India and China, "They're not going to start negotiating another treaty like Kyoto."
target_text: 在印度和中国，“他们不会开始谈判像京都议定书这样的另一项条约。”

source_text: India and China are classified as developing countries in the Kyoto protocol, so they can get money and technology but are not restricted by its limits.
target_text: 印度和中国在京都议定书中被列为发展中国家，因此它们可以获得资金和技术，但不受其限制。

source_text: In a ceremony attended by several European political leaders and 5,000 VIP guests, Airbus unveiled plans for the A380, a twin-deck aircraft that can carry up to 840 people in all-economy class (550 for a Boeing 747), or 555 people in typical three mixed classes layout.
target_text: 在几位欧洲政治领导人和5000名贵宾参加的仪式上，空客推出了A380飞机的计划，这架双层飞机可以携带经济舱840人（波音747飞机搭载550人），或传统的三种混合机舱布局555人。

source_text: The new aircraft will take the world's-largest title away from rival Boeing's 747.
target_text: 这架新飞机将从竞争对手波音747飞机上夺走世界上最大飞机的头衔。

source_text: Boeing's upcoming new design, the 7e7, does not attempt to compete directly with the A380 but instead is aimed at a more efficient and comfortable flight at 200-250 seats.
target_text: 波音公司即将推出的新设计，7e7不会直接与A380竞争，但是相反，目的是针对200-250座位推出更高效，更舒适的飞行的飞机。

source_text: Airbus chief executive Noel Forgeard stated that he expected sales of the aircraft to exceed the 250 required for the project to break even.
target_text: 空客公司首席执行官诺尔·弗加德表示，他预计该飞机的销量将超过该项目所需的250架以上的飞机才能实现盈亏平衡。

source_text: To date, 149 confirmed orders for the aircraft have been received.
target_text: 迄今为止，已收到149架已确认的飞机订单。

source_text: The company is currently in talks with China regarding possible sales there.
target_text: 该公司目前正与中国就可能的销售进行谈判。

source_text: The first test flight of the aircraft may take place as early as March, and the first commercial flight is expected to take off in mid-2006 from Singapore's Changi Airport.
target_text: 该飞机的首次试飞可能最早在3月进行，第一次商业试飞预计将于2006年中从新加坡樟宜机场起飞。

source_text: British and American airline Virgin Atlantic has purchased six of these aeroplanes and intend to fit them with gyms and bars as well as seats.
target_text: 英国和美国航空公司维珍航空购买了其中六架飞机，打算将它们与健身房，酒吧和座椅配合使用。

source_text: Steven Lacey, 56, from Brooten, Minnesota, was killed in a one-vehicle rollover late Sunday night, July 16, 2006.
target_text: 来自明尼苏达州布鲁滕的56岁的史蒂文·莱西于2006年7月16日星期日晚上在一次车辆翻车事故中丧生。

source_text: The victim was reportedly killed on impact when his 1995 Chevy pickup rolled over after leaving the road.
target_text: 据报道，当他的1995年雪佛兰皮卡在离开公路后翻身时，受害者被撞死。

source_text: The Pope County Sheriff's department reports that Lacey was not wearing his seatbelt at the time of the accident.
target_text: 教皇县警长的部门报告说，事故发生时莱西没有系安全带。

source_text: A red tide continues along South Padre Island and into Mexico, according to officials with the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department.
target_text: 德克萨斯公园和野生动物部门的官员表示，赤潮沿着南帕德雷岛继续流入墨西哥。

source_text: Effects include stinging eyes, respiratory difficulties, and dead marine life.
target_text: 影响包括眼睛刺痛，呼吸困难和海生物死亡。

source_text: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.
target_text: 赤潮是由高于正常浓度的腰鞭毛藻引起的，腰鞭毛藻是一种天然存在的单细胞海洋生物。

source_text: Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically.
target_text: 自然因素可以交叉产生理想条件，使藻类数量急剧增加。

source_text: The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish.
target_text: 藻类产生神经毒素，可以使人类和鱼类的神经致病。

source_text: Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters.
target_text: 由于水中的毒素浓度很高，鱼经常会死亡。

source_text: Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.
target_text: 水和波浪通过风的作用而带到空气中，从而使人受到影响。

source_text: Also, South Padre officials are investigating a paralyzed cat and deceased coyote who may have consumed fish killed by the red tide.
target_text: 此外，南帕德雷官员正在调查一只瘫痪的猫和死去的土狼，他们可能吃了被赤潮杀死的鱼。

source_text: This bloom has lingered almost three weeks, and affects waters parallel to South Padre Island for about 25 miles, and may extend as far as 10 miles along Mexico beaches.
target_text: 这种强势的赤潮已经持续了将近三周，影响到与南帕德雷岛平行的水域约25英里，并且可能沿着墨西哥海滩延伸至10英里。

source_text: South Africa has won the first One-Day International of the series against Zimbabwe by five wickets at Queens Sports Club, Bulawayo, Zimbabwe.
target_text: 南非在津巴布韦布拉瓦约皇后体育俱乐部以五个三柱门击败了津巴布韦队赢得了国际性单日比赛系列赛的第一场胜利。

source_text: Vernon Philander took two wickets in two balls and some poor running decisions led to five run outs in the whole innings.
target_text: 弗农·菲兰德在两个球中拿下了两个三柱门，但是一些糟糕的跑动决定导致了整场击球局中有五次被罚出局。

source_text: Elton Chigumbura and Gary Brent fought back for Zimbabwe with a partnership of 115 runs, with Chigumbura being run out for 59 runs and Brent finishing on 59 not out.
target_text: 埃尔顿·奇昆布拉和加里·布伦特为津巴布韦联手打出了115分的反击，奇昆布拉打出59分但有被罚出局，布伦特完成59分但没有出局。

source_text: The pair recovered Zimbabwe's innings which finished at 206 all out after fifty overs.
target_text: 这对搭档追平了兹姆巴布的击球局数，在五十个回合结束后，完成了总共206次全部出局。

source_text: South Africa suffered an early blow when opening batsman Loots Bosman was dismissed in the first over, but captain Graeme Smith and ODI debutant Gulam Bodi added 72 runs together, followed by a partnership of 74 runs from Bodi and A B de Villiers.
target_text: 当开场击球手博斯曼在第一场比赛中被替换下场时，南非遭遇了过早的打击，但队长格雷姆·史密斯和国际性单日比赛首秀的古兰·博迪一起奉献了72次防止攻方得分，这是博迪和A B·维利埃的第74次合作防止攻方得分。

source_text: Smith (50 runs), Bodi (51) and de Villiers (63) all made half centuries, and South Africa comfortably reached the target with nineteen balls remaining.
target_text: 史密斯（50次防止攻方得分），博迪（51）和德维利耶（63）都创造了半个世纪来的记录，而南非则轻松地达到了只剩下19个球的目标。

source_text: The tour comes two weeks before the start of the inaugural Twenty20 World Championship, which will be held in South Africa.
target_text: 这次巡演将在首届国际性20锦标赛开始前两周举行，该锦标赛将在南非举行。

source_text: Treasury documents released today under the Freedom of Information (FOI) act reveal that Australians could face up to an A$863 rise in household costs per annum if the government proceeds with its plans to put a tax on carbon emissions.
target_text: 今天根据信息自由法案（FOI）发布的财政部文件显示，如果政府继续对碳排放征税，澳大利亚人每年的家庭成本可能会增加863澳元。

source_text: The documents reveal an a annual price rise of $218.40 for electricity, $114.40 for gas, $187.20 for petrol and $88.40 for food for the average household.
target_text: 这些文件显示，电力每年价格上涨218.40美元，汽油价格上涨114.40美元，汽油价格上涨187.20美元，普通家庭食品价格上涨88.40美元。

source_text: The treasury modelling was based on a $30 carbon tax, but also estimated other prices such as a $40 tax which predicted a rise of over $1,100 to the average household's annual budget.
target_text: 财政部模型是基于30美元的碳税，但也估计其他价格，如40美元的税，预计比平均家庭的年度预算增加超过1,100美元。

source_text: However, they do not take into account the compensation deals and offsets promised by the government if a price is put on carbon.
target_text: 但是，他们没有考虑政府承诺的补偿交易和抵消，如果价格是关于碳的。

source_text: After viewing the treasury modelling, Treasurer Wayne Swan and Climate Change Minister Greg Combet released a joint statement saying without the finalization of compensation packages it is too early to predict price rises.
target_text: 在查看资金管理模型后，财务主管韦恩·斯旺和气候变化部长格雷格·康贝特发表联合声明称，如果不确定补偿方案，现在预测价格上涨还为时过早。

source_text: "No final decisions on the starting price or assistance have been taken and therefore it is far too early to speculate on any potential price impacts," the statement said.
target_text: 声明说：“没有对起始价格或援助作出最终决定，因此现在推测任何潜在的价格影响还为时尚早。”

source_text: "Until the final design and modelling have been settled, anyone who uses these figures to scare families about prices is engaging in a dishonest, misleading scare campaign."
target_text: “直到最终的设计和模型确定下来，任何使用这些数据吓唬家庭价格的人都会参与一场不诚实，误导性的恐吓活动。”

source_text: "This just demonstrates that the Government has known all along that its carbon tax won't clean up the environment but it will clean out your wallet," he said.
target_text: “这只是表明政府一直都知道，碳税不会清理环境，但会清理你的钱包，”他说。

source_text: "This is an $863 a year hit on families' cost of living."
target_text: “这是每年863美元的家庭生活费用。”

source_text: "They don't need a bad situation made much, much worse by Julia Gillard's carbon tax."
target_text: “他们不需要在糟糕的情况下赚很多钱，更糟糕的是朱莉娅·吉拉德的碳税。”

source_text: The Australian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (ACCI) has also officially opposed the adoption of a carbon tax.
target_text: 澳大利亚工商会也正式反对征收用碳税。

source_text: A resolution was passed by all 30 members at their general meeting to reject the Federal government's plan.
target_text: 所有30名成员在其股东大会上通过决议，来拒绝联邦政府的计划。

source_text: On the eve of December 7, 2007 Dr. Reginald Humayun, a Christian doctor working for Pennell Memorial Christian Hospital in Bannu, Pakistan, was kidnapped along with his driver while returning from a trip to Dera Ismail Khan.
target_text: 2007年12月7日前夕，在巴基斯坦本努的彭内尔纪念基督教徒医院工作的基督徒医生雷金纳·德哈博士在前往德拉·伊斯梅尔·汗的途中返回时与他的司机一起被绑架。

source_text: The All Pakistan Minority Alliance, the Church of Pakistan and the Christian community as a whole have appealed to the Government to expedite efforts for the doctor's safe recovery.
target_text: 全巴基斯坦少数民族联盟，巴基斯坦教会和整个基督教社区都呼吁政府尽快为医生的安全回来做出努力。

source_text: Dar Ali Khatak, leading the investigation by the Bannu Police has expressed deep concerns and vows to find the hostages though until now no progress has been seen.
target_text: 领导本努警方调查的达里·阿里·哈塔克表达了深切的关注，并发誓要找到人质，但直到现在还没有看到任何进展。

source_text: With the recent state of politics in Pakistan, it is becoming increasingly difficult for those who are providing humanitarian services.
target_text: 随着巴基斯坦最近的政治状况，提供人道主义服务的人越来越艰难。

source_text: Financial analysts say Google is planning an e-wallet service that could eventually compete with eBay's payment service PayPal.
target_text: 金融分析师表示，谷歌正在计划一项电子钱包服务，最终可能与易趣的支付服务贝宝竞争。

source_text: What form that expansion will take has been a hotly debated subject for the company whose stock valuation momentarily made it the world's biggest media company on June 7, 2005.
target_text: 这种扩张将采取何种形式一直是该公司激烈争论的主题，该公司的股票估值暂时使其成为2005年6月7日全球最大的媒体公司。

source_text: Even Microsoft has been mentioned as a possible future competitor.
target_text: 甚至微软也被提到可能成为未来的竞争对手。

source_text: Ebay's stock valuation dipped more than 2% on the news.
target_text: 易趣的股价估值下跌超过2％。

source_text: But one business analyst saw potential benefit for Paypal , depending on exactly how the "Google Wallet" takes shape.
target_text: 但是，一位商业分析师看到了贝宝的潜在好处，这取决于“谷歌钱包”究竟是如何形成的。

source_text: The uncertainty underlined the lack of substantive information behind the rumor.
target_text: 不确定性强调了传言背后缺乏实质性信息。

source_text: According to the New York Times, the CEO of a major online merchant, who spoke on the condition of anonymity, was approached by Google to take part in this service.
target_text: 根据“纽约时报”的报道，一位不愿透露姓名的主要在线商家的首席执行官接洽并参与谷歌此项服务。

source_text: Having announced that Barry Prime would take over the newly created post of National Performance Director for swimming, Swim Ireland has revealed that the British coach has changed his mind about taking up the post.
target_text: 在宣布巴里·普莱姆将担任新设的游泳国家绩效总监的职位后，爱尔兰游泳协会透露，这位英籍教练改变了要担任这个职位的主意。

source_text: Barry Prime had agreed earlier this month to take over the post, but has changed his mind because he does not wish to move to Ireland from his current home in Australia.
target_text: 巴里·普莱姆本月早些时候同意接任这个职位，但他已经改变了主意，因为他不想从他目前在澳大利亚的家中搬到爱尔兰。

source_text: He said, "I have realized that I do not wish to leave Australia and for that reason, and that reason alone, I will not take up the post."
target_text: 他说，“我已经意识到我不想离开澳大利亚，因此，仅凭这个原因，我就不会担任这个职位。”

source_text: The loss of Mr. Prime, a seasoned professional coach at the Australian Institute of Sport, is a major blow to Swim Ireland which has struggled in recent years to adapt to changes in international swimming.
target_text: 失去澳大利亚体育学院经验丰富的专业教练普莱姆先生对于爱尔兰游泳协会来说是一个重大打击，因为爱尔兰近年来一直在努力适应国际游泳的变化。

source_text: Academy Award-winning film director Paul Haggis declared to Scientology spokesman Tommy Davis that he had decided to leave the Church of Scientology after being a member for 35 years.
target_text: 获得奥斯卡金像奖的电影导演保罗·哈吉斯向科学教派发言人汤米·戴维斯宣布，他决定在已经成为会员35年后离开科学教会。

source_text: His letter to Davis was posted Saturday on the blog of former high-ranking Scientology official Marty Rathbun.
target_text: 他周六在前高级科学教派官员马蒂·拉思的博客上发表了他给戴维斯的信。

source_text: Haggis received Academy Awards for writing and producing the 2004 film Crash, which he also directed.
target_text: 哈吉斯因撰写和制作2004年电影《撞车》而获得奥斯卡奖，他也执导了该片。

source_text: Rathbun confirmed the authenticity of the letter by Haggis, and The Hollywood Reporter also confirmed it with a friend of the director.
target_text: 拉斯本证实了哈吉斯写这封信的真实性，而好莱坞记者也与导演的一位朋友证实了这一点。

source_text: At his blog, Rathbun has been critical of Scientology's current leader David Miscavige.
target_text: 在他的博客中，拉斯本一直批评科学教派现任领导人大卫·米西卡维治。

source_text: In the June article "Former Scientology executives say leader David Miscavige abused staff", Wikinews reported on criticism by Rathbun and other high-ranking officials that was published in a series of investigative articles in the St. Petersburg Times.
target_text: 在6月份的文章“前科学教派高管说领导人大卫·米西卡维治虐待员工”中，维基新闻报道了拉斯本和其他高级官员的批评，这些批评发表在圣彼得堡时报的一系列调查文章中。

source_text: In his letter to Davis, Haggis wrote that he read the series in the St. Petersburg Times, where these former Scientology officials accused David Miscavige of physically abusing Scientologists.
target_text: 在给戴维斯的信中，哈吉斯写道，他读了圣彼得堡时报的系列文章，这些前科学教派官员指责大卫·米西卡维治对教徒进行身体虐待。

source_text: He criticized the manner in which the Church of Scientology attempted to smear the former officials after they spoke out against the organization.
target_text: 他批评了科学教会在他们反对该组织后试图诽谤前官员的方式。

source_text: Well-known celebrity Scientologists include actors Tom Cruise and John Travolta.
target_text: 著名的名人教徒包括演员汤姆·克鲁斯和约翰·特拉沃尔塔。

source_text: Haggis had not been known to be a vocal public supporter of Scientology prior to his declaration to Davis that he was leaving the organization.
target_text: 在向戴维斯宣布离开该组织之前，哈吉斯并不是科学教派的公开支持者。

source_text: He expressed his disappointment to Davis, son of actress Anne Archer, that the San Diego, California branch of the Church of Scientology supported Proposition 8.
target_text: 他对女演员安妮·阿彻的儿子戴维斯表示失望，他认为科学教派加州圣地亚哥分会支持第8号提案。

source_text: Proposition 8 removed the rights of same-sex couples to marry in California.
target_text: 第8号提案取消了同性伴侣在加利福尼亚州结婚的权利。

source_text: The San Diego Church of Scientology was listed along with other groups on a Proposition 8 supporters website, but it was later removed.
target_text: 圣地亚哥科学教派与其他团体在第8号提案支持者网站上列出，但后来被删除。

source_text: Haggis said that Davis initially told him he would do something about the San Diego Church of Scientology's support for Proposition 8, but in the end Davis did not take action about this.
target_text: 哈吉斯说，戴维斯最初告诉他，他会对圣地亚哥科学教会对第8号提案的支持采取一些措施，但最终戴维斯没有对此采取行动。

source_text: Haggis called the inaction by Davis with regard to the San Diego Church of Scientology's stance on homosexuality "cowardly".
target_text: 哈吉斯称戴维斯对圣地亚哥科学教派关于同性恋“懦弱”的立场不采取行动。

source_text: According to Haggis, the Scientology practice of "disconnection" was imposed on Rennard and her husband, and they were ordered to disconnect from her parents because Rennard's parents had violated a rule of the organization.
target_text: 根据哈吉斯的说法，对于雷纳德和她的丈夫施加了“断开连接”的科学教派实践，并且由于雷纳德的父母违反了该组织的规定，他们被命令与父母脱离关系。

source_text: Due to having undergone a personal experience with regard to Scientology's practice of disconnection, Haggis was surprised to hear Davis deny the policy existed in an interview with CNN journalist John Roberts.
target_text: 由于个人经历了科学教派断绝关系的做法，哈吉斯很惊讶地听到戴维斯在接受美国有线电视新闻网记者约翰罗伯茨采访时否认该政策。

source_text: He concluded his letter to Davis by noting that his Scientologist friends might disassociate from him due to his words, writing, "...I am fully aware that some of my friends may choose to no longer associate with me, or in some cases work with me."
target_text: 他在给戴维斯的信中断定，他的科学教派朋友可能会因为他的话而与他脱离关系，写道：“……我完全清楚我的一些朋友可能选择不再与我联系，或者在某些情况下与我一起工作。”

source_text: I will always take their calls, as I always took yours.
target_text: 我会随时接听他们的电话，就正如我总是会接你的电话一样。

source_text: However, I have finally come to the conclusion that I can no longer be a part of this group.
target_text: 但是，我终于得出结论，我不能再成为这个群体的一部分。

source_text: Frankly, I had to look no further than your refusal to denounce the church's anti-gay stance, and the indefensible actions, and inactions, of those who condone this behavior within the organization.
target_text: 坦率地说，我不得不谴责你拒绝谴责教会的反同性恋立场，以及那些在组织内纵容这种行为的人的不可原谅的行为和不作为。

source_text: I am only ashamed that I waited this many months to act.
target_text: 我很惭愧，我等了很多个月才采取行动。

source_text: "I hereby resign my membership in the Church of Scientology."
target_text: “我在此辞去科学教会的会员资格。”

source_text: Roger Friedman of The Hollywood Reporter described the film director's decision to leave the Church of Scientology as "a stunning move".
target_text: “好莱坞报道”的罗杰·弗里德曼描述了电影导演决定离开科学教派是一个“惊人的举动”。

source_text: Friedman wrote that "Haggis has taken an enormous step here, and one that should resonate among all celebrity Scientologists."
target_text: 弗里德曼写道：“哈吉斯在这里迈出了巨大的一步，应该引起所有名人科学教派教徒的共鸣。”

source_text: Writing for Movieline, Kyle Buchanan characterized the letter by Haggis as "a candid, confrontational letter to Scientology top brass", and said "It's a must-read."
target_text: 凯尔·布坎南在为影视在线网站撰写的文章中，将哈格吉斯的这封信描述为“写给科学教派的一封坦率、具有挑战性的信”，并称“这是必读之物”。

source_text: Radar Online observed "In a shock heard-round-the-Scientology world, Paul Haggis has very publicly quit the organization."
target_text: 雷达在线观察到“在一个令人震惊的整个科学教派的世界中，保罗·哈吉斯已经公开地退出该组织。”

source_text: Foster Kamer wrote for Gawker that the letter by Haggis was "incredibly damning" to Scientology, and Adam McDowell of National Post called it "a scathing letter about church policy".
target_text: 福斯特·卡默为高克写道，哈吉斯的信对科学教派来说是“令人难以置信的诅咒”，国民邮政的亚当·麦克道尔称其为“一封关于教会政策的措辞严厉的信件”。

source_text: Vicki Hyman of The Star-Ledger called Haggis "the most famous name (if not face) to renounce the Church of Scientology", and Xan Brooks wrote in The Guardian that "the Church of Scientology lost one of its most high-profile members".
target_text: 明星记事的维姬·海曼称哈吉斯是“放弃科学教派的最著名的人物（如果不是指面孔”），而布鲁克斯在卫报中写道“科学教派失去了其中一位最知名的成员”。

source_text: According to The Guardian, the Church of Scientology has not yet responded publicly to the statements made by Haggis in his letter to Davis.
target_text: 根据“卫报”的报道，科学教派尚未公开回应哈吉斯在给戴维斯的信中所作的陈述。

source_text: Haggis has multiple credits in film, including work as writer-director for Crash, and writer for Million Dollar Baby (directed by Clint Eastwood), Casino Royale, Quantum of Solace, and Letters From Iwo Jima.
target_text: 哈吉斯在该电影界中身兼多职，包括担任电影《事故》的编剧兼导演，以及《百万美元宝贝》（由克林特·伊斯特伍德执导），《皇家赌场》，《量子危机》和《硫磺岛来信》的剧作家。

source_text: Both Million Dollar Baby (2004) and Crash (2005) won Academy Awards for Best Picture, making Haggis the first film writer since 1950 to pen movies which won Best Picture Oscars in consecutive years.
target_text: 《百万美元宝贝》（2004）和《事故》（2005）都获得了奥斯卡最佳影片奖，使哈吉斯成为自1950年以来第一位连续几年获得最佳影片奥斯卡奖的电影作家。

source_text: He is highly-regarded for his work as a humanitarian and for his civil liberties work, and his letter includes a list of awards he has received related to his dedication to civil rights.
target_text: 他因其人道主义工作和公民自由的工作而受到高度赞扬，他的信件内容包括他收到的与他致力于公民权利有关的奖项清单。

source_text: He is currently working on the film The Next Three Days, which includes actors Liam Neeson, Russell Crowe, and former Scientologist Jason Beghe.
target_text: 他目前正在制作电影《接下来的三天》，其中包括演员利亚姆·尼森、罗素·克劳和前科学教派教徒杰森·贝赫。

source_text: Beghe previously went public with his own criticism after leaving the Church of Scientology, and described how members must pay large amounts of money to advance in Scientology levels.
target_text: 在离开科学教派之后，贝赫之前公开了自我批评，并描述了成员们必须支付大量资金才能在科学教派中得到晋升。

source_text: According to Russian officials, an Aeroflot-Nord, Flight 821, a Boeing 737-500 crashed near the city of Perm at 3:15 a.m. local time with 88 people aboard, all feared to have been killed.
target_text: 根据俄罗斯官员的说法，北方航空821航班，一架波音737-500飞机在当地时间凌晨3点15分在彼尔姆市附近坠毁，飞机上有88人，可能全部遇害。

source_text: There were six crew and 82 passengers from 21 different nations including seven children and one baby on board the plane.
target_text: 飞机上有6名机组成员和来自21个不同国家的82名乘客，包括七名儿童和一名婴儿。

source_text: Reuters quotes the Ekho Moskvy (Echo of Moscow) radio station in Russia that all on board were dead.
target_text: 路透社援引俄罗斯莫斯科回声广播电台的话说，所有人都死了。

source_text: The plane took off at 1:12 a.m. local time and was traveling from Moscow to Perm when officials at the Bolshoye Savino Airport lost contact with the aircraft at about 1,800 meters in altitude.
target_text: 这架飞机于当地时间凌晨1点12分起飞，从莫斯科前往彼尔姆时，博索耶·萨维诺机场的官员在海拔约1800米处与飞机失去联系。

source_text: The plane crashed just outside the airport, while on final approach to land.
target_text: 这架飞机在机场外面坠毁，最后坠落在陆地上。

source_text: One report says it crashed into a ravine while another states it crashed into a swampy area.
target_text: 一份报告说，它坠毁在一个山沟，而另一个报告说它坠毁在一个沼泽地区。

source_text: Wreckage is reported to cover nearly 3 sq mi (4 km2).
target_text: 据报道，残骸覆盖面积近3平方英里（4平方公里）。

source_text: The wreckage burst into flames and one Russian report says the pilots tried to avoid hitting residential homes that were near the scene.
target_text: 残骸引发燃烧，俄罗斯的一份报告说，飞行员试图避免撞到现场附近的住宅。

source_text: The plane's wreckage was found a short time after the crash.
target_text: 坠机事故发生后不久就发现了这架飞机的残骸。

source_text: Part of the main Trans-Siberian Railway line was damaged as a result of the crash and has been closed.
target_text: 跨西伯利亚铁路干线部分路段因飞机坠毁而损坏，并已关闭。

source_text: "It came down within the city limits (in Perm) in a patch of waste ground."
target_text: “它在市内的一片废弃土地上（在彼尔姆）降下来。”

source_text: "Initial reports are of no casualties on the ground," said the Emergencies Ministries who also said that there was "no damage or deaths on the ground."
target_text: “初步报告显示，在当地没有人员伤亡，”紧急情况部门表示。他们也说“当地没有受伤或死亡”。

source_text: Witnesses in apartments near the crash describe it as sounding like a "war [had] started", followed by a "huge flames."
target_text: 坠机事故附近的公寓里的目击者形容这听起来像是“战争已经开始”，接着是“巨大的火焰”。

source_text: The aircraft, registered as number VP-BKO, was sixteen years old, originally operated by Xiamen Airlines.
target_text: 这架飞机注册号为VP-BKO，服役十六年，最初是厦门航空运营。

source_text: Officials are currently investigating the cause of the crash, but Sky News in Australia reports that there is no indication that terrorism was involved.
target_text: 官员目前正在调查事故原因，但澳大利亚的天空新闻报道说没有迹象表明涉及恐怖主义。

source_text: TIME reports that officials have located the plane's two black boxes and are analyzing the information.
target_text: 时代报道官员已经找到飞机的两个黑匣子并正在分析信息。

source_text: This is said to be Russia's worst commercial air disaster since August 2006 when 170 people died after a Tupolev Tu-154 passenger jet, flight 612, owned by St. Petersburg-based Pulkovo Airlines, crashed in the Ukraine.
target_text: 据称，这是自2006年8月以来俄罗斯发生的最严重的商业空难。2006年8月，圣彼得堡普尔科沃航空公司旗下的Tu-154客机612航班在乌克兰坠毁，造成170人死亡。

source_text: An investigation concluded that it had been hit by lightning.
target_text: 一项调查得出结论，它遭到了雷击。

source_text: China looks to launch it's second manned space mission in October, two years after it's first flight, a newspaper reported Friday.
target_text: 周五据一家报纸报道，中国计划于10月第二次启动载人航天飞行任务。

source_text: The Shenzhou VI capsule will "preferably be launched in early October," said Sun Weigang the director of the Space Department of the China Aerospace Science and Technology Corp, said in the report in the China Daily newspaper.
target_text: 中国航天科技集团航天部主任孙伟刚在“中国日报”的报道中说，神舟六号舱“最好在十月初发射”。

source_text: Chinese officials say to they plan to land an unmanned probe on the moon by 2010 and operate a space station.
target_text: 中国官员表示，他们计划到2010年在月球上登陆无人探测器，并运营一个空间站。

source_text: Iraqi Brigadier General Qassim Atta al-Mussawi reported that Operation Law and Order (Arabic: Fardh Al-Qanoon) has been successful in curbing violence in the capital.
target_text: 伊拉克准将卡西姆·阿塔·穆萨维报告说，“行动法和秩序”（阿拉伯语：法德赫·阿尔-卡农）成功地遏制了首都的暴力事件。

source_text: Coalition forces have swept through various Baghdad neighborhoods in the past few months.
target_text: 在过去几个月里，联军已经巡逻了巴格达的各个街区。

source_text: Atta, a spokesperson for the operation cited comparative statistics for the four-week periods of mid-January to mid-February versus mid-February to mid-March: * Civilian killing: 1440 to 265 * Roadside bombings: 163 to 102 * Carbombs: 56 to 36 * Mortar attacks: 204 to 109 * Assassination incidents: 519 to 22 * Kidnappings: 98 to 10
target_text: 该行动发言人阿塔引用了1月中旬至2月中旬对2月中旬至3月中旬这四周的比较统计：*平民死亡：1440对265 *路边炸弹爆炸：163对102 * 汽车炸弹：56对36 *迫击炮袭击：204对109 *暗杀事件：519对22 *绑架：98对10。

source_text: It is not clear what these numbers are based on, and independent estimates of the death toll are much higher.
target_text: 目前尚不清楚这些数字是根据什么得来的，并且对死亡人数的独立估计要高得多。

source_text: According to data compiled by Iraq Body Count (IBC), a volunteer project that maintains a database of civilian deaths in Iraq from media reports, at least 393 people died in and around Baghdad between February 15 and March 11.
target_text: 根据伊拉克尸体统计编制的数据，这是一个志愿者项目，从媒体报道中建立一个伊拉克平民死亡数据库，2月15日至3月11日期间，至少有393人在巴格达及其周边地区死亡。

source_text: The New York Times estimates 450 Iraqi civilian deaths in and around the capital in the period, using initial reports provided by hospitals and the Iraqi Interior ministry.

source_text: The final report, released in October, blamed pilot error for the disaster.
target_text: 10月份发布的最终报告灾难归咎于飞行员错误。

source_text: The report stated that the aircraft had approached at a speed far exceeding that at which the wing flaps could properly operate, and attempted to execute a landing at 408 kph (254 mph), which is 160 kph (100 mph) above the safe speed.
target_text: 报告指出，飞机接近的速度远远超过机翼襟翼能够正常运行的速度，并试图以408公里每小时（254英里每小时）的速度执行着陆，这比安全速度高160公里每小时（100英里每小时）。

source_text: It also found that captain Marwoto Komar had ignored fifteen activations of the Ground Proximity Warning System (GPWS) informing Mr Komar that the aircraft was flying at a speed beyond that at which it could safely land, but he failed to abort.
target_text: 它还发现船长马沃托·科马尔忽略了15次地面接近警告系统的激活，通知科尔马先生飞机的飞行速度超过了它可以安全降落的速度，但他没有终止。

source_text: It also commented that he missed one further opportunity for emergency evasive action when the airliner struck the runway and bounced into the air, at which point co-pilot Gagam Rochmana requested a 'go-around' procedure be initiated, but was also ignored.

source_text: It further criticised Mr Komar for singing during final approach, a direct violation of the Garuda Basic Operations Manual, which calls for activation of the Sterile Cockpit Rule at 10,000 feet and below.

source_text: He also confirmed that investigators cannot speak to the police, with the only permitted testimony under the legislation being to testify at a court hearing, and pointed out that the document does not actually appoint any blame.
target_text: 他还证实，调查人员不能与警方交谈，根据法律允许的唯一证词是在法庭听证会上作证，并指出该文件实际上没有任何指责。

source_text: The international legislation he was referring to is probably the Convention on International Civil Aviation, which stipulates that accident reports and related material, specifically transcripts of interviews, communications with crew and cockpit voice recorder and flight data recorder (collectively known as black boxes) readouts, must not be used for any purpose other than determining the cause of an accident or incident.
target_text: 他所指的国际立法可能是“国际民用航空公约”，其中规定了事故报告和相关材料，特别是访谈记录，与驾驶员和驾驶舱语音记录器和飞行数据记录器（统称为黑匣子）读数的通信，除了确定事故或事故原因外，不得将其用于任何其他目的。

source_text: The only possible exception to this is where potential benefit would outweigh the "adverse domestic and international impact" on the investigation in question or any other either in progress or in the future.
target_text: 唯一可能的例外是，潜在的利益将超过对有关调查或正在进行或将来的任何其他调查“不利的国内和国际影响”。

source_text: This legislation is in place to provide protection to witnesses on the basis that without it they may be less likely to cooperate with investigational procedures.
target_text: 这项立法是为了向证人提供保护，因为没有证据，他们可能不太可能配合调查程序。

source_text: Aridono Sukman, the police member in charge of the criminal investigation, said that the contents of the black box were vital evidence.
target_text: 负责刑事调查的警察阿里多诺·苏克曼说，黑匣子的内容是至关重要的证据。

source_text: Officials commented that some relatives had expressed their frustration over the legal challenges involved in the prosecution effort.
target_text: 官员评论说，一些亲属对控方起诉所涉及的法律挑战表示沮丧。

source_text: Early in February Mr Komar was arrested;
target_text: 2月初，科马尔先生被捕。

source_text: he has subsequently been charged with manslaughter charges which carry a maximum sentence of five years' imprisonment.
target_text: 他后来被指控犯有过失杀人罪，最高刑罚为五年监禁。

source_text: The London-based International Federation of Air Line Pilots Associations (IFALPA) issued a press release condemning this move, saying that further investigations are needed into the crash, and that criminal proceedings could prevent an accurate version of events from ever being known.
target_text: 总部位于伦敦的国际航线飞行员协会联合会发布了一份新闻稿，谴责这一举动，并表示需要对坠机事件进行进一步调查，并且刑事诉讼程序可能会阻止对事件的准确版本的了解。

source_text: Specifically, the release said that "IFALPA believes that the circumstances of the accident as set forth in the final report of the Indonesian investigation authority leaves many serious questions concerning the crew actions prior to the accident."
target_text: 具体而言，该发布说“国际航线飞行员协会联合会认为，印度尼西亚调查机关最终报告中提到的事故情况在事故发生前留下了许多关于机组人员行为的严重问题。”

source_text: "Central to these concerns are the underlying reasons for the reported behavior of Captain Marwoto Komar."
target_text: “这些问题的关注点的核心是马沃托·科马尔机长在报告中行为的影响因素。”

source_text: "Experienced pilots have considerable difficulty in attempting to explain what is reported in the context of normal airline operations."
target_text: “经验丰富的飞行员在试图解释航空公司正常运营情况下所报告的内容方面存在相当大的困难。”

source_text: "The Federation believes that the explanations proffered by the report do not square with the collective experience of our members."
target_text: “联合会认为报告提供的解释与我们成员的共同经验不符。”

source_text: The release went on to state the opinion that prosecution may bring total foreclosure to the case and could only be counterproductive.
target_text: 这份文件还指出，起诉可能会导致整个案件的止赎权全部丧失，而且可能不会起到任何作用。

source_text: It also said "He remains a professional who was involved in an unfortunate tragedy."
target_text: 它还说“他仍然是一个被卷入不幸悲剧的专业人士。”

source_text: One possible explanation had previously been suggested by the head of the Garuda pilots association, Stephanus Geraldus.
target_text: 印尼鹰航航空飞行员协会负责人斯蒂芬纳斯·杰拉尔德先前提出了一个可能的解释。

source_text: He said that marital problems between Mr Komar and his wife Norma Andriani were "common knowledge" and was backed up by an industry analyst and pilot who said he believed the couple had been arguing late into the night, and expressed concern that the report had not addressed psychological issues.
target_text: 他说，科尔马先生和他的妻子诺尔玛·阿德里亚诺之间的婚姻问题是“常识”，并得到了一位行业分析师和飞行员的支持，他说他相信这对夫妇一直在争论到深夜，并表示关心报告没有解决心理问题。

source_text: Mr Geraldus also said sleep deprivation could have contributed, with the flight crew reporting for duty at 4:30 am and the flight departing an hour and a half later.
target_text: 杰拉尔德斯先生还说睡觉剥夺可能是原因之一。机组人员于凌晨四时三十分报到值勤，航班在一个半小时后离开。

source_text: The report had hinted at problems, saying "The pilot was probably emotionally aroused because his conscious awareness moved from the relaxed mode "singing"to the heightened stressfulness of the desire to reach the runway by making an excessively steep and fast, unstabilised approach,"
target_text: 该报告暗示了问题，并称“领航员很可能是情绪激动，因为他的意识从放松的‘唱歌’模式转移到了高度紧张的状态，他想通过不稳定的，快速而陡峭的飞行方式到达跑道。”

source_text: It is also known that Mr Komar had been under police surveillance, during which time he was receiving psychological treatment.
target_text: 众所周知，科马尔先生一直受到警方的监视，在此期间他接受了心理治疗。

source_text: Meanwhile, two survivors, Adrianus Meliala and Retno Gunowati, went to the House of Representatives (DPR) to challenge those opposed to legal processes against the pilot.
target_text: 与此同时，两名幸存者阿德里亚诺·梅丽拉和吉诺·瓦提前往众议院挑战那些反对针对飞行员的法律程序的人。

source_text: He was forced to resign late in February with being fired his only alternative, and his licence has been suspended.
target_text: 他被迫在2月末辞职，被解雇是唯一的替代方案，并且他的执照被暂停。

source_text: He is believed to be the only man ever prosecuted in Indonesian history over an airliner crash.
target_text: 他被认为是印度尼西亚历史上唯一一个因飞机失事而被起诉的人。

source_text: Eva Avila, 19, of Gatineau, Quebec was crowned this years winner of Canadian Idol.

source_text: Avila won by approximately 131,000 votes, a margin of just over three per cent of the four million votes cast in the final.

source_text: "I'm just one tiny person on this planet but thanks to you guys, I'm feeling like I'm sitting on top of the world," Avila said Sunday.

target_text: 阿维拉演唱了她即将发行的专辑“想要飞”的第一首单曲，由香岱儿·克雷威亚朱科和她的丈夫雷恩·梅达共同创作。

source_text: Singer Andy Williams has died at 84 years old on Tuesday.
target_text: 歌手安迪·威廉姆斯周二去世，享年84岁。

source_text: Williams had a variety show on television called "The Andy Williams Show" from 1962 to 1967 and 1969 to 1971.
target_text: 威廉姆斯在1962年至1967年和1969年至1971年间在电视上播出了一部名为“安迪·威廉姆斯秀”的综艺节目。

source_text: His songs included Moon River, Can't Take My Eyes off You, and Christmas song It's the Most Wonderful Time of the Year.
target_text: 他的歌曲包括《月亮河》，《不能把我的眼睛从你身上移开》，圣诞歌曲：《年度最精彩时刻》。

source_text: 40th President of the United States Ronald Reagan said Williams' voice was "a national treasure".
target_text: 美国第40任总统罗纳德·里根说威廉姆斯的声音是“国宝”。

source_text: Williams was born Howard Andrew Williams on December 3, 1927 in Wall Lake, Iowa.
target_text: 威廉姆斯于1927年12月3日出生于爱荷华州沃尔湖的霍华德安德鲁威廉姆斯。

source_text: His older brothers Robert, Donald, and Richard and he formed the Williams Brothers, a singing quartet.
target_text: 他的哥哥罗伯特，唐纳德，理查德和他组成了威廉姆斯兄弟，一个歌唱四重奏组合。

source_text: He married Claudine Longet in 1961 and they divorced in 1975.
target_text: 他于1961年与克劳丁·龙吉斯特结婚，并于1975年离婚。

source_text: Four young girls were killed and six more people injured when a brick wall collapsed on top of them in Zambia.
target_text: 在赞比亚，一堵砖墙发生倒塌，四名年轻女孩死亡，另有六人受伤。

source_text: The victims had been trying to reach a free mosquito net handout when a stampede erupted, causing the collapse.
target_text: 当踩踏事件爆发时，受害者一直试图想拿到免费分发的蚊帐，导致坍塌事件的发生。

source_text: The accident occurred in the town of Mpika, where the Ministry of Health was conducting the handout as part of an anti-malaria initiative.
target_text: 事故发生在皮卡镇，卫生部在那里分发救济品作为抗疟疾倡议的一部分。

source_text: As people flocked to the community hall where the event was taking place, people outside the premises began climbing the walls in an effort to get in, initiating the collapse.
target_text: 当人们涌向活动所在的社区大厅时，场地外的人们开始爬墙，试图进入，引发了坍塌。

source_text: The four girls died on the spot in the incident, which occurred at around 17:30 local time.
target_text: 这四名女孩当场死亡，发生在当地时间17：30左右。

source_text: Six others were taken to the local Mpika District Hospital, where they were treated for their injuries, which are believed to be non life-threatening.
target_text: 其他六人被送往当地的皮卡地区医院，在那里他们因受伤而接受治疗，据悉这些患者没有生命危险。

source_text: A ban on smoking in enclosed public places in England is in effect as of 0600 BST today, bringing the country into line with similar laws already introduced in other parts of the United Kingdom.
target_text: 英国封闭式公共场所禁止吸烟的法令自英国夏令时间0600起生效，使该国符合英国其他地区已经引入的类似法律。

source_text: The aims of the ban are to reduce the risks associated with passive smoking and to reduce the number of smokers overall.
target_text: 该禁令的目的是降低与被动吸烟相关的风险，并减少整体吸烟者的数量。

source_text: The government estimates that 600,000 of the 10 million smokers in Britain will give up as a result.
target_text: 政府估计，英国1000万吸烟者中有60万人会因此而放弃。

source_text: Health Secretary Alan Johnson welcomes the ban, saying that "A smoke-free country will improve the health of thousands of people, reduce the temptation to smoke, and encourage smokers to quit."
target_text: 卫生部长艾伦·约翰逊对这项禁令表示欢迎，称“无烟国家将改善成千上万人的健康，减少吸烟的诱惑，并鼓励吸烟者戒烟。”

source_text: The ban is not being welcomed by all citizens, however.
target_text: 但是，禁令并未受到所有公民的欢迎。

source_text: The business community is expressing concerns about the impact on pubs and similar establishments.
target_text: 商界对于对酒吧和类似场所的影响表示担忧。

source_text: Research by Nielsen estimates that the sale of beer in England and Wales could fall by 200 million pints yearly.
target_text: 尼尔森的研究估计，英格兰和威尔士的啤酒销售量每年可减少2亿品脱。

source_text: However, a survey by the Campaign for Real Ale suggests 840,000 people who do not regularly go to the pub would do so following the introduction of the ban and that England's 6.2 million regular drinkers would be more likely to visit pubs and bars.
target_text: 然而，真实啤酒运动组织的一项调查表明，在实施禁令后，84万人不经常去酒馆的人会去酒馆，而且英国的620万常规饮酒者更有可能去酒馆和酒吧。

source_text: Smoking kills 100,000 people in Britain each year through cancer, lung conditions, and heart problems.
target_text: 吸烟导致英国每年10万人因癌症，肺部疾病和心脏病而死亡。

source_text: Approximately 1,000 people a day in England are admitted to hospital with an illness related to smoking, costing the National Health Service an estimated £1.5 billion.
target_text: 在英格兰，每天大约有1000人因吸烟而入院治疗，用在国民健康服务中心的费用估计为15亿英镑。

source_text: Ringo Starr, who is a member of The Beatles, was given his own star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on Monday.
target_text: 作为甲壳虫乐队成员的林戈斯塔尔周一在好莱坞星光大道上获得了自己的星形奖章。

source_text: The event, which was also celebrating fifty years since the pavement was founded, took place during the night for the first time.
target_text: 此次活动也是为庆祝星光大道建立五十年的活动，在夜间举行。

source_text: Starr was the 2401st individual to have a star awarded on the walk.
target_text: 斯塔尔是第2401位获得星形奖章的人。

source_text: The event also took place outside of the Capitol Records Building.
target_text: 该活动也在国会唱片大楼外举行。

source_text: Starr said outside of the event: "This is the start of the next 50 years of stars."
target_text: 斯塔尔在活动之外说：“这是未来50年明星的开始。”

source_text: According to Reuters," fellow Beatles bandmate Sir Paul McCartney was unable to attend the ceremony due to the fact that he was in England at the time", Starr said.
target_text: 据路透社报道，“披头士乐队的队友保罗·麦卡特尼爵士由于他当时在英国而未能出席仪式”，斯塔尔说。

source_text: Less than twelve months before Ringo was given his star on the Walk of Fame, Paul McCartney assisted in revealing a star for another former Beatles member, the late George Harrison.
target_text: 不到12个月后，林戈就在星光大道被授予了他的星形奖章。保罗·麦卡特尼协助展示另一名前披头士成员、已故的葛·哈里森的星形奖章。

source_text: The late John Lennon was also given a star on the pavement, which means that Paul McCartney is now the only member of the Beatles who has not yet been awarded a star.
target_text: 已故的约翰·列侬也在星光大道上获得了一颗星，这意味着保罗·麦卡特尼现在是甲壳虫乐队唯一尚未获得星形奖章的成员。

source_text: McCartney "[w]as selected and approved [for a star] many years ago."
target_text: 麦卡特尼“多年前被选中并批准【为一位明星】。”

source_text: "We are just waiting for his people to give us a date on when he would like to do it," according to a Hollywood Chamber of Commerce source.
target_text: 据好莱坞商会消息人士透露，“我们只是在等待他的人民给我们一个他希望何时去做的日期”。

source_text: The event was also partly to promote "Y Not", the drummer's recently released album.
target_text: 此次活动还部分是为了宣传鼓手最近发行的专辑“为什么不”。

source_text: "I don't know about you, but where I live."
target_text: “我不了解你，但我住在哪里。”

source_text: He referred to the other members of the Beatles as his "brothers".
target_text: 他将甲壳虫乐队的其他成员称为他的“兄弟”。

source_text: He also said about them: "They looked out for me, and I looked out for them."
target_text: 他还对他们说：“他们留心我，我留心他们。”

source_text: The first large-scale trial of a vaccine for HIV has been launched in South Africa.
target_text: 第一次大规模的艾滋病疫苗试验已在南非启动。

source_text: About 3,000 HIV-negative people will be administered the test vaccine MRKAd5 HIV-1 created by the pharmaceutical company Merck.
target_text: 大约3,000名HIV阴性的人将接受制药公司默克公司制造的测试疫苗MRKAd5 HIV-1。

source_text: The study will examine if the vaccine prevents infection or lowers HIV levels in those who do get infected.
target_text: 该研究将检查疫苗是否可以预防感染或降低感染者的HIV水平。

source_text: A parallel study will also be conducted in the United States and South America, to compare the vaccine's effectiveness on various strains of HIV.
target_text: 还将在美国和南美进行一项平行研究，以比较疫苗对各种HIV病毒株的有效性。

source_text: The vaccine's functioning in a heterosexual population and its effectiveness among women will also be studied.
target_text: 该疫苗在异性恋人群中的功能及其在女性中的有效性也将得到研究。

source_text: Preliminary trials for the vaccine have been conducted in the Americas and Australia as well as in Africa.
target_text: 该疫苗的初步试验已在美洲和澳大利亚以及非洲进行。

source_text: Between three and six million people are thought to have been infected in 2005.
target_text: 据认为，2005年有三百万到六百万人被感染。

source_text: The trial, named the Phambili ("Going forward") Trial, is being conducted by the International HIV Trials Network and the South African AIDS Vaccine Initiative (SAAVI).
target_text: 该试验命名为Phambili（“前进”）试验，由国际艾滋病毒试验网络和南非艾滋病疫苗倡议（SAAVI）进行。

source_text: The vaccine has been developed from an adenovirus, a type of virus that causes the common cold.
target_text: 腺病毒是一种引起普通感冒的病毒，该疫苗是由腺病毒开发的。

source_text: The virus has been genetically engineered to prevent it from causing the flu or from passing on from person to person.
target_text: 该病毒经过基因工程改造，可防止流感或人与人之间传播。

source_text: The three genes, called gag, pol and env contain information needed to make the structural proteins for the capsid, the "shell" of the HIV viron.
target_text: 这三种基因，称为gag、pol和env基因，含有制造衣壳结构蛋白所需的信息，衣壳是HIV瓦伊伦的“壳”。

source_text: The vaccine does not contain the remaining six HIV genes that cause HIV to infect cells, replicate and cause disease.
target_text: 该疫苗不含剩余的六种HIV基因，这些基因会导致HIV感染细胞，复制并引发疾病。

source_text: "The vaccine does not contain any live HIV and therefore cannot cause any infection", SAAVI said in a press release, adding that the vaccine was found to be safe and produced an immune response against HIV in earlier trials.
target_text: 南非艾滋病疫苗倡议在一份新闻稿中说：“该疫苗不含任何活HIV，因此不会引起任何感染。”他补充说，该疫苗在早期试验中被发现是安全的，并产生针对HIV的免疫应答。

source_text: SAAVI has expressed its commitment to the "highest level of preventive care" for those who take part in the trial, promising "extensive, state-of-the-art" counselling as well as some forms of medical care and for those taking part, through the duration of the trial.
target_text: 南非艾滋病疫苗倡议已经表达了对参与试验的人们“最高水平的预防性护理”的承诺，承诺“广泛的、最先进的”咨询以及在整个测试期间为那些参与者提供某些形式的医疗护理。

source_text: The trial starts a week after a different trial, involving a microbicide gel called Ushercell was stopped after more women who used the gel were found to be infected compared to those who were given a dummy gel as placebo.
target_text: 该试验在一个星期后开始，其中涉及一种名为引导细胞的杀微生物凝胶，与使用假凝胶作为安慰剂的女性相比，更多使用这种凝胶的女性被发现感染。

source_text: The trial is expected to cost $35 million and SAAVI will be supported by Eskom and the South African government.
target_text: 该试验预计耗资3500万美元，南非艾滋病疫苗倡议将得到艾斯康公司和南非政府的支持。

source_text: A United Nations court today convicted a woman, a former minister in the Rwandan government, for her role in the 1994 genocide in the ethnic war between the Tutsi and the Hutu peoples.
target_text: 联合国法院今天判定一名妇女有罪，她是前卢旺达政府部长，因1994年在图西族和胡图族人民之间的种族灭绝中所发挥的作用而判有罪。

source_text: Gilad Shalit, 20, is believed to be alive, and Hamas has released an audio tape in which Shalit says he needs to be hospitalized and that he regrets that Israel has not met the demands of the kidnappers.
target_text: 20岁的吉拉德·沙利特被认为还活着，而哈马斯已经发布了录音带，其中沙利特说他需要住院治疗，他对以色列没有满足绑架者的要求感到很遗憾。

source_text: "I have been in prison for an entire year and my health is deteriorating."
target_text: “我已经入狱一整年，我的健康状况正在恶化。”

source_text: "I regret the lack of interest of the Israeli government and military in my case and their failure to meet the demands."
target_text: “我感到遗憾的是，以色列政府和军方对我的情况缺乏兴趣以及他们未能满足要求。”

source_text: "Just as I have parents, a mother and father, thousands of Palestinian detainees have mothers and fathers whose sons must be returned to them."
target_text: “就像我有父母，一个母亲和一个父亲一样，成千上万的巴勒斯坦被拘留者都有母亲和父亲，必须把他们的儿子归还给他们。”

source_text: "I have a great hope from my government that it show more interest in me and meet the demands of the Mujahideen (kidnappers)," said Shalit on the audio tape.
target_text: 沙利特在录音带上说道，“我对我的政府抱有很大的希望，希望它对我表现出更多的兴趣并满足圣战者（绑架者）的要求。”

source_text: Noam Shalit, Gilad's father says that he is "almost sure" that the voice on the tape is that of his son, but also states that "we cannot know when it was recorded."
target_text: 吉拉德的父亲诺姆·沙利特说，他“几乎可以肯定”磁带上的声音是他儿子的声音，但也说“我们无法知道录制的时间。”

source_text: "I imagine that it's the same as the letter they dictated to him and doesn't reflect his real state."
target_text: “我想这与他们对他的口述相同，并不能反映他的真实状态。”

source_text: "We want somebody independent to see him, to examine him and the conditions under which he is held, his medical condition of course and his mental (condition)."
target_text: “我们希望有人单独见到他，检查他和他被关押的条件，当然还有他的病情和精神状况。”

source_text: Israeli officials believe that the kidnappers told Shalit what to say during the audio recording and that the Israeli government will not cooperate with the group.
target_text: 以色列官员认为绑架者告诉沙利特在录音过程中该说什么，以色列政府不会与该团伙合作。

source_text: "How cruel can Hamas be? "
target_text: “哈马斯有多残忍？”

source_text: "We will not cooperate with Hamas."
target_text: “我们不会与哈马斯合作。”

source_text: "We will not compromise with Hamas," said Miri Eisin, a spokeswoman for Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Olmert.
target_text: “我们不会与哈马斯妥协，”以色列总理埃胡德·奥尔默特的发言人米里·艾辛说。

source_text: Hamas states that Israel had every chance to swap prisoners to release Shalit, but that Israel has to act.
target_text: 哈马斯说，以色列有很多机会交换囚犯释放沙利特，但那样以色列必须采取行动。

source_text: "We have been flexible in every possible way when it came to a swap deal, but the Israeli side was too weak to make a decision."
target_text: “当谈到掉期协议时，我们一直都很灵活，但以色列方面太弱，无法作出决定。”

source_text: "The ball is now in the Israeli court," said Osama al-Muzaini, a senior official for Hamas.
target_text: 哈马斯的高级官员奥萨马·穆扎尼说：“球现在在以色列法院。”

source_text: Shalit was kidnapped exactly one year ago today on June 25, 2006.
target_text: 沙利特确实于一年前的今天，2006年6月25日被绑架。

source_text: He was kidnapped in Gaza City which sparked a month long war between Lebanon and Israel.
target_text: 他在加沙城被绑架，引发了黎巴嫩与以色列之间长达一个月的战争。

source_text: Poland came from behind with two set-piece goals to beat Costa Rica in Group A, Tuesday.
target_text: 周二，波兰队在A组以两个定位进攻射门击败哥斯达黎加队，扭转劣势。

source_text: The result of the match gave Poland three points but they did not qualify for the next round of the Fifa World Cup as Ecuador had six and Germany nine.
target_text: 这场比赛的结果给了波兰三分，但他们没有资格参加下一轮国际足联世界杯，因为厄瓜多尔有六分，德国有九分。

source_text: Costa Rica left the 2006 World Cup without a victory in three games.
target_text: 哥斯达黎加在三场比赛中没有一场取得胜利而离开2006年世界杯。

source_text: Though the pace of the game was rather slow in the heat the outcome did seem to matter to the two teams who both wanted a World Cup win.
target_text: 虽然比赛节奏相当缓慢但结果似乎对两队都很重要，他们都希望赢得世界杯。

source_text: During a Palestinian rally in Qalqilyah in the West Bank against Israeli attacks on Gaza, Mufid Saleh Walweel, 22, was shot and killed Sunday by Israeli forces, according to Palestinian medical officials.
target_text: 据巴勒斯坦医务官员称，在西岸盖勒吉利耶巴勒斯坦人集会反对以色列袭击加沙期间，22岁的Mufid Saleh Walweel星期天遭以色列军队开枪打死。

source_text: On Friday in Chicago, 4,000 people marched from Tribune Plaza to the Israeli Consulate demanding an end to the occupation of Palestine, and to the raids on Gaza.
target_text: 星期五在芝加哥，有4,000人从论坛报广场游行到以色列领事馆，要求结束对巴勒斯坦的占领以及对加沙的袭击。

source_text: Another 40,000 people gathered in Morocco to protest what they saw as the complicity of the Arab regimes in the attack.
target_text: 另有40,000人聚集在摩洛哥，抗议他们所看到的阿拉伯政权在袭击事件中的共谋。

source_text: On Saturday, thousands of protesters in Indonesia asked the Indonesian government to send troops to Gaza to fight against the Israelis who they called a "terrorist" force.
target_text: 星期六，印度尼西亚数千名抗议者要求印度尼西亚政府派兵到加沙与他们称之为“恐怖分子”的以色列人作战。

source_text: On the same day in Toronto, Canada, 1,000 people gathered in the business district to protest Israeli actions.
target_text: 同一天，在加拿大多伦多，有1000人聚集在商业区，抗议以色列的行动。

source_text: In addition 10,000 people marched past United Kingdom Prime Minister Gordon Brown's residence in London, hurling hundreds of shoes at his home.
target_text: 此外，还有一万人游过英国首相戈登布朗在伦敦的住所，向他家中投掷了数百双鞋子。

source_text: Louis Michel, the European Union's humanitarian aid commissioner said in a statement on Sunday that "blocking access to people who are suffering and dying is also a breach of humanitarian law."
target_text: 欧盟人道主义援助专员路易斯·米歇尔周日在一份声明中表示，“阻止遭受痛苦和死亡的人也是违反人道法的行为。”

source_text: The statement promised 3 million euros of emergency EU aid to the people of Gaza.
target_text: 该声明承诺向加沙人民提供300万欧元的紧急欧盟援助。

source_text: Al Jazeera says that 507 Palestinians have been killed and 2,700 wounded since Israeli bombardments on the Gaza Strip began in late December.
target_text: 半岛电视台说，自12月底以色列对加沙地带的轰炸开始以来，已有507名巴勒斯坦人被杀，2700人受伤。

source_text: Four Israelis were killed in that same time by Hamas rockets fired out of Gaza.
target_text: 在同一时间，哈马斯从加沙发射的火箭弹炸死了四名以色列人。

source_text: As much as 200 mm (8") of rain have been recorded in portions of British Columbia, on the west coast of Canada since Monday.
target_text: 自周一以来，在加拿大西海岸的不列颠哥伦比亚省部分地区已录得多达200毫米（8英寸）的降雨。

source_text: The heavy and sustained precipitation across the lower mainland regions have caused mudslides and flooding, with roads and highways being closed and families evacuated.
target_text: 大陆较低地区的大量持续降水导致泥石流和洪水，道路和高速公路关闭，家庭疏散。

source_text: In Port Coquitlam, a retaining wall burst, throwing concrete and rubble tens of metres and covering an arterial road with mud to a depth of two metres.
target_text: 在高贵林港，挡土墙爆裂，将混凝土和瓦砾投掷数十米，并用泥浆覆盖主干道，深度为2米。

source_text: Further inland and north, where colder temperatures have prevailed, the precipitation has been falling as freezing rain and sleet, or heavy snowfalls.
target_text: 进一步的内陆和北部地区，气温越来越低，降雨量越来越多，如冻雨和雨夹雪或大雪。

source_text: Terrace, BC, was isolated as highways north and south of the city were closed due to a heavy glaze of ice.
target_text: 不列颠哥伦比亚省被隔离，因为城市北部和南部的高速公路因冰层而被关闭。

source_text: The Trans-Canada Highway and most other roads through the mountains were closed due to heavy and sudden snow accumulations which created severe avalanche hazards.
target_text: 跨加拿大高速公路和大多数其他通过山区的道路因积雪和突然积雪而关闭，这造成了严重的雪崩危险。

source_text: "If the rain continues at the same magnitude and according to the forecast, then some of the rivers could reach flood stage either later [Tuesday] or Wednesday morning," said Allan Chapman, a hydrologist with the River Forecast Centre in Victoria.
target_text: 维多利亚河流预测中心的水文学家艾伦·查普曼说：“如果继续下雨达到预报的程度，那么一些河流可能会在【星期二】或星期三早上到达洪水阶段。”

source_text: The source of the wet weather is a large system reaching the coast from the Pacific Ocean tropics, a type of system nicknamed by meteorologists a "Tropical Punch".
target_text: 潮湿天气的来源是一个从太平洋热带到达海岸的大型系统，这是一种由气象学家称为“热带冲床”的系统。

source_text: A similar system caused severe flooding and precipitation in 2003.
target_text: 类似的系统在2003年引起了严重的洪水和降水。

source_text: Environment Canada expects the system, which lies southwest of Vancouver Island, to continue to develop "waves" of weather which will strike the mainland and head inland over the next several days to a week, possibly dropping 50-100 mm (2"-4") of additional rain per day at least until the end of the weekend.
target_text: 加拿大环境部预计位于温哥华岛西南部的该系统将继续发展“波浪”天气，这些天气将在未来几天到一周内袭击大陆并进入内陆，每天可能会有50-100毫米（2英寸-4英寸）额外下雨，降雨至少到周末结束。

source_text: Two Long Island, New York teenagers, aged 15 and 17, have been charged for their alleged involvement in a suspected plot to attack their school next April, on the ninth anniversary of the Columbine High School shooting massacre.
target_text: 纽约长岛两名15岁和17岁的青少年被控涉嫌参与明年4月哥伦比亚高中枪击案9周年之际袭击他们学校的阴谋。

source_text: The plot was uncovered when the 15-year-old suspect lost his journal at the McDonalds restaurant where he worked.
target_text: 当这名15岁的嫌疑人在他工作的麦当劳餐厅丢失他的日志时，计划被揭穿。

source_text: The journal was found by a fellow classmate of the teenagers' school, who quickly turned it over to school officials.
target_text: 该日志是由该少年同一学校的一位同学发现的，他很快将其转交给学校官员。

source_text: The journal is alleged to have outlined the teenagers' plan to attack the school with guns and home-made bombs.
target_text: 据称该日志概述了青少年用枪支和自制炸弹袭击学校的计划。

source_text: The 15-year-old suspect's home and computers were searched and evidence was collected, which revealed that he allegedly tried to purchase black powder explosives and machine guns over the Internet.
target_text: 这名15岁的嫌疑人的房屋和电脑被搜查，并收集了证据，据称他曾试图通过互联网购买黑色粉末爆炸物和机枪。

source_text: A video was also found in which the same teenager allegedly names some students and staff he would like to attack at the school.
target_text: 还发现了一个视频，其中据称同一名少年列出了他想在学校攻击的学生和工作人员。

source_text: The 17-year-old was allegedly planning to aid in the attack on the school.
target_text: 据称，那名17岁的男子计划援助袭击学校。

source_text: The two teens were arrested and held in Long Island jail on misdemeanor conspiracy, which is punishable by up to one year in prison.
target_text: 这两名青少年因涉嫌轻罪阴谋而被长期监狱关押在长岛监狱，最高可判处一年徒刑。

source_text: The 15-year-old will appear in juvenile court on Friday and the 17-year-old suspect is expected to plead not guilty at a hearing.
target_text: 这名15岁的男子将于周五出现在少年法庭，而这名17岁的嫌犯将在听证会上辩护无罪。

source_text: Paul Gray, American musician and bassist of the heavy metal band Slipknot, has been found dead in his hotel room in Iowa.
target_text: 重磅金属乐队滑结乐团的美国音乐家和贝司手保罗·格雷在爱荷华州的酒店房间被发现死亡。

source_text: His body was found at around 10:50 Monday morning by a hotel employee.
target_text: 周一早上10：50左右，一名酒店员工发现了他的尸体。

source_text: Police investigating the death said that no foul play was suspected.
target_text: 调查死亡事件的警方说，没有谋杀嫌疑。

source_text: Chris Diebel, the spokesman for the hotel where Gray was found, released a statement.
target_text: 发现格雷的酒店的发言人克里·斯迪贝尔发表声明。

source_text: He said "Gray checked into the extended-stay hotel on Saturday and was scheduled to check out today".
target_text: 他说：“格雷周六入住长住酒店，并计划今天退房”。

source_text: He added that Gray had "stayed at the hotel before and was remembered as being a quiet and respectful guest."
target_text: 他补充说，格雷“曾经住在酒店，因是一位安静而令人尊重的客人而被人们记住。”

source_text: They released, in 1996, their first album, which sold over a million copies worldwide.
target_text: 他们于1996年发行了他们的第一张专辑，全球销量超过一百万张。

source_text: The group has received seven Grammy award nominations and won one in 2006 for "Best Metal Performance" with "Before I Forget".
target_text: 该组合获得了七项格莱美奖提名，并在2006年以“在我忘记之前”获得“最佳金属表演”奖。

source_text: Gray was known by his fans by either his band number #2 or his nickname "The Pig".
target_text: 格雷的粉丝称呼他的乐队编号＃2或他的绰号“猪”。

source_text: Along with drummers Joey Jordison and Shawn Crahan, Gray was one of only three original members of Slipknot that still remained in the band.
target_text: 除了鼓手乔依·乔迪森和肖恩·韦恩斯之外，Gray还是滑结乐团一直留在乐队中的三个原始成员之一。

source_text: J.R. Siems, from the band Sound Proof Coalition, said: "everybody seemed to think he was in good health again, so it came as a big shock that this had to happen."
target_text: 来自隔音联盟乐队的J.R.西姆斯说：“每个人似乎都认为他身体状况又很好了，所以这种情况发生后，必然会很震惊。”

source_text: "He had the biggest heart of anyone I knew and would give anyone the shirt off his back."
target_text: “我认识的人当中，他心地最善良，他愿意把自己的一切都给别人。”

source_text: After two weeks of illness, Juan Bustos, the president of the Chamber of Deputies of Chile, died at 10:46 local time (14:46 UTC) yesterday.
target_text: 生病两周后，智利众议院议长胡安布斯托斯昨天于当地时间10：46（协调世界时14：46）去世。
