source_text: The death took place at a Clínica Alemana in Santiago.
target_text: 死亡发生在圣地亚哥的阿莱马那诊所。

source_text: At the time of his death, Bustos was with his wife and five of his seven children, who were deeply upset by the death.
target_text: 在他去世时，布斯托斯和他的妻子以及他的七个孩子中的五个一起，他们对他的死亡深感痛苦。

source_text: The other two children are expected to arrive from Europe soon to attend the funeral.
target_text: 预计另外两名孩子将很快从欧洲抵达参加葬礼。

source_text: Juan Bustos will be given a state fueral due to the position he occupied.
target_text: 由于他之前的职位，胡安布斯托斯将获得一个国家级别的葬礼。

source_text: In addition, the flags at many government buildings are being flown at half mast to mark the death.
target_text: 此外，许多政府大楼的旗帜正在降半旗以纪念他的死亡。

source_text: The body has been moved to the former National Congress building so that the body can be guarded until the state funeral, which takes place at 11:00 local time tomorrow.
target_text: 尸体已被移至前国会大厦，这样尸体可以在明天当地时间11：00开始的国葬之前得到保护。

source_text: After the state funeral, a private funeral for the family will take place.
target_text: 国家葬礼结束后，将举行家庭私人葬礼。

source_text: Cambridge University have defeated Oxford University by 1¼ lengths to win the 153rd Boat Race.
target_text: 剑桥大学以超过1¼长度的成绩击败牛津大学，赢得第153届划船比赛。

source_text: The Light Blues won with a time of 17 minutes and 49 seconds to record their first win in three years.
target_text: 莱特·布鲁斯以17分49秒的成绩赢得了三年来的首场胜利。

source_text: Oxford finished with a time of 18 minutes and 2 seconds.
target_text: 牛津完成时间为18分2秒。

source_text: Oxford won the toss and chose to row on the Surrey side of the river, with Cambridge rowing on the Middlesex side.
target_text: 牛津大学在掷硬币中获胜，他们选择在萨里一侧划船，剑桥划船在米德尔塞克斯一侧。

source_text: Oxford had the stronger start and were ahead for much of the first half of the race.
target_text: 牛津队有着更强的开局，并且在比赛的前半段大部分时间都领先。

source_text: They had a slight advantage over Cambridge at Hammersmith Bridge, where they would be favoured by racing the inside of the upcoming bend.
target_text: 牛津队在汉默史密斯大桥处比剑桥队略有一点优势，他们在即将出现的弯道内侧划行，这对他们有利。

source_text: However Cambridge never lost touch and pulled ahead at Chiswick steps, maintaining their lead for the remainder of the race.
target_text: 然而，剑桥队从未懈怠并在戚斯域领先，在剩余的赛程中保持领先。

source_text: Before the race, Cambridge were strong favourites, being 9lb heavier per man on average.
target_text: 在比赛开始之前，剑桥是夺冠热门，平均每人增重9磅。

source_text: The Cambridge crew had 5 returning blues compared to Oxford's one.
target_text: 与牛津大学相比，剑桥队有5名回归蓝调。

source_text: Furthermore the international achievement of Cambridge's rowers far exceeded that of Oxford: the World Champion stern pair of Germans Thorsten Engelmann (the heaviest ever oarsman at 110.8kg) and Sebastian Schulte, Olympic Gold medallist Kieran West MBE and GB medal winner Tom James.
target_text: 此外，剑桥的赛艇运动员的国际成就远远超过了牛津：船尾双人单桨世界冠军德国人托尔斯滕·恩格尔曼氏（最重的桨手110.8公斤）和塞巴斯蒂安·舒尔特，奥运会金牌得主基兰·莫比希和MBE和GB奖牌获得者汤姆·吉姆斯。

source_text: The heavily fancied Cambridge crew did not win by the margin expected by many, thanks in part to a strong row from Oxford, and the sagging stern containing the heaviest Cambridge oarsmen.
target_text: 备受瞩目的剑桥赛艇队并没有赢得许多人预期的胜利，这在一定程度上要归因于来自牛津的强势阵容，以及载着最重剑桥桨手的下垂船尾。

source_text: Also of note, only a week before, Cambridge were victorious at the prestigious Head of the River Race (raced on the same course, but from Mortlake to Putney).
target_text: 同样值得注意的是，仅仅一周之前，剑桥在著名的河王之争比赛中取得了胜利（参加同一赛道，但是从莫特莱克到普特尼）。

source_text: However the race was abandoned due to weather conditions with only 29 out of 420 crews finishing.
target_text: 然而，由于天气条件，比赛被取消，420名船员中只有29人完成。

source_text: The race, first held in 1829, is currently held on a 6,779 m (4 miles and 374 yards) stretch of the River Thames in London from Putney to Mortlake.
target_text: 这个比赛最初于1829年举行，目前在伦敦泰晤士河从普特尼到莫特莱克的的6,779米（4英里374码）区域举行。

source_text: Overall, Cambridge lead Oxford by 79 wins to 73 with one dead heat.
target_text: 总的来说，剑桥队在以79胜73负，还有一次并列冠军的成绩领先牛津队。

source_text: In the earlier race for reserve crews, Goldie (Cambridge) beat Isis (Oxford).
target_text: 在早期的预备队比赛中，Goldie（剑桥队）击败了Isis（牛津队）。

source_text: Racing for the women's and lightweight crews took place at Henley on April 1st, where Cambridge won the Women's Boat Race and Oxford won the reserve women's, lightweight women's, lightweight men's and reserve lightweight men's races.
target_text: 4月1日在亨利参加女子和轻量级队员比赛，剑桥队赢得了女子赛艇比赛，牛津队赢得了预备女子组、轻量级女子组，轻量级男子组和预备轻量级男子组的比赛。

source_text: Four F3 Tornado fighter jets were launched by the United Kingdom's Royal Air Force to intercept Russian military planes.
target_text: 英国皇家空军发射四架F3龙卷风战斗机，以用来拦截俄罗斯军用飞机。

source_text: The eight Russian jets were flying in airspace patrolled by Nato, officials from the UK claimed.
target_text: 英国官员声称，八架俄罗斯喷气式飞机在北约巡逻的空域飞行。

source_text: The long-range bombers were initially followed by Norwegian F16 jets, after Russia's recent decision to reinstate Cold War-style long-range patrols.
target_text: 在俄罗斯最近决定恢复冷战式远程巡逻之后，挪威F16战机最初也加入了远程轰炸机的行列。

source_text: The Ministry of Defence in the United Kingdom released a statement that the Russian Tupolev Tu-95 Bear aircraft, flying in four loosed pairs, were tracked by Norwegian aircraft before entering Nato airspace on Thursday morning.
target_text: 英国国防部发布声明说，俄罗斯图波列夫图-95熊飞机分成四组，在星期四早上进入北约领空之前被挪威飞机追踪。

source_text: The UK currently holds responsibility for the Nato airspace, and launched four F3 Tornados from RAF Leeming in North Yorkshire, UK, to identify the bombers.
target_text: 英国目前负责北约空域，并在英国北约克郡的英国皇家空军利明发射了四架F3龙卷风飞机，以识别轰炸机。

source_text: The bombers eventually left the Nato zone, under tracking by UK aircraft and RAF radar in Northumberland.
target_text: 轰炸机最终离开了北约地区，由诺森伯兰郡的英国飞机和英国皇家空军雷达追踪。

source_text: Lt Col John Inge Oegland, spokesman for the Norwegian armed forces, said there had been several similar incidents in recent months, but that the Russian flights were not causing alarm in Norway.
target_text: 挪威武装部队发言人约翰·英格·奥格兰中校表示，最近几个月发生了几起类似的事件，但俄罗斯飞机并没有引起挪威的恐慌。

source_text: Relations between Britain and Russia have worsened recently, particularly after Russia's refusal to allow the extradition of a former KGB bodyguard suspected of murdering emigre Alexander Litvinenko in London last year.
target_text: 英国和俄罗斯之间的关系最近恶化，特别是在俄罗斯拒绝允许引渡一名去年在伦敦前克格勃谋杀埃米格·雷亚历山大·利特维年科保镖之后。

source_text: Relations with Russia would "continue as normal outside the unresolved extradition request", a UK Foreign Office spokesman said.
target_text: 英国外交部发言人表示，与俄罗斯的关系将“在未解决的引渡请求之外保持正常”。

source_text: Bristol City Council has reported that it is possible the library will reopen on Tuesday, although it did say that it was likely the building would remain closed on that day.
target_text: 布里斯托尔市政府报告说，图书馆有可能在周二重新开放，尽管有人说该建筑可能会在当天仍保持关闭。

source_text: The head of Library services at Bristol City Council commented on the incident.
target_text: 布里斯托尔市议会图书馆服务负责人就此事件发表了评论。

source_text: She said "we [the Library service] apologise to our customers for this inconvenience but it is not possible to open the library as there remains problem's with power to parts of the building and there is a need to give contractors clear access to clean smoke damage in some public areas."
target_text: 她说：“我们【图书馆服务】因为这种不便向我们的客户道歉，但由于建筑物的某些部分仍然存在电力问题，无法开放图书馆，因此在一些公共区域需要让承包商进入清扫，以清除浓烟带来的损害。”

source_text: "We will review the situation again on Monday morning and issue further updates when further information is available."
target_text: “我们将在周一早上再次审查这一情形，并在有更多信息时发布进一步的更新。”

source_text: In a release issued this morning, Tony Clement, Minister of Industry is quoted as saying "Globalive is a Canadian company, and meets Canadian ownership and control requirements under the Telecommunications Act," differing with the CRTC's decision, where they ruled that control-in-fact of Globalive was with Cairo-based Orascom Telecom Holding S.A.E., the corporation holding much of Globalive's equity and debt.
target_text: 在今天上午发布的一份新闻稿中，工业部长托尼·克莱门兹称，“全球化无线管理公司是一家加拿大公司，符合电信法案规定的加拿大所有权和控制要求，”该声明与CRTC的决定不同，CRTC裁决全球化无线管理公司的实际控制权与总部位于开罗的奥拉斯科姆电信有限公司有关，该公司持有全球化无线管理公司的大部分股权和债务。

source_text: A decision had been rendered under Canadian Ownership and Control regulations by Industry Canada at the time of the Advanced Wireless Spectrum (AWS) auction held in 2007-2008, at which time they had ruled that Globalive did meet the tests of ownership and control under the same regulation, as referenced by the Order-in-Council included with the government's announcement this morning.
target_text: 加拿大工业部在2007-2008年举行的先进无线频谱（AWS）拍卖会期间，根据加拿大的所有权和控制权规定做出了此项决定。当时他们裁定，全球化无线管理公司确实符合同一条规定下的所有权和控制权测试，如同包括政府今晨发布公告在内的枢密院令所指。

source_text: With the decision by the government, Globalive is now permitted to launch their wireless service, which is expected to occur in the Calgary and Toronto markets in time for the busy holiday shopping season.
target_text: 因政府的决定，全球化无线管理公司现在获准推出无线服务，预计将能及时在卡拉里和多伦多的市场推出，以对应繁忙的假日购物季节。

source_text: Not everyone was quite as enthusiastic however, with Michael Hennessey, Senior VP of Regulatory and Government Affairs for TELUS Communications quoted as saying "If Wind is Canadian then so was King Tut," in a comment posted to Twitter, according to the CBC.
target_text: 然而，不是每个人都非常感兴趣，据英国广播公司报道，泰勒斯电信通讯的监管和政府事务高级副总裁迈克尔·亨尼西在发布的一条评论中称，“如果万德是加拿大人，那么图坦卡国王也是了。”

source_text: There is no word yet on whether TELUS or other carriers will attempt to appeal the ruling.
target_text: 目前还没有关于泰勒斯电信或其他通讯公司是否会试图对该裁决提出上诉的消息。

source_text: The northern port of Thessaloniki, Greece's second biggest city, will host the Inter-Balkan co-operation Summit, on the 3rd and 4th of May 2006.
target_text: 希腊第二大城市塞萨洛尼基北部港口将于2006年5月3日和4日举办巴尔干国家间合作峰会。

source_text: The countries of southeast Europe who are part of the Inter-Balkan Cooperation; Greece, Turkey, Bulgaria, Serbia-Montenegro, Romania, Albania, Croatia, Bosnia and FYROM will be represented by their leaders, Prime ministers and Ministers of foreign affairs.
target_text: 参与巴尔干国家间合作的东南欧国家，希腊、土耳其、保加利亚、塞尔维亚黑山、罗马尼亚、阿尔巴尼亚、克罗地亚、波斯尼亚和费罗的领导人、总理和外交部长将出席会议。

source_text: On the sidelines of the Inter-Balkan Cooperation Summit, which will take place at the Hyatt Regency Hotel of Thessaloniki, Greek Premier Kostas Caramanlis will meet with his Turkish counterpart Recep Tayyip Erdogan on Thursday in order to discuss bilateral issues, including the Cyprus problem.
target_text: 这次峰会将在塞萨洛尼基的凯悦酒店举行。在合作峰会期间，希腊总理科斯塔·斯卡拉曼利斯将于周四会见土耳其总理雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安，讨论包括塞浦路斯问题在内的双边议题。

source_text: For the safety of the leaders as well as for the convenience of city's traffic during possible demonstrations, a security plan has been prepared according to local police.
target_text: 为了保证领导人的安全以及在可能发生示威行动时确保城市交通方便，已根据当地警方制定了安全计划。

source_text: Three years ago, Thessaloniki was the host city of the 2003 European Union Summit.
target_text: 三年前，塞萨洛尼基是2003年欧盟峰会的主办城市。

source_text: Corus, the fifth largest steelmaker in the world, is set to cut 2000 jobs in both the United Kingdom and The Netherlands.
target_text: 康力斯集团是世界第五大钢铁制造商，将在英国和荷兰裁掉2000个工作岗位。

source_text: 123 jobs are reported to be going in the Netherlands with the remainder from the United Kingdom.
target_text: 据报道，荷兰将裁掉123个工作岗位，其余则裁自英国。

source_text: Corus have blamed the move on the "further deterioration" of the demand for steel in both the United States and Europe.
target_text: 康力斯集团将此举归咎于美国和欧洲对钢铁需求的“进一步恶化”。

source_text: He added that Corus have to achieve "long-term sustainable competitiveness in a global and over-supplied steel market".
target_text: 他补充说，康力斯集团必须在全球和供应过剩的钢铁市场实现“长期稳定的竞争力”。

source_text: In January of this year Corus cut approximately 3,500 staff worldwide; 2,500 of them in Britain.
target_text: 今年1月，康力斯集团在全球裁员约3,500人，其中2,500人在英国。

source_text: He added that it is clear a full recovery is years away.
target_text: 他补充说，“很明显，完全恢复还需要几年的时间。”

source_text: Scunthorpe will lose 500 members of staff, with 379 going at Stocksbridge and 377 at Rotherham.
target_text: 斯肯索普将失去500名员工，其中379人在斯托克斯桥，377人在罗瑟勒姆。

source_text: Corus will also reduce operations at Hartlepool, Skinningrove and their Teesside Beam Mill, in Cleveland, where an additional 2,000 already face redundancy.
target_text: 康力斯集团还将减少位于克利夫兰的哈特尔普尔、斯尼格罗夫及其提兹塞德大学梁厂的运营，此外还有2,000人已经面临裁员。

source_text: A total of 11 plants in the United Kingdom are affected.
target_text: 英国共有11家工厂受到影响。

source_text: Elliot Morley, Labour Member of Parliament for Scunthorpe, told the BBC that he was disappointed with the job cuts and said he had previously told Corus that they should be a last resort.
target_text: 斯肯索普议会工党议员埃利奥特·莫莉告诉英国广播电视台，他对裁员感到失望，并说他之前告诉康力斯集团那应该是最后的选择。

source_text: He added that this was a "sad day" for Scunthorpe.
target_text: 他补充说，对于斯肯索普来说，这是一个“悲伤的一天”。

source_text: The Community union general secretary Michael Leahy said that it was "devastating news" and spoke of his concerns for the integrity of the British steel industry.
target_text: 社区工会总书记迈克尔·莱希说，这是“毁灭性的新闻”，并谈到了他对英国钢铁业诚信的担忧。

source_text: The traditions of Bonfire Night peculiar to the Sussex area were once again observed in Lewes on November 4.
target_text: 11月4日，路易斯再次庆祝苏塞克斯地区特有的篝火之夜传统。

source_text: Consistent with the town traditions in the East Sussex county of England, effigies of various figures were carried through the town, and later burnt.
target_text: 与英格兰东苏塞克斯郡的城镇传统一致，各种人物的肖像都被抬过城镇，之后被烧毁。

source_text: The effigies this year included George Bush, Condoleezza Rice (as Wonder Woman) and Crocodile Hunter Steve Irwin.
target_text: 今年的肖像包括乔治·布什、康多莉扎·赖斯（作为神奇女侠）和鳄鱼猎人史蒂夫·欧文。

source_text: As per tradition and local fame, effigies were carried through the town and burned on huge fires.
target_text: 按传统和当地的名声，肖像被抬过城镇并在巨大的火焰中被烧毁。

source_text: These include The Pope, Guy Fawkes and other unpopular figures.
target_text: 其中包括教皇、盖伊·福克斯和其他不受欢迎的人物。

source_text: One of this year's unfortunate guest appearances was also rendered as a hugely grotesque likeness of the U.S. Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice.
target_text: 今年不幸的客串角色之一，也被以酷似美国国务卿康多莉扎·赖斯的怪诞形象呈现。

source_text: Smaller scale effigies, and so called 'enemies of bonfire', were also represented.
target_text: 还展示了较小的肖像，以及所谓的“篝火的敌人”。

source_text: This year's enemies included British Transport Police, whose attitude and handling of Bonfire night is an issue of local contention.
target_text: 今年的敌人包括英国交通警察，他们对篝火晚会的态度和处理方法是当地争论的问题。

source_text: Transport police were quietly represented by a pig head wearing a police helmet.
target_text: 头戴警察头盔的猪头被隐喻为警察的代表。

source_text: Six arrests occurred in respect of criminal damage and public order offences, but the event was less rowdy than in previous years and eras in the history of the Bonfire.
target_text: 六人被捕，罪名是破坏刑事秩序和扰乱公共秩序，但这次事件没有往年和篝火历史上的年代那么吵闹。

source_text: The steep streets of the small town, located one hour south of London, were filled during the chilly winter evening with crowds carrying burning torches, with police, and with alcohol consumption accompanied by loud deafening bangs.
target_text: 位于伦敦以南一小时的小镇，其陡峭的街道在寒冷的冬夜里充满了人群，他们带着燃烧的火把，伴随警察，消耗酒精并大声发出震耳欲聋的巨响。

source_text: In addition to effigies, flaming crosses were carried in recognition of the town's 17 Protestant Martyrs.
target_text: 除了肖像之外，为了表彰该镇的17名新教烈士，还带着火焰十字架。

source_text: These preceded elaborate costumed parades where participants dressed as Vikings, Antique firemen, Mongol warriors, and Zulus (including for the first time at Lewes, a female chieftain).
target_text: 这些都是事前精心准备的扮装游行，参与者扮成维京人、古代消防员、蒙古战士和祖鲁斯（包括首次在路易斯出现的女性酋长）。

source_text: The pirates towed a cannon which they fired and shocked the crowds.
target_text: 海盗拖着一门大炮，他们开火并震惊了人群。

source_text: The traditional striped jerseys worn by various Bonfire Society members were also in evidence.
target_text: 各种篝火协会成员穿的传统条纹球衣也非常显眼。

source_text: A plane carrying sixteen people has vanished over Papua, Indonesia.
target_text: 一架载有十六人的飞机在印度尼西亚的巴布亚消失了。

source_text: The Twin Otter propeller-driven aircraft has a crew of three and thirteen passengers, two of whom are babies.
target_text: 奥特兄弟螺旋桨驱动的飞机有三名机组人员和十三名乘客，其中两名是婴儿。

source_text: The plane, which belonged to Merpati Nusantara Airlines, was travelling from Sentani Airport, Jayapura, Papua to Oksibil, a town near the Papua New Guinean border.
target_text: 这架飞机属于努桑塔拉鸽航航空公司，从巴布亚查亚普拉的圣塔尼机场前往巴布亚新几内亚边境附近的奥克西比尔镇。

source_text: The journey normally takes fifty minutes and only three hours and thirty minutes worth of fuel was on board.
target_text: 这段旅程通常需要五十分钟，而且飞机上的燃料只够三小时三十分钟。

source_text: Both transportation authorities and the military have launched bids to locate the missing plane, with at least two aircraft taking off to search for the aircraft.
target_text: 运输当局和军方至少有两架飞机起飞，都已开始搜寻失踪的飞机。

source_text: However, poor weather conditions have forced these aircraft to return to land.
target_text: 然而，恶劣的天气条件迫使这些飞机返回陆地。

source_text: The plane was over a mountainous area covered with dense forest when air traffic control lost contact.
target_text: 飞机在飞行于覆盖着茂密森林的山区上空时与空中交通管制失联。

source_text: "We're focusing our search on the border between [the] Keerom and Pegunungan Bintang districts... it's a mountainous, jungly region," said air force commander Suwandi Miharja, who is in charge of the search.
target_text: 负责搜索的空军司令苏万迪·王公说，“我们正将搜索焦点放在凯罗姆和宾唐山脉地区之间的边界……这是一个多山的丛林地区”。

source_text: Sudanese President Omar al-Bashir announced the release of all journalists detained in the country's jails in an address to a gathering of journalists in the capital of Khartoum, on Saturday.
target_text: 星期六，苏丹总统奥马尔·巴希尔在首都喀土穆的记者集会上发表讲话，宣布释放被拘留在该国监狱的所有记者。

source_text: "I declare amnesty for all the journalists detained by the security authorities and their release," said Al-Bashir.
target_text: 巴希尔说，“我宣布大赦所有被安全当局拘留的记者。”

source_text: This came in the same month as the release of Abu Zar Al-Amin, deputy editor-in-chief of pro-opposition paper Ra'y Al-Sha'b.
target_text: 这与释放亲反对派新闻“拉·亚沙比”的副总编辑阿布扎尔·阿尔明发生在同一个月。

source_text: Al-Almin had served a prison term of nearly two years after he violating press restrictions and reporting on alleged co-operation between Sudan and the Iranian Revolutionary Guard.
target_text: 阿尔明违反新闻限制并报道苏丹与伊朗革命卫队之间据称的合作，已服刑近两年。

source_text: The release and amnesty follows a series of fresh violations of 'press freedoms', which resulted in the suspension of independent newspapers such as Al-Jaridah and Al-Ahdath on August 20 and 21.
target_text: 释放和大赦发生在一连串新的违反“新闻自由”的行为之后，而该违反造成贾利达和阿赫达赫等独立报纸于8月20日和21日被暂停。

source_text: According to Mozdalifa Mohamed Osman, Al-Ahdath's newsroom chief, the suspension caused financial losses of US$10,000.
target_text: 阿赫达赫新闻编辑室负责人莫兹达利法·穆罕默德·奥斯曼表示，暂停导致了1万美元的经济损失。

source_text: However, the editor-in-chief of AlJaridah, Saad Al-Din Ibrahim revealed that his paper was suspended because it did not allow the security services to interfere in its editorial and recruitment policies; sources believe the Al-Ahdath suspension was due to the publication of information on a planned meeting between President Al-Bashir and the leader of armed opposition group Sudan People's Liberation Movement (northern sector) Malik Aggar.
target_text: 然而，贾利达的主编萨阿德·阿尔丁·易卜拉欣透露，他们的新闻被暂停是因为不允许安全部门干涉其编辑和招聘政策；知情人士认为，阿赫达赫被暂停是因为公布了有关巴希尔总统与武装反对派苏丹人民解放运动（北部）马克利·阿加尔领导人之间计划会晤的信息。

source_text: Press freedoms may deteriorate with the National Congress Party contemplating further restrictions, including the possibility of pre-publication censorship.
target_text: 随着全国大会党考虑采取进一步的限制，其中包括出版前审查的可能性，新闻自由也许会恶化。

source_text: The leaders of more than 50 countries and heads of several international organisations attended the parade.
target_text: 50多个国家的领导人和几个国际组织的负责人参加了游行。

source_text: George W. Bush watched the parade with Russian President Vladimir Putin.
target_text: 乔治·W·布什与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京一起观看了游行。

source_text: More than 4,000 World War II veterans and 7,000 military personnel were involved in the parade.
target_text: 超过4,000名二战老兵和7,000名军事人员参与了游行。

source_text: The culmination was the flight of 12 planes (made up of SU-25s and MIG-29s), which emitted white, blue and red smoke to paint a Russian flag in the air.
target_text: 最高潮是12架飞机（由SU-25和MIG-29组成）的飞行，它们喷出白色、蓝色和红色的烟雾，在空中画出一面俄罗斯国旗。

source_text: Mass celebrations are planned to be held at Poklonnaya Gora, Moscow's primary WW2 memorial.
target_text: 计划在莫斯科波克龙娜亚·戈拉二战纪念碑举行大规模的庆祝活动。

source_text: Several new monuments were opened today, such as the 8-meter statue of Charles de Gaulle by Zurab Tsereteli and the monument to soldiers from Allied countries.
target_text: 今天开设了几座新纪念碑，如出自祖拉布·塞雷特利的8米高的戴高乐雕像和盟军国家的士兵纪念碑。

source_text: Faithless, an electronica band from the United Kingdom, have made the announcement that they are to separate at the end of their current tour.
target_text: 来自英国的电子乐队“无信念”宣布，他们将在目前的巡演结束后解散。

source_text: Their current tour is expected to conclude at the O2 Academy, Brixton on April 8, 2011.
target_text: 他们目前的巡回演出预计将于2011年4月8日在布里克斯顿的O2学院结束。

source_text: It consisted of three members, known as Maxi Jazz, Sister Bliss and Rollo Armstrong.
target_text: 该乐队由三名成员组成，分别名为马克西·爵士、西斯特·布利斯和若罗·阿姆斯特朗。

source_text: Insomnia, God Is a DJ and We Come 1 are amongst the most famous muscial works that have been released from Faithless.
target_text: “失眠”、“上帝是DJ”和“我们来做第一”是无信念乐队发行的最着名的音乐作品。

source_text: Human rights group Amnesty International has released satellite images showing how the Zimbabwean community of Porta Farm, which once housed some 10,000 people, has been completely destroyed.
target_text: 人权组织特赦国际发布了卫星图像，显示曾经收容了大约1万人的津巴布韦社区罗马门农场已经被彻底摧毁。

source_text: Taken in 2002 and 2006, the photos starkly contrast the previous built-up area with the empty scrubland that remains.
target_text: 照片拍摄于2002年和2006年，这些照片与之前的建筑区域形成鲜明对比，剩下的是空的灌木丛。

source_text: According to Amnesty International, residents of Porta Farm were given less than 24 hours notice to leave their homes.
target_text: 根据特赦国际的说法，罗马门农场的居民接到通知不到24小时就要离开他们的家。

source_text: Human rights monitors reported that several people died in the chaotic environment of the ensuing demolitions and forced evictions.
target_text: 人权监测员报告说，在随后的拆除和强迫迁离的混乱环境中有几人死亡。

source_text: Zimbabwe's forced evictions programme (called Operation Murambatsvina) has been widely condemned both within Zimbabwe and beyond.
target_text: 津巴布韦的强制驱逐计划（被称为净化行动）在津巴布韦及其他地区受到广泛谴责。

source_text: A 2005 report on Operation Murambatsvina by United Nations Special Envoy Anna Tibaijuka estimated that it has cost 700,000 people their homes or livelihoods.
target_text: 联合国特使安娜·提拜朱卡在2005年的一份关于“净化行动”的报告中估计，这场行动已使70万人失去家园或生计。

source_text: She was present at Porta Farm during the second day of its demolition, and was shocked by the brutality of the evictions.
target_text: 在拆迁的第二天，她出现在罗马门农场，并对驱逐的残酷行为感到震惊。

source_text: Residents of Porta Farm had fought eviction in the past, winning judgements from the High Court of Zimbabwe that they should not be evicted unless the government provided suitable alternative accommodation.
target_text: 罗马门农场的居民过去一直在为驱逐做抗争，并赢得津巴布韦高等法院的判决，判定除非政府提供合适的替代住宿，否则不应将他们驱逐出去。

source_text: However the High Court dismissed a contempt of court action that attempted to stop the 2005 evictions, giving no reason.
target_text: 然而，高等法院驳回了试图阻止2005年驱逐的藐视法庭诉讼，并没有给出理由。

source_text: The Zimbabwean government (led by President Robert Mugabe) says that the programme is in the public interest and was not against the law.
target_text: 津巴布韦政府（由总统罗伯特穆加贝领导）表示，该计划符合公共利益，并不违法。

source_text: The Telecommunications Commission of the Solomon Islands (TCSI) have issued a fine to a Papua New Guinea (PNG) mobile phone provider, for failing to meet the deadlines set out in the terms of its license.
target_text: 所罗门群岛电信委员会（TCSI）已向巴布亚新几内亚（PNG）移动电话提供商处以罚款，理由是未能满足其许可条款规定的截止日期。

source_text: bemobile, the second mobile network service provider in the Solomon Islands, was supposed to have covered 50% of the Solomons by September 2010 and 75% by February 1st 2011.
target_text: 所罗门群岛的第二家移动网络服务提供商比格移动，本应在2010年9月前覆盖50％的所罗门斯，并至2011年2月1日之前覆盖75％。

source_text: The National Statistics Office and the TCSI investigated claims by bemobile that it had covered 64% of the Islands, but found the claims were incorrect.
target_text: 国家统计局和TCSI调查了比格移动声称已经覆盖了64％群岛的说法，但发现这个声明并不正确。

source_text: As a result, the TCSI have now issued a fine of to the company for breaking its operating license.
target_text: 因此，TCSI现已向该公司处以罚款，因其违反营业许可。

source_text: This is the second time bemobile failed to meet its contractual obligations, and the Telecommunications Commissioner, Nicholas Williams, made it clear that they had fallen short of the target, despite being given time to sort the issue out.
target_text: 这是比格移动第二次未能履行其合同义务，电信专员尼古拉斯·威廉姆斯明确表示，已给了他们时间解决问题，但他们却没能达成目标。

source_text: Williams said, "TCSI has found that bemobile has failed to meet its third coverage threshold of 75% of the population that commenced on 1 February 2011, as well as during the 14-day rectification period that was provided for under the licence."
target_text: 威廉姆斯表示，“TCSI发现比格移动未能达到2011年2月1日开始的75％人口的第三次覆盖门槛，以及根据许可证规定的14天整改期间的要求。”

source_text: Commissioner Williams also stated he could have raised the fine to US$2.5M, but he hoped that bemobile would use the extra money to meet its September deadline.
target_text: 威廉姆斯专员还表示，他本可以将罚款提高至250万美元，但他希望比格移动能够使用多余的资金来满足9月份的截止日期的要求。

source_text: In a statement to the Commission, bemobile admitted it had not built any new transmitter masts since the latter part of 2010.
target_text: 在向委员会发表的声明中，比格移动承认自2010年下半年以来没有建造任何新的发射器桅杆。

source_text: Muzamil Umar Kadri, Khalil Ahmed Sayyed Nazir and Gulam Hafeez Shaikh were convicted of helping land RDX on the Shekhadi coast in February 1993, and also for tranporting weapons and possessing illegal arms.
target_text: 穆扎米尔·乌马尔·卡德里、哈利勒·艾哈迈德·纳齐尔和古拉姆·哈菲茨·沙赫被判于1993年2月在萨哈达海岸帮助接应黑索金、运送武器以及持有非法武器。

source_text: Tulsiram Dhondu Surve, watchman of high security Wangani microwave tower in Raigad district, was found guilty of allowing Tiger's men to use government property for the purpose of loading arms into vehicles which then transported them to Mumbai.
target_text: 位于莱加德区旺亚尼的高安全性微波塔的警卫杜尔西拉姆·敦杜·苏尔维被判有罪，因为他允许泰戈组织的男子使用政府财产将武器装入车辆，然后运往孟买。

source_text: CBI investigations also revealed that Surve had concealed 59 bags of explosives in his field, before handing them over to the bombers.
target_text: 印度中央调查局的调查还显示，在将其交给爆炸手之前，苏尔维在他的据点隐藏了59袋爆炸物。

source_text: The watchman was convicted under Section 202 of the Indian Penal Code for "not informing authorities of the smuggling of arms and explosives despite having knowledge of the activities."
target_text: 该警卫根据印度刑法典第202条“尽管知悉这些活动，但未通知当局有关走私武器和爆炸物的消息”而被定罪。

source_text: Judge Kode, however, acquitted Anant Bhoir, who had allowed his dumper to be used for disposing of RDX in the Nagla Bunder Creek.
target_text: 然而，科德法官无罪释放了阿南特·博伊尔，他允许自己的翻斗车被用在纳格拉布恩河处理黑索金。

source_text: The court said that Bhoir had not been aware that the sacks contained explosive material.
target_text: 法院说，博伊尔并不知道麻袋里装有爆炸物。

source_text: The court also ruled that Bhoir and his co-accused's confessions were inadmissible since they "appear to have been taken under duress."
target_text: 法院还裁定博伊尔及其同案被告的供词不可受理，因为他们“似乎被胁迫”。

source_text: Wikinews held an exclusive interview with James Burns, one of the candidates for the Libertarian Party nomination for the 2008 U.S. presidential election.
target_text: 詹姆斯·伯恩斯是争取2008年美国总统大选自由党提名的候选人之一，维基新闻对詹姆斯·伯恩斯进行了专访。

source_text: Burns, the former chairman of the Nevada Libertarian Party, was asked if he thinks he has a good shot at winning the Libertarian nomination and ultimately the presidency.
target_text: 前内华达州自由党主席伯恩斯被问到，他是否认为自己有很好的机会赢得自由党的提名，并最终成为总统。

source_text: He replied, "My chances of winning are not all in my hands."
target_text: 他回答说：“我获胜的机会并不全在我手中。”

source_text: "I shall do my best, but it comes down to what others will do."
target_text: “我将尽我所能，但这取决于别人会做什么。”

source_text: When asked about America's shrinking middle class he said, "The economic policies of the US government are the cause our troubles."
target_text: 当被问及美国萎缩的中产阶级时，他说：“美国政府的经济政策是造成我们麻烦的原因。”

source_text: "When I am President, the only economic policy I shall pursue is to be frugal with the funds of the United States."
target_text: “当我担任总统时，我唯一要追求的经济政策就是要节省美国的资金。”

source_text: Burns believes that the President "is not 'the leader of the free world,' rather....a person who attempts to protect our rights to life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness."
target_text: 伯恩斯认为，总统“不是‘自由世界的领导者’，而是……一个试图保护我们的生命权、自由权和追求幸福权的人。”

source_text: Five Chinese nationals, identified as Lu Mingcheng (52), Wan Huilan (42), Chan Kwok Kwong (52), Ngan Chiu Kuen (42) and Ieong Chi Kai (52), were sentenced to death by firing squad for trafficking nearly eight tons of marijuana by sea.
target_text: 五名中国公民，身份被鉴定为陆明成（52岁）、万惠兰（42岁）、陈国光（52岁）、邱秋琨（42岁）和永志凯（52岁），因走私贩卖将近8吨大麻而被判处枪决死刑。

source_text: The People's Court of the northern Quang Ninh Province made the sentence after a four-day trial, and confiscated 19,600 jeans used for smuggling, HK$1.5 million (278,262 Yuan, US$10,485) in assets.
target_text: 广宁省北部人民法院经过四天的审判做出了判决，并没收了19,600条用于走私的牛仔裤，150万港元（278,262元，10,485美元）的资产。

source_text: The group were hired in April 2008 by individuals known by A Giai and A Tran to transfer the marijuana from Pakistan to Canada and were caught on May 12, 2008.
target_text: 该组织于2008年4月被以水浒传人物名称闻名的个人雇用，将大麻从巴基斯坦运送至加拿大，他们于2008年5月12日被捕。

source_text: The seizure is one of the largest in Vietnam's history, a country with strict drug laws.
target_text: 这次的缉获量是越南史上最大的缉获量之一，而越南是一个有严格禁毒法的国家。

source_text: At Wilfrid Laurier University in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada, students are finding that popular MP3 players, such as Apple's iPod, are very convenient devices for listening to music at the gym, while traveling on foot, and in the car.
target_text: 在加拿大安大略省滑铁卢的威尔弗里德劳里埃大学，学生们发现流行的MP3播放器，如苹果的iPod，是在健身房里、步行和在车里时非常方便的听音乐设备。

source_text: In a recent ad-hoc survey conducted by Wikinews contributor Darren Mar, 150 students were randomly pulled aside in the hallways of the university, and asked if they own an MP3 player.
target_text: 在维基新闻撰稿人达伦·马尔最近进行的一项特别调查，150名学生被随机拉到了大学的走廊里，并询问他们是否拥有MP3播放器。

source_text: 94 of the 150 students (62.66%) did in fact own MP3 devices, most of who were found to be carrying it on them when questioned.
target_text: 150名学生中有94名（62.66％）实际上拥有自己的MP3设备，调查时发现大多数人在被询问时携带着它们。

source_text: There was one simple follow up question for those who had a player: "If it were possible to have complete and safe control of the device on the steering wheel of a car, would you rather listen to your device, or the radio?"
target_text: 针对那些有播放器的人，紧接着询问一个简单的问题：“如果可以在汽车的方向盘上完全安全地控制设备，你更愿意听你的设备，还是听收音机呢？”

source_text: There were three answers possible, yes, no or both.
target_text: 有三个答案可选，是，否，或两者兼之。

source_text: Of the 94, 78 (82.98%) said yes, eleven (11.70%) said no, and five (5.32%) said both.
The reasons for those who would listen to their device were commercial free music, personalized choice of music, and complete control of what you are listening to.
target_text: 那些愿意使用他们设备听歌的人，其理由包括商业免费音乐、个性化的音乐选择以及可以完全控制所听的内容。

source_text: This study was motivated by the new design of 2006+ model cars.
target_text: 这项研究的契机是来自2006款车型的新设计。

source_text: Many are being built with auxiliary jacks for the stock radio, allowing the driver to easily connect any audio playing device to the car's sound system with a simple 3.5mm plug.
target_text: 如今许多汽车已配备汽车收音机用的辅助塞孔，让司机可以用一个简单的3.5毫米插头，轻松地连接任何音频播放设备到汽车的音响系统。

source_text: What's more, cars in the upper price echelon are being built with (1) a custom made area in the dash for MP3 players (iPod's being the most popular), and (2) implementing audio device control right onto the steering wheel.
target_text: 更进一步，高端价格梯级的汽车将会配备（1）一个为MP3播放器（iPod是最流行的）定制的区域，和（2）实现音频设备控制的方向盘。

source_text: A good example of this is the Ford Fusion or the 2007 Lexus IS250: "The centre console input port allows an iPod, MP3 or Windows Media Audio player to be plugged into the IS audio system."
target_text: 一个很好的例子是福特蒙迪欧或2007款雷克萨斯IS250：“中控台输入端口允许将iPod、MP3或Windows Media音频播放器插入IS音频系统。”

source_text: Seniors who haven't been credited with passing the California High School Exit Exam won't be getting diplomas when graduation ceremonies are held next month because the First District Appellate Court won't hear the court case about the test until July 25.
target_text: 没有通过加州高中毕业考试的高年级学生将无法在下月举行的毕业典礼上获得毕业证书，因为第一地区上诉法院要到7月25日才会审理有关高考的案件。

source_text: The attorney for the students suing to block use of the test says he still expects to prevail.
target_text: 起诉要求阻止使用该测试的学生们的代表律师表示，他仍然希望获胜。

source_text: "They have to stay in school and pass their classes."
target_text: “他们必须留在学校并通过他们的课程。”

source_text: On May 12, Alameda County Superior Court Judge Robert Freedman agreed with Gonzalez' argument that the state's use of the test as a graduation requirement was unconstitutional because poor and minority students don't have access to equal educational resources, and therefore don't have equal protection under the law.
target_text: 5月12日，阿拉米达县高等法院法官罗伯特·弗里德曼同意冈萨雷斯的辩驳，即该州将该考试作为毕业条件是违宪的，因为贫困和少数民族学生无法获得平等的教育资源，因此没有受到法律规定的同等保护。

source_text: He issued an injunction against the use of the test.
target_text: 他发布了禁止使用该测试的命令。

source_text: That injunction seemed to pave the way for those of the 47,000 seniors statewide who haven't yet passed the test, but have completed all other requirements, to receive diplomas with their classmates at upcoming graduation events.
target_text: 这项禁令似乎为全州47,000名尚未通过考试，但已完成所有其他条件的学生铺平了道路，使他们能在即将到来的毕业典礼上与同学们一起获得文凭。

source_text: But State Superintendent of Schools Jack O'Connell quickly filed an appeal of Freedman's ruling and asked the State Supreme Court to issue a stay of Freedman's injunction.
target_text: 但州立教育局长杰克·奥康奈尔迅速就弗里德曼的裁决提出上诉，并要求州最高法院中止弗里德曼发布的禁令。

source_text: Earlier this week, the Court granted O'Connell's request for a stay, allowing schools to deny diplomas to students who haven't passed the test.
target_text: 本周早些时候，法院批准了奥康奈尔的中止申请，允许学校拒绝对未通过考试的学生授予文凭。

source_text: The Court also ordered the Appellate court to hear O'Connell's appeal of Freedman's ruling against the test.
target_text: 法院还命令上诉法院听取奥康奈尔对弗里德曼做出反对该测试裁决的上诉。

source_text: On Thursday, Gonzalez petitioned the Appellate Court to expedite their hearing of the case to as soon as next week, but today the court denied Gonzalez' request and scheduled the case for a hearing on July 25.
target_text: 星期四，冈萨雷斯请求上诉法院尽快在下周加快审理此案，但今天法院驳回了冈萨雷斯的请求，并安排于7月25日举行案件听证会。

source_text: In an email to the James Logan Courier, Gonzalez said he thinks his case is strong enough to withstand the appeal.
target_text: 冈萨雷斯在给“詹姆斯洛根信使”报的电子邮件中说，他认为他的案子足够强大，能够承受上诉。

source_text: "We intend to vigorously defend Judge Freedman's ruling," he said, "The record strongly supports his decision."
target_text: “我们打算大力捍卫弗里德曼法官的裁决，”他说，“该记录强烈支持他的决定。”

source_text: "If the court of appeals upholds Judge Freedman's ruling, students in the Class of 2006 may still receive their high school diplomas," he said.
target_text: 他说，“如果上诉法院支持弗里德曼法官的裁决，那么2006年度班级的学生们仍然可以获得高中毕业证书。”

source_text: About 70 seniors at James Logan High School in Union City, Ca., mostly minorities and those who are learning English, still need to pass the test.
target_text: 加州联合城詹姆斯洛根高中的大约70名高年级学生，主要是少数民族和正在学习英语的人，他们仍然需要通过考试。

source_text: O'Connell, an avid defender of the test, which is required by a law he wrote and championed when he was in the state legislature, said this week that he would make sure school districts knew that they had to require the test be passed in order to hand out diplomas to students.
target_text: 奥康奈尔，一个狂热的测试捍卫者，该测试是他在州立法机构写下并支持的一项法律所要求的，他在本周表示，将会确保学区知道为了向学生分发文凭，必须要求他们通过测试。

source_text: "I will communicate with districts today to ensure they are aware that the exit exam is a graduation requirement" he said, "Students who have worked hard to pass this exam will be given a diploma that signifies their mastery of essential skills in reading and math."
target_text: 他说，“我今天会与学区沟通，以确保他们知道毕业考试是毕业的条件”“努力通过考试的学生将获得一份文凭，表明他们掌握了阅读和数学的基本技能。”

source_text: Police are still looking for the suspect that killed Denver Broncos cornerback Darrent Williams, 24, in a drive by shooting January 1.
target_text: 警方仍在寻找嫌犯，犯人在1月1日的一次开枪中击杀了丹佛野马队的角卫，24岁的达伦特·威廉姆斯。

source_text: Williams was killed by a single gunshot wound to the neck.
target_text: 威廉姆斯被一枪击中颈部致死。

source_text: Police say there was a disagreement at a nightclub birthday party for Kenyon Martin, a forward with the Denver Nuggets National Basketball Association team, and Williams and his two friends left.
target_text: 警方称，在为肯尼亚·马丁——美国国家篮球协会丹佛掘金队的前锋——举办的夜总会生日派上有一场争执，于是威廉姆斯和他的两个朋友离开了。

source_text: His two friends, a man and a woman, were hit along with him.
target_text: 他的两个朋友，一男一女，和他一起被击中。

source_text: "We'll have a memorial service on Wednesday with our players and coaches and Darrent's family," Broncos coach Mike Shanahan said at a press conference on Tuesday.
target_text: 野马队主教练麦克·沙纳罕周二在新闻发布会上说，“我们将在周三与我们的球员和教练以及达伦特的家人举行追悼会。”

source_text: "I don't think he had a guy that wasn't his friend," added Shanahan.
target_text: “我不认为他有一个不是他朋友的家伙，”沙纳汉补充道。

source_text: The entire Denver Broncos will attend the funeral service for Williams on Saturday in his hometown of Fort Worth, Texas, according to Shanahan.
target_text: 根据沙纳罕的说法，整个丹佛野马队将于周六在威廉姆斯的家乡德克萨斯州沃思堡参加他的葬礼。

source_text: The "NBA 2K8 Asia Championship" Taiwan Qualifier, organized by NBA Asia Corp. and sponsored by Microsoft Taiwan, was held on December 22 & 23.
target_text: 由NBA亚洲公司组织并由微软台湾赞助的“NBA 2K8亚洲锦标赛”台湾资格赛于12月22日和23日举行。

source_text: According to the organizer, Taiwan was chosen as the first on-site stage tournament because of some of the market share factor on the gaming industry and the gaming population.
target_text: 根据主办方的说法，由于游戏行业和游戏人口的一些市场份额因素，台湾被选为第一个现场舞台比赛。

source_text: In Taiwan's qualifier, the organizer successively invited models from Catwalk Production House and two Taiwanese bands (Yummy, 2moro) for friendship matches with the public.
target_text: 在台湾的资格赛中，主办方先后邀请了凯渥模特经纪公司的模特和两个台湾乐队（Yummy、2moro）与公众进行友谊赛。

source_text: With the entertainers' participation, it attracted media and press in the entertainment industry.
target_text: 随着艺人的参与，它吸引了娱乐界的媒体和出版社。

source_text: On the other hand, to conjunct with sports and gaming, the organizer set the experience area with not only the Xbox 360 gaming console but also a shooting machine.
target_text: 另一方面，为了与运动和游戏相结合，主办方不仅在体验区配置了Xbox360游戏机而且还设置了射击机。

source_text: In this 2-day qualifier, due to some issues on the arrangement of the schedule, some registered gamers offered to quit the championship, but it didn't take effect on the results of the single day champion, the 2-day champion, and overall champion.
target_text: 在为期2天的资格赛中，由于时间安排上的一些问题，一些注册的游戏玩家主动退出比赛，但它没有影响到单日冠军、2天冠军和总冠军的结果。

source_text: Finally, Yu-cheng Lin won the overall champion to participate in the Grand Final of the championship in South Korea on January 12, 2008.
target_text: 最后，林昱成赢得了总冠军，将于2008年1月12日参加在韩国举办的总决赛。

source_text: According to the organizer, the Hong Kong qualifier will start on January 5 & 6, 2008 at Plaza Hollywood in Diamond Hill, Hong Kong.
target_text: 据主办方介绍，香港资格赛将于2008年1月5日和6日在香港钻石山的好莱坞广场举行。

source_text: Fifty people are feared to have drowned after a boat capsized in the Bagmati, an Indian river, on Tuesday, according to the government.
target_text: 根据政府的说法，周二在印度巴加马人河上翻船后，恐怕已有50人被淹死。

source_text: 75 people, mainly women and children, were aboard the vessel when it flipped over during a storm.
target_text: 当该船在暴风雨期间翻覆时，船上载有75人，主要是妇女和儿童。

source_text: They had been returning from a fair that marked the end of the Durga Puja, an annual Hindu festival that celebrates the worship of the Hindu goddess Durga.
target_text: 他们正从一个标志着杜尔迦供结束的集市返回，这是一年一度的印度教节日，庆祝对印度教女神杜尔加的崇拜。

source_text: Fifteen people were able to swim to safety, but it is unlikely the other passengers of the boat were able to survive, according to a report.
target_text: 据一份报告称，有15人得以游至安全地，但船上的其他乘客似乎很难存活。

source_text: An official from the district where the accident occurred said that "we have recovered 11 bodies so far and search is on for 40 other missing people."
target_text: 事故发生地区的一名官员表示，“到目前为止，我们已经收回了11具尸体，并正在持续搜索其他40名失踪人员。”

source_text: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has hiked the repo rate by 0.25 percent to 7.25 percent, keeping the reverse repo rate unchanged at 6%.
target_text: 印度储备银行（RBI）将回购利率上调0.25％至7.25％，将反向回购利率维持在6％不变。

source_text: The Bank rate and the cash reserve ratio are left unchanged at 6% and 5% respectively.
target_text: 银行利率和现金准备金率分别维持在6％和5％不变。

source_text: In its mid-year review of monetary and regulatory policy, the Reserve Bank has forecast an annual GDP growth of 8.0%, as against the 7.5-8.0% forecast earlier in its annual policy statement and first quarter review.
target_text: 在对货币和监管政策的年中回顾中，储备银行预测年度GDP增长率为8.0％，而其年度政策声明和第一季度审核中的预测为7.5-8.0％。

source_text: The Reserve Bank indicated that inflation will be contained between 5.0-5.5%, during the year 2006-07.
target_text: 储备银行表示，在2006-2007年度，通胀率将控制在5.0-5.5％之间。

source_text: The Reserve Bank estimated real GDP growth in the first quarter of 2006-07 at 8.9%, up from 8.5% last year.
target_text: 储备银行估计2006-2007年第一季度的实际GDP增长率为8.9％，高于去年的8.5％。

source_text: Norm Coleman filed an appeal with the Minnesota Supreme Court challenging opponent Al Franken's court victory last week which gave Franken a 312-vote lead in the disputed 2008 Minnesota United States Senate election, reports the Minneapolis Star-Tribune.
target_text: 据明尼阿波利斯星际论坛报道，诺姆·科尔曼向明尼苏达州最高法院提起上诉，要求驳回对手艾尔·弗兰肯上周赢得的法庭胜利，这使弗兰肯在有争议的2008年明尼苏达州美国参议院选举中领先312票。

source_text: The basis for Coleman's appeal has yet to be given and will be included in a legal brief to be filed by the Coleman campaign later this week.
target_text: 科尔曼上诉的根据有待公布，并将纳入本周晚些时候科尔曼竞选活动提交的法律简报中。

source_text: Jim Langdon, lawyer for the Coleman campaign, said that the oral arguments in the court could begin in anywhere from "two weeks to two months", adding more time to a process which has continued since a razor-thin difference between the two candidates' vote totals triggered an automatic recount in November 2008.
target_text: 科尔曼竞选活动的律师吉姆·兰登表示，法院的口头辩论可以从“两周到两个月”的任何时间开始，为仍持续进行的重新计票过程增加更多时间，因为两个候选人之间投票总数的极小差异在2008年11月引发了自动重新计票。

source_text: "Sometimes you come up on the short end of a close and bitter election."
target_text: “有时候你出现在一场紧密而艰苦的选举终局。”

source_text: "But at some point, you have to accept the reality for what it is," said Marc Elias, one of Franken's lawyers.
target_text: “但在某个时点，你必须接受现实，”弗兰肯的律师之一马克·伊莱亚斯说。

source_text: The Coleman campaign argues that 4,400 ballots from Coleman-leaning districts have improperly not been counted, while some undetermined number of ballots (perhaps contributing up to 100 of Franken's 312-vote margin) were accidentally double-counted.
target_text: 科尔曼竞选活动方辩称，来自亲科尔曼区域的4,400张选票未被适当地计算在内，而一些未确定数量的选票（也许对弗兰肯312票的差距贡献了高达100票）被意外地重复计算。

source_text: Coleman also argues that 132 ballots from the Dinkytown neighborhood of Minneapolis should not have been counted, since the envelope containing them was lost or stolen after the machine count and before the recount.
target_text: 科尔曼还争辩说，来自明尼阿波利斯小城街区的132张选票不应该被计算在内，因为装着它们的信封在机器计数之后和重新计票之前丢失或被盗。

source_text: The Franken campaign, meanwhile, supports the previous three-judge panel (from a Democrat, a Republican, and an Independent) unanimous ruling giving Franken victory.
target_text: 与此同时，弗兰肯的竞选活动支持之前由三法官小组（来自民主党、共和党和独立党）做出让弗兰肯获胜的一致裁决。

source_text: The Franken campaign, anticipating a final victory and certification by the Minnesota Secretary of State, has begun hiring a staff for Franken's senatorial office.
target_text: 弗兰肯的竞选活动，预计将获得最后的胜利并得到明尼苏达州国务卿的认证，已经开始为弗兰肯的参议院办公室雇用一名工作人员。

source_text: Franken's spokespeople say he is going to start by hiring Alana Peterson, a former state director for Representative Jim Oberstar, as state director.
target_text: 弗兰肯的发言人表示，他将首先聘请前州代表吉姆·奥伯施塔尔的州主任阿兰娜·彼得森担任州主任。

source_text: On Friday, the sheriff of Pickens County, South Carolina Rick Clark refused to lower the flag to honor Nelson Mandela after US President Barack Obama made an executive order that all US flags to be flown at half mast in honor of Mandela until sunset today.
target_text: 星期五，南卡罗来纳州皮肯斯县警长里克·克拉克拒绝降低旗帜以纪念纳尔逊·曼德拉，此前美国总统巴拉克·奥巴马制定了一项行政命令，要求将所有美国国旗降半旗以纪念曼德拉，直到今天日落。

source_text: On Friday, Clark posted to Facebook to explain his decision saying, "I usually don't post political items, but today is different."
target_text: 上周五，克拉克向脸书网发帖解释他的决定，“我通常不发布政治项目，但今天不同。”

source_text: "I received this notification today, 'As a mark of respect for the memory of Nelson Mandela, the President orders that the flag of the United States be flown at half-staff effective immediately until sunset, December 9, 2013' ".
target_text: “我今天收到了这个通知，‘为了纪念纳尔逊·曼德拉，总统命令美国国旗立即降半旗，直到2013年12月9日日落。’”。

source_text: He went on to say in the same post, "Nelson Mandela did great things for his country and was a brave man but he was not an AMERICAN!!! The flag should be lowered at our Embassy in S. Africa, but not here."
target_text: 他继续在同一篇贴文中说：“纳尔逊曼·德拉为他的国家做了很多伟大的事情，他是一个勇敢的人，但他不是美国人！我们在非洲大使馆的旗帜应该降下来，但不是在这里。”

source_text: Our flag is at half staff today for a Deputy in the low country who died going to help his fellow Deputy.
target_text: 今天我们为一个赤道附近国家的逝去的代表人降半旗，他是要去帮助他的代表人同伴。

source_text: "I have ordered that the flag here at my office back up after tomorrow's mourning of Pearl Harbor Day!"
target_text: “我已经下令，在明天珍珠港日的哀悼之后，将我办公室的旗帜升起来！”

source_text: According to Fox News, the US President cannot require US flag lowering at the local level.
target_text: 根据福克斯新闻报道，美国总统不能在地方级别要求美国国旗降旗。

source_text: According to CNN in an article published yesterday, presidents generally restrict requests for lowering the flag to major national figures, US governors, and foreign dignitaries.
target_text: 美国有线电视新闻网在昨天发表的一篇文章中表示，总统一般都会将要求降旗的请求限制在主要的国家级人物，如美国州长和外国政要。

source_text: Presidents of the United States have previously ordered the flag lowered in honor of non-Americans including Pope John Paul II who died in 2005, King Hussein of Jordan who died in 1999, Israeli Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin who died in 1995, Egyptian President Anwar Sadat who died in 1981, British Prime Minister Winston Churchill who died in 1965, and United Nations Secretary-General Dag Hammarskjold who died in 1961.
target_text: 美国总统此前曾下令降旗以纪念非美国人，其中包括2005年去世的教皇约翰·保罗二世、1999年去世的约旦国王侯赛因、1995年去世的以色列总理伊扎克·拉宾、1981年去世的埃及总统安瓦尔·萨达特、1965年去世的英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔、1961年去世的联合国秘书长达格·哈马舍尔德。

source_text: While President Obama expressed condolences regarding the death of Margaret Thatcher upon her death earlier this year, he did not issue an executive order that flags be lowered in her honour.
target_text: 虽然奥巴马总统在今年早些时候对玛格丽特·撒切尔今的去世表示哀悼，但他没有为她发布要求降低旗帜的行政命令。

source_text: An annual survey done by the New Zealand Consumers' Institute has shown that there has been a dramatic decline in satisfaction with the respondents' Internet service providers (ISP).
target_text: 新西兰消费者协会进行的年度调查显示，受访者对互联网服务提供商（ISP）的满意度大幅下降。

source_text: This is compared to the 2005 survey which was at 82%.
target_text: 这被拿来与2005年的调查结果相比，2005年的调查结果为82％。

source_text: The reason, according to the Consumers' Institute, is because of national ISP, Xtra dragging down the ratings.
target_text: 根据消费者协会的消息，原因在于国家互联网服务提供商，Xtra拖慢了额定值。

source_text: Only 55% of Xtra's customers said they were satisfied or very satisfied with Xtra, it was 78% last year.
target_text: 只有55％的Xtra客户表示他们对插件感到满意或非常满意，去年这一比例为78％。

source_text: Nick Brown, spokesman, said: "Xtra will be working to improve its ranking."
target_text: 发言人尼克布朗说：“Xtra将努力提高其等级”。

source_text: The best ISP, as voted by the survey respondents, was Inspire, the third consecutive time they have won.
target_text: 调查受访者投票选出的最佳互联网服务供应商是灵感，这是他们连续第三次获胜。

source_text: 97% of Inspire's users said that its performance was either good or very good.
target_text: 97％的灵感用户表示其表现不错或非常好。

source_text: David Russel, chief executive of the Consumers' Institute, said: "The wonderful world of cyberspace has a long way to go in New Zealand in terms of providing customer satisfaction."
target_text: 消费者协会首席执行官大卫•拉塞尔表示：“在提供客户满意度方面，新西兰网络空间的美好世界还有很长的路要走”。

source_text: "Broadband speed and the price people are paying are the biggest bones of contention."
target_text: “宽带速度和人们付出的代价是争论的最大争议点”。

source_text: Mr. Russell added: "Support, both online and offline is a key factor in satisfaction with your ISP."
target_text: 拉塞尔先生补充说：“在线和离线支持是对您的互联网服务供应商是否满意的关键因素”。

source_text: Speaker of the U.S. House John Boehner announced yesterday that he would agree to a two-month extension of the payroll tax cut.
target_text: 美国众议院议长约翰·博纳昨天宣布，他将同意将工资税减免延长两个月。

source_text: In an effort to end the impasse between the House and Senate, Boehner told Senate Democratic leader Harry Reid that he would schedule a House vote on the Senate version of the bill that would extend the tax cut, which was due to expire at the end of the year.
target_text: 为了结束众议院和参议院之间的僵局，博纳告诉参议院民主党领袖哈里·里德，他将安排众议院对参议院版本的法案进行投票，该法案将延长减税期限，减税期限于年底到期。

source_text: Speaker Boehner announced the agreement in a brief statement: "Senator Reid and I have reached an agreement that will ensure taxes do not increase for working families on January 1".
target_text: 发言人博纳在一份简短的声明中宣布了该协议：“参议员里德和我达成了一项协议，将确保1月1日工薪家庭的税收不增加”。

source_text: Boehner informed other congressmen of the deal in a conference call yesterday evening.
target_text: 昨天晚上，博纳在电话会议上向其他国会议员通报了这个协议。

source_text: The House may pass the bill via unanimous consent today, which would not require the presence of all members.
target_text: 众议院今天可以一致同意并通过该法案，这不需要所有成员在场。

source_text: Boehner and Reid also agreed to a bipartisan negotiation committee to sort out differences and extend the tax cut for an entire year, a goal recently sought by Republicans in the House.
target_text: 博纳和霍夫曼还同意一个两党谈判委员会来解决分歧，并将减税延长一年，这是共和党人最近在众议院寻求的目标。

source_text: Earlier yesterday, Senate Republican leader Mitch McConnell joined several other Republican Senators in encouraging the House to pass the extension.
target_text: 昨天早些时候，参议院共和党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔与其他几位共和党参议员一起鼓励众议院通过延期。

source_text: Senate Democratic leader Harry Reid said that once the House acts, he "will be happy to restart the negotiating process to forge a yearlong extension."
target_text: 参议院民主党领袖哈里·里德说，一旦众议院采取行动，他“将很乐意重启谈判进程，以便进行为期一年的延期。”

source_text: At a news conference, Speaker Boehner issued a statement: "We have fought the good fight."
target_text: 在新闻发布会上，议长博纳发表声明：“我们已经打了胜仗。”

source_text: "Why not do the right thing for the American people even though it's not exactly what we want."
target_text: “尽管这不是我们想要的，为什么不为美国人做正确的事情呢”。

source_text: President Obama also responded to the development in a statement: "This is good news, just in time for the holidays."
target_text: 奥巴马总统还在一份声明中回应了这一发展：“这是好消息，正好赶上假期。”

source_text: This is the right thing to do to strengthen our families, grow our economy, and create new jobs.
target_text: 这是加强家庭、发展经济和创造新工作的正确方法。

source_text: "This is real money that will make a real difference in people's lives."
target_text: “这是将对人们的生活产生真正的影响的实在的金钱。”

source_text: The tax cut extension impasse began when the House effectively rejected the Senate-approved version of the bill on Tuesday after being faced with opposition from House Republicans, specifically those associated with the Tea Party movement, who advocated for spending cuts and the controversial Keystone XL oil pipeline.
target_text: 减税延长计划陷入僵局的原因是，众议院在面对众议院共和党人的反对后，于星期二正式通过了参议院通过的减税法案。特别是那些与茶党运动有关的人和主张削减开支和有争议的XL拱顶石输油管道。

source_text: An ongoing struggle in Kazakhstan between the authorities and a local Hindu village has turned serious.
target_text: 哈萨克斯坦当局与当地印度教村庄之间的持续斗争已经越来越严重。

source_text: Forum 18 has been documenting the alleged human rights abuse regarding the Hare Krishna village for some time, but as of 21st November events took a drastic turn.
target_text: 论坛18已经记录了一段时间以来有关哈里克里希纳村庄的所谓人权虐待事件，但截至11月21日，事件发生了转变。

source_text: On November 21, 2006 at 1 pm the information was received that according to the court decision to evict the members of the religion organization International Society for Krishna Consciousness from the occupied land near Sri Vrindavan Dham farm, and the demolition of 13 country houses will begin immediately.
target_text: 2006年11月21日下午1时收到的信息是，根据法院决定，将宗教组织国际克里希纳意识学会的成员驱逐出位于Sri Vrindavan Dham农场附近的被占土地，并且立即开始拆除13座乡村房屋。

source_text: Heavy equipment was brought to the suburban community: trucks, demolition machines, three busses with riot policemen, a bus with demolition squad and the local authorities including the Hakim.
target_text: 重型设备被带到郊区社区：卡车、拆除机器、三辆载有防暴警察的公共汽车、一辆载有拆除小组和哈基姆在内的地方官员的公共汽车。

source_text: Electricity was disconnected in the morning of the same day.
target_text: 当天早上电力被切断了。

source_text: She had a conversation with B. Baikadamov, the only person she could reach at that time, who promised to communicate to the Committee of Religious Affairs at the Ministry of Justice, the Supreme Court, and the Court Administration Committee which includes the department of court decision execution.
target_text: 她与当时唯一能联系到的人B.Baikadamov进行了交谈，后者承诺与司法部宗教事务委员会、最高法院和包括法院判决执行部在内的法院行政委员会进行沟通。

source_text: At 3 pm representatives of human rights organizations: Ninel Fokina, Andrei Grishin, and Maxim Varfolomeev, press-secretary of the Society for Krishna Consciousness, plus, a journalist and representative of Astana TV channel left for the village which is located 40 km from Almaty.
target_text: 下午3点，人权组织代表：尼尔·福金娜，安洁烈·格里申和克里希纳意识协会新闻秘书马克西姆·瓦尔弗洛梅耶夫，以及阿斯塔纳电视频道的记者和代表前往距离阿拉木图40公里的村庄。

source_text: All the roads to village were closed and patrolled by police.
target_text: 通往村庄的所有道路都被关闭并且都有警察巡逻。

source_text: It was snowing, but they were able to reach the border of the village because of the four-wheel-drive jeep they were traveling in.
target_text: 下雪了，但是因为他们乘坐的四轮驱动吉普车，他们能够到达村庄边缘。

source_text: The jeep was not allowed to drive into the village.
target_text: 吉普车不允许驶入村庄。

source_text: Lieutenant colonel, who came with another patrol car, explained that they are not allowed to the village for their own safety.
target_text: 与另一辆巡逻车一起来的中校解释说，为了他们自己的安全，他们不得进入村庄。

source_text: He said that at that time the electric line was being dismounted in the area.
target_text: 他说当时该地区的电线正在被拆除。

source_text: The driver of the jeep had his wife and two months old daughter in the village.
target_text: 吉普车的司机在村里有他的妻子和两个月大的女儿。

source_text: He was begging to let him go through, but his request was denied.
target_text: 他乞求让他通过，但他的请求被拒绝了。

source_text: He was told that safety is guaranteed to his family.
target_text: 他被告知他的家人安全可以被保证。

source_text: As they approached the village they met two small groups of young people who were not drunk but unnaturally exited.
target_text: 当他们接近村庄时，他们遇到了两个年轻人小组，他们并没有喝醉，但是很不自然地离开了。

source_text: They held hammers, big dumb-bells, metal crow-bars and sticks.
target_text: 他们拿着锤子、大哑铃、金撬棍和棒子。

source_text: Two of them politely greeted the group, and one said gaily, "Your houses are finished."
target_text: 其中两人礼貌地迎接了这个小组，一个人高兴地说，“你的房子已经完工了”。

source_text: 30-40 policemen stood by the houses, and 20-30 people in civil clothes including the leaders of the district with the Hakim, the head of local executive authority stood on the street, watching the demolition.
target_text: 30-40名警察站在房子旁边，20-30人穿着便服，包括区长和地方行政首长哈基姆一起站在街上观看拆迁。

source_text: Residents’ household stuff such as mattresses, blankets, utensils cookware, and furniture were laying outside on the lawns by their houses.
target_text: 居民的家庭用品，如床垫、毯子、餐具、炊具和家具，都放在屋外草坪上。

source_text: People in construction outfits (labor people) got inside the houses and started crushing windows and doors, destroying walls.
target_text: 穿着建筑服装的人（劳工）进入房屋，开始破碎门窗，摧毁墙壁。

source_text: The bulldozer was demolishing the buildings and the big stone fencing with cast iron openwork lattice which separated the houses from the driving area.
target_text: 推土机拆除了建筑物和大石头围栏，铸铁镂空格子将房屋与驾驶区域分开。

source_text: A small group of inhabitants (20-30 people, mostly women) did not offer physical resistance.
target_text: 一小群居民（20-30人，大多数是女性）没有进行身体抵抗。

source_text: One of the women felt dizzy, fell down and was picked up by the ambulance.
target_text: 其中一名妇女感到头晕并且摔倒了，然后被救护车接走了。

source_text: Police was bringing down those few (basically women) who tried to interfere with the destruction of their property.
target_text: 警方正在镇压那些试图干涉他们财产破坏的少数人（基本上是妇女）。

source_text: Two men tried to prevent the entrance of destroyers into a house, but were brought down by 15 policemen who twisted their hands and took them away to the police car.
target_text: 两名男子试图阻止拆除者进入一所房子，但被15名警察击倒，他们双手被控制和被带到警车上。

source_text: During all these events none of the representatives from the Office of Public Prosecutor were present at the place of the event, even though both Krishna people and legal service people demanded meeting with representatives of the Office of Public Prosecutor who are obligated to be present during this type of actions.
target_text: 在所有这些活动中，检察官办公室的代表都没有出现在活动地点，尽管克里希纳人和法律服务人员都要求与检察官办公室的代表会面，而检察官办公室的代表在此种类型活动期间有义务在场。

source_text: The Hakim of the Yetisu district who was personally responsible for this action noticed A. Grishin photographing the destruction of the houses using a digital camera and commanded the policemen to detain him.
target_text: 负责这一行动的叶蒂苏区的哈基姆注意到A.格里申用数码相机拍摄房屋被毁的照片，并命令警察拘留他。

source_text: A. Grishin is an officer of the Human Rights Bureau and a journalist.
target_text: A.格里申是人权局的官员和记者。

source_text: To avoid confiscation of the camera A. Grishin tried to escape.
target_text: 为了避免被没收相机A.格里申试图逃跑。

source_text: He ran away by 200 meters and was caught by the police.
target_text: 他跑出去200米，但是被警察抓住了。

source_text: Police officers confiscated his digital camera and took away his journalist certificate.
target_text: 警察没收了他的数码相机并拿走了他的记者证。

source_text: Then he was let free, but police refused to return the camera, saying that they would give it to the Hakim.
target_text: 然后他被释放，但警察拒绝退还相机，说他们会把它交给哈基姆。

source_text: When Grishin approached the Hakim to find out for what reason his camera and his journalist ID were confiscated, the Hakim told in front of the witnesses, “If I see you here again, I will personally crash Your eyes, even though I am the Hakim.”
target_text: 当格里辛走近哈基姆，想知道他的相机和记者身份证被没收的原因时，哈基姆在目击者面前说：“如果我再在这里见到你，我会亲自撞碎你的眼睛，即使我是哈基姆。”

source_text: No one of the policemen, who took part in the camera and ID confiscation, wanted to reveal their names.
target_text: 没有一个参与摄像机和身份证没收的警察想透露他们的名字。

source_text: The envoy of human rights E. Baikadamov, who was also contacted, said that the president of the Court Administration Committee Z. Makashev confirmed that he would contact immediately the provincial department and would give the appropriate instructions.
target_text: 人权特使E.Baikadamov也被联系到，他说法院行政委员会主席Z.Makashev确认他将立即与省政府部门联系，并将给予适当的指示。

source_text: All the attempts of the representatives of the human rights organizations to find the people in charge of the operation and give them any information were unsuccessful.
target_text: 人权组织代表试图找到负责行动的人并向他们提供任何信息的所有努力都没有成功。

source_text: All the present officials refused to speak and declared that they were not responsible for the action.
target_text: 所有现任官员都拒绝发言并宣称他们不对此行为负责。

source_text: The OSCE representatives in Almaty Eugenia Benigni and Lisa Zhumakhmetova did not make it to the village.
target_text: 欧安组织在阿拉木图的代表尤金妮娅·贝尼尼和丽莎·朱玛基梅托娃没有到村里去。

source_text: When the darkness fell, at around 6 pm, everything was finished: 13 houses destroyed, people thrown to the snowbound street, the village left without electricity, without heat and water.
target_text: 当黑暗降临时，下午6点左右，一切都已完成：13栋房屋被毁，人们被扔到大雪的街道，村里没有电，没有热水。

source_text: The condition of the people who were thrown from their destroyed houses to the dirt and snow cannot be described.
target_text: 人们被从他们被摧毁的房子扔到泥土和雪中的情况无法描述。

source_text: When all the 13 buildings were destroyed as was planned ... while the adjacent houses of other people who do not belong to the Society for Krishna Consciousness were left untouched even though their title deeds have the same status ... the bailiffs decided to give an interview to the TV channel “to avoid one-sided opinion.”
target_text: 当所有13座建筑物按计划被摧毁时……其他不属于克里希纳意识协会的人的相邻房屋保持不变，即使他们的地契也具有相同的地位……法警们决定接受电视频道“兼听则明”的采访。

source_text: However no one of them introduced himself.
target_text: 然而，没有人介绍自己。

source_text: The only thing they could say, “we are executing the court decision.”
target_text: 他们唯一可以说的是，“我们正在执行法院裁决。”

source_text: Neither the Hakim, nor the police chiefs, nor the bailiffs would listen to the arguments that the governmental commission established to solve the issue around the Society for Krishna Consciousness has not yet come to final decision.
target_text: 哈基姆，警察局长和法警都不会听取政府委员会为解决克里希纳意识协会问题而建立的辩论，这些辩论还没有被最终决定。

source_text: Notice: the notifications of eviction and demolition of the 13 houses owned by members of the cottage cooperative, who are the members of the religious organization Society for Krishna Consciousness, were delivered to the watchman of Sri Vrindavan Dham in the evening of November 20.
target_text: 通知：11月20日晚，作为克里希纳意识宗教组织协会成员的农舍合作社成员拥有的13栋房屋的拆除和驱逐通知，已送交Sri Vrindavan Dham看守人。

source_text: The date of execution and the period for evacuating the buildings were not stated.
target_text: 没有说明执行日期和撤离建筑物的时间。

source_text: It should be noted that the acting Kazakh law does not stipulate such a kind of eviction as the demolition of houses, and the eviction should be accompanied by the inventory of property removed from the evacuated building, while the storage of this property should be provided is necessary.
target_text: 应当指出的是，哈萨克斯坦现行法律没有规定房屋拆迁等驱逐行为，驱逐行为应当附有从疏散建筑中移除的财产清单，提供财产的储存也是必要的。

source_text: The fourteenth Quiksilver Ceremonial Punta de Lobos Big Wave Invitational surf championship took place on Saturday in the Chilean city of Pichilemu, often called the "Capital of the Surf."
target_text: 第14届奎克西尔弗仪式蓬德罗布斯大浪邀请冲浪锦标赛于周六在智利城市匹兹勒姆举行，匹兹勒姆通常被称为“冲浪之都”。

source_text: In this year's competition, 24 surfers from countries such as South Africa, Peru, Chile, the United States, and Argentina participated in the championship, including Pichileminians Ramón Navarro and Cristian Merelló, and Hawaiian Köhl Christensen.
target_text: 在今年的比赛中，来自南非、秘鲁、智利和阿根廷等国家的24名冲浪选手参加了比赛，包括Pichileminians Ramón Navarro、Cristian Merelló以及Hawaiian Köhl Christensen。

source_text: Australia's Governor-General, Quentin Bryce, has cut Singapore and the UK from her official winter trip, keeping only France on her schedule, due to expectations that Prime Minister Julia Gillard will arrive at Government House in the coming days to request the Governor-General to call an election.
target_text: 由于预计总理吉拉德将在未来几天抵达总督府并要求总督安排选举，澳大利亚总督昆廷·布莱斯已将新加坡和英国从其正式的冬季出访行程中取消，只保留了法国。

source_text: There has been much speculation as to when Gillard was to request that the election be called by the Governor-General, with 21st and 28th of August being most likely.
target_text: 很多人猜测吉拉德最有可能是八月二十一日和二十八日要求总督召集选举。

source_text: This would be the first time since 1987 that an election was held during the winter.
target_text: 这将是自1987年以来第一次在冬季举行选举。

source_text: As a result, Ms Bryce will head to Fromelles in France to represent Australia in a dedication ceremony and then return home, bringing her ten day trip down to five days.
target_text: 因此，布莱斯女士将前往法国的弗罗梅勒代表澳大利亚参加献礼仪式，然后返回家园，将她的十天旅行降至五天。

source_text: In a speech today in Adelaide, South Australia Gillard suggested that she wanted to achieve a mandate by the people through the usual means of the Governor-General.
target_text: 今天在南澳大利亚阿德莱德的一次演讲中，吉拉德建议说，她希望通过总督的常规手段来实现人民的授权。

source_text: "I will ask the Australian people for their trust to move forward," Gillard said in the same speech.
target_text: 吉拉德在同一次演讲中说：“我将在澳大利亚人民的信任中前行”。

source_text: According to current Nielsen and Galaxy polls, on a two-party preferred basis, Julia Gillard leads her rival, opposition leader Tony Abbott, 52-48 percent.
target_text: 根据目前尼尔森和银河的民意调查，在两党优先的基础上，茱莉亚·吉拉德以52%对48%的优势领先对手、反对党领袖托尼·阿伯特。

source_text: APEC Australia 2007 has officially closed in Sydney, with Australian Prime Minister John Howard delivering APEC's final declaration.
target_text: 2007年，澳大利亚亚太经合组织在悉尼正式闭幕，澳大利亚总理约翰·霍华德发表了亚太经合组织的最后声明。

source_text: The final leader's declaration said that APEC member economies will support the Doha trade talks and that the leaders examined a series of measures to deal with terrorism, pandemics, contaminated food, energy security and natural disasters.
target_text: 最终的领导人声明说，亚太经合组织成员经济体将支持多哈贸易谈判，领导人审查了一系列措施，以应对恐怖主义、流行病、污染食品、能源安全和自然灾害问题。

source_text: Mr Howard said that the APEC members had decided to make "An urgent request to all countries involved in the Doha process to renew their efforts to achieve an outcome, emphasizing that agriculture and industrial products are the two priority areas".
target_text: 霍华德先生表示，亚太经合组织成员决定“向参与多哈进程的所有国家提出紧急要求，重新努力取得成果，强调农业和工业产品是两个优先领域”。

source_text: The leaders wish for Doha to enter its final phase this year.
target_text: 领导人希望多哈今年进入最后阶段。

source_text: Talks have been stalled due to disagreements between the European Union and United States over subsidies and tariffs for the agricultural sector.
target_text: 由于欧盟和美国在农业补贴和关税问题上存在分歧，谈判被搁置。

source_text: A plan by the United States to establish an APEC free trade zone received a mixed reception with some members believing that such a move would weaken the group's commitment to the Doha round.
target_text: 美国提出的建立亚太经合组织自由贸易区的计划受到了不同程度的欢迎，一些成员认为此举将削弱该组织对多哈回合的承诺。

source_text: They did agree that if the WTO's Doha talks were not completed by the end of the year, the APEC zone would be examined.
target_text: 他们同意如果世贸组织的多哈谈判未在年底前完成，将对亚太经合组织区域进行审查。

source_text: Speaking to CNBC, the head of the World Trade Organisation, Pascal Lamy said that negotiations taking place in Geneva were making progress.
target_text: 世界贸易组织负责人帕斯卡尔·拉米在接受美国全国广播公司财经频道采访时表示，日内瓦的谈判正在取得进展。

source_text: "There is a strong sense that it is a make-or-break moment."
target_text: “有一种强烈的感觉，那是一个成败的时刻。”

source_text: In the area of health, the final declaration also promised to share influenza samples and provide equitable access to vaccines.
target_text: 在健康领域，最终宣言还承诺分享流感样本并提供公平获得疫苗的机会。

source_text: Despite interest from India and Pakistan in joining the group, it was announced that additional members will be considered in 2010.
target_text: 尽管印度和巴基斯坦有兴趣加入该集团，但宣布将在2010年考虑增加其他成员。

source_text: The final declaration also reaffirmed the Sydney Declaration on climate change, which had been agreed upon on Saturday.
target_text: 最后宣言还重申了星期六商定的关于气候变化的悉尼宣言。

source_text: A suicide bomber killed at least one person and injured five at a police checkpoint in southern Russia on Friday, national news agencies reported.
target_text: 据国家新闻机构报道，一名自杀式炸弹袭击者星期五在俄罗斯南部的一个警察检查站造成至少一人死亡，五人受伤。

source_text: The explosion occurred in Nazran, the main city in the region of Ingushetia.
target_text: 爆炸发生在印古什地区的主要城市纳兹兰。

source_text: Spokesman Kaloi Akhiltov said to the Associated Press news agency that a van packed with explosive material drove into the traffic checkpoint.
target_text: 发言人卡洛伊·阿赫洛托夫向美联社通讯社说，一辆装有爆炸物的货车驶入交通检查站。

source_text: According to government-controlled RIA news agency, the single casualty from the blast was a civilian.
target_text: 据政府控制的RIA通讯社称，唯一一名因意外事故而遇难的是一个平民。

source_text: The attack has been blamed by regional authorities on Islamist separatist rebels.
target_text: 地方当局指责伊斯兰分裂主义叛乱分子的袭击行为。

source_text: The Caucasus region of Russia has seen an increase in attacks recently, following a few years of relative calm after two wars with separatists in the neigbouring region of Chechnya.
target_text: 俄罗斯高加索地区最近的袭击事件有所增加，此前在车臣邻近地区发生两场与分离主义分子的战争后，经历了几年的相对平静。

source_text: NASA has held a memorial ceremony to mark the fifth anniversary of the Space Shuttle Columbia disaster.
target_text: 美国宇航局举行纪念哥伦比亚号航天飞机遇难五周年纪念仪式。

source_text: All seven astronauts were killed when their spacecraft broke up on re-entry over Texas on February 1, 2003, 16 minutes prior to scheduled landing time at Florida.
target_text: 2003年2月1日，在佛罗里达州的预定着陆时间前16分钟，七名宇航员在他们的宇宙飞船重新进入德克萨斯州时全部遇难。

source_text: Columbia had been damaged by a chunk of loose foam during takeoff 16 days earlier.
target_text: 16天前哥伦比亚号起飞后，被一大块松散的泡沫材料损坏。

source_text: NASA officials, astronauts, schoolchildren and family members attended the ceremony, which was held just miles from Columbias intended landing site.
target_text: 美国宇航局官员、宇航员、学龄儿童和家人参加了仪式，该仪式距离哥伦比亚预定的着陆点只有几英里距离。

source_text: Approximately 200 people attended the event, held at the Kennedy Space Center's Space Mirror Memorial to all 24 astronauts killed in space disasters.
target_text: 大约有200人参加了在肯尼迪航天中心的太空镜像纪念馆举行的活动，来纪念在空间灾难中遇难的所有24名宇航员。

source_text: Each was presented with a rose, which was placed in front of a granite memorial bearing the names of the 24.
target_text: 每人手中都有一朵玫瑰，这朵玫瑰被放在了一个面刻着24个人的名字的花岗岩纪念碑的前面。

source_text: Evelyn Husband-Thompson, widow of commander Rick, who has remarried just three weeks ago, said "This morning, I couldn't stop thinking about Rick and Willie and Kalpana and Dave and Mike and Laurel and Ilan."
target_text: 伊夫林·赫斯本德·汤普森，里克指挥官的遗孀，三周前刚刚再婚，她说，“今天早上，我一直在想里克、威利、卡尔帕纳、戴夫、迈克，劳雷尔和利安。”

source_text: All of our families went through so much that day.
target_text: 那天我们所有的家庭经历了这么多。

source_text: "We so miss them, and we will never forget them."
target_text: “我们很想念他们，我们永远不会忘记他们。”

source_text: 44 teenagers from Israel were amongst those present, there in respect to astronaut Ilan Ramon.
target_text: 来自以色列的44名青少年在场，其中有宇航员伊兰·拉蒙。

source_text: G. Madhavan Nair represented India at the memorial, remembering Indian astronaut Kalpana Chawla.
target_text: G·马达万·奈尔代表印度参加纪念活动，记念印度宇航员卡帕娜·乔拉。

source_text: Former shuttle commander Bill Readdy commented that, despite a large number of memorials, including one on Mars, "... much more importantly than any physical monument, they're memorialized right here in our hearts," Going on to name them individually, then saying "We'll always miss your easy laughter and your smiling faces."
target_text: 前航天飞机指挥官比尔·雷迪评论说，“尽管有大量的纪念物，包括在火星上的纪念物，……比任何有形的纪念碑更重要的是，它们就在我们心中被铭记”，他念着他们每个人的名字并且继续说，“我们将永远怀念你们轻松的笑声和微笑的面庞”。

source_text: God willing, five years from now, they'll have even more to be proud of us about as we take even longer strides ... back to the moon and onward toward Mars.
target_text: 愿上帝保佑，五年后，当我们迈出更大的步伐时，他们会更加为我们感到骄傲……回到月球，向火星前进。

source_text: He proceeded to read a letter from United States President George W. Bush praising the astronauts, which was then presented to Husband-Thompson.
target_text: 他继续阅读美国总统乔治·W·布什的一封信，称赞宇航员，然后提交给赫斯本德·汤普森。

source_text: "Space exploration is a dream deeply rooted in humanity, and the seven brave astronauts of Columbia sacrificed their lives so the rest of mankind could realize that dream," said Bush's letter.
target_text: 布什的信中说，“太空探索是一个深深扎根于人类的梦想，哥伦比亚的七位勇敢的宇航员为了这一梦想牺牲了自己的生命，所以其余的人才有可能实现这一梦想。”

source_text: "They assumed great risk so they could understand what lies beyond the heavens."
target_text: “他们冒了很大的风险，所以他们可以理解天堂以外的东西。”

source_text: "We are grateful for their service and they will be always be cherished."
target_text: “我们感谢他们的功绩，他们将永远被我们珍惜。”

source_text: The 41st anniversary of the Apollo 1 fire was on Sunday, and Monday saw the 22nd anniversary of the Challenger disaster.
target_text: 阿波罗1号火灾发生41周年纪念日是星期天，周一是挑战者灾难发生22周年。

source_text: "The Stockholm district court has today found guilty the four individuals that were charged with accessory to breaching copyright laws."
target_text: “斯德哥尔摩地区法院今天判定四名被控违反版权法的人有罪”。

source_text: "The court has sentenced each of them to one year in prison," said a statement released by the court.
target_text: 法院发布的一份声明说，“法院判处他们每人入狱一年”。

source_text: "Stay calm -- Nothing will happen to TPB, us personally or file sharing whatsoever."
target_text: “保持冷静-TPB、我们个人或任何文件共享都不会发生任何事情”。

source_text: "This is just a theater for the media," said a spokesman for TPB.
target_text: TPB系统的发言人表示，“这只是媒体的影院”。

source_text: The spokesman also added that TPB "cannot and will not" pay the damages.
target_text: 发言人亦补充说，TPB系统“不能也不会”支付赔偿金。

source_text: The trial lasted two weeks, and ended on March 2.
target_text: 审判持续了两周，并于3月2日结束。

source_text: The lawsuit was filed on behalf of Sony Music Entertainment, Warner Bros. and Columbia Pictures among others.
target_text: 该诉讼是代表索尼音乐娱乐公司、华纳兄弟公司和哥伦比亚电影公司等提起的。

source_text: Investigators say at least 33 specific films and songs posted on TPB were tracked by authorities.
target_text: 调查人员说，当局至少追踪了在TPB上发布的33部具体电影和歌曲。

source_text: Microsoft has reported a profit increase of 60%, attributed to the widespread success of its new operating system, Windows 7, the fastest-selling operating system ever.
target_text: 微软报告利润增长了60％，这归功于其新操作系统Windows7的广泛成功，Windows7是有史以来销售最快的操作系统。

source_text: Net profit for the last three months of last year is $6.66bn, compared to $4.18bn for the last three months of 2008.
target_text: 去年最后三个月的净利润为66.6亿美元，而2008年最后三个月的净利润为41.8亿美元。

source_text: The software giant released Windows 7 in October 2009, and, since then, profits from Microsoft's client division, who makes Windows 7, has surged to 70%.
target_text: 这家软件巨头于2009年10月发布了Windows7，从那时起，制造Windows7的微软客户部门的利润飙升至70％。

source_text: "Exceptional demand for Windows 7 led to the positive top-line growth for the company", said Peter Klein, CFO of Microsoft.
target_text: 微软首席财务官彼得克莱恩表示，“对Windows7的特殊需求导致了该公司的积极营收增长”。

source_text: Chief Operating Officer of Microsoft, Kevin Turner, attributed the growth to the consumer and business-sector reception of the new operating system, which, after its October 22 launch, had 234% more sales than Vista did when it was released.
target_text: 微软首席运营官凯文·特纳将这一增长归功于消费者和商业部门对新操作系统的接受。该操作系统在10月22日推出后，销售额比Vista发布时的销售量高出234％。

source_text: 38 people were said to have died in a suicide bombing during a political rally in the North-West Frontier Province of Pakistan.
target_text: 据说在巴基斯坦西北边境省的一次政治集会中，有38人死于自杀性爆炸事件。

source_text: The attack occurred in the town of Timergarah in north east Pakistan.
target_text: 袭击事件发生在巴基斯坦东北部的蒂马格拉镇。

source_text: The incident occurred during a political rally by the leading local party.
target_text: 事件发生在当地主要政党的政治集会期间。

source_text: The attacker detonated a bomb, thereby blowing himself in Timargarah, 80 km (50 miles) northeast of the provincial capital, Peshawar, the principal town in the Lower Dir district.
target_text: 袭击者引爆了一枚炸弹，在位于下德尔地区主要城镇白沙瓦东北80公里（50英里）的蒂马格拉自杀。

source_text: According to residents, the bomb exploded near the stage built for the organized celebrations.
target_text: 根据居民的说法，炸弹在为有组织的庆祝活动建造的舞台附近爆炸。

source_text: "We have received 38 dead bodies," Doctor Wakeel Ahmed, head of the principal hospital in the town told AFP (Agence France-Presse) news agency.
target_text: “我们收到了38具尸体，”该镇主要医院负责人瓦克尔·艾哈迈德告诉法新社记者。

source_text: The Awami National Party (ANP), the predominant political party in North West Frontier Province had organized the celebrations because of their decision to rename the province to Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa.
target_text: 作为西北边境省主要政党的人民民族党组织了庆祝活动，因为他们决定将该省改名为开伯尔·普赫图赫瓦省。

source_text: "Our party had arranged a thanksgiving day to celebrate the changing of the name after 200 years of colonial legacy," he said to a private news agency.
target_text: 他对一家私人新闻机构说：“我们党已经安排了一个感恩节来庆祝这个名字在200年殖民遗产之后的更名”。

source_text: According to Haji Mohammad Adeel of ANP, the Talibans had "lost the battle" and were executing such "cowardly" attacks "out of desperation."
target_text: 根据人民民族党的哈吉·穆罕默德·阿德尔的说法，塔利班人“失去了战斗”并且正在“绝望地”执行这种“懦弱”的攻击。

source_text: This attack was followed by a triple attack in Peshawar by suspected Islamist insurgents.
target_text: 此次袭击之后，又在白沙瓦发生三次袭击，袭击怀疑是伊斯兰叛乱分子的所为。

source_text: On October 14, 2008, Canadians will be heading to the polls for the federal election.
target_text: 2008年10月14日，加拿大人将前往联邦选举投票。

source_text: Libertarian Party candidate Kevin Stricker is standing for election in the riding of Saskatoon—Rosetown—Biggar.
target_text: 自由党候选人凯文·斯特里克正在参加萨斯卡通-罗塞敦-比格尔的选举。

source_text: Born in Saskatoon, he graduated from the University of Saskatchewan in 2003, with a B.Sc. with Great Distinction in Computer Science; he received a University Medal in Science.
target_text: 他出生于萨斯卡通，2003年毕业于萨斯喀彻温大学，获得理学学士学位。在计算机科学中表现卓越，他获得了大学科学奖章。

source_text: Having worked for several area businesses, this is his first political run.
target_text: 曾为多个地区企业工作，这是他的第一次政治竞选。

source_text: A longtime member of Fair Vote Canada, he currently serves on the Libertarian Party's ethics committee.
target_text: 他是加拿大公平选举组织的长期成员，目前在自由党的道德委员会任职。

source_text: Wikinews contacted Kevin, to talk about the issues facing Canadians, and what they and their party would do to address them.
target_text: 维基新闻与凯文联系，讨论加拿大人面临的问题，以及他们和他们的政党将如何解决这些问题。

source_text: The riding includes southwest Saskatoon and area, including rural areas Biggar, Rosetown and Delisle.
target_text: 选区包括西南萨斯卡通和地区，包括大玫瑰城和德利斯勒等乡村地区。

source_text: First elected in 2000, Conservative MP Carol Skelton announced she would not be seeking re-election, and was shuffled out of her Minister of National Revenue and Minister of Western Economic Diversification cabinet posts.
target_text: 保守党议员卡罗尔·斯凯尔顿于2000年首次当选，她宣布不会寻求连任，并被免除了国民收入部长和西部经济多样化部长的内阁职务。

source_text: Winning the Conservative nomination in the riding is acclaimed Mayor of Waldheim Kelly Block, who is joined by Stricker, Amber Jones (Green), Roy Bluehorn (Liberal), Nettie Wiebe (NDP), Marcel Leon Bourassa (Christian Heritage), and independent Rick Barsky.
target_text: 在该选区中赢得保守党提名的是著名的瓦尔德海姆·凯利街区市长、被斯特里克、琥珀琼斯（格林）、罗伊·兰霍恩（自由党）、奈蒂·威贝（新民主党）、马塞尔·莱昂布拉沙（基督徒遗产党）和独立党里克·巴斯基支持。

source_text: For more information, visit the campaign's official website, listed below.
target_text: 有关更多信息，请访问以下活动的官方网站。

source_text: Protesters gathered in Amsterdam, Maastricht, and several other cities in The Netherlands to protest a visit by the United States President, George W. Bush.
target_text: 抗议者抗议美国总统乔治·W·布什的访问，他们聚集在阿姆斯特丹、马斯特里赫特和荷兰的其他几个城市。

source_text: As many as 2,000 people gathered in Amsterdam's Museum Square, voicing their discontent with the war in Iraq.
target_text: 多达2000人聚集在阿姆斯特丹博物馆广场，表达他们对伊拉克战争的不满。

source_text: Many protesters consider Bush personally responsible for the torture in Abu Ghraib prison and human rights violations in Guantanamo Bay.
target_text: 许多抗议者认为布什个人应该对阿布格莱布监狱的酷刑和关塔那摩湾的侵犯人权行为负有责任。

source_text: Mann, along with several dozen other suspected plotters, was arrested five years ago on charges of trying to start a coup to overthrow president Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo.
target_text: 五年前，曼恩和其他数十名可疑的密谋者因试图发动政变推翻总统特奥多罗·奥比昂·恩圭马·姆巴索戈而被捕。

source_text: Their plans were foiled, however, and Mann was arrested after arriving in Zimbabwe to purchase firearms and grenades.
target_text: 然而，他们的计划遭到挫败，曼恩在抵达津巴布韦购买枪支和手榴弹后被捕。

source_text: The conspirators had planned to install exiled opposition leader Severo Moto as president and to gain control over the country's vast oil supplies.
target_text: 这些阴谋者计划安排流亡的反对党领袖塞韦罗·莫托担任总统，并获得该国庞大的石油供应权。

source_text: The government said that the decision was made on compassionate grounds, seeing as Mann, aged 57, was reportedly not in good health.
target_text: 政府表示，该决定是出于同情的理由，因为据报道，57岁的曼恩身体状况不佳。

source_text: It stated that Mann had "shown sufficient and credible signs of repentance and a desire to take his place in society."
target_text: 它表示，曼恩“已经表现出足够和可靠的悔改迹象，并希望在社会中占据一席之地。”

source_text: Amnesty was also given to four other co-conspirators, among them Nick Du Toit, from South Africa.
target_text: 此外，还向其他四名同谋提供了大赦，其中包括来自南非的尼克·杜·托特。

source_text: Mann was arrested along with 63 others in 2004 when his plane landed in Zimbabwe allegedly to collect arms bought from the country's state arms manufacturer.
target_text: 2004年，当他的飞机降落在津巴布韦时，曼恩与其他63人一起被捕，据称是为了收集从该国国家军火制造商购买的武器。

source_text: After admitting to price fixing on cargo services between Japan and the United States, Japan Airlines (JAL) has been fined US$110 million by the United States Department of Justice.
target_text: 日本航空公司（JAL）承认日本和美国之间的货运服务存在定价问题后，被美国司法部罚款1.1亿美元。

source_text: Prosecutors allege JAL earned $2 billion illegally between 2000 and 2006, although it is possible the scheme was operating as early as 1995.
target_text: 检察官称，日本航空公司在2000年至2006年期间非法赚取了20亿美元，尽管该计划最早可能在1995年开始运作。

source_text: British Airways, Korean Air and Qantas all previously admitted being involved and paid fines.
