target_text: 英国航空公司、大韩航空公司和澳洲航空公司此前都承认参与并支付了罚款。

source_text: The cartel, which created artificially high prices by eliminating competition between its members, was exposed by whistleblower Lufthansa, who alerted authorities in exchange for immunity to prosecution.
target_text: 该卡特尔通过消除成员之间的竞争而人为地抬高了价格，而告密者汉莎航空则曝光了这一点，汉莎航空向当局发出了警告，以换取免于起诉。

source_text: Japan will not take any further action against the carrier.
target_text: 日本不会对承运人采取任何进一步行动。

source_text: The investigation was performed by two US groups, the FBI and the Department of Justice.
target_text: 调查由美国联邦调查局和美国司法部两个团体进行。

source_text: Witnesses heard gunshots in a Wal-Mart parking lot in Cedar Park, Texas, near Highway 183, on Sunday morning.
target_text: 周日早晨，目击者在德克萨斯州锡达公园的一个沃尔玛停车场听到了枪声，该停车场靠近183号高速公路。

source_text: Four, including the gunman who had facial wounds unrelated to the shooting, are being treated for injuries after the incident.
target_text: 事件发生后，有四人，其中包括与枪击无关的面部受伤的枪手，正在接受治疗。

source_text: The Cedar Park Wal-Mart was closed down briefly on Sunday morning; however, no staff or customers were injured.
target_text: 雪松公园沃尔玛在周日早上短暂关闭，所幸的是，没有员工或客户受伤。

source_text: Police have released the names of the victims, eighteen-year-old Cody McGrath, nineteen-year-old Shayne Davis, nineteen-year-old Zacharia Gietl and 22-year-old Leland McGlocklin.
target_text: 警方公布了受害者的姓名，十八岁的科迪·麦格拉思，十九岁的肖恩·戴维斯，十九岁的扎卡赖亚·斯托和22岁的利兰·麦格洛克林。

source_text: As-of Monday, Gietl has been released from hospital whilst the others remain in critical, but stable, condition.
target_text: 截至周一，斯托已经从医院出院，而其他人仍处于危急但稳定的状态。

source_text: Police informed media the incident occurred follwing a dispute which began at a nearby party where alcohol was being served.
target_text: 警方通知媒体，这起事件发生在一场纠纷之后，这场纠纷始于附近一个提供酒类服务的酒吧。

source_text: After moving the fight to the parking lot, Onwukaife is alleged to have shot the four victims.
target_text: 在将战斗转移到停车场之后，翁乌凯夫被指控射杀了四名受害者。

source_text: Onwukaife was expected to be released on Monday, after which he would immediately be jailed.
target_text: 预计翁乌凯夫将于周一获释，之后他将立即被判入狱。

source_text: Police advised media the investigation is on-going and more charges may still be filed.
target_text: 警方告知媒体调查正在进行中，仍可能提出更多指控。

source_text: Specifically, Police are trying to determine if any other participants in the fight were armed.
target_text: 具体来说，警方正在试图确定是否有其他参战者携带武器。

source_text: The murder rate in Ciudad Juarez, Mexico has become the highest in the world.
target_text: 墨西哥华雷斯城已成为世界上谋杀率最高的城市。

source_text: There were an average of seven killings every day for the past twelve months in the city, which is currently in the midst of a clash between two powerful drug cartels.
target_text: 在过去的12个月中，该市每天平均有7起杀人事件，目前正在两个强大的贩毒集团之间发生冲突。

source_text: The majority of the 1,986 murders this year remain unsolved, and most involve drug gang members who have come from elsewhere to fight for control of the drug smuggling route into neighbouring El Paso, Texas, as well as the lucrative local trade in drugs.
target_text: 这一年的1,986名凶手中的大部分至今仍未解决，其中大多数涉及来自其他地方的贩毒团伙成员，他们为了控制进入德克萨斯州埃尔帕索的毒品走私路线，以及利润丰厚的当地毒品贸易而斗争。

source_text: There is a jump of 815 murders from last year.
target_text: 自去年起猛增了815起谋杀案。

source_text: One man was tethered between two trucks and ripped apart; others have been decapitated or dismembered.
target_text: 一名男子被拴在两辆卡车之间，被撕开；其他人被斩首或肢解。

source_text: The violence results from a turf war between rivals Juarez cartel and Sinaloa cartel, the latter being run by the most wanted man in the country, Joaquin "El Chapo" Guzman.
target_text: 暴力事件是由竞争对手华雷斯卡特尔和锡那罗亚卡特尔之间的地盘战争造成的，后者由该国紧急通缉的人古兹曼经营。

source_text: In late 2006 authorities launched a crackdown on Mexican drugs cartels, with Ciudad Juarez receiving 45,000 troops during that time.
target_text: 2006年底，当局对墨西哥毒品卡特尔进行了镇压，在这期间，45,000名士兵来到华雷斯。

source_text: This year Israel turns sixty and it has embarked upon a campaign to celebrate its birthday.
target_text: 今年以色列已经60周年了，它开始了一场庆祝生日的运动。

source_text: Along with technology writers for Slate, PC Magazine, USA Today, BusinessWeek, Aviation Weekly, Wikinews was invited by the America-Israel Friendship League and the Israeli Foreign Ministry to review Israel’s technology sector.
target_text: 除了为《Slate》、《PC杂志》、《今日美国》、《商业周刊》、《航空周刊》撰写技术文章外，维基新闻还受美国-以色列友谊联盟和以色列外交部的邀请，对以色列的技术部门进行了审查。

source_text: It's part of an effort to 're-brand the country' to show America that there is more to Israel than the Palestinian conflict.
target_text: 这是“重塑国家品牌”努力的一部分，目的是向美国表明，以色列比巴勒斯坦冲突更有意义。

source_text: On this trip we saw the people who gave us the Pentium processor and Instant Messaging.
target_text: 在这次旅行中，我们看到了那些给我们奔腾处理器和即时消息的人。

source_text: The schedule was hectic: 12-14 hours a day were spent doing everything from trips to the Weizmann Institute to dinner with Yossi Vardi.
target_text: 行程非常繁忙：每天12-14小时的时间都花在从魏茨曼研究所的旅行到瓦尔迪的晚餐上。

source_text: On Thursday, the fifth day of the junket, David Saranga of the foreign ministry was able to arrange an exclusive interview for David Shankbone with the President of Israel, Nobel Peace Prize recipient Shimon Peres.
target_text: 星期四，即野餐的第五天，外交部的大卫·萨兰加能够与以色列总统，诺贝尔和平奖获得者西蒙佩雷斯一起接受大卫·尚克伯恩的专访。

source_text: For over an hour they spoke about Iranian politics, whether Israel is in danger of being side-lined in Middle Eastern importance because of Arab oil wealth, and his thoughts against those who say Israeli culture is in a state of decay.
target_text: 在一个多小时的时间里，他们谈到了伊朗的政治，以色列是否有因阿拉伯石油财富而处于中东的重要地位上被边缘化的危险，以及他对那些认为以色列文化处于腐朽状态的人的想法。

source_text: Shimon Peres spent his early days on kibbutz, a bygone socialist era of Israel.
target_text: 西蒙佩雷斯早年曾在以色列基布兹的社会主义时代度过。

source_text: In 1953, at the age of 29, Peres became the youngest ever Director General of the Ministry of Defense.
target_text: 1953年，佩雷斯年仅29岁，成为国防部有史以来最年轻的总干事。

source_text: It was still official Israeli policy to not speak with the PLO.
target_text: 以色列的官方政策仍然是不与巴解组织谈判。

source_text: Peres shares a Nobel Peace Prize with Yitzak Rabin and Arafat for orchestrating what eventually became the Oslo Accords.
target_text: 佩雷斯与伊扎克·拉宾和阿拉法特分享诺贝尔和平奖，因为他们策划了最终成为奥斯陆协议的协议。

source_text: The "roadmap" that came out of Oslo remains the official Israeli (and American) policy for peace in the Palestinian conflict.
target_text: 奥斯陆出台的“路线图”仍然是以色列（和美国）在巴勒斯坦冲突中实现和平的官方政策。

source_text: Although the majority of Israeli people supported the plans, land for peace was met with a small but fiery resistance in Israel.
target_text: 虽然大多数以色列人支持这些计划，但是“土地换和平”计划在以色列遭到了小规模但激烈的抵抗。

source_text: For negotiating with Arafat, former Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu shouted at Peres, "You are worse than Chamberlain!" a reference to Hitler's British appeaser.
target_text: 为了与阿拉法特谈判，前总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡对佩雷斯大喊大叫：“你比张伯伦还坏！”

source_text: It was during this time of heated exchanges in the 1990s that Yitzhak Rabin was assassinated by Yigal Amir, a Jew who thought it against Halakhic law to give up land given by God (Hashem).
target_text: 正是在20世纪90年代这段激烈的交流时期，伊扎克·拉宾被一个犹太人伊加尔·阿米尔暗杀，他认为放弃上帝赐予的土地是违反哈拉赫法律的。

source_text: Peres is the elder statesman of Israeli politics, but he remembers that he has not always been as popular as he is today.
target_text: 佩雷斯是以色列政治的老政治家，但他记得当时他并不像现在这样受欢迎。

source_text: "Popularity is like perfume: nice to smell, dangerous to drink," said Peres.
target_text: 佩雷斯说，“流行就像香水：闻起来很好，喝起来很危险。”

source_text: The search for popularity, he goes on to say, will kill a person who has an idea against the status quo.
target_text: 寻求受欢迎程度，他接着说，将会杀死一个有反对现状想法的人。

source_text: Below is David Shankbone's interview with Shimon Peres, the President of Israel.
target_text: 以下是大卫·山克本对以色列总统西蒙佩雷斯的采访。

source_text: OpenOffice.org today released version 2.0 of their free software office suite.
target_text: OpenOffice.org今天发布了其免费办公室软件套件的2.0版本。

source_text: This release marks over three years of continuous development and boasts many features over version 1.0 which was released in May 2002.
target_text: 此版本的发布标志着OpenOffice.org三年多的持续发展，它比2002年发布的1.0版本增加了很多功能。

source_text: The latest release may be downloaded from the OpenOffice.org web site free of charge.
target_text: 最新版本可以在OpenOffice.org网站上免费下载。

source_text: Site administrators from OpenOffice.org say the suite has been downloaded an average of over 400,000 times per week from the official site alone.
target_text: 据网站管理员称，该套件平均每周仅在官网上被下载的次数就已超过40万次。

source_text: When taking into account that the suite is freely redistributable, and that it is distributed with many versions of GNU/Linux, the total number of copies in distribution is larger still.
target_text: 另外，该套件可以免费重复发布，而且还与GNU/Linux的很多版本一同发布，如果把这些也考虑在内，该套件的总发布次数会更多。

source_text: One of the reasons for its significant popularity is the inclusion of several features not found in competing office suites, including in-built export to the PDF format and compatibility with Windows, Linux and Mac OS X operating systems.
target_text: 该套件如此受欢迎的原因之一是它包含了几个在同类办公套件中所没有的功能，包括内置的PDF格式导出功能，以及与Windows、Linux和MAC OSX运行系统的可兼容性。

source_text: Distributed under the terms of the GNU Lesser General Public License, the OpenOffice.org office suite can be run, studied, modified, and redistributed by anybody that receives a copy.
target_text: OpenOffice.org办公套件是根据GNU宽通用公共许可证发布的，它可以由任何接收到副本的人运行、研究、修改并重新发布。

source_text: This means that any person, group, or company can publish an alternative version - which makes problems such as vendor lock-in impossible.
target_text: 这就意味着任何个人、团体或公司都可以发布替代版本，这样就避免了供应商锁定等问题。

source_text: It also guarantees that the development will roughly follow with the wants of the userbase - instead of just the business model of one company.
target_text: 而且还确保会大体按照用户的需求开发软件，而不是只适用于某个公司的商业模式。

source_text: A lot of work has gone into making this release more visually compatible with the look of Microsoft Office on computers running Windows XP, however, some users were not happy with the effects these changes had on the look of OpenOffice.org when using a dark theme (colour settings).
target_text: OpenOffice.org做了大量的工作，使此次发布的版本可与运行WindowXP系统的电脑的Microsoft Office更好的兼容，但是，一些用户对使用暗色主题（颜色设置）时，这些改动对OpenOffice.org的外观产生的影响表示不满意。

source_text: An angry Judge Rodney S. Melville threatened to issue a bench warrant for the arrest of world famous pop singer Michael Jackson if he failed to appear at the Santa Barbara County Superior Court in California Thursday Jan. 10, 2005.
target_text: 愤怒的法官罗德尼S·梅尔维尔扬言，如果世界著名流行歌手迈克尔·杰克逊2005年1月10日星期四不出现在加利福尼亚圣巴巴拉县高级法院，他就会签发法院拘票，逮捕迈克尔·杰克逊。

source_text: Jackson is under indictment there on seven counts of lewd and lascivious acts on a child under 14, and two counts of administering an intoxicating agent.
target_text: 杰克逊因7次猥亵14岁以下儿童，两次使用致醉剂而被起诉。

source_text: Jackson, held briefly under the threat of jail by authorities on Nov. 20, 2003 when charges brought against him were formalized, gained his freedom later that day by posting a $3 million bail.
target_text: 杰克逊于2003年11月20日被正式指控，受到官方将他判决入狱的威胁，在支付了三百万美金的保释金后于当天晚些时候获得释放。

source_text: Judge Melville, apparently frustrated with Jackson who had in two earlier instances caused delays in his court room, issued the warrant just 5 minutes after noting the singer’s conspicuous absence at the scheduled 8:30 a.m. proceedings.
target_text: 梅尔维尔法官显然对杰克逊之前有两次导致开庭延迟的行为非常不满，所以当他发现这位歌手缺席定于上午8：30进行的诉讼程序，仅5分钟后就签发了拘票。

source_text: Jackson's defense lawyer, Tom Mersereau Jr., advised the judge that Jackson awoke earlier that morning with severe back pain and was under treatment at an area hospital at the time.
target_text: 杰克逊的辩护律师汤姆·默塞尤通知法官，杰克逊当天早上因严重背痛很早就起床了，当时正在区医院进行治疗。

source_text: The judge moved to give the celebrity one hour to appear or face arrest for contempt of court.
target_text: 法官决定给这位名人一个小时的时间必须出现，否则就会因藐视法庭而被拘捕。

source_text: During the countdown, live televised reports recounted how Jackson had arrived for court 20 minutes late on his own arraignment for these charges, only to be met by a stern lecture from Judge Melville for that transgression.
target_text: 在倒计时的过程中，电视直播报道再次讲述了杰克逊是如何为了迎合梅尔维尔法官的严苛警告在收到对其指控的传讯后到达法庭应诉时迟到20分钟的。

source_text: There was also another occasion where Jackson, while recovering from flu symptoms, delayed the trial's jury selection for a week until he was well enough to return.
target_text: 还有一次，杰克逊因患流感，导致法庭的陪审团遴选推迟了一个星期，一直等到他痊愈。

source_text: The glaringly clear message sent by the judge was: bad back or not, Jackson was to appear in court! And fast! Only the televised scene of Jackson's expectant defense lawyer Mersereau with his assistant Susan Yu, both busy on cells phones while tensely waiting curbside beside the court house for the Jackson motorcade, seemed to undermine a feeling that Jackson would make it in time to avoid having his bail revoked.
target_text: 法官传达的明确信息是：无论是否有背痛，杰克逊必须出庭！而且要快！在电视直播现场，杰克逊的候选辩护律师默塞尤和他的助理苏珊·于在法庭旁边的街道上紧张等待的时候都在忙着打电话，这似乎让人感觉杰克逊不会为了避免其保释被撤销而及时到庭。

source_text: As the deadline came and passed without Jackson’s arrival, live reports were busy with speculation on the superstar persona of Michael Jackson then taking on newer aspects of super-bizarre.
target_text: 截止时间已过，杰克逊仍然没有到庭，现场报道都忙于报导对迈克尔·杰克逊明星形象的猜测，然后会新表现的超级古怪的一面。

source_text: But Jackson’s flair for tardiness showed itself with an arrival that was a mere 3 minutes after the judge was being forced to make good on his threat.
target_text: 但是杰克逊在法官被迫兑现他的威胁言论之后仅3分钟就到达了法庭，充分表现出了他爱迟到的天性。

source_text: Dressed in a blue blazer over a light weight undershirt, the star's recent departure from the hospital was evident by the pajama bottom pants and open-heeled bedroom slippers he wore into the court room.
target_text: 他穿着一件蓝色的运动上衣，里面是一件薄汗衫，从他进入法庭时穿着的睡衣下裤和开跟居家拖鞋，可以明显看出，这位明星刚从医院出来。

source_text: Jackson had the assistance of his father and a body guard at each side to keep him steady as he gingerly walked into the Santa Maria court house.
target_text: 杰克逊由其父亲和一位保镖在其两侧搀扶，小心翼翼地进入圣玛利亚法院。

source_text: He listed slightly to the right and kept a fixed, distant face that was surrounded by uncombed strands of his long hair.
target_text: 他微微向右倾斜，面部表情呆滞，脸被篷乱的长头发所遮盖。

source_text: The summons issued by the judge forced Jackson from his hospital bed to show the world he was not above the law.
target_text: 法官的传唤迫使杰克逊离开医院的病床，来向世界证明他没有凌驾于法律之上。

source_text: In private chambers, Judge Melville met with both the prosecution lawyer, Tom Sneddon, and Jackson’s defense lawyer to verify the defendant’s claims of back pain.
target_text: 梅尔维尔法官在私人房间会见了控方律师汤姆·斯奈登和杰克逊的辩护律师，以证实被告人背痛的说辞。

source_text: After re-taking the bench in the court room, the judge announced to the jury they would proceed with the docket as planned.
target_text: 重新回到法庭时，法官宣告陪审团按照原计划进行诉讼程序。

source_text: Mr. Jackson narrowly escaped prison, and the trial would continue where it left off on the previous day with direct testimony from the now 15 year old boy who accuses him.
target_text: 杰克逊先生勉强逃过牢狱之灾，根据控告他的那个15岁男孩的直接证据，审判在前一天暂停后继续进行。

source_text: Canadian Prime Minister Stephen Harper made a visit to Hamilton yesterday to watch the 2007 annual Tim Hortons Brier at the Copps Coliseum.
target_text: 加拿大总理史蒂芬·哈珀昨天到访汉密尔顿，观看在科普斯体育馆举行的2007年男子冰壶世锦赛选拔赛。

source_text: Harper, who is currently writing a book about the history of Hockey, admitted he's a curling fan.
target_text: 哈珀目前正在写一本关于曲棍球历史的书，他承认自己是一个冰壶迷。

source_text: He started to be a fan of curling in Winnipeg, Manitoba 10 years ago and said his father used to play it.
target_text: 他是10年前在马尼托巴省温尼伯的时候开始喜欢冰壶的，他说他的父亲以前玩过冰壶。

source_text: "I've never curled but my father did when I was very young," he said.
target_text: 他说：“我从来没有玩过冰壶，但是在我很小的时候，我父亲玩过冰壶。”

source_text: About the last decade or so I've made an effort to get to the Brier when I could.
target_text: 在过去的大约十年里，只要条件允许，我都会尽量来看选拔赛。

source_text: "I've obviously got a soft spot for Kevin Martin and Alberta because he's had such a great career," said Harper.
target_text: 哈珀说：“我非常喜欢凯文·马丁和亚伯达，因为他取得了辉煌的成就。”

source_text: "But what's so great about the Brier is whoever wins is not like your normal pro athlete."
target_text: “但是冰壶世锦赛选拔赛之所以如此有影响力，是因为取得比赛胜利的人都不是正规的职业运动员。”

source_text: She wore a large crown and was draped in gold.
target_text: 她戴着一个大皇冠，披着金色的披肩。

source_text: She got to meet the PM and was quoted saying: "Not a lot of people get to meet a prime minister."
target_text: 她要去见总理，有人引述她的话说：“没有多少人能有机会见到总理。”

source_text: Authorities have said that 48 whales near Christchurch, New Zealand were beached yesterday.
target_text: 据官方消息称，昨天新西兰克赖斯特彻奇附近有48头鲸鱼在海滩搁浅。

source_text: Fifteen of them died, although the other 33 were re-floated out to sea, according to a conservation official.
target_text: 据一位环保官员称，其中15头死亡，另外33头重新游回海里。

source_text: The pilot whales beached themselves at Port Levy on South Island, but dozens of volunteers helped to try and get them back out to the open water out of the inlet, which is muddy and shallow.
target_text: 巨头鲸搁浅在南岛的利维港，但是有很多志愿者试图帮助它们从泥泞的浅海水湾回到开放水域。

source_text: An alarm was called out at about 06.30 local time.
target_text: 警报大概于当地时间6.30发出。

source_text: This is the third mass stranding on the country's coast this summer; 125 pilot whales died in the two other beachings earlier, and another 43 were re-floated out to the ocean.
target_text: 这是今年夏天新西兰海岸上第三次大面积搁浅；在这之前的两次搁浅中有125头巨头鲸死亡，另外43头被重新送回海里。

source_text: "We thought everything was OK, we checked them in the boat and then we woke up this morning and saw a whole lot on the beach here."
target_text: “我们认为一切还好，我们在船上检查了那些鲸鱼，今天早上起床时，我们看到这里的海滩上有很多鲸鱼。”

source_text: "We really just stood with them and as the tide came in and started floating, we were just able to push them out and away they went," said a local, Ted Haowden, as quoted by United Press International.
target_text: 据美国合众国际新闻社报道，当地人特德・豪登说：“我们就站在鲸鱼的旁边，开始涨潮时，我们正好可以将它们推到海里。”

source_text: Locals are expected to bury the dead whales this afternoon.
target_text: 当地人将于今天下午将死亡的鲸鱼掩埋。

source_text: According to Campbell, autopsies will be performed on two of the fifteen dead whales.
target_text: 据坎贝尔称，将会从15头死亡的鲸鱼中选择两头进行尸检。

source_text: Whales are frequently stranded on the beaches of New Zealand each summer, as they travel en route from Antarctica to breeding grounds.
target_text: 每年夏天新西兰都会经常有鲸鱼在从南极洲往繁殖区迁徙的路途中搁浅在沙滩上。

source_text: A 55-year-old unidentified male died Saturday after his silver Peugeot motor vehicle collided with a red and white articulated truck and tanker on the A15 road.
target_text: 星期六，在A15公路上一名身份不明的55岁男性在其驾驶的银色标致汽车与一辆红白相间的铰接式卡车相撞后死亡。

source_text: According to the Humberside Police, the road traffic accident happened on the A15 near the small village of Hibaldstow, North Lincolnshire at approximately 0739 UTC on Saturday.
target_text: 据亨伯赛德郡警方消息称，此次交通事故于星期六UTC时间大约7：39发生在北林肯郡的小村庄希伯尔斯托附近的A15公路上。

source_text: Although the sole occupant of the Peugeot was fatally injured, the occupant of the lorry was uninjured.
target_text: 虽然标致车的唯一乘员受伤身亡，但是卡车的乘员没有受伤。

source_text: A spokesperson stated: "Officers would like to speak to anyone who witnessed the collision or the vehicles prior to the collision."
target_text: 据一位发言人称：“警官会与看到撞车事故或者在撞车前看到过肇事汽车的所有人谈话。”

source_text: An investigation has begun to try to establish whether the icy and snowy weather conditions were a factor in this collision.
target_text: 关于冰雪天气是否导致此次事故的原因之一的调查已经开始。

source_text: The police have commented that it is too early to know whether the weather conditions were a factor in this crash.
target_text: 据警方称，目前还不确定天气状况是否是导致此次撞车事故的原因之一。

source_text: Shinzo Abe took 66% of the vote in today's Liberal Democratic Party election for a leader to replace Junichiro Koizumi, whose term as party chief expired.
target_text: 安倍晋三在今天的自民党领导人选举中获得了百分之66的票数，此次选举的领导人将取代政党领袖任职期间已过的小泉纯一郎。

source_text: Abe is a third-generation politician related to two former Prime Ministers.
target_text: 安倍是继前两任首相之后的第三代政治家。

source_text: The election comes on the day before his 52nd birthday.
target_text: 选举在他52岁生日的前一天举行。

source_text: "The LDP has helped make Japan a democracy that has contributed to the world," Abe said after the vote.
target_text: 安倍在选举结束后说：“自民党使日本成为一个为世界做出贡献的民主国家。”

source_text: "I will demonstrate my leadership to preserve the flame of ideals, and put reforms forward as the first party leader from the postwar generation."
target_text: “我会像战后第一代政党领袖一样，通过保持追求理想的热情和推动改革来证明我的领导能力。”

source_text: A rather unimpressive Dublin side narrowly beat an even less impressive Westmeath side last night in front of a capacity (10,000) crowd at Dublin's Parnell Park to bag two points in the Allianz NFL Division 1A match.
target_text: 昨天晚上，都柏林的帕内尔公园座无虚席（1万人），在安联国家橄榄球联盟1A赛区的比赛中，成绩平平的都柏林队以微弱优势击败了稍显逊色的韦斯特米斯队，获得2分。

source_text: The first half included a succession of poor wides by Dublin's forwards, but Westmeath failed to capitalise on the mistakes of their opponents, finishing the half with just three points.
target_text: 在上半场比赛中，都柏林前锋连续出现边球失误，但是韦斯特米斯队并没有利用好对手的失误，仅以3分的成绩结束上半场比赛。

source_text: The second half was a slightly better contest with a sudden burst of energy by the Westmeath forwards producing several points to bring the game back to level pegging at 0-8 to 0-8.
target_text: 下半场比赛稍微精彩一些，韦斯特米斯队前锋突然发力，得了好几分，将比分恢复锁定在至0-8至0-8。

source_text: However with several chances squandered and consistently poor passing, Westmeath fell two points behind in the final few minutes of the game.
target_text: 但是，由于几次没有抓住得分机会，加上连续传球失误，韦斯特米斯队在比赛的最后几分钟比分落后了2分。

source_text: The European Union (EU) competitions commission has announced its decision to fine the Microsoft Corporation €899 million (US$1.35 billion), approximately 1/10th of the company's gross yearly earnings, for failing to comply with the 2004 antitrust order.
target_text: 因微软公司未遵守2004年反垄断令，欧盟竞争委员会公布了对其罚款8.99亿欧元（13.5亿美元）的决定，此金额大约是微软公司年度总收入的十分之一。

source_text: It is the highest ever fine charged by the EU (also being the largest fine of its kind ever imposed upon a company), and the first time that the EU has fined a company because of non-compliance with an antitrust decision.
target_text: 这是欧盟有史以来收取的最高额的罚款（也是对一个公司收取的同类罚款的最大数额），这也是欧盟第一次因为不遵守反垄断判决而对公司罚款。

source_text: The first decision in this antitrust case was given in 2004 citing that Microsoft withheld needed interoperability information from rival software companies which prevented them from making software compatible with Windows.
target_text: 此反垄断案的第一个判决是在2004年作出的，内容是微软没有给与其竞争的软件公司提供所需的互操作性，使他们无法制作与Windows兼容的软件。

source_text: Microsoft agreed to this, providing the information for royalty fees of 6.5% of the licensee's revenues for the product on grounds of innovation (specifically, 3.87% for the patent license and of 2.98% for the information license).
target_text: 微软同意此判决，提供了关于以新技术为基础的产品许可证收入的6.5%作为版权费的信息（具体为，专利许可证占3.87%，信息许可证占2.98%）。

source_text: The EU found these royalty fees unreasonable and Microsoft was ordered to lower them.
target_text: 欧盟认为版权费不合理，责令微软降低费用。

source_text: Microsoft complied with this, adjusting the royalty rates to 1.2% (changing the rates for the licenses to 0.7% and 0.5%, respectively) in the European Union, while keeping the rate the same for the rest of the world.
target_text: 微软按照要求，将欧盟内部的版权费调整至1.2%（两个许可证的费用分别调至0.7%和0.5%），但是对世界其他地区仍保持原来的费用标准。

source_text: The EU still saw this as an unreasonable rate, and Microsoft, two month after lowering the rates, reduced the rates yet again to a flat rate of €10000 or a royalty of 0.4% applicable worldwide.
target_text: 欧盟仍然认为此收费标准不合理，微软于降低版权费之后的两个月，再次降低收费标准，统一收取1万欧元或0.4%的版权费，此标准适用于世界各地。

source_text: Microsoft's royalty rates, which were deemed unreasonable for the period of 15 months between June 21, 2006 and October 21, 2007 are the cause for the fine.
target_text: 微软在2006年6月13日至2007年10月21日这15个月期间收取的版权费被认为不合理，是欧盟对其罚款的原因。

source_text: So far, the EU has fined Microsoft €1.68 billion in 3 separate fines in this case.
target_text: 到目前为止，欧盟已经在此案中分三次对微软进行罚款共计16.8亿欧元。

source_text: This fine will go towards the European Union annual budget.
target_text: 此罚款将计入欧盟的年度预算。

source_text: The European Anti-trust commissioner Neelie Kroes stated that the fine was "reasonable and proportionate", as the figure could have gone up as high as €1.5 billion, the maximum that the EU commission can impose.
target_text: 欧洲反垄断专员内莉・克勒斯称，此罚款是“合理而恰当的”，这个数字本来可以达到欧盟可以收取的最大金额15亿欧元。

source_text: She also said that it should act as "a signal to the outside world, and especially Microsoft, that they should stick to the rules" and that "Talk is cheap."
target_text: 她还说，此事应该作为“对外界的一个信号，特别是微软，应该遵守规则”，“空谈没有意义”。

source_text: Although she also expressed hope that "today's decision closes a dark chapter in Microsoft's record of non-compliance with the Commission".
target_text: 但是，她仍然希望“今天的判决能够结束微软不遵守欧盟规则的不光彩历史。”

source_text: There is no certainty whether Microsoft will appeal this decision, a Microsoft Spokesperson has stated that Microsoft will review this latest fine, citing that "The commission announced in October 2007 that Microsoft was in full compliance with the 2004 decision, so these fines are about the past issues that have been resolved."
target_text: 微软是否会对该判决提出上诉尚不能确定，一位微软的发言人称，微软会对最近的这次罚款进行复核，并提及“欧盟2007年10月公布微软完全按照2004年的判决执行，所以这些罚款是针对过去已经解决的问题的。”

source_text: Microsoft's General Counsel Brad Smith commented "It's clearly very important to us as a company that we comply with our obligations under European law."
target_text: 微软的法律顾问布拉德•史密斯称“作为一个公司，履行欧洲法律规定的义务对我们来说无疑是非常重要的。”

source_text: "We'll study this decision carefully, and if there are additional steps that we need to take in order to comply with it, we will take them."
target_text: “我们会认真研究此判决，如果需要我们采取进一步措施来执行判决，我们会照做。”

source_text: Microsoft had appealed to fines by the EU before, but all the charges were defeated.
target_text: 微软以前曾经对欧盟的罚款提出过上诉，但是全部败诉。

source_text: If Microsoft does not appeal the decision, the company will have 3 month (starting February 27th) to pay the fine in full.
target_text: 如果微软不提出上诉，将有3个月的时间（从2月27日开始）将全部罚款付清。

source_text: Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer stated that the company had news that the fine was pending.
target_text: 微软总裁史蒂夫·鲍尔默称，公司得到消息罚款仍悬而未决。

source_text: "We didn't know it was this week, but we knew it was coming at some point."
target_text: “我们不知道会在本周，但是知道肯定会在某个时间来决定。”

source_text: This may not be the end of Microsoft's troubles with the European Union yet, as the commission is currently investigating two other complaints about the company's anti-competition practices.
target_text: 此事或许并不能结束微软与欧盟之间的麻烦，因为欧盟目前正在调查另外两起关于微软公司反竞争行为的投诉。

source_text: The decisions came after Microsoft announced they were disclosing 30,000 pages of previously secret software code last Thursday (February 21st).
target_text: 判决是在微软宣布他们上周四（2月21日）公开了30,000页过去对外保密的软件代码之后作出的。

source_text: Microsoft shares slipped 12 cents to $28.26 on NASDAQ after news of the fine.
target_text: 罚款消息公布后，微软在纳斯达克的股票下滑12美分，跌至$28.26。

source_text: The National Cowboy & Western Heritage Museum exhibit, Prix de West, opened yesterday and will exhibit 313 paintings and sculptures by contemporary western artists from Oklahoma.
target_text: 国家牛仔与西部遗产博物馆主办的展会《西部大奖赛》于昨日开幕。这次活动将展出313件由俄克拉荷马州当代西部艺术家们完成的绘画与雕塑作品。

source_text: All exhibit pieces will remain on display until September 10 and will be available for sale at a fixed-price this weekend.
target_text: 所有的展品将于9月10日之前连续展出，并于本周末按固定的价格予以出售。

source_text: The total value of the works on display is approximately $4.1 million.
target_text: 全部展品的总价格大约为四百一十万美元。

source_text: Today, during the exhibition's banquet, the museum is to present Bob Kuhn with their lifetime achievement award.
target_text: 在展会于今日举办的宴会上，该博物馆将向鲍勃·库恩颁发终生成就奖。

source_text: Over 50 pieces of his work is being featured in a special exhibit at the museum.
target_text: 博物馆内专门为他的50件作品开辟了特别展区。

source_text: For more information, visit the National Cowboy & Western Heritage Museum website.
target_text: 若想得到更多信息，请访问国家牛仔与西部遗产博物馆的网站。

source_text: The Senate employment committee will hold an inquiry into the legislation.
target_text: 参院就业委员会将对该项立法展开调查。

source_text: According to Mr Andrews this inquiry will probably run for a week in the non-sitting period of parliament.
target_text: 据安德鲁斯先生说，调查可能会在议会休会期间持续一周时间。

source_text: He said the legislation would then be debated in the Senate in the last sitting weeks of the year.
target_text: 他说，然后这项立法将在参院今年的最后一个会议周内进行辩论。

source_text: The new workplace reforms have evoked widespread controversy from both sides of the political spectrum.
target_text: 这个新就业改革方案在政界双方都引起了广泛争议。

source_text: The Australian Council of Trade Unions launched TV advertisements to counter the government's new legislation.
target_text: 澳大利亚工会理事会发动了一场电视宣传攻势来反对政府的这项新立法。

source_text: The 100 million dollar 'Work Choices' advertisements by the Australian Government has been criticised as a political use of taxpayers dollars.
target_text: 由澳大利亚政府启动的，价值1亿美元的“择业”宣传活动遭到了批评，人们认为这是利用纳税人的钱为政治目的服务。

source_text: Prime Minister John Howard has contended that the new reforms are necessary to keep our economy competitive and update outdated laws.
target_text: 约翰·霍华德总理则声称，新的改革方案有利于保持经济竞争力和更新过时法律，因而是有必要的。

source_text: The opposition says a new class of working poor will be created in Australia under the planned IR changes.
target_text: 反对派说，这项计划中的劳资关系改革立法将在澳大利亚制造出一个新的穷忙族阶层。

source_text: One proposed change will deny Centrelink welfare payments to anyone who refuses a job, no matter what the conditions.
target_text: 建议中的一项改革措施是，福利署将拒绝向任何不愿意工作的人发放福利金，不论出于什么原因。

source_text: "For an individual the best form of welfare they can have is to have a job".
target_text: “对个人来说，最好的福利就是有一份工作”。

source_text: "What we will end up with is people being forced onto inferior wages, inferior conditions and the great risk is that we end up with a working poor just as you find in the United States,"
target_text: “其最后结果就是强迫人们接受低工资和恶劣的工作条件，而且其巨大的风险就是最后会形成一个穷忙族群体，就像在美国那样”。

source_text: Michael Raper, spokesperson for the National Welfare Rights Network says it is a severe penalty.
target_text: 国家福利权益网发言人迈克尔·雷帕说，这是一项严重的处罚。

source_text: "We've been trying to draw attention to the fact that any unemployed person will have to accept whatever conditions they're offered because if you reject a job offer you will lose Centrelink payments for eight weeks," he said.
target_text: 他说：“我们一直试图引起人们注意，失业人员将不得不接受任何工作条件，因为，一旦你拒绝接受一份工作，那么你就会失去8个月的福利署救济金”。

source_text: The University of Sydney has released a report card on the changes available.
target_text: 悉尼大学已就可能发生的变化发布了报告单。

source_text: On Saturday, the French Constitutional Council announced its approval for a proposed law that would make it illegal for anybody other than professional journalists to videotape acts of violence.
target_text: 星期日，法国宪法委员会宣布批准一项法案，该法案将使得除专业记者外的任何人拍摄暴力录像的行为成为非法。

source_text: The law is, as the Associated Press dubs it, a "clumsy effort" to curb the urban youth activity known as happy slapping in which an act of violence, such as kicking a helpless victim, is filmed by the attacker's friends for entertainment purposes.
target_text: 这项法案被美联社说成是一次“笨拙的努力”，它试图制止在城市青年中流行的一种名为“开心耳光”的活动，即由攻击者的朋友将其暴力行为，比如用脚蹬踏无助的受害者录制下来供其消遣。

source_text: The new law was tucked inside a much larger anti-crime bill put before the Council, and has been chastised for being "deliberately" vague and allowing the prosecution of non-guilty parties who simply videotape events of police brutality, urban riots or other violence.
target_text: 新法案被纳入一个更大的反犯罪提案中提交给宪法委员会审议，并被谴责为“故意”言辞含糊，为起诉那些仅仅拍摄了警方施暴、城市暴乱或其他暴力行为的无罪当事人发放了许可。

source_text: Under the new legislation, written by Minister of the Interior Nicolas Sarkozy, convicted "citizen journalists" could face up to five years in prison.
target_text: 根据这项由内政部长尼科拉斯·萨尔科奇撰写的新法案，被判有罪的“民间记者”可能会面临长达5年的监禁。

source_text: Media freedom group Reporters Without Borders has called the act "dangerous", and warned that it can be used to target "regular citizens" who film acts of violence.
target_text: 媒体自由团体“无国界记者组织”称之为一项“危险的”法案，并警告说，它可能被用来对付拍摄暴力行为的“正当市民”。

source_text: The U.S. Senate unanimously confirmed on Wednsday the nomination of Dr. Michael Griffin to head the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), making him the 11th administrator of the US-based space agency.
target_text: 美国参议院于星期三一致确认了对迈克尔·格里芬博士出任国家航空与航天局（NASA）局长的提名。他将成为这个以美国为基地的空间机构的第11任掌门人。

source_text: The presidential nominee Griffin was the head of the Applied Physics Laboratory's Space Department at Johns Hopkins University, a position he held almost a year.
target_text: 获得总统提名的格里芬曾任约翰·霍普金斯大学应用物理实验室空间部的主任，任职接近一年。

source_text: Prior to that, he was a chief engineer at NASA before coming over from service as Deputy for Technology at the Strategic Defense Initiative Organization.
target_text: 在那以前，他是NASA的一名总工程师，后来又在战略防御倡议组织担任过技术代表。

source_text: Griffin was critical at times of U.S. priorities in space exploration by questioning its continued commitment to the International Space Station.
target_text: 格里芬间或对美国空间探索的优先项目持批评态度，对美国为国际空间站做出的持续性承诺表示质疑。

source_text: In a statement during his April 12, 2005, confirmation hearing before the Senate Commerce Committee, Griffin said, "In the twenty-first century and beyond, for America to continue to be preeminent among nations, it is necessary for us also to be the preeminent spacefaring nation," with a spirit of discovery similar to the exploration of the New World by Columbus with the support of the Spanish crown.
target_text: 在2005年4月12日举行的参院商务委员会听证会上，他发表声明说：“在二十一世纪以后，美国要想在各个国家中保持出类拔萃的地位，就必须成为一个出类拔萃的太空大国”，发挥哥伦布在西班牙王室支持下探索新世界的那种发现主义精神。

source_text: Griffin, 55, notably holds seven academic degrees from various institutions, including a bachelor's degree in physics; master's degrees in aerospace science, electrical engineering, applied physics, civil engineering and business administration; and a PhD in Aerospace Engineering from the University of Maryland.
target_text: 现年55岁的格里芬持有7个由各种机构颁发的学位，包括物理学学士学位；航空航天科学、电气工程学、应用物理学、土木工程学和工商管理学硕士学位；以及马里兰大学的航空航天工程学博士学位。

source_text: Lake effect snow has come early to parts of Western New York prompting a State of Emergency and a flood watch to be issued, especially in Buffalo, New York and its suburbs where nearly 2 feet of snow fell during the afternoon and last night.
target_text: 雪湖效应提前来到纽约西部，促使政府宣布了紧急状态和防洪监视警报，特别是在布法罗、纽约及其郊区，昨天下午和夜晚降雪厚达2英尺。

source_text: A driving ban has been issued for Tonawanda, New York, Buffalo and Amherst where at least "80% of roads in Amherst are impassible."
target_text: 在托纳万达、纽约、布法罗和阿默斯特发布了驾驶禁令。在阿默斯特有至少百分之80的公路无法通行。

source_text: The New York State Throughway, or interstate 90 is closed from nearly Rochester, New York to Dunkirk, New York which is nearly 110 miles long.
target_text: 纽约州高速公路，或称90号州际公路，关闭了从该州罗切斯特附近至敦刻尔克之间的路段，长度大约有110英里。

source_text: Motorists at the Williamsville, New York toll barrier are being turned around.
target_text: 司机们正在纽约威廉姆斯维尔收费站掉头返回。

source_text: A driving ban remains in effect while a state of emergency exists.
target_text: 在紧急状态持续期间，驾驶禁令一直有效。

source_text: Water will be shut off in 24 hours due to the lack of electricity to water pumps in the area and in a press conference, Mayor of Buffalo, Byron Brown issued a "boil water advisory."
target_text: 由于当地缺乏电力，导致水泵断电，因而将于24小时后停止供水。布法罗市的市长拜伦·布朗在记者会上颁布了“开水咨询通报”。

source_text: Brown also said that "70,000 of the 75,000 residents and businesses in Amherst are still without power."
target_text: 布朗还说：“在阿默斯特居住的75,000户居民和商家中，有70,000户仍然无法获得供电”。

source_text: Residents are asked to bottle water and prepare for the outage.
target_text: 居民被要求用瓶子储水，为停水作准备。

source_text: It is not known when water will be turned back on.
target_text: 恢复供水的时间尚不得而知。

source_text: Two of those people were killed in a two-car accident in Lancaster, New York, and the other person was in Niagara County and died after being hit by a vehicle.
target_text: 其中2人在纽约州兰卡斯特死于一场两车相撞事故，另外1人在尼亚加拉县因被车撞而死亡。

source_text: One person was crushed and killed by a falling tree in Amherst, while in the process of removing snow from his property.
target_text: 1人在阿默斯特的家里清除积雪时，被一棵倒伏的树压死。

source_text: Hundreds of trees have snapped in half as the snow began to fall around the city.
target_text: 当全城开始降雪时，数百棵树被拦腰截断。

source_text: Many trees, which still have their leaves, have broken into pieces as the heavy, wet snow began to pile up, as much as an inch an hour.
target_text: 随着积雪以每小时1英寸的速度在迅速增厚，许多树木虽然仍留有树叶，但是已经被沉重的积雪压成数段。

source_text: Early on Thursday, the airport had received nearly 9 inches (23cm) of snow and climbing.
target_text: 星期四早些时候，机场上已经累积了几乎9英寸（23厘米）厚的积雪，而且仍然在继续加厚。

source_text: The storm has caused many delays and cancellations in flights leaving from or going to Buffalo.
target_text: 暴风雪导致许多往来于布法罗的航班被延误或取消。

source_text: Nearly 400,000 people in Buffalo and surrounding suburbs are still without power and forecasters at the NOAA are warning people "not to go outside in an area where heavy snow has fallen unless absolutely necessary."
target_text: 布法罗市及其郊区有大约400,000人仍然得不到供电。国家海洋与大气局警告人们：“除非绝对必要，否则不要在严重降雪区内走出户外”。

source_text: Power may not be restored to the affected areas until Sunday and possibly next week in some areas.
target_text: 受灾的地区可能直到星期日才能恢复供电，其中有些地区也许要等到下个星期了。

source_text: Damage to trees is extensive with nearly every tree destroyed on Granger Place in Buffalo.
target_text: 大量树木遭到破坏，布法罗市格兰杰广场上的树几乎无一幸存。

source_text: "This was extremely heavy snow and most of the trees still have most of their leaves ... we can't do a complete damage assessment until the snow stops falling," said spokesman for Niagara Mohawk, Western New York's area power company, Steve Brady.
target_text: 西部纽约地区电力公司“尼亚加拉莫霍克”的发言人，史蒂夫·布拉迪说：“这是一场异常严重的暴雪，多数树木上仍然留有大部分树叶……，在降雪停下来之前，无法评估整体受损程度”。

source_text: "At 8 pm [on Thursday], utility companies were reporting over 50,000 customers without power."
target_text: “【星期四】上午8时，各公用事业公司陆续报告说，有50,000家客户断电”。

source_text: "The reason for the widespread power outages has been the combination of very heavy water laden snow accumulating on the trees that still have most of their leaves."
target_text: “大范围断电的原因是，异常沉重的含水积雪在仍然留有大部分树叶的树枝上聚集”。

source_text: "Tree's limbs break under the weight of the snow and bring down power lines as they fall," said a statement on NOAA's website.
target_text: 国家海洋与大气局在其网站发布声明解释道：“树枝在积雪的重压下断裂，并在落地时压断了输电线路”。

source_text: Many business and nearly every school in Western New York are still closed due to the weather and the snow is forecasted to move south again over the Buffalo Metropolitan area, but snow amounts are not expected to be significant.
target_text: 由于天气原因，西部纽约的许多商家和几乎所有学校仍然处于关闭状态。据预报，这场雪将再次南下移动到布法罗城区，但是预计雪量不会太大。

source_text: Wind is expected to be strong and gusty which could bring down tree limbs which are broken but still attached to the tree.
target_text: 预期风力仍然强劲，可能会将已经断裂但仍然连接在树干上的树枝吹落。

source_text: Some areas could see an additional 6 inches of snow by Saturday morning.
target_text: 到星期六上午，有些地区可能会再次见到6英寸厚的降雪。

source_text: Iranian authorities have released five British yachtsmen who were detained last week in the Persian Gulf.
target_text: 伊朗当局释放了上周在波斯湾被拘留的5名英国帆船运动员。

source_text: A statement from Iran's Revolutionary Guards said that, after investigation, it reached the conclusion that their illegal entry was a mistake.
target_text: 伊朗革命卫队发布声明说，调查结果表明，这些人的非法入侵是一个错误。

source_text: Britain's Foreign Office confirmed the release, and said the yachtsmen are being towed to international waters, and were expected to head to Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
target_text: 英国外交部确认了释放的消息，并且说，这几名帆船运动员正被拖轮带到国际水域，预期将驶往阿联酋的迪拜。

source_text: Iranian naval forces detained the Britons on the 25th of November as they sailed from Bahrain to Dubai for a race.
target_text: 伊朗海军于11月25日拘留了这些英国人，当时他们正处于从巴林驶往迪拜的比赛途中。

source_text: The chair of Sail Bahrain, Andrew Pindar, which owns the yacht, said the vessel "may have strayed inadvertently" into Iranian waters due to a problem with its propeller.
target_text: 帆船的主人是巴林帆船协会。该协会主席安德鲁·平德尔说，由于推进器出了故障，这条船“可能无意间误入了”伊朗领水。

source_text: State radio quoted a statement by the Iranian Revolutionary Guards as saying that "after getting necessary guarantees, Iran released the five."
target_text: 国家电台引用伊朗革命卫队的声明说：“在取得必要的保证后，伊朗释放了这5个人”。

source_text: "We reached the conclusion that they entered Iran’s territorial waters by mistake."
target_text: “我们得出的结论是，他们进入伊朗领水的行为属于误入”。

source_text: The news comes hours after British Foreign Secretary David Miliband spoke to his Iranian counterpart Manouchehr Mottaki by phone and pressed him for clear information on the incident.
target_text: 英国外交大臣戴维·米利班与伊朗外交部长马努切赫·莫塔基通话并要求对方提供事件的清晰信息。几个小时之后便发布了这条消息。

source_text: He said the incident has "nothing to do" with politics or Iran's nuclear program.
target_text: 他说，此事与政治或伊核计划“没有任何关系”。

source_text: The first thing to catch my eye when I approached what used to be a Texeco gas station, was a guy up in a man-lift beside the pump price sign.
target_text: 当我来到一个曾经属于德士古公司的加油站时，一眼就看见有一个人站在油泵价格标牌旁边的载人电梯里。

source_text: After stopping in later and talking with the owner, I was impressed by how elated he was on the subject of bank processing fees.
target_text: 当作业停下来以后，我就与主人攀谈起来。他谈到银行手续费这个话题时的那个兴奋劲儿，给我留下了深刻印象。

source_text: The man-lift I saw earlier is absent from the photograph I took.
target_text: 先前看到的那个载人电梯并没有出现在我拍摄的这张照片里。

source_text: They had used the lift to change the pump price sign from Texaco to Shell.
target_text: 他们利用这部电梯把德士古和壳牌公司的油泵价格标牌都换掉了。

source_text: A 21-year-old Swedish man killed himself and broadcast it over the internet via his webcam feed Monday, after posting to a message board that he had swallowed some painkillers and was going to hang himself.
target_text: 星期一，一名21岁瑞典男青年在留言板发帖子说他已经吞食了一些止痛片并打算绞死自己之后，就结束了自己的生命，并利用自己的网络摄像头在英特网进行了直播。

source_text: At 11:51 a.m. Central European Summer Time (0951 UTC), Marcus Jannes, a student from Järna, Stockholm, posted to the Mental Health Problems forum of Sweden's Flashback message boards using the newly-registered username "LurifaxFlux", stating that he was going to hang himself, adding that he had already swallowed 100mg of dexofen and 1500mg of paracetamol.
target_text: 中欧夏令时上午11：51（世界时09：51），马尔克斯·雅内斯，这名来自斯德哥尔摩迦尔纳的学生，用新注册的用户名“lurifaxFlux”在瑞典的“倒叙留言板精神健康问题论坛”中发帖子说，他准备绞死自己，又说他已经吞食了100毫克的Dexofen和1500毫克的扑热息痛。

source_text: He said that he had set up a webcam to record the event, and would post details later of a FTP server for people to watch.
target_text: 他说，自己已经安置了一只网络摄像头来记录这一事件，并将细节发到FTP服务器上供人们观看。

source_text: Some offered messages of hope, such as, "How bad can it be? When everything is at its worst, it can only get better", and "Think of poor people, mutilated people, people who are lame or blind."
target_text: 有些人发帖子进行劝导，比如：“那该有多么糟糕呀？坏事走到尽头，就只能向好的方向转变”，还有人说：“想想那些穷人，残疾人，那些瘸腿的人和盲人吧”。

source_text: "They can not change their lives! But you still have the ability to alter yours!"
target_text: “他们无法改变自己的生活！而你还有改变生活的能力！”

source_text: Others tried to keep him online by talking to him empathetically: "Is there anything that can make you change your mind?", "Tell me about yourself."
target_text: 还有人试图通过不断与他倾心交谈的方式让他保持在线：“难道没有什么办法能让你改变主意吗？”，“跟我说说你自己的情况”。

source_text: However, other users posted messages saying they didn't believe him, wishing him luck with his attempt, and calling him an attention whore and a troll.
target_text: 然而，也有一些用户发帖子说，他们不相信他会自杀，祝他尝试成功，而且还说他哗众取宠，是个巨魔。

source_text: They also goaded him by saying, "you won't dare, you are too cowardly", and offering advice on the best way to hang himself: "I recommend ... you do it from a height that you can jump off so you are guaranteed to break your neck."
target_text: 他们还刺激他说：“你不敢，你是个懦夫”，并提出自杀的最好办法：“建议……你吊在一个跳起来才够得着的高度上，那样保证能勒断你的脖子”。

source_text: In a later post, Jannes said that he had been feeling suicidal for about six months, but was too scared to actually attempt anything until he tried to strangle himself with his own hands.
target_text: 在后来发的一个帖子里，雅内斯说，六个月来他一直想自杀，但是他太害怕了，不敢实际尝试，后来他试图用双手勒死自己。

source_text: He also told them that he had Asperger syndrome and High-functioning autism, and was emotionally vulnerable and lacked normal social skills.
target_text: 他还告诉他们，自己患有阿斯伯格综合症和高功能自闭症，情感脆弱，缺乏正常的社交技能。

source_text: He admitted to feeling lonely, and alluded to experiencing problems at school, but admitted that he had a good upbringing and had a rather good life.
target_text: 他承认有孤独感，暗示在学校里遇到了问题，但是他承认有良好的教养，过着相当不错的生活。

source_text: At around the same time, he also updated his Facebook status to say life was "just too difficult", and that he was going to kill himself.
target_text: 大约与此同时，他更新了自己的“脸书”。他说，生活“简直太艰难了”，所以他打算自尽。

source_text: Scotland defeated Romania 42-0 in Pool C of the 2007 Rugby World Cup at Murrayfield, Edinburgh.
target_text: 在爱丁堡默里菲尔德举行的2007年橄榄球世界杯赛C组初赛上，苏格兰队以42比0战胜罗马尼亚队。

source_text: Romania, who rarely looked like scoring, missed a chance to score a few minutes later when Ionut Dimofte missed a penalty.
target_text: 几分钟后，看起来很少有得分希望的罗马尼亚队失去了一次机会，爱奥努特·蒂莫夫特罚球失误。

source_text: Allister Hogg and Rory Lamont added a try each during the first half to extend Scotland's lead to 21-0 at the interval.
target_text: 阿里斯塔·霍格和罗利·拉蒙在上半场各自赢得了一次门后触地得分，在中间休息时将苏格兰的领先地位扩大到21比0。

source_text: In the second half Scotland continued to dominate and Allister Hogg scored two more tries to complete his hat-trick.
target_text: 苏格兰队在下半场继续主宰赛场，阿里斯塔·霍格又实现了两次门后触地得分，从而完成了帽子戏法。

source_text: Rory Lamont scored his second try towards the end of the match, and Scotland comfortably won without conceding a point.
target_text: 在比赛快要结束的时候，罗利·拉蒙完成了第二次门后触地得分，结果苏格兰以未失一分的成绩轻松赢得比赛。

source_text: Scotland have won both games played and are second in Pool C with ten points, behind New Zealand on points difference.
target_text: 苏格兰已经以两场全胜，得10分的成绩位列C组第二名，仅仅由于场上比分差距的原因而排在新西兰之后。

source_text: Romania have lost both their games and are fourth in the group with one point, behind Italy with four and Portugal with none.
target_text: 罗马尼亚队两场皆输，得1分，位列C组第四，排在得4分的意大利队和未得分的葡萄牙队后面。

source_text: On July 18, 2005 CN Rail notified the CAW that they intend to cancel the CN-CAW previously Negotiated Health & Safety Plan.
target_text: 加拿大国家铁路公司于2005年6月18日通知加拿大汽车工人工会说，该公司有意取消此前与后者谈妥的健康与安全计划。

source_text: The CAW will be going to arbitration this fall to address the issue.
target_text: 加拿大汽车工人工会将于秋季将这个问题诉诸仲裁。

source_text: CN Rail used to have part-time positions filled as well, but at this time there are no part-time employees to cover work if a full-time employee is absent.
target_text: 加拿大国家铁路公司过去也采用过兼职岗位替补的办法，但是这一次不同。如果全职员工不在位，那么也没有兼职员工来替岗。

source_text: Overtime is necessary to keep the trains running on time.
target_text: 要想让列车准时运行，就必须加班。

source_text: CN Rail expects the trains to go out on time, and in a safe condition, but staff is overworked, because there are not enough of them.
target_text: 加拿大国家铁路公司希望列车能安全准时地开出，但是员工们都已劳累过度，因为人手不足。

source_text: In fact, one worker noticed that most of the rail cars that contained 40 foot overseas containers did not have their loading guides in place.
target_text: 事实上，有一名工人注意到，多数载有40英尺海外集装箱的铁路车辆都没有安装载货导轨。

source_text: Trains are not allowed to go out without these guides placed into the cars (the guides stop the loads from swaying from side to side in the cars), important for safety with double stacked containers, but it seems that in this case the lack of employees forced the train to leave without them.
target_text: 如果车辆上没有安装这些导轨（可防止货物在车里左右晃动），列车就不准驶离，这对双层集装箱的安全来说是非常重要的。但是看起来，由于缺乏员工的原因，只好迫使列车在未安装导轨的情况下开出去了。

source_text: New Zealand Members of Parliament will receive thousands more after getting pay increases today.
target_text: 今日获得加薪后，新西兰国会议员们将领取比原先多达数千元的工资。

source_text: The pay rises for backbench MPs are between 3.8% and 4.1% which will mean a backbench MP will now earn around NZ$122,500.
target_text: 后座议员的加薪幅度为百分之3.8至百分之4.1，意味着后座议员现在的收入可达到122,500新元左右。

source_text: The pay rises are to counter inflation next year of about 2.5% which will result in MPs receiving more money.
target_text: 这次加薪的目的是为了抵消明年大约百分之2.5的通货膨胀率，结果将导致议员们领到更多的钱。

source_text: Other MPs with senior positions will get rises of between 4% and 8.1%.
target_text: 其他资深议员的加薪幅度在百分之4和百分之8.1之间。

source_text: This year the Prime Minister's increase will be worth just over $14,000 - paying her $6,942 a week.
target_text: 总理在今年的加薪幅度略超过14,000新元，每周支付给她6,942新元。

source_text: Helen Clark, PM of New Zealand, received a 9.4 per cent rise last year, increasing her salary by nearly $30,000 to $347,000.
target_text: 新西兰议员海伦·克拉克去年获得了百分之9.4的加薪，这使她的薪水从接近30,000新元增加到347,000新元。

source_text: The latest increase will see her salary rise to about $361,000.
target_text: 最近这次加薪将使她的薪水增加到大约361,000新元。

source_text: National's multimillionaire John Key has already secured a significant pay rise this week with his election to the leader's job and is on $216,000.
target_text: 随着国家党的千万富翁约翰·基被推选到领导职位，他本周已经得到了大幅度加薪，其薪水为216,000新元。

source_text: The pay rise will be backdated to July 1, The New Zealand Herald reported today.
target_text: 《新西兰先驱报》今天报道说，所增加的薪水将从7月1日开始补发。

source_text: Mr Key told The New Zealand Herald that he would donate a significant amount of his pay check to charitable organisations, as he has done since he first became an MP.
target_text: 基先生告诉《新西兰先驱报》说，他会把工资中相当大的一部分捐给慈善机构，就像他首次担任议员时那样。

source_text: Last year backbenchers got a 4.1% increase in their pay.
target_text: 去年，后座议员获得了百分之4.1的加薪。

source_text: Judges are also going to expect a pay rise next year of about 5%.
target_text: 法官们预期明年也可加薪大约百分之5。

source_text: Shin Corporation, the multi-billion baht telecom and IT giant, has lost its defamation suit against Supinya Klangnarong for her comments in an interview with the Thai Post in July 2003.
target_text: 臣那越集团，这一身价数十亿泰铢的电信和信息技术巨人集团，输掉了对苏品雅·克朗娜荣的诽谤诉讼案。案子的起因是后者在2003年7月接受《泰国邮报》采访时发表的言论。

source_text: In her interview Supinya, secretary general of the Campaign for Popular Media, had stated that Shin corporation gained revenue following the election of Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra, the company's founder.
target_text: 在采访的过程中，“大众媒体运动”秘书长苏品雅说，臣那越集团在该公司创始人他信·西那瓦当选为总理以后，收入增加了。

source_text: As a result the corporation sued her and five of the Thai Post's executives for defamation.
target_text: 结果，该集团对她和《泰国邮报》的5名高管提出了诽谤起诉。

source_text: The court's finding that Supinya has a right to express her opinion, and that it did not defame Shin Corp. followed a number of attempts by the company to settle out of court or otherwise avoid a judgement.
target_text: 法庭的裁决是，苏品雅有权表达自己的看法，而且她并没有诽谤臣那越集团。此后该公司几次试图庭外和解，或者换一种说法，避免判决。

source_text: This judgement comes at an inopportune moment for the Prime Minister: his family's recent tax-free sale of their stake in Shin has acted as a catalyst for the protests calling for Thaksin to resign.
target_text: 对于总理来说，这个判决来得不是时候：他的家族最近免税出售了臣那越集团的股权，这成了呼吁他信辞职的抗议活动的催化剂。

source_text: The Australian government and the New South Wales State goverernment are going to fund the Forbes Global CEO Conference, to be held at the Sydney Opera House next week.
target_text: 澳大利亚政府和新西兰南威尔士州政府计划为“福布斯全球首席执行官大会”提供资助。会议将于下周在悉尼歌剧院召开。

source_text: The State government has said that the contract prevents it from revealing how much taxpayers money will be spent.
target_text: 州政府说，合同条款不允许透露将有多少纳税人的钱被花掉。

source_text: A spokesman for the Deputy Premier, John Watkins, said that they could not divulge the costs "under the contract arrangements".
target_text: 据副州长约翰·沃特金斯的发言人说，“根据合同条款”，他们不能泄漏成本信息。

source_text: A government source suggested to the Sydney Morning Herald that the state and federal governments are spending up to $1million each.
target_text: 一位政府消息人士对《悉尼先驱晨报》暗示说，州政府和联邦政府将各自花费1百万美元。

source_text: The State government has been criticised for providing free police protection at the conference.
target_text: 州政府已经由于为会议提供免费警察保护而遭到批评。

source_text: Security will require 200 police a day, at an estimated cost of more than $500,000.
target_text: 安保工作将需要每天提供200名警察，预计成本将超过500,000美元。

source_text: A number of Global justice and peace groups have pledged to protest at the conference.
target_text: 多个全球正义与和平团体已经承诺要在会议期间组织抗议活动。

source_text: The number of protestors is currerntly projected to be around 2,000.
target_text: 目前预计，抗议人数大约为2,000人。

source_text: Australian Prime Minister John Howard has announced that 150 SAS personnel will be serving in Afghanistan within two months, and a further 200 troops will follow them by early next year.
target_text: 澳大利总理约翰·霍华德宣布，在未来2个月内，将派遣150名特别空勤团人员去阿富汗执行勤务，明年年初将继续派遣200名士兵。

source_text: According to Mr Howard the decision is the result of a request from the United States and others.
target_text: 根据霍华德先生的说法，这一决定是应美国和其他国家的要求而做出的。

source_text: Opposition leader Kim Beazley has said that Labor supported the plan.
target_text: 反对派领袖金·比兹利说，工党支持这个计划。

source_text: Mr Beazley has been critical of the government in recent weeks because of its military focus on Iraq rather than Afghanistan, which he says is the source of the terrorist threat.
target_text: 比兹利先生近几周来一直对政府持批评态度，因为后者将军事重点放在伊拉克而不是阿富汗。他说，后者才是恐怖威胁的根源。

source_text: Beazley offered that it has been "obvious for some time that the job was only partially completed when the commitment was made earlier."
target_text: 比兹利表示：“很明显，承诺虽然早已做出，但是活儿只干了一部分”。

source_text: "The progress that has been made in the establishment of a legitimate government in Afghanistan has come under increasing attack and pressure from the Taliban - and some elements of al-Qaeda," Mr Howard said.
target_text: 霍华德先生说：“在阿富汗建立合法政府的进程遭受了来自塔利班和基地分子的越来越多的攻击和压力”。

source_text: The additional troop commitment has been welcomed by the Afghani government.
target_text: 阿富汗政府对增兵的承诺表示欢迎。

source_text: Lutfullah Mashal, Afghanistan's Interior Ministry spokesman, said that assistance with security or reconstruction and development is always welcome, however he expressed disappointment that the deployment would only be for 12 months.
target_text: 阿富汗内政部发言人拉特弗拉·马绍尔说，在安全、重建和发展方面提供的援助总是受欢迎的。然而，他又对只有短短12个月的部署时间表示失望。

source_text: Mr Howard has said that he does not like to make open ended commitments, and also stated that extra security would be needed for the APEC summit in 2007.
target_text: 霍华德先生说，他不愿意做任何开放式的承诺，而且2007年的APEC高峰会议还需要提供额外的安全保护。

source_text: "At the time of the APEC meeting and in the months leading up to it, the need in this country is for a heightened elite security capacity," he said.
target_text: 他说：“在APEC会议期间，以及在开会前的这几个月内，这个国家需要采取强化的精英安保措施”。

source_text: ABC News has obtained and released a transcript of a taped message from Osama Bin Laden.
target_text: 美国广播公司新闻网获得并发表了奥萨马·本拉登一段录像信息的文本。

source_text: Osama bin Laden's first video in almost three years has surfaced but has mixed reviews in the Arab world.
target_text: 奥萨马·本拉登三年以来的第一段视频浮出水面，但是阿拉伯世界却对此褒贬不一。

source_text: Jeb Bush, the former governor of Florida, announced his endorsement of Republican presidential candidate hopeful Mitt Romney yesterday.
target_text: 佛罗里达州前州长杰布·布什昨天宣布支持共和党总统候选人，充满希望的米特·罗姆尼。

source_text: This follows Romney's win in the Illinois primary on Tuesday, where he beat Rick Santorum by 12 percentage points.
target_text: 此前，罗姆尼已在星期二赢得了伊利诺州的初选，以12个百分点的优势击败了里克•桑托勒姆。

source_text: In a statement, Bush argued that "now is the time for Republicans to unite behind Governor Romney and take our message of fiscal conservatism and job creation to all voters this fall".
target_text: 布什在一份声明中强调：“到了共和党人应该团结在罗姆尼州长身边的时候了，要把我们财政保守主义和创造就业机会的纲领在这个秋天里传递给所有的投票人”。

source_text: He also stated that he believed Romney to be "a leader who understands the economy, recognises more government regulation is not the answer, believes in entrepreneurial capitalism and works to ensure that all Americans have the opportunity to succeed".
target_text: 他还说，他认为罗姆尼是“一位懂经济的人，知道制定更多的政府规章并不解决问题，相信创业资本主义并努力确保所有的美国人都有成功的机会”。

source_text: "He has long demonstrated an outstanding ability to bring people together."
target_text: “他长期以来一直表现出团结民众的杰出能力”。

source_text: The next primary will take place in Louisiana on Saturday, followed by primaries on April 3 in Wisconsin, Maryland and the District of Columbia.
target_text: 下一次初选将于星期六在路易斯安那州展开，此后将在威斯康辛州、马里兰州和哥伦比亚特区陆续展开。

source_text: In Wisconsin, Romney is reported to be spending $2 million on television adverts compared to Santorum's $50,000.
target_text: 据报道，罗姆尼在威斯康辛州花了2百万美元电视广告费，而相比之下，桑托勒姆仅仅花了5万美元。

source_text: New Jersey is considering a state-wide ban on Brazilian waxes, the removal of hair from the bikini area.
target_text: 新泽西州正在考虑在全州范围内禁止使用巴西蜜蜡脱毛法来清除比基尼区的体毛。

source_text: Although genital waxing has never really been allowed in the state, the New Jersey Board of Cosmetology and Hairstyling plans to propose a ban with more specific legal wording, in response to two women who reported being injured during a wax.
target_text: 虽然该州从未真正允许使用生殖器脱毛蜜蜡，但是针对两位女士关于在使用蜜蜡脱毛时受伤的报告，新泽西美容美发委员会计划提出一项含有更明确法律措辞的禁令。

source_text: The board will consider the proposal at their next meeting on April 14.
target_text: 该委员会将在4月14日召集的下一次会议上考虑这一建议。

source_text: If the measure passes, New Jersey may become the only US state to ban the practice outright.
target_text: 如果建议被通过，那么新泽西可能成为美国唯一一个彻底禁止这一疗法的州。

source_text: Although millions of Americans engage in bikini waxes, which generally cost between $50 and $60 per session, the practice comes with risks.
target_text: 尽管数以百万计的美国人在使用比基尼蜜蜡脱毛疗法，大约每个疗程要花费50至60美元，但是这种疗法是有风险的。

source_text: Skin care experts say the hot wax can irritate delicate skin in the bikini area, and result in infections, ingrown hairs and rashes.
target_text: 护肤专家说，热蜡会刺激比基尼区娇嫩的皮肤，引发感染、毛法内生和皮疹。

source_text: Waxing on the face, neck, abdomen, legs and arms would continue to be permitted in the state under the proposed ban.
target_text: 根据建议中的禁令，将仍然允许在面部、颈部、腹部和臂部使用蜜蜡脱毛。

source_text: Although New Jersey statutes have always banned bikini waxing, the laws were unclear and seldom enforced.
target_text: 虽然新泽西州法令一直禁用比基尼区蜜蜡脱发疗法，但是规定并不明确，也很少得到执行。

source_text: As a result, many salons from around the state have offered bikini waxing for years.
target_text: 结果，全州许多美容院多年来一直提供比基尼区蜜蜡脱毛治疗。

source_text: Many salon owners spoke out against the proposed ban, which they said would severely damage their business.
target_text: 许多美容院主公开反对这项建议中的禁令，因为它将严重影响她们的生意。

source_text: "I really don't know if the state can stop it at this point," said Valentia Chistova, owner of the Monmouth County salon Brazil.
target_text: 蒙茅斯县巴西美容院的店主瓦伦西亚·克里斯托娃说：“目前我真不知道州府是否应该禁止使用它”。

source_text: "I know a lot of women who are really hooked."
target_text: “我认识的很多女士都对此非常着迷”。

source_text: The Israeli ministry of tourism is reconsidering cutting ties with Christian televangelist Pat Robertson over the construction of a Christian heritage, pilgrimage and tourism site near the Sea of Galilee.
target_text: 以色列旅游部正重新考虑是否要在加利利海附近的基督教遗产、朝圣遗址和旅游景点建设问题上与基督教远程传道者帕特·罗伯森割断联系。

source_text: The Christian Heritage Center which would stretch over 125 acres is placed where, according to Christian tradition, Jesus taught and lived in the Galilee region.
target_text: 占地125英亩的基督教遗产中心就定位在那里。根据基督教的传统说法，耶稣就曾在加利利地区居住和布道。

source_text: Robertson was one of the people at the heart of the project which was supported by many other evangelicals who worked to raise $50 million (USD).
target_text: 罗伯森是这个项目的核心人物之一。该项目得到了许多其他福音会教徒的支持，并为此筹集了5千万美元。

source_text: Israeli tourism minister, Avraham Hirchson, and Robertson were just about to sign an agreement that the Israeli government would set aside land and infrastructure for the site, when Robertson made comments on his daily show, The 700 Club, claiming that Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon's stroke was "Divine retribution" for withdrawing from the Gaza Strip.
target_text: 在以色列旅游部长埃弗拉罕·赫奇森和罗伯森即将签署有关以色列政府为该遗址留出土地和基础设施的协议之际，罗伯森在他的每日秀节目“700俱乐部”中评论道，以色列总理阿里尔·沙龙的中风是因撤离加沙地带而招致的“神的报应”。

source_text: Robertson said, "'This is my land,' and for any prime minister of Israel who decides he is going to carve it up and give it away, God says, 'No, this is mine.'"
target_text: 罗伯森说：“‘这是我的土地，’如果任何以色列总理打算把它切下来送人的话，上帝会说‘不行，这是我的土地’”。

source_text: Many evangelicals considered the withdrawal as retreating from biblical prophecy of Jewish sovereignty over the Holy Land.
target_text: 许多福音会教徒将这次撤离看作放弃了圣经中关于犹太人对圣地拥有主权的预言。

source_text: Robertson's comments earned him a harsh backlash from many different groups, including the White House and former Presidential candidate, Senator John Kerry of Massachusetts.
target_text: 罗伯森的言论遭到许多不同团体的强烈反对，其中包括白宫和前总统候选人，马萨诸塞州参议员约翰·凯利。

source_text: A spokesperson for Robertson said the comments were taken out of context.
target_text: 罗伯森的一位发言人说，这些言论被断章取义了。

source_text: On Wednesday, Robertson sent a letter addressed to Sharon's son Omri apologizing for his comments.
target_text: 星期三，罗伯森写信给沙龙的儿子奥姆里为自己的言论表示歉意。

source_text: In the letter, Robertson said Sharon is "kind, gracious, and gentle man" who was "carrying an almost insurmountable burden of making decisions for his nation."
target_text: 罗伯森在信中说道，沙龙是“一个心地善良，谦和，和蔼可亲的人”，他“为他的国家承担了巨大的决策重任”。

source_text: The letter further added, "My concern for the future safety of your nation led me to make remarks which I can now view in retrospect as inappropriate and insensitive in light of a national grief."
target_text: 他在信中继续说道：“在举国悲痛的时刻，我出于对贵国未来安全的关注而说的那些话，现在回想起来是不合时宜，又不顾及别人情感的”。

source_text: Robertson wrote, "I ask your forgiveness and the forgiveness of the people of Israel."
target_text: 罗伯森写道：“我恳求您的宽恕，也恳求以色列人民的宽恕”。

source_text: According to the Israeli Ambassador to the United States, Israel accepts the apology.
target_text: 根据以色列驻美国大使的说法，以色列接受了他的道歉。

source_text: However, despite the apology by Robertson, it was doubtful that he would be brought back into the plan.
target_text: 然而，尽管罗伯森表示了歉意，但是人们怀疑他是否还有可能重新回到这个计划。

source_text: Hirchson said on Wednesday that "Robertson's help was no longer welcome."
target_text: 赫奇森于星期三说：“罗伯森的帮助不再受欢迎”。

source_text: Ironically, Robertson helped make television ministries what they are today, and the Heritiage Center would contain studios and satellite uplinks for live broadcasts.
target_text: 具有讽刺意味的是，正是在罗伯森的帮助下才把电视部建设成现在这个样子，而且遗产中心里将建有供直播使用的播音室和卫星上行链路。

source_text: The groundbreaking for the project is slated to begin later in the year.
target_text: 这个项目预定将于今年晚些时候破土动工。

source_text: A leaked draft of a report on instances of state repression during Mexico's "dirty war" has been called into question by top officials.
target_text: 一份关于墨西哥“肮脏战争”期间国家镇压行动的报告草稿遭到泄露，顶层官员对此表示质疑。

source_text: Report author, Ignacio Carrillo, assigned to the task by President Fox, commented by saying, "He will have to render his report."
target_text: 报告的作者，伊格纳西奥·卡利罗，是根据福克斯总统的指示执行这项任务的。他评论说：“他必须提交这份报告”。

source_text: "It will be placed in an open, public place," and "that will be there for history, but legally it's over."
target_text: “报告将被置于一个公开的公共场所”，而且“它将作为历史被保存在那里，但是从法律角度看，一切都结束了”。

source_text: This being a reference to the fact that the Supreme Court has ruled that it is too late to prosecute possible offenders.
target_text: 这段话暗指的事实是，最高法院已经裁定，现在对可能的罪犯进行起诉，已经为时过晚。

source_text: Carrillo claims, however, that his report is similar to the recently leaked draft.
target_text: 然而，卡利罗声称，他的报告与最近被泄露的草稿很相似。

source_text: He said, "It's not going to totally contradict the draft."
target_text: 他说：“它与草稿并不完全矛盾”。

source_text: The draft was published by a Mexican magazine, claiming that the public has a right to know.
target_text: 这份草稿被一份墨西哥杂志发表了。该杂志声称，公众有知情权。

source_text: The basis for the report is recently declassified military documents from the years 1964 – 1982.
target_text: 报告的基本内容来自最近分类整理的1964到1982年间军事文件。

source_text: Carrillo also claims that his work was hindered by resistance from the courts, bad resources, and people involved being unwilling to cooperate.
target_text: 卡利罗还说，他的工作遭受了各种各样的阻力，有的来自法庭，有的来自不良资源，还有的来自不愿意合作的当事人。

source_text: Much controversy exists in the region about what is to be done with alleged offenders in the Dirty War.
target_text: 在如何对待肮脏战争期间被指控的罪犯这个问题上，该地区存在着相当大的争议。

source_text: Thai low-cost air carrier One-Two-Go Airlines has announced that it will be grounding all 16 of its aircraft immediately until September 15.
target_text: 泰国低成本空运公司“一二走”航空公司宣布，该公司将立即停飞其全部16架飞机，直到9月15日为止。

source_text: The news comes as legal action against the airline and associated companies begins over the September crash of Flight 269, which killed 90 people, mostly foreigners.
target_text: 消息发表的时候，恰逢人们开始就9月份导致90人丧生，多数为外国人的269号航班坠机事件，对该公司及其关联公司提起法律诉讼。

source_text: He says 70% of operating costs are taken up with fuel, and the airline has already raised fuel surcharges again by 100 baht to 850 baht per leg.
target_text: 他说，在运营成本中，燃油成本占了百分之70，该公司已经将燃油附加费提高了100泰铢，达到每个航次850泰铢。

source_text: "In this kind of environment, anyone can go (bankrupt) anytime," said Urdom, who declined to comment on the impact the present financial situation has had on his airline, saying only that they "are financially sustainable."
target_text: 乌冬说：“在这种情况下，任何人都可能随时破产”。他谢绝对当前财务状况对该公司产生的影响进行评论。只是说，公司“在财务上具有可持续性”。

source_text: He also said that the airline could return to service with ease if prices dropped, noting that, "if the situation improved with fuel prices being lowered and the profitability outlook was better, we could be airborne again."
target_text: 他还说，如果价格能降下来，公司就能够轻而易举地恢复经营。他指出：“如果情况有所改善，油价下降，且盈利前景看好，那我们就可能再次升空”。

source_text: The airline began operations in 2003; it is a subsidiary of Orient Thai Airlines.
target_text: 这家航空公司于2003年开始运营，是“东方泰国航空公司”下属的一家子公司。

source_text: Orient Thai, which will continue to operate as normal, recently opened Thailand's first freight-only airline, Orient Thai Cargo, with a pair of Boeing 747-200Fs bought from Japan Airlines.
target_text: “东方泰国”将继续正常运营，且最近还从“日本航空公司”购买了2架波音747-200F飞机，开办了泰国第一家货运航空公司“东方泰国货运”。

source_text: Urdon said that a major part of the problem is that eight of the company's aircraft are MD-11s, which consume large volumes of fuel.
target_text: 乌冬说，主要的问题在于，该公司的飞机都是MD11。这种机型消耗大量的燃油。

source_text: He also said that a collapse of a damage limitation scheme with rivals Nok Airlines and Thai AirAsia had affected his decision.
target_text: 他还说，竞争对手“泰鸟航空公司”和“泰国亚洲航空公司”根据损害限制方案而宣布倒闭，这一点也影响到他的决策。

source_text: The news comes as the first families of victims of Flight OG269 launch legal action against the airline, as well as parent airline Orient Thai and lessor Grandmax Group.
target_text: 公布这则消息的时候，OG269航班遇难者的第一批家属正要对该公司及其上级公司“东方泰国”和租赁公司“Grandmax集团”提起法律诉讼。

source_text: Already confirmed to be involved in the action are Richard and Margaret Collins as well as Steve and Jean Jones, parents of Alex Collins, 22, and Bethan Jones, also 22, an unmarried Welsh couple who, a few days into a round-the-world trip, were among the 123 passengers on board.
target_text: 目前已证实参与这次诉讼的有理查德和玛格丽特·科林斯夫妇，以及史蒂夫和吉恩·琼斯夫妇。他们是22岁的阿列克斯·科林斯的父母和同样是22岁的贝珊·琼斯的父母。这对未婚夫妇在事故发生几天前刚刚开始他们的环球旅行。机上共有123名乘客。

source_text: "We believe the air crash was completely avoidable and those responsible should be held to account."
target_text: “我们认为这次空难是完全可以避免的，必须对责任人进行追责”。

source_text: "While we accept that nothing can bring Alex and Bethan and the other people who lost their lives back, we are keen to make sure we prevent this from happening again," said the families in a joint statement.
target_text: 这两家人在其联合声明中指出：“虽然我们接受阿列克斯、贝珊和其他遇难者均不可能复生的事实，但是我们必须防止这类事情再次发生”。

source_text: "We will be forcing One-Two-Go Airlines to prove in court that they are not a low cost, low safety airline," said James Healy-Pratt, head of aviation at Stewarts Law in London.
target_text: 伦敦斯图尔特诉讼公司的航空法律诉讼负责人詹姆斯·希利·普拉特说：“我们要迫使‘一二走’航空公司在法庭上证明他们不是一家低成本低安全的航空公司”。

source_text: He also said that the action will be brought before courts in the United States.
target_text: 他还说，诉讼将提交美国法庭受理。

source_text: Finnish symphonic power metal band, Nightwish, has announced details about their latest studio album, which will be the first to feature new Swedish lead vocalist Anette Olzon, who recently replaced Tarja Turunen.
target_text: 芬兰交响金属乐队“夜愿”公布了其最新录音专辑的详细信息。那将是第一部由瑞典歌手阿奈特·奥尔宗主唱的专辑。他最近取代了塔雅·图伦尼的角色。

source_text: Among the details released is the name of the new album, which until now had been unrevealed.
target_text: 所发布的细节中包括新专辑的名称，这个信息此前从来没有被透露过。

source_text: Nightwish have also released a full track listing for the album and revealed that as well as Eva, which has already been released, the song Amaranth will be released as a single.
target_text: “夜愿”还发布了专辑的完整曲目列表，并透露说，就像已经发布的“伊娃”一样，“阿玛兰什”也将作为一个单辑发布。

source_text: The album will debut in the band's native Finland on September 26 from record labels Spinefarm Records and distributed by Universal Music Group.
target_text: 这个专辑将于9月26日在该乐队的故乡芬兰由Spinefarm Records公司首次推出，发行者为环球音乐集团。

source_text: It will be released in the US and the rest of Europe two days later, with the US label being Roadrunner Records and the European label being Nuclear Blast Records.
target_text: 两天后将在美国和其他欧洲国家发行。负责发行的美国公司是“走鹃唱片公司”，欧洲公司是“核爆炸唱片公司”。

source_text: Nuclear Blast will release Amaranth on August 24 and Spinefarm/Universal will release it on August 22.
target_text: “核爆炸唱片公司”将于8月24日发行“阿玛兰什”，而Spinefarm和环球这两家公司将于8月22日发布这个单辑。

source_text: According to the United States Geological Survey (USGS) at least two earthquakes with a magnitude 7.2 and 5.1 have rocked the island of Vanuatu.
target_text: 根据美国地质调查局（USGS）的消息，瓦努阿图岛遭遇了至少两次地震，震级分别达到7.2级和5.1级。

source_text: The first 7.2 quake was recorded at 4:08 a.m., Thursday morning local time (UTC+11), 55 kilometers (35 miles) east, southeast of Luganville, Espiritu Santo, Vanuatu with a depth of 144.8 km (90.0 miles).
target_text: 当地时间星期四凌晨4：08（世界时+11小时），在瓦努阿图埃斯皮里图桑托岛的路干维尔镇东南偏东55公里（35英里）处记录到第一次地震，震级为7.2级，震源深度为144.8公里（90.0英里）。

source_text: The second 5.1 quake was recorded at 47 km (29 miles) east, northeast of Santo (Luganville), Vanuatu with a depth of 149.3 km (92.8 miles) and it struck nearly one hour later at 5:07 a.m.
target_text: 将近1个小时以后，即凌晨5：07，在瓦努阿图桑托岛（路干维尔镇）东北偏东47公里（29英里）处记录到第二次地震，震级为5.1级，震源深度为149.3公里（98.2英里）。

source_text: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration has issued a tsunami bulletin for the first quake saying that "based on all available data a destructive Pacific-wide tsunami not expected," but that small waves could be expected locally near the quake's epicenter.
target_text: 国家海洋与大气局在第一次地震发生后发布了海啸公报。公报中指出：“根据全部现有数据的分析结果，预期不会在太平洋全域发生毁灭性的海啸”，但是，预期在震中附近的局部海区会引发较小的波浪。

source_text: So far there are no reports of injuries, deaths or damage, but the USGS reports that damage could be "moderate to heavy."
target_text: 目前尚无伤亡或损害报告，但是根据国家海洋与大气局的报告，损害级别可能达到“中度至重度”。

source_text: Dove soaps continues their North American "Campaign for Real Beauty" advertising with a television commercial that explores the alterations that can be done on models.
target_text: “德芙”牌肥皂继续在北美展开其“真美运动”广告攻势，通过电视广告片来探讨在模特化妆方面可以做出什么样的改变。

source_text: From there, she is primped and plucked by hair and makeup artists, then tweaked on a Photoshop-like program.
target_text: 在那个广告中，一位女模特被发型师和化妆师们精心装扮一番，然后用一个类似Photoshop的程序进行处理。

source_text: Two young, teenage girls walk past, glancing at the board.
target_text: 两名十几岁的年轻女孩子路过，瞟了一眼广告。

source_text: "No wonder our perception of beauty is distorted" ends the ad in text, "Every girl deserves to feel beautiful just the way she is."
target_text: 结尾的广告词是这样说的：“难怪对美的感知被扭曲了”，“每个姑娘都有权按照自己的方式来感觉美”。

source_text: Dove runs the Dove Self-Esteem Fund as a part of their Campaign for Real Beauty.
target_text: 作为“真美运动”的一个组成部分，“德芙”建立了自己的“德芙自尊基金”。

source_text: In the marketing campaign, Dove uses "real" women, instead of professional models, in an attempt to instill self-esteem in their customers.
target_text: 在营销宣传运动中，“德芙”展示的是“真实”的女性，而不是专业女模特，试图以此为客户注入自尊。

source_text: This continuing promotion, launched in 2004, was on the forefront of a current trend in Western culture to abandon the overly idealised images the media portrays of women.
target_text: 这个开始于2004年的连续促销运动站在了当前西方文化潮流的前列，即摒弃媒体对妇女形象过于理想化的展示。

source_text: Recently some fashion capitals have mandated minimum body mass indexes for runway models.
target_text: 最近，有些时尚之都强制推出了对走秀模特的最低体重指数要求。

source_text: The top rated comedy in the United States and Canada is Ugly Betty, a series that stars an average girl coping at a fashion magazine.
target_text: 在美国和加拿大，评价最高的喜剧片是《丑女贝蒂》。这部连续剧讲述了一个普通女孩与时尚杂志打交道的故事。

source_text: The series is based on Betty la Fea, an extremely popular Colombian telenovela, which has been reproduced internationally.
target_text: 连续剧的原版本是《贝蒂·拉菲》，一部极受欢迎的哥伦比亚电视连续剧。该剧已在国际上被翻拍。

source_text: Only two percent of women surveyed worldwide consider themselves beautiful, according to ABC Good Morning America co-anchor Robin Roberts, whose program debuted the commercial this morning at 8:07 am EST.
target_text: 根据美国广播公司“早安，美国”节目的联合主持人罗宾·罗伯茨的说法，在全世界接受调查的女性中，只有百分之二的人认为自己是美丽的。他的节目将于东部时间8：07首次播出。

source_text: The ad is currently playing on the Campaign for Real Beauty's homepage.
target_text: 这则广告目前正在“真美运动”的主页上播放。

source_text: Fisheries Minister, Ian Macdonald, told the nation's ABC Radio that a number of boats caught fishing for shark fin and reef fish had been taken to Gove and Darwin.
target_text: 渔业部长伊安·麦克唐纳告诉ABC电台说，一些捕捞鲨鱼翅和珊瑚鱼的船只已被押送戈弗和达尔文。

source_text: The nine-day joint navy, customs and army "Operation Clearwater" was continuing, and had taken months to plan.
target_text: 为时9天的，由海军、海关与陆军联合实施的“清水行动”还在持续之中。该行动已经计划了几个月。

source_text: "I think all of the illegal vessels up there, because of their inter-vessel communication will now be aware that there is a major sting on by the Australian authorities and those that haven't been arrested, I think will be hightailing it back to Indonesian ports as we speak," said Senator MacDonald.
target_text: 参议员麦克唐纳说：“我认为在那里的所有非法船只，现在应该已经通过它们之间的通信联络了解到，澳大利亚当局对此深感不安。我想，那些尚未被拘捕的船只，在我们说话的这会儿，应该正在逃回印尼港口”。

source_text: Intelligence indicated what he called "organised transnational criminal activity", including some Asian connections beyond the Indonesian village ports where the vessels originated, but the activity was apparently limited to illegal fishing, and did not include smuggling.
target_text: 有情报表明，他所说的“有组织的国际犯罪活动”，具有超越这些船只所在的印尼乡村港口范围之外的某些亚洲背景，但是这个活动显然仅限于非法捕鱼，不包括走私。

source_text: Two boats each had one tonne of fish, and shark fin.
target_text: 有两艘船上各装载了1吨重的鱼和鲨鱼翅。

source_text: Fishing by some Indonesian peoples has occurred legitimately in the area between the two nations for hundreds of years before European colonization.
target_text: 在欧洲殖民活动开始以前几百年的时间里，有些印尼人一直在两国之间的海区里合法捕鱼。

source_text: A 1906 Australian claim on as much as 80% of the waters has since been softened by a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the two governments, recognizing some traditional fishing rights.
target_text: 澳大利亚于1905年提出对该海域百分之80水域的声索，但是两国政府后来通过一份谅解备忘录进行了弱化处理，承认了一部分传统捕捞权力。

source_text: However analysts say the Australian government strategy is flawed, since it is based on the fishing technology employed, rather than catch numbers.
target_text: 然而，分析家们说，澳大利亚政府的策略存在瑕疵，因为它所依据的是所使用的捕鱼技术，而不是捕捞量。

source_text: Senator MacDonald told the ABC Radio programme AM that he expected in the case of those thought to have been fishing in Australian waters illegally, the captain and perhaps the senior fishing master would be charged, with other crew being immediately repatriated to Indonesia.
target_text: 参议员麦克唐纳告诉ABC无线电节目AM说，他估计，在据认为是在澳大利亚水域非法捕鱼的这个案件中，船长和高级捕捞长们会被起诉，而其他船员会被立即遣送回印度尼西亚。

source_text: As for the boats, "We're required by international law to offer them to bond them back to the owners, but as the crew are immediately repatriated the ability of the owners to get them back to Indonesia ... is fairly limited," the Senator explained.
target_text: 至于那些船只，“根据国际法，我们应该把它们还给船主，但是，由于船员都被立即遣返了，所以船主将这些船取回印尼……的能力相当有限，”参议员解释说。

source_text: "I would expect that most of these boats apprehended in operation Clearwater will actually be forfeited to the crown and will be destroyed."
target_text: “我估计，在‘清水行动’中拘留的多数船只会被官方没收并销毁”。

source_text: The fishermen were expected to appear in court next week, reported Reuters news agency.
target_text: 据路透社报道，预期这些渔民将于下周出庭。

source_text: An Indonesian fisherman was last week fined $A130,000, setting a new record, after his boat was caught off with over 100kg of dried reef fish, 300kg of fish on ice and 10kg of dried shark fin.
target_text: 一位印尼渔民上周被罚款130,000澳元，由此创下了一项新的纪录。被拘捕时，他的船上有100公斤干珊瑚鱼，300公斤冷冻鱼和10公斤干鲨鱼翅。

source_text: The Northern Territory Fisheries Minister, Kon Vatskalis, on ABC Radio asked the Federal Government to commit the same level of resources permanently.
target_text: 北领地渔业部长孔·瓦茨喀里斯在ABC无线节目中要求联邦政府承诺永久性提供同等水平的资源保障。

source_text: "Provide the extra funding, provide the extra resources to the Navy and the Customs and then they will be able to stop the illegal boats, not only when they run an operation but every day, every week, every month," Mr Vatskalis told the ABC.
target_text: 瓦茨喀里斯先生告诉ABC电台说：“要为海军和海关提供额外的资金和额外的资源，这样他们才有能力每个月，每个星期，每天都去阻止非法船只活动，而不是仅靠一次联合行动”。

source_text: An earthquake of magnitude 7.0 on the Richter scale has been reported as having struck the Pacific island of New Britain, the second island in the Papua and New Guinea group.
target_text: 据报道，一次震级达到里氏7.0级的地震袭击了太平洋上的新不列颠岛。此为巴布亚和新几内亚群岛中的第二大岛。

source_text: The quake, which struck at 22:01 UTC yesterday evening, hit at a depth of approximately 54 kilometers (34 mi) according to the United States Geological Survey.
target_text: 根据美国国家地质调查局提供的消息，昨晚世界时22：01发生的这场地震，其震深为大约54公里（34英里）。

source_text: According to a member of staff at the Port Moresby Geophysical Observatory, minor effects of the quake were felt there, more than South West of the epicenter.
target_text: 根据莫尔兹比港地球物理观测站的一位成员说，当地能感觉到地震的较小影响，但比震中西南方的影响更大一些。

source_text: First reports from the area indicate that the Western parts of New Britain have no power or telecommunications.
target_text: 来自该地区的首批报告表明，新不列颠岛西部地区既没有电力供应，也没有通信联络。

source_text: A report posted in the local language, Tok Pisin by Radio Australia's language service, gives the general location of the quake as Southeast of Madang, and there are no initial reports of any tsunami warnings, and no reports of damage or casualties at press time.
target_text: 在澳大利亚电台语言服务节目用当地的语言托克皮辛语撰写的一份张贴报告中指出，地震的大概位置在马当东南。到发稿时为止，没有接到任何初始海啸预警报告，也没有接到任何损害或伤亡报告。

source_text: A state of emergency was declared in Bahrain on Tuesday by King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa as protests in the country escalated further, leaving at least two dead.
target_text: 随着抗议活动在该国进一步升级并导致至少2人死亡后，巴林国王哈马德·本·伊萨·阿勒哈利法宣布国家进入紧急状态。

source_text: Further protests took place Tuesday in both the capitol of Manama and the nearby city of Sitra.
target_text: 星期二，抗议活动在马纳马国会大厦和临近的锡特拉城两地相继发生。

source_text: Two people were reported to have died, one of whom was part of the Bahraini security force.
target_text: 据报道，2人已经死亡，其中1人是巴林安全部队的成员。

source_text: These deaths come in addition to seven people killed since the protests began in February.
target_text: 除此以外，另有7人已经在2月份的抗议活动中丧生。

source_text: Marches took place near the Saudi Arabian embassy, with protesters wearing masks as a defense against tear gas.
target_text: 抗议队伍佩戴着防催泪瓦斯的面具出现在沙特阿拉伯大使馆附近。

source_text: According to a doctor near the fighting, there are "many, many casualties …"
target_text: 根据冲突发生地附近一位医生的说法，“伤亡非常，非常大……”。

source_text: "People are coming in with bullet wounds and injuries caused by rubber bullets …"
target_text: “人们带着橡皮子弹造成的伤口走进来……”。

source_text: "We received one major case—a man whose skull had been split open by something."
target_text: “我们接收了一位重伤员，他的颅骨被某种器械撕裂了”。

source_text: One protester said that security personnel "started attacking the villages and the towns."
target_text: 一名抗议者说，安全部队人员“开始攻击村庄和城镇”。

source_text: "If there is anybody in the road they will shoot them."
target_text: “只要路上有人，他们就会开枪射击”。

source_text: "If there is nobody in the road they will enter the houses."
target_text: “如果路上没有人，他们就会闯进屋子里来”。

source_text: The declaration comes one day after other Middle Eastern countries sent troops into Bahrain at the request of the Bahraini government.
target_text: 在紧急状态被宣布的前一天，其他中东国家根据巴林政府的要求派部队进入了巴林。

source_text: One virus, Antinny (or Kintama (testicle)-virus) is believed responsible for uploading documents to the filesharing network without first obtaining user permission.
target_text: 有一种叫做Antinny的病毒（或者“睾丸病毒”）能够在不事先获得用户许可的情况下将文件上传至文件共享网络。

source_text: This is believed to be the cause of virus-induced leaks from the police and Defense Agency.
target_text: 据信，这就是导致警方和防卫厅病毒泄密事件的原因。

source_text: The Chief Cabinet Secretary stated in a press interview, "Unless each one bewares and takes counter measures, information leaks cannot be prevented."
target_text: 官房长官在接受新闻采访时说：“除非每一个人都保持警惕并采取反措施，否则就无法阻止信息泄露”。
