source_text: The World Health Organization (WHO) announced Wednesday that an outbreak of viral hemorrhagic fever, caused by Marburg virus, in Angola has claimed the lives of 311 Angolans.
target_text: 世界卫生组织（WHO）于星期三宣布，在安哥拉爆发的，由马尔堡病毒引起的病毒性出血热已经夺去311名安哥拉人的生命。

source_text: The great majority of cases have originated in Uige Province.
target_text: 绝大多数病情起源于威热省。

source_text: WHO estimates that 75% of the cases have occurred in children under the age of 5 years old.
target_text: 据世界卫生组织估计，百分之75的病人是5岁以下的儿童。

source_text: From the WHO: :'Marburg virus disease has no vaccine or curative treatment, and can be rapidly fatal.'
target_text: 该组织说：“马尔堡病毒引起的疾病没有疫苗或治愈性疗法，并可迅速致命”。

source_text: In the present outbreak, most deaths have occurred between 3 to 7 days following the onset of symptoms.'
target_text: 在当前爆发的疫情中，多数患者在症状出现后的3至7天内死亡。

source_text: Past outbreaks indicate that close contact with bodily fluids of infected people, as may occur in health care settings or during burial practices, increases the risk of infection.'
target_text: 根据过去发生的疫情来看，与感染人群发生密切体液接触可增加被感染的风险。这种情况可能会在医疗机构或在殡葬过程中发生。

source_text: This is the largest recorded outbreak of Marburg viral hemorrhagic fever in history.
target_text: 这是有史以来最大的一次马尔堡病毒出血热疫情。

source_text: The risk to international travelers is low, according to the WHO, because the disease requires close personal contact to be transmitted.
target_text: 根据世界卫生组织的说法，对于国际游客来说，风险不大，因为这种疾病需要通过密切的个人接触才能传播。

source_text: San Fernando, Chile — Ten students from the Liceo María Luisa Bombal of Rancagua, O'Higgins Region were detained by the local police yesterday.
target_text: 圣费尔南多，智利。10名来自奥伊金斯将军解放者大区兰卡瓜市玛丽·路易·邦巴尔学校的学生昨日被当地警方拘留。

source_text: At around 08:00 local time (1200 UTC), Leonardo Fuentes, general secretary of the Municipal Educational Corporation of Rancagua, authorized the police to clear out the students.
target_text: 当地时间08：00（世界时12：00）兰卡瓜市教育委员会秘书长列奥纳多·弗恩特斯授权警方将这些学生清除出大楼。

source_text: Student leader Jennifer Olivares told Diario VI Región the police "stripped off [their] clothes" upon their arrival at the police station, Comisaría de Rancagua, something which Lieutenant Colonel of Carabineros Iván Guajardo did not deny.
target_text: 学生领袖简妮弗·奥利瓦尔斯告诉《第六区日报》说，一到兰卡瓜警察局，警察就“剥掉了【他们】的衣服”，武装警察中校伊万·瓜哈多并没有否认这一点。

source_text: However, police stated the students will be charged by the public prosecutor with robbing food from the school.
target_text: 然而，警方声明，这些学生将因为盗窃学校的食品而遭到检察官的起诉。

source_text: Ignacio Muñoz, former leader of the occupation of the Liceo María Luisa Bombal, told El Rancahuaso "the Mayor [Eduardo Soto] promised to begin the reconstruction works last summer, and it's August already and they don't even begin to take the debris outside".
target_text: 伊格纳西奥·米诺斯，占校行动的前领袖，告诉《El Rancahuaso》报社说：“市长【埃德瓦多·索托】承诺于夏天开始重建，现在已经是8月了，他们甚至还没有开始清除废瓦砾”。

source_text: Education Regional Secretary (Seremi de Educación) Pedro Larraín said the government "does not share" such actions, "because they harm education".
target_text: 当地教育秘书佩德罗·拉兰说，政府“不赞同”这类行动，“因为它对教育有伤害”。

source_text: The Region of Libertador General Bernardo O'Higgins was one of the first in 2012 to resuscitate the previous year's student protests, more specifically at the Liceo Industrial de San Fernando, which was taken control by the students in late July, and which as of yesterday was still taken.
target_text: 奥伊金斯将军解放者大区是第一批于2012年恢复学生抗议活动的地区之一。更具体地说，是在圣费尔南多工业学校。该校在7月末被学生控制，而且直至昨日仍在学生们的控制之下。

source_text: As of August 11, eight high schools have been taken control of by students, in response to the government's failure to satisfy the secondary and university students' requests.
target_text: 至8月11日为止，由于政府未能满足高中生和大学生的要求，学生们已经占领了8所高级中学。

source_text: Belarusian Prime Minister Sergei Sidorsky has been sacked by President Alexander Lukashenko after a cabinet reshuffle following last week's disputed Presidential election.
target_text: 在上周因总统选举而发生争议后进行的内阁改组中，白俄罗斯总理谢尔盖·西多尔斯基被总统亚历山大·卢卡申科解除职务。

source_text: His successor is Mikhail Myasnikovich, a former Deputy Prime Minister of Belarus back in the 1990s.
target_text: 继任者是米哈伊尔·米亚斯尼科维奇，一位在1990年代任职的前白俄罗斯副总理。

source_text: Sidorsky was the Prime Minister of Belarus since July of 2003 when he was appointed by President Lukashenko.
target_text: 自从2003年7月接受卢卡申科总统的任命以来，西多尔斯基一直担任总理。

source_text: He is Belarus' longest serving Prime Minister, having served over seven years.
target_text: 他担任总理7年多，是白俄罗斯任职最长的总理。

source_text: Before that he was Deputy Prime Minister from 2001 to 2002.
target_text: 在那以前，他曾于2001年至2002年间担任副总理。

source_text: This comes a week after the Presidential election which saw the re-election of the incumbent Alexander Lukashenko who has ruled Belarus since the establishment of the office in 1994.
target_text: 此事发生在总统选举结束一周以后。现任总统卢卡申科再次当选。自从1994年设置了总统这个职位以来，他一直统治着白俄罗斯。

source_text: Following the elections, an estimated 600 people were detained by the government, including 11 Russian nationals.
target_text: 选举结束以后，估计有600人被政府拘留，其中包括11名俄罗斯公民。

source_text: Australian Prime Minister John Howard will visit Banda Aceh this afternoon.
target_text: 澳大利亚总理约翰·霍华德下午将访问班达亚齐市。

source_text: He will visit the hospital which reopened recently with the help of Australian and German military doctors, and also take a helicopter tour of tsunami-ravaged coastal areas.
target_text: 他将参观一家在澳大利亚和德国军医帮助下于近日重新恢复运行的医院，并将乘坐直升机视察被海啸摧毁的沿岸地区。

source_text: He will also hold talks with senior Indonesian ministers who are overseeing relief efforts.
target_text: 他还将与正在监督赈灾工作的印尼高级部长们会谈。

source_text: Australia has committed AUD$1 Billion in aid over five years to the tsunami recovery, it's largest ever foreign aid program.
target_text: 澳大利亚承诺在5年内提供10亿澳元的海啸恢复款。这是该国有史以来最大的一个对外援助项目。

source_text: Exactly one year since the popular Suprnova BitTorrent link site went offline, its founder, Andrej Preston (known as "Sloncek" to the Internet community), has spoken out about what happened on his website.
target_text: 自从颇受欢迎的 Supprenova BitTorrent链节网站下线以来，至今整整一年了。该网站的创始人安德雷伊·普莱斯顿（互联网界称之为“Sloncek”）终于说出他的网站当时发生了什么事情。

source_text: After twelve months of speculation amongst former users and many sites popping up to try and take its place, Preston says "it is time for everybody to know the truth and that it is time for me to stop pretending like nothing ever happened".
target_text: 在过去12个月里，前用户们一直在猜测，同时也有许多网站跳了出来企图取代其地位。普莱斯顿说：“到了让每一个人都了解真相的时候了，我也不能再装作什么事也没有发生过”。

source_text: According to Preston his nightmare began in November, 2004 when he received a phonecall from his ISP stating that Preston's servers had just been raided.
target_text: 根据普莱斯顿的说法，他的噩梦开始于2004年11月。当时他接到了网络服务商的一个电话，说是普莱斯顿的服务器刚才遭到了袭击。

source_text: Preston claims that at this time he had no communication from the police.
target_text: 普莱斯顿声称当时警方并没有联系他。

source_text: After reading about himself in various Slovenian newspapers in early December, Preston decided to take his suprnova.org site offline.
target_text: 到了11月初，当他看到各种斯洛文尼亚报纸关于他的报道后，普莱斯顿决定将他的suprnova.org网站下线。

source_text: At the same time another project Preston was involved in eXeem was touted as being the biggest thing to happen to file sharing.
target_text: 同时，另一个普莱斯顿参与开发的项目eXeem却被吹捧为文件共享方面发生的最重大事件。

source_text: Preston claims that a month or so after his site went offline his home was raided by the police at 6:30 in the morning.
target_text: 普莱斯顿声称，在他的网站下线后一个月左右的时候，警方在早晨6：30突然查抄了他的家。

source_text: Preston was then called into the local police unit another month later for a hearing.
target_text: 直到又过了一个月以后，普莱斯顿被召到当地警察部队进行听证。

source_text: Preston, on the advice of his lawyer decided he would not answer anything during the interview with the police.
target_text: 根据律师的建议，普莱斯顿决定在与警方的会面中不回答任何问题。

source_text: At the conclusion of the interview Preston was told that the matter would be handed over to the prosecutor.
target_text: 在会面结束时，普莱斯顿被告知，这件事将移交给检察官。

source_text: Preston recalls that on October 18, 2005 he received a notice to go to the post office and pick up another letter which he must sign for.
target_text: 普莱斯顿回忆道，2005年10月18日，他接到通知，要求他去邮局取另一封信，而且必须在信上签名。

source_text: Upon receiving the notice Preston says that he "became completely depressed and sad".
target_text: 接到这份通知后，普莱斯顿说他“沮丧和悲伤透了”。

source_text: Preston however was greeted with good news at the post office when he opened the letter and discovered that his matter had been dropped.
target_text: 然而，在邮局里等待普莱斯顿的却是一个好消息。他拆开信件一看，发现他的案子已经被撤销了。

source_text: Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas of Fatah, Prime Minister Ismail Haniyeh and Damascus-based chief Khaled Meshaal ofHamas arrived in Mecca, Saudi Arabia for negotiations in an attempt to end the fighting between Hamas and Fatah in the Gaza strip.
target_text: 巴勒斯坦总统，法塔赫的马哈茂德·阿巴斯、总理伊斯梅尔·哈尼亚，以及哈马斯大马士革首领哈立德·迈沙阿勒到达沙特阿拉伯的麦加城进行谈判，试图结束哈马斯与法塔赫之间在加沙地带的战争。

source_text: Ever since the Hamas movement, which refuses to recognize Israel and stop attacks on Israel, won elections for the Palestinian parliament last year, there have been repeated clashes between the two groups.
target_text: 自从拒绝承认以色列并拒绝停止攻击以色列的哈马斯运动去年赢得了巴勒斯坦议会选举后，在这两个组织之间不断发生冲突。

source_text: The result has been over 80 deaths.
target_text: 至今已导致80多人死亡。

source_text: Saudi Arabia’s King Abdullah called the talks in order to stop the violence and help both sides to come to an agreement and establish some sort of unity government.
target_text: 沙特国王阿卜杜拉呼吁进行这次谈判，以便停止暴力行动，帮助双方达成协议，并成立某种联合政府。

source_text: Hamas and Fatah officials said they hoped the leaders would come together for a meeting with King Abdullah later on Tuesday night.
target_text: 哈马斯和法塔赫官员都表示，他们希望领导人能在星期二晚上与阿卜杜拉国王坐在一起协商。

source_text: The leaders are expected to take a pilgrimage to the Grand Mosque in Mecca, Islam's holiest site, before opening talks, which are expected to continue on Wednesday.
target_text: 预期这些领导人们将在开始会谈之前去伊斯兰教的圣地麦加大清真寺朝圣，然后于星期三继续会谈。

source_text: The United States and the European Union have labelled Hamas a terrorist organization and have blocked financial aid until the movement recognizes Israel and agrees to uphold previous agreements with Israel signed by the Palestinian Authority.
target_text: 美国和欧盟均给哈马斯贴上了恐怖主义组织的标签，并冻结了资金援助，直到该组织承认以色列并同意执行此前巴勒斯坦当局与以色列签订的协议为止。

source_text: Senior Abbas aide, Azzam al-Ahmad, said the talks would aim to persuade Hamas to accept the program of the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO), which would involve an implicit Hamas recognition of Israel that could end the aid blockade.
target_text: 阿巴斯的高级助手，阿扎姆·埃尔·阿哈默德说，谈判的目标是要说服哈马斯接受巴勒斯坦解放组织（PLO）的计划，包括哈马斯对以色列的默认，从而结束援助被冻结的状态。

source_text: If indeed such a government can be formed it will allow the resumption of negotiations between Israel and the Palestinians that were stopped in 2003.
target_text: 如果确实能够组成这样一个政府，那么将可能导致以色列与巴勒斯坦恢复在2003年被中断的双边谈判。

source_text: Previous attempts to negotiate an agreement between the two Palestinian groups have ended in cease- fire that have lasted only a short time.
target_text: 此前在这两个巴勒斯坦组织之间曾经通过谈判形成过协议，并导致了短暂的停火。

source_text: Rick DiPietro stopped 35 of 36 shots as the New York Islanders defeated the Pittsburgh Penguins 3-1 Thursday night, snapping a three game losing streak and DiPietro's career high 31st win of the season.
target_text: 星期四晚上，里克·迪皮埃特罗阻止了36次射门中的35次，使得纽约岛人队以3-1的比分战胜了匹兹堡企鹅队，终止了三连败。迪皮埃特罗创造了本赛季获胜31次的职业生涯纪录。

source_text: It was a frustrating game for the Penguins, as they were unable to convert 0 of 6 power play attempts.
target_text: 对于企鹅队来说，那是一次令人沮丧的比赛，因为面对对手的6次强攻，他们一次也未能扭转局面。

source_text: Colby Armstrong scored the game's first goal, assisted by Gary Roberts and Sergei Gonchar, to give the Penguins the early lead.
target_text: 科尔比·阿姆斯特朗在加里·罗伯茨和谢尔盖·贡查尔的配合下攻进了第一个球，企鹅队领先。

source_text: After Armstrong scored, the Islanders' defense tightened, and would not give up another goal.
target_text: 阿姆斯特朗得分后，岛人队加强了防守，没有让对手再次得分。

source_text: Trent Hunter scored a goal on an Islanders power play 2:37 into the 2nd period, assisted by Miroslav Satan and Chris Campoli.
target_text: 在比赛第二段2分37秒的时候，岛人队发动强攻，特伦特·亨特在米罗斯拉夫·萨坦和克里斯·坎伯里的配合下得分。

source_text: Less than three minutes later, Jason Blake would notch his 36th of the year, beating Penguins goalie Marc-Andre Fleury.
target_text: 不到三分钟以后，杰森·布雷克创造了他本年度第36个进球，超过了企鹅队的得分手马克·安德烈·弗勒里。

source_text: New York would seal the deal at 1:42 in the 3rd period when Viktor Kozlov scored his 22nd goal of the season, with Alexei Yashin and Miroslav Satan assisting on the play.
target_text: 在第三段1分42秒，就在纽约队即将奠定胜局的时刻，维克托·科兹洛夫在阿列克谢·亚辛和米罗斯拉夫·萨坦的配合下完成了他本赛季第22个进球。

source_text: SpaceX Corporation launched its Falcon I rocket today from Kwajalein Atoll.
target_text: 太空探索公司今天从夸贾林环礁发射了第一枚“猎鹰一号”火箭。

source_text: The first stage was completely successful, although there appeared to be some problems with the second stage.
target_text: 飞行的第一阶段完全成功，虽然第二段似乎出了一些问题。

source_text: The sub-orbital flight reached an altitude of 300 km, and is on a traectory for re-entry.
target_text: 这次亚轨道飞行达到了300公里的高度，现在正处于重返大气层的轨道上。

source_text: This is the second launch for the low-cost SpaceX rocket, and the first successful launch for the company.
target_text: 这是低成本SpaceX火箭的第二次发射，也是该公司第一次成功发射。

source_text: The previous launch had a successful lift-off, but failed 35 seconds into the flight and crashed near to the launch pad due to a fuel leak in the engine.
target_text: 此前那次发射虽然成功地升空，但是由于引擎发生燃油泄漏，起飞后35秒钟即坠落在发射台附近。

source_text: At some time before 11 AM, local time, a fire started in Bar Apache on the popular Phi Phi Island in Thailand.
target_text: 当地时间不到上午11点，泰国披披岛阿帕奇酒吧内发生了火灾。

source_text: By eleven it had spread to neighbouring shops and restaurants along the main road.
target_text: 到11点时，火势已沿着主路蔓延到临近的商场和饭店。

source_text: Since there is no fire brigade on Phi Phi, locals and tourists formed a bucket chain to help put out the fire.
target_text: 由于披披岛上没有消防队，当地居民和游客拎着水桶排队帮助灭火。

source_text: An eye witness, Simon Vestling, says there were over 300 people helping out with putting out the fire and tearing down buildings.
target_text: 目击者西蒙·韦斯特林说，有300人参加了灭火和拆除建筑物的行动。

source_text: To stop the fire from spreading to other nearby buildings, which are closely grouped together, they were forced to pull some of them down using nothing but man power.
target_text: 为了防止火势蔓延到其他密集分布在附近的建筑物，他们不得不将其中的一些房屋拆除，没有工具，只能依靠人力。

source_text: Boats were brought over from local Krabi Island in case an evacuation was needed, but that was not the case.
target_text: 从当地的甲米岛调来了船只，准备在一旦需要的时候进行人员转移，但是并没有发生这种情况。

source_text: The debate over whether Australians should be required to have a national identity card has been reignited following an announcement by Attorney-General Phillip Ruddock yesterday that a study will be conducted.
target_text: 在澳大利亚司法部长菲利普·拉多克昨天宣布将进行一项相关研究后，关于澳大利亚人是否应该被要求拥有国民身份证的争论被再次激起。

source_text: The concept is not new, being first floated by Bob Hawke in 1986.
target_text: 这个概念并不新鲜，最早由鲍勃·霍克于1986年提出。

source_text: The idea was abandoned after being defeated in the Australian Senate and due to strong criticism.
target_text: 在澳大利亚参议院中失败并受到强烈抨击之后，这个想法被放弃了。

source_text: The government cites terrorism and fraud protection as needs for a universal national identity system.
target_text: 政府提及恐怖主义与诈骗保护，以作为对国民身份证系统的需求的佐证。

source_text: The opposition remains neutral on the proposal, saying only that cost and privacy would be major issues.
target_text: 反对派对该提案保持中立，只说成本和隐私将成为主要问题。

source_text: The Australian Chamber of Commerce and Industry, which represents big business in Australia has voiced its opposition to the plan claiming the system could cost $750 per person to introduce, most of which would be borne by big business.
target_text: 代表澳大利亚大企业的澳大利亚工商会则表示反对该计划，称采用该计划将带来每人750美元的支出，而其中的绝大多数都将由大企业来承担。

source_text: Wikinews has learned that the Islamic Republic of Iran Broadcasting (IRIB) website has been hacked and is suffering from an apparent Distributed denial-of-service attack (DDoS).
target_text: 维基新闻了解到，伊朗伊斯兰共和国广播（IRIB）网站遭到了黑客入侵，并遭受明显的分布式拒绝服务攻击（DDoS）。

source_text: As of this report, the main IRIB website could be reached.
target_text: 截至本报告，IRIB主页已恢复并可访问。

source_text: Just after 6:00 p.m. (EDT) the site came back online with only a few connection issues.
target_text: 美国东部时间下午6点过后，该网站在仍存在一些连接问题的情况下重新上线。

source_text: On further investigation, it was discovered that an individual or group claims responsibility for attacking the website on an Iranian internet forum.
target_text: 经过进一步调查，发现个人或团体声称有责任在伊朗互联网论坛上攻击该网站。

source_text: The page also contains the statement "hacked by the Iranian people."
target_text: 该页面还包含“被伊朗人民攻击”的声明。

source_text: It was also discovered that citizens have set up internet channels on IRC in an attempt to disseminate proxy servers and addresses to bypass the blocking of the internet by the Iranian government.
target_text: 还发现公民已经在IRC上建立了互联网渠道，试图传播代理服务器和地址，以绕过伊朗政府对互联网的屏蔽。

source_text: The Iranian government has blocked access to the Internet, or access to websites, in nearly all of Iran.
target_text: 伊朗政府已在几乎在整个伊朗对互联网接入和站点访问进行了屏蔽。

source_text: A partial list of blocked websites includes Facebook, BBC, and several Iranian based websites.
target_text: 部分被屏蔽网站列表包括Facebook，BBC和几个位于伊朗的网站。

source_text: "We launched an operation to neutralise heavy weapons Gbagbo's special forces have been using against the civilian population for the last three months."
target_text: “我们发起了一项行动，以摧毁近三个月以来巴博的特种部队一直在对平民使用的重型武器。”

source_text: "We destroyed them in four locations", said spokesman Hamadoun Toure in an email.
target_text: “我们对他们中的四处进行了摧毁”，发言人哈玛德·图雷在一封电子邮件中说。

source_text: In concert with the UN, France has deployed an additional 350 peacekeepers to compliment its 7,500 troops already in the country.
target_text: 在于联合国互相协助之下，法国已经增派了350名维和人员，以对已经部署在该国的7500人的部队进行增援。

source_text: The recent violence in Ivory Coast stems from Gbagbo's refusal to accept his loss in the recent presidential elections.
target_text: 最近在象牙海岸发生的暴力事件源于巴博拒绝承认其在总统选举上的失败。

source_text: He has stated that he will not transfer power to his successor Alassane Ouattara, the declared winner.
target_text: 他表示他不会将权力移交给他的继任者阿拉萨内·瓦塔拉。

source_text: Gbagbo's spokesman, Abdon George Bayeto, told the BBC the elections were rigged as an "international plot against the incumbent" and was going to continue fighting forces loyal to Ouattara.
target_text: 巴博的发言人阿布顿·乔治·拜托告诉BBC，选举被视为“反对现任者的国际阴谋”，并将继续与支持瓦塔拉的武装力量对抗。

source_text: Lieutenant Jean-Marc Tago of the Ivory Coast army announced the return of General Phillippe Mangou.
target_text: 象牙海岸军队中尉让·马克·塔戈宣布菲利普·曼古将军回归。

source_text: British foreign secretary William Hague said in a statement, "We call for an end to the violence, for defeated former president Gbagbo to step down, for all human rights abuses to be investigated, and for the International Criminal Court to investigate the crimes which appear to have taken place."
target_text: 英国外交大臣威廉·黑格在一份声明中说：“我们呼吁结束暴力，让落选的前总统巴博下台，对所有侵犯人权行为进行调查，并要求国际刑事法庭对所发生的罪行进行调查。”

source_text: The crisis has created a humanitarian problem as one million of Abidjan's four million people has been displaced.
target_text: 这场危机造成了人道主义问题，阿比让的400万人口中有100万人流离失所。

source_text: State officials in Queensland, Australia, have begun working on a draft protocol to use security cameras to record conversations in taxis.
target_text: 澳大利亚昆士兰州的官员已经开始制定议定书草案，使用安全摄像头记录出租车内的对话。

source_text: The new draft proposes to change a current policy which allows for cameras in taxis which do not record sound for privacy reasons, in the hope that audio recordings will make some investigations easier.
target_text: 新草案建议改变目前的政策，出租车中的摄像机不再出于隐私原因而不录制声音，希望录音能使一些调查变得更容易。

source_text: The paper, which says audio recordings would "provide greater certainty with regard to investigations, particularly in situation of conflicting statements," is currently at the Transport and Main Roads department.
target_text: 该文件称音频录音将“在调查方面提供更大的确定性，特别是在声明冲突的情况下”，该文件目前在运输及主要道路部。

source_text: The chairman of one taxi company said the proposed measure would increase the safety of his drivers.
target_text: 一家出租车公司的主席表示，该草案的措施将增加司机的安全。

source_text: "In 2006 the government introduced the security cameras and most cabs now have GPS units," he said.
target_text: “2006年，政府推出了安全摄像头，现在大多数出租车都配备了GPS装置，”他说。

source_text: Queensland Taxi Advisers Incorporated, a union of taxi operators, said they supported the introduction of audio recording because it would create "greater transparency and certainty in investigations where there were conflicting statements from drivers and passengers."
target_text: 出租车运营商联盟，昆士兰出租车顾问公司表示，他们支持音频录音的引入，因为它会在司机和乘客声明冲突的情况下创造“更大的透明度和确定性。”

source_text: To address privacy concerns, the paper proposes to add stickers to the entry points at the taxis.
target_text: 为了解决隐私问题，该草案建议在出租车的入口处添加提示贴纸。

source_text: Scott Emerson, a spokesperson for the Liberal National Party of Queensland, objected to the measure on privacy grounds.
target_text: 昆士兰自由国家党发言人斯科特·爱默生则以隐私为由反对该措施。

source_text: Michael Cope, the president of the Queensland Council of Civil Liberties said he opposed the measure because the recordings might be used by taxi companies in civil cases concerning driver complaints.
target_text: 昆士兰民权理事会主席迈克尔·科普表示，他反对这项措施，因为出租车公司可能会在涉及司机投诉的民事案件中使用这些录音。

source_text: "We're swapping from saying it's about safety to saying it's about setting fare disputes," he said.
target_text: 他说：“我们所说的并不是安全问题，而是将引起的票价纠纷。”

source_text: "We don't think that justifies collecting ... intensely personal information that audio recordings collect."
target_text: “我认为这并不足以支持使用录音来收集相应的个人信息。”

source_text: Queensland's privacy commissioner Linda Matthews reacted said the recordings would be used for genuine law enforcement purposes.
target_text: 昆士兰州的隐私专员琳达·马休斯表示，这些录音将被用于真正的执法目的。

source_text: Annastacia Palaszczuk, Queensland's Transport Minister, said the ideas within the proposal would be heavily considered before being implemented.
target_text: 昆士兰州交通部长安娜斯塔西亚·帕拉斯祖克表示，草案中的观点将在实施前得到认真考虑。

source_text: She said: "If people think it's a good idea then we go to full consultation."
target_text: 她说：“如果人们认为这是个好主意，那我们将会进行全面磋商。”

source_text: "I would be meeting with the privacy commissioner, I'd be meeting with the taxi industry, I'd be consulting with members of the public in a much more formal way."
target_text: “我将与隐私专员会面，我将与出租车行业会面，我将以更正式的方式与公众进行磋商。”

source_text: The animated series Family Guy returned to the FOX television network with a new episode Sunday for the first time since it was taken off the schedule three years ago.
target_text: 动画片《恶搞之家》系列于周日首次回归福克斯电视网，这是自三年前其被取消播放后的首次。

source_text: Although the show kept most of its audience that lead-in The Simpsons gave, FOX was still fourth out of five major broadcast networks in the half-hour, losing most notably to ABC's hit Desperate Housewives (UPN, the other major American broadcast network, does not air original programming on Sundays).
target_text: 尽管这部剧保留了《辛普森一家》的大部分观众，但福克斯在半小时内仍然在五大广播电视网中仅排名第四名，明显落后于美国广播公司热播的《绝望主妇》（UPN，美国其他主要广播网络，不会在周日播放原创节目）。

source_text: "Sweeps" occurs four times a year and helps networks and independent affiliates determine how much a fixed amount of time for commercial advertisement will cost (the higher the ratings, the more revenue for the networks selling the time to advertisers).
target_text: “扫描”每年进行四次，帮助网络和独立的附属机构确定商业广告的固定时间（评分越高，网络向广告商出售时间的收入越多）。

source_text: On the whole, Family Guy averaged a 6.3 rating in the overnights as posted by Zap2It.
target_text: 整体上来说，Zap2it公布的《恶搞之家》的平均夜间评分为6.3分。

source_text: While the overnight ratings are fairly accurate, the numbers are preliminary and are subject to minor change.
target_text: 虽然夜间评分相当准确，但这些数字是初步的，并且会有微小的变化。

source_text: One ratings point is equal to 1,096,000 households, as there are now 109,600,000 households in the United States with at least one television.
target_text: 一个评分点等于1,096,000户，因为现在美国至少有109,600,000户家庭拥有电视。

source_text: This translates into a little more than 6.9 million households whose sets were tuned into Family Guy, as recorded by the sample of "Nielsen families," who record their viewing habits and contribute to the ratings process the US uses.
target_text: 这就意味着超过690万个家庭的在通过电视机观看《恶搞之家》，该数据由长年记录美国观众的观看习惯，并为美国收视率进程做出贡献的“尼尔森家庭”采样记录。

source_text: The use of the word "share" in the article means that it is the rough percentage of viewers with their sets on at that hour tuning into a certain program.
target_text: 文章中的“份额”一词指一个粗略的百分比，即观众在特定的时间将电视调至某个节目的比率。

source_text: For example, nine percent of viewers in the United States with their televisions on at 9 P.M. Eastern Daylight Time were tuned to Family Guy.
target_text: 例如，有百分之9的美国观众在美国东部时间晚上9点时观看《恶搞之家》。

source_text: This only added up to a 9 household share for the hour, compared to an 11 share for Law & Order: Criminal Intent on NBC, a 14 share for a CBS Hallmark Hall of Fame movie of the week (traditionally only aired during the key sweeps periods), and a 23 share for the aforementioned Desperate Housewives.
target_text: 这个小时仅增加了9个家庭份额，相比之下，国家广播公司的《法律与秩序：犯罪倾向》拥有11个份额，哥伦比亚广播公司的《贺轩名人殿堂：本周电影》（传统上仅在关键扫描期间播出）拥有14个份额，而之前所提及的《绝望主妇》则拥有23个份额。

source_text: Averaged with the performance of American Dad, a cartoon produced by Family Guy creator Seth MacFarlane, FOX earned a mere 5.8 rating/9 share for the hour.
target_text: 《恶搞之家》，与其创造者塞斯·麦克法兰的另一部动画《美国老爸》，仅为福克斯带来了平均5.8的评分与9个份额。

source_text: The episode revolved around a big scheme Peter Griffin, the main character of the series, conjured.
target_text: 这一集围绕着皮特·格里芬、该系列的主角的一个神奇大计划展开。

source_text: To give his wife Lois (who no longer finds him sexually attractive) a second honeymoon in order to "spice up" their love life, he pretends to be actor Mel Gibson so they can stay in a new luxury hotel for free.
target_text: 为了给他的妻子路易斯（不再认为他有任何性吸引力）第二次度蜜月以“为他们的爱情生活增添情趣”，他假装成演员梅尔·吉布森，以便让他们可以免费入住一家新的豪华酒店。

source_text: Peter stumbles upon a sequel to the film The Passion of the Christ, and vows to keep the movie from ever seeing the light of day.
target_text: 皮特偶然发现了电影《耶稣受难记》的续集，并誓言要让这部影片永不见天日。

source_text: To get the movie back, Gibson kidnaps Lois and keeps her captive on top of Mount Rushmore, which leads to a scene in which the three battle on top of the monument, in a homage to the film North by Northwest.
target_text: 为了让电影回归，吉布森绑架了路易斯并将她俘虏在拉什莫尔山顶上，进而引发了向电影《西北偏北》致敬的总统山之战的场景。

source_text: The London bomb suspect, Hussain Osman, also known as Hamdi Issac, has arrived in London and been arrested following his extradition from Italy.
target_text: 伦敦爆炸案嫌犯侯赛因·奥斯曼，化名哈姆迪·伊萨克，在从意大利被逮捕并引渡后，已被押解至伦敦。

source_text: Allegedly involved in the second set of attacks on London in July, which targeted the city's public transport infrastructure, Osman was arrested in Rome by Italian police on July 29, just one week after the failed attacks.
target_text: 据称，奥斯曼在7月参与了针对伦敦公共交通基础设施的第二次袭击，7月29日，在袭击失败一周后，意大利警方在罗马逮捕了奥斯曼。

source_text: On September 13, a final appeal against extradition was rejected by an Italian court despite his lawyer's protests that he could not get a fair trial in the UK.
target_text: 9月13日，意大利法院驳回了针对引渡的最终上诉，尽管他的律师抗议称他在英国无法得到公正的审判。

source_text: Osman is accused of planting the failed bomb at Shepherd's Bush Underground station.
target_text: 奥斯曼被指控在牧羊丛地铁站安放了未能引爆的炸弹。

source_text: His flight subsequent to the attack proved futile as phone records led police to Rome, and a raid on his brother's apartment, where he was captured.
target_text: 袭击发生后，他的乘机逃离被证明是徒劳的，警方通过电话记录将线索锁定在罗马，在那里对其哥哥的住所进行突袭，并将其逮捕。

source_text: Pending his extradition, he was held at Rebibbia jail, Rome, a high-security facility on the outskirts of the city.
target_text: 在被引渡之前，他被关押在罗马的里比比亚监狱，这是该市郊区的一个高级安全设施。

source_text: Flying on a chartered private jet, Osman and his escort landed at RAF Northolt, where Osman was charged on arrival.
target_text: 奥斯曼与随行人员乘坐一架包机降落在英国皇家空军诺霍特机场，奥斯曼在抵达同时被指控。

source_text: He is expected to be put on trial at the Old Bailey in London, alongside the other suspects involved in the failed attacks.
target_text: 预计他将在伦敦老贝利，与其他参与袭击未遂的嫌疑人一起接受审判。

source_text: Bob Woolmer, Pakistan's cricket coach died at a university hospital in Kingston, Jamaica earlier today.
target_text: 巴基斯坦板球教练鲍勃·伍尔默今天早些时候在牙买加金斯顿的一所大学医院中去世。

source_text: Woolmer was found unconscious in his room at the Pegasus Hotel at 10:45 Sunday morning, only hours after Pakistan's Cricket World Cup exit at the hands of Ireland.
target_text: 周日上午10点45分，就在巴基斯坦队的板球世界杯之旅被爱尔兰队终结几小时后，伍尔默被发现不省人事地躺在帕加索斯酒店的房间里。

source_text: After being found by hotel workers in his room, he was rushed to the emergency department at the University Hospital in Kingston, but doctors where not able to save him.
target_text: 在被酒店工作人员发现后，他被紧急送往金斯敦大学医院的急诊科，但医生们没能挽救他的生命。

source_text: Team spokesman Parvez Mir reported that when he was found "He had blood on him and there was vomit on the walls."
target_text: 球队发言人帕维兹·米尔称，当他被发现时，“身上有血，墙上有呕吐物。”

source_text: Mir also told media that Woolmer suffered from a medical condition, but that it was too early to decide whether or not it had anything to do with his death.
target_text: 米尔还告诉媒体，伍尔默患有疾病，但现在判断它是否与他的死有关还为时尚早。

source_text: Woolmer played 19 Tests for England and was the coach for Warwickshire and South Africa before becoming coach for Pakistan in 2004.
target_text: 在2004年成为巴基斯坦队教练之前，伍尔默曾在英格兰队参加过19场测试赛，并曾担任沃里克郡队和南非队的教练。

source_text: He was to remain coach until after the 2007 World Cup, and was tipped to replace Duncan Fletcher as the coach of England after his contract with the PCB expired.
target_text: 在2007世界杯结束之前，他本将一直担任巴基斯坦队教练，并在与巴基斯坦队的合同到期后，他将取代邓肯·弗莱彻成为英格兰队教练。

source_text: Croatia's ruling Democratic Union (HDZ) party expelled the former prime minister Ivo Sanader following his political comeback Sunday.
target_text: 克罗地亚执政党的民主联盟在前总理伊沃·萨纳德于周日重返政坛后将其驱逐出党。

source_text: Of twenty two members of the party presidency, 16 voted for expulsion, three were against (Luka Bebić, Mario Zubović and Damir Polančec) and two abstained (Bianca Matković and Petar Selem).
target_text: 在该党主席团22名成员中，16人赞成驱逐，3人反对（卢卡·贝比，马里奥·祖博维和达米尔·波兰·埃克），2人弃权（比安卡·马特科维和佩塔·塞勒姆）。

source_text: Mr. Sanader declared he would be returning to a more active role in politics, stating that his decision to withdraw was a mistake, and that the HDZ is a "winning party and not a party that wins 12% of the vote", a remark made in connection with the first round of the presidential election held one week before, in which HDZ's candidate didn't score well.
target_text: 萨纳德先生曾宣布他将以更加积极的形象回归政坛，他表示决定退出政坛是一个错误，并表示民主联盟是“是一个胜利党派，而不是那种只能赢的百分之12选票的党派”，这句话，这与一周前举行的第一轮总统选举有关，其中民主联盟的候选人支持率不高。

source_text: He was supported by a dozen HDZ MPs, including the president of the parliament, Bebić.
target_text: 他得到了十几个民主联盟议员的支持，其中包括议会议长贝比奇。

source_text: Several of those MPs later disclaimed any association with Sanader and claimed they were misled.
target_text: 其中一些议员后来否认与萨纳德有任何关联并声称他们被误导了。

source_text: Sanader quit from his PM position in July last year, vowing to quit politics for good, also.
target_text: 去年7月，萨纳德辞去总理职位，并誓言要退出政坛。

source_text: He held the post since the 2003 parliamentary elections, and it was during his government that Croatia entered NATO.
target_text: 自2003年议会选举以来，他一直担任该职务，并且在他执政期间，克罗地亚加入了北约。

source_text: Australian Prime Minister Kevin Rudd announced today that the HSK Kormoran has been located approximately 112 nautical miles off Steep Point Western Australia.
target_text: 澳大利亚总理陆克文今天宣布，HSK科莫兰号被发现于西澳大利亚州陡坡附近约112海里。

source_text: Sonar imagery of the Kormoran shows the site consists of two main pieces at a depth of 2560 metres.
target_text: 声纳图像显示，科莫兰号的沉没地点由两个主要部分组成，深度为2560米。

source_text: A debris field 4 nautical miles south of the wreck believed to be the site of the battle.
target_text: 在沉船以南4海里处的碎片场被认为是战斗的地点。

source_text: The Kormoran (HSK 8) was a German auxiliary cruiser of Kriegsmarine during World War II.
target_text: 科莫兰号（HSK8）是第二次世界大战德国帝国海军的一艘辅助巡洋舰。

source_text: On November 19, 1941, the Kormoran encountered the HMAS Sydney.
target_text: 1941年11月19日，科莫兰号遭遇了HMAS悉尼号。

source_text: The resulting battle saw the Sydney sunk with the loss of all 645 hands, the Kormoran was scuttled by the crew with the loss of 60, 320 survivors including three Chinese prisoners of war were rescued.
target_text: 这场战斗的结果是，悉尼号沉没，舰上645人全部阵亡，科莫兰号遭其船员抛弃，阵亡60人，包括三名中国战俘在内的320名幸存者获救。

source_text: The loss of the Sydney has been the subject of much controversy, speculation and conspiracy theory.
target_text: 失去悉尼号一直是争议、猜测和阴谋论的主题。

source_text: There have been many searches for the two vessels, this latest search is by the "Finding Sydney Foundation".
target_text: 这两艘船的搜索次数很多，最近的搜索是“寻找悉尼号基金会”。

source_text: "Finding the Kormoran is one big step forward," said Prime Minister Rudd.
target_text: “找到科莫兰号是向前迈出的一大步，”陆克文总理说。

source_text: "This is an important part in resolving a 65 year old puzzle."
target_text: “这是解决这个长达65年谜团的重要部分。”

source_text: Warren Snowdon Minister for Defense Science and Personnel said that the Federal Republic of Germany has been advised of the discovery and that the site is to be protected.
target_text: 沃伦斯诺登国防科学和人事部长说，德意志联邦共和国已被告知这一发现，沉船遗址将受到保护。

source_text: Finding Sydney Foundation Chairman Ted Graham says the search area for the Sydney can now be narrowed down to 300 nautical miles.
target_text: 寻找悉尼号基金会主席泰德·格雷厄姆说，悉尼号的搜索区域现在可以缩小到300海里。

source_text: "So if we hadn't found Kormoron it would have made it much more difficult"
target_text: “所以，如果我们没有找到科莫兰号，这会让它变得更加困难”。

source_text: Friday marks the 50th anniversary of a mining disaster which occured in Lanarkshire, Scotland on September 18, 2009, killing 47 miners.
target_text: 本周五，2009年9月18日，是苏格兰拉纳克郡采矿灾难50周年，此次矿难造成47名矿工死亡。

source_text: Scotland's First Minister Alex Salmond MSP unveiled a bronze statue and a memorial garden in Moodiesburn on Sunday in front of a crowd of approximately 600.
target_text: 苏格兰首席部长亚历克斯·萨尔蒙德MSP周日在约600人的人群面前，在穆迪斯本为一尊青铜雕像和一座纪念花园揭幕。

source_text: At roughly 0700 BST on September 18, 1959, 47 men who were working in Auchengeich Collery in North Lanarkshire, Scotland were overcome by smoke as they were walking down to start work.
target_text: 在英国夏时令1959年9月18日大约07：00，在苏格兰北拉纳克郡的奥辛盖希煤矿工作的47名男子在下井作业时被浓烟所困。

source_text: They were subsequently killed after being trapped by a fire in the mine which prevented them from escaping.
target_text: 他们被矿井中的大火所围困，无法逃离，相继死去。

source_text: At the time, a decision had been made to flood the pit after attempts to rescue the men failed.
target_text: 与此同时，当尝试营救的努力失败后，人们决定了淹没矿坑。

source_text: It transpired that the fire was caused by an electrical fault 1,000 ft below the surface.
target_text: 据了解，火灾是由地表以下1000英尺的电气故障引起的。

source_text: First Minister Salmond unveiled a memorial garden and a bronze statue which had been placed to mark the 50th anniversary of the incident.
target_text: 第一部长萨尔蒙德公布了一座纪念花园和一座青铜雕像，这座雕像是为纪念这一事件发生50周年而设立的。

source_text: A religious service was carried out from Bishop Joseph Devine.
target_text: 约瑟夫迪瓦恩主教举办了宗教仪式。

source_text: Tom Clarke, MP for Chryston and Bellshill, also attended the event.
target_text: 克莱斯顿与贝尔希尔的国会议员汤姆·克拉克也参加了此次活动。

source_text: Memorial committee chairman Daniel Taylor read out the names of the late 47 people while another person was playing bagpipes in the background.
target_text: 纪念委员会主席丹尼尔泰勒宣读了已故47人的名字，与此同时另一个人正在背景中演奏风笛。

source_text: When the service came to a close, First Minister Salmond commented on the tragedy, saying "The tragedy at Auchengeich Colliery left barely a town, village or mining family in North Lanarkshire unaffected."
target_text: 当活动即将结束时，萨尔蒙德第一部长就悲剧发表评论说：“奥辛盖希煤矿的悲剧几乎影响到了拉纳克郡北部的每一个城镇、村庄或采矿家庭。”

source_text: "Fifty years on, the memories of the fateful day which claimed the lives of so many husbands, fathers, brothers and sons endure and I am honoured to pay tribute to them."
target_text: “五十年过去了，许多丈夫、父亲、兄弟和儿子的生命都被这特殊的一天所铭记，我很荣幸地向他们致敬。”

source_text: "Scotland is fortunate enough to have been blessed with rich natural resources, from the abundant coal seams of the central belt to the oil and gas reserves off our shores and the emerging renewable energy sources we are just beginning to feel the benefits of."
target_text: “苏格兰有幸拥有丰富的自然资源，从中央带丰富的煤层到我们海岸的石油和天然气储备以及新兴的可再生能源，我们才开始感受到它的好处。”

source_text: "But we should never forget the human cost which has come with that."
target_text: “但我们永远不应该忘记随之而来的人力成本。”

source_text: "Just as the Piper Alpha tragedy more than two decades ago underlined the hazards of North Sea exploration, the Auchengeich disaster showed all too starkly the dangers and risks which miners all over Scotland took for granted as part of their job every time they descended the pits."
target_text: “正如二十多年前派普阿尔法钻油平台悲剧强调了北海勘探的危害一样，奥辛盖希的灾难也非常明显地表明了苏格兰各地的矿工在每次下山时都把危险和风险视为他们工作的一部分。”

source_text: "The excellent work of the people of North Lanarkshire and Auchengeich Miners' Welfare has provided this new memorial garden and magnificent bronze sculpture."
target_text: “北拉纳克郡和奥辛盖希矿工福利人员的出色工作为这座新的纪念花园和宏伟的青铜雕塑提供了便利。”

source_text: "Together, they are a truly fitting tribute to those 47 brave men who died in Auchengeich half a century ago."
target_text: “在一起，他们是对半个世纪前在奥辛盖希死去的47名勇敢的人的真正的敬意。”

source_text: NASA's Spitzer Space Telescope made news this week when it was announced that the space observatory had, for the first time, captured enough light to detect molecules in the atmospheres of planets outside the solar system.
target_text: 本周，美国国家航空航天局的斯皮策太空望远镜发布消息称，空间观测站首次捕捉到足够的光来探测太阳系外行星大气中的分子。

source_text: The planets are too far away to be observed directly with current technology, but by measuring the spectra of each planet when visible with its star, and again when the planet was hidden behind its star, the teams were able to determine the measurements of the planets spectra.
target_text: 这些行星距离太远，目前的技术无法直接观测到，但是通过测量每颗行星在其恒星可见时的光谱，以及当行星隐藏在其恒星后面时，研究小组能够确定这些行星光谱的测量值。

source_text: In a paper published in the February 22 issue of Nature, Dr. Jeremy Richardson of NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center presented measurements of HD 209458 b, a hot, Jupiter-like planet located 153 light-years from Earth, in the constellation Pegasus.
target_text: 在2月22日出版的《自然》杂志上，美国宇航局戈达德航天飞行中心的杰里米·理查森博士发表了一篇论文，介绍了在飞马座中对HD209458b的测量结果，这是一颗炎热的，类似木星的行星，距离地球153光年。

source_text: Richardson's team found a peak in the infrared spectra and was able to determine that the atmosphere of HD 209458 b likely consisted of clouds of silicate dust.
target_text: 理查森的研究小组在红外光谱中发现了一个峰值，并能够确定HD209458b的大气很可能是由硅酸盐尘埃云组成的。

source_text: Dr. Mark Swain of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory led another study of HD 209458 b, and found similar results.
target_text: 喷气推进实验室的马克·斯温博士领导了对HD209458B的另一项研究，并发现了类似的结果。

source_text: Another team, led by Dr. Carl Grillmair of Spitzer Science Center at Caltech, performed a similar study of HD 189733b, 63 light-years away, in the constellation Vulpecula.
target_text: 另一个由加州理工大学斯皮策科学中心的卡尔·格里尔迈尔博士领导的团队，对63光年外的狐狸座HD189733b进行了类似的研究。

source_text: "These planets, these hot Jupiters very, very close in to their parent stars are 2,000 degrees Fahrenheit or so, so it's not a pleasant place to live."
target_text: “这些行星，这些炎热的类木行星离它们的母星非常非常近，它们大约有2000华氏度，所以那里绝不是什么宜居场所。”

source_text: "And what we found instead and what the other group found for this completely different planet around another star, is that the spectrum is essentially flat."
target_text: “和我们的发现不同，另一组人员在另一个恒星附近发现了一个特征完全不同的行星，它的光谱特征是平坦的。”

source_text: "It really doesn't show any of the features we would have expected from water."
target_text: “它没有显现出任何我们对水的期待。”

source_text: "The theorists' heads were spinning when they saw the data," adds Dr. Richardson.
target_text: 理查森博士补充说：“当理论学家们看到数据时，他们的头脑在旋转。”

source_text: "It is virtually impossible for water, in the form of vapor, to be absent from the planet, so it must be hidden, probably by the dusty cloud layer we detected in our spectrum."
target_text: “这个星球上几乎不可能没有以蒸汽形式存在的水，所以它肯定是被掩盖了，很可能是被我们在光谱中探测到的尘土飞扬的云层所掩盖。”

source_text: Dr. Grillmair: "The observations are showing us that things are not the way we expected them."
target_text: 格里尔迈尔博士：“观察结果表明事情并非我们所期望的那样。”

source_text: "And so there'll be a big push to get a lot more data while Spitzer is still alive."
target_text: “因此，在斯皮策还在运作的时候，我们将大力推进以获取更多的数据。”

source_text: "I think this will ultimately be one of the most important legacies of the Spitzer Space Telescope, unanticipated as it was before launch."
target_text: “我认为这最终将成为斯皮策太空望远镜最重要的遗产之一，这是在发射之前是未曾预料到的。”

source_text: "I think it will become extremely important in the future."
target_text: “我认为这将在未来变得非常重要。”

source_text: The telescope was launched in August of 2003 with a maximum expected life cycle of 5 years.
target_text: 该望远镜于2003年8月发射，最大预期寿命为5年。

source_text: "With these new observations, we are refining the tools that we will one day need to find life elsewhere if it exists," said Swain.
target_text: “通过这些新的观察，我们正在改进我们有朝一日需要在其他地方寻找生命的工具，”斯温说到。

source_text: Dr. Swain's and Dr. Grillmair's studies are pending publication in Astrophysical Journal Letters.
target_text: 斯温博士和格里尔迈尔博士的研究正在等待发表在《天体物理杂志快报》上。

source_text: The South Carolina Democratic Party denied Stephen Colbert a place on the primary ballot Thursday.
target_text: 南卡罗来纳州民主党星期四在初选中否决了斯蒂芬·科尔伯特的席位。

source_text: “The council really agonized over this because they really like him, they love his show, and everyone thinks it’s wonderful that he cares about us,” said Carol Fowler, the chairwoman of the state’s Democratic Party.
target_text: 州民主党主席卡罗尔·福勒说：“委员会对此感到非常痛心，因为他们真的很喜欢他，他们很喜欢他的表演，每个人都认为他关心我们是一件好事。”

source_text: According to their statement, Colbert did not meet two basic requirements: that he be a viable national candidate; and that he actively campaign for the state’s primary.
target_text: 根据他们的声明，科尔伯特没有满足两个基本要求：他必须是一个潜在的全国候选人；他必须积极竞选该州的初选。

source_text: "It's a distraction," said Waring Howe Jr., one of the executive council member who voted against Colbert, "and takes away from the seriousness of our primary here and takes attention from the serious candidates: Clinton, Edwards, Barack Obama and the rest."
target_text: “这会使我们分心，”曾投票反对科尔伯特的执行委员会成员之一小伟林·豪说，“它会让我们不再关注初选的严肃性，不再关注那些认真的候选人：克林顿，爱德华兹，巴拉克·奥巴马和其他人。”

source_text: Colbert's Thursday night program centered around his campaign in South Carolina until a Democratic official called mid-show with the news of the council's rejection.
target_text: 近期科尔伯特的周四晚间节目以他在南卡罗来纳州的竞选活动为中心，直到在一次民主党中期节目中宣布委员会对此的拒绝。

source_text: Colbert had originally announced his intention to run as both a Republican and Democrat, but only filed for the Democratic.
target_text: 科尔伯特最初宣布他打算兼任共和党和民主党候选人，但他只在民主党进行了注册。

source_text: The Republican primary ballot application cost was $35,000, versus $2,500 for the Democratic application.
target_text: 共和党的主要选票申请费用为35,000美元，而民主党申请仅为2,500美元。

source_text: The government passed a law on Friday ratifying Romania's accession treaty to the European Union, after the Treaty was signed in a ceremony in Luxembourg in April 25, which was attended by the heads of state of all 25 current EU member states.
target_text: 在由欧盟所有25个成员国的国家元首出席了签署仪式，罗马尼亚加入欧盟的条约于4月25日在卢森堡签署后，政府于周五通过了一项法律。

source_text: The government pointed out that, aside from ratification by Romania and Bulgaria, the two states which signed the accession treaty in April 25, the treaty must also be ratified by the 25 current member states who also signed the treaty in Luxembourg.
target_text: 政府指出，除4月25日签署加入条约的罗马尼亚和保加利亚批准外，该条约还必须由在卢森堡签署该条约的25个现任成员国批准。

source_text: The law passed by the Romanian government on Friday has been forwarded to the Parliament to be debated.
target_text: 罗马尼亚政府周五通过的法律已提交议会进行辩论。

source_text: It must be approved in a joint session of the Senate and the Chamber of Deputies, with at least a two-thirds majority.
target_text: 它必须在参议院和众议院的联席会议上获得至少有三分之二多数票通过。

source_text: Once the accession treaty is ratified by all 25 member states of the European Union, Romania and Bulgaria will become full members in January 1, 2007.
target_text: 加入条约一经欧盟25个成员国批准，罗马尼亚和保加利亚将于2007年1月1日成为正式成员国。

source_text: On the 3rd day of the 2007 World Deaf Swimming Championships, the Men 1500m Freestyle, Women 800m Freestyle, 50m Breaststroke, 200m Freestyle, 4x100m Medley Relay Groups finales took place during the afternoon and evening.
target_text: 2007年世界聋人游泳锦标赛第3天，男子1500米自由泳、女子800米自由泳、50米蛙泳、200米自由泳、4x100米混合泳接力团体决赛在下午和晚上举行。

source_text: Belarus deaf swimmer Natalia Deeva not only broke old "women 50m breaststroke record" established by her teammate Aksana Petrushenka on June 19, 2006 with 35.28 seconds at 50m Breaststroke heat session within 34.97 seconds, but also broke her record again at final session within 34.91 seconds.
target_text: 白俄罗斯聋人游泳运动员娜塔莉亚·迪瓦不仅以34.97秒的成绩在女子50米蛙泳的激烈竞争中打破了2006年6月19日队友阿克萨娜·佩鲁申卡创造的35.28秒的纪录，而且在决赛中以34.91秒的成绩再次打破了纪录。

source_text: Besides of individual record, Natalia Deeva and Aksana Petrushenka also participated Women 4x100m Medley Relay Group Final, not only won the 1st place, but also broke former record established by Russian National Team on January 10, 2005 with 4 minute and 39.63 seconds at that group final within 4 minute and 38 seconds.
target_text: 除了个人记录外，娜塔莉亚·迪瓦和阿克萨娜·佩鲁申卡还参加了女子4x100米混合泳接力团体决赛，不仅获得了第一名，而且以4分38秒的成绩打破了在2005年1月10日俄罗斯国家队在团体决赛中4分39.63秒的纪录。

source_text: With the three-times new world records written, that's exactly a "New Record Day" for Belarus.
target_text: 一天内三次创造新的世界纪录，这对白俄罗斯来说是一个“新纪录日”。

source_text: Even though heats and finales were still in process, but due to a torrential rain in Taiwan, the Award Ceremony of 3rd Matchday has been postponed to next matchday.
target_text: 尽管决赛仍在激烈的进行，但是由于台湾的暴雨，第三个比赛日的颁奖仪式被推迟至下一个比赛日。

source_text: Earlier today, the government of Chad set free three French journalists and four Spanish flight attendants, who had been held since October 25.
target_text: 今天早些时候，乍得政府释放了3名法国记者和4名西班牙空乘人员，他们从10月25日起被关押。

source_text: Chadian authorities had been investigating the role of the seven and 14 other suspects with regard to an attempt to fly 103 African children to Europe for placement with host families.
target_text: 乍得当局一直在调查这7人和14名其他嫌疑人在试图将103名非洲儿童空运至欧洲安置在寄宿家庭中所起的作用。

source_text: The release of the seven came as French President Nicolas Sarkozy arrived in Chad to hold talks on the case with Chadian officials.
target_text: 七人的获释正值法国总统萨科齐抵达乍得并与乍得官员就此事举行会谈之际。

source_text: The lawyer for the seven, Jean-Bernard Padare, told Reuters that the seven were free to collect their belongings from the courthouse.
target_text: 七人的律师让·伯纳德·帕达雷告诉路透社，他们可以自由地从法院收回他们的财物。

source_text: A French charity, Zoe's Ark, had arranged for the 103 children to be flown out of Chad in an attempt to rescue them from the humanitarian crisis created as a result of the neighbouring Darfur conflict.
target_text: 一个名叫佐伊方舟的法国慈善机构安排103名儿童乘飞机离开乍得，试图将他们从邻国达尔富尔冲突造成的人道主义危机中解救出来。

source_text: However, Chadian officials have since described the operation as "kidnapping" and "extortion", while the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees revealed that many of the children involved were not orphans.
target_text: 然而，乍得官员随后将这次行动描述为“绑架”和“敲诈”，而联合国难民事务高级专员透露，所涉及的许多儿童并不是孤儿。

source_text: According to Radio France, Eric Breteau, the founder of Zoe's Ark charity, spoke at a pretrial hearing in N'Djamena, Chad and stated that the seven released Europeans had not been involved with the charity's plans.
target_text: 据法国广播电台报道，佐伊方舟慈善组织的创始人埃里克·布雷托在乍得恩贾梅纳举行的审前听证会上说，七名获释的欧洲人没有参与该慈善组织的计划。

source_text: Ten other Europeans are still being held in Chad and are facing child abduction and fraud charges.
target_text: 另外10名欧洲人仍被关押在乍得，他们将面临儿童绑架和欺诈指控。

source_text: The August Bank Holiday weekend, as usual, played host to many festivals and musical events around the UK, not least the Camel Rock Festival held at Porthcressa on the Isles of Scilly.
target_text: 像往常一样，八月的银行假日周末在英国各地举办了许多节日和音乐活动，尤其是在锡利群岛的波尔切萨举办的骆驼摇滚音乐节。

source_text: Local bands included those formed at the Five Islands' School, the members of the Steamband under the temporary name Senile Shambles and the rhythm and blues band, Roadrunner.
target_text: 当地乐队包括在五岛学校组建的乐队，临时名称为“长者的狂乱”的蒸汽乐队成员，以及节奏和蓝调乐队，“走鹃”。

source_text: The event, deemed 'unique' in the local press, raises money for local musical projects on the islands.
target_text: 该活动将为岛上的当地音乐项目筹集资金，并当地媒体上被视为“独一无二”。

source_text: It's future is, as always, in doubt due to the amount of work for organisers and volunteers, especially for the clean-up operation.
target_text: 由于组织者和志愿者的工作量，尤其是清洁工作的工作量，未来的情况一如既往地令人怀疑。

source_text: Organiser Paul Lewis hopes that the event will return next year as long as there are still volunteers.
target_text: 组织者保罗·刘易斯希望，只要还有志愿者，这项活动明年还将继续举办。

source_text: In response to the United States Department of State issuing its annual Country Reports on Human Rights Practices, China has issued a contradictory report highlighting human rights abuses in the US, The Human Rights Record of the United States in 2004.
target_text: 针对美国国务院发布年度国家人权报告，中国发布了一份矛盾的2004年美国的人权记录，强调了美国的侵犯人权行为。

source_text: For the past six years, the People's Republic of China has issued an annual statement on human rights in the US in response to the annual report on China.
target_text: 在过去的六年里，中华人民共和国为响应中国的年度报告，发表了关于美国人权的年度声明。

source_text: "Only the Chinese people themselves have the right to comment on the human rights situation in their own country," said Liu Jianchao, spokesman for the Chinese Foreign Ministry.
target_text: 中国外交部发言人刘建超说：“只有中国人民自己才有权对本国的人权状况发表评论。”

source_text: The US State Department, beginning in 1977, issues annual country reviews of its perceptions of the rights records of individual nations, based on the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
target_text: 美国国务院从1977年开始，根据《世界人权宣言》，每年对各国对各自权利记录的看法进行审查。

source_text: Amnesty International, the international 'watch-dog organization' for human rights, has however criticized this paper as being biased, because it is made by a government which itself is violating human rights on many sectors.
target_text: 然而，国际人权监督组织大赦国际批评这篇文章带有偏见，因为它是由一个本身在许多领域侵犯人权的政府所做的。

source_text: Amnesty International's 2004 annual report on US human rights in 2003 agrees with many of these claims.
target_text: 大赦国际在2004年发表的2003年美国人权年度报告与许多这些主张一致。

source_text: Amnesty is also worried about: severe violations committed by the United States' army outside the countries' borders; the situation of the prisoners in Guantanamo Bay; United States' general misbehaviour against international peace; ill-treatment of US immigrants; ill-treatment and excessive use of force by the US law enforcement officials; the US citizens losing civil rights and liberties after the 9/11 attacks; and continued use of death penalty by the state, which is in direct breach with the 3rd article of the United Nations' Universal Declaration of Human Rights (the right to life).
target_text: 大赦也令人担忧：美国军队在国境外犯下的严重违法行为；关塔那摩湾囚犯的处境；美国对国际和平的普遍不当行为；对移民的虐待；美国执法人员虐待和过度使用武力；美国在911袭击后失去公民权利和自由的公民；以及国家继续使用死刑，这直接违反了《联合国世界人权宣言》（生命权）第3条。

source_text: Comment by Peter Edidin of The New York Times, characterized the Chinese report as "a frank indictment [that] draws a picture of America that approaches caricature.
target_text: 《纽约时报》的彼得·伊迪丁的评论将中国的报告描述为“一份坦率的起诉书，描绘了一幅接近漫画的美国图景。

source_text: But that doesn't mean it won't buttress the negative image of the United States held by its critics around the world."
target_text: 但这并不意味着它不会支持美国在世界各地的批评者所持的负面形象。”

source_text: This ongoing dispute does not capture the entire relationship of US and China on civil rights.
target_text: 目前正在进行的这场争端并没有涵盖美中两国在民权问题上的全部关系。

source_text: Even as both sides trade accusations, the US on March 18, 2005, declined to table a resolution at the UN criticizing China, citing the ongoing improvements that are being made in that country.
target_text: 尽管双方都提出了贸易指控，但美国在2005年3月18日拒绝在联合国提出批评中国的决议，理由是该国正在进行改善。

source_text: This is the second time in three years that the US has not submitted such a resolution, which in fact has never passed the UN when it was submitted before.
target_text: 这是美国三年来第二次没有提交这样的决议，事实上，此类决议在联合国也从未通过的记录。

source_text: Adam is a robot developed by Welsh Aberystwyth University researchers which combines artificial intelligence (AI), robotics and automation to independently conduct and analyse biological laboratory research.
target_text: 亚当是威尔士阿伯里斯特威斯大学的研究人员开发的一种机器人，它将人工智能、机器人和自动化结合起来，独立进行和分析生物实验室的研究。

source_text: "What's new and exciting about Adam is [it is] the first time we've managed to show that a computer can not only think up new scientific ideas, but experimentally test them and decide whether they're true," said Ross King, a computer science professor and lead researcher at Aberystwyth University, "Adam makes up its own mind what to do.
target_text: “亚当的新的和令人兴奋的是，这是我们第一次证明计算机不仅可以想出新的科学想法，而且可以通过实验来检验它们，并决定它们是否是真的，”阿伯里斯特威斯大学的计算机科学教授和首席研究员罗斯·金说，“亚当自己决定怎么做。

source_text: He says that for other lab experiments the hardware is already in place, the only step needed is to change the software.
target_text: 他说，对于其他实验室实验，硬件已经到位，唯一需要的步骤是更换软件。

source_text: The artificial intelligence alone spans three computers which holds the databases and analytical software to enable Adam to think.
target_text: 人工智能单独跨越三台计算机，它们拥有数据库和分析软件，使亚当能够思考。

source_text: For the yeast experiment, Adam was loaded with databases which hold known information relating to yeasts and organisms.
target_text: 对于酵母实验，亚当载有数据库，其中包含与酵母和生物有关的已知信息。

source_text: Adam compared all fields in the database to find the areas of missing information from which he devised 20 hypotheses.
target_text: 亚当比较了数据库中的所有字段，找出了他设计了20个假设的信息缺失区域。

source_text: Adam's AI is connected to robotic arms, sensors, incubators and cameras which enable Adam to start over 1,000 individual experiments every day and follow their progress over a week.
target_text: 亚当的人工智能与机器人手臂、传感器、恒温箱和摄像头相连，使亚当能够每天进行1000多次独立实验，并在一周内跟踪他们的进展。

source_text: A part of the process is that Adam's AI can cycle and analyze the results of the experiments as well doing routine repetitious lab work.
target_text: 这个过程的一部分是亚当的人工智能可以循环和分析实验结果，也可以做常规的重复性实验工作。

source_text: Following Adam's testing, King's team manually tested three of Adam's hypotheses and found that the robot's conclusions were correct, and each was a breakthrough to the scientific community.
target_text: 在亚当的测试之后，金的团队手工测试了亚当的三个假设，发现机器人的结论是正确的，每个都是科学界的一个突破。

source_text: William Melek, an assistant professor of mechanical engineering at Ontario's University of Waterloo, has noted that to set up the AI needed for subsequent experiments involving new biological variables and criteria, the human expertise would be time consuming to customize it.
target_text: 安大略省滑铁卢大学机械工程助理教授威廉·梅莱克指出，要建立涉及新的生物变量和标准的后续实验所需的人工智能，人类的专业知识定制人工智能将非常耗时。

source_text: The usefulness would be limited therefore to the allotment of human input needed to set up Adam.
target_text: 因此，设置亚当时所需的人力将会是其实用性的一大限制。

source_text: David Waltz of Columbia University and Bruce Buchanan of the University of Pittsburgh say that "For the foreseeable future, the prospect of using automated systems as assistants holds vast promise as these assistants are becoming not only faster but much broader in their capabilities -- more knowledgeable, more creative, and more self-reflective,"
target_text: 哥伦比亚大学的大卫·沃尔茨和匹兹堡大学的布鲁斯·布坎南说，“在可预见的未来，使用自动化系统作为助手的前景是巨大的，因为这些助手不仅变得更快，而且在能力上也变得更广泛-更具知识性、更具创造性和更具自省性。”

source_text: They note the potential of such lab assistants which may more efficiently process the research data.
target_text: 他们注意到这些自动化实验室助手的潜力，这些助手可以更有效地处理研究数据。

source_text: It was reported that Adam cost about $1million in production costs and this was weighed against the costs of hiring lab techs.
target_text: 据报道，亚当的生产成本约为100万美元，这与雇佣实验室技术人员的成本相当。

source_text: King said, We made many mistakes and learned from Adam.
target_text: 金说，我们曾犯了许多错误，并从亚当那里学到很多。

source_text: Eve's artificial intelligence will be enhanced to analyze compounds needed for medicinal drugs which may treat killer diseases such as malaria.
target_text: 夏娃的人工智能将得到增强，以分析治疗疟疾等致命疾病的药物所需的化合物。

source_text: The national football team of Bosnia and Herzegovina has been banned by FIFA, the sport's international governing body.
target_text: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那国家足球队已被国际足联禁赛。

source_text: The ban comes after the Bosnian Football Federation (NSBIH) rejected a demand from FIFA to change its three-man presidency to a single president.
target_text: 这项禁令是在波斯尼亚足球联合会（NSBIH）拒绝国际足联要求将其三人主席制改为单一主席制后颁布的。

source_text: The change was rejected on Wednesday during an NSBIH meeting, causing FIFA and European football governing body UEFA to make the decision to suspend the federation.
target_text: 在周三的一次NSBIH会议上，否决了这一变更要求，导致国际足联和欧洲足球管理机构欧足联决定暂时将该联盟除籍。

source_text: FIFA and UEFA said in a statement that "[t]he NSBIH representative and club teams are no longer entitled to take part in international competitions as of 1 April 2011 and until the aforementioned problem is solved.
target_text: 国际足联和欧足联在一份声明中说：“自2011年4月1日起，在上述问题得到解决之前，NSBIH代表队和俱乐部球队不再有权参加国际比赛。

source_text: This also means that, as of 1 April 2011, no NSIBH official or representative may participate in any international match or event."
target_text: 这也意味着，自2011年4月1日起，NSIBH官员或代表不得参加任何国际比赛或活动。”

source_text: The Bosnia and Herzegovina national team's manager, Safet Susic, spoke out against FIFA's ruling, blaming politics for the demand not being met.
target_text: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那国家队经理萨菲特·苏西奇公开反对国际足联的裁决，指责称因政治因素他们无法做到该要求。

source_text: He said "[t]here is absolutely no chance that the NSBIH might find a way out of the present deadlock and get the job done.
target_text: 他说：“NSBIH绝对不可能找到摆脱目前僵局的方法来达成目标。

source_text: These people are incapable of running the NSBIH properly, although this situation is partly a result of political orders because Bosnia is an ethnically divided country where a dysfunctional system has now caught up with football.
target_text: 这些人无法正确管理NSBIH，尽管这种情况部分是政治秩序的结果，因为波斯尼亚是一个种族分裂的国家，体制上的失调已经体现在了足球上。

source_text: Bosnia and Herzegovina are currently competing in the qualifying stage of the 2012 European championship.
target_text: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那目前正在参加2012年欧洲锦标赛的资格赛。

source_text: Bosnia are only five points behind group leaders France, and hold a game in hand over both Belarus and Albania.
target_text: 波斯尼亚队只落后于法国队5分，并且与白俄罗斯和阿尔巴尼亚队交手。

source_text: Unless FIFA's ruling is reversed, it seems unlikely that Bosnia's next game against Romania on June 3 will take place.
target_text: 除非国际足联的裁决被推翻，否则波斯尼亚在6月3日对阵罗马尼亚的下一场比赛似乎会被取消。

source_text: As part of peace talks between and the , Israel released on Tuesday early in the morning 26 Palestinian prisoners imprisoned before the 1994 for murder or attempted murder of Israelis.
target_text: 作为相互之间和平谈判的一部分，以色列星期二早晨释放了26名巴勒斯坦囚犯，他们因谋杀或企图谋杀以色列人而在1994年前被监禁。

source_text: As a prerequisite for the peace talks between the Israelis and the Palestinians led by the US, Israel committed in July to free 104 prisoners imprisoned before the Oslo accords.
target_text: 作为以美为首的以色列人和巴勒斯坦人进行和平谈判的先决条件，以色列7月承诺释放在奥斯陆协定之前被监禁的104名囚犯。

source_text: In this wave, the third out of four, Israel freed 26 Palestinian prisoners out of 'Ofer' prison in Israel.
target_text: 在这场浪潮中，作为四批中的第三批，以色列将26名巴勒斯坦囚犯从以色列的“奥弗”监狱中释放出来。

source_text: The prisoners, who had been in Israeli prison for 19–28 years, were released to the , to the , and to Jerusalem where enthusiastic crowds waited for them.
target_text: 这些被关押在以色列监狱19到28年的囚犯被释放到，到，到耶路撒冷，在那里热情的人群等待着他们。

source_text: The prisoners released to the West Bank in were welcomed by the president of the Palestinian National Authority, , at the presidential residence, and put flowers on Palestinian leader 's tomb.
target_text: 被释放到约旦河西岸的囚犯在总统官邸受到巴勒斯坦民族权力机构主席的欢迎，并在巴勒斯坦领导人的墓上献花。

source_text: Abbas, speaking before thousands of people gathered for the prisoners' release, said, "We will not sign a final peace deal with Israel before all the prisoners are released".
target_text: 阿巴斯在因囚犯释放而聚集起来的数千人面前表示：“在所有囚犯都被释放之前，我们不会与以色列签署最后的和平协议。”

source_text: Israel confirmed the release on Saturday, but delayed it until Tuesday for an Israeli court appeal by victims' families to prevent it.
target_text: 以色列本将在周六进行释放，但将释放推迟到周二，因为以色列法院收到了受害者家属提出的阻止释放的上诉。

source_text: The appeal filed by the 'Almagor' organization representing the Israeli victims' families was not accepted.
target_text: 代表以色列受害者家属的“阿尔玛戈尔”组织提出的上诉未被接受。

source_text: Addressing the issue, the Israeli Prime Minister, , said at the meeting of his party, "Leadership is judged by the ability to implement decisions, difficult as they may be.
target_text: 以色列总理在他的政党会议上谈到这个问题时说：“领导能力的评判标准是执行决定的能力，尽管这些决定很困难。

source_text: Wildlife scientists confirmed on Thursday that a bird long thought extinct, the Ivory-billed woodpecker, has been found in Arkansas.
target_text: 野生动物科学家周四证实，在阿肯色州发现了一种被认为已灭绝的鸟，象牙嘴啄木鸟。

source_text: The remarkable birds have a 30-inch wingspan and stand nearly 20 inches high.
target_text: 这些非凡的鸟有30英寸的翼展，将近20英寸高。

source_text: The birds inhabited a wide swath of American bottomlands and mountain pine forests until the latter part of the 1800s.
target_text: 这些鸟栖息在美国大片的低地和山地松林中，直到19世纪后期。

source_text: They require a large feeding ground, and it is thought the expansion of towns and cities closed off their domain.
target_text: 它们需要一个大的活动空间，而且人们认为城镇的扩张封锁了它们的领地。

source_text: There were thought to be only 22 of them left in 1938.
target_text: 据推测，1938年只剩下22只。

source_text: In an effort to support the birds, the Cornell Lab of Ornithology, The Nature Conservancy, and other groups have joined to form the Big Woods Conservation Partnership to conserve 200,000 acres of forest habitat and rivers in the area during the next 10 years.
target_text: 为了保护这些鸟类，康奈尔鸟类学实验室、自然保护协会和其他组织已联合成立了大森林保护伙伴关系，在未来10年内保护该地区20万英亩的森林栖息地和河流。

source_text: Amazingly, America may have another chance to protect the future of this spectacular bird and the awesome forests in which it lives."

source_text: Spanish police believe they are close to capturing Aribert Heim, the 91-year-old known as "Dr. Death".
target_text: 西班牙警方认为，他们将抓获91岁的被称为“死亡博士”的阿里伯特·海姆。

source_text: Dr. Heim, described by The Times as "the most wanted Nazi still believed to be alive", is thought to be living in the town of Palafrugell in the Costa Brava area of Spain.
target_text: 海姆博士被《泰晤士报》称为“最高通缉的纳粹被认为仍然在世”，他被认为生活在西班牙布拉瓦海岸地区的帕拉弗鲁格尔镇。

source_text: His experiments reportedly included operating on a patient without anaesthetic to see how much pain a human being could endure, and injecting petrol into the bloodstream, then timing how long it took for the victim to die.
target_text: 据报道，他的实验包括在病人身上进行无麻醉手术，看一个人能忍受多大的痛苦，并在血流中注入汽油，然后计时受害者死亡的时间。

source_text: Hundreds of people are believed to have died as a result of these experiments.
target_text: 据信有数百人死于这些实验。

source_text: The Times reports that Heim led a normal civilian life after the end of the Second World War, but fled Germany in 1962, when the authorities were about to issue a warrant for his arrest.
target_text: 《泰晤士报》报道说，海姆在二战结束后过着正常的平民生活，但在1962年逃离德国，当时当局正准备签发逮捕令。

source_text: Nazi hunters, including researchers from the Simon Wiesenthal Center, have been looking for him ever since.
target_text: 纳粹猎人，包括西蒙·维森塔尔中心的研究人员，从那时起就一直在寻找他。

source_text: The center's founder, Simon Wiesenthal, was himself active in pursuing Heim prior to his death last month.
target_text: 该中心的创始人西蒙·维森塔尔一直在积极追捕海姆，直至其上个月逝世为止。

source_text: German police received a tip six weeks ago by an Israeli citizen who met a man in Ibiza with characteristics similar to Heim.
target_text: 六周前，一名以色列公民在伊比沙岛遇到了一名特征与海姆相似的男子，德国警方收到了他的提示。

source_text: Other evidence pointing the trail to Palafrugell involve banking transfers and tax filings.
target_text: 其他证据表明帕拉弗鲁格尔的线索涉及银行转账和税务申报。

target_text: 2007年，维特霍夫说，“只要他还能把头套进去，他就一直穿这件球衣。”

target_text: 警方启动橙色警戒级别，并正在寻找1994年白色雪佛兰郊区型或蓝绿色克莱斯勒协和型汽车。

source_text: King's mother, Julia Hudson, who was previously reported missing, is pleading for whoever has her son, to release him.
target_text: 先前被报道失踪的金的母亲茱莉亚·哈德森，她请求绑架者释放她的儿子。

source_text: "I don't care who you are, just let the baby go.
target_text: “我不管你是谁，请放过孩子。

source_text: I don't know what else to do but pray," said Hudson during a press conference on Saturday.
target_text: 我不知道我除了祈祷还能做什么，”哈德森在周六的记者招待会上说。

source_text: The FBI was called in because authorities suspected King might have been taken over state lines.
target_text: 当局请求联邦调查局介入是因为怀疑金可能已经被带出了州境。

source_text: Police have detained and questioned several people, and some reports say that includes William Balfour, who police previous thought to have kidnapped King.

source_text: Seven people are dead after a suicide bomber attacked a convoy of Western soldiers in Kabul, the capital of Afghanistan on Tuesday.
target_text: 周二，一名自杀式炸弹袭击者袭击了阿富汗首都喀布尔的一支西方士兵车队，造成7人死亡。

source_text: Security officials say the bomber drove his vehicle into the convoy on the Jalalabad road, which is notorious for being the scene of frequent attacks by the Taleban.
target_text: 安全官员说，这名炸弹袭击者驾驶他的车辆进入贾拉拉巴德公路的车队，该公路因塔利班频繁袭击而臭名昭着。

source_text: "I saw wounded people and dead people everywhere," a shopkeeper named Sawad told the Reuters news agency.
target_text: “我看到到处都是死伤者，”一位名叫索瓦德的店主告诉路透社。

source_text: "I helped some people to ambulances, their clothes were covered in blood stains."
target_text: “我帮忙把一些人送上救护车，他们的衣服上满是血迹。”

source_text: Two Afghan staff from the United Nations are feared to be among the casualties from the attack.
target_text: 两名来自联合国的阿富汗工作人员恐怕是这次袭击的受害者。

target_text: 联合国特别代表凯·艾德说：“得知我的两名工作人员在今天的自杀式爆炸中丧生，我感到震惊和痛心。”

source_text: The violence comes before Thursday's presidential election, which militants have promised to disrupt.
target_text: 袭击发生在星期四的总统选举之前，激进分子承诺要破坏选举。

target_text: 阿富汗总统哈米德卡尔扎伊说，这些袭击不会阻止公民参与选举，他们将会投票。“敌人的一切努力，不过是对外展现了他们的野蛮行径。”

target_text: 美国职业棒球大联盟的救援投手纽约洋基队的乔巴·张伯伦在周日晚上以8-5输给波士顿红袜队后给他妹妹回了电话。

source_text: Joba's father, Harlan Chamberlain, 55, collapsed at his home in Lincoln, and is currently at St. Elizabeth Regional Medical Center.
target_text: 乔巴的父亲，55岁的哈兰·张伯伦，在林肯市的家中病倒，目前在圣伊丽莎白地区医疗中心。

source_text: Although the exact nature of his collapse is unknown, Harlan, a full-blooded Winnebago Native American, has struggled with post-polio syndrome since childhood.
target_text: 尽管他生病的确切性质还不清楚，哈兰，这个血统纯正的温内巴哥土著美国人，从小就受到小儿麻痹后遗症困扰。

source_text: He has been known to be in declining health in recent years.

target_text: 尽管如此，哈兰还是在洋基球场参加了今年球队首日系列赛。

target_text: 他去年也参加了同样的旅行，当时乔巴在大联盟首次亮相，备受期待。

target_text: 乔巴已经被允许离开球队去探望他的父亲，并且至少他在洋基队在佛罗里达州圣彼得堡的托皮卡纳球场对阵坦帕湾射线队的两个系列赛中不会出场。

source_text: Senior officials from nearly 50 countries and international organizations have gathered in Annapolis, Maryland near Washington, D.C. for a conference aimed at launching final-status peace negotiations between Israel and the Palestinians.
target_text: 来自近50个国家和国际组织的高级官员聚集在马里兰州首都华盛顿附近的安纳波利斯，参加旨在启动以色列和巴勒斯坦之间的最终和平谈判的会议。

source_text: The meeting, the product of months of Middle East diplomacy by the Bush administration, is intended to reopen peace talks between the two sides for the first time in seven years.
target_text: 这次会议是布什政府几个月来中东外交的成果，旨在七年来首次重启双方的和平谈判。

source_text: The conference, hosted by the United States Department of State, has been dubbed the Annapolis Conference.
target_text: 这次会议由美国国务院主办，被称为安纳波利斯会议。

source_text: "Our purpose here in Annapolis is not to conclude an agreement.
target_text: 我们在安纳波利斯的目的不是达成协议。

source_text: Rather, it is to launch negotiations between the Israelis and Palestinians," said President George W. Bush at the first formal session of the conference.
target_text: 相反，它是在以色列和巴勒斯坦之间启动谈判，”乔治·W·布什总统在会议的第一次正式会议上说。

source_text: "The time is right, the cause is just, and with hard effort, I know they can succeed."
target_text: “时间是对的，事业是公正的，经过努力，我知道他们能成功。”

source_text: Bush said that direct negotiations for a Palestinian state will begin December 12.
target_text: 布什说，巴勒斯坦国的直接谈判将于12月12日开始。

source_text: "Such a state will provide Palestinians with the chance to lead lives of freedom, purpose and dignity," Bush said.
target_text: 布什说：“这样一个国家将为巴勒斯坦人提供过自由、目的和尊严的生活的机会。”

source_text: He hopes a solution be found before he leaves office.
target_text: 他希望在离任前找到解决方案。

source_text: As the summit got underway, thousands of people demonstrated in Gaza City.
target_text: 随着峰会的召开，数千人在加沙城示威。

source_text: "Let them go to a thousand conferences, we say in the name of the Palestinian people that we did not authorise anyone to sign any agreement that harms our rights," said Mahmoud al-Zahar, a co-founder of Hamas.
target_text: 哈马斯联合创始人马哈茂德·扎哈尔说：“让他们参加一千次会议吧，我们以巴勒斯坦人民的名义说，我们没有授权任何人签署任何损害我们权利的协议。”

source_text: Mahmoud Abbas has no right to make concessions to the Israelis he said.
target_text: 他说，马哈茂德阿巴斯无权向以色列人做出让步。

source_text: "Abbas is a traitor" and "Death to Israel, death to America," the crowd chanted.
target_text: “阿巴斯是叛徒”和“以色列去死，美国去死，”人群高呼。

source_text: The Prime Minster of Israel, Ehud Olmert said: "This time it's different because we are going to have lots of participants in what I hope will launch a serious process of negotiations between us and the Palestinians."
target_text: 以色列总理埃胡德·奥尔默特说：“这一次情况不同，因为我们将有很多参加者，我希望他们能在我们和巴勒斯坦人之间展开一个严肃的谈判过程。”

source_text: Mahmoud Abbas, President of the Palestinian National Authority said: "We have a great deal of hope that this conference will produce... expanded negotiations over all permanent-status issues that would lead to a peace agreement between Israel and the Palestinian people."
target_text: 巴勒斯坦民族权力机构主席阿巴斯说：“我们非常希望这次会议能够产生……扩大对所有永久性地位问题的谈判，以期在以色列和巴勒斯坦人民之间达成和平协议。”

source_text: Observers have noted that the summit has attracted the participation of Saudi Arabia and Syria—two Arab states that do not recognize Israel—and say that this is critical to chances for success.
target_text: 观察员指出，这次峰会吸引了沙特和叙利亚这两个不承认以色列的阿拉伯国家的参与，并表示这对成功的机会至关重要。

source_text: The conference began informally last night with a dinner hosted by US Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice.
target_text: 昨晚，美国国务卿康多莉扎·赖斯主持了一场晚宴，会议非正式地开始了。

source_text: "We've come together this week because we share a common goal: two democratic states—Israel and Palestine—living side by side in peace and security," Bush said in an address to the participants.
target_text: 布什在致与会者的一次讲话中说：“我们本周聚在一起是因为我们有一个共同的目标：两个民主国家以色列和巴勒斯坦和平与安全并肩生活。”

source_text: Achieving this goal requires the commitment of the international community, including the United States," he continued.
target_text: 实现这一目标需要包括美国在内的国际社会的承诺，”他继续说。

source_text: State-owned flag carrier Garuda Indonesia had hoped to begin flights to Europe imminently and has ordered ten new jetliners to serve routes there and to the United States.

source_text: The European Court of Human Rights has awarded €2500 to Abu Qatada, an Islamic militant and cleric, in a lawsuit he filed against the United Kingdom which detained him without trial in 2002.

source_text: The US Army Corps of Engineers decision to place restrictions on issuance of nationwide pollution permits has been upheld by a federal court.
target_text: 在联邦法院的支持下，美国陆军工程兵团决定限制全国范围内的污染许可证的发放。

source_text: In National Association of Home Builders v. Army Corps of Engineers, the District Court for the District of Columbia found that the Corps of Engineers had not acted in an "arbitrary" or "capricious" manner in changing the terms and conditions for issuance of a national pollution permit, including reducing the size of area into which pollutants may be discharged from 10 acres to 1 acre, raising the threshold for requiring additional permits from 1 acre to 1/10 acre,
target_text: 在美国房屋建筑商协会诉美国陆军工程兵团案中，哥伦比亚特区地方法院发现，工程兵团在更改签发国家污染许可证的条款和条件时，没有采取“武断”或“反复无常”的行动，包括将污染物排放面积从10英亩缩小到1英亩，将要求额外许可的门槛从1英亩提高到1／10英亩。

source_text: A nationwide permit allows an organization to engage in certain industrial activities on a national basis (such as mining and construction), reducing the amount of paperwork and filings needed for otherwise minor environmental impacts, as opposed to an ordinary permit for a specific location which will engage in activities which generate water pollution.
target_text: 全国性许可证允许一个组织在全国范围内从事某些工业活动（如采矿和建筑），减少其他轻微环境影响所需的文书和文件数量，而不是在特定地点进行产生水污染活动的普通许可证。

source_text: Due to concerns over the amount of discharge taking place in waterways, the Corps of Engineers began in the 1980s to reduce the authority granted by nationwide permits and to bar use of the permits in certain ecologically sensitive areas.
target_text: 由于对水路排放量的担忧，工程兵团从20世纪80年代开始减少全国范围内许可的授权，并禁止在某些生态敏感地区使用许可。

source_text: Some industry groups, including the plaintiff in the above case, The National Association of Home Builders, sued the Corps of Engineers in 2000 over the change in an attempt to block its implementation.
target_text: 一些行业团体，包括上述案件的原告，全国房屋建筑商协会，在2000年起诉了美国工程兵团，试图阻止其实施变更。

source_text: Environmental groups, including the Sierra Club, were given permission to intervene in the case in support of the actions of the Corps.
target_text: 环境组织，包括塞拉俱乐部，获准介入此案，以支持兵团的行动。

source_text: Environmental groups were pleased with the decision, but are concerned over other actions of the Bush Administration, such as the attempts to weaken provisions of the 2002 Clean Water Act to allow additional dumping of construction and mining waste into waterways as fill material.
target_text: 环境组织对这一决定表示满意，但对布什政府的其他行动表示关切，例如试图削弱2002年《清洁水法》的规定，允许将建筑和采矿废物作为填料额外倾倒到水道中。

source_text: The Iraqi government has demanded the immediate withdrawal of Turkish troops, saying the five-day incursion is threatening their otherwise friendly relations.

target_text: 伊拉克政府发言人达巴格说，政府拒绝土耳其单方面入侵，因为这是对他们睦邻关系的威胁。

source_text: About 20 percent of Turkish citizens are Kurds and in the southeast, bordering Iraq, they make up the majority.
target_text: 大约百分之二十的土耳其公民是库尔德人，他们是在与伊拉克接壤的土耳其东南地区主要民族。
