source_text: Mahmoud al-Mashhadani, president of the Iraqi Parliament, says they have asked Turkey to resolve the situation peacefully.
target_text: 伊拉克议会主席马哈茂德·马沙达尼说，他们要求土耳其和平解决局势。

source_text: He says the Turks should hold a referendum in south Turkey to give the Kurds the rights they want.
target_text: 他说，土耳其人应该在土耳其南部举行全民公决，赋予库尔德人想要的权利。

source_text: Elsewhere, a suicide bomber detonated in a bus near the northern city of Mosul, killing at least nine and wounding several others.
target_text: 在其他地方，一名自杀式炸弹袭击者在北部城市摩苏尔附近的一辆公共汽车上引爆，造成至少9人死亡，数人受伤。

source_text: Meanwhile, millions of Shiites in Iraq gathered in the southern Iraqi city of Karbala for Arbaeen, a major Shiite commemoration.
target_text: 与此同时，伊拉克数百万什叶派教徒聚集在伊拉克南部城市卡尔巴拉，参加什叶派重要纪念活动“阿巴因”。

source_text: Iraqi TV showed huge crowds of Shiites walking in procession, beating drums, and whipping and hitting themselves in ritual prostration.
target_text: 伊拉克电视台播放了大批什叶派教徒游行，打鼓，并对自己进行仪式性的鞭笞。

source_text: More than 60 Shiite pilgrims were killed while making their way to Karbala this week, most of them from a Sunday suicide bombing.
target_text: 本周，60多名什叶派朝圣者在前往卡尔巴拉的途中丧生，其中大部分人是在周日的自杀式爆炸中丧生的。

source_text: On Monday, Google published on their blog that they are testing a new product named Google Base, in which users will be able to upload their own articles to a database.
target_text: 周一，谷歌在他们的博客上发布了他们正在测试一个名为“谷歌数据库”的新产品，在该产品中，用户可以将自己的文章上传到数据库中。

source_text: This allegedly will complement the current services offered by Google.
target_text: 据称这将补充谷歌目前提供的服务。

source_text: Examples of contributions may include recipes, scientific findings, and other pieces of information one may wish to share.
target_text: 贡献的例子可能包括菜谱、科学发现和人们希望分享的其他信息。

source_text: Several news agencies are reporting that Google Base will be used for classified ads.
target_text: 一些新闻机构报道说，谷歌数据库将用于广告分类。

source_text: According to the Google Base website, which was made inaccessible to the public after a few hours, both were examples of entries you could post.
target_text: 根据几小时后公众无法访问的谷歌数据库网站，这两个网站都是你可以发布的条目的例子。

source_text: Google Base is expected to be a major competitor of craigslist, which is partly owned by eBay.
target_text: 谷歌数据库预计将成为克雷格列表的主要竞争对手，克雷格列表的部分归易趣所有。

source_text: A massive earthquake, registering 7.0 on the moment magnitude scale, struck Haiti yesterday, destroying many buildings, disrupting communications, and burying an unknown number of people underneath rubble.
target_text: 昨天海地发生了一场震级为7.0级的大地震，许多建筑物被摧毁，通讯遭破坏，不明人数的人被瓦砾掩埋。

source_text: Thousands of people are feared to have been killed by the tremors, which were felt as far away as Venezuela.
target_text: 恐有数千人在地震中丧生，甚至在委内瑞拉都有震感。

source_text: Witnesses say bodies were lining the streets of the capital, Port-au-Prince, after the quake struck on Tuesday afternoon, sending a cloud of dust from falling buildings into the sky.
target_text: 目击者说，星期二下午地震发生后，首都太子港的街道上布满了尸体，空中全是倒塌的建筑所扬起的尘埃。

source_text: The quake was centered about sixteen kilometers from the capital, and struck at a depth of just ten kilometers, exacerbating the damage.
target_text: 震中距首都约16公里，震源深度仅10公里，这加深了造成的损害。

source_text: At least 27 aftershocks were also recorded, the strongest of which came in at 5.5 and 5.9 magnitude.
target_text: 记录中至少还发生了27次余震，其中最强的是5.5级和5.9级。

source_text: A tsunami alert was initially issued following the tremor, but it was retracted shortly afterwards.
target_text: 震后不久还发布了海啸预警，但不久之后又被收回。

source_text: Buildings across the capital have collapsed, including the presidential palace and the headquarters of the United Nations peacekeeping mission in Haiti.
target_text: 整个首都的建筑物已经倒塌，包括总统府和联合国驻海地维和部队的总部。

source_text: However, the president, René Préval, and his wife reportedly survived the collapse of the building.
target_text: 然而，据报道，总统任佩瓦尔和他的妻子在大楼倒塌后幸存了下来。

source_text: The country's envoy to the United States believed damage costs could reach billions of dollars.
target_text: 该国驻美国使节认为，损失可能达到数十亿美元。

source_text: UN peacekeeping chief Alain Le Roy said many people were in the UN building when it went down and they remain unaccounted for.
target_text: 联合国维和负责人阿兰·勒罗伊说，联合国大楼倒塌时，很多人都在里面，他们仍然下落不明。

source_text: A Brazilian military official later said four Brazilian soldiers who were part of the UN mission were killed.
target_text: 巴西一名军事官员后来说，四名参与联合国任务的巴西士兵丧生。

source_text: The Notre Dame of the Assumption Cathedral in Port-au-Prince was also destroyed, killing Joseph Serge Miot, the Archbishop of Port-au-Prince.
target_text: 太子港圣母升天大教堂的圣母院也被摧毁，导致太子港大主教约瑟夫·谢尔盖·米特死亡。

source_text: In a statement released yesterday, the UN remarked that "[f]or the moment, a large number of personnel remain unaccounted for."
target_text: 联合国在昨天发布的一份声明中指出，“现在，仍有大量人员下落不明。”

source_text: India's has labelled honour killings a "slur on the nation," and warned the death penalty will await those found guilty of the crime.
target_text: 印度已将荣誉谋杀定为“对国家的侮辱”，并警告说，死刑将等待那些被判有罪的人。

source_text: An independent study says each year an estimated 900 people are murdered in India for bringing dishonour to their families, usually by falling in love and marrying outside their caste or within their sub-caste.
target_text: 一项独立的研究表明，每年大约有900人在印度被谋杀，因为他们给自己的家庭带来了耻辱，通常是因他们与种姓之外或与低种姓的人坠入爱河和结婚。

source_text: Honour killings, accepted as a cultural tradition in some parts of India, are normally punished with life imprisonment.
target_text: 荣誉谋杀在印度某些地区被视为一种文化传统，通常会被判处无期徒刑。

source_text: But Justices Markandey Katju and Gyan Sudha Misra have now called for a tougher stance, directing courts throughout India to use capital punishment in their sentencing.
target_text: 但法官马坎迪·卡朱伊和吉安·苏达·米斯拉现在呼吁采取更强硬的立场，要求印度各地的法院在判决中使用死刑。

source_text: "It is time to stamp out these barbaric, feudal practices which are a slur on the nation.
target_text: “现在是时候消除这些野蛮的封建习俗了，这是对国家的侮辱。

source_text: This is necessary as a deterrent for such outrageous, uncivilised behaviour.
target_text: 这是必要的，以威慑这种野蛮、不文明的行为。

source_text: All persons who are planning to perpetrate honour killings should know that gallows await them," Justice Katju said.
target_text: 所有计划实施荣誉谋杀的人都应该知道绞刑架在等着他们，”卡图法官说。

source_text: The crack-down came yesterday, as the Supreme Court dismissed an appeal to lessen the life imprisonment of Bhagwan Dass.
target_text: 昨天，最高法院驳回了一项减少巴格温·达斯无期徒刑的上诉。

source_text: The man strangled his married daughter to death with wire after discovering she was in an incestuous affair.
target_text: 那人发现他已婚的女儿乱伦后，用铁丝勒死了她。

source_text: The Supreme Court also condemned the traditional village councils who endorse these honour killings and order them to be carried out.
target_text: 最高法院还谴责了传统的村委会，这些村委会支持并命令执行这些荣誉谋杀。

source_text: A last minute deal reached Saturday dictates that about 1,000 Israeli settler greenhouses located in the Gaza strip will not be dismantled after Monday's pullout.
target_text: 星期六最后一分钟达成的协议规定，在星期一撤军后，位于加沙地带的大约1000个以色列定居者温室将不会被拆除。

source_text: Instead, they will remain standing and be placed in Palestinian control.
target_text: 相反，他们将被保留，并由巴勒斯坦控制。

source_text: The deal allows one of the Gaza strip's largest employers to remain intact.
target_text: 该协议允许加沙地带最大的雇主之一保持原样。

source_text: Greenhouses in the region currently employ more than 4,000 people.
target_text: 该地区的温室目前雇用4000多人。

source_text: Mr. Wolfenson will purchase the greenhouses using funds amounting to US$14 million.
target_text: 沃尔芬森先生将用1400万美元的资金购买温室。

source_text: He will proceed to turn the properties over to Palestine.
target_text: 他将着手把财产移交给巴勒斯坦。

source_text: Daniel Ayalon, Israeli ambassador to the United States, spoke optimistically of the greenhouse agreement.
target_text: 以色列驻美国大使丹尼尔·阿亚隆乐观地谈到了温室协议。

source_text: Said Mr. Ayalon, "As we leave Gaza, and some parts of the West Bank, we are not leaving scorched earth.
target_text: 阿亚隆说：“当我们离开加沙和西岸的一些地区时，我们不会留下焦土。

source_text: On the contrary, we are leaving behind means for them to take over and immediately better their situation."
target_text: 相反，我们会留下设施让他们接管并立即改善他们的处境。”

source_text: In Gaza, the median age is 15 and about 80% of the population live in poverty.
target_text: 在加沙，平均年龄是15岁，大约百分之八十的人口生活在贫困中。

source_text: Iraq has defeated Australia 3-1 in their 2007 AFC Asian Cup Group A match at the Rajamangala Stadium, Bangkok, Thailand.
target_text: 在泰国曼谷拉贾曼加拉体育场举行的2007年亚洲杯A组比赛中，伊拉克以3比1击败澳大利亚队。

source_text: Iraq took the lead after twenty-three minutes when midfielder Nashat Akram scored.
target_text: 伊拉克在23分钟后取得领先，中场纳沙特·阿克拉姆进球。

source_text: He curled in a free kick from around thirty yards out, and Salih al Sadwn rushed towards Australian goalkeeper Mark Schwarzer.
target_text: 他在30码外的任意球中发出弧线球，萨利·萨登冲向澳大利亚门将马克·施瓦泽。

source_text: Al Sadwn's presence sufficiently distracted Schwarzer, who dived the wrong way.
target_text: 萨登的出现充分分散了施瓦泽的注意力，他走错了方向。

source_text: Two minutes after the break, Australia equalised through striker Mark Viduka.
target_text: 休息两分钟后，澳大利亚队通过前锋马克·维杜卡扳平比分。

source_text: The Australian captain managed to head a curling cross by midfielder Brett Emerton back across Iraqi Noor Hassan's goal and into the top corner.
target_text: 澳大利亚队长在中场布雷特·埃默顿的一记弧线传球后成功顶过了伊拉克的努尔·哈桑的球门，进入了顶角。

source_text: Hawar Mulla Mohammed was played through with a lovely ball from a teammate, who had attracted the Australian central defence out-of-position.
target_text: 哈瓦·穆拉·穆罕默德接到一个队友漂亮的传球，他吸引了澳大利亚中央防守队员。

source_text: Mohammed slotted the ball home from 15 yards to re-take the lead.
target_text: 穆罕默德将球从15码打进，重新领先。

source_text: Iraq sealed the three Group A points when Karrar Jassim Mohammed scored in the eighty-sixth minute.
target_text: 当卡拉尔·贾西姆·穆罕默德在第86分钟进球时，伊拉克队取得了三个A组积分。

source_text: He managed to get on the end of a deflected shot and calmly tap the ball into an empty net, after goalkeeper Schwarzer had dived to defend the initial shot.
target_text: 他设法将球踢向侧门住，在守门员施瓦泽试图扑住这次射门时，他冷静的将球打进了空门。

source_text: The win puts Iraq on equal-top of the group with hosts Thailand.
target_text: 这场胜利使伊拉克在该组中与东道主泰国平分秋色。

source_text: If Iraq defeats or draws with Oman in their final Group A encounter, they will progress through to the quarter-final stage.
target_text: 如果伊拉克在最后一次A组交锋中击败或与阿曼平局，他们将进入四分之一决赛阶段。

source_text: Australia must defeat Thailand to remain any chance of progressing through to the next stage.
target_text: 澳大利亚必须击败泰国，才能继续出线。

source_text: In the event that Australia win (ie. are on four points) and Iraq win or draw (ie. are on seven or five points), Australia will progress through to the next stage on head-to-head rather than Thailand despite having a possibly-worse goal difference.
target_text: 如果澳大利亚队赢了（即四分），伊拉克队赢了或打平了（即七或五分），澳大利亚将出线，而泰国将无法出线，因为双方的净胜球相差巨大。

source_text: Goal difference (goals for minus goals against) is only used to separate two teams if they drew in their head-to-head match in the group stage.
target_text: 净胜球（进球数减去被进球数）仅用于在小组赛两支球队积分相等时。

source_text: If Iraq lose to Oman and Australia win, all four teams will end up on four points.
target_text: 如果伊拉克输给阿曼，澳大利亚赢了，这四支球队最终都将得到四分。

source_text: It is unclear how the head-to-head rule will be applied by the AFC in this situation, and it is probable that goal difference will be used.
target_text: 目前还不清楚AFC将如何在这种情况下应用什么规则，很可能会使用净胜球。

source_text: In Group B, Japan defeated United Arab Emirates 3-1 at the My Dinh National Stadium, Hanoi, Vietnam.
target_text: 在B组，日本队在越南河内的米丁国家体育场以3比1击败了阿拉伯联合酋长国队。

source_text: Defending champions Japan took the lead when Naohiro Takahara scored after twenty-two minutes.
target_text: 卫冕冠军日本队在22分钟后高桥直彦得分，取得领先。

source_text: Takahara doubled their advantage five minutes later when he sent a lovely volley into the right-hand side of the net after twenty-seven minutes, leaving Emirates goalkeeper Majed Maqdemi stranded.
target_text: 五分钟后，高桥将优势扩大了一倍，他在27分钟后漂亮的凌空抽射进了网的右侧，让阿联酋队门将马吉德·马克德米陷入困境。

source_text: The Emirates scored a goal after sixty-six minutes through Saeed Alkas, but no comeback eventuated and the final score was 3-1 top Japan.
target_text: 阿联酋队在比赛六十六分钟后由赛义德·阿尔卡斯进球，但没能扳回败局，最终比分为日本3比1获胜。

source_text: It leaves Japan equal on top of the Group B table with Vietnam on two points, with the teams locked on four points each.
target_text: 这让日本在B组排名并列第一，越南队获得两分，其余两队各得4分。

source_text: The winner of the match will take top spot in the group.
target_text: 比赛的胜者将成为该组的头把交椅。

source_text: In the event that the Japan-Vietnam match is drawn, both teams have a goal difference of +2.
target_text: 如果日本对越南的比赛平局，两队的净胜球数为+2。

source_text: However, Japan have scored one more goal than Vietnam, and will take top spot in the group on that basis.
target_text: 然而，日本的进球数比越南多一个，并且在此基础上将成为小组第一。

source_text: Qatar, the other team in Group B, must win against UAE and hope for a winner in the Japan-Vietnam match to progress, or else defeat the Emirates by three goals or more.
target_text: B组的另一支球队卡塔尔必须赢得对阿联酋的胜利，并希望在日本在对越南比赛中获胜，或者以三球或更多的目标击败阿联酋队。

source_text: Qatar drew both matches with Japan and Vietnam, meaning it will come down to goal difference if two sides are equal on four points.
target_text: 卡塔尔队在日本队和越南队的比赛中都取得了两场比赛，这意味着如果双方都是四分的话，那将会比较净胜球数。

source_text: Ferrari's second driver, Rubens Barrichello, announced today that he will depart from Ferrari at the end of the season.
target_text: 法拉利的第二位车手鲁本斯·巴里切罗今天宣布他将在赛季结束后离开法拉利。

source_text: Barrichello was with the team since 2000, won nine Grand Prix, helping win five constructor titles.
target_text: 巴里切罗2000年加入车队，并赢得9场大奖赛，帮助车队赢得了5次冠军。

source_text: Ferrari announced Felipe Massa, currently driving for Sauber, as Michael Schumacher's teammate for next season.
target_text: 法拉利宣布目前正在为索伯车队效力的菲利普·马萨担任迈克尔·舒马赫下赛季的队友。

source_text: "I am aware of the responsibility it places on me and I cannot wait to be part of a team like Ferrari, alongside the best driver in the world, Michael Schumacher," said Massa.
target_text: “我知道它给我带来的责任，我迫不及待想成为像法拉利车队的一员，与世界上最好的车手迈克尔·舒马赫一起，”马萨说。

source_text: Massa was Ferrari's test driver in 2003 season: "Now, I am in my third season as a Sauber driver and I can also count on a year's experience as a Ferrari test driver, an experience which helped me to grow a great deal."
target_text: 马萨是法拉利在2003赛季的试驾：“现在，我作为索伯车手进入了我的第三个赛季，我也可以依靠一年的法拉利试车经验，这种经历帮助我成长了很多。”

source_text: Kenneth Thomson, Canada's richest man and the 9th wealthiest person in the world according to Forbes's 2005 ranking, died Monday morning at his office in Toronto.
target_text: 加拿大首富肯尼思·汤姆森周一早上在多伦多的办公室去世，根据“福布斯”2005年排名，他是世界上第9位最富有的人。

source_text: The cause of death is reported to be a heart attack.
target_text: 据报道，死亡原因是心脏病发作。

source_text: He was the former Thomson Corp. chairman and the company's controlling shareholder.
target_text: 他是前汤姆森公司董事长兼公司的控股股东。

source_text: He made most of his money by making his father's trans-Atlantic newspaper (The Globe and Mail) into one of the world's leading resources for electronic information and data.
target_text: 他通过将父亲的跨大西洋报纸（环球邮报）打造成世界领先的电子信息和数据资源，这是他的主要收入来源。

source_text: Mr. Thomson is survived by his wife, Marilyn; three sons, David, who succeeded him as chairman of Thomson in 2002, Peter and Taylor; and a sister, Audrey Campbell.
target_text: 汤姆森先生现存的亲属有他的妻子玛丽莲；三个儿子，在2002年接替他担任汤姆森董事长的大卫，以及彼得和泰勒；姐姐奥黛丽·坎贝尔。

source_text: A memorial service will be held on a date that has yet to be announced.
target_text: 追悼会将会举行，但日期尚未公布。

source_text: Documents leaked on Wikileaks and seen by Wikinews have revealed that Cuba signed a confidential deal with Venezuela to ensure that Cuba gets access to a high speed internet connection by 2010.
target_text: 泄露在维基解密并被维基新闻看到的文件显示，古巴与委内瑞拉签署了一项保密协议，以确保古巴在2010年之前能够获得高速互联网连接。

source_text: The document stated, in Spanish, that the countries aim to "build and operate a line of fiber optic cables between Venezuela and Cuba."
target_text: 该文件用西班牙语表示，这些国家的目标是“在委内瑞拉和古巴之间建造和运营一系列光纤电缆”。

source_text: The document then says that cable will "extend between two terminals located at the coast of both countries."
target_text: 该文件随后说，电缆将“延伸到位于两国海岸的两个终端之间”。

source_text: Information week has reported that the cable is expected to cost several million US dollars.
target_text: 信息周报道称，该电缆预计耗资数百万美元。

source_text: They base this on a fact that a cable between Cuba and Florida, which is a much shorter distance than between Cuba and Venezuela, would cost half a million dollars.
target_text: 他们基于古巴和佛罗里达之间的电缆距离古巴和委内瑞拉之间的距离要短得多这一事实，这将仅耗资50万美元。

source_text: The US government has prevented the building of the Florida cable.
target_text: 美国政府已经阻止了佛罗里达电缆的建设。

source_text: "Normal" in the 2007 Ironman Triathlon World Championship was only the fact the sun rose in the east, as shortly past the swim start the day brought forth a hot and cloudless Hawaiian sky; injuries and illnesses to many; DNFs for two years worth of defending champions; and a first-time winner.
target_text: 2007年铁人三项世界锦标赛中的“正常”的只有太阳在东部升起的事实，因为在游泳开始不久，这一天带来了一片炎热无云的夏威夷天空；受伤与病痛；第一届冠军与两年成功卫冕队伍。

source_text: In even more excitement, rookie (her first Ironman length race was seven weeks ago in Korea) Chrissie Wellington, from Great Britain, claimed the women's title finished in 9:08:45.
target_text: 更令人兴奋的是，来自英国的新秀克丽丝·惠灵顿（她七周前在韩国第一次参加铁人赛事）以9：08：45的成绩夺得了女子组冠军。

target_text: 2006年卫冕冠军诺曼·施塔德勒和米歇尔·琼斯以及2005年冠军法里斯·艾尔·苏丹因胃病而倒下；六届获得冠军和2005年冠军娜塔莎·巴德曼在锥形公路上撞到一起；卢克·贝尔因腿部受伤而退出比赛。

source_text: The Iraq Inquiry in London has revealed that United Kingdom justice secretary Jack Straw ignored the advice of Sir Michael Wood, the Foreign Office's most senior legal adviser until his resignation in 2006, that the 2003 invasion of Iraq was illegal under international law.
target_text: 伦敦的伊拉克调查显示，英国司法部长杰克·斯特劳拒绝了外交部最高级法律顾问迈克尔·伍德爵士在2006年辞职前的建议，即根据国际法，2003年入侵伊拉克是非法的。

source_text: This is the first time that Wood has publicly expressed an opinion on the war.
target_text: 这是伍德第一次公开表达对这场战争的看法。

source_text: Wood advised Straw, then Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs, that invading Iraq without the backing of the United Nations Security Council in the form of a specific mandate—which the resolution the government used to support the war lacked—would "amount to the crime of aggression", to which Straw responded that he was being "dogmatic and international law was pretty vague".
target_text: 伍德建议时任外交及英联邦事务国务卿的斯特劳，如果没有联合国安理会的支持，以一项具体任务的形式入侵伊拉克，而该国政府用来支持这场战争的决议却缺乏，这将“等同于侵略罪”，斯特劳对此作出了回应，称他是“教条主义”并称“国际法相当模糊”。

source_text: This, however, turned exclusively on the interpretation of a specific text and it is one on which I think that international law was pretty clear."
target_text: 然而，这完全取决于对某一具体文本的解释，我认为国际法在这一点上是相当清楚的。”

source_text: He says that it was unprecedented for the government to ignore his advice, and told the inquiry that he "considered that the use of force against Iraq in March 2003 was contrary to international law," since the Security Council had not met to approve the use of force, nor to agree that Iraq was committing a "material breach" of existing disarmament resolutions.
target_text: 他说，政府对他的建议置之不理是史无前例的，他告诉调查组，他“认为2003年3月对伊拉克使用武力违反了国际法”，因为安理会没有举行会议批准使用武力，也不认为伊拉克正在“实质性地违反”现有的裁军决议。

source_text: He believed that regime change was the reason for the British interest in the nation, and that it was not a valid reason for war.
target_text: 他认为，政权更迭是英国对这个国家感兴趣的原因，而这并不是战争的正当理由。

source_text: He told the inquiry, "I made it clear that, in my view, the draft that they were working toward did not authorize the use of force without a further decision of the Security Council".
target_text: 他在调查中说：“我明确表示，在我看来，他们正在努力的草案并未授权在没有安全理事会进一步决定的情况下使用武力”。

source_text: Recently declassified letters prove that Wood raised these concerns directly with Jack Straw.
target_text: 最近解密的信件证明，伍德直接与杰克·斯特劳提出了这些担忧。

source_text: In one of these letters, dated January 24, 2003, Wood said that the "UK cannot lawfully use force in Iraq in ensuring compliance" with UN resolutions (including resolution 1441, which gave Saddam Hussein a "final opportunity" to comply with the UN's mandates on weapons of mass destruction by November 2002).
target_text: 伍德在2003年1月24日的其中一封信中说，“英国不能合法地在伊拉克使用武力”以确保遵守联合国的决议（包括第1441号决议，该决议给萨达姆·侯赛因一个“最后的机会”，使其在2002年11月前遵守联合国关于大规模杀伤性武器的授权）。

source_text: In his reply, Straw "noted", but "did not accept" Wood's advice.
target_text: 在他的回答中，斯特劳“注意到”，但“没有接受”伍德的建议。

source_text: Straw said he was "as committed as anyone to international law and its obligations".
target_text: 斯特劳说，他“像任何人一样致力于国际法及其义务”。

source_text: In this case, the issue is an arguable one, capable of honestly and reasonably held differences of view."
target_text: 在这种情况下，这个问题是一个有争议的问题，能够诚实和合理地持有不同的观点。”

source_text: He said he wanted a new UN resolution "for political reasons", but said that there was a "strong case" that existing resolutions would "provide a sufficient basis in international law to justify military action".
target_text: 他说，他“出于政治原因”想要一项新的联合国决议，但他说，有一个“强有力的理由”，即现有决议将“为国际法提供充分的基础，以证明军事行动是正当的”。

source_text: Instead of following Wood's advice, government ministers used the advice of Lord Goldsmith, who was then the Attorney General for England and Wales.
target_text: 政府部长没有遵循伍德的建议，而是使用戈德史密斯勋爵的建议，戈德史密斯当时是英格兰和威尔士的司法部长。

source_text: Goldsmith—who is scheduled to appear before the Inquiry this Wednesday—advised Straw that a second UN resolution would not be required to invade, based on a series of UN resolutions reaching back to the end of the Gulf War, despite having told the prime minister—only then days before—to wait for another UN resolution, the passing of which they had pushed other Security Council members for in the weeks running up to the invasion.
target_text: 预定于本周三出席调查的戈德史密斯建议斯特劳，根据联合国追溯到海湾战争结束的一系列决议，不需要第二个联合国决议来决定入侵，尽管此前几天才告诉首相等待另一项联合国决议，但在入侵前的几周，他们一直在推动安理会其他成员国通过这项决议。

source_text: The inquiry, chaired by Sir John Chilcot, was told that there were concerns about how the decision was made among the Foreign Office's senior legal advisors.
target_text: 由约翰·奇尔科特爵士主持的调查被告知，对外交部高级法律顾问如何作出决定存在担忧。

source_text: Elizabeth Wilmshurst, then Deputy Legal Adviser to the Foreign and Commonwealth Office, resigned in protest only days before the invasion.
target_text: 当时担任外交和联邦事务副法律顾问的伊丽莎白·威尔姆舒斯特在入侵前几天辞职以示抗议。

source_text: She criticised the decision-making process for its lack of transparency, and called it "lamentable".
target_text: 她批评决策过程缺乏透明度，并称其为“可悲的”。

source_text: She also called the fact that Goldsmith gave his opinion only days before the invasion "extraordinary".
target_text: 她还说，戈德史密斯在入侵前几天发表了自己的意见，这是“非同寻常的”。

source_text: Wood said that Straw had "often been advised things were unlawful and gone ahead anyway and won in the courts" when he was home secretary.
target_text: 伍德说，斯特劳在担任内政部长时“经常被告知，事情是非法的，但无论如何都会继续进行，并在法庭上获胜”。

source_text: Last week, Straw—when questioned by the inquiry—called the decision to support the war a "profoundly difficult political and moral dilemma", and said it was the "most difficult" decision of his entire career.
target_text: 上周，斯特劳在接受调查时称，支持战争的决定是一个“极其困难的政治和道德困境”，并称这是他整个职业生涯中“最困难”的决定。

source_text: Liberal Democrat foreign affairs spokesman Ed Davey called Wood's statement "the final nail in the coffin of the case for a legal war."
target_text: 自由民主党外交事务发言人艾德·戴维称伍德的声明是“法律战争案件棺材的最后钉子”。

source_text: He asks if the advice reached then prime minister Tony Blair or Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown, "And if not, why not?"
target_text: 他问当时的首相托尼·布莱尔或财政大臣戈登·布朗是否收到了建议，“如果没有，那又什么原因？”

source_text: Wood's statement is expected to cause problems for Tony Blair when he appears before the inquiry on Friday.
target_text: 伍德的声明预计将在托尼·布莱尔周五出席调查时对其提出问题。

source_text: The war has provoked protests, and much outrage among politicians who believe that Blair was wrong to support then United States President George W. Bush by sending 45,000 British soldiers—179 of whom died in combat—to fight in Iraq.
target_text: 这场战争引发了抗议，政治家们也非常愤怒，他们认为布莱尔错误地支持当时的美国总统布什，向伊拉克派遣了45000名英国士兵，其中179人在战争中丧生。

source_text: Brown said yesterday that he "think[s] the mistake in the war was not to do the reconstruction and plan it in the way that was necessary so that Iraq could recover quickly after Saddam Hussein fell," and is expected to come under fire from the inquiry, which he himself set up, for his role in the war.
target_text: 布朗昨天表示，他“认为这次战争的错误是没有在萨达姆·侯赛因倒台后按照所需的计划进行重建”，并且预计会遭到抨击。他也会由于自己在战争中的作用，受到他自己所设立的调查项目的追查。

source_text: ]After holding an emergency meeting, the World Health Organisation (WHO) officially declared a worldwide swine flu pandemic on Thursday.
target_text: 在召开紧急会议后，世界卫生组织（WHO）周四正式宣布全球猪流感大流行。

source_text: The agency increased its pandemic alert level to the sixth level, its highest.
target_text: 该机构将其大流行警戒级别提高到第六级，为最高级别。

source_text: "On the basis of available evidence, and these expert assessments of the evidence, the scientific criteria for an influenza pandemic have been met.
target_text: “根据现有证据和这些证据的专家评估，已经达到了流感大流行的科学标准。

source_text: I have therefore decided to raise the level of influenza pandemic alert from phase 5 to phase 6," said the the WHO's director Margaret Chan in a press conference earlier today.
target_text: 因此，我决定将流感大流行警戒的水平从第5阶段提高到第6阶段，“世卫组织主任陈冯富珍今天早些时候在新闻发布会上说。

source_text: Based on past experience, this pandemic will be with us for some months, if not years, to come."
target_text: 根据过去的经验，这场大流行将伴随我们几个月，甚至数年。”

source_text: Chan, however, stressed the move does not indicate that the influenza has become more deadly or severe.
target_text: 然而，陈强调此举并未表明流感已变得更致命或严重。

source_text: "Moving to pandemic phase six does not imply we will see increases in deaths or serious cases," she said.
target_text: “转向大流行六期并不意味着我们会看到死亡或严重病例的增加，”她说。

source_text: The WHO says that many of the severe cases of the virus are reported in people with prior chronic illnesses.
target_text: 世界卫生组织表示，在患有既往慢性疾病的人群中报告了许多严重的病毒病例。

source_text: Of those infected, the WHO says the majority are aged from 30 to 50 years old.
target_text: 在感染者中，世界卫生组织表示，大多数人年龄在30至50岁之间。

source_text: Currently, the WHO's official tally says there were almost thirty thousand confirmed cases of the H1N1 virus so far, with about 141 fatalities from the disease.
target_text: 目前，世界卫生组织的官方统计数据显示，到目前为止，已有近三万例甲型H1N1流感病毒确诊病例，其中约有141例死于该病。

source_text: Numerous smuggled artifacts were found at an Austrian tour guide's home.
target_text: 在一名奥地利导游的家里发现了许多走私的文物。

source_text: Five Italians were arrested and twenty-eight others are now being investigated.
target_text: 五名意大利人被捕，另有二十八人正在接受调查。

source_text: The Austrian, known as "Mozart" in the art trafficking world, received a citation for his involvement.
target_text: 在艺术品走私界被称为“莫扎特”的奥地利人也参与其中。

source_text: Many of the items were gold and silver, along with ceramics.
target_text: 其中许多都是金银器物，并有部分陶器。

source_text: One item, a cup, has been valued at several thousand Euros.
target_text: 其中一件，一个杯子，就价值数千欧元。

source_text: The artifacts were plundered from an archaeological site near Rome by "Mozart" using his tour guide credentials.
target_text: 这些文物是由“莫扎特”使用他的导游证书从罗马附近的考古遗址中盗出的。

source_text: A compound in the common daisy-like plant feverfew kills human leukemia stem cells and could form the basis for newer, more effective drugs for the disease.
target_text: 常见的菊花状植物小白菊中的一种化合物会杀死人类白血病干细胞，并可能成为更新，更有效的治疗该疾病的基础。

source_text: American researchers at the University of Rochester Medical Center in New York say that it could take months to develop a useable drug from the compound, parthenolide.
target_text: 纽约罗彻斯特大学医学中心的美国研究人员表示，从化合物小白菊内酯开发可用药物可能需要数月时间。

source_text: However, they are working to do so with chemists at the University of Kentucky who have identified a water-soluble molecule with the same properties.
target_text: 然而，他们正在努力与肯塔基大学的化学家合作，他们已经确定了具有相同特性的水溶性分子。

source_text: "This research is a very important step in setting the stage for future development of a new therapy for leukemia," says Rochester researcher Craig Jordan.
target_text: 罗切斯特研究员克雷格・乔丹说：“这项研究是为白血病新疗法的未来发展奠定了非常重要的一步。”

source_text: "We have proof that we can kill leukemia stem cells with this type of agent, and that is good news."
target_text: “我们已经证明我们可以用这种类型的药剂杀死白血病干细胞，这是个好消息。”

source_text: Parthenolide appears to target the roots of myeloid leukemia, stem cells, while current treatments including the relatively new drug Gleevec don't.
target_text: 小白菊内酯似乎针对骨髓白血病的根基，干细胞进行攻击，而当下的治疗包括相对较新的药物格列卫都无法做到这点。

source_text: So, "You're pulling the weed without getting to the root," says Jordan.
target_text: 因此，“你无法在不除根的情况下清除杂草，”乔丹说。

source_text: Used for centuries to fight fevers, inflammation and arthritis, feverfew earned interest from the Rochester researchers after other scientists showed that it could prevent skin cancer in animal models.
target_text: 几个世纪以来一直用于对抗发烧，炎症和关节炎，在其他科学家证明可以预防动物模型中的皮肤癌后，小白菊获得了罗切斯特研究人员的兴趣。

source_text: So the researchers investigated how a concentrated form of the plant component parthenolide would affect leukemia cells and normal cells.
target_text: 因此，研究人员研究了浓缩形式的植物成分小白菊内酯如何影响白血病细胞和正常细胞。

source_text: Comparing the impact of parthenolide to the common chemotherapy drug cytarabine, they found that parthenolide selectively killed leukemia cells while sparing normal cells better.
target_text: 比较小白菊内酯对普通化疗药物阿糖胞苷的影响，他们发现小白菊内酯选择性地杀死白血病细胞，同时更好地保留正常细胞。

source_text: While the findings suggest that parthenolide is a good starting point for new drugs, people with leukemia aren't being encouraged to take high doses of feverfew as they could not take enough of the remedy to halt the disease.
target_text: 虽然研究结果表明小白菊内酯是新药的良好起点，但不鼓励患有白血病的人服用高剂量的小白菊，因为他们无法采取足够的药物来阻止这种疾病。

source_text: On Monday, Russian troops advanced roughly 25 miles into Georgia.
target_text: 周一，俄罗斯军队向格鲁吉亚推进了大约25英里。

source_text: The Russian Defence department has stated that the push into Georgian territory was necessary because of the continued attacks by the Georgian troops in South Ossetia.
target_text: 俄罗斯国防部表示，由于格鲁吉亚军队继续在南奥塞梯发动袭击，必须进入格鲁吉亚领土。

source_text: Dmitry Medvedev, the President of Russia, stated that "the enforced detention of Russian citizens in Georgia is an unacceptable situation and in complete violation of international law," according to a press release published by the Russia Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
target_text: 俄罗斯外交部发布的新闻稿称，俄罗斯总统德米特里梅德韦杰夫表示，“在格鲁吉亚强行拘留俄罗斯公民是一种令人无法接受的情况，完全违反国际法。”

source_text: On August 11th, the Russian Defence Ministry announced that troops are leaving the military base in Senaki, and preparing to head back to Abkhazia.
target_text: 8月11日，俄罗斯国防部宣布部队正离开塞纳基的军事基地，并准备返回阿布哈兹。

source_text: Georgian sources confirmed the announcement, stating that the base had been destroyed.
target_text: 格鲁吉亚消息来源证实了这一消息，称该基地已被摧毁。

source_text: According to Russian officials, Russia has no intention of occupying territory beyond South Ossetia and Abkhazia.
target_text: 据俄罗斯官员称，俄罗斯无意占领南奥塞梯和阿布哈兹以外的领土。

source_text: Both the town of Senaki and Zugdidi lie in Georgia proper, outside the "security zone" around the region of Abkhazia.
target_text: 塞纳基镇和祖格迪迪镇都位于格鲁吉亚境内，位于阿布哈兹地区周围的“安全区”之外。

source_text: The border has been maintained by Russian forces since the 1990s.
target_text: 自20世纪90年代以来，俄罗斯军队一直维持边界。

source_text: There has been increasing pressure by foreign powers for a ceasefire in the South Ossetian conflict.
target_text: 在南奥塞梯冲突中，外国势力要求停火的压力越来越大。

source_text: Mikhail Saakashvili, the President of Georgia signed a European Union supported ceasefire, but it was not accepted by Russia.
target_text: 格鲁吉亚总统米哈伊尔·萨卡什维利签署了欧盟支持的停火协议，但俄罗斯并未接受。

source_text: According to Reuters, Georgian troops did not observe the cease fire, since six helicopters bombed Tskhinvali on August 11.
target_text: 据路透社报道，由于六架直升机于8月11日轰炸了茨欣瓦利，格鲁吉亚军队没有遵守停火协议。

source_text: The crisis broke out after days of fighting between Georgian forces and Ossetian separatist units.
target_text: 在格鲁吉亚军队和奥赛梯分离主义分子之间的几天战斗之后，危机爆发了。

source_text: On August 7, Georgian troops launched an offensive against Tskhinvali, the capital of South Ossetia region.
target_text: 8月7日，格鲁吉亚军队对南奥塞梯地区首府茨欣瓦利发起进攻。

source_text: The next day Russian forces entered the territory of Georgia and bombed several targets in the country.
target_text: 第二天，俄罗斯军队进入格鲁吉亚领土并轰炸了该国的几个目标。

source_text: On August 10th, Russian Black Sea Fleet began a naval blockade of Georgian port of Poti and landed several thousand Russian troops in Abkhazia in western Georgia.
target_text: 8月10日，俄罗斯黑海舰队开始对格鲁吉亚波蒂港进行海上封锁，并在佐治亚州西部的阿布哈兹登陆数千名俄罗斯军队。

source_text: Ukraine threatened to bar Russian warships dispatched to the Abkhazian coast from returning to their Ukrainian base of Sevastopol if they engage in any military action.
target_text: 乌克兰威胁说，如果被派遣到阿布哈兹海岸的俄罗斯军舰参与任何军事行动，他们将禁止返回乌克兰塞瓦斯托波尔基地。

source_text: Robert Mugabe, president of the Republic of Zimbabwe bitterly slated opposition and the United Kingdom, Zimbabwe's former colonial ruler, in a speech he made earlier today.
target_text: 津巴布韦共和国总统穆加贝在今天早些时候发表的讲话中痛斥反对派和津巴布韦前殖民统治者英国。

source_text: This is his first speech after the recent disputed elections in which Morgan Tsvangirai's Movement for Democratic Change (MDC) won the parliamentary voting.
target_text: 这是在摩根·茨万吉拉伊的民主变革运动（MDC）赢得议会投票后的第一次演讲。

source_text: However announcement of an overall victory for the MDC has come to a standstill as results from 23 out of the 210 constituencies are still being recounted.
target_text: 然而，由于210个选区中有23个选区的选举结果仍在重新计算中，民主变革运动取得全面胜利宣言已停止。

source_text: Mr. Mugabe asked his 15,000 strong audience to "maintain utmost vigilance in the face of vicious British machinations and the machinations of our other detractors, who are allies of Britain" while speaking at the Gwanzura Stadium in Zimbabwe's capital city of Harare.
target_text: 穆加贝在津巴布韦首都哈拉雷的格万祖拉体育场发表讲话时，要求他的15000名听众“在英国恶毒的阴谋和英国盟友的诽谤和阴谋面前保持高度警惕”。

source_text: The audience wore shirts adorned with Mugabe portraits and waved banners reading "Defending our land from imperialists" and "Zimbabwe has no place for sell-outs" in support of Zanu-PF policies.
target_text: 观众们穿着印有穆加贝肖像的衬衫，挥舞着横幅，上面写着“保卫我们的土地不受帝国主义的侵扰”和“津巴布韦没有地方出售”来支持民盟的政策。

source_text: "Down with the British" was chanted, Mr. Mugabe saying the British are "like thieves fronting their lackeys among us, which they pay to confuse our people".
target_text: 穆加贝高呼“打倒英国人”，他说英国人“和他们的走狗就像小偷一样混在我们当中，他们用钱来迷惑我们的人民”。

source_text: "We, not the British, established democracy based on one person, one vote - democracy which rejected racial or gender discrimination and upheld human rights and religious freedom," he said in response to the international criticism he has lately received, especially from Gordon Brown.
target_text: “我们，而不是英国人，建立了基于一人一票的民主制度，这一制度拒绝种族或性别歧视，维护人权和宗教自由，”他在回应他最近收到的国际批评时说，特别是针对来自戈登·布朗的批评。

source_text: The speech was made in a celebration of 28 years since the day of Zimbabwean independence, which Mr. Mugabe called the day on which his nation "finally shook off the chains of British racist settler colonialism".
target_text: 这一讲话是为了庆祝津巴布韦独立28周年，穆加贝称这一天他的国家“终于摆脱了英国种族主义者的殖民枷锁”。

source_text: With fifty days left to until the start of the 2012 Summer Paralympics, the Australian Paralympic Committee earlier today announced the 35-member final swimming Paralympic squad bound for the London Games.
target_text: 距离2012年夏季残奥会开幕还有50天，澳大利亚残奥委员会今天早些时候宣布，将组建最后由35人组成的残奥游泳队，前往伦敦奥运会。

source_text: Five Queensland swimmers have earned spots to London, including Kayla Clarke of Silkstone, Daniel Fox of Cleveland, Brenden Hall of Petrie, Grant Patterson of Cairns and Rick Pendleton of Sippy Downs.
target_text: 五位昆士兰游泳运动员已经在伦敦获得了一席之地，其中包括锡克斯通的凯拉·克拉克、克利夫兰的丹尼尔·福克斯、皮特里的布伦登大厅、凯恩斯的格兰特·帕特森和西皮·唐斯的里克·彭德尔顿。

source_text: Only four Victorians booked a trip to London, including Matthew Haanappel of Croydon Hills, Tanya Huebner of Hampton, Ahmed Kelly of North Melbourne and Prue Watt of Hawthorn East.
target_text: 只有四位维多利亚人预订了伦敦之旅，包括克罗伊登山的马修·哈纳佩尔、汉普顿的坦雅·休布纳、北墨尔本的艾哈迈德·凯利和霍桑东部的普鲁·瓦特。

source_text: South Australia qualified three swimmers, including Matthew Cowdrey of Seaton, Jay Dohnt of Ferrydon Park and Esther Overton of Enfield.
target_text: 南澳大利亚有三名游泳选手，包括西顿的马修·考德瑞、费里登公园的杰伊·多恩和恩菲尔德的埃丝特·奥弗顿。

source_text: Western Australia and the Australian Capital Territory are each sending two swimmers, with Katherine Downie of Quinns Rocks and Jeremy McClure of Mount Pleasant representing Western Australia and Ellie Cole of Bruce and Richard Eliason of Flynn representing the Australian Capital Territory.
target_text: 西澳州和澳大利亚首都领土各派出两名游泳运动员，代表西澳大利亚的来自昆斯山的凯瑟琳·唐尼和普莱森特山的杰里米·麦克鲁尔，代表澳大利亚首都领土的布鲁斯的埃莉·科尔和弗林的理查德·艾莉森。

source_text: Tasmania and the Northern Territory did not qualify any swimmers.
target_text: 塔斯马尼亚和北领地没有任何游泳运动员获得参赛资格。

source_text: The team will travel to London for a training camp on August 10 ahead of the August 29 start of the Games.
target_text: 该队将于8月10日在8月29日奥运会开幕前前往伦敦参加训练营。

source_text: Ten suspected terrorists were arrested in three different parts of Britain.
target_text: 十名涉嫌恐怖分子在英国三个不同地区被捕。

source_text: In the Croydon section of south London three men were arrested.
target_text: 在伦敦南部的克罗伊登区，有三名男子被捕。

source_text: In Wolverhampton four were arrested in a series of dawn raids at three addresses and three in Derby, Scotland Yard said.
target_text: 伦敦警察厅称，在伍尔弗汉普顿，4人在一系列黎明突袭中在3个地点被捕，3人在德比被捕。

source_text: The anonymous individual responsible for suggesting, 14 hours before police discovered the body, that WWE wrestler Chris Benoit's wife was dead is saying his/her comment was a "terrible coincidence."
target_text: 警方称在发现尸体14小时前，暗示WWE摔跤手克里斯·贝诺特的妻子已经死亡的匿名人士的评论只是“可怕的巧合”。

source_text: In a post made at 12:26 AM EDT Friday morning to the talk page of a Wikinews article headlined as the "Death of Nancy Benoit rumour posted on Wikipedia hours prior to body being found", the user admitted to writing that Nancy Benoit was dead at the Wikipedia article page for Benoit came from information that was garnered from "rumors and speculation online."
target_text: 在美国东部时间星期五上午12：26发布到维基新闻的一篇标题为“尸体被发现前几个小时在维基百科上发布的南希·贝诺伊特的死亡谣言”的文章中，用户承认在维基百科的一篇文章中写到南希·贝诺伊特死亡的信息来源于“谣言和猜测在线”网站。

source_text: The IP Address of the individual making the apology was identical to that of the one who posted the Nancy Benoit rumor, a strong confirmation of the admission's authenticity.
target_text: 做出道歉的人的IP地址与发布南希·贝诺伊特谣言的人的IP地址相同，这是对承认真实性的有力确认。

source_text: The lengthy apology was not signed, with the individual claiming, "I am just an everyday individual who posted a wrongful remark at the time that received so much attention because it turned out to actually happen."
target_text: 漫长的道歉没有署名，个人声称，“我只是一个每天都发表错误评论的人，当时收到了如此多的关注，因为事实证明它确实发生了。”

source_text: The fact the edit originated from a computer in Stamford, Connecticut (the site of WWE headquarters) appears to be another coincidence.
target_text: 编辑来自康涅狄格州斯坦福德（WWE总部所在地）的一台计算机，这似乎是另一个巧合。

source_text: The anonymous editor left a lengthy apology to the Wikimedia community, explaining, "I hope this puts an end to this speculation that someone knew about the tragedy before it was discovered."
target_text: 这位匿名编辑向维基媒体社区做了一个冗长的道歉，解释说：“我希望这能结束人们在悲剧被发现之前就知道此事的猜测。”

source_text: Wikinews is continuing to follow the story, but the anonymous user has declined an interview.
target_text: 维基新闻继续关注这个事件，但匿名用户拒绝接受采访。

source_text: Illinois Governor Rod Blagojevich’s office announced layoffs of up to 450 state employees and the closure of 25 historic sites and state parks.
target_text: 伊利诺伊州州长罗德·布拉戈耶维奇的办公室宣布裁员多达450名州雇员，关闭25处历史遗迹和州立公园。

source_text: Fourteen state historic sites are scheduled to be closed October 1.
target_text: 14个州历史遗迹定于10月1日关闭。

source_text: A spokesperson for the governor stated that the office had no choice but to make the budget cuts because of a faltering economy and an unbalanced state budget.
target_text: 州长的一位发言人说，由于经济不稳定和州预算不平衡，该办公室别无选择，只能进行预算削减。

source_text: Included in the cuts were the Illinois Department of Natural Resources (IDNR), which operates the state parks, the Department of Children and Family Services (IDCFS), slated to have 179 employees cut, the Illinois Historic Preservation Agency (IHPA) and the Department of Human Services, which is expected to lose 79 positions.
target_text: 其中包括负责管理州立公园的伊利诺伊州自然资源部（IDNR），计划裁员179人的儿童和家庭服务部（IDCFS），预计将裁减79个职位的伊利诺伊州历史保护局（IHPA）和人力资源部。

source_text: The IHPA, which operates the state historic sites slated for closure will cut some 38 positions.
target_text: 该州历史遗址的运营商IHPA将削减大约38个职位。

source_text: The closures and job cuts will save the state money over the next fiscal year.
target_text: 关闭和裁员将在下一个财政年度节省州资金。

source_text: Cuts in the IDNR will save an estimated US$19.5 million and cuts at the IDCFS will save around US$2 million.
target_text: 裁减IDNR将节省约1950万美元，裁减IDCFS将节省约200万美元。

source_text: The closures are considered indefinite but will last at least through the end of the fiscal year, July 1, 2009.
target_text: 关闭被认为是无限期的，并至少会持续到2009年7月1日财政年度结束。

source_text: Each site will have one employee on site for security and maintenance.
target_text: 每个现场将有一名员工在现场进行安全和维护。

source_text: Once entrances to state parks are barred on November 1, the public will no longer be allowed to enter the sites.
target_text: 从11月1日起将封闭州立公园，公众将不再被允许进入公园。

source_text: Any member of the public entering the closed state parks after November 1 could be arrested and charged with trespassing.
target_text: 11月1日之后进入封闭的州立公园的任何公民都可能被逮捕并被控非法侵入。

source_text: Two museums in San Diego, California have been bequested an art collection worth more than 40 million.
target_text: 加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥的两家博物馆已经收到价值超过4000万美元的艺术收藏品。

source_text: The art collection was donated by Dr. Vance E. Kondon and Elisabeth Giesberger to both the Museum of Contemporary Art San Diego and the San Diego Museum of Art.
target_text: 万斯·E·康登博士和伊丽莎白·吉斯伯格将这批艺术品捐赠给了圣地亚哥当代艺术博物馆和圣地亚哥艺术博物馆。

source_text: Kondon, a former board member of the Museum of Contemporary Art, died in 1997 and Giesberger died in 2011.
target_text: 康登曾是当代艺术博物馆的董事会成员，1997年去世，而吉斯伯格于2011年去世。

source_text: Kondon was a notable art collector in San Diego, and collected for over 30 years.
target_text: 康登是圣地亚哥著名的艺术收藏家，从事收藏30多年。

source_text: The collection will be separated between the two museums due to the art movements represented within it.
target_text: 由于博物馆内的艺术活动，两个博物馆的藏品将被分开。

source_text: The Museum of Contemporary Art will receive 30 contemporary works by artists such as Franz Kline, Christo, and Craig Kauffman.
target_text: 当代艺术博物馆将收到弗兰兹·克莱恩、克里斯托和克雷格·考夫曼等30幅当代艺术家的作品。

source_text: The Museum of Art was bequeathed 48 German Expressionist paintings, drawings and prints.
target_text: 艺术博物馆遗赠了48幅德国表现主义绘画、绘画和版画。

source_text: This collection includes artworks by Otto Dix, Gustav Klimt, and Egon Schiele.
target_text: 该系列包括奥托·迪克斯、古斯塔夫·克里姆特和埃贡·席勒的作品。

source_text: Microsoft Corporation announced plans to launch a new security product later this year, named Windows OneCare.
target_text: 微软公司宣布计划在今年晚些时候推出一款名为Windows OneCare的新安全产品。

source_text: Product features are to include anti-virus software capabilities, a new firewall and PC tune ups.
target_text: 产品功能包括防病毒软件功能、新防火墙和PC调整。

source_text: The PC tune ups include utilities for improved backup and restore capabilities, and easy access to Windows PC maintenance tools for file repair and hard drive clean up.
target_text: PC调整包括用于改进备份和恢复功能的实用程序，以及用于文件修复和硬盘清理的Windows PC维护工具的轻松访问。

source_text: An early beta version of product, not including the anti-spyware capability, has already been released to Microsoft employees.
target_text: 早期的测试版产品，不包括反间谍软件功能，已经发布给微软员工。

source_text: Microsoft plans to make Windows OneCare available to customers for a yearly subscription fee.
target_text: 微软计划以年费订阅的方式向客户提供Windows OneCare。

source_text: Recently, Microsoft bought Giant software, makers of antivirus and spyware prevention software.
target_text: 最近，微软收购了反病毒和间谍软件预防软件制造商巨人软件。

source_text: The American Red Cross is not lending its usual assistance in New Orleans, because the Louisiana National Guard acted first.
target_text: 因为路易斯安那州国民警卫队率先采取了行动，美国红十字会没有在新奥尔良提供通常的援助。

source_text: After Saturday September 3, it was agreed with state officials the Red Cross was not needed because the large-scale evacuation of the city was under way.
target_text: 在9月3日星期六之后，与州政府官员商定，不需要红十字会，因为该市正在进行大规模撤离。

source_text: Making the offer the next day to Col. Jay Mayeaux, the deputy director of the Louisiana Office of Homeland Security and Emergency Preparedness, the Red Cross was asked to wait 24 hours while preparations were made.
target_text: 第二天，美国红十字会向路易斯安那州国土安全和应急准备办公室副主任杰伊·马约克斯上校发出了邀请，但红十字会被要求在准备工作期间等待24小时。

source_text: Super Typhoon Saomai made landfall in the eastern province Zhejiang in China around 5:30 p.m. Thursday afternoon.
target_text: 超强台风桑美于星期四的下午5：30左右在中国浙江省东部登陆。

source_text: By Friday evening Saomai had left a path of destruction in Zhejiang and neighboring province Fujian.
target_text: 到了星期五晚上，桑美在浙江和邻省福建留下了毁灭之路。

source_text: Over 100 people have been reported dead with even more missing.
target_text: 据报道，已有100多人死亡，更多人失踪。

source_text: An estimated 3.5 million people were affected by the storm, some 1.6 million of whom were evacuated.
target_text: 估计有350万人受到这场风暴的影响，其中约有160万人被疏散。

source_text: Reports from the civil affairs bureau tell of large-scale material destruction.
target_text: 民政局的报告讲述了大规模的物质破坏。

source_text: In Zhejiang, 18,000 houses were destroyed and in Fujian, 32,000.
target_text: 在浙江，18000所房屋被毁，福建省有32000所房屋被毁。

source_text: Phone and power lines were knocked down and outages were wide-spread.
target_text: 电话和电源线被吹倒，引发了大范围停电。

source_text: With wind speeds of 216 km/h (135 mph) at the time of landfall it is the strongest typhoon to hit China since August 1, 1956, when a storm with wind speeds of 244 km/h killed 4,900 people.
target_text: 台风登陆时风速216公里／小时（135英里／小时），是1956年8月1日以来中国遭遇的最强台风，当时风速244公里／小时的台风造成4900人死亡。

source_text: Emergency plans have been implemented and supplies are being sent in from other provinces.
target_text: 政府已经实施了应急计划，并从其他省份运送物资。

source_text: The central government has allocated 166 million yuan to assist the affected region.
target_text: 中央政府已拨款1.66亿元援助受灾地区。

source_text: Divers from the combined teams of the Philippine Navy and Coast Guard helped in the rescue operations.
target_text: 菲律宾海军和海岸警卫队的潜水员联合起来帮助了救援行动。

source_text: 11 of the fatalities, including the vessel owner, Arellano, and her daughter were identified.
target_text: 11人死亡，包括船主阿雷拉诺和她的女儿被确认。

source_text: The police said "there was a possibility that the boat was overloaded," saying that "there was also livestock on board."
target_text: 警方说，“有可能是船超载了，”并称，“船上还有牲畜。”

source_text: Due to "trauma," the ferry's captain refused to talk to police.
target_text: 由于“创伤”，渡船的船长拒绝与警察交谈。

source_text: Meanwhile, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) formed a Special Board of Marine Inquiry (SBMI) to investigate the sea tragedy.
target_text: 与此同时，菲律宾海岸警卫队（PCG）组建了一个海洋调查特别委员会（SBMI）来调查此次悲剧。

source_text: It ordered the "immediate dispatch of SAR-003 and MCS-3005 vessels and the PCG Islander for aerial surveillance."
target_text: 它下令“立即派遣SAR-003和MCS-3005船只以及PCG岛上的居民进行空中监视”。

source_text: PCG noted the possible overloading of the vessel since the boat's franchise authorized it to carry only 40 passengers and 10 crew members.
target_text: PCG注意到船只可能超载，因为该船的特许经营权授权它只能运载40名乘客和10名船员。

source_text: In November, a cargo vessel sank in rough seas north of Cagayan, and passing vessels rescued 16 of 20 passengers.
target_text: 11月，一艘货船在卡加延北部的波涛汹涌的海面上沉没，过往的船只救出了20名乘客中的16名。

source_text: Weeks earlier, separate storms sank two passenger vessels in the central Philippines, drowning more than 50 people.
target_text: 几周前，菲律宾中部的两艘客轮因风暴而沉没，50多人溺水身亡。

source_text: Prior to the ferry sinking, the Philippine weather bureau had issued Gale warnings to coastal towns, of approaching tropical storm "Ulysses" (international codename: Dolphin) from the Pacific with winds of up to 60 miles (95 kilometers) per hour, centered off southeastern Catanduanes, eastern Philippines.
target_text: 在渡轮沉没之前，菲律宾气象局已向沿海城镇发出大风警告，从太平洋以每小时60英里（95公里）的风速接近热带风暴“尤利西斯”（国际代号：海豚），中心位于菲律宾东部卡坦多内斯东南部。

source_text: During a press conference yesterday, United States military and intelligence officials presented material they say link weapons used by Iraq fighters to Iran.
target_text: 在昨天的新闻发布会上，美国军方和情报官员展示了他们所说的伊拉克战斗人员使用的武器与伊朗有关的材料。

source_text: Defense Secretary Robert Gates told reporters in Madrid on Friday that the there was "pretty good" evidence that Iranians are supplying either weapons or technology to Iraqi militants.
target_text: 国防部长罗伯特・盖茨星期五在马德里告诉记者，有“非常好”的证据表明伊朗人向伊拉克武装分子提供武器或技术。

source_text: No recording devices of any kind were allowed during the press conference.
target_text: 记者招待会期间不允许使用任何类型的录音设备。

source_text: Reacting to the U.S. claims, Iran's President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad said in a television interview that the allegations were "excuses to prolong the stay" of the U.S. military in Iraq, and that the U.S. was pointing fingers at others in an effort to "hide its defeats and failures"; however in an interview with Diane Sawyer on February 12th, Ahmadinejad refused to address accusations that his country was supplying weapons to insurgents in Iraq.
target_text: 伊朗总统艾哈迈迪・内贾德对美国的说法作出回应，在电视采访中说，这些指控是“延长美军在伊拉克逗留时间的借口”，美国指责其他国家企图“掩盖其失利和失败”；但是在2月12日对黛安索耶的采访中，内贾德的反应是，他拒绝回应有关伊朗向伊拉克叛乱分子提供武器的指控。

source_text: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Mohammad Ali Hossein termed the accusations baseless propaganda and said that the U.S. had a long history of "fabricating evidence".
target_text: 伊朗外交部发言人穆罕默德·阿里·侯赛因称这一指控是毫无根据的宣传，并说美国“伪造证据”的历史由来已久。

source_text: American officials displayed weaponry including Explosively Formed Penetrators (EFPs) and thermal detectors used for remotely exploding bombs.
target_text: 美国官员展示了武器，包括爆炸成型的穿甲弹（EFP）和用于远程爆炸炸弹的热探测器。

source_text: The officials claimed that such sophisticated weaponry could not have been assembled by the Shia militia and said that it must have been supplied from neighbouring Iran.
target_text: 官方声称，这些尖端武器不可能由什叶派民兵组装，并说一定是由邻国伊朗提供。

source_text: The U.S. view is that only a state arms company would have the ability to manufacture weapons of this kind and the officials maintained that the weapons were smuggled in to Iraq by the Qods Force of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) and have estimated that such an operation was known to the Iranian government and encouraged by it, but did not present any evidence to support the claims.
target_text: 美国认为，只有国有武器公司才有能力制造此类武器，官员们坚持认为，这些武器是由伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）的Qods部队走私到伊拉克的，并估计伊朗政府知道并受到伊朗政府的鼓励，但没有提供任何证据来支持这一主张。

target_text: 工人们正在采取非官方行动，支持在英国林肯郡的林赛炼油厂举行为期三天的罢工。

source_text: Staff have walked out at sites in Scotland, Wales and Teesside in north eastern England.
target_text: 在苏格兰、威尔士和英格兰东北部的蒂赛德，工作人员已停工。

source_text: The original strike was called over the awarding of a contract by refinery owners Total to an Italian company.
target_text: 最初的罢工是因为炼油厂业主道达尔将合同授予一家意大利公司。

source_text: This brought 300 Italian and Portuguese workers on to the site.
target_text: 这使300名意大利和葡萄牙工人进入工地。

source_text: The latest reports say workers at the UK's main oil refinery at Grangemouth in Scotland have come out in sympathy, as have workers at the former ICI plant on Teesside in England and at the nearby Corus steel plant.
target_text: 最新的报道说，在苏格兰格兰杰默斯的英国主要炼油厂工作的工人表示了同情，在英国蒂赛德的前ICI工厂和附近的科鲁斯钢铁厂工作的工人也表示同情。

source_text: Workers have walked out at a power station in Aberthaw in south Wales and at plants at Fidler's Ferry in Cheshire, at Lackenby in Teesside and at the gas terminals near Peterhead in Scotland and Milford Haven in Wales.
target_text: 工人们在南威尔士阿伯索的一个发电站，柴郡的费德勒渡口，蒂赛德的拉肯比，苏格兰的彼得黑德附近的加油站和威尔士的米尔福德港都举行了罢工。

source_text: A protest outside the Lindsey refinery has now dispersed but local union leaders say it will resume on Monday.
target_text: 林赛炼油厂外的抗议活动现已散去，但当地工会领导人说，抗议活动将于周一恢复。

source_text: Secondary industrial action has been illegal in the United Kingdom since the 1980s.
target_text: 自20世纪80年代以来，二次工业行动在英国是非法的。

source_text: However, the penalties apply only to unions organising secondary strikes, not to workers acting individually.
target_text: 但是，处罚仅适用于组织二次罢工的工会，而不适用于单独行事的工人。

source_text: Wikipedia hit the half-million mark Friday as the English-language encyclopedia passed the 500 thousand article mark, according to a press prelease by the Wikimedia Foundation (The Wikimedia Foundation also runs Wikinews).
target_text: 根据维基媒体基金会的新闻预告（维基媒体基金会还运行维基新闻），维基百科星期五达到了50万里程碑，因为英语百科收录了超过50万个条目。

source_text: The article that put the site over the top was Involuntary settlements in the Soviet Union.
target_text: 将该网站置于首页的文章是《苏联的非自愿结算》。

source_text: The total of 500 thousand articles exceeds any other encyclopedia, according to the press release.
target_text: 根据新闻稿，共有50万篇文章的数量超过任何其他百科全书。

source_text: With an average of 2,500 characters per article, Wikipedia contains 1.25 gigabytes of raw text, which if printed on double-sided letter-size paper would form a stack about 66 feet or more than six stories tall.
target_text: 每篇文章平均2500个字符，维基百科包含1.25千兆字节的原始文本，如果用双面信纸打印，大约能堆66英尺或6层楼那么高。

source_text: Other recent additions to its English-language edition include hundreds of full-length songs, almost a gigabyte of new images, and subject-specific portals.
target_text: 它的英文版最近增加了数百首全长歌曲，几乎一个千兆字节的新图像，以及特定主题的门户网站。

source_text: In response to recent accusations that United States government employees have engaged in Wikipedia vandalism and other forms of perceived negative editing of articles, Wikipedia editors have set up a webpage listing all Wikipedia edits made through IP addresses that are allocated to the United States House of Representatives and other United States government agencies.
target_text: 为了回应最近有关美国政府雇员参与维基百科破坏和其他形式的负面文章编辑的指控，维基百科的编辑们已经建立了一个网页，列出所有维基百科通过分配给美国众议院和其他美国政府机构的IP地址所做的编辑。

source_text: The House IP address was briefly banned from editing Wikipedia articles in the wake of the initial controversy, but the ban was lifted on January 30 after Wikipedia administrators decided that there have been a number of valuable contributions made through the House and Senate IP addresses in addition to the controversial edits.
target_text: 在最初的争论之后，众议院的IP地址被暂时禁止编辑维基百科文章，但是在维基百科管理员决定除了有争议的编辑之外，众议院和参议院的IP地址也做出了一些有价值的贡献之后，禁令于1月30日被取消。

source_text: On January 31 and February 1, however, the U.S. House of Representatives' common IP address, 143.231.249.141, were banned again for three hours due to vandalism.
target_text: 然而，在1月31日和2月1日，美国众议院的公共IP地址143.231.249.141因故意破坏而再次被禁止三小时。

source_text: Because the IP address is shared by House staff members, it is uncertain whether or not the same person(s) responsible for the previous vandalism are also responsible for the latest.
target_text: 由于IP地址由众议院工作人员共享，因此不确定对先前的破坏行为负责的同一个人是否也对最近的破坏行为负责。

source_text: After the block from Wikipedia expired, the House of Representatives user continued to edit the article on Chris Shays.
target_text: 在维基百科的禁止到期后，众议院用户继续编辑关于克里斯·谢斯的文章。

source_text: Chris Shays had co-sponsored a bill with Marty Meehan, whose staffers had previously been found to have been negatively editing Wikipedia entries, The American Civil Liberties Union said of the bill "key elements of Shays-Meehan violate the First Amendment right to free speech because the legislation contains provisions that would violate the constitutionally-protected right of the people to express their opinions about issues through broadcast advertising if they mention the name of a candidate."
target_text: 克里斯·谢斯与马蒂·米汉共同发起了一项法案，之前他们的工作人员被发现对维基百科条目进行了负面编辑。美国公民自由联盟提到这项法案时说，“谢斯与米汉主要违反了《第一修正案》的言论自由权，因为该法案包含的条款违反了宪法保护的人们在提到候选人姓名时，通过广播广告表达他们对问题的意见的权利。”

source_text: All mentions of the bill were removed from the article.
target_text: 所有提到的法案都从文章中删去了。

source_text: Also removed was a paragraph about Chris Shays raising $70,000 with House Speaker Dennis Hastert at a country club event.
target_text: 同时删除了一段关于克里斯·谢斯在乡村俱乐部活动中与众议院议长丹尼斯·哈斯特尔特一起筹集7万美元的内容。

source_text: Again, the IP address was blocked for an eight-hour period.
target_text: 再次，IP地址被禁止了8个小时。

source_text: Wikipedia edits in Congress are not coming from the House of Representatives alone.
target_text: 维基百科在国会的编辑并非仅来自众议院。

source_text: An edit from the Senate in July removed references to a plagiarism scandal with Senator Joe Biden, who has informally said he may seek a Democratic nomination for president in 2008.
target_text: 参议院7月份的一篇编辑文章删除了对参议员乔·拜登的剽窃丑闻的引用。拜登曾非正式地表示，他可能在2008年寻求民主党总统候选人提名。

source_text: As of February 4, 2006, the edit has not been fixed by Wikipedia users.
target_text: 截至2006年2月4日，维基百科用户尚未对编辑进行修改。

source_text: Redwood City, California - The jury in the Scott Peterson trial suggest that Peterson receive the death penalty.
target_text: 加利福尼亚州雷德伍德城。斯科特・彼得森审判中的陪审团表示，彼得森将被判处死刑。

source_text: Peterson was found guilty of murdering his pregnant wife Laci and their unborn child.
target_text: 彼得森因谋杀怀孕的妻子拉奇及其未出生的孩子而被判有罪。

source_text: The official sentence will be announced on February 25th, 2005.
target_text: 官方判决将于2005年2月25日公布。

source_text: The Central Tibetan Administration, headed by the Dalai Lama, says that at least 80 people have been killed in protests by supporters of Tibet against Chinese rule, despite China's claim that only ten people are dead.
target_text: 以达赖喇嘛为首的西藏中央政府表示，尽管中国声称只有十人死亡，但至少有80人在西藏支持者反对中国统治的抗议活动中丧生。

source_text: "As the Tibet uprising continues, reliable sources have confirmed that at least 80 people were killed on 14th March 2008 in Lhasa," the website Tibet.net reported.
target_text: “随着西藏起义的继续，可靠消息来源证实，2008年3月14日拉萨至少有80人遇难，”Tibet.net网站报道。

source_text: They also said that many dead bodies have been stashed in front of a Public Security Department office in Lhasa, the Tibetan capital where most of the unrest occurred.
target_text: 他们还说，许多尸体被藏在西藏首都拉萨的一个公安部办公室前，那里发生了大部分骚乱。

source_text: The report from Xinhua, China's state-run news agency, was much different.
target_text: 中国官方新闻机构新华社的报道大不相同。

source_text: "In Friday's riot, at least ten civilians died, mostly from burns caused by the roving mobs and some others were injured," Xinhua said, citing the Tibetan Regional Government's report.
target_text: 新华社援引西藏地区政府的报告称，“在星期五的骚乱中，至少有十名平民死亡，其中大多数是由流动的暴徒引起的烧伤和其他一些人受伤”。

source_text: Additionally, they reported that police in Lhasa had saved 580 people, including an entire school, from the violent array of sabotage.
target_text: 此外，他们报告说，拉萨的警察已经拯救了580人，其中包括整个学校，以免遭受暴力破坏。

source_text: Tenzin Gyatso, the Dalai Lama, condemned China's reaction to the protests, calling it a "cultural genocide".
target_text: 达赖喇嘛丹增嘉措谴责中国对抗议活动的反应，称其为“文化种族灭绝”。

source_text: At a press conference in Dharamsala, seat of the Tibetan government in exile, he said, "They simply rely on using force in order to simulate peace, a peace brought by force using a rule of terror."
target_text: 在西藏流亡政府所在地达兰萨拉举行的新闻发布会上，他说：“他们只是依靠武力来模拟和平，这是一种利用恐怖统治武力带来的和平。”

source_text: China has declared a "People's War" against the protesters, vowing to "expose" the Dalai Lama.
target_text: 中国宣布对抗议者发动“人民战争”，誓言“揭露”达赖喇嘛。

source_text: "We must wage a people's war to beat splittism and expose and condemn the malicious acts of these hostile forces and expose the hideous face of the Dalai Lama group to the light of day," officials were quoted as saying.
target_text: “我们必须发动人民的战争，以击败分裂主义，暴露和谴责这些敌对势力的恶意行为，并将达赖喇嘛集团的丑恶面孔暴露在光明之中，”官员们引述道。

source_text: China also prevented access to video website YouTube after many international videos of the protests were posted on the website.
target_text: 在网站上发布了许多抗议活动的国际视频后，中国也阻止访问视频网站YouTube。

source_text: YouTube is normally easily accessible in China, which blocks other pornographic or subversive sites with its 'Great Firewall'.
target_text: YouTube通常可以在中国轻松访问，通过其“防火墙”屏蔽其他色情或颠覆网站。

source_text: Both rebel groups and government troops are accused of rape, with march organisers hoping to draw international attention to rape as a weapon in war.
target_text: 反政府组织和政府军都被指控强奸，游行组织者希望引起国际社会对强奸作为战争武器的关注。

source_text: Eastern Congo is worse affected, and aid groups have suggested the actual figure may be higher as victims are unlikely to come forward.
target_text: 刚果东部受到的影响更为严重，援助组织表示，由于受害者不太可能挺身而出，实际数字可能会更高。

source_text: The UN states mass rapes have occurred in the area for at least 15 years.
target_text: 联合国表示，该地区已发生大规模强奸至少15年。

source_text: Some rape victims left hospital to participate in the march.
target_text: 一些强奸受害者离开医院参加游行。

source_text: The third "World March of Women" followed several days of talks aimed at changing the social acceptance of violence, especially against women, in the Congo.
target_text: 第三次“世界妇女游行”是在刚果举行的旨在改变社会对暴力，特别是对妇女暴力的接受程度会谈的几天之后举行的。

source_text: Peace and development were also on the agenda for women from nations including Togo, South Africa, Pakistan, and Brazil.
target_text: 和平与发展也是多哥，南非，巴基斯坦和巴西等国家妇女的议程。

source_text: The British government have vowed to ban payment fees and other hidden and excessive credit card charges.
target_text: 英国政府发誓要禁止支付费用和其他隐藏和过度的信用卡费用。

source_text: They hope to do so by the end of 2012, following a consultation in the new year.
target_text: 他们希望在新的一年里经过协商，在2012年底前完成这项工作。

source_text: Hidden fees are often not shown until the end of an ordering process on the web which prevents consumers from making an informed choice and comparing the actual prices of different products and services according to the Office of Fair Trading.
target_text: 隐藏费用通常在网上订购过程结束后才显示出来，这会阻止消费者根据公平交易办公室做出明智的选择，并比较不同产品和服务的实际价格。

source_text: Plans are also underway to bring in Europe-wide regulation of credit card fees in 2014.
target_text: 2014年还计划在欧洲范围内对信用卡费用进行监管。

source_text: Mark Hoban, a Treasury Minister, said consumers "have a right to understand the charges they may incur up front and not be hit through a hidden last-minute payment surcharge."
target_text: 财政部长马克·霍班表示，消费者“有权了解他们可能预先承担的费用，而不是通过隐藏的最后一刻支付附加费。”

source_text: He said the plans announced today will increase "transparency" for consumers, and that consumers currently "feel ripped off".
target_text: 他说，今天宣布的计划将提高消费者的“透明度”，目前消费者“感觉被敲竹杠”。

source_text: The consumer group Which? claimed that these surcharges were increasing the cost of air travel by £265,000 a day (or about £97 million per year).
target_text: 消费者团体声称这些附加费增加了每天26.5万英镑的航空旅行成本（每年约9700万英镑）。

source_text: The OFT stated that the figure was £300m a year.
target_text: OFT表示，该数字为每年3亿英镑。

source_text: A Wikinews reporter contacted Which? about this disparity but they had not responded at the time of publication.
target_text: 一位维基新闻记者就这种差异进行了联系，但他们在发表时没有做出回应。

source_text: Former Roman Catholic priest Bartley Sorensen of the US state of Pennsylvania was yesterday sentenced to eight years and one month in federal prison after pleading guilty to child pornography charges in May 2012.
target_text: 美国宾夕法尼亚州前罗马天主教神父巴特利·索伦森昨日在2012年5月承认对儿童色情的指控后，被判入狱8年1个月。

source_text: Sorenson, now aged 63, was discovered to be downloading child pornography by an employee of his parish at the St. John Fisher Church in Churchill, Allegheny County in December 2011.
target_text: 索伦森现年63岁，2011年12月在阿勒格尼郡丘吉尔的圣约翰费希尔教堂被他的教区员工发现下载儿童色情作品。

source_text: The employee had been tutored on how to distinguish predators.
target_text: 该员工接受过如何辨别奴役他人者的指导。

source_text: Police investigating the case found some 5,000 child pornography images in Sorenson's church office.
target_text: 调查此案的警方在索伦森教堂办公室发现了大约5000张儿童色情图片。

source_text: Following Sorenson's release, he will also be supervised for five years.
target_text: 在索伦森获释后，他还将受到五年的监督。

source_text: Sorenson has also been ordered to pay a fine of $25,000.
target_text: 索伦森还被勒令支付25,000美元的罚款。

source_text: He claimed that he wanted to be caught and left the image on his computer screen in order to be found out and required to go to counselling, but was unaware that it was illegal.
target_text: 他声称他想被抓到，把照片留在电脑屏幕上以便被发现，并要求去咨询，但他不知道这是违法的。

source_text: The Netherlands lost to the Russia national football team in a quarter-final match of UEFA Euro 2008.
target_text: 荷兰队在2008年欧洲杯四分之一决赛中输给了俄罗斯国家足球队。

source_text: Roman Pavlyuchenko opened the scoring in main play, a goal that was matched by Ruud van Nistelrooy after only 30 minutes.
target_text: 罗马·帕夫柳琴科在主打中首开纪录，在30分钟后被；路德·范·尼斯特鲁伊扳回比分。

source_text: Then it was a hardy play-off for both teams, especially the Dutch, but Torbinsky and Arshavin scored goals, effectively put an end to the match.
target_text: 这对两支球队来说都是一场艰苦的比赛，尤其是荷兰队，但是托宾斯基和阿尔沙文的进球，有效地结束了这场比赛。

source_text: Now it will be the first major semi final for Russia since the break up of the USSR.
target_text: 现在，这将是自苏联解体以来俄罗斯第一次进入半决赛。

source_text: The Cassini–Huygens spacecraft has discovered "organic material" and water spewing from a geyser on one of Saturn's moons, Enceladus.
target_text: 卡西尼惠更斯号宇宙飞船发现了“有机物质”，水从土星一颗卫星土卫二的间歇泉中喷出。

source_text: According to NASA, the discovery was made when Cassini flew by the moon on March 12.
target_text: 据美国宇航局称，这一发现是在卡西尼号3月12日飞越月球时发现的。

source_text: "A completely unexpected surprise is that the chemistry of Enceladus, what's coming out from inside, resembles that of a comet.
target_text: 一个完全出乎意料的惊喜是，土卫二的化学成分，从内部喷发出来的物质，类似于彗星。

source_text: To have primordial material coming out from inside a Saturn moon raises many questions on the formation of the Saturn system," said Hunter Waite, principal investigator for the Cassini Ion and Neutral Mass Spectrometer at the Southwest Research Institute located in San Antonio, Texas.
target_text: 位于德克萨斯州圣安东尼奥的西南研究所的卡西尼离子和中性质谱仪的首席研究员亨特·韦特说：“原始物质从土星卫星内部出来，对土星系统的形成提出了许多问题。”

source_text: The Ion and Neutral Mass Spectrometer saw a much higher density of volatile gases, water vapor, carbon dioxide and carbon monoxide, as well as organic materials, some 20 times denser than expected.
target_text: 离子和中性质谱仪发现挥发性气体、水蒸气、二氧化碳和一氧化碳以及有机物质的密度比预期高出20倍。

source_text: This dramatic increase in density was evident as the spacecraft flew over the area of the plumes.
target_text: 当宇宙飞船飞过羽流区域时，密度的急剧增加是显而易见的。

source_text: New high-resolution heat maps of the south pole by Cassini's Composite Infrared Spectrometer show that the so-called tiger stripes, giant fissures that are the source of the geysers, are warm along almost their entire lengths, and reveal other warm fissures nearby.
target_text: 卡西尼的复合红外光谱仪绘制的南极新的高分辨率热图显示，所谓的虎纹，即作为间歇泉源头的巨大裂缝，几乎在整个长度上都是温暖的，并且显示了附近的其他温暖裂缝。

source_text: These more precise new measurements reveal temperatures of at least minus 93 degrees Celsius (minus 135 Fahrenheit.)
target_text: 这些更精确的新测量显示温度至少为零下93摄氏度（零下135华氏度）。

source_text: That is 17 degrees Celsius (63 degrees Fahrenheit) warmer than previously seen and 93 degrees Celsius (200 degrees Fahrenheit) warmer than other regions of the moon.
target_text: 这比先前看到的温度高17摄氏度（63华氏度），比月球其他区域高93摄氏度（200华氏度）。

source_text: The warmest regions along the tiger stripes correspond to two of the jet locations seen in Cassini images.
target_text: 沿着虎纹最热的区域对应于卡西尼号图片中的两个喷射位置。

source_text: "Enceladus has got warmth, water and organic chemicals, some of the essential building blocks needed for life.
target_text: “土卫二已经获得了温暖、水和有机化学物质，这是生命所需的一些基本组成部分。

source_text: We have quite a recipe for life on our hands, but we have yet to find the final ingredient, liquid water, but Enceladus is only whetting our appetites for more," said Dennis Matson, Cassini project scientist at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Pasadena, California.
target_text: 加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳的美国宇航局喷气推进实验室的卡西尼项目科学家丹尼斯·马特森说：“我们手头上有很多关于生命的配方，但我们还没有找到最终的成分，即液态水，但土卫二只是在激起我们更多的欲望。”

source_text: When it flew through the plumes it was 120 miles from the moon's surface.
target_text: 当它飞过羽流时，离该卫星表面120英里。

source_text: India have beaten England by nine runs in the second One-Day International of the series at the County Ground, Bristol, England.
target_text: 印度队在英格兰布里斯托尔郡球场举办的单日性国际比赛系列赛的第二场中以九分之差击败英格兰队。

source_text: India, having won the toss and elected to bat first, raced to 113 runs after the first twenty overs.
target_text: 印度队在掷骰子中获胜，并选择先击球，在头20节比赛中获得113分。

source_text: Sourav Ganguly was caught off the bowling of Andrew Flintoff, who finished the innings as the top performing England bowler, taking 5-56.
target_text: 苏拉夫·甘古利接飞了安德鲁·弗林托夫的击球，作为英格兰表现最佳的投球手在一个击球局中他以5-56的比分完成了比赛。

source_text: Sachin Tendulkar fell just short of a century, being caught behind on 99 runs.
target_text: 萨钦·坦杜卡尔在不到中场就落败了，以99分落后。

source_text: Yuvraj Singh and Rahul Dravid added 63 runs before Singh was dismissed for 49.
target_text: 尤夫拉吉·辛格和拉胡尔·德拉维德增加了63分，之后辛格以49分下场。

source_text: In reply England started quickly, recording 75 runs off the first ten overs.
target_text: 作为回应，英格兰队开始很快，在前十节比赛中取得了75分。

source_text: However Munaf Patel took two wickets in two balls to dismiss both the England opening batsmen.
target_text: 然而，穆纳夫·帕特尔在两个球中拿下两个三柱门，从而将英格兰首发的两名击球手击杀出局。

source_text: The England wickets fell regularly after that, with Kevin Pietersen and Paul Collingwood bowled by Piyush Chalwa for 25 and 27 runs respectively.
target_text: 此后，英格兰的三柱门经常失守，凯文·彼得森和保罗·科林伍德分别被皮尤斯·查瓦投了25分和27分。

source_text: Dimitri Mascarenhas hit 52 runs, including five sixes, and Stuart Broad hit 20 runs off the final over, but it came too late and England fell ten runs short of the 330 run target.
target_text: 迪米特里·马斯卡雷纳打出52分，其中包括5个六分球，斯图尔特·布罗德在最后一节时打出20分，但为时已晚，英格兰落后于330分的目标10分。

source_text: The third match will be played at Edgbaston, Birmingham, on August 27.
target_text: 第三场比赛将于8月27日在伯明翰的埃格巴斯顿举行。

source_text: Anna Nicole Smith, who was born as Vickie Lynn Hogan, was found unconscious in the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino in Hollywood, Florida in her 6th floor hotel room.
target_text: 安娜·妮可·史密斯，曾用名维姬·林恩·霍根，在佛罗里达州好莱坞的塞米诺尔硬石酒店和赌场的6楼酒店房间中被发现不省人事。

source_text: One of her attorneys has confirmed that she was pronounced dead at a hospital less than an hour later.
target_text: 她的一位律师证实，她不到一个小时后就在医院被宣告死亡。

source_text: Paramedics are reported to have performed CPR on the actress and had to have breathing equipment inserted into her chest after a nurse found her passed out in her hotel room and witnesses say that Smith was receiving CPR while the ambulance took her to the hospital around 2:00 p.m. [EST].
target_text: 据报道，在一名护士发现她在酒店房间昏倒后，医护人员对这位女演员进行了心肺复苏术，不得不将呼吸设备插入她的胸部。目击者说，史密斯正在接受心肺复苏术，救护车大约在美国东部时间下午2：00把她送到医院。

source_text: Smith's bodyguard is reported to have given Smith "cardiopulmonary resuscitation" before paramedics arrived.
target_text: 据报道，史密斯的保镖在医护人员赶到之前给史密斯进行了“心肺复苏”。

source_text: This is just tragic and that's all you can say right now and I don't know anything further," said one of Anna Nicole's lawyers, Ron Rale.
target_text: 安娜·妮科尔的一位律师罗恩·雷尔说：“这只是一场悲剧，你现在只能说这些了，我不知道还有什么更深入的了解。”

source_text: Smith was taken by ambulance to Memorial Regional Hospital and "checked in Monday [to the hotel] at 8 p.m. as a guest.
target_text: 史密斯被救护车送往纪念区医院，“周一下午8点登记入住【入住酒店】”。

source_text: She was due to check out tomorrow," said cafe spokeswoman, Danielle Giordaano.
target_text: 她明天就要退房了，”咖啡馆女发言人丹尼尔·乔丹诺说。

source_text: "Our rescue crews got there, and they were escorted to a bedroom, where they found a female alone in her room and unresponsive.
target_text: “我们的救援人员到了那里，他们被护送到一间卧室，在那里他们发现一位女性独自呆在她的房间里，没有反应。

source_text: We then began our normal protocol for dealing with a non-breathing individual.
target_text: 然后，我们开始处理一个没有呼吸的人的正常方案。

source_text: Authorities are not yet treating her death as a crime.
target_text: 当局尚未将她的死亡视为犯罪。

source_text: One of Smith's attorneys, Howard K. Stern, is reported to have been staying with Smith in her room, but authorities have yet to locate Mr. Stern.
target_text: 据报道，史密斯的一名律师霍华德·K·斯特恩一直住在史密斯的房间里，但当局尚未找到斯特恩。

source_text: I don't know where he's at right now," said Charlie Tiger the chief of the Seminole Police Department also adding that Smith's 5 month old baby was not with them.
target_text: 我不知道他现在在哪里，”塞米诺尔警察局局长查理·泰格说，他还补充说史密斯5个月大的孩子不在他们身边。

source_text: Smith was a spokeswoman for the company TRIMSPA when she passed, and TrimSpa has removed all content from their site for now, shutting it down and posting only a message in response to her death.
target_text: 史密斯去世时是Trimspa公司的发言人，目前Trimspa已经将所有内容从他们的网站上删除，关闭了网站，只发布了一条回应她死亡的信息。

source_text: "Today, Anna Nicole Smith’s grief stricken and tumultuous personal life came to an end.
target_text: “今天，安娜·妮可·史密斯的悲痛和喧嚣的生命走到了尽头。

source_text: Anna came to our Company as a customer, but she departs it as a friend.
target_text: 安娜以顾客的身份来到我们公司，但她以朋友的身份离开了公司。

source_text: While life for Anna Nicole was not easy these past few months, she held dear her husband, Howard K. Stern, her daughter, Dannielynn Hope, her most cherished friends, beloved dogs, and finally, her work with TRIMSPA.
target_text: 在过去的几个月里，安娜·妮可的生活并不轻松，但她仍然拥有亲爱的丈夫霍华德·K·斯特恩、女儿丹妮琳·霍普、她最珍爱的朋友、心爱的狗，最后，还有她在Trimspa的工作。

source_text: Anna knew both the joy of giving life, and the heartache of losing a child.
target_text: 安娜知道给予生命的快乐和失去孩子的心痛。

source_text: We pray that she is granted the peace that eluded her more recent days on earth, and that she find comfort in the presence of her son, Daniel," said the statement on TRIMSPA's website posted by Alex Goen, CEO and Founder of TRIMSPA.
target_text: 我们祈祷她能得到最近几天在地球上所逃避的安宁，并在她儿子丹尼尔面前得到安慰。”Trimspa首席执行官兼创始人艾利克斯·戈恩在其网站上发表的声明称。

source_text: Smith was rushed to the hospital in November of 2006 after she was suffering from symptoms of pneumonia.
target_text: 2006年11月，史密斯出现肺炎症状后被送往医院。

source_text: Smith's son, Daniel Smith, died on September 10, 2006 shortly after Anna gave birth to a baby girl 5 months ago.
target_text: 史密斯的儿子丹尼尔·史密斯于2006年9月10日在安娜5个月前生下一个女婴后不久去世。

source_text: Smith was shopping for a new boat in Florida and reports say she felt ill and had a fever for at least a day.
target_text: 史密斯当时正在佛罗里达州买一艘新船，据报道，她生病发烧至少一天。

source_text: The first leg of the matches ended in a goalless draw, as both teams were spirited in defense.
target_text: 比赛的上半场以无进球结束，因为两支球队都在防守方面表现出色。

source_text: Kaka and Inzaghi played as frontmen for AC, while Vennegoor of Hesselink and Jiri Jarosik were the strike pair for Celtic.
target_text: 卡卡和因扎吉是AC的前锋，海塞林克的维内古尔和吉利·贾罗西克则组成了凯尔特人的攻击线。

source_text: Milan had the first chance of the game early when Kaka found room and flashed a shot towards the bottom corner, but keeper Artur Boruc got down well to make the stop.
target_text: 当卡卡找到空间并向底角进行一次近距离射门时，米兰有了第一次得分的机会，但是门将阿图尔·博鲁克很好地把球阻挡了下来。

source_text: Celtic then had a valid penalty claim after only 6 minutes when Jarosik's volley looked to be blocked by the hand of Maldini, but referee Konrad Plautz waved away the appeals.
target_text: 凯尔特人在6分钟后要求判罚一个有效的点球，当时贾罗西克的凌空射门似乎被马尔蒂尼的手挡住了，但是裁判康拉德·普劳兹挥手拒绝。

source_text: Celtic's defense continued to play well, and they limited Milan's chances to long ranged shots.
target_text: 凯尔特人的防守一直很好，他们限制了米兰的远射机会。

source_text: Lee Naylor then performed defensive heroics for Celtic as he took the ball away from the open Inzaghi, who was waiting to tap the ball in at the back post.
target_text: 然后，李·内勒为凯尔特人表演了英雄般的防守，他把球从无人防守的因扎吉的脚下抢过球，当时因扎吉正等着从后面把球敲入。

source_text: Kaka had two more shots from range at the net, but neither were on target.
target_text: 卡卡还有两次远射打正，但都没有进球。

source_text: Naylor again saved Celtic by clearing the ball off the line from a Kaka attempt.
target_text: 内勒再次阻止了卡卡的进攻，把球踢出底线，拯救了凯尔特人。

source_text: Over an hour had passed when Gordon Strachan sent Thomas Graveson on for Celtic in place of Jarosik, and the Dane almost scored right away.
target_text: 一个多小时后，戈登·斯特拉坎为凯尔特人队派上托马斯·格雷夫森替换加洛西克，这位丹麦人差一点马上取得进球。

source_text: He struck a fine shot at the net, but Massimo Oddo did well to block the attempt.
target_text: 他射门正中球门，但是马西莫·奥多把球挡住。

source_text: Milan counter attacked quickly, and Kaka saw his attempt also blocked by a defender.
target_text: 米兰反击很快，卡卡看到他的进攻又被一名后卫挡住了。

source_text: McManus and Naylor were forced to clear headers off the line from Ambrosini and Inzaghi, both occurring after corners.
target_text: 麦克马努斯和内勒被迫用头球把安布罗西尼和因扎吉发出的角球顶出底线。

source_text: Maldini then had a header at the Celtic net, but Boruc was again in the right place to make the stop.
target_text: 马尔蒂尼随后用头球击中凯尔特人球门，但博鲁克再次站位很棒阻止了这次进攻。

source_text: Celtic had another claim for a penalty when Nakamura was brought down in the area, but the Austrian referee again waved away all appeals.
target_text: 凯尔特人又一次要求判罚点球，当时中村在该地区被击倒，但奥地利裁判再次挥手驳回。

source_text: Boruc was again forced into action from a Seedorf free kick, which he was able to deflect out with a hand.
target_text: 博鲁克再次被迫出击将西多夫的任意球扑出，他用一只手将球打偏出去。

source_text: As 90 minutes approached, Celtic had two well positioned free-kicks, but could take advantage of neither, and the game entered extra time.
target_text: 在接近90分钟的时候，凯尔特人有两个位置很好的任意球，但两个都没有进球，比赛进入加时赛。

source_text: It took Milan little time to go ahead in the extra period, and the scorer would be no other than the Brazilian Kaka.
target_text: 在加时赛内，米兰很快往前推进，这次得分的正是巴西人卡卡。

source_text: The youthful striker put on a burst of speed to beat out the tired Celtic defenders and blasted the ball through Borucs legs to give the homeside the lead.
target_text: 这位年轻的前锋突然加速摆脱了疲惫不堪的凯尔特人后卫，并从博鲁克斯的胯下腿将球踢进，从而让主队取得领先。

source_text: The game continued however, as the Champions League works on full extra time, and Celtic still had 27 minutes to equalize.
target_text: 然而比赛仍在继续，因为欧洲冠军联赛要求要踢完加时赛，凯尔特人仍有27分钟去扳平比分。

source_text: It was Milan who pushed however, and Andrea Pirlo twice forced Boruc to make saves.
target_text: 然而米兰却进行反击，安德烈亚·皮尔洛两次迫使博鲁克进行扑救。

source_text: Gravesen's long effort for Celtic was easy pickings for Dida, and Craig Beattie headed a good chance over the bar.
target_text: 格拉维森为凯尔特人队的一直努力让迪达轻易获得机会，克雷格·比蒂在禁区内获得头球，但高出横梁。

source_text: Celtic vainly tried to tie the game, bringing on Kenny Miller, but AC finished the game comfortably, and advanced to the next round of the tournament.
target_text: 凯尔特人徒劳地试图扳平比分，换上了肯尼·米勒，但是AC笑到了最后，并晋级到下一轮比赛。

source_text: Residents of Santa Clara County, California expressed their opposition at a public hearing Thursday January 31 to a local detainment provision of the Secure Communities program of US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).
target_text: 加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉县的居民在1月31日星期四举行的一次公开听证会上表达了他们的反对意见，反对地方拘留提供美国移民和海关执法安全社区计划（ICE）。

source_text: Secure Communities includes a provision that ICE can ask state and local detention facilities to hold anyone arrested who might be in the US without adequate documentation until ICE has time to review their case.
target_text: 安全社区包括一项规定，ICE可以要求州和地方拘留机构拘留任何可能没有充足获许文件而留在美国的人，直到ICE有时间审查他们的案件。

source_text: The comments came in a public hearing of a policy working group of the Public Safety and Justice Committee, convened to discuss a November 7 recommendation by District Attorney Jeff Rosen to honor ICE detainer requests for serious and violent offenders.
target_text: 这一评论是在公共安全和司法委员会的一个政策工作组的公开听证会上发表的，该工作组召集会议讨论了地区检察官杰夫·罗森于11月7日提出的一项建议，即尊重对严重和暴力犯罪者的拘留要求。

source_text: Since October 18, 2011, Santa Clara County has refused ICE requests to detain individuals who would otherwise be released.
target_text: 自2011年10月18日起，圣克拉拉县拒绝了ICE要求拘留原本将被释放的人。

source_text: Supporters of DA Rosen's proposal had earlier asked their people to email the supervisors and attend this meeting and the Board of Supervisors' Meeting next Tuesday, February 12.
target_text: 达·罗森提议的支持者早些时候曾要求他们的人给监事们发电子邮件，并参加本次会议和2月12日下周二的监事会会议。

source_text: The January 31 hearing began with comments by approximately 25 of the audience of roughly 35–40, all of which opposed the DA's proposal.
target_text: 1月31日的听证会开始时约有25名观众约35至40人的评论，所有观众都反对达的提议。

source_text: They said public safety was enhanced under the current policy because many in the immigrant community have less reason to fear that they or people they care about would be deported if the police were called.
target_text: 他们表示，根据现行政策，公共安全得到了加强，因为移民社区的许多人没有理由担心如果警察被召唤他们或他们关心的人会被驱逐出境。

source_text: Several in the audience replied by asking how many other criminals would go free because people refused to report or testify as a result of increased fear of deportation.
target_text: 听众中的一些人回答说，有多少其他罪犯会获释，因为人们因为害怕被驱逐而拒绝举报或作证。

source_text: Comments supporting the current policy have been made by people who did not attend.
target_text: 那些没有参加的人提出了支持现行政策的意见。

source_text: The San Jose Mercury News for January 31 includes an op ed by Supervisor Dave Cortese, acting Public Defender Molly O'Neal, and Director of the Domestic Violence Advocacy Consortium Cynthia Hunter.
target_text: 1月31日的《圣何塞水星新闻》包括主管戴夫·科尔特斯、代理公共辩护人莫莉·奥尼尔和反家庭暴力倡导协会辛西娅·亨特主任的一篇专栏文章。

source_text: This is especially true in Santa Clara County, where two-thirds of residents live in immigrant households."
target_text: 尤其是在圣克拉拉县，三分之二的居民居住在移民家庭中。”
