source_text: Since the January 31 hearing, support for the position of the Sheriff and the DA has begun to materialize with at least one conservative group asking their followers to email the supervisors and attend public meetings such as the one this Thursday and the Board of Supervisors' meeting next Tuesday, February 12.
target_text: 自1月31日听证会以来，对警长和达的立场的支持已经开始实现，至少有一个保守派团体要求他们的粉丝给监督员发电子邮件并参加本周四举行的公开会议以及下周二2月12日的监事会会议。

source_text: The policy adopted October 18, 2011 stated Santa Clara County would honor ICE detention requests "for individuals who have been convicted of a serious or violent felony," provided ICE agreed in writing to reimburse the county for the additional expense.
target_text: 2011年10月18日通过的政策规定，圣克拉拉县将尊重ICE拘留请求，“对于那些被判定犯有严重或暴力重罪的人”，只要ICE书面同意赔偿该县的额外费用。

source_text: DA Rosen's November 7 presentation claimed honoring ICE holds would "produce an undetermined amount of cost savings by reducing probation costs", as individuals otherwise on probation would be transferred to federal detention.
target_text: 达·罗森11月7日的报告声称，遵守ICE监禁将“通过降低缓刑成本产生不确定的成本节约”，因为不这样的话缓刑内的人将被转移到联邦拘留所。

source_text: ICE claims an official limit of at most two days.
target_text: ICE声称官方限制最多两天。

source_text: Los Angeles is currently being sued over questionable detentions of a number of individuals including a British filmmaker named Duncan Roy, who was held for 89 days.
target_text: 洛杉矶目前因涉嫌拘留一些人而被起诉，其中包括一位名叫邓肯·罗伊的英国电影制片人，他被关押了89天。

source_text: If Los Angeles loses, it appears local taxpayers may be liable.
target_text: 如果洛杉矶输了，那么当地纳税人可能会承担责任。

source_text: After DA Rosen's presentation on November 7, the Santa Clara County Public Safety and Justice Committee referred this issue to its policy review working group, which held various private meetings, failed to reach a consensus, and then organized the public meeting of January 31.
target_text: 在11月7日达罗森的陈述之后，圣克拉拉县公共安全和司法委员会将这一问题提交给其政策审查工作组，该工作组举行了各种私人会议，但未能达成共识，随后组织了1月31日的公共会议。

source_text: The next official action on this issue is currently scheduled for the March 7 meeting of the Public Safety and Justice Committee.
target_text: 关于这个问题的下一个官方行动目前定于3月7日公共安全和司法委员会会议。

source_text: United States soldier Bradley Manning, accused of leaking US state secrets to WikiLeaks and detained under restrictive conditions at the Marine base at Quantico, Virginia since July 2010, was ordered Wednesday to sleep stripped of all clothing.
target_text: 自2010年7月起，美国士兵布拉德利·曼宁被指控向维基解密泄露美国国家机密，并在弗吉尼亚州匡蒂科海军基地的限制条件下被拘留，周三被命令在睡眠中被剥夺所有衣物。

source_text: According to his attorney, this condition was imposed because Manning made a "sarcastic quip" about the harsh conditions of his confinement.
target_text: 根据他的律师所说，这一条件之所以被强调，是因为曼宁对自己被监禁的严酷条件“挖苦”了一番。

source_text: For most of the eight months he has been held there, Manning has been required to sleep only in his boxer shorts because he has been under "prevention of injury watch," according to First Lieutenant Brian Villiard, a spokesman for the Quantico facility.
target_text: 根据匡蒂科设施发言人布莱恩·维利亚德中尉的说法，在他被关押的八个月中的大部分时间里，曼宁被要求只穿着他的平角裤，因为一直在“防止受伤”。

source_text: On Wednesday night, the brig commander determined that Manning must give up his boxer shorts also.
target_text: 周三晚上，准将决定曼宁也必须放弃他的平角短裤。

source_text: Villiard, citing privacy rules designed to protect the detainees, did not explain how Manning could harm himself if allowed to wear his underwear.
target_text: 维利亚德援引旨在保护被拘留者的隐私规定，没有解释曼宁如果被允许穿内裤会如何伤害自己。

source_text: Coombs said Manning was not put under a suicide watch because that would have required the decision of a mental health professional.
target_text: 库姆斯说曼宁并没有被置于自杀状况之下，因为这需要精神卫生专业人员的决定。

source_text: As a result of the tightening of Manning's conditions, he will be required for the indefinite future to sleep naked in his cell, and endure, according to Coombs, the "humiliation of standing naked at attention for the morning roll call".
target_text: 由于对曼宁的要求收紧，他将被要求无限期在他的牢房中裸睡，并忍受库姆斯所说的“早上点名时光着身子站在众人面前的耻辱”。

source_text: In a statement, Senator John Kerry suggested recent publicity will cast light on Manning's situation and the balance between humane treatment and suicide prevention: "I think that a lot of people are now reviewing this very, very closely, people have weighed in, myself included, I think that analyses are being made.
target_text: 参议员约翰·克里在一份声明中建议，最近的宣传将揭示曼宁的处境以及人道治疗和自杀预防之间的平衡：“我认为现在有很多人正在非常、非常密切地审查这一问题，人们已经参与其中，包括我自己在内，我认为正在进行分析。

source_text: And I'm convinced that there will be real scrutiny with respect to that issue."
target_text: 而且我相信对这个问题会有真正的审查。

source_text: On November 13, Torontoians will be heading to the polls to vote for their ward's councillor and for mayor.
target_text: 11月13日，多伦多人将前往投票站，投票选出他们选区的议员和市长。

source_text: This ward's candidates include Francis Ahinful, Ted Berger, Anthony Caputo, Suzan Hall (incumbent), Andre Lucas, Rosemarie Mulhall, Brian Prevost, and Sonali Verma.
target_text: 该区的候选人包括弗朗西斯·阿辛福尔、泰德·伯杰、安东尼·卡普托、苏珊·霍尔（现任）、安德烈·卢卡斯、罗斯玛丽·穆霍尔、布莱恩·普雷福斯特和索纳利·维玛。

source_text: The Pakistani army says that at least 150 to 200 Taliban militants, along with 50 Pakistani troops have been killed in recent battles between al-Qaeda, Taliban fighters and Pakistani troops along the border region of Pakistan and Afghanistan in an area known as North Waziristan.
target_text: 巴基斯坦军方说，最近在巴基斯坦和阿富汗边境地区一个被称为北瓦济里斯坦的地区，基地组织、塔利班武装分子和巴基斯坦军队之间的战斗中，至少有150到200名塔利班武装分子和50名巴基斯坦士兵丧生。

source_text: At least 20 other troops were injured and at least 15 are reported to be missing.
target_text: 至少有20名士兵受伤，据报至少有15人失踪。

source_text: "We have told them to surrender and give up their weapons," said Major General of the Pakistani army, Waheed Arshad.
target_text: 巴基斯坦陆军少将瓦希德·阿尔沙德说：“我们已经告诉他们投降并放弃武器。”

source_text: The battles began on Saturday October 6 in the town of Mir Ali and have lasted three days so far.
target_text: 战斗于10月6日星期六在米尔阿里镇开始，到目前为止已持续了三天。

source_text: Army officials say that they will "continue punitive action until complete peace is restored."
target_text: 陆军官员表示，他们将“继续采取惩罚性行动，直到恢复完全和平”。

source_text: The battles were triggered after several Pakistani officials were targeted and peace talks with officials in Islamabad failed to go forward.
target_text: 几名巴基斯坦官员成为袭击目标后与伊斯兰堡官员的和平谈判未能展开。

source_text: In September, Osama bin Laden issued a new audio tape in which he told militants to resist Pakistani troops and rebel against the army.
target_text: 今年9月，奥萨马·本·拉登发布了一段新的录音带，在录音带中，他告诉武装分子要抵抗巴基斯坦军队和反抗军队。

source_text: He also asked militants to seek revenge for the assault on the Red Mosque when almost 100 were killed by militants and troops.
target_text: 他还要求武装分子为袭击红色清真寺寻求报复，当时有将近100人被武装分子和军人打死。

source_text: Samer al-Issawi, a Palestinian prisoner who went on a hunger strike in an Israeli prison as a protest against his imprisonment, was released on Monday to his home in .
target_text: 萨默尔·以萨维是一名巴勒斯坦籍囚犯，他在被囚禁于以色列监狱时进行了绝食抗议，并于周一被释放，回到了他自己的家。

source_text: Issawi returned Monday to his home in the Issawiyeh neighborhood in East Jerusalem after his release from the Shatta prison in northern Israel.
target_text: 以萨维星期一从以色列北部的沙塔监狱获释后回到了他在东耶路撒冷以萨维耶社区的家中。

source_text: Hundreds of people came to welcome him home and celebrate his release, despite an Israeli order given to his family not to have a public party for his arrival.
target_text: 成百上千的人来欢迎他回家并庆祝他的获释，尽管以色列下令他的家人不要为他的到来举行公众聚会。

source_text: After his release, Issawi said during a TV interview, "It is our obligation as freedom fighters to free all the Palestinian political prisoners!".
target_text: 以萨维获释后，在接受电视采访时说：“作为自由战士，我们有义务让所有巴勒斯坦政治犯重获自由！”。

source_text: Issawi was arrested in 2002 in , during the by the Israeli army for shooting at Israeli vehicles and reportedly also charged with making pipe bombs.
target_text: 以萨维于2002年因向以色列车辆开枪而被以色列军队逮捕，据报道还被控制造管状炸弹。

source_text: He was sentenced to more than 25 years in prison.
target_text: 他被判处25年以上有期徒刑。

source_text: In 2011, during a prisoner exchange deal Israel made with Hamas, Issawi was released along with over a thousand other Palestinian prisoners.
target_text: 2011年，在以色列与哈马斯达成的一项囚犯交换协议中，以萨维和1000多名其他巴勒斯坦囚犯被释放。

source_text: He was released under restrictive conditions and forbidden to go outside of Jerusalem, his residence.
target_text: 他在限制条件下被释放，禁止离开他所居住的耶路撒冷。

source_text: However, after only nine months from his release date he was arrested again for breaking the conditions.
target_text: 然而，在他发布日期仅九个月后，他因违反条件再次被捕。

source_text: He was required to serve the rest of the 2002 sentence and stay in prison till 2029.
target_text: 他被要求服刑2002年判决的剩余部分，直到2029年方可出狱。

source_text: As a protest against the punishment, Issawi began a publicized hunger strike.
target_text: 作为抗议惩罚的措施，以萨维开始公开绝食抗议。

source_text: For more than 260 days he was fed water, vitamins, and additional materials only by infusion.
target_text: 超过260天的时间内，他只通过输液获取水，维生素和其他营养。

source_text: According to the Los Angeles Times, Israel decided to start a negotiation lest Issawi's death in the Israeli prison cause violence from the Palestinians in the .
target_text: 根据“洛杉矶时报”的报道，以色列决定开始谈判，以免以萨伊在以色列监狱中的死亡导致巴勒斯坦人的暴力事件发生。

source_text: In the end, Issawi agreed to stay in the Israeli prison for an additional eight months to serve the administrative arrest he was under and in exchange he stopped his hunger strike.
target_text: 最后，以萨维同意在以色列监狱再呆8个月，以执行他所受的行政逮捕，作为交换，他停止了绝食抗议。

source_text: Kevin Rudd has been elected as leader of the Labor party by the party's caucus.
target_text: 陆克文被党的核心小组选为工党领袖。

source_text: His running-mate Julia Gillard was elected unopposed to the deputy leadership.
target_text: 他的竞选伙伴朱莉娅·吉拉德当选为无人反对的副领导。

source_text: The vote was called on Friday after Kevin Rudd challenged former leader Kim Beazley for the leadership.
target_text: 周五，陆克文挑战前领导人金·比兹利的领导权，并被召集进行投票。

source_text: Rudd becomes the party's third leader since the 2004 election, where the Howard government won a fourth consecutive term in government.
target_text: 陆克文成为该党自2004年大选以来的第三任领导人，霍华德政府连续第四次赢得政府任期。

source_text: Long-serving deputy leader Jenny Macklin did not contest the deputy leadership following the defeat of Mr Beazley.
target_text: 在比兹利被失败后，长期任职的副领导人珍妮·麦克林没有与副领导人竞争。

source_text: Mrs Macklin has been deputy leader under three leaders since 2001.
target_text: 麦克林女士自2001年以来一直担任三位领导人的副领导。

source_text: The party will elect its shadow ministry in a separate ballot on Thursday.
target_text: 该党将在周四的单独投票中选出影子内阁。

source_text: "It's important that if you have good policy and good government, it's important you also have stability in leadership," said Beattie.
target_text: 比蒂说：“重要的是，如果你有良好的政策和良好的政府，你的领导能力也必须保持稳定。”

source_text: "I'd urge everyone to get behind Kevin - having a Queenslander as the alternative prime minister is good for the state and good for Australia."
target_text: “我敦促每个人都支持凯文-让一位昆士兰人作为代理总理对国家有利，对澳大利亚有利。”

source_text: Labor MP Dick Adams said even though he voted for Beazley to remain as leader, he supports the party's new leadership.
target_text: 工党下院议员迪克·亚当斯说，尽管他投票支持比兹利继续担任领导人，但他支持该党的新领导层。

source_text: "There'll be a lot more harmony and a lot more opportunity of ideas," he said.
target_text: 他说：“会有更多的和谐和想法的机会。”

source_text: "I think the new ideas need to flow and I think if it's opened up, as some people have said, they want those ideas to come forward, but I think we'll have some interesting policy direction to take to the people."
target_text: “我认为新的想法需要流动，我认为如果像一些人所说的那样开放，他们希望这些想法能被提出，但我认为我们将有一些有趣的政策方向来引导人们。”

source_text: Sharan Burrow, the president of the ACTU - the peak union body in Australia said Mr Rudd will be a strong leader.
target_text: 澳大利亚最高工会组织主席沙兰·伯罗表示，陆克文将是一位强有力的领导人。

source_text: "I have no doubt that Kevin Rudd will say that these laws have to go, that they will be replaced by a policy that reinstates rights," Ms Burrow has told Sky News.
target_text: “我毫不怀疑陆克文会说这些法律必须废除，它们将被恢复权利的政策所取代，”伯罗告诉天空新闻。

source_text: "The combination of Kevin Rudd and Julia Gillard will have all the hallmarks of the mongoose and the cobra.
target_text: 陆克文和茱莉亚·吉拉德的组合将具有猫鼬和眼镜蛇的所有特征。

source_text: It shows Labor is obsessed about leadership rather than policy and strategy," Mr Pyne said.
target_text: 这表明工党对领导能力而不是政策和战略很着迷。”派恩先生说。

source_text: In a poll released by Newspoll today, a Rudd-Gillard leadership team had 48 percent support of the public, compared to the outgoing Beazley-Macklin team's 27 percent.
target_text: 在今天由NewsPoll发布的一项民意调查中，陆克文-吉拉德领导团队获得了48%的公众支持，而即将离任的比兹利·麦克林领导团队则获得了27%的支持。

source_text: Two games of round 16 of the Gippsland Football League split the round over the weekend.
target_text: 吉普斯兰足球联盟第16轮的两场比赛在周末结束。

source_text: On Saturday, Sale defeated Moe by 75 points, while on Sunday, Warragul lost to Drouin.
target_text: 周六，赛尔队以75分击败了莫伊队，而周日，瓦拉古尔队输给了德罗伊队。

source_text: The split round will be completed next weekend with Leongatha traveling to Maffra and Morwell travelling to Wonthaggi.
target_text: 比赛回合将于下周末完成，莱昂加塔队将前往马夫拉，莫维尔队将前往旺塔吉。

source_text: The preliminary ladder has, in order, Maffra on top followed by Traralgon, Morwell, Drouin and Leongatha in the the top five.
target_text: 初步排名马夫拉在首位，其次是特拉罗贡、莫威尔、杜鲁因和利昂加塔位居前五。

source_text: Moe and Sale need to win both of their remaining games and have other results go their way to make the finals.
target_text: 莫伊和赛尔需要赢得他们剩下的全部比赛，并用其他结果才能进入决赛圈。

source_text: The Gippsland Football League, officially the Gippsland League, is the only major Australian rules football competition in the rural region east from Melbourne to the New South Wales border, according to the Victorian Country Football League.
target_text: 据维多利亚州乡村足球联盟称，吉普斯兰足球联盟，正式名称吉普斯兰联盟，是墨尔本到新南威尔士边境以东的农村地区的唯一一个澳式规则足球比赛。

source_text: At 10:30pm on November 23, 2008, near the airport in McGregor, Texas, Space Exploration Technologies Corporation (SpaceX) tested their new Falcon 9 rocket at full thrust for nearly 3 minutes (160 seconds).
target_text: 2008年11月23日晚上10：30，在德克萨斯州麦格雷戈机场附近，空间探索技术公司（SpaceX）对他们的新猎鹰9号火箭进行了近3分钟（160秒）的全推力测试。

source_text: The engineers then shut down two of the nine engines — in order to limit potential damage to the launch pad — and continued the test for 18 more seconds before finally shutting the rocket down.
target_text: 工程师们随后关闭了九台发动机中的两台，以限制对发射台的潜在损坏，并在最后关闭火箭之前继续测试18秒。

source_text: "We ran the engines just like they would run during flight, but instead of being up in the air, they were held down.
target_text: “我们像在飞行中那样运行发动机，但发动机没有升到空中，而是被压在了地上。

source_text: They weren’t moving," said Lauren Dreyer, SpaceX's manager for business development.
target_text: 他们没有动，”SpaceX业务发展经理劳伦·德雷尔说。

source_text: This was the Falcon 9's first major test firing, and it marks a milestone for the company in its plans to capture a section of the commercial launch market.
target_text: 这是猎鹰9的首次重大测试，它标志着该公司计划进军商业发布市场的一个里程碑。

source_text: The test reportedly shook the windows of houses 5 miles away, causing agitation among residents who felt that they had not received adequate warning.
target_text: 据报道，测试震动了5英里外的房屋窗户，引起居民的不安，他们觉得自己没有得到足够的警告。

source_text: "I appreciate the fact that the company notified [the City of] McGregor, but did they not think the test would affect the surrounding communities?" asked commenter Lorena Resident on the website for the Waco Tribune-Herald.
target_text: “我很感激公司通知麦格雷戈【市】的事实，但他们认为测试不会影响周围社区吗？”瓦科论坛网站的评论员洛伦娜说。

source_text: The Falcon 9 rocket, and its smaller sibling the Falcon 1, are the first rockets capable of entering Low Earth Orbit (LEO) to have their design be privately funded in its entirety.
target_text: 猎鹰9号火箭及其较小的型号的猎鹰1号，是第一批能够进入近地轨道（LEO）的火箭，其设计全部由私人出资。

source_text: According to SpaceX the Falcon 9 can generate 4 times the maximum thrust of a Boeing 747 while firing in a vacuum, and will eventually be able to perform interplanetary missions in addition to its initial role as an orbital launch vehicle.
target_text: 根据SpaceX的说法，“猎鹰9号”在真空中发射时，可以产生波音747最大推力的4倍推力，除了最初作为轨道运载火箭的作用外，还将最终能够执行行星际任务。

source_text: SpaceX is also designing a crew and cargo capsule for the Falcon 9, which it has named the "Dragon".
target_text: SpaceX还为猎鹰9号设计了一个船员和货舱，并将其命名为“龙”。

source_text: SpaceX is a contender for future commercial contracts from various government run space agencies, with NASA expressing particular interest.
target_text: SpaceX是未来各种政府运营的航天机构签订商业合同的竞争者，美国国家航空和宇宙航行局对此表示特别关注。

source_text: NASA will be retiring their fleet of Columbia Class Space Shuttles in 2010, but will not have the Shuttles' replacements (the Ares I and Ares V rockets) ready until at least 2014.
target_text: 美国国家航空和宇宙航行局将于2010年退役哥伦比亚级航天飞机，但至少到2014年才准备好航天飞机的替代品（战神一号和战神五号火箭）。

source_text: NASA hopes to fill some of this gap using commercial launches from companies such as SpaceX.
target_text: 美国国家航空和宇宙航行局希望通过SpaceX等公司的商业发布填补这一空白。

source_text: SpaceX has already reached an agreement with NASA to conduct three test flights of the Dragon capsule in conjunction with the Falcon 9.
target_text: SpaceX已经与美国宇航局达成协议，将与猎鹰9号一起进行三次“龙”太空舱的试飞。

source_text: Elon Musk, CEO and CTO of SpaceX, said, "The full mission-length test firing clears the highest hurdle for the Falcon 9 first stage before launch.
target_text: SpaceX首席执行官兼首席技术官埃隆·马斯克表示：“整个任务长度的试射为猎鹰9号发射前的第一阶段扫清了最高障碍。

source_text: In the next few months, we will have the first Falcon 9 flight vehicle on its launch pad at Cape Canaveral, preparing for lift-off in 2009."
target_text: 在接下来的几个月里，我们将在卡纳维拉尔角的发射台上安装第一架猎鹰9号飞行器，准备在2009年发射升空。”

source_text: Team New Zealand have defeated Swiss syndicate Alinghi in the second race of the 32nd America's Cup Challenge on Sunday, making the overall score equal with one win for each team.
target_text: 新西兰队在周日举行的第32届美洲杯挑战赛的第二场比赛中击败了瑞士银团阿林吉队，使双方的总比分相等，两队各赢得一场比赛。

source_text: Team New Zealand, racing with NZL-92, crossed the start line three seconds ahead of Alinghi's yacht, SUI-100.
target_text: 新西兰队派NZL-92比赛，在阿林吉队赛艇SUI-100之前3秒冲过起跑线。

source_text: But Alinghi led the race at the first mark by 13 seconds, though near the ending of the race, Team New Zealand managed to overtake Alinghi to lead the final leg of the race by 28 seconds.
target_text: 但是阿林吉队设法在第一节以13秒的成绩领先，尽管比赛接近尾声，新西兰队还是成功的将比赛扳回，以28秒的成绩在最后一程赢得比赛。

source_text: Former Alinghi and Team New Zealand skipper, Russell Coutts said that the latest win for Team New Zealand will act as a big boost for them.
target_text: 前阿林吉队长，现任新西兰队队长拉塞尔·库茨说，新西兰队最近的胜利将对他们起到很大的推动作用。

source_text: Ray Davis, Team New Zealand after-guard, said, "It’s been huge for the team to get a win on the board in the America’s Cup.
target_text: 新西兰队后卫雷·戴维斯说：“在美洲杯上赢得一场胜利对队伍来说是十分重要的。

source_text: It has been a long time coming for Emirates Team New Zealand."
target_text: 新西兰队等待此刻已经很久了。”

source_text: Dan Cowie, Team New Zealand trimmer, said, "As we said yesterday there are two very even boats out there.
target_text: 新西兰队舵手丹·考伊说：“正如我们昨天所说，两艘船的竞争非常激烈。

source_text: The next race is scheduled for tomorrow, Monday being a race-off day.
target_text: 下一场比赛定于明天举行，星期一是休息日。

source_text: The last time Alinghi and Team New Zealand fought for the America's Cup was when Team New Zealand was defending the trophy in Auckland, New Zealand.
target_text: 上次阿林吉队和新西兰队为美洲杯而战是新西兰队在奥克兰主场卫冕奖杯时。

source_text: The past three consecutive America's Cup challenges have been all whitewash victories, and five of the last six challenges have also been whitewashes.
target_text: 连续三届卫冕美洲杯为胜利增光添彩，过去的六场比赛中的五次胜利又让光辉更进一层。

source_text: After its first appearance in the 3rd Division, Pavlos Melas Soccer Club finished in the 14th position and was relegated, despite its 2-1 victory over Doxa Dramas Football Club, with 36 points in 32 games.
target_text: 帕夫洛斯·梅拉斯足球俱乐部在第三阶段首次亮相后，尽管以2比1战胜了多沙戏剧足球俱乐部，最终在32场比赛中取得36分，但仍因排名14位而被降级。

source_text: Former Olympiacos SFC player Alekos Tatsis, almost Anderlecht, Belgium's starlet, was released free by OSFC.
target_text: 来自比利时安德来特的新星，前奥林匹亚科斯SFC队球员阿列科·斯塔西斯，已和OSFC队解约。

source_text: Pavlos Melas was planning to sign him, but after the relegation, Tatsis probably won't join the "Greens".
target_text: 帕夫洛斯·梅拉斯计划签下他，但在降级之后，斯塔西斯可能不会加入“新进球队”。

source_text: An Airbus A320 airliner owned by Air New Zealand crashed into the Mediterranean Sea near Perpignan, killing at least two of a crew of seven, French officials reported on Thursday.
target_text: 据法国官员周四报道，新西兰航空公司旗下的一架空客A320客机在佩皮尼昂附近坠入地中海，造成7名机组人员中至少2人死亡。

source_text: The aircraft crashed at about 5 p.m. local time (1600 UTC) during a test flight.
target_text: 飞机在当地时间下午5点（世界标准时间16：00）试飞时坠毁。

source_text: The twin-engine jet airliner had just undergone maintenance at Perpignan in preparation for its return to Air New Zealand by German airline XL Airways, which had been operating it on lease.
target_text: 这架双引擎喷气式客机刚刚在佩皮尼昂进行了维修，准备由德国航空公司XL航空公司返回新西兰航空公司，该公司一直在租赁该飞机。

source_text: The seven on board included two XL Airways crew, Civil Aviation Authority inspector Jeremy Cook of Wellington, and four Air New Zealand personnel.
target_text: 机上七名机组人员包括两名XL航空公司机组人员、威灵顿民航局检查员杰里米·库克和四名新西兰航空公司人员。

source_text: Air New Zealand has identified involved personnel as Captain Brian Horrell and Murray White of Auckland, and Michael Gyles and Noel Marsh of Christchurch.
target_text: 新西兰航空公司已确认相关人员为奥克兰的布莱恩·霍雷尔机长和默里·怀特，以及克赖斯特彻奇的迈克尔·吉尔斯和诺埃尔·马什。

source_text: No additional passengers were on board for the flight, which was part of a maintenance test procedure.
target_text: 飞机上没有其他乘客，这是维护测试程序的一部分。

source_text: Though rescue efforts persisted into the night, there is no hope of the remaining five crew members being found alive, according to French officials.
target_text: 据法国官员称，尽管救援工作一直持续到深夜，但剩下的五名机组成员已无生还希望。

source_text: The pilots may have attempted an emergency landing on water.
target_text: 飞行员可能试图在水上紧急着陆。

source_text: French, German, and New Zealand aviation authorities and investigators have been dispatched to the site to investigate the incident.
target_text: 法国、德国和新西兰航空当局和调查人员已被派往现场调查这一事件。

source_text: A Civil Aviation Authority spokesperson stated that the incident does not cast any doubt on the airworthiness of the A320 design, a popular aircraft which has been involved in only ten fatal accidents since its introduction in 1987.
target_text: 民航局发言人说，这起事故并不会引起对A320设计上的怀疑，该经典机型自1987年被引入以来，只发生过10起致命事故。

source_text: A Japanese official has stated that Japan is opposed to re-entering into six-party talks between the United States, China, Russia, South Korea, and North Korea in regards to the N. Korean nuclear weapons program stating that N. Korea must "compromise."
target_text: 一位日本官员表示，日本反对美国、中国、俄罗斯、韩国和朝鲜就朝鲜核武器计划重新进行六方会谈，并表示朝鲜必须“妥协”。

source_text: "It's fine if North Korea can bring some contribution to peace, but simply starting talks is not meaningful," said the chairman of the Liberal Democratic Party's policy research council in Japan, Shoichi Nakagawa.
target_text: 自民党日本政策研究委员会主席中川昭一说：“如果朝鲜能为和平做出一些贡献，那就好了，仅仅是开始会谈是没有意义的。”

source_text: "The situation has changed since the last six-party talks in September last year.
target_text: “自去年9月举行的六方会谈以来，情况发生了变化。

source_text: North Korea has conducted missile test launches and undertaken a nuclear test.
target_text: 朝鲜进行了导弹试射并进行了核试验。

source_text: North Korea successfully tested a nuclear missile on October 9, 2006.
target_text: 朝鲜于2006年10月9日成功测试了核导弹。

source_text: We believe it is necessary for North Korea to show concrete actions toward the abandonment of all nuclear weapons and existing nuclear programs," said Shinzo Abe, the Prime Minister of Japan.
target_text: 日本首相安倍晋三说：“我们认为，朝鲜有必要采取具体行动，放弃所有核武器和现有的核计划。”

source_text: Six-party talks are said to resume on December 18, 2006.
target_text: 据说六方会谈于2006年12月18日恢复。

source_text: Australian Prime Minister John Howard has announced a five year plan costing AU$1.8 billion to address issues with the country's mental health system.
target_text: 澳大利亚总理约翰·霍华德宣布了一项花费18亿澳元的五年计划，以解决澳大利亚精神卫生系统的问题。

source_text: The plan follows a commitment made at the Council of Australian Governments (COAG) meeting in February.
target_text: 该计划是在2月份澳大利亚政府理事会（COAG）会议上作出的承诺之后制定的。

source_text: The federal government will improve access to clinical and health services, increase the number of mental health professionals in Australia, create mental health work teams consisting of GPs, psychiatrists, psychologists and mental health nurses, provide respite services for people suffering mental illness and their carers, and introduce new programs for community awareness.
target_text: 联邦政府将改善获得临床和卫生服务的机会，增加澳大利亚精神卫生专业人员的数量，建立由全球定位系统、精神病医生、心理学家和精神卫生护士组成的精神卫生工作组，为患有精神疾病的人及其护理人员提供服务，并引入新的社区意识计划。

source_text: Mr Howard said the plan addresses issues which fall into its area of responsibility.
target_text: 霍华德表示，该计划解决了属于其责任范围的问题。

source_text: He hopes that the states and territories will complement the federal government's package by investing in supported accommodation, hospital and emergency services, crisis care services and the provision of mental health care in gaols.
target_text: 他希望州和地区将通过投资支持的住宿、医院和紧急服务、危机护理服务和提供精神卫生保健来补充联邦政府的一揽子计划。

source_text: Under the federal government's plan, psychologists will play a greater role in the mental health system.
target_text: 根据联邦政府的计划，心理学家将在心理健康系统中发挥更大的作用。

source_text: From November, Patients will be able to claim a rebate from Medicare (Australia's universal healthcare scheme) for the services of psychologists if they have been referred by a GP or psychiatrist.
target_text: 从11月开始，如果患者被一位全科医生或精神病医生推荐，他们将可以申请从医疗保险（澳大利亚的全民医疗计划）中获得心理学家服务的折扣。

source_text: At present patients pay around $100 for a standard 30 minute consultation.
target_text: 目前，患者在标准的30分钟咨询中需要支付约100美元。

source_text: Mr Howard claims that there is an issue for mental health professionals in treating patients with a substance abuse problem and mental illness.
target_text: 霍华德声称，心理健康专家在治疗患者的药物成瘾和精神疾病方面存在问题。

source_text: To address this the government will provide extra funding for drug and alcohol rehabilitation services.
target_text: 为了解决这一问题，政府将为戒毒和戒酒康复服务提供额外资金。

source_text: The government has promised increase funding for telephone counselling and suicide prevention services, living skills programs and additional support for those with a mental illness who are having difficulty finding or keeping work.
target_text: 政府已承诺增加电话咨询和自杀预防服务以及生活技能计划的资金，并为精神病患者寻找或继续工作提供额外支持。

source_text: The government will also provide 900 personal helpers and mentors, increase funding for living skills programs and provide additional employment assistance to those who have difficulty finding or retaining employment due to their illness.
target_text: 政府还将提供900名个人帮手和导师，增加生活技能计划的资金，并向因生病而难以找到或留住工作的人提供额外的就业援助。

source_text: The Thai Prime Minister, Thaksin Shinawatra, despatched an additional 1,000 troops to the south of the country to help deal with the widespread violence.
target_text: 泰国总理他信·西那瓦向该国南部派遣了另外1000名士兵，以帮助处理大范围的暴力事件。

source_text: This brings the total number of security forces operating in the three troubled provinces to approximately 30,000.
target_text: 这使得三个陷入困境的省份的安全部队总数达到了大约30000人。

source_text: Mr. Shinawatra's recent visit to the region was followed by further shootings.
target_text: 西那瓦最近访问了该地区，随后又发生了枪击事件。

source_text: In Narathiwat Province a 40 year old village worker was shot while helping a neighbour repair a fence.
target_text: 在纳拉提瓦特省，一名40岁的村民在帮助邻居修理栅栏时被枪击。

source_text: Friday saw the shooting of an assistant village head in Yala Province, and an elderly couple were shot in Pattani Province whilst returning from a local market.
target_text: 上周五，雅拉省一名助理村长被枪杀，一对老年夫妇在从当地市场返回时在芭堤尼省被枪杀。

source_text: The insurgency and campaign for an independent Muslim state in the southern provinces has resulted in an exodus from the area.
target_text: 企图建立一个独立的穆斯林国家的叛乱引发了南方省份的大规模逃难。

source_text: Estimates put the number of Thai Buddhists who have fled the area at 34,000.
target_text: 据估计，逃离该地区的泰国佛教徒人数为34000人。

source_text: There are also some reports that Muslim inhabitants of the area have been seeking refuge in Malaysia.
target_text: 还有一些报道称，该地区的穆斯林居民一直在马来西亚寻求庇护。

source_text: The state of emergency imposed last month has had a mixed reception.
target_text: 上月实施的紧急状态喜忧参半。

source_text: Largely favoured by Buddhists in the provinces, this grants additional powers to the Prime Minister and follows on from martial law having been in place since January 2004.
target_text: 这在很大程度上受到各省佛教徒的青睐，授予总理额外的权力，并从2004年1月开始实施戒严。

source_text: Despite these security measures, over 1,000 people have died in the insurgency.
target_text: 尽管采取了这些安全措施，仍有1000多人在叛乱中丧生。

source_text: An aide to ousted Honduran President Manuel Zelaya said that a deal designed to end the country's political crisis has failed, after interim leader Roberto Micheletti announced the formation of a new cabinet.
target_text: 被驱逐的洪都拉斯总统曼努尔・塞拉亚的一名助手说，旨在结束该国政治危机的协议已经失败，随后临时领导人罗伯托・米切莱蒂宣布组建新内阁。

source_text: Micheletti said late on Thursday that he is installing a national unity government without the participation of Zelaya, who has declined to name any cabinet members.
target_text: 米切莱蒂周四晚些时候表示，他将在塞拉亚不参与的情况下组建一个国家统一政府，塞拉亚拒绝透露任何内阁成员的姓名。

source_text: The two signed an agreement last week to resolve the four-month political standoff.
target_text: 两人上周签署了一项协议，以解决为期四个月的政治僵局。

source_text: Zelaya warned on Thursday the accord was at risk of collapsing unless the Honduran Congress held a vote to restore him to power immediately to serve out his term that ends in January.
target_text: 塞拉亚周四警告说，除非洪都拉斯国会投票决定立即恢复他的权力，直至1月任期结束，否则这项协议有崩溃的危险。

source_text: Congress must vote on Zelaya's restitution, but has not yet done so.
target_text: 国会必须对塞拉亚的复归进行投票，但截至目前该投票并未进行。

source_text: The recently signed pact does not stipulate a deadline for the Congressional vote.
target_text: 最近签署的协议没有规定国会投票的最后期限。

source_text: The United States, a major broker in the mediation efforts, said this week the next step in the political crisis is up to Honduras.
target_text: 作为主要调停方的美国本周表示，政治危机的下一步行动取决于洪都拉斯。

source_text: The governments of several countries have threatened not to recognize the presidential elections if Zelaya is not first returned to power.
target_text: 一些国家的政府威胁说，如果塞拉亚不首先掌权，就不会承认总统选举。

source_text: Zelaya was ousted in a military-backed coup in June, but returned to Honduras in September, where he has taken refuge in the Brazilian embassy in Tegucigalpa.
target_text: 塞拉亚6月在军事支持的政变中被驱逐，但9月回到洪都拉斯，他在特古西加尔巴的巴西大使馆避难。

source_text: Thousands of Greeks gathered last night in Syntagma square in front of the parliament building in Athens to protest over the political response to the fires.
target_text: 昨晚，数千希腊人聚集在雅典议会大楼前的宪法广场，抗议对火灾的政治反应。

source_text: An estimated 8,000 people attended, after a call for a silent protest had been distributed through e-mail, text messages and eventually the media.
target_text: 据估计，在通过电子邮件、短信和媒体发布了一个无声抗议呼吁之后，有8000人参加了这次抗议活动。

source_text: Some protesters taunted riot police, who responded with stun grenades.
target_text: 一些抗议者嘲弄防暴警察，防暴警察用眩晕手榴弹回应。

source_text: Wikipedia, one of the top ten websites on the internet, will soon be receiving a face lift.
target_text: 维基百科，互联网十大网站之一，很快将改头换面。

source_text: The first part of the change is a new skin called Vector.
target_text: 变化的第一部分是一个叫做“矢量”的新皮肤。

source_text: This skin, currently used on Wikinews, will be enabled for Wikipedia on April 5th and provide a more updated look and feel.
target_text: 这个皮肤，目前用于维基新闻，将在4月5日为维基百科启用，将带来一个更为全新的外观和体验。

source_text: The second part will change the toolbar when editing, and is intended to ease common tasks.
target_text: 第二部分将在编辑时更改工具栏，以简化常见任务。

source_text: Both changes are important to encourage new people to edit and update content.
target_text: 这两项更改对于鼓励新人编辑和更新内容都很重要。

source_text: The improvements have been tested by more than 500,000 beta-testers.
target_text: 这些改进经过了50多万个测试人员的测试。

source_text: The wiki code will also be altered; editors will be able to change tables data and other elements with what is intended as an easier form, in addition to editing an article while watching it.
target_text: 维基的代码也将被修改；除了可在观看文章的同时编辑文章之外，编辑们还可以用更简单的形式更改表格数据和其他元素。

source_text: On the other hand, the staff of Wikimedia requested more editors to add and update articles in their wikis.
target_text: 另一方面，维基媒体的工作人员要求更多的编辑在他们的维基中添加和更新文章。

source_text: Wikipedia is a website maintained by users in unprecedented numbers.
target_text: 维基百科是一个由数量空前的用户来维护的网站。

source_text: Maintenance and updating processes are dependent on just one percent of their users.
target_text: 维护和更新过程仅依赖于其百分之一的用户。

source_text: Based on some statements, fewer than a thousand users do the maintenance and updating work.
target_text: 据一些声明称，只有不到1000个用户在进行维护和更新工作。

source_text: According to family, former United States senator for Texas and former Treasury Secretary, Lloyd Bentsen has died at the age of 85 in his home located in Houston, Texas.
target_text: 据美国前德克萨斯州参议员、前财政部长劳埃德·本特森的家人说，他在位于德克萨斯州休斯顿的家中去世，享年85岁。

source_text: Bentsen is most famous for his words during a Vice Presidential debate on October 5, 1988.
target_text: 本特森最著名的是他在1988年10月5日的副总统辩论中所说的话。

source_text: Indiana Senator Dan Quayle, the Republican candidate for Vice President, compared his congressional experience to that of former President John F. Kennedy when he sought the presidency.
target_text: 印第安纳州参议员丹·奎尔，共和党副总统候选人，将他的国会经验与前总统约翰·肯尼迪竞选总统时的经验进行了比较。

source_text: The sharp rebuke, however, didn't save Bentsen, as George H.W. Bush and Quayle defeated Michael Dukakis and Bentsen in the 1988 elections.
target_text: 然而，尖锐的指责并没有拯救本特森，因为乔治H.W.布什和奎尔在1988年的选举中击败了迈克尔·杜卡基斯和本特森。

source_text: In 1998, Bentsen suffered a small stroke, which he said was caused by a 3-month long trip to 15 different nations.
target_text: 1998年，本特森患了一次小中风，他说这是因为他到15个不同的国家进行了长达3个月的旅行。

source_text: Bentsen was born on February 11, 1921 and represented the state of Texas for 28 years.
target_text: 本特森出生于1921年2月11日，曾在28年内作为德克萨斯州的代表。

source_text: The deportation was widely anticipated, but the French government had refused to confirm that it would be expelling Afghan illegal immigrants until Wednesday.
target_text: 尽管广泛猜测阿富汗非法移民已被驱逐，但法国政府在周三前一直拒绝确认该消息。

source_text: Immigration Minister Eric Besson told Europe One radio that three Afghan men had been put on a plane that had been chartered by the British government.
target_text: 移民部长埃里克·贝松告诉欧洲一号电台，三名阿富汗男子被安置在一架由英国政府租用的飞机上。

source_text: The plane was also carrying illegal Afghan immigrants living in Britain.
target_text: 这架飞机还载有居住在英国的阿富汗非法移民。

source_text: Besson said a fourth Afghan had been slated to be expelled as well, but was held back at the last minute.
target_text: 贝松说，第四名阿富汗人也将被驱逐出境，但在最后一刻被阻止。

source_text: He said those expelled had lost their appeals against deportation, including one before the European Court of Human Rights.
target_text: 他说，那些被驱逐的人已经失去了对驱逐出境的上诉机会，其中包括在欧洲人权法院的上诉。

source_text: He said that he will not rule out future deportation flights with Britain.
target_text: 他说，他不排除将来还会有与英国合作的驱逐出境航班的可能。

source_text: The expulsions have sparked widespread outcry on the part of human rights groups and opposition politicians, including Paris Mayor Bertrand Delanoe.
target_text: 驱逐引起了包括巴黎市长伯特兰·德拉诺在内的人权组织和反对党政治家的广泛抗议。

source_text: The French rights group France Terre d'Asile has gathered thousands of signatures in a petition against deportation.
target_text: 法国人权组织“法兰西庇护地”在一份反对驱逐出境的请愿书中收集了数千个签名。

source_text: Marie-Helene Senay, communications director for France Terre d'Asile, said she opposed the deporting of Afghans back to their country, which has been torn by conflict, even if they do not meet asylum requirements in France.
target_text: 法兰西庇护地的通讯主管玛丽·海琳·塞奈说，她反对把阿富汗人遣返他们的国家，因为阿富汗一直受到冲突的困扰，即使他们不符合法国的庇护要求。

source_text: The French government, however, has argued that it is only trying to crack down on human smuggling rings and that illegal immigrants are given every legal recourse to remain in France.
target_text: 然而，法国政府辩称，它只是在试图打击人口走私团伙，非法移民被给予一切合法的追索权以留在法国。

source_text: Immigration Minister Besson defended the decision, saying that "if France never sends people back, it becomes the target for people traffickers."
target_text: 移民部长贝松为这一决定辩护说：“如果法国不遣返人员，它就成了人口贩子的目标。”

source_text: The three 100 foot reinforced concrete sugar storage silos around which the investigation into the 2008 Georgia sugar refinery explosion is centred have been demolished.
target_text: 三个100英尺的钢筋混凝土储糖筒仓已经被拆除，2008年乔治亚州炼糖厂爆炸事件的调查就是围绕着这个筒仓展开。

source_text: The February industrial disaster killed 13 people when the Imperial Sugar refinery at Port Wentworth, United States exploded.
target_text: 今年2月，美国温特沃斯港的帝国糖业精炼厂发生爆炸，造成13人死亡。

source_text: The initial investigation concluded the disaster to have been a dust explosion that ignited under the silos, but investigators from the U.S. Chemical Safety Board (CSB) and the Occupational Health and Safety Administration (OSHA) have been hampered as OSHA declared them to be unsafe after the accident.
target_text: 最初的调查得出的结论是，这场灾难是一场在筒仓下点燃的粉尘爆炸，但是来自美国化学安全委员会（CSB）和职业健康与安全管理局（OSHA）的调查人员受到了阻碍，因为OSHA在事故发生后宣布这些筒仓并不安全。

source_text: A 7,000lb wrecking ball has now been brought in and demolished the structures, which were 18 inches thick.
target_text: 一个7000磅的破坏球已经被带入现场并拆除了18英寸厚的建筑结构。

source_text: This will allow access for investigators, and make way for replacement silos and a new sugar packaging building, which are scheduled to be in place by Summer 2009.
target_text: 这将允许调查人员进入，并为替换筒仓和新的糖果包装大楼打开空间，该大楼计划在2009年夏天建成。

source_text: The refinery hopes to restart sugar processing by the end of the year.
target_text: 该厂希望在年底前重新开始糖加工。

source_text: Imperial vice president Brian Harrison, who is overseeing reconstruction at the site, said of the move "Several people have indicated to me it's a passage from the old to the new and a significant sign of the progress we're making to rebuild."
target_text: 负责现场重建工作的帝国副总统布莱恩·哈里森说：“有几个人向我表明，这是一条从旧到新的道路，也是我们重建工作取得进展的重要标志。”

source_text: 2.8 million pounds of fire-hardened sugar were still present in one silo, and 500,000 pounds in another.
target_text: 一个筒仓中仍然存在280万磅被火烧硬的糖，而另一个筒仓中还有50万磅。

source_text: Imperial brought in a crane with a bucket to retrieve this and intends to recycle it for ethanol production.
target_text: 帝国糖业带来了一个带铲斗的起重机来取回它们，并打算将其回收用于乙醇生产。

source_text: Four workers are still hospitalised after the explosion, three in critical condition.
target_text: 仍有4名在爆炸中受伤的工人住院，其中3人尚未脱离生命危险。

source_text: The disaster is also blamed for a $15.5 million loss Imperial posted in this year's first quarter.
target_text: 帝国糖业今年第一季度亏损1550万美元也归咎于该事件。

source_text: The government motion was defeated by opposition from the Labour Party, as well as rebel MPs from both the Conservative and Liberal Democratic parties.
target_text: 政府的动议被工党的反对以及保守党和自由民主党的反对派国会议员所否决。

source_text: David Cameron argued the recent events in Syria were a "humanitarian catastrophe, and if there are no consequences for it, there is nothing to stop Assad and other dictators from using these weapons again and again".
target_text: 大卫·卡梅伦认为，叙利亚最近发生的事件是一场“人道主义灾难，如果不让其付出代价，就没有什么可以阻止阿萨德和其他独裁者一次又一次地使用这些武器”。

source_text: The motion rejected by the Commons said the House "agrees that a strong humanitarian response is required from the international community and that this may, if necessary, require military action", and such action would be "legal, proportionate and focused on saving lives by preventing and deterring further use of Syria's chemical weapons".
target_text: 下议院否决的议案表示，众议院“同意国际社会需要采取强有力的人道主义反应，如果有必要，将采取军事行动”，这种行动将是“为了防止和阻止叙利亚进一步使用化学武器，因而是合法的，适当的，并且主要是为了拯救生命”。

source_text: Thirty Conservative MPs and nine Liberal Democrats voted against their party against military intervention.
target_text: 三十名保守党议员和九名自由民主党投票反对他们的政党进行军事干预。

source_text: Ed Miliband, leader of the opposition Labour Party, said the proposal to go to war was an "ill-thought through action", it lacked international support, and Cameron had acted in a "cavalier and reckless" manner.
target_text: 反对党工党领袖艾德·米利班德表示，参战的提议是一种“不明智的行动”，缺乏国际支持，卡梅伦采取了“傲慢和鲁莽”的行动。

source_text: Deputy Prime Minister and Liberal Democratic leader Nick Clegg said the sole intention of the government's motion was to "relieve humanitarian suffering by deterring and disrupting the further use of chemical weapons".
target_text: 副首相兼自由民主党领袖尼克·克莱格说，政府的提议的唯一目的是“通过阻止和破坏进一步使用化学武器来减轻人道主义危机”。

source_text: "President Obama's intentions are highly limited and so are ours."
target_text: “奥巴马总统的意图受到很大限制，我们也是如此。”

source_text: The former foreign secretary and Conservative MP Sir Malcolm Rifkind said during the debate: "The Assad regime in Damascus are watching very carefully as to whether they will get away with what they have done."
target_text: 前外交部长和保守党下院议员马尔科姆·里夫金德爵士在辩论中说：“大马士革的阿萨德政权正在密切关注他们是否能从他们的所作所为中逃脱。”

source_text: Opposition came also from Britain's smaller parties: Caroline Lucas from the Green Party said the actions "cannot be justified", and expressed concern that the United Kingdom would be "flouting international law" by going into Syria.
target_text: 反对意见也来自英国的小党派：绿党的卡罗琳·卢卡斯说，这些行动“不合理”，并表示担心英国进入叙利亚将“违反国际法”。

source_text: Labour proposed an opposing motion that called for the government to present "compelling" evidence before action, which was rejected as well as the government's motion.
target_text: 工党提出了一项反对的动议，要求政府在采取行动前提供“令人信服的”证据，这项动议和政府的动议都遭到了拒绝。

source_text: The defeat of the government motion for military intervention has surprised some.
target_text: 政府军事干预动议的失败让一些人感到惊讶。

source_text: Shadow Defence Secretary Jim Murphy said "Parliament is entirely unpredictable sometimes and I don't think many people saw this coming."
target_text: 影子国防部长吉姆墨菲说：“议会有时完全不可预测，我认为很多人都没有看到这一点。”

source_text: Philip Hammond, the Defence Secretary, confirmed that following the vote, the country would not participate in any action in Syria, but he noted he expected the United States to carry on without the UK, anticipating "the US and other countries will continue to look at responses to the chemical attack."
target_text: 国防部长菲利普·哈蒙德证实，投票后，英国不会参与任何在叙利亚的行动，但他指出，他预计美国将在没有英国的情况下继续进行干预，预计“美国和其他国家将继续关注对化学攻击的反应”。

source_text: "They will be disappointed that Britain will not be involved."
target_text: “他们会对英国不会参与感到失望。”

source_text: "I don't expect that the lack of British participation will stop any action."
target_text: “我不认为缺乏英国参与会阻止任何行动。”

source_text: Hammond noted the rejection of military intervention would strain the "special relationship" between Britain and the United States.
target_text: 哈蒙德指出，拒绝军事干预将使英国与美国之间的“特殊关系”变得紧张。

source_text: The former leader of the British Army, General Lord Dannatt, said the vote in the Commons was a "victory for common sense".
target_text: 英国陆军前领导人丹纳特勋爵表示，下议院的投票是“常识的胜利”。

source_text: US defense secretary Chuck Hagel said the US would seek to build an "international coalition".
target_text: 美国国防部长查克·哈格尔表示，美国将寻求建立一个“国际联盟”。

source_text: Hayden said that President Obama "will be guided by what is in the best interests of the United States", and that Obama "believes that there are core interests at stake for the United States... countries who violate international norms regarding chemical weapons need to be held accountable".
target_text: 海登说，奥巴马总统“将以美国的最佳利益为指导”，奥巴马“相信美国的核心利益处于危险之中……违反有关化学武器的国际规范的国家需要承担责任”。

source_text: Representative Eliot Engel, a Democrat on the House Foreign Affairs Committee, said the White House had told them "beyond a doubt [...] chemical weapons were used, and used intentionally by the Assad regime", and that there is evidence from intercepted communications of involvement by "high-level Syrian officials".
target_text: 众议院外交事务委员会的民主党代表艾略特·恩格尔说，白宫告诉他们，“毫无疑问，阿萨德政权使用了【…】化学武器，并且有意使用的”，而且从被截获的信息中有证据表明“叙利亚高官”参与其中。

source_text: The Parliamentary vote on intervention in Syria is on the front pages of many of the national newspapers in Britain, with The Times claiming Cameron was "humiliated" by the vote.
target_text: 英国许多国家报纸的头版都刊登了议会对叙利亚干预的投票，英国《泰晤士报》称卡梅伦在投票中受到了“羞辱”。

source_text: It was an unusual ending to Thursday's game at U.S. Cellular Field between the Chicago White Sox and the Cleveland Indians.
target_text: 周四芝加哥白袜队和克利夫兰印第安人在美国蜂窝球场的比赛有一个不寻常的结局。

source_text: With the game tied in the bottom of the ninth inning, Cleveland pitcher Roberto Hernández hit batter A.J. Pierzynski with the bases loaded, walking in the winning run.
target_text: 随着比赛在第九局的最后一局打平，克利夫兰投手罗伯托·赫尔南德兹击中了正在跑垒的击球手A.J.皮耶兹斯基。

source_text: Grady Sizemore got things started for the Indians by hitting a solo home run in the first, but the Sox would tie it up in the second on a Paul Konerko RBI groundout.
target_text: 格雷迪·西泽莫尔通过在第一局比赛中击出一个本垒打为印第安人队赢得开门红，但是保罗·科内尔科在第二局中帮白袜队将比分扳平。

source_text: Another Indian homer came from the bat of Jason Michaels, but the Sox again tie it up in the fourth with Tadahito Iguchi hitting an RBI sacrifice fly.
target_text: 杰森·迈克尔斯为印第安人贡献了另一个本垒打，但白袜队再次依靠井口资仁高飞牺牲打得点扳回了比分。

source_text: Chicago took their first lead of the game in the seventh with a Scott Podsednik RBI, but Jason Michaels would tie it up again in the eighth.
target_text: 芝加哥队在第七场比赛中以斯科特·波塞德尼克的打点取得了第一次领先，但杰森·迈克尔斯将在第八局再次将比分扳平。

source_text: In the bottom of the ninth inning, an inside pitch hit batter A.J. Pierzynski, walking in the winning run and ending the game.
target_text: 在第九局的最后一局，在击球手A.J.皮耶兹斯基跑出了制胜的一步时，一个内线球击中了他，结束了比赛。

source_text: Chicago starter Mark Buehrle left the game in the second inning suffering from bruising on his forearm after being hit just below the elbow of his pitching arm.
target_text: 芝加哥首发球员马克·布赫勒在第二局比赛中因前臂受伤而退出比赛，他被击中的位置正好在他的手肘部以下。

source_text: He has been diagnosed with having a contusion on his left forearm, and his status will be day-to-day.
target_text: 他被诊断为左前臂挫伤，这个状态将持续一段时间。

source_text: Matt Thornton is credited a blown save for giving up Chicago's one run lead in the eighth.
target_text: 马特·桑顿一次意外的扑救让本已放弃该局的芝加哥队在第八局取得了领先。

source_text: Cleveland starter Jeremy Sowers pitched the first six innings, giving up just a hit and two runs.
target_text: 克利夫兰的首发杰里米·索沃斯在前六局投出了一个安打和两分。

source_text: The White Sox, now 1-2, are staying in town to play the visiting Minnesota Twins while Cleveland, now 2-1, will go home to face off against the Seattle Mariners.
target_text: 现在一胜两负的白袜队将继续主场迎战明尼苏达双胞胎队，而现在2-1的克利夫兰队将回到主场迎战西雅图水手队。

source_text: The government of China has claimed that the Dalai Lama is cooperating with Islamic extremists as part of a plot to bring the country into crises before the Olympic Games, which are due to be half in Beijing this Summer.
target_text: 中国政府声称，达赖喇嘛正在与伊斯兰极端主义者合作，作为在奥运会之前使中国陷入危机的阴谋的一部分，奥运会将于今年夏天在北京举行。

source_text: The official newspaper of the government of China claimed that "the Dalai Lama is scheming to take the Beijing Olympics hostage to force the Chinese government to make concessions to Tibet independence."
target_text: 中国政府的官方报纸声称“达赖喇嘛计划以北京奥运会作要挟，迫使中国政府对西藏独立做出让步。”

source_text: This move comes after Tenzin Gyatso, the 14th Dalai Lama, vowed to step down from his position if things "get out of control" in Tibet, where violent demonstrations against China have killed anywhere from 13 to 100 people.
target_text: 在这一行动之前，第14任达赖喇嘛丹津吉索誓言，如果西藏局势“失控”，他将下台。在西藏，针对中国的暴力示威活动已经造成13至100人死亡。

source_text: The protests, which began in Lhasa, have since spread to neighboring provinces.
target_text: 从拉萨开始的抗议活动已经蔓延到邻近省份。

source_text: "Earlier today, the whole town was teeming with police and soldiers," he said.
target_text: “今天早些时候，整个城里到处都是警察与士兵，”他说。

source_text: "People are anticipating that something big is going to happen."
target_text: “人们预计会发生大事。”

source_text: Elsewhere in Sichuan, thousands of Tibetans turned out in the streets of Seda, according to the Tibetan Center for Human Rights and Democracy.
target_text: 据藏族人权与民主中心称，在四川，数千名藏人出现在色达的街道上。

source_text: The international community has repeatedly urged China to use restraint in dealing with protesters, and to start talks with the Dalai Lama.
target_text: 国际社会一再敦促中国在对付抗议者时保持克制，并开始与达赖喇嘛会谈。

source_text: United States Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice said on Monday, "We have really urged the Chinese over several years to find a way to talk with the Dalai Lama, who is a figure of authority, who is not a separatist, and to find a way to engage him and bring his moral weight to a more sustainable and better solution of the Tibet issue."
target_text: 美国国务卿康多莉扎·赖斯星期一说：“多年来，我们确实敦促中国人找到一种方式与达赖喇嘛进行对话，达赖喇嘛是一个权威人物，不是一个分离主义者，并找到一种方式与达赖喇嘛接触，使达赖喇嘛的道义地位更可持续，更好地解决西藏问题。”

source_text: Djibouti and Eritrea have spoken to the United Nations security council on Thursday to discuss a border dispute.
target_text: 吉布提和厄立特里亚星期四同联合国安理会讨论边界争端。

source_text: Djibouti has said that unless the UN intervenes there will be war.
target_text: 吉布提说，除非联合国介入，否则将发生战争。

source_text: Djibouti's ambassador to the UN, Roble Olhaye, has accused Eritrea of avoiding mediation on the problem.
target_text: 吉布提驻联合国大使罗伯·奥尔哈伊指责厄立特里亚逃避对该问题的调解。

source_text: Djibouti's President Omah Guelleh told the UN security council "Continued inaction in whatever form not only will encourage but will benefit Eritrea's attitude."
target_text: 吉布提总统奥马哈·盖勒对联合国安理会说：“无论以何种形式继续不作为，不仅会鼓励厄立特里亚，而且会有利于厄立特里亚的态度。”

source_text: "This would only give my country one option, the option of war."
target_text: “这只会给我的国家一个选择，即战争的选择。”

source_text: The Eritrean ambassador to the UN, Araya Desta, claimed to have peaceful intentions and that his nation had no wishes to take new territory.
target_text: 厄立特里亚驻联合国大使阿拉亚·德斯塔声称，他有和平的意图，他的国家不希望占领新的领土。

source_text: He claimed his country desired "the cultivation of good neighbourly relations with Djibouti," and said that "Contrary to the claims made, Eritrea has not taken any land that belongs to Djibouti and it does not have any territorial ambitions."
target_text: 他声称，他的国家希望“与吉布提建立良好的邻里关系”，并说，“与所提出的主张相反，厄立特里亚没有夺取任何属于吉布提的土地，也没有任何领土野心。”

source_text: Desta accused Ethiopia of worsening the situation by preparing military forces to help Djibouti.
target_text: 德斯塔指责埃塞俄比亚准备军事力量帮助吉布提，使局势恶化。

source_text: "Ethiopia has built from the Djiboutian side a network of winding roads up the mount and deployed offensive long-range artillery and heavy equipment directed at Eritrea," he said.
target_text: 他说：“埃塞俄比亚在吉布提一侧修建了一个蜿蜒的公路网络，并部署了攻击性且指向厄立特里亚的远程火炮和重型装备。”

source_text: Olhaye dismissed the idea of Ethiopia's involvement with the claim "Whatever the Eritrean ambassador has said is hogwash."
target_text: 奥尔哈伊驳斥了埃塞俄比亚参与该争端的说法，“厄立特里亚大使所说的一切都是胡说八道。”

source_text: The UN security council has urged both nations to show restraint; it was the UN who called on the nations to agree to a ceasefire in June.
target_text: 联合国安理会敦促两国保持克制；联合国呼吁两国在6月份达成停火协议。

source_text: Veteran fighter Carlo "Neo" Prater also prevailed in his Strikeforce debut against Bryan Travers.
target_text: 老牌拳手“尼奥”卡洛·普拉特也战胜了新秀莱恩·特拉弗斯。

source_text: Ryan Couture, son of MMA legend Randy Couture, remained undefeated in his second-ever bout.
target_text: MMA传奇人物兰迪·库卓之子，莱安·库卓，在他的第二场比赛中继续保持不败纪录。

source_text: Lyle Beerbohm came into the main event bout with an undefeated 15-0-0 record, in addition to his 8-0-0 amateur record.
target_text: 莱尔·比尔博姆凭借15胜0平0败，以及新人赛8胜0平0败的不败战绩，挺进了主赛事。

source_text: "This is going to be a fun, tough, hard fight that I expect will go everywhere," stated Beerbohm in a pre-fight media workout on Wednesday.
target_text: 比尔博姆在周三的一次赛前媒体训练中说“如我期待，有趣并艰苦的战斗将无处不在，”。

source_text: "My time has come and I am really looking forward to the fight."
target_text: “我的时间到了，我期待着这场战斗。”

source_text: Beerbohm also stated he wanted to eventually fight for a Strikeforce Lightweight title, but recognized that he first needed to move past his veteran opponent, Pat Healey, who came into the fight with a record of 25-17-0, who was making his return to action since his loss to Josh Thompson via submission in 2010.
target_text: 比尔博姆还表示，他希望最终夺取打击力量轻量级冠军头衔，但他认识到，他首先需要战胜他的老对手帕特·希利，希利以25胜17平0败的战绩进入主赛，这是他在2010年输给乔希·汤普森之后的复出赛。

source_text: The bout was very close, going the distance through all three rounds.
target_text: 这场比赛非常接近，经过了三个回合。

source_text: While Beerbohm pushed a lot of the action, especially with grappling on the ground, Healey was able to land more effective strikes and weathered persistent take-down attempts from Beerbohm.
target_text: 虽然比尔博姆十分主动的进攻，尤其是在地面擒技上占据主动，但希利总能进行更有效的攻击，察觉并化解比尔博姆的攻击意图。

source_text: The action was back-and-forth, neither fighter never able to clearly dominate the other.
target_text: 战斗有来有回，双方都无法占据明显优势。

source_text: The last few minutes of the fight proved to be the best for Healey, who wore down Beerbohm's strength and left him gasping for air, allowing Healey to attempt more submissions on the ground.
target_text: 战斗的最后几分钟变得对希利极其有利，他已经耗尽了比尔博姆的体力，让他气喘吁吁，这让希利在地面战上获取了优势。

source_text: The three judges scored the bout 29-28, 29-28, and 29-28 to give Healey the unanimous decision win.
target_text: 三位裁判均打出了29比28的比分，一致决定希利获得了比赛的胜利。

source_text: After the match, Beerbohm was upbeat, but felt he had won the bout.
target_text: 赛后，比尔博姆仍很乐观，他认为他赢了这场比赛。

source_text: "I thought going into the third we'd each won a round, but I definitely thought I won that last round."
target_text: “我本以为比赛会因前两局平手而进入第三局，我真的认为我在第二局中获胜了。”

source_text: "But that's what happens when you let it go to the hands of the judges."
target_text: “但当让裁判进行判决时，这种事也是会发生的。”

source_text: Healey complimented his opponent, "Beerbohm fought a good fight but I think I outworked and outhustled him."
target_text: 希利称赞他的对手：“比尔博姆打得很好，但我觉得我比他打得好，也比他强。”

source_text: Healey also welcomed the idea of a rematch, stating, "He talked a lot of trash, but if he wants a rematch, I'll give him one anytime."
target_text: 希利对重赛的想法也很欢迎，他说：“他说了很多废话，但如果他想重赛，我随时奉陪。”

source_text: Asked who he wanted to face next, Healey stated he wanted to fight the winner of the Billy "Cyborg" Evangelista and Jorge "Gamebred" Masvidal on March 5, noting that both fighters had previously defeated his brother, Pat Healey.
target_text: 当被问及接下来要面对谁时，希利表示他想在3月5日与“生化人”比利·伊万杰里和“纯种”豪尔赫·马斯威达尔之间的胜者战斗，并指出这两人都曾战胜过他的兄弟帕特·希利。

source_text: The co-main event for the show featured Carlo "Neo" Prater, a veteran fighter with a 25-10-1 record making his Strikeforce debut against the 14-3-0 Bryan Travers.
target_text: 另一场主要赛事是有着25胜10平1败战绩的老将“尼奥”卡洛·普拉特对阵有着14胜3平0败战绩的，在打击力量主赛首次亮相的新秀布赖恩·特拉弗斯。

source_text: The bout was over in just 38 seconds as Prater used his superior reach to jab Travers several times before using a trip to take Travers to the ground and submitting him with an Anaconda Choke.
target_text: 比赛在短短的38秒内结束，普拉特利用他的优势多次逼近猛击特拉弗斯，随后将他绊倒在地，最后以水蟒绞制服了对手。

source_text: "My record shows I'm not a perfect fighter, but when you're down you get up," Prater said.
target_text: 普拉特说：“我的记录显示我不是一个完美的战士，但当你倒下的时候，你就得爬起来。”

source_text: "This was a good win, I'll get better off this fight, but I'll be right back in the gym soon."
target_text: “这是一场很好的胜利，我会在这场比赛中有所改善，但我现在得回健身房了。”

source_text: Ryan Couture, the son of MMA legend Randy "the Nature" Couture, pushed his fight record to 2-0-0 with a victory over 2-0-0 opponent Lee Higgins.
target_text: MMA传奇人物“大自然”兰迪·库卓的儿子莱安·库卓，战胜了有着2站全胜记录的对手李·希金斯，将他的战绩提升至2胜0平0败。

source_text: Most of the first round featured very little action until Higgins attempted to take down Couture, and found himself fighting off Guillotine Choke and a D'Arce Choke in the last minute of the round.
target_text: 第一局的大部分时间双方都没有什么举动，直到希金斯试图击倒库卓，结果导致他直至该局的最后一刻都在试图挣脱库卓的断头台与达斯绞。

source_text: Couture dominated nearly all of the second round with superior stand-up striking and ground control.
target_text: 库卓凭借出色的站立打击和地面控制技，几乎占据了整个第二局的主导。

source_text: Higgins fared little better in the third, as Couture was able to put Higgins against the cage and stop Higgins' take-down attempts, and then eventually control Higgins on the ground before submitting him with a Rear Naked Choke with 20 seconds left in the bout.
target_text: 希金斯在第三局也未能有更好表现，库卓将希金斯逼至笼边，让他无法试图击倒库卓。最终库卓将希金斯控制在地面上，并在比赛的最后20秒以裸绞将其制服。

source_text: The main card was broadcast in the United States on premium broadcast network Showtime.
target_text: 主赛事在美国高级广播网络“演出时间”上播放。

source_text: The Showtime Strikeforce Challengers series highlights mixed martial arts fights between up-and-coming fighters as well as veteran fighters who are looking to move up towards the larger Strikeforce events.
target_text: “演出时间”的“打击力量挑战者”系列综合格斗赛事为初露头角的战士和期待在进军更高级“打击力量”赛事的资深战士提供了舞台。

source_text: Mauritanians voted in favour of a new Constitution by an overwhelming majority in a referendum held on June 26, according to results announced by Interior Ministry officials today.
target_text: 根据内政部官员今天宣布的结果，毛里塔尼亚在6月26日举行的全民公投中，新宪法以绝对多数的赞同票获得通过。

source_text: The new Constitution sets limits on the number of presidential terms a leader can serve, in contrast to several sub-Saharan countries, where several leaders have amended their Constitutions to retain power.
target_text: 新宪法对总统连任任期进行了限制，这一点和其他一些撒哈拉以南的国家不同，那些国家的领导者修改了他们的宪法以维持自己的权力。

source_text: The Interior Minister, Mohamed Ahmed Ould Mohamed Lemine said that over 96 percent votes cast were in favour of the new Constitution.
target_text: 内政部长穆罕默德·艾哈迈德·乌尔德·穆罕默德·莱明称，超过百分之96的选票支持新宪法。

source_text: The turnout was over 76 percent of the close to One million registered voters, who constitute about a third of the country's population.
target_text: 占全国人口约三分之一的100万注册选民中，有76%参与了投票。

source_text: The referendum will now lead to municipal and legislative elections to be held in November, followed by elections to the parliamentary upper house and the President's post in 2007.
target_text: 公投之后市政与立法选举将于11月进行，随后将在2007年进行议会上议院与总统选举。

source_text: The new Constitution provides for a presidential form of government, with the President commanding significant powers, including the appointment of the prime minister.
target_text: 新宪法规定了总统式政府，总统拥有包括任命总理在内的重要权力。

source_text: The Parliament though, can vote for no confidence in the government or censure it.
target_text: 尽管如此，议会还是可以发起对政府的不信任投票，或是谴责政府。

source_text: The Constitution disallows members of the present junta from running for the President's post and requires future leaders to swear on the Qur'an that they will not amend the Constitution to stay in power.
target_text: 宪法禁止现任军政府成员竞选总统，并要求未来的领导人向古兰经发誓，他们不会修改宪法以维持权力。

source_text: International observers from the African Union and the Arab League said that the referendum appeared to have gone smoothly, but have yet to make their final reports.
target_text: 来自非洲联盟和阿拉伯联盟的国际观察员说，公投似乎进展顺利，但尚未作出最后报告。

source_text: "I am sure that all Mauritanians feel the same way and that for this reason the Constitution will receive massive support."
target_text: “我确信所有毛里塔尼亚人都有同样的感受，因此宪法将获得大量支持。”

source_text: The Constitution has the backing of most civic and political groups, though two small parties called for a boycott of the referendum, saying the proposed Constitution ignores slavery, which is officially banned but still persists according to activists; and issues of "cohabitation between the different national communities" (such as Blacks and Arabs).
target_text: 尽管宪法获得了大多数公民与政治团体的支持，但仍有两个小党派抵制公投结果，他们声称拟议的宪法忽略了奴隶制问题，虽然奴役在官方来说是被禁止的，但它在毛里塔尼亚依然存在；除此之外，还有“不同民族社区的共同定居”问题（如黑人与阿拉伯人）。

source_text: An Australian man arrested last December near the Cambodian border in Vietnam, Trinh Huu, has been sentenced to death by a Vietnamese People's Court for smuggling 2kg of heroin.
target_text: 一名澳大利亚籍男子郑有去年12月在越南柬埔寨边境附近被捕，并因走私2公斤海洛因被越南人民法院判处死刑。

source_text: Amnesty International has urged the Australian Federal Government to do everything it can to help the man.
target_text: 大赦国际组织敦促澳大利亚联邦政府尽一切可能帮助这名男子。

source_text: The Australian Department of Foreign Affairs has said that Trinh was receiving consular assistance, but that it was too early to negotiate for clemency as his case is still subject to appeal.
target_text: 澳大利亚外交部曾表示，郑正在接受领事援助，但由于他的案件仍将受到上诉，因此谈判寻求宽大处理为时过早。

source_text: The government has reiterated its long standing opposition to the death penalty.
target_text: 澳大利亚政府重申其反对死刑的长期立场。

source_text: According to reports, multiple Israeli airstrikes in the Gaza Strip have injured three children, including one infant.
target_text: 据报道，以色列多次空袭加沙地带，造成三名儿童受伤，其中包括一名婴儿。

source_text: According to a reporter for Al Jazeera, at least six locations were attacked by the strikes; meanwhile, Palestinian sources told the BBC that there were a total of at least thirteen strikes.
target_text: 据半岛电视台的一名记者称，至少有6个地点受到袭击；与此同时，巴勒斯坦消息人士告诉BBC，总共至少有13次袭击。

source_text: A correspondent for the BBC reported that the attacks were the most serious in the area in over a year.
target_text: BBC的一名记者报道说，这是一年多来该地区最严重的袭击事件。

source_text: Israel's military commented that it was targeting weapon storage areas in the centre of the Gaza Strip, and that their move was a reaction to rockets fired from Gaza.
target_text: 以色列军方评论说，他们的目标是加沙地带中心的武器储存区，他们的行动是对从加沙地带发射的火箭弹的反击。

source_text: According to Palestinian news agencies, Israeli aircraft threw leaflets around areas of Gaza yesterday, cautioning people that there would be retaliation for clashes near Khan Yunis last week, which killed two Israeli troops.
target_text: 据巴勒斯坦通讯社报道，以色列飞机昨天在加沙地区抛洒传单，警告人们，上周在汗尤尼斯附近发生并导致两名以色列士兵死亡的冲突将引发报复行动。

source_text: Hamas officials and witnesses reported that farms, a milk factory, small areas belonging to the Hamas military, and metal workshop facilities were targeted.
target_text: 哈马斯官员和目击者报告说，一些农场、一家牛奶厂、一些哈马斯的小型军事设施以及一间金属工坊都成为了攻击目标。

source_text: MSNBC translator Jacob Keryakes has stated that the claim of responsibility for the London bombings of July 7, supposedly made by a militant Islamist group, contains an error in one of the Quranic verses that it cites, suggesting that the claim may be phony.
target_text: MSNBC的翻译雅各布·克雅科斯表示，由一个激进的伊斯兰组织提出的对7月7日伦敦爆炸事件负责的声明中，一句古兰经经文有错误，暗示这一声明可能是假的。

source_text: The claim of responsibility by The Secret Organization of al-Qaida in Europe for the London attacks has also been questioned on the grounds that the rhetoric is not consistent with militant Islamic ideology.
target_text: 欧洲基地组织也声称对该声明表示质疑，理由是该声明与激进的伊斯兰意识形态不一致。

source_text: The statement asked "the Nation of Islam and the Nation of Arabism to rejoice" about the attacks.
target_text: 声明要求“伊斯兰国家和阿拉伯国家为这次袭击感到高兴”。

source_text: According to the Associated Press, Islamic expert Mishari al-Thaidi wrote in an essay published Saturday in the London-based Arabic Asharq Al Awsat newspaper: "What strikes attention here is addressing the Arab nation."
target_text: 据美联社报道，伊斯兰专家米沙里·塔伊迪周六在伦敦《阿拉伯国家报》上发表的一篇文章中写道：“这里的袭击警告应该是指向阿拉伯国家的。”

source_text: The National Socialist Movement is, according to its website, the largest and most active Nazi party in the United States.
target_text: 根据其网站，国家社会主义运动是美国规模最大，最活跃的纳粹党派。

source_text: Accordingly, it refers to itself as 'America's Nazi Party' and aims to instigate major change in the US.
target_text: 因此，它将自己称为“美国纳粹党”，旨在美国煽动重大变革。

source_text: Wikinews was able to conduct an interview with the head of the party, Commander Jeff Schoep.
target_text: 维基新闻对党的领导人，指挥官杰夫·肖普进行采访。

source_text: U.S. media giant Time Warner plans to increase the international reach of its HBO television empire with an expansion of television offerings in Asia.
target_text: 美国媒体巨头时代华纳计划扩大其HBO电视帝国在亚洲的电视业务，从而扩大其国际影响力。

source_text: The channels will be available via both wired cable services and by satellite, which is more popular in Asia than it is in the United States.
target_text: 这些频道将通过有线电视服务和卫星电视提供，这在亚洲比在美国更受欢迎。

source_text: "Cable operators throughout Asia are preparing to dramatically expand channel capacity on many of their systems through digital technology," Jonathan Spink, CEO of HBO Asia said in a World Screen News report.
target_text: HBO亚洲首席执行官乔纳森·斯宾克在一份世界电视新闻报道中表示：“亚洲各地的有线电视运营商正准备通过数字技术大幅扩大其许多系统的频道容量。”

source_text: He said HBO plans to be one of the first programmers to take advantage of increased channel capacity.
target_text: 他说，HBO计划成为第一批利用增加频道容量的频道之一。

source_text: The first new channel HBO plans to launch in Asia is HBO Signature, which is targeted to women.
target_text: HBO计划在亚洲推出的第一个新频道是面向女性观众的HBO Signature。

source_text: It is planned to debut in Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Macau and Sri Lanka by the end of the year.
target_text: 该频道计划于今年年底在新加坡、香港、印度尼西亚、澳门、斯里兰卡等地亮相。

source_text: According to reports, HBO already has struck deals for carriage in all of those countries except Macau.
target_text: 据报道，除了澳门，HBO已经在所有这些国家与地区签订了协议。

source_text: In addition to programming HBO Signature to women, the company said it plans on two other genre-based channels, but did not disclose what niches they would market toward.
target_text: 除了为女性定制的HBO Signature之外，该公司还表示计划推出另外两个不同类别的频道，但并未透露他们将会面向什么市场。

source_text: A clue could be to look to the U.S. where HBO's niche channels include HBO Family for children-friendly programming and the self-explanatory HBO Comedy channel.
target_text: 线索可以从美国的HBO频道中找到，其中包括面向儿童的HBO家庭频道，以及其市场不言自明的HBO喜剧频道。

source_text: Like the parent HBO Asia channel, along with limited original programming, the new genre channels are expected to offer top Hollywood fare dubbed into local languages.
target_text: 与HBO亚洲主频道一样，除了少量的原创节目之外，新类别的频道还有望能提供当地语言配音的顶级好莱坞节目。

source_text: This is the largest expansion of HBO Asia, which has been operating in Asia since 1992 and serves 25 countries, since the launch of Cinemax Asia in 1996.
target_text: 这是自Cinemax亚洲在1996成立以来，HBO亚洲最大规模的扩张，该公司自1992年起于亚洲运营，服务亚洲25个国家与地区。

source_text: British Airways (BA) and the Spanish airline Iberia have signed a merger deal, which will create one of the largest air carrier groups in the world.
target_text: 英国航空公司（BA）和西班牙伊比利亚航空公司签署了一项合并协议，这将创建世界上最大的航空公司集团之一。

source_text: The two announced the merger yesterday, and said that the deal, which has been expected for a long time, is to be implemented by the end of 2010.
target_text: 这两家公司昨日宣布合并，表示这笔交易已经计划很长一段时间并将于2010年底实施。

source_text: The move will make a group with a market value of US$8 billion.
target_text: 此举将诞生一个市值达80亿美元的集团。

source_text: Under the plan, both companies keep their own brands and operations, but will be owned by International Airlines Group, a new holding company.
target_text: 根据该计划，两家公司都保留自己的品牌和业务，但将由新成立的控股公司国际航空集团所有。

source_text: It will be listed in London, but taxed in Spain.
target_text: 它将在伦敦上市，但在西班牙征税。

source_text: The airlines believe the merger will save $530 million annually.
target_text: 两家航空公司相信这次合并每年将节省5.3亿美元。

source_text: In February, BA reported a loss of $102.4 million for the final three quarters of 2009, whilst Iberia posted an operating loss of $629 million.
target_text: 今年2月，英国航空公司报告2009年最后三个季度亏损1.024亿美元，而伊比利亚航空公司则公布营业亏损6.29亿美元。

source_text: Meanwhile, investors in BA will receive an IAG share for every BA share they own, and stockholders in Iberia 1.0205 shares for each share in the Spanish airline; thus, BA shareholders will take 55% of IAG.
target_text: 与此同时，BA的股东持有的每个BA股份，都将兑换成一个IAG股份，伊比利亚的股东则需1.0205的股份来兑换1份西班牙航空股份；因此，BA股东将持有百分之55的IAG股份。

source_text: "The merged company will provide customers with a larger combined network," commented BA chief executive Willie Walsh.
target_text: 英航首席执行官威利·沃尔什表示：“合并后的公司将为客户提供更大的联合航空网络。”

source_text: "It will also have greater potential for further growth by optimising the dual hubs of London and Madrid and providing continued investment in new products and services."
target_text: “它还将通过优化伦敦和马德里的双重枢纽，并提供对新产品和服务的持续投资，使其具有更大增长潜力。”

source_text: Meanwhile, Iberia chief executive Antonio Vázquez remarked: "This is an important step in creating one of the world's leading global airlines that will be better equipped to compete with other major airlines and participate in future industry consolidation."
target_text: 与此同时，伊比利亚航空公司首席执行官安东尼奥·巴斯克斯表示：“这是创建世界领先的全球航空公司的重要一步，该公司将具备更好的装备，能够与其他主要航空公司竞争，并参与未来的行业整合。”

source_text: Independent aviation specialist James Halstead said he believed the merger was necessary for BA to remain competitive amongst other European air carriers.
target_text: 独立航空专家詹姆斯·霍尔斯特德说，他认为英航有必要进行合并，以保持与其他欧洲航空公司的竞争力。

source_text: "BA's unique position at Heathrow could help it survive for a short while, but in the long run it needs more than just Heathrow."
target_text: “英航在希思罗机场的独特地位可以帮助它生存一段时间，但从长远来看，它需要的不仅仅是希思罗机场。”

source_text: "The main point of the Iberia deal is to be able to cut costs and put the combined company in the position that Air France-KLM and Lufthansa are already in," he said, quoted by The Independent.
target_text: 独立报援引他的话说：“伊比利亚协议的主要目的是能够降低成本，使合并后的公司处于法航荷航和汉莎航空对等的地位。”

source_text: Artistic gymnastics events at the London 2012 Summer Olympic Games concluded yesterday with two gold medal wins for China and gold medals for the Netherlands and the United States.
target_text: 2012年伦敦夏季奥运会的竞技体操项目昨天结束，中国获得两枚金牌，荷兰和美国各获得一枚金牌。

source_text: China's Feng Zhe won gold in the men's parallel bars, just narrowly beating out the German gymnast Marcel Nguyen by 0.166 points.
target_text: 中国选手冯哲在男子双杠比赛中获得金牌，仅以0.166分的微弱优势击败德国体操运动员马塞尔·阮。

source_text: China also claimed a gold with Deng Linlin scoring a 15.600 in the women's beam.
target_text: 中国选手邓琳琳在平衡木项目上以15.600的分数夺得冠军。

source_text: The balance beam proved treacherous for some: Gabrielle Douglas, considered a favourite for the event, came seventh after a dramatic fall.
target_text: 平衡木对一些人来说是危险的：加布丽尔·道格拉斯被认为是这项赛事最有望夺冠的选手，但在戏剧性的摔下平衡木后，她仅名列第七。

source_text: The United States did manage to get a bronze on the beam thanks to Alexandra Raisman who pulled off a routine that received enormous applause.
target_text: 美国在平衡木项目上获得了铜牌，这要归功于亚历山德拉·雷斯曼，她一反常规的动作获得了全场喝彩。

source_text: She initially got less points than Romania's Catalina Ponor, but took the bronze after an appeal.
target_text: 她最初的分数低于罗马尼亚的卡塔琳娜·波诺，但在申诉后获得了铜牌。

source_text: Danell Leyva from the United States started with a strong 15.833 point routine.
target_text: 来自美国的达尼尔·莱瓦以15.833分的强劲表现开局。

source_text: China's Zhang Chenglong then grabbed the lead by earning 16.266 points.
target_text: 中国选手张成龙又以16.266分的成绩领先。

source_text: The German gymnast Fabian Hambuchen raised the bar even further with a 16.400 routine.
target_text: 德国体操运动员法比安·汉布肯以16.400分进一步提高了成绩。

source_text: Zonderland's performance makes him the first Dutch gymnast to win gold at the Olympics since the win for the Dutch women's team at the Amsterdam Games in 1928.
target_text: 桑德兰的表现使他成为自从1928年荷兰女子队在阿姆斯特丹奥运会上获胜之后首位在奥运会上获得金牌的荷兰体操运动员。

source_text: Hambuchen got a silver medal and the Chinese gymnast Zou Kai took bronze.
target_text: 汉布肯获得银牌，中国体操运动员邹凯获得铜牌。

source_text: In the women's floor event, the eighteen-year-old United States gymnast Alexandra Raisman secured a second gold after her success in the women's team event last week.
target_text: 在女子自由体操项目中，18岁的美国体操运动员亚历山德拉·赖斯曼在上周女子团体项目中获得了第二枚金牌。

source_text: As in the beam event, she narrowly beat out Catalina Ponor from Romania with a score of 15.600 to 15.200.
target_text: 在平衡木项目中，她以15.600比15.200险胜罗马尼亚的卡特琳娜·波诺。

source_text: Aliya Mustafina from Russia took home bronze for her 14.900 point routine.
target_text: 来自俄罗斯的阿利娅·穆斯塔芬娜以14.900分的成绩获得了铜牌。

source_text: According to three news wires, the fourth London bombing suspect — just named as Hussain Osman — has been arrested by Italian police in Rome.
target_text: 据三家通讯社报道，第四名伦敦爆炸案嫌疑人，侯赛因·奥斯曼，已在罗马被意大利警方逮捕。

source_text: The arrest has been confirmed by the Italian Minister of the Interior.
target_text: 意大利内政部长已确认逮捕。

source_text: Hussein is a UK citizen who was born in Somalia, and later moved to Britain and naturalized.
target_text: 侯赛因是英国公民，出生于索马里，后来移居英国并入籍。

source_text: It comes as two bombing suspects were arrested today in West London, and one in Birmingham on 27 July.
target_text: 今天在伦敦西部逮捕了两名爆炸嫌疑犯，7月27日在伯明翰逮捕了另一名嫌疑犯。

source_text: Swindon, England, has an unusual new twin town: Walt Disney World in Florida.
target_text: 英国斯温登有一个不寻常的双子城：佛罗里达的沃尔特迪斯尼世界。

source_text: The Wiltshire town beat 24 others in a competition to become the first ever to be twinned with the famous resort.
target_text: 威尔特郡在一场比赛中击败了其他24个城镇，成为第一个与这个著名的度假胜地结为姐妹的城市。

source_text: Rebecca Warren, a local building society worker, created a poem and video praising Swindon which won over the judges.
target_text: 当地建筑协会的工作人员丽贝卡·沃伦创作了一段赞美斯温登的诗和视频，赢得了评委的支持。

source_text: Among other features she highlighted the town's well-known Magic Roundabout, a complicated junction composed of five interlinked mini-roundabouts, comparing it to Disney World's teacup rides.
target_text: 除了其他特色外，她还强调了该镇著名的魔法环岛，一个由五个相互连接的迷你环岛组成的复杂交叉点，将其与迪斯尼世界的茶杯游乐设施进行了类比。

source_text: A sign marking the twinning is planned for the roundabout.
target_text: 计划在环形交叉路口设置一个标志牌，用以标识双子城的关联。

source_text: Ms. Warren will travel to Florida with her eleven-year-old nephew and five-year-old niece to unveil a similar sign at the resort.
target_text: 沃伦将和她11岁的侄子和5岁的侄女一起前往佛罗里达，在度假胜地揭开一个类似的标志。

source_text: A celebration will be held in Swindon in January, and it will also be the focus of an exhibit at Walt Disney World's Epcot park.
target_text: 今年1月将在斯温顿举行一场庆祝活动，这也是沃尔特·迪斯尼世界艾普科特公园展览的焦点。

source_text: "Britain clearly has a love for Walt Disney World and long-standing affinity with the parks and their magic, which is probably why the number and quality of entries received was so high," said Disney's Hugh Wood.
target_text: 迪士尼的休·伍德说：“英国显然对迪士尼乐园有着浓厚的热爱，公园和它们的魔力有着长期的亲和力，这可能就是为什么参赛作品的数量和质量如此之高的原因。”

source_text: Other towns shortlisted in the competition included Aberdeen, Blackpool, Milton Keynes, and Cambridge.
target_text: 其他入围的城镇包括阿伯丁、布莱克浦、米尔顿凯恩斯和剑桥。

source_text: The jury in the Isiah Thomas sexual harassment trial revealed a guilty verdict Tuesday, ruling that the current New York Knicks coach subjected former Madison Square Garden executive Anucha Browne Sanders to unwanted sexual advances and verbal insults.
target_text: 伊西娅·托马斯性骚扰案的陪审团星期二宣布了一项有罪判决，裁定现任纽约尼克斯队教练让前麦迪逊广场花园队执行官阿努查·布朗·桑德斯遭受不必要的性骚扰和言语侮辱。

source_text: In a minor victory for Thomas, the ruling also said that Thomas will not have to pay punitive damages.
target_text: 不过对于托马斯来说还是有些许的小胜，判决说托马斯将不必支付惩罚性赔偿金。

source_text: The ugly three-week trial originated with a US$10 million lawsuit filed by Browne Sanders, the former senior vice president of marketing and business operations for the Knicks.
target_text: 这场为期三周的难看审判是由尼克斯队前营销和商业运营高级副总裁布朗·桑德斯以1000万美元的诉讼费提起的。

source_text: She was fired by the team in December of 2006, and following her dismissal she filed the explosive lawsuit alleging that Madison Square Garden fostered an environment of sexism and inequality, personified by the conduct of Isiah Thomas.
target_text: 2006年12月，她被队伍解雇，在被解雇后，她提起了爆炸性诉讼，指控麦迪逊广场花园队营造了一个性别歧视和不平等的环境，伊西娅·托马斯的行为就是其代表。

source_text: She stated that Thomas repeatedly called her a "bitch" and a "ho", and pressured her to kiss him and said that he loved her.
target_text: 她说托马斯反复叫她“婊子”和“妓女”，说他爱她并强迫她吻他。

source_text: She also stated that the firing was the result of her filing a complaint about Thomas.
target_text: 她还说，解雇是她投诉托马斯的结果。

source_text: Madison Square Garden, and the coach known for his charismatic and emotional demeanor, denied the charges.
target_text: 麦迪逊广场花园队和以其魅力和情感风范而闻名的教练否认了指控。

source_text: After the guilty verdict was read, a relieved Browne Sanders hugged her family and friends who were present at the trial.
target_text: 在宣读有罪判决后，布朗·桑德斯松了一口气，拥抱了在场的家人和朋友。

source_text: "I'm extremely disappointed that the jury did not see the facts in this case."
target_text: “陪审团没有看到此案的事实，我非常失望。”

source_text: "I will appeal this, and I remain confident in the man that I am and what I stand for and the family that I have."
target_text: “我会上诉的，我对我所属的人，我所代表的人，以及我所拥有的家庭仍然充满信心。”

source_text: Madison Square Garden is also expected to appeal the decision.
target_text: 麦迪逊广场花园队预计也将提起上诉。

source_text: Young people are gathering in Kigali for the first Global Youth Conference on Genocide Prevention.
target_text: 年轻人聚集在基加利参加第一次预防种族灭绝全球青年会议。

source_text: The conference comes at a crucial time, with Rwanda facing the Gacaca process, the regional implications of that process, and the spotlight on Africa to an unprecedented level.
target_text: 会议在关键时刻召开，卢旺达面临着加卡会议进程、该进程对区域的影响以及世界对非洲的关注达到了前所未有的水平。

source_text: Hu Jintao, the President of the People's Republic of China had lunch today with the President of Brazil, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, at the Granja do Torto, the President's country residence in the Brazilian Federal District.
target_text: 中华人民共和国主席胡锦涛今天与巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦在位于巴西联邦区的总统乡间住所共进午餐。

source_text: Lunch was a traditional Brazilian barbecue with different kinds of meat.
target_text: 午餐是传统的巴西烧烤，有各种肉类。

source_text: Some Brazilian ministers were present at the event: Antonio Palocci (Economy), Eduardo Campos (Science and Technology), Roberto Rodrigues (Agriculture), Luiz Fernando Furlan (Development), Celso Amorim (Exterior Relations), Dilma Rousseff (Mines and Energy).
target_text: 一些巴西部长出席了会议：安东尼奥·帕洛奇（经济）、爱德华多·坎波斯（科技）、罗伯托·罗德里格斯（农业）、路易斯·费尔南多·弗兰（发展）、塞尔索·阿莫林（外交）、迪尔玛·罗塞夫（矿业和能源）。

source_text: Also present were Roger Agnelli (Vale do Rio Doce company president) and Eduardo Dutra (Petrobras, government oil company, president).
target_text: 出席会议的还有罗杰·阿格内利（淡水河谷公司总裁）和爱德华多·杜特拉（巴西石油总裁，政府石油公司）。

source_text: This meeting is part of a new political economy agreement between Brazil and China where Brazil has recognized mainland China's market economy status, and China has promised to buy more Brazilian products.
target_text: 这次会议是巴西和中国之间新的政治经济协议的一部分，巴西承认中国大陆的市场经济地位，中国承诺购买更多的巴西产品。

source_text: Manchester United defeated AS Roma 1-0 in Group F of the UEFA Champions League 2007-08 at Old Trafford, Manchester, England.
target_text: 在英格兰曼彻斯特老特拉福德球场，曼彻斯特联队在2007-08年欧洲冠军联赛F组的比赛中以1比0击败罗马队。

source_text: Wayne Rooney scored the only goal of the match, his first goal of the season for Manchester United, in the 70th minute.
target_text: 鲁尼在第70分钟为曼联打进了本场比赛唯一的进球，这也是他本赛季的第一个进球。

source_text: Manchester United currently lead Group F with two wins from two matches.
target_text: 曼联目前以两胜的成绩暂列F组第一。

source_text: AS Roma are second on goal difference ahead of Sporting CP, who defeated FC Dynamo Kyiv 2-1.
target_text: 罗马队在净胜球数上位居小组第二，领先于里斯本竞技队，后者以2比1击败了基辅迪纳摩队。

source_text: President Bush is lobbying the U.S. House of Representatives to pass the Central America Free Trade Agreement (CAFTA), which is scheduled for a vote Wednesday night.
target_text: 布什总统正在游说美国众议院通过中美洲自由贸易协定（CAFTA），该协定定于周三晚上进行投票。

source_text: Similar to the existing North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) among the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, CAFTA would create a free trade zone putting an end to most trade barriers between the United States and six additional countries, including Costa Rica, El Salvador, Honduras, Guatemala, Nicaragua, and the Dominican Republic.
target_text: 与美国、加拿大和墨西哥之间现有的北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA）类似，CAFTA将建立一个自由贸易区，以结束美国与其他六个国家（包括哥斯达黎加、萨尔瓦多、洪都拉斯、危地马拉、尼加拉瓜和多米尼加共和国）之间的大多数贸易壁垒。

source_text: Many Republicans who represent agricultural Corn Belt or industrial Rust Belt and southern textile states in Congress also have stated opposition to the bill.
target_text: 国会中许多代表农业玉米带或工业锈带和南方纺织州的共和党人也表示反对该法案。

source_text: But with a Republican majority in the House large enough to ensure passage of CAFTA, party leaders are trying to shore up enough votes to ensure CAFTA's passage.
target_text: 但是，由于共和党在众议院的多数席位足以确保通过CAFTA，政党领导人正试图获得足够的选票，以确保通过CAFTA。

source_text: This has prompted last minute action by the President to lobby individual members of the House, reminding them that Central American countries have committed troops and other resources to fight the U.S. War on Terror.
target_text: 这促使总统在最后一刻采取行动游说众议院的个别成员，提醒他们中美洲国家已投入军队和其他资源协助美国的反恐战争。

source_text: Other Republican leaders have been using the party's traditional pro-business message and linking it to homeland security issues.
target_text: 其他共和党领导人一直在利用该党传统的亲商业信息，并将其与国土安全问题联系起来。

source_text: "Trade creates jobs and lifts people out of poverty and there's nothing like a stable society to fight terrorism and strengthen democracy, freedom and rule of law," Dennis Hastert, Speaker of the House, reportedly said at a news conference Tuesday.
target_text: 据报道，众议院议长丹尼斯·哈斯特尔特周二在新闻发布会上说：“贸易创造了就业机会，使人们摆脱贫困，没有什么比一个稳定的社会更能打击恐怖主义，加强民主、自由和法治。”

source_text: CAFTA is "a bad deal for Central Americans and also for Latinos in this community... (with CAFTA) the exploitation of workers will continue in Central America," Democrat Representative Hilda Solis of Los Angeles said.
target_text: CAFTA“对中美洲人和这个地区的拉丁裔人来说并不是什么好的协定……（与CAFTA）对工人的剥削将继续在中美洲进行，”来自洛杉矶的民主党代表希尔达·索利斯说。

source_text: According to opponents of CAFTA, the current trend of American jobs being sent to foreign countries, particularly in the information technology sector, would greatly expand under the treaty.
