target_text: CAFTA的反对者称，目前美国就业机会被吸引至外国的趋势，特别是在信息技术产业，将因为该协定大大提升。

source_text: "They'll keep the vote open for several hours, in violation of the rules."
target_text: “他们会违反规定，让投票持续几个小时。”

source_text: "If it passes, it will be by fewer than five votes," predicted Rep. Sherrod Brown, a Democrat from Ohio, according to a Washington Post report.
target_text: 据《华盛顿邮报》报道，来自俄亥俄州的民主党众议员谢罗德·布朗预测：“如果投票通过的话，那总票数一定少于5票。”

source_text: Afghan President Hamid Karzai agreed yesterday to a runoff vote with former Foreign Minister Abdullah Abdullah on November 7, after much international pressure, following a report on voting irregularities.
target_text: 由于此前有一份关于投票违规的报告而面临巨大的国际社会压力，阿富汗总统哈米德・卡尔扎伊昨天同意与前外交部长阿卜杜拉・阿卜杜拉在11月7日举行决选。

source_text: Secretary General Ban Ki-moon has said that the United Nations has requested that the Independent Election Commission (IEC) replace 200 of its officials in order to avoid a repeat incident.
target_text: 秘书长潘基文表示，联合国已要求独立选举委员会（IEC）更换200名官员，以避免再次发生此类事件。

source_text: President Karzai said it was "time to move forward to stability and national unity".
target_text: 卡尔扎伊总统说，现在是“向稳定和民族团结迈进的时候了”。

source_text: The New Zealand Police have issued a warning to state broadcaster TVNZ (Television New Zealand) for not telling them that they knew where a rapist on the run from police was.
target_text: 新西兰警方已向国家广播公司TVNZ（新西兰电视台）发出警告，因为他们未向警方告知他们所知的强奸犯逃离警方的地点。

source_text: However, he did turn himself in after giving the interview.
target_text: 然而，在接受采访后他确实自首了。

source_text: John Clarke, the convicted rapist, was on the run from police after leaving his home while he was on home detention on Monday, and two probation officers were also present.
target_text: 周一，约翰·克拉克，这个被定罪的强奸犯，在被警方居家监禁期间离开家并逃离了警方控制，两名缓刑官当时也在现场。

source_text: One News, owned by TVNZ, were interviewing John Clarke yesterday, meanwhile a lot of time and effort from police was going into trying to hunt him down.
target_text: 由TVNZ的《头条新闻》节目昨天采访了约翰·克拉克，与此同时警方正在花费大量时间和努力来尝试找到他。

source_text: After they have finished the interview, Mr Clarke handed himself in to the Greymouth police, which One News also recorded.
target_text: 在采访完成后，克拉克向格雷默斯警方自首，《头条新闻》也记录了这一情况。

source_text: "He wandered in off the street with a TV film crew," said Greymouth Sergeant David Cross.
target_text: 格雷默斯警长大卫·克罗斯说：“他和一个电视摄制组一起在街上徘徊。”

source_text: A spokeswoman for TVNZ, Megan Williams said that they would only agree to the interview with Mr Clarke if he handed himself into police after they had finished.
target_text: TVNZ的发言人梅根·威廉姆斯表示，他们同意采访的条件是克拉克必须在结束采访后向警方自首。

source_text: She said that if he had not handed himself in, they would then have gone to the police.
target_text: 她说，如果他没有自首，那他们就会通告警方。

source_text: The police say that they would have expected TVNZ to have called them "...to say 'look Gary, perhaps if you pull back some of your resources at 5 o'clock, this guy's going to give himself up'," said Sergeant Cross.
target_text: 警方表示，他们本希望TVNZ能够联系警方“……说‘看，加里，或许你应该在5点时撤回一些资源的，这家伙会自首的’。”克罗斯警长说到。

source_text: Sergeant Alison Eleam, Christchurch's central area commander, says that she is not impressed with the way TVNZ acted.
target_text: 基督城的中区指挥官艾莉森·埃勒姆中士说，她对TVNZ的所作所为并不印象深刻。

source_text: TVNZ say that they are now happy to talk to the police.
target_text: TVNZ说他们现在很高兴与警方交谈。

source_text: Ben Marlin, bassist for American brutal death metal band Disgorge, died Wednesday after a lengthy battle with cancer.
target_text: 美国残忍死亡金属乐队Disgorge的贝斯手本·马林，在与癌症长期斗争后于周三去世。

source_text: San Diego-based Disgorge announced his death in the following statement:
target_text: 位于圣地亚哥的乐队在以下声明中宣布了他的死亡：。

source_text: "We are regretful to say that after nearly a year and a half of battling cancer, our brother and bass player Ben Marlin has passed away just about the stroke of 5 a.m. this January 2nd, 2008."
target_text: “我们很遗憾地说，在与癌症斗争了近一年半之后，我们的兄弟兼贝司手本·马林于2008年1月2日凌晨5点左右去世了。”

source_text: "Ben, thank you for all your years of friendship and brutality."
target_text: “本，谢谢你多年的友谊和残暴。”

source_text: Upon hearing of Marlin's death Ruud Lemmen of Neurotic Records released the following statement:
target_text: 在听到马林的死后，神经质唱片公司的创始人鲁德·勒曼发布了以下声明：。

source_text: "It is with great regret that I've just learned about Ben losing his battle with cancer."
target_text: “很遗憾，我刚刚得知本与癌症的斗争失败。”

source_text: "Ben was a great friend, and the time he spent in Europe with Disgorge (especially the nights off at my own home) have been nothing but great."
target_text: “本是一个很好的朋友，他在欧洲与Disgorge一起度过的时光（特别是在我家里度过的夜晚）一直都很棒。”

source_text: "Ben was a good guy, a funny fellow and I will never forget him."
target_text: “本是一个好人，一个有趣的家伙，我永远不会忘记他。”

source_text: "For one, I can't even imagine how thrilled I was when he took off his own personal, extremely limited Cranial Impalement (early band demo) long-sleeve and threw it my way, saying, 'Hey bro, it's yours.'"
target_text: “首先，我甚至无法想象，当他脱下属于他自己的，限定版的头颅刺穿（早期乐队演示）长袖衫，把它扔给我，并说，‘嘿，兄弟，这是你的’的时候，我是多么的激动。”

source_text: "This is just one of many perfect examples that showed what kind of humble person Ben was."
target_text: “这只是许多完美的例子中的一个，展示了本是什么样的谦逊的人。”

source_text: London, England— Australia lost Sunday night to Canada 50–57 in the women's wheelchair basketball at the Olympic Park in London.
target_text: 英国伦敦，周日晚上，澳大利亚在伦敦奥林匹克公园女子轮椅篮球赛中以50比57输给加拿大。

source_text: Poor shooting doomed the Australian Gliders' hopes of a third victory in a row at the Basketball Arena; they only managed to make only 23 out of 68 shots at the basket, a miserable 34%.
target_text: 糟糕的投篮让澳大利亚滑翔机队在篮球场上连续第三次取得胜利的希望化为泡影；他们在68次投篮中只有23次成功，进球率只有可怜的34%。

source_text: The Gliders were down by eight points at quarter time; but, fought their way back into the game, tying at 40-all at one point in the third quarter.
target_text: 滑翔机队在第一节结束时落后8分；尽管如此，他们还是在第三节中获得了40分。

source_text: Both Amber Merritt and Cobi Crispin ran up large numbers of personal fouls: four for Meritt and five for Crispin, hampering Australia's game style.
target_text: 安伯·梅里特和科比·克里斯平都有大量的犯规：梅里特四次，克里斯平五次，这妨碍了澳大利亚队的发挥。

source_text: Nonetheless, the pair still contributed to the team's scoreline, with Crispin scoring 12 points with 15 rebounds, and Merritt scoring 16 points with six rebounds.
target_text: 尽管如此，两人仍然为球队的得分做出了贡献，克里斯平得到12分，15个篮板，梅里特得到16分，6个篮板。

source_text: Shelley Chaplin scored eight points with five rebounds and seven assists.
target_text: 雪莱·卓别林得到8分，5个篮板和7次助攻。

source_text: The other players in the Gliders Sarah Vinci, Bridie Kean, Amanda Carter, Tina McKenzie, Leanne del Toso, Clare Nott, Kylie Gauci, Sarah Stewart and Katie Hill.
target_text: 滑翔机的其他选手是莎拉·文西、布里迪·基恩、阿曼达·卡特、蒂娜·麦肯齐、莱恩·德尔托索、克莱尔·诺特、凯莉·高奇、莎拉·斯图尔特和凯蒂·希尔。

source_text: This was the Australian's third game in the Group A round-robin.
target_text: 这是澳大利亚队在A组循环赛中的第三场比赛。

source_text: The five teams in each of two groups play each other once.
target_text: 两组中的五支队伍进行循环赛。

source_text: The top four teams in each group then go on into the quarter-finals.
target_text: 然后每组的前四支球队进入四分之一决赛。

source_text: With the win all 32 teams have qualified for the 2010 games.
target_text: 随着这场胜利，2010世界杯决赛圈的全部32只队伍已选拔完毕。

source_text: Sebastian Abreu scored for Uruguay first when he headed in a goal.
target_text: 塞巴斯蒂安·阿布鲁为乌拉圭队首开纪录，他头球破门。

source_text: Walter Centeno scored for Costa Rica but a draw failed to seal a win for Costa Rica and lost the game and the chance to qualify for the 2010 World Cup.
target_text: 沃尔特·森特诺为哥斯达黎加打进一球，但平局未能为哥斯达黎加赢得一场胜利，不仅没能赢得比赛，还失去了出线资格。

source_text: The game continued despite it being stopped after five minutes media started scuffling with the Costa Rica substitutes.
target_text: 尽管5分钟后媒体开始与哥斯达黎加的替补球员发生冲突，比赛仍在继续。

source_text: With Uruguay's qualification they join other South American teams Brazil, Argentina, Paraguay and Chile.
target_text: 随着乌拉圭队出线，他们将会和其他南美球队一同征战世界杯，其中包括巴西队，阿根廷队，巴拉圭队和智利队。

source_text: Two-time former winners Uruguay missed the 2006 World Cup after losing in a qualifier to Australia, who have also qualified for next year's tournament.
target_text: 两届世界杯夺主乌拉圭队在预选赛上败给了澳大利亚队，痛失2006年世界杯出线资格，而澳大利亚队则顺利出线征战次年的世界杯比赛。

source_text: Next year's World Cup will see the return of several teams to the tournament.
target_text: 明年的世界杯将会让几支球队重返赛场。

source_text: The host South Africa are making their first appearance since 2002 along with Denmark, Nigeria, Cameroon and Slovenia.
target_text: 东道主南非与丹麦、尼日利亚、喀麦隆和斯洛文尼亚自2002年以来首次亮相。

source_text: Chile last appeared in 1998, Greece in 1994 and Algeria in 1986.
target_text: 智利最后一次出线在1998年，希腊是1994年，阿尔及利亚则是1986年。

source_text: New Zealand and Honduras have also qualified, their last appearance was in 1982 and North Korea have not competed in the World Cup since 1966.
target_text: 新西兰和洪都拉斯也都获得了世界杯参赛资格，他们最后一次出场是在1982年，朝鲜自1966年以来没有参加过世界杯。

source_text: Serbia has previously qualified as Yugoslavia and Serbia and Montenegro, while Slovakia previously played as Czechoslovakia.
target_text: 塞尔维亚以前是南斯拉夫、塞尔维亚和黑山的身份获得过参赛资格，斯洛伐克上次进入世界杯时还是叫捷克斯洛伐克。

source_text: The tournament is due to start in South Africa on the June 11, 2010 and last for one month.
target_text: 比赛将于2010年6月11日在南非开始，持续一个月。

source_text: A camera set up in the jungles of Malaysian Borneo in Sabah by the World Wide Fund for Nature or WWF, has captured, for the first time, a Borneo Rhino on videotape.
target_text: 世界自然基金会在马来西亚沙巴州婆罗洲的丛林中架设了一台摄像机，首次将婆罗洲犀牛的照片拍摄下来。

source_text: "This astonishing footage captures one of the world's most elusive creatures."
target_text: “这段惊人的视频捕捉到了世界上最神秘的生物之一。”

source_text: "Tremendous progress has been made in recent years to secure the rhino's habitat but so much more needs to be done considering this species may very well disappear in the next 10 years," said President and CEO of the World Wildlife Fund in a press release, Carter Roberts.
target_text: 世界野生动物基金会主席兼首席执行官卡特·罗伯茨在一份新闻稿中说：“近年来在保护犀牛栖息地方面取得了巨大进展，但考虑到这个物种很可能在未来10年内消失，我们还有很多工作要做。”

source_text: "In the video, the rhino comes out of the jungle brush and then proceeds to sniff the camera and equipment surrounding it."
target_text: “在视频中，犀牛从丛林灌木丛中出来，然后继续嗅相机和周围的设备。”

source_text: "The video also shows the rhino getting a bite to eat."
target_text: “视频还显示犀牛随便吃了点东西。”

source_text: It is estimated that there are only 25 to 50 of the rhinos alive on the planet, and they can only be found in the jungles of Sabah, or better known as the "Heart of Borneo."
target_text: 据估计，目前地球上仅存25至50头犀牛，而且它们只能在沙巴的丛林中或更为人所知的“婆罗洲心脏”的丛林中找到。

source_text: Researchers say that poaching to use the rhino's horn in medicine and encroachment into their habitats are causing them to decline.
target_text: 研究人员表示，用犀牛角来制药业的偷猎行为以及对犀牛栖息地的侵犯正在导致犀牛数量下降。

source_text: Researchers also say that because the rhino is so isolated from the rest of Malaysia, that they are rarely able to breed together.
target_text: 研究人员还说，由于犀牛与马来西亚其他地区隔离，因此它们很少能够共同繁殖。

source_text: "The rhino is very sensitive to the presence of human beings."
target_text: “犀牛对人类的存在非常敏感。”

source_text: Just hours after firing two contract employees and disciplining a third for inappropriately examining the passport file of Democratic presidential candidate Sen. Barack Obama, US Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice told Sen. Hillary Clinton that her passport file was also breached in 2007.
target_text: 美国国务卿康多莉扎·赖斯在解雇两名合同工并因审查民主党总统候选人奥巴马的护照文件不当而惩罚第三人几小时后，对希拉里·克林顿表示，她的护照文件在2007年也遭到了破坏。

source_text: Sen. John McCain, the Republican candidate for president, also had his file breached — this time by one of the same individuals who had examined Obama's records.
target_text: 共和党总统候选人约翰·麦凯恩的档案也遭到了破坏，这次是同一个人检查了奥巴马的档案。

source_text: Both Clinton and McCain were informed that their files were improperly accessed, according to their Senate offices, after Rice called to apologize to Barack Obama for the incident hours before.
target_text: 据他们的参议院办公室说，克林顿和麦凯恩都被告知，他们的文件被不当访问。几个小时前，赖斯打电话向奥巴马就此事道歉。

source_text: "I told him I was sorry and I told him that I myself would be very disturbed if anyone had looked at my passport file and that, therefore, I will stay on top of this," Rice said.
target_text: 赖斯说：“我对他说，我很抱歉。我告诉他，如果有人看了我的护照档案，我本人也会感到非常不安。因此，我将继续处理这件事。”

source_text: "We are going to do an investigation through the inspector general."
target_text: “我们将通过总检察长进行调查。”

source_text: "None of us want us to have a situation where any American's passport file is accessed in an unauthorized way."
target_text: “我们都不希望任何美国人的护照文件在未经授权的情况下被查看。”

source_text: According to Assistant Secretary of State, Sean McCormack, at least one breach occurred during a training session, with a contract employee brought in to deal with a large backlog of passport applications.
target_text: 根据助理国务卿肖恩·麦科马克的说法，至少有一起违反规定的事件发生在一次培训期间，一名合同工带进来需要处理的大量被积压的护照申请。

source_text: "We do feel that the system worked, but the system isn't perfect," McCormack said.
target_text: 麦科马克说：“我们确实感到这个系统发挥了作用，但是这个系统并不完美。”

source_text: Obama's response to the incident was "One of the things that the American people count on in their interactions with any level of government is that if they have to disclose personal information, then it is going to stay personal and stay private."
target_text: 奥巴马对这一事件的回应是，“美国人民在与各级政府的交往中所依赖的一件事是，如果他们必须披露个人信息，那么这些信息将保持隐私。”

source_text: He also told reporters he expects a full and thorough congressional investigation.
target_text: 他还对记者说，他期待国会进行全面彻底的调查。

source_text: McCain, who was in France after recently traveling to Iraq responded to the incident stating, "The United States of America values everyone's privacy and corrective action should be taken."
target_text: 麦凯恩最近访问了伊拉克，目前正在法国。他对这一事件作出回应说：“美国重视每个人的隐私，应该采取纠正措施。”

source_text: In testimony given before a U.S. military hearing, criminal investigator Benjamin Bierce narrated his account of how an incident involving five soldiers involved the serial rape of a 14-year-old Iraqi girl prior to shooting her.
target_text: 刑事调查员本杰明·比尔斯在美国军方听证会上作证，讲述了一起涉及五名士兵的事件，其中一名14岁的伊拉克女孩在遭到连续强奸后被开枪打死。

source_text: The hearing will determine whether four current U.S. soldiers have to face a court martial hearing; an additional former soldier allegedly involved in the incident, Steven D. Green, was recently discharged from the military and has pleaded not guilty to rape and murder charges in federal court in Kentucky.
target_text: 听证会将决定四名现任美国军人是否必须接受军事法庭的审讯，另一名据称卷入该事件的前士兵史蒂文·D·格林最近被退伍，他在肯塔基州联邦法院对强奸和谋杀指控拒不认罪。

source_text: According to Bierce, a U.S. Special Agent investigating the incident, the brutal attack which saw Abeer Qassim al-Janabi slain and her parents and younger sister murdered was premeditated.
target_text: 调查这起事件的美国特工比尔斯说，目睹阿比尔·卡西姆·贾纳比被杀、她的父母和妹妹被杀的残酷袭击是有预谋的。

source_text: Citing a sworn statement from Army Specialist James Barker, the five accused were said to have plotted the rape whilst drinking whisky and playing cards.
target_text: 据称，五名被告在喝威士忌和打牌时密谋强奸，并引用了陆军专家詹姆斯·巴克的一份宣誓声明。

source_text: According to Agent Bierce, Spc. Barker said that Pte. Spielman grabbed the girl while Pte. Green seized her father and they then took them into the house and Sgt. Cortez and Spc. Barker followed them inside.
target_text: 据特工比尔斯说，专业军士巴克说，二等兵斯皮尔曼抓住了女孩，而二等兵格林抓住了她的父亲，然后他们把他们带进了房子，中士科尔特斯和专业军士巴克跟着他们进去。

source_text: Pte. Green supposedly led the father, mother and younger sister into the bedroom and closed the door, while the teenage girl remained in the living room with the other Americans, Spc. Barker's statement said.
target_text: 专业军士巴克在声明中说，据推测二等兵格林带着父亲、母亲和妹妹进入卧室并关上房门，而这个十几岁的女孩则和其他美国人呆在起居室里。

source_text: Cortez then allegedly pushed the girl to the floor, pulled up her dress and tore off her underwear while she was struggling, Bierce said, again citing Spc. Barker's statement.
target_text: 比尔斯再次引用巴克的声明说，据称科尔特斯当时把女孩推倒在地，拉起衣服，在挣扎中脱下内衣。

source_text: Cortez appeared to then rape Abeer and afterward, Spc. Barker tried to rape the girl, the statement said.
target_text: 声明说，科尔特斯当时似乎强奸了阿比尔，后来，巴克试图强奸这个女孩。

source_text: Cortez held Abeer down while Pte. Green raped the girl; according to Spc. Barker's statement.
target_text: 根据专业军士巴克的声明，科尔特斯在二等兵格林强奸这名女孩的时候把阿比尔抓了下来。

source_text: Pte. Green then picked up the AK-47 and shot Abeer once, waited, and then shot her a few more times, the U.S. official, Agent Bierce, said, quoting from Spc. Barker's statement.
target_text: 美国官员比尔斯援引专业军士巴克的声明称，二等兵格林随后拿起AK-47，朝阿比尔开了一枪，等了一会儿，然后又朝她开了几枪。

source_text: Spc. Barker said that he then poured kerosene lamp fuel on the girl's body but Barker did not say who set it on fire.
target_text: 专业军士巴克说，然后他把煤油灯的燃料倒在女孩的身上，但巴克没有说是谁放火的。

source_text: Gary Griesmyer, another Special Agent, quoted Sgt. Cortez as telling him that the teenage girl was crying and talking in Arabic and that Spc. Barker told her to "shut up."
target_text: 另一位特别探员加里·格里斯迈尔引用科特斯中士的话说，那个十几岁的女孩在用阿拉伯语哭泣和说话，而专业军士巴克则告诉她“闭嘴”。

source_text: Private Justin Watt testified that Pte. Howard told him before the incident that Pte. Green, Sgt. Cortez and Spc. Barker were planning to rape a girl, and Pte. Howard was going to be the lookout.
target_text: 二等兵贾斯汀·瓦特作证说，霍华德在事发前告诉他二等兵格林、科特斯中士和专业军士巴克计划强奸一个女孩，二等兵霍华德将负责监视。

source_text: Watt testified that he heard Mr. Green say, "I want to kill and hurt a lot of Iraqis."
target_text: 瓦特作证说，他听到格林先生说：“我想杀死并伤害很多伊拉克人。”

source_text: Green has been discharged from the military and has pleaded not guilty in a federal court in Kentucky where he will stand trial; he will not be facing a court martial regardless of what occurrs in the Baghdad hearing.
target_text: 格林已经退伍，并在肯塔基州的联邦法庭上拒不认罪，他将在那里接受审判。无论巴格达听证会上发生什么，他都不会面临军事法庭的审判。

source_text: "If you have the power to make something right, you should do it."
target_text: “如果你有能力做出正确的事情，你应该这样做。”

source_text: "But if something went down -- something terrible like that -- then it's my obligation to come forward," Watt said.
target_text: “但如果事情发生了变化-那种可怕的事情-那么我有责任挺身而出，”瓦特说。

source_text: Watt also said life for some of the soldiers in the B Company, 1st Battalion, 502nd Infantry Regiment, was horrible while they were manning a military post in nearby Yusufiyah.
target_text: 瓦特还说，第502步兵团第1营B连的一些士兵在尤苏菲耶附近的一个军事哨所执勤时，他们的生活是可怕的。

source_text: Some lived in a "dilapidated, abandoned water treatment facility" he said.
target_text: 他说，有些人住在“破旧、废弃的水处理设施”里。

source_text: Pfc. Watt, who is identified as the whistle-blowing soldier who disclosed the attack during a counseling session, also said; "I feared for my safety at the TCP (traffic control point)."
target_text: 瓦特一等兵也说，他被认定是在一次心理咨询期间披露了这起袭击的举报者，“我担心自己在交通控制点的安全。”

source_text: Pfc. Justin Cross testified that deadly attacks by insurgents sapped morale and raised combat stress in the U.S. Army unit that included the soldiers accused of raping and murdering Abeer.
target_text: 贾斯汀·克罗斯作证说，反叛分子发动的致命袭击削弱了美军部队的士气，增加了战斗压力，其中包括被控强奸和谋杀阿比尔的士兵。

source_text: He said that the "mentally draining" living conditions of the combat unit was a factor.
target_text: 他说，战斗部队“精神枯竭”的生活条件是一个因素。

source_text: "You feel like every step you might get blown up."
target_text: “你觉得你的每一步都可能被炸飞。”

source_text: "You just hit a point where you're like, 'If I die today, I die.'"
target_text: “你会突然想到，‘如果我今天死了，我就死了。’”。

source_text: An article 32 hearing, like this, seeks to determine if a soldiers should face court martial.
target_text: 像这样的第32条听证会，旨在决定士兵是否应该面临军事法庭。

source_text: Its similar to that of a preliminary hearing or a grand jury proceeding in civilian law.
target_text: 它类似于民事法中的预审或大陪审团程序。

source_text: Two men were arrested today by the Ontario Provincial Police (OPP) at a Caledonia rally at about 12:00 p.m. ET after entering the disputed land in Caledonia, Ontario waving Canadian flags.
target_text: 安大略省警察局（OPP）今天中午东部时间12点左右在喀里多尼亚集会上逮捕了两名男子。这两个人进入安大略省喀里多尼亚有争议的土地后挥舞着加拿大国旗。

source_text: One was Gary McHale, a Richmond Hill, Ontario man who entered the occupied land in Caledonia, Ontario to organize a rally against the ongoing aboriginal occupation.
target_text: 其中一位是安大略省里士满山的加里·麦克海尔，他进入安大略省喀里多尼亚的被占领土，想聚集民众起来反对原住民对该地的占领。

source_text: Vandermaas was forced to the ground by police officers, who ripped the flag out of his hand when he crossed the police line.
target_text: 范得马阿斯被警官们逼倒在地面，当时他越过了警戒线，从手中把旗帜撕开了。

source_text: According to news reports, McHale intended to put the Canadian flag across the street from DCE (Douglas Creek Estates) where the aboriginal occupation has been ongoing for 10 months.
target_text: 据新闻报道，麦克海尔打算把加拿大国旗插在土著居民占领了10个月的DCE（道格拉斯溪庄园）对面。

source_text: Back in late October the aboriginals had already put up their flags across from the DCE property and the OPP made no attempt to stop them.
target_text: 早在10月底，土著居民就已经在DCE地产对面竖起了旗帜，OPP也没有试图阻止他们。

source_text: However, on Dec. 2 residents of Caledonia attempted to put up Canadian flags with Yellow ribbons in various areas in Caledonia.
target_text: 然而，12月2日，喀里多尼亚的居民试图在喀里多尼亚的各个地区用黄丝带挂上加拿大国旗。

source_text: When they tried to put up a Canadian Flag across from DCE property the OPP sent in 100 officers to stop them.
target_text: 当他们试图在DCE大楼对面竖起加拿大国旗时，OPP派遣了100名官员阻止他们。

source_text: Mr. McHale called for people to gather on Dec. 16 to try to put up Canadian Flags across from DCE property on the same hydro poles that Natives already had put up their flags.
target_text: 麦克海尔呼吁人们在12月16日聚集起来，在DCE大楼对面的电线杆上竖起加拿大国旗，而当地人已经在电线杆上竖起了他们的旗帜。

source_text: Mr. McHale stated, "I have asked 2 dozen OPP officers why it is legal to have a Native Flag up along the highway but illegal for a Canadian Flag to be up and I have never received an answer."
target_text: 麦克海尔先生说：“我问过24名OPP官员，为什么在高速公路上悬挂本地的旗帜是合法的，而悬挂加拿大国旗是非法的，但我从未得到过任何答复。”

source_text: "The OPP set up a line just about a hundred yards away from that site and several people were able to cross that line."
target_text: “OPP在距离该站点约一百码的地方拉起了一条警戒线，有几个人越过了那条线。”

source_text: "They got through a farmer's field on far left side of where I'm standing here," said CTV reporter Joel Bowey.
target_text: CTV记者乔尔·鲍伊说：“他们穿过了我站在这里最左边的一块农地。”

source_text: "We're hearing that Mr. McHale got in the middle of the street and put a flag down there, and that's when he and the other man from London, Ont. were arrested."
target_text: “我们听说麦克海尔先生走到街道中央并在那里放了一面旗帜，那时他和来自安大略省伦敦的另一名男子被捕了。”

source_text: "So far all we know is that those two men have been arrested and there are no other arrests at this point."
target_text: “到目前为止，我们所知道的是，这两名男子已经被捕，此时没有其他人被捕。”

source_text: "I've now said that Mr. McHale's plans were counterproductive and potentially dangerous to what we've been trying to do there, and that is to reach a peaceful settlement," said David Ramsay, Ontario's minister of aboriginal affairs.
target_text: 安大略省土著事务部长大卫·拉姆齐说：“我现在说，麦克海尔先生的计划适得其反，对我们在那里所做的努力有潜在的危险，那就是要达成和平解决方案。”

source_text: "I've twice now offered Mr. McHale the opportunity to protest at Queen's Park [the site of the Legislative Assembly of Ontario building]."
target_text: “我曾经两次让麦克海尔先生有机会在女王公园【安大略省立法大会所在地】抗议。”

source_text: "In fact, I said I would sponsor his rally and set up a platform and a microphone, a PA system for him."
target_text: “事实上，我说过我会赞助他的集会，为他搭建一个平台和一个麦克风，一个扩音器系统。”

source_text: Mayor Marie Trainer of Haldimand County, were Caledonia is located, said: "The next meeting or two will be wasted on frivolous stuff again instead of getting down to business."
target_text: 哈尔迪蒙德郡市长玛丽·特雷纳说：“接下来的一两场会议将会被浪费在一些无关紧要的事情上，而不是真正地谈正事。”

source_text: Trainer also says that he should not be entering the town and did not specify what side she is on or if she is not taking any side.
target_text: 特雷纳还说，他不应该进入这个城镇，也没有具体说明她站在哪一边，或者她是否不站在哪一边。

source_text: This was not the first time Gary McHale entered the disputed land.
target_text: 这不是加里·麦克海尔第一次进入这片有争议的土地。

source_text: On October 15, 2006, McHale with approximately 2000 (as reported by local newspapers) participants rallied in Caledonia, but the OPP blocked the entrance to the occupied site.
target_text: 2006年10月15日，麦克海尔和大约2000名（当地报纸报道）参加者在喀里多尼亚集会，但OPP封锁了被占领地区的入口。

source_text: "Our fight is not with the natives, we're just trying to be equal in a democratic Canada," said Christine McHale, wife of Gary McHale.
target_text: 加里·麦克海尔的妻子克里斯汀·麦克海尔说：“我们不是在和土著居民斗争，我们只是想在一个民主的加拿大实现平等。”

source_text: "When a native commits a serious crime or any crime, they stand by and watch the crime take place and will not do anything to stop the crime."
target_text: “当一个当地人犯下严重罪行或任何罪行时，他们会袖手旁观并观察犯罪行为，并且不会做任何事情来制止犯罪。”

source_text: "When a resident does the simplest thing, even putting up a Canadian flag or drinking a coffee in a lawn chair across some magic line, they will send in scores of officers to arrest the person," said Gary McHale.
target_text: 加里·麦克海尔说：“当一名居民做了最简单的事情，甚至是挂起加拿大国旗，或者在草坪上的椅子上喝咖啡，跨过一条神奇的线，他们就会派出几十名警察来逮捕这个人。”

source_text: "We have to take a stand and say to police forces that there is one set of laws for all citizens."
target_text: “我们必须采取立场，并向警察部队说，所有公民都有一套法律。”

source_text: "Police have one set of policies for natives and another set of policies for non-natives," he said before the rally.
target_text: “警方对土着人有一套政策，对非本地人有另一套政策，”他在集会前说。

source_text: "It's against our Charter of Rights, that clearly says there's not to be any discriminations based on their religion, beliefs, race or their skin colour."
target_text: “这违反了我们的权利宪章，它明确表示不存在任何基于宗教，信仰，种族或肤色的歧视。”

source_text: McHale has been long critical of the Ontario Provincial Police over the land claim saying that they treat aboriginals differently.
target_text: 麦克海尔长期以来一直批评安大略省警方对这片土地的主张，称他们对待原住民的方式不同。

source_text: McHale and his wife operate a website called Caledonia Wake Up Call.com, were they detail what they describe as police bias.
target_text: 麦克海尔和他的妻子经营着一个名为Caledonia Wake Up Call.com的网站，他们详细描述了警方的偏见。

source_text: France have defeated New Zealand 18-20 in the quarter-final of the 2007 Rugby World Cup at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff, Wales.
target_text: 法国队在威尔士卡迪夫千禧体育场举行的2007年橄榄球世界杯四分之一决赛中以18-20战胜新西兰队。

source_text: New Zealand led 13-3 at half time, after Dan Carter kicked two penalties and Luke McAlister scored a try.
target_text: 上半场，新西兰以13-3领先，在此之前，丹·卡特踢进两粒点球，卢克·麦卡利斯特射门得分。

source_text: France missed chances to score with Lionel Beauxis and Jean-Baptiste Élissalde both missing penalties and Damien Traille missing a drop goal attempt.
target_text: 法国队错失了进球的机会，莱昂内尔·博克西斯和让-巴蒂斯特·埃里萨尔德都错失了点球，达米安·特雷尔也错失了一次射门机会。

source_text: Lionel Beauxis scored France's first points with a penalty just before half time.
target_text: 中场休息前，莱昂内尔·博克西斯以点球为法国队首开纪录。

source_text: However, New Zealand centre Luke McAlister was harshly sin-binned early in the second half for illegally blocking a French player and preventing a try scoring opportunity.
target_text: 然而，新西兰中锋卢克·麦卡利斯特在下半场早些时候因为非法拦截一名法国球员和阻止一次试射得分的机会而被罚下场。

source_text: France took advantage of having the extra man, and levelled to 13-13 by the time the 10 minute suspension had elapsed with Lionel Beauxis adding a penalty and Thierry Dusautoir scoring a try.
target_text: 法国队利用了多一名球员的优势，在对方被禁赛的10分钟结束时将比分追平至13-13，莱昂内尔·博克西斯罚进一粒点球，蒂埃里·达索特尔射门得分。

source_text: Luke McAlister missed a last minute drop goal attempt as France held on to win.
target_text: 卢克·麦卡利斯特在最后一分钟错失了一个得分机会，法国队保住了胜利。

source_text: Some New Zealand fans blamed the loss on English referee Wayne Barnes due to alleged bias towards the French team.
target_text: 一些新西兰球迷将这场失利归咎于英国裁判韦恩·巴恩斯偏向法国队。

source_text: Controversial decisions included Luke McAlister's sin binning and an apparent forward pass that led to France's second try, allowing them to take the lead.
target_text: 有争议的判罚包括卢克·麦卡利斯特的犯规，以及一次明显的前锋传球，导致法国队获得第二次尝试进攻，并让法国队取得领先。

source_text: However, most neutrals also noted an apparent forward pass in the build up to an earlier New Zealand try and consider Barnes to have done a reasonable job in such a high profile game.
target_text: 然而，大多数中立者也注意到在新西兰之前的比赛中有一个明显的向前传球，他们认为巴恩斯在这样一场高调的比赛中做得很好。

source_text: France advance to the semi-final stage of the tournament and will play England, who defeated Australia 12-10 earlier today, in a repeat of the 2003 semi-final.
target_text: 法国队晋级半决赛，将与今天早些时候以12比10击败澳大利亚队的英格兰队比赛，这是2003年半决赛的重演。

source_text: Raymond Lee Oyler of California, United States has been convicted of the murders of five US Forest Service firefighters killed while attempting to control a wildfire he had lit.
target_text: 美国加利福尼亚州的雷蒙德·李·奥勒被判谋杀5名美国林务局消防员，这些消防员在试图控制他点燃的大火时被杀。

source_text: Oyler, 38, set the Esperanza Fire out of anger his dog had been impounded, according to prosecutors.
target_text: 检察官称，38岁的奥勒因愤怒他的狗被扣押而放火烧了埃斯佩朗萨。

source_text: The October 2006 blaze destroyed 34 houses and 20 outbuildings, scorching over 17,400 hectares.
target_text: 2006年10月的大火摧毁了34座房屋和20座外围建筑，烧毁面积超过1.74万公顷。

source_text: Prosecutors also alleged Oyler started the fire at night specifically to leave firefighters "on their own" without aerial support.
target_text: 检察官还指称，奥勒在夜间纵火，是为了让消防队员在没有空中支援的情况下“独自行动”。

source_text: He was identified as the arsonist behind the fire after a security camera saw his car several times and samples taken from the scene matched those found in his girlfriend's house.
target_text: 在安全摄像头多次看到他的车，并从现场采集的样本与在女友家中发现的样本相符之后，他被确认为火灾背后的纵火犯。

source_text: Oyler, an unemployed car mechanic, was also identified by the owner of a local petrol station as having stood in a car park and watched the fire's spread.
target_text: 奥勒是一名失业的汽车机械师，当地一家加油站的老板也指认他曾站在一个停车场里，看着火势蔓延。

source_text: The five firefighters that were killed died when their truck was overrun by the flames.
target_text: 五名消防员在他们的卡车被大火吞噬时丧生。

source_text: Oyler was convicted of murdering them on Friday March 6 after a six-week trial in Riverside California.
target_text: 奥勒于3月6日星期五在加州河滨市经过六周的审讯后被判谋杀他们。

source_text: The twelve-member jury took nearly a week of deliberation before returning the guilty verdict, and will meet to hear arguments regarding Oyler's sentence on Tuesday.
target_text: 由12名成员组成的陪审团经过将近一周的审议后，才作出有罪判决。星期二，他们将开会听取有关奥伊勒的判决的辩论。

source_text: His defense had admitted Oyler likely started several fires in the Riverside County area, but denied he had started the one that killed the firefighters.
target_text: 他的辩护律师承认，奥勒可能在河滨县地区引发了几起火灾，但否认是他引发了导致消防员死亡的火灾。

source_text: California-based Autodesk Inc. announced yesterday that they plan to acquire Toronto-based Alias for $182 million in cash.
target_text: 总部位于加州的欧特克公司昨天宣布，他们计划以1.82亿美元现金收购总部位于多伦多的阿利亚斯公司。

source_text: The acquisition is expected to be completed within six months.
target_text: 此次收购预计将在六个月内完成。

source_text: "Alias' technology spans several of our most important markets and augments the synergy between our design and media business," said Carl Bass, COO of Autodesk.
target_text: 欧特克首席运营官卡尔·巴斯表示：“阿利亚斯的技术跨越了我们几个最重要的市场，增强了我们的设计和媒体业务之间的协同作用。”

source_text: Autodesk is the creator of one of the top computer aided design programs; AutoCAD, which is used by many engineers and architects for design activities including drafting.
target_text: 欧特克是顶级计算机辅助设计程序之一的创造者；AutoCAD被许多工程师和建筑师用于设计活动，包括绘图。

source_text: They were founded in 1983 under the name Alias Research.
target_text: 它们成立于1983年，名为阿利亚斯研究。

source_text: They merged with Wavefront Technologies under SGI in 1995 and changed its name to Alias in July 2003.
target_text: 1995年，他们与SGI旗下的波前技术公司合并，并于2003年7月更名为阿利亚斯。

source_text: In the 2005 fiscal year they earned $83 million in revenue.
target_text: 在2005财年，他们的收入为8300万美元。

source_text: Alias customers include DreamWorks SKG, Pixar, Nintendo, Industrial Light & Magic, General Motors, and BMW.
target_text: 阿利亚斯的客户包括梦工厂SKG，皮克斯，任天堂，工业光魔，通用汽车和宝马。

source_text: According to Alias, their software has been used in nearly every film nominated for an Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences award in the Best Visual Effects and Best Animated Feature Films categories.
target_text: 根据阿利亚斯的说法，他们的软件几乎应用于每一部获得美国电影艺术与科学学院最佳视觉效果和最佳动画长片提名的电影。

source_text: 25 New Zealand police officers have left today, July 11, for three months in East Timor.
target_text: 25名新西兰警察于今天7月11日离开了待了3个月的东帝汶。

source_text: The police force will assist the 160 New Zealand Defence Force armed personnel that are already in East Timor as well as other country's personnel.
target_text: 警察部队将协助已经在东帝汶的160名新西兰国防军武装人员以及其他国家的人员。

source_text: Grant O'Fee, contingent commander, said "attempts will be made to establish good relations with village chiefs."
target_text: 特遣队指挥官格兰特·奥菲说：“将努力与村长建立良好关系。”

source_text: The police teams will try to prosecute those who are responsible for arson and assault following the recent violence in East Timor.
target_text: 在最近的东帝汶暴力事件发生后，警方将试图起诉那些对纵火和袭击事件负责的人。

source_text: The recent two weeks of violence has died down since the former Prime Minister (PM) of East Timor resigned giving his post to the former foreign and defence minister, Jose Ramos Horta.
target_text: 自从东帝汶前总理辞职，将其职位交给前外交和国防部长何塞·拉莫斯·奥尔塔以来，最近两周的暴力已经平息。

source_text: This appointment has been congratulated by the United Nations (UN) Secretary General, Kofi Annan.
target_text: 这一任命得到了联合国秘书长科菲·安南的祝贺。

source_text: Horta said the main priority for his government will be "restoring security and moving 150,000 people in refugee camps back home."
target_text: 奥尔塔表示，他的政府的主要优先事项是“恢复安全并将难民营中的15万人送回家。”

source_text: The Canadian House of Commons will re-open the debate on same-sex marriage next Wednesday, December 6th, when it debates a resolution to reconsider the Civil Marriage Act that was passed by the previous Liberal-led parliament in 2005.
target_text: 加拿大下议院将于12月6日星期三重新开启关于同性婚姻的辩论，届时将讨论重新考虑2005年前自由党领导的议会通过的“民事婚姻法”的决议。

source_text: In the intervening election, the victorious Conservatives promised that if they were elected parliament would hold a free vote on whether to amend or repeal the Act.
target_text: 在干预选举中，胜利的保守党承诺，如果他们当选，议会将就是否修改或废除该法案进行自由投票。

source_text: Several surveys have suggested that MPs in the minority parliament will overwhelmingly reaffirm support for same-sex marriage once a vote has held.
target_text: 几项调查显示，一旦举行投票，少数派议会的议员们将以压倒性优势重申对同性婚姻的支持。

source_text: The pro-same sex marriage group Canadians for Equal Marriage estimates that the motion will be defeated by at least 35 votes.
target_text: 支持同性婚姻的加拿大人争取平等婚姻组织估计，该动议将被至少35票否决。

source_text: This has prompted supporters of same-sex marriage to urge that a vote be held as soon as possible while opponents of gay marriage have been urging the government to delay the vote until the next election, expected early in 2007, in hopes of the election of a Conservative majority that would repeal the act.
target_text: 这促使同性婚姻的支持者敦促尽快举行投票，而同性婚姻的反对者则敦促政府将投票推迟到2007年初预期的下一次选举，希望通过保守党多数派的选举来废除该法案。

source_text: A number of Conservative MPs and strategists have supported an early vote, however, in the belief that the same-sex issue would hurt the Tories in an election campaign by emphasizing a social conservative agenda that is unpopular in urban areas and Quebec.
target_text: 然而，一些保守党议员和战略家支持提前投票，他们认为同性问题会在竞选中损害保守党的利益，因为它强调了一项在城市地区和魁北克不受欢迎的社会保守派议程。

source_text: Andrew Burris, from Curtis, Ohio, and member of Carpenters Local 1138, died in Toledo, Ohio when the construction platform he was on fell around 9:15 a.m. EST.
target_text: 来自俄亥俄州柯蒂斯的安德鲁·伯里斯是本地木工1138会员，他所在的施工平台在东部时间上午9点15分左右倒塌，然后伯里斯在俄亥俄州托莱多去世。

source_text: The platform was attached to the northbound side of the Veterans' Glass City Skyway, a new bridge on Interstate 280.
target_text: 该平台连接在退伍军人玻璃城高架路的北侧，这是280号州际公路上的一座新桥。

source_text: The platform was clamped to the side of the bridge, and broke off.
target_text: 平台被卡在桥边，断了。

source_text: Burris fell about 95 feet to the ground, where he landed on the east side of the roadway.
target_text: 伯里斯从95英尺高的地方掉到地上，落在了公路的东侧。

source_text: Authorities from the Occupational Safety and Health Administration do not know why the platform broke free from the bridge.
target_text: 职业安全与健康管理局的有关部门不知道为什么平台从桥上脱落。

source_text: The Toledo Police department does not suspect foul play, and considers the death to be accidental.
target_text: 托莱多警察局没有怀疑这是一起谋杀，认为这是一起意外死亡事件。

source_text: The $220 million bridge is scheduled for opening in June, 2007, and is the largest construction project in the history of Ohio.
target_text: 这座耗资2.2亿美元的桥梁计划于2007年6月开放，是俄亥俄州历史上最大的建筑项目。

source_text: "On behalf of Director Beasley and the Ohio Department of Transportation, we extend our deepest sympathy to the family of Andrew Burris," said ODOT District 2 director, Dave Dysard.
target_text: “我们代表比斯利局长和俄亥俄州交通部向安德鲁·伯里斯的家人致以最深切的慰问，”奥多第2区主任戴夫·迪拉德说。

source_text: "We also extend our condolences to his relatives, friends and his fellow workers who have made us proud through their commitment and dedication to their work."
target_text: “我们也向他的亲人、朋友和同事表示哀悼，他们对工作的投入和奉献让我们感到自豪。”

source_text: "Andrew was a part of the team that took the pylon to the top back in 2005."
target_text: “早在2005年，安德鲁就是将电缆塔安装到顶部的团队一员。”

source_text: "For four-and-a-half years, he was an integral part of the team that worked to complete this vital link for our community."
target_text: “在四年半的时间里，他是为我们的社区完成这一重要环节的团队不可或缺的一员。”

source_text: On Presidents' Day in 2004, five workers were killed and four were injured when a crane collapsed.
target_text: 在2004年的总统日，起重机倒塌时，有5名工人死亡，4人受伤。

source_text: Mr. Burris was from a line of carpenters, and kept a scrapbook of the project.
target_text: 伯里斯是木匠出身，他保存着这个项目的剪贴簿。

source_text: His mother, Ruth, was quoted as saying "I think he felt closer to heaven there."
target_text: 引用他的母亲露丝的话说：“我觉得他在那里感觉离天堂更近了。”

source_text: The British Parliament approved the first stage of the new Crossrail underground railroad through London as a £15 billion construction project earlier this month.
target_text: 本月早些时候，英国议会批准了一项耗资150亿英镑、贯穿伦敦的新横贯铁路的第一阶段建设项目。

source_text: Crossrail is the first major new train line to be built in London in decades.
target_text: 横贯铁路是伦敦几十年来修建的第一条主要的新铁路线。

source_text: The rail line being implemented as a hybrid bill in Parliament.
target_text: 这条铁路线在议会中作为一项混合法案实施。

source_text: After a second reading in Parliament, it was voted upon and decided that the government will commit to the project so that the line will be built.
target_text: 经过议会的二读，它被投票表决，并决定政府将致力于该项目，以便该线路将建成。

source_text: The next issue before Parliament of to ensure that the implementation of the bill so it is consistent with private interests of neighborhoods to be affected by Crossrail.
target_text: 下一个问题是在议会面前确保法案的实施，使其与受横贯铁路影响的社区的私人利益相一致。

source_text: This is when residents can petition Parliament to change the way the line is constructed.
target_text: 这时居民可以请求议会改变线路的建设方式。

source_text: As a result of construction of the Crossrail line, hundreds of homes will have new tunnels excavated beneath them.
target_text: 由于修建横贯铁路，将在数百户家庭其下方挖掘新的隧道。

source_text: On contacting Crossrail, they have indicated approximately £50 will be offered to each landowner to buy all the land rights-of-way to build the train tunnel more than 9 meters below the residential buildings.
target_text: 在与横贯铁路联系后，他们表示，将向每位土地所有者提供大约50英镑，以购买修建在住宅建筑下方9米以上火车隧道的所有土地使用权。

source_text: The average value for properties in the affected areas is £350,000.
target_text: 受影响地区的物业平均价值为350,000英镑。

source_text: Under UK compulsory purchase laws to be used in this bill, the residents are entitled to the difference in the value of the whole property with and without a tunnel under it.
target_text: 根据英国将在该法案中使用的强制购买法，居民有权获得其下有隧道或无隧道的全部财产的价值差额。

source_text: If the offer given by Crossrail is not accepted by any of the residents, the residents can take the case to the Land Tribunal, where the fair value will be established.
target_text: 市民如不接受横贯铁路的建议，可向土地法庭提出上诉，由土地法庭确定公允价值。

source_text: Crossrail does not indicate that it will attempt to assign a fair value in the original offer and instead is only going to offer around £50 per property in the hope that not many people take the matter to the Land Tribunal.
target_text: 横贯铁路并没有表示，它将尝试在最初的报价中给出一个公平的价格，而是将每处房产的报价定在50英镑左右，希望不会有多少人将此事提交土地法庭。

source_text: A Florida man was killed and another man hospitalized after their boat sank off Cape May, New Jersey, US.
target_text: 在他们的船在美国新泽西州五月角沉没后一名佛罗里达男子死亡，另一名男子住院治疗。

source_text: The Sea Wolf sent a distress signal via emergency satellite beacon at about 1:35 AM on Thursday, seven miles off Cape May.
target_text: 周四凌晨1点35分左右，“海狼”号通过应急卫星信标发出了遇险信号，距离五月角7英里。

source_text: A member of the State Police informed the Coast Guard who sent out an MH-65 rescue helicopter and two rescue launches.
target_text: 一名州警察通知海岸警卫队派出了一架MH-65救援直升机和两艘救援艇。

source_text: The helicopter managed to save Steve Hopkins of the District of Columbia but was unable to do the same for Gregory Arlotta of Florida.
target_text: 这架直升机成功地拯救了哥伦比亚特区的史蒂夫·霍普金斯，但却无法拯救佛罗里达州的格雷戈里·阿洛塔。

source_text: The 62 year old disappeared among the debris in eight-foot waves.
target_text: 这位62岁的老人在八英尺高的海浪中消失了。

source_text: Arlotta had recently bought the vessel in New York; its previous owner was in his seventies and had decided to sell the ship.
target_text: 阿洛塔最近在纽约买了这艘船，之前的船主已经70多岁，决定卖掉这艘船。

source_text: The Sea Wolf had been operating for a couple of decades prior to the sinking, and was described by one local as unfit for the voyage it was undertaking to New Orleans.
target_text: “海狼号”在沉没前已经航行了几十年，当地的一位居民认为它不适合前往新奥尔良。

source_text: A 1963 Gilligan, it was designed for use within ten miles of shore for fishing.
target_text: 1963年的吉利根号，设计用于离海岸十英里以内的捕鱼。

source_text: Nico Rosberg drove his Williams up to fourth place, while the second McLaren of Heikki Kovalainen came fifth.
target_text: 尼科·罗斯伯格驾驶他的威廉姆斯车队升至第四名，而迈凯轮车队的第二名海基·科瓦莱宁名列第五。

source_text: Championship leader Jenson Button gained two points for Brawn by finishing 7th and is now 18.5 points ahead of Webber, who has moved into second place ahead of Vettel.
target_text: 冠军领跑者简森·巴顿以第七名的成绩为布朗拿下两分，现在领先韦伯18.5分，韦伯已经超越维特尔排名第二。

source_text: He split the two Toyota cars of Timo Glock and Jarno Trulli, who completed the top eight.
target_text: 他将丰田的蒂莫·格洛克和雅诺·特鲁利的两辆车分成两组，这两辆车都进入了前八名。

source_text: The International Football Association Board (IFAB), the body that decides on the laws of the game, has decided to discontinue all experiments involving technology, and for the first time has also decided on the exact size of a soccer field.
target_text: 国际足球协会理事会（IFAB）是决定足球比赛规则的机构，它决定停止所有涉及技术的实验，并首次决定足球场的确切大小。

source_text: Instead of pursuing the idea of using cameras or microchips in the ball to see if it has crossed the goal-line, the International Board wants to see if the introduction of two extra assistant referees can improve the quality of referee's decisions.
target_text: 国际足联并不打算在球上安装摄像头或微芯片来检测球是否越过了球门线，而是希望增加两名助理裁判，以提高裁判的判罚质量。

source_text: FIFA general secretary Jerome Valcke declared: "We have decided to freeze for the time being the goal-line technology and all technology experiments."
target_text: 国际足联秘书长杰罗姆·瓦尔克宣布：“我们已经决定暂时冻结球门线技术和所有技术实验。”

source_text: "We will look on these two additional referees and we avoid considering any goal-line technology during this time."
target_text: “我们会考虑另外两名裁判，在此期间我们不会考虑任何球门线技术。”

source_text: FIFA President Sepp Blatter said the move was necessary to maintain the universal spirit of the game: "We have 260 million people directly involved in the game."
target_text: 国际足联主席塞普·布拉特表示，这一举措对于保持比赛的普遍精神是必要的：“我们有2.6亿人直接参与比赛。”

source_text: "If we maintain the laws of the game ... it's so easy to understand ..."
target_text: “如果我们维持比赛规则……这很容易理解……”。

source_text: "We have to live with errors, football has to keep its human face."
target_text: “我们必须忍受错误，足球必须保持人性化。”

source_text: "We have to maintain the laws of the game in their simplicity."
target_text: “我们必须以简洁的方式维护比赛规则。”

source_text: "Do you want technical devices to take decisions? That's why, after three years of tests with no conclusions, I am in favour of putting the whole thing on ice," Blatter explained.
target_text: “你想让技术设备做出决定吗？”这就是为什么在三年的测试没有得出任何结论之后，我倾向于把整个事情搁置一边，布拉特解释道。

source_text: Platini made the suggestion to freeze all investigations into technology and to try two additional assistants behind each goal.
target_text: 普拉·蒂尼建议冻结对技术的所有调查，并在每个球门后面再增加两名助手。

source_text: Blatter said the system using the microchip "was very complicated, needing electrified lines on the field of play and other devices including antennae and when we tested it in Tokyo last year there was one mistake during the seven matches we used as an experiment at the Club World Championship."
target_text: 布拉特表示，使用这种微芯片的系统“非常复杂，需要在赛场上安装电气化线路，以及包括天线在内的其他设备。去年我们在东京测试时，我们在俱乐部世界锦标赛上用作实验的七场比赛中出现了一个错误。”

source_text: With regards to the system using cameras, he pointed to "problems with players obscuring the views of the cameras, or of flares or weather conditions."
target_text: 关于摄像机使用系统，他指出存在“运动员遮挡摄像机视野，耀斑或天气状况等问题。”

source_text: The system of the extra referees will be tested at an upcoming FIFA or UEFA tournament, and a final ruling is expected at next year's meeting, according to FIFA's Jerome Valcke.
target_text: 根据国际足联的杰罗姆·瓦克的说法，在即将举行的国际足联或欧洲足联锦标赛上，将对额外裁判员的制度进行测试，最终裁决将在明年的会议上做出。

source_text: Hawk-Eye, the company that was working on the goal-line technology that is already being used for line calls in tennis, reacted with disappointment: "I'm livid, it is completely out of the blue..."
target_text: 鹰眼是一家致力于球门线技术的公司，该技术已经在网球比赛中被用于出线呼叫。鹰眼公司相关人士对此表示失望：“我脸色铁青，这完全出乎意料……”。

source_text: "A year ago they met and gave us four criteria to meet and we have met all of them, yet they have kicked it out now..."
target_text: “一年前，他们达到了标准，给了我们四个标准，我们都达到了，但现在他们把它踢了出去……”。

source_text: He said he was encouraged to continue research on the project only 10 days ago at a private showing for IFAB members at Reading's Madejski Stadium.
target_text: 他说，就在10天前，在雷丁马代斯基体育场举行的IFAB成员私人展览上，他还被鼓励继续研究这个项目。

source_text: While the Welsh FA were also against the idea, the English Football Association supported the use of technology and was hoping to start using it by next season.
target_text: 虽然威尔士足协也反对这一想法，但英国足球协会支持使用技术，并希望在下个赛季开始使用它。

source_text: A spokesperson of the Premier League said that "A lot of time, money and effort has gone into developing a system that meets all the criteria laid down last year."
target_text: 英超联赛的一位发言人表示，“我们投入了大量的时间、金钱和精力来开发一个符合去年制定的所有标准的体系。”

source_text: FA chief executive Brian Barwick expressed his disappointment at the annual meeting of the IFAB in Gleneagles, Scotland: "We were in favour of goal-line technology but there will be no more experiments and it will not be back on the agenda next year, or in the foreseeable future."
target_text: 英足总首席执行官布莱恩·巴威克在苏格兰格伦伊格尔斯举行的IFAB年会上表达了他的失望：“我们支持球门线技术，但不会再有更多的实验，它也不会在明年或可预见的未来重返议程。”

source_text: "I have defended goal-line technology but it has become clear that such systems are too complicated and very costly."
target_text: “我一直在为球门线技术辩护，但很明显，这样的系统过于复杂，成本也非常高昂。”

source_text: "Nor would they necessarily add anything positive to the game and could harm the authority of the referee."
target_text: “他们也不一定会给比赛增加任何积极的东西，而且可能会损害裁判的权威。”

source_text: Johnnie Cochran, U.S. lawyer famous for getting O.J. Simpson acquitted of murder charges in the 1990s, died Tuesday afternoon in his home in Los Angeles, California.
target_text: 美国律师约翰尼·科克伦周二下午在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的家中去世，他因在20世纪90年代使O·J·辛普森无罪释放而闻名。

source_text: He had been suffering from complications of an inoperable brain tumor.
target_text: 他一直遭受着无法手术的脑瘤并发症的折磨。

source_text: "The world has lost not only a legendary attorney, but an outstanding humanitarian."
target_text: “世界不仅失去了一位传奇的律师，而且还失去了一位杰出的人道主义者。”

source_text: Gidget, the chihuahua featured in the Taco Bell adverts in the United States has died from a stroke.
target_text: 美国塔可钟广告中的吉娃娃吉吉特死于中风。

source_text: The dog died at the age of 15 on Tuesday night.
target_text: 周二晚上，这只15岁的狗死了。

source_text: Sue Chipperton, the owner and trainer of Gidget commented saying, "She made so many people happy."
target_text: 吉吉特的老板兼教练苏·奇普顿评论说：“她让很多人都很开心。”

source_text: The dog was featured in the 1990s adverts that ran from 1997 to 2000.
target_text: 这只狗出现在上世纪90年代的广告中，广告从1997年持续到2000年。

source_text: Gidget was portrayed as a male dog and is remembered for the dubbed saying "Yo quiero Taco Bell" which is Spanish for "I want Taco Bell."
target_text: 吉吉特被描绘为一只公狗，并且因为这句话“Yo quiero Taco Bell”而被人们记住，这是西班牙语“我想要塔可钟”的意思。

source_text: The advert was meant to be shown only once but was turned into a campaign.
target_text: 这则广告本打算只播放一次，但却变成了一场宣传活动。

source_text: Gidget was also featured in Legally Blonde 2 and adverts for the board game Trivial Pursuit.
target_text: 吉吉特还出现在《律政俏佳人2》和棋盘游戏《平凡的追求》的广告中。

source_text: Israeli soldiers are in the process of removing Jewish protesters from synagogues in Neve Dekalim and Kfar Darom in the Gaza Strip as part of an operation to force the evacuation of settlements.
target_text: 以色列士兵正在把加沙地带内夫·德卡里姆和法尔·达罗姆犹太教堂的犹太抗议者赶出去，这是迫使定居点撤离行动的一部分。

source_text: The settlement of Neve Dekalim was founded in 1983 and was home to 500 Orthodox Jewish families.
target_text: 内夫·德卡里姆定居点建于1983年，是500个正统犹太家庭的家园。

source_text: It also was occupied earlier before back in the 1940s, settled by a couple Jewish families who were able to hold off the Eygptian army.
target_text: 早在20世纪40年代它就被占领了，由一对犹太家庭定居下来，他们阻止了埃及军队的进攻。

source_text: Around 1,500 protesters inside the synagogue refused to leave despite warnings from the soldiers.
target_text: 尽管士兵发出警告，但犹太教堂内约有1,500名抗议者拒绝离开。

source_text: The protesters have linked their arms in a chain to attempt to prevent themselves being removed.
target_text: 抗议者们手拉手连在一起，试图阻止自己被驱赶出去。

source_text: The protesters are mostly not Gaza settlers, but are extremist youths from the West Bank and Israel.
target_text: 抗议者大多不是加沙定居者，而是来自约旦河西岸和以色列的极端青年。

source_text: After several hours of unsuccessful negotiations unarmed security forces entered the complex to begin removing people to buses waiting outside.
target_text: 经过几个小时的不成功谈判，非武装的安全部队进入综合大楼，开始将人员送到外面等候的公共汽车上。

source_text: Those who did not go as instructed were usually escorted by two or three guards each to the buses.
target_text: 那些没有按照指示行事的人通常由两三个警卫护送到公共汽车上。

source_text: Meanwhile, all male protesters have been removed from the building while the female protesters are still inside the synagogue.
target_text: 与此同时，所有男性抗议者都被赶出了大楼，而女抗议者仍然在犹太教堂内。

source_text: In another Gaza town, Kfar Darom, protesters are also making their last stand in a synagogue, and thousands of troops have surrounded the buildings.
target_text: 在加沙的另一个城镇法达罗姆，抗议者也在犹太教堂进行最后的抵抗，数千名军队包围了这些建筑。

source_text: There, soldiers entered the synagogue as well and are dragging protesters out of the building.
target_text: 在那里，士兵也进入了犹太教堂，并将抗议者拖出大楼。

source_text: They were, however, hampered by protesters on the roof, who, among other things, threw caustic soda at the soldiers.
target_text: 然而，他们受到屋顶上抗议者的阻挠，他们向士兵们投掷烧碱等物品。

source_text: Consequently, the rooftop was taken by security forces as well.
target_text: 因此，屋顶也被安全部队占领。

source_text: Seventy seven people have been injured, two moderately on the roof of the synagogue.
target_text: 有77人受伤，其中两人在犹太教堂屋顶受伤。

source_text: Researchers at the Massachusetts General Hospital have created laboratory-grown rat kidneys that function when transplanted into rats according to a study published online yesterday in the medical journal Nature Medicine.
target_text: 美国马萨诸塞州总医院的研究人员在实验室培育的大鼠肾脏中培育出了一种新的肾脏，这种肾脏可以在移植到大鼠体内时发挥作用。

source_text: The kidneys were capable of urine production and excretion without blood clots in both the laboratory and inside living rats.
target_text: 无论在实验室还是在活体老鼠体内，肾脏都能够在没有血块的情况下产生和排泄尿液。

source_text: The researchers were able to create the functional kidneys by using a donor kidney and using a detergent to remove the rats' kidney cells, then used new cells to cause the kidney to grow around the remaining "scaffolding," the natural protein-based structure of the kidney that remained after washing the kidney.
target_text: 研究人员利用捐献者的肾脏和去污剂去除大鼠的肾细胞，从而制造出功能性肾脏，然后利用新的细胞使肾脏在剩余的“支架”周围生长，这是一种在清洗肾脏后仍然存在的以天然蛋白质为基础的肾脏结构。

source_text: These kidneys would also be of the patient's tissue avoiding issues of organ rejection and would increase the pool of kidneys available for human transplant.
target_text: 这些肾脏也是患者组织的一部分，避免了器官排斥的问题，并将增加可供人类移植的肾脏数量。

source_text: The researchers incubated the kidneys in a specialized oven for 12 days to mimic the insides of a rat.
target_text: 研究人员将肾脏放在特制的实验箱中培养12天，模拟老鼠的内部结构。

source_text: The researchers reported that these kidneys produced urine at 23% of the normal levels of properly working kidneys.
target_text: 研究人员报告说，这些肾脏产生的尿液是正常肾脏正常工作水平的百分之23。

source_text: The lead researcher of the study published in Nature Medicine, Dr. Harald C. Ott, says this partial functionality is enough, saying, "If you're on haemodialysis then kidney function of 10% to 15% would already make you independent of hemodialysis."
target_text: 发表在《自然医学》杂志上的这项研究的首席研究员哈拉尔德·c·奥特博士说，这部分功能已经足够了，他说，“如果你在进行血液透析，那么百分之10到百分之15的肾功能就已经让你不依赖血液透析了。”

source_text: "It's not that we have to go all the way."
target_text: “并不是说我们必须一路走下去。”

source_text: The techniques developed by Ott and the team of researchers still have to be further researched before it can be applied for use in humans.
target_text: 奥特和研究团队开发的技术在应用于人类之前还有待进一步研究。

source_text: When it comes time for use in humans, Ott says that pigs' kidneys would be used as the templates for making human-usable kidneys.
target_text: 当它被用于人类时，奥特说猪的肾脏将被用作制造人类可用肾脏的模板。

source_text: Ott said, "You'd take a kidney matrix off the shelf."
target_text: 奥特说，“你需要从基架上取下肾脏基质。”

source_text: "Then in an ideal world, you'd take cells from that patient and create a kidney on demand."
target_text: “然后在一个理想的世界里，你会从那个病人身上取出细胞并根据需要创造一个肾脏。”

source_text: Roughly 100,000 patients in the United States need an immediate kidney transplant, with 500,000 more on dialysis.
target_text: 美国大约有10万名患者需要立即进行肾脏移植，另外还有50万名患者需要透析。

source_text: In one of the most contentious Democratic primary races of the season, Iraqi war veteran Tammy Duckworth garnered 44% of the vote in the 6th Illinois congressional district, beating out Christine Cegalis (40%) and Lindy Scott (16%).
target_text: 在本赛季最具争议的民主党初选中，伊拉克战争老兵塔米·达克沃斯击败克里斯汀·切加利（百分之四十）和林迪·斯科特（百分之十六），获得了伊利诺伊州第6选区百分之四十四的选票。

source_text: Duckworth's victory earns her a spot in the race against Republican state Senator Peter Roskam, who won the Republican nomination to replace retiring Congressman Henry Hyde.
target_text: 达克沃斯的胜利使她在与共和党州参议员彼得·罗斯卡姆的竞争中赢得了一席之地。罗斯卡姆赢得了共和党提名，接替即将退休的国会议员亨利·海德。

source_text: Cegalis, a software engineer, was running unopposed for the nomination until Duckworth joined the race in December.
target_text: 软件工程师塞加利斯一直在毫无异议地竞选总统候选人，直到达克沃斯12月加入竞选。

source_text: Supported by the Democratic establishment, Duckworth quickly out-fundraised her opponents, receiving support from prominent Democrats such as John Kerry, Hillary Clinton, Rahm Emmanual, and Barack Obama.
target_text: 在民主党当权派的支持下，达克沃斯很快就筹集到了超过对手的资金，获得了约翰·克里、希拉里·克林顿、拉姆·伊曼纽尔和巴拉克·奥巴马等知名民主党人的支持。

source_text: The race became strongly contested between self-proclaimed progressive activists supporting Cegalis and Democrats who preferred to work with the party candidate.
target_text: 这场竞选在自称支持塞加利斯的进步积极分子和倾向于与该党候选人合作的民主党人之间引起了激烈的争论。

source_text: Duckworth, who lost her legs in Iraq in 2004, received a strong showing of support from outside the district, including large fundraisers in New York and Chicago.
target_text: 2004年，达克沃斯在伊拉克失去了双腿，她得到了区外人士的大力支持，包括纽约和芝加哥的大型募捐活动。

source_text: Scott, a former pastor of an evangelical church in Des Plains, attempted to paint the race in religious terms.
target_text: 斯科特曾是德斯普莱恩斯一个福音派教会的牧师，他试图用宗教术语来描绘种族。

source_text: His campaign was run on the principle that he could win votes through his moderate, religious views, which he said would attract Republican voters in the district.
target_text: 他竞选的原则是，他可以通过自己温和的宗教观点赢得选票，他说这将吸引该地区的共和党选民。

source_text: Wikinews reporter David Shankbone is currently, courtesy of the Israeli government and friends, visiting Israel.
target_text: 维基新闻记者大卫·尚克博恩目前正在以色列政府和朋友的礼遇下访问以色列。

source_text: This is a first-hand account of his experiences and may — as a result — not fully comply with Wikinews' neutrality policy.
target_text: 这是他经历的第一手资料，因此可能不完全符合维基新闻的中立政策。

source_text: Please note this is a journalism experiment for Wikinews and put constructive criticism on the collaboration page.
target_text: 请注意，这是维基新闻的新闻实验，并在协作页面上提出了建设性的批评。

source_text: Dr. Yossi Vardi is known as Israel's 'Father of the Entrepreneur', and he has many children in the form of technology companies he has helped to incubate in Tel Aviv's booming Internet sector.
target_text: 约西·瓦尔迪博士被称为以色列的“企业家之父”，他有很多公司都是他在特拉维夫蓬勃发展的互联网行业帮助孵化的科技公司。

source_text: At the offices of Superna, one such company, he introduced a whirlwind of presentations from his baby incubators to a group of journalists.
target_text: 在Superna这样的一家公司的办公室里，他向一群记者介绍了自己的初创孵化器的演示情况。

source_text: What stuck most in my head was when Vardi said, "What is important is not the technology, but the talent."
target_text: 让我印象最深的是，瓦尔迪说：“重要的不是技术，而是人才。”

source_text: Perhaps because he repeated this after each young Internet entrepreneur showed us his or her latest creation under Vardi's tutelage.
target_text: 也许是因为在每一位年轻的互联网企业家向我们展示了他或她在瓦尔迪指导下的最新作品之后，他都重复了这句话。

source_text: This seemingly paradoxical thinking was talked about as new back then; but even Thomas Edison—the Father of Invention—is oft-quoted for saying, "I have not failed."
target_text: 这种看似矛盾的想法在当时被认为是新鲜事物；但就连发明之父托马斯·爱迪生也经常被引用，说“我没有失败”。

source_text: "I have just found ten thousand ways that won't work."
target_text: “我刚刚发现了一万种不起作用的方法。”

source_text: These are the sort of studies that confuse parents on how to raise their kids.
target_text: 这些研究使父母对如何抚养孩子感到困惑。

source_text: The first, by Carol Dweck at Stanford University, came to the conclusion that children who are not praised for their efforts, regardless of the outcome's success, rarely attempt more challenging and complex pursuits.
target_text: 第一个是斯坦福大学的卡罗尔·德韦克得出的结论，无论结果如何成功，如果孩子们的努力没有得到表扬，他们很少会尝试更具挑战性和更复杂的追求。

source_text: According to Dweck's study, when a child knows that they will receive praise for being right instead of for tackling difficult problems, even if they fail, they will simply elect to take on easy tasks in which they are assured of finding the solution.
target_text: 根据德韦克的研究，当一个孩子知道他们会因为正确而得到表扬，而不是因为解决了难题，即使他们失败了，他们也会选择做一些简单的任务，在这些任务中他们有信心找到解决方案。

source_text: Only one month earlier the Times produced another story for parents to agonize over, this time based on a study from the Brookings Institution, entitled "Are Kids Getting Too Much Praise?"
target_text: 就在一个月前，《纽约时报》还发表了另一篇文章，让家长们为之苦恼。这篇文章是基于布鲁金斯学会的一项名为“孩子得到了太多表扬吗？”的研究。

source_text: The study found American kids are far more confident that they have done well than their Korean counterparts, even when the inverse is true.
target_text: 研究发现，美国孩子比韩国孩子对自己的表现更加自信，即使事实正好相反。

source_text: The Times adds in the words of a Harvard faculty psychologist who intoned, "Self-esteem is based on real accomplishments."
target_text: 《泰晤士报》还引用了哈佛大学一位心理学教授的话说，“自尊是建立在真正的成就之上的。”

source_text: "It's all about letting kids shine in a realistic way."
target_text: “这一切都是为了让孩子们以现实的方式发光。”

source_text: But this is not the first time the self-esteem generation's proponents have been criticized.
target_text: 但这并不是自尊世代的支持者第一次受到批评。

source_text: That's not to say he has not found his latest ICQ, though only time—and consumers—will tell.
target_text: 这并不是说他没有找到他最新的ICQ，尽管只有时间和消费者会告诉我们答案。

source_text: For a Web 2.User like myself, I was most fascinated by Fixya, a site that, like Wikipedia, exists on the free work of people with knowledge.
target_text: 对于一个像我这样的网络用户来说，我最着迷的是Fixya，这个网站像维基百科一样存在于知识人士的免费工作中。

source_text: Fixya is a tech support site where people who are having problems with equipment ask a question and it is answered by registered "experts."
target_text: Fixya是一个技术支持网站，设备出现问题的人会问一个问题，并由注册的“专家”回答。

source_text: These experts are the equivalent of Wikipedia's editors: they are self-ordained purveyors of solutions.
target_text: 这些专家相当于维基百科的编辑：他们是自我定位的解决方案提供者。

source_text: But instead of solving a mystery of knowledge a reader has in their head, these experts solve a problem related to something you have bought and do not understand.
target_text: 但是，这些专家不是解决读者头脑中存在的知识之谜，而是解决与你所购买的东西有关的问题，而这些东西你并不理解。

source_text: From baby cribs to cellular phones, over 500,000 products are "supported" on Fixya's website.
target_text: 从婴儿床到手机，Fixya网站上“支持”超过500,000种产品。

source_text: The Fixya business model relies upon the good will of its experts to want to help other people through the ever-expanding world of consumer appliances.
target_text: Fixya商业模式依赖于其专家的良好意愿，希望通过不断扩大的消费电器世界帮助其他人。

source_text: But it is different from Wikipedia in two important ways.
target_text: 但它在两个重要方面与维基百科不同。

source_text: The altruistic exchange of information is somewhat dampened by the knowledge that somebody, somewhere, is profiting from whatever you give.
target_text: 利他主义的信息交换在某种程度上被这样一种认识所抑制：在某个地方，某人从你所给予的一切中获利。

source_text: Second, with Wikipedia it is very easy for a person to type in a few sentences about a subject on an article about the Toshiba Satellite laptop, but to answer technical problems a person is experiencing seems like a different realm.
target_text: 其次，在维基百科上，一个人可以很容易地在一篇关于东芝卫星笔记本电脑的文章中键入有关某个主题的几句话，但要回答一个人正在经历的技术问题，似乎是另一个领域。

source_text: "Another difference from Wikipedia is that we have a premium content version of the site."
target_text: “与维基百科的另一个不同之处在于，我们有一个高级内容版本的网站。”

source_text: Their premium site is where they envision making their money.
target_text: 他们的付费网站是他们设想赚钱的地方。

source_text: Customers with a problem will assign a dollar amount based upon how badly they need an answer to a question, and the expert-editors of Fixya will share in the payment for the resolved issue.
target_text: 有问题的客户将根据他们对问题的答案的迫切需要分配一个金额，Fixya的专家编辑将分享解决问题的费用。

source_text: The site is currently working on offering extended warranties with some manufacturers, although it was not clear how that would work on a site that functioned on the work of any expert.
target_text: 该网站目前正在与一些制造商一起提供延长保修期，虽然目前尚不清楚这对有助于专家工作的这个网站是如何运作的。

source_text: Another collaborative effort product presented to us was YouFig, which is software designed to allow a group of people to collaborate on work product.
target_text: 向我们展示的另一个协作努力产品是YouFig，它是一种软件，旨在让一群人在工作产品上进行协作。

source_text: This is not a new idea, although may web-based products have generally fallen flat.
target_text: 这并不是一个新想法，尽管基于网络的产品可能普遍表现平平。

source_text: The idea is that people who are working on a multi-media project can combine efforts to create a final product.
target_text: 其理念是，从事多媒体项目的人员可以结合工作来创建最终产品。

source_text: They envision their initial market to be academia, but one could see the product stretching to fields such as law, where large litigation projects with high-level of collaboration on both document creation and media presentation; in business, where software aimed at product development has generally not lived up to its promises; and in the science and engineering fields, where multi-media collaboration is quickly becoming not only the norm, but a necessity.
target_text: 他们设想他们最初的市场是学术界，但人们可以看到产品延伸到法律等领域，在这些领域，大型诉讼项目在文件创建和媒体展示方面都有高水平的合作；在商业领域，以产品开发为目标的软件通常没有实现其承诺；在科学和工程领域，多媒体协作正迅速成为规范，而且是必要的。

source_text: For the popular consumer market, Superna, whose offices hosted our meeting, demonstrated their cost-saving vision for the Smart Home (SH).
target_text: 对于大众消费市场，Superna的办公室主持了我们的会议，展示了他们对智能家居（SH）的节约成本的愿景。

source_text: Current SH systems require a large, expensive server in order to coordinate all the electronic appliances in today's air-conditioned, lit and entertainment-saturated house.
target_text: 当前的SH系统需要大型昂贵的服务器，以便协调当今空调，灯光和娱乐饱和房屋中的所有电子设备。

source_text: There were a few start-ups where Vardi's fatherly mentoring seemed more at play than long-term practical business modeling.
target_text: 在一些初创企业中，瓦尔迪父亲般的指导似乎比长期的实际商业模式更有效。

source_text: In the hot market of WiFi products, WeFi is software that will allow groups of users, such as friends, share knowledge about the location of free Internet WiFi access, and also provide codes and keys for certain hot spots, with access provided only to the trusted users within a group.
target_text: 在wifi产品的热销市场中，wefi是一种允许朋友等用户群共享免费互联网wifi接入位置信息的软件，它还为某些热点提供代码和密钥，仅向一个组内的受信任用户提供接入。

source_text: The mock-up that was shown to us had a Google Maps-esque city block that had green points to the known hot spots that are available either for free (such as those owned by good Samaritans who do not secure their WiFi access) or for pay, with access information provided for that location.
target_text: 展示给我们的模型有一个谷歌地图风格的城市街区，它有指向已知热点的绿点，这些热点可以免费使用（例如那些不保证WiFi访问安全的好心人拥有的热点），也可以付费使用并提供该位置的访问信息。

source_text: I saw two long-term problems: first, WiMAX, which is able to provide Internet access to people for miles within its range.
target_text: 我看到了两个长期存在的问题：第一，WiMAX，它能够在其服务范围内为人们提供数英里的互联网接入。

source_text: There is already discussion all over the Internet as to whether this technology will eventually make WiFi obsolete, negating the need to find "hot spots" for a group of friends.
target_text: 关于这项技术是否最终会让WiFi过时，网络上已经有了广泛的讨论，人们不再需要为一群朋友寻找“热点”。

source_text: The second problem is if good Samaritans are more easily located, instead of just happened-upon, how many will keep their WiFi access free?
target_text: 第二个问题是如果好心人更容易找到，而不是刚刚发生，有多少人会保持他们的WiFi免费接入？

source_text: It has already become more difficult to find people willing to contribute to free Internet.
target_text: 现在已经很难找到愿意为免费互联网做出贡献的人了。

source_text: Even in Tel Aviv, and elsewhere, I have come across several secure wireless users who named their network "Fuck Off" in an in-your-face message to freeloaders.
target_text: 即使是在特拉维夫和其他地方，我也遇到过一些安全的无线用户，他们在一封给爱占便宜的人的当面邮件中给自己的网络命名为“滚开”。

source_text: Another child of Vardi's that the Brookings Institution might say was over-praised for self-esteem but lacking real accomplishment is AtlasCT, although reportedly Nokia offered to pay US$8.1 million for the software, which they turned down.
target_text: 布鲁金斯学会可能说瓦尔迪的另一个公司阿特拉斯克在自尊方面得到了过度的赞扬，但缺乏真正的成就，尽管据报道诺基亚愿意支付810万美元购买他们拒绝的软件。

source_text: Although one can see an e-classroom in architecture employing such software to allow students to take a walking tour through Rome, its desirability may be limited.
target_text: 虽然你可以看到一个建筑电子教室使用这样的软件，让学生步行游览罗马，它的可取性可能是有限的。

source_text: Whether Vardi is a smart parent for his encouragement, or in fact propping up laggards, is something only time will tell him as he attempts to bring these products of his children to market.
target_text: 当瓦尔迪试图将他孕育的初创产品推向市场时，只有时间才能告诉他，究竟瓦尔迪是一个鼓励孩子的聪明家长，还是一个支持落后者的家长。

source_text: The look of awe that came across each company's representative whenever he entered the room provided the answer to the question of Who's your daddy?
target_text: 无论何时他走进房间时，每家公司的代表都带着敬畏的表情，这就回答了这个问题：谁是你的爸爸？

source_text: MIT has announced that Elwood "Woody" Norris, inventor of potentially revolutionary technologies of Hypersonic Sound beams and AirScooter flying vehicles, will receive this year's Lemelson-MIT prize for invention this Friday, April 22.
target_text: 麻省理工学院宣布，极超音速光束和空中滑板飞行器的潜在革命性技术发明人、“伍迪”诺里斯将于4月22日（本周五）获得今年的勒默尔森-麻省理工学院发明奖。

source_text: The prize comes with an award of US$500,000, making it the largest single award for invention given in the United States.
target_text: 该奖项的奖金为50万美元，是美国颁发的最大的发明奖项。

source_text: Nearly 330,000 people in San Diego County, California located in the United States are being ordered to evacuate after massive wildfires started to spread and grow.
target_text: 在大规模野火开始蔓延和火势变猛之后，美国加州圣地亚哥近33万人被命令撤离。

source_text: As a result, U.S. President George W. Bush has declared a state of emergency in California clearing the way for federal aid assistance.
target_text: 结果，美国总统乔治·W·布什宣布加州的紧急状态为联邦援助扫清了道路。

source_text: "All of us across this nation are concerned for the families who have lost their homes and the many families who have been evacuated from their homes."
target_text: “全国人民都为那些失去家园的家庭和许多被迫撤离家园的家庭感到担忧。”

source_text: "We send the help of the federal government," said Bush in a statement to the press.
target_text: “我们提供联邦政府援助，”布什在向媒体发表的声明中表示。

source_text: Almost 1,500 houses have been burned to ashes and fires continue to threaten nearly 60,000 more.
target_text: 将近1500所房屋被烧成灰烬，火灾继续威胁到近6万所房屋。

source_text: One person has died as a result of the fires with 42 injured.
target_text: 火灾造成一人死亡，42人受伤。

source_text: 16 of those are reported to be firefighters who were battling the blazes.
target_text: 据报道，其中16人是与火焰作斗争的消防员。

source_text: At least 13 wildfires have burned more than 356,000 acres (142,400 hectares) in areas stretching from San Diego, near the border with Mexico, to Malibu, near Los Angeles.
target_text: 在从墨西哥边境附近的圣地亚哥到洛杉矶附近的马里布，至少有13场野火烧毁了超过356,000英亩（142,400公顷）的土地。

source_text: At least six people died in a raid lead by Iraqi forces assisted by US troops near the Iraqi city of Fallujah Wednesday.
target_text: 周三，在伊拉克费卢杰附近，在美军协助下，由伊拉克军队领导的袭击造成至少6人死亡。

source_text: US Army spokesman Major Rob Philips says the troops went into an al-Qaeda hideout.
target_text: 美国陆军发言人罗伯特·飞利浦说，部队进入基地组织藏身之地。

source_text: Insurgents shot at the troops and they returned fire, killing six.
target_text: 叛乱分子向部队开枪，他们还击，造成6人死亡。

source_text: Philips says the forces were searching for a top al-Qaeda official.
target_text: 飞利浦表示，部队正在寻找一名基地组织高级官员。

source_text: Reports from Fallujah police say seven people died and the raid was illegal and troops targeted civilians.
target_text: 费卢杰警方的报告称，有7人死亡，袭击是非法的，部队以平民为目标。

source_text: They say there is high tension in Iraq's Anbar province over the government's military actions.
target_text: 他们说，伊拉克安巴尔省因政府的军事行动而处于高度紧张状态。

source_text: India's nominee for the post of Secretary-General of the United Nations, Shashi Tharoor has revealed a four-point plan to tackle the problems the international body is facing.
target_text: 印度提名的联合国秘书长候选人沙什·塔鲁尔公布了一项四点计划，以解决联合国面临的问题。

source_text: He said that the biggest hurdle faced by the UN is that it has to deal with a large number of issues at the same time.
target_text: 他说，联合国面临的最大障碍是它必须同时处理大量问题。

source_text: The United Nations with its "impressive achievements" and "haunting failures" has changed but needs to change further, he said in an article in Newsweek International.
target_text: 他在《国际新闻周刊》的一篇文章中表示，联合国以其“令人印象深刻的成就”和“令人难忘的失败”而改变，但需要进一步改变。

source_text: Tharoor's proposal is concentrated on four areas- making democracy a priority; bolstering the ranks (of the United Nations); prioritising and streamlining; and healing wounds.
target_text: 塔鲁尔的提议主要集中在四个方面：优先考虑民主；加强（联合国）的队伍；确定优先事项和精简；以及治愈创伤。

source_text: He talked about the crisis in the Middle East, and the nuclear standoff between the U.N and countries like North Korea and Iran, referring to them as "obvious and trying".
target_text: 他谈到了中东的危机，以及联合国与北朝鲜、伊朗等国之间的核僵局，并称之为“显而易见而又令人难受”。

source_text: He also pointed out "problems without passports" such as climate change, narcotics smuggling and human rights violations.
target_text: 他还指出了“无护照问题”，如气候变化，毒品走私和侵犯人权等问题。

source_text: Tharoor stated that further efforts were needed to promote democracy and good governance the world over.
target_text: 塔鲁尔说，需要进一步努力在全世界促进民主和良好的治理。

source_text: "We now have a Democracy Fund to help us do that, financed not just by the rich West but by countries like India," he said.
target_text: “我们现在有一个民主基金会帮助我们做到这一点，不仅由富裕的西方国家资助，而且由印度等国家资助，”他说。

source_text: He also pointed out that the UN should try and stand up more for human rights by making sure the Human Rights Council did its job more effectively than the "over-politicised" Human Rights Commission it replaced.
target_text: 他还指出，联合国应该通过确保人权理事会比其所取代的“过度政治化的”人权委员会更有效地开展工作，努力争取人权。

source_text: Tharoor also spoke about the conflict in Iraq, saying "And where the task, like enforcing peace in Iraq, is clearly beyond us (the UN), we should let wars be fought by warriors, not peacekeepers,"
target_text: 塔鲁尔还谈到了伊拉克的冲突，他说：“在伊拉克执行和平这样的任务显然超出了我们（联合国）的范围，我们应该让战争由战士而不是维和人员来打。”

source_text: In reference to "healing wounds", he pointed out the danger of the Cold War divisions being replaced by a North-South divide at the UN.
target_text: 在谈到“治愈创伤”时，他指出，冷战时期的分歧有可能被联合国的南北分歧所取代的危险。

source_text: "The new secretary-general must urgently combat this."
target_text: “新任秘书长必须紧急打击这一点。”

source_text: "I would focus on building issue-based coalitions to deal with specific practical problems (things like management inefficiencies, procurement policies, information technology, outsourcing) that have little to do with ideological politics," he said.
target_text: 他说：“我将集中精力建立以问题为基础的联盟，处理与意识形态政治无关的具体实际问题（如管理效率低下、采购政策、信息技术、外包等）。”

source_text: Tharoor is currently the UN's Under Secretary-General for Communications and Public Information.
target_text: 塔鲁尔目前是联合国负责通讯和公共信息的副秘书长。

source_text: He and South Korean Foreign Minister Ban Ki Moon are considered frontrunners in the race to succeed Annan, whose term ends at the end of the year.
target_text: 他和韩国外长潘基文被认为是接替安南的热门人选。安南的任期将于今年年底结束。

source_text: Thailand's Deputy Prime Minister Surakiart Sathirathai and former UN disarmament chief Jayantha Dhanapala from Sri Lanka are also official candidates for the top UN job.
target_text: 泰国副总理素拉加特·萨蒂拉泰和斯里兰卡前联合国裁军事务负责人贾扬塔·达纳帕拉也是联合国最高职位的正式候选人。

source_text: An analysis of melatonin studies has upheld the controversial supplement's effectiveness as a sleep aid.
target_text: 对褪黑激素研究的分析支持了有争议的补充剂作为睡眠辅助的有效性。

source_text: The analysis, which included 17 peer-reviewed scientific papers, was aimed at determining whether supplements of the hormone can improve sleep among insomniacs, older adults and others.
target_text: 这项分析包括17篇同行评议的科学论文，旨在确定补充这种激素是否能改善失眠症患者、老年人和其他人的睡眠。

source_text: "A meta-analysis essentially tells 'yes' or 'no'—that a treatment does or does not have a significant effect," says Richard Wurtman of MIT, the study's principal investigator.
target_text: 该研究的主要研究者、麻省理工学院的理查德·沃特曼说：“一项荟萃分析基本上告诉我们‘是’或‘否’-治疗是否有显著效果。”

source_text: "When a meta-analysis says 'yes,' there should no longer be any controversy about whether the treatment works."
target_text: “当一项荟萃分析说‘是’时，关于这种治疗是否有效，就不再存在任何争议。”

source_text: Previous studies by Wurtman and colleagues showed that small doses of melatonin, about 0.3 milligrams, are necessary for restful effects.
target_text: 沃特曼和同事们之前的研究表明，小剂量的褪黑激素（约0.3毫克）对休息效果是必要的。

source_text: The researchers found, however, that commercially available melatonin pills can contain 10 times the effective amount.
target_text: 然而，研究人员发现，市面上可买到的褪黑激素药片所含的褪黑激素是其有效剂量的10倍。

source_text: At that dose, says Wurtman, the hormone's effects end after a few days because melatonin receptors in the brain become unresponsive when exposed to too much of the hormone.
target_text: 沃特曼说，在这种剂量下，这种激素的效果在几天后就会消失，因为大脑中的褪黑激素受体在接触过多这种激素时变得没有反应。

source_text: Such inadvertent overdosing, say the researchers, has contributed to controversy over melatonin's efficacy.
target_text: 研究人员说，这种无意中过量服用褪黑激素的行为引发了对褪黑激素有效性的争议。

source_text: But the new meta-analysis shows that melatonin does indeed have positive effects on sleep—even though some of the analyzed studies also involved high doses of the hormone.
target_text: 但新的荟萃分析表明，褪黑激素确实对睡眠产生了积极影响，尽管一些分析研究也涉及高剂量的激素。

source_text: The research is reported in the journal Sleep Medicine Reviews.
target_text: 这项研究发表在睡眠医学评论杂志上。

source_text: India won the first match of the 2011 Cricket World Cup against Bangladesh by 87 runs on February 19.
target_text: 2月19日，印度以87分的成绩赢得了2011年板球世界杯对孟加拉国的第一场比赛。

source_text: The Group B match was played at the Shere Bangla National Stadium in Mirpur, Bangladesh.
target_text: B组比赛在孟加拉国米尔普尔的谢尔邦拉国家体育场举行。

source_text: In the Indian innings, Virender Sehwag scored the highest total, 175 runs off 140 balls, his highest one-day international score and Virat Kolhi played his debut World Cup match and scored a century, while remaining unbeaten on 100.
target_text: 在印度的击球局中，施瓦格获得了最高的总得分，140个球中获得175分，这是他的单日国际性赛事中的最高得分。维拉特·高丽参加了他的首次世界杯比赛，并获得100分，同时保持着100球不败。

source_text: The first referral of the World Cup came after the 4th ball of the 2nd innings was bowled.
target_text: 世界杯的第一次引荐这个判罚系统是在第二局的第四个球投出之后。

source_text: India's Shanthakumaran Sreesanth had bowled a yorker and the umpire declared it not out.
target_text: 印度的三塔库马兰・斯里三斯击出了一个击球棒下面通过的球，裁判宣布没有出界。

source_text: Dhoni referred it to the TV umpire and a replay showed it might have missed the leg stump, so the original decision was upheld.
target_text: 多尼把判罚交给了电视裁判，回放显示球可能从三柱门门柱旁边滑过，所以维持原判。

source_text: The match marked the debut of the controversial umpire referral system in World Cup cricket.
target_text: 这场比赛标志着有争议的裁判执法系统在世界杯板球赛上的首次亮相。

source_text: German police are embarrassed after a 27-year-old man, whom they had just booked for burglary, walked out of the police station and stole an unmarked police vehicle.
target_text: 一名27岁男子刚刚以行窃罪被警方登记在册，然后当他走出警察局时又偷走了一辆没有标识的警车，这件事情让德国警方十分难堪。

source_text: "It's not just unusual, it's embarrassing," said a spokesman for police in the town of Eschwege.
target_text: “这不仅不寻常，而且令人难堪，”埃施韦格镇警方发言人说。

source_text: It is thought that the man stole the key from an officer at the station.
target_text: 据认为，这名男子从车站的一名军官那里偷走了钥匙。

source_text: When he was booked and released, he was observed by officers getting into the unmarked police car.
target_text: 当他被记录在案并被释放后，他被警察发现进入了一辆没有标记的警车。

source_text: Three vehicles (including the stolen police car) were damaged during the pursuit.
target_text: 三辆车（包括偷来的警车）在追击过程中受损。

source_text: The stolen vehicle was recovered upon arrest of its unlawful driver.
target_text: 失窃的车辆在其非法司机被捕后被追回。

source_text: The FBI has confirmed that the chunky substance discovered in the Moore-Hill dormitory at the University of Texas on Thursday is not the poison ricin.
target_text: 美国联邦调查局证实，周四在德克萨斯大学摩尔希尔宿舍发现的大块物质不是蓖麻毒素。

source_text: Ricin is one of the most deadly poisons in the world and can exist in the form of a pellet, mist, or powder.
target_text: 蓖麻毒素是世界上最致命的毒药之一，可以以颗粒，薄雾或粉末的形式存在。

source_text: An earlier report by the Associated Press had said tests had found the substance might be ricin.
target_text: 美联社早些时候的报道说，测试发现这种物质可能是蓖麻毒素。

source_text: Such tests are designed to error on the side of caution, thus ensuring that possible poisoning victims receive treatment in time.
target_text: 这样的测试是为了谨慎起见而设计的，从而确保可能的中毒受害者得到及时的治疗。

source_text: Last year there were similar false positive reports of ricin in London, which were further publicized by Vice President Cheney and Secretary of State Colin L. Powell.
target_text: 去年，伦敦也有类似的蓖麻毒素假阳性报告，副总统切尼和国务卿科林·鲍威尔进一步公布了这些报告。

source_text: The Speaker of the Bundestag, Wolfgang Thierse, welcomed the decision and urged the parties to conduct fair campaigns.
target_text: 德国联邦议院议长沃尔夫冈·蒂尔斯对这一决定表示欢迎，并敦促两党开展公平的竞选活动。

source_text: Chancellor Schröder also paid his respect to Köhler, calling his decision confident and again expressed that he intents to resume the good way on which Germany is heading under his leadership.
target_text: 施罗德总理也对科勒表示敬意，称他的决定充满信心，并再次表示，他有意恢复德国在他的领导下前进的良好道路。

source_text: The Chair of the conservative Christian Democrats (CDU) and her party's candidate for chancellor, Angela Merkel, welcomed the call for early elections and wants to get Germany on the right track if her party gets to power in September.
target_text: 保守的基督教民主联盟（CDU）主席和她所在政党的总理候选人安格拉·默克尔对提前选举的呼吁表示欢迎，并希望如果她的政党在9月掌权，能让德国走上正轨。

source_text: The dissolving is the result of a long political muddle that began on May 22th when Schröder's Social Democrats (SPD) lost the most populous state of Germany, North Rhine-Westphalia, to the CDU, the biggest opposition party.
target_text: 解散是一场长期的政治混乱的结果，这场混乱始于5月22日，当时施罗德的社会民主党（SPD）在人口最多的德国北莱茵-威斯特伐利亚州输给了最大的反对党CDU。

source_text: Minutes after the early projections were in, SPD chair Franz Müntefering announced that his party would seek re-election in fall of 2005.
target_text: 在初步预测公布几分钟后，社民党主席弗朗茨·芒特费林宣布，社民党将在2005年秋季寻求连任。

source_text: However, the Basic Law of Germany does not permit the self-dissolving of the Bundestag.
target_text: 但是，德国的“基本法”不允许联邦议院自行解散。

source_text: The only way to achieve early elections is when the chancellor loses a motion of confidence.
target_text: 实现提前选举的唯一途径是总理失去一项信任动议。

source_text: All major parties, including the opposition, support the call for early election.
target_text: 所有主要政党，包括反对派，都支持提前选举的呼吁。

source_text: Polls also indicate that 75% of the population support going to the ballots in September.
target_text: 民调还显示，百分之七十五的民众支持9月份的投票。
