source_text: However, some MP's, most notably Werner Schulz of SPD's coalition partner, The Greens, say that the procedure was unconstitutional because the loss of confidence was orchestrated.
target_text: 然而，一些议员，尤其是社民党的联合伙伴绿党的沃纳·舒尔茨表示，这一程序违宪，因为信心的丧失是精心策划的。

source_text: They announced that they will sue against the dissolving before the Constitutional Court of Germany.
target_text: 他们宣布将向德国宪法法院提起诉讼，反对解散。

source_text: Germany has been struggling with high unemployment for several years and the reforms Schröder introduced were criticized as being neo-liberalistic by unions and also by members of his own party.
target_text: 多年来，德国一直在努力应对高失业率，施罗德所引入的改革被工会以及他自己党派的成员批评为新自由主义者。

source_text: Current polls see the CDU at 44%, while the SPD can only expect 27%.
target_text: 目前的民意调查显示CDU为44％，而SPD只达到27％。

source_text: The liberal FDP, CDU's possible coalition partner, can expect 7%, The Greens 8% and the Party of the Left (formerly PDS) 11%.
target_text: 基民盟可能的联合伙伴自由民主党FDP的支持率预计为百分之七，绿党为百分之八，左翼党（前PDS）为百分之十一。

source_text: The governing SPD-Green coalition is faced with an overwhelming opposition majority in the Bundesrat, the upper chamber, that is able to block most bills.
target_text: 执政的社民党-绿党联盟在上议院联邦参议院面临着压倒性的多数反对意见，能够阻止多数法案的通过。

source_text: Schröder claims that the CDU is engaging in a policy of blockade rendering him unable to make laws and implement policy changes while Angela Merkel, says that Schröder's government is simply incapable to take action.
target_text: 施罗德声称，基民盟实行的封锁政策使他无法制定法律和实施政策改革，而安格拉·默克尔则表示，施罗德政府根本无力采取行动。

source_text: The Albuquerque Academy eighth grade basketball team used tough defense to close out the 2005-2006 season with a win, 46-30 over Los Lunas.
target_text: 阿尔伯克基学院八年级篮球队在2005-2006赛季以46-30大胜洛斯卢纳斯，用强硬的防守结束了赛季。

source_text: The Chargers spread things evenly in the first quarter; five players scored for the team in the period.
target_text: 该学院的冲锋者队在第一节一切都很顺利；在此期间有五名球员为球队得分。

source_text: Both forward Jon Cabarrus and guard Dylan Gordon followed their own shots and scored on putbacks.
target_text: 前锋乔恩·卡巴鲁斯和后卫迪伦·戈登都在投篮后进行跟进并补篮得分。

source_text: Forwards Xavier Moya and Chris Thompson provided tough inside defense on one possession.
target_text: 前锋泽维尔·莫亚和克里斯·汤普森在一次进攻中提供了强硬的内线防守。

source_text: While Los Lunas managed several rebounds, they were unable to get any baskets over the outstretched arms of Moya and Thompson.
target_text: 虽然洛斯卢纳斯队抢下了几个篮板，但他们没能从莫亚和汤普森伸出的手臂上投篮得分。

source_text: Cabarrus scored on another putback for his fourth points of the game late in the quarter, helping Academy to a twelve to eight lead at the end of the first.
target_text: 卡巴鲁斯在本节比赛的尾段补篮得到了本场比赛的第四分，帮助阿尔伯克基学院队在第一节结束时以12比8领先。

source_text: The second period was a low scoring one for both teams.
target_text: 对于两支球队来说，第二节的得分都很低。

source_text: The Chargers scored just nine points, but also held Los Lunas to only three.
target_text: 冲锋者队仅得到9分，但也只让洛斯卢纳斯队拿到了3分。

source_text: Both offenses were struggling when guard Andrew Matthew stole the ball and made a pass to Gordan, who threw another pass to fellow guard Jordan Fleisher, who took the ball and scored on a layup.
target_text: 双方进攻都非常拼，此时后卫安德鲁·马修把球抢断并把球传给戈登，后者又把球传给队友后卫乔丹·弗莱舍，然后带球上篮得分。

source_text: With a minute in the half, reserve Matt Brown took a pass and drove the length of the court for a layup.
target_text: 半场结束前一分钟，替补队员马特·布朗接到一个传球，在全场带球上篮。

source_text: Academy ended the second half with a twenty-one to eleven lead.
target_text: 学院队在上半场结束时以21比11领先。

source_text: Academy again spread the ball around in the second half, with eight Charger players scoring.
target_text: 下半场，学院队再次全场拉开传球，有八名球员得分。

source_text: Leading the way in the second half was Patrick Zacharias, who scored seven points in the half.
target_text: 帕特里克·扎卡里亚斯控制了下半场的比赛，他贡献了7分。

source_text: Gordon connected with Thompson on a play that gave Thompson a layup.
target_text: 戈登与汤普森做了一个配合并由汤普森上篮得分。

source_text: Gordon stole the ball away from Los Lunas and made a pass to Thompson while sandwiched between two Los Lunas defenders.
target_text: 戈登从洛斯卢纳斯队员手中抢断球，在两名洛斯卢纳斯后卫的夹击中把球传给汤普森。

source_text: Thompson received the pass under the basket and scored on a layup.
target_text: 汤普森在篮下接到传球并上篮得分。

source_text: Los Lunas came back with a three pointer by #24 and some layups by other players.
target_text: 洛斯卢纳斯队回过神来，由24号投进了一个三分，其他球员也上篮得分。

source_text: The quarter ended with Academy still holding the lead, 33-22.
target_text: 本节结束时学院队仍以33-22领先。

source_text: AA was again playing tough defense midway through the fourth quarter until #32 hit a three pointer, sparking a small Los Lunas rally, but it was not enough to overcome the offense and defense of the Chargers.
target_text: AA（阿尔伯克基学院）队在第四节中段为止一直打出了强硬的防守，直到对方32号投中一个三分，并带动洛斯卢纳斯队打出一个得分高潮，但这还不足以战胜冲锋者队的进攻和防守。

source_text: Zacharias scored on a tip in of a Gordon shot that hung on the rim and fell out.
target_text: 戈登的投篮碰到篮筐偏出，扎卡雷斯用手轻点得分。

source_text: Zacharias was also fouled on the shot and made the free throw to complete the three point play.
target_text: 扎卡利亚斯在投篮时被犯规，由他罚球完成了三分得分。

source_text: With less than fifteen seconds left, Stanfield received a pass underneath the basket.
target_text: 还剩不到15秒，斯坦菲尔德在篮下接到一个传球。

source_text: His shot didn't fall, but he was fouled with seven seconds left.
target_text: 他的投篮没有命中，但他在还剩7秒时被犯规。

source_text: Stanfield's first free throw bounced up after hitting the rim but didn't fall through.
target_text: 斯坦菲尔德的第一个罚球击中篮筐后弹了起来，但没有掉进篮筐。

source_text: His second shot bounced high in the air two times before falling through the hoop.
target_text: 他的第二次罚篮高高地在空中弹了两下才落入篮筐。

source_text: Stanfield threw his arms up in celebration over his made shot, putting an end to Academy's 14-1 season.
target_text: 斯坦菲尔德举起双手庆祝他的得分，以14-1的战绩结束了学院队的赛季。

source_text: Arung Samudera, the Indonesian naval tall ship that was recently grounded off Queensland, Australia, has been salvaged from the beach at Inskip Point and is currently being towed to Brisbane for repairs.
target_text: 最近在澳大利亚昆士兰州搁浅的印尼海军“阿荣萨穆德拉号”高船，已在因斯基普角的海滩被打捞上来，目前正被拖往布里斯班进行维修。

source_text: The 35m vessel has been stranded since last Thursday, when she was grounded whilst on her way to the APEC meeting in Sydney.
target_text: 这艘35米长的船只自上周四以来一直搁浅，当时它正在前往悉尼参加亚太经合组织会议的途中。

source_text: The ship is expected to berth in Brisbane near the naval barracks at approximately 11 a.m. (AEST).
target_text: 该船预计将于上午11点（澳大利亚东部标准时间）在布里斯班靠近海军营房停泊。

source_text: The tri-masted sailing training vessel, built in New Zealand, is believed to be seaworthy, but has serious damage to her keel and rudder.
target_text: 在新西兰建造的三桅帆船训练船被认为是适航的，但龙骨和方向舵有严重损伤。

source_text: After the completion of repairs, the ship is expected to continue to Sydney, although it will not reach it in time for the APEC meeting.
target_text: 维修完成后，预计该船将继续驶往悉尼，但赶不上悉尼APEC会议。

source_text: The ship's 18-man crew are said to be "very happy" with developments.
target_text: 据称，这艘船的18名船员对事态发展“非常满意”。

source_text: According to the Australian Navy's Commander Forbes Peters, Indonesian officials are as pleased as the ships crew, with Peters saying "The naval attache and the first secretary to the ambassador are on site here and they cuddled Lieutenant Commander Larry Cook."
target_text: 据澳大利亚海军司令福布斯·彼得斯称，印尼官员和船员们一样高兴，彼得斯说：“海军专员和大使第一秘书都在现场，他们拥抱了海军中将拉里·库克。”

source_text: "They are over the moon and I'm sure the commanding officer is as well, even though he's currently at sea on his ship."
target_text: “他们非常高兴，我相信指挥官也非常高兴，尽管他目前正在他的船上航行。”

source_text: Palestinian gunmen have reportedly kidnapped two foreign journalists working for Fox News, a news company owned by parent-company News Corp.
target_text: 据报道，巴勒斯坦枪手绑架了两名为福克斯新闻公司工作的外国记者，福克斯新闻公司是母公司新闻集团旗下的新闻集团。

source_text: A Palestinian witness who worked with the journalists, said that American reporter Steve Centanni, and Olaf Wiig, a cameraman from New Zealand were taken against their will.
target_text: 与记者一起工作的一名巴勒斯坦目击者说，美国记者史蒂夫·森坦尼和来自新西兰的摄影师奥拉夫·韦格被强行带走。

source_text: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade spokeswoman Helen Tunnah said that the ministry had not received any information on the kidnapping.
target_text: 新西兰外交和贸易部发言人海伦·图纳说，外交部没有收到任何关于绑架的信息。

source_text: Fox News said that they did not know who captured the journalists but said that "We can confirm that two of our people were taken against their will in Gaza," and that "negotiations were under way to secure their release."
target_text: 福克斯新闻表示，他们不知道是谁逮捕了这两名记者，但表示，“我们可以证实，我们的两名人员在加沙被强行带走”，“有关方面正在进行谈判，以确保他们获释。”

source_text: The incident began when two vehicles blocked the transmission truck, labelled 'TV', and their bodyguard was forced to the ground at gunpoint by a masked man.
target_text: 事件起因是两辆车挡住了标有“TV”字样的传输卡车，他们的保镖被一名蒙面男子用枪逼倒在地。

source_text: Hamas, the Islamic militant group that heads Gaza's government, did not claim responsibility, and condemned the kidnapping.
target_text: 领导加沙政府的伊斯兰激进组织哈马斯没有宣称对此负责，并谴责绑架事件。

source_text: Fox News Vice President John Moody said in an internal message to Fox News personnel that "The rumors are true: two of our employees have been abducted in Gaza."
target_text: 福克斯新闻副总裁约翰·穆迪在给福克斯新闻工作人员的内部消息中说，“谣言是真的：我们的两名员工在加沙被绑架了。”

source_text: "Do not comment officially and of course, not on the air, about it."
target_text: “不要正式发表评论，当然，也不要在电视上发表评论。”

source_text: Parties to a lawsuit against Amazon.com agreed September 25 to a proposed settlement resolving claims that Amazon unlawfully deleted content from users' Kindle reading devices.
target_text: 9月25日，针对亚马逊的诉讼各方同意一项拟议的和解协议，解决有关亚马逊非法删除用户Kindle阅读设备内容的指控。

source_text: Justin Gawronski, a Michigan high school senior, and Antoine Bruguier, a California engineer, had sued on July 30, after Amazon deleted George Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four from their Kindles.
target_text: 密歇根高中四年级学生贾斯汀·加沃伦斯基和加州工程师安托万·布鲁吉尔于7月30日起诉亚马逊，此前亚马逊将乔治·奥威尔的《一九八四》从Kindles上删除。

source_text: Gawronski also said his digital notes lost value because they were no longer associated with the relevant text.
target_text: 加夫龙斯基还说，他的数字笔记失去了价值，因为它们不再与相关文本相关联。

source_text: The plaintiffs argued that Amazon had breached its terms of service and violated the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act and Washington Consumer Protection Act.
target_text: 原告辩称，亚马逊违反了其服务条款，违反了“计算机欺诈和滥用法案”和“华盛顿消费者保护法”。

source_text: Amazon had first claimed it was forced to delete the books when it learned it did not have the right to sell them.
target_text: 亚马逊首先声称，当它了解到没有权利出售书籍时，它被迫删除了这些书籍。

source_text: However, it apologized on July 23 and on September 7 offered affected customers either US$30 or a copy of the deleted book.
target_text: 但是，它在7月23日和9月7日道歉，向受影响的客户提供了30美元或已删除书籍的副本。

source_text: The proposed settlement includes a commitment that Amazon will only delete e-books remotely under four circumstances: the user consents, the user fails to pay or gets a refund, the government mandates it, or the deletion is necessary to "protect" the consumer, device, or network.
target_text: 这份和解协议包括，亚马逊将在以下四种情况下远程删除电子书：用户同意、用户未能付款或退款、政府强制要求删除，或者删除是为了“保护”消费者、设备或网络。

source_text: Michael Aschenbrener, an attorney at KamberEdelson, described the agreement as a "great settlement" that "provides protection for Kindle users and provides confidence to them that the books, newspapers and magazines they purchase will not be subject to remote deletion by Amazon."
target_text: 坎贝雷德森律师迈克尔·阿森布伦纳称，该协议是一项“伟大的和解”，“为Kindle用户提供了保护，并让他们相信，他们购买的书籍、报纸和杂志不会被亚马逊远程删除。”

source_text: "It sends a message to digital media purveyors of all kinds that sellers really need to respect users' rights to that content."
target_text: “它向各类数字媒体供应商发出了一个信息，那就是卖家真的需要尊重用户对这些内容的权利。”

source_text: Hassan Rowhani, head of the Supreme National Security Council for Iran, announced Monday that the country would temporarily suspend conversion of uranium as of November 22.
target_text: 伊朗最高国家安全委员会主席哈桑·罗哈尼周一宣布，该国将于11月22日暂停中止铀的转换。

source_text: The process of conversion modifies the uranium oxides into uranium hexafluoride.
target_text: 该转换过程将氧化铀转化为六氟化铀。

source_text: Uranium hexafluoride cannot itself be used in a nuclear weapon, but can be enriched into weapons-grade uranium, or it can be converted into plutonium in a nuclear reactor.
target_text: 六氟化铀本身不能用于核武器，但可以富集成武器级铀，或者可以在核反应堆中转化为钚。

source_text: Iran has claimed to be using its nuclear program for only peaceful nuclear energy, rather than for nuclear weapons, but there are concerns in the European Union and the USA as to whether they are being truthful.
target_text: 伊朗声称其核计划只用于和平的核能，而不是用于核武器，但欧盟和美国担心这些计划是否真实。

source_text: Software giant Microsoft has been attempting to purchase Internet giant Yahoo! in hopes of leveraging the internet presence of Yahoo! in Microsoft's battle with Google.
target_text: 软件巨头微软一直试图收购互联网巨头雅虎！希望在微软与谷歌的斗争中能充分利用雅虎！在互联网上的影响力。

source_text: The original offer for Yahoo! was $44 billion; however since this offer Microsoft has seen a revenue drop this last quarter which could greatly affect the software giant's ability to up the price again in hopes Yahoo! would accept.
target_text: 雅虎！最初的出价是440亿美元；然而，由于微软上个季度的收入有所下降，这将极大地影响这家软件巨头再次提高价格的能力，希望雅虎！能接受。

source_text: This includes a 24% drop in revenue from the Windows Operating System alone.
target_text: 这包括仅Windows操作系统收入下降的24％。

source_text: Stock prices of both Microsoft and Yahoo! have decreased during the merger discussions.
target_text: 在合并谈判中，微软和雅虎！的股价都有所下降。

source_text: Microsoft's next move is unknown but there has been talk of potentially going directly to the Yahoo! shareholders with a buyout plan.
target_text: 微软的下一步行动尚不清楚，但有传言称，可能会直接向雅虎！股东提出收购计划。

source_text: Recent comments from Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer and CFO Chris Liddell have mentioned that not acquiring Yahoo! is also an option.
target_text: 微软首席执行官史蒂夫·鲍尔默和首席财务官克里斯·里德尔最近发表评论，称不会收购雅虎！也是一种选择。

source_text: Whatever Microsoft's plan is, the longer this takes, the more competitor Google will likely use this to their advantage is obtaining both clients and employees, says Juan Carlos Perez of IDG.
target_text: IDG的胡安·卡洛斯·佩雷斯说，无论微软的计划是什么，这需要的时间越长，谷歌将越有可能利用这一优势同时获得客户和员工。

source_text: The state broadcaster of New Zealand, Television New Zealand (TVNZ), has announced its plans to fire at least 160 people because they have falling revenue, mainly from their NZ$9.3 million advertising loss.
target_text: 新西兰国家电视台新西兰电视台（TVNZ）宣布，计划解雇至少160名员工，因为他们的收入在下降，主要来自930万新西兰元的广告亏损。

source_text: 50 of the job losses will be from the news and current affairs department, where a total of 350 people currently work.
target_text: 裁员中的50人将来自新闻和时事部门，目前共有350人在那里工作。

source_text: The numbers are not set in stone, according to a spokesperson for TVNZ.
target_text: 据TVNZ发言人称，这些数字并非一成不变。

source_text: The union which represents some of the staff working at TVNZ, Engineering Printing and Manufacturing Union, said that some of the staff are asking themselves how TVNZ will be able to start and manage the new digital 24 hour news channel with fewer staff.
target_text: 代表TVNZ、工程印刷和制造工会部分员工的工会表示，一些员工正在问自己，TVNZ将如何用更少的员工来启动和管理新的24小时数字新闻频道。

source_text: In two weeks time, staff will be asked what they think of the proposed changes, which also includes a top level management restructuring.
target_text: 在两周内，工作人员将被问及他们对拟议变更的看法，其中还包括顶级管理层重组。

source_text: Steve Mahery, broadcasting minister, said, "The restructuring of TVNZ is an operational issue, and I expect they'll meet their charter requirements."
target_text: 广播部长史提夫·马赫里表示：“TVNZ的重组是一个运营问题，我预计它们将满足其章程要求。”

source_text: "How they structure the company to achieve this is entirely up to them."
target_text: “他们如何构建公司以实现这一点完全取决于他们。”

source_text: It is reported that Margaret Beckett, UK Foreign Secretary, is considering becoming the first UK Government Minister to admit to a link between the invasion of Iraq and the threat of terrorism in UK.
target_text: 据报道，英国外交大臣玛格丽特·贝克特正考虑成为首位承认入侵伊拉克与英国恐怖主义威胁之间存在关联的英国政府部长。

source_text: This follows a leak last week of Cabinet papers that demand "a significant reduction in the number and intensity of the regional conflicts that fuel terror activity".
target_text: 这是在上周内阁文件泄露之后发生的，该文件要求“大幅减少助长恐怖活动的地区冲突的数量和强度”。

source_text: Prime Minister Tony Blair has always claimed that the war in Iraq has not fuelled terrorism in UK; that there was terrorism long before the invasion.
target_text: 英国首相托尼·布莱尔一直声称，伊拉克战争并未助长英国的恐怖主义；在入侵之前很久就有了恐怖主义。

source_text: This despite the posthumous video recording of one of the 7/7 bombers, Shehzad Tanweer who said his actions were provoked by British foreign policy and that attacks would continue until British soldiers were withdrawn from Iraq and Afghanistan.
target_text: 尽管7/7炸弹袭击者之一谢赫扎德·坦维尔 死后的视频记录了这一点，但他表示，他的行为是受到英国外交政策的挑衅，袭击将持续下去，直到英国士兵从伊拉克和阿富汗撤出。

source_text: Beckett is considering admitting the link between Iraq and terrorism in UK when discussing the problem of Muslim youth becoming influenced by international terrorists.
target_text: 在讨论穆斯林青年受国际恐怖分子影响的问题时，贝克特正在考虑承认伊拉克与英国的恐怖主义之间的联系。

source_text: She has already disagreed openly with Prime Minister Blair recently by demanding that there be public debate into the need for the replacement of the Trident missile system and the Royal Navy's Vanguard class submarines, by apologising for the Iraq invasion and by not disagreeing with General Sir Richard Dannatt, who said that British troops in Iraq were provoking trouble.
target_text: 通过要求公开辩论是否需要更换三叉戟导弹系统和皇家海军的先锋级潜艇，通过为伊拉克入侵道歉，通过不反对曾说过英国军队在伊拉克挑起事端的理查德·丹纳特将军的观点等手段，她最近已经公开反对布莱尔首相，。

source_text: According to the United States Geological Survey (USGS) a magnitude 4.2 earthquake with a depth of just under two miles, has struck California approximately 3 miles (5 kilometers) northeast of Wrightwood.
target_text: 根据美国地质调查局（USGS）的数据，一场4.2级的地震袭击了位于赖特伍德东北约3英里（5公里）的加利福尼亚州，震源深度略低于2英里。

source_text: The USGS states that there could be some damage, but that it would likely be "very light," but so far the San Bernardino County Fire Department says that no damage has been reported.
target_text: 美国地质勘探局表示可能存在一些损坏，但它可能“非常轻”，但到目前为止，圣贝纳迪诺县消防局表示没有损坏报告。

source_text: There are no reports of any injuries, but witnesses say that they were awoken from their sleep as far away as Los Angeles.
target_text: 目前还没有人员受伤的报道，但目击者说，他们从远在洛杉矶的睡眠中醒来。

source_text: Some 500,000 people gathered today in Rome to march silently, demanding the liberation of Giuliana Sgrena, a reporter who was kidnapped on February 4 in Iraq.
target_text: 今天，约50万人聚集在罗马，静静地游行，要求解放2月4日在伊拉克被绑架的记者朱利亚娜·斯格雷娜。

source_text: Politicians, associations and citizens took part in the gathering, set up by the Communist newspaper Il Manifesto, Sgrena's employer.
target_text: 政治人物、协会和公民都参加了这次集会。这次集会是由斯格雷娜的雇主、共产党报纸《伊拉克宣言》发起的。

source_text: "The march is a way to say, loud and clear, that we want Giuliana Sgrena to be freed... to say no to terrorism and violence", Piero Fassino, leader of the Democratici di Sinistra (Democrats of the Left) party, said.
target_text: “游行是一种方式，响亮而清晰地表明，我们希望茱莉亚娜·斯格雷娜获得自由……为了对恐怖主义和暴力说不”，左翼民主党领袖皮耶罗·法西诺说道。

source_text: Giuliana Sgrena was kidnapped near Baghdad's University on February 4 while she was covering Iraqi elections for Il Manifesto.
target_text: 2月4日，茱莉亚娜·斯格雷娜在巴格达大学附近被绑架，当时她正在为《伊拉克宣言》报道伊拉克选举。

source_text: On February 15 Associated Press Television received a video showing Sgrena demanding help from Italian politicians and people, and asking for Italian troop's withdrawal from Iraq.
target_text: 2月15日，美联社电视台收到一段视频，显示斯格雷娜要求意大利政界人士和人民提供帮助，并要求意大利军队撤出伊拉克。

source_text: British Prime Minister Tony Blair could face a House of Commons inquiry into claims that chief police officers were pressured to support a political agenda during Wednesday's vote to extend detention without charge.
target_text: 英国首相托尼·布莱尔可能将面临下议院的调查。此前有说法称，在周三的投票中，英国警察局长迫于压力，支持一项政治议程，要求在不受指控的情况下延长拘留时间。

source_text: Although the proposal was rejected by the House of Commons, the lobbying has provoked criticism from senior members of the opposition Conservative Party, who are pushing for an inquiry into the behaviour of government ministers towards the police and for 'embroiling them in politics'.
target_text: 尽管下议院拒绝了这一提议，但游说活动已招致反对党保守党资深成员的批评，他们正推动调查政府部长对警察的行为，以及“将他们卷入政治”的行为。

source_text: Former Tory cabinet minister Peter Lilley said: "Every chief constable knows their job is up for re-selection in the next year or so."
target_text: 前保守党内阁大臣彼得·利利说：“每一个警察局长都知道，他们的工作将在明年左右进行重新选择。”

source_text: Home Office minister Hazel Blears denied the claims: "It is entirely proper that the police were there to make their case and for Parliament to consider it."
target_text: 内政部部长黑兹尔·布利尔斯否认了这一说法：“警察在那里为他们的案件辩护，并让议会考虑，这是完全正确的。”

source_text: "Certainly, as a Member of Parliament I would want to have the benefit of the best professional advice I could get before reaching my decision."
target_text: “当然，作为国会议员，我希望在做出决定之前能够获得最好的专业建议。”

source_text: Asteroid 2004 XP14, a half-mile wide chunk of hard rock travelling at 40 000 miles an hour, will miss the Earth by a few hundred thousand miles, Monday.
target_text: 周一，小行星2004xp14，半英里宽的硬岩石，以每小时40000英里的速度运行，将以几十万英里的速度错过地球。

source_text: Dr David Asher from the Armagh Observatory in Northern Ireland said if the rock, discovered in 2004, were to hit the Earth the result would be devastating.
target_text: 北爱尔兰阿玛天文台的大卫·阿舍博士说，如果2004年发现的岩石撞击地球，其结果将是毁灭性的。

source_text: Amateur astronomers with 6-inch telescopes would be able to follow the speeding space debris in Europe and North America at its closest approach to the planet at 0425 UTC.
target_text: 拥有6英寸望远镜的业余天文学家将能够在欧洲和北美以最接近地球的速度在世界协调时0425观测到高速运行的空间碎片。

source_text: 2004 XP14 is named as a Potentially Hazardous Asteroid (PHA), along with 782 known others by Astronomers at the Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory at Harvard.
target_text: 2004年，XP14被命名为一颗潜在危险的小行星（PHA），也是哈佛大学史密森天体物理天文台的天文学家已知的第782颗。

source_text: Zipping about in the solar system no PHAs have yet been found on direct collision course with the Earth.
target_text: 在太阳系中还没有发现直接与地球相撞的行星。

source_text: Still, "For something of this size to come this close is unusual," said Don Yeomans, the head of NASA's Near Earth Object Program.
target_text: 美国宇航局近地天体计划的负责人唐·约曼斯说：“对于这样大小的东西来说，这种情况并不常见。”

source_text: An expert at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Pasadena, California said it was the closest approach by such a massive object for over 80 years - since 1925.
target_text: 美国宇航局位于加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳市的喷气推进实验室的一位专家说，这是自1925年以来的80多年里最接近如此巨大的天体的一次。

source_text: Before 2004 XP14's exact orbital path around the sun was known with more precision, there were concerns it would hit the Earth.
target_text: 在2004年XP14围绕太阳的确切轨道轨道更加精确之前，有人担心它会撞上地球。

source_text: In the near future Jon Giorgini said such cosmic uncertainty would be much less and the public less alarmed.
target_text: 乔恩·乔尔奇尼说，在不久的将来，这样的宇宙不确定性将大大减少，公众也不会那么惊慌。

source_text: "In the next 20 to 30 years, we'll have a complete catalog of hazardous objects," Giorgini said.
target_text: “在未来的20到30年里，我们将有一个完整的危险物品目录，”乔尔奇尼说。

source_text: Edward Lu and Stanley Love, of Johnson Space Centre, Houston, also have allayed fears about a collision.
target_text: 休斯顿约翰逊航天中心的爱德华·卢和斯坦利·洛夫也减轻了人们对撞击的恐惧。

source_text: In a 2005 article in Nature they theorised a "gravity tractor" could move any known threat within a year.
target_text: 在2005年发表于《自然》杂志的一篇文章中，他们提出了一个理论：“重力牵引器”可以在一年内移动任何已知的威胁。

source_text: According to Robert Burns of the Associated Press, U.S. military officials acknowledged that, "a Muslim holy book was splashed with urine," and "a detainee's Quran was deliberately kicked and another's was stepped on."
target_text: 据美联社的罗伯特·伯恩斯称，美国军方官员承认，“一本穆斯林圣典溅满了尿液”，“一名被拘留者的古兰经被故意踢了一脚，另一本被踩了一脚。”

source_text: The US government first denied a specific report that the Qu'ran had been flushed down a toilet at the prison facility, but on Friday agreed that similar allegations were indeed true.
target_text: 美国政府首先否认了一份关于古兰经被冲进监狱厕所的具体报道，但上周五各方一致认为，类似的指控确实属实。

source_text: On May 16, Newsweek magazine apologized to the victims of deadly riots that ensued due to a Newsweek article stating that U.S. officials defiled the Qur'an.
target_text: 5月16日，“新闻周刊”杂志向致命的骚乱受害者道歉，这些骚乱是由于“新闻周刊”的一篇文章说美国官员玷污了古兰经。

source_text: White House Press Secretary Scott McClellan criticized Newsweek's initial response to the incident, saying it was "puzzling."
target_text: 白宫新闻秘书斯科特·麦克莱伦批评了《新闻周刊》对这一事件的最初反应，称这是“令人费解的”。

source_text: Later that day, Newsweek retracted the story, which the White House said was a "good first step".
target_text: 当天晚些时候，《新闻周刊》撤回了这篇报道，白宫称这是“良好的第一步”。

source_text: On May 20, the International Red Cross (IRC) revealed in a rare public announcement that it had documented and reported to the United States credible information concerning desecration of the Qur'an by Guantanamo Bay personnel.
target_text: 5月20日，国际红十字会（IRC）在一份罕见的公开声明中透露，它已经记录并向美国报告了有关关塔那摩湾人员亵渎古兰经的可信信息。

source_text: Pentagon spokesman Bryan Whitman, acknowledged that allegations were made on "rare occasions" but were uncorroborated.
target_text: 五角大楼发言人布赖恩·惠特曼承认，这些指控是在“罕见的情况”下提出的，但没有经过证实。

source_text: Simon Schorno, a Red Cross spokesman, disputed the Pentagon's denial saying, "All information we received were corroborated allegations."
target_text: 红十字会发言人西蒙·索尔诺对五角大楼否认的说法提出异议，“我们收到的所有信息都是有证据的。”

source_text: Scott McClellan explained in a press conference that the White House is not trying to tell Newsweek what to print.
target_text: 斯科特·麦克莱伦在新闻发布会上解释说，白宫并没有试图告诉《新闻周刊》要印刷什么。

source_text: McClellan said, "Look, this report caused serious damage to the image of the United States abroad."
target_text: 麦克莱伦说：“看，这份报告严重损害了美国在海外的形象。”

source_text: "We appreciate the step that they took by retracting the story."
target_text: “我们感谢他们撤回报道的做法。”

source_text: "Now we would encourage them to move forward and do all that they can to help repair the damage that has been done by this report."
target_text: “现在我们鼓励他们继续前进，尽其所能帮助修复本报告所造成的损害。”

source_text: "But, no, you're absolutely right, it's not my position to get into telling people what they can and cannot report."
target_text: “但是，不，你绝对是对的，我的立场不是告诉人们他们能报告什么和不能报告什么。”

source_text: On May 25, Amnesty International called for the shutdown on Guantanamo Bay due to numerous human rights violations, saying "The 'war on terror' appeared more effective in eroding international human rights principles than in countering international 'terrorism'."
target_text: 5月25日，国际特赦组织呼吁关闭关塔那摩湾，原因是该监狱存在大量侵犯人权的行为。该组织称，“‘反恐战争’在侵蚀国际人权原则方面似乎比在打击国际‘恐怖主义’方面更有效。”

source_text: Amnesty International's view was shared by both the International Red Cross (IRC) and the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU).
target_text: 大赦国际的观点得到了国际红十字会（IRC）和美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）的共同认可。

source_text: The IRC has said it reported to the U.S. government detainee's reports of desecration of the Qur'an.
target_text: IRC已经表示它向美国政府报告了有关亵渎古兰经的报道。

source_text: In the foreword of the report, written by Amnesty International Secretary General Irene Khan, Guantanamo was compared to a Soviet-era gulag in that it is "entrenching the practice of arbitrary and indefinite detention in violation of international law".
target_text: 在这份由大赦国际秘书长艾琳·汗撰写的报告前言中，关塔那摩被比作苏联时代的古拉格，因为它“强化了任意无限期拘留的做法，违反了国际法”。

source_text: White House spokesman Scott McClellan responded saying the report's allegations were "ridiculous and unsupported by the facts."
target_text: 白宫发言人斯科特·麦克莱伦回应说，该报告的指控是“荒谬的，没有事实支持”。

source_text: "The United States is leading the way when it comes to protecting human rights and promoting human dignity."
target_text: “美国在保护人权和促进人类尊严方面处于领先地位。”

source_text: "We have liberated 50 million people in Iraq and Afghanistan."
target_text: “我们在伊拉克和阿富汗解放了5000万人。”

source_text: About the allegations of abuse at Guantanamo, which McClellan has previously called isolated incidents, he said, "We hold people accountable when there is abuse."
target_text: 麦克莱伦此前曾将关塔那摩湾虐囚事件称为孤立事件。在谈到这些指控时，麦克莱伦说：“当虐囚事件发生时，我们会追究人们的责任。”

source_text: "We take steps to prevent it from happening again, and we do so in a very public way for the world to see that we lead by example, and that we do have values that we hold very dearly and believe in."
target_text: “我们采取措施防止它再次发生，我们以一种非常公开的方式这样做，让世界看到我们以身作则，我们确实拥有我们非常珍视并相信的价值观。”

source_text: "The United States is a country that promotes freedom around the world," Bush said of the Amnesty International report.
target_text: “美国是一个促进全世界自由的国家，”布什在大赦国际的报告中说。

source_text: William F. Schulz, executive director of Amnesty International USA, defended the report, saying, "What is 'absurd' is President Bush's attempt to deny the deliberate policies of his administration."
target_text: 美国大赦国际执行主任威廉·舒尔茨为该报告辩护说，“荒谬的是，布什总统试图否认他的政府的蓄意政策。”

source_text: Irene Khan also responded saying, "The administration's response has been that our report is absurd, that our allegations have no basis, and our answer is very simple: if that is so, open up these detention centres, allow us and others to visit them."
target_text: 艾琳·汗也回应说：“政府的回应是，我们的报告是荒谬的，我们的指控没有根据，我们的回答非常简单：如果是这样，就开放这些拘留中心，允许我们和其他人参观。”

source_text: And, on Friday, the U.S. military released the results of their investigation and confirmed that in 5 separate incidents, American guards at the Guantánamo Bay prison "mishandled" the Islamic holy book.
target_text: 星期五，美国军方公布了他们的调查结果，证实在5起单独的事件中，关塔那摩湾监狱的美国看守“错误地处理”了伊斯兰教的圣经。

source_text: However, they stress that guards were usually "respectful" of the Qur'an.
target_text: 然而，他们强调警卫通常“尊重”古兰经。

source_text: Brigadier-General Jay Hood, the commander of the jail, looked into the allegations, published and then retracted by Newsweek, that American personnel flushed a Qur'an down a toilet.
target_text: 监狱指挥官杰伊·胡德准将调查了《新闻周刊》发布并随后撤回的指控，即美国人员将古兰经扔进马桶。

source_text: He said that the inquiry did not find any evidence supporting this particular allegation.
target_text: 他说，调查没有找到任何支持这一特定指控的证据。

source_text: "The inquiry found no credible evidence that a member of the Joint Task Force at Guantanamo Bay ever flushed a Qur'an down a toilet."
target_text: “调查没有发现任何可信的证据表明关塔那摩湾的联合特遣部队成员曾将古兰经扔进马桶。”

source_text: A 'terrorist attack' took place yesterday in the form of reportedly at least four explosions at the Mahabodhi Temple in Bodh Gaya, India.
target_text: 昨天发生了一起“恐怖袭击事件”，据报道，印度菩提伽耶的摩诃菩提寺发生了至少四起爆炸事件。

source_text: Four other explosions took place in the vicinity, including one near an eighty-foot tall statue of Buddha and three at Tergar Monastery.
target_text: 附近还发生了四起爆炸事件，其中一起发生在八十英尺高的佛像附近，三处发生在特尔加寺。

source_text: Early reports claim little damage was done to the temple.
target_text: 早期报道声称对寺庙造成的损害很小。

source_text: Police commented that Sundays are quiet days at the temple, or more could have been injured.
target_text: 警方表示，周日寺庙里很安静，否则可能有更多人受伤。

source_text: One suspect has been arrested based on closed circuit television that recorded two men placing bombs at the temple.
target_text: 根据闭路电视记录，两名男子在寺庙放置炸弹，一名嫌疑人已被逮捕。

source_text: Mahabodhi Temple is considered one of the holiest sites in Buddhism and in India.
target_text: 摩诃菩提寺被认为是佛教和印度最神圣的地方之一。

source_text: The temple is located next to the Bodhi tree, where Buddhists believe that Buddha achieved enlightenment.
target_text: 寺庙坐落在菩提树旁，佛教徒认为佛陀就是在这里悟道的。

source_text: The bombs were described as "low-intensity but not crude," according to police.
target_text: 据警方称，这些炸弹被描述为“强度低但不粗糙”。

source_text: The bombs used comprised of a small container with gas, a detonator, and an analog clock.
target_text: 使用的炸弹包括一个带有气体的小容器，一个雷管和一个模拟时钟。

source_text: The bombs were timed to explode at 5:45 AM local time, when Buddhists start praying in the morning.
target_text: 爆炸时间定在当地时间早上5点45分，也就是佛教徒早上开始祈祷的时候。

source_text: The bombs actually went off starting at 5:25 AM and ending at 5:58 AM local time.
target_text: 炸弹实际上是在当地时间早上5点25分开始爆炸，在当地时间早上5点58分结束。

source_text: 200 monks live at the monastery, where daily classes take place during the times when the explosions happened.
target_text: 这座寺庙里住着200名僧侣，爆炸发生时，每天都要在这里上课。

source_text: However, no classes were being held the morning of the attack.
target_text: 然而，袭击发生的当天上午没有上课。

source_text: The Ministry of Home Affairs has declared the explosions an act of terrorism.
target_text: 内政部宣布爆炸是一种恐怖主义行为。

source_text: That led to the arrests of four suspects involved in the Indian Mujahideen, who were believed to have been involved in the 2012 Pune bombings.
target_text: 这导致四名涉嫌参与2012年普纳爆炸案的印度圣战者被捕。

source_text: The four suspects named other members of the terrorist group and claimed that they planned to attack Mahabodhi Temple.
target_text: 这四名嫌疑人指名道姓地说出了该恐怖组织的其他成员，并声称他们计划袭击摩诃菩提寺。

source_text: The police in Delhi claim to have told the police in Bihar about the potential of a terrorist attack.
target_text: 德里的警察声称已经告诉比哈尔邦警方有关恐怖袭击的可能性。

source_text: Political conflict has risen in the wake of the attacks between the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and Indian National Congress.
target_text: 在印度人民党（印度人民党）和印度国民议会发生袭击之后，政治冲突已经上升。

source_text: BJP is accusing the United Progressive Alliance, which is under the umbrella of the Indian National Congress, of ignoring the Indian Mujahideen's threats about attacking the temple.
target_text: 印度人民党指责印度国民大会制下的团结进步联盟无视印度圣战者袭击寺庙的威胁。

source_text: The Ministry also believes that it could be tied to conflicts in Myanmar between Buddhists and Muslims, despite the rarity of violence against Buddhists in India.
target_text: 佛教事务部还认为，这可能与缅甸佛教徒和穆斯林之间的冲突有关，尽管印度很少发生针对佛教徒的暴力事件。

source_text: Additional security has been placed at Buddhist temples and Tibetan communities in India after the explosions.
target_text: 爆炸发生后，印度的佛教寺庙和藏族社区加强了安保。

source_text: One suspect, Vinod Mistri, was arrested on Monday morning in Patna.
target_text: 其中一名嫌疑人维诺德·米斯特里周一上午在巴特那被捕。

source_text: Two dog attacks in a week puts Spotsylvania County authorities in the spotlight to take action on pet owners for their dog's behavior.
target_text: 斯波特西瓦尼亚县当局在一周内发生了两起犬类袭击事件，人们纷纷将矛头指向宠物主人，要求他们对宠物狗的行为采取行动。

source_text: In unrelated incidences, an elderly woman was killed and another woman was bitten.
target_text: 在无关的两个事件中，一名老妇被杀，另一名妇女被咬伤。

source_text: An 82 year old woman was walking her Shih Tzu breed of dog in her front yard last week when she came under attack by three Pit Bulls.
target_text: 上周，一位82岁的老妇人在自家前院遛她的西施犬时，遭到了三只比特犬的攻击。

source_text: She died being transported to the hospital after police responded and shot two of the attacking dogs.
target_text: 她在被送往医院的途中死亡，当时警方做出了回应，并开枪打死了两条攻击她的狗。

source_text: More recently, a 31 year old woman was bitten on her hand during a fight that ensued between two Pit Bulls in her back yard.
target_text: 最近，一名31岁的妇女在她的后院与两头比特犬打斗时被咬伤了手。

source_text: Public outcry over the death of the elderly woman stirred procecutors to charge the dogs' owner, Deeana Large, with involuntary manslaughter.
target_text: 公众对老妇人死亡的强烈抗议，促使遗嘱执行人指控狗的主人迪安娜·莫吉犯有过失杀人罪。

source_text: This is a first for the Commonwealth of Virginia where charges that carry a maximum penalty of 10 years are leveled in a case involving a pet's owner.
target_text: 这是弗吉尼亚州首次对涉及宠物主人的案件提出最高可判处10年监禁的指控。

source_text: In order to gain an indictment, prosecuters will have to prove the dogs' owner was criminally negligent.
target_text: 为了获得起诉，控方必须证明狗的主人有刑事过失。

source_text: In the biting incident, the attacking dog's owner faces a misdemeanor charge of letting the dog run at large.
target_text: 在咬人事件中，攻击狗的主人面临着让狗自由奔跑的轻罪指控。

source_text: Deeana Large, who initially said she owned only 1 of the 3 dogs involved in the mauling case, has not yet been formally charged and awaits indictment.
target_text: 迪安娜·玛格最初表示，她只拥有参与这起伤人案件的3只狗中的1只，目前尚未受到正式指控，正等待起诉。

source_text: Investigators in the case say there were earlier reports of her dogs allegedly killing a German Shepard and a kittten in her neighborhood.
target_text: 调查此案的人员表示，早些时候有报道称，她的狗杀死了她家附近的一只德国牧羊犬和一只小猫。

source_text: Complaints by neighbors spurred an animal control officer to be looking for the dogs at the time the woman was killed.
target_text: 邻居的投诉促使一名动物管制人员在该名女子被杀时正在寻找这些狗。

source_text: On September 26, United States Representative Duncan Hunter (R-Calif.) introduced a bill to prohibit federal grants to Columbia University in response to Columbia's decision to allow Iran's President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad to speak on campus.
target_text: 9月26日，美国众议员邓肯·亨特（加州共和党人）提出一项法案，禁止联邦拨款给哥伦比亚大学，以回应哥伦比亚政府允许伊朗总统马哈茂德·艾哈迈迪内贾德在校园内发言的决定。

source_text: The bill arrived at the House of Representatives within two days after the speaking engagement.
target_text: 这项议案是在会谈开始后两天内送到众议院的。

source_text: A portion of the bill requests a denial of funds to the University, "for permitting State terrorist access to campus."
target_text: 法案的一部分要求拒绝向该大学提供资金，因为“以允许国家恐怖分子进入校园”。

source_text: Iran's parliament, in September this year, labelled the U.S. forces as terrorists.
target_text: 伊朗议会今年9月将美国军队称为恐怖分子。

source_text: Hunter, who is seeking the Republican Presidential nomination, argued in favor of the bill last week.
target_text: 正在寻求共和党总统候选人提名的亨特上周支持这项法案。

source_text: "If the left-wing leaders of academia will not support our troops, they, in the very least, should not support our adversaries," he said.
target_text: “如果学术界的左翼领导人不支持我们的军队，他们至少不应该支持我们的对手，”他说。

source_text: Prior to Ahmedinejad's speech, U.S. President George W. Bush expressed a different view, saying that Columbia's invitation "really speaks to the freedoms of the country."
target_text: 在艾哈迈迪内贾德发表讲话之前，美国总统乔治·W·布什表达了不同的看法，称哥伦比亚的邀请“真正说明了国家的自由”。

source_text: "I'm not so sure I'd offer the same invitation, but nevertheless, it speaks volumes about the greatness, really, of America."
target_text: “我不确定我是否会发出同样的邀请，但无论如何，这充分说明了美国的伟大，真的。”

source_text: "We're confident enough to let a person express his views," he said.
target_text: “我们有足够的信心让一个人表达自己的观点，”他说。

source_text: University of Oregon football's star running back, LeGarrette Blount, was suspended for the remainder of the season – and thereby the remainder of his college football career – after punching an opposing player after the opening game.
target_text: 俄勒冈大学足球队的明星跑卫，勒加雷特·布朗特，在首场比赛后打了对方球员，在本赛季余下的时间里，也就是他大学足球生涯的余下时间里，被停赛了。

source_text: The University of Oregon Ducks opened their 2009 season with a 19–8 loss to rival Boise State Broncos.
target_text: 俄勒冈大学鸭子队以19比8输给对手博伊西州立野马队，开启了他们的2009赛季。

source_text: The high-profile game was nationally televised on the ESPN network.
target_text: 这部备受瞩目的比赛在ESPN网络全国播出。

source_text: The volatile Blount, coming off a 1,000+ yard season in which he broke a school record for rushing touchdowns, had struggled in several 2008 games, including the encounter with the Broncos.
target_text: 在经历了一个超过1000码的赛季，他打破了学校的快速触地记录后，这个反复无常的布朗特在2008年的几场比赛中都表现不佳，包括与野马队的比赛。

source_text: The Broncos, however, won 19–8 in their home field; and Blount and Oregon's offense failed to achieve a single first down for the game's first 37 minutes.
target_text: 然而，野马队在主场以19比8获胜；布朗特和俄勒冈队的进攻在比赛的前37分钟连一次触地得分都没有。

source_text: A few seconds after the end of the game, Boise State defensive end Byron Hout taunted Blount and pushed him on the shoulder pad.
target_text: 比赛结束几秒钟后，博伊西州防守端拜伦·豪特嘲笑了布朗特，并推了推他的肩垫。

source_text: But Blount responded with a swift punch to the jaw, knocking Hout to the ground.
target_text: 但布朗特迅速一拳打在他的下巴上，把他击倒在地。

source_text: Blount then pushed teammate Garrett Embry, who was attempting to restrain him.
target_text: 布朗特推了推队友加勒特·恩布里，恩布里正试图阻止他。

source_text: Boise State replayed the punch on their large screen in the end-zone multiple times, before Blount had returned to the locker room.
target_text: 在布朗特回到更衣室之前，博伊西州立大学在终端区的大屏幕上反复播放了这一拳。

source_text: As he was escorted to the locker room, Blount confronted jeering Boise State fans.
target_text: 当布朗特被护送到更衣室时，他遇到了博伊西州球迷的嘲笑。

source_text: Two police officers and Oregon assistant coach Scott Frost restrained Blount and escorted him into the locker room.
target_text: 两名警官和俄勒冈州助理教练斯科特·弗罗斯特将布朗特制服，并护送他进入更衣室。

source_text: Blount apologized after the incident, saying: "I just apologize to everybody that was watching this — ESPN, national TV — I just apologize to all of our fans, all the Boise fans."
target_text: 布朗特在事件发生后表示道歉，他说：“我向所有观看比赛的人道歉——ESPN、国家电视台——我向我们所有的球迷道歉，向博伊西的球迷道歉。”

source_text: "I lost my head, and I shouldn't have taken it that far."
target_text: “我失去了理智，我不应该这么做。”

source_text: Coach Chip Kelly suspended Blount for the remainder of the 2009 season.
target_text: 教练奇普·凯利在2009赛季余下的时间里停赛了布朗特。

source_text: Blount was not dismissed from the team, however, and will be permitted to attend practice and retain his scholarship.
target_text: 然而，布朗特没有被球队解雇，并且将被允许参加练习并保留他的奖学金。

source_text: The incident was seen an important test for a leadership team in its first year.
target_text: 这一事件被视为领导团队第一年的重要考验。

source_text: According to Oregon Athletic Director Mike Bellotti, the fact that the incident occurred after the game's conclusion made it the team's responsibility, rather than a Pac-10 issue.
target_text: 根据俄勒冈州体育总监迈克·贝洛蒂的说法，事件发生在赛事结束后的事实使得球队有责任，而不是太平洋十联盟（Pac-10）问题。

source_text: Kelly, Bellotti, and University of Oregon President Lariviere had each just entered the first year of his position.
target_text: 凯利、贝洛蒂和俄勒冈大学校长拉里维埃刚刚上任一年。

source_text: Pac-10 Commissioner Larry Scott, also in his first year, was in attendance at the game.
target_text: PAC-10的专员拉里·斯科特也在第一年参加了比赛。

source_text: He consulted with Oregon officials in advance of Blount's suspension, and afterward, the Pac-10 expressed complete support for the suspension, while declining to comment on the Broncos, who are not part of the Pac-10.
target_text: 在布朗特被禁赛之前，他与俄勒冈州官员进行了磋商，之后，Pac-10表达了对禁赛的完全支持，同时拒绝对野马队发表评论，因为野马队不是Pac-10的成员。

source_text: As a result of his negative rushing total (-5 yards) in the one game he played in the 2009 season prior to the suspension, combined with 1,002 yards in 2008, Blount holds the unusual distinction of having a 1,000-yard season with the Ducks, but less than 1,000 yards over his entire NCAA career.
target_text: 由于在停赛前的2009赛季，布朗特在一场比赛中的冲刺总成绩为负（-5码），加上2008年的1002码，布朗特在与鸭子的比赛中有着1000码的赛季，但在他整个NCAA生涯中，这场比赛的冲刺总成绩还不到1000码。

source_text: Attackers raided bus stations and seized travellers and local vendors.
target_text: 袭击者袭击了公共汽车站，并抓获了旅行者和当地商贩。

source_text: This happened a day after 21 people were dragged off buses and killed in Diyala province.
target_text: 一天前，迪亚拉省有21人被从公交车上拖下来，并被杀害。

source_text: Of the 50 people, there are two Syrians and one is an Interior Ministry official.
target_text: 在50人中，有两名叙利亚人，一名是内政部官员。

source_text: The gunmen rounded up people from the area including people from the many travel agencies that populate the area.
target_text: 枪手围捕了该地区的人，包括该地区许多旅行社的人。

source_text: The people were then herded into cars and taken away.
target_text: 然后人们被赶进汽车并被带走。

source_text: "They took all the workers from the company and nearby shops," says Haidar Mohammed Eleibi, who works for the Swan Transportation Co. in the Salihiya business district.
target_text: “他们把公司和附近商店的所有工人都带走了，”在萨利希亚商业区天鹅运输公司工作的海达尔·穆罕默德·埃莱比说。

source_text: Most of the buses at the station were headed to Jordan, Syria and Lebanon.
target_text: 车站的大多数公共汽车都前往约旦，叙利亚和黎巴嫩。

source_text: NB this subject is also covered in Gmail 1st Birthday; Storage capacity increased to 2GB
target_text: 注意，这个主题也包括在Gmail第一个生日；存储容量增加到2GB。

source_text: On the first anniversary of Gmail's release, Google has announced that it will increase the amount of storage available for the users of the web-based email service from 1 GB to over 2 GB.
target_text: 在Gmail发布一周年之际，谷歌宣布将把基于网络的电子邮件服务用户的可用存储量从1GB增加到2GB以上。

source_text: According to a page at the Gmail Help Center, while not all accounts currently have the formatting features added, "over the next several weeks, we are introducing rich formatting to all of our users."
target_text: 根据Gmail帮助中心的一个页面，虽然并非所有帐户都添加了格式化功能，但“在接下来的几周内，我们会向所有用户引入丰富的格式。”

source_text: The increase in storage is announced on the main Gmail page with a JavaScript counter that increases the quoted available storage in relation to the current date.
target_text: 存储的增加是在主Gmail页面上宣布的，其中包含一个JavaScript计数器，它根据当前日期增加引用的可用存储。

source_text: For example, on April 1 at 5 a.m. UTC the site announced 1025 MB available, 30 hours later — 2050 MB, and a week later it should announce a total of 2075 MB.
target_text: 例如，在UTC时间4月1日凌晨5点，该站点宣布可用1025MB，30小时后为2050MB，一周后应该宣布总数为2075MB。

source_text: Unless Google adjusts the code behind the counter, the text will read "Over 2075" after April 9.
target_text: 除非谷歌调整计数器后面的代码，否则4月9日后的文本将显示“超过2075”。

source_text: As many as six hundred villagers from the island of Taiwan are missing after torrential rains from Typhoon Morakot caused mudslides, according to state media.
target_text: 据官方媒体报道，台风莫拉克暴雨导致泥石流暴雨后，台湾岛上有多达600名村民失踪。

source_text: Taiwanese authorities said that approximately a hundred people were rescued after a portion of a mountain started to slump and flooded the village of Shiao Lin in the south of the country.
target_text: 台湾当局说，一部分山峰开始坍塌，淹没了该地区南部的萧林村，大约有一百人获救。

source_text: "The mudslide covered a large part of the village, including a primary school and many homes."
target_text: “泥石流覆盖了村庄的大部分，包括一所小学和许多家庭。”

source_text: "A part of the mountain above us just fell on the village," said a rescued villager, Lin Chen-chung.
target_text: 获救的村民林振中说：“我们上方的一座山的一部分刚刚落在村子里。”

source_text: Several Villages Taitung County also suffered severe flooding caused by the rains.
target_text: 台东县的几个村庄也遭受了暴雨引发的严重洪灾。

source_text: A five-story hotel building along the river in Taitung has collapsed due to the raging flood.
target_text: 台东河沿岸的一幢五层楼的酒店大楼因洪水泛滥而坍塌。

source_text: In some areas of the country, the storm dumped as much as two metres of water.
target_text: 在该地的一些地区，风暴带来了高达两米的洪水。

source_text: Morakot has resulted in the deaths of at least fourteen people in Taiwan and a further 22 deaths in the Philippines.
target_text: 莫拉克台风已造成台湾至少14人死亡，菲律宾另有22人死亡。

source_text: According to Iranian state run media, current Iranian president Mahmoud Ahmadinejad has won re-election by a margin of 2 to 1.
target_text: 据伊朗官方媒体报道，伊朗现任总统马哈茂德·艾哈迈迪内贾德以2比1的优势再次当选。

source_text: According to the reports, the country's interior minister says Ahmadinejad won with 66% of the votes counted so far in the nation's election on Friday.
target_text: 据报道，该国内政部长表示，艾哈迈迪内贾德星期五在全国大选中获得了66％的选票。

source_text: One of Ahmadinejad opponents Mir Hossein Mousavi, had earlier declared himself "definitely" the winner and said he may dispute the results.
target_text: 艾哈迈迪内贾德的反对者之一穆萨维早些时候曾宣称自己“肯定”获胜，并说他可能会对选举结果提出异议。

source_text: At present, there are unconfirmed reports that Mir Hossein Mousavi may have been detained by "members of the intelligence community".
target_text: 目前，有未经证实的报道说，米尔·侯赛因·穆萨维可能被“情报人员”拘留。

source_text: In addition, there are unconfirmed reports that Mousavi's Tehran campaign headquarters was surrounded by the intelligence service as well.
target_text: 此外，有未经证实的报道说，穆萨维的德黑兰竞选总部也被情报机构包围。

source_text: Mousavi's supporters have taken to the streets of Tehran to protest the election results.
target_text: 穆萨维的支持者走上德黑兰街头抗议选举结果。

source_text: An Amtrak train collided with a parked Norfolk Southern freight train in Chicago on Friday.
target_text: 周五，一辆美铁列车与一辆停在芝加哥的诺福克南方货运列车相撞。

source_text: 30 people were injured, five of them Amtrak personnel who were most seriously injured.
target_text: 30人受伤，其中5人是美铁人员，伤势最严重。

source_text: Amtrak train 371, the Pere Marquette, started in Grand Rapids, Michigan and carried 193 people on board including six crew members.
target_text: 美铁371号列车“皮埃·马盖特”从密歇根州大急流城出发，载有193名乘客，其中包括6名机组人员。

source_text: The train was in south Chicago heading towards its destination of Chicago Union Station when the crash occurred around 17:30 UTC.
target_text: 事故发生在世界时17：30左右，当时这列火车正在南芝加哥开往目的地芝加哥联合车站。

source_text: No injuries were reported among the crew of the Norfolk Southern freight train.
target_text: 诺福克南方货运列车的船员没有受伤。

source_text: Amtrak's locomotive, a GE Genesis, was derailed by the force of the impact, although the rest of the passenger train remained on the tracks.
target_text: 美国铁路公司的一辆通用电气创世纪机车在撞击力的作用下脱轨，不过其他乘客列车仍在轨道上。

source_text: All Amtrak trains between Chicago and Michigan are currently cancelled while workers remove the locomotive from the scene and perform any needed repairs.
target_text: 目前，美铁芝加哥至密歇根州之间的所有列车都被取消，工人们将火车头移出现场，进行必要的维修。

source_text: A National Transportation Safety Board "Go Team" led by Ted Turpin was dispatched to the scene to conduct a federal investigation into the crash.
target_text: 美国国家运输安全委员会派出由特德·特平领导的“加油小组”前往事故现场，对事故进行联邦调查。

source_text: According to the National Institute of Standards and Technology, Daylight Saving Time will end on November 4, 2007 at 2:00 a.m. local time for most of the United States and Canada.
target_text: 据美国国家标准与技术研究所称，美国和加拿大大部分地区的夏令时将于2007年11月4日当地时间凌晨2点结束。

source_text: This change is different from previous years due to a U.S. mandated daylight saving time change, which was caused by the Energy Policy Act of 2005.
target_text: 这一变化与前几年有所不同，因为美国2005年通过的《能源政策法案》规定了夏令时的变化。

source_text: The next change to regular Daylight Saving Time will be in 2038.
target_text: 常规夏令时的下一个变化将在2038年。

source_text: The number of laboratory-confirmed cases of H1N1 swine flu virus in Fiji rose to 97 on Thursday.
target_text: 周四，斐济实验室确诊的H1N1猪流感病毒病例数增加到97例。

source_text: A further 16 cases were confirmed by the laboratory at Mataika House, one day after it had confirmed 8 cases to bring the total to 81.
target_text: 马泰卡房实验室在确认了8例病例后的第二天又确认了16例，使总数达到81例。

source_text: Both sets of cases were confirmed from batches of 24 samples sent for testing.
target_text: 两组病例均从24个送检样品批次中得到确认。

source_text: The 8 cases confirmed on Wednesday were all men, 7 from Suva and 1 from Nadi.
target_text: 周三确诊的8例患者均为男性，7例来自苏瓦，1例来自纳迪。

source_text: All 16 of the cases confirmed on Thursday were from Suva, 8 men and 8 women.
target_text: 周四确认的所有16例病例均来自苏瓦，8名男性和8名女性。

source_text: The spokesman for the Fiji Health Ministry, Iliesa Tora, reiterated the Fijian government's advice to the public, stating that as yet there have been no H1N1 cases in Fiji that have incurred serious complications.
target_text: 斐济卫生部发言人伊利萨·托拉重申了斐济政府对公众的建议，他说，迄今为止，斐济目前还没有出现引起严重并发症的H1N1病例。

source_text: 2008 COMPUTEX, famed as the 2nd-largest ICT trade show in the world, started today at the Taipei World Trade Center, Taipei International Convention Center, and TWTC Nangang with 1725 companies' participation including top 5 nations - Hong Kong, South Korea, China, France, and Japan.
target_text: 2008年台北国际电脑展，被誉为全球第二大ICT贸易展，今天在台北世贸中心、台北国际会议中心开幕，TWTC南港有1725家公司参与，其中包括香港、韩国、中国、法国、日本五大国家。

source_text: This year of COMPUTEX has some special features including "Design and Innovation Award of COMPUTEX", set to discover innovative designs world-wide, "Environment-related topics", highly respected by environmentalists and industrial businesspeople with many ICT products related to energy-efficiency and green technology showcased at "Mega Trends Pavilion".
target_text: 本届国际电脑展的特色包括旨在探索世界范围内的创新设计的“国际电脑展设计创新奖”、深受许多与能效相关的ICT产品打交道的环保人士和业界人士推崇的“环境相关主题”以及在“大趋势展馆”展出的绿色技术重。

source_text: With another concurrent trade show - "2008 WiMAX Expo Taipei", located at Taipei Show Hall 2, Taipei Computer Association, one of the show organizers, will mainly promote the "WING"-conceptual products like WiMAX, ICT crossovers, Notebooks, and Green IT products this year.
target_text: 另一个同时举办的贸易展-“2008年台北Wimax博览会”，位于台北市计算机协会第二展厅。该协会是展会组织者之一，今年将主要推广Wimax、ICT交叉、笔记本电脑和绿色IT产品等“翼”概念产品。

source_text: In addition, DRAMeXchange Compuforum, e21Forum, Taiwan Design Forum, and Next Generation Network Forum will be held in conjunction with the COMPUTEX to attract international businesspeople from vast industries.
target_text: 此外，台北国际电脑展还将联合举办“戏剧交流国际电脑展”、“e21国际电脑展”、“台湾设计论坛”和“下一代网络论坛”，以吸引来自各行各业的国际商务人士。

source_text: At least two people have died at a Cypriot army aircraft crash in the village of Kolossi this morning, west of the island's southern coastal town of Limassol.
target_text: 今天早上，塞浦路斯南部沿海城镇利马索尔以西的科洛西村庄发生军用飞机坠毁事故，造成至少两人死亡。

source_text: Kolossi is a community of some 2,000 Britons, Germans and Cypriots.
target_text: 科洛西是一个由大约2000名英国人、德国人和塞浦路斯人组成的社区。

source_text: Director of the President's Press Office Marios Karoyan told CNA that the aircraft was a PC - 9 (Pilatus).
target_text: 总统新闻办公室主任马里奥斯·卡洛扬告诉CNA，这架飞机是一架PC-9（皮拉图斯）。

source_text: It is one of the two training military aircraft of the National Guard (Cyprus Army) and according to the first reports two people have died, believed to be the two pilots.
target_text: 它是国民警卫队（塞浦路斯军队）的两架训练军用飞机之一，根据第一份报告，有两人死亡，据信是两名飞行员。

source_text: Steve Wright, yesterday convicted of the murder of five women in Ipswich, Suffolk, England, has today been sentenced at Ipswich Crown Court to life imprisonment.
target_text: 史蒂夫·赖特，昨天在英格兰萨福克伊普斯维奇被判谋杀五名妇女，今天在伊普斯维奇刑事法院被判处无期徒刑。

source_text: The bodies of the five women who worked as sex workers in Ipswich were found around the town in December 2006.
target_text: 2006年12月，在伊普斯威奇做性工作者的五名妇女的尸体被发现。

source_text: The judge, Mr Justice Gross said that a "substantial degree of pre-meditation and planning" was involved meaning the requirments for a whole life sentence for Wright was met.
target_text: 法官格罗斯表示，此案涉及“相当程度的事先周密考虑和计划”，这意味着符合赖特被判终身监禁的条件。

source_text: "It is right you should spend your whole life in prison."
target_text: “你应该在狱中度过一生，这是对的。”

source_text: Speaking after the sentencing, Deputy Chief Constable of Suffolk Police, Jacqui Cheer said, "At the start of the inquiry we could not have asked for anything more."
target_text: 萨福克郡警察局副局长杰基·多莱在宣判后表示，“在调查开始时，我们不可能要求更多。”

source_text: "It is a tribute to all the people who have been involved - not only police officers but their support teams and all the members of the public who phoned-in offering information."
target_text: “这是对所有参与其中的人的敬意-不仅是警察，还有他们的支持团队和所有打电话提供信息的公众成员。”

source_text: A recent scientific review, involving more than 300,000 people across several previous studies, has revealed that inadequate social networking and frequent isolation can have negative effects on a person's health equal to that caused by smoking and alcohol abuse.
target_text: 最近一项涉及30多万人的科学研究表明，社交网络不足和频繁的孤立对一个人的健康造成的负面影响，可能与吸烟和酗酒造成的影响相当。

source_text: It was found that those who experience sufficient social interactions were 50 per cent more likely to be alive when re-examined eight years later than those who were more socially isolated.
target_text: 研究发现，那些经历过充分社交互动的人，在8年后再次接受调查时，比那些社交孤立的人活下来的可能性高出百分之五十。

source_text: The scientists on the project ranked having low-quality relationships with friends and family as equivalent to frequent substance abuse (that is to say, 15 cigarettes a day or heavy alcohol consumption) but worse for a person's health than not participating in exercise and being obese.
target_text: 参与该项目的科学家们将与朋友和家人的低质量关系等同于频繁的药物滥用（也就是说，每天15支烟或大量饮酒），但与不锻炼和肥胖的人相比，这对一个健康的人来说更为糟糕。

source_text: Timothy Smith, project leader from Brigham Young University (BYU), in Utah, claims that "the importance of having a network of friends and good family relationships is comparable to quitting smoking and exceeds many risk factors of mortality such as obesity, physical inactivity."
target_text: 犹他州杨百翰大学（BYU）项目负责人蒂莫西·史密斯声称，“拥有一个朋友网络和良好的家庭关系的重要性与戒烟相当，并且超过了许多死亡的危险因素，如肥胖、缺乏体育锻炼。”

source_text: Related studies have shown that quality relationships stimulate mental and physical health.
target_text: 相关研究表明，良好的人际关系能促进身心健康。

source_text: Smith went onto suggest that General Practitioners should also examine a patient's social network to promote good health.
target_text: 史密斯接着建议全科医生也应该检查病人的社交网络来促进健康。

source_text: "Physicians, health professionals, educators and the public media take risk factors such as smoking, diet and exercise seriously."
target_text: “医生、健康专家、教育工作者和公共媒体都很重视吸烟、节食和锻炼中的风险因素。”

source_text: "The data presented here make a compelling case for social relationship factors to be added to that list," he continued.
target_text: 他继续说道：“这里提供的数据为将社会关系因素加入这一名单提供了一个令人信服的理由。”

source_text: He was today released on bail after a court appearance.
target_text: 他在今天出庭后获准保释。

source_text: Edward Woollard, who is studying A-levels in Philosophy, Politics, and Classics, at Brockenhurst College in the New Forest, attended last Wednesday's student protests in London, before following a crowd of around 200 students into the Tory HQ and making it to the building's roof, whilst the rest of the building was vandalised.
target_text: 爱德华·伍拉德正在新森林的布罗肯赫斯特学院学习哲学、政治和古典文学的A级课程，他参加了上周三在伦敦举行的学生抗议活动，随后跟随大约200名学生进入保守党总部，到达大楼的屋顶，而大楼的其余部分遭到破坏。

source_text: Watched by thousands of students gathered outside, a fire extinguisher was thrown from the roof, giving glancing blows to two police officers on the ground 70 feet (21 metres) below.
target_text: 在数千名学生聚集在外面的注视下，一个灭火器从屋顶上被扔了下来，砸向70英尺（21米）以下地面上的两名警官。

source_text: The sixth-form student, who was wanted on suspicion of attempted murder earlier this week, handed himself in at his local police station and was taken to Belgravia police station for questioning.
target_text: 这名六年级学生本周早些时候因涉嫌谋杀未遂而被通缉，他在当地警察局自首，随后被带到贝尔格拉维亚警察局接受审问。

source_text: Today, he appeared at Westminster Magistrates' Court charged with violent disorder, speaking only to confirm his name age and address.
target_text: 今天，他在威斯敏斯特地方法院出庭，被指控有暴力行为，但他只是确认了自己的姓名、年龄和地址。

source_text: His lawyer, Matthew Foot, sought adjournment to examine video evidence, and the trial was adjourned until 24 November.
target_text: 他的律师马修·富特要求休庭以审查录像证据，审判被推迟到11月24日。

source_text: Until then, Woollard has been granted bail, on condition that he remains at his current address, and does not enter the City of Westminster.
target_text: 在此之前，伍拉德已经获准保释，条件是他必须留在目前的住所，而且不能进入威斯敏斯特市。

source_text: India's 2011 census reports that its population has increased by 181 million in the span of one decade, a figure 17.6 percent greater than 2001.
target_text: 印度2011年人口普查报告称，其人口在十年内增加了1.81亿，比2001年增加了17.6％。

source_text: The census results, publicised today, show the population of India now stands at 1.21 billion.
target_text: 今天公布的人口普查结果显示，印度人口目前为12.1亿。

source_text: C. Chandramauli, the commissioner of the census, said India's population represents "over 17 percent of the world population, [while] India is 2.4 percent of the world’s surface area."
target_text: 印度人口普查局局长钱德拉莫里说，印度人口“占世界人口的17％以上，而印度的国土面积只占世界的2.4％。”

source_text: According to BBC News Online, the current population of the country is in excess of the populations of Pakistan, Indonesia, Bangladesh, Brazil and the United States put together.
target_text: 据英国广播公司在线新闻报道，该国目前的人口超过了巴基斯坦、印度尼西亚、孟加拉国、巴西和美国的人口总和。

source_text: While India's population has increased by more than 17 percent since the 2001 census, this growth rate is the lowest since India achieved independence in 1947.
target_text: 自2001年人口普查以来，印度人口增长了17％以上，而这一增长率是自1947年印度实现独立以来的最低增幅。

source_text: Between 1991 and 2011, the population growth rate has steadily decreased.
target_text: 1991年至2011年间，人口增长率稳步下降。

source_text: Approximately 25 percent of Indians over the age of seven were found to be illiterate in the 2011 census, a decrease of 10 percent from the census held ten years ago.
target_text: 在2011年的人口普查中，大约25％的7岁以上的印度人被认为是文盲，比十年前的人口普查减少了10％。

source_text: The increase in literate females is greater than that of males, the new census reports.
target_text: 新的人口普查报告称，识字女性的增加幅度大于男性。

source_text: The findings have suggested a preference of male over female children.
target_text: 研究结果表明，男孩比女孩更受欢迎。

source_text: For every one thousand boys below the age of seven, there were 914 girls, a decrease from the 2001 census, which reported 927 female for every one thousand male children.
target_text: 每1000名7岁以下的男孩中就有914名女孩，比2001年的人口普查数据有所下降，2001年的人口普查报告显示每1000名男性儿童中有927名女性。

source_text: "This is the lowest ever in the demographic history of the country," he said, and noted "[t]he last census in 2001 had warned us about this, the tendency has worsened."
target_text: “这是该国人口历史上有史以来最低的，”他说，并指出“2001年的上次人口普查已经警告过我们，这种趋势已经恶化了。”

source_text: This pattern continues although the Indian government has prohibited hospitals from disclosing the gender of an unborn child.
target_text: 尽管印度政府禁止医院公布未出生婴儿的性别，但这种情况仍在继续。

source_text: According to The Washington Post, parents in much of India abort female fetuses and young female children for financial reasons.
target_text: 据“华盛顿邮报”报道，印度大部分地区的父母因经济原因流产了女性胎儿和年幼女童。

source_text: Incidents like this occur more frequently in the better educated and the richer Indian states, including Punjab and Gujarat.
target_text: 像这样的事件在受过良好教育的印度国家，包括旁遮普邦和古吉拉特邦，更频繁地发生。

source_text: Pillai, the home secretary, has claimed that "[w]hatever policy measures we have been following in the last 40 years will need a complete review now."
target_text: 内政大臣皮莱声称，“我们在过去40年里所采取的任何仇恨政策措施，现在都需要进行全面的审查。”

source_text: There are now 940 female adults for every one thousand men, in contrast to 2001, when there were 933 women per thousand males.
target_text: 现在每千人中有940名女性成年人，而2001年则是每千名男性中有933名女性。

source_text: However, in the capital, Delhi, only 866 females were counted for every one thousand males.
target_text: 然而，在首都德里，每1000名男性中只有866名女性。

source_text: Throughout the states of India, the population growth rate varies significantly.
target_text: 在整个印度各州，人口增长率差异很大。

source_text: According to Management Institute of Population and Development consultant Devendra Kothari: "Our federal government sends funds to the states according to their population."
target_text: 根据人口与发展管理研究所顾问德文德拉·科塔里的说法：“我们的联邦政府根据人口向各州提供资金。”

source_text: "This means that the states that have worked harder to reduce their population growth get less money from New Delhi".
target_text: “这意味着那些努力减少人口增长的州从新德里获得的资金减少了”。

source_text: Kothari continued: "The states with lesser population send fewer members to the Indian parliament."
target_text: 科塔里继续说：“人口较少的州向印度议会派出的成员较少。”

source_text: Over the course of the approaching year, concluding census figures will be publicised, according to officials.
target_text: 官方称，在即将到来的一年中，最终的人口普查数据将被公布。

source_text: "We're looking at a flood that is around the one in one hundred year flood level," said Phil Campbell, State Emergency Service spokesperson.
target_text: “我们看到的是大约百年一遇的洪水，”国家应急服务部门发言人菲尔·坎贝尔说。

source_text: Ambulance crews spent the night rescuing stranded residents caught off guard by the sudden deluge.
target_text: 救护人员整夜都在营救被突如其来的洪水围困的居民。

source_text: As many as 2,700 residents had been trapped by the floodwaters.
target_text: 多达2,700名居民被洪水困住。

source_text: 420 people sought refuge in evacuation centres over night, of these all but 70 have returned home.
target_text: 420人在疏散中心避难过夜，其中70人已经返回家中。

source_text: The Red Cross flood evacuation centre in Urunga was left without power but still harbours 300 who sought refuge there.
target_text: 乌伦加红十字会洪水疏散中心断电，但仍有300人在那里避难。

source_text: Inland floodwaters trapped more than 1,000 residents in Coffs Harbour, New South Wales over night.
target_text: 在新南威尔士州的科菲港，超过1000名居民在夜间被内陆洪水围困。

source_text: "It does seem likely that we'll need to make a natural disaster emergency declaration and that's something which obviously then brings some resources in."
target_text: “看来，我们确实需要做出一份自然灾害紧急声明，这显然会带来一些资源。”

source_text: "The most immediate challenge of course is for the 3,000 or so people who are still isolated and over 300 who are in evacuation centres at the moment."
target_text: “目前最紧迫的挑战当然是3000名左右仍处于孤立状态的人，以及300多名目前在疏散中心的人。”

source_text: Floodwaters are starting to recede, however the Bureau of Meteorology does not see an end to the heavy rains.
target_text: 洪水开始消退，但是气象局认为暴雨还没有结束。

source_text: A Russian Proton-M/Briz-M carrier rocket launched this morning at 00:18 UTC, carrying the Ekspress AM-33 (also known as Express AM-33) communication satellite.
target_text: 一枚俄罗斯质子-M/BRIZ-M运载火箭UTC时间今天上午00：18搭载Ekspress AM-33（也称为Express AM-33）通信卫星发射升空。

source_text: Launch, from area 200/39 at the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan took place on schedule, and the satellite was successfully placed into an intermediate transfer orbit.
target_text: 哈萨克斯坦拜科努尔航天发射场200/39区域的发射如期进行，卫星成功进入中间转移轨道。

source_text: Operations to place the satellite into its final Geosynchronous orbit, through further burns of the Briz-M upper stage, should have been completed, however no official announcement has yet been made.
target_text: 通过进一步燃烧BRIZ-M上层空间，应已经完成将卫星送入其最终地球同步轨道的行动，然而，目前还没有官方宣布。

source_text: This is the third orbital launch of 2008, and the first to be conducted by Russia.
target_text: 这是2008年的第三次轨道发射，也是第一次由俄罗斯进行。

source_text: The satellite will provide C, L and Ku-band communication services.
target_text: 该卫星将提供C，L和Ku波段通信服务。

source_text: It has a mass of 2600kg, and an expected orbital lifetime of 12 years.
target_text: 它的质量为2600千克，轨道寿命为12年。

source_text: It was constructed by NPO PM and Thales Alenia Space, and will be operated by the Russian Space Communication Company, and RKA.
target_text: 它由NPO PM和泰勒斯阿莱尼亚空间公司建造，将由俄罗斯空间通信公司和RKA公司运营。

source_text: It will replace the AM-11 satellite, which malfunctioned in 2006.
target_text: 它将取代2006年发生故障的AM-11卫星。

source_text: Microsoft released today the final version of its new service, MSN Search.
target_text: 微软今天发布了其新服务MSN搜索的最终版本。

source_text: The new features that are available include tabs that allow consumers to target searches to the Web, news, images, music, desktop or Microsoft Encarta.
target_text: 可用的新功能包括选项卡，允许用户针对Web、新闻、图像、音乐、桌面或Microsoft Encarta进行搜索。

source_text: Journalist, counselor, painter, and US 2012 Presidential candidate Joe Schriner of Cleveland, Ohio took some time to discuss his campaign with Wikinews in an interview.
target_text: 来自俄亥俄州克利夫兰的记者、顾问、画家、2012年美国总统候选人乔·施里纳在接受维基新闻采访时谈到了他的竞选活动。

source_text: Schriner previously ran for president in 2000, 2004, and 2008, but failed to gain much traction in the races.
target_text: 施里纳曾在2000年、2004年和2008年竞选总统，但在竞选中没有获得太多支持。

source_text: He announced his candidacy for the 2012 race immediately following the 2008 election.
target_text: 他在2008年大选后立即宣布参加2012年的竞选。

source_text: Schriner refers to himself as the "Average Joe" candidate, and advocates a pro-life and pro-environmentalist platform.
target_text: 施里纳称自己这个候选人是一个“普通的乔”，主张建立一个有利于生活和环境保护的平台。

source_text: He has been the subject of numerous newspaper articles, and has published public policy papers exploring solutions to American issues.
target_text: 他是众多报纸文章的主题，并发表了公共政策论文，探讨解决美国问题的方法。

source_text: Wikinews reporter William Saturn‎ talks with Schriner and discusses his campaign.
target_text: 维基新闻记者威廉·三图与施里纳交谈并讨论了他的竞选活动。

source_text: Previously, China has opposed two attempts at United Nations Security Council resolutions to control the violence in Syria and to ask for President Bashar al-Assad to resign.
target_text: 此前，中国曾两次反对联合国安理会通过控制叙利亚暴力的决议，并要求叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德辞职。

source_text: While the Arab League, the European Union, Turkey, and the United States all have pursued sanctions against the regime in Syria, China so far has been against the removal of the Syrian regime and has rejected sanctions.
target_text: 虽然阿拉伯联盟、欧盟、土耳其和美国都在寻求对叙利亚政权实施制裁，但中国迄今一直反对推翻叙利亚政权，并拒绝制裁。

source_text: The former Secretary-General of the United Nations Kofi Annan has been newly appointed as a Joint Special Envoy of the United Nations and the Arab League, which has been endorsed by the Chinese statement.
target_text: 联合国前秘书长科菲·安南新任命为联合国和阿拉伯联盟的联合特使，该特使已得到中方声明的认可。

source_text: "The fact that aid is prevented and access is refused to United Nations officials constitutes another crime," the minister said.
target_text: 他说：“阻止联合国官员获得援助和拒绝联合国官员进入缅甸，构成了另一种罪行。”

source_text: The Red Cross had been denied access to the city of Homs.
target_text: 红十字会被拒绝进入霍姆斯市。

source_text: China has usually hesitated to support international intervention in national situations, as when a United Nations resolution was invoked to support the bombing of Libya by NATO forces last year.
target_text: 中国通常不愿支持国际社会对国家局势的干预，就像去年联合国通过决议支持北约部队轰炸利比亚那样。

source_text: Yesterday, Republican Fred Thompson confirmed his campaign for the United States presidential election, 2008.
target_text: 昨天，共和党人弗雷德·汤普森证实了他参加2008年美国总统大选的竞选活动。

source_text: The much expected announcement comes on the tail of criticism about his lobbying past and that he has waited too long to declare his intentions.
target_text: 这一备受期待的声明是在外界对他过去的游说经历提出批评之后发布的，批评称他等了太久才宣布自己的意图。

source_text: He is expected to file papers next Thursday to make his candidacy official.
target_text: 预计他将于下周四提交文件，正式成为总统候选人。

source_text: Thompson much expected declarations comes after months of "testing the waters."
target_text: 汤普森在经过几个月的“试水”之后，发表了外界期待已久的声明。

source_text: Already appearing in the top tier of GOP candidates, Thompson's announcement comes after staff changes and lack luster fundraising.
target_text: 汤普森已经出现在共和党的最高层候选人中，汤普森的声明是在员工变动和不光彩筹款之后发布的。

source_text: According to an advisor, Thompson will make the announcement on Leno opting not to appear at the Republican debate on September 5.
target_text: 据一位顾问透露，汤普森将宣布雷诺选择不参加9月5日的共和党辩论。

source_text: David Cameron, the leader of the Conservative Party and UK leader of the opposition today made a speech to the conference of the Scottish Conservative Party.
target_text: 英国保守党领袖、反对党领袖戴维·卡梅伦今天在苏格兰保守党大会上发表讲话。

source_text: In the speech he addressed the issue of Scottish independence.
target_text: 他在演讲中谈到了苏格兰独立问题。

source_text: "I want to be Prime Minister of the United Kingdom - all of it, including Scotland."
target_text: “我想成为全英国的首相，包括苏格兰在内。”

source_text: "I absolutely believe we are stronger together, and weaker apart, and I will do anything and everything to keep our two countries as one," he said.
target_text: 他说：“我绝对相信，我们在一起会更强大，分开会更弱。我将尽一切努力保持我们两国的团结。”

source_text: "Whether we like it or not, the ugly stain of separatism is seeping through the Union flag," said Cameron, stating his opinion on the movements for Scottish independence.
target_text: “不管我们喜不喜欢，分裂主义的丑陋污点正在渗透到英国国旗上，”卡梅伦在阐述他对苏格兰独立运动的看法时说。

source_text: "The simple truth is that the Union between England and Scotland is under attack as never before."
target_text: “简单的事实是英格兰和苏格兰之间的联盟正受到前所未有的冲击。”

source_text: "To play games by calling for a referendum right at the moment when people would take any opportunity to give the most unpopular Government in living memory a good kicking, isn’t clever... isn’t good politics …isn’t defending the Union."
target_text: “在人们将抓住任何机会给人们记忆中最不受欢迎政府一顿痛打时的这个时刻，为了玩游戏而要求举行全民公决是不明智的……不是好的政治，不是在捍卫联邦。”

source_text: "The Union is in danger for other reasons too," he claimed.
target_text: “联盟也因其他原因而处于危险之中，”他声称。

source_text: "The number of people who think themselves British – ahead of Scottish or English - is in decline."
target_text: “认为自己是苏格兰人或英格兰人之前，首先是英国人的人数在下降”。

source_text: Cameron also addressed Scottish First Minister and leader of the Scottish National Party:
target_text: 卡梅伦还向苏格兰第一部长和苏格兰民族党领袖发表讲话：。

source_text: I know you think a Conservative government at Westminster will ignore what Scotland wants and needs, and that you will use such claims to promote your separatist agenda.
target_text: 我知道你认为一个保守党政府在威斯敏斯特会忽视苏格兰想要和需要什么，你会利用这些主张来推动你的分离主义议程。

source_text: And to the people of Scotland, I make this guarantee.
target_text: 对苏格兰人民来说，我做出了这个保证。

source_text: A father and son from Romania have been found guilty of a string of prostitution-related offences in the United Kingdom.
target_text: 来自罗马尼亚的父亲和儿子在英国被判犯有一系列与卖淫有关的罪行。

source_text: For four years, Marius "Mario" Nejloveanu and father Bogdan trafficked women into and around the UK, forcing their victims into prostitution.
target_text: 四年来，马吕斯·“马里奥”·内杰洛瓦努和他的父亲博格丹将妇女贩卖到英国各地，迫使受害者卖淫。

source_text: Nejloveanu, 23, was also convicted of a series of rapes and headed the business with guidance from his 51-year-old father.
target_text: 23岁的内杰洛瓦努也被判犯有一系列强奸罪，并在51岁父亲的指导下领导事业。

source_text: Five women were lured from Romania, the youngest in her teens, the oldest 27, with promises of work and romance with Marius.
target_text: 五名女子被从罗马尼亚引诱而来，其中最小的十几岁，最大的27岁，怀揣着要和马吕斯一起工作和恋爱承诺而来。

source_text: Originally founding a brothel in their hometown of Birmingham, the pair met resistance from local rival pimps and relocated the women to Manchester.
target_text: 他们最初在家乡伯明翰开了一家妓院，但遭到了当地皮条客的抵制，于是两人把这些女人带到了曼彻斯特。

source_text: There, they worked six or seven days each week, sleeping in brothels and having sex with eight-to-ten men each night against their will.
target_text: 在那里，这些女人每周工作六七天，睡在妓院里，每晚违背自己的意愿与八到十个男人发生性关系。

source_text: Typical fees from customers were around £40 but some may have paid as low as £10.
target_text: 来自客户的典型费用约为40英镑，但有些客户可能只支付了10英镑。

source_text: Police launched raids, rescuing the women after receiving a tip-off.
target_text: 警方在接到线报后展开突袭，救出了这些妇女。

source_text: Bogdan was accused by Rachel Smyth, prosecuting, of giving advice and assistance to Marius; Smyth opened the trial last year telling Manchester Crown Court "[h]aving heard the evidence you [the jury] may conclude that the son, Marius, learnt this trade from his father and that this was a family business."
target_text: 雷切尔·史密斯指控博格丹向马吕斯提供建议和帮助；去年提起诉讼的史密斯告诉曼彻斯特刑事法院，“听取了证据，陪审团可能会得出结论，儿子马吕斯从他父亲那里学到了这项交易，这是家族事业。”

source_text: Bogdan was convicted of seven offences - three counts of trafficking within the UK for sexual exploitation, three counts of trafficking into the UK for sexual exploitation and controlling prostitution for gain.
target_text: 博格丹被判犯有七项罪行-三项在英国境内进行的性剥削贩运，三项输入英国的性剥削贩运以及为牟利而控制卖淫。

source_text: Marius was found guilty of five counts of trafficking women into the UK for sexual exploitation, one count of conspiracy to traffic a woman into the UK for sexual exploitation, two counts of trafficking women within the UK for sexual exploitation, one count of trafficking a woman out of the UK for sexual exploitation, four counts of rape, five counts of assault, two counts of causing a woman to engage in sexual activity without consent, five counts of controlling prostitution for gain, and one count of witness intimidation to total 27 offences.
target_text: 马吕斯被判犯有五项以性剥削为目的向英国贩运妇女罪，一项以性剥削为目的共谋向英国贩运妇女罪，两项以性剥削为目的在英国境内贩运妇女罪，一项罪名是将一名妇女为性剥削目的而从英国贩运出去，四项罪名是强奸，五项罪名是殴打，两项罪名是导致一名妇女未经同意而从事性活动，五项罪名是为了牟利而控制卖淫，一项罪名是恐吓证人，共计27项罪行。

source_text: The duo join two others who admitted lesser roles in the scheme.
target_text: 这两人加入了另外两名承认在该计划中扮演次要角色的人的行列。

source_text: Costel Maruntelu, 24, was previously jailed for five years and six months for sex trafficking crimes.
target_text: 24岁的科斯特尔·马龙特鲁此前因性交易罪被判入狱5年零6个月。

source_text: New Zealand Māori leaders have said that they will try to get a Maori temporary tattoo kit from the Los Angeles store Halloween Town withdrawn from sale, as they find it insulting to the Māori culture.
target_text: 新西兰的毛利人领导们说，他们将试图从洛杉矶的商店“万圣节城”取得已停止销售的一套毛利人临时纹身工具组，因为他们发现这对毛利人文化是一种侮辱。

source_text: The Halloween Town, a store that specializes in Halloween costumes and accessories, is selling the tattoo kit for NZ$16.
target_text: 万圣节城，一家专门贩售万圣节服装和配饰的商店，以16新西兰元的价格出售这套纹身工具组。

source_text: Aroha Mead, Victoria University of Wellington Māori business lecturer said that the Tā moko is not frightening, "And he doesn't look scary to me – he looks quite handsome,", but added "There didn't appear to be much that Māori could do."
target_text: 惠灵顿毛利维多利亚大学商务讲师阿罗哈·米德表示，Ta moko并不吓人，“对我来说，他看起来并不吓人，他看起来相当英俊，”但他补充道，“看来毛利人似乎没有太多能做的。”

source_text: "No-one likes to see their culture being denigrated but we are aware that the moko is in the public domain."
target_text: “没有人喜欢看到他们的文化遭到诋毁，但我们知道moko属于公共领域。”

source_text: Rotorua acedmic Ngahihi o te ra Bidois, who has a full facial moko, has asked the Halloween Town store to remove the tattoo kits.
target_text: Rotorua acedmic Ngahihi o te ra Bidois拥有全脸的moko，他已经要求万圣节城移除纹身工具组。

source_text: "It is insulting ... what they are doing is not portraying Māori correctly," Bidois said.
target_text: “这是侮辱……他们所做的并不是正确地描绘毛利人，”Bidois说。

source_text: A full-face moko is traditionally restricted to male Māori and is used to represent mana (prestige).
target_text: 传统上，全脸moko仅限于男性毛利人，用于表示法力（声望）。

source_text: A series of explosions have hit an Albanian arms depot near Tirana, leaving at least 155 people injured.
target_text: 阿尔巴尼亚首都地拉那附近的一个军火库发生一系列爆炸，造成至少155人受伤。

source_text: Juela Mecani, spokesperson for Albamian PM Sali Berisha, said to Reuters "We do not know the exact number (of casualties) but we fear the worst for the three teams, each of 21 people, working there at the time."
target_text: 阿尔巴缅总理萨利·贝里沙的发言人朱埃拉·梅卡尼对路透社说：“我们不知道确切的伤亡人数，但是我们担心当时在那里工作的三个小组，每个小组有21人，他们的情况会更糟。”

source_text: The three teams referred to were dismantling obsolete munitions stored there, as part of a programme to remove Stalinist era arms and modernize the military in order to qualify for an invitation to join NATO next month.
target_text: 被提到的三个小组正在拆除储存在那里的陈旧弹药，作为拆除斯大林时代武器和使军队现代化的计划的一部分，以便有资格获得下个月加入北约的邀请。

source_text: Injured people have been rushed to hospitals amid ongoing explosions, which Interior Ministry spokesman Avni Neza says have prevented helicopters landing in the area.
target_text: 在持续发生的爆炸中，受伤人员被迅速送往医院，内政部发言人艾夫尼·内扎说，爆炸阻止了直升机降落在该地区。

source_text: The wounded are suffering from burns, concussion, broken limbs and shrapnel injuries.
target_text: 伤者患有烧伤、脑震荡、四肢骨折和弹片伤。

source_text: Meanwhile, Neza says police and army units are attempting to reach the area in armored cars.
target_text: 与此同时，内扎说，警察和军队部队正试图乘坐装甲车抵达该地区。

source_text: Albanian health minister Nard Ndoka said that the 155 known to be hospitalized so far had to make their way to nearby villages as the ongoing explosions had also prevented road ambulances reaching the scene.
target_text: 阿尔巴尼亚卫生部长纳尔德·恩多卡说，到目前为止，目前已知的155名住院患者不得不前往附近的村庄，因为持续的爆炸也阻止了公路救护车到达现场。

source_text: Tirana Airport spokesman Arlinda Causholli said glass windows and doors at the airport, a few kilometers from the site, were shattered by the initial series of explosions.
target_text: 地拉那机场发言人阿林达·考索利说，距离现场几公里远的机场玻璃门窗被最初的一系列爆炸震碎。

source_text: "We evacuated passengers from the affected area and suspended flights for around 30 minutes," he said.
target_text: 他说：“我们从受灾地区疏散了乘客，并暂停了大约30分钟的航班。”

source_text: "Terrified people are leaving the area on foot along the highway, women and children…"
target_text: “惊恐的人们沿着高速公路步行离开该地区，妇女和儿童……”。

source_text: Local media reports Tirana residents rushing to donate blood to help with the emergency.
target_text: 当地媒体报道说，地拉那的居民纷纷献血，帮助应对紧急情况。

source_text: Explosions were felt in Tirana and in Durres, 20km (12 miles) from the base.
target_text: 距基地20公里（12英里）的地拉那和杜尔斯都能感受到爆炸。

source_text: In the nearby village of Gerdec, some residents fled to the hills, while others sought shelter in concrete bunkers built by late Stalinist leader Enver Hoxha.
target_text: 在附近的格德克村，一些居民逃到山上，其他人则躲在已故斯大林主义领导人恩维尔·霍克沙建造的混凝土掩体里。

source_text: The initial blast was heard 150km away in Macedonia and Serbia
target_text: 在150公里外的马其顿和塞尔维亚都听到了最初的爆炸声。

source_text: Statoil ASA (Statoil), a Norwegian state-owned oil company, entered into an agreement Friday to purchase all outstanding common shares of the privately held Canadian firm, North American Oil Sands Corporation (NAOSC).
target_text: 挪威国家石油公司（Statoil）于上周五签署协议，将收购加拿大私人控股公司北美油砂公司（NAOSC）全部已发行的普通股。

source_text: The deal is reported to be worth CAD2.2 billion in an all-cash transaction.
target_text: 据报道，这笔全现金交易价值22亿加元。

source_text: It manages 1,110 square kilometres of oil sands leases located in northern Alberta.
target_text: 它管理着位于阿尔伯塔省北部的1,110平方公里的油砂租赁。

source_text: It is estimated that the NOASC oil sands hold approximately 2.2 billion barrels of oil reserves.
target_text: 据估计，NOASC油砂储量约为22亿桶石油储量。

source_text: The company is planning to develop an extraction project and an upgrading facility.
target_text: 该公司计划开发一个开采项目和一个升级设施。

source_text: When the project is completed, NAOSC expects it to produce over 200,000 barrels of bitumen per day.
target_text: 该项目完工后，NAOSC预计每天将生产20万桶以上的沥青。

source_text: The upgrading facility would then process the bitumen into synthetic crude oil.
target_text: 然后，升级设施将沥青加工成合成原油。

source_text: The NAOSC board of directors has approved the bid from Statoil unanimously, and has recommended that its shareholders accept the offer.
target_text: NAOSC董事会已一致批准挪威国家石油公司的出价，并建议其股东接受该提议。

source_text: Paramount announced Friday that it had entered into a lock-up agreement with Statoil, which calls for Paramount to sell its 30.9% interest in NAOSC to Statoil ASA for a cash deal worth approximately $682 million.
target_text: 派拉蒙周五宣布，已与挪威国家石油公司签署了一项禁售协议，协议要求派拉蒙公司以约6.82亿美元现金的价格，将其在NAOSC公司百分之30.9的股权出售给挪威国家石油公司。
