source_text: "We are impressed by the performance and competence held by the employees in NAOSC,” said Helge Lund, chief executive of Statoil.
target_text: 挪威国家石油公司首席执行官海尔格·隆德表示：“我们对NAOSC员工的表现和能力印象深刻。”

source_text: “Combined with Statoil’s experience and commitment to prudent operations, we are well-positioned to develop the resources in a sustainable manner, creating value for Statoil and its shareholders."
target_text: “结合挪威国家石油公司的经验和谨慎经营的承诺，我们处于有利地位，能够以可持续的方式开发资源，为挪威国家石油公司及其股东创造价值。”

source_text: Statoil suggests that the development plans for the NAOSC oil sands includes an application of Steam Assisted Gravity Drainage (SAGD) technology, which, according to the company, leaves a smaller environmental footprint than strip mining.
target_text: 挪威国家石油公司表示，NAOSC油砂开发计划包括采用蒸汽辅助重力排水（SAGD）技术，据该公司称，这种技术比露天开采对环境的影响更小。

source_text: Statoil admits, however, that heavy oil production, such as is required in the oil sands, is "energy intensive and challenging in an environmental perspective."
target_text: 然而，挪威国家石油公司承认，重油生产，如油砂开采所需要的重油，是“能源密集型的，从环境角度来看具有挑战性”。

source_text: The company said it intends to capture the carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions from its oil sands production and store it underground.
target_text: 该公司表示，它打算捕捉油砂生产过程中排放的二氧化碳（CO2），并将其储存在地下。

source_text: Under new environmental regulations announced Thursday by Canadian Environment Minister John Baird, companies that can't meet new intensity targets for CO2 emission reductions will be able to purchase offset credits or contribute to a technology fund, at an initial cost of $15 per tonne of emissions.
target_text: 根据加拿大环境部长约翰·贝尔德周四宣布的新环境法规，无法实现二氧化碳减排新强度目标的公司，将可以购买抵扣额度或向一个技术基金捐款，初始成本为每吨排放15美元。

source_text: New plants would have three years before they were obligated to begin reducing their emissions.
target_text: 新工厂将经过三年时间后才开始承担减少排放的义务。

source_text: However, Julia Langer, director of the World Wildlife Fund's global threats program, told the Globe and Mail that the initial exemptions for new plants and the technology fund contributions would undermine the government's new environmental plan.
target_text: 然而，世界野生动物基金会全球威胁项目主任茱莉亚·兰格告诉“环球邮报”，对新工厂和技术基金捐款的最初豁免将破坏政府的新环境计划。

source_text: "This is a regulatory plan that is geared to business as usual for the tar sands sector," said Langer.
target_text: 兰格表示：“这是一项控规，旨在让油砂行业一如既往地开展业务。”

source_text: The Statoil-NAOSC transaction is expected to close by the end of the second quarter of 2007.
target_text: 挪威国家石油公司的NAOSC交易预计将在2007年第二季度结束。

source_text: A civilian helicopter chartered by NATO has crashed while taking off from Kandahar International Airport in Afghanistan, killing sixteen.
target_text: 北约租用的一架民用直升机从阿富汗坎大哈国际机场起飞时坠毁，造成十六人死亡。

source_text: The helicopter had been chartered from the Russian company Vertical-T and all the victims were civilians.
target_text: 这架直升机是从俄罗斯垂直-T公司租来的，所有遇难者都是平民。

source_text: A NATO statement said that there was no obvious cause for the accident but hostile fire had been ruled out.
target_text: 北约一份声明说，事故没有明显原因，但已排除敌对火力。

source_text: The airport serves as NATO's operating base for southern Afghanistan.
target_text: 该机场是北约在阿富汗南部的行动基地。

source_text: The crash comes just days after another civilian helicopter chartered for military activities crashed near Sangin Airbase in Helmand.
target_text: 就在几天前，另一架包租用于军事活动的民用直升机在赫尔曼德省桑金空军基地附近坠毁。

source_text: The Mil Mi-26 is believed to have been shot down; six Ukrainian civilians onboard and one Afghan girl on the ground were killed in the crash on Tuesday.
target_text: Mil Mi-26据信已经被击落，周二，机上六名乌克兰平民和一名阿富汗女孩在坠机中丧生。

source_text: The helicopter had been taking supplies to a British military base.
target_text: 这架直升机一直在向英国军事基地提供物资。

source_text: Roads in Afghanistan are often difficult to traverse, so militaries often contract aircraft, especially from Russia, to transport troops and cargo between bases.
target_text: 阿富汗的公路通常很难穿越，所以军队经常订约飞机，特别是从俄罗斯，以便在各基地之间运送军队和货物。

source_text: Fiji’s fourth coup in 20 years rose today as troops disarmed Fiji's only armed police unit.
target_text: 斐济今天发生20年来的第四次政变，军队解除了斐济唯一的武装警察部队的武装。

source_text: This is the first step in the long expected military coup.
target_text: 这是预料中的长期军事政变的第一步。

source_text: Fiji's president dissolved parliament on Tuesday and sanctioned the military to remove embattled Prime Minister Laisenia Qarase, said New Zealand Prime Minister Helen Clark
target_text: 新西兰总理海伦·克拉克说，斐济总统星期二解散了议会，并批准军方罢免严阵以待的总理莱西尼亚·恩加拉塞。

source_text: Qarase, who is in his residence in Suva, said the military was staging a coup and he would not resign but would have to be forcibly removed from office.
target_text: 目前在其苏瓦住处的恩加拉塞说，军方正在发动政变，他不会辞职，但不得已将被迫下台。

source_text: "I am the democratically elected prime minister of the people of Fiji."
target_text: “我是民主选举产生的斐济人民总理。”

source_text: "I have been advised this morning that the president of Fiji has acted outside his constitutional powers and supported the removal of the democratic prime minister by the military," Clark said in a statement to the New Zealand parliament.
target_text: 克拉克在向新西兰议会发表的一份声明中说：“我今天早上被告知，斐济总统的行为超出了他的宪法权力，并支持军方推翻民主选出的总理。”

source_text: Acting Police Commissioner Moses Driver denied that any take over had occurred.
target_text: 代理警察局长摩西·德莱弗否认发生过任何接管事件。

source_text: He said soldiers arrived to inspect police weapons, and were waiting for approval for that inspection.
target_text: 他说，士兵到场是为了检查警察的武器，并等待着批准检查的指令。

source_text: Troops later surrounding the Nasova Police Academy in Suva demanding the handover of weapons, and occupied the main police station in Suva.
target_text: 军队随后包围苏瓦的纳索瓦警察学院，要求移交武器，并占领了苏瓦的主要警察局。

source_text: No shots were fired when the police were locked out.
target_text: 当警察被锁在门外时没有人开枪。

source_text: At a news conference inside the main Suva barracks, Commander Frank Bainimarama said that police weapons were confiscated so that "dissidents" did not use them against the military.
target_text: 在苏瓦的主要军营内举行的新闻发布会上，指挥官弗兰克·拜尼马拉马说，警方的武器被没收，因此“持不同政见者”就不会用它们来对付军方。

source_text: There are also reports that military checkpoints are been set up around the capital.
target_text: 还有报道称在首都周围设立了军事检查站。

source_text: Troops tried to arrest the Prime Minister of Fiji, Laisenia Qarase, in the afternoon by setting up a roadblock between Suva and the province where Mr Qarase was attending a meeting, but he escaped in a helicopter, and has since been in hiding.
target_text: 当天下午，军队试图通过在苏瓦和恩加拉塞正在开会的省份之间设置路障来逮捕斐济总理恩加拉塞，但是恩加拉塞先生乘坐直升机逃走了，之后一直躲藏着。

source_text: The Prime Minister and his cabinet are understood to be in safe, secure places, and some of them separated for extra security.
target_text: 据了解，总理和他的内阁都在安全可靠的地方，而为了进一步的安全，其中有些人还被分散开来。

source_text: The army kept up the pressure on Mr Qarase when he was later summoned to President Ratu Josefa Iloilo's residence.
target_text: 当恩加拉塞后来被传唤到总统拉图·约瑟夫·伊洛伊洛的住所时，军方继续对他施加压力。

source_text: A witness inside the grounds said the prime minister, whose bodyguards were also disarmed by the military, refused and returned to his office.
target_text: 现场一名目击者说，连保镖也被解除武装的总理拒绝并返回了办公室。

source_text: Mr Qarase will make another attempt to meet President Iloilo on Tuesday morning.
target_text: 恩加拉塞将于周二上午再次尝试与伊洛伊洛总统会面。

source_text: Military chief Commander Frank Bainimarama had repeatedly threatened to remove Prime Minister Laisenia Qarase's government unless it drops several pieces of legislation, including a bill that would grant amnesty to those involved in a coup in 2000.
target_text: 军事指挥官弗兰克·拜尼马拉马曾多次威胁要推翻总理莱西尼亚·恩加拉塞的政府，除非政府放弃几项立法，其中包括一项赦免2000年政变参与者的法案。

source_text: Commander Bainimarama has laid allegations on PM Qarase of stalling his pledge of ditching of the controversial legislation.
target_text: 指挥官拜尼马拉马对恩加拉塞总理提出指控，称他拖延了放弃这项有争议立法的承诺。

source_text: He had earlier imposed a deadline of noon (0000GMT) on Friday, December 1 but that deadline was extended to today as there was the annual rugby game between the police and the military.
target_text: 早些时候，他将最后期限定在12月1日（星期五）中午（格林威治时间0000GMT），但由于警察和军队之间有一年一度的橄榄球比赛，最后期限被延长到了今天。

source_text: Commander Bainimarama is both an avid rugby fan and active church goer.
target_text: 指挥官拜尼马拉马既是狂热的橄榄球球迷，也是活跃的教堂常客。

source_text: "I maintain my demands and the deadline still stands and I will make a commitment to my stand after the rugby match," he said.
target_text: 他说：“我坚持我的要求，截止日期仍然有效，我将在橄榄球赛后对我的立场做出承诺。”

source_text: Mr Qarase told Fiji radio on Monday morning that he remained in control and has called an emergency cabinet meeting for Tuesday.
target_text: 恩加拉塞周一上午对斐济电台表示，他仍然控制着局面，并已于周二召开紧急内阁会议。

source_text: Fiji's Great Council of Chiefs called for calm on Monday and for the military to return to negotiations with the government.
target_text: 斐济大酋长会议周一呼吁各方保持冷静，并呼吁军方恢复与政府的谈判。

source_text: Local radio reported seven government vehicles used by ministers and parliament's Speaker had been confiscated by the military since Monday night.
target_text: 当地电台报道称，自周一晚间以来，部长和议会议长使用的七辆政府车辆已被军方没收。

source_text: Including New Zealand which has banned Commander Bainimarama from entering New Zealand except if he is attending political crises talks.
target_text: 包括新西兰，该国禁止拜尼玛拉马指挥官进入新西兰，除非他会参加政治危机谈判。

source_text: Helen Clark described the situation as "...it's a very disturbing situation."
target_text: 海伦·克拉克将这种情况描述为“……这是一个非常令人不安的情况。”

source_text: Some of Commander Bainimarama's close family live in New Zealand.
target_text: 拜尼马拉马指挥官的一些近亲住在新西兰。

source_text: Conditions on the street of Fiji are said to be mixed, with some apprehension.
target_text: 据说斐济街头的情况好坏参半，令人有些担心。

source_text: The United Nations might discontinue use of Fijian soldiers in peacekeeping operations of which is a large source of Fiji's income.
target_text: 联合国可能会停止在维持和平行动中使用斐济士兵，而维和行动是斐济收入的重要来源。

source_text: The International Community have said they will discontinue aid to Fiji which is worth millions annually.
target_text: 国际社会已表示将停止向斐济提供每年数百万美元的援助。

source_text: The City of Brampton in Ontario, Canada, and Marikina in the Philippines have recently been "twinned".
target_text: 加拿大安大略省的布兰普顿市和菲律宾的马里基纳市最近结成了“姐妹市”。

source_text: Both cities are roughly the same size, both have female mayors, both are near urban destinations (one of Toronto, the other Manila) and feel they can benefit economically with each other.
target_text: 这两个城市的面积大致相同，都有女市长，都靠近城市目的地（一个是多伦多，另一个是马尼拉），都觉得彼此可以在经济上受益。

source_text: Mayor Susan Fennell of Brampton commented "This twinning agreement between Brampton and Marikina City will not only provide new and exciting economic possibilities, but it is an excellent chance to recognize and celebrate the Filipino community in Brampton."
target_text: 布兰普顿市长苏珊·芬内尔评论说：“布兰普顿市和马里基纳市之间的这一友好协议不仅将提供新的、令人兴奋的经济机会，而且是认可和赞扬布兰普顿菲律宾社区的绝佳机会。”

source_text: "As one of Canada's most diverse cities, Brampton is home to more than 8,000 Filipino residents with a distinct culture, and I am pleased to be able to celebrate that culture with this agreement."
target_text: “作为加拿大最多样化的城市之一，布兰普顿有8000多名菲律宾居民，他们有着独特的文化，我很高兴能够通过这项协议来赞扬这种文化。”

source_text: Spanish law allows the courts to pursue cases of torture and war crimes beyond Spanish borders.
target_text: 西班牙法律允许法院在西班牙境外审理酷刑和战争罪案件。

source_text: But American legal experts said the warrants, if issued, would be a largely symbolic gesture and that the officials would likely not be arrested if they did not leave the United States.
target_text: 但美国法律专家表示，如果发出逮捕令，在很大程度上将是一种象征性姿态，如果这些官员不离开美国，他们很可能不会被逮捕。

source_text: The officials are accused of providing the framework of policies and legal opinions that justified torture at the Guantanamo Bay detention camp and afforded no protection under the Geneva Convention to Al-Qaeda suspects.
target_text: 这些官员被控提供政策框架和法律意见，为关塔那摩湾拘留营的虐囚行为辩护，而未根据日内瓦公约为基地组织嫌疑人提供保护。

source_text: "The charges as related to make make no sense," said Douglas J. Feith, former Under Secretary of Defense for Policy, who is one of the six accused former officials.
target_text: 前国防部政策副部长道格拉斯·J·菲思是被指控的六名前官员之一，他说：“与此相关的指控毫无意义。”

source_text: "They criticize me for promoting a controversial position that I never advocated."
target_text: “他们批评我提出了一个我从未主张过的有争议的立场。”

source_text: The other officials are former Vice President Dick Cheney's chief of staff David Addington, Pentagon attorney William Haynes, and Justice Department officials John Yoo and Jay Bybee.
target_text: 其他官员包括前副总统迪克·切尼的办公厅主任戴维·艾丁顿、五角大楼检察官威廉·海恩斯以及司法部官员约翰·刘和杰伊·比比。

source_text: Defenders of the officials said their legal analyses, which were conducted immediately following the September 11 attacks, are now being unfairly second-guessed.
target_text: 这些官员的辩护人说，他们的法律分析是在911恐怖袭击之后立即进行的，现在却遭到了不公平的事后批评。

source_text: A Spanish human rights group called the Association for Dignity of Inmates filed the criminal complaint.
target_text: 一个名为囚犯尊严协会的西班牙人权组织提起了该刑事诉讼。

source_text: He said a report compiled by the Australian National Retailers Association, representing major supermarkets, showed that by the end of last year supermarkets had reduced their annual use of lightweight, single-use bags by 45 per cent compared with 2002.
target_text: 他表示，代表大型超市的澳大利亚全国零售商协会编制的一份报告显示，截至去年年底，超市每年使用的一次性轻购物袋比2002年减少了百分之45。

source_text: "This is an enormous achievement by shoppers and supermarket management and a clear demonstration of a behavioural change by thousands of Australians," Senator Campbell said.
target_text: “这是购物者和超市管理层取得的巨大成就，也是成千上万澳大利亚人行为改变的明确证明，”坎贝尔参议员说。

source_text: "The goal must be to stop plastic bags getting into the litter stream and spoiling Australia’s environment."
target_text: “目标必须是阻止塑料袋进入垃圾流并破坏澳大利亚的环境。”

source_text: The Senator says the result came from entirely voluntary action – "no regulations, no levies or additional costs to shoppers."
target_text: 参议员说，结果来自完全自愿的行动“没有规定，没有征税或购物者的额外费用。”

source_text: "I am delighted that the major supermarkets are committed to achieving the 50 per cent goal by the end of this year."
target_text: “我很高兴主要超市致力于在今年年底前达到50％的目标。”

source_text: "I also share their view that development of a viable degradable bag to replace existing lightweight plastic ones is a key to achieving further significant reductions."
target_text: “我也同意他们的观点，即开发一种可行的可降解塑料袋来取代现有的轻质塑料袋，是实现进一步大幅减排的关键。”

source_text: Plastics have been widely used in Australia in the past few decades but environmentalists say plastic bags have had a devastating impact on the nation's natural environment.
target_text: 在过去的几十年里，塑料已在澳大利亚广泛使用，但环保人士称塑料袋对国家的自然环境造成了毁灭性的影响。

source_text: According to Clean Up Australia plastic bags can take between 20 and 1000 years to break down.
target_text: 根据“清理澳大利亚”的数据，塑料袋可能需要20到1000年的时间才能分解。

source_text: Many thousands of marine mammals and seabirds die every year around the world as a result of plastic litter.
target_text: 由于塑料垃圾，全世界每年都有成千上万的海洋哺乳动物和海鸟死亡。

source_text: A 2004 NSW Parliamentary paper reported that plastic bags are of "significant concern in the marine and aquatic environment, as aquatic life can be threatened through entanglement, suffocation and ingestion."
target_text: 2004年新南威尔士州议会的一份文件报告说，塑料袋“在海洋和水生环境中是极为令人担心的，因为水生生物可能通过缠绕、窒息和吞食受到威胁。”

source_text: The then Federal Environment Minister was reported as saying: "All environmental ministers believe that all plastic bags should be phased out within five years."
target_text: 据报道，当时的联邦环境部长说：“所有环保部长都认为所有塑料袋应在五年内逐步淘汰。”

source_text: "If this voluntary campaign isn’t working then of course we have to consider what to do (next)…."
target_text: “如果这种自愿运动不起作用，那么我们当然要考虑做什么（下一步）……”。

source_text: Defense minister Søren Gade was there, having secretly flown into Iraq for the event.
target_text: 已秘密飞往伊拉克的国防部长索伦·加德抵达当地参加活动。

source_text: During the ceremony, there was a rocket attack, causing everyone to hit the deck.
target_text: 在仪式上，发生了火箭袭击，导致所有人都撞到了甲板上。

source_text: The 460 members of the army has already been reduced to 50 soldiers.
target_text: 军队的460名成员已经减少到50名士兵。

source_text: Denmark's contribution to the Multinational force in Iraq will now consist of a small air force unit of four helicopters and 55 airmen that will work with the British.
target_text: 丹麦对驻伊拉克多国部队的贡献现在将是一个由四架直升机和55名飞行员组成的小型空军单位，并将与英国合作。

source_text: On July 20, Denmark said that it had airlifted translators and other Iraqi employees with their families.
target_text: 7月20日，丹麦表示，已将翻译和其他伊拉克雇员及其家属空运回国。

source_text: In total it was about 200 people that by cooperating with MNF may be in danger of reprisals from insurgents.
target_text: 通过与多国部队合作，总共约有200人可能面临叛乱分子的报复危险。

source_text: "Out of concern for the interpreters and their families' security as well as the security of the Danish base in Iraq, the Defence Ministry has chosen to inform the public after the interpreters and others had left Iraq," the Danish Defence Ministry said in a statement.
target_text: 丹麦国防部在一份声明中表示：“出于对口译员及其家属以及丹麦驻伊拉克基地安全的担忧，国防部选择在口译员和其他人离开伊拉克后通知公众。”

source_text: "They had been working for us for about four years, and those who felt their security in Iraq was threatened have been granted visas to go to Denmark" where they can apply for asylum, the Danish ambassador to Iraq, Bo Eric Weber told Reuters.
target_text: 丹麦驻伊拉克大使博·埃里克·韦伯对路透表示，“他们为我们工作了大约四年，那些觉得自己在伊拉克的安全受到威胁的人，已经获得了前往丹麦的签证”，在那里他们可以申请庇护。

source_text: Denmark announced in February that it would withdraw by August of this year.
target_text: 丹麦在2月份宣布，将在今年8月之前撤军。

source_text: On Friday, the United States Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) expanded its long-standing definition of rape to include men, and the rape of any gender by lack of consent — as opposed to physical coercion.
target_text: 周五，美国联邦调查局（FBI）将其长期以来对强奸的定义扩大到包括男性，以及未经同意的任何性别的强奸，而不是身体胁迫。

source_text: The revised definition should ensure all rapes are recorded in crime statistics.
target_text: 修订后的定义应确保所有强奸都记录在犯罪统计数据中。

source_text: Valerie Jarrett, a White House adviser, said it was a "very, very important step."
target_text: 白宫顾问瓦莱丽·贾勒特表示，这是“非常非常重要的一步”。

source_text: Describing the changes to crime reporting as "long overdue", United States Attorney General Eric Holder said the revised definition of rape will, "help ensure justice for those whose lives have been devastated by sexual violence and reflect the Department of Justice's commitment to standing with rape victims".
target_text: 美国司法部长埃里克·霍尔德将犯罪报告的变化描述为“迟来的”，他说，修订后的强奸定义将“有助于确保那些因性暴力而遭受破坏的人获得公正，并反映司法部与强奸受害者站在一起的承诺”。

source_text: The prior definition of rape — "the carnal knowledge of a female, forcibly and against her will" — was set by the FBI in 1927.
target_text: 早在1927年，美国联邦调查局就对强奸下了一个定义，即“对女性的肉体的了解，强行违背她的意愿”。

source_text: In contrast, the revised definition drops the requirement that there be physical resistance, thus including crimes where the victim is unable to give consent because they are under the influence of alcohol or drugs, or due to their age.
target_text: 相比之下，修订后的定义降低了身体抵抗的要求，因此包括被害人因受酒精或毒品影响或因年龄而无法给予同意的犯罪。

source_text: The changes are primarily a revision to the Uniform Crime Reports system (UCR), and are not expected to impact prior cases or current prosecutions.
target_text: 这些变化主要是对统一犯罪报告系统（UCR）的修订，预计不会影响先前的案件或当前的起诉。

source_text: Introducing no changes to current State or Federal law, the FBI expects the revised definition of rape will see victim numbers "more accurately reflected in national crime statistics".
target_text: 不修改现行的州或联邦法律，美国联邦调查局预计，修订后的强奸定义将使受害者人数“更准确地反映在国家犯罪统计数据中”。

source_text: Close to the revised rape definition is a 2010 study by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), which included male rape and non-consensual sex; their figures indicate that, at some point in their lives, about 20% of women and 1.5% of men in the United States have been raped.
target_text: 与修订后的强奸定义相近的是疾病控制和预防中心（CDC）2010年的一项研究，该研究包括男性强奸和非自愿性行为；他们的数据表明，在他们生活的某个阶段，美国大约百分之20的妇女和百分之1.5的男子被强奸。

source_text: Writing for Significance magazine, Stephanie Kovalchik says this report shows the US "is experiencing an epidemic of sexual violence."
target_text: 斯蒂芬妮·科瓦奇克在为《重要性》杂志撰稿时表示，这份报告显示，美国“正在经历一场性暴力流行病”。

source_text: Comparing with other CDC reports, she highlights "that [the] number of American women who have been raped is greater than the number who are current smokers."
target_text: 与疾控中心的其他报告相比，她强调说，“被强奸的美国妇女的人数比现在吸烟的妇女的人数还要多。”

source_text: Vice President Joe Biden, with a history of advocating improved rape legislation, described the changes as "a victory for women and men across the country whose suffering has gone unaccounted for over 80 years."
target_text: 美国副总统乔·拜登一向主张改善强奸立法，他形容这些变化是“全国各地遭受了80多年无法解释的痛苦的人们的胜利”。

source_text: Whilst still in the Senate, Biden led efforts to implement legislative change — including authoring the Violence Against Women Act.
target_text: 在担任参议员期间，拜登领导了实施立法改革的努力，包括制定《反妇女暴力法》。

source_text: The Philippine economy grew by 5.9%, annual rate, during the second quarter of 2012 which is less than the first quarter's figure of more than 6% annual rate, as reported by The Associated Press.
target_text: 据美联社报道，2012年第二季度菲律宾经济同比增长百分之5.9，低于第一季度百分之6以上的增速。

source_text: In spite of this growth, numerous risks still lurk around the corner, said Balisacan.
target_text: 巴利萨坎说，尽管有这种增长，但仍有许多风险潜伏在隐秘处。

source_text: Balsican also noted that poor infrastructure may also have a negative impact although spending on infrastructure, which may cost nearly $200 million in investment, may contribute to growth.
target_text: 巴利萨坎还指出，基础设施薄弱也可能会产生负面影响，尽管基础设施的投资可能会导致增长，这可能需要近2亿美元的投资。

source_text: The Philippines central bank has cut key interest rates three times already this year in order to continue this economic expansion.
target_text: 菲律宾央行今年已经三次下调基准利率，以继续经济扩张。

source_text: Analysts, such as economist Eugene Leow of Singapore-based DBS bank, agree that, "There is definitely room to further cut rates if needed," in order to promote further growth.
target_text: 新加坡星展银行经济学家尤金·利奥等分析师一致认为，“如果需要，肯定有进一步降息的空间”，以促进进一步增长。

source_text: Update November 21, 2005: All of the 14 miners missing were confirmed dead on Monday, the official Xinhua News Agency said.
target_text: 2005年11月21日更新：据新华社报道，所有失踪的14名矿工周一被证实死亡。

source_text: Seven miners have been killed and seven more are missing after a coal mine flooded in north China's Hebei province.
target_text: 在中国北方河北省的一个煤矿被洪水淹没后，有7名矿工遇难，另有7人失踪。

source_text: The Xinhua news agency reports the latest coal mine disaster occurred around 5:00 a.m. on Saturday in Xingtai City.
target_text: 据新华社报道，最近一次煤矿灾害发生在周六凌晨5点左右的邢台市。

source_text: A reason for the accident has not yet been given.
target_text: 事故原因还没有给出。

source_text: Owners of the coal mine have been detained by local police and the investigation into the cause of the flooding is underway.
target_text: 煤矿的业主已被当地警方拘留，正在调查洪水的原因。

source_text: State media reports say the disaster occurred at a pit in Xingtai City, but gave few other details.
target_text: 官方媒体报导说，这场灾难发生在邢台市的一个矿井，但没有提供其他细节。

source_text: China's mines, many of them illegal, are considered the world's most dangerous.
target_text: 中国的煤矿，其中许多是非法的，被认为是世界上最危险的。

source_text: Other independent estimates put the real figure at around 20,000.
target_text: 其他独立机构估计，实际数字在2万左右。

source_text: Saturday's accident follows a gas explosion at a coal mine in south-western China's Guizhou province on Friday killing at least ten people.
target_text: 星期六的事故是在星期五中国西南部贵州省一个煤矿的瓦斯爆炸事故发生后，造成至少10人死亡。

source_text: Xinhua reports that rescue work is underway, according to the local work safety supervision bureau.
target_text: 据新华社报道，当地安监局表示，救援工作正在进行中。

source_text: A spokesman said Yuanda Coal Mine, a collectively-owned mine in Neiqiu county of Xingtai, was flooded and all the 14 miners working down the pit were trapped.
target_text: 发言人说，邢台内丘县的集体矿山远大煤矿遭到洪水淹没，14名井下工作人员被困。

source_text: This is the second fatal mine accident in the area in two weeks.
target_text: 这是两周内该地区发生的第二起致命矿难事故。

source_text: Cave-ins at three plaster mines on November 6 caused 33 deaths and left at least four missing.
target_text: 11月6日，三个石膏矿发生塌方，造成33人死亡，至少4人失踪。

source_text: The unemployment rate in the Eurozone, or the sixteen countries in which the euro is used, reached ten percent last December, for the first time since the euro was introduced in 1999.
target_text: 去年12月，欧元区16个使用欧元的国家的失业率达到百分之10，这是自1999年引入欧元以来的首次。

source_text: A ten-percent jobless rate was initially recorded in November, although that was later revised down to 9.9%.
target_text: 在11月失业率最初记录为百分之十，尽管后来被修正为百分之9.9。

source_text: According to Eurostat, 15.8 million people now are without jobs in the Eurozone.
target_text: 据欧盟统计局统计，目前欧元区有1580万人没有工作。

source_text: For all 27 countries in the European Union, 23 million people collectively are unemployed.
target_text: 对于欧盟的所有27个国家，共有2300万人失业。

source_text: Eurostat reports that 87,000 jobs were lost throughout the eurozone in December, the smallest loss since May.
target_text: 欧盟统计局报告称，整个欧元区12月份共有8.7万人失业，这是自5月份以来的最小降幅。

source_text: Latvia had the highest jobless rate for the EU, at 22.8%, whilst Spain has the highest for the eurozone, at 19.5%.
target_text: 拉脱维亚的失业率最高，为22.8％，而西班牙是欧元区最高的失业率，为19.5％。

source_text: The two countries with the lowest unemployment rates were the Netherlands and Austria, with jobless figures of 4% and 5.4%, respectively.
target_text: 失业率最低的两个国家是荷兰和奥地利，失业率分别为4％和5.4％。

source_text: An analyst for IHS Global Insight, Howard Archer, commented on the figures.
target_text: IHS全球洞察力的分析师霍华德·阿彻对这些数据发表了评论。

source_text: "Although the rise in eurozone unemployment has slowed in recent months, it still seems poised to trend higher during much, if not all, of 2010," he noted.
target_text: 他指出：“尽管最近几个月欧元区失业率的上升有所放缓，但在2010年的大部分时间里，如果不是全部的话，失业率似乎仍有上升趋势”。

source_text: St. Petersburg, Florida police were taped on video handcuffing a five-year-old kindergarten student who had earlier torn papers off a bulletin board and punched an assistant principal.
target_text: 佛罗里达州圣彼得堡的警方被拍到给一名5岁的幼儿园学生戴上手铐，这位学生早先从公告板上撕下文件，并打了一名助理校长一拳。

source_text: The camera happened to be filming on March 14 as part of a classroom self-improvement exercise at Fairmount Park Elementary.
target_text: 3月14日，在费尔蒙特公园小学的一次课堂自我提高练习中，这架照相机碰巧正在拍摄。

source_text: Video of the event has been released by a lawyer for the child's mother.
target_text: 该事件的视频已由孩子母亲的律师发布。

source_text: The little girl had already calmed down from her tantrum by the time of arrival of the police, but they cuffed her anyway.
target_text: 警察来的时候，小女孩的怒气已经平息下来了，但他们还是把她铐了起来。

source_text: Police had been called when a phone call to mother Inga Akins, had led teachers to believe that it would take an hour for Ms Akins to arrive and take the girl away.
target_text: 当一个电话打给因加·阿金斯的母亲时，警方接到了报警，这让老师们相信，阿金斯女士需要一个小时的时间才能赶到并把女孩带走。

source_text: The video reportedly shows three officers pin the passive girl's arms behind her back and put on handcuffs, as she screams, "No!"
target_text: 据报道，录像显示，三名警官将毫无还击力的女孩的胳膊别在背后，戴上手铐，同时她尖叫着：“不！”

source_text: Attorney for the mother, John Trevena, called the incident "incomprehensible".
target_text: 母亲的律师约翰·特雷维纳称这一事件“不可理解”。

source_text: He provided the tape to the media this week, after obtaining it from police.
target_text: 在从警方那里得到这盘录像带后，他于本周向媒体提供了这盘录像带。

source_text: "The image itself will be seared into people's minds when you have three police officers bending a child over a table and forcibly handcuffing her," said Mr Trevena.
target_text: 特雷维纳说：“当你看到三名警察把一个孩子弯到桌子前，强行给她戴上手铐时，这个形象本身就会深深印在人们的脑海里。”

source_text: Western Australian district court judge Shauna Deane has found that a Muslim woman must remove her burqa in order to testify with regard to an Islamic school's alleged receiving of state and federal government funding in a fraudulent manner.
target_text: 西澳大利亚地区法院法官肖娜·迪恩发现，一名穆斯林女子必须脱掉罩袍，才能就一所伊斯兰学校涉嫌以欺诈方式接受州和联邦政府资助一事作证。

source_text: The woman, identified only as 'Tasneem', was deemed unable to wear her traditional coverings despite feeling uncomfortable removing them in public.
target_text: 这名女子名字仅为“塔斯尼姆”，她被认定为不能穿上罩袍，尽管在公共场合脱下传统的罩衫会让她感到不舒服。

source_text: Judge Shauna Deane found that it would not be suitable for 'Tasneem' to offer evidence with her face covered, stating that the need to maintain a fair trial is consistent with allowing the jury to view and interpret cues from the face of a witness.
target_text: 法官肖娜·迪恩认为，“塔斯尼姆”不适合在脸被遮住的情况下提供证据，她表示，维持公正审判的需要与允许陪审团查看和解释证人面部表情的暗示是一致的。

source_text: Leader of the Japanese opposition Democratic Party of Japan, Yukio Hatoyama, won a majority of votes in the House of Representatives of Japan in the Japanese general election on Sunday.
target_text: 日本反对党民主党领导人鸠山由纪夫周日在日本大选中获得日本众议院多数票。

source_text: He will be named the 93rd Prime Minister of Japan.
target_text: 他将被任命为日本第93任首相。

source_text: Hatoyama ran against now former Prime Minister of Japan and Liberal Democratic Party leader Taro Aso.
target_text: 鸠山由纪夫的对手是日本前首相、自民党党魁麻生太郎。

source_text: The results of the election were announced today, less that two and a half hours after polling stations closed, and end 54 years of nearly unbroken rule by the LDP.
target_text: 选举结果今天公布，距离投票站关闭不到两个半小时，结束了自民党54年几乎没有间断的统治。

source_text: It has been estimated that roughly 30% of LDP supporters voted for the victorious DPJ, mainly due to the current economic climate.
target_text: 据估计，大约30％的自民党支持者投票支持胜利的民主党，主要是由于目前的经济环境。

source_text: The Liberal Democratic Party was left with just 57 of 480 total seats.
target_text: 自由民主党在480个席位中仅剩57个席位。

source_text: Outgoing Prime Minister Taro Aso has promised to resign as party leader, saying, "I believe this is the judgement of the public and we have to accept that and reflect on what we did."
target_text: 即将卸任的首相麻生太郎已承诺辞去党的领导职务，并表示，“我相信这是公众的判断，我们必须接受这一点并反思我们所做的事情。”

source_text: "The people have shown their disappointment with the party and I have to accept that as my destiny."
target_text: “人们已经表现出对党的失望，我不得不接受这一点作为我的命运。”

source_text: Aso also said that he will stay on as leader until a new one is chosen.
target_text: 麻生太郎还表示，在选出新的领导者之前他将继续担任领导者。

source_text: The newly elected party also pledges to focus spending on households, especially rural families and those with children.
target_text: 新当选的民主党还承诺将把支出重点放在家庭上，尤其是农村家庭和有孩子的家庭。

source_text: Tokyo economist Koichi Haji predicts that the hope instilled in the Japanese people by the election result will stimulate the economy, causing stock prices to rise.
target_text: 东京经济学家Koichi Haji预测，选举结果给日本人民灌输的希望将刺激经济，导致股价上涨。

source_text: However, questions have been raised about the Democratic Party's stability, due to the wide spectrum of views and ideologies the party encompasses.
target_text: 然而，由于民主党拥有广泛的观点和意识形态，人们对民主党的稳定性提出了质疑。

source_text: Seminars and forums always played key roles to forecast the future of ICT industry worldwide after the COMPUTEX became more and more critical for businesspeople.
target_text: 在台北国际电脑展对商务人士越来越重要之后，研讨会和论坛一直在预测全球ICT产业的未来方面发挥着关键作用。

source_text: Not only e21FORUM, the DRAMeXchange Compuforum was progressively respected by DRAM industry since 2006.
target_text: 不仅是e21论坛，自2006年以来，DRAMeXchange台北国际计算机展论坛逐渐受到DRAM业界的尊重。

source_text: Since the mobile devices have become popular in the presence, the supply of DRAM modules is still inadequate to meet the demand.
target_text: 由于移动设备在现场变得很受欢迎，DRAM模块的供应仍不足以满足需求。

source_text: "The abandonment of 12-inch fabs and the suspension of 8-inch fabs are considered critical issues in this incident."
target_text: “在这起事件中，放弃12英寸晶圆厂和暂停生产8英寸晶圆厂被认为是关键问题”。

source_text: "If the Mainland China wants to enlarge its market stably, the supply chain and costs of material should be cautioned."
target_text: “如果中国大陆希望稳定扩大市场，就应该警惕供应链和原材料成本”。

source_text: With innovations of information technology, capacity of USB flash drives and mobile drives are larger and larger.
target_text: 随着信息技术的创新，USB闪存驱动器和移动驱动器的容量越来越大。

source_text: "Capacity, costs of production, prices, and efficiency on writing and reading are critical factors to determine an user on choosing SSDs, hard disks, or flash drives."
target_text: “容量、生产成本、价格和读写效率是决定用户选择ssd、硬盘或闪存驱动器的关键因素”。

source_text: "The market shares on storage will transform from enterprises to digital storage with a significant grown-up of Internet users within four years."
target_text: “存储市场份额将在4年内从企业向数字存储转变，互联网用户将大量增长”。

source_text: The UK Ministry of Defence (MoD) confirmed in a news release, March 21, 2007, that two Royal Navy crew members had been killed in an accident aboard nuclear submarine HMS Tireless earlier in the day.
target_text: 英国国防部（MoD）在2007年3月21日的一份新闻稿中证实，当天早些时候，英国皇家海军“不懈号”核潜艇发生事故，两名船员遇难。

source_text: Another submariner had been injured and was airlifted to a United States military hospital for treatment.
target_text: 另一名潜艇艇员受伤，被空运到美国军队医院接受治疗。

source_text: The accident occurred at 4:20 a.m., March 21, on board HMS Tireless, a Trafalgar class submarine, during a joint US-UK exercise in the Arctic.
target_text: 事故发生在3月21日凌晨4点20分，在英国和美国在北极联合演习期间，在特拉法加级潜艇“不懈号”上。

source_text: The MoD suggested that the accident involved a piece of air-purification equipment in the forward section of the submarine.
target_text: 国防部表示，事故涉及潜艇前部的一台空气净化设备。

source_text: The submarine was not in danger and its nuclear reactor was unaffected.
target_text: 潜艇没有危险，其核反应堆未受影响。

source_text: HMS Tireless is a hunter-killer submarine and does not carry nuclear missiles.
target_text: “不懈号”是一艘猎杀型潜艇，不携带核导弹。

source_text: HMS Tireless was submerged under the ice cap at the time of the incident.
target_text: 事故发生时，“不懈号”已被淹没在冰盖下。

source_text: The crew brought the submarine to surface quickly through the ice.
target_text: 船员们很快使潜艇穿过冰层浮出水面。

source_text: The Tireless was fitted, in 2001, with an update to the piece of air-purification machinery thought to have failed.
target_text: 2001年，“不懈号”被安装上了一个被认为已经失灵的空气净化设备的升级版。

source_text: As a precaution, the MoD is restricting its use on other boats until safety checks have been carried out.
target_text: 作为预防措施，在安全检查完成之前，国防部将限制在其他船只上使用。

source_text: "I very much regret that this incident has occurred and my thoughts go out to the family and friends of the men who have lost their lives," said Admiral Sir James Burnell-Nugent, Commander-in-Chief Fleet.
target_text: 美国海军上将、海军总司令詹姆斯·伯内尔·纽金特爵士表示：“我对这一事件的发生深感遗憾，我向遇难者的家人和朋友表示慰问”。

source_text: He added, "I also wish to pay tribute to the crew of HMS Tireless that this incident has been dealt with and contained so professionally."
target_text: 他补充说：“我也想向不懈号上的船员致敬，这一事件得到了如此专业的处理和控制”。

source_text: A representative of the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU), which supported Wikileaks, has told Wikinews their opinion of the court injunction.
target_text: 支持维基解密的美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）的一名代表告诉维基新闻他们对法院禁令的看法。

source_text: They have claimed that the lifting of the injunction was a "victory for the first amendment."
target_text: 他们声称取消禁令是“第一次修正案的胜利”。

source_text: The representative stated that the ACLU hopes this injunction acts as an example to other judges who take part in similar cases.
target_text: 该代表表示，ACLU希望这一禁令可以作为参与类似案件的其他法官的榜样。

source_text: This opinion was shown when the representative said that the lifting of the injunction will "hopefully help show other courts that injunctions against speech, including speech on the Internet, are not appropriate."
target_text: 该代表表示，解除禁令“希望有助于向其他法院表明，禁止言论，包括在互联网上发表言论，是不恰当的”。

source_text: The permanent injunction was granted in the California Northern District Court in San Francisco, California to Bank Julius Baer, a Swiss bank, which has caused the domain to be taken off line in the U.S..
target_text: 位于加州旧金山的加州北部地区法院向瑞士宝盛银行下达了永久禁令，导致该域名在美国下线。

source_text: Wikileaks previously published several documents obtained from a whistleblower of the Swiss Bank, "purportedly showing offshore tax evasion and money laundering by extremely wealthy and in some cases, politically sensitive, clients from the United States, Europe, China and Peru."
target_text: 维基解密此前公布了几份从瑞士银行一名告密者那里获得的文件，“据称显示了极为富有的人和一些政治敏感的美国、欧洲、中国和秘鲁客户的离岸逃税和洗钱行为”。

source_text: "Blocking access to the entire site in response to a few documents posted there completely disregards the public's right to know," said Ann Brick a lawyer for the ACLU, in a statement made before the injunction was lifted.
target_text: 美国公民自由联盟的律师安·布里克在禁令解除前发表的一份声明中表示：“为了回应发布在网站上的一些文件而封锁对整个网站的访问完全无视公众的知情权”。

source_text: At least 18 other organizations have signed documents in defense of Wikileaks.
target_text: 至少有18个其他组织已经签署了为维基解密辩护的文件。

source_text: On Tuesday the 31st of January, Dr Don Brash, the leader of the New Zealand National Party gave his third state of the nation speech to the Orewa Rotary Club where he focussed on the economy.
target_text: 1月31日星期二，新西兰国家领袖唐·布拉什博士在奥瑞瓦扶轮社发表了他的第三次国情咨文演说，在演说中他将重点放在经济上。

source_text: Brash said business confidence in New Zealand is at its lowest level in 30 years and almost every day there is another company closing its doors or sharply reducing its staff.
target_text: 布拉什表示，新西兰的商业信心处于30年来的最低水平，几乎每天都有另一家公司关门或大幅削减员工。

source_text: He predicted that "many businesses will face very tough times, and that unemployment will rise steeply."
target_text: 他预测“许多企业将面临非常艰难的时期，失业率将急剧上升”。

source_text: Brash said the blame for any recession will lie squarely with the Prime Minister Helen Clark and Labour.
target_text: 布拉什说，任何经济衰退的责任都将完全由英国首相海伦·克拉克和工党承担。

source_text: Brash said he had hoped to return as Prime Minister to give this speech.
target_text: 布拉什说，他曾希望以总理的身份回来发表这次演讲。

source_text: He also said that he intends to lead National in the next New Zealand general election (2008) and would be surprised if he is replaced before then.
target_text: 他还说，他打算在下一次新西兰大选（2008年）中领导国家党，如果他在那之前被取代，他会感到惊讶。

source_text: He also claimed the speech was riddled with inaccuracies, particularly over Government spending.
target_text: 他还声称，演讲充斥着不准确之处，尤其是在政府开支方面。

source_text: Brash's first speech at Orewa, delivered by Brash on 27 January 2004, was highly controversial.
target_text: 布拉什于2004年1月27日在布拉什发表的第一次奥拉瓦演讲引起极大争议。

source_text: It addressed the theme of race relations in New Zealand, particularly the special status of Māori, New Zealand's indigenous ethnic group.
target_text: 它讨论了新西兰种族关系的主题，特别是新西兰土著族群毛利人的特殊地位。

source_text: Some regard the speech as a watershed moment in New Zealand politics.
target_text: 一些人认为这次演讲是新西兰政治的一个分水岭。

source_text: German rock and metal label GUN Records (Great Unlimited Noises) announced Friday that they were to close.
target_text: 德国摇滚和金属唱片公司GUN Records（无限噪音）周五宣布关闭。

source_text: Formed as a joint venture between BMG and Wolfgang Funk in 1992, the label had seen its parent merge with Sony in 2005 to form Sony BMG and Funk quit as president in December 2008.
target_text: 1992年，BMG与沃尔夫冈·芬克成立合资公司，2005年其母公司与索尼合并，成立索尼BMG。2008年12月，芬克辞去总裁一职。

source_text: GUN's current international acts - including Wales' Bullet for My Valentine, Finland's Lordi and the Netherlands' Within Tempatation - will now be handled out of Sony's Munich international division.
target_text: GUN目前的国际演出包括威尔士的《情人节的子弹》、芬兰的《洛迪》和荷兰的《在诱惑内》，现在将由索尼慕尼黑国际分部负责。

source_text: National artists, such as Oomph! and The Donots, will also be Sony's direct responsibility via either Four Music or Columbia Germany in Berlin.
target_text: 民族艺术家，如Oomph！和Donots，此外，索尼还将通过四音乐或位于柏林的哥伦比亚德国分公司直接负责多诺特唱片的销售。

source_text: The label has also worked with Sturm und Drang, Apocalyptica and HIM.
target_text: 该品牌还与狂飚时期、金属启示录和HIM合作。

source_text: The closure will affect eight employees including Arno Hartfield, the managing director.
target_text: 此次关闭将影响包括董事总经理阿诺·哈特菲尔德在内的8名员工。

source_text: Gonzales is accused of secretly agreeing to pay $11 million in city funds to waste disposal company Norcal Waste Systems, without notice or approval by the city council.
target_text: 冈萨雷斯被控在未经市政委员会通知或批准的情况下，秘密同意向废物处理公司诺克尔废品管理局支付1100万美元的市政资金。

source_text: The scandal has already resulted in an independent investigation, civil grand jury proceedings, Gonzales's censure by the council, and council members calling for his resignation or removal from office.
target_text: 这一丑闻已经导致了独立调查、民事大陪审团程序、委员会对冈萨雷斯的指责，以及委员会成员要求他辞职或下台。

source_text: In a statement responding to the DA's investigation, Gonzales announced he has hired Allen Ruby, a high-profile Silicon Valley attorney, to represent him in this matter.
target_text: 冈萨雷斯在一份回应地方检察官调查的声明中宣布，他已聘请硅谷知名律师艾伦·鲁比在这件事上代表他。

source_text: Ruby has previously represented the National Football League in lawsuits against Oakland Raiders owner Al Davis.
target_text: 鲁比此前曾代表美国国家橄榄球联盟起诉奥克兰袭击者队老板阿尔·戴维斯。

source_text: Gonzales's statement also supported the decision of the DA to conduct further investigations into the city's contract.
target_text: 冈萨雷斯的声明也支持地方检察官对该市合同进行进一步调查的决定。

source_text: The mother of a firefighter who died in his duties fighting the blaze in southern California, has pleaded to the arsonist responsible for the 40,450 acre inferno to give himself up, and that she will not judge him.
target_text: 一名消防队员在南加州救火时殉职，他的母亲请求负责40450英亩火海的纵火犯自首，她不会批评他。

source_text: Bonnie McKay, mother to 27-year-old Jason McKay, said "I firmly believe you didn't believe that things were going to turn out the way they did, but they did."
target_text: 27岁的杰森·麦凯的母亲邦尼·麦凯说：“我坚信你不相信事情会发展成现在的样子，但事实确实如此”。

source_text: The fire, which has claimed the lives of four firefighters and caused 95% burns to a fifth, is now 60% contained.
target_text: 这场夺去四名消防员的生命，造成五分之一的人烧伤率在百分之95的大火，现在百分之60已经得到控制。

source_text: There is a massive aerial attack on the fire in progress, making use of fire helicopters and planes to dump thousands of gallons of water onto the blaze over the canyons of Riverside County.
target_text: 一场大规模的空中灭火正在进行中，消防直升机和飞机将数千加仑的水倾倒在河滨县的峡谷上。

source_text: The blaze has now destroyed as many as 27 homes, and has forced the evacuation of 500 more.
target_text: 大火现在已经摧毁了多达27所房屋，并迫使500多人撤离。

source_text: Bingu wa Mutharika, the president of the African country of Malawi, was inaugurated on Friday after having been reelected to a second five-year term.
target_text: 非洲马拉维国家总统宾瓦·穆塔里卡在连任第二个五年任期后于周五就职。

source_text: The Malawian election commission had earlier reported that wa Mutharika had won the election, having taken 2.7 million votes, more than twice than the 1.3 million votes received by the second place contestant, John Tembo.
target_text: 马拉维选举委员会早些时候报告说，瓦·穆塔里卡赢得了选举，获得270万张选票，是第二名选手约翰·坦博获得的130万张选票的两倍多。

source_text: In a statement at his inauguration ceremony, Mutharika said one of his highest priorities would be to battle with corruption.
target_text: 穆塔里卡在就职仪式上的一份声明中表示，他的首要任务之一就是与腐败作斗争。

source_text: "I shall continue to fight corruption because it is evil."
target_text: “我将继续打击腐败，因为它是邪恶的”。

source_text: "Corruption in whatever form or shape is an enemy to growth and prosperity because it robs the poor, and denies their legitimate right to development."
target_text: “任何方式或形态的腐败都是增长和繁荣的敌人，因为它剥夺了穷人，剥夺了他们合法的发展权”。

source_text: "In the next five years my administration will continue to prioritize agriculture and food security," the president said.
target_text: “在未来五年内，我的政府将继续优先考虑农业和粮食安全”，总统说。

source_text: "We will remain committed in ensuring that our current food production levels increase further to sustain the country's food self-sufficiency."
target_text: “我们将继续致力于确保我们目前的粮食产量水平进一步提高，以维持本国的粮食自给自足”。

source_text: The opposition has contested the election results and boycotted the president's inauguration.
target_text: 反对派对选举结果提出质疑，并抵制总统的就职典礼。

source_text: "These elections have been rigged," opposition leader John Tembo said.
target_text: “这些选举被操纵了”，反对派领导人约翰·坦博说。

source_text: He has said he will challenge the election's outcome in court.
target_text: 他说，他将在法庭上对选举结果提出质疑。

source_text: December 29, 2004 The death toll from the earthquake and tsunamis that has hit countries in Asia and Eastern Africa continues to rise, passing 80,000 people according to reports from several news agencies.
target_text: 2004年12月29日根据几家新闻机构的报道，地震和海啸对亚洲和东非国家造成的死亡人数继续增加，超过8万人。

source_text: A spokesman for the Red Cross speculated that the toll could increase to over 100,000 as some of the smaller islands in the Indian Ocean are checked, and a U.N. official said that the death toll might eventually approach 80,000 in Indonesia alone.
target_text: 红十字会一位发言人猜测，随着印度洋上一些较小岛屿的搜救工作进行，死亡人数可能会增加到10万以上。一名联合国官员说，仅印度尼西亚的死亡人数最终就可能接近8万人。

source_text: The immediate fatalities from the earthquake and resulting tsunamis are but a fraction of the total effect from the disaster.
target_text: 地震和随之而来的海啸造成的直接死亡只是这场灾难全部影响的一小部分。

source_text: The World Health Organization (WHO) estimates that 5 million people lack food, water or basic sanitation necessary for survival.
target_text: 世界卫生组织（WHO）估计，有500万人缺乏生存所需的食物、水或基本卫生设施。

source_text: In the 20 games so far this season, only three home wins had been recorded, but for the first time ever in the league, all four home teams won their respective matches in a single round.
target_text: 在本赛季迄今为止的20场比赛中，只有三场主场胜利被记录在案，但这是联盟有史以来第一次，所有四支主场球队都在一轮比赛中赢得了各自的比赛。

source_text: The Mariners stay four points clear at the top despite losing its first game of the season against Adelaide, while Wellington had their first taste of victory at home, with the Phoenix smashing Perth 4-1.
target_text: 尽管在本赛季的第一场比赛中输给阿德莱德，但水手队仍然以4分的优势领先，而威灵顿队则在主场首次尝到了胜利的滋味，菲尼克斯以4-1大胜珀斯队。

source_text: Melbourne and Sydney are set for a blockbuster in Sydney next week, after both had hard fought wins.
target_text: 墨尔本和悉尼将于下周在悉尼上演重磅的比赛，此前两场比赛都取得了艰苦的胜利。

source_text: The United States Army has suspended its contract with a company that delivered old and corroding ammunition from China for use by Afghan army and police forces in a way that violated the contract terms.
target_text: 美国军方暂停了与一家公司的合同。这家公司从中国运送陈旧、锈蚀的弹药，供阿富汗军队和警察部队使用，违反了合同条款。

source_text: The ammunition was supplied by the Miami-based AEY Inc., a company run by a 22-year old named Efrain Diveroli.
target_text: 弹药由总部位于迈阿密的AEY Inc.提供，该公司由22岁的埃夫瑞恩·泰华沃里经营。

source_text: The nearly US$300 million contract stated that bullets were coming from Hungary, but were actually decades-old, damaged and corroded bullets from China.
target_text: 这项近3亿美元的合同规定，子弹来自匈牙利，但实际上是来自中国的数十年之久，受损和腐蚀的子弹。

source_text: Officials from the Army Legal Services Agency notified Diveroli, via a letter, that his company is suspended from future contracting with any U.S. government agency.
target_text: 美国陆军法律服务局的官员通过一封信通知泰华沃里，他的公司今后不再与任何美国政府机构签订合同。

source_text: The letter came as part of an Army investigation since November regarding violation of the contract.
target_text: 自去年11月以来，这封信是军方就违反合同展开调查的一部分。

source_text: According to the New York Times, Diveroli signed papers back on November 25, 2007 certifying that 28 pallets of ammunition for Afghanistan had been manufactured by MFS 2000, a Hungarian company, according to a memo written by investigators.
target_text: 据《纽约时报》报道，根据调查人员撰写的一份备忘录，泰华沃里在2007年11月25日签署了文件，证明匈牙利MFS2000公司为阿富汗生产了28个弹药托盘。

source_text: AEY violated the contract by breaking two clauses, one stating that the ammunition could not be acquired directly or indirectly from the People’s Republic of China, which is a violation of American law.
target_text: AEY违反合同的两个条款，一个条款规定弹药不能直接或间接从中华人民共和国获得，这违反了美国法律。

source_text: The other clause specified that it must be packaged to comply with best commercial practices for international shipment.
target_text: 另一条款规定必须对其进行包装，以符合国际货运的最佳商业惯例。

source_text: According to the Times, says the ammunition arrived in decomposing cardboard boxes which contained ammunition dating as far back as 1966.
target_text: 据《泰晤士报》报道，这些弹药是从分解的纸箱里运来的，纸箱里的弹药可以追溯到1966年。

source_text: However, Army officials believe some ammunition even dates back further to 1962.
target_text: 然而，陆军官员认为，一些弹药甚至可以追溯到1962年。

source_text: The Army had contracted with AEY in January 2007 to supply various types of nonstandard ammunition for use by the Afghan National Army and Afghan National Police, an Army official said on background.
target_text: 一名军方官员透露，军方在2007年1月与AEY签订合同，为阿富汗国民军和阿富汗国家警察提供各种非标准弹药。

source_text: The company was required to purchase the ammunition and deliver it to Kabul International Airport in Afghanistan.
target_text: 该公司被要求购买弹药并运送到阿富汗喀布尔国际机场。

source_text: AEY was recently awarded a delivery order amount of $48,717,553 on March 17, 2007 as part of the $298,004,398 contract.
target_text: AEY最近于2007年3月17日获得了48,717,553美元的交付订单金额，作为298,004,398美元合同的一部分。

source_text: Also according to the Times, when purchasing the ammunition, AEY worked with middlemen and a shell company which has been placed on federal list of entities suspected of illegal arms trafficking.
target_text: 据“泰晤士报”报道，在购买弹药时，AEY与中间人和一家空壳公司合作，该公司被列入涉嫌非法武器贩运的联邦实体名单。

source_text: Also, the Times reported that, Diveroli was secretly recorded in conversation that suggested corruption on his company's purchase of 100 million aging rounds from Albania.
target_text: 此外，《纽约时报》报道称，泰华沃里的谈话被秘密录音，录音中暗示，他的公司从阿尔巴尼亚购买了1亿枚老化弹，存在腐败行为。

source_text: Bryan Whitman, The Pentagon's spokesperson told reporters that suspension of the contract was due to the violation of the origin of the ammunition and the packaging of the ammunition, not the safety and performance.
target_text: 五角大楼发言人惠特曼对记者说，暂停合同是因为违反了弹药的产地和包装，而不是因为安全和性能。

source_text: ”They have had no safety incidents reported and no reports of any ammunition that has malfunctioned associated with this particular contract,” Whitman told the press.
target_text: “他们没有报告任何安全事件，也没有任何与此特定合同有关的弹药报告”，惠特曼告诉记者。

source_text: “As the United States government does business, they are obviously always trying to ensure they get the best value,” he said.
target_text: “随着美国政府开展业务，他们显然总是试图确保他们获得最大价值”，他说。

source_text: “But that does not mean that, in achieving the best value for the taxpayer, that we will accept something that is below standard for what it is we are purchasing, either.”
target_text: “但这并不意味着，为了实现纳税人的最大价值，我们将接受一些低于我们购买的标准的东西”。

source_text: According to an Army official, the suspension of the contract will not have an impact on Afghanistan operations and other contractors are expressing interest into entering into a contract.
target_text: 根据一名陆军官员的说法，暂停合同不会对阿富汗的行动产生影响，其他承包商也表示有兴趣签订合同。

source_text: Michael Diveroli, Efrain's father, who originally founded AEY as a small printing business, said of his son's career choice to CBS' Miami affiliate, WFOR, "I would prefer he became a nice Jewish doctor or lawyer rather than an arms dealer."
target_text: 埃夫伦的父亲迈克尔·泰华沃里最初是一家小型印刷企业，他对哥伦比亚广播公司迈阿密分公司WFOR的职业选择表示：“我更希望他成为一名优秀的犹太医生或律师，而不是军火商”。

source_text: "He doesn't always take my advice, I don't influence him."
target_text: “他并不总是接受我的建议，我不会影响他”。

source_text: "As a father of a boy genius he's hard to control."
target_text: “作为一个天才少年的父亲，我觉得他很难控制”。

source_text: Angelo Diveroli, Efrain's grandfather said the young man frequently accompanied him to gun shows when he was younger and became an expert at weapons.
target_text: 埃夫拉因的祖父安吉洛·泰华沃里说，埃夫拉因年轻时经常陪他去看枪支展览，后来成了一名武器专家。

source_text: "How do you give someone, a 21 year old kid a contract like that?"
target_text: “你怎么给一个21岁的孩子这样的合同？”

source_text: The United States Army Criminal Investigation Command is continuing their investigation, according to officials.
target_text: 据官员称，美国陆军刑事侦查司令部正在继续调查。

source_text: Having outlined his manifesto in his last pre-election radio broadcast, beleaguered Thai Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra has failed to deflect calls for his resignation.
target_text: 在上一次选举前广播中概述了他的宣言后，四面楚歌的泰国总理他信·西那瓦未能转移要求他辞职的呼声。

source_text: Offering an increased minimum wage, additional debt relief for farmers, and pay rises for civil servants the PM starts the election campaign with his Thai Loves Thais (Phak Thai Rak Thai) party in good shape for the snap election announced last Friday.
target_text: 总理宣布提高最低工资标准，免除农民额外的债务，并提高公务员的工资。为了迎接上周五宣布的临时选举，总理带领他的泰国爱泰党（为泰党）开始了竞选活动。

source_text: Thaksin's dissolution of the lower house of parliament, and move to re-establish his authority through elections has met with criticism from leaders in the troubled southern provinces as well as from political opponents.
target_text: 他信解散议会下院，并通过选举重新建立自己的权力，遭到了南方各省以及政治反对派领导人的批评。

source_text: Zafi-in Jae-loh, the deputy chairman of Narathiwat Islamic Committee said the move would do nothing to help the situation faced by ethnic Malay Muslims in the south.
target_text: 纳拉提瓦特伊斯兰委员会副主席扎菲在杰洛说，此举对南部马来族穆斯林面临的形势没有任何帮助。

source_text: The three southernmost provinces, Narathiwat, Pattani, and Yala face near-daily bombings and shootings with a considerable armed forces presence contributing to tensions in the area.
target_text: 最南端的三个省，纳拉提瓦特、帕塔尼和雅拉，每天都面临着爆炸和枪击事件，大量武装力量的存在加剧了该地区的紧张局势。

source_text: Opposition parties concerned that the three years early election will not resolve the current political situation have announced that they may boycott the April 2 poll.
target_text: 反对党担心，提前三年举行的选举无法解决目前的政治局势，已宣布他们可能会抵制4月2日的投票。

source_text: The Democrats (Phak Prachatipat) and the smaller Great People's Party (Phak Mahachon) took over 25% of the vote in the February 2005 elections.
target_text: 民主党和较小的伟大人民党在2005年2月的选举中获得了百分之25的选票。

source_text: Third placed at the last election with 11.4% of the vote, the Thai Nation Party (Phak Chart Thai) have yet to announce their decision, leaving party leader Banharn Silapa-archa to decide.
target_text: 泰国民族党 在上一次选举中以百分之11.4的得票率位居第三，但尚未宣布他们的决定，政党领导人Barharn Silapa Archa将做出决定。

source_text: Despite the upcoming election, and in the face of rumours of violence, a mass protest against the Prime Minister still went ahead.
target_text: 尽管即将举行大选，面对暴力传言，针对首相的大规模抗议仍在继续。

source_text: The People’s Alliance for Democracy was reported to be monitoring a crowd they were suspicious of ahead of the rally in Sanam Luang, Bangkok.
target_text: 据报道，人民民主联盟在曼谷的萨南卢昂集会前监视着一群他们怀疑的人。

source_text: Noon saw the arrival of former politician Chamlong Srimuang with the Santi Asoke Buddhist sect, including barefoot monks and nuns.
target_text: 中午，前政治家查姆隆·斯里蒙与三提阿育王佛教派别，包括赤脚僧侣和修女，一同抵达。

source_text: Alluding to past protests that had toppled Thai governments, Chamlong said "We can eat anything, sleep anywhere."
target_text: 查姆龙提到过去推翻泰国政府的抗议，他说：“我们可以吃任何东西，睡任何地方”。

source_text: Anti-Thaksin banners displayed at the open-air rally stated that the he had "No right to rule", while others read "Thaksin=Toxin" below an image aimed at comparing the PM with Adolf Hitler.
target_text: 在露天集会上展示的反他信的横幅写着他“无权统治”，而其他人则在下面读到“他信=毒素”，目的是将首相与阿道夫·希特勒进行比较。

source_text: Calls for the PM to go have a long history, with his policy of pursuing his opponents through the courts drawing the attention of the King, thus leading to Thaksin dropping cases against media firebrand, Sondhi Limthongkul.
target_text: 呼吁总理下台的历史由来已久，他通过法庭追捕对手的政策引起了国王的注意，从而导致他信放弃了对媒体煽动者桑迪·利莫通库尔的起诉。

source_text: A challenge through the country's Constitutional Court was brought by 28 of the country's senators following the PM's family selling their 49% share in Shin Corporation tax-free.
target_text: 在首相的家人免税出售其在新公司百分之49的股份后，28名参议员通过该国宪法法院提出了一项挑战。

source_text: The sale, to Temasek Holdings, was widely seen as allowing control of key telecoms infrastructure to pass into foreign hands.
target_text: 此次出售给淡马锡控股公司，被广泛视为允许将对关键电信基础设施的控制权移交给外国。

source_text: Wikipedia describes Temasek as, "the investment arm of the Singapore government."
target_text: 维基百科将淡马锡描述为“新加坡政府的投资部门”。

source_text: 15 elite commandos in the Pakistan anti-terror unit have been killed in a suicide car bomb attack.
target_text: 巴基斯坦反恐部队的15名精英突击队员在一次自杀式汽车炸弹袭击中丧生。

source_text: The car rammed into the brigade headquarters of the Special Operations Task Force, part of the Pakistan military Special Services Group, set up in conjunction with the United States.
target_text: 这辆汽车撞上了巴基斯坦特别行动部队的旅总部，该部队隶属于巴基斯坦军事特别服务集团，是与美国联合成立的。

source_text: It is believed to be the work of Islamic terrorists.
target_text: 据信这是伊斯兰恐怖分子所为。

source_text: The bomb destroyed the mess hall, killing at least 15 and injuring 50 more, six critically.
target_text: 炸弹摧毁了食堂，造成至少15人死亡，50人受伤，其中6人伤势严重。

source_text: It is thought the dead may include members of the CIA.
target_text: 据认为死者可能包括中央情报局的成员。

source_text: The wounded were taken to a local military hospital for treatment, while security forces secured the scene of the blast.
target_text: 伤者被送往当地军队医院接受治疗，而安全部队则保护了爆炸现场。

source_text: The attack coincided with US Deputy Secretary of State John Negroponte visiting the country.
target_text: 袭击发生时，美国副国务卿约翰·内格罗蓬特正在访问该国。

source_text: The Special Operations Task Force was heavily involved in last month's storming of the Red Mosque in Islamabad, and is accused by Islamic extremists with links to Al-Qaeda and the Taliban of brutal conduct in the incident.
target_text: 特别行动特别小组积极参与了上月对伊斯兰堡红色清真寺的袭击，并被与基地组织和塔利班有联系的伊斯兰极端分子指控在该事件中有野蛮行为。

source_text: The unit has also attacked terrorists near the border on which Osama bin Laden is thought to be hiding.
target_text: 该部队还袭击了奥萨马·本·拉登藏身的边境附近的恐怖分子。

source_text: Observers have expressed concern at the fact that the bomber was able to successfully attack such a high-profile and heavily guarded target as the headquarters, especially considering the building's close proximity to the Tarbela Dam generator, considered an important strategic asset.
target_text: 观察员对轰炸机能够成功攻击总部这样一个备受瞩目、戒备森严的目标表示关注，特别是考虑到该建筑靠近塔尔贝拉大坝发电机，这被认为是一项重要的战略资产。

source_text: “Obviously, this was someone who was known and familiar to the soldiers there, and it could be one of the civilians working at the base.”
target_text: “显然，这个人是那里的士兵熟悉的，可能是在基地工作的平民之一”。

source_text: Earlier this month, an attack aimed at the powerful Inter-Services Intelligence killed 25 people.
target_text: 本月早些时候，一场针对强大的三军情报局的袭击造成25人死亡。

source_text: In the morning of 30 October 2005, Romania with other countries from Europe will switch to Official Winter Time.
target_text: 2005年10月30日上午，罗马尼亚和其他欧洲国家将正式改用官方冬令时。

source_text: Thus, 04:00 AM will become 03:00 AM and will be valid until 26 March 2006 when the Official Summer Time will be again used.
target_text: 因此，04：00AM将变为03：00AM，有效期至2006年3月26日，届时将再次使用官方的夏令时。

source_text: Official Winter Time is adopted in the last Sunday of October and the Summer Time in last Sunday of March.
target_text: 官方的冬令时是在10月的最后一个星期日，夏令时是在3月的最后一个星期日。

source_text: Usually, the official time of a country is Winter Time.
target_text: 通常，一个国家的官方时间是冬令时。

source_text: Summer Time is a legal time adopted by some countries or territories during a part of a year.
target_text: 夏令时是一些国家或地区在一年中某段时间内采用的法定时间。

source_text: Summer Time is usually one hour in front of Standard Official Time.
target_text: 夏令时通常比标准的官方时间提前一小时。

source_text: During summer months, the time is moved forward in order to use as much sunlight for human activities, as well as to save electric energy used for lighting.
target_text: 在夏季的几个月里，时间被提前，以便为人类活动使用尽可能多的阳光，以及节省用于照明的电能。

source_text: Until 1939 this worked yearly from the first Sunday of April (in 1932: 22 May) 00:00 AM and the first Sunday of October 01:00 AM (local time).
target_text: 1939年以前，每年从4月的第一个星期日（1932年5月22日）上午00：00和10月的第一个星期日上午01：00（当地时间）开始实行。

source_text: From 1 April 1940 00:00 AM and 2 November 1942 03:00 AM, Summer Time was permanent in Romania.
target_text: 从1940年4月1日凌晨00：00到1942年11月2日凌晨03：00，夏令时在罗马尼亚是永久性的。

source_text: From 1943 the Summer Time was suspended and Romania used just Official Time (Winter Time).
target_text: 从1943年起，夏令时暂停，罗马尼亚仅使用官方时间（冬令时）。

source_text: A 70 centimeter (27.6 in) zander on Lake Maggiore, Switzerland was killed by police divers after it attacked several swimmers over the weekend.
target_text: 瑞士马焦雷湖上一个70厘米（27.6英寸）的梭鲈在周末袭击了几名游泳运动员后被警察潜水员杀死。

source_text: The fish bit six bathers, two of whom required emergency medical treatment for bite wounds up to 10 centimeters (3.9 in) long.
target_text: 这条鱼咬伤了6名游泳者，其中2人的伤口长达10厘米（3.9英寸），需要紧急治疗。

source_text: It is suspected the fish's aggression could have been a result of a hormonal imbalance.
target_text: 人们怀疑这种鱼的攻击性可能是荷尔蒙失衡的结果。

source_text: After attempts to capture the Zander with a net failed, police divers resorted to harpooning it.
target_text: 在试图用网捕获这只梭鱼失败后，警方潜水员只好用鱼叉将其捕获。

source_text: Meat from the fish was later served to tourists around the lake.
target_text: 鱼的肉后来被供应给湖边的游客。

source_text: Two cars have been involved in a road traffic accident in the Scottish Lothian and Borders region, causing three fatalities and sending three to hospital.
target_text: 两辆汽车在苏格兰洛锡安和边境地区发生道路交通事故，造成3人死亡，3人被送往医院。

source_text: The incident occurred on the A68 road approximately 1.5 miles south of the Midlothian village of Pathhead when a Škoda Octavia and a Nissan Note travelling in opposite directions collided at approximately 0730 UTC today.
target_text: 事故发生在A68公路上，距离帕斯黑德的中洛锡安郡村以南约1.5英里，今天，一辆斯科达奥克塔维亚和一辆朝相反方向行驶的日产诺特在大约7：30协调时相撞。

source_text: Three male Buddhist monks who sat in the back of the car died at the site of the crash.
target_text: 三名坐在汽车后座的男性佛教僧侣在车祸现场死亡。

source_text: The female driver of the vehicle managed to get out of the vehicle herself but another male passenger in the front of the car had to be cut free by fire service members.
target_text: 这辆车的女司机设法自己离开了车辆，但前面的另一名男乘客不得不由消防队员救出来。

source_text: The two front-seat passengers as well as the male driver of the Škoda were hospitalised at the Royal Infirmary of Edinburgh, although none of their injuries are considered likely to be fatal.
target_text: 这两名前排乘客以及斯柯达的男司机在爱丁堡皇家医院接受了住院治疗，尽管他们的伤势都不被认为是致命的。

source_text: "This is a tragic incident," Inspector Simon Bradshaw of Lothian and Borders Police said, "and we are currently in the process of carrying out inquiries in order to establish the full circumstances of the collision."
target_text: “这是一个悲惨的事件”，洛蒂安和边境警察局的西蒙·布拉德肖警官说，“我们目前正在进行调查，以确定碰撞的全部情况”。

source_text: The A68 road close to the location of the accident was temporarily closed to allow police to investigate the incident, with traffic redirected to the B6370 road via the town of Gorebridge.
target_text: 靠近事故发生地的A68公路被暂时关闭，以便警方调查事故，车辆经戈尔布里奇镇改道至B6370公路。

source_text: Pakistani military agreed to help in the rescue mission of Slovenian alpinist Tomaž Humar.
target_text: 巴基斯坦军方同意协助斯洛文尼亚登山运动员托马胡马尔的营救任务。

source_text: Humar was on his paramount course mission on the 4700 meter high south rock wall of the 8125 meter high Nanga Parbat mountain (the utmost west of the mountain chain) in the Himalaya mountains, being trapped in the ice-hole at an approximate height of 5900 meters for five days.
target_text: 胡马尔在喜马拉雅山脉南加帕尔巴特山（山脉最西端）海拔8125米的南岩壁上执行他的首要任务，在大约5900米的冰洞中被困5天。

source_text: The rescue mission with the military helicopter is planned for Monday morning local time, August 8, 2005.
target_text: 直升机救援任务定于当地时间8月8日星期一上午进行。

source_text: Swiss Air Zermatt rescue pilots offered their help in the effort.
target_text: 瑞士泽马特航空公司的救援飞行员在救援行动中提供了的帮助。

source_text: In an atmosphere of fun and excitement, the 4th annual Junior Eurovision Song Contest was held in Bucharest, Romania.
target_text: 在一个充满乐趣和兴奋的气氛中，第四届欧洲青年歌曲大赛在罗马尼亚布加勒斯特举行。

source_text: Followed by Russia were pre-contest favorites Belarus (winners of the 2005 edition), and Sweden taking the second and third places respectively.
target_text: 被俄罗斯紧随其后的是赛前最受喜爱的白俄罗斯（2005年世界杯冠军）和瑞典分列第二和第三。

source_text: The evening began with an introduction by 12-year-old co-hostess Ioana Ivan followed by an elaborate dance routine.
target_text: 晚会开始时，12岁的联合主持人伊万做了一个介绍，随后是一个精心安排的舞蹈节目。

source_text: Romanian reporter, Andreea Marin took to the stage to kick off the 15 performances from various European countries.
target_text: 罗马尼亚记者安德烈·马林上台开场，开始了来自欧洲各国的15场演出。

source_text: Romania incorporated historic and modern elements in an interesting way that would appeal to children everywhere.
target_text: 罗马尼亚以有趣的方式将历史和现代元素纳入其中，以吸引世界各地的儿童。

source_text: Dracula was also present on stage, helping Ioana and Andreea present.
target_text: 德古拉也出现在舞台上，帮助伊奥娜和安德烈出场。

source_text: At the end of the voting, most of the reactions expressed shock in the Portuguese and Macedonian results.
target_text: 在投票结束时，大多数人对葡萄牙和马其顿的结果表示震惊。

source_text: These two countries could be found at the bottom of the scoreboard.
target_text: 这两个国家可以在记分板的底部找到。

source_text: The Greater Manchester town of Rochdale has begun setting up decorations for a number of festivities, including Eid, a Muslim holiday.
target_text: 大曼彻斯特城镇罗奇代尔已经开始为许多庆祝活动设置装饰品，包括穆斯林节日开斋节。

source_text: However, there's a twist—in order to save money, the town is also erecting Christmas decorations early.
target_text: 然而为了省钱出现了交叠，该镇也早早地开始了圣诞装饰。

source_text: Among the decorations were a giant Noel sign, holly leaves, and a skiing penguin.
target_text: 其中的装饰品有巨型诺埃尔标志、冬青树叶和滑雪企鹅。

source_text: Some residents were opposed to the move; one person said, "Seeing the lights makes me feel depressed."
target_text: 一些居民反对搬迁，有人说，“看到灯光让我感到沮丧”。

source_text: "I know we haven't had much of a summer, but let's get it out of the way first".
target_text: “我知道我们这个夏天过得不怎么样，但让我们先把它解决掉”。

source_text: "It's the height of summer and they're putting up Christmas lights."
target_text: “现在正值盛夏，二他们已经在挂圣诞灯”。

source_text: "A worker told me they had to be up in time for all the religious festivals, but most of the lights refer to the Christian Christmas."
target_text: “一个工人告诉我，他们必须在所有的宗教节日都准时起床，但大多数的灯都是指基督教的圣诞节”。

source_text: A spokeswoman for the Rochdale borough council said, "We understand that we're early putting Christmas lights up now, but we are merely putting them up and not switching them on."
target_text: 罗奇代尔市议会的一位女发言人说：“我们知道，我们现在提前挂上了圣诞灯，但我们只是把它们挂起来，并没有把它们打开”。

source_text: "We have a duty to save taxpayers' money, and by putting them up now with lights for other festivities – including Eid in September – we will be saving around £10,000".
target_text: “我们有责任节省纳税人的钱，现在让他们为包括9月份的开斋节在内的其他庆祝活动安装彩灯，我们将节省大约1万英镑”。

source_text: Recent tests have shown that an inexpensive drug may be able to kill cancer cells in humans.
target_text: 最近的试验表明，一种便宜的药物可能能够杀死人类的癌细胞。

source_text: Dichloroacetate, a drug generally used to treat rare metabolic disorders, has shown the potential to assist in the treatment of brain, lung, and breast cancers, researchers at the University of Alberta in Edmonton, Canada say.
target_text: 加拿大埃德蒙顿阿尔伯塔大学的研究人员称，通常用于治疗罕见代谢性疾病的药物二氯乙酸已显示出帮助治疗脑癌、肺癌和乳腺癌的潜力。

source_text: Dr. Evangelos Michelakis of the University of Alberta in Edmonton, Canada found that that DCA causes tumor regressions in animals with human cancers.
target_text: 加拿大埃德蒙顿阿尔伯塔大学的伊万格罗斯·米克拉吉斯博士发现DCA导致人类癌症动物的肿瘤退化。

source_text: Testing showed that DCA attacked cancer cells but did not attack healthy cells.
target_text: 测试显示DCA攻击癌细胞但未攻击健康细胞。

source_text: The researchers and the Alberta Cancer Board and Capital Health do not advise the use of DCA to treat cancer yet, as clinical trials for the drugs use to treat cancer have not been performed yet.
target_text: 研究人员和阿尔伯塔省癌症委员会以及首都卫生部还没有建议使用DCA来治疗癌症，因为用于治疗癌症的药物的临床试验还没有进行。

source_text: Unlike healthy cells, cancerous cells do not convert food molecules into energy in the mitochondria.
target_text: 与健康细胞不同，癌细胞不会将食物分子转化为线粒体中的能量。

source_text: This means that another key function of the mitochondria - to activate an abnormal cell's self-destruct mechanism, apoptosis - is also blocked.
target_text: 这意味着线粒体的另一个关键功能-激活异常细胞的自毁机制-凋亡-也被阻断了。

source_text: When Dichloroacetate (DCA) enters a cancer cell, it restarts the mitochondria which in turn activate apoptosis, and the cancerous cell destroys itself.
target_text: 当二氯乙酸（DCA）进入癌细胞时，它重新启动线粒体，进而激活细胞凋亡，癌细胞自我破坏。

source_text: The drug is also expected to be cheaper to manufacture than other drugs since there is no patent for it.
target_text: 由于没有专利，这种药物的制造成本也有望低于其他药物。

source_text: A bomb exploded Tuesday night in Colombo, the capital of Sri Lanka.
target_text: 星期二晚上，一枚炸弹在斯里兰卡首都科伦坡爆炸。

source_text: The bomb may have targeted a high-profile individual, traveling through the high-security zone in the Colombo Fort area.
target_text: 炸弹袭击的目标可能是一位知名人士，他正在科伦坡堡地区的高安全区旅行。

source_text: Earlier in the day, a government minister was killed by a roadside bomb.
target_text: 当天早些时候，一名政府部长被路边炸弹炸死。

source_text: This blast has been blamed on the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) by government officials.
target_text: 这场爆炸事件被政府官员归咎于泰米尔伊拉姆猛虎解放组织（猛虎组织）。

source_text: The deputy director of the government teaching hospital in the town of Ragama, Lalini Gurusinghe, announced the death of the minister.
target_text: 拉加马市政府教学医院副院长拉利尼·古鲁辛哈宣布了部长的死讯。

source_text: The explosion took place in Ja-Ela, a town some 12 miles north of Colombo.
target_text: 爆炸发生在科伦坡以北约12英里的贾埃拉镇。

source_text: Its mission is to bring the key donors of aid and relief together with the Israeli and Palestinian governments to address the current state of affairs between the two countries.
target_text: 它的任务是使主要的援助和救济捐助者与以色列和巴勒斯坦政府一起处理两国之间的当前事态。

source_text: The AHLC keeps track on how donor countries interact with the Palestinian authorities and how the support they provide is handled.
target_text: AHLC跟踪捐助国如何与巴勒斯坦当局互动，以及如何处理它们提供的支持。

source_text: Early on the first day, Norwegian Foreign Minister Jonas Gahr Støre and Palestinian Prime minister Salam Fayyad both expressed optimism and hope for the Palestinian situation.
target_text: 第一天早些时候，挪威外交部长乔纳斯·盖尔·斯托勒和巴勒斯坦总理萨拉姆·法耶德都对巴勒斯坦局势表示乐观和希望。

source_text: Minister Støre underlined the importance of continuing aid, but stated that he understood that most countries still had problems because of the world economic crisis.
target_text: 部长斯托勒强调持续的援助的重要性，但说他明白，大多数国家仍有问题，因为世界经济危机。

source_text: As for the unstable political situation in Palestine, Prime Minister Fayyad explained that "the political instability is also a reason why we need more aid."
target_text: 至于巴勒斯坦不稳定的政治局势，法耶兹总理解释说，“政治不稳定也是我们需要更多援助的原因”。

source_text: During the second day, a press conference with Minister Støre clarified the motives of the donations saying, "It’s is important to stress that donors are not doing this as a humanitarian project."
target_text: 在第二天，与部长斯托勒举行的记者招待会重新澄清了捐赠的动机并说：“重要的是要强调，捐助者不会把这作为一个人道主义项目来做”。

source_text: Our donor aid is a political project aim[ed] at supporting and sustaining the Palestinian Authority, a key institution in what is supposed to become an independent Palestinian state.
target_text: 我们的援助是一个政治项目，旨在支持和维持巴勒斯坦权力机构，这是一个应该成为独立巴勒斯坦国的关键机构。

source_text: Minister Støre continued, stating, "It’s very important to stress that without a political horizon what we do as donors becomes less meaningful."
target_text: 斯托勒部长继续说道，“强调在没有政治视野的情况下，我们作为捐助者所做的事情变得不那么有意义，这一点非常重要”。

source_text: "So the current states of affairs where the political horizon is unclear and where we don’t have political negotiations of the two states as previous commitments indicates and obligate the party’s."
target_text: “所以目前的情况是，政治前景不明朗，我们没有像之前承诺的那样进行两国的政治谈判，没有强迫党派”。

source_text: "Donors start to change their stand and other agendas get the upper hand."
target_text: “捐助者开始改变立场，其他议程占上风。”

source_text: "So in 2009 at this present stage, donors have only delivered half the amount they had at this time last year."
target_text: “因此，在2009年的现阶段，捐赠者只交付了去年同期的一半”。

source_text: "You can leave that up to the financial crisis, but at the big donor conferences in Paris December 2007, and Sharm el-Sheikh February 2009 there were pledges enough to carry this through."
target_text: “你可以把这件事留到金融危机之前，但在2007年12月在巴黎举行的大型捐助者会议和2009年2月在沙姆沙伊赫举行的大型捐助者会议上，都有足够的承诺来实现这一目标”。

source_text: On the question if the donor countries had offered to give any immediate financial relief, Minister Støre said "This has to be stressed, [this] has not been a pledging conference."
target_text: 关于捐助国是否愿意立即提供财政救济的问题，斯托勒部长说：“必须强调这一点，【这】并非认捐会议”。

source_text: "This has not been a donor conference where governments have been invited to come and make new pledges, as I said if everybody lived by their Paris pledges in December 2007, which were three year pledges, we are exactly half way in that, we would have been more or less fine."
target_text: “这并不是一个捐助者会议，各国政府都应邀前来作出新的承诺，正如我所说，如果每个人都能兑现2007年12月的巴黎承诺，即三年的承诺，那么我们现在已经完成了一半，我们或多或少会好起来的”。

source_text: "But I think we have seen a forthcoming approach by some delegations, I will not name them or put a figure on it but I think it follows from what the prime minister and I have together have expressed here that there is an urgent need."
target_text: “但我认为，我们已经看到一些代表团即将采取的行动，我不会列举这些行动的名称，也不会在其上加上数字，但我认为这是根据我和总理在这里共同表示的迫切需要而定”。

source_text: 22 million counterfeit cigarettes have been found in Cardiff, Wales by officials working for HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC).
target_text: 英国税务及海关总署（HMRC）的官员在威尔士卡迪夫发现了2200万支假冒卷烟。

source_text: They had an estimated value of five million GBP and impersonated the Classic Gold and Raquel brands of cigarette.
target_text: 他们估计价值500万英镑，模仿了经典的黄金和拉奎尔香烟品牌。

source_text: The HMRC have stated that they have worked to find the source of the illegal products during the time since the discovery was made.
target_text: 英国皇家税务与海关总署表示，自发现以来，他们一直致力于寻找非法产品的来源。

source_text: The assistant director of criminal investigation for the organisation, Andrew Pavlinic, explained the reasons for this.
target_text: 该组织的刑事调查助理主任安德鲁·帕夫林奇解释了这一点的原因。

source_text: "Had it been successful, it would have undermined the business of honest traders who only sell duty paid tobacco products," he continued.
target_text: 他继续说：“如果这项计划获得成功，就会损害诚实商人的生意，因为他们只出售已缴关税的烟草产品”。

source_text: "The sheer quantity involved in this attempt suggests these cigarettes could have ended up in locations across the UK."
target_text: “这一尝试涉及的香烟数量之多表明，这些香烟最终可能在英国各地销售”。

source_text: "We have prevented UK consumers from being conned into buying cigarettes that are counterfeit and could have more serious risk to health than legitimate brands."
target_text: “我们阻止了英国消费者被骗购买假冒香烟，这些香烟对健康的危害可能比合法品牌更严重”。

source_text: The discovery was the largest hoard of cigarettes found by custom officials in the whole of 2008, although several other significant stashes were found throughout the year.
target_text: 这一发现是海关官员在2008年全年发现的最大的香烟窖藏，尽管全年还发现了其他一些重要的窖藏。

source_text: For example, nine million counterfeit cigarettes were found in Suffolk in August, and eight million were found in Belfast in May.
target_text: 例如，8月份在萨福克发现了900万支假冒卷烟，5月份在贝尔法斯特发现了800万支。

source_text: A truck carrying 35,500 pounds (16,100 kg) of explosives used in mining and seismic exploration overturned and exploded on a rural mountain section of U.S. Highway 6 in Utah's Spanish Fork Canyon Thursday afternoon.
target_text: 星期四下午，一辆载有35,500磅（16,100千克）炸药的卡车在犹他州西班牙岔口峡谷美国6号公路的一个乡村山区发生翻车和爆炸。

source_text: The wreck occurred shortly after 2 pm, as driver Travis Stewart, 30, of Rexburg, Idaho, was leaving Ensign-Bickford Co., a commercial explosives manufacturing plant at the mouth of the canyon.
target_text: 事故发生在下午2点后不久，当时爱达荷州雷克斯堡市30岁的司机特拉维斯·斯图尔特正从峡谷口的一家商业炸药制造厂海军少尉比克福德公司离开。

source_text: Witnesses said Mr. Stewart appeared to lose control of the truck after entering a curve in the road at a high rate of speed.
target_text: 目击者称斯图尔特先生在高速行驶进入道路弯道后似乎失去了对卡车的控制权。

source_text: Utah Highway Patrol Lt. Ken Peay said, "speed was a factor" in the wreck of the truck but refused to speculate on how fast the truck was traveling when it wrecked.
target_text: 犹他州公路巡逻队中尉肯·皮伊说，“速度是造成卡车失事的一个因素”，但拒绝推测卡车失事时的行驶速度。

source_text: Lt. Peay said the posted speed limit on the road is 60 mph, but the advised speed is 40.
target_text: 皮伊中尉说，公路上的限速是每小时60英里，但建议的限速是每小时40英里。

source_text: At least 17 people received minor injuries and the explosion left a 35 foot deep crater in the highway.
target_text: 至少17人受轻伤，爆炸在高速公路上留下了一个35英尺深的弹坑。

source_text: The driver was transported via helicopter to a hospital, where he was listed in fair condition, and was later released.
target_text: 这名司机通过直升机被送往医院，他在医院的情况良好，随后被释放。

source_text: The co-driver Troy Lysfjord, 37, of Blackfoot, Idaho, was helped from the wreck by passers by and listed in fair condition at Utah Valley Regional Hospital in Provo.
target_text: 来自爱达荷州布莱克富特的37岁的副驾驶特洛伊·莱斯峡湾在过路人的帮助下从残骸中爬了出来，目前在普罗沃的犹他谷地区医院接受治疗，情况良好。

source_text: The wreck site occurred on a major thoroughfare between Denver and Salt Lake City - about 60 miles south of Salt Lake City - was already under reconstruction by nightfall, as road crews began installing 10 inches of asphalt on the two lane road.
target_text: 失事地点位于丹佛和盐湖城之间的一条主干道上，位于盐湖城以南约60英里。夜幕降临前，道路工作人员已经开始在这条双车道公路上铺设10英寸长的沥青，重建工作正在进行中。

source_text: Utah Department of Transportation spokesman Tom Hudachko said officials hoped to have the road fully repaired by Friday afternoon, adding that, "When you take a look at that hole that was there 24 hours ago, I think it's amazing the progress that was made."
target_text: 犹他州交通部发言人汤姆·胡达科表示，官员们希望在周五下午之前完全修复这条公路，并补充说，“看看24小时前的那个洞，我认为取得的进展是惊人的”。

source_text: As of press time, the mouth of the canyon was reopened to traffic, while traffic at the accident site was impassible, and rerouted nearby.
target_text: 截至发稿时，大峡谷口已重新开放，事故现场交通仍无法通行，且在附近改道。

source_text: Uinta National Forest spokesman Loyal Clark said forest firefighters were unable to respond to several small fires nearby that were apparently started by flying debris, and that helicopters dropped water to extinguish them.
target_text: 乌因塔国家森林发言人洛亚尔·克拉克说，附近发生的几起小火灾显然是由飞出的碎片引起的，森林消防员无法应对，直升机空投了水来灭火。

source_text: High humidity and lack of fuel from a previous fire delayed the fire's spread.
target_text: 前一场火灾造成的高湿度和燃料短缺推迟了火势的蔓延。

source_text: The cost of repairs, while paid immediately by the state, will ultimately be borne by the trucking company's insurance carrier.
target_text: 维修费用由国家立即支付，最终将由货运公司的保险公司承担。

source_text: The truck is registered to R&R Trucking of Duenweg, Missouri.
target_text: 这辆卡车登记在密苏里州杜恩威的R&R卡车运输公司。

source_text: UHP Lt. Peay said the investigation findings will be turned over to Utah County Attorney Kay Bryson whom would make any final decision about what charges, if any, would be pressed.
target_text: 惠普公司的皮伊说，调查结果将移交给犹他州的检察官凯·布莱森，布赖森将对将提出的指控做出最终决定。

source_text: The looming debate on whether the Australian Health Minister Tony Abbott or the Theraputic Goods Administration (TGA) should regulate mifepristone, RU486, has entered the Australian Senate, February 8.
target_text: 关于澳大利亚卫生部长托尼·阿博特或治疗药品管理局是否应该监管米非司酮的争论迫在眉睫，已于2月8日进入澳大利亚参议院。

source_text: A free vote is due to be conducted on this issue.
target_text: 将就此问题进行自由投票。

source_text: The first speakers have been all women speaking in support of passing control from the Health Minister to the TGA: Australian National Party Senator Fiona Nash, Australian Democrats Senator Lyn Allison, Australian Labor Party Senator Claire Moore.
target_text: 第一批发言者都是支持将控制权从卫生部长移交给TGA的妇女：澳大利亚国家党参议员菲奥娜·纳什、澳大利亚民主党参议员林恩·艾里森、澳大利亚工党参议员克莱尔·摩尔。

source_text: They have drawn attention to the fact that abortion is already legal in Australia, the inappropriateness of a Parliament minister to regulate a single drug versus a scientific and independent body, and if RU486 is an unsafe drug then the TGA will not approve the drug.
target_text: 他们注意到堕胎在澳大利亚已经是合法的，一个国会部长管理单一药物和一个科学独立的机构是不合适的，如果RU486是一种不安全的药物，那么TGA将不会批准该药物。

source_text: Petitions were presented by Moore with the undersigned stating "medical experts, not the health minister" should regulate the drug.
target_text: 摩尔提交了请愿书，签名人说“医学专家，而不是卫生部长”应该管制这种药物。

source_text: Australian Liberal Party Senator Gary Humphries then spoke, stating that the bill is a "mistake", not because of the possible risks, or that the TGA is unfit to perform the evaluation, but because RU486 is "not just another drug", "facilitating a medical procedure that is not just a medical procedure".
target_text: 澳大利亚自由党参议员加里·汉弗莱斯随后说，该法案是一个“错误”，不是因为可能存在的风险，或者TGA不适合进行评估，而是因为RU486“不仅仅是另一种药物”，“促进一种不仅仅是医疗程序的医疗程序”。

source_text: Australian Greens Senator Kerry Nettle spoke in favour of the bill, making mention of views of others on the supposed push polling of some groups opposing the bill.
target_text: 澳大利亚绿党参议员凯里·内特尔表示支持该法案，并提到了其他人对一些反对该法案的团体所谓的推动投票的看法。

source_text: Liberal Senator Nick Minchin, the new Leader of the Government in the Senate, spoke in support of Humphries and his views, and "was not persuaded to support [the] bill", and expressed his "conservative" views that life begun "from conception onwards".
target_text: 参议院新政府领导人自由党参议员尼克明钦表示支持汉弗莱斯及其观点，并“没有被说服支持【该】法案”，并表达了他“保守”的观点，认为生命始于“从概念开始”。

source_text: Family First Party Senator Steven Fielding spoke out against the bill also, likening the TGA as comprising of "unelected bureaucrats".
target_text: 家庭第一党参议员史蒂芬·菲尔丁也对该法案表示反对，他将TGA比作由“未经选举的官僚”组成。

source_text: He further commented that Family First cannot consider the social policy issues without considering social views, and drew attention to the TGA's response in the earlier Senate inquiry that the TGA "cannot consider social and ethical issues".
