target_text: 他进一步评论说，家庭首先不能在不考虑社会观点的情况下考虑社会政策问题，并提请注意TGA在参议院早些时候的调查中的回应，即TGA“不能考虑社会和道德问题”。

source_text: Fielding drew attention to the guillotine being placed on the debate of the bill and the attitudes of the non-Government senators earlier criticising the Government on the industrial relations legislation being "rammed through" late last year.
target_text: 菲尔丁引起了人们对该法案辩论中的环状刀和非政府参议员的态度的关注，他们早些时候批评政府在去年年底“强行通过”劳资关系立法。

source_text: Prior to 2007 Taipei 101 Run Up, organizers held a 35-floors warming up match for local athletes from 2009 Summer Deaflympics with the theme of "Value Your Every Step".
target_text: 在2007年台北101跑步之前，组织者为2009年夏季奥运会的本地运动员举办了35层的热身赛，主题是“珍惜你的每一步”。

source_text: This warming up simulated every possible situation as athletes wore the RFID chip and some professional medical teams stood by for emergency.
target_text: 这种热身模拟了运动员佩戴RFID芯片和一些专业医疗队紧急情况下的所有可能情况。

source_text: Hsiao-hua Tseng and Lan-feng Chen, men's and women's fastest athlete in this (warming up) match, finished separately with 6 min 9 secs and 6 min 45 secs.
target_text: 在这场热身赛中，男子和女子最快运动员曾晓华和陈兰凤分别以6分9秒和6分45秒的成绩结束了比赛。

source_text: After this match, the host (Taipei 101) awarded certifications and announced that the main match will take place next Sunday (November 25) morning.
target_text: 赛后，主办单位（台北101）颁发证书，宣布主赛将于下周日（11月25日）上午举行。

source_text: The wins by the Steel and the Vixens are considered by those who follow the netball league to be major upsets.
target_text: 钢铁队和维克森队的胜利被网球联盟的后起之秀视为重大的麻烦。

source_text: The Firebirds' loss this past Sunday was their first in fifteen games extending back to last season.
target_text: 上个星期天的失利是火鸟队自上赛季以来15场比赛中的第一次失利。

source_text: Last season's championship is not a harbinger of success this season, as every season since the league was founded in 2008, the defending champions have failed to finish in the top four and attempt to repeat their title claim.
target_text: 上个赛季的冠军赛并不是这个赛季成功的预兆，自从2008年联赛成立以来，每个赛季卫冕冠军都没能进入前四，并试图再次夺冠。

source_text: Going into the game, the teams had played eight games against each other, splitting the record at 4 wins each.
target_text: 比赛开始时，两队打了8场比赛，各赢4场，打破了记录。

source_text: Firebird captain Laura Geitz's quality play could not overcome other difficulties on the court for her team.
target_text: 火鸟队队长劳拉·盖茨的高水平发挥并没有为她的球队克服场上的其他困难。

source_text: In the Magic versus Steel game, the teams were tied at 44–44 with five minutes left in the game.
target_text: 在魔术对钢铁的比赛中，两队在比赛还剩5分钟时以44比44打平。

source_text: The local crowd were behind the Steel, and they finished the game ahead by two baskets.
target_text: 当地人落后于钢铁，他们以两分的优势结束了比赛。

source_text: The Magic's coach blames the loss partly on not preparing adequately to play against the Steel's Donna Wilkins, who gave birth to her third child in January of this year.
target_text: 魔术队的教练将这场失利部分归咎于对钢铁队的唐娜·威尔金斯的准备不足，后者今年1月生下了第三个孩子。

source_text: Jess Waitapu made her debut for the Magic because teammate Julianna Naoupu had health problems that impacted her ability to play.
target_text: 杰西·韦塔普在魔术队首次亮相是因为队友朱丽安娜·娜奥普的健康问题影响了她的比赛能力。

source_text: On Sunday in Auckland, the favored LG Northern Mystics held on to defeat the Haier Central Pulse 51–47.
target_text: 星期天在奥克兰，受到青睐的LG北方神秘主义者以51比47战胜了海尔中央脉冲队。

source_text: Silver Ferns member Maria Tutaia was replaced by coach Debbie Fuller in favor of Grace Rasmussen, with Rasmussen making six out of seven shots to help put the game away for her team.
target_text: 西尔弗弗恩队的成员玛丽亚图泰亚被德比富勒取代，取而代之的是格雷斯·拉斯穆森，拉斯穆森7投6中，帮助她的球队把比赛拉开。

source_text: The Mystics had six fewer shots than the visiting Pulse, but had a better shooting percentage which proved to be a decisive factor in the game.
target_text: 神秘主义者的投篮比来访的脉冲少了6次，但命中率更高，这被证明是决定比赛胜负的因素。

source_text: In Perth on Monday, the West Coast Fever beat the Easiyo Canterbury Tactix by a score of 55–35.
target_text: 周一在珀斯，西海岸热队以55比35击败了坎特伯雷战术队。

source_text: The team's captain Maree Bowden and coach Leigh Gibbs were disappointed in the team's performance but believed there were some positives and room for improvement.
target_text: 球队队长马雷·鲍登和教练雷·吉布斯对球队的表现感到失望，但他们相信球队还有一些积极的方面和改进的空间。

source_text: The West Coast Fever are the only Australian side in the competition to never have won the league's championship, with their best ever finish being seventh in the ten-team competition.
target_text: 西岸热火队是唯一一支从未赢得联赛冠军的澳大利亚球队，他们有史以来最好的成绩是10支球队中的第七名。

source_text: In September of last year, following the Australian victory at the Netball World Championships held in Singapore in July, the Fever signed Australian national team coach Norma Plummer as the club's new coach.
target_text: 去年9月，继7月在新加坡举行的世界网球锦标赛中澳大利亚队获胜后，热火队签下了澳大利亚国家队教练诺玛·普卢默作为俱乐部的新教练。

source_text: stuff.co.nzs Chris Barclay believes this means the Fever have a chance of winning, especially following a pre-season that included two wins, a tie to the Firebirds and a single loss.
target_text: stuff.co.nzs克里斯巴克莱认为这意味着热病有可能获胜，特别是在季前赛中两场胜利，一场与火鸟队的平局和一场失利之后。

source_text: She has sought to instill a greater sense of discipline in her players, not taking excuses for missing practices with the exception of Australian Diamond Susan Fuhrmann who is recovering from a chronic knee injury.
target_text: 除了澳大利亚钻石选手苏珊·富尔曼，她一直在努力培养球员的纪律性，不为缺席训练找借口，因为她正从慢性膝关节损伤中恢复过来。

source_text: She also sought to improve the Fever's roster with the inclusion of England national netball team player Eboni Beckford-Chamber and former Swifts player Catherine Cox.
target_text: 她还试图通过英格兰国家网球队球员埃博尼·贝克福德·钱伯斯和前瑞士球员凯瑟琳·考克斯的加入来改善热病的阵容。

source_text: The Tactix are to play the Swifts at home this coming Monday in the second round.
target_text: Tactix将在本周一的第二轮比赛中主场迎战Swifts。

source_text: In the third round, the Tactix will play the Steel, in a game stuff.co.nzs writer Matt Richens believes they can win.
target_text: 在第三轮比赛中，Tactix将在一场比赛中对阵Steel队，stuff.co.nzs作家马特·里奇斯认为他们可以获胜。

source_text: In Adelaide this past Saturday, the Adelaide Thunderbirds beat the NSW Swifts by a score of 57–40.
target_text: 在上周六的阿德莱德，阿德莱德雷鸟队以57比40的成绩击败新南威尔士州的雨燕队。

source_text: Australian Diamond goal attack Sharelle McMahon has taken the season off from the Vixens as a result of pregnancy.
target_text: 由于怀孕，澳大利亚钻石射手沙列尔·麦克马洪本赛季已从雌狐狸队退出，休养了一个赛季。

source_text: A study by the Ernst & Young Scottish ITEM Club has predicted that Scotland will enter the worst recession seen in the nation since 1980, but that the rest of the United Kingdom will fare worse.
target_text: 安永苏格兰ITEM俱乐部的一项研究预测苏格兰将进入自1980年以来全国最严重的经济衰退期，但英国其他地区的情况将更糟。

source_text: Scottish GDP is expected to contract by 0.4% in 2009, compared to 1% for elsewhere in the UK.
target_text: 预计2009年苏格兰国内生产总值将收缩0.4％，而英国其他地区则为1％。

source_text: The report expects this to account for 50,000 job losses in Scotland, with the worst level of unemployment since the 1990s - a jump from 74,000 to 124,000 out of work, or 4.4%.
target_text: 该报告预计，这将导致苏格兰5万人失业，失业率达到上世纪90年代以来的最差水平，从7.4万升至12.4万，增幅4.4％。

source_text: Dougie Adams, author of the report, warns that if the financial crisis is worst than anticipated there could be a contraction of 1%, making 60,000 jobs lost.
target_text: 该报告的作者道格·亚当斯警告说，如果金融危机比预期更糟，可能会出现1％的萎缩，导致6万个工作岗位流失。

source_text: Private services will fare worst, he says, with 20,000 jobs to go.
target_text: 他说，私营服务行业将面临最糟糕的情况，将失去2万个工作岗位。

source_text: "The economy must face a future with a changed landscape for its previously buoyant banking sector," said Adams.
target_text: 亚当斯说：“经济必须面对一个变化了的未来，它以前繁荣的银行业前景将发生改变。”

source_text: "These include policy actions at a global and UK level, including any fiscal measures announced in the pre-Budget report, and the fall in oil and commodity prices."
target_text: “这包括全球和英国层面的政策行动，包括预算前报告中宣布的任何财政措施，以及石油和大宗商品价格的下跌”。

source_text: "The sharp decline in inflation that is in the pipeline will buoy disposable incomes and leaves an open door to further interest rate cuts."
target_text: “即将到来的通胀大幅下降将提振可支配收入，并为进一步降息打开大门”。

source_text: "Finally, the UK will also benefit from the sharp fall in sterling that is unlikely to be frittered away by wage inflation."
target_text: “最后，英国也将受益于英国货币的大幅下跌，而这种贬值不太可能被工资通胀抵消”。

source_text: "However, recovery critically depends on both the willingness of the banking system to extend credit and the readiness of businesses and consumers to use it."
target_text: “然而，复苏在很大程度上取决于银行体系是否愿意扩大信贷，以及企业和消费者是否愿意使用信贷”。

source_text: In 2010, he predicts Scottish growth to recover by 1.5%, with the rest of the UK gaining only 1%.
target_text: 他预测，2010年苏格兰经济增长将恢复1.5％，而英国其他地区仅增长1％。

source_text: Known for his struggle against French rule, Ben Bella led the nation from 1963 to 1965 having only learned during a prison sentence.
target_text: 本·贝拉以反抗法国统治而闻名，他在1963年至1965年间领导着这个国家，但他只在服刑期间学到了一些东西。

source_text: He came from a poor, agricultural background and left school early, but it was during his schooldays he joined Messali Hadj's Algerian People's Party.
target_text: 他出身于贫穷的农业家庭，很早就离开了学校，但正是在上学期间，他加入了梅萨里·哈吉领导的阿尔及利亚人民党。

source_text: Serving in World War II, Ben Bella was decorated with five medals for actions including conflict at the 1944 Battle of Monte Cassino in Italy and shooting down a German aircraft over Marseille, France.
target_text: 本·贝拉曾在二战中服役，因在1944年意大利卡西诺山战役中的冲突以及在法国马赛上空击落一架德国飞机等行为被授予五枚勋章。

source_text: After the war he was elected to seniority within a group dedicated to ending French rule.
target_text: 战后，他被选为一个致力于结束法国统治的团体的资深成员。

source_text: The movement was deemed illegal and Ben Bella escaped and fled two years after his 1951 arrest for his part in a fundraising robbery.
target_text: 该运动被认为是非法的，本·贝拉在1951年因参与集资抢劫被捕两年后逃跑了。

source_text: A bloody conflict for Algerian independence eventually convinced France to relinquish control in 1962 and Ben Bella was freed.
target_text: 一场争取阿尔及利亚独立的血腥冲突最终说服法国在1962年放弃了对该国的控制，本·贝拉获得了自由。

source_text: The following year he took control of a one-party nation.
target_text: 第二年，他控制了一个一党制国家。

source_text: Within years of attaining power, defence minister , an ally of current president Abdelaziz Bouteflika, overthrew Ben Bella in a coup.
target_text: 现任总统阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·布特弗利卡的盟友、国防部长本·贝拉在掌权后不到几年就在政变中被推翻。

source_text: Ben Bella had grappled with post-war consolidation after about 1.5 million French left the nation, leaving gaps in its economy.
target_text: 在150万法国人离开这个国家、留下经济缺口之后，本·贝拉一直在努力应对战后的整合。

source_text: "Today we lost one of modern Algeria's bravest leaders," said Bouteflika, declaring eight days of mourning.
target_text: “今天我们失去了现代阿尔及利亚最勇敢的领导人之一”，布特弗利卡说，他宣布了八天的哀悼。

source_text: Successive regimes detained Ben Bella first in prison and later his home from his deposition to 1980 when he left for Switzerland in exile, before being pardoned a decade later.
target_text: 本·贝拉先是在监狱里被关押，后来被关押在他的家中，直到1980年他流亡瑞士，10年后被赦免。

source_text: A cork was temporarily used to fix a fuel leak on a British passenger train.
target_text: 软木被临时用于修复英国旅客列车上的燃油泄漏。

source_text: The leak was created when the train struck a concrete block that vandals left on the tracks.
target_text: 泄漏是由于火车撞上了一个破坏公物的人留在铁轨上的混凝土块造成的。

source_text: This abrupt stop created a hole in the sightglass which helps monitor fuel levels.
target_text: 这一突然的停车在观察镜上形成了一个孔，这个观察镜是帮助监测燃油油位的。

source_text: Worried the incident could cause a fuel leak, staff decided to use the cork of a wine bottle found in the buffet car, to block the hole.
target_text: 由于担心这一事故会导致燃油泄漏，工作人员决定用餐车里发现的一个酒瓶的软木塞堵住这个洞。

source_text: An incident that people worried would cause a delay of hours, was cleared up in around 20 minutes.
target_text: 人们担心会导致数小时延迟的事件在大约20分钟内被解决。

source_text: The newly appointed Ontario Provincial Police Commissioner Julian Fantino told reporters on Monday that "the Caledonia land dispute is the single biggest issue facing him" and that, " 'lawbreakers' in Caledonia will be dealt with swiftly, regardless of which side of the native occupation they are on."
target_text: 新任命的安大略省警察局长朱利安·范蒂诺周一对记者说，“喀里多尼亚的土地纠纷是他面临的最大问题”，而且，“‘喀里多尼亚的违法者’将被迅速处理，不管他们是在当地占领的哪一边”。

source_text: The Caledonia land dispute has been going on since February 28 and still has not been resolved.
target_text: 喀里多尼亚土地纠纷自2月28日以来一直在进行，但仍未得到解决。

source_text: The native protesters occupied the Douglas Creek Estates, a housing development, southwest of Hamilton, saying that the property belongs to them.
target_text: 当地抗议者占领了位于汉密尔顿西南部的一个住宅开发项目道格拉斯克里克庄园，称该地产属于他们。

source_text: Townspeople have repeatedly called for police to remove the protesters from the land, which is now owned by the province and being held in trust until the dispute is resolved.
target_text: 当地居民多次呼吁警方将抗议者从这片土地上赶走。这片土地现在归该省所有，在争端解决之前一直被托管。

source_text: "I certainly don't expect that there will be lawbreaking that isn't dealt with and that will be my message to our people as well, that it's their duty and responsibility is to enforce the laws," said OPP Commissioner Julian Fantino, on his first official day on the job.
target_text: OPP专员朱利安·范蒂诺在工作的第一个正式日说：“我当然不希望出现未处理的违法行为，这也是我向我们的人民传达的信息，他们的职责和责任就是执行法律”。

source_text: "I assure that those who do break the law will be dealt with."
target_text: “我保证那些违法的人将被处理”。

source_text: Fantino said the on-going occupation of a property by members of the Six Nations Reserve is beyond his ability to resolve.
target_text: 范蒂诺说，六国储备委员会成员对一处房产的持续占领超出了他的解决能力。

source_text: His role in the contentious dispute will be to keep the peace in the town of Caledonia.
target_text: 他在这场有争议的争端中所扮演的角色将是维持喀里多尼亚镇的和平。

source_text: Officials in Ontario and the federal governments are currently negotiating with Six Nations representatives.
target_text: 安大略省和联邦政府的官员目前正在与六个国家的代表进行谈判。

source_text: Both the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) and the All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK) parties have announce "freebies" as part of their election manifestos in the lead-up to the vote in the south Indian state of Tamil Nadu.
target_text: 德拉维达·蒙内特拉·卡扎加姆（DMK）和全印度安娜·德拉维达·蒙内特拉·卡扎加姆（AIADMK）两党都宣布“免费赠品”作为他们在南印度泰米尔纳德邦投票前的选举宣言的一部分。

source_text: Freebies have been a success from the 2006 Tamil Nadu elections when DMK lured voters by announcing free colour televisions to households.
target_text: 自2006年泰米尔纳德邦选举以来，免费赠品取得了成功，当时DMK通过向家庭宣布免费彩色电视来吸引选民。

source_text: That triumph led the major opposition AIADMK to announce similar freebies in their manifesto published Thursday.
target_text: 这一胜利促使主要反对党AIADMK在周四发表的宣言中宣布了类似的免费赠品。

source_text: DMK has announced free laptops to college students, kitchen appliances and modern networks to rural regions.
target_text: DMK宣布向大学生免费提供笔记本电脑，向农村地区提供厨房电器和现代化网络。

source_text: The AIADMK, publishing their manifesto later, expanded on each of the promises of the DMK, plus offering 4g gold mangalsutra for the poor, monetary help for rural households and fishermen, free rice, and more.
target_text: AIDMK随后发表了他们的宣言，扩展了DMK的每一项承诺，并为穷人提供4G黄金曼格苏特拉，为农村家庭和渔民提供货币援助、免费大米等等。

source_text: AIADMK manifesto addresses larger issues, such as taking on the near-monopoly of the cable industry television industry, starting new Power generation plants to address power shortages in recent years.
target_text: AIADMK宣言解决了更大的问题，比如挑战有线电视行业近乎垄断的地位，建立新的发电厂来解决近年来的电力短缺问题。

source_text: Television star Jerry Springer has signed a contract to join the year-old political network Air America Radio Network starting April 1.
target_text: 电视明星杰里·施普林格已经签署了一份合同，将于4月1日加入成立仅一年的政治网络美国航空广播公司。

source_text: He says the new deal will not affect his popular television program, which will continue to be produced.
target_text: 他说，新协议不会影响他广受欢迎的电视节目，这个节目将继续制作。

source_text: After initially being carried by only 45 stations nationwide, the host of the long-running syndicated program, The Jerry Springer Show will eventually have his radio show heard on all 51 Air America affiliates.
target_text: 在最初由全国45个电台，长期联合节目的主持人，播出之后，杰里·斯普林格的节目最终将在所有51家美国航空公司的分支机构中播出。

source_text: The show also is planned to be broadcast by the Sirius and XM satellite radio services.
target_text: 该节目还计划由天狼星和XM卫星广播服务公司播出。

source_text: Springer said he is committed to making his radio show a success.
target_text: 施普林格说，他致力于使他的广播节目取得成功。

source_text: "Progressive, populist voices need to be a part of our nation's dialogue," Springer said in a press release.
target_text: 施普林格在一份新闻稿中说：“进步、民粹主义的声音需要成为我们国家对话的一部分”。

source_text: Although best-known for his low-budget, tongue-in-cheek talk show, Springer does have a political pedigree.
target_text: 虽然施普林格以低成本、半开玩笑的脱口秀节目而闻名，但他确实有政治渊源。

source_text: He was a Democrat mayor of Cincinnati in 1977 and made a failed bid for governor of Ohio in 1982.
target_text: 1977年他是辛辛那提的民主党市长，1982年竞选俄亥俄州州长失败。

source_text: Lexmark International introduced the Lexmark P450 in the USA yesterday, the first printer to have a built-in CD burner.
target_text: 利盟国际昨天在美国推出了利盟P450打印机，这是第一款带有CD刻录机的打印机。

source_text: The CD burner allows users to copy photos from their camera directly to CD without requiring the printer to be connected to a computer.
target_text: 用户可以用该CD刻录机把相机里的照片直接复制到CD中，无需将打印机连接到电脑。

source_text: The P450 is a small, portable printer that can print 4in by 6in photos.
target_text: P450是一款可以打印4英寸×6英寸照片的小型便携式打印机。

source_text: Photos can be printed from USB flash drives, memory cards, Bluetooth devices and PictBridge compatible digital cameras.
target_text: 照片可以直接从U盘、存储卡、蓝牙设备和PicBridge兼容数码相机中打印出来。

source_text: The printer includes a 2.4-inch color LCD from which users can perform basic editing tasks such as cropping, rotating, and removing red-eye.
target_text: 此款打印机有一个2.4英寸的彩色液晶显示器，用户可以通过这个显示器进行裁剪、旋转、去除红眼等基本的编辑任务。

source_text: "The Lexmark P450 brings more photo processing functions to the home."
target_text: “利盟P450打印机为家庭用户提供了更多的照片处理功能。”

source_text: "People can now save and organize their digital photos on CD, print from a cell phone, view their photos on a television and much more."
target_text: “人们现在可以在CD上保存和整理数码照片，从手机打印出来，在电视上浏览照片，还有更多其他的功能。”

source_text: "The Lexmark P450 is quite intuitive, easy to use and affordably priced," said Najib Bahous, president of Lexmark’s Consumer Printer Division.
target_text: “利盟P450打印机使用方法简单方便，而且价格合理，”利盟公司用户打印机部门总裁纳吉布·包豪斯说。

source_text: This printer will compete with many other portable printers such as the popular and slightly cheaper HP Photosmart 375.
target_text: 此款打印机将与很多其他品牌的便携式打印机互相竞争，比如非常受欢迎而且价格稍微便宜一些的惠普Photosmart 375打印机。

source_text: The Lexmark P450 is scheduled to be released in the USA in October, with an estimated retail price of $199USD, and Canada in November, with an estimated retail price of $299CAD.
target_text: 利盟P450计划于10月份在美国发布，预计零售价199美元，11月在加拿大发布，预计零售价299加元。

source_text: It is scheduled to be released in other countries shortly thereafter.
target_text: 之后很快会在其他国家发布。

source_text: Around 50 people have been arrested ahead of a planned human rights protest in Swaziland.
target_text: 在斯威士兰，一场有计划的人权抗议开始之前，已经有大约50人左右被逮捕。

source_text: The protest had been planned against the monarchy of Swaziland to call attention to the country's alleged lack of human rights.
target_text: 此次抗议的目的是反对斯威士兰的君主政体，呼吁人们关注该国存在的缺乏人权的问题。

source_text: Many of those arrested have been released but several people remain in custody.
target_text: 很多被逮捕的人已经被释放，但是还有几个人在押。

source_text: The King of Swaziland, Mswati III, has come under pressure for living in luxury with his thirteen wives while many Swazi people are on the poverty line.
target_text: 斯威士兰国王姆斯瓦蒂三世面临很大压力，因为他与他的13个妻子过着奢华的生活，而许多斯威士兰人民还生活在贫困线下。

source_text: He has also faced criticism for having a high number of sexual partners, when 26% of 15 to 49 year olds are HIV positive.
target_text: 他还因为配偶数量过多，而且因其中百分之26的15-49岁配偶艾滋病测试呈阳性而受到批判。

source_text: Several South African trade unionists were included in the protesters arrested.
target_text: 被逮捕的抗议者中还包括几名南非工会会员。

source_text: A spokesman for Cosatu, the South African trade union federation, said that two of the unionists had not been released and their current whereabouts are unknown.
target_text: 南非工业联盟的一位发言人称，其中两名工会会员还未被释放，目前下落不明。

source_text: Human rights group Amnesty International has commented on the events saying that, "The arbitrary arrest of these political activists, lawyers, trade unionists and journalists is nothing short of police harassment and intimidation."
target_text: 人权组织大赦国际对此事发表评论称：“对政治活动家、律师、工会会员和新闻记者的擅自逮捕无异于警察骚扰和恐吓。”

source_text: Swaziland is the last country in Africa to hold an absolute monarchy.
target_text: 斯威士兰是非洲最后一个实行君主专制政体的国家。

source_text: The Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) approved two new IEEE 1394 Firewire standards last week.
target_text: 电气和电子工程师协会（IEEE）上周批准了两个新的IEEE1394火线（Firewire）标准。

source_text: S1600 and S3200 — which enable data transmission rates up to 1.6 Gbps and 3.2 Gbps respectively — would make Firewire (Apple's name for the standard) theoretically four times faster than is currently possible.
target_text: S1600和S3200，可以使数据传输速度分别达到1.6Gbps和3.2Gbps，使Firewire（苹果公司赋予该标准的名字）理论上比目前版本可达到的速度快4倍。

source_text: According to IEEE, the new standards are based on IEEE 1394b (FireWire 800) Standard.
target_text: 据IEEE称，新标准是以IEEE1394b（FireWire800）标准为基础的。

source_text: The new standard will allow peer-to-peer transfer without linking computers.
target_text: 新标准可以无需连接电脑进行点对点传输。

source_text: In addition, the S1600 and S3200 standards will continue supporting the S400 and S800 previous standards through backward compatibility.
target_text: 而且，S1600和S3200标准会通过反向兼容继续支持之前的S400和S800标准。

source_text: "The new standard includes all of the amendments, enhancements and more than 100 errata which have been added to the base standard over the last 12 years," Les Baxter, chair of the working group which developed the standard, said in a press release cited in several sources.
target_text: 几家消息来源均在新闻稿中引用了开发该标准的工作组主席莱斯・巴克斯特的话：“新标准包含了过去12年对基础标准进行的所有修改、优化以及100多次勘误。”

source_text: "This update provides developers with a single document they can rely upon for all of their application needs."
target_text: “这次升级为开发者提供了其所有应用需求所需要的单独文件。”

source_text: Though not as common as the USB standard, Firewire serves a niche market, especially the aviation industry.
target_text: 虽然不如USB标准应用普遍，但是Firewire面向的是利基市场，特别是航空业。

source_text: USB 3.0, the next generation of the competing USB standard, is due in 2010 with reported speeds of 4.8 Gbps.
target_text: USB标准的下一代USB3.0将于2010年到期，据称其速度为4.8Gbps。

source_text: The United States Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) says it finished interrogating the nearly 105 Iraqi scientists it held in its search for weapons of mass destruction (WMD).
target_text: 美国中央情报局（CIA）称其已经结束了对其扣留的将近105位研究大规模杀伤性武器（WMD）的伊拉克科学家的询问。

source_text: In many cases their information was helpful, but in other cases the wrong people were detained, and were subjected to questioning by "inexperienced and uninformed" interrogators.
target_text: 在很多情况下，他们提供的信息是有用的，但是在其他情况下，会有一些错误的人员被扣留，然后由“没有经验和不知情的询问者”对进行询问。

source_text: From an update to the Comprehensive Report of the Special Adviser to the DCI on Iraq's WMD, "As matters now stand, the WMD investigation has gone as far as feasible."
target_text: 根据特别顾问向DCI提交的关于伊拉克大规模杀伤性武器的最新综合报告，“按照目前的情况，关于大规模杀伤性武器的调查已经到了可行的阶段。”

source_text: After more than 18 months, the WMD investigation and debriefing of the WMD-related detainees has been exhausted.
target_text: 18个多月之后，大规模杀伤性武器调查和与大规模杀伤性武器相关的被扣押者的任务执行报告已经彻底完成。

source_text: "As far as the WMD investigation is concerned, there is no further purpose in holding many of these detainees."
target_text: “关于大规模杀伤性武器调查，扣留这么多人没有任何其他目的。”
